|| || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || gāṃdharvastveṣaloko'mī gaṃdharvāśca śubhavratāḥ|| devānāṃ gāyanādyete cāraṇāḥ stutipāṭhakāḥ || 21 || gītajñā atigītena toṣayaṃti narādhipān || stuvaṃti ca dhanāḍhyāṃśca dhanalobhena mohitā. || 22 || rājñāṃ prasādalabdhāni suvāsāṃsi dhanānyapi|| dravyāṇyapi sugaṃdhīni karpūrādīnyanekaśaḥ || 23 || brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchaṃti gītaṃ gāyaṃtyaharniśam || śrutāveva manasteṣāṃ nāṭyaśāstrakṛtaśramāḥ || 24 || tena puṇyena gāṃdharvo lokastveṣāṃ viśiṣyate || brāhmaṇāstoṣitā yadvai gītavidyārjitairdhanaiḥ || 25 || gītavidyāprabhāvena devarṣirnārado mahān || mānyo vaiṣṇavaloke vai śrīśaṃbhoścātivallabhaḥ || 26 || tuṃbururnā radaścobhau devānāmatidurlabhau || nādarūpī śivaḥ sākṣānnādatattvavidau hi tau || 27 || yadi gītaṃ kvacidgītaṃ śrīmaddhariharāṃtike || mokṣastu tatphalaṃ prāhuḥ sā nnidhyamathavā tayoḥ || 28 || gītajño yadi gītena nāpnoti paramaṃ padam || rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate || 29 || asmim̐lloke sadā kālaṃ smṛtire ṣā pragīyate || tadgītamālayā pūjyau devau hariharau sadā || 4.1.8.30 || iti śṛṇvankṣaṇātprāpa punaranyanmanoharam || śivaśarmātha papraccha kiṃ saṃjñaṃ nagaraṃ tvidam || 31 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || asau vaidyādharo loko nānā vidyā viśāradāḥ || ete vidyārthināmannamupānadvastrakaṃbalam || 32 || auṣadhānyapi yacchaṃ ti tatpīḍāśamanāni hi || nānākalāḥ śikṣayaṃti vidyāgarvavivarjitāḥ || 33 || śiṣyaṃ putreṇa paśyaṃti vastra tāṃbūla bhojanaiḥ || alaṃkṛtāśca satkanyā dharmā dudvāhayaṃti ca || 34 || abhilāṣadhiyā nityaṃ pūjayaṃtīṣṭadevatāḥ || etaḥ puṇyairvasaṃtīha vidyādhara varā ime ||35|| yāvaditthaṃ kathāṃ cakrustāvatsaṃyaminīpatiḥ || dharmarājobhisaṃprāpto devaduṃdubhi niḥsvanaiḥ ||36|| somyamūrtirvimānastho dharmajñaiḥ parivāritaḥ || sevākarmasu caturairbhṛtyaistricaturaiḥ saha ||37|| dharmarāja uvāca || sādhusādhu mahābuddhe śivaśarmandvijottama || kulocitaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhavatā pratipāditam || 38 || vedābhyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ guravaścāpi toṣitāḥ || dharmaśāstrapurāṇe ṣu dṛṣṭo dharmastvayā''dṛtaḥ || 39 || kṣālitaṃ muktipuryadbhirāśugaṃtṛśarīrakam || kovido'sti bhavāneva jīvite jīvitetare || 4.1.8.40 || kalevaraṃ pūtigaṃdhi sadaivāśucibhājanam || sutīrthapuṇya paṇyena samyagvinimitaṃ tvayā || 41 || ataevāhi pāṃḍityamādriṃyate vicakṣaṇāḥ || ahaḥkṣepaṃ na kṣipaṃti kṣaṇamekaṃ hi te budhāḥ || 42 || nimeṣānpaṃcapānmartye prāṇaṃti prāṇino dhruvam || tatrāpi na pravarteyuraghakarmaṇi garhite || 43 || sthirāpāyaḥ sadā kāyo na dhanaṃ nidhane'vati || tanmūḍhaḥ prauḍhakārye kiṃ na yateta bhavāniva ||44|| satvaraṃ gatvaraṃ cāyurlokaḥ śokasamākulaḥ || tasmāddharme matiḥ kāryā bhavateva sudhārmikaiḥ||45|| satkarmaṇo vipāko'yaṃ tava vaṃdyau mamāpyaho || yadetau bhagavadbhaktau sakhitvaṃ bhavato gatau || 46 || mamājñā dīyatāṃ tasmātsāhāyyaṃ karavāṇi kim || yatkartavyaṃ mādṛśaiste tatkṛtaṃ bhavataivahi || 47 || adya dhanyatarosmīha yaddṛṣṭau bhagavadgaṇau || sevā sadaiva me jñāpyā śrīmaccaraṇasannidhau || 48 || tataḥ prasthāpitastābhyāṃ prāviśatsvapurīṃ yamaḥ || aprākṣīcca tato viprastau gaṇau prasthite yame ||49 || || śivaśarmovāca || || sākṣādayaṃ dharmarājo nanu saumyatarākṛtiḥ || dharmyāṇyeva vacāṃsyasya manaḥ prītikarāṇi ca || 4.1.8.50 || purī saṃyamanī seyamatīva śubhalakṣaṇā || ākarṇya yasya nāmāpi pāpino'tīva bibhyati || 51 || yamarūpaṃ varṇa yaṃti martyaloke'nyathā janāḥ || anyathā'yaṃ mayā dṛṣṭo brūtaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ gaṇau || 52 || kena paśyaṃtyamuṃ lokaṃ nivasaṃti tathātra ke || idamevāsya kiṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ cānyacca nivedyatām ||53|| || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || śṛṇu saumya susaumyo'sau dṛśyatetra bhavādṛśaiḥ|| dharmamūrtiḥ prakṛtyaiva niḥśaṃkaiḥ puṇyarāśibhiḥ ||54|| ayameva hi piṃgākṣaḥ krodharaktāṃtalocanaḥ || daṃṣṭrākarālavadano vidyullalanabhīṣaṇaḥ || 55 || ūrdhvakeśo'tikṛṣṇāṃgaḥ pralayāṃbudaniḥsvanaḥ || kāladaṃḍodyatakaro bhukuṭī kuṭilānanaḥ || 56 || ānayainaṃ pātayainaṃ badhānāmuṃca durdama || ghātayainaṃ sudurvṛttaṃ mūrdhni tīvramayoghanaiḥ || 57 || ātāḍayainaṃ durvṛttaṃ dhṛtvā pādau śilātale || utpāṭayāsya netre tvaṃ nidhāya caraṇaṃ gale || 58 || etasya gallāvutphullau kṣureṇāśuvi pāṭaya || pāśena kaṃṭhaṃ baddhāsya samullaṃbaya bhūruhe || 59 || vidārayāsya mūrdhānaṃ karapatreṇa dāruvat || pārṣṇighātairghnatāsyāsyaṃ samuccūrṇaya dāruṇaiḥ || 4.1.8.60 || paradāraprasṛmaraṃ karaṃ chiṃdhyasya pāpinaḥ || paradāragṛhaṃ yātuḥ pādau cāsya vikhaṃḍaya || 61 || sūcībhī romakūpeṣu tanuṃ vyadhihi sarvataḥ || dātuḥ parakalatrāṃge nakhapaṃktī durātmanaḥ || 62 || paradāramukhāghrāturmukhe niṣṭhīvayāsya hi || vaktuḥ parāpavādasya kīlaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ mukhe kṣipa || 63 || bharjayainaṃ caṇakavattaptavāluka karparaiḥ || bhrāṣṭre vikaṭavaktratvaṃ parasaṃtāpakāriṇam || 64 || doṣāropaṃ sadākarturadoṣe krūralocana || nimajjayāsya vadanaṃ pūyaśoṇitakardame || 65 || adattaparavastūnāṃ gṛhṇataḥ karapallavam || āplutyāplutya tailena taptāṃgāre pacotkaṭa || 66 || apavādaṃ gurorvakturniṃdākartuḥ suparvaṇām || taptalohaśalākāśca mukhe bhīṣaṇa nikṣipa ||67|| paramarma spṛśaścāsya paracchidraprakāśituḥ|| sutaptāyomayāñcchaṃkūnsarvasaṃdhiṣu ropaya || 68 || anye na dīyamāne sve niṣeddhuḥpāpakāriṇaḥ || ācchettuḥ paravṛttīnāṃ jihvāṃ chiṃdhyasya durmukha ||69|| devasvabhoktuḥ kroḍāsya brāhmaṇasvasyabhojinaḥ || vidāryodaramasyāśu viṭkīṭaiḥ paripūraya || 4.1.8.70 || na devārthe na viprārthe nātithyarthe pacetkvacit || tamamuṃ svārthapaktāraṃ kuṃbhīpāke pacāṃdhaka || 71 || ugrāsya śiśuhaṃtāramamuṃ viśraṃbhaghātinam || kṛtaghnaṃ naya vegena mahāraurava rauravam || 72 || brahmaghnaṃ cāṃdhatāmisre surāpaṃ pūyaśoṇite || kālasūtre hemacauramavīcau gurutalpagam ||73|| tatsaṃsargiṇamāvarṣamasipatravane tathā || etānmahāpātakinastaptatailakaṭāhake || 74 || āplutyāplutya durdaṃṣṭrakākolairlohatuṃḍakaiḥ || saṃtodyamānānpāpiṣṭhānnityaṃ kalpaṃ nivāsaya || 75 || strīghnaṃ goghnaṃ ca mitraghnaṃ kūṭaśālmalipādape|| ullaṃbaya ciraṃkālamūrdhvapādamadhomukham ||76|| tvacamasya ca saṃdaṃśaistroṭaya tvaṃ mahābhuja|| āśleṣiturmitrapatnyā bhujāvutpāṭayā śuca ||77|| jvālākīle mahāghore narake'muṃ ni pātaya || yo vahninā dāhayati parakṣetraṃ parālayam || 78 || kālakūṭe ca garadaṃ kūṭasākṣyābhivādinam|| mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kaṃṭhamoṭe nipātaya || 79 || lālāpibeca duṣprekṣya tīrthāsuṣṭhīvinaṃ(?) naya || āmapāke ca garbhaghnaṃ śūlapāke'nyatāpinam || 4.1.8.80 || rasavikrayiṇaṃ vipramikṣuyaṃtre prapīḍaya || prajāpīḍākaraṃ bhūpamaṃdhakūpe nipātaya || 81 || gotilāṃśca turaṃgāṃśca vikretāraṃ dvijādhamam || mātulānyāḥ surāyāśca vikretāraṃ halāyudha || 82 || musalolūkhale vaiśyaṃ kaṃḍayainaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || śūdraṃ dvijāvamaṃtāraṃ dvijāgre maṃcasevinam || 83 || adhomukhe ca narake dīrghagrīvaprapīḍya ||84|| śūdraṃ brāhmaṇajetāraṃ vaiśyaṃ bāhmaṇamāninam || kṣatriyaṃ yājakaṃ cāpi vipraṃ vedavivarjitam || 85 || lākṣālavaṇamāṃsānāṃ satailaviṣasarpiṣām || āyudhekṣuvikārāṇāṃ vikretāraṃ dvijādhamam || 86 || pāśapāṇekaśāpāṇe baddhvaitāṃścaraṇedṛḍham || ghātayaṃtau kaśāghātairnayataṃ taptakardame || 87 || imāṃ striyaṃ śleṣayāśu puṃścalīṃ kulakalmaṣām || tenopapatinā sārdhaṃ taptāyasamayena ca || 88 || svayaṃ gṛhītvā niyamaṃ yastyajedajiteṃdriyaḥ || taṃ prāpaya durādharṣaṃ bahubhramaradaṃśake || 89 || ityādijalpandurvṛttaiḥ śrūyate dūrato yamaḥ || svakarmaśaṃkitaiḥ pāpai rdṛśyateti bhayaṃkaraḥ || 4.1.8.90 || ye prajāḥ pālayaṃtīha putrāneva nijaurasān || daṃḍayaṃti ca dharmeṇa bhūpāste'sya sabhāsadaḥ || 91 || varṇāśramāśca yadrāṣṭre 'nutiṣṭhaṃti nijāṃ kriyām || kālenāpannanidhanā bhūpāste'sya sabhāsadaḥ || 92 || naiva dīno na durvṛtto nāpadgrasto na śokabhāk || yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre pradṛśyaṃte bhūpāste'sya sabhāsadaḥ || 93 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ svadharma niratāḥ sadā || anyepi ye saṃyaminaḥ saṃyaminyāṃ vasaṃti te || 94 || uśīnaraḥ sudhanvā ca vṛṣaparvā jayadrathaḥ || rajiḥ sahasrajitkukṣirdṛḍhadhanvā ripuṃjayaḥ || 95 || yuvanāśvo daṃtavaktro nābhāgo ripumaṃgalaḥ || karaṃdhamo dharmasenaḥ paramardaḥ parāṃtakaḥ || 96 || ete cānye ca bahavo rājāno nītivartinaḥ || dharmādharmavicārajñāḥ sudharmāyāṃ samāsate || 97 || anyacca te pravakṣyāvo yena paśyaṃti bhāskarim || daṃḍapāśodyatakarāndūtānugrānanānkvacit ||9|||| goviṃdamādhavamukuṃda haremurāre śaṃbho śiveśa śaśiśekhara śūlapāṇe || dāmodarācyuta janārdana vāsudeva tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanaṃti||99|| gaṃgādharāṃdhakaripo haranīlakaṃṭha vaikuṃṭha kaiṭabharipo kamaṭhābjapāṇe|| bhūteśakhaṃḍaparaśomṛḍacaṃḍikeśa tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanaṃti|| 4.1.8.100|| viṣṇonṛsiṃhamadhusūdanacakrapāṇe gaurīpate giriśa śaṃkara caṃdracūḍa || nārāyaṇāsuranibarhaṇaśārṅgapāṇe tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanaṃti || 101 || mṛtyuṃjayograviṣamekṣaṇakāmaśatro śrīkāṃtapītavasanāṃbuda nīlaśaure || īśānakṛttivasanatridaśaikanātha tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanaṃti || 102 || lakṣmīpate madhuripo puruṣottamādyaśrīkaṃṭhadigvasana śāṃtapinākapāṇe || ānaṃdakaṃda dharaṇīdhara padmanābha tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanati || 103 || sarveśvara tripurasūdana devadeva brahmaṇyadevagaruḍadhvaja śaṃkhapāṇe || tryakṣoragābharaṇabālamṛgāṃkamaule tyajyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanaṃti || 104 || śrīrāmarāghavarameśvararāvaṇāre bhūteśamanmatharipo pramathādhinātha || cāṇūramardanahṛṣīkapatemurāre tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanati || 105 || śūlingirīśa rajanīśa kalāvataṃ sakaṃsapraṇāśana sanātanakeśināśa || bhargatrinetrabhavabhūtapate purāre tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanaṃti || 106 || gopīpate yadupate vasudevasūno karpūragauravṛṣabhadhvajabhālanetra || govardhanoddharaṇadharmadhurīṇagopa tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanaṃti || 107 || sthāṇo trilocana pinākadharasmarāre kṛṣṇāniruddhakamalākarakalmaṣāre || viśveśvara tripathagārdrajaṭākalāpa tyājyā bhaṭāya iti saṃtatamāmanaṃti || 108 || aṣṭottarādhikaśatenasucārunāmnāṃ saṃdarbhitāṃ lalitaratnakadaṃbakena || sannāyakāṃ dṛḍhaguṇāṃ ddhijakaṃṭhagāṃ yaḥ kuryādimāṃ srajamaho sa yamaṃ na paśyet || 109 || itthaṃ dvijeṃdra nijabhṛtyagaṇānsadaiva saṃśikṣayedavanigānsa hi dharmarājaḥ || anyepi ye hariharāṃkadharā dharāyāṃ te dūrataḥ punaraho parivarjanīyāḥ || 4.1.8.110 || agastiruvāca || yo dharmarājaracitāṃ lalitaprabaṃdhāṃ nāmāvaliṃ sakalakalmaṣabījahaṃtrīm || dhīrotra kaustubhabhṛtaḥ śaśibhūṣaṇasya nityaṃ japetstanarasaṃ sa pibenna mātuḥ || 111 || iti śṛṇvankathāṃ ramyāṃ śivaśarmāpriye'naghāma || prahṛṣṭavaktraḥ purato dadarśāpsarasāpurīm || 112 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyā saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe yamalokavarṇanaṃnāmā'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || || cha ||
<4.1.9>
|| śivaśarmovāca || kā imā rūpalāvaṇya saubhāgyanidhayaḥ striyaḥ || divyālaṃkāradhāriṇyo divyabhogasamanvitāḥ || 1 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || etā vāravilāsinyo yajñabhājāṃ priyaṃkarāḥ || gītajñā nṛtyakuśalā vādyavidyā vicakṣaṇāḥ ||2|| kāmakelikalābhijñā dyūtavidyāviśāradāḥ || rasajñā bhāvavedinyaścaturāścocitoktiṣu || 3 || nānādeśa viśeṣajñā nānābhāṣā sukovidāḥ || saṃketodaṃtanipuṇā naikāsvairacarā mudā || 4 || līlānarmasusābhijñāḥ supralāpeṣu paṃḍitāḥ || yūnāṃ manāṃsi satataṃ svairhāvai ramayaṃtyamūḥ ||5|| nirmathyamānātkṣīrodātpūrvamapsarasastvamūḥ || niḥsṛtāstrijagajjeturmohanāstramanobhuvaḥ || 6 || urvaśī menakā raṃbhā caṃdralekhā tilottamā || vapuṣmatīkāṃtimatī līlāvatyutpalāvatī || 7 || alaṃbuṣā guṇavatī sthūlakeśī kalāvatī || kalānidhirguṇanidhiḥ karpūratilakorvarā || 8 || anaṃgalatikā cāpi tathā madanamohinī || cakorākṣī caṃdrakalā tathā munimanoharā || 9 || grāvadrāvā tapodveṣṭī cārunāsā sukarṇikā || dārusaṃjīvinī suśrīḥ kratuśulkā śubhānanā || 4.1.9.10 || tapaḥśulkā tīrthaśulkā dānaśulkā himāvatī || paṃcāśvamedhikā caiva rājasūyārthinī tathā || 11 || aṣṭāgnihomikā tadvadvājapeyaśatodbhavā || ityādyapsarasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sahasraṃ ṣaṣṭisaṃmitam || 12 || etasminnapsaroloke vasaṃtyanyā apistriyaḥ || sadā skhalitalāvaṇyāḥ sadāskhalitayauvanāḥ || 13 || divyāṃbarā divyamālyā divyagaṃdhānulepanāḥ || divyabhogaiḥ susaṃpannāḥ svecchāvidhṛtavigrahāḥ ||14|| kṛtvā māsopavāsāni skhalaṃti brahmacaryataḥ || sakṛdeva dvikṛtvo vā triḥkṛtvo daivayogataḥ ||15|| tā imā divyabhoginyo rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpadaḥ|| nivasaṃtyapsaroloke sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ ||16|| kṛtvā vratāni sāṃgāni kāmikāni vidhānataḥ || bhavaṃti svairacāriṇyo devabhogyā ihāgatāḥ || 17 || pativratadhṛtā nāryo balena balinā dhṛtāḥ || bhartabuddhyāramaṃtetaṃ(?) kadācittā imā dvija ||18 || bhartari proṣite yāśca brahmacaryavratāḥ sadā || viplavaṃ te sakṛddaivāttā etā vāmalocanāḥ||19|| kusumāni sugaṃdhīni suvāsaṃ caṃdanaṃ tathā || sugauraṃ cāpi karpūraṃ susūkṣmāṇyaṃbarāṇi ca || 4.1.9.20 || parṇāni ṛjutārāṇi jīrṇāni kaṭhināni ca || sāgrāṇi svarṇavarṇāni sthūlanīlaśirāṇi ca || 21 || suvāsopaskarāḍhyāni nāgavallyā dvijottama || śayyāvicitrābharaṇā ratiśālocitāni ca || 22 || bahukautukavastūni samarcyadvijadaṃpatī || bhogadānamidaṃ kāmyaṃ pratisaṃkramaṇaṃ raveḥ || 23 || kiṃvā prativyatīpātamekasaṃvatsarāvadhi|| kodāditi ca maṃtreṇa yā dadyādvaravarṇinī||24|| kāmarūpadharo devaḥ prīyatāmiti vādinī || sā śreṣṭhā'psarasāṃ madhye vasetkalpamihāṃganā ||25|| kanyārūpadharākācidyābhuktā kenacitkvacit || devarūpeṇa taṃ kālamārabhya brahmacāriṇī || 26 || tadeva vṛttaṃ dhyāyaṃtī nidhanaṃ yāti kālataḥ || divyarūpadharā seha jāyate divya bhogabhāk || 27 || nidānamapsarolokasyetiśṛṇvandvijāgraṇīḥ || sauraṃ lokamatha prāpya kṣaṇena sa vimānagaḥ || 28 || yathā kadaṃbakusumaṃ kiṃjalkaiḥ sarvatovṛtam || dedīpyamānaṃ hi tathā samaṃtādbhānubhānubhiḥ || 29 || dūrādraviṃ sa vijñāya dhṛtatāmarasadvayam || navabhiryojanānāṃ ca sahasraiḥ saṃmitena ha || 4.1.9.30 || vicitreṇaikacakreṇa saptasaptiyutena ca || anūruṇādhiṣṭhitena puratodhṛtaraśminā || 31 || apsaromunigaṃdharva sarpagrāmaṇi nairṛtaiḥ || syaṃdanenātijavinā praṇanāma kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 32 || tasya praṇāmaṃdevopi bhrūbhaṃgenānumanya ca|| atidūraṃ nabhovartma vyaticakrāma sakṣaṇāt || 33 || prakrāṃte dyumaṇau dūraṃ śivaśarmātiśarmavān || provāca bhagavadbhaktau kathaṃ labhyaṃ raveḥ padam || 34 || etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotumācakṣāthāṃ mamāgrataḥ || satāṃ sāptapadī maitrī tanme maitryā praṇoditau || 35 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || śṛṇu dvija mahāprājña tvayyakathyaṃ na kiṃcana || satsaṃgādeva sādhūnāṃ satkathā saṃpravartate || 36 || niyaṃtā sarvabhūtānāṃ ya ekaḥkāraṇaṃ param || anāmā gotrarahito rūpādi parivarjitaḥ || 37 || āvirbhāva tirobhāvau yadbhūnartanavartinau || sa eva vakti satataṃ sarvātmā vedapūruṣaḥ || 38 || yosāvādityapuruṣaḥ sosāvahamiti sphuṭam || aṃdhatamaḥ praviśaṃti ye caivānyamupāsate || 39 || niścitārthāṃ śrutimimāṃ brāhmaṇāso dvijottama || tamekamupatiṣṭhaṃte niścityeti punaḥpunaḥ || 4.1.9.40 || upalabhya ca sāvitrīṃ nopatiṣṭheta yaḥ parām || kāle trikālaṃ saptāhātsa patennātra saṃśayaḥ ||41|| tāvatprātarjapaṃstiṣṭhedyāvadardhodayo raveḥ || āsanastho japenmaunī pratyagātārakodayāt || 42 || sādityāṃ madhyamāṃ saṃdhyāṃ japedādityasaṃmukhaḥ || kālalopo na kartavyastataḥ kālaṃ pratīkṣayet || 43 || kāle phalaṃtyoṣadhayaḥ kāle puṣpaṃti pādapāḥ || varṣaṃti toyadāḥ kāle tasmātkālaṃ na laṃghayet || 44 || maṃdehadehanāśārthamudayāstamaye raviḥ || samīhate dvijotsṛṣṭaṃ maṃtratoyāṃjalitrayam || 45 || gāyatrīmaṃtratoyāḍhyaṃ dattaṃ yenāṃjalitrayam || kāle savitre kiṃ na syāttena dattaṃ jagattrayam || 46 || kiṃ kiṃ na savitā sūte kāle samyagupāsitaḥ || āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ vasūni sapaśūni ca || 47 || mitraputra kalatrāṇi kṣetrāṇi vividhāni ca || bhogānaṣṭavidhāṃścāpi svargaṃ cāpyapavargakam || 48 || aṣṭādaśa suvidyāsu mīmāṃsātigarīyasī || tatopi tarkaśāstrāṇi purāṇaṃ tebhya eva ca || 49 || tatopi dharmaśāstrāṇi tebhyo gurvī śrutirdvija || tatopyupaniṣacchreṣṭhā gāyatrī ca tatodhikā || 4.1.9.50 || durlabhā sarvamaṃtreṣu gāyatrī praṇavānvitā || na gāyatryādhikaṃ kiṃcittrayīṣu parigīyate || 51 || na gāyatrī samo maṃtro na kāśī sadṛśī purī || na viśveśa samaṃ liṃgaṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 52 || gāyatrī vedajananī gāyatrī brāhmaṇaprasūḥ || gātāraṃ trāyate yasmādgāyatrī tena gīyate || 53 || vācyavācakasaṃbaṃdho gāyatryāḥ saviturdvayoḥ || vācyosau savitā sākṣādgāyatrīvācikāparā || 54 || prabhāveṇaiva gāyatryāḥ kṣatriyaḥ kauśiko vaśī || rājarṣitvaṃ parityajya brahmarṣipadamīyivān||55|| sāmarthyaṃ prāpa cātyuccairanyadbhuvanasarjane || kiṃ kiṃ na dadyādgāyatrī samyagevamupāsitā || 56 || na brāhmaṇo vedapāṭhānna śāstrapaṭhanādapi || devyāstrikālamabhyāsādbāhmaṇaḥ syāddhi nānyathā || 57 || gāyatryeva paraṃ viṣṇurgāyatryeva paraḥśivaḥ || gāyatryeva parobrahmā gāyatryeva trayī tataḥ || 58 || devatrayaṃ sa bhagavānaṃśumālī divākaraḥ || sarveṣāṃ mahasāṃ rāśiḥ kālakālapravartakaḥ || 59 || arkamuddiśya satatamasmallokanivāsinaḥ || śrutiṃ hyudāharaṃtīmāṃ sārāsāravivekinaḥ ||4.1.9.60|| eṣo ha devaḥ pradiśonu sarvāḥ pūrvo ha jātaḥ sa u garbhe aṃtaḥ || sa eva jātaḥ sa janiṣyamāṇaḥ pratyaṅjānāstiṣṭhati sarvatomukhaḥ || 61 || sadaivamupatiṣṭheransaurasūktairataṃdritāḥ || ye namaṃtyatra te viprā viprā bhāskarasannibhāḥ || 62 || puṣyārkepyatha hastārke mūlārkepyathavā dvija || uttarārke'tha yatkāryaṃ tatphalatyeva nānyathā || 63 || pauṣe māsyarkadivase yaḥ snātvā bhāskarodaye || dānahomaṃjapaṃkuryādarcāmarkasya suvrata || 64 || śraddhāvānekabhaktaśca kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ || sahāpsarobhirdyutimānsa vasedatra bhogavān || 65 || ayane viṣuve cāpi ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu vā || viṣṇupadyāṃ ca ye dadyurmahādānāni suvratāḥ || 66 || tilāñjuhvati sājyāṃśca brāhmaṇānbhojayaṃti ca || pitṝnuddiśya ca śrāddhaṃ ye kurvaṃti vipaścitaḥ || 67 || mahāpūjāṃ ca ye kuryurmahāmaṃtrāñjapaṃti ca || te'tra vaikartane loke vikartanasamaprabhā ||68|| na daridrā na ca duḥkhārtā na vyādhi paripīḍitāḥ || saṃkrameṣvarkabhaktā ye na virūpā na durbhagāḥ ||69|| saṃkrameṣu na yairdattaṃ na snātaṃ tīrthavāriṣu|| viśeṣahomo na kṛtaḥ kapilājyāplutaistilaiḥ || 4.1.9.70 || te dṛśyaṃte pratidvāraṃ vihīna nayanānanāḥ || dehidehīti jalpaṃto dehinaḥ sapaṭaccarāḥ || 71 || samaṃ kṛṣṇalakenāpi yo dadyātkāṃcanaṃ kṛtī || sūryagrahe kurukṣetre sa vasedatra puṇyabhāk || 72 || sarvaṃ gaṃgāsamaṃ toyaṃ sarve brahmasamā dvijāḥ || sarvaṃ deyaṃ svarṇasamaṃ rāhugraste divākare || 73 || dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ snātaṃ yatkiṃcitsadanuṣṭhitam|| bhānūparāge śrāddhādi taddheturbradhna saṃnidhe ||74|| ravivāre saṃkramaśceduparāgo'thavābhavet || tadā yadarjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tadihākṣayamāpyate || 75 || bhānuvāro yadā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saptamyāmatha jāyate || tadā yatsukṛtaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tadiha bhujyate || 76 || haṃso bhānuḥ sahasrāṃśustapanastāpano ravi || vikartano vivasvāṃśca viśvakarmā vibhāvasuḥ || 77 || viśvarūpo viśvakartā mārtaṃḍo mihiroṃ'śumān || ādityaścoṣṇaguḥ sūryo'ryamā bradhno divākaraḥ || 78 || dvādaśātmā saptahayo bhāskaro haskaraḥ khagaḥ || suraḥ prabhākaraḥ śrīmām̐llokacakṣurgraheśvaraḥ || 79 || trilokeśo lokasākṣītamoriḥ śāśvataḥ śuciḥ || gabhastihastastīvrāṃśustaraṇiḥ sumahoraṇiḥ ||4.1.9.80|| dyumaṇirharidaśvorko bhānumānbhayanāśanaḥ|| chandośvo vedavedyaśca bhāsvānpūṣā vṛṣākapiḥ || 81 || ekacakraratho mitro maṃdehāristamisrahā || daityahā pāpahartā ca dharmodharma prakāśakaḥ || 82 || helikaścitrabhānuśca kalighnastārkṣyavāhanaḥ || dikpatiḥ padminīnāthaḥ kuśeśayakaro hariḥ || 83 || gharmaraśmirdurnirīkṣyaścaṃḍāṃśuḥ kaśyapātmajaḥ || ebhiḥ saptatisaṃkhyākaiḥ puṇyaiḥ sūryasya nāmabhiḥ || 84 || praṇavādi caturthyaṃtairnamaskāra samanvitaiḥ || pratyekamuccarannāma dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā divākaram|| 85 || vigṛhya pāṇiyugmena tāmrapātraṃ sunirmalam || jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā paripūrya jalena ca || 86 || karavīrādi kusumai raktacaṃdanamiśritaiḥ || dūrvāṃkurairakṣataiśca nikṣiptaiḥ pātramadhyataḥ || 87 || dadyādarghyamanarghyāya savitre dhyānapūrvakam || upamauli samānīya tatpātraṃ nānyadṛṅmanāḥ || 88 || pratimaṃtraṃ namaskuryādudayāstamaye ravim || anayā nāmasaptatyā mahāmaṃtrarahasyayā || 89 || evaṃ kurvannaro jātu na daridro na duḥkhabhāk || vyādhibhirmucyate ghorairapijanmāṃtarārjitaiḥ || 4.1.9.90 || vinauṣadhairvinā vaidyairvināpathyaparigrahaiḥ || kālena nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate || 91 || ityekadeśaḥ kathito bhānulokasya sattama || mahātejonidherasya koviśeṣamavaityaho || 92 || svakarṇaviṣayīkurvannitipuṇyakathāmimām || kṣaṇādālokayāṃcakre maheṃdrasya mahāpurīm || 93 || || agastiruvāca || || śrutvā saurīṃ kathametāmapsarolokasaṃyutām || na daridro bhavetkvāpi nādharmeṣu pravartate || 94 || brāhmaṇaiḥ satataṃ śrāvyamidamākhyānamuttamam || vedapāṭhena yatpuṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaphaladāyakam || 95 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śṛṇvaṃto'dhyāyamuttamam || pātakāni visṛjyeha gatiṃ yāsyaṃtyanuttamām || 96 || iti śrīskāṃdamahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārdhe apsaraḥsūryalokavarṇanaṃnāmanavamo'dhyāyaḥ || |||9||
<4.1.10>
|| śivaśarmovāca || || ramayaṃtī manotīva keyaṃ kasyeyamīśituḥ || nayanānaṃdasaṃdohadāyinīpūranuttamā || 1 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || śivaśarmanmahābhāgasutīrthaphalitadruma || loko'tra ramate vipra sahasākṣapurī tviyam || 2 || tapobalena mahatā vihitā viśvakamarṇā || divāpi kaumudī yasyāḥ saudhaśreṇīśriyaṃ śrayet || 3 || yadākalānidhiḥ kvāpi darśe 'dṛśyatvamāvahet || tadā svapreyasīṃ jyotsnāṃ saudheṣveṣu nigūhayet || 4 || yadacchabhittau vīkṣya svamanyayopidviśaṃkitā || mugdhānāśuviśeccitramapisvāṃcitraśālikām || 5 || harmyeṣu nīlamaṇibhirnirmiteṣvatranirbhayam || svanīlimānamādhāya tamohaḥsvapi tiṣṭhati || 6 || caṃdrakāṃtaśilājālasrutamātrāmalaṃjalam || tatra cādāya kalaśairnecchaṃtyanyajjalaṃ janāḥ || 7 || kuviṃdā na ca saṃtyatra na ca te paśyato harāḥ || cailānyalaṃkṛtīratra yataḥ kalpadrumorpayet || 8 || gaṇakā nātra vidyaṃte ciṃtāvidyāviśāradāḥ || yataściketi sarveṣāṃ ciṃtā ciṃtāmaṇirdrutam || 9 || sūpakārā na saṃtyatra rasakarma vicakṣaṇāḥ|| dugdhe sarvarasānekā kāmadhenuratoyataḥ || 4.1.10.10 || kīrtiruccaiḥśravā yasya sarvato vājirājiṣu || ratnamuccaiḥśravāḥ sotra hayānāṃ pauruṣādhikaḥ || 11 || airāvato daṃtivaraścaturdaṃtotra rājate || dvitīya iva kailāso jaṃgamasphaṭikojjvalaḥ || 12 || taruratnaṃpārijātaḥ strīratnaṃ sorvaśī tviha || naṃdanaṃ vanaratnaṃ ca ratnaṃ maṃdākinī hyapām || 13 || trayastriṃśatsurāṇāṃ yā koṭiḥ śruti samīritā || pratīkṣate sā'vasaraṃ sevāyai pratyahaṃtviha || 14 || svargeṣviṃdrapadādanyanna viśiṣyeta kiṃcana || yadyattrilokyāmaiśvaryaṃ na tattulyamanena hi || 15 || aśvamedhasahasrasya labhyaṃ vinimayena yat || kiṃ tena tulyamanyatsyātpavitramathavā mahata || 16 || arciṣmatī saṃyaminī puṇyavatyamalāvatī || gaṃdhavatyalakeśī ca naitattulyā mahardhibhiḥ || 17|| ayameva sahasrākṣastvayameva divaspatiḥ || śatamanyurayaṃ devo nāmānyetāni nāmataḥ || 18 || saptāpi lokapālā ye ta enaṃ samupāsate || nāradādyairmunivarairayamāśīrbhirīḍyate || 19 || etatsthairyeṇa sarveṣāṃ lokānāṃ sthairyamiṣyate || parājayānmaheṃdrasya trailokyaṃ syātparājitam || 4.1.10.20 || danujā manujā daityāstapasyaṃtyugrasaṃyamāḥ || gaṃdharva yakṣarakṣāṃsi maheṃdrapadalipsavaḥ || 21 || sagarādyā mahīpālā vājimedhavidhāyakāḥ || kṛtavaṃto mahāyatnaṃ śakraiśvaryajighṛkṣavaḥ || 22 || niṣpratyūhaṃ kratuśataṃ yaḥ kaścitkurute'vanau || jiteṃdriyomarāvatyāṃ sa prāpnoti pulomajām || 23 || asamāptakratuśatā vasaṃtyatra mahībhujaḥ || jyotiṣṭomādibhiryāgairye yajaṃtyapi te dvijāḥ ||24|| tulāpuruṣadānādi mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa || ye yacchaṃtyamalātmānaste labhaṃte'marāvatīm || 25 || aklībavādino dhīrāḥ saṃgrāmeṣvaparāṅmukhāḥ || vikrāṃtā vīraśayane te'tra tiṣṭhaṃti bhūbhujaḥ ||26|| ityuddeśātsamākhyātā maheṃdranagarī sthitiḥ || yāyajūkā vasaṃtyatra yajñavidyāviśāradāḥ || 27 || imāmarciṣmatīṃ paśya vītihotrapurīṃ śubhām || jātavedasi ye bhaktāste vasaṃtyatra suvratāḥ || 28 || agnipraveśaṃ ye kuryurdṛḍhasattvā jiteṃdriyāḥ || striyo vā sattvasaṃpannāste sarve agnitejasaḥ || 29 || agnihotraratā viprāstathāgnibrahmacāriṇaḥ || paṃcāgnivratino ye vai te'gnilokegnitejasaḥ || 4.1.10.30 || śīte śītāpanutyai yastvidhmabhārānprayacchati || kuryādagniṣṭikāṃ vā'tha sa vasedagnisannidhau || 31 || anāthasyāgnisaṃskāraṃ yaḥ kuryācchraddhayānvitaḥ || aśaktaḥ prerayedanyaṃ sogniloke mahīyate ||32|| jaṭharāgnivivṛddhyai yo dadyādāgneyamauṣadham || maṃdāgnaye sa puṇyātmā vahniloke vasecciram || 33 || yajñopaskara vastūni yajñārthaṃ draviṇaṃ tu vā || yathāśakti pradadyādyo hyarciṣmatyāṃvasetsa vai || 34 || agnireko dvijātīnāṃ niḥśreyasakaraḥ paraḥ || gururdevo vrataṃ tīrthaṃ sarvamagnirviniścitam || 35 || apāvanāni sarvāṇi vahnisaṃsargataḥ kṣaṇāt || pāvanāni bhavaṃtyeva tasmādyaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 36 || api vedaṃ viditvā yastyaktvā vai jātavedasam || anyatra badhnāti ratiṃ brāhmaṇo na sa vedavit ||37|| aṃtarātmā hyayaṃ sākṣānniścito hyāśuśukṣaṇiḥ || māṃsagrāsānpacetkukṣau strīṇāṃ no māṃsapeśikām ||38|| taijasī śāṃbhavī mūrtiḥ pratyakṣā dahanātmikā || kartrī haṃtrī pālayitrī vinaināṃ kiṃ vilokyate || 39 || citrabhānurayaṃ sākṣānnetraṃ tribhuvaneśituḥ || aṃdhaṃ tamomaye loke vinainaṃ kaḥ prakāśakaḥ || 4.1.10.40 || dhūpapradīpanaivedya payo dadhi ghṛtaikṣavam || etadbhuktaṃ niṣevaṃte sarve divi divaukasaḥ || 41 || śivaśarmovāca || || koyaṃ kṛśānuḥ kasyāyaṃ sūnuḥ kathamidaṃ padam || āgneyaṃ labdhametena brūtametanmamāgrataḥ || 42 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || ākarṇaya mahāprājña varṇayāvo yathātatham || yoyaṃ yasya yathā'nena prāpi jyotiṣmatīpurī || 43 || narmadāyāstaṭe ramye pure narmapure purā || purāribhaktaḥ puṇyātmā'bhavadviśvānaro muniḥ ||44|| brahmacaryāśrame niṣṭho brahmayajñarataḥsadā || śāṃḍilyagotraḥ śucimānbrahmatejo nidhirvaśī || 45 || vijñātākhilaśāstrārtho laukikācāracaṃcuraḥ || kadācicciṃtayāmāsa hṛdi dhyātvā maheśvaram || 46 || caturṇāmapyāśramāṇāṃ kotīva śreyase satām || yasminprāpnoti saṃkṣuṇṇe paratreha ca vā sukham ||47|| idaṃ śreyastvidaṃ śreyastvidaṃ tu sukaraṃ bhavet || itthaṃ sarvaṃ samāloḍya gārhasthyaṃ praśaśaṃsa ha || 48 || brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ || eṣāmādhārabhūtosau gṛhastho nānyatheti ca || 49 || devairmanuṣyaiḥ pitṛbhistiryagbhiścopajīvyate || gṛhasthaḥ pratyahaṃ yasmāttasmācchreṣṭho gṛhāśramī ||4.1.10.50 || asnātvā cāpyahutvā vā'dattvā vāśnāti yo gṛhī || devādīnāmṛṇī bhūtvā narakaṃ pratipadyate || 51 || asnātāśī malaṃ bhuṃkte tvajapī pūyaśoṇitam || ahutāśī kṛmīnbhuṃktepyadattvāviḍvibhojanaḥ || 52 || brahmacaryaṃ hi gārhasthye yādṛkkalpanayojjhitam || svabhāvacapale citte kva tādṛgbrahmacāriṇi || 53 || haṭhādvā lokabhītyā vā svārthādvā brahmacaryabhāk || saṃkalpayati citte cetkṛtamapyakṛtaṃ tadā || 54 || paradāraparityāgātsvadāraparituṣṭitaḥ || ṛtukālābhigāmitvādbrahmacārī gṛhīritaḥ || 55 || vimuktarāgadveṣo yaḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ || sāgniḥ sadāraḥ sa gṛhī vānaprasthādviśiṣyate || 56 || vairāgyādgṛhamutsṛjya gṛhadharmānhṛdi smaret || sa bhavedubhayabhraṣṭo vānaprastho na vā gṛhī || 57 || ayācitopasthitayā yo vṛttyā vartate gṛhī || yena kenāpi saṃtuṣṭo bhikṣukātsa viśiṣyate || 58 || prāthayedyatkvacitkiṃcidduṣprāpaṃ vā bhaviṣyati || aśaneṣu na saṃtuṣṭaḥ sa yatiḥ patito bhavet || 59 || guṇāguṇavicāryetthaṃ sa vai viśvānaro dvijaḥ || udvavāha vidhānena svocitāṃ kulakanyakām || 4.1.10.60 || agniśuśrūṣaṇarataḥ paṃcayajñaparāyaṇaḥ || ṣaṭkarmanirato nityaṃ devapitratithipriyaḥ || 61 || dharmārthakāmānyuktātmā sorjayansvasvakālataḥ || parasparamasaṃkocaṃ daṃpatyorānukūlyataḥ || 62 || pūrvāhṇe daivikaṃ karma sokarotkarmakāṃḍavit || madhyaṃdine manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝṇāmaparāhnake ||63|| evaṃ bahutithe kāle gate tasyāgrajanmanaḥ || bhāryā śuciṣmatī nāma kāmapatnī vasuvratā || 64 || apaśyaṃtyaṃkuramapi saṃtateḥ svargasādhanam || vijñāya śaṃkaṃraṃ kāṃtaṃ praṇipatya vyajijñapat || 65 || śuciṣmatyuvāca|| āryaputrāryadhiṣaṇa prāṇanātha priyavrata || na durlabhaṃ mamāstīha kiṃcittvaccaraṇārcanāt || 66 || ye vai bhogāḥ samucitāḥ strīṇāṃ te tvatprasādataḥ || alaṃkṛtya mayā bhuktāḥ prasaṃgādvacmi tānyapi ||67|| suvāsāṃsi suvāsāśca suśayyā sunitaṃbinī|| sraktāṃbūlānnapānāśca aṣṭau bhogāḥ svadharmiṇām || 68 || ekaṃ me prārthitaṃ nātha cirāya hṛdisaṃsthitam || gṛhasthānāṃ samucitaṃ tattvaṃ dātumihārhasi || 69 || viśvānara uvāca || kimadeyaṃ hi suśroṇi tava priyahitaiṣiṇi || tatprārthaya mahābhāge prayacchāmyavilaṃbitam ||4.1.10.70|| maheśituḥ prasādena mama kiṃcinna durlbham || ihāmutra ca kalyāṇi sarvakalyāṇakāriṇaḥ || 71 || iti śrutvā vacaḥ patyustasya sā patidevatā || uvāca hṛṣṭavadanā yadi deyo varo mama ||72|| varayogyāsmi cennātha nānyaṃ varamahaṃ vṛṇe || maheśasadṛśaṃ putraṃ dehi māheśvarānava || 73 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā śuciṣmatyāḥ śucivrataḥ || kṣaṇaṃ samādhimādhāya hṛ(?)dyetatsamaciṃtayat ||74|| aho kimetayā tanvyā prārthitaṃ hyatidurlabham || manorathapathāddūramastuvā sa hi sarvakṛt ||75|| tenaivāsyā mukhe sthitvā vāksvarūpeṇa śaṃbhunā || vyāhṛtaṃ ko'nyathākartumutsaheta bhavedidam ||76|| tataḥ provāca tāṃ patnīmekapatnivrate sthitaḥ || viśvānaramuniḥ śrīmāniti kāṃte bhaviṣyati || 77 || itthamāśvāsya tāṃ patnīṃ jagāma tapase muniḥ || yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣātkāśīnāthodhitiṣṭhati || 78 || prāpya vārāṇasīṃ tūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvātha maṇikarṇikām || tatyāja tāpatritayamapijanmaśatārjitam || 79 || dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi liṃgāni viśveśa pramukhāni ca || snātvā sarveṣu kuṃḍeṣu vāpīkūṭasaraḥsu ca || 4.1.10.80 || natvā vināyakānsarvāngaurīḥ sarvāḥ praṇamya ca || saṃpūjya kālarājaṃ ca bhairavaṃ pāpabhakṣaṇam || 81 || daṇḍanāyakamukhyāṃśca gaṇānstutvā prayatnataḥ || ādikeśavamukhyāṃśca keśavānparitoṣya ca || 82 || lolārkamukhya sūryāṃśca praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ || kṛtvā piṇḍapradānāni sarvatīrtheṣvataṃdritaḥ || 83 || sahasrabhojanādyaiśca yatīnviprānpratarpya ca || mahāpūjopacāraiśca liṃgānyabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ || 84 || asakṛccintayāmāsa kiṃ liṃgaṃ kṣiprasiddhidam || yatra niścalatāmeti tapastanayakāmyayā || 85 || śrīmadoṃkāranāthaṃ vā kṛttivāseśvaraṃ kimu || kāleśaṃ vṛddhakāleśaṃ kalaśeśvarameva ca || 86 || kedāreśaṃ tu kāmeśaṃ candreśaṃ vā trilocanam || jyeṣṭheśaṃ jaṃbukeśaṃ vā jaigīṣavyeśvaraṃ tu vā || 87 || daśāśvamedhamīśānaṃ drumi caṃḍeśameva ca || dṛkkeśaṃ garuḍeśaṃ ca gokarṇeśaṃ gaṇeśvaram || 88 || ḍhuṃḍhyāśāgajasiddhākhyaṃ dharmeśaṃ tārakeśvaram || nandikeśaṃ nivāseśaṃ patrīśaṃ prītikeśvaram || 89 || parvateśaṃ paśupatiṃ brahmeśaṃ madhyameśvaram || bṛhaspatīśvaraṃ vātha vibhāṃḍeśvarameva ca || 4.1.10.90 || bhārabhūteśvaraṃ kiṃ vā mahālakṣmīśvaraṃ tu vā || marutteśaṃ tu mokṣeśaṃ gaṃgeśaṃ narmadeśvaram || 91 || mārkaṃḍaṃ maṇikarṇīśa ratneśvaramathāpi vā || athavā yoginīpīṭhaṃ sādhakasyaiva siddhidam || 92 || yāmuneśaṃ lāṃgalīśaṃ śrīmadviśveśvaraṃ vibhum || avimukteśvaraṃ vātha viśālākṣīśameva ca || 93 || vyāghreśvaraṃ varāheśaṃ vyāseśaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam || varuṇeśaṃ vidhīśaṃ vā vasiṣṭheśaṃ śanīśvaram || 94 || someśvaraṃ kimindreśaṃ svarlīnaṃ saṃgameśvaram || hariścaṃdreśvaraṃ kiṃ vā harikeśeśvaraṃ tu vā||95|| trisaṃdhyeśaṃ mahādevamupaśāṃti śivaṃ tathā|| bhavānīśaṃ kapardīśaṃ kaṃdukeśaṃ makheśvaram || 96 || mitrāvaruṇasaṃjñaṃ vā kimeṣāmāśuputradam || kṣaṇaṃ vicārya sa muniriti viśvānaraḥ sudhīḥ || 97 || ājñātaṃ vismṛtaṃ tāvatphalito me manorathaḥ || siddhaiḥ saṃsevitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ param || 98 || darśanātsparśanādyasya mano nirvṛtibhāgbhavet || udghāṭitaṃ sadaivāste svargadvāraṃ hi yatra vai || 99 || divāniśaṃ pūjanārthaṃ vijñāpya tridaśeśvaram || pañcamudre mahāpīṭhe siddhide sarvajaṃtuṣu || 4.1.10.100 || yatra sā vikaṭā devī prakaṭā siddhirūpiṇī || yatra sthitānāṃ bhaktānāṃ sākṣātsiddhivināyakaḥ || 101 || nirdhūya vighnajālāni sarvāḥ siddhīḥ prayacchati || avimukte mahākṣetre siddhikṣetraṃ hi tatparam || 102 || yatra vīreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mahāguhyatamaṃ matam || tilāṃtarāpi no kāśyāṃ bhūmirliṃgaṃ vinā kvacit || 103 || paraṃ vīreśa sadṛśaṃ na liṃgaṃ tvāśusiddhidam || dharmadaṃ cārthadaṃ samyakkāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ||104|| yathā vīreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāṃ nānyattathā dhuvam || paṃcasvarotra gaṃdharvaḥ parāṃ siddhimagātpurā||105|| vidyādharaḥ svacchavidyo vasupūrṇaśca yakṣarāṭ || nṛtyaṃtī nijabhāvena purāhyatrāpsarovarā || 106 || sadehā kokilālāpā liṃgamadhye layaṃ gatā || ṛṣirvedaśirā nāma japanvai śatarudriyam || 107 || mantrajyotirmaye liṃge saśarīro viśatpurā || candramauli bharadvājāvubhau pāśupatottamau || 108 || vīreśvaraṃ samabhyarcya gāyamānau layaṃ gatau || śaṃkhacūḍo hi nāgeṃdraḥ svaphaṇāmaṇibhirniśi || 109 || ṣaṇmāsātsiddhimagamadbahunīrājanairiha || kinnarī haṃsapadyatra bhartrā veṇupriyeṇa vai || 4.1.10.110 || gāyaṃtī susvaraṃ yātā parāṃ nirvāṇabhūmikām || asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi siddhāḥ siddhimihāgatāḥ || 111 || siddhaliṃgamihākhyātaṃ tasmādvīreśvaraṃ param || 112 || vīreśvaraṃ samārādhya bhraṣṭarājyo jayadrathaḥ || hatvā ripūnaskhalitaṃ rājyaṃ prāpa videhajaḥ || 113 || vidūratho'tha nṛpatiraputraḥ putravānabhūt || vīreśvaraprasādena magadhādhipatirvaśī || 114 || vasudattotra ca vaṇiksutāṃ vasusutopamām || abdamabhyarcya vīreśaṃ ratnadattopyavāptavān || 115 || ahamapyatra vīreśaṃ samārādhyatrikālataḥ || āśu putramavāpsyāmi yathābhilaṣitaṃ striyā || 116 || iti kṛtvā matiṃ dhīro vipro viśvānaraḥ kṛtī || candrkūpajalaiḥ snātvā jagrāha niyamaṃ vratī || 117 || ekāhārobhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ naktāśanobhavata || ayācitāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ tyaktāśanaḥ punaḥ || 118 || payovratobhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ śākaphalāśanaḥ || māsaṃ muṣṭitilāhāro māsaṃ pānīyabhojanaḥ || 119 || paṃcagavyāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ cāṃdrāyaṇavratī || māsaṃ kuśāgrajalabhuṅmāsaṃ śvasanabhakṣaṇaḥ || 4.1.10.120 || atha trayodaśe māsi snātvā tripathagāṃbhasi || pratyūṣa eva vīreśaṃ yāvadāyāti sa dvijaḥ || 121 || tāvadvilokayāṃcakre madhye liṃgaṃ tapodhanaḥ || vibhūtibhūṣitaṃ bālamaṣṭavarṣākṛtiṃ śubham ||122|| ākarṇapūrṇanetraṃ ca suraktadaśanacchadam || cārupiṃgajaṭāmauliṃ nagnaṃ prahasitānanam || 123 || śaiśavocitanepathyadhāriṇaṃ cittahāriṇam || paṭhaṃtaṃ śrutisūktāni hasaṃtaṃ ca svalīlayā || 124 || tamālokya stutiṃ cakre romakaṃcukito mudā || proccaradgadgadālāpo namostviti punaḥ punaḥ || 125 || viśvānara uvāca || || ekabrahmaivādvitīyaṃ samastaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ nehanānāsti kiṃcit || eko rudro na dvitīyovatasthe tasmādekaṃ tvāṃ prapadye maheśam || 126 || ekaḥ kartā tvaṃ hi sarvasya śaṃbho nānārūpeṣvekarūposya rūpaḥ || yadvatpratyapsvarka ekopyanekastasmānnānyaṃ tvāṃ vineśaṃ prapadye ||127|| rajjau sarpaḥ śuktikāyāṃ ca rūpyaṃnairaḥpūrastanmṛgākhye marīcau || yadvattadvadviṣvageṣa prapaṃco yasmiñjñāte taṃ prapadye maheśam || 128 || toye śaityaṃ dāhakatvaṃ ca vahnau tāpo bhānau śīta bhānauprasādaḥ || puṣpe gaṃdho dugdhamadhyepi sarpiryattacchaṃbho tvaṃ tatastvāṃ prapadye || 129 || śabdaṃ gṛhṇāsyaśravāstvaṃ hi jighreraghrāṇastvaṃ vyaṃghrirāyāsi dūrāt || vyakṣaḥ paśyestvaṃ rasajñopyajihvaḥ kastvāṃ samyagvettyatastvāṃ prapadye || 4.1.10.130 || novedastvāmīśa sākṣāddhivedano vā viṣṇurnovidhātā'khilasya || no yogīṃdrāneṃdramukhyāśca devā bhakto veda tvāmatastvāṃ prapadye || 131 || no te gotraṃ neśajanmāpinākhyāno vā rūpaṃ naiva śīlaṃ na deśaḥ || itthaṃbhūtopīśvarastvaṃ trilokyāḥ sarvānkāmānpūrayestadbhaje tvām || 132 || tvattaḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ hi sarvaṃ smarāre tvaṃ gaurīśastvaṃ ca nagno'tiśāṃtaḥ || tvaṃ vai vṛddhastvaṃ yuvā tvaṃ ca bālastattvaṃ yatkiṃnāsyatastvāṃ natosmi || 133 || stutveti bhūmau nipapāta vipraḥ sa daṃḍavadyāvadatīva hṛṣṭaḥ || tāvatsa bālokhilavṛddhavṛddhaḥ provāca bhūdeva varaṃ vṛṇīhi || 134 || tata utthāya hṛṣṭātmā munirviśvānaraḥ kṛtī || pratyabravītkimajñātaṃ sarvajñasya tava prabho || 135 || sarvāṃtarātmā bhagavānsarvaḥ sarvaprado bhavān || yācñāṃ pratiniyuṃkte māṃ kimīśo dainyakāriṇīm || 136 || iti śrutvā vacastasya devo viśvānarasya ha || śuceḥ śucivratasyāśu śucismitvābravīcchiśuḥ || 137 || bāla uvāca || tvayā śuce śuciṣmatyāṃ yobhilāṣaḥ kṛto hṛdi || acireṇaivakālena sa bhaviṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ || 138 || tava putratvameṣyāmi śuciṣmatyāṃ mahāmate || khyāto gṛhapatirnāmnā śuciḥ sarvāmarapriyaḥ || 139 || abhilāṣāṣṭakaṃ puṇyaṃ stotrametattvayeritam || abdaṃ trikālapaṭhanātkāmadaṃ śivasaṃnidhau || 4.1.10.140 || etatstotrasya paṭhanaṃ putra pautra dhanapradam || sarvaśāṃtikaraṃ cāpi sarvāpatparināśanam || 141 || svargāpavarga saṃpattikārakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || prātarutthāya susnāto liṃgamabhyarcya śāṃbhavam || 142 || varṣaṃ japannidaṃ stotramaputraḥ putravānbhavet || vaiśākhe kārtike māghe viśeṣaniyamairyutaḥ || 143 || yaḥ paṭhetsnānasamaye sa labhetsakalaṃ phalam || kārtikasya tu māsasya prasādādahamavyayaḥ || 144 || tava putratvameṣyāmi yastvanyastatpaṭhiṣyati || abhilāṣāṣṭakamidaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 145 || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena mahāvaṃdhyāprasūtikṛt || striyā vā puruṣeṇāpi niyamālliṃga saṃnidhau || 146 || abdaṃ japtamidaṃ stotraṃ putradaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || ityuktvāṃtardadhe bālaḥ sopi vipro gṛhaṃ gataḥ || 147 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṇḍe pūvārddhe iṃdrāgnilokavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha ||
<4.1.11>
|| agastiruvāca || || śṛṇu suśroṇi subhage vaiśvānarasamudbhavam || puṇyaśīlasuśīlābhyāṃ yathoktaṃ śivaśarmaṇe || 1 || atha kālena tadyoṣidaṃtarvatnī babhūva ha || vi dhivadvihite tena garbhādhānākhya karmaṇi || 2 || tataḥ puṃsavanaṃ tena spaṃdanātprāgvipaścitā || gṛhyoktavidhinā samyakkṛtaṃ puṃstvavivṛddhaye || 3 || sīmantothāṣṭame māsi garbharūpasamṛddhikṛt || sukhaprasava siddhyai ca tenākāri kriyāvidā || 4 || athātaḥ satsutārāsu tārādhipa varānanaḥ || keṃdre gurau śubhe lagne sugraheṣvayugeṣu ca ||5|| ariṣṭaṃ dīpayandīptyā sarvāriṣṭavināśakṛt || tanayo nāma tasyāṃ tu śuciṣmatyāṃ babhūva ha ||6|| sadyaḥ samastasukhado bhūrbhuvaḥsvarnivāsinām || gaṃdhavāhāgandhavāhādigvadhūmukhavāsanāḥ || 7 || iṣṭagandhaprasūnaughairvavarṣuste ghanāghanāḥ || devadundubhayo neduḥ praseduḥ sarvatodiśaḥ ||8|| paritaḥ saritaḥ svacchā bhūtānāṃ mānasaiḥ saha 9 || tamo'tāmyattu nitarāṃ rajopi virajobhavat || 9 || sattvāḥ sattvasamāyuktā vasudhāsīcchubhā tadā || kalyāṇī sarvato vāṇī prāṇinaḥ prīṇayaṃtyabhūt || 4.1.11.10 || tilottamorvaśīraṃbhā prabhā vidyutprabhā śubhā || sumaṃgalā śubhālāpā suśīlāḍyā(?)varāṃganāḥ ||11|| kvaṇatkaṃkaṇa pātrāṇi kṛtvā karatalaṃ mudā || muktamuktāphalāḍhyāni yakṣakardamavaṃti ca || 12 || vajravaidūrya dīpāni haridrā lepanāni ca || gārutmataikarūpāṇi śaṃkhaśuktidadhīni ca || 13 || padmarāgapravālākhyaratnakuṃkumavaṃti ca || gomedapuṣparāgeṃdra nīlasanmālyabhāṃji ca || 14 || vidyādharyaśca kinnaryastathā'maryaḥ sahasraśaḥ || cāmara vyagrahastāgra maṃgaladravyapāṇayaḥ || 15 || gaṃdharvoragayakṣāṇāṃ suvāsinyaḥ śubhasvarāḥ || gāyaṃtyo lalitaṃ gītaṃ tatrājagmuranekaśaḥ || 16 || marīciratri pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ || vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapaścāhaṃ vibhāṃḍo māṃḍavīsutaḥ || 17 || lomaśo lomacaraṇo bharadvājotha gautamaḥ || bhṛgustu gālavo gargo jātūkarṇyaḥ parāśaraḥ || 18 || āpastaṃbo yājñavalkya dakṣavālmīkimudgalāḥ || śātātapaśca likhitaḥ śilādaḥ śaṃkhauṃchabhuk || 15 || jamadagniśca saṃvarto mataṃgo bharatoṃśumān || vyāsaḥ kātyāyanaḥ kutsaḥ śaunakaḥ suśrutaḥ śukaḥ ||4.1.11.20 || ṛṣyaśṛṃgotha durvāsā rucirnāradatuṃburū || uttaṃko vāmadevaśca cyavanositadevalau ||21 || śālaṃkāyanahārī tau viśvāmitrothabhārgavaḥ || mṛkaṃḍaḥ saha putreṇa dālbhya uddālakastathā || 22 || dhaumyopamanyuvatsādyā munayo munikanyakāḥ | tacchāṃtyarthaṃ samājagmurdhanyaṃ viśvānarāśramam || 23 || brahmā bṛhaspatiyuto devo garuḍavāhanaḥ || naṃdi bhṛṃgi samāyukto gauryā saha vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 24 || maheṃdramukhyā gīrvāṇā nāgāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ || ratnānyādāya bahuśaḥ sasaritkā mahābdhayaḥ || 25 || sthāvarā jaṃgamaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā yātāḥ sahasraśaḥ || mahāmahotsave tasminbabhūvākālakaumudī || 26|| jātakarma svayaṃ cakre tasya devaḥ pitāmahaḥ || śrutiṃ vicārya tadrūpāṃ nāmnā gṛhapatistvayam ||27|| iti nāma dadau tasmai deyamekādaśehani || nāmakarmavidhānena tadarthaṃ śrutimuccaran || 28 || ayamagnirgṛhapatirgārhapatyaḥ prajāyā vasuvittamaḥ || agne gṛhapatebhidyumnamabhi saha āyacchasva || 29 || agne gṛhapate sthityā parāmapi nidarśayan || caturnigamamaṃtroktairāśīrbhirabhinaṃdya ca || 4.1.11.30 || kṛtvā bālocitāṃ rakṣāṃ hareṇa hariṇā saha || niryayau haṃsamāruhya sarveṣāṃ prapitāmahaḥ || 31 || ahorūpamaho tejastvaho sarvāṃgalakṣaṇam || aho śuciṣmatībhāgyamāvirāsītsvayaṃ haraḥ || 32 || athavā kimidaṃ citraṃ śarvabhaktajaneṣvaho || āvirbhavetsvayaṃ rudro yatorudrāstadarcakāḥ || 33 || iti stuvaṃtastvanyonyaṃ jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam || viśvānaraṃ samāpṛcchya saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ || 34 || ataḥ putraṃ samīhaṃte gṛhasthāśramavāsinaḥ || putreṇa lokāñjayati śrutireṣā sanātanī || 35 || aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyamaputrasyārjanaṃ vṛthā || aputrasyānvayaśchinno nāpavitraṃ hyaputrataḥ || 36 || na putrātparamo lābho na putrātparamaṃ sukham || na putrātparamaṃ mitraṃ paratreha ca kutracit || 37 || aurasaḥ kṣetrajaḥ krīto dattaḥ prāptaḥ sutāsutaḥ || āpatsurakṣitaścānyaḥ putrāḥ saptātra kīrtitāḥ || 38 || eṣāmanyatamaḥ kāryo gṛhasthena vipaścitā || pūrvapūrvaḥ sutaḥ śreyānhīnaḥsyāduttarottaraḥ || 39 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || niṣkramotha caturthe'sya māsi pitrākṛto gṛhāt || annaprāśanamabdārdhe cūḍābde cārthavatkṛtā || 4.1.11.40 || karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śravaṇarkṣe sakarmavit || brahmatejobhivṛddhyarthaṃ paṃcame'bde vrataṃ dadau || 41 || upākarma tataḥ kṛtvā vedānadhyāpayatsudhīḥ || tryabdaṃ vedānsavidhinā'dhyaiṣṭa sāṃgapadakramān || 42 || vidyājātaṃ samastaṃ ca sākṣimātrādgurormukhāt || vinayādiguṇānāviṣkurvañjagrāha śaktimān || 43 || tatotha navame varṣe pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratam || vaiśvānaraṃ gṛhapatiṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmacaro muniḥ || 44 || viśvānaroṭajaṃ prāpya devarṣirnāradaḥ sudhīḥ || papraccha kuśalaṃ tatra gṛhītārghāsanaḥ kramāt || 45 || || nārada uvāca || || viśvānara mahābhāga śuciṣmati śubhavrate || kurute yuvayorvākyamayaṃ gṛhapatiḥ śiśuḥ || 46 || nānyattīrthaṃ na vā devo na gururna ca satkiyā || vihāya pitrorvacanaṃ nānyo dharmaḥ sutasya hi || 47 || na pitroradhikaṃ kiṃcittrilokyāṃ tanayasya hi || garbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyāṃ piturmātā garīyasī || 48 || aṃbhobhirabhiṣicyasvaṃ jananīcaraṇacyutaiḥ || prāpnuyātsvardhunīśuddha kabaṃdhādhikaśuddhatām || 49 || saṃnyastākhilakarmāpi piturvaṃdyo himaskarī || sarvavaṃdyena yatinā prasūrvaṃdyā prayatnataḥ || 4.1.11.50 || idameva tapotyugramidamevaparaṃ vratam || ayameva paro dharmo yatpitroḥ paritoṣaṇam || 51 || manyemānyo nādhamasya tathānyasya yathā yuvām || sukhākārairvinītasya śiśorgṛhapateraham || 52 || vaiśvānarasamabhyehi mamotsaṃge niṣīda bho || lakṣaṇāni parīkṣehaṃ pāṇiṃ darśaya dakṣiṇam || 53 || ityukto muninā bālaḥ pitrorājñāmavāpya saḥ || praṇamya nāradaṃ śrīmānbhaktyāprahva upāviśat || 54 || tato dṛṣṭvāsya sarvāṃgaṃ tālujihvādvijānapi || ānīya kuṃkumāraktaṃ sūtraṃ ca triguṇīkṛtam || 55 || smṛtvā śivau gaṇādhyakṣamūrdhvībhūtamudaṅmukham || muniḥ parimamau bālamāpādatalamastakam || 56 || tiryagūrdhvaṃ samo māne yoṣṭottaraśatāṃgulaḥ || sa bhavetpṛthivīpālo bālo'yaṃ te yathā dvija || 57 || paṃcasūkṣmaḥ paṃcadīrghaḥ saptaraktaḥ ṣaḍunnataḥ || tripṛthurlaghugaṃbhīro dvātriṃśallakṣaṇastviti || 58 || paṃcadīrghāṇi śasyāni yathādīrghāyuṣosya vai || bhujau netre hanurjānu nāsā'sya tanayasya te || 59 || grīvājaṃghā mehanaiśca tribhirhrasvoyamīḍitaḥ || svareṇa sattvanābhibhyāṃ trigaṃbhīraḥ śiśuḥ śubhaḥ || 4.1.11.60 || tvakkeśāṃgulidaśanāḥ parvāṇyaṃgulijānyapi || tathāsya paṃcasūkṣmāṇi dikpālapadabhāgyathā || 61 || vakṣaḥ kukṣyalakaṃ skaṃdha karaṃ vaktraṃ ṣaḍunnatam || tathā'tra dṛśyate bāle mahadaiśvaryabhāgyathā || 62 || pāṇyostale ca netrāṃte tālujihvādharauṣṭhakam || saptāruṇaṃ ca sanakhamasminrājyasukhapradam || 63 || lalāṭakaṭivakṣobhistrivistīrṇo yathāhyasau || sarvatejotiraiśvaryaṃ tathā prāpsyati nānyathā || 64 || kamaṭhīpṛṣṭhakaṭhināvakarmakaraṇau karau || rājyahetū śiśorasya pādau cādhvani komalau ||65|| acchinnā tarjanīṃ vyāpya tathā rekhāsya dṛśyate || kaniṣṭhā pṛṣṭhaniryātā dīrghāyuṣyaṃ yathārpayet || 66 || pādau sumāṃsalau raktau samau sūkṣmau suśaubhanau || samagulphau svedahīnau snigdhāvaiśvaryasūcakau ||67|| svalpābhiḥ kararekhābhirāraktābhiḥ sadāsukhī || liṃgena kṛśahrasvena rājarājo bhaviṣyati || 68 || utkaṃṭāsanagulphāsphignābhirasyāpi vartulā || dakṣiṇāvartamaruṇaṃ mahadaiśvaryasūcikā || 69|| dhāraikā mūtrayatyasmindakṣiṇāvartinī yadi || gaṃdhaśca mīnamadhunoryadi vīrye tadā nṛpaḥ || 4.1.11.70 || vistīrṇau māṃsalau snigdhau sphicāvasya sukhocitau || vāmāvartau supralaṃbau doṣau digrakṣaṇocitau ||71|| śrīvatsavajracakrābja matsyakodaṃḍadaṃḍabhṛt || tathāsya karagā rekhā yathā syāttridivaspatiḥ || 72 || dvātriṃśaddaśanaścāyaṃ karakaṃbu śirodharaḥ || kauṃcaduṃdubhihaṃsābhra svaraḥ sarveśvarādhikaḥ || 73 || madhupiṃgalanetro'sau nainaṃ śrīstyajati kvacit || paṃcarekhalalāṭastu tathā siṃhodaraḥ śubhaḥ|||74|| ūrdhvarekhāṃkitapado niḥśvasanpadmagaṃdhavān || acchidrapāṇiḥ sunakho mahālakṣaṇavānayam || 75 || kiṃtu sarvaguṇopetaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || saṃpūrṇanirmalakalaṃ pātayedvidhuvadvidhiḥ || 76 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena rakṣaṇīyastvasau śiśuḥ || guṇopi doṣatāṃ yāti vakrībhūte vidhātari || 77 || śaṃke'sya dvādaśevarṣe pratyūho vidyudagnitaḥ || ityuktvā nārado dhīmānsa jagāma yathāgatam || 78 || viśvānaraḥ sapatnīkastacchrutvā nāraderitam || tadaiva manyamānobhūdvajrapātaṃ sudāruṇam || 79 || hāhatosmīti vacasā hṛdayaṃ samatāḍayat || mūrcchāmavāpa mahatīṃ putraśokasamākulaḥ || 4.1.11.80 || śuciṣmatyapi duḥkhārtā rurodātīva duḥsaham || ārtasvareṇa hārāvairatyaṃta vyākuledriyā || 81 || hāśiśo hāguṇanidhe hā piturvākyakāraka || hā kuto maṃdabhāgyāyā jaṭhare me samāgataḥ || 82 || tvadekaputrāṃ hāputrako'tra māṃ trāyate purā || tvadṛte tvadguṇormyāḍhye patitāṃ śokasāgare || 83 || hā bāla hā vimala hā kamalāyatākṣa hā lokalocanacakora kuraṃgalakṣman || hā tāta tāta nayanābja mayūkhamālinhā māturutsavasahasrasukhaikaheto || 84 || hā pūrṇacaṃdramukha hā sunakhāṃgulīka hā cāṭukāravacanāmṛtavīcipūra || duḥkhaiḥ kiyadbhirahahāṃ gamayātvamāptaḥ kiṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ gṛhapate na mayā tvadāptyai || 85 || nopto balirna bata kāsu ca devatā sutīrthāni kāni na mayādhyuṣitāni vatsa || ke ke mayā na niyamauṣadhamaṃtrayaṃtrāḥ saṃsādhitāstava kṛte sukṛtaikalabhya || 86 || saṃsārasāgaratare hara duḥkhabhāraṃ sāraṃ mukheṃdumabhidarśaya saukhyasiṃdho || punnāmatīvranarakārṇava vāḍavāgnessaṃjīvayasva pitaraṃ nijavāksudhokṣaiḥ || 87 || kiṃdevatā ahaha janmamahotsave'sya jñātveti bhāvimilitā yugapatsamastāḥ || ekastha sarvaguṇa śīla kalākalāpa sauṃdaryalakṣaṇaparīkṣaṇapūrṇaharṣāḥ || 88 || śaṃbho maheśa karuṇākara śūlapāṇe mṛtyuṃjayastvamiti vedavido vadaṃti || tvaddatta bālatanaye yadi kālakālaḥ syādevamatra vada kasya bhavenna pātaḥ || 89 || hā haṃtahaṃtabhavatā bhava tāpahārī kasmādvidhe'tra vidadhe bahubhiḥ prayatnaiḥ || bālo viśālaguṇasiṃdhumagādhamadhyaṃ sadratnasāramakhilaṃ savidhaṃ vidhāya || 4.1.11.90 || hā kālabālakavatī kimutena rājñī tvatkālatāṃ na hṛtavānnasutānaneṃduḥ || bāleti komalamṛṇāla latāṃgalīlaṃ daṃbholiniṣṭhurakaṭhorakuṭhāradaṃṣṭraḥ || 91 || itthaṃ vilapya bahuśo nayanāṃbudhārāsaṃpātajāta taṭinī śatamuttaraṃgam || sā tokaśokajanitānala tāpataptā procchvasyadīrghavipuloṣṇamaho śuśoṣa|| 92 || ākarṇya tatkaruṇavatparidevitāni tāni drumā vratatayaḥ kusumāśrupātaiḥ || prāyo rudaṃti patatāṃ virutārtarāvairālolyamaulimasakṛtpavanacchalena || 93 || ruṇṇaṃ tayā kila tathā bahumuktakaṃṭhamārtasvaraiḥ pratiravacchalato yathoccaiḥ || tadduḥkhatonururudurgirikaṃdarāsyāḥ sarvā diśaḥ sthagitapatrimṛgāgamā hi || 94 || śrutvārtanādamiti viśvanaropi mohaṃ hitvotthitaḥ kimiti kiṃtviti kiṃkimetat || uccairvadangṛhapatiḥ kva same bahisthaḥ prāṇoṃtarātmanilayaḥ sakaleṃdriyeśaḥ || 95 || agastya uvāca || || tato dṛṣṭvā sa pitarau bahuśokasamāvṛtau || smitvovāca tato mātastrāsastvīdṛkkuto hi vām ||96|| na māṃkṛta vapustrāṇaṃ bhavaccaraṇareṇubhiḥ || kālaḥ kalayituṃ śakto varākī caṃcalālpikā || 97 || pratijñāṃ śṛṇutaṃ tātau yadi vāṃ tanayo hyaham || kariṣyehaṃ tathā tena vidyunmattastrasiṣyati || 98 || mṛtyuṃjayaṃ samārādhya sarvajñaṃ sarvadaṃ satām || kālakālaṃ mahākālaṃ kālakūṭaviṣādinam || 99 || iti śrutvā vacastasya jaritau dvijadaṃpatī || akālāmṛtavarṣaugha śāṃtatāpau tadocatuḥ || 4.1.11.100 || apayodapayovṛṣṭiradugdhābdhiḥ sudhodayaḥ || aniṃduḥ kaumudīkāṃtiḥ kuto nau sukhayatyalam || 101 || punarbrūhipunarbrūhi kīdṛkkīdṛkpunaḥpunaḥ || kālaḥ kalayituṃ nālaṃ varākī caṃcalālpikā ||102|| āvayostāpanāśāya mahopāyastvayeritaḥ || mṛtyuṃjayasya devasya samārādhanalakṣaṇaḥ|| 103 || tadgaccha śaraṇaṃ tāta nātaḥ parataraṃ hitam || manorathapathātīta kāriṇaḥ kālahāriṇaḥ || 104 || kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā tāta śvetaketu yathā purā || pāśitaṃ kālapāśena rarakṣa tripurāṃtakaḥ || 105 || śilādatanayaṃ mṛtyugrastamaṣṭābdamarbhakam || śivo nijajanaṃ cakre naṃdinaṃ viśvanaṃdinam || 106 || kṣīrodamathanodbhūtapralayānalasaṃnibham || pītvā hālāhalaṃ ghoramarakṣadbhuvanatrayam || 107 || jālaṃdharaṃ mahādarpaṃ hṛtatrailokyasaṃpadam || caraṇāṃguṣṭharekhotthacakreṇanijaghānayaḥ || 108 || ya ekeṣu nipātottha jvalanaistripuraṃ purā || vidhāya patriṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ jvālayāmāsa dhūrjaṭiḥ || 109 || aṃdhakaṃ yastriśūlāgraprotaṃ varṣāyutaṃ purā || trailokyaiśvaryasaṃmūḍhaṃ śoṣayāmāsa bhānunā|| 4.1.11.110 || kāmaṃ dṛṣṭinipātena trailokyavijayorjitam || nināyānaṃgapadavīṃ vīkṣamāṇeṣvajādiṣu || 111 || taṃ brahmādyekakartāraṃ meghavāhanamacyutam || prayāhi putra śaraṇaṃ viśvarakṣāmaṇiṃ śivam || 112 || pitroranujñāṃ prāpyeti praṇamya caraṇau tayoḥ || pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya bahvāśvāsya viniryayau || 113 || sa prāpya kāśīṃ duṣprāpāṃ brahmanārāyaṇādibhiḥ || mahāsaṃvartasaṃvṛtta tāpādviśveśapālitām || 114 || phirasvardhunyā hārayaṣṭyeva rājitāṃ kaṃṭhabhūmiṣu || vicitraguṇaśālinyāhāranīhāragaurayā || 115 || bahusaṃsārasaṃtāpasaṃtaptajanatodbhavam || vārayaṃtīṃ varaṇayā chiṃdaṃtīmasidhārayā || 116 || yallabhyate ca kaivalyaṃ sudṛḍhāṣṭāṃgayogataḥ || vikāsayaṃtīṃ tatsamyakkāśikāṃyāṃjagurbudhāḥ || || 117 || saṃsāratāpataptābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ sa dṛṣṭavān || karṇākarṇaprakīrṇābhyāṃ prāgyayau maṇikarṇikām || 118 || tatra snātvā vidhānena dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ vibhum || trailokyaprāṇisaṃtrāṇakāriṇaṃ praṇanāma ha || 119 || ālokyālokya talliṃgaṃ tutoṣa hṛdaye bahu || paramānaṃdakaṃdākhyaṃ sphuṭametanna saṃśayaḥ || 4.1.11.120 || aho na matto dhanyosti trailokye sacarācare || yadadrākṣiṣamadyāhaṃ śrīmadviśveśvaraṃ vibhum ||121|| trilokīsārasarvasvaṃ piṃḍībhūtamidaṃ kila || kiṃ vā pīyūṣapiṃḍoyamudgataḥ kṣīranīradheḥ ||122 || ātmāvabodhamahasaḥ kimasau prathamāṃkuraḥ || brahmānaṃda sukaṃdo vā kimu brahmarasāyanam || 123 || yogihṛtpadmanilayaṃ yadanākāramucyate || tadākāratvamāpede kimidaṃ liṃgakaitavāt || 124 || brahmāṃḍabhāṃḍamathavā nānā ratnaughapūritam || athavā mokṣavṛkṣasya phalametannasaṃśayaḥ || 125 || nirvāṇalakṣmyāḥ kimatha keśapāśaḥ supuṣpayuka || kaivalyamallīvallyāḥ kiṃstabakaḥ stāvakārthadaḥ || 126 || niḥśreyasaśriyaḥ kiṃvā''naṃdakrīḍanakaṃdukaḥ || apavargo dayādreḥ kimudiyāya sudhākaraḥ || 127 || saṃsāramohatimirabhiduraḥkimasau raviḥ || kimu kalyāṇaramaṇīramyaśṛṃgāradarpaṇaḥ || 128 || ājñātaṃ nabhavedanyatsarveṣāṃ dehadhāriṇām || anekakarmabījānāṃ bījapūro'yamadbhutaḥ ||129|| viśveṣāṃ viśvabījānāṃ karmākhyānāṃ layo yataḥ || asminnirvāṇade liṃge viśvaliṃgamidaṃ tataḥ || 4.1.11.130 || mama bhāgyodayenaiva nāradena maharṣiṇā || tadāgatya tathoktaṃ yatkṛtakṛtyosmyahaṃ tataḥ || 131 || ityānaṃdāmṛtarasairvidhāyasahi pāraṇam || tataḥśubhe'hni saṃsthāpya liṃgaṃ sarvahitapradam || 132 || jagrāha niyamānghorānduṣkarānakṛtātmanām || aṣṭottaraśataiḥ kuṃbhaiḥ pūrṇairgaṃgāmṛtodravaiḥ || 133 || saṃsnāpya vāsasā pūtaiḥ pūtātmā pratyahaṃ śivam || nīlotpalamayīṃ mālāṃ samarpayati so'nvaham || 134 || aṣṭādhikasahasraistu sumanobhirvinirmitām || sapakṣārdhena ṣaṇmāsaṃ kaṃdamūlaphalāśanaḥ||135|| śīrṇaparṇāśanaḥ pakṣe tvāṣaṇmāsaṃ babhūva saḥ || ṣaṇmāsaṃ vāyubhakṣobhūtṣaṇmāsaṃ jalabiṃdubhuk ||136|| evaṃ varṣadvayaṃ tasya vyatikrāṃtaṃ tathā sataḥ || janmato dvādaśe varṣe tadvaco nāraderitam || 137 || satyaṃ kariṣyannivatamabhyagātkuliśāyudhaḥ || uvāca ca varaṃ brūhi dadmi tanmanasi sthitam ||138|| ahaṃ śatakraturvipra prasannosmi śubhavrataiḥ || ityākarṇya maheṃdrasya vākyaṃ munikumārakaḥ||139|| uvāca madhuraṃ dhīraḥ kīravanmadhurākṣaram|| maghavanvṛtraśatro tvāṃ jāne kuliśapāṇinam || 4.1.11.140 || nāhaṃ vṛṇe varaṃ tvattaḥ śaṃkaro varadosti me || 141 || iṃdra uvāca || na mattaḥ śaṃkarostvanyo devadevosmyahaṃ śiśo || vihāya bāliśatvaṃ tvaṃ varayācasva māṃ varam || 142 || brāhmaṇa uvāca || gacchāhalyāpate'sādho gotrāre pākaśāsana || na prārthaye paśupateranyadevāṃtaraṃ sphuṭam ||143|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || udyamya kuliśaṃ ghoraṃ bhīṣayāmāsa bālakam ||144|| sa dṛṣṭvā bālako vajraṃ vidyujjvālāśatākulam || smarannāradavākyaṃ ca mumūrccha bhayavihvalaḥ || 145 || atha gaurīpatiḥ śaṃbhurāvirāsīttamonudaḥ || uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te sparśaiḥ saṃjīvayanniva || 146 || unmīlya netrakamale supte iva divākṣaye || apaśyadagre cotthāya śaṃbhumarkaśatādhikam || 147 || bhāle locanamālokya kaṃṭhe kālaṃ vṛṣadhvajam || vāmāṃgasaṃniviṣṭādritanayaṃ caṃ draśekharam || 148 || kapardena virājaṃtaṃ triśūlājagavāyudham || sphuratkarpūragaurāṃgaṃ pariṇaddha gajājinam ||149|| parijñāya mahādevaṃ guruvākyata āgamāt || harṣa bāṣpākulaḥ sanna kaṭho romāṃcakaṃcukaḥ || 4.1.11.150 || kṣaṇaṃsthagitavattasthau citrakṛtrimaputrakaḥ || yathātathā susaṃpanno vismṛtyātmānameva ca || 151 || na stotuṃ na namaskartuṃ kiṃcidvijñaptumeva ca || yadāsanaśaśākālaṃ tadā smitvā''ha śaṃkaraḥ || 152 || īśvara uvāca || śiśo gṛhapate śakrādvajrodyataparādaho || jñāto bhītosi mā bhaiṣīrjijñāsā te kṛtā mayā || 153 || mama bhaktasya no śakro na vajraṃ nāṃtakopi vā || prabhavediṃdrarūpeṇa mayaiva tvaṃ hi bhāṣitaḥ || 154 || varaṃ dadāmi te bhadra tvamagnipadabhāgbhava || sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ vadanaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ||155|| sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ tvamagneṃ'taścaro bhava || dharmarājeṃdrayormadhye digīśo rājyamāpnuhi ||156 || tvayedaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati || agnīśvaraṃ iti khyātaṃ sarvatejobhibṛṃhaṇam || 157 || agnīśvarasya bhaktānāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyudagnijam || agnimāṃdya bhayaṃ naiva nākālamaraṇaṃ kvacit || 158 || agnīśvaraṃ samabhyarcya kāśyāṃ sarvasamṛddhidam || anyatrāpi mṛto daivādagniloke mahīyate ||159|| tataḥ kāśīṃ punaḥ prāpya kalpāṃte mokṣamāpnuyāt || vīreśvarasya pūrveṇa gaṃgāyāḥ paścime taṭe || 4.1.11.160 || agnīśvaraṃ samārādhya vahniloke vasennaraḥ || pitṛbhyāṃ svajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ mitrabaṃdhusamāyutaḥ || 161 || vimānamidamāruhya prayāhyeva diśaḥpate || ityuktvānīya tadbaṃdhūn pitrośca paripaśyatoḥ || dikpatitve'bhiṣicyāgniṃ tatra liṃge śivoviśat || 162 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || itthamagnisvarūpaṃ te śivaśarmanpravarṇitam || kimanyacchrotukāmosi kathayāvastadīraya || 163 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvāddheṃ vahnilokavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<4.1.12>
śivaśarmovāca || nairṛtādīn kramāllokānākhyātaṃ puruṣottamau || puruṣottamapādābjaparāgoddhūsarālakau || 1 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || ākarṇaya mahābhāga saṃyaminyāḥ purīṃ parām || dikpaternirṛtasyāsau puṇyāpuṇyajanoṣitā || 2 || rākṣasānivasaṃtyasyāmaparadrohiṇaḥ sadā || jātimātreṇa rakṣāṃsi vṛttaiḥ puṇyajanā ime || 3 || smṛtyuktaśrutivartmāno jātavarṇāvareṣvapi || nādriyaṃte'nnapānānāmasmṛtyuktaṃ kadācana || 4 || paradāra paradravya paradrohaparāṅmukhāḥ || jātājātau nikṛṣṭāyāmapipuṇyānusāriṇaḥ || 5 || dvijātibhaktyutpannārthairātmānaṃ poṣayaṃti ye || sadā saṃkucitāṃgāśca dvijasaṃbhāṣaṇādiṣu || 6 || āhūtā vastravadanā vadaṃti dvijasaṃnidhau || jayajīvabhagonātha svāminniti hi vādinaḥ || 7 || tīrthasnānaparānityaṃ nityaṃ devaparāyaṇāḥ || dvijeṣu nityaṃ praṇatāḥ svanāmākhyānapūrvakam || 8 || dama dāna dayā kṣāṃti śauceṃdriya vinigrahāḥ || asteya satyāhiṃsāśca sarveṣāṃ dharmahetavaḥ || 9 || āvaśyeṣu sadodyuktā ye jātā yatrakutracit || sarvabhogasamṛddhāste vasaṃtyatra purottame ||4.1.12.10|| mlecchā api sutīrtheṣu ye mṛtānātmaghātakāḥ || vihāya kāśīṃ nirvāṇa viśrāṇāṃte'tra bhoginaḥ || || 11 || aṃdhaṃ tamo viśeyuste ye caivātmahano janāḥ || bhuktvā nirayasāhasraṃ te ca syurgrāmasūkarāḥ || 12 || ātmaghāto na kartavyastasmātkvāpi vipaścitā || ihāpi ca paratrāpi na śubhānyātmaghātinām || 13 || yatheṣṭamaraṇaṃ kecidāhustattvāvabodhakāḥ || prayāge sarvatīrthānāṃ rājñisarvābhilāṣade || 14 || aṃtyajā api ye keciddayādharmānusāriṇaḥ || paropakṛtiniṣṭhāste vasaṃtyatra tu sattamāḥ || 15 || asya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāvo dikpateḥ kṣaṇataḥ śṛṇu || madhye viṃdhyāṭavi purā pakkaṇasthajanāgraṇīḥ || 15 || pallīpatirabhūdugraḥ piṃgākṣa iti viśrutaḥ || nirviṃdhyāyāstaṭe śūraḥ krūrakarmaparāṅmukhaḥ || 17 || ghātayeddūrasaṃsthopi yaḥ pāṃthaparipaṃthinaḥ || vyāghrādīn duṣṭasattvāṃśca sa hinasti prayatnataḥ || 18 || jīvenmṛgayu dharmeṇa tatrāpi karuṇāparaḥ || na viśvastānpakṣimṛgānna suptānna vyavāyinaḥ || 19 || na toyagṛdhnūnna śiśūnnāṃtarvartnitvalakṣaṇān || sa ghātayati dharmajño jātidharmaparāṅmukhaḥ || 4.1.12.20 || śramāturebhyaḥ pāṃthebhyaḥ sa viśrāmaṃ prayacchati || haretkṣudhā kṣudhārtānāmupānaddo'nupānahe || 21 || mṛgattvacotimṛdulā vivastrebhyātisarjati || anuvrajati kāṃtāre prāṃtare pathikānpathi || 22 || na jighṛkṣati tebhyorthamabhayaṃ ceti yacchati || āviṃdhyāṭavi me nāma grāhyaṃ duṣṭabhayāpaham || 23 || nityaṃ kārpaṭikānsarvān sa putreṇa prapaśyati || tepi ca pratitīrthaṃ hi tamāśīrvādayaṃ ti vai ||24|| iti tiṣṭhati piṃgākṣe sāṭavī nagarāyitā || adhvanīne 'dhvagānkopi na ruṇaddhi sasādhvasaḥ ||25|| kadācittatpitṛvyeṇa samīpa grāmavāsinā || śrutaḥ kārpaṭikānāṃ hi sārthaḥ sārtho mahāsvanaḥ || 205 || lubdhakastaddhane lubdhaḥ kṣudrastannidhanodyataḥ || sa rurodha tamadhvānamagre gatvā'tigūḍhavat || 27 || tadā yupyasyaśeṣeṇa piṃgākṣo mṛgayāṃ gataḥ || tasminnaraṇye tanmārgaṃ nikaṣādhyuṣito niśi || 28 || paraprāṇadruhāṃ puṃsāṃ na siddhyeyurmanorathāḥ || viśvaṃ kuśalitenaitadviśveśaparirakṣitam || 29 || na ciṃtayedaniṣṭāni tasmātkṛṣṭiḥ kadācana || vidhidṛṣṭaṃ yato bhāvi kaluṣaṃbhāvi kevalam ||4.1.12.30|| tasmādātmasukhaṃprepsu riṣṭāniṣṭaṃ na ciṃtayet || ciṃtayeccettadāciṃtyo mokṣopāyo na cetaraḥ ||31|| vyuṣṭāyāmathayāminyāmabhūtkolāhalo mahān || ghātayadhvaṃ pātayadhvaṃ nagnayadhvaṃ drutaṃ bhaṭāḥ ||32|| mā mārayadhvaṃ trāyadhvaṃ bhaṭāḥ kārpaṭikā vayam || anāyāsaṃ luṃṭhayadhvaṃ nayadhvaṃ ca yadasti naḥ || 33 || vayaṃ pāṃthā anāthāḥ smo viśvanāthaparāyaṇāḥ || sanāthāste na dūraṃ sanāthatāṃ pathiko'paraḥ || 34 || vayaṃ piṃgākṣaviśvāsādasminmārge'kutobhayāḥ || yātāyātaṃ sadā kurmaḥ sa ca dūra ito vanāt ||35|| iti śrutvā'tha piṃgākṣo bhaṭaḥ kārpaṭikeritama || dūrānmā bhaiṣṭa mābhaiṣṭa bruvanniti samāgataḥ || 36 || tatkarmasūtrairākṛṣṭo bhillaḥkārpaṭikapriyaḥ || tūrṇaṃ tadāyuṣyamiva tatropasthitavān kṣaṇāt || 37 || koyaṃkoyaṃ durācāraḥ piṃgākṣe mayi jīvati || ulluluṃṭhayiṣuḥ pāṃthānprāṇaliṃgasamānmama || 38 || iti tadvākyamākarṇya tārākṣastatpitṛvyakaḥ || dhanalobhena piṃgākṣe pāpaṃ pāpo vyaciṃtayat ||39|| kuladharmaṃ vyapāsyaiṣa vartate kulapāṃsanaḥ || ciraṃ ciṃtitamadyāmuṃ ghātayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 4.1.12.40 || vicāryeti sa duṣṭātmā bhṛtyānājñāpayatkrudhā || ādāvenaṃ ghātayaṃtu tataḥ kārpaṭikānimān || 41 || tato 'yudhyandurācārāstenaikena ca te'khilāḥ || yathākathaṃcittānanayatsa ca svāvasathāṃtikam || 42 || ācchinnaṃ hi dhanurvāṇaṃ chinnaṃ sannahanaṃ śaraiḥ || asūdayiṣyametāṃstadabhaviṣyaṃ yadīśvaraḥ || 43 || abhilapyanniti prāṇānatyākṣītsa parārthataḥ || tepi kārpaṭikāḥ prāptāstatpallīṃ gatasādhvasāḥ || 44 || yā matistvaṃtakāle syādgatistadanurūpataḥ || digīśatvamataḥ prāpto nirṛtyāṃ nairṛteśvaraḥ || 45 || itthamasya svarūpaṃ te āvābhyāṃ samudīritam || etasyottarato loko varuṇasyāyamadbhutaḥ ||46|| kūpavāpītaḍāgānāṃ kartāro nirmalairdhanaiḥ || iha loke mahīyaṃte vāruṇe varuṇaprabhāḥ ||47|| nirjale jaladātāraḥ parasaṃtāpahāriṇaḥ || arthibhyo ye prayacchaṃti citracchatrakamaṃḍalūn ||48|| pānīyaśālikāḥ kuryurnānopaskarasaṃyutāḥ || dadyurdharmaghaṭāṃścāpi sugaṃdhodakapūritān ||49|| aśvatthasekaṃ ye kuryuḥ pathi pādaparopakāḥ || viśrāmaśālākartāraḥ śrāṃtasaṃtāpanodakāḥ ||4.1.12.50|| grīṣmoṣprahaṃti māyūrapicchādi racitānyapi || citrāṇi tālavṛṃtāni vitaraṃti tapāgame ||51|| rasavaṃti sugaṃdhīni himavaṃti tapartuṣu || viśrāṇayaṃti vā tṛpti pānakāni prayatnataḥ || 52 || ikṣukṣetrāṇi saṃkalpya brāhmaṇebhyo dadatyapi || tathā nānāprakārāṃśca vikārānaikṣavānbahūn || 53 || gorasānāṃ pradātārastathā gomahiṣīpradāḥ || dhārāmaṃḍapakartāraśchāyāmaṃḍapakāriṇaḥ ||54|| devālayeṣu ye dadyurbahudhārāgalaṃtikāḥ || tīrthe vā karahartārastīrthamārgāvanejakā. || 55 || abhayaṃ ye prayacchaṃti bhayārtodyata pāṇayaḥ || nirbhayā vāruṇe loke te vasaṃti lasaṃti ca || 56 || vipāśayaṃti ye puṇyā durvṛtaiḥ kaṃṭhapāśitān || te pāśapāṇe lokesminnivasaṃtyakutobhayāḥ || 57 || naukādyupāyairna dyādau pāṃthānye tārayaṃtyapi || tārayaṃtyapi duḥkhābdhestatra nāgarikā dvija ||58 || ghaṭṭānpuṇyataṭinyāderbaṃdhayaṃti śilādibhiḥ || toyārthisukhasiddhyarthaṃ ye narāstetra bhoginaḥ || 59 || vitarpayaṃti ye puṇyāstṛṣitāñśītalairjalaiḥ || te'tra vai vāruṇe loke sukhasaṃtatibhāginaḥ || 4.1.12.60 || jalāśayānāṃ sarveṣāmayamekatamaḥ patiḥ || pracetā yādasāṃnāthaḥ sākṣī sarveṣukarmasu || 61 || asyotpattiṃ śṛṇu patervaruṇasyamahātmanaḥ || āsīnmunirameyātmā kardamasya prajāpateḥ || 62|| śuciṣmāniti vikhyātastanayo vinayocitaḥ || sthairya mādhurya dhairyādyairguṇairupacitohitaḥ || 63 || acchode sarasi snātuṃ sa gato bālakaiḥ saha || jalakrīḍanasaṃsaktaṃ śiśumāro haracca tam ||64|| tatastasminmunisute hṛte'tyāhitaśaṃsibhiḥ || taiḥ samāgatya śiśubhiḥ kathitaṃ tatpituḥ puraḥ || 65 || harārcanopaviṣṭasya samādhau niścalātmanaḥ || śrutabālavipatteśca cacāla na manoharāt || 66 || adhikaṃ śīlayāmāsa sa sarvajñaṃ trilocanam || paśyañśaṃbhoḥ samīpe sa bhuvanāni caturdaśa || 67 || nānā bhūtāni bhūtāni brahmāṃḍāṃtargatāni ca || caṃdrasūryarkṣatārāśca parvatānsarito drumān || 68 || samudrānaṃtarīyāṇi hyaraṇyānīssarāṃsi ca || nānā devanikāyāṃśca bahvīrdiviṣadāṃ purīḥ || 69 || vāpīkūpataḍāgāni kulyāḥ puṣkariṇīrbahu || ekasminkvāpi sarasi jalakrīḍāparāyaṇān || 4.1.12.70 || bahūnmunikumārāṃśca majjanonmajjanādibhiḥ || karayaṃtravinirmuktatoyadhārābhiṣecanaiḥ || 71 || karatāḍitapānīyaśabdadiṅmukhanādibhiḥ || jalakhelanakairitthaṃ saṃsaktānbahubālakān ||72|| teṣāṃ madhye dadarśātha samādhisthaḥ sa kardamaḥ || svaṃ śiśuṃ śiśumāreṇa nīyamānaṃ suvihvalam || 73 || kayācijjaladevyātha tasmāccakrūrayādasaḥ || prasahya nītvodadhaye dṛṣṭavāṃstaṃ samarpitam || 74 || nirbhartsya saritāṃnāthaṃ kenacidrudrarūpiṇā || triśūlapāṇinetyuktaṃ krodhatāmrānanenaca || 75 || kuto jalānāmadhipa śivabhaktasya bālakaḥ || prajāpateḥ kardamasya mahābhāgasya dhīmataḥ || 76|| ajñātvā śivasāmarthyaṃ bhavatāciramāsitaḥ || bhayatrastena tadvākyaśravaṇāttamudanvatā ||77|| bālaṃ ratnairalaṃkṛtya baddhvā taṃ śiśumārakam || samarpitaṃ samānīya śaṃbhupādābjasaṃnidhau || || 78 || natvā vijñāpayattaṃ ca nāparādhyāmyahaṃ vibho || anāthanāthaviśveśa bhaktāpattivināśana || 79 || bhaktakalpataro śaṃbho'nenāyaṃ duṣṭayādasā || anāyina mayā nātha bhavadbhaktajanārbhakaḥ || 4.1.12.80 || gaṇena tena vijñāya śaṃbhoratha manogatam || pāśena baddhvā tadyādaḥ śiśuhaste samarpitam || 81 || gṛhāṇemaṃ svatanayaṃ pārṣade śaṃkarājñayā || yāhi svabhavanaṃ vatsa bruvatīti sa kardamaḥ || 82|| samādhisamaye sarvamiti śṛṇvannudāradhīḥ|| unmīlya nayane yāvatpraṇidhānaṃ visṛjya ca||83|| saṃpaśyate śiśuṃ tāvatpurataḥ samavaikṣata || gṛhītaśiśumāraṃ ca pārśve'laṃkṛtakarṇikam || 84 || toyārdrakākapakṣāgraṃ kaṣāyanayanāṃcalam || kiṃcidvirūkṣaṃ tvakkṣobhaṃ saṃbhramāpannamānasam || 85 || kṛtapraṇāmamāliṃgya jighraṃstanmukhapaṃkajam || punarjātamivāmaṃsta paśyaṃścāpi muhurmuhuḥ || 86 || śatānipaṃcavarṣāṇi praṇidhānasthitasya hi || kardamasya vyatītāni śaṃbhumarcayatastadā || 87 || kardamopi ca tatkālamajñāsītkṣaṇasaṃgatam || yato na prabhavetkālo mahākālasya saṃnidhau || 88 || tatastaṃ tanayaḥ pṛṣṭvā pitaraṃ praṇipatya ca || jagāma tūrṇaṃ tapase śrīmadvārāṇasīṃ purīm || 89 || tatra taptvā tapo ghoraṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya śāṃbhavam || paṃcavarṣasahasrāṇi sthitaḥ pāṣāṇaniścalaḥ || 4.1.12.90 || āvirāsīnmahādevastuṣṭastattapasā tataḥ || uvāca kārdame brūhi kaṃ dadāmi varottamam || 91 || kārdamiruvāca || || yadi nātha prasannosi bhaktānāmanukaṃpaka || sarvāsāmādhipatyaṃ me dehyapāṃ yādasāmapi || 92 || iti śrutvā maheśānaḥ sarvaciṃtitadaḥ prabhuḥ || abhyaṣiṃcata taṃ tatra vāruṇe parame pade || 93 || ratnānāmabdhijātānāmabdhīnāṃ saritāmapi || sarasāṃ palvalānāṃ ca vāpyaṃbu srotasā punaḥ || 94 || jalāśayānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratīcyāścāpi vaidiśaḥ || adhīśvaraḥ pāśapāṇirbhava sarvāmarapriyaḥ || 95 || dadāmi varamanyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ hitakārakam || tvayaitatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati || 96 || varuṇeśamiti khyātaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ susiddhidam || maṇikarṇeśa liṃgasya nairṛtyāṃ diśi saṃsthitam || 97 || ārādhitaṃ sadā puṃsāṃ sarvajāḍyavināśakṛt || varuṇeśasya ye bhaktā na teṣāmabbhayaṃ kvacit || 98 || na saṃtāpabhayaṃ teṣāṃ nāpāyamaraṇaṃ kvacit || jalodarabhayaṃ naiva na bhayaṃ vai tṛṣaḥ kvacit || 99 || nīrasānyannapānāni varuṇeśvara saṃsmṛteḥ || sarasāni bhaviṣyaṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 4.1.12.100 || ityuktvāṃtardadhe śaṃbhurvaruṇopi svabaṃdhubhiḥ || imaṃ lokamalaṃkurvaṃstadārabhya sthito dvijaḥ || 101 || idaṃ varuṇalokasya svarūpaṃ te nirūpitam || yacchrutvā na naraḥ kvāpi durapāyaiḥ prabādhyate || 102 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvāddhe nirṛtivaruṇalokavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || cha ||
<4.1.13>
gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || imāṃ gaṃdhavatīṃ puṇyāṃ purīṃ vāyorvilokaya || vāruṇyā uttare bhāge mahābhāgyanidhe dvija || 1 || asyāṃ prabhaṃjano nāma jagatprāṇodigīśvaraḥ || ārādhya śrīmahādevaṃ dikpālatvamavāptavān || 2 || purā kaśyapadāyādaḥ pūtātmeti ca viśrutaḥ || dhūrjaṭe rājadhānyāṃ sa cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 3 || vārāṇasyāṃ mahābhāgo varṣāṇāmayutaṃ śatam || sthāpayitvā mahāliṃgaṃ pāvanaṃ pavaneśvaram || 4 || yasya darśanamātreṇa pūtātmā jāyate naraḥ || pāpakaṃcukamutsṛjya sa vasetpāvane pure || 5 || tatastasyogratapasā tapasāphaladaḥ śivaḥ || āvirāsīttato liṃgājjyotīrūpo maheśvaraḥ || 5 || uvāca ca prasannātmā karuṇāmṛtasāgaraḥ || uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha pūtātmanvaraṃ varaya suvrata || 7 || anena tapasogreṇa liṃgasyārādhanena ca || tavādeyaṃ na pūtātmaṃstrailokye sacarācare ||8|| || pūtātmovāca || devadevamahādeva devānāmabhayaprada || brahmanārāyaṇeṃdrādi sarvadevapadaprada || 9 || vedāstvāṃ na ca viṃdaṃti kimātmaka iti prabho|| prāptāḥ śatapathatvaṃ ca netinetītivādinaḥ ||4.1.13.10|| brahmaviṣṇvopi girāṃ gocaro na ca vākpateḥ|| pramatheśaṃ kathaṃ stotuṃ mādṛśaḥ prabhavetprabho ||11|| prasahya pramimīteśa bhaktirmāṃstutikarmaṇi || karomi kiṃ jagannātha na vaśyānīṃdriyāṇi me || 12 || viśvaṃ tvaṃ nāsti vai bhedastvamekaḥ sarvago yataḥ || stutyaṃ stotā stutistvaṃ ca saguṇo nirguṇo bhavān ||13|| sargātpurā bhavāneko rūpanāma vivarjitaḥ || yoginopi na te tattvaṃ viṃdaṃti paramārthataḥ || 14 || yadaikalo na śaknoṣi raṃtuṃ svairacara prabho || tadicchā tavayotpannā sevyā śaktirabhūttava || 15 || tvameko dvitvamāpannaḥ śivaśaktiprabhedataḥ || tvaṃ jñānarūpo bhagavānsvecchā śaktisvarūpiṇī || 16 || ubhābhyāṃ śivaśaktibhyā yuvābhyāṃ nijalīlayā || utpāditā kriyāśaktistataḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat || 17 || jñānaśaktirbhavānīśa icchāśaktirumā smṛtā || kriyāśaktiridaṃ viśvamasya tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ tataḥ || 18 || dakṣiṇāṃgaṃ tava vidhirvāmāṃgaṃ tava cācyutaḥ || caṃdrasūryāgninetrastvaṃ tvanniḥśvāsaḥ śrutitrayam || 19 || tvatsvedādaṃbunidhayastava śrotraṃ samīraṇaḥ || bāhavaste daśadiśo mukhaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 4.1.13.20 || rājanyavaryāste bāhu vaiśyā ūrusamudbhavāḥ || padbhyāṃ śūdrastaveśāna keśāste jaladāḥ prabho || 21 || tvaṃ puṃ prakṛtirūpeṇa brahmāṃḍamasṛjaḥ purā|| madhye brahmāṃḍamakhilaṃ viśvametaccarācaram|| 22 || atastvatto na manye'haṃ kiṃcidbhinnaṃ jaganmaya || tvayi sarvāṇi bhūtāni sarvabhūtamayo bhavān || 23 || namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namastu'bhyaṃ namonamaḥ || ayameva varo nātha tvayi me'stu sthirā matiḥ || 24 || ityuktavati deveśa stasminpūtātmani prabhuḥ || svamūrtitvaṃ samāropya dikpālapadamādadhe || 25 || sarvago mama rūpeṇa sarvatattvāvabodhakaḥ || sarveṣāmāyuṣorūpaṃ bhavāneva bhaviṣyati || 26 || tava liṃgamidaṃ divyaṃ ye drakṣyaṃtīha mānavāḥ || sarvabhogasamṛddhāste tvallokasukhabhāginaḥ || 27 || pavamāneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ madhye janmasakṛnnaraḥ || yathoktavidhinā pūjya sugaṃdhasnapanādibhiḥ || 28 || sugaṃdhacaṃdanaiḥ puṣpairmama loke mahīyate || jyeṣṭheśātpaścimebhāge vāyukuṃḍottareṇa tu || 29 || pāvamānaṃ samārādhya pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || iti dattvā varāndevastasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yayau ||4.1.13.30|| gaṇāvūcatuḥ || iti gaṃdhavatī puryāḥ svarūpaṃ te nirūpitam || tasyāḥ prācyāṃ kuberasya śrīmatyeṣālakāpurī || 31 || śaṃbhoḥ sakhitvamāpede nāthosyā bhaktiyogataḥ || nidhīnāṃ padmamukhyānāṃ dātā bhoktā harārcanāt || 32 || || śivaśarmovāca || || kosau kasya punaḥ kīdṛgbhaktirasya sadāśive || yayā sakhitvamāpanno devadevasyadhūrjaṭeḥ || 33 || iti śrotuṃ mama manaḥ śrutigocaratāṃ gatam || yuvayorvāksudhāsvāda medurodaramaṃtharam || 34 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || śivaśarmanmahāprājña pariśuddheṃdriyeśvara || sutīrthakṣālitāśeṣajanmajātamahāmala || 35 || suhṛdi premasaṃpanne tvayyanudyaṃ na kiṃcana || sādhubhiḥ saha saṃvādaḥ sarvaśreyo'bhivṛddhaye || 36 || āsītkāṃpilyanagare somayājikulodbhavaḥ || dīkṣito yajñadattākhyo yajñavidyāviśāradaḥ || 37 || vedavedāṃgavedārthānvedoktācāracaṃcuraḥ || rājamānyo bahudhano vadānyaḥ kīrtibhājanam || 38 || agniśuśrūṣaṇarato vedādhyayanatatparaḥ || tasya putro guṇanidhiścaṃdrabiṃbasamākṛtiḥ || 39 || kṛtopanayanaḥ sotha vidyāṃ jagrāha bhūriśaḥ || atha pitrānabhijñāto dyūtakarmarato'bhavat || 4.1.13.40 || ādāyādāya bahuśo dhanaṃ mātuḥ sakāśataḥ || dadāti dyūtakārebhyo maitrī taiśca cakāra saḥ || 41 || saṃtyakta brāhmaṇācāraḥ saṃdhyāsnānaparāṅmukhaḥ || niṃdako vedaśāstrāṇāṃ devabrāhmaṇaniṃdakaḥ |||42||| smṛtyācāravihīnastu gītavādyavinodabhāk || naṭapākhaṃḍibhaṃḍaiśca baddhapremaparaṃparaḥ || 43 || preritopi jananyā sa na yāti pituraṃtikam || gṛhakāryāṃtaravyagro dīkṣito dīkṣitāyinīm || 44 || yadā yadaiva tāṃ pṛcchedayeguṇanidhiḥ sutaḥ || na dṛśyate mayā gehe kva yāti vidadhāti kim || 45 || tadā tadeti sā brūyādidānīṃ sa bahirgataḥ || snātvā samarcya vai devānetāvaṃtamanehasam || 46 || adhītyādhyayanārthaṃ sa dvitrairmitraiḥ samaṃ yayau || ekaputreti tanmātā pratārayati dīkṣitam || 47 || na tatkarma ca tadvṛttaṃ kiṃcidvetti sa dīkṣitaḥ || sa ca keśāṃtakarmāsya kṛtvā varṣe'tha ṣoḍaśe || 48 || gṛhyoktena vidhānena pāṇigrāhamakārayat || pratyahaṃ tasya jananī sutaṃ guṇanidhiṃ mṛdu || 49 || śāsti snehārdrahṛdayā krodhanaste pitetyalam || yadi jñāsyati te vṛttaṃ tvāṃ ca māṃ tāḍayiṣyati ||4.1.13.50|| ācchādayāmi te nityaṃ pituragre kuceṣṭitam || lokamānyosti te tātaḥ sadācārairna vai dhanaiḥ || 51 || brāhmaṇānāṃ dhanaṃ putra sadvidyā sādhusaṃgamaḥ || sacchrotriyāstvanūcānā dīkṣitāḥ somayājinaḥ || || 52 || iti rūḍhimiha prāptāstava pūrvapitāmahāḥ || tyaktvā durvṛttasaṃsargaṃ sādhusaṃgarato bhava || 53 || sadvidyā sumano dhehi brāhmaṇācāramācara || tavānurūpārūpeṇa vayasākulaśīlataḥ || 54 || ūnaviṃśatiko'si tvameṣā ṣoḍaśavārṣikī || tava patnī guṇanidhe sādhvī madhurabhāṣiṇī || 55 || etāṃ saṃvṛṇu sadvṛttāṃ pitṛbhaktiyutā bhava || śvaśuropi hi te mānyaḥ sarvatra guṇaśīlataḥ || 56 || tato'patrapase kiṃ na tyaja durvṛttatāṃ śiśo || mātulāste'tulāḥ putra vidyāśīlakulādibhiḥ|| || 57 || tebhyopi na bibheṣi tvaṃ śuddhosyubhaya vaṃśataḥ || paśyaitānprativeśmasthānbrāhmaṇānāṃ kumārakān || 58 || gṛhepi śiṣyānpaśyaitānpituste vinayocitān || rājāpi śroṣyati yadā tava duśceṣṭitaṃ suta || 59 || śraddhāṃ vihāya te tāte vṛttilopaṃ kariṣyati || bālaceṣṭitamevaitadvadaṃtyadyāpi te janāḥ || 4.1.13.60 || anaṃtaraṃ hasiṣyaṃti yuktaṃ dīkṣitatāstviti || sarvepyākṣārayiṣyaṃti tava vipraṃ ca māṃ ca vai ||61|| mātuścaritraṃ tanayo dhatte durbhāṣaṇairiti || pitā pitena pāpīyāñcchrutismṛtipathīnakim || 62 || tadaṃghrilīnamanaso mama sākṣī maheśvaraḥ || na cartusnātayāpīha mukhaṃ duṣṭasya vīkṣitam ||63|| aho balīyānsavidhiryena jātā bhavāniti || pratikṣaṇaṃ jananyeti śikṣyamāṇotidurmadaḥ || 64 || na tatyāja ca taddharmaṃ durbodho vyasanī yataḥ || mṛgayā madya paiśunya veśyācauryadurodaraiḥ || 65 || sapāradārairvyasanairebhiḥ kotra na khaṃḍitaḥ || yadyanmadhye gṛhe paśyettattannītvā sudurmatiḥ || 66 || arpayeddyūtakārāṇāṃ sakupyaṃ vasanādikam || navaratnamayīṃ mātuḥ karataḥ piturūrmikāma || 67 || svapaṃtyāstvekadā''dāya durodarikare'rpayat || ekadā gacchatā rājabhavanānnijamudrikā || 68 || dīkṣitena parijñātā daivāddyūtakṛtaḥ kare || uvāca dīkṣitastaṃ ca kuto labdhā tvayormikā || pṛṣṭastenātha nirbaṃdhādasakṛtpratyuvāca kim || 69 || mamākṣipasi viproccaiḥ kiṃ mayā caurya karmaṇā || labdhā mudrā tvadīyena putreṇaiṣā mamārpitā || 4.1.13.70 || mama māturhi pūrve dyurjitvānīto hi śāṭakaḥ || na kevalaṃ mamāpyetadaṃgulīyaṃ samarpitam || 71 || anyeṣāṃ dyūtakartṛṇāṃ bhūri tenārpitaṃ vasu || ratnakupyadukūlāni bhṛṃgāruprabhṛtīni ca || 72 || bhājanāni vicitrāṇi kāṃsya tāmramayāni ca || nagnīkṛtyaprati dinaṃ baddhyaṃte dyūtakāribhiḥ || 73 || na tena sadṛśaḥ kaścidākṣiko bhūmimaṃḍale || adya yāvattvayā vipra durodaraśiromaṇiḥ || 74 || kathaṃ nājñāyi tanayo 'vinayānayakovidaḥ || iti śrutvā trapābhāra vinamratarakaṃdharaḥ || 75 || prāvṛtya vāsasā mauliṃ prāviśannijamaṃdiram || mahāpativratāmāsya patnīṃ provāca tāmatha || 76 || dīkṣitāyini kutrāsi kva te guṇanidhiḥ sutaḥ || atha tiṣṭhatu kiṃ tena kva sā mama śubhormikā || 77 || aṃgodvartana kāle yā tvayā meṃ'gulito hṛtā || navaratnamayīṃ śīghraṃ tāmānīya prayaccha me || 78 || iti śrutvātha tadvākyaṃ bhītā sā dīkṣitāyinī || provāca sā tu mādhyāhnīṃ kriyāṃ niṣpādayatvatha || 79 || vyagrāsmi devapūjārthamupahārādi karmaṇi || samayoyamatikrāmedatithīnāṃ priyātithe || 4.1.13.80 || idānīmeva pakvānnakaraṇavyagrayā mayā || sthāpitā bhājane kvāpi vismṛteti na vedmyaham || 81 || dīkṣita uvāca || || haṃho satputrajanani nityaṃ satyaprabhāṣiṇi || yadāyadā tvāṃ saṃpṛcche tanayaḥ kva gatastviti || 82 || tadātadeti tvaṃ brūyā nāthedānīṃ sa nirgataḥ || adhītyādhyayanārthaṃ ca dvitrairmitraiḥ sayugbahiḥ || 83 || kutastvacchāṭakaḥ patni māṃjiṣṭho yo mayā'rpitaḥ || laṃbate vastradhānyāṃyastathyaṃ brūhi bhayaṃ tyaja || 84 || sāṃprataṃ nekṣyate sopi bhṛṃgārurmaṇimaṃḍitaḥ || paṭṭasūtramayīsāpi tripaṭī kva nṛpārpitā || 85 || kva dākṣiṇātyaṃ tatkāṃsyaṃ gauḍī tāmraghaṭī kva sā || nāgadaṃtamayī sā kva sukhakautukamaṃcikā || 86 || kva sā parvatadeśīyā caṃdrakāṃtaśilodbhavā || dīpikā vyagrahastāgrā sālaṃkṛcchālabhaṃjikā || 87 || kiṃ bahūktena kulaje tubhyaṃ kupyāmyahaṃ vṛthā || tadābhyavahariṣyehamupayaṃsyāmyahaṃ yadā || 88 || anapatyosmi tenāhaṃ duṣṭena kuladūṣiṇā || uttiṣṭhānaya darbhāṃbu tasmai dadyāṃ tilāṃjalim || 89 || aputratvaṃ varaṃ nṛṇāṃ kuputrātkulapāṃsanāt || tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe nītireṣā sanātanī || 4.1.13.90 || snātvā nityavidhiṃ kṛtvā tasminnevāhnikasyacit || śrotriyasya sutāṃ prāpya pāṇiṃ jagrāha dīkṣitaḥ || 91 || śrutvā tathā sa vṛttāṃtaṃ prāktanaṃ svaṃ viniṃdya ca || kāṃciddiśaṃ samālocya niryayau dīkṣitāṃgajaḥ ||92|| ciṃtāmavāpa mahatīṃ kva yāmi karavāṇi kim || nāhamabhyastavidyosmi na caivāsti dhanosmyaham || 93 || deśāṃtare hyasti dhanaḥ sadvidyaḥ sukhamedhate || bhayamasti dhane caurātsavidyaḥ sarvato'bhayaḥ || 94 || yāyajūke kule janma kvakva me vyasanaṃ tathā || aho balīyānsa vidhirbhāvikarmānusaṃdhayet ||95|| bhikṣituṃ nādhigacchāmi na me paricitaḥ kvacit || na ca pārśve dhanaṃ kiṃcitkimatra śaraṇaṃ bhavet || 96 || sadābhyudite bhānau prasūrme mṛṣṭabhojanam|| dadyādadyātra kaṃ yāce yāceha jananī na me ||97|| iti ciṃtayatastasya bhānurastācalaṃ gataḥ || etasminneva samaye kaścinmāheśvaro naraḥ||98|| mahopahārānādāya nagarādbahirabhyagāt || samabhyarcitumīśānaṃ śivarātrāvupoṣitaḥ || 99 || pakvānnagaṃdhamāghrāya kṣudhitaḥ sa tamanvagāt || idamannaṃ mayā grāhyaṃ śivāyopaskṛtaṃ niśi || 4.1.13.100 || ityāśāmavalaṃbyātha dvāri śaṃbhorupāviśat || dadarśa ca mahāpūjāṃ tena bhaktena nirmitām || 101 || vidhāya nṛtyagītādi bhaktāḥ suptāḥ kṣaṇaṃ yadā || naivedyaṃ sa tadā''dātuṃ garbhāgāraṃ viveśa ha || 102 || dīpaṃ maṃdaprabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā pakvānnāvekṣaṇāya saḥ || nijacailāṃcalādvartiṃ dattvā samudadīpayat || 103 || tataḥ pakkānnamādāya tvaritaṃ gacchato bahiḥ || tasya pādatalāghātātprasuptaḥ kopyabudhyata || 104 || koyaṃkoyaṃ tvarāpannaścoroyaṃ gṛhyatāmiti || yāvadbhūyātsamāgatya tāvatsa purarakṣakaiḥ || 105 || palāyamāno nihataḥ kṣaṇātpaṃcatvamāgataḥ || abhakṣayacca naivedyaṃ bhāvipuṇyabalānna saḥ || 106 || atha baddhaḥ samāgatya pāśamudgarapāṇibhiḥ || ninīṣubhiḥ sayaminīṃ yāmaiḥ sa vikaṭairbhaṭaiḥ || 107 || tāvatpāriṣadāḥ prāptāḥ kiṃkiṇījālamālitam || divyaṃvimānamādāya taṃ netuṃ śūlapāṇayaḥ || 108 || śaṃbhorgaṇānsamālokya bhītaistairyamakiṃkaraiḥ || avādipraṇatairitthaṃ durvṛttoyaṃ gaṇā dvijaḥ || 109 || kulācārapratīpoyaṃ pitrorvākyaparāṅmukhaḥ || satyaśaucaparibhraṣṭaḥsaṃdhyāsnānavivarjitaḥ || 4.1.13.110 || āstāṃ dūre'sya karmāṇi śivanirmālyahārakaḥ || pratyakṣato'travīkṣadhvamaspṛśyoyaṃ bhavādṛśām || 111 || śivanirmālyabhoktāraḥ śivanirmālyalaṃghakāḥ(?) || śivanirmālyadātāraḥ sparśasteṣāṃ hyapuṇyakṛt ||112|| viṣamāloḍya vāpe yaṃ śreyovā'naśanaṃ param || sevitavyaṃ śivasvaṃ na prāṇaḥ kaṃṭhagatairapi || 113 || yūyaṃ pramāṇaṃ dharmeṣu yathā na ca tathā vayam || asti ceddharmaleśosya gaṇāstacchṛṇumo vayam || 114 || itthaṃ tadvākyamākarṇya procuḥ pāriṣadāstataḥ || kiṃkarāḥ śivadharmā ye sūkṣmāste vai bhavādṛśaiḥ || 115 || sthūlalakṣyaiḥ kathaṃ lakṣyā lakṣyā ye sūkṣmadṛṣṭibhiḥ || anenānena sā karma yatkṛtaṃ śṛṇuteha tat || 116 || pataṃtī liṃgaśirasi dīpacchāyā nivāritā || svacailāṃcalato'nena dattvādīpe daśāṃ niśi ||117|| aparopi paro dharmo jātastatrāsya kiṃkarāḥ || śṛṇvatā śivanāmāni prasaṃgādapigṛhṇataḥ || 118 || bhaktena vidhinā pūjā kriyamāṇā nirīkṣitā || upoṣite na bhūtāyāmanena sthiracetasā || 119 || kaliṃgarājobhavitā'dhunāvidhutakalmaṣaḥ || eṣa dvijavaro dūtā yūyaṃ yāta yathāgatāḥ || 4.1.13.120 || pārṣadairyamadūtebhyo mocitastviti sa dvijaḥ || ariṃdamasya tanayaḥ kaliṃgādhiterdamaḥ || 121 || kramādrājyamavāpyātha pitaryuparate yuvā || nānyaṃ dharmaṃ vijānāti durdamo bhūpatirdamaḥ ||122|| śivālayeṣu sarveṣu dīpadānādṛte dvija|| grāmādhīśānsamāhūya sarvāntsvaviṣayasthitān ||123|| itthamājñāpayāmāsa sa me daṃḍyo bhaviṣyati || yasya yasyābhito grāmaṃ yāvaṃtaśca śivālayāḥ || 124 || tatra tatra sadā dīpo dyotanīyo'vicāritam || mamājñābhaṃgadoṣeṇa śiraśchetsyāmyasaṃśayam || 125 || iti tadbhayato dīptā dīpāḥ prati śivālayam || anenaiva sa dharmeṇa yāvajjīvaṃ damo nṛpaḥ ||126 || dharmarddhi mahatīṃ prāpya kāladharmavaśaṃ gataḥ || sadīpavāsanāyāgodbahūndīpānpradīpya vai || 127 || alakāyāḥ patirabhūdratnadīpaśikhāśrayaḥ || evaṃ phalati kālena śive'lpamapi yatkṛtam || 128 || iti jñātvā śive kāryaṃ bhajanaṃ svasukhārthibhiḥ || kva sa dīkṣitadāyādaḥ sarvadharma parāṅmukhaḥ || 129 || svārthadīpadaśodyota liṃgamauli tamoharaḥ || kaliṃgaviṣaye rājyaṃ prāpto dharmaratiḥ sadā || 4.1.13.130 || śivālaye samuddīpya dīpānprāgvāsanodayāt || kvaiṣā dikpālapadavī śivaśarmanvilokaya || manuṣyadharmaṇānena sāṃprataṃ yeha bhujyate || 131 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || sarvadaiva śivenāsau sakhitvaṃ ca yatheyivān || tadapyekamanā vipra saṃśṛṇuṣva bravāvahai || 132 || pādme kalpe purā vipra brahmaṇo mānasātsutāt || pulastyādviśravā jajñe tasya vaiśravaṇaḥ sutaḥ||133|| teneyamalakā bhuktā purī viśvakṛtā kṛtā || ārādhyaṃ tryaṃbakaṃ devamatyugratapasā purā || 134 || vyatīte tatra kalpe vai pravṛtte meghavāhane || yājñadattirasauśrīdastapastepe suduḥsaham || 135 || bhaktiprabhāvaṃ vijñāya śaṃbhostaddīpamātrataḥ || purīṃ purāreḥ saṃprāpya kāśikāṃ citprakāśikām || 136 || śivaikadaśamudbodhya citraratnapradīpakam || ananyabhaktisnehāḍhyaṃ tanmahodhyānaniścalam || 137 || śivaikyasumahāpātraṃ tapogniparibṛṃhitam || kāmakrodhamahāvighnapataṃgāghātavarjitam || 138 || prāṇasaṃrodhanirvātaṃ nirmalaṃ nirmalekṣaṇāt|| saṃsthāpya śāṃbhavaṃ liṃgaṃ sadbhāvakusumārcitam ||139|| tāvattatāpa sa tapastvagasthipariśeṣitam|| yāvadbabhūva tadvarṣma varṣāṇāmayutaṃ śatam||4.1.13.140|| tataḥ saha viśālākṣyā devo viśveśvaraḥ svayam || alakāpatimālokya prasannenāṃtarātmanā || 141 || liṃge manaḥ samādhāya sthitaṃ sthāṇusvarūpiṇam || uvāca varadosmīti taptvālamalakāpate || 142 || unmīlya nayane yāvatsa paśyati tapodhanaḥ || tāvadudyatsahasrāṃśu sahasrādhika tejasam || 143 || puro dadarśa śrīkaṃṭhaṃ caṃdracūḍamumādhavam || tattejaḥ paribhūtākṣitejāḥ saṃmīlya locane || 144 || uvāca devadeveśaṃ manorathapathātigam || nijāṃghridarśanenātha dṛksāmarthyaṃ prayaccha me ||145|| ayameva varo nātha yattvaṃ sākṣānnirīkṣyase || kimanyena vareṇeśa namaste śaśiśekhara || 146 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadeva umāpatiḥ || dadau darśanasāmarthyaṃ spṛṣṭvā pāṇitalena tam || 147 || prasārya nayane pūrvamumāmeva vyalokayat || śaṃbhoḥ samīpe kāyoṣideṣā sarvāṃgasuṃdarī || 148 || anayā kiṃtapastaptaṃ mamāpi tapasodhikam || aho rūpamaho prema saubhāgyaśrīraho bhṛśam || 149 || krūradṛgvīkṣate yāvatpunaḥpunaridaṃ vadan || tāvatpusphoṭa tannetraṃ vāmaṃ vāmā vilokanāta || 4.1.13.150 || atha devyabravīddevaṃ kimasau duṣṭatāpasaḥ || asakṛdvīkṣya māṃ vakti nyakkurvanme tapaḥprabhām || 151 || asakṛddakṣiṇenākṣṇā punarmāmevapaśyati || asūyamāno me rūpaṃ premasaubhāgyasaṃpadaḥ || 152 || iti devīgiraṃ śrutvā prahasya prāha tāṃ prabhuḥ || ume tvadīyaḥ putroyaṃ na ca krūreṇa cakṣuṣā || 153 || saṃpaśyate tapo lakṣmīṃ tava kiṃ tvadhivarṇayet || iti devīṃ samābhāṣya tamīśaḥ punarabravīt || 154 || varāndadāmi te vatsa tapasānena toṣitaḥ || nidhīnāmadhināthastvaṃ guhyakānāṃ bhaveśvaraḥ || 155 || yakṣāṇāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ ca rājā rājñāṃ ca suvrata || patiḥ puṇyajanānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dhanado bhava || 156 || mayā sakhyaṃ ca te nityaṃ vatsyāmi ca tavāṃtike || alakāṃ nikaṣāmitra tava prītivivṛddhaye || 157 || āgaccha pādayorasyāḥ pata te jananī tviyam || iti dattvā varāndevaḥ punarāha śivāṃ śivaḥ || prasādaṃ kuru deveśi tapasvinyaṃgaje'tra vai || 158 || devyuvāca || || vatsa te niścalā bhaktirbhave bhavatu sarvadā || bhavaikāṃṣeṃgo(?)gonetreṇa vāmena sphuṭitena ha || 159 || devena dattā ye tubhyaṃ varāḥ saṃtu tathaiva te || kubero bhava nāmnā tvaṃ mama rūperṣyayā suta || 4.1.13.160 || tvayedaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati || siddhidaṃ sādhakānāṃ ca sarvapāpaharaṃ param || 161 || na dhanena viyujyeta na sakhyā na ca bāṃdhavaiḥ || kubereśvaraliṃgasya kuryādyo darśanaṃ naraḥ || 162 || viśveśāddakṣiṇebhāge kubereśaṃ samarcayet || naro
