lipyeta no pāpairna dāridryeṇa no'sukhaiḥ || 163 || iti dattvā varāndevo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ || dhanadāyā viveśātha dhāma vaiśveśvaraṃ param || 164 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || itthaṃ sakhitvaṃ śrīśaṃbhoḥ prāpaiṣa dhanadaḥ param || alakāṃ nikaṣācaiṣa kailāsaḥ śaṃkarālayaḥ || 165 || puryāṃ yakṣeśvarāṇāṃ te svarūpamiti varṇitam || yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo naro mucyedasaṃśayam ||166|| || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe gaṃdhavatyalakāvarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśodhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<4.1.14>
|| gaṇāvūcatuḥ || alakāyāḥ purobhāge pūraiśānīmahodayā || asyāṃ vasaṃti satataṃ rudrabhaktāstapodhanāḥ ||1|| śivasmaraṇasaṃsaktāḥ śivavrataparāyaṇāḥ || śivasātkṛtakarmāṇaḥ śivapūjāratāḥ sadā ||2|| sābhilāṣāstapasyaṃti svargabhogostvitīha naḥ || te'tra rudrapure ramye rudrarūpadharā narāḥ || 3 || ajaikapādahirbudhnya mukhyā ekādaśāpi vai || rudrāḥ parivṛḍhāścātra triśūlodyatapāṇayaḥ || 4 || puryaṣṭakaṃ ca duṣṭebhyo devadhrugbhyo hyavaṃti te || prayacchaṃti varānnityaṃ śivabhaktajane varāḥ || 5 || etairapi tapastaptaṃ prāpya vārāṇasīṃ purīm || īśāneśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ paristhāpya śubhapradam || 6 || īśāneśa prasādena diśyaiśyāṃ hi digīśvarāḥ || ekādaśāpyekacarā jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitāḥ || 7 || bhālanetrā nīlagalāḥ śuddhāṃgā vṛṣabhadhvajāḥ || asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhibhūtalam || 8 || te'syāṃ puri vasaṃtyaiśyāṃ sarvabhogasamṛddhayaḥ || īśāneśaṃ samabhyarcya kāśyāṃ deśāṃtareṣvapi || 9 || vipannāstena puṇyena jāyaṃte 'trapurohitāḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmīśāneśaṃ yajaṃti ye || 4.1.14.10 || ta eva rudrā vijñeyā ihāmutrāpyasaṃśayam || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrāvīśāneśvara saṃnidhau ||11|| upoṣyabhūtāṃyāṃkāṃcinna naro garbhabhākpunaḥ || svargamārge kathāmitthaṃ śṛṇvanviṣṇugaṇoditām || 12 || śivaśarmā divāpyuccairapaśyaccaṃdracaṃdrikām || āhlādayaṃtīṃ bahuśaḥ samaṃ sarveṃdriyairmanaḥ || 13 || camatkṛtya camatkṛtya koyaṃ loko harergaṇau || papraccha śivaśarmā tau procatustaṃ ca tau dvijam || 14 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || śivaśarmanmahābhāga loka eṣa kalānidheḥ || pīyūṣavarṣibhiryasya karairāpyāyyate jagat || 15 || pitā somasya bho vipra jajñe'trirbhagavānṛṣiḥ || brahmaṇo mānasātpūrvaṃ prajāsargaṃ vidhitsataḥ || 16 || anuttaraṃ nāma tapo yena taptaṃ hi tatpurā || trīṇivarṣasahasrāṇi divyānītīha nau śrutam || 17 || ūrdhvamācakrame tasya retaḥ somatvamīyivat || netrābhyāṃ tacca susrāva daśadhā dyotayaddiśaḥ || 18 || taṃ garbhaṃ vidhinā diṣṭā daśa devyo dadhustataḥ || sametya dhārayāmāsurnaiva tāḥ samaśaknuvan || 19 || yadā na dhāraṇe śaktāstasya garbhasya tā diśaḥ || tatastābhiḥ sajūḥ somo nipapāta vasuṃdharām ||4.1.14.20|| patitaṃ somamālokya brahmā lo kapitāmahaḥ || rathamāropayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||21|| sa tena rathamukhyena sāgarāṃtāṃ vasuṃdharām || triḥsaptakṛtvo druhiṇaścakārāmuṃ pradakṣiṇam ||22|| tasya yatplavitaṃ tejaḥ pṛthivīmanvapadyata || tathauṣadhyaḥ samudbhūtā yābhiḥ saṃdhāryate jagat || 23 || salabdhatejā bhagavānbrahmaṇā vardhitaḥ svayam || tapastepe mahābhāga padmānāṃ daśatīrdaśa || 24 || avimuktaṃ samāsādya kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam || saṃsthāpya liṃgamamṛtaṃ caṃdreśākhyaṃ svanāmataḥ || 25 || bījauṣadhīnāṃ toyānāṃ rājābhūdagrajanmanām || prasādāddevadevasya viśveśasya pinākinaḥ || 26 || tatra kūpaṃ vidhāyaikamamṛtodamiti smṛtam || yasyāṃbupānasnānābhyāṃ naro'jñātātpramucyate || 27 || tuṣṭenadevadevena svamaulau yo dhṛtaḥ svayam || ādāya tāṃ kalāmekāṃ jagatsaṃjavinīṃ parām ||28|| paścāddakṣeṇa śaptopi māsone kṣayamāpya ca || āpyāyyatesau kalayā punareva tayā śaśī || 29 || sa tatprāpya mahārājyaṃ somaḥ somavatāṃ varaḥ || rājasūyaṃ samājahre sahasraśatadakṣiṇam || 4.1.14.30 || dakṣiṇāmadadatsomastrīṃllokāniti nau śrutam || tebhyo brahmarṣimukhyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyaśca bho dvija || 31 || hiraṇyagarbho brahmā'trirbhṛguryatrartvijobhavan || sadasyobhūddharistatra munibhirbahubhiryutaḥ || 32 || taṃsinī ca kuhūścaiva dyutiḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhāvasuḥ || kīrtirdhṛtiśca lakṣmīśca navadevyaḥ siṣevire || 33 || umayā sahitaṃ rudraṃ saṃtarpyādhvarakarmaṇā || prāpa soma iti khyātiṃ dattāṃ somena śaṃbhunā || 34 || tatraiva taptavānsomastapaḥ paramaduṣkaram || tatraiva rājasūyaṃ ca cakre caṃdreśvarāgrataḥ || 35 || tatraiva brāhmaṇaiḥ prītairityuktosau kalānidhiḥ || somosmākaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ rājā trailokyadakṣiṇaḥ || 36 || tatraiva devadevasya vilocanapadaṃ gataḥ || devena prītamanasā trailokyāhlādahetave || 37 || tvaṃ mamāsya parāmūrtirityuktastattapobalāt || jagattavodayaṃ prāpya bhaviṣyati sukhodayam || 38 || tvatpīyūṣamayairhastaiḥ spṛṣṭametaccarācaram || bhānutāpaparītaṃ ca parā glāniṃ vihāsyati || 39 || etaduktvā maheśāno varānanyānadānmudā || dvijarājatapastaptaṃ yadatyugraṃ tvayātra vai || 4.1.14.40 || yacca kratu kriyotsargastvayā mahyaṃ niveditaḥ || sthāpitaṃ yattvidaṃ liṃgaṃ mama caṃdreśvarābhidham || 41 || tatotra liṃge tvannāmni somasomārdharūpadhṛk || pratimāsaṃ paṃcadaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ sarvagopyaham || || 42 || ahorātraṃ vasiṣyāmi trailokyaiśvaryasaṃyutaḥ || tatotra pūrṇimāyāṃ tu kṛtā svalpāpi satkriyā || 43 || japahomārcanadhyānadānabrāhmaṇabhojanam || mahāpūjā ca sā nūnaṃ mama prītyai bhaviṣyati || 44 || jīrṇoddhārādikaraṇaṃ nṛtyavādyādikārpaṇam || dhvajāropaṇakarmādi tapasviyatitaparṇam || 45 || caṃdreśvare kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tadānaṃtyāya jāyate || anyacca te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu guhyaṃ kalānidhe || 46 || abhaktāya ca nākhyeyaṃ nāstikāya śrutidruhe || amāvāsyā yadā soma jāyate somavāsare || 47 || tadopavāsaḥ kartavyo bhūtāyāṃ sadbhirādarāt || kṛtanityakriyaḥ soma trayodaśyāṃ niśāmaya || 48 || śanipradoṣe saṃpūjya liṃgaṃ caṃdreśvarāhvayam || naktaṃ kṛtvā trayodaśyāṃ niyamaṃ parigṛhya ca || 49 || upoṣya ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi || prātaḥ somakuhūyoge snātvā caṃdrodavāribhiḥ ||4.1.14.50|| upāsya saṃdhyāṃ vidhivatkṛtasarvodaka kriyaḥ || upacaṃdrodatīrtheṣu śrāddhaṃ vidhivadācaret ||51|| āvāhanārghyarahitaṃ piṃḍāndadyātprayatnataḥ || vasurudrāditisutasvarūpapuruṣatrayam ||52|| mātāmahāṃstathoddiśya tathānyānapi gotrajān || guruśvaśurabaṃdhūnāṃ nāmānyuccārya piṃḍadaḥ || 53 || kurvañchrāddhaṃ ca tīrthesmiñchraddhayoddharatekhilān || gayāyāṃ piṃḍadānena yathā tupyaṃti pūrvajāḥ || 54 || tathā caṃdrodakuṃḍe'tra śrāddhaistṛpyaṃti pūrvajāḥ || gayāyāṃ ca yathā mucyetsarvarṇātpitṛjānnaraḥ || 55 || tathā pramucyate carṇāccaṃdrode piṇḍadānataḥ || yadā caṃdreśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ yāyātkopi narottamaḥ||56|| tadā nṛtyaṃti muditāstatpūrvaprapitāmahāḥ|| ayaṃ caṃdrodatīrthesmiṃstarpaṇaṃ naḥ kariṣyati || 57|| asmākaṃ maṃdabhāgyatvādyadi naiva kariṣyati|| tadātattīrtha saṃsparśādasmattṛptirbhaviṣyati|| 58|| spṛśennāpi yadā maṃdastadā drakṣyati tṛptaye|| evaṃ śrāddhaṃ vidhāyātha spṛṣṭvā caṃdreśvaraṃ vratī|| saṃtarpya viprāṃśca yatīnkuryādvai pāraṇaṃ tataḥ||59|| evaṃ vrate kṛte kāśyāṃ sadarśe somavāsare|| bhavedṛṇatrayānmukto mṛgāṃkamadanugrahāt || 4.1.14.60 || atra yātrā mahācaitryāṃ kāryā kṣetranivāsibhiḥ || tārakajñānalābhāya kṣetravighnanivartinī || 61 || caṃdreśvaraṃ samabhyarcya yadyanyatrāpi saṃsthitaḥ || aghaughapaṭalīṃ bhittvā somalokamavāpsyati ||62|| kalau caṃdreśamahimā nābhāgyairavagamyate|| anyacca te pravakṣyāmi paraṃ guhyaṃ niśāpate || 63|| siddhayogīśvaraṃ pīṭhametatsādhakasiddhidam || surāsureṣu gaṃdharva nāgavidyādhareṣvapi || 64 || rakṣoguhyakayakṣeṣu kiṃnareṣu nareṣu ca || saptakoṭyastu siddhānāmatra siddhā mamāgrataḥ 65|| ṣaṇmāsaṃ niyatāhāro dhyāyanviśveśvarīmiha|| caṃdreśvarārcanāyātānsiddhānpaśyati so'gragān||66|| siddhayogīśvarī sākṣādvaradā tasya jāyate || tavāpi mahatī siddhiḥ siddhayogīśvarīkṣaṇāt|| 67|| saṃti pāṭhānyanekāni kṣitau sādhakasiddhaye|| paraṃ yogīśvarī pīṭhādbhūpṛṣṭhenāśu siddhidam|| 68 || yatra caṃdreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tvayedaṃ sthāpitaṃ śaśin|| idameva hi tatpīṭhamadṛśyamakṛtātmabhiḥ|| 69|| jitakāmā jitakrodhā jitalobhaspṛhāsmitāḥ|| yogīśvarīṃ prapaśyaṃti mama śaktiparāṃ hitām || 4.1.14.70 || ye tu pratyaṣṭami janāstathā prati caturdaśi || siddhayogīśvarīpīṭhe pūjayiṣyaṃti bhāvitāḥ || 71 || adṛṣṭarūpāṃ subhagāṃ piṃgalāṃ sarvasiddhidām || dhūpanaivedyadīpādyaisteṣāmāvirbhaviṣyati || 72 || iti dattvā varāñchaṃbhustasmai caṃdramase dvija || aṃtarhito maheśānastatra vaiśveśvare pure || 73 || tadārabhya ca loke'smindvijarājodhipobhavat || diśovitimirāḥ kurvannijaiḥ prasṛmaraiḥ karaiḥ || 74 || somavāravratakṛtaḥ somapānaratā narāḥ || somaprabheṇayānena somalokaṃ vrajaṃti hi || || 75 || caṃdreśvarasamutpattiṃ tathā cāṃdramasaṃ tapaḥ || yaḥ śroṣyati naro bhaktyā caṃdraloke sa ijyate || 76 || agastiruvāca || || śivaśarmaṇi śarmakāriṇīṃ pa thi divye śramahāriṇīṃ gaṇau || kathayaṃtau tu kathāmimāṃ śubhāmuḍulokaṃ parijagmatustataḥ || 77 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe somalokavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||14||
<4.1.15>
agastiruvāca || śṛṇu patni mahābhāge lopāmudre sadharmiṇi || kathā viṣṇugaṇābhyāṃ ca kathitāṃ śivaśarmaṇe || 1 || śivaśarmovāca || aho gaṇau vicitreyaṃ śrutā cāṃdramasī kathā || uḍulokakathāṃ khyātaṃ viṣvagākhyānakovidau || 2 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || purā sisṛkṣataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuraṃguṣṭhapṛṣṭhataḥ || dakṣaḥ prajāvinirmāṇe dakṣo jātaḥ prajāpatiḥ|| ṣaṣṭirduhitarastasya tapolāvaṇyabhūṣaṇāḥ || sarvalāvaṇyarohiṇyo rohiṇīpramukhāḥ śubhāḥ || 4 || tābhistaptvā tapastīvraṃ prāpya vaiśveśvarīṃ purīm || ārādhito mahādevaḥ somaḥ somavibhūpaṇaḥ || 5 || yadā tuṣṭoyamīśāno dātuṃ varamathāyayau || uvāca ca prasannātmā yācadhvaṃ varamu ttamam || 6 || śaṃbhorvākyamathākarṇya ūcustāśca kumārikāḥ || yadi deyo varo'smākaṃ varayogyāḥ sma śaṃkara || 7 || bhavatopi mahādeva bhavatāpaharo hi yaḥ || rūpeṇa bhavatā tulyaḥ sa no bhartā bhavatviti || 8 || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya sumahannakṣatreśvara saṃjñitam || vāraṇāyāstaṭe ramye saṃgameśvarasannidhau| || 9 || divyaṃ varṣa sahasraṃ tu puruṣāyitasaṃjñitam || tapastaptaṃ mahattābhiḥ puruṣairapi duṣkaram || 4.1.15.10 || tatastuṣṭo hi viśveśo vyataradvaramuttamam || sarvāsāmekapatnīnāmakatre(?) sthiracetasām || 11 || śrī viśveśvara uvāca || || na kṣāṃtaṃ hi tapotyugrametadanyābhirīdṛśam || purā'balābhistasmādvonāmanakṣatramatra vai || 12 || puruṣāyita saṃjñena taptaṃyattapasādhunā || bhavatībhistataḥ puṃstvamicchayā vo bhaviṣyati || 13 || jyotiścakre samaste'sminnagragaṇyā bhaviṣyatha || meṣādīnāṃ ca rāśī nāṃ yonayo yūyamuttamāḥ || 14 || oṣadhīnāṃ sudhāyāśca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca yaḥ patiḥ || patimatyo bhavatyopi tena patyā śubhānanāḥ|| 15 || bhavatīnāmidaṃ liṃgaṃ nakṣatreśvara saṃjñitam || pūjayitvā naro gaṃtā bhavatīlokamuttamam || 16 || upariṣṭānmṛgāṃkasya loko vastu bhaviṣyati || sarvāsāṃ tārakāṇāṃ ca madhye mānyā bhaviṣyatha || 17 || nakṣatrapūjakā ye ca nakṣatravratacāriṇaḥ || te vo loke vasiṣyaṃti nakṣatra sadṛśaprabhāḥ || 18 || nakṣatragraharāśīnāṃ bādhāsteṣāṃ kadācana || na bhaviṣyaṃti ye kāśyāṃ nakṣatreśvaravīkṣakāḥ || 19 || agastya uvāca || || atithitvamavāpa netrayorbudhalokaḥ śivaśarmaṇastvatha || gaṇayorbhagaṇasya saṃkathāṃ kathayitro riti viṣṇucetasoḥ || 4.1.15.20 || śivaśarmovāca || || kasya lokoyamatulo brūtaṃ śrībhagavadgaṇau || pīyūṣabhānoriva me manaḥ prīṇayatetarām || 21 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || śivaśarmañchṛṇu kathāmetāṃ pāpāpahāriṇīm|| svargamārgavinodāya tāpatrayavināśinīm || 22 || yosau pūrvaṃ mahākāṃtirāvābhyāṃ parivarṇitaḥ || sāmrājyapadamāpanno dvijarājastavāgrataḥ || 23 || dakṣiṇā rājasūyasya yena tribhuvanaṃ kṛtā || tapastatāpa yotyugraṃ padmānāṃ daśatīrdaśa ||24|| atrinetrasamudbhūtaḥ pautro vai druhiṇasya yaḥ || nāthaḥ sarvauṣadhīnāṃ ca jyotiṣāṃ patireva ca || 25 || nirmalānāṃ kalānāṃ ca śevadhiryaśca gīyate || udyanparopatāpaṃ yaḥ svakarairgalahastayet || 26 || mudaṃkumudinīnāṃyastanoti jagatā saha || digvadhū cāru śṛṃgāradarśanādarśamaṃḍalaḥ || 27 || kimanyairguṇasaṃbhārairatopi na samaṃ vidhoḥ || nijottamāṃge sarvajñaḥ kalāṃ yasyāvataṃsayet || 28 || bṛhaspatessa vai bhāryāmaiśvaryamadamohitaḥ || purohitasyāpigurorbhrāturāṃgirasasya vai || 29 || jahāra tarasā tārāṃ rūpavānrūpaśālinīm|| vāryamāṇopi gīrvāṇairbahudevarṣibhiḥ punaḥ || 4.1.15.30 || nāyaṃ kalānidherdoṣo dvijarājasya tasya vai || hitvā trinetraṃ kāmena kasya no khaḍitaṃ manaḥ ||31|| dhvāṃtametadabhitaḥ prasāriyattacchamāya vidhināvinirmitam|| dīpabhāskarakarāmahauṣadhaṃ nādhipatya tamasastukiṃcana || 32 || ādhipatyamadamohitaṃ hitaṃ śaṃsitaṃ spṛśati no harerhitam || durjanavihitatīrthamajjanaiḥ śuddhadhīriva viruddhamānasam|| 33 || dhigdhigetadadhikarddhi ceṣṭitaṃ caṃkramekṣaṇavilakṣitaṃ yataḥ || vīkṣate kṣaṇamacārucakṣuṣā ghātitena vipadaḥpadena ca || 34 || kaḥ kāmena na nirjitastrijagatāṃ puṣpāyudhenāpyaho kaḥ krodhasyavaśaṃgato nanaca ko lobhena saṃmohitaḥ || yoṣillocanabhallabhinnahṛdayaḥ ko nāptavānāpadaṃ ko rājyaśriyamāpyanāṃdhapadavīṃ yātopi sallocanaḥ || 35 || ādhipatyakamalāticaṃcalā prāpyatāṃ ca yadihārjitaṃ kila || niścalaṃ sadasaduccakairhitaṃ kāryamāryacaritaiḥ sadaiva tat || 36 || na yadāṃgirase tārāṃ sa vyasarjayadulbaṇaḥ || rudrotha pārṣṇiṃ jagrāha gṛhītvājagavaṃ dhanuḥ || 37 || tena brahmaśironāma paramāstraṃ mahātmanā || utsṛṣṭaṃ devadevāyatena tannāśitaṃ tataḥ || 38 || tayostadyuddhamabhavadghoraṃ vai tārakāmayam || tatastvakāṃḍa brahmāṃḍa bhaṃgādbhītobhavadvidhiḥ ||39|| nivārya rudraṃ samarātsaṃvartānalavarcasam || dadāvāṃgirase tārāṃ svayameva pitāmahaḥ ||4.1.15.40|| athāṃtargarbhamālokya tārāṃ prāha bṛhaspatiḥ || madīyāyāṃ na te yonau garbho dhāryaḥ kathaṃcana ||41|| iṣīkāstaṃbamāsādya garbhaṃ sā cotsasarja ha || jātamātraḥ sa bhagavāndevānāmākṣipadvapuḥ || 42 || tataḥ saṃśayamāpannāstārāmūcuḥ surottamāḥ || satyaṃ būhi sutaḥ kasya somasyātha bṛhaspateḥ || 43 || pṛcchamānā yadā devai rnāha tārā'tisatrapā || tadā sā śaptumārabdhā kumāreṇātitejasā || 44 || taṃ nivārya tadā brahmā tārāṃ papraccha saṃśayam|| provāca prāṃjaliḥ sā taṃ somasyeti pitāmaham || 45 || tadā sa mūrdhnyupāghrāya rājā garbhaṃ prajāpatiḥ || budha ityakaronnāma tasya bālasya dhīmataḥ || 46 || tataśca sarvadevebhyastejorūpabalādhikaḥ || budhaḥ somaṃ samāpṛcchaya tapase kṛtaniścayaḥ ||47|| jagāma kāśīṃ nirvāṇarāśiṃ viśveśapālitām || tatra ligaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sa svanāmnā budheśvaram || 48 || tapaścacāra cātyugramugraṃ saṃśīlayanhṛdi || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ bālo bāleṃdutilakaṃ śivam || 49 || tato viśvapatiḥ śrīmānviśveśo viśvabhāvanaḥ || budheśvarānmahāliṃgādāvirāsīnmahodayaḥ || 4.1.15.50 || uvāca ca prasannātmā jyotīrūpo maheśvaraḥ || varaṃ brūhi mahābuddhe budhānya vibudhottamaḥ || 51 || tavānenāti tapasā liṃgasaṃśīlanena ca || prasannosmi mahāsaumya nādeyaṃ tvayi vidyate || 52 || iti śrutvā vacaḥ sotha meghagaṃbhīra niḥsvanam|| avagrahaparimlāna sasyasaṃjīvanopamam|| 53 || unmīlyalocane yāvatpuraḥ paśyati bālakaḥ || tāvalliṃge dadarśātha tryaṃbakaṃ śaśiśekharam||54|| budha uvāca || || namaḥ pūtātmane tubhyaṃ jyotīrūpa namostu te || viśvarūpa namastubhyaṃ rūpātītāya te namaḥ ||55 || namaḥ sarvārti nāśāya praṇatānāṃ śivātmane || sarvajñāya namastubhyaṃ sarvakartre namostu te || 56 || kṛpālave namastubhyaṃ bhaktigamyāya te namaḥ || phaladātre ca tapasāṃ taporūpāya te namaḥ || 57 || śaṃbho śivaśivākāṃta śāṃtaśrī kaṃṭhaśūlabhṛt || śaśiśekharaśarveśa śaṃkareśvara dhūrjaṭe || 58 || pinākapāṇe giriśa śitikaṃṭha sadāśiva || mahādeva namastubhyaṃ devadeva namostu te || 59 || stutikartuṃ na jānāmi stutipriya maheśvara || tava pādāṃbujadvaṃdve nirdvaṃdvā bhaktirastu me || 4.1.15.60 || ayameva varo nātha prasannosi yadīśvara || nānyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe tvattaḥ karuṇāmṛtavāridhe || 61 || tataḥ prāha maheśānastatstutyā paritoṣitaḥ || rauhiṇeya mahābhāga saumyasaumyavaconidhe || 62 || nakṣatralokādupari tava loko bhaviṣyati || madhye sarvagrahāṇāṃ ca saparyāṃ lapsyase parām || 63 || tvayedaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarveṣāṃ buddhidāyakam || durbuddhiharaṇaṃ saumya tvallokavasatipradam || 64 || ityuktvā bhagavāñchaṃbhustatraivāṃtaradhīyata || budhaḥ svarlokamagamaddevadevaprasādataḥ || 65 || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || kāśyāṃ budheśvarasamarcanalabdhabuddhiḥ saṃsārasiṃdhumadhigamya naro hyagādham || majjenna sajjanavilocana caṃdrakāṃtiḥ kāṃtānanastvadhivasecca budhe'tra loke || 66 || caṃdreśvarātpūrvabhāge dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ budheśvaram || na buddhyā hīyate jaṃturaṃtakālepi jātucit ||67|| gaṇau yāvatkathāmitthaṃ cakrāte budhalokagām || tāvadvimānaṃ saṃprāptaṃ śukralokamanuttamam || 68 || || iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe nakṣatrabudhalokayorvarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcadaśodhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
<4.1.16>
|| gaṇāvūcatuḥ || śivaśarmanmahābuddhe śukralokoyamadbhutaḥ || dānavānāṃ ca daityānāṃ gururatra vasetkaviḥ || 1 || pītvā varṣasahasraṃ vai kaṇadhūmaṃ suduḥsaham || yaḥ prāptavānmahāvidyāṃ mṛtyusaṃjīvinīṃ harāt || 2 || imāṃ vidyāṃ na jānāti devācāryoti dupkarām || ṛte mṛtyuṃjayātskaṃdātpārvatyā gajavaktrataḥ || 3 || śivaśarmovāca || || kosau śukra iti khyāto yasyāyaṃ loka uttamaḥ || kathaṃ tena ca vidyāptā mṛtyusaṃjīvanī harāt || 4 | ācakṣāthāmidaṃ devau yadi prītirmayi prabhū || tatastau smāhaturdevau śukrasya paramāṃ kathām || 5|| yāṃ śrutvā cāpamṛtyubhyo hīyaṃte śraddhayāyutāḥ || bhūtapretapiśācebhyo na bhayaṃ cāpi jāyate || 6 || ājau pravartamānāyāmaṃdhakāṃdhakavairiṇoḥ || anirbhedya girivyūha vajravyūhādhināthayoḥ ||7|| apasṛtya tato yuddhādaṃdhakaḥ śukrasaṃnidhim || adhigamya babhāṣedamavaruhya rathāttataḥ || 8 || bhagavaṃstvāmupāśritya vayaṃ devāṃśca sānugān || manyāmahe tṛṇaistulyānrudropeṃdrādikānapi || 9 || kuṃjarā iva siṃhebhyo garuḍebhya ivoragāḥ || asmatto bibhyati surā guro yuṣmadanugrahāt || 4.1.16.10 || vajravyūhamanirbhedyaṃ viviśurdetyadānavāḥ || vidhūya pramathānīkaṃ hradaṃ tāpārditā iva || 11 || vayaṃ tvaccharaṇaṃ bhūtvā parvatā iva niścalāḥ || sthitvā carāma niḥśaṃkā brāhmaṇeṃdra mahāhave || 12 || āptabhāvena ca vayaṃ pādau tava sukhapradau || sadārāḥ sasutāścaiva śuśrūṣāmo divāniśam || 13 || abhirakṣābhito vipra prasannaḥ śaraṇāgatān || paśya huṃḍaṃ tuhuṃḍaṃ ca kujaṃbhaṃ jaṃbhameva ca || 14 || pākaṃ kārtasvanaṃ caiva vipākaṃ pākahāriṇam || taṃ candradamanaṃ śūraṃ śūrāmaravidāraṇam ||15|| pramathairbhīmavikrāṃtaiḥ krāṃtaṃ mṛtyupramāthibhiḥ || sūditānpatitāṃścaiva drāviḍairiva caṃdanān|| 16|| yā pītvā kaṇadhūmaṃ vai sahasraṃ śaradāṃ purā || varā vidyā tvayā prāptā tasyāḥ kāloyamāgataḥ ||17|| atha vidyāphalaṃ tatte daityānsaṃjīvayiṣyataḥ || paśyaṃtu pramathāḥ sarve tvayā saṃjīvitānimān||18|| ityaṃdhakavacaḥ śrutvā sthiradhīrbhārgavomuniḥ || kiṃcitsmitaṃ tadā kṛtvā dānavādhipamabravīt || 19 || dānavādhipate sarvaṃ tathyaṃ yadbhāṣitaṃ tvayā || vidyopārjanametaddhi dānavārthaṃ mayā kṛtam || 4.1.16.20 || pītvā varṣasahasraṃ vai kaṇadhūmaṃ suduḥsaham || eṣā prāpteśvarādvidyā bāṃdhavānāṃ sukhāvahā || 21 || etayā vidyayā sohaṃ pramayairmathitānraṇe || utthāpayiṣye glānāni dhānyanyaṃbudharo yathā ||22|| nirvraṇānnīrujaḥ svasthānsuptveva punarutthitān|| asminmuhūrte draṣṭāsi dānavānutthitānnṛpa || 23 || ityuktvā dānavapatiṃ vidyāmāvartayatkaviḥ || ekaikaṃ daityamuddiśya ta uttasthurdhṛtāyudhāḥ || 24 || vedā iva sadabhyastāḥ samaye vā yathāṃbudāḥ || brāhmaṇebhyo yathā dattāḥ śraddhayārthā mahāpadi || 25|| ujjīvitāṃstu tāndṛṣṭvā tuhuṃḍādyānmahāsurān || vineduḥ pūrvadevāste jalapūrṇā ivāṃbudāḥ || 26 || śukreṇojīvitāndṛṣṭvā dānavāṃstāngaṇeśvarāḥ || vijñāpyameva deveśe hyevaṃ te'nyonyamabruvan || 27 || āścaryarūpe pramatheśvarāṇāṃ tasmiṃstathā vartati yuddhayajñe || amarṣito bhārgavakarmadṛṣṭvā śilādaputrobhyagamanmaheśam || 28 || jayeti coktvā jaya yonimugramuvāca naṃdī kanakāvadātam|| gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ raṇakarma deva devaiśca seṃdrairapi duṣkaraṃ yat || 29 || tadbhārgaveṇādya kṛtaṃ vṛthā naḥ saṃjīvya tānājimṛtānvipakṣān || āvartya vidyāṃ mṛtajīvadātrīmekaikamuddiśya sahelamīśa || 4.1.16.30 || tuhuṃḍahuṃḍādikajaṃbhajaṃbhavipākapākādi mahāsureṃdrāḥ || yamālayādadya punarnivṛttā vidrāvayaṃtaḥ pramathāścaraṃti || 31 || yadi hyasau daityavarānnirastānsaṃjīvayedatra punaḥpunastān || jayaḥ kuto no bhavitā maheśa gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ kuta eva śāṃtiḥ || 32 || ityevamuktaḥ pramatheśvareṇa sa naṃdinā vai pramatheśvareśaḥ || uvāca devaḥ prahasaṃstadānīṃ taṃ naṃdinaṃ sarvagaṇeśarājam|| 33 || naṃdinprayāhi tvaritotimātraṃ dvijeṃdravaryaṃ ditinaṃdanānām || madhyātsamuddhṛtya tathānayāśu śyeno yathā lāvakamaṃḍajātam || 34 || sa eva mukto vṛṣabhadhvajena nanāda naṃdī vṛṣasiṃhanādaḥ || jagāma tūrṇaṃ ca vigāhya senāṃ yatrābhavadbhārgavavaṃśadīpaḥ || 35 || taṃ rakṣyamāṇaṃ ditijaiḥ samastaiḥ pāśāsivṛkṣopalaśailahastaiḥ || vikṣobhya daityānbalavāñjahāra kāvyaṃ sa naṃdī śarabho yathebham|| 36 || srastāṃbaraṃ vicyutabhūṣaṇaṃ ca vimuktakeśaṃ balinā gṛhītam || vimocayiṣyaṃta ivānujagmuḥ surārayaḥ siṃharavānsṛjaṃtaḥ || 37 || daṃbholi śūlāsiparaśvadhānāmuddaṃḍacakropala kaṃpanānām || naṃdīśvarasyopari dānavedrā varṣaṃ vavarṣurjaladā ivogram || 38 || taṃ bhārgavaṃ prāpya gaṇādhirājo mukhāgninā śastraśatāni dagdhvā || āyātpravṛddhe'suradevayuddhe bhavasya pārśve vyathitārisainyaḥ || 39 || ayaṃ sa śukro bhagavannitīdaṃ nivedayāmāsa bhavāya śīghram || jagrāha śukraṃ sa ca devadevo yathopahāraṃ śucinā pradattam || 4.1.16.40 || na kiṃciduktvā sa hi bhūtagoptā cikṣepa vaktre phalavatkavīṃdram || hāhāravastairasuraiḥ samastairuccairvimukto hahaheti bhūri || 41 || kāvye nigīrṇe girijeśvareṇa daityā jayāśā rahitā babhūvuḥ || hastairvimuktā iva vāraṇeṃdrāḥ śṛṃgairvihīnā iva govṛṣāśca || 42 || śarīra hīnā iva jīvasaṃghā dvijā yathā cādhyayanena hīnāḥ || nirudyamāḥ sattvaguṇā yathā vai yathodyamā bhāgyavivarjitāśca || 43 || patyā vihīnāśca yathaiva yoṣā yathā vipakṣā iva mārgaṇaughāḥ || āyūṃṣi hīnāni yathaiva puṇyairvṛttena hīnāni yathā śrutāni || 44 || vinā yathā vaibhavaśaktimekāṃ bhavaṃti hīnāḥ svaphalaiḥ kriyaughāḥ || tathā vinā taṃ dvijavaryamekaṃ daityā jayāśā vimukhā babhūvuḥ || 45 || naṃdināpahṛte śukre gilite ca viṣādinā || viṣādamagamandaityā hīyamānaraṇotsavāḥ || 46 || tānvīkṣya vigatotsāhānaṃdhakaḥ pratyabhāṣata || kaviṃ vikramya nayatā naṃdinā vaṃcitā vayam || 47|| tanūrvinā hṛtāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāmadya tena naḥ || dhairyaṃ vīryaṃ gatiḥ kīrtiḥ sattvaṃ tejaḥ parākramaḥ ||48|| yugapanno hṛtaṃ sarvamekasminbhārgave hṛte || dhigasmānkulapūjyo yairekopi kulasattamaḥ || guruḥ sarvasamarthaśca trātā trāto na cāpadi || 49 || taddhairyamavalaṃbyeha yudhyadhvamaribhiḥ saha || sūdayiṣyāmyahaṃ sarvānpramathānsaha naṃdinā || 4.1.16.50 || adyaitānvivaśānhatvā saha devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ || bhārgavaṃ mocayiṣyāmi jīvaṃ yogīva karmataḥ || 51 || sa cāpi yogī yogena yadi nāma svayaṃ prabhuḥ || śarīrāttasya nirgacchedasmākaṃ roṣapālitā || 52 || ityaṃdhakavacaḥ śrutvā dānavā meghaniḥsvanāḥ || pramathā nardayāmāsurmartavye kṛta niścayāḥ || 53 || satyāyupi na no jātu śaktāḥ syuḥ pramathābalāt || asatyāyuṣi kiṃ gatvā tyaktvā svāminamāhave || || 54 || ye svāminaṃ vihāyājau bahumānadhanā janāḥ || yāṃti te yāṃti niyatamaṃdhatāmisramālayam || 55 || ayaśastamasā khyātiṃ malinīkṛtyabhūriśaḥ || ihāmutrāpi sukhino na syurbhagnā raṇājirāt || 56|| kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca kiṃ tīrthaparimajjanaiḥ || dharātīrthe yadi snātaṃ punarbhava malāpahe || 57 || saṃpradhāryeti te'nyonyaṃ daityāste danujāstathā || mamaṃthuḥ pramathānājau raṇabherīrninādya ca || 58 || tatra vāṇāsivajraughaiḥ kaṭaṃkaṭaśilāmayaiḥ || bhuśuṃḍībhiṃdipālaiśca śaktibhalla paraśvadhaiḥ || 59 || khaṭvāṃgaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlairlakuṭairmusalairalam || parasparamabhighnaṃtaḥ pracakruḥ kadanaṃ mahat || 4.1.16.60 || kārmukāṇāṃ vikṛṣṭānāṃ patatāṃ ca patatriṇām || bhiṃdipālabhuśuṃḍīnāṃ kṣveḍitānāṃ ravo'bhavat || 61 || raṇatūryaninādaiśca gajānāṃ bahubṛṃhitaiḥ || heṣāravairhayānāṃ ca mahānkolāhalo'bhavat ||62|| pratisvanairavāpūri dyāvābhūmyoryadaṃtaram || abhīrūṇāṃ ca bhīrūṇāṃ mahāromodgamo'bhavat || 63 || gajavājimahārāva sphuṭacchabdagrahāṇi ca || bhagnadhvajapatākāni kṣīṇapraharaṇāni ca || 64 || rudhirodgāra citrāṇi vyaśvahastirathāni ca || pipāsitāni sainyāni mumūrchurubhayatra vai || 65 || dṛṣṭvā sainyaṃ ca pramathairbhajyamānamitastataḥ || dudrāva rathamāsthāya svayamevāṃdhako gaṇān || 66 || śaravajraprahāraistairvajrāghātairnagā iva || pramathāneśire vātairnistoyā iva toyadāḥ || 67 || yāṃtamāyāṃtamālokya dūrasthaṃ nikaṭasthitam || pratyekaṃ romasaṃkhyābhirvyadhādbāṇaistadāṃdhakaḥ || 68 || vināyakena skaṃdena naṃdinā somanaṃdinā || naigameyena śākhena viśākhena balīyasā || 69 || ityādyaistu gaṇairugrairaṃdhakopyaṃdhakīkṛtaḥ || triśūla śaktibāṇaugha dhārāsaṃpātapātibhiḥ || 4.1.16.70 || tataḥ kolāhalo jātaḥ pramathāsurasainyayoḥ || tena śabdena mahatā śukraḥ śaṃbhūdare sthitaḥ || 71 || chidrānveṣī bhramansotha viniḥketo yathānilaḥ || saptalokān sapālānsa rudradehe vyalokayat ||72|| brahmanārāyaṇeṃdrāṇāmādityāpyarasāṃ tathā || bhuvanāni vicitrāṇi yuddhaṃ ca pramathāsuram || 73 || savarṣāṇāṃ śataṃ kukṣau bhavasya parito bhraman || na tasya dadṛśe raṃdhraṃ śuce raṃdhraṃ khalo yathā || 74 || śāṃbhavenāthayogena śukrarūpeṇa bhārgavaḥ || caskaṃdātha nanāmāpi tato devena bhāṣitaḥ || 75 || śukravanniḥsṛtoyasmāttasmāttvaṃ bhṛgunaṃdana || karmaṇānena śukrastvaṃ mama putrosi gamyatām || 76 || jaṭharānnirgate śukre devopi mumudetarām || bhramañchreyobhavadyanme na mṛto jaṭhare dvijaḥ || 77 || ityevamukto devena śukrorkasadṛśa dyutiḥ || viveśa dānavānīkaṃ meghamālāṃ yathā śaśī || 78 || śukrodayānmudaṃ lebhe sa dānava mahārṇavaḥ || yathā caṃdrodaye harṣamūrmimālī mahodadhiḥ || 79 || aṃdhakāṃdhakahaṃtrorvai vartamāne mahāhave || itthaṃ nāmnābhavacchukraḥ sa vai bhārgavanaṃdanaḥ || 4.1.16.80 || yathā ca vidyāṃ tāṃ prāpa mṛtasaṃjīvanīṃ parām || śaṃbhoranugrahātkāvyastanniśāmaya suvrata || 81 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || purā'sau bhṛgudāyādo gatvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || aṃḍajasvedajodbhijjajarāyuja gatipradām || 82 || saṃsthāpya liṃgaṃ śrīśaṃbhoḥ kūpaṃ kṛtvā tadagrataḥ || bahukālaṃ tapastepe dhyāyanviśveśvaraṃ prabhum || 83 || rājacaṃpakadhattūra karavīrakuśeśayaiḥ || mālatī karṇikāraiśca kadaṃbairbakulotpalaiḥ || 84 || mallikāśatapatrībhiḥ siṃduvāraiḥ sakiṃśukaiḥ || aśokaiḥ karuṇaiḥ puṣpaiḥ punnāgairnāgakesaraiḥ || 85 || kṣudrābhirmādhavībhiśca pāṭalā bilvacaṃpakaiḥ || navamallīvicikilaiḥ kuṃdaiḥ samucukuṃdakaiḥ || 86 || maṃdārairbilvapatraiśca droṇairmarubakairbakaiḥ || graṃthiparṇairdamanakaiḥ surabhūcūtapallavaiḥ || 87 || tulasī devagaṃdhārī bṛhatpatrī kuśāṃkuraiḥ || nadyāvartairagastyaiśca saśālairdevadārubhiḥ || 88 || kāṃcanāraiḥ kurabakairdūrvāṃkura kuraṃṭakaiḥ || pratyekamebhiḥ kusumaiḥ pallavairaparairapi ||89|| patraiḥ śatasahasraiśca sa samānarca śaṃkaram|| paṃcāmṛtairdroṇamitairlakṣakṛtvaḥ prayatnataḥ ||4.1.16.90|| snapayāmāsa deveśaṃ sugaṃdhasnapanairbahu || sahasrakṛtvo deveśaṃ caṃdanairyakṣakardamaiḥ ||91|| samāliliṃpa deveśaṃ sugaṃdhodvartanānyanu || gītanṛtyopahāraiśca śrutyuktastutibhirbahuḥ ||92|| nāmnāṃ sahasrairanyaiśca stotraistuṣṭāva śaṃkaram || sahasraṃ paṃcaśaradāmitthaṃ śukraḥ samarcayan || 93 || yadā devaṃ nāluloke manāgapi varonmukham|| tadānyaṃ niyamaṃ ghoraṃ jagrāhātīvaduḥsaham|| 94|| prakṣālya cetaso tyaṃtaṃ cāṃcalyākhyaṃ mahāmalam || bhāvanāvārbhi rasakṛdiṃdriyaiḥ sahitasya ca || 95 || nirmalīkṛtya tacceto ratnaṃ dattvā pinākine || prapapau kaṇadhūmaughaṃ sahasraṃ śaradāṃ kaviḥ ||96|| prasasāda tadā devo bhārgavāya mahātmane || tasmālliṃgādvinirgatya sahasrārkādhikadyutiḥ || 97 || uvāca ca virūpākṣaḥ sākṣāddākṣāyaṇīpatiḥ || taponidhe prasannosmi varaṃ varaya bhārgava || 98 || niśamyeti vacaḥ śaṃbhoraṃbhojanayano dvijaḥ || udyadānaṃdasaṃdoha romāṃcāṃcita vigrahaḥ || 99 || tuṣṭāvāṣṭatanuṃ tuṣṭaḥ praphu lla nayanāṃcalaḥ || maulāvaṃjalimādhāya vadañjayajayeti ca || 4.1.16.100 || bhārgava uvāca || || tvaṃ bhābhirābhirabhibhūya tamaḥ samastamastaṃ nayasyabhimatāni niśācarāṇām || dedīpyase maṇegaganehitāya lokatrayasya jagadīśvara tannamaste || 101 || loketivelamativelamahāmahobhirnirmāsi kaumudamudaṃ ca samutsamudram || vidrāvitākhilatamāḥ sutamohimāṃśo pīyūṣapūraparipūrita tannamaste || 102 || tvaṃ pāvane pathi sadāgatirasyupāsyaḥ kastvāṃ vinā bhuvanajīvanajīvatīha || stabdhaprabhaṃjana vivardhita sarvajaṃtosaṃtoṣitāhi kulasarvagatannamaste || 103 || viśvaikapāvakanatāvakapāvakaika śakterṛte'mṛtavatāmṛtadivyakāryam || prāṇityado jagadaho jagadaṃtarātmaṃstatpāvaka pratipadaṃ śamadaṃ namaste || 104 || pānīyarūpa parameśa jagatpavitra citraṃ vicitrasucaritra karoṣi nūnam || viśvapavitramamalaṃ kila viśvanātha pānāvagāhanata etadato natosmi || 105 || ākāśarūpa bahiraṃtarutāvakāśa dānādvikasvaramiheśvara viśvamaitat || tvattaḥ sadā sadayasaṃśvasiti svabhāvātsaṃkocameti bhavatosmi natastatastvām || 106 || viśvaṃbharātmaka bibharti vibho'traviśvaṃ ko viśvanātha bhavatonya tamastamore || tattvāṃ vinā na śamināṃ himajāhibhūṣastavyo'paraḥ paraparapraṇatastatastvām || 107 || ātmasvarūpa tava rūpa paraṃparābhirābhistataṃ hara carācara rūpametat || sarvāṃtarātmanilayapratirūparūpanityaṃnatosmi paramātmatano'ṣṭamūrte || 108 || ityaṣṭamūrtibhi rimābhirumābhivaṃdyavaṃdyātivaṃdya bhava viśvajanīnamūrte || etattataṃ suvitataṃ praṇatapraṇīta sarvātharsārthaparamārtha tato natosmi || 109 || aṣṭamūrtyaṣṭakeneṣṭaṃ pariṣṭūyeti bhārgavaḥ || bhargabhūmimilanmauliḥ praṇanāma punaḥpunaḥ || 4.1.16.110 || iti stuto mahādevo bhārgaveṇātitejasā || utthāpya bhūmerbāhubhyāṃ dhṛtvā taṃ praṇataṃ dvijam || 111 || uvāca daśanajyotsnā pradyotita digaṃtaraḥ || anenātyugratapasā hyananyācaritena ca || 112 || liṃgasthāpanapuṇyena liṃgasyārādhanena ca || cittaratnopahāreṇa śucinā niścalena ca ||113|| avimukta mahākṣetre pavitrācaraṇena ca || tvāṃ sutābhyāṃ prapaśyāmi tavādeyaṃ na kiṃcana || 114 || anenaiva śarīreṇa mamodaradarīṃ gataḥ || madvareṃdriyamārgeṇa putra janmatvameṣyasi || 115 || anyaṃ varaṃ prayacchāmi duṣprāpaṃ pārṣadairapi || harau hiraṇyagarbhepi prāyaśo'haṃ jugopayām || 116 || mṛtasaṃjīvanī nāma vidyā yā mama nirmalā || tapobalena mahatā mayaiva parinirmitā || 117 || tvāṃ tāṃ tu prāpayāmyadya maṃtrarūpāṃ mahāśuce || yogyatā te'sti vidyāyāstasyāḥ śucitaponidhe || 118 || yaṃyamuddiśyaniyatametāmāvartayiṣyasi || vidyāṃ vidyeśvaraśreṣṭha sa sa prāṇiṣyati dhuvam ||119|| atyarkamatyagniṃ(?) ca te tejo vyomnyatitārakam || dedīpyamānaṃ bhavitā grahāṇāṃ pravaro bhava ||4.1.16.120|| abhi tvāṃ ye kariṣyaṃti yātrāṃ nāryo naropi vā || teṣāṃ tvadṛṣṭipātena sarvaṃ kāryaṃ praṇaṃkṣyati || 121 || tavodaye bhaviṣyaṃti vivāhādīni suvrata || sarvāṇi dharmakāryāṇi phalavaṃti nṛṇāmiha || 122 || sarvāśca tithayo maṃdāstava saṃyogataḥ śubhāḥ || tava bhaktā bhaviṣyaṃti bahuśukrā bahuprajāḥ || 123 || tvayedaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ śukreśamiti saṃjñitam || ye'rcayiṣyaṃti manujāsteṣāṃ siddhirbhaviṣyati || 124 || āvarṣaṃ pratiśukraṃ ye naktavrataparā narāḥ || tvaddine śukrakūpe ye kṛtasarvodakakriyāḥ || 125 || śukreśamarcayiṣyaṃti śṛṇu teṣāṃ tu yatphalam || avaṃdhyaśukrāste martyāḥ putravaṃto'tiretasaḥ || 126 || puṃstvasaubhāgyasaṃpannā bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || vyapetavighnāste sarve janāḥ syuḥ sukhavāsinaḥ || iti dattvā varāndevastatra liṃge layaṃ yayau ||127|| gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || śukreśvarasya ye bhaktāḥ śukraloke vasaṃti te || viśveśvarāddakṣiṇataḥ śukreśosti paraṃtapa || 128 || tasya darśanamātreṇa śukraloke mahīyate || ityeṣā śukralokasya sthitiruktā mahāmate ||129 || agastya uvāca || || itthaṃ sadharmiṇi kathāṃ śukralokasya suvrate || śṛṇvannāṃgārakaṃ lokamāluloke'tha sa dvijaḥ || 4.1.16.130 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārdhe śukralokavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||16||
<4.1.17>
|| śivaśarmovāca || || śukrasaṃbaṃdhinī devau kathā śrāvi mayā śubhā || yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa prīṇite śravaṇe mama || 1 || kasya puṇyanidherlokaḥ śokahṛttveṣa nirmalaḥ || etadākhyātumudyuktau bhavaṃtau bhavatāṃ mama || 2 || dhayitvā śrotrapātrābhyāṃ vāṇīmamṛtarūpiṇīm || na tṛptimadhigacchāmi bhavanmukhasukhodgatām ||3|| || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || lohitāṃgasya lokoyaṃ śivaśarmannibodha ha || utpattiṃ cāsya vakṣyāvo bhūsutoyaṃ yathābhavat || 4 || purā tapasyataḥ śaṃbhordākṣāyaṇyā viyogataḥ || bhālasthalātpapātaikaḥ svedabiṃdurmahītale || 5 || tataḥ kumāraḥ saṃjajñe lohitāṃgo mahītalāt || snehasaṃvardhitaḥ sotha dhātryā dhātrīsvarūpayā || 6 || māheya ityataḥ khyātiṃ parāmeṣa gataḥ sadā || tatastepe tapotyugramugrapuryāṃ purānagha || 7 || asiśca varaṇā cāpi saritau yatra śobhane || dyunadyottaravāhinyā milite'tra jagaddhite || 8 || sarvagopi hi viśveśo yatra nityaṃ prakāśate || muktaye sarvajaṃtūnāṃ kālojjñita svavarṣmaṇām || 9 || amṛtaṃ hi bhavaṃtyeva mṛtā yatra śarīriṇaḥ || anugrahaṃ samāsādya paraṃ viśveśvarasya ha || 4.1.17.10 || apunarbhavadehāste ye'vimukretanutyajaḥ || vinā sāṃkhyena yogena vinā nānāvratādibhiḥ || 11 || saṃsthāpya liṃgaṃ vidhinā svanāmnāṃgārakeśvaram || pāṃcamudre mahāsthāne kaṃbalāśvatarottare || 12 || jvaladaṃgāravattejo yāvattasyaśarīrataḥ || viniryayau tapastāvattena taptaṃ mahātmanā || 13 || tatoṃgāraka nāmnā sa sarvalokeṣu gīyate || tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo dadau grahapadaṃ mahat || 14 || aṃgāraka caturthyāṃ ye snātvottaravahāṃbhasi || abhyarcyāṃgārakeśānaṃ namasyaṃti narottamāḥ ||15 || na teṣāṃ grahapīḍā ca kadācitkvāpi jāyate || aṃgāṃrakena saṃyuktā caturthī labhyate yadi ||16|| uparāgasamaṃ parva taduktaṃ kālavedibhiḥ || tasyāṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||17|| śraddhayā śrāddhadā ye vai caturthyaṃgārayogataḥ || teṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ bhavitā tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī || 18 || aṃgārakacaturthyāṃ tu purā jajñe gaṇeśvaraḥ || ataeva tu tatparva proktaṃ puṇyasamṛddhaye || 19|| ekabhaktavratī tatra saṃpūjya gaṇanāyakam|| kiṃciddattvā tamuddiśya na vighnairabhibhūyate || 4.1.17.20 || aṃgāreśvara bhaktā ye vārāṇasyāṃ narottamāḥ || te'sminnaṃgārake loke vasaṃti paramarddhayaḥ ||21|| agastya uvāca || || itthaṃ kathayatoreva ramyāṃ puṇyavatīṃ kathām || bhagavadgaṇayoḥ prāpa netrātithyaṃ guroḥ purī || 22 || netrānaṃdakarīṃ dṛṣṭvā śivaśarmā'tha tāṃ purīm || papracchācāryavaryasya kasyeyaṃ pūranuttamā || 23 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || sakhe sukhaṃ samākhyāvo nānākhyeyaṃ tavāgrataḥ || adhvakhedāpanodāya punarasyāḥ puraḥ kathām|| 24 || vidhervidhitsataḥ pūrvaṃ trilokīracanāṃ mudā || āvirāsuḥ sutāḥ sapta mānasāḥ svasyasaṃnibhāḥ || 25 || marīcyatryaṃgiro mukhyāḥ sarve sṛṣṭipravartakāḥ || prajāpateraṃgirasasteṣvabhūddevasattamaḥ || 26 || sutaścāṃgiraso nāma buddhyā vibudhasattamaḥ || śāṃto dāṃto jitakrodho mṛduvāṅnirmalāśayaḥ || 27 || vedavedārthatattvajñaḥ kalāsu kuśalo'malaḥ || pāradṛśvā tu sarveṣāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ nītivittamaḥ || 28 || hitopadeṣṭā hitakṛdahitātyahitaḥ sadā || rūpavāñchīlasaṃpanno guṇavāndeśakālavit || 29 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃbhāra saṃbhṛto guruvatsalaḥ || tatāpa tāpasīṃ vṛttiṃ kāśyāṃ sa mahatīṃ dadhata || 4.1.17.30 || mahalliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya śāṃbhavaṃ bhūribhāvanaḥ || ayutaṃ śaradāṃ divyaṃ divyatejā mahātapāḥ ||31|| tataḥ prasanno bhagavānviśveśo viśvabhāvanaḥ || āvirbhūya tato liṃgānmahasāṃ rāśirabravīt ||32|| prasannosmi varaṃ brūhi yatte manasi vartate || iti śaṃbhuṃ samālokya tuṣṭāveti sa hṛṣṭavān || 33 || || āṃgirasa uvāca || || jaya śaṃkara śāṃta śaśāṃkaruce rucirārthada sarvada sarvaśuce || śucidatta gṛhīta mahopahṛte hṛtabhaktajanoddhatatāpatate || 34 || tatasarvahṛdaṃbara varadanate natavṛjinamahāvana dāhakṛte || kṛtavividhacaritratanosutano tanuviśikhaviśoṣaṇadhairyanidhe || 35 || nidhanādi vivarjitakṛtanatikṛtkṛtivihitamanorathapannagabhṛt || nagabhartṛsutārpitavāmavapuḥ svavapuḥparipūritasarvajagat || 36 || trijaganmayarūpavirūpasudṛgdṛgudaṃcanakuṃcana kṛtahutabhuk || bhavabhūtapatepramathaikapate patiteṣvapidattakaraprasṛte || 37 || prasūtākhilabhūtalasaṃvaraṇapraṇavadhvanisaudhasudhāṃśudhara || vararājakumārikayā parayā paritaḥ parituṣṭa natosmi śiva || 38 || śivadeva girīśa maheśa vibho vibhavaprada giriśa śiveśamṛḍa || mṛḍayoḍupatidhra jagattritayaṃ kṛtayaṃtraṇabhaktivighātakṛtām || 39 || na kṛtāṃta ta eṣa bibhebhi harapraharāśu mahāghamamoghamate || namatāṃtaramanyadavaini śivaṃ śivapādanateḥ praṇatosmi tataḥ || 4.1.17.40 || vitate'tra jagatyakhile'ghaharaṃ hara toṣaṇameva paraṃ guṇavan || guṇahīnamahīna mahāvalayaṃ pralayāṃtakamīśa natosmi tataḥ || 41 || iti stutvā mahādevaṃ virarāmāṃgiraḥ sutaḥ || vyataracca maheśānaḥ stutyā tuṣṭo varānbahūn ||42|| || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || bṛhatā tapasānena bṛhatāṃ patiredhyaho || nāmnā bṛhaspatiriti graheṣvarcyobhava dvija || 43 || asmālliṃgārcanānnityaṃ jīvabhūtosi me yataḥ || ato jīva iti khyātiṃ triṣu lokeṣu yāsyasi ||44|| vācāṃ prapaṃcaiścaturairniṣprapaṃco yataḥ stutaḥ || ato vācāṃ prapaṃcasya patirvācaspatirbhava ||45|| asya stotrasya paṭhanādapi vāgudiyācca yam || tasya syātsaṃskṛtā vāṇī tribhirvarṣaistrikālataḥ || 46 || samutpanne mahākārye na sa buddhyā prahīyate || yaḥ paṭhiṣyatyadaḥ stotraṃ vāyavyākhyaṃ dinedine || 47 || asyastotrasya paṭhanānniyataṃ mama saṃnidhau || na durvṛttau pravṛttiḥ syādavivekavatāṃ nṛṇām || 48 || adaḥ stotraṃ paṭhañjaṃturjātupīḍāṃ grahodbhavām || na prāpsyati tato japyamidaṃ stotraṃ mamāgrataḥ || 49 || nityaṃ prātaḥ samutthāya yaḥ paṭhiṣyati mānavaḥ || imāṃ stutiṃ hariṣye'haṃ tasya bādhāḥ sudāruṇāḥ || 4.1.17.50 || tvatpratiṣṭhitaliṃgasya pūjāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ || imāṃ stutimadhīyāno manovāṃchāmavāpsyati || 51 || iti dattvā varāñchaṃbhuḥ punarbrahmāṇamāhvayat || seṃdrāndevagaṇānsarvānsayakṣoragakinnarān || 52 || tānāgatānsamālokya śivo vrahmāṇamabravīt || vidhevidhehi madvākyādamuṃ vācaspatiṃ munim || 53 || guruṃ sarvasureṃdrāṇāṃ paritaḥ svaguṇairgurum || abhiṣiṃca vidhānena devācārya pade mude || 54 || atīva dhiṣaṇādhīśo mamaprītobhaviṣyati || mahāprasāda ityājñāṃ śirasyādhāya tatkṣaṇāt || 55 || surajyeṣṭhaḥ surācāryaṃ cakārāṃgirasaṃ tadā || devaduṃdubhayo nedurnanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || 56 || gurupūjāṃ vyadhuḥ sarve gīrvāṇā muditānanāḥ || abhiṣikto vasiṣṭhādyairmaṃtrapūtena vāriṇā || 57 || punaranyaṃ varaṃ prādādgirīśaḥ pataye girām || śṛṇvāṃgirasa dharmātman devejyakulanaṃdana || 58 || bhavatāsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ subuddhiparivardhanam || bṛhaspatīśvara iti khyātaṃ kāśyāṃ bhaviṣyati || 59 || gurupuṣyasamāyoge liṃgametatsamarcya ca || yatkariṣyaṃti manujāstatsiddhimadhiyāsyati || 4.1.17.60 || bṛhaspatīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mayā gopyaṃ kalau yuge || asya saṃdarśanādeva pratibhā pratilabhyate ||61|| caṃdreśvarāddakṣiṇato vīreśānnairṛte sthitam || ārādhya dhiṣaṇeśaṃ vai guruloke mahīyate ||62|| gurvaṃganā gamanajaṃ pāpaṃ ṣaṇmāsa sevanāt || avaśyaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodayādyathā || 63 || ataeva hi goptavyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || bṛhaspatīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasyakasyacit ||64 || iti dattvā varāndevastatraivāṃtarhito bhavat || druhiṇo guruṇā sārdhaṃ seṃdropeṃdro bṛhaspatim || 65 || asminpurebhiṣicyātha visṛjyeṃdrādikānsurān || alaṃcakāra svaṃ lokaṃ viṣṇunā'numato dvija || 66 || || agastya uvāca || || atikramya gurorlokaṃ lopāmudre dadarśa saḥ || śivaśarmā purī saureḥ prabhāmaṃḍala maṃḍitām || 67 || pṛṣṭau tena ca tau tatra tāṃ purīṃ pradadarśatuḥ || dvijena dvijavaryāya gaṇavaryau śucismite ||68|| gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || mārīceḥ kaśyapājjajñe dākṣāyaṇyāṃ dvijoṣṇaguḥ || tasyabhāryābhavatsaṃjñā putrī tvaṣṭuḥ prajāpateḥ || 69 || bharturiṣṭā tatastasmādrūpayauvanaśālinī || saṃjñā babhūva tapasā sudīptena samanvitā || 4.1.17.70 || ādityasya hi tadrūpaṃ maṃḍalasya tu tejasā || gātreṣu paridadhyau vai nātikāṃtamivābhavat || 71 || na khalvayamṛtoṃ'ḍastha iti snehādabhāṣata || tadā prabhṛti lokeyaṃ mārtaṃḍa iti cocyate || 72 || tejastvabhyadhikaṃ tasya sā'sahiṣṇurvivasvataḥ || yenātitāpayāmāsa trailokyaṃ tigmaraśmibhṛt || 73 || trīṇyapatyāni bho brahmansaṃjñāyāṃ mahasāṃ nidhiḥ || ādityo janayāmāsa kanyāṃ dvau ca prajāpatī || 74 || vaivasvataṃ manuṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ yamaṃ ca yamunāṃ tataḥ || nātitejomayaṃ rūpaṃ soḍhuṃ sā'laṃ vivasvataḥ || 75 || māyāmayīṃ tataśchāyāṃ savarṇāṃ nirmame svataḥ || prāṃjaliḥ praṇatā bhūtvā saṃjñāṃ chāyā tadābravīt || 76 || tavājñākāriṇīṃ devi śādhi māṃ karavāṇi kim || saṃjñovāca tataśchāyāṃ savarṇe śṛṇu suṃdari || 77 || ahaṃ yāsyāmi sadanaṃ tvaṣṭustvaṃ punaratra me || bhavane vasa kalyāṇi nirviśaṃkaṃ mamājñayā || 78 || manureṣa yamāvetau yamunā yama saṃjñakau || svāpatyadṛṣṭyā draṣṭavyametadbālatrayaṃ tvayā || 79 || anākhyeyamidaṃ vṛttaṃ tvayā patyau śucismite || ityākarṇyātha sā tvāṣṭrīṃ devīṃ chāyā jagāda ha || 4.1.17.80 || ākacagrahaṇānnāhamāśāpācca kadācana || ākhyāsyāmi caritraṃ te yāhi devi yathāsukham || 81 || ityādiśya savarṇāṃ sā tathetyuktā savarṇayā || pituraṃtikamāsādya natvā tvaṣṭāramabravīt |||| 82 || pitaḥ soḍhuṃ na śaknomi tejastejonidheraham || tīvraṃ tasyāryaputrasya kāśyapasya mahātmanaḥ || || 83 || niśamyodīritaṃ tasyāḥ pitrānirbhartsitā bahu || bhartuḥ samīpaṃ yāhīti niyuktā sā punaḥpunaḥ || 84 || ciṃtāmavāpa mahatīṃ strīṇāṃ dhikceṣṭitaṃ tviti || niniṃda bahudhātmānaṃ strītvaṃ cāti niniṃda sā ||85|| svātaṃtryaṃ na kvacitstrīṇāṃ dhigasvātaṃtryajīvitam || śaiśave yauvane prāṃte pitṛbhartṛsutādbhayam ||86|| tyaktaṃ bhartṛgṛhaṃ maugdhyāddhaṃta duvṛrttayā mayā || avijñātāpi cedyāyāmatha patyurniketanam ||87 || tatrāsti sā savarṇā vai paripūrṇamanorathā || athāvatiṣṭhe sātraiva pitrā nirbhartsitāpyaham || 88 || tatoti caṃḍaścaṃḍāśuḥ pitroratibhayaṃkaraḥ || aho yaducyate lokairupākhyānamidaṃ hi tat || 89 || sphuṭaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayādyeti svakarāṃgārakarṣa(rpa?)ṇam || naṣṭaṃ bhartṛgṛhaṃ maugdhyācchreyo vā na piturgṛham |||| 4.1.17.90 || vayaśca prathamaṃ cāru rūpaṃ trailokyakāṃkṣitam || sarvābhibhavanaṃ strītvaṃ kulaṃ cātīva nirmalam || 91 || patiśca tādṛksarvajño lokacakṣustamopahaḥ || sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣī sarvaḥ sarvatrasaṃcaraḥ || 92 || mahyaṃ śreyaḥ kathaṃ vā syāditi sā pariciṃtya ca || agacchadvaḍavā bhūtvā tapase paryaniṃditā || 93 || uttarāṃśca kurūnprāpa caraṃtī nīrasaṃtṛṇam || vyuttepe ca tapastīvraṃ patimādhāya cetasi || tapobalena tatpatyuḥ sahiṣye teja ityalam || 94 || manyamānotha tāṃ saṃjñāṃ savarṇāyāṃ tadā raviḥ || sāvarṇiṃ janayāmāsa manumaṣṭamamuttamam || 95 || śanaiścaraṃ dvitīyaṃ ca sutāṃ bhadrāṃ tṛtīyikām || savarṇā sveṣvapatyeṣu sāpatnyātstrīsvabhāvataḥ || 96|| cakārābhyadhikaṃ snehaṃ na tathā pūrvajeṣvatha || manustatkṣāṃtavāñjyeṣṭho bhakṣyālaṃkāralālane || 97 || kaniṣṭheṣvadhikaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāvarṇyādiṣu no yamaḥ || kadācidroṣato bālyādbhāvinorthasya gauravāt || 98 || padā saṃtarjayāmāsa yamaḥ saṃjñāsarūpiṇīm || taṃ śaśāpa ca sā krodhātsāvarṇerjananī tadā || 99 || jighāṃsatā tvayā pāpa māṃ yadaṃghriḥ samudyataḥ|| acirāttatpatatveṣa taveti bhṛśaduḥkhitā || 4.1.17.100 || mātṛśāpa paritrasto yamopi pituragrataḥ || śaśaṃsa sarvaṃ tadvṛttaṃ rakṣarakṣetyuvāca ca || 101 || mātrāsu teṣu sarveṣu vartanīyaṃ samaṃ yataḥ || tasyāṃ mayodyataḥ pādo na dehe paripātitaḥ || 102 || bālyādvā yadi vā mohāttadbhavānkṣaṃtumarhasi || gopate śāpato māturmā patatvaṃghrireṣa me ||103|| || vivasvānuvāca || || aparādhasahasrepi jananī na śapetsutam || tasmātkimapi bho bāla bhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam || 104 || yena tvāṃ sā'śapatkrodhāddharmajñaṃ satyavādinam || mātṛśāponyathākartuṃ na śakyaḥ kenacitkvacit || 105 || kṛmayo māṃsamādāya yāsyaṃtyasmānmahītalam || itthaṃ tu caritārthaḥ syācchāpastrāto bhavānapi || 106 || iti putraṃ samāśvāsya raviraṃtaḥpuraṃ yayau || ciramālokya tāṃ bhāryāmuvāca savitā vacaḥ || 107 || ayi bhāmini bāleṣu sameṣvapi kutastvayā || vidhīyate'dhikaḥ snehaḥ sāvarṇyādiṣvanādiṣu || 108 || nācacakṣe yadāsā'tha bhāsvate paripṛcchate || tadātmānaṃ samādhāya sojñāsītsarvameva hi || 109 || tato bhagavate śaptumudyate sā śaśaṃsa ha || yathāvṛttaṃ tathā tathyaṃ tutoṣa bhagavānapi || 4.1.17.110 || tathyabhāṣaṇatastāṃ tu ravirjñātvā nirāgasam || na śaśāpa ca saṃkruddho yayau ca tvaṣṭuraṃtikam ||111|| tvaṣṭāpi ca yathānyāyaṃ sānvayaṃ tigmatejasam|| nirdagdhukāmaṃ kopena prāgānarca mudā tadā || vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ tvaṣṭovācā'śu taṃ ravim || 112 || tvaṣṭovāca || || tavātitejaso bhītā prāpyottarakurūn rave || vaḍavārūpamāsthāya vane carati śādvale|| 113 || draṣṭā hi tāṃ bhavānadya svāṃ bhāryāmāryacāriṇīm || adhṛṣyāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejasā niyamena ca || 114 || tvaṣṭrā yattakṣitaḥ sūryastasyaivānumatena ca || bhramimāropya yatnena sotikāṃtataro'bhavat || 115 || labdhānujño'tha savitā gatvottarakurūnaram || sākṣāttapomayīṃ lakṣmīṃ caraṃtīṃ ca tapo mahat || 116 || dadarśa vaḍavārūpāṃ vāḍavānalatejasam || nīrasā nitṛṇānyeva vṛṇvaṃtīṃ yogamāyayā || 117 || anenasaṃ sa vijñāya tāṃ tvāṣṭrīmaśvarūpiṇīm || saharirharirūpeṇa mukhena samabhāvayad || 118 || tvaramāṇā ca paritaḥ parapūruṣaśaṃkayā || sā tanniravamacchukraṃ nāsikābhyāṃ vivasvataḥ || 119 || devau tasmādajāyetāmaśvinau bhiṣajāṃvarau || svarūpamanurūpaṃ ca dyumaṇistāmadarśayata || 4.1.17.120 || tutoṣa sāpi taṃ dṛṣṭvā mitraṃ netramudāvaham || patiṃ pativratā kāṃ taṃ svāṃtasaṃtāpahāriṇam || 121 || nirvṛttiṃ ca parāṃ prāpa duṣprāpaṃ tapasātha kim || tapa eva paraṃ śreyastapa eva paraṃ dhanam || 122 || tapa eva hi devatve kāraṇaṃ paramaṃ matam || śivaśarmanyadetadvai dṛśyate cātidīptimat || 123 || jyotiścakrasvarūpaṃ ca vyomnyuparyadha eva ca || tatsarvamiha jānīhi sumahattāpasaṃ mahaḥ ||124|| evaṃ śanaiścaro jajñe savarṇāyāṃ vivasvataḥ || so'tha vārāṇasīṃ gatvā sarvatridaśavaṃditām || 125 || taptvā tapo'tivipulaṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya śāṃkaram || imaṃ lokamavāpoccairgrahatvaṃ ca harārcanāta ||126|| śanaiścareśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vārāṇasyāṃ suśobhanam || śanibādhā na jāyeta śanivāre tadarcanāt ||127|| viśveśāddakṣiṇebhāge śukreśāduttareṇa hi || śanaiścareśamabhyarcya loke'tra parimodate || 128 || śrutvā'dhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ grahapīḍā na jāyate || nopasargabhayaṃ tasya kāśyāṃ nivasataḥ sataḥ || 129 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe bhaumaguruśanilokavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<4.1.18>
|| agastiruvāca || || iti śṛṇvankathāṃ ramyāṃ śivaśarmā'tha māthuraḥ || muktipuryāṃ susaṃsnāto māyāpuryāṃ gatāsukaḥ ||1|| netrayoḥ prāghuṇī cakre tataḥ saptarṣimaṃḍalam || vrajansa vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamaṃte viṣṇupurīkṣaṇāt || 2 || uvāca ca prasannātmā stutaścāraṇamāgadhaiḥ || prārthito devakanyābhistiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cakṣaṇam ||3|| sthitā sutāsu niḥśvasasya maṃdabhāgyā vayaṃ tviti || gataḥ puṇyatamām̐llokānasau yatpuṇyavattamaḥ || 4 || iti śṛṇavanmukhāttāsāṃ vacanāni vimānagaḥ || devau kasyāyamatulo lokastejomayaḥ śubhaḥ || 5 || iti dvijavacaḥ śrutvā procaturgaṇasattamau || śivaśarmañchivamate sadā saptarṣayomalāḥ ||6|| vasaṃtīha prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ viniyuktāḥ prajāsṛjā || marīciratriḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ kraturaṅgirāḥ || 7 || vasiṣṭhaśca mahābhāgo brahmaṇo mānasāḥ sutāḥ || sapta brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ || 8 || saṃbhūtiranasūyā ca kṣamā prītiśca sannatiḥ || smṛtirūrjā kramādeṣāṃ patnyo lokasya mātaraḥ ||9|| eteṣāṃ tapasā caitaddhāryate bhuvanatrayam || utpādya brahmaṇā pūrvamete proktā maharṣayaḥ ||4.1.18.10|| prajāḥ sṛjata re putrā nānārūpāḥ prayatnataḥ|| tataḥ praṇamya brahmāṇaṃ tapase kṛtaniścayāḥ || 11 || avimuktaṃ samāsādya kṣetraṃkṣetrajñadhiṣṭhitam || muktaye sarvajaṃtūnāmavimuktaṃ śivena yat || 12 || pratiṣṭhāpya ca liṃgāni te svanāmnāṃkitāni ca || śiveti parayā bhaktyā tepurugraṃ tapo bhṛśama||13|| tuṣṭastattapasā śaṃbhuḥ prājāpatyapadaṃ dadau || liṃgānyatrīśvarādīni dṛṣṭvā kāśyāṃ prayatnataḥ || 4 || prājāpatye'tra te loke vasaṃtyujjvalatejasaḥ || gokarṇeśasya sarasaḥ pratyaktīre pratiṣṭhitam || 15 || liṃgamatrīśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmatejobhivardhate || karkoṭa vāpyā īśāne marīceḥ kuṃḍamuttamam || 185 || tatra snātvā naro bhakttyā bhrājate bhāskaro yathā || marīcīśvara saṃjñaṃ tu tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 17 || talliṃgadarśanādvipra mārīcaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || kāṃtyā marīcimālīva śobhate puruṣarṣabhaḥ || 18 || pulaheśa pulastyeśau svargadvārasya paścime || tau dṛṣṭvā manujo loke prājāpatye mahīyate || 19 || harikeśavane ramye dṛṣṭvaivāṃgiraseśvaram || iha loke vasedvipra tejasāparibṛṃhitaḥ || 4.1.18.20 || varaṇāyāstaṭe ramye dṛṣṭvā vāsiṣṭhamīśvam || kratvīśvaraṃ ca tatraiva labhate vasatiṃ tviha || 21 || kāśyāmetāni liṃgāni sevitāni śubhaiṣibhiḥ|| manobhivāṃchitaṃ dadyuriha loke paratra ca||22|| gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || śivaśarmanmahābhāga tiṣṭhate sātra suṃdarī || aruṃdhatī mahāpuṇyā pativrataparāyaṇā || 23 || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa gaṃgāsnāna phalaṃ labhet || aṃtaḥpuracarairdvitraiḥ pavitraiḥ sahito vibhuḥ || 24 || sadā nārāyaṇo devo yasyāścakre kathāṃ mudā || kamalāyāḥ purobhāge pātivratya sutoṣitaḥ || 25 || pativratāsvaruṃdhatyāḥ kamale vimalāśayaḥ || yathāsti na tathā'nyasyāḥ kasyāścitkāpi bhāmini ||26|| na tadrūpaṃ na tacchīlaṃ na tatkaulīnyameva ca || na tatkalāsukauśalyaṃ patyuḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ na tat || 27 || na mādhuryaṃ na gāṃbhīryaṃ na cāryaparitoṣaṇam || aruṃdhatyā yathā devi tathā'nyāsāṃ kvacitpriye || 28 || dhanyāstā yoṣito loke sabhāgyāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ || aruṃdhatyāḥ prasaṃge yā nāmāpi parigṛhṇate || 29 || yadā pativratānāṃ tu kathāsmadbhavane bhavet || tadā prāthamikīṃ rekhāmeṣā'laṃkurute satī || 4.1.18.30 || bruvatoriti saṃkathāṃ tathā gaṇayorvaiṣṇavayormudāvahām || dhruvalokaupāgatastato nayanātithyamatathyavarjitaḥ || 31 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe saptarṣilokavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||
<4.1.19>
śivaśarmovāca || tiṣṭhannekena pādena koyaṃ bhramati sattamau || anekaraśanāvyagra hastāgro vyagralocanaḥ ||1|| trilokīmaṃḍapastaṃbha sannibhobhābhirāvṛtaḥ || atulaṃ jyotiṣāṃ rāśiṃ tulayā tulayanniva||2|| sūtradhāra iva vyoma vyāyāmaparimāpakaḥ || traivikramoṃghridaṃḍo vā proddaṃḍo gaganāṃgaṇe || 3 || athavāṃbarakāsārasārayūpasvarūpadhṛk || koyaṃ kathaya taṃ devau kṛpayā parayā mama || 4 || niśamyeti vacastasya vayasyasya vimānagau|| praṇayādāhatustasmai dhruvāṃ dhruvakathāṃ gaṇau ||5|| || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasyāsīduttānacaraṇaḥ sutaḥ || tasya kṣitipatervipra dvau sutau saṃbabhūvatuḥ || 6 || surucyāmuttamo jyeṣṭhaḥ sunītyāṃ tu dhruvo paraḥ || madhye sabhaṃ narapaterupaviṣṭasya caikadā || 7 || sunītyā rājasevāyai niyukto'laṃkṛtorbhakaḥ || dhruvo dhātreyikāputraiḥ samaṃ vinayatatparaḥ || 8 || sa gatvottānacaraṇaṃ kṣoṇīśaṃ praṇanāma ha || dṛṣṭvottamaṃ tadutsaṃge niviṣṭaṃ janakasya vai || 9 || proccasiṃhāsanasthasya nṛpaterbālyacāpalāt || āroḍhukāmastvabhavatsaunīteyastadā dhruvaḥ || 4.1.19.10 || ārurukṣumavekṣyāmuṃ surucirdhuvamabravīt || daurbhageya kimāroḍhumiccheraṃkaṃ mahīpateḥ || 11 || bālabāliśabuddhitvādabhāgyā jaṭharodbhava || asminsiṃhāsane sthātuṃ na tvayā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam || || 12 || yadi syātsukṛtaṃ tatkiṃ durbhagodarago'bhavaḥ || anenaivānumānena budhyasva svālpapuṇyatām || 13 || bhūtvā rājakumāropi nālaṃkuryā mamodaram || sukukṣijamamuṃ paśya tvamuttamamanuttamam || 14 || adhijānudharājānermānena paribṛṃhitam || prāṃśoḥ siṃhāsanasyāsya ruciścedadhirohaṇe || 15 || kukṣiṃ hitvā kimavasaḥ suruceśca surociṣam || madhye bhūpasabhaṃ bālastayeti paribhartsitaḥ || 16 || patannipītabāṣpāṃburdhairyātkiṃcinna coktavān || ucitā'nucitaṃ kiṃcinnocivānsopi pārthivaḥ || 17 || niyaṃtrito mahiṣyāśca tasyāḥ saubhāgyagauravāt || vimṛjya ca sabhālokaṃ śokaṃ saṃmṛjya ceṣṭitaiḥ || 18 || śaiśavaiḥ sa śiśurnatvā nṛpaṃ svasadanaṃ yayau || sunītirnītinilayamavalokyātha bālakam || 19 || sukhalakṣmyaivacājñāsīddhruvaṃ samavamānitam || abhisṛtya ca taṃ bālaṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya sā sakṛt || 4.1.19.20 || kiṃcitparimlānamiva sasāṃtvaṃ pariṣasvaje || atha dṛṣṭvā sunītiṃ sa rahoṃtaḥ puravāsinīm ||21|| dīrghaṃ niḥśvasya bahuśo māturagre ruroda ha || sāṃtvayitvāśrunayanā vadanaṃ parimārjya ca || 22 || dukūlāṃcala saṃparkairmṛdulairmṛdupāṇinā || papraccha tanayaṃ mātā vada rodanakāraṇam || vidyamāne narapatau śiśo kenāpamānitaḥ || 23 || apothasamupaspṛśya tāṃbūlaṃ parigṛhya ca || mātrā pṛṣṭaḥ soparodhaṃ dhruvastāṃ paryabhāṣata ||24 || saṃpṛcche janani tvāhaṃ samyakśaṃsa mamāgrataḥ || bhāryātvepi ca sāmānye kathaṃ sā suruciḥ priyā || 25 || kathaṃ na bhavatī mātaḥ priyā kṣitipaterasi || kathamuttamatāṃ prāpta uttamaḥ suruceḥ sutaḥ || 26 || kumāratvepi sāmānye kathaṃ tvahamanuttamaḥ || kathaṃ tvaṃ maṃdabhāgyāsi sukukṣiḥ suruciḥ katham ||27|| kathaṃ nṛpāsanaṃ yogyamuttamasya kathaṃ na me || kathaṃ me sukṛtaṃ tucchamuttamasyottamaṃ katham || 28 || iti śrutvā vacastasya sunītirnītimacchiśoḥ || kiṃciducchvasya śanakaiḥ śiśukopopaśāṃtaye || 29 || svabhāvamadhurāṃ vāṇīṃ vaktuṃ samupacakrame || sāpatnaṃ pratighaṃ tyaktvā rājanītividāṃvarā ||4.1.19.30|| || sunītiruvāca || || ayi tāta mahābuddhe viśuddhenāṃtarātmanā || nivedayāmi te sarvaṃ mā'pamāne matiṃ kṛthāḥ || 31 || tayā yaduktaṃ tatsarvaṃ tathyameva na cānyathā || sāpatyurmahiṣīrājño rājñīnāmati vallabhā || 32 || tayā janmāṃtare tāta yatpuṇyaṃ samupārjitam || tatpuṇyopacayādrājā surucyāṃ surucirbhṛśam || 33 || mādṛśyo maṃdabhāgyāyāḥ pramadāsu pratiṣṭhitāḥ || kevalaṃ rājapatnītvavādastāsu na tadruciḥ || 34 || mahā sukṛtasaṃbhārairuttamaścottamodare || uvāsa tasyāḥ puṇyā yā nṛpasiṃhāsanocitaḥ || 35 || ātapatraṃ ca caṃdrābhaṃ śubhe cāpi ca cāmare || bhadrāsanaṃ tathoccaṃ ca siṃdhurāśca madoddhurāḥ || 36 || turaṃgamāśca turagāstvanādhivyādhijīvitam || niḥsapatnaṃ śubhaṃ rājyaṃ prājyaṃ hariharārcanam || 37 || vipulaṃ ca kalājñānamadhītamaparājitam || tathā jayoriṣaḍvarge svabhāvātsāttvikī matiḥ || 38 || dṛṣṭiḥ kāruṇyasaṃpūrṇā vāṇī madhurabhāṣiṇī || anālasyaṃ ca kāryeṣu tathā gurujane natiḥ || 39 || sarvatra śucitā tāta sā paropakṛtiḥ sadā || aurjasvalā manovṛttiḥ sadaivādīnavāditā || || 4.1.19.40 || sadojire ca pāṃḍityaṃ prāgalbhyaṃ caraṇāṃgaṇe || ārjavaṃ baṃdhuvargeṣu kāṭhinyaṃ krayavikraye || 41 || mārdavaṃ strīprayogeṣu vatsalatvaṃ prajāsu ca || brāhmaṇebhyo bhayaṃ nityaṃ vṛddhavṛttyupajīvanam || 42 || vāso bhāgīrathītīre tīrthe vā maraṇaṃ raṇe || aparāṅmukhatā'rthibhyaḥ pratyarthibhyo viśeṣataḥ || 43 || bhogaḥ parijanaiḥ sārdhaṃ dānāvaṃdhyadināgamaḥ || vidyāvyasanitā nityaṃ nityaṃ pitrorupasthitiḥ || 44 || yaśasaḥ saṃcayo nityaṃ nityaṃ dharmasya saṃcayaḥ || svargāpavargayoḥ siddhiḥ sadā śīlasya maṃḍanam || 45 || sadbhiśca saṃgatirnityaṃ maitrī ca pitṛmitrakaiḥ || itihāsapurāṇānāmutkaṃṭhā śravaṇe sadā || 46 || vipadyapi paraṃ dhairyaṃ sthairyaṃ saṃpatsamāgame || gāṃbhīryaṃ vāgvilāseṣu audāryaṃ pātrapāṇiṣu || 47 || dehe paraikā kṛśatā tapobhirniyamairyamaiḥ || etairmanorathaphalaiḥ phalatyeva tapodrumāḥ || 48 || tasmādalpatapastvādvai tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca mahāmate || prāpyāpi rājasāṃnidhyaṃ rājalakṣmyā na bhājanam || 49 || mānāpamānayostasmātsvakṛtaṃ kāraṇaṃ param || sraṣṭāpi nāpamārṣṭuṃ tatparīṣṭe svakṛtāṃ kṛtim || mā śocastvamataḥ putra diṣṭamiṣṭaṃ samarpayet ||4.1.19.50 || ityākarṇya sunītyāstanmahāvākyaṃ sunītimat || saunīte yo dhruvovācamādade vaktumuttaram || 51 || dhruva uvāca || || janayitri sunīte me śṛṇu vākyamanākulam || mā bāla iti matvā māmavamaṃsthāstapasvini || 52 || yadyahaṃ mānave vaṃśe jātosmyatyaṃta pāvane || uttānapādatanayastvadīyodara saṃbhavaḥ ||53|| tapa eva hi cenmātaḥ kāraṇaṃ sarvasaṃpadām || tattadāsāditaṃ vidvipadamanyairdurāsadam || 54 || ekameva hi sāhāyyaṃ kuru mātarataṃdritā || anujñā dānamātraṃ ca āśīrbhirabhinaṃdaya || || 55 || sāpi jñātvā mahāvīryaṃ kumāraṃ kukṣisaṃbhavam || mahatyotsāhasaṃ pattyā rājamānamuvāca tam || 56 || anujñātuṃ na śaktā'haṃ tvāmuttānaśayāṃgaja || sāṣṭaikavarṣadeśīyantathāpi kathayāmyaham || 57 || sapatnīvākyabhallībhirbhinne mahati me hṛdi || tava bāṣpaughavārīṇi na tiṣṭhaṃti karomi kim || 58 || tāni manye'tra mārgeṇa sravaṃtyavirataṃ śiśo || sravaṃtīśca cikīrṣaṃti pratikūla jalāḥ kila || 59 || tvadekatanayā tāta tvadādhāraikajīvitā || tvamaṃgayaṣṭirasi me tvanmukhāsaktalocanā || 4.1.19.60 || labdhosi katibhiḥ kaṣṭairiṣṭāḥ saṃprārthya devatāḥ || tvanmukheṃdūdaye tāta manmanaḥ kṣīranīradhiḥ || 61 || ānandapayasāpūrya kucāvudvelito bhavet || tvadaṃgasaṃgasaṃbhūta sukhasandoha śītalā || 62 || sukhaṃśaye suśayane prāvṛtya pulakāṃbaram || apo'tha samupaspṛśya tāṃbūlaṃ parigṛhya ca ||63|| tvadāsyasyauṣṭhapuṭaka dugdhavārdhi vivardhitām || sudhāsudhāṃśuvadanadhayatyapi dhinomi na || 64 || tvadīyaḥ śītalālāpaḥ prāpa śrutipathaṃ yadā || sapatnīvākyadavathustadaivatyātsa vepathuḥ ||65|| yadaṃga nidrāsiciraṃ dhyāyaṃtyasmi tadetyaham || kadā nidrā daridrosau bhavitārkodaye'bjavat ||66|| yadopeyā gṛhānvatsa khelitvā bālakhelanaiḥ || tadānarghyārghyamutsraṣṭuṃ stanausyātāmivonmukhau || || 67 || yadā saudhādviniryāyāḥ padmarekhāṃkitaṃ padam || prāṇānāṃ te yiyāsūnāṃ tadā tadavalaṃbanam || 68 || yadāyadā bahiryāsi putra tricaturaṃ padam || tadātadā mama prāṇaḥ kaṃṭhaprāghuṇikī bhavet || 69 || citraṃ putra tvarayati yātuṃ me mānasāṃḍajaḥ || sudhādhārādhara iva bahiścirayati tvayi || 4.1.19.70 || atha tiṣṭhaṃtu kaṭhināḥ prāṇāḥ kaṃṭhāṭavītaṭe || tapasyaṃtotisaṃtaptāstapase tvayi yāsyati || 71 || ityanujñāmanuprāpya jananī caraṇāṃbujau || kṣaṇaṃ maulijajaṃbāla jaḍau kṛtvā dhruvo yayau || 72 || tayāpi dhairyasūtreṇa sunītyā pariguṃphya ca || netreṃdīvarajāmālā dhruvasyopāyanīkṛtā || 73 || mātrātanmārgarakṣārthaṃ tadā tadanugīkṛtāḥ || parairavāryaprasarāḥ svāśīrvādāḥ paraḥśatāḥ || 74 || svasaudhātsa vinirgatya bālo'bālaparākramaḥ || anukūlena marutā darśitādhvā'viśadvanam || 75 || samaruttaruśākhāgra prasāraṇamiṣeṇa saḥ || kṛtāhūtiriva premṇā vanena vanamāviśat || 76 || samātṛdaivatobhijñaḥ kevalaṃ rājavartmani || na veda kānanādhvānaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dadhyau nṛpātmajaḥ || 77 || yāvadunmīlya nayane puraḥ paśyati sa dhruvaḥ || tāvaddadarśa saptarṣīnatarkita gatīnvane || 78 || vāliśeṣvasahāyeṣu bhavedbhāgyaṃ sahāyakṛt || araṇyānyāṃ raṇe gehe tato bhāgyaṃ hi kāraṇam || ||79|| kva rājatanayo bālo gahanaṃ kva ca tadvanam || balātsvasātpratkurvatyai namaste bhavitavya te ||4.1.19.80|| yatra yasya hi yadbhāvyaṃ śubhaṃ vā'śubhameva ca || ākṛṣyabhāvinī rajjustatra tasya hi dāpayeta || 81 || anyathā vidadhātyeṣa mānavo buddhivaibhavāt || bhagavatyā bhavitryā'sau vidadhyādvidhiranyathā || 82 || navayo na ca vai citryaṃ na citraṃ vidadhehitam || na balaṃ nodyamaḥ puṃsāṃ kāraṇaṃ prākkṛtaṃ kṛtam ||83 || atha dṛṣṭvā sa saptarṣīnsaptasaptyatitejasaḥ || bhāgyasūtrairivākṛṣyopanītānpramumoda ha || 84 || tilakāṃkita sadbhālānkuśopagrahitāṃgulīn || kṛṣṇājinopaviṣṭāṃśca yajñasūtrairalaṃkṛtān || 85 || sākṣasūtrakarānkiṃcidvinimīlitalo canān || sudhautasūkṣmakāṣāyavāsaḥ prāvaraṇānvitāna || 86 || akāṃḍepi mahābhāgānmilitānsaptanīradhīn || citraṃ vipadvinirmagnānuddidhīrṣūniva prajāḥ || 87 || upagamya vinamraḥ sa prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ || dhruvo vijñāpayāṃcakre praṇamya lalitaṃ vacaḥ || 88 || || dhruva uvāca || || avaita māṃ munivarāḥ sunītyudarasaṃbhavam|| uttānapādatanayaṃ dhruvaṃ nirviṇṇamānasam || 89 || idaṃ vanamanuprāptaṃ sanāthaṃ yuṣmadaṃghribhiḥ || prāyonabhijñaṃ sarvatra maharddhyuṣitamānasam ||4.1.19.90|| te dṛṣṭvorjasvalaṃ bālaṃ svabhāva madhurākṛtim || anarghyanayanepathyaṃ mṛdugaṃbhīrabhāṣiṇam || 91 || upopaveśya śiśukaṃ procurvai vismitā bhṛśam || ahobālaviśālākṣa mahārāja kumāraka || 92 || vicāryāpi na jānīmo vada nirvedakāraṇam || adya te hyarthaciṃtā no kvāpamānaḥ prasūrgṛhe || 93 || nīrukcharīrasaṃpattirnivede kiṃ nu kāraṇam || anavāptābhilāṣāṇāṃ vairāgyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || 94 || saptadvīpapaterājñaḥ kumārastvaṃ tathā katham || svabhāvabhinnaprakṛtau lokesminna manogatam || 95 || avagaṃtuṃ hi śakyeta yūno vṛddhasya vā śiśoḥ || iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ sahajapremanirbharam || 96 || vācaṃ jagrāha sa tadā śiśuḥ prāṃśumanorathaḥ ||dhruva uvāca || || preṣito rājasevārthaṃ jananyā'haṃ munīśvarāḥ || 97 || rājāṃkamārurukṣurhi surucyā paribhartsitaḥ || uttamaṃ cottamīkṛtya māṃ ca manmātaraṃ tathā ||98|| dhikkṛtya praśaśaṃsa svaṃ nirvede kāraṇaṃ tvidam || niśamyeti śiśorvākyaṃ parasparamavekṣya te ||99|| kṣātrameva śaśaṃsustadaho bālepi na kṣamā|| 4.1.19.100 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kimasmābhiraho kāryaṃ kastavāsti manorathaḥ || jñāto bhavatu tāvatsa naḥ śravo gocarī kuru || 101 || || dhruva uvāca || || munayo mama yo baṃdhuruttamaścottamottamaḥ || pitrā dattaṃ ca so'dhyāstāṃ tadbhadrāsanamuttamam || 102 || bhavatkṛtaṃ hi sāhāyyametadicchāmi suvratāḥ || prāyo jāne na bālatvādupadeśastaducyatām || 103 || ananyanṛpabhuktaṃ yadyadanyebhyaḥ samucchritam || iṃdrādiduravāpaṃ yatkathaṃ labhyaṃ durāsadam || 104 || pitrotsṛṣṭaṃ na kāṃkṣāmi kāṃkṣāmi svabhujājitam || manorathapathātītaṃ bhavedyatpiturapyaho || 105 || pitṛsaṃpattibhoktāraḥ prāyaśo na yaśodhanāḥ || narottamāstu te jñeyā ye pitrādhikyadarśinaḥ || 106 || upārjitaṃ hi pitrā ye nāśayaṃti yaśaḥśrutam || dhanaṃ nidhanamevāstu teṣāṃ durvṛttacetasām || 107 || iti śrutvā vacastasya munayaḥ sunayorjitam || yathārthameva pratyūcurmarīcyādyāstathā dhruvam || 108 || marīciruvāca || || anarcitācyutapadaḥ padamāpadyate katham || yathātathātvamātthāṃga nātathyaṃ kathayāmyaham || 109 || atriruvāca || anāsvāditagoviṃdapadāṃbujarajorasaḥ || manorathapathātītaṃ sphītaṃ nākalayetpadam || 4.1.19.110 || aṃgirā uvāca || || adavīyaḥ padaṃ tasya sarvāsāṃ saṃpadāmiha || kamalākāṃtakāṃtāṃghri kamale yaḥ suśīlayet || 111 || || pulastya uvāca || || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa mahāpātakasaṃtatiḥ || paramāṃtamavāpnoti sa viṣṇuḥ sarvado dhruva || 112 || || pulaha uvāca || || yadāhuḥ paramaṃ brahma pradhāna puruṣātparam || yanmāyayā tataṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ dāsyati socyutaḥ || 113 || || kraturuvāca || || yo yajñapuruṣo viṣṇurvedavedyo janārdanaḥ || aṃtarātmā'sya jagataḥ tuṣṭaḥ kiṃ na yacchati || 114 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || yadbhrūnartanavartinyaḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau nṛpātmaja || tamārādhya hṛṣīkeśamapavargopyadūrataḥ || 115 || dhruva uvāca || || satyamuktaṃ munīśānā viṣṇorārādhanaṃ prati || kathaṃ vā bhagavānījyaḥ savidhiścopadiśyatām ||116|| || munaya ūcuḥ || || tiṣṭhatā gacchatā vāpi svapatā jāgratā tathā || śayānenopaviṣṭena japyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā ||117|| dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa vāsudevātmakena ca|| dhyāyaṃścaturbhujaṃ viṣṇuṃ japtvā siddhiṃ na ko gataḥ || 118 || atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam || kṣaṇaṃ sarvātmakaṃ paśyanko na sidhyati bhūtale ||119|| putrānkalatramitrāṇi rājyaṃ svargāpavargakam || vāsudevaṃ japanmartyaḥ sarvaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 4.1.19.120 || vāsudeva japāsaktānapipāpakṛto janān || nopaspṛśaṃti vai vighnā yamadūtāśca dāruṇāḥ || 121 || pitāmahena tepyeṣa mahāmaṃtra upāsitaḥ || manunā rājyakāmena vaiṣṇavena maharddhinā || 122 || tvamapyetena maṃtreṇa vāsudevaparo bhava || yathābhilaṣitāmṛddhiṃ kṣipramāpnuhi sattama || 123 || ityuktvāṃ'tarhitāḥ sarve mahātmāno munīśvarāḥ || vāsudevamanā bhūtvā dhruvopi tapase gataḥ || 124 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūvārddhe dhruvalokavarṇane dhuvopadeśonāmaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
<4.1.20>
|| gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || auttānapādirnirgatya tataḥ kānanato dvija || ramyaṃ madhuvanaṃ prāpa yamunāyāstaṭe mahata || 1 || ādyaṃ bhagavataḥ sthānaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ harimedhasaḥ || pāpopi jaṃtustatprāpya niṣpāpo jāyate dhruvam || 2 || japansa vāsudevākhyaṃ paraṃbrahma nirāmayam || apaśyattanmayaṃ viśvaṃ dhyānastimitalocanaḥ || 3 || harirharitsu sarvāsu harirharimarīciṣu || śivāmṛgamṛgeṃdrādi rūpaḥ kānanago hariḥ || 4 || jale śālūrakūrmādi rūpeṇa bhagavānhariḥ || hariraśvādirūpeṇa maṃdurāsvapi bhūbhujām || 5 || anaṃtarūpaḥ pātāle gagane'naṃtasaṃjakaḥ || ekopyanaṃtatāṃ yāto rūpabhedairanaṃtakaiḥ || 6 || deveṣu yo vasennityaṃ devānāṃ vasatirhi yaḥ || sa vāsudevaḥ sarvatra dīvyedyadvāsanāvaśāt || 7 || viplṛvyāptāvayaṃdhāturyatrasārthakatāṃ gataḥ|| te viṣṇunāma svarūpe hi sarvavyāpanaśīlini || 8 || sarveṣāṃ ca hṛṣīkāṇāmīśanātparameśvaraḥ || hṛṣīkeśa iti khyāto yaḥ sa sarvatrasaṃsthitaḥ || 9 || na cyavaṃtepi yadbhaktā mahati pralaye sati || ato'cyuto'khile loke sa ekaḥ sarvago'vyayaḥ || 4.1.20.10 || idaṃ carācaraṃ viśvaṃ yo babhāra svalīlayā || bhṛtyāsvarūpasaṃpattyā so'tra viśvaṃbharo'khilam || 11 || tasyekṣaṇe samīkṣete nānyadvipṇupadādṛte || nirīkṣyaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣo nānyo niyamato hyataḥ || 12 || nānya śabdagrahau tasya jātau śabdagrahāvapi || vinā mukuṃda goviṃda dāmodara caturbhuja || 13 || goviṃdacaraṇārthārcāṃ tatpriyaṃkarmavai vinā || śaṃkhacakrāṃkitau tasya nānyakarmakaraukarau || 14 || nirdvaṃdvacaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ tanmano manute hareḥ || hitvānyanmananaṃ sarvaṃ niścalatvamavāpa ha || 15 || caraṇau viṣṇuśaraṇau hitvā nārāyaṇāṃgaṇam || tasya no caratonyatra carato vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 16 || vāṇīpramāṇī kriyate goviṃdaguṇavarṇane || joṣaṃ samāsatā tena mahāsāraṃ tapasyatā || 17 || nitāṃtakamalākāṃta nāmadheyasudhārasam || rasayaṃtī na rasanā tasyānyarasaspṛhā || 18 || śrīmukuṃda padadvaṃdva padmāmodapramoditam || gaṃdhāṃtaraṃ na tadghrāṇaṃ parijighratyaśīghragam || 19 || tvagiṃdriyaṃ madhuripoḥ parispṛśya padadvayam || sarvasparśasukhaṃ prāpa tasya bhūjānijanmanaḥ || 4.1.20.20 || śabdādiviṣayādhāraṃ sāraṃ dāmodaraṃ param || dhruveṃdriyāṇi saṃprāpya kṛtārthānyabhavaṃstadā || 21 || luptāni sarvatejāṃsi tattapastapanodaye || caṃdrasūryānalarkṣāṇāṃ pradīpita jagattraye || 22 || iṃdra caṃdrāgni varuṇa samīraṇa dhanādhipāḥ || yama nairṛtamukhyāśca jātāḥ svapadaśaṃkitāḥ || 23 || vaimānikāstathā'nyepi vasumukhyā divaukasaḥ || tato dhuvātsamuttresuḥ svādhikāraidhitādhayaḥ ||24|| yatra yatra dhruvaḥ pādaṃ minoti pṛthivītale || dharā tasya bharākrāṃtā vinamettatra tatra vai ||25|| aho tadaṃgasaṃgīni tyaktvā jāḍyaṃ jalānyapi || rasavaṃti padasthāni sphuraṃtyanyatra tadbhayāt || 26 || yāvaṃti viṣvaktejāṃsi siddharūpaguṇāni ca || netrātithīni tāvaṃti tattapastejasā'bhavan || 27 || aho nijaguṇasparśaḥ satataṃ mātariśvanā || dūradeśāṃtarasthopi tattvaco viṣayīkṛtaḥ || 28 || vyomnāpi śabdaguṇinā dhruvārādhanabuddhinā || śabdajātastvaśeṣopi tatkarṇa śaraṇīkṛtaḥ ||29|| ārādhito'nudivasaṃ sabhūtairapi paṃcabhiḥ || tapa eva paraṃ mene goviṃdārpita mānasaḥ || 4.1.20.30 || kaustubhodbhāsitahṛdaḥ pītakauśeyavāsasaḥ || dhyānāttejomayaṃ viśvaṃ tenaikṣi nṛpasūnunā || 31 || marutvatātimahatī ciṃtā'ptā tattapobhayāt || matpadaṃ cedakāṃkṣiṣyadahariṣyaddhruvaṃ dhuvaḥ || 32 || samarthastvapsarovargo niyaṃtuṃ yamināṃ yamān || sa tu yūni prabhavati nātra bāle karomi kim || 33 || tapasvināṃ tapo haṃtuṃ dvau matsāhāyyakāriṇau || kāmakraudhau na tāvasminprabhavetāṃ śiśau dhruve || 34 || eka eva kilopāyo bāle me prabhaviṣyati || bhūtāliṃ bhīṣaṇākārāṃ prahiṇomīha tadbhiye || 35 || bālatvādbhīṣito bhūtaistapastyakṣyatyasau dhruvam || iti niścitya bhūtāliṃ preṣayāmāsa vāsavaḥ || 36 || bhallūkākārasarvāṃga uṣṭralaṃbaśirodharaḥ || kaściddurdarśadaśanastvabhyadhāvattamarbhakam || 37 || taṃ vyāghravadanaḥ kaścidvyādāya vikaṭānanam || dvipocca dehasaṃsthāno muhurgarjansamabhyagāt || 38 || rayāttu māṃsakaṃ bhuṃjankaścidvikaṭadaṃṣṭrakaḥ || roṣāttamabhidudrāva dṛṣṭvā saṃtarjayanniva || 39 || atitīkṣṇairviṣāṇāgraistaṭānuccānvidārayan || khurāgrairdalayanbhūmiṃ mahokṣo'bhijagarjatam || 4.1.20.40 || kaściddhi pannagī bhūya phaṭāṭopabhayānakaḥ || atiloladvirasanaḥ pusphūrjanikaṣācitam || 41 || kaścicca mahiṣākāraḥ kṣipañśṛṃgāgrato giron || lāṃgūlatāḍitadharaḥ śvasanvegāttamāptavān|| 42 || kaściddāvānalālīḍha kharjūradrumasannibham || bibhradūrudvayaṃbhūto vyāttāsyastamabhīṣayat || 43 || maulijairabhrasaṃgharṣaṃ kurvandīrghakṛśodaraḥ || nimagnapiṃganayanaḥ kaścidbhīṣayati sma tam || 44 || kṛpāṇapāṇirbhagnāsyo vāmahastakapāladhṛt || pracaṃḍaṃ kṣveḍayankaścidabhyadhāvattamarbhakam || 45 || viśāla sālamādāya kurvankila kilāravam || kaścittamabhito yāti kālo daṃḍadharo yathā || 46 || tamaḥ saṃketasadanaṃ vyāghraṃ vai vadanaṃ mahat|| kṛtāṃtakaṃ darākāraṃ bibhratkaścittamabhyagāt|| 47 || ulūkākāratāṃ dhṛtvā phūtkārairatidāruṇaiḥ || hṛdayākaṃpanaiḥ kaścidbhīṣayāmāsa taṃ dhruvam || 48 || yakṣiṇī kācidānīya rudaṃtaṃ kasyacicchiśum || apibadrudhiraṃ koṣṭhāccakhādāsthi mṛṇālavat || 49 || pipāsitādya rudhiraṃ tepi pāsyāmyahaṃ dhuva || yathāsya bālasya tathā carvitvāsthīni vādinī || 4.1.20.50 || anīya tṛṇadārūṇi paristīrya samaṃtataḥ || dāvāgniṃ jvālayāmāsa kācidvātyāvivardhitam || 51 || vetālī rūpamāsthāya bhaṃktvā kācittarūngirīn || rurodha gaganādhvānaṃ kaṃpayaṃtī ca taṃ bhṛśam || 52 || anyā sunītirūpeṇa tamabhiprekṣya dūrataḥ || rurodātīvaduḥkhārtā vakṣoghātaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 53 || uvāca ca vacaścāṭu bahumāyā vinirmitam || kāruṇyapūrṇa vātsalyamatīvātanvatī satī || 54 || tvadekaśaraṇāṃ vatsa bata mṛtyurjighāṃsati || rakṣarakṣa gatāsuṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatavatsala || 55 || pratigrāmaṃ pratipuraṃ pratyadhvaṃ pratikānanam || pratyāśramaṃ pratigiriṃ śrāṃtā tvadvīkṣaṇāturā || 56 || yadā prabhṛti re bāla niragāttapase bhavān || tadeva dinamārabhya nirgatā'haṃ tvadīkṣaṇe || 57 || taistaiḥ sapatnīdurvākyairdunopi tvaṃ yathārbhaka || tathā'hamapi dūnāsmi nitarāṃ tadvaco'gninā || 58 || na nidrāmi na jāgarmi nāśnāmi na pibāmyaham || dhyāyāmi kevalaṃ tvā'haṃ yoginīva viyoginī ||59|| nidrādaridranayanā svapnepi na tavānanam || ānaṃdi sarvathā yanme maṃdabhāgyā vilokaye || 4.1.20.60 || tvadānanapratinidhirvidhurvidhurayā mayā || uditvaropināloki tāpaṃ vai tyaktukāmayā || 61 || tvadālāpasamālāpaṃ kalayankilakākalīm || kokilopi mayākarṇi nālakākīrṇakarṇayā ||62|| tvadaṃgasaṃgamadhuro dhruvadhūpitayāmayā || nānilopi mayāliṃgi kvacidviśrāṃtayā bhṛśam || 63 || ke deśāḥ kāśca saritaḥ ke śailāstvatkṛte dhruva || mayā caraṇacāriṇyā rājapatnyā na laṃghitāḥ || 64 || adhruvaṃ sarvamevaitatpaśyaṃtyaṃdhīkṛtāsmyaham || dhātrīṃ trāyasva māṃ putra prāpya tvaṃmeṃ'dhayaṣṭitām || 65 || mṛdulāni tavāṃgāni kvemāni kva tapastvidam || paruṣaṃ puruṣaiḥ sādhyaṃ paruṣāṃgairnararṣabha || 66 || anena tapasā vatsa tvayā''pyaṃ kimanenasā || dharādhīśatanūjatvādadhikaṃ tadvadādhunā || 67 || anena vayasā bāla khelanīyaṃ tvayā'niśam || bālakrīḍanakairanyaiḥ savayaḥ śiśubhiḥ samam || 68 || tataḥ kaumāramāsādya vayo'bhidhyānaśīlinā || bhavatā sarvavidyānāṃ bhāvyaṃ vai pāradṛśvanā || 69 || vayotha caturaṃ prāpya yoṣāsrakcaṃdanādikān || nirvekṣyasi bahūnbhogāniṃdriyārthānkṛtārthayan || 4.1.20.70 || utpādyātha bahūnputrānguṇino dharmavatsalān || parisaṃkrāmitaśrīkasteṣvatho tvaṃ tapaścara || 71 || idānīmeva tapasi bālye vayasi kaḥ śramaḥ || pādāṃguṣṭhakarīṣāgniḥ kadā maulimavāpsyati || 72 || vipakṣaparibhūtena hṛtamānena kenacit || paribhraṣṭaśriyā vāpi taptavyaṃ teṣu ko bhavān || 73 || hṛtamānena taptavyaṃ niśamyeti vaco dhruvaḥ || dīrghamuṣṇaṃ hi niḥśvasya punardadhyau hariṃ hṛdi || 74 || janayitrīmanābhāṣya bhūtabhītiṃ vihāya ca || dhruvo'cyutadhyānaparaḥ punareva babhūva ha || 75 || sāpi bhūtāvalī bhītiṃbahubhīṣaṇabhūṣaṇā || darśayaṃtī tamabhito'drākṣīccakraṃ sudarśanam || 76 || paritaḥ pariveṣābhaṃ sūryasyoccaiḥ sphuratprabham || rakṣaṇāya ca rakṣobhyastasyādhokṣaja nirmitam || 77 || bhūtāvalī tamālokya sphuraccakrasudarśanam || jvālāmālākulaṃ tīvraṃ rakṣaṃtaṃ parito dhruvam || 78 || atīva niṣkaṃpahṛdaṃ govidārpitacetasam || tapoṃkuramivodbhidya medinīṃ samuditvaram || 79 || sāpi pratyutabhītātaṃ dhruvaṃ dhruvaviniścayam || namaskṛtya yathāyātaṃ yātāvyarthamanorathā || 4.1.20.80 || garjatkādaṃbinījālaṃ vyomni vai vyākulaṃ yathā || vṛthā bhavati saṃprāpya manāganilalolatām || 81 || atha jaṃbhāriṇā sārdhaṃ bhītāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ || saṃmaṃtrya tvaritā jagmurbrahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ dvija || 82 || natvā vijñāpayāmāsuḥ pariṣṭutyā pitāmaham || vaco'vasaramālokya pṛṣṭāgamanakāraṇāḥ || 83 || || devā ūcuḥ || || dhātaruttānapādasya tanayena suvarcasā || tapatā tāpitāḥ sarve trilokī talavāsinaḥ || 84 || samyaksaṃvidmahe tāta dhuvasya na manīṣitam || padaṃ parijihīrṣuḥ sa kasyāsmāsu mahātapāḥ || 85 || iti vijñāpito devairvihasya caturānanaḥ || pratyuvācātha tānsarvāndhruvato bhītamānasān || 86 || || brahmovāca || || na bhetavyaṃ surāstasmāddhruvāddhruvapadaiṣiṇaḥ || vrajaṃtu vijvarāḥ sarve na sa vaḥ padamicchati || 87 || na tasmādbhagavadbhaktādbhetavyaṃ kenacitkvacit || niścitaṃ viṣṇubhaktā ye na te syuḥ paratāpinaḥ || 88 || ārādhya viṣṇuṃ deveśaṃ labdhvā tasmātsvakāṃkṣitam || bhavatāmapi sarveṣāṃ padāni sthirayiṣyati || 89 || niśamyeti ca gīrvāṇāḥ praṇītaṃ brahmaṇo vacaḥ || praṇipatya svadhiṣṇyāni prahṛṣṭāḥ parivavrajuḥ || 4.1.20.90 || atha nārāyaṇo devastaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛḍhamānasam || ananyaśaraṇaṃ bālaṃ gatvā tārkṣyaratho'bravīt || 91 || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || prasannosmi mahābhāga varaṃ varaya suvrata || tapaso'smānnivartasva ciraṃ khinnosi bālaka || 92 || vaco'mṛtaṃ samākarṇya paryunmīlya vilocane || iṃdranīlamaṇijyotiḥ paṭalīṃ paryalokayat || 93 || pratyagravikasannīlotpalānāṃ nikuraṃbakaiḥ || protphullitāṃ samaṃtācca rodasī sarasīmiva || 94 || lakṣmīdevīkaṭākṣoghaiḥ kaṭākṣitamivākhilam || dhuvastadāniraikṣiṣṭa dyāvābhūmyoryadaṃtaram || 95 ||
prodyatkādaṃbinīmadhya vidyuddāmasamānaruk || puraḥ pītāṃbaraḥ kṛṣṇastena netrātithīkṛtaḥ || 96 || nabho nikaṣa pāṣāṇo merukāṃcana rekhitaḥ || yathātathā dhruveṇaikṣi tadā garuḍavāhanaḥ || 97 || sunīlagaganaṃ yadvadbhūṣitaṃ tu kalāvatā || pītena vāsasā yuktaṃ sa dadarśa hariṃ tadā || 98 || daṃḍavatpraṇipatyātha paritaḥ pariluṭhya ca || ruroda dṛṣṭveva ciraṃ pitaraṃ duḥkhitaḥ śiśuḥ ||99|| nāradena sanaṃdena sanakena susaṃstutaḥ || anyaiḥ sanatkumārādyairyogibhiryogināṃ varaḥ ||4.1.20.100|| kāruṇyavāṣpanīrārdra puṃḍarīkavilocanaḥ|| dhruvamutthāpayāṃcakre cakrī dhṛtvā kareṇa tam||101|| haristu paripasparśa tadaṃgaṃ dhūlidhūsaram || karābhyāṃ sukaṭhorābhyāṃ nityaṃ śāstraparigrahāt|||102|| sparśanāddevadevasya susaṃskṛtamayī śubhā || vāṇī pravṛttā tasyāsyāttuṣṭāvātha dhruvo harim || 103 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe dhruvākhyāne bhagavaddarśananāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
<4.1.21>
|| dhruva uvāca || || namo hiraṇyagarbhāya sarvasṛṣṭividhāyine || hiraṇyaretase tubhyaṃ suhiraṇyapradāyine || 1 || namo harasvarūpāya bhūtasaṃhārakāriṇe || mahābhūtātmabhūtāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ || 2 || namaḥ sthitikṛte tubhyaṃ viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave || tṛṣṇāharāya kṛṣṇāya mahābhāra sahiṣṇave || 3 || namo daityamahāraṇya dāvavahnisvarūpiṇe || daityadrumakuṭhārāya namaste śārṅgapāṇaye ||4|| namaḥ kaumodakīvyagra karāgrāya gadādhara || mahādanujanāśāya namo naṃdakadhāriṇe || 5 || namaḥ śrīpataye tubhyaṃ namaścakradharāya ca || dharādharāya vārāha rūpiṇe paramātmane || 6 || namaḥ kamalahastāya kamalāvallabhāya te || namo matsyādirūpāya namaḥ kaustubhavakṣase || 7 || namo vedāṃtavedyāya namaḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe || namo guṇasvarūpāya guṇine guṇavarjite || 8 || namaste padmanābhāya pāṃcajanyadharāya ca || vāsudeva namastubhyaṃ devakīnaṃdanāya ca || 9 || pradyumnāya namastubhyamaniruddhāya te namaḥ || namaḥ kaṃsavināśāya namaścāṇūramardine || 4.1.21.10 || dāmodarahṛṣīkeśa gorvidācyutamādhava || upeṃdrakaiṭabhā'rāte madhuhaṃtaradhokṣaja || 11 || nārāyaṇāya narakahāriṇe pāpahāriṇe || vāmanāya namastubhyaṃ haraye śauraye namaḥ || 12 || anaṃtāya namastubhyamanaṃtaśayanāya ca || rukmiṇīpataye tubhyaṃ rukmipramathanāya ca || 13 || caidyahaṃtre namastubhyaṃ dānavāresurāraye || mukuṃdaparamānaṃda naṃdagopapriyāya ca || 14 || namaste puṃḍarīkākṣa danujeṃdra niṣūdine || namo gopālarūpāya veṇuvādanakāriṇe || 15 || gopīpriyāya keśighne govardhanadharāya ca || rāmāya raghunāthāya rāghavāya namonamaḥ || 16 || rāvaṇāre namastubhyaṃ vibhīṣaṇaśaraṇyada || ajāya jayarūpāya raṇāṃgaṇavicakṣaṇa ||17|| kṣaṇādi kālarūpāya nānārūpāya śārṅgiṇe || gadine cakriṇe tubhyaṃ daityacakravimardine ||18|| balāya balabhadrāya balārātipriyāya ca || baliyajñapramathana namo bhaktavaraprada || 19 || hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣo vidāraṇa raṇapriya || namo brahmaṇyadevāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca || 4.1.21.20 || namaste dharmarūpāya namaḥ sattvaguṇāya ca || namaḥ sahasraśirase puruṣāya parāya ca || 21 || sahasrākṣa sahasrāṃghre sahasrakiraṇāya ca || sahasramūrte śrīkāṃta namaste yajñapūruṣa ||22|| vedavedyasvarūpāya namo vedapriyāya ca|| vedāya vedagadine sadācārādhvagāmine ||23|| vaikuṃṭhāya namastubhyaṃ namo vaikuṃṭhavāsine|| viṣṭaraśravase tubhyaṃ namo garuḍagāmine ||24|| viṣvaksena namastubhyaṃ jaganmaya janārdana|| trivikramāya satyāya namaḥ satyapriyāya ca||25|| keśavāya namastubhyaṃ māyine brahmāgāyine|| taporūpāya tapasāṃ namaste phaladāyine || 26 || stutyāya stutirūpāya bhaktastutiratāya ca || namaste śrutirūpāya śrutyācāra priyāya ca || 27 || aṃḍajāya namastubhyaṃ svedajāya namostu te || jarāyuja svarūpāya nama udbhijjarūpiṇe || 28 || devānāmiṃdrarūposi grahāṇāmasi bhānumān || lokānāṃ satyaloko'si siṃdhūnāṃ kṣīrasāgaraḥ || 29 || surāpagā'si saritāṃ sarasāṃ mānasaṃ saraḥ || himavānasi śailānāṃ dhenūnāṃ kāmadhugbhavān || 4.1.21.30 || dhātūnāṃ hāṭakamasi sphaṭikaścopaleṣvasi || nīlotpalaṃ prasūneṣu vṛkṣeṣu tulasī bhavān || 31 || sarvapūjyaśilānāṃ vai śālagrāma śilā bhavān || muktikṣetreṣu kāśī tvaṃ prayāgastīrthapaṃktiṣu ||32|| varṇeṣu śvetavarṇo'si dvipadāṃ brāhmaṇo bhavān || garuḍosyaṃḍajeṣvīśa vyavahāreṣu vāgbhavān || 33 || vedeṣūpaniṣadrūpā maṃtrāṇāṃ praṇavohyasi || akṣarāṇāmakārosi yajvanāṃ somarūpadhṛk || 34 || pratāpināmagnirasi kṣamā'si tvaṃ kṣamāvatām || dātṝṇāmasi parjanyaḥ pavitrāṇāṃ parohyasi || 35 || cāposi sarvaśastrāṇāṃ vāto vegavatāmasi || manosīṃdriyavargeṣu nirbhayāṇāṃ karohyasi || 36 || vyomavyāptimatāṃ tvaṃ vai paramātmā'si cātmanām || saṃdhyopāstirbhavāndeva sarvanityeṣu karmasu|| 37 || kratūnāmaśvamedhosi dānānāmabhayaṃ bhavān || lābhānāṃ putralābhosi vasaṃtastvamṛtuṣvaho ||38|| yugānāṃ prathamosi tvaṃ tithīnāṃ tvaṃ kuhūrhyasi || puṣyosi nakṣatragaṇe saṃkramaḥ sarvaparvasu || 39 || yogeṣu vyatipātastvaṃ tṛṇeṣu hi kuśo bhavān || udyamānāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ nirvāṇaṃ tvamasi prabho || 4.1.21.40 || sarvāsāmiha buddhīnāṃ dharmabuddhirbhavānaja || aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣeṣu somavallī latāsu ca || 41 || prāṇāyāmosi sarvepu sādhaneṣu śuciṣvaho || sarvadaḥ sarvaliṃgeṣu śrīmānviśveśvaro bhavān || 42 || mitrāṇāṃ hi kalatraṃ tvaṃ dharmastvaṃ sarvabaṃdhuṣu || tvatto nānyajjagatyasminnārāyaṇa carācare || 43 || tvameva mātā tvaṃ tātastvaṃ sutastvaṃ mahādhanam || tvameva saukhyasaṃpattistvamāyurjīvaneśvaraḥ || 44 || sā kathā yatra te nāma tanmano yattvadarpitam || tatkarma yattvadarthaṃ vai tattapo yadbhavatsmṛtiḥ ||45|| taddhanaṃ dhanināṃ śuddhaṃ yattvadarthe vyayīkṛtam || sa eva sakalaḥ kālo yasmiñjiṣṇo tvamarcyase || 46 || tāvacca jīvitaṃ śreyo yāvattvaṃ hṛdi vartase || rogāḥ praśamamāyāṃti tvatpādodaka sevanāt || 47 || mahāpāpāni goviṃda bahujanmārjitānyapi || sadyo vilayamāyāṃti vāsudeveti kīrtanāt || 48 || aho puṃsāṃ mahāmohastvaho puṃsāṃ pramādatā || vāsudevamanādṛtya yadanyatra kṛtaśramāḥ || 49 || idameva hi māṃgalyamidameva dhanārjanam || jīvitasya phalaṃ caitadyaddāmodarakīrtanam || 4.1.21.50 || adhokṣajātparodharmo nārtho nārāyaṇātparaḥ || na kāmaḥ keśavādanyo nāpavargo hariṃ vinā || 51 || iyameva parā hānirupasargo yamevahi || abhāgyaṃ paramaṃ caitadvāsudevaṃ na yatsmaret || 52 || harerārādhanaṃ puṃsāṃ kiṃ kiṃ na kurute bata || putramitrakalatrārtha rājyasvargāpavargadam || 53 || haratyaghaṃ dhvaṃsayati vyādhīnādhīnniyacchati || dharmaṃ vivardhayetkṣipraṃ prayacchati manoratham || 54 || bhagavaccaraṇadvaṃdvaṃ nirddvaṃdva dhyānamuttamam || pāpināpi prasaṃgena vihitaṃ svahitaṃ param || 55 || pāpināṃ yāni pāpāni mahopapadabhāṃjyapi || sulīnadhyānasaṃpanno nāmoccāro harerharet ||56|| pramādādapi saṃspṛṣṭo yathā'nalakaṇo dahet || tathauṣṭhapuṭasaṃspṛṣṭa harināma haredagham || 57 || nitāṃtaṃ kamalākāṃte śāṃtacittaṃ vidhāya yaḥ || saṃśīlayetkṣaṇaṃ nūnaṃ kamalā tatra niścalā ||58|| ayameva parodharmastvidameva paraṃ tapaḥ || idameva paraṃ tīrthaṃ viṣṇupādāṃbu yatpibeta || 59 || tavopahāraṃ bhaktyāya sevate yajapūruṣa || sevitastena niyataṃ puroḍāśo mahādhiyā || 4.1.21.60 || sa caivāvabhṛthasnātaḥ sa ca gaṃgājalāplutaḥ || viṣṇupādodakaṃ kṛtvā śaṃkhe yaḥ snāti mānavaḥ || 61 || śālagrāma śilā yena pūjitā tulasī dalaiḥ || sa pārijātamālābhiḥ pūjyate surasadmani || 62 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā yadi vetaraḥ || viṣṇubhakti samāyukto jñeyaḥ sarvottamaśca saḥ || 63 || śaṃkhacakrāṃkitatanuḥ śirasāṃ maṃjarīdharaḥ || gopīcaṃdanaliptāṃgo dṛṣṭaścettadaghaṃ kutaḥ || 64 || pratyahaṃ dvādaśaśilāḥ śālagrāmasya yo'rcayet || dvāravatyāḥ śilāyuktaḥ sa vaikuṃṭhe mahīyate || 65 || tulasī yasya bhavane pratyahaṃ paripūjyate || tadgṛhaṃ nopasarpaṃti kadācidyamakiṃkarāḥ || 66 || harināmākṣaramukhaṃ bhāle gopīmṛdāṃkitam || tulasīmālitoraskaṃ spṛśeyurnayamānugāḥ || 67 || gopīmṛttulasī śaṃkhaḥ śālagrāmaḥ sacakrakaḥ || gṛhepi yasya paṃcaite tasya pāpabhayaṃ kuta. || 68 || ye muhūrtāḥ kṣaṇā ye ca yā kāṣṭhā ye nimeṣakāḥ || ṛte viṣṇusmṛteryātāsteṣu muṣṭo yamena saḥ || 69 || kva dvayakṣaraṃ harernāma sphuliṃgasadṛśaṃ jvaleta || mahatī pātakānāṃ ca rāśistūlopamā kva ca || 4.1.21.70 || goviṃda paramānaṃdaṃ mukuṃdaṃ madhusūdanama || tyaktvānyaṃ naiva jānāmi na bhajāmi smarāmi na || 71 || na namāmi na ca staumi na paśyāmīha cakṣuṣā || na spṛśāmi na vāyāmi gāyāmi na na hariṃ vinā || 72 || jale sthale ca pātālepyanile cānale'cale || vidyādharāsurasure kiṃ nare vānare nare || 73 || tṛṇestraiṇe ca pāṣāṇe tarugulmalatāsu ca || sarvatra śyāmalatanuṃ vīkṣe śrīvatsavakṣasam || 74 || sarveṣāṃ hṛdayāvāsaḥ sākṣātsākṣī tvameva hi || bahiraṃtarvinā tvāṃ tu nahyanyaṃ vedmi sarvagam || 75 || ityuktvā virarāmāsau śivaśarmandhruvastadā || devopi bhagavānviṣṇustamuvāca prasannadṛk || 76 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || api bāla viśālākṣa dhruva dhruvamate'nagha || parijñāto mayā samyaktavahṛtstho manorathaḥ || 77 || annādbhavaṃti bhūtāni vṛṣṭerannasamudbhavaḥ || tadvṛṣṭeḥ kāraṇaṃ sūryaḥ sūryādhāro dhruvaidhi bhoḥ ||78|| jyotiścakrasya sarvasya graharkṣādeḥ samaṃtataḥ || gagane bhramato nityaṃ tvamādhāro bhaviṣyasi || 79 || meḍhībhūtastu vai sarvānvāyupāśairniyaṃtritān || ākalpaṃ tatpadaṃ tiṣṭha bhrāmayañjyotiṣāṃgaṇān || 4.1.21.80 || ārādhya śrī mahādevaṃ purāpadamidaṃ mayā || āsādiyattadetatte tapasā pratipāditam || 81 || keciccaturyugaṃ yāvatkecinmanvaṃtaraṃ dhruva || tiṣṭhaṃti tvaṃ tu vai kalpaṃ padametatpraśāsyasi || 82 || manunāpi na yatprāpi kimanyairmānavairdhruva || tatpadaṃ vihitaṃ tvatsācchakrādyairapi durlabham || 83 || anyānvarānprayacchāmi stavenānena toṣitaḥ || sunītirapi te mātā tvatsamīpe cariṣyati || 84 || idaṃ stotravaraṃ yastu paṭhiṣyati samāhitaḥ || trisaṃdhyaṃ manujastasya pāpaṃ yāsyati saṃkṣayam||85|| na tasya sadanaṃ lakṣmīḥ parityakṣyatyasaṃśayam || na jananyā viyogaśca na baṃdhukalahodayaḥ || 86 || dhruvastutiriyaṃ puṇyā mahāpātakanāśinī || brahmahāpi viśuddhyeta kā kathetara pāpinām || 87 || mahāpuṇyasya jananī mahāsaṃpattidāyinī || mahopasargaśamanī mahāvyādhivināśinī || 88 || yasyā'stiparamā bhaktirmayi nirmalacetasaḥ || dhruvastutiriyaṃ tena japyā matprītikāriṇī || 89 || samasta tīrthasnānena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || tatphalaṃ samyagāpnoti
