japanstutyānayā mudā || 4.1.21.90 || saṃti stotrāṇyanekāni mama prītikarāṇi ca || dhruvastuterna caitasyāḥ kalāmarhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 91 || śrutvāpīmāṃ stutiṃ martyaḥ śraddhayā parayā mudā || pātakairmucyate sadyo mahatpuṇyamavāpnuyāt || 92 || aputraḥ putramāpnoti nirdhano dhanamāpnuyāt || abhakto bhaktimāpnoti kīrtanācca dhruvastuteḥ || || 93 || dattvā dānānyanekāni kṛtvā nānā vratāni ca || yathālābhānavāpnoti tathā stutyā'nayā naraḥ || 94 || tyaktvā sarvāṇi kāryāṇi tyaktvā japyānyanekaśaḥ || dhruvastutiriyaṃ japyā sarvakāmapradāyinī || 95 || śrībhagavānuvāca || || dhruvāvadhehi vakṣyāmi hitaṃ tava mahāmate || yena te niścalaṃ samyakpadametadbhaviṣyati || 96 || ahaṃ jigamiṣustvāsaṃ purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām || sākṣādviśveśvaro yatra tiṣṭhate mokṣakāraṇam || 97 || vipannānāṃ ca jaṃtūnāṃ yatra viśveśvaraḥ svayam || karṇe jāpaṃ prakurute karmanirmūlana kṣamam || 98 || asya saṃsāraduḥkhasya sarvopadravadāyinaḥ || upāya eka evāsti kāśikānaṃdabhūmikā || 99 || idaṃ ramyamidaṃ neti bījaṃ duḥkhamahātaroḥ || tasminkāśyagninā dagdhe duḥkhasyāvasaraḥ kutaḥ ||4.1.21.100|| prāpya saṃprāpyate yena na bhūyo yena śocyate || parāyānirvṛteḥ sthānaṃ yattadānaṃdakānanam || 101 || amṛtāyanamutsṛjya puruṣonyatra yo vaset || ānaṃdakānanaṃ śaṃbhoḥ kutastasya sukhodayaḥ || 102 || varaṃ śarāvahastasya cāṃḍālāgāravīthiṣu || bhikṣārthamaṭanaṃ kāśyāṃ rājyaṃ nānyatra nīriṣu || 103 || vaikuṃṭhanagarātkāśīṃ nityaṃ viśveśamarcitum || ahamāyāmi niyamājjagadarcyaṃ tadarcitām || 104 || mayi yā paramā śaktistrilokyā rakṣaṇakṣamā || tatra heturmaheśānaḥ sa sudarśanacakradaḥ || 105 || purā jālaṃdharaṃ daityaṃ mamāpi parikaṃpanam || pādāṃguṣṭhāgrarekhotthaṃ cakraṃ sṛṣṭvā haro'harat || 106 || tacca cakraṃ mayā labdhaṃ netrapadmārcanādvibhoḥ || etatsudarśanākhyaṃ vai daityacakrapramardanam || 107 || tanmayā tava rakṣārthaṃ bhūtavidrāvaṇaṃ param || tāvatpraṇunnaṃ puratastataścāhamihāgataḥ ||108|| kāśīmidānīṃ yāsyāmi viśveśvara vilokane|| adya yātrā'sti mahatī kārtikyāṃ bahupuṇyadā || 109 || kārtikasya caturdaśyāṃ viśveśaṃ yo vilokayet || snātvā cottaravāhinyāṃ na tasya punarāgatiḥ || 4.1.21.110 || ityuktvā tārkṣyamāropya dhruvamānaṃdameduram || kṣaṇādvārāṇasīṃ prāpa hariḥ smaraharoṣitām || 111 || paṃcakrośyāśca sīmānaṃ prāpya devo janārdanaḥ || vainateyādavāruhya kare dhṛtvā dhruvaṃ tataḥ || 112 || maṇikarṇyāṃ parisnāya viśveśamabhipūjya ca || dhruvaṃ babhāṣe bhagavānhitaṃ tasya cikīrṣayan || 113 || liṃgaṃ sthāpaya yatnena kṣetre'traivāvimuktake || trailokyasthāpanaṃ puṇyaṃ yathā bhavati te'kṣayam || 114 || niyutaṃ yatparisthāpya liṃgāni phalamāpyate || anyatra tadihaikena liṃgena parilabhyate || 115 || kālena bhaṃgamāpannaṃ jīrṇoddhāraṃ karoti yaḥ || iha tasya phalasyāṃtaḥ pralayepi na jāyate || 116 || vittaśāṭhyaṃ parityajya prāsādaṃ yo'tra kārayet || tena datto bhavetsarvo merurniyutayojanaḥ || 117 || kūpavāpītaḍāgāni śaktyā yo'tra tu kārayet || anyatra karaṇāttasya puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇādhikam || 118 || ijyārthamatra yaḥ kuryātsuramyāṃ puṣpavāṭikām || puṣpepuṣpe phalaṃ tasya suvarṇakusumādhikam || 119 || atra brahmapurīṃ kṛtvā yo viprebhyaḥ prayacchati || varṣāśanena saṃyuktāṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 4.1.21.120 || kṣīyaṃte salilānyabdherbhaumāśca trasareṇavaḥ || kṣayo na tasya puṇyasya śivaloke samāsataḥ || 121 || maṭhānapi tapasvibhyaḥ kārayitvā'tra yorpayet || jīvanopāyasaṃyuktānsopi pūrvaphalāśrayaḥ || 122 || kṛtvā mahāṃti puṇyāni yo'tra viśveśvare'rpayet || na tasya punarāvṛratti ghore saṃsārasāgare ||123|| anaṃta iti vādoyaṃ mayiloke'tra gīyate || paraṃ kāśī guṇānāṃ hi mayāpyaṃto na labhyate ||124|| tasmātprayatnataḥ kāśyāṃ dhuva śreyaḥ samāśrayet || kāśī śreyaḥ phalaṃ puṃsāmakṣayā yopajāyate ||125|| gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || dhruvamityupadiśyātha jagāma garuḍadhvajaḥ || dhruvopi liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya vaidyanāthasamīpataḥ || 126 || prāsādaṃ sumahatkrṛtvā kṛtvā kuṃḍaṃ tadagrataḥ || viśveśvaraṃ samabhyarcya kṛtakṛtyo gṛhaṃ yayau || 127 || dhruveśvaraṃ samabhyarcya dhruvakuṃḍe kṛtodakaḥ || dhruvalokamavāpnoti naro bhogasamanvitaḥ || 128 || dhruvasya paramākhyānaṃ yaḥ paṭhetpāṭhayedapi || sa viṣṇulokamāsādya jāyate viṣṇuvallabhaḥ || 129 || naro dhruvasya caritaṃ prasaṃgena smarannapi || na pāpairabhibhūyeta mahatpuṇyamavāpnuyāt || 4.1.21.130 || ḍati śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe dhruvastutirnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<4.1.22>
|| śivaśarmovāca || dhruvākhyānamidaṃ ramyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || mahāścaryakaraṃ puṇyaṃ śrutvā tṛptosmi bho gaṇau || 1 || || agastya uvāca || || itthaṃ yāvaddvijo brūte vimānaṃ vāyuvegagam || tāvatprāpa maharlokaṃ svarlokātparamādbhutam || 2 || dvijo'tha lokaṃ saṃvīkṣya sarvato mahasā vṛtam || tau gaṇau pratyuvācedaṃ koyaṃ loko manoharaḥ || 3 || tāvūcatustato vipraṃ niśāmaya mahāmate || ayaṃ sa hi maharlokaḥ svarlokātparamādbhutaḥ || 4 || kalpāyuṣo vasaṃtyatra tapasā dhūtakalmaṣāḥ || viṣṇusmaraṇa saṃkṣīṇa samastakleśasaṃcayāḥ ||5|| nirvyājapraṇidhānena dṛṣṭvā tejomayaṃ jagat || mahāyogasamāyuktā vasaṃtyatra surottamāḥ || 6 || itthaṃ kathāṃ kathayatorbhagavadgaṇayoḥ priye || kṣaṇārdhena vimānaṃ tajjanalokaṃ nināyatān || 7 || nivasaṃtyamalā yatra mānasā bahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ || sanaṃdanādyā yogīṃdrāḥ sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ || 8 || anye tu yogino ye vai hyaskhaladbrahmacāriṇaḥ || sarvadvaṃdvavinirmuktāste vasaṃtyatinirmalāḥ ||9|| janalokāttapolokasteṣāṃ locanagocaraḥ || kṛtastena vimānena manovegena gacchatā || 4.1.22.10 || vairājā yatra te devā vaseyurdāhavarjitāḥ || vāsudeve mano yeṣāṃ vāsudevārpitakriyāḥ || 11 || tapasā toṣya goviṃdamabhilāṣavivarjitāḥ|| tapolokamimaṃ prāpya vasaṃti vijiteṃdriyāḥ ||12|| śiloṃcha vṛttayā ye vai daṃtolūkhalikāśca ye || aśmakuṭṭāśca munayaḥ śīrṇaparṇāśinaśca ye || 13 || grīṣme paṃcāgnitapaso varṣāsu sthaṃḍileśayāḥ || hemaṃtaśiśirārdhe ye kṣapaṃti salile kṣapāḥ ||14|| kuśāgranīraviprūṣastṛṣitā yatayo'piban|| vātāśinotikṣudhitāḥ pādāgrāṃguṣṭha bhūspṛśaḥ || 15 || ūrdhvadoṣo ravidṛśastvekāṃghri sthāṇu niścalāḥ || ye vai divā nirucchvāsā māsocchvāsāśca ye punaḥ ||16|| māsopavāsavratinaścāturmāsya vratāśca ye || ṛtvaṃtatoyapānā ye ṣaṇmāsopavāsakāḥ || 17 || ye ca varṣanimeṣā vai varṣadhārāṃbu tarṣakāḥ || ye ca sthāṇūpamāṃ prāptā mṛgakaṃḍūti saukhyadāḥ || 18 || jaṭāṭavī koṭarāṃtaḥ kṛtanīḍāṃḍajāśca ye || prarūḍhavāmalūrāṃgāḥ snāyunaddhāsthisaṃcayāḥ || 19 || latāpratānaiḥ parito veṣṭitāvayavāśca ye || sasyāni ca prarūḍhāni yadaṃgeṣu cirasthiti || 4.1.22.20 || ityādi sutapaḥ kliṣṭavarṣmāṇo ye tapodhanāḥ || brahmāyuṣastapoloke te vasaṃtyakutobhayāḥ ||21|| yāvaditthaṃ sa puṇyātmā śṛṇoti gaṇayormukhāt || tāvannetrātithībhūtaḥ satyaloko mahojjvalaḥ || 22 || tvarāvaṃtau gaṇau tatra vimānādavaruhya tau || sraṣṭāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ tena sārdhaṃ praṇematuḥ || 23 || brahmovāca || gaṇāvasau dvijo dhīmānvedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || smṛtyuktācāracaṃcuśca pratīpaḥ pāpakarmasu || 24 || ayi dvija mahāprājña jāne tvāṃ śivaśarmaka || sādhūkṛtaṃ tvayā vatsa sutīrthaprāṇamokṣaṇāt || 25 || satvaraṃ gatvaraṃ sarvaṃ yaccaitadbhavatekṣitam || dainaṃdinapralayataḥ sṛjāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ || 26 || ā vairājaṃ pratipadamupasaṃharate haraḥ || kā kathā maśakābhānāṃ nṛṇāṃ maraṇadharmiṇām || 27 || caturṣu bhūtagrāmeṣu hyeka eva guṇo nṛṇām || tasminvai bhārate varṣe karmabhūmau mahīyasi || 28 || capalāni vinirjityeṃdriyāṇi manasā saha || vihāya vairiṇaṃ lobhaṃ viṣvagguṇagaṇasya ca || 29 || dharmavaṃśaharaṃ kāmamarthasaṃcayahāriṇam || jarāpalitakartāraṃ viniṣkṛtya vicārataḥ ||4.1.22.30|| jitvā krodharipuṃ dhairyāttapaso yaśasaḥ śriyaḥ || śarīrasyāpi hartāraṃ netāraṃ tāmasīṃ gatim || 31 || sadā madaṃ parityajya pramādaikapadapradam || pramādaikaśaraṇyaṃ ca saṃpadāṃ vinivartakam || 32 || sarvatra laghutā hetumahaṃkāraṃ vihāya ca || dūṣaṇāropaṇe yatnaṃ kurvāṇaṃ sajjaneṣvapi || 33 || hitvā mohaṃ mahādroharopaṇaṃ matighātinam || atyaṃtamaṃdhīkaraṇamaṃdhatāmisradarśakam || 34 || śrutismṛtipurāṇoktaṃ parikṣuṇṇaṃ mahājanaiḥ || dharmasopānamāruhya yadihāyāṃti helayā || 35 || karmabhūmiṃ samīhaṃte sarve svargaukaso dvija || yattatrārjitabhoktāraḥ padeṣūccāvaceṣvamī || 36 || nāryāvartasumo deśo na kāśī sadṛśī purī || na viśveśa samaṃ liṃgaṃ kvāpi bahmāṃḍamaṃḍale ||37|| saṃti svargā bahuvidhāḥ sukhetara vivarjitā|| sukṛtaikaphalāḥ sarve yuktāḥ sarvasamṛddhibhiḥ|| || 38 || svarlokādadhikaṃ ramyaṃ nahi brahmāṃḍagolake || sarve yataṃte svargāya tapodānavratādibhiḥ || 39 || svarlokādapiramyāṇi pātālānīti nāradaḥ || prāha svargasadāṃ madhye pātālebhyaḥ samāgataḥ || 4.1.22.40 || āhlādakāriṇaḥ śubhrā maṇayo yatra suprabhāḥ || nāgāṃgābharaṇaprotāḥ pātālaṃ kena tatsamam || 41 || daityadānavakanyābhiritaścetaśca śobhite || pātāle kasya na prītirvimuktasyāpi jāyate || 42 || divārkaraśmayastatra prabhāṃ tanvaṃti nātapam|| śaśinaśca na śītāya niśi dyotāya kevalam || 43 || yatra na jñāyate kālo gatopi danujādibhiḥ || vanāni nadyo ramyāṇi sadaṃbhāṃsi sarāṃsi ca || 44 || kalāḥ puṃsko kilālāpāḥ sucailāni śucīni ca || bhūṣaṇānyatiramyāṇi gaṃdhādyamanulepanam || 45 || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgādi nisvanāḥ śrutihāriṇaḥ || hāṭakeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ yatra vai sarvakāmadam || 46 || etānyanyāni ramyāṇi bhogyogyāni dānavaiḥ || daityoragaiśca bhujyaṃte pātālāṃtaragocaraiḥ || 47 || pātālebhyopi vai ramyaṃ dvija varṣamilāvṛtam|| ratnasānuṃ samāśritya paritaḥ parisaṃsthitam||48|| sadā sukṛtino yatra sarvabhogabhujo dvija|| navayauvanasaṃpannā nityaṃ yatra mṛgīdṛśaḥ ||49|| bhogabhūmiriyaṃ proktā śreyo vinimayārjitā || bhujyate tvadvidhairlokaistīrthābhityakta dehakaiḥ || 4.1.22.50 || aklībabhāṣibhiścāpi putrakṣetrādyahīnakaiḥ || paropakārasaṃkṣīṇasukhāyurdhanasaṃcayaiḥ || 51 || saṃti dvīpā hyanekā vai pārāvārāṃtarasthitāḥ || jaṃbūdvīpasamo dvīpo na kvāpi jagatītale || 52 || tatrāpi navavarṣāṇi bhārataṃ tatra cottamam || karmabhūmiriyaṃ proktā devānāmapidurlabhā ||53|| aṣṭau kiṃpuruṣādīni devabhogyāni tāni tu || teṣu svargātsamāgatya ramaṃte tridivaukasaḥ || 54 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi navavistāratastvidam || bhārataṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ merordakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || 55 || tatrāpi himaviṃdhyādreraṃtaraṃ puṇyadaṃ param || gaṃgāyamunayormadhye hyaṃtarvedī bhuvaḥ parāḥ || 56 || kurukṣetraṃ hi sarveṣāṃ kṣetrāṇāmadhikaṃ tataḥ || tatopi naimiṣāraṇyaṃ svargasādhanamuttamam || 57 || naimiṣāraṇyatopīha sarvasminkṣitimaṃḍale || sarvebhyopi hi tīrthebhyastīrtharājo viśiṣyate || 58 || svargadomokṣadaścaiva sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || prayāgastanmahatkṣetraṃ tīrtharāja iti smṛtaḥ || 69 || yāgāḥ sarve mayā pūrvaṃ tulayā vidhṛtā dvija || tacca tīrthavaraṃ ramyaṃ kāmikaṃ kāmapūraṇāta || 4.1.22.60 || dṛṣṭvā prakṛṣṭayāgebhyaḥ puṣṭebhyo dakṣiṇādibhiḥ || prayāgamiti tannāma kṛtaṃ hariharādibhiḥ || 61 || nāmamātrasmṛteryasya prayāgasya trikālataḥ || smartuḥ śarīre no jātu pāpaṃ vasati kutracit || 62 || saṃti tīrthānyanekāni pāpatrāṇakarāṇi ca || na śaktānyadhikaṃ dātuṃ kṛtainaḥ pariśuddhitaḥ || 63 || janmāṃtareṣvasaṃkhyeṣu yaḥ kṛtaḥ pāpasaṃcayaḥ || duṣpraṇodyo hi nitarāṃ vratairdānaistapojapaiḥ || 64 || sa tīrtharājagamanodyatasya śubhajanmanaḥ || aṃgeṣu vepate'tyaṃtaṃ drumo vātahato yathā || 65 || tataḥ krāṃtārdhamārgasya prayāga dṛḍhacetasaḥ || puṃsaḥ śarīrānniryātumapekṣeta padāṃtaram || || 66|| bhāgyānnetrātithībhūte tīrtharāje mahātmanaḥ || palāyate drutataraṃ tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 67 || saptadhātumayī bhūtatanau pāpāni yāni vai || keśeṣu tāni tiṣṭhaṃti vapanādyāṃti tānyapi || 68 || evaṃ niṣkaluṣībhūya tataḥ snāyātsitāsite || yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyaṃstaṃ tamāpnoti nānyathā || 69 || puṇyarāśiṃ ca vipulaṃ puṇyānbhogānyathepsitān || svargaṃ prāpnoti tatpuṇyānniṣkāmo mokṣamāpnuyāt || 4.1.22.70 || snāyādyobhilaṣanmokṣaṃ kāmānanyānvihāya ca || sopi mokṣamavāpnoti kāmadāttīrtharājataḥ || 71 || tīrtharājaṃ parityajya yo'nyasmātkāmamicchati || bhāratākhye mahāvarṣe sa kāmaṃ nāpnuyātsphuṭam || 72 || satyaloke prayāge ca nāṃtaraṃ vedmyahaṃ dvija || tatra ye śubhakarmāṇaste mallokanivāsinaḥ || 73 || tīrthābhilāṣibhirmartyaissevyaṃ tīrthāṃtaraṃ nahi || anyatra bhūmivalaye tīrtharājātprayā gataḥ ||74|| yathāṃtaraṃ dvijaśreṣṭha bhūpetvitarasevake || dṛṣṭāṃtamātraṃ kathitaṃ prayāgetara tīrthayoḥ ||75|| yathākathaṃcittīrthe'sminprāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ || tasyātmaghātadoṣo na prāpnuyādīpsitānyapi || 76 || yasya bhāgyavataścātra tiṣṭhaṃtyasthīnyapi dvija || na tasya duḥkhaleśopi kvāpi janmani jāyate || 77 || brahmahatyādi pāpānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ cikīrṣuṇā || prayāgaṃ vidhivatsevyaṃ dvijavākyānna saṃśayaḥ || 78 || kiṃ bahūktena vipreṃdra mahodayamabhīpsunā || sevyaṃ sitāsitaṃ tīrthaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ jagatītale || 79 || prayāgatopi tīrtheśātsarveṣu bhuvaneṣvapi || anāyāsena vai muktiḥ kāśyāṃ dehāvasānataḥ ||4.1.22.80|| prayāgādapi vai ramyamavimuktaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣātsvayaṃ samadhitiṣṭhati || 81 || avimuktānmahākṣetrādviśveśa samadhiṣṭhitāt || na ca kiṃcitkvacidramyamiha brahmāṃḍagolake || 82 || avimuktamidaṃ kṣetramapi brahmāṃḍamadhyagam || brahmāṃḍamadhye na bhavetpaṃcakrośapramāṇataḥ || 83 || yathāyathā hi vardheta jalamekārṇavasya ca || tathātathonnayedīśastatkṣetraṃ pralayādapi || 84 || kṣetrametattriśūlāgre śūlinastiṣṭhati dvija || aṃtarikṣena bhūmiṣṭhaṃ nekṣaṃte mūḍhabuddhayaḥ|| 85 || sadā kṛtayugaṃ cātra mahāparvasadā'tra vai || na grahā'stodayakṛto doṣo viśveśvarāśrame ||86|| sadā saumyāyanaṃ tatra sadā tatra mahodayaḥ || sadaiva maṃgalaṃ tatra yatra viśveśvarasthitiḥ||87|| yathābhūmitale vipra puryaḥ saṃti sahasraśaḥ || tathā kāśī na maṃtavyā kvāpi lokottarātviyam || 88 || mayā sṛṣṭāni vipreṃdra bhuvanāni caturdaśa || asyāḥ puryā vinirmātā svayaṃ viśveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 89 || purā yamastapastaptvā bahukālaṃ suduṣkaram || trailokyādhikṛtiṃ prāptastyaktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 4.1.22.90 || carācarasya sarvasya yāni karmāṇi tāni vai || gocare citraguptasya kāśīvāsikṛtādṛte || 91 || praveśo yamadūtānāṃ na kadāciddvijottama || madhye kāśīpurī kvāpi rakṣiṇastatra tadgaṇāḥ || 92 || svayaṃ niyaṃtā viśveśastatra kāśyāṃ tanutyajām || tatrāpi kṛtapāpānāṃ niyaṃtā kālabhairavaḥ || 93 || tatra pāpaṃ na kartavyaṃ dāruṇā rudrayātanā || aho rudrapiśācatvaṃ narakebhyopi duḥsaham || 94 || pāpameva hi kartavyaṃ matirasti yadīdṛśī || sukhenānyatra kartavyaṃ mahī hyasti mahīyasī || 95 || api kāmāturo jaṃturekāṃ rakṣati mātaram || api pāpakṛtā kāśī rakṣyā mokṣārthinaikikā || 96 || parāpavādaśīlena paradārābhilāṣiṇā || tena kāśī na saṃsevyā kva kāśī nirayaḥ kva saḥ || 97 || abhilaṣyaṃti ye nityaṃ dhanaṃ cātra pratigrahaiḥ || parasvaṃ kapaṭairvāpi kāśī sevyā na tairnaraiḥ || 98 || parapīḍākaraṃ karma kāśyāṃ nityaṃ vivarjayet || tadeva cetkimatra syātkāśīvāso durātmanām || || 99 || tyaktvā vaiśveśvarīṃ bhaktiṃ ye'nyadevaparāyaṇāḥ || sarvathā tairna vastavyā rājadhānī pinākinaḥ || 4.1.22.100 || arthārthinastu ye vipra ye ca kāmārthino narāḥ || avimuktaṃ na taiḥ sevyaṃ mokṣakṣetramidaṃ yataḥ || 101 || śivaniṃdāparā ye ca vedaniṃdā parāśca ye || vedācārapratīpā ye sevyā vārāṇasī na taiḥ || 102 || paradrohadhiyo ye ca parerṣyākāriṇaśca ye || paropatāpino ye vai teṣāṃ kāśī na siddhaye || 103 || manasāpi na ye kāśīmabhinaṃdaṃti durdhiyaḥ || teṣāṃ nirvāṇavārtāpi dūre durvṛttacetasām || 104 || jñānena na vinā mokṣaḥ kvacidastīha bhūtale || tajjñānaṃ na vratairlabhyamapi cāṃdrāyaṇādibhiḥ || 105 || tulāpuruṣamukhyaiśca dānaiśca śraddhayānvitaiḥ || deśakāle ca vidhinā pātrebhyaḥ pratipāditaiḥ || 106 || na yamairbrahmacaryādyairniyamairnārcanādibhi. || śarīraśoṣaṇairugrairna tapobhirdvijottama || 107 || na mahāmaṃtrajapyaiśca gurubhiḥ pratipāditaiḥ || na svādhyāyairyathoktaiśca nāgniśuśrūṣaṇaiḥ paraiḥ || 108 || na sevayā gurūṇāṃ ca na śrāddhairdevatārcanaiḥ || na nānātīrthayātrābhirjñānaṃ samadhigamyate || 109 || na yogena vinā jñānaṃ yogastattvārthaśīlanam || gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa sadābhyāsavaśena ca || 4.1.22.110 || tasyāṃtarāyā bahavaḥ sudūraśravaṇādayaḥ || ato na prāpyate jñānaṃ yogādekena janmanā || 111 || vinā tapo japādyaiśca vinā yogena suvrata || niḥśreyo labhyate kāśyāmihaikenaiva janmanā ||112|| tvayā śuddhadhiyā kāśyāṃ yacchreyaḥ samupārjitam || tacchreyasopyudarkaste mahānasti dvijottama || 113 || ukteti virarāmājaḥ śṛṇvatorgaṇayostayoḥ || sopi pramuditaścābhūcchivaśarmā mahāmanāḥ || 114 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe brahmakṛtakāśīpraśaṃsānāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
<4.1.23>
|| śivaśarmovāca || || satyalokeśvara vidhe sarveṣāṃ prapitāmaha || kiṃcidvijñaptukāmosmi na bhayādvaktumutsahe || 1 || || brahmovāca || || yattvaṃ praṣṭumanā vipra jñātaṃ te tanmanogatam || pipṛcchiṣustvaṃ nirvāṇaṃ gaṇau tatkathayiṣyataḥ ||2|| netayorviṣṇugaṇayoragocaramihāsti hi || sarvametau vijānīto yatkiṃcidbrahmago lake || 3 || ityuktvā satkṛtāste vai brahmaṇā bhagavadgaṇāḥ || praṇamya lokakartāraṃ te'pi hṛṣṭāḥ pratasthire || 4 || punaḥ svayānamāruhya vaikuṃṭhamabhito yayuḥ || gacchatāpi punastatra dvijenāpṛcchitau gaṇau || 5 || || śivaśarmovāca || || kiyaddūre vayaṃ prāptā gaṃtavyaṃ ca kiyatpunaḥ || pṛcchāmyanyacca vāṃ bhadrau brūtaṃ prītyā tadapyaho || || 6 || kāṃcyavaṃtī dvāravatī kāśyayodhyā ca paṃcamī || māyāpurī ca mathurā puryaḥ sapta vimuktidāḥ || 7 || vihāya ṣaṭpurīścānyāḥ kāśyāmevapratiṣṭhitā || muktirviśvasṛjā tatkiṃ mama muktirna saṃprati || 8 || iti sarvaṃ mama puraḥ prasādādvaktumarhatam || iti tadvākyamākarṇya gaṇāvūcaturādarāt || 9 || || gaṇāvūcatuḥ || yathārthaṃ kathayāvaste yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatānagha || viṣṇuprasādājjānīvo bhūtaṃbhāvibhavattathā || 4.1.23.10 || viprāvabhāsate yāvatkiraṇaiḥ puṣpavaṃtayoḥ || tāvatībhūḥ samuddiṣṭā sasamudrādri kānanā || 11 || viyacca tāvadupari vistāraparimaṃḍalam || yojanānāṃ ca niyute bhūmerbhānurvyavasthitaḥ || 12 || bhānoḥ sakāśādupari lakṣe lakṣyaḥ kṣapākaraḥ || nakṣatradhaṃ(maṃ?)ḍalaṃ somāllakṣayojanamucchritam || 13|| uḍumaṃḍalataḥ saumya upariṣṭāddvilakṣataḥ || dvilakṣe tu budhācchukraḥ śukrādbhaumo dvilakṣake || 14 || māheyādupariṣṭācca surejyo niyutadvaye || dvilakṣayojanotsedhaḥ saurirdevapurohitāt || 15 || daśāyutasamucchrāyaṃ saureḥ saptarṣimaṃḍalam || saptarṣibhyaḥ sahasrāṇāṃ śatādūrdhvaṃ dhruvasthitaḥ || || 16 || pādagamyaṃ hi yatkiṃcidvastvasti dharaṇītale || tadbhūrloka iti khyātaḥ sābdhidvīpādrikānanam || 17 || bhūrlokācca bhuvarloko bradhnāvadhirudāhṛtaḥ || ādityādādhruvaṃ vipra svarloka iti gīyate || |18 || maharlokaḥ kṣiterūrdhvamekakoṭipramāṇataḥ || koṭidvaye tu saṃkhyāto jano bhūrlokato janaiḥ || 19 || catuṣkoṭipramāṇastu tapoloko'sti bhūtalāt || upariṣṭātkṣiteraṣṭau koṭayaḥ satyamīritam || 4.1.23.20 || satyādupari vaikuṃṭho yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ || bhūrlokātparisaṃkhyātaḥ koṭiṣoḍaśasaṃmitaḥ || 21 || yatrāste śrīpatiḥ sākṣātsarveṣāmabhayapradaḥ || tatastu ṣoḍaśaguṇaḥ kailāso'sti śivālayaḥ || 22 || pārvatyā sahitaḥ śaṃbhurgajāsya skaṃda naṃdibhiḥ || yatra tiṣṭhati viśveśaḥ sakalaḥ sa paraḥ smūtaḥ || 23 || tasya devasya khelo'yaṃ svalīlā mūrtidhāriṇaḥ || sa viśveśa iti khyāta stasyājñākṛdidaṃ jagat || 24 || sarveṣāṃ śāsakaścāsau tasya śāstā na cāparaḥ || svayaṃ sṛjati bhūtāni svayaṃ pāti tathātti ca || 25 || sarvajña ekaḥ sa proktaḥ svecchādhīna viceṣṭitaḥ || tasya pravatarkaḥ kopi nahi naiva nivartakaḥ || 26 || amūrtaṃ yatparaṃ brahma samūrtaṃ śruticoditam || sarvavyāpi sadā nityaṃ satyaṃ dvaitavivarjitam || 27 || sarvebhyaḥ kāraṇebhyaśca parātparataraṃ param || ānaṃdaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ śrutayo yatpracakṣate || 28 || saṃvidaṃ tena yaṃ vedā viṣṇurveda na vai vidhiḥ || yato vāco nivartaṃte hyaprāpya manasā saha || 29 || svayaṃvedyaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ sarvasya hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ || yogigamyastvanākhyeyo yaḥ pramāṇaikagocaraḥ || 4.1.23.30 || nānārūpopyarūpo yaḥ sarvagopi na gocaraḥ || anaṃtopyaṃtaka vapuḥ sarvavitkarmavarjitaḥ ||31|| tasyedamaiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ khaṃḍacaṃdrāvataṃsakam || tamālaśyāmalagalaṃ sphuradbhālavilocanam || 32 || lasadvāmārdhanārīkaṃ kṛtaśeṣaśubhāṃgadam || gaṃgātaraṃgasatsaṃga sadādhautajaṭātaṭam || 33 || smarāṃgarajaḥpuṃja pūjitāvayavojjvalam || vicitragātravidhṛtamahāvyālavibhūṣaṇam || 34 || mahokṣasyaṃdanagamaṃ virutājagavāyudham|| gajājinottarāsaṃgaṃ daśārdhavadanaṃ śubham || 35 || uttrāsita mahāmṛtyu mahābalagaṇāvṛtam || śaraṇārthikṛtatrāṇaṃ nata nirvāṇakāraṇam || manorathapathātītaṃ varadānaparāyaṇam || 36 || tasya tattvasvarūpasya rūpātītasya bho dvija || parāvare rudrarūpe sarvevyāpyāvatiṣṭhata || 37 || nirākāropi sākāraḥ śiva eva hi kāraṇama || muktaye bhuktaye vāpi na śivānmokṣado paraḥ || 38 || yathā tenākhilaṃ hyetatpārvatīpatisātkṛtama || idaṃ carācaraṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyādṛśyamarūpiṇā || 39 || tathā mṛḍānīkāṃtena viṣṇusādakhilaṃjagata || vidhāya krīḍyate vipra nityaṃ svacchaṃda līlayā || 4.1.23.40 || yathāśivastathā viṣṇuryathāviṣṇustathā śivaḥ || aṃtaraṃ śivaviṣṇvośca manāgapi na vidyate || 41 || āhūya pūrvaṃ brahmādīnsamastāndevatāgaṇān || vidyādharoragādīṃśca siddhagaṃdharvacāraṇān || 42 || nijasiṃhāsanasamaṃ kṛtvā siṃhāsanaṃ śubham || upaveśya hariṃ tatra cchatraṃ kṛtvā manoharam ||43|| ślakṣṇaṃ koṭiśalākaṃ ca viśvakarmavinirmitam || pāṃḍuraṃ ratnadaṃḍaṃ ca sthūlamuktāvalaṃbitam || 44 || kalaśena vicitreṇa hyupariṣṭādvirājitam || sahasrayojanāyāmaṃ sarvaratnamayaṃ śubham ||45|| paṭṭasūtramayairamyaiścāmaraiśca pariṣkṛtam || rājābhiṣekayogyaiśca dravyaiḥ sarvauṣadhādibhiḥ || 46 || pratyakṣatīrthapāthobhiḥ paṃcakuṃbhairmanoharaiḥ || siddhārthākṣatadūrvābhirmaṃtraiḥ svayamupasthitaiḥ || 47 || devānāṃ ca tatharṣīṇāṃ siddhānāṃ phaṇināmapi || ānīya maṃgalakarāḥ kanyāḥ ṣoḍaśaṣoḍaśa || 48 || vīṇāmṛdaṃgābjabherī maru ḍiṃḍimajharjharaiḥ || ānakaiḥ kāṃsyatālādyai rvādyairlalitagāyanaiḥ ||49|| brahmaghoṣamahārāvairāpūritanabhoṃgaṇe || śubhe tithau śubhe lagne tārācaṃdrabalānvite ||4.1.23.50 || ābaddhamukuṭaṃ ramyaṃ kṛtakautukamaṃgalam || mṛḍānīkṛtaśṛṃgāraṃ suśriyā suśriyāyutam ||51|| abhiṣicya maheśena svayaṃ brahmāṃḍamaṃḍape || dattaṃ samastamaiśvaryaṃ yannijaṃ nānyagāmi ca || 52 || tatastuṣṭāva deveśaḥ pramathaiḥ saha śārṅgiṇam || brahmāṇaṃ lokakartāramuvāca ca vacastvidam || 53 || mama vaṃdyastvayaṃ viṣṇuḥ praṇamatvamamuṃ harim || ityuktvātha svayaṃ rudro nanāma garuḍadhvajam || 54 || tato gaṇeśvaraiḥ sarvaiṃrbrahmaṇā ca marudgaṇaiḥ || yogibhiḥ sanakādyaiśca siddhairdevarṣibhistathā || 55 || vidyādharaiḥ sagaṃdharvairyakṣarakṣopsarogaṇaiḥ || guhyakaiścāraṇairbhūtaiḥ śeṣa vāsuki takṣakaiḥ || 56 || patatribhiḥ kiṃnaraiśca sarvaiḥ sthāvarajaṃgamaiḥ || tato jayajayetyuktvā namostviti namostviti || 57 || tatoharirmaheśena saṃsadi dyusadāṃ tadā || etairmahāravai ramyaiścānarci paramārciṣā || 58 || tvaṃ kartā sarvabhūtānāṃ pātā hartā tvameva ca || tvameva jagatāṃ pūjyastvameva jagadīśvaraḥ || 59 || dātā dharmārthakāmānāṃ śāstā durnayakāriṇām || ajeyastvaṃ ca saṃgrāme mamāpi hi bhaviṣyasi || 4.1.23.60 || icchāśaktiḥ kriyāśaktirjñānaśaktistathottamā || śaktitrayamidaṃ viṣṇo gṛhāṇa prāpitaṃ mayā || 61 || tvaddveṣṭāro hare nūnaṃ mayā śāsyāḥ prayatnataḥ || tvadbhaktānāṃ mayā viṣṇo deyaṃ nirvāṇamuttamam || 62 || māyāṃ cāpi gṛhāṇemāṃ duṣpraṇodyāṃ surāsuraiḥ || yayā saṃmohitaṃ viśvamakiṃcijjñaṃ bhaviṣyati || 63 || vāmabāhurmadīyastvaṃ dakṣiṇosau pitāmahaḥ || asyāpi hi vidheḥ pātā janitāpi bhaviṣyasi || 64 || vaikuṃṭhaiśvaryamāsādya hareritthaṃ haraḥ svayam || kailāse pramathaiḥ sārdhaṃ svairaṃ krīḍatyumāpatiḥ || 65 || tadā prabhṛti devosau śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ || trailokyamakhilaṃ śāsti dānavāṃtakaro hariḥ ||66|| iti te kathitā vipra lokānāṃ ca paristhitiḥ || idānīṃ kathayiṣyāvastavanirvāṇa kāraṇam || 67 || idaṃ tu paramākhyānaṃ śṛṇuyādyaḥ samāhitaḥ || svarlokamabhigamyātha kāśyāṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyāt || 68 || yajñotsave vivāhe ca maṃgaleṣvakhileṣvapi || rājyābhiṣeka samaye devasthāpanakarmaṇi || 69 || sarvādhikāradāneṣu navaveśmapraveśane || paṭhitavyaṃ prayatnena tatkārya parisiddhaye ||4.1.23.70|| aputro labhate putramadhano dhanavānbhavet || vyādhito mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta baṃdhanāt||71|| japyametatprayatnena satataṃ maṃgalārthinā || amaṃgalānāṃ śamanaṃ haranārāyaṇapriyama ||72|| || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe caturbhujābhiṣeko nāma trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || || cha ||
<4.1.24>
gaṇāvūcatuḥ || || śivaśarmannudarkaṃ te kathayāvo niśāmaya || tvamatra vaiṣṇave loke bhuktvā bhogānsupuṣkalān || 1 || brahmaṇo vatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ ramamāṇo'psarogaṇaiḥ || sutīrthamaraṇopātta puṇyaśeṣeṇa vai punaḥ || 2 || bhaviṣyasi mahīpālo nagare naṃdivardhane || rājyaṃ prāpyāsapatnaṃ ca samṛddhabalavāhanam ||3|| kṛṣṭibhirhṛṣṭapuṣṭaiśca ramyahāṭakabhūṣaṇaiḥ || saṃjuṣṭamiṣṭāpūrtānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ nityakartṛbhiḥ||4|| sadāsaṃpannasasyaṃ ca sūrvarakṣetrasaṃkulam|| sudeśaṃ suprajaṃ susthaṃ sutṛṇaṃ bahugodhanam || 5 || devatāyatanānāṃ ca rājibhiḥ parirājitam || suyūpā yatra vai grāmāḥ suvittarddhi virājitāḥ || 6 || supuṣpa kṛtrimodyānāḥ sasadāphalapādapāḥ || sapadminīkakāsārā yatra rājaṃti bhūmayaḥ || 7 || sadaṃbhā nimnagārājirna yatra janatā kvacit || kulānyeva kulīnāni na cānyāyadhanāni ca || 8 || vibhramo yatra nārīṣu navidvatsu ca karhicit || nadyaḥ kuṭilagāminyo na yatra viṣaye prajāḥ || 9 || tamoyuktāḥ kṣapā yatra bahuleṣu na mānavāḥ || rajoyujaḥ striyo yatra na dharmabahulā narāḥ || 4.1.24.10 || dhanairanaṃdho yatrāsti mano naiva ca bhojanam || anayaḥ syaṃdanaṃ yatra na ca vai rājapūruṣaḥ || 11 || daṃḍaḥ paraśukuddāla vālavya janarājiṣu || ātapatreṣu nānyatra kvacitkrodhāparādhajaḥ ||12|| anyatrākṣikavṛṃdebhyaḥ kvacinna paridevanam || ākṣikā eva dṛśyaṃte yatra pāśakapāṇayaḥ || 13 || jāḍyavārtā jaleṣveva strīmadhyā eva durbalāḥ || kaṭhorahṛdayā yatra sīmaṃtinyo na mānavāḥ || 14 || auṣadheṣveva yatrāsti kuṣṭhayogo na mānave || vedhopyaṃtaḥsuratneṣu śūlaṃ mūrtikareṣu vai || 15 || kaṃpaḥsāttvikabhāvottho na bhayātkvāpi kasyacit || saṃjvaraḥ kāmajo yatra dāridryaṃ kaluṣasya ca || 16 || durlabhatvaṃ sadā kasya sukṛtena ca vastunaḥ || ibhā eva pramattā vai yuddhaṃ vīcyorjalāśaye || 17 || dānahānirgajeṣveva drumeṣveva hi kaṃṭakāḥ || janeṣveva vihārā hi na kasyaciduraḥsthalī || 18 || bāṇeṣu guṇaviśleṣo baṃdhoktiḥ pustake dṛḍhā || snehatyāgaḥ sadaivāsti yatra pāśupate jane || 19 || daṃḍavārtā sadā yatra kṛtasaṃnyāsakarmaṇām || mārgaṇāścāpakeṣveva bhikṣukā brahmacāriṇaḥ || 4.1.24.20 || yatra kṣapaṇakā eva dṛśyaṃte maladhāriṇaḥ || prāyo madhuvratā eva yatra caṃcalavṛttayaḥ || 21 || ityādi guṇavaddeśe tvayirājyaṃ praśāsati || dharmeṇa rājadharmajña śauṃḍīryaguṇaśālini || 22 || saubhāgyabhāji rūpāḍhye śauryaudāryaguṇānvite || sīmaṃtinīnāṃ ramyāṇāṃ lāvaṇyavarjita suśriyām || 23 || rājñīnāmayutaṃbhāvi kumārāṇāṃ śatatrayam || vṛddhakāla iti khyāta ugraḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ || 24 || vijitānekasamaraḥ śrīsaṃtarpitamārgaṇaḥ || anekaguṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ pūrṇacaṃdranibhadyutiḥ || 25 || saṃtatāvabhṛthaklinna mūrdhajaḥ kṣitiṣarṣabhaḥ || prajāpālanasaṃpannaḥ kośaprīṇitabhūsuraḥ || 26 || padāraviṃdaṃ gauviṃdaṃ hṛdi dhyāyannataṃdritaḥ || vāsudevakathālāpaparikṣipta dinakṣapaḥ || 27 || kadācidupaviṣṭaḥsanmadhye rājasabhaṃ dvija || dūrātkārpaṭikairdṛṣṭo vārāṇasyāḥ samāgataiḥ || 28 || tatkarmabhāvisadṛśaistadātvamabhinaṃditaḥ || taiḥ sarvai rājaśārdūlasyāśīrvādairanekaśaḥ || 29 || śrīmadviśveśvaro devo viśveṣāṃ jagatāṃ guruḥ || kāśīnāthastute kuryātkumaterapavarjanam || 4.1.24.30 || naiḥśreyasīṃ ca saṃpattiṃ yo deyātsmaraṇādapi || kāśīnāthaḥ sa te diśyājjñānaṃ malavivarjitam || 31 || yena puṇyena te prāptaṃ rājyaṃ prājyamakaṃṭakam || tatpuṇyaśeṣatobhūyādviśvanāthe matistava || 32 || yasya prasādātsulabhamāyuḥ putrāṃbarāganāḥ || samṛddhayaḥ svargamokṣau sa viśveśaḥ prasīdatu || 33 || nāmaśravaṇamātreṇa yasya viśveśiturvibhoḥ || mahāpātakavicchedaḥ sa viśveśo'stu te hṛdi || 34 || tvaṃ vṛddhakālo bhūpālaḥ śrutvetyāśīḥ paraṃparām || smariṣyasīdaṃ vṛttāṃtaṃ pulakāṃkavapustadā || 35 || ākāragopanaṃ kṛtvā tebhyo dattvā dhanaṃ bahu || sumuhūrtamanuprāpya sute rājyaṃ vidhāya ca || 36|| anaṃgalekhayā rājñyā tataḥ kāśīṃ gamiṣyasi || dattvā dānāni bhūrīṇi prīṇayitvā'rthino janān || 37 || svanāmnā tatra saṃsthāpya liṃgaṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam || prāsādaṃ tatra kṛtvoccaistadagre kūpamuttamam || 38 || vidhāya vidhivattatra kalaśāropaṇādikam || maṇimāṇikya cāṃpeya dukūlebhāśvagodhanam || 39 || mahādhvajapatākāśca cchatracāmaradarpaṇam || devopakaraṇaṃ bhūri viśrāṇya śramavarjitaḥ || 4.1.24.40 || vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ parikṣīṇakalevaraḥ || madhyāhne nirjane tatra drakṣyasyekaṃ tapodhanam || 41 || atīvajīrṇavapuṣaṃ paripiṃgajaṭānvitam || mūrtimaṃtaṃmiva prāṃśuṃ dharmaṃ janamanoharam|| 42|| bhāraṃ śarīrayaṣṭeśca dṛḍhayaṣṭyāṃ samarpya ca || garbhāgārādviniṣkramyābhyāyāṃtaṃraṃgamaṃḍape ||43|| upaviśya samīpe te prakṣyatyevamanukramāt || kosi tvaṃ kimihāsi tvaṃ dvitīya iva kastvayam || 44 || prāsādaḥ kāritaḥ kena jānāsyeṣa tato vada || asya liṃgasya kiṃ nāma prāyo jāne na vārdhakāt || 45 || pṛṣṭastvamiti te nātha tadā vṛddha tapasvinā || kathayiṣyasyahaṃ rājā vṛddhakāla iti śrutaḥ || 46 || dākṣiṇātya iha prāptastvetayā saha kāṃtayā || dhyāyāmi liṃgametacca prārthayāmi na kiṃcana || 47 || prāsādasyāsya jaṭila svayaṃkārayitā śivaḥ || viśeṣato'syaliṃgasya nāma no vedmi niścitam|| 48 || iti śrutvā narapatervākyaṃprāha jaṭādharaḥ || satyamuktaṃ tvayaikaṃ hi liṃganāma na vetsi yat || 49 || paśyeyaṃ tvāmahaṃ nityamupaviṣṭaṃ suniścalam || śruto bhaviṣyati tava prāsādo yena kāritaḥ || 4.1.24.50 || mamāgre tatsamācakṣva yadi jānāsi tattvataḥ || ākarṇyeti vacastasya punaḥ prāha bhavāniti ||| 51 || kartā kārayitā śaṃbhuḥ kimatathyaṃ bravīmyaham || athavā ciṃtayā kiṃ me tapasvinnanayā vibho || 52 || iti tvayi sthite joṣaṃ sa punarvṛddhatāpasaḥ || pipāsurasmi pānīyamānīyāśu prayaccha me || 53 || iti tena ca nunnastvaṃ vāryānīya ca kūpataḥ || pāyayiṣyasi taṃ vṛddhaṃ tāpasaṃ tatkṣaṇācca saḥ || 54 || tadaṃbupānato bhūyātsupārvaṇa śaśiprabhaḥ || taruṇo rūpasaṃpannaḥ kośonmuktorago yathā || 55 || jātāścaryeṇa bhavatā punarevābhyabhāṣi saḥ || kaḥ prabhāvo hi bhagavanneṣa yena bhavānpunaḥ || 56 || parityajyātra jarasaṃ na vo bhrājasi sāṃpratam || asti cedavakāśaste tato brūhi tapodhana || 57 || tapodhana uvāca || || vṛddhakālakṣitipate jāne tvāṃ sumahāmate || imāmapi ca jāne'haṃ tava patnīṃ pativratām|| 58 || janmano'smādiyaṃ rājannāsīdviprasya kanyakā || turvasorvedavapuṣaḥ śubhācārā śubhānanā || 59 || tena dattā vivāhārthaṃ naidhruvāya mahātmane || sa ca kālavaśaṃ prāpto naidhruvo'prāptayauvanaḥ || 4.1.24.60 || vaidhavyaṃ pālayaṃtyeṣā mṛtā'vaṃtyāṃ śubhavratā || tena puṇyena saṃjātā pāṃḍyasya nṛpateḥ sutā || 61 || pariṇītā tvayā rājanpativrataratā sadā || tvayā saheha saṃprāptā muktiṃ prāpsyatyanuttamām || 62 || ayodhyāyāmathāvaṃtyāṃ mathurāyāmathāpi vā || dvāravatyāṃ ca kāṃcyāṃ vā māyāpuryāmatho nṛpa || 63 || api pātakino ye ca kālena nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || te hi svargādihāgatya kāśyāṃ mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ || 64 || avaimi tvāmapi nṛpadvijo'bhūḥ pūrvajanmani || māthuraḥ śivaśarmākhyo māyāpuryāṃ bhavānmṛtaḥ || 65 || tatpuṇyātprāpya vaikuṃṭhaṃ bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān || tatpuṇyaśeṣātkṣitipo jātastvaṃ naṃdivardhane || 66 || vṛddhakālāvanīpāla tenaiva sukṛtena ca || mokṣakṣetramidaṃ prāpto muktiṃ prāpsyasyanuttamām || 67 || anyacca śṛṇu rājeṃdra tvayā yatsamudīritam || kartā kārayitā śaṃbhuḥ prāsādasyeti tatsphuṭam || 68 || sukṛtaṃ naiva satatamākhyātavyaṃ kadācana || kṛtaṃ mayeti kathanātpuṇyaṃ kṣayati tatkṣaṇāt || 69 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena gopanīyaṃ nidhānavat || sukṛtaṃ kīrtanādvyarthaṃ bhavedbhasmahutaṃ tathā|| 4.1.24.70 || niścitaṃ viśvanāthena preritena tvayā'nagha || kṛtaṃ hi kṛtakṛtyena prāsādādiha vedmyaham || 71 || vṛddhakāleśvaraṃ nāma liṃgametanmahīpate || jānīhyanādisaṃsiddhaṃ nimittaṃ kiṃtu vai bhavān || 72 || darśanātsparśanāttasya pūjanācchravaṇānnateḥ || vṛddhakāleśaliṃgasya sarvaṃ prāpnoti vāṃchitam || 73 || kūpaḥ kālodako nāma jarāvyādhivighātakṛt || yadīya jalapānena mātuḥstanyamapānavān || 74 || kṛtakūpodakasnānaḥ kṛtaitalliṃgapūjanaḥ || varṣeṇa siddhimāpnoti manobhilaṣitāṃ naraḥ || 75 || na kuṣṭhaṃ na ca visphoṭā naraṃghā na vicarcikā || pītātspṛṣṭātpratiṣṭhaṃti kaphaḥ kālatamodakāt || 76 || nāgnimāṃdyaṃ naiva śūlaṃ na meho na pravāhikā || na mūtrakṛcchraṃ nā pāmā pānāyasyāsya sevanāt || 77 || bhūtajvarāśca ye kecidye kecidviṣamajvarāḥ || te kṣipramupaśāmyaṃti hyetatkūpodasevanāt || 78 || tavāgrato mama jarā palitaṃ ca yathāvidhi || etatkūpodapānena kṣaṇānnaṣṭaṃ navo'bhavam || 79 || vṛddhakāleśvare liṃge sevitena daridratā || nopasargā na vā rogā na pāpaṃ nāghajaṃ phalam || 4.1.24.80 || uttare kṛttivāsasya vārāṇasyāṃ prayatnataḥ || vṛddhakāleśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ siddhikāmukaiḥ || 81 || ityuktvā taṃ mahīpālaṃ haste dhṛtvā tapodhanaḥ || sānaṃgalekhā rājñīkaṃ tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yayau || 82 || mahākāla mahākāla mahākāleti kīrtanāt || śatadhā mucyate pāpairnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 83 || itthaṃ bhavitrī te muktiḥ kaiṭabhārātidarśanāt || bhogānbhuktvā bahuvidhānvaikuṃṭha nagare śubhe || 84 || iti saṃhṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ sa vipro bhagavattadgaṇavaktrato niśamya || svamudarkamathārkakoṭiramyaṃ harilokaṃ parilokayāṃcakāra || 85 || || maitrāvaruṇiruvāca || || lopāmudre sa vipreṃdro bhogānbhuktvā manoramān || māyāpuryāṃ kṛtaprāṇatyāga puṇyabalena ca || 86 || vaikuṃṭhalokādāgatya pattane naṃdivardhane || bhaumāni bhuktvā saukhyāni putrānutpādya suṃdarān || || 87 || teṣu rājyaṃ vinikṣipya prāpya vārāṇasīṃ purīm || viśveśvaraṃ samārādhya nirvāṇapadamīyivān || 88 || etatpuṇyatamākhyānaṃ viprasya śivaśarmaṇaḥ || śrutvā pāpavinirmukto jñānaṃ paramamṛcchati|| || 89 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvāddhe śivaśarmanirvāṇaprāpaṇaṃ nāma caturviṃśodhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
<4.1.25>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu sūta pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ kalaśajanmanaḥ || yāmākarṇya naro bhūyādvirajā jñānabhājanam || 1 || giriṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śrīsaṃjñaṃ kalaśodbhavaḥ || sapatnīko dadarśātha ramyaṃ skaṃdavanaṃ mahat || 2 || sarvartaṃ kusumāḍhyaṃ ca rasavatphalapādapam || susevya kaṃdamūlāḍhyaṃ suvalkalamahīruham|| 3 || nivītaśvāpadagaṇaṃ sasaritpalvalāvṛtam || svaccha gaṃbhīrakāsāraṃ sāraṃ sarvabhuvaḥ param || 4 || nānāpatatrisaṃghuṣṭaṃ nānāmunijanoṣitam || tapaḥsaṃketanilayamivaikaṃ saṃpadāṃ padam || 5 || lohito nāma tatrāsti giriḥ svarṇagiriprabhaḥ || sukaṃdaraprasravaṇaḥ svasānu śikharaprabhaḥ ||6|| kailāsasyaikaśakalaṃ karmabhūmāvihāgatam || tapastaptumiva proccairnānāścaryasamanvitam|| 7 || tatrādrākṣīnmuniśreṣṭho'gastyaḥ sākṣātṣaḍānanam || praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau sapatnīko mahātapāḥ || 8 || tuṣṭāva girijāsūnuṃ sūktaiḥ śrutisamudbhavaiḥ || tathā svakṛtayā stutyā prabaddha karasaṃpuṭaḥ || 9 || agastiruvāca || || namostu vṛṃdārakavṛṃdavaṃdya pādāraviṃdāya sudhākarāya || ṣaḍānanāyāmitavikramāya gaurīhṛdānaṃdasamudbhavāya ||4.1.25.10|| namostu tubhyaṃ praṇatārtihaṃtre kartre samastasya manorathānām || dātre rathānāṃ paratārakasya haṃtre pracaṃḍāsura tārakasya || 11 || amūrtamūrtāya sahasramūrtaye guṇāya guṇyāya parātparāya || apārapārāya parāparāya namostu tubhyaṃ śikhivāhanāya || 12 || namostu te brahmavidāṃvarāya digaṃbarāyāṃbara saṃsthitāya || hiraṇyavarṇāya hiraṇyabāhave namo hiraṇyāya hiraṇyaretase || 13 || tapaḥsvarūpāya tapodhanāya tapaḥphalānāṃ pratipādakāya || sadā kumārāya himāramāriṇe taṇīkṛtaiśvarya virāgiṇe namaḥ || 14 || namostu tubhyaṃ śarajanmane vibho prabhātasūryāruṇadaṃtapaṃktaye || bālāya cābālaparākramāya ṣāṇmāturāyālamanāturāya || 15 || mīḍhuṣṭamāyottaramīḍhuṣe namo namo gaṇānāṃ pataye gaṇāya || namostu te janmajarātigāya namo viśākhāya suśaktipāṇaye || 16 || sarvasya nāthasya kumārakāya krauṃcāraye tārakamārakāya || svāheya gāṃgeya ca kārtikeya śaiveya tubhyaṃ satataṃ namo'stu || 17 || itthaṃ pariṣṭutya sa kārtikeyaṃ namo namastvityabhibhāṣamāṇaḥ || dvistriḥparikramya puro viveśa sthito munīśopaviśeti coktaḥ || 18 || || kārtikeya uvāca || || kṣemosti kuṃbhaja mune tridaśaikasahāyakṛt || jāne tvāmiha saṃprāptaṃ tathā viṃdhyācalonnatim || 19 || avimukte mahākṣetre kṣemaṃ tryakṣeṇa rakṣite || yatra kṣīṇāyuṣāṃ sākṣādvirūpākṣo'sti mokṣadaḥ || 4.1.25.20 || bhūrbhuvaḥ svastale vāpi na pātālatale malam || nordhvaloke mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tādṛkkṣetraṃ kvacinmune || 21 || ahamekacaropyatra tatkṣetraprāptaye mune || tapye tapāṃsinādyāpi phaleyurme manorathāḥ || 22 || na tatpuṇyairna taddānairna tapobhirna tajjapaiḥ || na labhyaṃ vividhairyajñairlabhyamaiśādanugrahāt || 23 || īśvarānugrahādeva kāśīvāsaḥ sudurlabhaḥ || sulabhaḥ syānmune nūnaṃ na vai sukṛtakoṭibhiḥ || 24 || anyaiva kācitsā sṛṣṭirvidhāturyā'tirekiṇī || na tatkṣetraguṇānvaktumīśvaro'pīśvaro yataḥ || 25 || aho mateḥ sudaurbalyamahobhāgyasya daurvidham || aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ yatkāśīha na sevyate ||26|| śarīraṃ jīryate nityaṃ saṃjīryaṃtīṃdriyāṇyapi || āyurmṛgo mṛgayunā kṛtalakṣyo hi mṛtyunā || 27 || sāpadaṃ saṃpadaṃ jñātvā sāpāyaṃ kāyamuccakaiḥ || capalā capalaṃ cāyurmatvā kāśīṃ samāśrayet || 28 || yāvannaityāyuṣaścāṃtastāvatkāśī na mucyate || kālaḥ kalālavasyāpi saṃkhyātuṃ naiva vismaret || 29 || jarānikaṭanikṣiptā bādhaṃte vyādhayo bhṛśam || tathāpi deho nāneho nāho kāśīṃ samīhate || 4.1.25.30 || tīrthasnānena japyena paropakaraṇoktibhiḥ || vinārthaṃ labhyate dharmo dharmādarthaḥ svayaṃ bhavet || 31 || vinaivārthārjanopāyaṃ dharmādartho bhaveddhruvam || ato'rthaciṃtāmutsṛjya dharmamekaṃ samāśrayet || 32 || dharmādartho'rthataḥ kāmaḥ kāmātsarvasukhodayaḥ || svargopi sulabho dharmātkāśye kā durlabhā param || 33 || upāyatrayamevātra sthāṇurnirvāṇakāraṇam|| śarvāṇyagreva bhāṇāddhā parinirṇīya sarvataḥ || 34 || pūrvaṃ pāśupato yogastatastīrthaṃ sitāsitam || tatopyekamanāyāsamavimuktaṃ vimuktidam || 35 || śrīśaila himaśailādyā nānānyāyatanāni ca || tridaṃḍadhāraṇaṃcāpi saṃnyāsaḥ sarvakarmaṇām || 36 || tapāṃsi nānārūpāṇi vratāni niyamā yamāḥ || siṃdhūnāmapi saṃbhedā araṇyāni bahūnyapi || 37 || mānasānyapi bhaumāni dhārātīrthādikāni ca || ūṣarāścāpi pīṭhāni hyacchinnāmnāyapāṭhanam|| 38 || japaścāpi manūnāṃ ca tathā'gnihavanāni ca || dānāni nānākratavo devatopāsanāni ca || 39 || trirātraṃ paṃcarātrāṇi sāṃkhyayogādayastathā || viṣṇorārādhanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ muktaye'bhihitaṃ kila || 4.1.25.40 || puryaścāpi samākhyātānṛtajaṃtu vimuktidā || kaivalyasādhanānīha bhavaṃtyeva viniścitam || 41 || etāni yāni proktāni kāśīprāptikarāṇi ca || prāpya kāśīṃ bhavenmukto jaṃturnānyatrakutracit || 42 || ataeva hi tatkṣetraṃ pavitramaticitrakṛt || viśveśituḥ priyanityaṃ viṣvagbrahmāṇḍamaṃḍale || 43 || idameva hi tatkṣetraṃ kuśalapraśnakāraṇam || ehyehi dehi me sparśaṃ nijagātrasya suvrata || 44 || api kāśyāḥ samāgacchatsparśavatsparśa iṣyate || mayātra tiṣṭhatā nityaṃ kiṃtu tvaṃ tata āgataḥ || 458 || trirātramapiye kāśyāṃ vasaṃti niyateṃdriyāḥ || teṣāṃ punaṃti niyataṃ spṛṣṭāścaraṇareṇavaḥ || 46 || tvaṃ tu tatra kṛtāvāsaḥ kṛtapuṇyamahoccayaḥ || uttarapravahā snāna jātapiṃgalamūrdhajaḥ || 47 || tava tatra tu yatkuṃḍamagastīśvarasannidhau || tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca kṛtasarvodakakriyaḥ || 48 || pitṝnpiṃḍaiḥ samabhyarcya śraddhāśrāddhavidhānataḥ || kṛtyakṛtyo bhavejjaṃturvārāṇasyāḥ phalaṃ labhet || 49 || ityuktvā sarvagātrāṇi spaṣṭvā kuṃbhodbhavasya ca || skaṃdo'mṛtasarovāri vigāhya sukhamāptavān ||4.1.25.50|| jaya viśveśa netrāṇi vinimīlya vadannapi || tataḥ kiṃcitkṣaṇaṃ dadhyau guhaḥ sthāṇusuniścalaḥ || 51 || skaṃde visarjitadhyāne suprasannamanomukhe || pratīkṣya vāgavasaraṃ papracchātha munirguham || 52 || || agastiruvāca || || svāminyathā bhagavatā bhagavatyai purā'kathi || vārāṇasyāstu mahimā himaśailabhuve mudā || 53 || tvayā yathā samākarṇi tadutsaṃganivāsinā || tathā kathaya ṣaḍvaktra tatkṣetraṃ me'tirocate || 54 || || skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇuṣva maitrāvaruṇe yathā bhagavatā'kathi || tatkṣetrasyāvimuktasya mama mātuḥ puraḥ purā || 55 || śrutaṃ ca yattadutsaṃge sthitena sthiracetasā || māhātmyaṃ tacchṛṇu mune kathyamānaṃ mayā'nagha || 56 || guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyamavimuktamiheritam || tatra saṃnihitā siddhistatra nityaṃ sthito vibhuḥ || 57 || bhūrloke naiva saṃlagnaṃ tatkṣetraṃ tvaṃtarikṣagam || ayogino na vīkṣaṃte paśyaṃtyeva ca yoginaḥ || || 58 || yastatra nivasedvipra saṃyatātmā samāhitaḥ || trikālamapi bhuṃjāno vāyubhakṣasamo bhavet || 59 || nimeṣamātramapi yo hyavimukte'tibhaktibhāk || brahmacaryasamāyuktaṃ tena taptaṃ mahattapaḥ || 4.1.25.60 || yastu māsaṃ vaseddhīro laghvāhāro jiteṃdriyaḥ || sarvaṃ tena vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ divyaṃ pāśupataṃ bhavet || 61 || saṃvatsaraṃ vasaṃstatra jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || aparasvavipuṣṭāṃgaḥ parānnaparivarjakaḥ || 62 || parāpavādarahitaḥ kiṃciddānaparāyaṇaḥ || samāḥ sahasramanyatra tena taptaṃ mahattapaḥ || 63 || yāvajjīvaṃ vasedyastu kṣetramāhātmyavinnaraḥ || janmamṛtyu bhayaṃ hitvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 64 || na yogairyā gatirlabhyā janmāṃtaraśatairapi || anyatrahelayā sā'tra labhyeśasya prasādataḥ ||65|| brahmahā yo'bhigacchedvai daivādvārāṇasīṃ purīm || tasya kṣetrasya māhātmyādbrahmahatyā nivartate || 66 || ādehapatanaṃ yāvadyovimuktaṃ na muṃcati || na kevalaṃ brahmahatyā prakṛtiśca nivartate || 67 || ananyamānaso bhūtvā tatkṣetraṃ yo na muṃcati || sa muṃcati jarāmṛtyuṃ garbhavāsaṃ suduḥsaham || 68 || avimuktaṃ niṣeveta devarṣigaṇasevitam || yadīcchenmānavo dhīmānna punarjananaṃ bhuvi || 69 || avimuktaṃ na muṃceta saṃsārabhayamocanam || prāpya viśveśvaraṃ devaṃ na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate || 4.1.25.70 || kṛtvā pāpasahsrāṇi piśācatvaṃ varaṃtviha || na tu kratuśataprāpyaḥ svargaḥ kāśīpurīṃ vinā || 71 || aṃtakāle manuṣyāṇāṃ bhidyamāneṣu marmasu || vātenātudyamānānāṃ smṛtirnaivopajāyate || 72 || tatrotkramaṇakāle tu sākṣādviśveśvaraḥ svayam || vyācaṣṭe tārakaṃ brahma yenāsau tanmayo bhavet || 73 || aśāśvatamidaṃ jñātvā mānuṣyaṃ bahukilbiṣam || avimuktaṃ niṣeveta saṃsārabhayanāśanam || 74 | vighrairāloḍyamānopi yo'vimuktaṃ na muṃcati || naiḥśreyasī śriyaṃ prāpya duḥkhāṃtaṃ sodhigacchati || 75 || mahāpāpaughaśamanīṃ puṇyopacayakāriṇīm || bhuktimuktipradāmaṃte ko na kāśīṃ sudhīḥ śrayet || 76 || evaṃ jñātvā tu medhāvī nāvimuktaṃ tyajennaraḥ || avimuktaprasādena vimukto jāyate yataḥ || 77 || avimuktasya māhātmyaṃ ṣaḍbhirvaktraiḥ kathaṃ mayā || vaktuṃ śakyaṃ na śaknoti sahasrāsyopi yatparam || 78 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe skaṃdāgastyadarśanaṃ nāma paṃcaviśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<4.1.26>
|| agastiruvāca || || prasannosi yadi skaṃda mayi prītiranuttamā || tatsamācakṣva bhagavaṃściraṃ yanme hṛdisthitam || 1 || avimuktamidaṃ kṣetraṃ kadārabhya bhuvastale || parāṃ prathitimāpannaṃ mokṣadaṃ cābhavatkatham || 2 || kathameṣā trilokīḍyā gīyate maṇikarṇikā || tatrāsītkiṃ purāsvāminyadā nāmaranimnagā || 3 || vārāṇasīti kāśīti rudrāvāsa iti prabho || avāpa nāmadheyāni kathametāni sā purī || ānaṃdakānanaṃ ramyamavimuktamanaṃtaram || 4 || mahāśmaśāna iti ca kathaṃ khyātaṃ śikhidhvaja || etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ saṃdehaṃ me'panodaya || 5 || || skaṃda uvāca || praśnabhāroyamatulastvayā yaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || kuṃbhayone'mumevārthamaprākṣīdaṃbikā haram || 6 || yathā ca devadevena sarvajñena niveditam || jaganmātuḥ purastācca tathaiva kathayāmi te || 7 || mahāpralaya kāle ca naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame || āsīttamomayaṃ sarvamanarkagrahatārakam || 8 || acaṃdramanahorātramanagnyanilabhūtalam || apradhānaṃ viyacchūnyamanyatejovivardhitam || 9 || draṣṭṛtvādi vihīnaṃ ca śabdasparśasamujjhitam || vyapetagaṃdharūpaṃ ca rasatyaktamadiṅmukham || 4.1.26.10 || itthaṃ satyaṃdhatamasi sūcībhedye niraṃtare || tatsadbrahmeti yacchrutyā sadaikaṃ pratipādyate || 11 || amanogocarovācāṃ viṣayaṃ na kathaṃcana || anāmarūpavarṇaṃ ca na sthūlaṃ na ca yatkṛśam || 12 || ahrasvadīrghamalaghugurutvaparivarjitam || na yatropacayaḥ kaścittathā cāpacayopi ca || 13 || abhidhatte sa cakitaṃ yadastīti śrutiḥ punaḥ || satyaṃ jñānamanaṃtaṃ ca yadānaṃdaṃ paraṃ mahaḥ || 14 || aprameyamanādhāramavikāramanākṛti || nirguṇaṃ yogigamyaṃ ca sarvavyāpyekakāraṇam || 15 || nirvikalpaṃ nirāraṃbhaṃ nirmāyaṃ nirupadravam || yasyetthaṃ saṃvikalpyaṃte saṃjñāḥ saṃjñoditasya vai || 16 || tasyaikalasya carato dvitīyecchā bhavatkila || amūrtena svamūrtiśca tenākalpi svalīlayā || 17 || sarvaiśvaryaguṇopetā sarvajñānamayī śubhā || sarvagā sarvarūpā ca sarvadṛksarvakāriṇī || 18 || sarvaikavaṃdyā sarvādyā sarvadā sarvasaṃkṛtiḥ || parikalpyeti tāṃ mūrtimīśvarīṃ śuddharūpiṇīm || 19 || aṃtardadhe parākhyaṃ yadbrahmasarvaṃgamavyayam || 4.1.26.20 || amūrtaṃ yatparākhyaṃ vai tasya mūrtirahaṃ priye || arvācīnaparācīnā īśvaraṃ māṃ jagurbudhāḥ ||21|| tatastadaikalenāpi svairaṃ viharatāmayā || svavigrahātsvayaṃ sṛṣṭā svaśarīrānapāyinī || 22 || pradhānaṃ prakṛtiṃ tvāṃ ca māyāṃ guṇavatīṃ parām || buddhi tattvasya jananīmāhurvikṛtivarjitām || 23 || yugapacca tvayā śaktyā sākaṃ kālasvarūpiṇā|| mayā''dya puruṣeṇaitatkṣetraṃ cāpi vinirmitam||24|| sā śaktiḥ prakṛtiḥ proktā sa pumānīśvaraḥ paraḥ || tābhyāṃ ca ramamāṇābhyāṃ tasminkṣetre ghaṭodbhava ||25|| paramānaṃdarūpābhyāṃ paramānaṃdarūpiṇī || paṃcakrośaparīmāṇe svapādatalanirmite||26 || mune pralayakālepi na tatkṣetraṃ kadācana|| vimuktaṃ hi śivābhyāṃ yadavimuktaṃ tato viduḥ || 27 || na yadā bhūmivalayaṃ na yadā'pāṃ samudbhavaḥ || tadā vihartumīśena kṣetrametadvini rmitam|| 28 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ kṣetrasya veda kopi na kuṃbhaja|| nāstikāya na vaktavyaṃ kadāciccarmacakṣuṣe || 29 || śraddhālave vinītāya trikālajñānacakṣuṣe || śivabhaktāya śāṃtāya vaktavyaṃ ca mumukṣave || 4.1.26.30 || avimuktaṃ tadarabhya kṣetrametadudīryate || paryaṃka(?)bhūtaṃ śivayorniraṃtarasukhāspadam || 31 || (payaka) abhāvaḥ kalpyate mūḍhairyadā ca śivayostayoḥ|| kṣetrasyāsya tadābhāvaḥ kalpyo nirvāṇakāriṇaḥ|| 32 || anārādhya maheśānamanavāpya ca kāśikām|| yogādyupāyavijñopi na nirvāṇamavāpnuyāt ||33|| asyānaṃdavanaṃ nāma purā kāri pinākinā || kṣetrasyānaṃdahetutvādavimuktamaṃnataram || 34 || ānaṃdakaṃdabījānāmaṃkurāṇi yatastataḥ || jñeyāni sarvaliṃgāni tasminnānaṃdakānane || 35 || avimuktamiti khyātamāsīditthaṃ ghaṭodbhava || tathā cākhyāmyatha mune yathāsīnmaṇikarṇikā || 36 || prāgānaṃdavane tatra śivayo ramamāṇayoḥ || icchetyabhūtkalaśaja sṛjyaḥ kopyaparaḥ kila || 37 || yasminnyaste mahābhāre āvāṃ svaḥ svairacāriṇau || nirvāṇaśrāṇanaṃ kurvaḥ kevalaṃ kāśiśāyinām || 38 || sa eva sarvaṃ kurute sa eva paripāti ca || sa eva saṃvṛṇotyaṃte sarvaiśvaryanidhiḥ sa ca || 39 || cetaḥsamudramākuṃcya ciṃtākalloladolitam || sattvaratnaṃ tamogrāhaṃ rajovidrumavallitam || 4.1.26.40 || yasya prasādāttiṣṭhāvaḥ sukhamānaṃdakānane || parikṣipta manovṛttau kva hi ciṃtāture sukham || 41 || saṃpradhāryeti sa vibhuḥ sarvataścitsvarūpayā || tayā saha jagaddhātryā jagaddhātā'tha dhūrjaṭiḥ || 42 || savye vyāpārayāṃcakre dṛśamaṃge sudhāmucam || tataḥ pumānāvirāsīdekastrailokyasuṃdaraḥ || 43 || śāṃtaḥ sattvaguṇodrikto gāṃbhīrya jitasāgaraḥ || tathā ca kṣamayā yukto mune'labdhopamo'bhavat || 44 || iṃdranīladyutiḥśrīmānpuṃḍarīkottamekṣaṇaḥ || suvarṇākṛti succhāya dukūlayugalāvṛtaḥ || 45 || lasatpracaṃḍadordaṃḍa yugaladvayarājitaḥ || ullasatparamāmodanābhīhradakuśeśayaḥ || 46 || ekaḥ sarvaguṇāvāsastvekaḥ sarvakalānidhiḥ || ekaḥ sarvottamo yasmāttato yaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 47 || tato mahāṃtaṃ taṃ vīkṣya mahāmahimabhūṣaṇam || mahādeva uvācedaṃ mahāviṣṇurbhavācyuta || 48 || tava niḥśvasitaṃ vedāstebhyaḥ sarvamavaiṣyasi || vedadṛṣṭena mārgeṇa kuru sarvaṃ yathocitam|| 49 || ityuktvā taṃ maheśāno buddhitattvasvarūpiṇam || śivayā sahito rudro viveśānaṃdakānanam || 4.1.26.50 || tataḥ sa bhagavānviṣṇurmaulāvājñāṃ nidhāya ca || kṣaṇaṃ dhyānaparo bhūtvā tapasyeva mano dadhau || 51 || khanitvā tatra cakreṇa ramyāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ hariḥ || nijāṃgasvedasaṃdoha salilaistāmapūrayat || 52 || samāḥ sahasraṃ paṃcāśattapa ugraṃ cacāra saḥ || cakrapuṣkīraṇī tīre tatra sthāṇusamākṛtiḥ || 53 || tataḥ sa bhagavānīśo mṛḍānyā sahito mṛḍaḥ || dṛṣṭvā jvalaṃtaṃ tapasā niścalaṃ mīlitekṣaṇam|| 54 || tamuvāca hṛṣīkeśaṃ maulimāṃdolayanmuhuḥ || aho mahattvaṃ tapasastvaho dhairyaṃ ca cetasaḥ || 55 || aho aniṃdhano vahnirjvalatyeṣa niraṃtaram|| alaṃ taptvā mahāviṣṇo varaṃ varaya sattama || 56 || mṛḍasyāmroḍitamidaṃ pratyabhijñāya bhāṣitam || unmīlita dṛgaṃbhojaḥ samuttasthau caturbhujaḥ || 57 || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || yadi prasanno deveśa devadeva maheśvara || bhavānyā sahitaṃ tvāṃ tu draṣṭumicchāmi sarvadā || 58 || sarvakarmasu sarvatra tvāmeva śaśiśekhara || puraścaraṃ taṃ paśyāmi yathā tanme varastathā || 59 || tvadīya caraṇāṃbhoja makaraṃdamadhūtsukaḥ || macceto bhramaro bhrāṃtiṃ vihāyāstu suniścalaḥ ||4.1.26.60|| || śrīśiva uvāca || evamastu hṛṣīkeśa yattvayoktaṃ janārdana || anyaṃ varaṃ prayacchāmi tamākarṇaya suvrata || 61 || tvadīyasyāsya tapaso mahopacaya darśanāt || yanmayāṃdolito maulirahiśravaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ || 62 || tadāṃdolanataḥ karṇātpapāta maṇikarṇikā || maṇibhiḥ khacitā ramyā tato'stu maṇikarṇikā || 63 || cakrapuṣkariṇī tīrthaṃ purākhyātamidaṃ śubham || tvayā cakreṇa khananācchaṃkhacakragadādhara || 64 || mama karṇātpapāteyaṃ yadā ca maṇikarṇikā || tadāprabhṛti loke'tra khyātāstu maṇikarṇikā ||65|| || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || muktākuṃḍalapātena tavādritanayāpriya || tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ muktikṣetramihāstu vai ||66|| kāśate'tra yato jyotistadanākhyeyamīśvaraḥ || ato nāmāparaṃ cāstu kāśīti prathitaṃ vibho || 67 || anyaṃ varaṃ vare deva deyaḥ sopyavicāritam || sa te paropakārārthaṃ jagadrakṣāmaṇe śiva || 68 || ābrahmastaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ yatkiṃcijjaṃtusaṃjñitam || caturṣu bhūtagrāmeṣu kāśyāṃ tanmuktimāpsyatu ||69|| asmiṃstīrthavare śaṃbho maṇiśrava ṇabhūṣaṇe || saṃdhyāṃ snānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ vedādhyayanamuttamam || tarpaṇa piṃḍadānaṃ ca devatānāṃ ca pūjanam || 4.1.26.70 || gobhūtilahiraṇyāśvadīpānnāṃbarabhūṣaṇam || kanyādānaṃ prayatnena saptataṃtūnanekaśaḥ || 71 || vratotsargaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ liṃgādi sthāpanaṃ tathā || karoti yo mahāprājño jñātvāyuḥkṣaṇagatvaram || 72 || vipattiṃ vipulāṃ cāpi saṃpattimatibhaṃgurām || akṣayā muktirekāstu vipākastasya karmaṇaḥ ||73|| anyaccāpi śubhaṃ karma yadatra śraddhayāyutam || vinātmaghātamīśāna tyaktvā prāyopaveśanam||74|| naiḥśreyasyāḥ śriyo hetustadastu jagadīśvara || nānuśocati nākhyāti kṛtvā kālāṃtarepi yat ||75|| tadihākṣayatāmetu tasyeśa tvadanugrahāt|| tava prasādāttasyeśa sarvamakṣayamastu tat || 76 || yadasti yadbhaviṣyacca yadbhūtaṃ ca sadāśiva || tasmādetacca sarvasmātkṣetramastu śubhodayam || 77 || yathā sadāśiva tvatto na kiṃcidadhikaṃ śivam || tathānaṃdavanādasmātkiṃcinmāstvadhikaṃ kvacit || 78 || vinā sāṃkhyena yogena vinā svātmāvalokanam|| vinā vrata tapo dānaiḥ śreyo'stu prāṇināmiha || 79 || śaśakā maśakā kīṭāḥ pataṃ gāsturagoragāḥ || paṃcakrośyāṃ mṛtāḥ kāśyāṃ saṃtu nirvāṇadīkṣitāḥ || 4.1.26.80 || nāmāpi gṛhṇatāṃ kāśyāḥ sadaivāstvenasaḥ kṣayaḥ || 81 || sadā kṛtayugaṃ cāstu sadācāstūttarāyaṇam|| sadā mahodayaścāstu kāśyāṃ nivasatāṃ satām || 82 || yāni kāni pavitrāṇi śrutyuktāni sadāśiva || tebhyo'dhikataraṃ cāstu kṣetrametattrilocana || 83 || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ puṇyamadhyayanācca yat || tatpuṇyaṃ jāyatāṃ kāśyāṃ gāyatrīlakṣa jāpyataḥ || 84 || aṣṭāṃgayogābhyāsena yatpuṇyamapi jāyateḥ || tatpuṇyaṃ sādhikaṃ bhūyācchraddhākāśīniṣevaṇāt || 85 || kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇādyaiśca yacchreyaḥ samupārjyate || tadekenopavāsena bhavatvānaṃdakānane || 86 || anyatra yattapastaptvā śreyaḥ syāccharadāṃ śatam || tadastu kāśyāṃ varṣeṇa bhūmiśayyā vratena hi || 87 || ājanma maunavratato yadanyatraphalaṃ smṛtam || tadastu kāśyāṃ pakṣāhaḥ satyavākparibhāṣaṇāt || 88 || anyatra dattvā sarvasvaṃ sukṛtaṃ yatsamīritam || sahasrabhojanātkāśyāṃ tadbhūyādayutādhikam || 89 || muktikṣetrāṇi sarvāṇi yatsaṃsevyoditaṃ phalam || paṃcarātrāttadatrāstu niṣevya maṇikarṇikām || 4.1.26.90 || prayāgasnānapuṇyena yatpuṇyaṃ syācchivapradam || kāśīdarśanamātreṇa tatpuṇyaṃ śraddhayāstviha || 91 || yatpuṇyamaśvamedhena yatpuṇyaṃ rājasūyataḥ || kāśyāṃ tatpuṇyamāpnotu trirātraśayanādyamī || 92 || tulāpuruṣadānena yatpuṇyaṃ samyagāpyate || kāśīdarśanamātreṇa tatpuṇyaṃ śraddhayāstu vai || 93 || iti viṣṇorvaraṃ śrutvā devadevo jagatpatiḥ || uvāca ca prasannātmā tathā'stu madhusūdana || 94 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || śṛṇu viṣṇo mahābāho jagataḥ prabhavāpyaya || vidhehi sṛṣṭiṃ vividhāṃ yathāvattvaṃ śrutīritām || 95 || piteva sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmataḥ pālako bhava || vidhvaṃsanīyā vividhā dharmadhvaṃsavidhāyinaḥ || 96 || dharmetarapathasthānāmupasaṃhṛtaye hare || hetumātraṃ bhavānyasmātsvakarmanihatā hi te || 97 || yathā pariṇataṃ sasyaṃ patetprasavabaṃdhanāt || te parīṇatapāpmānaḥ patiṣyaṃti tathā svayam || 98 || ye ca tvāmavamanyaṃte darpitāḥ svatapobalaiḥ || teṣāṃ caivopasaṃhṛtyai prabhaviṣyāmyahaṃ hare || 99 || upapātakino ye ca mahāpātakinaśca ye || tepi kāśīṃ samāsādya bhaviṣyaṃti gatainasaḥ || 4.1.26.100 || idaṃ mama priyaṃ kṣetraṃ paṃcakrośīparīmitam || mamājñā prabhavedatra nānyājñā prabhavediha || 101 || punarviṣṇurmayā prokto mṛḍāni śubhalocane || atyugratejasā tejo bhramaṃstrailokyavibhramaḥ || 102 || pāpināmapi jaṃtūnāmavimuktanivāsinām || nānyaḥ śāsayitā vipṇo teṣāṃ śāstā'hameva hi || 103 || yojanānāṃ śatasthopi yo(?)'vimuktaṃ smareddhṛdi || bahupātakapūrṇopi na sa pāpaiḥ prabādhyate ||104|| mama priyasya kṣetrasya yo'vimuktasya saṃsmaret || prāṇa prayāṇasamaye dūragopyaghavānapi ||105|| sa pāpapūgamutsṛjya svargabhogānsamaśnute || kāśīsmaraṇapuṇyena svargādbhraṣṭo hi jāyate||106|| pṛthivyāmekarāḍbhūtvā bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ || prāpyāvimuktaṃ tatpuṇyānnirvāṇapadabhāgbhavet || 107 || bahukālamuṣitvā'tra niyateṃdriyamānasaḥ || yadyanyatra vipadyeta daivayogācchucismite || 108 || sopi svargasukhaṃ bhuktvā bhūtvā kṣitipatīśvaraḥ || punaḥ kāśīmavāpyātha viṃdennaiḥśreyasīṃ śriyam || 109 || viṣṇo'vimukte saṃvāsaḥ karmanirmūlanakṣamaḥ || dvitrāṇāṃ hi pavitrāṇāṃ nirvāṇā yeha jāyate || 4.1.26.110 || viṣṇuruvāca || || deveśakṣetramāhātmyaṃ yo na jānāti tattvataḥ || na śraddadhāti mriyate mṛte tasyeha kā gatiḥ ||111|| || śiva uvāca || || anyatra kṛtvā pāpāni bahūni sumahāṃti ca || aśraddadhāno'tattvajño yadyatra ca vipadyate || 112 || mahimanyanabhijñopi kṣetrasyāsya janārdana|| tasya yā gatiruddiṣṭā tāṃ niśāmaya suvrata || 113 || paṃcakrośīṃ praviśatastasya pātakasaṃtatiḥ || bahireva pratiṣṭheta nāṃtarnirviśate kvacit || 114 || bhayādbahiḥ sthitāyāṃ ca tasya pātakasaṃtatau || triśūlapāśapāṇīnāṃ gaṇānāṃ sīmacāriṇām || 115 || praveśamātrādanagha sarvairenobhirujjhitaḥ || saṃsnāya maṇikarṇikyāṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam || 116 || sarvatīrtheṣusaṃsnānādyatpuṇyaṃ samavāpyate || tatpuṇyamāpyate samyaṅmaṇikarṇyeka majjanāt || 117 || vidhinā tatra saṃsnāya mṛdgomayakuśādibhiḥ || svaśākhāvāruṇairmaṃtrairdūrvāpāmārgadarbhakaiḥ || 118 || sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || maṇikarṇyāṃ vidhisnātaḥ śraddhayā tadavāpnuyāt || 119 || aśraddhayāpi yaḥ snāto maṇikarṇyāṃ vidhānataḥ || sopi puṇyamavāpnoti svargaprāptikaraṃ param || 4.1.26.120 || śraddhayā vidhivatsnātvā kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam || tilabarhiryavaiḥ samyaksarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet || 121 || śraddadhāno vidhisnātaḥ kṛta sarvodakakriyaḥ || japandevānsamabhyarcya sarvamaṃtraphalaṃ labhet || 122 || snātvā maunena viśveśa darśanā nniyateṃdriyaḥ || sarvavratakṛtaṃ śreyo labhedvācaṃyamaḥ śive || 123 || snāne devārcane japye malamūtravisarjane || maunaṃ kuryātprayatnena daṃtadhāvanahomayoḥ || 124 || viśveśvaraṃ samabhyarcya sūpacārairvidhānataḥ || yāvajjīvaṃ śivārcāyāḥ phalamāpnoti vai sakṛt || 125 || dattvālpamapi deveśi nyāyenopārjitaṃ dhanam || avimukte mama kṣetre na daridro bhavetkvacit || 126 || vividhaṃ dhanamāvarjya yo'vimukte na yacchati || saṃprāpya nidhanaṃ mūḍho'nyatra śocati sarvadā || 127 || ramyāṇi yāni ratnāni gogajāśvāṃbarāṇyapi || kṛtāni tāni śreyorthamavimuktanivāsinām || 128 || viśveśaprīṇanārthāya dhanaṃ nidhanameva vā || nyāyena kāśyāṃ yaḥ kuryātsa dhanyaḥ sa ca dharmavit || 129 || yosau viśveśvaro devaḥ kāśīpuryāmume sthitaḥ || liṃgarūpadharaḥ sākṣānmama śreyāspadaṃ hi tat || 4.1.26.130 || avimuktaṃ mahatkṣetraṃ paṃcakrośaparīmitam || jyotirligaṃ tadekaṃ hi jñeyaṃ viśveśvarābhidham || 131 || ekadeśasthitamapi yathā mārtaṃḍamaṃḍalam || dṛśyate sarvagaṃ sarvaiḥ kāśyāṃ viśveśvarastathā || 132 || niṣpratyūhena yogena nānājanmārjitena ca || yatphalaṃ labhyate'nyatra tatkāśyāṃ tyajatastanuma || 133 || taptvā tapāṃsi sarvāṇi bahukālaṃ jiteṃdriyaiḥ || yatphalaṃ labhyate'nyatra tatkāśyāmekarātrataḥ || 134 || akṣetramahimajñopi śraddhāhīnopi kālataḥ || kāśīpraveśādanagho'mṛtatvaṃ labhatemṛtaḥ || 135 || kṛtvāpyenāṃsi cogrāṇi kālātprāpyātha kāśikām || tyaktvā tanuṃ prasādānme māmeva pratipadyate || 136 || vinā mama prasādaṃ vai kaḥ kāśīṃ pratipadyate || vinā bradhnaṃ viśālākṣi dinakṛtka ihocyate || 137 || aprāpya kāśīṃ ko devi niraṃtara sukhaṃ labhet || bahmādyāḥ prākṛtaiḥ pāśairyato baddhā niraṃtaram || 138 || caturviṃśatibhiḥ pāśaistriguṇaiḥ kriyayā dṛḍhaiḥ || kaṃṭhe baddhā vimucyaṃte kathaṃ kāśīṃ vinā janāḥ || || 139 || bahūpasargo yogoyaṃ kṛcchrasādhyaṃ tapo hi yat || yogādbhraṣṭastapobhraṣṭo garbhakleśasahaḥpunaḥ || 4.1.26.140 || kṛtvāpi kāśyāṃ pāpāni kāśyāmeva mriyeta cet || bhūtvā rudrapiśācopi punarmuktimavāpsyati || 141 || kāśyāṃ mṛtānāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ daivātpāpakṛtāmapi || na pāto narake teṣāṃ teṣāṃ śāstāhameva yat || 142 || kāyaṃ vijñāya sāpāyaṃ smṛtvā garbhasya vedanām || tyaktvā rājyamapi prājyaṃ sevyā kāśī niraṃtaram || 143 || atarkitaṃ samabhyetya yamadūtāḥ sudāruṇāḥ || baddhvā pāśairhaniṣyaṃti kṣipraṃ kāśīṃ tataḥ śrayeta || 144 || na pāpebhyo bhayaṃ yatra na bhayaṃ yatra vai yamāt || na garbhavāsabhīryatra tāṃ kāśīṃ ko na saṃśrayet || 145 || adya prātaḥ paraśvo vā maraṇaṃ prāpyameva ca || yāvatkālavilaṃbosti tāvatkāśīṃ samāśrayet || 146 || prāpte tu maraṇe puṃsāṃ punarjanma punarmṛtiḥ || apunarbhavabhūmiṃ ca tasmātkāśīṃ śrayedbudhaḥ || 147 || putrakṣetrakalatrākhyāṃ tyaktvā māyāṃ hi vaiṣṇavīm || bhavāṃtarenekarūpāṃ bhavaghnīṃ kāśikāṃ śrayet ||148|| || skaṃda uvāca || dūraṃ me maraṇaṃyuvāhamadhunā dhāryaṃ na cittetviti śrotavyo nibhṛtaṃ kṛtāṃta mahiṣagraiveyaghaṃṭāravaḥ || naikaṭyātprakaṭotkaṭaśramaghaṭāmaprāpya hitvā drutaṃ jīrṇāṃ parṇakuṭīṃ tataḥ paṭumatirgacchetpurīṃ dhūrjaṭeḥ || 149 || vyāsa uvāca || agastyasya puraḥ sūta kathayitvā kathāmimām || sarvapāpapraśamanīṃ punaḥ skaṃda uvāca ha || 4.1.26.150 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe maṇikarṇikākhyānaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || || cha || || cha ||
<4.1.27>
skaṃda uvāca || vārāṇasīti prathitaṃ yathā cānaṃdakānanam || tathā ca kathayāmīha devadevenabhāṣitam || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || niśāmaya mahābāho viṣṇo trailokyasuṃdara || prāptaṃ vārāṇasītyākhyāmavimuktaṃ yathā tathā || 2 || nirdagdhānsāgarāñchrutvā kapilakrodhavahninā || aśvamedhāśvasaṃyuktānpūrvajānsvānbhagīrathaḥ || 3 || sūryavaṃśe mahātejā rājā paramadhārmikaḥ || ārirādhayiṣurgaṃgāṃ tapase kṛtaniścayaḥ ||4|| himavaṃtaṃ nagaśreṣṭhamamātya nyastarājyadhūḥ || jagāma yaśasāṃ rāśiruddidhīrṣuḥ pitāmahān || 5 || brahmaśāpāgninirdagdhānmahādurgatigānapi || vinā trimārgagāṃ viṣṇo ko jaṃtūṃstridivaṃ nayet || 6 || mamaiva sā parāmūrtistoyarūpā śivātmikā || brahmāṃḍānāmanekānāmādhāraḥ prakṛtiḥ parā || 7 || śuddhavidyāsvarūpā ca triśaktiḥ karuṇātmikā || ānaṃdāmṛtarūpā ca śuddhadharmasvarūpiṇī || 8 || yāmetāṃ jagatāṃ dhātrīṃ dhārayāmi svalīlayā || viśvasya rakṣaṇārthāya parabrahmasvarūpiṇīm || 9 || trailokye yāni tīrthāni puṇyakṣetrāṇi yāni ca || sarvatra sarve ye dharmāḥ sarvayajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ || 4.1.27.10 || tapāṃsi viṣṇo sarvāṇi śrutiḥ sāṃgā caturvidhā || ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca kaścāpi devatānāṃ gaṇāśca ye || || 11 || puruṣārthāśca sarve vai śaktayo vividhāśca yāḥ || gaṃgāyāṃ sarva evaite sūkṣmarūpeṇa saṃsthitāḥ || 12 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvakratuṣu dīkṣitaḥ || cīrṇasarvavrataḥ sopi yastu gaṃgāṃ niṣevate || 13 || tapāṃsi tena taptāni sarvadānapradaḥ sa ca || sa prāpta yoganiyamo yastu gaṃgāṃ niṣevate ||14|| sarvavarṇāśramebhyaśca vedavidbhyaśca vai tathā || śāstrārthapāragebhyaśca gaṃgāsnāyī viśipyate || 15 || manovākkāyajairdoṣairduṣṭo bahuvidhairapi || vīkṣya gaṃgāṃ bhavetpūtaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ ||16|| kṛte sarvatra tīrthāni tretāyāṃ puṣkaraṃ param || dvāpare tu kurukṣetraṃ kalau gaṃgaiva kevalam || 17 || pūrvajanmāṃtarābhyāsa vāsanāvaśato hare || gaṃgātīre nivāsaḥ syānmada nugrahataḥ parāt || 18 || dhyānaṃ kṛte mokṣahetustretāyāṃ tacca vai tapaḥ || dvāpare taddvayaṃ yajñāḥ kalau gaṃgaiva kevalam || 19 || yo dehapatanādyāvadgaṃgātīraṃ na muṃcati || sa hi vedāṃtavidyogī brahmacaryavratī sadā || 4.1.27.20 || kalau kaluṣacittānāṃ paradravyaratātmanām || vidhihīnakriyāṇāṃ ca gatirgaṃgāvinā nahi || 21 || alakṣmīḥ kālakarṇī ca duḥsvapno durviciṃtitam || gaṃgāgaṃgeti japanāttāni nopaviśaṃti hi || 22 || gaṃgā hi sarvabhūtānāmihāmutraphalapradā || bhāvānurūpato viṣṇo sadāsarvajagaddhitā || 23 || yajña dāna tapo yoga japāḥ saniyamā yamāḥ || gaṃgāsevāsahasrāṃśaṃ na labhaṃte kalau hare || 24 || kimaṣṭāṃgena yogena kiṃ tapobhiḥ kimadhvaraiḥ || vāsa eva hi gaṃgāyāṃ brahmajñānasya kāraṇam || 25 || apidūrasthitasyāpi gaṃgāmāhātmyavedinaḥ || ayogyasyāpi goviṃdabhaktyā gaṃgā prasīdati || 26 || śraddhā dharmaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā jñānaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ || śraddhā svargaśca mokṣaśca śraddhayā sā prasīdati || 27 || ajñānarāgalobhādyaiḥ puṃsāṃ saṃmūḍhacetasām || śraddhā na jāyate dharme gaṃgāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 28 || bahiḥ sthitaṃ jalaṃyadvannārikelāṃtare sthitam || tathā brahmāṃḍabāhyasthaṃ parabrahmāṃbu jāhnavī || 29 || gaṃgālābhātparo lābhaḥ kvacidanyo na vidyate || tasmādgaṃgāmupāsīta gaṃgaiva paramaḥ pumān ||4.1.27.30|| śaktasya paṃḍitasyāpi guṇino dānaśīlinaḥ || gaṃgāsnānavihīnasya hare janma nirarthakam || 31 || vṛthā kula vṛthā vidyā vṛthā yajñā vṛthātapaḥ || vṛthā dānāni tasyeha kalau gaṃgāṃ na yo bhajet || 32 || guṇavatpātrapūjāyāṃ na syādvai tādṛśaṃ phalam || yathā gaṃgājalasnāna pūjane vidhinā phalam || 33 || mamatejognigarbheyaṃ mamavīryātisaṃvṛtā || dāhikā sarvadoṣāṇāṃ sarvapāpavināśinī || 34 || smaraṇādeva gaṃgāyāḥ pāpasaṃghātapaṃjaram || śatadhā bhedamāyāti girirvajrahato yathā || 35 || gaṃgāṃ gacchati yastveko yastu bhaktyānumodayet || tayostulyaphalaṃ prāhurbhaktirevātra kāraṇam|| || 36 || gacchaṃstiṣṭhañjapandhyānbhuṃjañjāgratsvapanvadan || yaḥ smaretsatataṃ gaṃgāṃ sa hi mucyeta baṃdhanāt || 37 || pitṝnuddiśya yobhaktyā pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyutam || guḍasarpistilaiḥsārdhaṃ gaṃgāṃbhasi vinikṣipet || 38 || tṛptā bhavaṃti pitarastasya varṣaśataṃ hare || yacchaṃti vividhānkāmānparituṣṭāḥ pitāmahāḥ || || 39 || liṃge saṃpūjite sarvamarcitaṃ syājjagadyathā || gaṃgāsnānena labhate sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tathā || 4.1.27.40 || gaṃgāyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā yo liṃgaṃ nityamarcati || ekena janmanā muktiṃ parāṃ prāpnoti sa dhruvam || 41 || agnihotraṃ ca yajñāśca vratadānatapāṃsi ca || gaṃgāyāṃ liṃgapūjāyāḥ koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥ || 42 || gaṃgāṃ gaṃtuṃ viniścitya kṛtvā śrāddhādikaṃ gṛhe || sthitasya samyaksaṃkalpāttasya naṃdaṃti pūrvajāḥ || 43 || pāpāni ca rudaṃtyāśu hā kva yāsyāma ityalam || lobhamohādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ maṃtrayaṃti punaḥpunaḥ || 44 || yathā na gaṃgāṃ yātyeṣa tathā vighnaṃ prakurmahe || gaṃgāṃ gato yathā caiṣa na ucchittiṃ vidhāsyati || 45 || gṛhādgaṃgāvagāhārthaṃ gacchatastu padepade || nirāśāni vrajaṃtyeva pāpānyasya śarīrataḥ || 46|| pūrvajanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyaistyaktvā lobhādikaṃ hare || vyudasya sarvavighnaughāngaṃgāṃ prāpnoti puṇyavān || 47 || anuṣaṃgeṇa maulyena vāṇijyenāpi sevayā || kāmāsaktopi vā martyo gaṃgāsnāto divaṃ vrajet || 48 || anicchayāpi saṃspṛṣṭo dahano hi yathā dahet || anicchayāpi saṃsnātā gaṃgā pāpaṃ tathā dahet || 49 || tāvaddhamati saṃsāre yāvadgaṃgāṃ na sevate || saṃsevya gaṃgāṃ no jaṃturbhavakleśaṃ prapaśyati || 4.1.27.50 || yo gaṃgāṃbhasi nisnāto bhaktyā saṃtyaktasaṃśayaḥ || manuṣyacarmaṇā naddhaḥ sa devo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 51 || gaṃgāsnānārthamudyukto madhyemārgaṃ mṛto yadi || gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ sopi tadāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ || 52 || māhātmyaṃ ye ca gaṃgāyāḥ śṛṇvaṃti ca paṭhaṃti ca || tepyaśeṣairmahāpāpairmucyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || 53 || durbuddhayo durācārā haitukā bahusaṃśayāḥ || paśyaṃti mohitā viṣṇo gaṃgāmanya nadīmiva || 54 || janmāṃtarakṛtairdānaistapobhirniyamairvrataiḥ || iha janmani gaṃgāyāṃ nṛṇāṃ bhaktiḥ prajāyate || 55 || gaṃgābhaktimatāmarthe maheṃdrādi pureṣu ca || harmyāṇi ramyabhogāni nirmitāni svayaṃbhuvā || 56 || siddhayaḥ siddhiliṃgāni sparśaliṃgānyanekaśaḥ || prāsādā ratnaracitāściṃtāmaṇigaṇā api || 57 || gaṃgājalāṃtastiṣṭhaṃti kalikalmaṣabhītitaḥ || ataeva hi saṃsevyā kalau gaṃgeṣṭasiddhidā || 58 || sūryodaye tamāṃsīva vajrapātabhayānnagāḥ || tārkṣyekṣaṇādyathāsarpā meghā vātāhatā iva || 59 || tattvajñānādyathā mohaḥ siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā mṛgāḥ || tathā sarvāṇi pāpāni yāṃti gaṃgekṣaṇātkṣayam || 4.1.27.60 || divyauṣadhairyathā rogā lobhena ca yathā guṇāḥ || yathā grīṣmoṣmasaṃpattiragādhahrada majjanāt || 61 || tūlaśailaḥ sphuliṃgena yathā naśyati tatkṣaṇāt || tathā doṣāḥ praṇaśyaṃti gaṃgāṃbhaḥ sparśanāddhruvam || 62 || krodhena ca tapo yadvatkāmena ca yathā matiḥ || anayena yathā lakṣmīrvidyā mānena vai yathā || 63 || daṃbha kauṭilya māyābhiryathādharmo vinaśyati || tathā naśyaṃti pāpāni gaṃgāyā darśanena tu || 64 || mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya vidyutsaṃpātacaṃcalam || gaṃgāṃ yaḥ sevate sotra buddheḥ pāraṃ paraṃ gataḥ || 65 || vidhūtapāpā ye martyāḥ paraṃ jyotiḥsvarūpiṇīm || sahasrasūryapratimāṃ gaṃgāṃ paśyaṃti te bhuvi || 66 || sādhāraṇāṃbhasā pūrṇāṃ sādhāraṇa nadīmiva|| paśyaṃti nāstikā gaṃgāṃ pāpopahatalocanāḥ || 67 || saṃsāramocakaścāhaṃ janānāmanukaṃpayā || gaṃgātaraṃgarūpeṇa sopānaṃ nirmame divaḥ || 68 || sarva eva śubhaḥ kālaḥ sarvo deśastathā śubhaḥ || sarvo jano dānapātraṃ śrīmatī jāhnavī taṭe || 69 || yathāśvamedho yajñānāṃ nagānāṃ himavānyathā || vratānāṃ ca yathā satyaṃ dānānāmabhayaṃ yathā || 4.1.27.70 || prāṇāyāmaśca tapasāṃ maṃtrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā || dharmāṇāmapyahiṃsā ca kāmyānāṃ śrīryathā varā || 71 || yathātmavidyā vidyānāṃ strīṇāṃ gaurī yathottamā || sarvardavegaṇānāṃ ca yathā tvaṃ puruṣottama ||| 72 || sarvaṣāmeva pātrāṇāṃ śivabhakto yathā varaḥ || tathā sarveṣu tīrtheṣu gaṃgātīrthaṃ viśiṣyate || 73 || hareyaścāvayorbhedaṃ na karoti mahāmatiḥ || śivabhaktaḥ sa vijñeyo mahāpāśupataśca saḥ || 74 || pāpapāṃsumahāvātyā pāpadrumakuṭhārikā || pāpeṃdhanadavāgniśca gaṃgeyaṃ puṇyavāhinī || 75 || nānārūpāśca pitaro gāthā gāyaṃti sarvadā || api kaścitkulesmākaṃ gaṃgāsnāyī bhaviṣyati || 76 || devarṣīnparisaṃtarpya dīnānāthāṃśca duḥkhitān || śraddhayā vidhinā snātvā dāsyate salilāṃjalim || 77 || api naḥ sa kule bhūyācchive viṣṇau ca sāmyadṛk || tadālayakaro bhaktyā tasya saṃmārjanādikṛt || 78 || akāmo vā sakāmo vā tiryagyonigatopi vā || gaṃgāyāṃ yo mṛto martyo narakaṃ sa na paśyati ||79|| tīrthamanyatpraśaṃsaṃti gaṃgātīre sthitāśca ye || gaṃgāṃ na bahu manyaṃte te syurnirayagāminaḥ ||4.1.27.80|| māṃ ca tvāṃ caiva yo dveṣṭi gaṃgāṃ ca puruṣādhamaḥ|| svakīyaiḥ puruṣaiḥ sārdhaṃ sa ghoraṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 81 || ṣaṣṭirgaṇasahasrāṇi gaṃgāṃ rakṣaṃti sarvadā || abhaktānāṃ ca pāpānāṃ vāse vighnaṃ prakurvate || 82 || kāmakrodhamahāmohalobhādi niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || ghnaṃti teṣāṃ manastatra sthitiṃ cāpanayaṃti ca || 83 || gaṃgāṃ samāśrayedyastu sa muniḥ sa ca paṃḍitaḥ || kṛtakṛtyaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye || 84 || gaṃgāyāṃ ca sakṛtsnāto hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || tarpayaṃśca pitṝṃstatra tārayennarakārṇavāt || 85 || nairaṃtaryeṇa gaṃgāyāṃ māsaṃ yaḥ snāti puṇyavān || śakraloke sa vasati yāvacchakraḥ sapūrvajaḥ || 86 || abdaṃ yaḥ snāti gaṃgāyāṃ nairaṃtaryeṇa puṇyabhāk || viṣṇorlokaṃ samāsādya sa sukhaṃ saṃvasennaraḥ || 87 || gaṃgāyāṃ snāti yo martyo yāvajjīvaṃ dinedine || jīvanmuktaḥ sa vijñeyo dehāṃte mukta eva saḥ || ||88 || tithinakṣatraparvādi nāpekṣyaṃ jāhnavī jale || snānamātreṇa gaṃgāyāṃ saṃcitāghaṃ vinaśyati || 89 || paṃḍitopi sa mūrkhaḥ syācchaktiyuktopyaśaktikaḥ || yastu bhāgīrathītīraṃ sukhasevyaṃ na saṃśrayet || 4.1.27.90 || kiṃvāyupāpyarogeṇa vikāsinyātha kiṃ śriyā || kiṃ vā buddhyā vimalayā yadi gaṃgāṃ na sevate || 91 || yaḥ kārayedāyatanaṃ gaṃgāpratikṛternaraḥ || bhuktvā sa bhogānpretyāpi yāti gaṃgā salokatām || 92|| śṛṇvaṃti mahimānaṃ ye gaṃgāyā nityamādarāt || gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ teṣāṃ vācakaprīṇanāddhanaiḥ ||93|| pitṝnuddiśya yo liṃgaṃ snapayedgāṃga vāriṇā || tṛptāḥ syustasya pitaro mahānirayagā api || 94 || aṣṭakṛtvomaṃtrajaptairvastrapūtaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ || procurgāṃgajalaiḥ snānaṃ ghṛtasnānādhikaṃ budhāḥ || 95 || aṣṭadravyavimiśreṇa gaṃgātoyena yaḥ sakṛt || māgadhaprasthamātreṇa tāmrapātrasthitena ca || 96 || bhānave'rghaṃ pradadyācca svakīya pitṛbhiḥ saha || sotitejo vimānena sūryaloke mahīyate || 97 || āpaḥ kṣīraṃ kuśāgrāṇi ghṛtaṃ madhugavāṃdadhi || raktāni karavīrāṇi raktacaṃdanamityapi || 98 || aṣṭāṃgārgho yamuddiṣṭastvatīva ravitoṣaṇaḥ || gāṃgairvārbhiḥ koṭiguṇo jñeyo viṣṇo'nyavāritaḥ || 99 || gaṃgātīre svaśaktyā yaḥkuryāddevālayaṃ sudhīḥ || anyatīrthapratiṣṭhāto bhavetkoṭiguṇaṃ phalaṃ || 4.1.27.100 || aśvatthavaṭacūtādi vṛkṣāropeṇa yatphalam || kūpavāpītaḍāgādi prapā satrādibhistathā || 101 || anyatra yadbhavetpuṇyaṃ tadgaṃgādarśanādbhavet || puṣpavāṭyādibhiścāpi gaṃgāsparśaṃ tato'dhikam ||102|| kanyādānena yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ go'nnadānataḥ || tatpuṇyaṃ syācchataguṇaṃ gaṃgāgaṃḍūṣapānataḥ || 103 || cāṃdrāyaṇasahasreṇa yatpuṇyaṃ syājjanārdana || tato'dhikaphalaṃ gaṃgā'mṛtapānādavāpnuyāt || 104 || bhaktyā gaṃgāvagāhasya kimanyatphalamucyate || akṣayaḥ svargavāsopi nirvāṇamathavā hare || 105 || gaṃgāyāḥ pādukāyugmaṃ nityamarcati yo naraḥ || āyuḥ puṇyaṃ dhanaṃ putrānsvargamokṣau ca viṃdati || 106 || nāsti gaṃgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ kalikalmaṣanāśanam || nāsti muktipradaṃ kṣetramavimuktasamaṃ hare || 107 || gaṃgāsnānarataṃ martyaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva yamakikarāḥ || diśo daśa palāyaṃte siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā mṛgāḥ || 108 || gaṃgābhajanaśīlasya gaṃgātaṭanivāsinaḥ || arcāṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 109 || gobhūhiraṇyadānena bhaktyā gaṃgātaṭe śubhe || naro na jāyate bhūyaḥ saṃsāre duḥkhakaṃṭake ||4.1.27.110 || dīrghāyuṣyaṃ ca vāsobhirjñānaṃ pustakadānataḥ || annadānena saṃpattiṃ kīrtiṃ kanyāpradānataḥ || 111 || anyatra yatkṛtaṃ karma vrataṃ dānaṃ japastapaḥ || gaṃgātaṭe tu tatsarvaṃ hare koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 112 || dhenuṃ savatsā yo dadyād gaṃgātīre vidhānataḥ || goromasaṃkhyayā viṣṇo yugānsarvasamṛddhimān || 113 || goloke mama loke vā kāmadhenupradānataḥ || bhuṃjānaḥ sarvakāmāṃstu divyānnānāvidhānbahūn || 114 || devānāmapyalabhyāṃśca bhuktvā tu saha bāṃdhavaiḥ || pitṛbhiśca suhṛdbhiśca sarvaratnavibhūṣitaḥ || 115 || jāyate satkule paścāddhanadhānyasamākule || ratnakāṃcanasaṃpanne śīlavidyāsamanvite || 116 || bhuktvā sa vipulānbhogānputrapautrasamanvitaḥ || punargaṃgāṃ samāsādya kāśyāmuttaravāhinīm || 117 || viśveśvaraṃ samārādhya prāgjanurvāsanāvaśāt || kālāddehāṃtamāsādya brahma saṃpadyate tataḥ || 118 || vivartanadvayamapi bhūmerbhāgīrathītaṭe || naro dadāti yo bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 119 || tadbhūmitrasareṇūnāṃ saṃkhyayā yugamānayā || maheṃdra caṃdralokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānmanaḥpriyān || 4.1.27.120 || saptadvīpapatirbhūtvā mahādharmaparāyaṇaḥ || narakasthānpitṝnsarvānprāpayettridivaṃ hare ||121|| svargasthāṃśca pitṝnsarvānmocayitvā mahādyutiḥ || aṃte jñānāsinā chittvā hyavidyāṃ pāṃcabhautikīm || 122 || paravaiṃrāgyamāpanno yuṃjāno yogamuttamam || prāpyāthavā vimuktaṃ ca paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || || 123 || suvarṇamātramapi yaḥ suvarṇaṃ saṃprayacchati || suvarṇāya suvarṇaṃ ca hare bhāgīrathītaṭe || 124 || sa hemaratnakhacite vimāne sarvage śubhe || sarvaiśvaryasamāyuktaḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ || 125 || brahmāṃḍāṃtarasaṃstheṣu bhuṃjanbhogānmanoramān || sarvaiḥ saṃpūjito viṣṇo yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 126 || ekarāṭa dhatato(?) bhūtvā jaṃbūdvīpe pratāpavān || tato'vimuktamāsādya padaṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati || 127 || janmarkṣe tu kṛte snāne gaṃgāyāṃ bhaktipūrvakam || janmaprabhṛtipāpaughātsaṃcitānmucyate kṣaṇāt || 128 || vaiśākhe kārtike māghe gaṃgāsnānaṃ sudurlabham || darśe śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃkrātau ca sahasrakam |1|29|| caṃdrasūryagrahe lakṣaṃ vyatīpātetvanaṃtakam || ayutaṃ viṣuve caiva niyutaṃ tvayanadvaye || 4.1.27.130 || somagrahaḥ somadine ravivāraravagrahaḥ || taccūḍāmaṇiparvākhyaṃ tatrasnānamasaṃkhyakam || 131 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homo yadyaccūḍāmaṇau kṛtam || tadakṣayaṃ sarvamiha viṣṇo bhāgīrathītaṭe || 132 || śraddhayā bhaktiyuktastu gaṃgāṃ snātvā vidhānataḥ || brahmahāpi viśuddhyeta kiṃpunastvanya pātakī || 133 || kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyā ye mṛtā jāhnavītaṭe || kūlātpataṃti ye vṛkṣāstepi yāṃti parāṃ gatim || 134 || jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe daśamyāṃ hastasaṃyute || gaṃgātīre tu puruṣo nārī vā bhaktibhāvataḥ ||135 || niśāyāṃ jāgaraṃ kuyādgaṃgāṃ daśavidhairhare || puṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhairnaivedyaiḥ phalairdaśadaśonmitaiḥ ||136|| pradīpairdaśabhirdhūpairdaśāṃgairgaruḍadhvaja || pūjayecchraddhayā dhīmāndaśakṛtvo vidhānataḥ || 137 || sājyāṃstilānkṣipettoye gaṃgāyāḥ prasṛtīrdaśa || guḍasaktumayānpiṃḍāndadyācca daśamaṃtrataḥ || 138 || namaḥ śivāyai prathamaṃ nārāyaṇyai padaṃ tataḥ || daśaharāyai padamiti gaṃgāyai maṃtra eṣa vai || 139 || svāhāṃtaḥ praṇāvādiśca bhavedviṃśākṣaro manuḥ || pūjādānaṃ japo homo 'nenaiva manunā smṛtaḥ || 4.1.27.140 || hemnā rūpyeṇa vā śaktyā gaṃgāmūrtiṃ vidhāya ca || vastrācchāditavaktrasya pūrṇakuṃbhasya copari || 141 || pratiṣṭhāpyārcayeddevīṃ paṃcāmṛtaviśodhitām || caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca nadīnadaniṣevitām || 142 || lāvaṇyāmṛtaniṣpaṃda saṃśīladgātrayaṣṭikām || pūrṇakuṃbhasitāṃbhoja varadābhayasatkarām || 143 || tato dhyāyetsusaumyā ca caṃdrāyutasamaprabhām || cāmarairvījyamānāṃ ca śvetacchatropaśobhitāma || 144 || sudhāplāvitabhūpṛṣṭhāṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanām || trailaukyapūjitapadāṃ devarṣibhirabhiṣṭutām || 145 || dhyātvā samarcya maṃtreṇa dhūpadīpopahārataḥ || māṃ ca tvāṃ ca vidhiṃ bradhnaṃ himavaṃtaṃ bhagīratham || 146 || pratimāgre samabhyarcya caṃdanākṣatanirmitān || daśaprasthatilāndadyāddaśaviprebhya ādarāt || 147 || palaṃ ca kuḍavaḥ prastha āḍhako droṇa eva ca || dhānyamānena boddhavyāḥ kramaśomī caturguṇāḥ || 148 || matsya kacchapa maṃḍūka makarādi jalecarān || haṃsakāraṃḍava baka cakraṭiṭṭibhasārasān || 149 || yathāśakti svarṇarūpya tāmrapṛṣṭhavinirmitān || abhyarcya gaṃdhakusumairgaṃgāyāṃ prakṣipedvratī || 4.1.27.150 || evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjitaḥ || upavāsī vakṣyamāṇairdaśapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 151 || adattānāmupādānaṃ hiṃsācaivāvidhānataḥ || paradāropasevā ca kāyikaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam || 152 || pāruṣyamanṛtaṃ caiva paiśunyaṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ || asaṃbaddha pralāpaśca vāṅmayaṃsyāccaturvidham || 153 || paradravyeṣvabhidhyānaṃ manasāniṣṭaciṃtanam || vitathābhiniveśaśca mānasaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam || || 154 || etairdaśavidhaiḥ pāpairdaśajanmasamudbhavaiḥ || mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ gadādhara || 155 || uttarennarakātpūrvāndaśaghorāddaśāvarān || vakṣyamāṇamidaṃ stotraṃ gaṃgāgre śraddhayā japet || 156 || oṃ namaḥ śivāyai gaṃgāyai śivadāyai namonamaḥ || namaste viṣṇurūpiṇyai brahmamūrttyai namostu te || 157 || namaste rudrarūpiṇyai śāṃkaryai te namonamaḥ || sarvadevasvarūpiṇyai namo bheṣajamūrttaye || 158 || sarvasyasarvavyādhīnāṃ bhiṣakśreṣṭhyai namostu te || sthāsnujaṃgamasaṃbhūta viṣahaṃtryai namostu te || 159 || saṃsāraviṣanāśinyai jīvanāyai namostu te || tāpatritaya saṃhaṃtryai prāṇeśyai te namonamaḥ || 4.1.27.160 || śāṃti saṃtānakāriṇyai namaste śuddhamūrtaye || sarvasaṃśuddhikāriṇyai namaḥ pāpārimūrtaye ||161|| bhuktimuktipradāyinyai bhadradāyai namonamaḥ || bhogopabhogadāyinyai bhogavatyai namostu te || 162 || maṃdākinyai namastestu svargadāyai namonamaḥ || namastrailokyabhūṣāyai tripathāyai namonamaḥ || 163 || namastriśuklasaṃsthāyai kṣamāvatyai namonamaḥ || trihutāśanasaṃsthāyai tejovatyai namonamaḥ || 164 || naṃdāyai liṃgadhāriṇyai sudhādhārātmane namaḥ || namaste viśvamukhyāyai revatyai te namonamaḥ || 165 || bṛhatyai te namastestu lokadhātryai namostu te || namaste viśvamitrāyai naṃdinyai te namonamaḥ || 166 || pṛthvyai śivāmṛtāyai ca suvṛṣāyai namonamaḥ || parāparaśatāḍhyāyai tārāyai te namonamaḥ || 167 || pāśajālanikṛṃtinyai abhinnāyai namostu te || śāṃtāyai ca variṣṭhāyai varadāyai namonamaḥ ||168|| ugrāyai sukhajagdhyai ca saṃjīvinyai namostu te || brahmiṣṭhāyai brahmadāyai duritaghnyai namonamaḥ || 169 || praṇatārti prabhaṃjinyai jaganmātre namostute || sarvāpatpratipakṣāyai maṃgalāyai namonamaḥ || 4.1.27.170 || śaraṇāgatadīnārta paritrāṇaparāyaṇe || sarvasyārti hare devi nārāyaṇi namostu te || 171 || nirlepāyai durgahaṃtryai dakṣāyai te namonamaḥ || parāparaparāyai ca gaṃge nirvāṇadāyini || 172 || gaṃge mamāgrato bhūyā gaṃge me tiṣṭha pṛṣṭhataḥ || gaṃge me pārśvayoredhi gaṃge tvayyastu me sthitiḥ || 173 | | ādau tvamaṃte madhye ca sarvaṃ tvaṃ gāṃ gate śive || tvameva mūlaprakṛtistvaṃ pumānpara eva hi || gaṃge tvaṃ paramātmā ca śivasvatubhyaṃ namaḥ śive || 174 || ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ śṛṇuyācchraddhayāpi yaḥ || daśadhā mucyate pāpaiḥ kāyavākcittasaṃbhavaiḥ || || 175 || rogastho rogato mucyedvipadbhyaśca vipadyutaḥ || mucyate baṃdhanādbaddho bhīto bhītaḥ pramucyate || 176 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti pretya ca tridivaṃ vrajet || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya divyastrīparivījitaḥ || 177 || gṛhepi likhitaṃ yasya sadā tiṣṭhati dhāritama || nāgnicorabhayaṃ tasya na sarpādi bhayaṃ kvacita || 178 || jyeṣṭhe māse site pakṣe daśamī hastasaṃyutā || saṃharettrividhaṃ pāpaṃ budhavāreṇa saṃyutā || 179 || tasyāṃ daśamyāmetacca stotraṃ gaṃgājale sthitaḥ || yaḥ paṭheddaśakṛtvastu daridro vāpi cākṣamaḥ || 4.1.27.180 | | sopi tatphalamāpnoti gaṃgāṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || pūrvoktena vidhānena yatphalaṃ saṃprakīrtitama || 181 || yathā gaurī tathā gaṃgā tasmādgauryāstu pūjane || yo vidhirvihitaḥ samyaksopi gaṃgāprapūjane || 182 || yathā'haṃ tvaṃ tathā viṣṇo yathā tvaṃ tu tathāhyumā || umā yathā tathā gaṃgā catūrūpaṃ na bhidyate || 183 || viṣṇurudrāṃ taraṃ caiva śrīgauryoraṃtaraṃ tathā || gaṃgāgauryaṃtaraṃ caiva yo brūte mūḍhadhīstu saḥ || 184 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe gaṃgāmahimavarṇanapūrvaka daśaharā stotrakathanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
<4.1.28>
umovāca || || kiṃcitpraṣṭumanā nātha svasaṃdehāpanuttaye || vada khedo yadi na te trikālajñānakovida || 1 || tadā bhagīratho rājā kva kva bhāgīrathī tadā || yadā viṣṇustapastepe cakrapuṣkariṇī taṭe || 2 || || śiva uvāca || || saṃdeho'tra na kartavyo viśālākṣi sadāmale || śrutau smṛtau purāṇeṣu kālatrayamudīryate || || 3 || bhūtaṃ bhāvi bhavaccāpi saṃśayaṃ mā vṛthā kṛthāḥ || ityuktvā punarāheśo gaṃgāmāhātmyamuttamam ||4|| || agastya uvāca || pārvatīnaṃdana punardyunadyāḥ parito vada || mahimokto harau yadvaddevadevena vai tadā || 5 || skaṃda uvāca || muna'tra maitrāvaruṇe yathā devena bhāṣitam || śuṇu tripathagāminyā māhātmyaṃ pātakāpaham ||6|| trisrotasaṃ samāsādya sakṛtpiṃḍāndadāti yaḥ || uddhṛtāḥ pitarastena bhavāṃbhodhestilodakaiḥ || 7 || yāvaṃtaśca tilā martyairgṛhītā pitṛkarmaṇi|| tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi pitaraḥ svargavāsinaḥ || 8 || devāḥ sapitaro yasmādgaṃgāyāṃ sarvadā sthitāḥ || āvāhanaṃ visargaṃ ca teṣāṃ tatra tato nahi || 9 || pitṛvaṃśe mṛtā ye ca mātṛvaṃśe tathaiva ca || guru śvaśura baṃdhūnāṃ ye cānye bāṃdhavā mṛtāḥ || 4.1.28.10 || ajātadaṃtā ye kecidye ca garbhe prapīḍitāḥ || agnividyuccorahatā vyāghradaṃṣṭribhireva ca ||11 || udbaṃdhana mṛtā ye ca patitā ātmaghātakāḥ || ātmavikrayiṇaścorā ye tathā'yājyayājakāḥ || 12 || rasavikrayiṇo ye ca ye cānye pāparogiṇaḥ || agnidā garadāścaiva goghnāścaiva svavaṃśajāḥ || 13 || asipatravane ye ca kuṃbhīpāke ca ye gatāḥ || rauravepyaṃdhatāmisre kālasūtre ca ye gatāḥ ||14|| jātyaṃtarasahasreṣu bhrāmyaṃte ye svakarmabhiḥ || ye tu pakṣimṛgādīnāṃ kīṭavṛkṣādi vīrudhām || 15 || yoniṃ gatāstvasaṃkhyātāḥ saṃkhyātānāmaśobhanāḥ || prāpitā yamalokaṃ tu sughorairyamakiṃkaraiḥ || 16 || ye'bāṃdhavā bāṃdhavā vā ye'nyajanmani bāṃdhavāḥ || yepi cājñātanāmāno ye cāputrāḥ svagotrajāḥ || 17 || viṣeṇa ca mṛtā vai ye ye vai śṛṃgibhirāhatāḥ || kṛtaghnāśca gurughnāśca ye ca mitradruhastathā || 18 || strī bālaghātakā ye ca ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ || asatyahiṃsāniratā sadā pāparatāśca ye || 19 || aśvavikrayiṇo ye ca paradravyaharāśca ye || anāthāḥ kṛpaṇā dīnā mānuṣyaṃ prāptumakṣamāḥ || 4.1.28.20 || tarpitā jāhnavītoyairnareṇa vidhinā sakṛt || prayāṃti svargatiṃ tepi svargiṇo muktimāpnuyuḥ ||21|| etānmaṃtrānsamuccārya yaḥ kuryātpitṛtarpaṇam || śrāddhaṃ piṃḍapradānaṃ ca sa vidhijña ihocyate || 22|| kāmapradāni tīrthāni trailokye yāni kānicit || tāni sarvāṇi sevaṃte kāśyāmuttaravāhinīm || 23 || svaḥsiṃdhuḥ sarvataḥ puṇyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī || kāśyāṃ viśeṣato viṣṇo yatra cottaravāhinī || 24 || gāyaṃti gāthāmetāṃ vai daivarṣipitarogaṇāḥ || api dṛggocarā naḥ syātkāśyāmuttaravāhinī ||25|| yatratyāmṛtasaṃtṛptāstāpatritayavarjitāḥ || syāma tvamṛtamevāddhā viśvanāthaprasādataḥ || 26 || gaṃgaiva kevalā muktyai nirṇītā parito hare || avimukte viśeṣeṇa mamādhiṣṭhānagoravāt || 27 || jñātvā kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ gaṃgābhaktiḥsugopitā || na viṃdatiṃ janā gaṃgāṃ muktimāgairkadāyikām || 28 || anekajanmaniyutaṃ bhrāmyamāṇastu yo niṣu || nirvṛtiṃ prāpnuyātkotra jāhnavībhajanaṃ vinā || 29 || narāṇāmalpabuddhīnāmeno vikṣiptacetasām || gaṃgeva paramaṃ viṣṇo bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām || 4.1.28.30 || khaṃḍasphuṭitasaṃskāraṃ gaṃgātīre karoti yaḥ || mama loke ciraṃ kālaṃ tasyākṣaya sukhaṃ hare|| 31|| gaṃtumuddiśya yo gaṃgāṃ parārthasvārthameva vā || na gacchati paraṃ mohātsapate tpitṛbhiḥsaha || 32 || sarvāṇi yeṣāṃ gāṃgeyaistoyaiḥ kṛtyāni dehinām || bhūmisthā api te martyā amartyā eva vai hare || 33 || caramepi vayobhāge svaḥsiṃdhuṃ yo nipevate || kṛtvāpyenāṃsi bahuśaḥ sopi yāyācchubhāṃ gatim ||34|| yāvadasthimanuṣyāṇāṃ gaṃgātoyeṣu tiṣṭhati || tāvadabdasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate||35|| viṣṇuruvāca || || devadevajagannātha jagatāṃhitakṛtprabho || kīkasaṃ cetpateddaivāddurvṛttasya durātmanaḥ ||36|| jale dyunadyā niṣpāpe kathaṃ tasya parāgatiḥ || apamṛtyu vipannasya tadīśavinivedyatām || 37 || || maheśvara uvāca || || atrārthe kathayiṣyāmi purāvṛttamadhokṣaja || śṛṇuṣvaikamanā viṣṇo vāhīkasya dvijanmanaḥ || 38 || purā kaliṃgaviṣaye dvijo lavaṇavikrayī || saṃdhyāsnānavihīnaśca vedākṣaravivarjitaḥ || 39 || vāhīkonāmatoyajñasūtramātraparigrahaḥ || parigrahaśca tasyāsītkauviṃdī vidhavā navā || 4.1.28.40 || durbhikṣapīḍitenātha vṛṣalīpatinā vinā ||
