prāṇādhāraṃ tadā tena deśāddeśāṃtaraṃ yayau || 41 || madhye'tha daṃḍakāraṇyaṃ kṣutkṣāmaḥ saṃgavarjitaḥ || vyāghreṇa ghātitastatra naramāṃsapriyeṇa saḥ || 42 || tasya vāmapadaṃ gṛdhro gṛhītvodapatattataḥ || māṃsāśinā'nya gṛdhreṇa tasya yuddhamabhūddivi || 43 || gṛdhrayorāmiṣaṃ gṛdhnvoḥ parasparajayaiṣiṇoḥ || avāpatatpādagulphaṃ kaṃkacaṃcupuṭāttadā || 44 || tasya vāhīka viprasya vyāghravyāpāditasya ha || madhye gaṃgaṃ daivayogādapataddvaṃdvakāriṇoḥ || 45 || yadaiva hatavāndvīpī taṃ vāhīkamaraṇyagam || tasminneva kṣaṇe baddhaḥ sa pāśaiḥ krūrakiṃkaraiḥ || 46 || kaśābhirghātitotyaṃtamārābhiḥ paritoditaḥ || vamanrudhiramāsyena nītastaiḥ sa yamāgrataḥ || 47|| āpṛcchi dharmarājena citraguptothamāpate || dharmādharmaṃ vicāryāsya kathayāśu dvijanmanaḥ || 48 || vaivasvatena pṛṣṭotha citragupto vicitradhīḥ || sarvadā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ veditā sarvakarmaṇām || 49 || jagāda yamunābaṃdhuṃ vāhīkasya dvijanmanaḥ || janmakarmadinārabhya durvṛttasya śubhetaram || 4.1.28.50 || citragupta uvāca || || garbhādhānādikaṃ karma prākkṛtaṃ nāsya kenacit || jātakarmakṛtaṃ nāsya pitrā'jñānavatā hare || 51 || garbhainaḥ śamane hetuḥ samastāyuḥ sukhapradam || ekādaśehni nāmāsya na kṛtaṃ vidhipūrvakam ||52|| khyātaḥ syādyena vidhinā sarvatra vidhipāvanam || nākārṣīnnirgamaṃ cāsya caturthe māsi maṃdadhīḥ ||53|| janakaḥ śubhatithyādau videśagamanāpaham || ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃmāsi na kṛtaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 54 || sarvadā miṣṭamaśnāti karmaṇā yena bhāskare || na cūḍākaraṇaṃ cāsya kṛtamabde yathākulam || 55 || karmaṇā yena keśāḥ syuḥ snigdhāḥ kusumavarṣiṇaḥ || nākāri karṇavedhosya janitrā samaye śubhe || 56 || suvarṇagrāhiṇau yena karṇau syātāṃ ca suśrutī || mauṃjībaṃdhopyabhūdasya vyatītebde'ṣṭame hare || brahmacaryābhivṛddhyai yo brahmagrahaṇahetukaḥ || 57 || mauṃjīmokṣaṇavārtāpi kṛtā nāsya januḥkṛtā || gārhasthyaṃ prāpyate yasmātkarmaṇo'naṃtaraṃ varam || 58 || yathākathaṃcidūḍhā'tha patnī tyaktakulādhvagā || vṛṣalīpatinā tena paradārāpahāriṇā ||59|| ārabhya paṃcamādvarṣātparasvasyāpahārakaḥ || abhūdeṣa durācāro durodaraparāyaṇaḥ || 4.1.28.60 || rumāyāṃ vasatā'nena hatāgaurekavārṣikī || ekadā dṛḍhadaṃḍena lihaṃtī lavaṇaṃ mṛtā || 61 || jananīṃ pādapātena bahuśo'sāvatāḍayat || kadācidapi no vākyaṃ pituḥ kṛtamanena vai || 62 || viṣaṃ bhakṣitavāneṣa bahuśaḥ kalahapriyaḥ || janopatāpaśīlosau kṛtodaravidāraṇaḥ || 53 || dhattūrakaravīrādi bahudhopaviṣāṇi ca || krīḍākalahamātreṇa bhakṣayaccaiṣa durmatiḥ || 64 || dagdhosāvagninā saure śvabhiśca kavalīkṛtaḥ || śṛṃgibhiḥ paritaḥ proto viṣāṇāgrairasau bahu || 65 || daṃdaśūkairbhṛśaṃ daṣṭo duṣṭaḥ śiṣṭairvigarhitaḥ || kāṣṭheṣṭaloṣṭaiḥ pāpiṣṭhaḥ kṛtāniṣṭaḥ sadātmanaḥ || 66 || āsphālitaṃ śironenāsakṛccāpi durātmanā || yadarcyate sadā sadbhiruttamāṃgamanekadhā || 67 || asau hi brāhmaṇo maṃdo gāyatrīmapivedana || kāmato matsyamāṃsāni jagdhānyetena durdhiyā || 68 || ātmārthaṃ pāyasamasau paryapākṣīdanekadhā || lākṣālavaṇamāṃsānāṃ sapayodadhisarpiṣām ||69|| viṣalohāyudhānāṃ ca dāsīgovājināmapi || vikretā'sau sadā mūḍhastathā vai keśacarmaṇām || 4.1.28.70 || śūdrānna paripuṣṭāṃgaḥ parvaṇyahani maithunī || parāṅmukho daivapitryakarmaṇyeṣa durātmavān || 71 || pakṣiṇo ghātitānena mṛgāścāpi paraḥ śatam || akāraṇa drumacchedī sadā nirdayamānasaḥ || 72 || udvegajanako nityaṃ nijabaṃdhujaneṣvapi || asatyavādī satataṃ sadā hiṃsāparāyaṇaḥ || 72 || adattadānaḥ piśunaḥ śiśnodaraparāyaṇaḥ || kiṃ bahūktena ravija sākṣātpātaka mūrtimān || 74 || rauravepyaṃdhatāmisre kuṃbhīpāke'tiraurave || kālasūtre kṛmibhuji pūyaśoṇitakardame || 75 || asipatravane ghore yaṃtrapīḍe sudaṃṣṭrake || adhomukhe pūtigaṃdhe viṣṭhāgatteṃṣvabhojane ||76|| sūcībhedye'tha saṃdaṃśe lālāpe kṣuradhārake || pratyekaṃ narake tveṣa pātyatāṃ kalpasaṃkhyayā || 77 || dharmarājaḥ samākarṇya citraguptamukhāditi || nirbhartsya taṃ durācāraṃ kiṃkarānādideśa ha || 78 || bhrū saṃjñayā hṛtairnītaḥ sa baddhvā nirayālayam || ākraṃdarāvo yatroccaiḥ pāpināṃ romaharṣaṇaḥ || 79 || || īśvara uvāca || || yātanāsvatitīvrāsu vāhīke saṃsthite tadā || tatkālapuṇyaphalade gāṅgeyāṃbhasi nirmale || 4.1.28.80 || patitaṃ taddhi gṛdhrāsyādvāhīkasya dvijanmanaḥ || hare vimānaṃ tatkālamāpannaṃ surasadmataḥ || 81 || ghaṃṭāvalaṃbitaṃ divyaṃ divyastrīśatasaṃkulam || āruhya devayānaṃ sa divyaveṣadharo dvijaḥ || 82 || vījyamāno'psarovṛṃdairdivyagaṃdhānulepanaḥ || jagāma svargabhuvanaṃ gaṃgāsthipatanāddhare || 83 || skaṃda uvāca || || vastuśaktivicāroyamadbhutaḥ kopi kuṃbhaja || dravarūpeṇa kāpyeṣā śaktiḥ sādāśivī parā || 84 || karuṇāmṛtapūrṇena devadevena śaṃbhunā || eṣā pravartitā gaṃgā jagaduddharaṇāya vai || 85 || yathānyāḥ sarito loke vāripūrṇāḥ sahasraśaḥ || tathaiṣānānumaṃtavyā sadbhistripathagāminī||86|| śrutyakṣarāṇi niścitya kāruṇyācchaṃbhunā mune || nirmitā taddravaireṣā gaṃgā gaṃgādhareṇa vai || 87 || yogopaniṣadāmetaṃ sāramākṛṣya śaṃkaraḥ || kṛpayā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ cakāra saritāṃ varām || 88 || akalānidhayo rātryo vipuṣpāścaiva pādapāḥ || yathā tathaiva te deśā yatra nāstyamarāpagā || 89 || anayāḥ saṃpado yadvanmakhā yadvadadakṣiṇāḥ || tadvaddeśā diśaḥ sarvā hīnā gaṃgāṃbhasā hare || 4.1.28.90 || vyomāṃgaṇamanarkaṃ ca nakte'dīpaṃ yathā gṛhama || avedā brāhmaṇā yadvadgaṃgāhīnāstathā diśaḥ || 91 || cāṃdrāyaṇasahasraṃ tu yaḥ kuryāddehaśodhanam || gaṃgāmṛtaṃ pibedyastu tayorgaṃgābupo'dhikaḥ || 92 || pādenaikena yastiṣṭhetsahasraṃ śaradāṃ śatam || abdaṃ gaṃgāṃbupo yastu tayorgaṃgāṃbupo'dhikaḥ || 93 || avākchirāḥ pralaṃbedyaḥ śatasaṃvatsarānnaraḥ || bhīṣmasūbālukātalpaśayastasmādvaro hare || 94 || pāpatāpābhitaptānāṃ bhūtānāmiha jāhvavī || pāpatāpaharā yadvadgaṃgā nānyattathā kalau || 95 || tārkṣyavīkṣaṇamātreṇa phaṇinau nirviṣā yathā || niṣprabhāṇi tathenāṃsi bhāgīrathyavalokanāt || 96 || gaṃgātaṭodbhavāṃ mṛtsnāṃ yo maulau bibhṛyānnaraḥ || bibharti so'rkabiṃbaṃ vai tamonāśāya niścitam || 97 || vyasanairabhibhūtasya dhanahīnasya pāpinaḥ || gaṃgaiva kevalaṃ tasya gatiruktā na cānyathā || 98 || śrutābhilaṣitā dṛṣṭā spṛṣṭā pītā'vagāhitā || puṃsāṃ vaṃśadvayaṃ gaṃgā tārayennātra saṃśayaḥ || 99 || kīrtanāddarśanātsparśādgaṃgāpānāvagāhanāt || daśottaraguṇā jñeyā puṇyāpuṇyarddhināśayoḥ || 4.1.28.100 || na sutairna ca vā vittairnānyenāpi sukarmaṇā || tatphalaṃprāpyate martye gaṃgāmāpya yadāpyate || 101 || jātyaṃdhāḥ paṃgavaste vai jīvaṃtopyatha te mṛtāḥ || samarthā api ye gaṃgāṃ na snāyurmokṣagarbhiṇīm || 102 || śrutiṃ niśāmaya hare gaṃgāmāhātmyabhāṣiṇīm || viniścitārthāṃ yāṃ śrutvā śrayedgaṃgāṃ narottamaḥ || 103 || irāvatīṃ madhumatīṃ payasvinīmamṛtarūpāmūrjasvatīm || tridivaprasūtāṃ gaṃgāṃ śritāsastridivaṃ vrajaṃti || 104 || ṛṣijuṣṭāṃ viṣṇupadīṃ purāṇāṃ supuṇyadhārāṃ manasā hi loke || sarvātmanā jāhnavīṃ ye prapannāste brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ saṃprayāṃti ||105|| lokānimānnayati yā jananīva putrānsvargaṃ sadā sarvaguṇopapannā || sthānamiṣṭaṃ brāhmamabhīpsamānairgaṃgā sadaivātmavaśairupāsyā ||106|| usraijuṣṭāmiṣatīṃ viśvarūpāmirāvatīṃ janayitrīṃ guhasya || śiṣṭaiḥ sevyāmamṛtāṃ brahmakāṃtāṃ gaṃgāṃ śrayedātmaviśuddhikāmaḥ || 107 || gaṃgāyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā brahmacārī samāhitaḥ || vidhūtapāpo bhavati vājapeyaṃ ca viṃdati || 108 || aśubhaiḥ karmabhirgrastānmajjamānānmahārṇave || patato niraye gaṃgā saṃśritānuddharetsadā || 109 || brahmalokastu lokānāṃ sarveṣāmuttamo yathā || saritāṃ sarasāṃ vāpi variṣṭhā jāhnavī tathā || 4.1.28.110 || anyatra samyaksaṃkalpya tapaḥ kṛtvā samātra yam || yatphalaṃ tadbhavedbhaktyā gaṃgāyāṃ ghaṭikā'rdhataḥ || 111 || svargasthasya na sā prītirbhuṃjataḥ sukhamakṣayam || yā syādgaṃgātaṭe puṃsāṃ rātrau caṃdrodaye sati || 112 || jarārogābhipannaṃ tu kuṇapaṃ jāhnavī jale|| dhairyeṇa tṛṇavattyaktvā praviśedamarāvatīm|| 113|| vāyoṃghaiḥ satataṃ yasyāḥ plāvyate śaśimaṃḍalam|| bhūyodhikatarāṃ śobhāṃ bibharti tadahaḥ kṣaye|| 114 || āhutasya jale yasyāḥ sadyo naśyaṃti pātakam || mahataḥ śreyasaḥ prāptistatkṣaṇādeva jāyate ||115|| pitṛbhyaḥ śraddhayā yatra dattāstvāpaḥ svavaṃśajaiḥ|| prayacchaṃti parāṃ tṛptiṃ śaradāṃ trayamacyuta|| 116|| tārayetkṣitiyānmartyānadhaḥsthāṃśca sarīsṛpān|| svarge svargasado viṣṇorgaṃ(?)gā tripathagā tataḥ|| 117|| tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ saritāmuttamā sarit || svargadā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ mahāpātakināmapi || 118 || adhyuṣṭāḥ koṭayo viṣṇo saṃti tīrthāni sarvataḥ || divibhuvyaṃtarikṣe ca jāhnavyāṃ tāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || 119 || jñātvājñātvā ca gaṃgāyāṃ yaḥ paṃcatvamavāpnuyāt || anātmaghātī svargī syānnarakānsa na paśyati || 4.1.28.120 || gaṃgaiva sarvatīrthāni gaṃgaiva ca tapovanam || gaṃgaiva siddhikṣetraṃ hi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 121 || yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā mahī yatra hiraṇmayī || jāhnavī snāyinastatra nivasaṃti ghaṭodbhava || 122 || dhenuṃ bhāgīrathī tīre suśīlāṃ ca payasvinīm || vāsoratnairalaṃkṛtvā brāhmaṇāya dadāti yaḥ || 123 || yāvaṃti tasyā lomāni mune tatsaṃtaterapi || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sa svargasukhabhugbhavet || 124 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe gaṃgāmahimānāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāya ||28||
<4.1.29>
||| agastya uvāca || || vinā snānena gaṃgāyā nṛṇāṃ janmaniratharkam || upāyāṃtaramastyanyadyena snānaphalaṃ labhet ||1|| aśaktānāṃ ca paṃgūnāmālasyopahatātmanām || dūradeśāṃtarasthānāṃ gaṃgāsnānaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 2 || dānaṃ vā'tha vrataṃvā'tha maṃtraḥstotrajapo'thavā || tīrthāṃtarābhiṣeko vā devatopāsanaṃ tu vā || 3 || yadyastikiṃcitṣaḍvaktra gaṃgāsnānaphalapradam || vidhānāṃtaramātreṇa tadvada praṇatāya me || 4 || tvatto na vedaskaṃdānyo gaṃgāgarbha samudbhava || paraṃ svargataraṃgiṇyā mahimānaṃ mahāmate || 5 || || skaṃda uvāca || || saṃti puṇyajalānīha sarāṃsi sarito mune || sthāne sthāne ca tīrthāni jitātmādhyuṣitāni ca ||6|| dṛṣṭapratyayakārīṇi mahāmahima bhāṃjyapi || paraṃ svargataraṃgiṇyāḥ koṭyaṃśopi na tatra vai ||7 || anenaivānumānena buddhyasva kalaśodbhava || dadhre gaṃgottamāṃgena devadevena śaṃbhunā||8|| snānakāle'nya tīrtheṣu japyate jāhnavī janaiḥ || vinā viṣṇupadīṃ kvānyatsamarthamaghamocane||9|| gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ brahmangaṃgāyāmeva labhyate|| yathā drākṣāphalasvādo drākṣāyāmeva nānyataḥ ||4.1.29.10|| astyupāya iha tvekaḥ syādyenāvikalaṃ phalam|| snānasya devasarito mahāguhyatamo mune|| 11|| śivabhaktāya śāṃtāya viṣṇubhaktiparāya ca || śraddhālave tvāstikāya garbhavāsamupukṣave || 12 || kathanīyaṃ na cānyasya kasyacitkenacitkvacit || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 13 || mahāśreyaskaraṃ puṇyaṃ manorathakaraṃ param || dyunadīprītijanakaṃ śivasaṃtoṣasaṃtati || 14 || nāmnāṃ sahasragaṃgāyāḥ stavarājeṣuśo bhanam || japyānāṃ paramaṃ japyaṃ vedopaniṣadāsamam || 15 || japanīyaṃ prayannena mauninā vācakaṃ vinā || śucisthāneṣu śucinā suspaṣṭākṣarameva ca || 16 || skaṃda uvāca || || oṃnamo gaṃgādevyai || oṃkārarūpiṇyajarā'tulā'namatā'mṛtasravā || atyudārā'bhayā'śokā'lakanaṃdā'mṛtā'malā || 17 || anāthavatsalā'moghā'pāṃyoniramṛtapradā || avyaktalakṣaṇā'kṣobhyā 'navacchinnā'parājitā || 18 || anāthanāthā'bhīṣṭārthasiddhidā'naṃgavardhinī || aṇimādiguṇā'dhārāgragaṇyā'līkahāriṇī || 19 || aciṃtyaśaktiranaghā'dbhutarūpā'ghahāriṇī || adrirājasutā'ṣṭāṃgayogasiddhipradā'cyutā || 4.1.29.20 || akṣuṇṇaśaktirasudā'naṃtatīrthā'mṛtodakā || anaṃtamahimā'pārā'naṃtasaukhyapradā'nnadā || 21 || aśeṣadevatāmūrtiraghorā'mṛtarūpiṇī || avidyājālaśamanī hyapratarkyagatipradā || 22 || aśeṣavighnasaṃhartrī tvaśeṣaguṇaguṃphitā || ajñānatimirajyotiranugrahaparāyaṇā || 23 || abhirāmā'navadyāṃgyanaṃtasārā'kalaṃkinī || ārogyadā''naṃdavallī tvāpannārtivināśinī || 24 || āścaryamūrtirāyuṣyā hyāḍhyā''dyā''prā''ryasevitā || āpyāyinyāptavidyā''khyātvānaṃdā''śvāsadāyinī || 25 || ālasyaghnyāpadāṃ haṃtrī hyānaṃdāmṛtavarṣiṇī || irāvatīṣṭadātrīṣṭā tviṣṭāpūrtaphalapradā || 26 || itihāsaśrutīḍyārthā tvihāmutraśubhapradā|| || ijyāśīlasamijyeṣṭhā tviṃdrādiparivaṃditā || 27|| ilālaṃkāramāleddhā tviṃdirāramyamaṃdirā || idiṃdirādisaṃsevyā tvīśvarīśvaravallabhā || 28 || ītibhītihareḍyā ca tvīḍanīya caritrabhṛt || utkṛṣṭaśaktirutkṛṣṭoḍupamaṃḍalacāriṇī ||29|| uditāṃbaramārgosroragalokavihāriṇī || ukṣorvarotpalotkuṃbhā upeṃdracaraṇadravā ||4.1.29.30|| udanvatpūrtihetuścodārotsāhapravardhinī || udvegaghnyuṣṇaśamanī uṣṇaraśmisutā priyā ||31|| utpatti sthiti saṃhārakāriṇyuparicāriṇī || ūrjaṃ vahaṃtyūrjadharorjāvatī cormimālinī || 32 || ūrdhvaretaḥpriyordhvādhvā hyūrmilordhvagatipradā || ṛṣivṛṃdastutarddhiśca ṛṇatrayavināśinī || 33 || ṛtaṃbhararddhidātrī ca ṛksvarūpā ṛjupriyā || ṛkṣamārgavaharkṣārcirṛjumārgapradarśinī || 34 || edhitā'khiladharmārthātvekaikāmṛtadāyinī || edhanīyasvabhāvaijyā tvejitā śeṣapātakā || 35 || aiśvaryadaiśvaryarūpā hyaitihyaṃ hyaiṃdavī dyutiḥ || ojasvinyoṣadhīkṣetramojodaudanadāyinī || 36 || oṣṭhāmṛtaunnatyadātrī tvauṣadhaṃ bhavarogiṇām || audāryacaṃcuraupeṃdrī tvaugrīhyaumeyarūpiṇī || 37 || aṃbarādhvavahāṃ'vaṣṭhāṃ varamālāṃbujekṣaṇā || aṃbikāṃbumahāyoniraṃdhodāṃdhakahāriṇī || 38 || aṃśumālāhyaṃśumatī tvaṃgīkṛtaṣaḍānanā || aṃdhatāmisrahaṃtryaṃdhuraṃ janāhyaṃjanāvatī || 39 || kalyāṇakāriṇī kāmyā kamalotpalagaṃdhinī || kumudvatī kamalinī kāṃtiḥ kalpitadāyinī || 4.1.29.40 || kāṃcanākṣī kāmadhenuḥ kīrtikṛtkleśanāśinī || kratuśreṣṭhā kratuphalā karmabaṃdhavibhedinī || 41 || kamalākṣī klamaharā kṛśānutapanadyutiḥ || karuṇārdrā ca kalyāṇī kalikalmaṣanāśinī || 42 | kāmarūpākriyāśaktiḥ kamalotpalamālinī || kūṭasthā karuṇākāṃtā karmayānā kalāvatī || 43 || kamalākalpalatikā kālīkaluṣavairiṇī || kamanīyajalākamrā kapardisukapardagā || 44 || kālakṛṭapraśamanī kadaṃbakusumapriyā || kāliṃdī kelilalitā kalakallolamālikā || 45 || krāṃtalokatrayākaṃḍūḥ kaṃḍūtanayavatsalā || khaḍginī khaḍgadhārābhā khagā khaṃḍeṃdudhāriṇī || 46 || khekhelagāminī khasthā khaṃḍeṃdutilakapriyā|| khecarīkhecarīvaṃdyā khyātiḥ khyātipradāyinī ||47|| khaṃḍitapraṇatāghaughā khalabuddhivināśinī || khātainaḥ kaṃdasaṃdohā khaḍgakhaṭvāṃga(?) kheṭinī|| || 48 || kharasaṃtāpaśamanī khaniḥ pīyūṣapāthasām || gaṃgā gaṃdhavatī gaurī gaṃdharvanagarapriyā || 49 || gaṃbhīrāṃgī guṇamayī gatātaṃkā gatipriyā || gaṇanāthāṃbikā gītā gadyapadyapariṣṭutā || 4.1.29.50 || gāṃdhārī garbhaśamanī gatibhraṣṭagatipradā || gomatī guhyavidyāgaurgoptrī gaganagāminī || 51 || gotrapravardhinī guṇyā guṇātītā guṇāgraṇīḥ || guhāṃbikā girisutā goviṃdāṃghrisamudbhavā || 52 || guṇanīyacaritrā ca gāyatrī giriśapriyā || gūḍharūpā guṇavatī gurvī gauravavardhinī || 53 || grahapīḍāharā guṃdrā garaghnī gānavatsalā || gharmahaṃtrī ghṛtavatī ghṛtatuṣṭipradāyinī || 54 || ghaṃṭāravapriyā ghorā'ghaughavidhvaṃsakāriṇī || ghrāṇatuṣṭikarī ghoṣā ghanānaṃdā ghanapriyā ||55|| ghātukā ghṛrṇitajalā ghṛṣṭapātakasaṃtatiḥ || ghaṭakoṭiprapītāpā ghaṭitāśeṣamaṃgalā || 56 || ghṛṇāvatī ghṛṇanidhirghasmarā ghūkanādinī || ghusṛṇā piṃjaratanurghargharā ghargharasvanā ||57|| caṃdrikā caṃdrakāṃtāṃbuścaṃcadāpā caladyutiḥ|| cinmayī citirūpā ca caṃdrāyutaśanānanā || 58 || cāṃpeyalocanā cāruścārvaṃgī cārugāminī || cāryā cāritranilayā citrakṛccitrarūpiṇī || 59 || caṃpaścaṃdanaśucyaṃbuścarcanīyā cirasthirā || cārucaṃpakamālāḍhyā camitāśeṣa duṣkutā || 4.1.29.60 || cidākāśavahāciṃtyā caṃcaccāmaravījitā || coritāśeṣavṛjinā caritāśeṣamaṃḍalā || 61 || cheditākhilapāpaughā chadmaghnī chalahāriṇī || channatriviṣṭapa talā choṭitāśeṣabaṃdhanā || 62 || churitāmṛtadhāraughā chinnaināśchaṃdagāminī || chatrīkṛtamarālaughā chaṭīkṛtanijāmṛtā ||63|| jāhnavī jyā jaganmātā japyā jaṃghālavīcikā || jayā janārdanaprītā juṣaṇīyā jagaddhitā ||64|| jīvanaṃ jīvanaprāṇā jagajjyeṣṭhā jaganmayī || jīvajīvātulatikā janmijanmanibarhiṇī || || 65 || jāḍyavidhvaṃsanakarī jagadyonirjalāvilā || jagadānaṃdajananī jalajā jalajekṣaṇā || 66 || janalocanapīyūṣā jaṭātaṭavihāriṇī || jayaṃtī jaṃjapūkaghnī janitajñānavigrahā || 67 || jhallarī vādyakuśalā jhalajjhālajalāvṛtā || jhiṃṭīśavaṃdyā jhāṃkārakāriṇī jharjharāvatī || 68 || ṭīkitāśeṣapātālā ṭaṃkikainodripāṭane || ṭaṃkāranṛtyatkallolā ṭīkanīyamahātaṭā ||69|| ḍaṃbarapravahāḍīna rājahaṃsakulākulā|| ḍamaḍḍamaruhastā ca ḍāmarokta mahāṃḍakā ||4.1.29.70|| ḍhaukitāśeṣanirvāṇā ḍhakkānādacalajjalā || ḍhuṃḍhivighneśajananī ḍhaṇaḍḍhuṇitapātakā ||71|| tarpaṇītīrthatīrthā ca tripathā tridaśeśvarī || trilokagoptrī toyeśī trailokyaparivaṃditā|| 72|| tāpatritayasaṃhartrī tejobalavivardhinī || trilakṣyā tāraṇī tārā tārāpatikarārcitā || 73 || trailokyapāvanī puṇyā tuṣṭidā tuṣṭirūpiṇī || tṛṣṇāchettrī tīrthamātā ttrivikramapadodbhavā|| 74 || tapomayī taporūpā tapaḥstoma phalapradā || trailokyavyāpinī tṛptistṛptikṛttattvarūpiṇī || 75 || trailokyasuṃdarī turyā turyātītapadapradā || trailokyalakṣmīstripadī tathyātimiracaṃdrikā || 76 || tejogarbhā tapaḥsārā tripurāri śirogṛhā || trayīsvarūpiṇī tanvī tapanāṃgajabhītinut ||77|| taristaraṇijāmitraṃ tarpitāśeṣapūrvajā || tulāvirahitā tīvrapāpatūlatanūnapāt || || 78 || dāridryadamanī dakṣā duṣprekṣā divyamaṃḍanā || dīkṣāvatīdurāvāpyā drākṣāmadhuravāribhṛt || 79 || darśitānekakutukā duṣṭadurjayaduḥkhahṛt || dainyahṛdduritaghnī ca dānavāri padābjajā || 4.1.29.80 || daṃdaśūkaviṣaghrī ca dāritāghaughasaṃtatiḥ || drutādeva drumacchannā durvārāghavighātinī || 81 || damagrāhyā devamātā devalokapradarśinī || devadevapriyādevī dikpālapadadāyinī || 82 || dīrghāyuḥkāriṇī dīrghā dogdhrī dūṣaṇavarjitā || dugdhāṃbuvāhinī dohyā divyā divyagatipradā || 83 || dyunadī dīnaśaraṇaṃ dehidehanivāriṇī || drāghīyasī dāghahaṃtrī ditapātakasaṃtatiḥ || 84 || dūradeśāṃtaracarī durgamā devavallabhā|| durvṛttaghnī durvigāhyā dayādhārā dayāvatī || 85 || durāsadā dānaśīlā drāviṇī druhiṇastutā || daityadānavasaṃśuddhikartrī durbuddhihāriṇī ||86|| dānasārā dayāsārā dyāvābhūmivigāhinī|| dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaprāptirdevatāvṛṃdavaṃditā|||| 87 || dīrghavratā dīrghadṛṣṭirdīptatoyā durālabhā || daṃḍayitrī daṃḍanītirduṣṭadaṃḍadharārcitā || 88 || durodaraghnī dāvārcirdravadravyaikaśevadhiḥ || dīnasaṃtāpaśamanī dātrī davathuvairiṇī || 89 || darīvidāraṇaparā dāṃtā dāṃtajanapriyā || dāritādritaṭā durgā durgāraṇyapracāriṇī || 4.1.29.90 || dharmadravā dharmadhurā dhenurdhīrā dhṛtirdhruvā || dhenudānaphalasparśā dharmakāmārthamokṣadā || 91 || dharmormivāhinī dhuryā dhātrī dhātrīvibhūṣaṇam || dharmiṇī dharmaśīlā ca dhanvikoṭikṛtāvanā || 92 || dhyātṛpāpaharā dhyeyā dhāvanī dhūtakalmaṣā || dharmadhārā dharmasārā dhanadā dhanavardhinī || 93 || dharmādharmaguṇacchettrī dhattūrakusumapriyā || dharmeśī dharmaśāstrajñā dhanadhānyasamṛddhikṛt || 94 || dharmalabhyā dharmajalā dharmaprasavadharmiṇī || dhyānagamyasvarūpā ca dharaṇī dhātṛpūjitā || 95 || ? dhūrdhūrjaṭijaṭāsaṃsthā dhanyā dhīrdhāraṇāvatī|| naṃdā nirvāṇajananī naṃdinī nunnapātakā || || 96 || niṣiddhavighnanicayā nijānaṃdaprakāśinī || nabhoṃgaṇacarī nūtirnamyā nārāyaṇīnutā || 97 || nirmalā nirmalākhyānā nāśinītāpasaṃpadām || niyatā nityasukhadā nānāścaryamahānidhiḥ || 98 || nadīnadasaromātā nāyikā nākadīrghikā || naṣṭoddharaṇadhīrā ca naṃdanānaṃdadāyinī || 99 || nirṇiktāśeṣabhuvanā niḥsaṃgā nirupadravā || nirālaṃbā niṣprapaṃcā nirṇāśitamahāmalā || 4.1.29.100 || nirmalajñānajananī niḥśeṣaprāṇitāpahṛt || nityotsavā nityatṛptā namaskāryā niraṃjanā || 101 || niṣṭhāvatī nirātaṃkā nirlepā niścalātmikā || niravadyā nirīhā ca nīlalohitamūrdhagā || 102 || naṃdibhṛṃgigaṇastutyā nāgānaṃdā nagātmajā || niṣpratyūhā nākanadī nirayārṇavadīrghanauḥ || 103 || puṇyapradā puṇyagarbhā puṇyā puṇyataraṃgiṇī || pṛthuḥ pṛthuphalā pūrṇā praṇatārtiprabhaṃjinī || 104 || prāṇadā prāṇijananī prāṇeśī prāṇarūpiṇī || padmālayā parāśaktiḥ purajitparamapriyā || 105 || parāparaphalaprāptiḥ pāvanī ca payasvinī || parānaṃdā prakṛṣṭārthā pratiṣṭhāpālanī parā || 106 || purāṇapaṭhitā prītā praṇavākṣararūpiṇī || pārvatīpremasaṃpannā paśupāśavimocanī || 107 || paramātmasvarūpā ca parabrahmaprakāśinī || paramānaṃdaniṣpaṃdā prāyaścittasvarūpiṇī || 108 || pānīyarūpanirvāṇā paritrāṇaparāyaṇā || pāpeṃdhanadavajvālā pāpāriḥ pāpanāmanut || 109 || paramaiśvaryajananī prajñā prājñā parāparā || pratyakṣalakṣmīḥ padmākṣī paravyomāmṛtasravā || 4.1.29.110 || prasannarūpā praṇidhiḥ pūtā pratyakṣadevatā || pinākiparamaprītā pagmeṣṭhikamaṃḍaluḥ || 111 || padmanābhapadārghyeṇa prasūtā padmamālinī || pararddhidā puṣṭikarī pathyā pūrtiḥ prabhāvatī || 112 || punānā pītagarbhaghnī pāpaparvatanāśinī || phalinī phalahastā ca phullāṃbujavilocanā || 113 || phālitainomahākṣetrā phaṇilokavibhūṣaṇam || phenacchalapraṇunnaināḥ phullakairavagaṃdhinī || 114 || phenilācchāṃbudhārābhā phuḍuccāṭitapātakā || phāṇitasvādusalilā phāṃṭapathyajalāvilā || 115 || viśvamātā ca viśveśī viśvā viśveśvarapriyā || brahmaṇyā brahmakṛdbrāhmī brahmiṣṭhā vimalodakā || 116 || vibhāvarī ca virajā vikrāṃtānekaviṣṭapā || viśvamitraṃ viṣṇupadī vaiṣṇavī vaiṣṇavapriyā || 117 || virūpākṣapriyakarī vibhūtirviśvatomukhī || vipāśā vaibudhī vedyā vedākṣararasasravā || 118 || vidyāvegavatī vaṃdyā bṛṃhaṇī brahmavādinī || varadā viprakṛṣṭā ca variṣṭhā ca viśodhanī || 119 || vidyādharī viśokā ca vayovṛṃdaniṣevitā || bahūdakā balavatī vyomasthā vibudhapriyā || 4.1.29.120 || vāṇī vedavatī vittā brahmavidyātaraṃgiṇī || brahmāṃḍakoṭivyāptāṃburbrahmahatyāpahāriṇī || 121 || brahmeśaviṣṇurūpā ca buddhirvibhavavardhinī || vilāsisukhadā vaiśyā vyāpinī ca vṛṣāraṇiḥ || 122 || vṛṣāṃkamaulinilayā vipannārtiprabhaṃjinī || vinītā vinatā bradhnatanayā vinayānvitā || 123 || vipaṃcīvādyakuśalā veṇuśrutivicakṣaṇā || varcaskarī balakarī valonmūlitakalmaṣā || 124 || vipāpmā vigatātaṃkā vikalpaparivarjitā || vṛṣṭikartrī vṛṣṭijalā vidhirvicchinnabaṃdhanā || 125 || vratarūpā vittarūpā bahuvighnavināśakṛt || vasudhārā vasumatī vicitrāṃgī vibhāvasuḥ || 126 || vijayā viśvabījaṃ ca vāmadevī varapradā || vṛṣāśritā viṣaghnī ca vijñānormyaṃśumālinī ||127 || bhavyā bhogavatī bhadrā bhavānī bhūtabhāvinī || bhūtadhātrī bhayaharā bhaktadāridryaghātinī || 128 || bhuktimuktipradābheśī bhaktasvargāpavargadā || bhāgīrathī bhānumatī bhāgyabhogavatī bhṛtiḥ || 129 || bhavapriyā bhavadveṣṭī bhūtidā bhūtibhūṣaṇā || bhālalocanabhāvajñā bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ || 4.1.29.130 || bhrāṃtijñānapraśamanī bhinnabrahmāṃḍamaṃḍapā || bhūridā bhaktisulabhā bhāgyavaddṛṣṭigocarī || 131 || bhaṃjitopaplavakulā bhakṣyabhojyasukhapradā || bhikṣaṇīyā bhikṣumātā bhāvābhāvasvarūpiṇī || 132 || maṃdākinī mahānaṃdā mātā muktitaṃragiṇī || mahodayā madhumatī mahāpuṇyā mudākarī || 133 || munistutā mohahaṃtrī mahātīrthā madhusravā || mādhavī māninī mānyā manorathapathātigā || 134 || mokṣadā matidā mukhyā mahābhāgyajanāśritā || mahāvegavatīmedhyā mahāmahimabhūṣaṇā || 135 || mahāprabhāvā mahatī mīnacaṃcalalocanā || mahākāruṇyasaṃpūrṇā maharddhiśca mahotpalā || 136 || mūrtimanmuktiramaṇī maṇimāṇikyabhūṣaṇā || muktākalāpanepathyā manonayananaṃdinī || 137 || mahāpātakarāśighnī mahādevārdhahāriṇī || mahormimālinī muktā mahādevī manonmanī || 138|| mahāpuṇyodayaprāpyā māyātimiracaṃdrikā|| mahāvidyā mahāmāyā mahāmedhā mahauṣadham || 139 || mālādharī mahopāyā mahoragavibhūṣaṇā || mahāmohapraśamanī mahāmaṃgalamaṃgalam|| 4.1.29.140|| mārtaṃḍamaṃḍalacarī mahālakṣmīrmadojjhitā || yaśasvinī yaśodā ca yogyā yuktātmasevitā || 141 || yogasiddhipradā yājyā yajñeśaparipūritā || yajñeśī yajñaphaladā yajanīyā yaśaskarī ||142|| yamisevyā yogayoniryoginī yuktabuddhidā || yogajñānapradā yuktā yamādyaṣṭāṃgayogayuk ||143|| yaṃtritāghaughasaṃcārā yamalokanivāriṇī|| yātāyātapraśamanī yātanānāmakṛṃtanī ||144|| yāminīśahimācchodā yugadharmavivarjitā || revatīratikṛdramyā ratnagarbhā ramā ratiḥ ||145|| ratnākarapremapātraṃ rasajñā rasarūpiṇī|| ratnaprāsādagarbhā ca ramaṇīyataraṃgiṇī||146|| ratnārcī rudraramaṇī rāgadveṣavināśinī|| ramā rāmā ramyarūpā rogijīvāturūpiṇī||147|| rucikṛdrocanī ramyā rucirā rogahāriṇī || rājahaṃsā ratnavatī rājatkallolarājikā ||148|| rāmaṇīyakarekhā ca rujārī rogaroṣiṇī|| rākāraṃkārtiśamanī ramyā rolaṃbarāviṇī || 149 || rāgiṇīraṃjitaśivā rūpalāvaṇyaśevadhiḥ || lokaprasūrlokavaṃdyā lolatkallolamālinī || 4.1.29.150 || līlāvatī lokabhūmirlokalocanacaṃdrikā || lekhasravaṃtī laṭabhā laghuvegā laghutvahṛt || 151 || lāsyattaraṃgahastā ca lalitā layabhaṃgigā || lokabaṃdhurlokadhātrī lokottaraguṇorjitā || 152 || lokatrayahitā lokā lakṣmīrlakṣaṇalakṣitā || līlālakṣitanirvāṇā lāvaṇyāmṛtavarṣiṇī || 153 || vaiśvānarī vāsaveḍyā vaṃdhyatvaparihāriṇī || vāsudevāṃghrireṇughnī vajrivajranivāriṇī || 154 || śubhāvatī śubhaphalā śāṃtiḥ śāṃtanuvallabhā || śūlinī śaiśavavayāḥ śītalā'mṛtavāhinī || 155 || śobhāvatī śīlavatī śoṣitāśeṣakilbiṣā || śaraṇyā śivadā śiṣṭā śarajanmaprasūḥ śivā || 156 || śaktiḥ śaśāṃkavimalā śamanasvasṛsaṃmatā || śamā śamanamārgaghnī śitikaṃṭhamahāpriyā ||157|| śuciḥ śucikarī śeṣā śeṣaśāyipadodbhavā || śrīnivāsa śrutiḥ śraddhā śrīmatī śrīḥ śubhavratā || || 158 || śuddhavidyā śubhāvartā śrutānaṃdā śrutistutiḥ || śivetaraghnī śabarī śāṃbarīrūpadhāriṇī || 159 || śmaśānaśodhanī śāṃtā śaśvacchatadhṛtiṣṭutā || śālinī śāliśobhāḍhyā śikhivāhanagarbhabhṛt || 4.1.29.160 || śaṃsanīyacaritrā ca śātitāśeṣapātakā || ṣaḍguṇaiśvaryasaṃpannā ṣaḍaṃgaśrutirūpiṇī || 161 || ṣaṃḍhatāhāri salilāṣṭyāyannadanadīśatā || saridvarā ca surasā suprabhā suradīrghikā || 162 || svaḥsiṃdhuḥ sarvaduḥkhaghnī sarvavyādhimahauṣadham || sevyāsiddhiḥ satī sūktiḥ skaṃdasūśca sarasvatī ||163|| saṃpattaraṃgiṇī stutyā sthāṇumaulikṛtālayā || sthairyadā subhagā saukhyā strīṣu saubhāgyadāyinī || 164 || svarganiḥśreṇikā sūkṣmā svadhā svāhā sudhājalā || samudrarūpiṇī svargyā sarvapātakavairiṇī || 165 || smṛtāghahāriṇī sītā saṃsārābdhitaraṃḍikā || saubhāgyasuṃdarī saṃdhyā sarvasārasamanvitā || 166 || harapriyā hṛpīkeśī haṃsarūpā hiraṇmayī || hṛtāghasaṃghā hitakṛddhelā helāghagarvahṛt ||167|| kṣemadā kṣālitāghaughā kṣudravidrāviṇī kṣamā || iti nāmasahasraṃ hi gaṃgāyāḥ kalaśodbhava || kīrtayitvā naraḥ samyaggaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet ||168|| sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavighna vināśanam || sarvastotrajapācchreṣṭhaṃ sarvapāvanapāvanam ||169|| śraddhayābhīṣṭaphaladaṃ caturvargasamṛddhikṛt || sakṛjjapādavāpnoti hyekakratuphalaṃmune ||4.1.29.170|| sarvatīrtheṣu yaḥ snātaḥ sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ || tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ trikālapaṭhanācca tat ||171|| sarvavrateṣu yatpuṇyaṃ samyakcīrṇeṣu vāḍava || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti trisaṃdhyaṃ niyataḥ paṭhan || 172 || snānakāle paṭhedyastu yatrakutra jalāśaye || tatra sannihitā nūnaṃ gaṃgā tripathagā mune || 173 || śreyorthī labhate śreyo dhanārthī labhate dhanam || kāmī kāmānavāpnoti mokṣārthī mokṣamāpnuyāt ||174|| varṣaṃ trikālapaṭhanācchraddhayā śucimānasaḥ || ṛtukālābhigamanādaputraḥ putravānbhavet || 175 || nākālamaraṇaṃ tasya nāgnicorāhi sādhvasam || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ gaṃgāyā yo japecchraddhayā mune || 176 || gaṃgā nāma sahasraṃ tu japtvā grāmāṃtaraṃ vrajet || kāryasiddhimavāpnoti nirvighno gehamāviśet ||177|| tithivārarkṣayogānāṃ na doṣaḥ prabhavettadā || yadā japtvā vrajedetatstotraṃ grāmāṃtaraṃ naraḥ || 178|| āyurārogyajananaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam|| sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṃsāṃ gaṃgānāmasahasrakam || 179 || janmāṃtara sahasreṣu yatpāpaṃ samyagarjitam || gaṃgānāmasahasrasya japanāttatkṣayaṃ vrajet || 4.1.29.180 || brahmaghno madyapaḥ svarṇasteyī ca gurutalpagaḥ || tatsaṃyogī bhrūṇahaṃtā mātṛhā pitṛhā mune || 181 || viśvāsaghātī garadaḥ kṛtaghno mitraghātakaḥ || agnido govadhakaro gurudravyāpahārakaḥ || 182 || mahāpātakayuktopi saṃyuktopyupapātakaiḥ || mucyate śraddhayā japtvā gaṃgā nāma sahasrakam || 183 || ādhivyādhiparikṣipto ghora tāpa pariplutaḥ || mucyate sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ stavasyāsyānukīrtanāt || 184 || saṃvatsareṇa yuktātmā paṭhanbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || abhīpsitāṃ labhetsiddhiṃ sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 185 || saṃśayāviṣṭacittasya dharmavidveṣiṇopi ca || dāṃbhikasyāpi hiṃsrasya ceto dharmaparaṃ bhavet ||186|| varṇāśramapathīnastu kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ || yatphalaṃ labhate jñānī tadāpnotyasya kīrtanāt || 187 || gāyatryayutajapyena yatphalaṃ samupārjitam || sakṛtpaṭhanataḥ samyaktadaśeṣamavāpnuyāt ||188|| gāṃ dattvā vedaviduṣe yatphalaṃ labhate kṛtī || tatpuṇyaṃ samyagākhyātaṃ stavarājasakṛjjapāt ||189|| guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ kurvanyāvajjīvaṃ narottamaḥ|| yatpuṇyamarjayettadbhāgvarṣaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ japan ||4.1.29.190|| vedapārāyaṇātpuṇyaṃ yadatra paripaṭhyate || tatṣaṇmāsena labhate trisaṃdhyaṃ parikīrtanāt || 191 || gaṃgāyāḥ stavarājasya pratyahaṃ pariśīlanāt || śivabhaktimavāpnoti viṣṇubhakto'thavā bhavet || 192 || yaḥ kīrtayedanudinaṃ gaṃgānāmasahasrakam || tatsamīpe sahacarī gaṃgādevī sadā bhavet || 193 || sarvatra pūjyo bhavati sarvatra vijayī bhavet || sarvatra sukhamāpnoti jāhnavīstotrapāṭhataḥ || 194 || sadācārī sa vijñeyaḥ saśucistu sadaiva hi || kṛtasarvasurārcaḥ sa kīrtayedya imāṃ stutim ||195|| tasmiṃstṛpte bhavettṛptā jāhnavī nātra saṃśayaḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena gaṃgābhaktaṃ samarcayet || 196 || stavarājamimaṃ gāṃgaṃ śṛṇuyādyaśca vai paṭhet || śrāvayedatha tadbhaktāndaṃbhalobha vivarjitaḥ ||197|| mucyate trividhaiḥ pāpairmanovākkāya saṃbhavaiḥ || kṣaṇānniṣpāpatāmeti pitṝṇāṃ ca priyo bhavet ||198|| sarvadevapriyaścāpi sarvarṣigaṇasaṃmataḥ || aṃte vimānamāruhya divyastrīśatasaṃvṛtaḥ || 199 || divyābharaṇasaṃpanno divyabhogasamanvitaḥ || naṃdanādivane svairaṃ devavatsa pramodate || 4.1.29.200 || bhujyamāneṣu vipreṣu śrāddhakāle viśeṣataḥ || japannidaṃ mahāstotraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam || 201 || yāvaṃti tatra sikthāni yāvaṃtoṃ'bukaṇāḥ sthitāḥ || tāvaṃtyeva hi varṣāṇi modaṃte svaḥ pitāmahāḥ || 202 || yathā prīṇaṃti pitaro gaṃgāyāṃ piṃḍadānataḥ || tathaiva tṛpnuyuḥ śrāddhe stavasyāsyānusaṃśravāt || 203 || etatstotraṃ gṛhe yasya likhitaṃ paripūjyate || tatra pāpabhayaṃ nāsti śuci tadbhavanaṃ sadā || 204 || agaste kiṃbahūktena śṛṇu me niścitaṃ vacaḥ || saṃśayo nātra kartavyaḥ saṃdigdhe(?)raphalaṃ nahi||205|| (saṃdegdhari) yāvaṃti martye stotrāṇi maṃtrajālānyanekaśaḥ || tāvaṃti stavarājasya gāṃgeyasya samāni na||206|| yāvajjanma japedyastu nāmnāmetatsahasrakam|| sa kīkaṭeṣvapi mṛto na punargarbhamāviśet ||207|| nityaṃ niyamavānetadyo japetstotramuttamam || anyatrāpi vipannaḥ sa gaṃgātīre mṛto bhavet || 208 || etatstotravaraṃ ramyaṃ purā proktaṃ pinākinā || viṣṇave nijabhaktāya muktibījākṣarāspadam|| 209 || gaṃgāsnānapratinidhiḥ stotrametanmayeritam|| sisnāsurjāhnavīṃ tasmādetatstotraṃ japetsudhīḥ || 210 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe gaṃgāsahasranāmakathanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||
<4.1.30>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇvagastyamahābhāga sa ca rājā bhagīrathaḥ || ārādhya śrīmahādevamuddidhīrṣuḥ pitāmahān ||1|| brahmaśāpa vinirdagdhānsarvānrājarṣisattamaḥ || mahatā tapasā bhūmimānināya trivartmagām || 2 || trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ hitāya mahate nṛpaḥ || samānaiṣīttato gaṃgāṃ yatrāsīnmaṇikarṇikā || 3 || ānaṃdakānanaṃ śaṃbhoścakrapuṣkariṇī hareḥ || parabrahmaikasukṣetraṃ līlāmokṣasamarpakam || 4 || prāpayāmāsa tāṃ gaṃgāṃ dailīpiḥ purataścaran || nirvāṇakāśanādyatra kāśīti prathitā purī || 5 || avimuktaṃ mahākṣetraṃ na muktaṃ śaṃbhunā kvacita || prāgeva hi mune'narghyaṃ jātyaṃ jāṃbūnadaṃ svayam || 6 || punarvāritareṇāpi hīreṇayadi saṃgatam || cakrapuṣkaraṇītīrthaṃ prāgeva śreyasāṃpadam ||7|| tataḥ śreṣṭhataraṃ śaṃbhormaṇiśravaṇabhūṣaṇāt || ānaṃdakānane tasminnavimukte śivālaye|| || 8 || prāgeva muktiḥ saṃsiddhā gaṃgāsaṃgāttatodhikā || yadā prabhṛti sā gaṃgā maṇikarṇyāṃ samāgatā || 9 || tadāprabhṛti tatkṣetraṃ duṣprāpaṃ tridaśairapi || kṛtvā karmāṇyanekāni kalyāṇānītarāṇi vā || 4.1.30.10 || tāni kṣaṇātsamutkṣipya kāśīsaṃstho'mṛtobhavet || tasyāṃ vedāṃtavedyasya nididhyāsanato vinā || 11 || vinā sāṃkhyena yogena kāśyāṃ saṃstho'mṛto bhavet || karmanirmūlanavatā vinā jñānena kuṃbhaja || 12 || śaśimauliprasādena kāśīsaṃstho'mṛto bhavet || yatnato'yatnato vāpi kālāttyaktvā kalevaram || 13 || tārakasyopadeśena kāśīsaṃstho'mṛto bhavet || anekajanmasaṃsiddhairbaddho'pi prākṛtairguṇaiḥ || 14 || asisaṃbheda yogena kāśīsaṃstho'mṛto bhavet || dehatyāgo'tra vai dānaṃ dehatyāgotra vai tapaḥ || 158 || dehatyāgo'tra vai yogaḥ kāśyāṃ nirvāṇasaukhyakṛt || prāpyottaravahāṃ kāśyāmatiduṣkṛtavānapi || 16 || yāyātsvaṃ helayā tyaktvā tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || yameṃdrāgnimukhā devā dṛṣṭvā muktipathonmukhān || 17 || sarvānsarve samālokya rakṣāṃ cakruḥ purāpuraḥ || asiṃ mahāsirūpāṃ ca pāpyasanmatikhaṃḍanīm || 18 || duṣṭapraveśaṃ dhunvānāṃ dhunīṃ devā vinirmamuḥ || varaṇāṃ ca vyadhustatra kṣetravighnanivāriṇīm || 19 || durvṛttasupravṛtteśca nivṛttikaraṇīṃ surāḥ || dakṣiṇottaradigbhāge kṛtvā'siṃ varaṇāṃ surāḥ || 4.1.30.20 || kṣetrasya mokṣanikṣepa rakṣāṃ nirvṛtimāpnuyuḥ || kṣetrasya paścāddigbhāge taṃ dehalivināyakam || 21 || svayaṃ vyāpārayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ śaśiśekharaḥ || anujñātapraveśānāṃ viśveśena kṛpāvatā || 22 || te praveśaṃ prayacchaṃti nānyeṣāṃ hi kadācana || ityarthe kathayiṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam || āścaryakāriparamaṃ kāśībhaktipravardhanam || 23 || || skaṃda uvāca || || dakṣiṇābdhitaṭe kaścitsetubaṃdhasamīpataḥ || vaṇigdhanaṃjayo nāma mātṛbhaktisamanvitaḥ || 24 || puṇyamārgārjita dhano dhanatoṣitamārgaṇaḥ || mārgaṇasphāritayaśā yaśodātanayārcakaḥ || 25 || samunnatopi saṃpattyā vinayānatakaṃdharaḥ || ākaropi guṇānāṃ hi guṇiṣvākāragopakaḥ || 26 || rūpasaṃpadudāropi paradāraparāṅmukhaḥ || sasaṃpūrṇakalopyāsīnniṣkalaṃkodayaḥ sadā || 27 || sasatyānṛtavṛttiśca prāyaḥ satyapriyo mune || varṇetaropyabhūlloke suvarṇakṛtavarṇanaḥ || 28 || sadācaraṇagopyeṣa sukhayānacaraḥ kṛtī || adaridropi medhāvī sobhūtpāpadaridradhīḥ || 29 || tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kadācitkālaparyayāt || jananī nidhanaṃ prāptā vyādhitā'tijarāturā ||4.1.30.30 || tayā ca yauvanaṃ prāpya meghacchāyāticaṃcalam || prāvṛṇnadīpūrasamaṃ svapatiḥ parivaṃcitaḥ || 31 || dina tricaturasthāyi yā nārī prāpya yauvanam|| bhartāraṃ vaṃcayenmohātsā'kṣayaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 32 || śīlabhaṃgena nārīṇāṃ bhartādharmaparopi hi || patedduḥkhārjitātsvargācchīlaṃ rakṣyaṃ tataḥ striyā || 33 || viṣṭhāgarte ca niraye svayaṃ patati durmatiḥ || ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvattataḥ syādgrāmasūkarī ||34|| svaviṣṭhāpāyinī cātha valgulī vṛkṣalaṃbinī|| ulūkī vā divāṃdhā syādvṛkṣakoṭaravāsinī || || 35 || rakṣaṇīyaṃ mahāyatnādidaṃ sukṛtabhājanam || vapuḥ parasya duḥsparśātsukhābhāsātmakātstriyā || 36 || anenaiva śarīreṇa bhartṛsādvihitena hi || kiṃ satī na ca tastaṃbha bhānumudyaṃtamājñayā || 37 || atripatnyanasūyā kiṃ bhartṛbhaktiprabhāvataḥ || dadhāra na trayīṃ garbhe pativrata parāyaṇā || 38 || iha kīrtiśca vipulā svargevāsastathā'kṣayaḥ || pātivratyātstriyā labhyaṃ sakhitvaṃ ca śriyā saha || 39 || sādurvṛttyā parityajya patidharmaṃ sanātanam || svacchaṃdacāriṇī bhūtvāmṛtānirayamudyayau || 4.1.30.40 || dhanaṃjayopi ca mune kenacicchivayoginā || sārdhaṃ tapodayāditthaṃ so'bhavaddharmatatparaḥ ||41|| dhanaṃjayopi dharmātmā mātṛbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || ādāyāsthīnyatho māturgaṃgā mārgasthito'bhavat ||42|| paṃcagavyena saṃsnāpya tataḥ paṃcāmṛtena vai || yakṣakardamalepena liptvā puṣpaiḥ prapūjya ca || 43 || āveṣṭya netravastreṇa tataḥ paṭṭāṃbareṇa vai || tataḥ surasavastreṇa tato māṃjiṣṭhavāsasā ||44|| nepālakaṃbalenātha mṛdācā'tha viśuddhayā || tāmrasaṃpuṭake kṛtvā māturaṃgānyaho vaṇik || 45 || aspṛṣṭahīnajātiḥ sa śuciṣmānsthaṃḍileśayaḥ || ānayañjvaritopyāsīnmadhye mārgaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ ||46|| bhāravāhaḥ kṛtastena kaściddattvocitāṃ bhṛtim || kiṃ bahūktena ghaṭaja kāśī prāptā'tha tena vai || 47 || dhṛtvā saṃbhṛtirakṣārthaṃ bhāravāhaṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ || jagāmāpaṇamānetuṃ kiṃcidvastvaśanādikam || 48 || bhāravāhyaṃtaraṃ prāpya tasya saṃbhṛtimadhyataḥ || tāmrasaṃpuṭamādāya dhanaṃ jñātvā gṛhaṃ yayau || 49 || vāsasthānamathāgatya tamadṛṣṭvā dhanaṃjayaḥ || tvarāvānsaṃbhṛtiṃ vīkṣya tāmrasaṃpuṭavarjitām || 4.1.30.50 || hāhetyātāḍya hṛdayaṃ cakraṃda bahuśo bhṛśam || itastatastamālokya gatastadanusārataḥ || 51 || akṛtvā jāhnavīsnānamanavekṣya jagatpatim || tasya saṃvasathaṃ prāpto bhāravoḍhurdhanaṃjayaḥ || 52 || bhāravāḍapyaraṇyānyāṃ tāmrasaṃpuṭamadhyataḥ|| dṛṣṭvāsthīni viniḥśvasya tāni tyaktvā gṛhaṃ yayau| ||53|| vaṇikca tadgṛhaṃ prāpya śuṣkakaṃṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ || dṛṣṭvā'tha cailaśakalaṃ tṛṇakuṭyaṃtare tadā ||54|| āśayā kiṃcidāśvasya tatpatnīṃ paripṛṣṭavān || satyaṃ brūhi na bhetavyaṃ dāsyāmyanyadapi dhruvam || 55 || vasu kva te gato bhartā māturasthīnime'rpaya || vayaṃ kārpaṭikā bhadre bhavāmo na ca duḥkhadāḥ || 56 || ajñātvā lobhavaśatastena nīto'sthisaṃpuṭaḥ || tasyaiṣa doṣo no bhadre māturme karma tādṛśam ||57|| athavā na prasū doṣo maṃdabhāgyo'smi tatsutaḥ || sutenakṛtyaṃ yatkṛtyaṃ tatprāptirnāsti bhilli me ||58|| udyamaṃ kṛtavānasmi na siddhyenmaṃdabhāgyataḥ || āyātu satyavākyānme mā bibhetu vanecaraḥ || || 59 || asthīni darśayatvāśu dhanaṃ dāsye'dhikaṃ tataḥ || ityuktā tena sā bhillī vyājahāra nijaṃ patim || 4.1.30.60 || lajjānamraśirāḥso'tha vṛttāṃtaṃ vinivedya ca || nināya tāmaraṇyānīṃ śabarastaṃ dhanaṃjayam ||61|| vanecaro'tha tatsthānaṃ daivādvismṛtavānmune || digbhrāṃtiṃ samavāpyātha paribabhrāma kānane ||62|| itoraṇyāttato yāti tatoraṇyādito vrajet || vanādvanāṃtaraṃ bhrāṃtvā khinnaḥ sopi vanecaraḥ || 63 || vihāya madhye'raṇyāni taṃ yayau ca svapakkaṇam || dvitrāṇyahāni saṃbhramya sa kārpaṭikasattamaḥ || 64 || kṣutkṣāmaḥ śuṣkakaṃṭhoṣṭho hāheti paridevayan || punaḥ kāśīpurīṃ prāptaḥ parimlānamukho vaṇik ||8 65 || tanmaṃdabhāgyatāṃ śrutvā lokātkārpaṭiko mune || kṛtvā gayāṃ prayāgaṃ ca tataḥ svaviṣayaṃ yayau || 66 || kāśyāṃ praveśaṃ prāpyāpi tadasthīni ghaṭodbhava || vinā vaiśveśvarīmājñāṃ bahiryātāni tatkṣaṇāt || || 67 || evaṃ kāśyāṃ praviśyāpi pāpī dharmānuṣaṃgataḥ || na kṣetraphalamāpnoti bahirbhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 68 || tasmādviśveśvarājñaiva kāśīvāse'tra kāraṇam || asiśca varaṇā yatra kṣetrarakṣākṛtau kṛte || 69 || vārāṇasīti vikhyātā tadārabhya mahāmune || aseśca varaṇāyāśca saṃgamaṃ prāpya kāśikā || 4.1.30.70 || vārāṇasīha karuṇāmayadivyamūrtirutsṛjya yatra tu tanuṃ tanubhṛtsukhena || viśveśadṛṅmahasi yatsahasā praviśya rūpeṇa tāṃ vitanutāṃ padavīṃ dadhāti || 71 || jāto mṛto bahuṣu tīrthavareṣu re tvaṃ jaṃto na jātu tava śāṃtirabhūnnimajya || vārāṇasī nigadatīha mṛto'mṛtatvaṃ prāpyādhunā mama balātsmaraśāsanaḥ syāḥ || 72 || anyatra tīrtha salile patitodvijanmā devādibhāvamayate na tathā tu kāśyām || citraṃ yadatra patitaḥ punarutthitiṃ na prāpnoti pulkasajanopi kimagra janmā || 73 || naiṣā purī saṃsṛtirūpapārāvārasya pāraṃ purahā purāriḥ || yasyāṃ paraṃ pauruṣamarthamicchansiddhiṃ nayetpauraparaṃparāṃsaḥ || 74 || tīrthāṃtarāṇi manujaḥ parito'vagāhya hitvā tanuṃ kaluṣitāṃ divi daivataṃ syāt || vārāṇasīparisare tu visṛjya dehaṃ saṃdehabhāgbhavati dehadaśāptayepi || 75 || vārāṇasī samarasīkaraṇādṛtepi yogādayogijanatāṃ janatāpahaṃtrī || tattārakaṃ śravaṇagocaratāṃ nayaṃtī tadbahmadarśayati yena punarbhavo na || 76 || vārāṇasī parisare tanumiṣṭadātrīṃ dharmārthakāmanilayāmahahāvisṛjya || iṣṭaṃ padaṃ kimapi hṛṣṭatarobhilaṣya lābhostumūlamapi no yadavāpa śūnyam || 77 || āḥkāśivāsijanatā nanu vaṃcitābhūdbhāle vilocanavatāvanitārdhabhājā || ādāya yatsandhyakṛtabhājanamiṣṭadehaṃ nirvāṇamātramapavarjayatāpunarbhu || 78 || vārāṇasī sphuradasīmaguṇaikabhūmiryatra sthitāstanubhṛtaḥśaśibhṛtprabhāvāt || sarve gale garalino'kṣiyujo lalāṭe vāmārdhavāmatanavo'tanavastatoṃ'te || 79 || ānaṃdakānanamidaṃ sukhadaṃ puraiva tattrāpi cakrasarasī maṇikarṇikā'tha|| svaḥ siṃdhusaṃgatiratho paramāspadaṃ ca viśveśituḥ kimiha tanna vimuktaye yat|| 4.1.30.80|| vārāṇasīha varaṇāsi saridvariṣṭhā saṃbhedakhedajananī dyunadī lasacchrīḥ || viśrāmabhūmiracalā'malamokṣalakṣmyāhaināṃ vihāya kimusīdati mūḍhajaṃtuḥ || 81 || kiṃ vismṛtaṃ tvahahagarbhajamāmanasyaṃ kārtāṃtadūtakṛtabaṃdhana tāḍanaṃ ca || śaṃbhoranugraha parigraha labhya kāśīṃ mūḍho vihāya kimu yāti karastha muktim || 82 || tīrthāṃtarāṇi kaluṣāṇi harati sadyaḥ śreyo dadatyapi bahu tridivaṃ nayaṃti || pānāvagāhanavidhānatanuprahāṇairvārāṇasī tu kurute bata mūlanāśam||83 || kāśīpurī parisare maṇikarṇikāyāṃ tyaktvā tanuṃ tanubhṛtastanumāpnuvaṃti || bhāle vilocanavatīṃ galanīlalakṣmīṃ vāmārdhabaṃdhuravadhūṃ vidhurāvarodhāḥ || 84 || jñātvā prabhāvamatulaṃ maṇikarṇikāyāṃ yaḥ pudgalaṃ tyajati cāśucipūyagaṃdhi || svātmāvabodhamahasā sahasā militvā kalpāṃtareṣvapi sa naiva pṛthaktvameti || 85 || rāgādidoṣaparipūra mano hṛṣīkāḥ kāśīpurīmatuladivyamahāprabhāvām || ye kalpayaṃtyaparatīrthasamāṃ samaṃtātte pāpino na saha taiḥ paribhāṣaṇīyam || 86 || vārāṇasīṃ smaraharapriyarājadhānīṃ tyaktvā kuto vrajasi mūḍha digaṃtareṣu || prāpyāpyajādyasulabhāṃsthiramokṣalakṣmīṃ lakṣmīṃ svabhāvacapalāṃ kimu kāmayethāḥ || 87 || vidyā dhanāni sadanāni gajāśvabhṛtyāḥ srakcaṃdanāni vanitāśca nitāṃta ramyāḥ || svargopyagamya iha nodyamabhājipuṃsi vārāṇasītvasulabhā śalabhādimuktiḥ| dhātrā dhṛtāni tulayā tulanāmavaituṃ vaikuṃṭhamukhyabhuvanāni ca kāśikā ca || tānyudyayurlaghutayānyagiyaṃ gurutvāttasthau purīha puruṣārthacatuṣṭayasya || 89 || kāśī purīmadhivasandrinaronaropihmāropyamāṇaihamānyahavaikarudraḥ || nānopasargajanisargajaduḥkhabhāraiḥkarmāpanudyasaviśetparameśadhāmni || 4.1.30.90 || sthirāpāyaṃ kāyaṃ jananamaraṇakleśanilayaṃ vihāyāsyāṃ kāśyāmahahaparigṛhṇīta na kutaḥ || vapustejorūpaṃ sthirataraparānaṃdasadanaṃ vimūḍho'sau jaṃtuḥ sphuṭitamivakāṃmyaṃ vinimayan || 91 || aho lokaḥ śokaṃ kimiha sahate haṃtahatadhīrvipadbhāraiḥ sārairniyatanidhanairdhvasita dhanaiḥ || kṣitau satyāṃ kāśyāṃ kathayati śivo yatra nidhane śrutau kiṃcidbhūyaḥ praviśati na yenodaradarīm || 92 || kāśivāsinijane vanecaredvitribhujyapi samīrabhojane || svairacāriṇi jiteṃdriyepyaho kāśivāsini jane viśiṣṭatā || 93 || nāstīha duṣkṛtakṛtāṃ sukṛtātmanāṃ vā kācidviśeṣagatiraṃtakṛtāṃ hi kāśyām || bījāni karmajanitāni yadūṣarāyāṃ nāṃkūraṃyati haradṛgjvalitāniteṣām || 94 || śaśakā maśakā bakāḥ śukāḥ kalaviṃkāśca vṛkāḥ sajaṃbukāḥ || turagoraga vānarānarā girije kāśimṛtāḥ parāmṛtam || 95 || arudrarudrākṣaphaṇīṃdrabhūṣaṇāstripuṃḍracaṃdrārdhadharādharāgatāḥ || niraṃtaraṃ kāśinivāsinojanā girīṃdraje pāriṣadā matā mama || 96 || yāvaṃta eva nivasaṃti ca jaṃtavo'tra kāśyāṃ jalasthalacarā jhaṣajaṃbukādyāḥ || tāvaṃta eva madanugraha rudradehā dehāvasānamadhigamya mayi praviṣṭāḥ || 97 || ye tu varṣeṣavorudrā divi devi prakīrtitāḥ || vāteṣavoṃ'tarikṣe ye ye bhuvyanneṣavaḥ priye || 98 || rudrā daśa daśa prācyavācī pratyagudaksthitāḥ || ūrdhvadiksthāśca ye rudrāḥ paṭhyaṃte vedavādibhiḥ || 99 || asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhibhūtale || tatsarvebhyo'dhikā kāśyāṃ jaṃtavo rudrarūpiṇaḥ ||4.1.30.100|| rudrāvāsastataḥ proktamavimuktaṃ ghaṭodbhava || tasmātsamarcya kāśisthānvarṇānvarṇetarāśramān|| 101 || śraddhayeśvarabuddhyā ca rudrārcā phalabhāṅnaraḥ || 102 || śma śabdena śavaḥ proktaḥ śānaṃ śayanamucyate|| nirvacaṃti śmaśānārthaṃ mune śabdārthakovidāḥ || 103 || mahāṃtyapi ca bhūtāni pralaye samupasthite || śerate'tra śavā bhūtvā śmaśānaṃ tu tato mahat || 104 || apsu bhūriha laye layaṃ vrajedāpa aurvavadanograkaṃdare || mātariśvani mahātanūnapādvyomni saṃkṣayati vai sadāgatiḥ || 105 || vyoma cāpi layametyahaṃkṛtau sāpi ṣoḍaśavikārasaṃyutā || līyate mahati buddhisaṃjñakehā mahānprakṛtimadhyago bhavet || 106|| sā guṇatrayamayī ca nirguṇaṃ taṃ pumāṃsamavaguhya tiṣṭhati || paṃcaviṃśatitamaḥ paraḥ pumāndehagehapatireṣa jīvakaḥ || 107 || prākṛtaḥ pralaya eṣa ucyate haṃsayāna hari rudravarjitaḥ || kālamūrtiratha taṃ ca pūruṣaṃ helayā kalayatīśvaraḥ paraḥ || 108 || sa vai mahāviṣṇuritīryate budhaistaṃ vai mahādevamudāharaṃti || soṃ'tādimadhyaiḥ parivarjitaḥ śivaḥ sa śrīpatiḥ sopi hi pārvatīpatiḥ || 109 || dainaṃdine'tha pralaye triśūlakoṭau samutkṣipya purīṃ haraḥ svām || bibharti saṃvarta mahāsthibhūṣaṇastato hi kāśī kalikālavarjitā || 4.1.30.110 || || skaṃda uvāca || || vārāṇasīti kāśīti rudrāvāsa iti dvija || mahāśmaśānamityevaṃ proktamānaṃdakānanam ||111|| iti devīpuraḥ proktaṃ devadevena śaṃbhunā || yathāviṣṇoḥ purākhyātaṃ tathaiva ca mayā śrutam || tacca tvadagre kathitaṃ rahasyaṃ kāśijaṃ mahat ||112|| japtvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || śrāvayitvā dvijānsamyakchivaloke mahīyate || 113 || ataḥ paraṃ kalaśaja kiṃ śuśrūṣasi tadvada || kāśīkathā kathyamānā mamāpi paritoṣakṛt || 114 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe vārāṇasīmahimavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
<4.1.31>
|| agastya uvāca || || sarvajña hṛdayānaṃda skaṃdaskaṃdita tāraka || na tṛptimadhigacchāmi śṛṇvanvārāṇasīkathām || 1 || anugraho yadi mayi yogyosmi śravaṇe yadi || tadā kathaya me nātha kāśyāṃ bhairava saṃkathām || 2 || kosau bhairavanāmātra kāśipuryāṃ vyavasthitaḥ || kiṃ rūpamasya kiṃ karma kāni nāmāni cāsya vai ||3|| kathamārādhitaścaiva siddhidaḥ sādhakasya vai || ārādhitaḥ kutra kāle kṣipraṃ siddhyati bhairavaḥ || 4 || || skaṃda uvāca || || vārāṇasyāṃ mahābhāga yathā te prema vartate || tathā na kasyacinmanye tato vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ || 5 || prādurbhāvaṃ bhairavasya mahāpātakanāśanam || yacchrutvā kāśivāsasya phalaṃ nirvighramāpnuyāt || 6 || pāṇibhyāṃ paritaḥ prapīḍya sudṛḍhaṃ niścotya niścotya ca brahmāṃḍaṃ sakalaṃ pacelimarasāloccaiḥ phalābhaṃ muhuḥ || pāyaṃpāyamapāyatastrijagatīmunmattavattai rasairnṛtyaṃstāṃḍavaḍaṃbareṇa vidhināpāyānmahābhairavaḥ || 7 || kuṃbhayone na vettyeva mahimānaṃ maheśituḥ || caturbhajopi vaikuṃṭhaścaturvaktropi viśvakṛt || 8 || na citramatra bhūdeva bhavamāyā duratyayā || tayā saṃmohitāḥ sarve nāvayaṃtyapi taṃ param || 9 || vedayedyadicātmānaṃ sa eva parameśvaraḥ || tadā viṃdaṃti brahmādyāḥ svecchayaiva na taṃ viduḥ || 4.1.31.10 || sa sarvagopi nekṣyeta svātmārāmo maheśvaraḥ || devavadbudhyate mūḍhairatīto yo manogirām || 11 || purā pitāmahaṃ vipra meruśṛṃge maharṣayaḥ || procuḥ praṇamya lokeśaṃ kimekaṃ tattvamavyayam || 12 || samā yayā maheśasya mohito lokasaṃbhavaḥ || avijñāya paraṃ bhāvamātmānaṃ prāha varpiṇam || 13 || jagadyonirahaṃ dhātā svayaṃbhūreka īśvaraḥ || anādimadahaṃ brahma māmanarcya na mu cyate || 14 || pravartako hi jagatāmahameko nivartakaḥ || nānyo madadhikaḥ satyaṃ kaścitkopi surottamāḥ || 15 || tasyaivaṃ bruvato dhātuḥ kraturnārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ || provāca prahasanvākyaṃ roṣatāmravilocanaḥ || 16 || avijñāya paraṃ tattvaṃ kimetatpratipādyate || ajñānaṃ yogayuktasya na caitaducitaṃ tava || 17 || ahaṃ kartā hi lokānāṃ yajño nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ || na māmanādṛtya vidhe jīvanaṃ jagatāmaja || 18 || ahameva paraṃ jyotirahameva parā gatiḥ || matpreritena bhavatā sṛṣṭireṣā vidhīyate || || 19 || evaṃ vipra kṛtau mohātparasparajayaiṣiṇau || papracchatuḥ pramāṇajñānāgamāṃścaturopi tau || 4.1.31.20 || || vidhikratū ūcatuḥ || || vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ sarvatra pratiṣṭhāṃ paramāmitāḥ || yūyameva na saṃdehaḥ kiṃ tattvaṃ pratitiṣṭhata || 21 || śrutaya ūcuḥ || || yadi mānyā vayaṃ devau sṛṣṭisthitikarau vibhū || tadā pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmo bhavatsaṃdehabhedakam || 22 || śrutyuktamidamākarṇya procatustau śrutīḥ prati || yuṣmaduktaṃ pramāṇaṃ nau kiṃ tattvaṃ samyagucyatām || 23 || ṛguvāca || || yadaṃtaḥsthāni bhūtāni yataḥ sarvaṃ pravartate || yadāhustatparaṃ tattvaṃ sa rudrastveka eva hi || 24 || || yajuruvāca || || yo yajñairakhilairīśo yogena ca samijyate || yena pramāṇaṃ hi vayaṃ sa ekaḥ sarvadṛkchivaḥ ||25|| || sāmovāca || || yenedaṃ bhraśyate viśvaṃ yogibhiryo viciṃtyate || yadbhāsā bhāsate viśvaṃ sa ekastryaṃbakaḥ paraḥ || 26 || || atharvovāca || || yaṃ prapaśyaṃti deveśaṃ bhaktyānugrahiṇo janāḥ || tamāhurekaṃ kaivalyaṃ śaṃkaraṃ duḥkhataskaram || 27 || śrutīritaṃ niśamyetthaṃ tāvatīva vimohitau || smitvāhatuḥ kratu vidhīmohādhyenāṃkitau mune || 28 || kathaṃ pramathanāthosau ramamāṇo niraṃtaram|| digaṃbaraḥ pitṛvane śivayā dhūlidhūsaraḥ || 29 || viṭaṃkaveśo jaṭilo vṛṣagovyālabhūṣaṇaḥ || paraṃ brahmatvamāpannaḥ kva ca tatsaṃgavarjitam|| 4.1.31.30 || tadudīritamākarṇya praṇavātmā sanātanaḥ || amūrto mūrtimānbhūtvā hasamāna uvāca tau || 31 || praṇava uvāca || na hyeṣa bhagavāñchaktyā svātmano vyatiriktayā || kadācidramate rudro līlārūpadharo haraḥ || 32 || asau hi bhagavānīśaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ sanātanaḥ || ānaṃdarūpā tasyaiṣā śaktirnāgaṃtukī śivā || 33 || ityevamuktepi tadā makhamūrterajasya hi || nājñānamagamannāśaṃ śrīkaṃṭhasyaiva māyayā || 34 || prādurāsīttato jyotirubhayoraṃtare mahat || pūrayannijayā bhāsā dyāvābhūmyoryadaṃtaram|| 35 || jyotirmaṃḍalamadhyastho dadṛśe puruṣākṛtiḥ || prajajvālātha kopena brahmaṇaḥ paṃcamaṃ śiraḥ || 36 || āvayoraṃtaraṃ kosau bibhṛyātpuruṣākṛtim || vidhiḥ saṃbhāvayedyāvattāvatsa hi vilokitaḥ || 37 || sraṣṭā kṣaṇena ca mahānpuruṣo nīlalohitaḥ || triśūlapāṇirbhālākṣo nāgoḍupavibhūṣaṇaḥ || 38 || hiraṇyagarbhastaṃ prāha jāne tvāṃ caṃdraśekharam || bhālasthalānmamapurā rudraḥ prādurabhūdbhavān || 39 || rodanādrudranāmāpi yojitosi mayā purā || māmeva śaraṇaṃ yāhi putra rakṣāṃ karomi te || 4.1.31.40 || atheśvaraḥ padmayoneḥ śrutvā garvavatīṃ giram|| sakopataḥ samutpādya puruṣaṃ bhairavākṛtim || 41 || prāha paṃkajajanmāsau śāsyaste kālabhairava || kālavadrājase sākṣātkālarājastato bhavān || 42 || viśvaṃ bhartuṃ samartho'si bharaṇādbhairavaḥ smṛtaḥ || tvatto bheṣyati kālopi tatastvaṃ kālabhairavaḥ || 43 || āmardayiṣyati bhavāṃstuṣṭo duṣṭātmano yataḥ || āmardaka iti khyāti tataḥ sarvatra yāsyati || 44 || yataḥ pāpāni bhaktānāṃ bhakṣayiṣyati tatkṣaṇāt || pāpabhakṣaṇa ityeva tava nāma bhaviṣyati || 45 || yā me muktipurī kāśī sarvābhyopi garīyasī || ādhipatyaṃ ca tasyāste kālarāja sadaiva hi ||46|| tatra ye pāpakartārasteṣāṃ śāstā tvameva hi || śubhāśubhaṃ na tatkarma citragupto likhiṣyati || 47 || etānvarānpragṛhyā'tha tatkṣaṇātkālabhairavaḥ || vāmāṃgulinakhāgreṇa cakarta ca śiro vidheḥ || 48 || yadaṃgamaparādhnoti kāryaṃ tasyaiva śāsanam || ato yena kṛtā niṃdā tacchinnaṃ pacamaṃ śiraḥ || 49 || yajñamūrtidharo viṣṇustatastuṣṭāva śaṃkaram || bhīto hiraṇyagarbhopi jajāpa śatarudriyam || 4.1.31.50 || āśvāsya tau mahādevaḥ prītaḥ praṇatavatsalaḥ || prāha svāṃ mūrtimaparāṃ bhairavaṃ taṃ kapardinam || 51 || mānyo'dhvarosau bhavatā tathā śatadhṛtistvayam || kapālaṃ vaidhasaṃ cāpi nīlalohita dhāraya || 52 || brahmahatyāpanodāya vrataṃ lokāya darśayan|| cara tvaṃ satataṃ bhikṣāṃ kāpālavratamāsthitaḥ || ityuktvāṃ'tarhito devastejorūpastadā śivaḥ || 53 || utpādya kanyāmekāṃ tu brahmahatyeti viśrutām || raktāṃbaradharāṃ raktāṃ raktasraggaṃdhalepanām|| 54 || daṃṣṭākarālavadanāṃ lalajjihvātibhīṣaṇām || aṃtarikṣaikapādāgrāṃ pibaṃtīṃ rudhiraṃ bahu ||55|| kartrīṃ karparahastāgrāṃ sphuratpiṃgogratārakām || garjayaṃtīṃ mahāvegāṃ bhairavasyāpibhīṣaṇām || 56 || yāvadvārāṇasīṃ divyāṃ purīmeṣa gamiṣyati || tāvattvaṃ bhīṣaṇe kālamanugacchograrūpiṇi || 57 || sarvatra te praveśosti tyaktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm|| niyojyatāmiti śivopyaṃtardhānaṃ gatastataḥ || 58 || tatsānnidhyādbhairavopi kālobhūtkālakālataḥ || sa devadevavākyena bibhratkāpālikaṃ vratam|| 59 || kapālapāṇirviśvātmā cacāra bhuvanatrayam|| nātyākṣīccāpi taṃ devaṃ brahmahatyā sudāruṇā || 4.1.31.60 || satyalokepi vaikuṃṭhe maheṃdrādi purīṣvapi || trijagatpatirugropi vratī trijagatīśvaraḥ ||61|| pratitīrthaṃ bhramannāpi vimukto brahmahatyayā ||62|| anenaivānumānena mahimā tvavagamyatām || brahmahatyāpanodinyāḥ kāśyāḥ kalaśasaṃbhava || 63 || saṃti tīrthānyanekāni bahūnyāyatanāni ca || adhi trilokino kāśyāḥ kalāmarhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 64 || tāvadgarjaṃti pāpāni brahatyādikānyalam || yāvannāma na śṛṇvaṃti kāśyāḥ pāpācalāśaneḥ || 65 || pramathaiḥ sevyamāno'yaṃ trilokīṃ vicaranharaḥ || kāpāliko yayau devo nārāyaṇaniketanam || 66 || athāyāṃtaṃ mahākālaṃ trinetraṃ sarpakuṃḍalam || mahādevāṃśasaṃbhūtaṃ bhairavaṃ bhīṣaṇākṛtim || 67 || papāta daṃḍavadbhūmau dṛṣṭvā taṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ || devāśca munayaścaiva devanāryaḥ samaṃtataḥ || 68 || nipetuḥ praṇipatyainaṃ praṇataḥ kamalāpatiḥ || śirasyaṃjalimāropya stutvā bahuvidhaiḥ stavaiḥ ||69|| kṣīrodamathano tāṃ prāha padmālayāṃ hariḥ || priye paśyā'bjanayane dhanyā'si subhagenaghe || 4.1.31.70 || dhanyo'haṃ devi suśroṇi yatpaśyāvo jagatpatim || ayaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca lokānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ || 71 || anādiḥ śaraṇaḥ śāṃtaḥ paraḥ ṣaḍviṃśasaṃmitaḥ || sarvajñaḥ sarvayogīśaḥ sarvabhūtaikanāyakaḥ ||72|| sarvabhūtāṃtarātmā'yaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvadaḥ sadā || yaṃ vinidrā viniḥśvāsāḥ śāṃtā dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || 73 || dhiyā paśyaṃti hṛdaye soyamadya samīkṣyatām|| yaṃ vidurvedatattvajñā yogino yatamānasāḥ || 74 || arūpo rūpavānbhūtvā soyamāyāti sarvagaḥ || aho vicitraṃ devasya ceṣṭitaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||74||| yasyākhyāṃ bruvatāṃ nityaṃ na dehaḥ sopi dehadhṛk|| yaṃ dṛṣṭvā na punarjanma labhyate mānavairbhuvi||76|| soyamāyāti bhagavāṃstryaṃbakaḥ śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ || puṃḍarīkadalāyāme dhanyeme'dya vilocane || 77 || dhigdhikpadaṃ tu devānāṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā'tra śaṃkaram || labhyate yanna nirvāṇaṃ sarvaduḥkhāṃtakṛttu yat || 78 || devatvādaśubhaṃ kiṃciddevaloke na vidyate || dṛṣṭvāpi sarvadeveśaṃ yanmuktiṃ na labhāmahe || 79 || evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || praṇipatya mahādevamidamāha vṛṣadhvajam || 4.1.31.80 || kimidaṃ devadevena sarvajñena tvayā vibho || kriyate jagatāṃ dhātrā sarvapāpaharā'vyaya || 81 || krīḍeyaṃ tava deveśa trilocana mahāmate || kiṃ kāraṇaṃ virūpākṣa ceṣṭitaṃ te smarārdana ||82 || kimarthaṃ bhagavatrchaṃbho bhikṣāṃ carasi śaktipa || saṃśayo me jagannātha natatrailokyarājyada || 83 || evamuktastataḥ śaṃbhurviṣṇumetadudāharat || brahmaṇastu śiraśchinnamaṃgulyagranakhena ha || 84 || tadaghapratighaṃ viṣṇo carāmyetadvrataṃ śubham || evamukto maheśena puṃḍarīkavilocanaḥ || 85 || smitvā kiṃcinnataśirāḥ punarevaṃ vyajijñapat || yathecchasi tathā krīḍa sarvaviṣṭapanāyaka || 86 || māyayā māṃ mahādeva nacchādayitumarhasi || nābhīkamalakośāttu koṭiśaḥ kamalāsanān || 87 || kalpe kalpe sṛjāmīśa tvanniyogabalādvibho || tyaja māyāmimāṃ deva dustarāmakṛtātmabhiḥ || 88 || madādyo mahādeva māyayā tava mohitāḥ || yathāvadavagacchāmi ceṣṭitaṃ te śivāpate || 89|| saṃhārakāle saṃprāpte sadevānakhilānmunīn || lokānvarṇāśramavato hariṣyasi yadā hara || 4.1.31.90 || tadā kva te mahādeva pāpa brahmavadhādikam || pārataṃtryaṃ na te śaṃbho svairaṃ krīḍettato bhavān || 91 || atītabrahmaṇāmasthnāṃ srakkaṃṭhe tava bhāsate || tadātadā kvānugatā brahmahatyā tavānagha || 92 || kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ tvāṃ yaḥ smarati bhāvataḥ || ādhāraṃ jagatāmīśaṃ tasya pāpaṃ vilīyate || 93 || yathā tamo na tiṣṭheta saṃnidhāvaṃśumālinaḥ || tathā na bhavabhaktasya pāpaṃ tasya vrajetkṣayam || 94 || yaściṃtayati puṇyātmā tava pādāṃbujadvayam || brahmahatyādikamapi pāpaṃ tasya vrajetkṣayam || 95 || tava nāmānuraktā vāgyasya puṃso jagatpate || apyadrikūṭatulitaṃ nainastamanubādhate || 96 || rajasā tamasā vivardhitaṃ kva nu pāpaṃ paritāpadāyakam || kva ca te śiva nāma maṃgalaṃ janajīvātu jagadrujāpaham || 97 || yadi jātucidaṃdhakadviṣastavanāmauṣṭhapuṭādviniḥsṛtam || śivaśaṃkara caṃdraśekharetyasakṛttasya na saṃsṛtiḥ punaḥ || 98 || paramātmanparaṃdhāma svecchā vidhṛta vigraha || kutūhalaṃ taveśedaṃ kva parādhīnateśvare || 99 || adya dhanyosmi deveśa yaṃ na paśyati yoginaḥ || paśyāmi taṃ jaganmūlaṃ parameśvaramakṣayam || 4.1.31.100 || adya me paramo lābhastvadya me maṃgalaṃ param || tvaddṛṣṭyamṛtatṛptasya tṛṇaṃ svargāpavargadam || 101 || itthaṃ vadati goviṃde vimalā padmayā tayā || manorathavatī nāma bhikṣāpātre samarpitā || 102 || bhikṣāṭanāya devopi niragātparayā mudā || dṛṣṭvā'nuyāyinīṃ tāṃ tu samāhūya janārdanaḥ || saṃprārthayadbrahmahatyāṃ vimuṃca tvaṃ triśūlinam|| 103 || || brahmahatyovāca || || anenāpi miṣeṇā'haṃ saṃsevyāmuṃ vṛṣadhvajam || ātmānaṃ pāvayiṣyāmi kva punarbhavadarśanam || 104 || sā tatyāja na tatpārśvaṃ vyāhṛtāpi murāriṇā || tamūce'tha hariṃ śaṃbhuḥ smerāsyo vacanaṃ śubham || 105 || tvadvākpīyūṣapānena tṛptosmi bahumānada || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva goviṃda varado'smi tavānagha || 106 || na mādyaṃti yathā bhaikṣairbhikṣavopyatisaṃskṛtaiḥ || yathāmānasudhāpānairnunna bhikṣāṭanajvarāḥ || 107 || mahāviṣṇuruvāca || || eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yadahaṃ devatādhipam || paśyāmi tvāṃ devadevaṃ manorathapathātigam || 108 || anabhreyaṃ sudhāvṛṣṭiranāyāso mahotsavaḥ || ayatno nidhilābho yadvīkṣaṇaṃ harate satām || 109 || aviyogo'stu me deva tvadaṃghriyugalena vai || eṣa eva varaḥ śaṃbho nānyaṃ kaṃcidvaraṃ vṛṇe || 4.1.31.110 || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ bhavatu te'naṃta yattvayoktaṃ mahāmate || sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ varadastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 111 || anugṛhyeti daityāriṃ keṃdrādi bhuvane caran || bheje vimuktijananīṃ nāmnā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 112 || yatra sthitānāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm|| api brahmādi devānāṃ padāni vipadāṃ padam || 113 || varaṃ vārāṇasī vāsī jaṭī muṃḍī digaṃbaraḥ || nānyatracchatrasaṃchanna vasudhāmaṃḍaleśvaraḥ || 114 || varaṃ vārāṇasī bhikṣā na lakṣādhipatānyataḥ || lakṣādhīśo viśedgarbhaṃ tadbhikṣāśī na garbhabhāk || 115 || bhikṣāpi yatra bhikṣubhyo dattāmalakasaṃmitā || sumeruṇāpi tulitā vārāṇasyāṃ gururbhavet || 116|| varṣāśanaṃ hi yo dadyātkāśyāṃ sīdatkuṭuṃbine || yāvaṃtyabdāni tāvaṃti yugāni sa divījyate || 117 || vārāṇasyāṃ varṣabhojyaṃ yo dadyānnirupāyine || sa kadācittṛṭkṣudhā no duḥkhaṃ bhuṃkte nararṣabhaḥ || 118 || vārāṇasyāṃ nivasatāṃ yatpuṇyamupajāyate || tadeva saṃvāsayituḥ phalaṃ tvavikalaṃ bhavet || 119 || brahmahatyādi pāpāni yasyā nāmnopi kīrtanāt || tyajaṃti pāpinaṃ kāśī sā kenehopamīyate || 4.1.31.120 || kṣetre praviṣṭamātre'tha bhairave bhīṣaṇākṛtau || hāhetyuktvā brahmahatyā pātālatalamāviśat || 121 || kapālabrahmaṇo rudraḥ sarveṣāmeva paśyatām|| hastātpatitamālokya nanarta parayā mudā || 122 || vidheḥ kapālaṃ nāmuṃcatkaramatyaṃtaduḥsaham|| harasya bhramataḥ kvāpi tatkāśyāṃ kṣaṇato'patat || 123 || śūlino brahmaṇo hatyā nāpaiti sma ca yā kvacit || sā kāśyāṃ kṣaṇato naṣṭā kathaṃ kāśī na durlabhā ||124|| ataḥ pradakṣiṇīkāryā pūjanīyā purī tviyam || 125 || vārāṇasīti kāśīti mahāmaṃtramimaṃ japam || yāvajjīvaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ tu jaṃturjātu na jāyate || 126 || avimuktaṃ mahākṣetraṃ smaranprāṇāṃstu yastvajet || dūradeśāṃtarasthopi sopi jātu na jāyate || 127 || ānaṃdakānane yasya cittaṃ saṃsmarate sadā || tatkṣetranāmaśravaṇānna sa bhūyo'bhijāyate || 128 || rudrāvāse vasennityaṃ naro niyatamānasaḥ || enasāmapi saṃbhāraṃ kṛtvā kālādvimucyate || 129 || mahāśmaśānamāsādya yadi devādvipadyate || punaḥ śmaśānaśayanaṃ na kvāpi labhate pumān || 4.1.31.130 || kapālamocanaṃ kāśyāṃ ye smariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || teṣāṃ vinaṃkṣyati kṣipramihānyatrāpi pātakam || 131 || āgatya tīrthapravare snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || tarpayitvā pitṝndevānmucyate brahmahatyayā || 132 || aśāśvatamidaṃ jñātvā vārāṇasyāṃ vasaṃti ye || dehāṃte tatparaṃ jñānaṃ teṣāṃ dāsyati śaṃkaraḥ || 133 || iyaṃ kāśīpurī vipra sākṣādrudratanuḥ parā || anirvācyā parānaṃdā duṣprāpyeśavirodhibhiḥ || 134 || asyāstattvamahaṃ jāne śivabhaktiparopi vā || mucyaṃte jaṃtavo'traiva yathā yogena yoginaḥ || 135 || paraṃpadamiyaṃ kāśī parānaṃda iyaṃ purī || iyameva paraṃ jñānaṃ sevyā'sau mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 136 || atroṣitvāpīśabhaktānviruṇaddhi tu yaḥ kudhīḥ || puryaidruhyati vā mūḍhastasyānyatrātra no gatiḥ || 137 || kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ puraskṛtvā tu bhairavaḥ || tatraiva tasthau bhaktānāṃ bhakṣayannaghasaṃtatim || 138 || pāpabhakṣaṇamāsādya kṛtvāpāpaśatānyapi || kuto bibheti pāpebhyaḥ kālabhairavasevakaḥ || 139 || āmardayati pāpāni duṣṭānāṃ ca manorathān || āmardaka iti khyātastato'sau kālabhairavaḥ|| 4.1.31.140 || kalikālaṃ kalayati sadā kāśī nivāsinām|| ataḥ khyātiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ kālabhairavasaṃjñitām || 141 || sadaiva yasya bhaktebhyo yamadūtāḥ sudāruṇāḥ || paramāṃ bhīrutāṃ prāptāstatosau bhairavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 142 || mārgaśīrṣāsitāṣṭamyāṃ kālabhairavasaṃnidhau || upoṣya jāgaraṃ kurvanmahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate || 143 || yatkiṃcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mānuṣabuddhitaḥ || tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti kālabhairava darśanāt ||144|| anekajanmaniyutairyatkṛtaṃ jaṃtubhistvagham|| tatsarvaṃ vilayatyāśu kālabhairava darśanāt || 145|| kṛtvā ca vividhāṃ pūjāṃ mahāsaṃbhāravistaraiḥ || naro mārgāsitāṣṭamyāṃ vārṣikaṃ vighnamutsṛjet || 146 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ ravibhūmijavāsare || yātrāṃ ca bhairavīṃ kṛtvā kṛtaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 147 || kālabhairava bhaktānāṃ sadā kāśīnivāsinām || vighnaṃ yaḥ kurute mūḍhaḥ sa durgatimavāpnuyāt || 148 || viśveśvarepi ye bhaktā no bhaktāḥ kālabhairave || kāśyāṃ te vighnasaṃghātaṃ labhaṃte tu pade pade || 149 || tīrthe kālodake snātvā kṛtvā tarpaṇamatvaraḥ || vilokya kālarājaṃ ca nirayāduddharetpitṝn || 4.1.31.150 || aṣṭau pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pratyahaṃ pāpabhakṣaṇam || naro na pāpairlipyeta manovākkāyasaṃbhavaiḥ ||151|| tasminnāmardake pīṭhe japtvāsvābhīṣṭadevatām || ṣaṇmāsaṃ siddhimāpnoti sādhako bhairavājñayā || 152 || vārāṇasyāmuṣitvā yo bhairavaṃ na bhajennaraḥ || tasya pāpāni vardhaṃte śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī ||153|| yaṃ yaṃ saṃcitayetkāmaṃ pāpabhakṣaṇasevayā || balipūjopahāraiśca taṃ taṃ sa samavāpnuyāt || 154 || kālarājaṃ na yaḥ kāśyāṃ pratibhūtāṣṭamīkujam || bhajettasyakṣayetpuṇyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe yathā śaśī || 155 || śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmahatyāpanodakam || bhairavotpattisaṃjñaṃ ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 156 || baṃdhanāgārasaṃsthopi prāptopi vipadaṃ parām || prādurbhāvaṃ bhairavasya śrutvā mucyeta saṃkaṭāt || 157 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe bhairavaprādurbhāvonāmekatriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 31 ||
<4.1.32>
|| agastya uvāca || || barhiyāna samācakṣva harikeśasamudbhavam || kosau kasya sutaḥ śrīmānkīdṛgasya tapo mahat || 1 || kathaṃ ca devadevasya priyatvaṃ samupeyivān || kāśīvāsijanīnobhūtkathaṃ vā daṃḍanāyakaḥ || 2 || etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ prasādaṃ kuru me vibho || annadatvaṃ ca saṃprāptaḥ kathameṣa mahāmatiḥ || 3 || saṃbhramo vibhramaścobhau kathaṃ tadanugāminau || vibhrāṃtikāriṇau kṣetravairiṇāṃ sarvadā nṛṇām || 4 || || skaṃda uvāca || || samyagāpṛcchi bhavatā kāśīvāsisamāhitam || kuṃbhasaṃbhava viprarṣe daṃḍapāṇi kathānakam || 5 || yadākarṇya naraḥ prājña kāśīvāsasya yatphalam || niṣpratyūhaṃ tadāpnoti viśvabhartturanugrahāt || 6 || ratnabhadra iti khyātaḥ parvate gaṃdhamādane || yakṣaḥ sukṛtalakṣaśrīḥ purā parama dhārmikaḥ || 7 || pūrṇabhadraṃ sutaṃ prāpya so'bhūtpūrṇamanorathaḥ || vayaścaramamāsādya bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ || 8 || śāṃbhavenātha yogena dehamutsṛjya pārthivam || āsasādāśavaṃ śāṃtaṃ śāṃtasarveṃdriyārthakaḥ || 9 || pitaryuparateso'tha pūrṇabhadro mahāyaśāḥ || sukṛtopāttavibhava bhavasaṃbhogabhuktibhāk || 4.1.32.10 || sarvānmanorathām̐llebhe vinā svargaikasādhanam || gārhasthyāśrama nepathyaṃ pathyaṃ paitāmahaṃ mahat || 11 || saṃsāratāpasaṃtaptāvayavāmṛtasīkaram || apatyaṃ patatāṃ potaṃ bahukleśamahārṇave || 12 || pūrṇabhadro'tha saṃvīkṣya maṃdiraṃ sarvasuṃdaram || tadbālakomalālāpa vikalaṃ tyaktamaṃgalam|| 13 || śūnyaṃ daridrahṛdiva jīrṇāraṇyamivāthavā || pāṃthavatprāṃtaramiva khinno'tīvānapatyavān || 14 || āhūya gṛhiṇī so'tha yakṣaḥ kanakakuṃḍalām || uvāca yakṣiṇīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ pūrṇabhadro ghaṭodbhava || 15 || na harmyaṃ sukhadaṃ kāṃte darpaṇodarasuṃdaram || muktā gavākṣasubhagaṃ caṃdrakāṃtaśilājiram || 16 || padmarāgeṃdranīlārcirarcitāṭṭālakaṃ kvaṇat || vidrumastaṃbhaśobhāḍhyaṃ sphuratsphaṭikakuḍyavat || 17 || preṃkhatpatākānikaraṃ maṇimāṇikyamālitam|| kṛṣṇāgurumahādhūpa bahulāmodamoditam || 18 || anarghyāsanasaṃyuktaṃ cāruparyaṃkabhūṣitam || ramyārgalakapāṭāḍhyaṃ dukūlacchannamaṃḍapam || 19 || suramyaratiśālāḍhyaṃ vājirājivirājitam || dāsadāsīśatākīrṇaṃ kiṃkiṇīnādanāditam || 4.1.32.20 || nūpurārāvasotkaṃṭha kekikekāravākulam || kūjatpārāvata kulaṃ gurusārīkathāvaram || 21 || khelanmarālayugalaṃ jīvaṃ jīvakakāṃtimat || mālyāhūta dvirephāṇāṃ maṃjuguṃjāravāvṛtam || 22 || karpūraiṇa madāmoda sodarānilavījitam || krīḍāmarkaṭadaṃṣṭrāgrī kṛtamāṇikyadāḍimam || 23 || dāḍimībījasaṃbhrāṃtaśukatuṃḍāttamauktikam || dhanadhānyasamṛddhaṃ ca padmālayamivāparam || 24 || kamalāmodagarbhaṃ ca garbharūpaṃ vinā priye || garbharūpamukhaṃ prekṣye kathaṃ kanakakuḍale || 25 || yadyupāyo'sti tadbrūhi dhigaputrasya jīvitam || sarvaśūnyamivābhāti gṛhametadanaṃgajam || 26 || dhigetatsaudhasauṃdaryaṃ dhigetaddhanasaṃcayam || vināpatyaṃ priyatame jīvitaṃ ca dhigāvayoḥ || 27 || pralapaṃtamiva proccaiḥ priyaṃ kanakakuṃḍalā || babhāṣeṃ'tarviniḥśvasya yakṣiṇī sā pativratā || 28 || || kanakakuṃḍalovāca || || kimarthaṃ khidyase kāṃta jñānavānasi yadbhavān || atropāyo'styapatyāptyai visrabdhamavadhāraya || 29 || kimudyamavatāṃ puṃsāṃ durlabhaṃ hi carācare || īśvarārpitabuddhīnāṃ sphuṃraṃtyagre manorathāḥ || 4.1.32.30 || daivaṃ hetuṃ vadaṃtyevaṃ bhṛśaṃ kāpuruṣāḥ pate || svayaṃ purākṛtaṃ karma daivaṃ tacca na hītarat ||31|| tataḥ pauruṣamālaṃbya tatkarma pariśāṃtaye || īśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāyātsarvakāraṇakāraṇam || 32 || apatyaṃ draviṇaṃ dārā hārā harmya hayā gajāḥ || sukhāni svargamokṣau ca na dūre śivabhaktitaḥ || 33 || vidhātuḥ śāṃbhavīṃ bhaktiṃ priya sarve manorathāḥ || siddhayoṣṭau gṛhadvāraṃ sevaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || 34 || nārāyaṇopi bhagavānaṃtarātmā jagatpatiḥ || carācarāṇāmavitā jātaḥ śrīkaṃṭhasevayā || 35 || brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭikarttṛtvaṃ dattaṃ tenaiva śaṃbhunā || iṃdrādayo lokapālā jātā śaṃbhoranugrahāt || 36 || mṛtyuṃjayaṃ sutaṃ lebhe śilādopyanapatyavān || śvetaketurapi prāpa jīvitaṃ kālapāśataḥ || 37 || kṣīrārṇavādhipatitāmupamanyuravāptavān || aṃdhakopyabhavadbhṛṃgī gāṇapatyapadorjitaḥ || 38 || jigāya śārṅgiṇaṃ saṃkhye dadhīciḥ śaṃbhusevayā || prājāpatyapadaṃ prāpa dakṣaḥ saṃśīlya śaṃkaram|| 39 || manorathapathātītaṃ yacca vācāmagocaram|| gocaro gocarīkuryāttatpadaṃ kṣaṇato mṛḍaḥ || 4.1.32.40 || anārādhya maheśānaṃ sarvadaṃ sarvadehinām || kopi kvāpi kimapyatra na labheteti niścitam || 41 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja || yadicchasi priyaṃ putraṃ priyasarvajanīnakam || 42 || iti śrutvā vacaḥ patnyāḥ pūrṇabhadraḥ sa yakṣarāṭ || ārādhya śrīmahādevaṃ gītajño gītavidyayā || 43 || dinaiḥ katipayaireva paripūrṇamanorathaḥ || putrakāmamavāpoccaistasyāṃ patnyāṃ dṛḍhavrataḥ || 44 || nādeśvaraṃ samabhyarcya kaiḥ kairnāpi svaciṃtitam || tasmātkāśyāṃ prayatnena sevyo nādeśvaro nṛbhiḥ || 45 || aṃtarvatnyatha kālane tatpatnī suṣuve sutam || tasya nāma pitā cakre harikeśa iti dvija || 46 || prītidāyaṃ dadau cātha bhūriputrānanekṣaṇāt || pūrṇabhadrastathāgastya hṛṣṭā kanakakuṃḍalā || 47 || bālo'pi pūrṇacaṃdrābha vadano madanopamaḥ || vṛddhiṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ prāpa śuklapakṣa ivoḍurāṭ || 48 || yadāṣṭavarṣadeśīyo harikeśo'bhavacchiśuḥ || nityaṃ tadāprabhṛtyevaṃ śivamekamamanyata || 49 || pāṃsukrīḍanasaktopi kuryālliṃgaṃ rajomayam || śādvalaiḥ komalatṛṇaiḥ pūjayecca sa kautukam || 4.1.32.50 || ākārayati mitrāṇi śivanāmnā'khilāni saḥ || caṃdraśekharabhūteśa mṛtyuṃjaya mṛḍeśvaraḥ || 51 || dhūrjaṭe khaṃḍaparaśo mṛḍānīśa trilocana || bhargaśaṃbhopaśupate pinākinnugraśaṃkara || 52 || śrīkaṃṭhanīlakaṃṭheśa smarāre pārvatīpate || kapālinbhālanayana śūlapāṇe maheśvara || 573 || ajināṃbaradigvāsaḥ svardhunī klinnamaulija || virūpākṣāhinepathya gṛṇannāmāvalīmimām || 54 || savayaskāniti muhuḥ samāhvayati lālayan || śabdagrahau na gṛhṇītastasyānyākhyāṃ harādṛte || 55 || padbhyāṃ na padyate cānyadṛte bhūteśvarājirāt || draṣṭuṃ rūpāṃtaraṃ tasya vīkṣaṇena vicakṣaṇe || 56 || rasayettasya rasanā haranāmākṣarāmṛtam|| śivāṃghrikamalāmodādghrāṇaṃ naiva jighṛkṣati || 57 || karau tatkautukakarau mano manati nāparam || śivasātkṛtyapeyāni pīyate tena saddhiyā || 58 || bhakṣyate sarvabhakṣyāṇi tryakṣapratyakṣagānyapi || sarvāvasthāsu sarvatra na sa paśyecchivaṃ vinā || 59 || gacchangāyansvapaṃstiṣṭhañcchayāno'danpibannapi || paritastryakṣamaikṣiṣṭa nānyaṃ bhāvaṃ ciketi saḥ || 4.1.32.60 || kṣaṇadāsu prasuptopi kva yāsīti vadanmuhuḥ || kṣaṇaṃ tryakṣa pratīkṣasva budhyatīti sa bālakaḥ || 61 || spaṣṭāṃ ceṣṭāṃ vilokyeti harikeśasya tatpitā || aśikṣayatsutaṃ so'tha gṛhakarmarato bhava || 62 || ete turaṃgamā vatsa tavaite'śvakiśo rakāḥ || citrāṇīmāni vāsāṃsi sudukūlānyamūni ca || 63 || ratnānyākaraśuddhāni nānājātīnyanekaśaḥ || kupyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ caitadgodhanāni mahāṃti ca ||64|| amatrāṇi mahārhāṇi raupya kāṃsyamayāni ca || paṇanīyāni vastūni nānādeśodbhavānyapi || 65 || cāmarāṇi vicitrāṇi gaṃdhadravyāṇyanekaśaḥ || etānyanyāni bahuśastvaneke dhānyarāśayaḥ || 66 || etattvadīyaṃ sakalaṃvastujātaṃ samaṃtataḥ || arthopārjanavidyāśca sarvāḥ śikṣasva putraka || 67 || ceṣṭāstyaja daridrāṇāṃ dhūlidhūsariṇāmamūḥ || abhyasyavidyāḥ sakalā bhogānnirviśya cottamān || 68 || tāṃ daśāṃ caramāṃ prāpya bhaktiyogaṃ tataścara || asakṛcchikṣitaḥ pitretyavamanya gurorgiram|| 69 || ruṣṭadṛṣṭiṃ ca janakaṃ kadācidavalokya saḥ || nirjagāma gṛhādbhīto harikeśa udāradhīḥ || 4.1.32.70 || tataściṃtāmavāpoccairdigbhrāṃtimapi cāptavān || aho bāliśabuddhitvātkutastyaktaṃ gṛhaṃ mayā || 71 || kva yāmi kva sthite śaṃbho mama śreyo bhaviṣyati || pitrā nirvāsitaścāhaṃ na ca vedmyatha kiṃcana || 72 || iti śrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ piturutsaṃgavartinā || gadatastātapurataḥ kasyacidvacanaṃ sphuṭam || 73 || mātrā pitrā parityaktā ye tyaktā nijabaṃdhubhiḥ || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ vārāṇasī gatiḥ || 74 || jarayā paribhūtā ye ye vyādhivikalīkṛtāḥ || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ vārāṇasī gatiḥ || 75 || pade pade samākrāṃtā ye vipadbhiraharniśam || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃvārāṇasī gatiḥ || 76 || pāparāśibhirākrāṃtā ye dāridrya parājitāḥ || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ vārāṇasī gatiḥ || 77 || saṃsāra bhayabhītāya ye ye baddhāḥ karmabaṃdhanaiḥ || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ vārāṇasī gatiḥ || 78 || śrutismṛtivihīnā ye śaucācāravivarjitāḥ || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ vārāṇasī gatiḥ || 79 || ye ca yogaparibhraṣṭāstapo dāna vivarjitāḥ || yeṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti teṣāṃ vārāṇasī gatiḥ || 4.1.32.80 || madhye baṃdhujane yeṣāmapamānaṃ pade pade || teṣāmānaṃdadaṃ caikaṃ śaṃbhorānaṃdakānanam ||81|| ānaṃdakānane yeṣāṃ rucirvai vasatāṃ satām || viśveśānugṛhītānāṃ teṣāmānaṃdajodayaḥ || 82 || bharjyate karmabījāni yatra viśveśavahninā || ato mahāśmaśānaṃ tadagatīnāṃ parā gatiḥ || 83 || harikeśo vicāryeti yāto vārāṇasīṃ purīm || yatrāvimukte jaṃtūnāṃ tyajatāṃ pārthivīṃ tanum || 84 || punarno tanusaṃbaṃdhastanudveṣiprasādataḥ || ānaṃdavanamāsādya sa tapaḥ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 85 || atha kālāṃtare śaṃbhuḥ praviśyānaṃdakānamam || pārvatyai darśayāmāsa nijamākrīḍakānanam || 86 || amaṃdāmodamaṃdāraṃ kovidārapariṣkṛtam || cārucaṃpakacūtāḍhyaṃ protphullanavamallikam || 87 || vikasanmālatījālaṃ karavīravirājitam || prasphuṭatketakivanaṃ prodyatkurabakorjitam || 88 || jṛṃbhadvicakilāmodaṃ lasatkaṃkelipallavam|| navamallīparimalākṛṣṭaṣaṭpadanāditam || 89 || puṣpyapunnāganikaraṃ bakulāmodamoditam || medasvipāṭalāmoda sadāmodita diṅmukham || 4.1.32.90 || bahuśolaṃbirolaṃba mālāmālitabhūtalam || calaccaṃdanaśākhāgra ramamāṇapi kākulam || 91 || guruṇā'guruṇāmatta bhadrajātivihaṃgamam || nāgakesaraśākhāstha śālabhaṃji vinoditam || 92 || merutuṃga namerusthacchāyākrīḍitakiṃnaram || kiṃnarīmithunodgītaṃ gānavacchukakiṃśukam || 93 || kadaṃbānāṃ kadaṃbeṣu guṃjadrolaṃbayugmakam || jitasauvarṇavarṇocca karṇikāravirājitam || 94 || śālatālatamālālī hiṃtālī lakucāvṛtam || lasatsaptacchadāmodaṃ kharjūrīrājirājitam || nārikela tarucchanna nāraṃgīrāgaraṃjitam || 95 || phalijaṃbīranikaraṃ madhūkamadhupākulam || śālmalī śītalacchāyaṃ picumaṃda mahāvanam|| 96 || madhurāmoda damanacchannaṃ marubanoditam || lavalīlolalīlābhṛnmaṃdamārutalolitam || 97 || bhillī hallīsakaprīti jhillīrāvavirāviṇam || kvacitsaraḥ parisarakrīḍatkroḍakadaṃbakam || 98 || marālīgalanālīstha bisāsaktasitacchadam || viśokakokamithunakrīḍākreṃkārasuṃdaram || 99 || bakaśāvakasaṃcāraṃ lakṣmaṇāsakta sārasam || mattabarhiṇasaṃghuṣṭaṃ kapiṃjalakulākulam || 4.1.32.100 || jīvaṃjīvalasajjīvaṃ kvaṇatkāraṃḍavotkaṭam || dīrghikāvārisaṃcāri śītamāruta vījitam || 101 || madāṃdolitakahlāra parāgaparipiṃgalam || ullasatpaṃkajamukhaṃ nīleṃdīvaralocanam || 102 || tamālakabarībhāraṃ vilasaddāḍimīradam || bhramarālīlasadbhrūkaṃ śukanāsāvirājitam || 103 || mahāṃdhuśravaṇaṃ dūrvā śmaśrubhiḥ pariśobhitam || kamalāmodaniḥśvāsaṃ biṃbīphala radacchadam || 104 || supadmapatravasanaṃ karṇikāravibhūṣaṇam || kamrakaṃbu lasatkaṃṭhaṃ śaṃkaraskaṃdha baṃdhuram || 105 || gaṃdhasārasamāsaktā hīna dordaṃḍamaṃḍitam || aśokapallavāṃguṣṭhaṃ ketakīnakharojjvalam || 106 || lasatkaṃṭhīravoraskaṃ gaṃḍaśailapṛthūdaram || jalāvartalasannābhi tarujaṃghā yugānvitam || 107 || sthalabhākpadmacaraṇaṃ mattamātaṃgagāminam || lasatkadalikedāradalaccīnāṃśukāvṛtam || 108 || nānāsukumamālābhirmālitaṃ ca samaṃtataḥ || akaṃṭakitarucchannaṃ mahiṣa śvāpadāvṛtam || 109 || caṃdrakāṃtaśilāsuptakṛṣṇaiṇaharitoḍupam || taruprakīrṇakusuma jitasvarlokatārakam || darśayannitthamākrīḍaṃ devyai devoviśadvanam || 4.1.32.110 || || devadeva uvāca || || yathāpriyatamā devi mama tvaṃ sarvasuṃdari || tathā priyataraṃ caitanme sadānaṃdakānanam || 111 || atrānaṃdavane devi mṛtānāṃ madanugrahāt || vapustvamṛtatāṃ prāptamapunarbhavinastu te || 112 || bhavino ye vipadyaṃte vārāṇasyāṃ mamājñayā || teṣāṃ bījāni dagdhāni śmaśānajvaladagninā || 113 || mahāśmaśāne ye prāptā dīrghanidrāṃ girīṃdraje || na punargarbhaśayane te svapaṃti kadācana || 114 || brahmajñānena mucyaṃte nānyathā jaṃtavaḥ kvacit || brahmajñānamaye kṣetre prayāge vā tanutyajaḥ || 115 || brahmajñānaṃ tadevāhaṃ kāśīsaṃsthitibhāginām || diśāmi tārakaṃ prāṃte mucyaṃte te tu tatkṣaṇāt || 116 || gṛhṇīyuḥ pāpakarmāṇi kāśīmṛtaviniṃdakāḥ || sukṛtāni stutikṛto mucyaṃte te'tra jaṃtavaḥ || 117 || brahmajñānaṃ kuto devi kalinopahatātmanām || svabhāvacaṃcalākṣāṇāṃ tadbrahmeha diśāmyaham || 118 || yogino yogavibhraṣṭāḥ pataṃtyaiśvaryamohitāḥ || kāśyāṃ patitvā na punaḥ pataṃtyapi mahālaye || 119 || brahmajñānaṃ na viṃdaṃti yogairekena janmanā || janmanaikena mucyaṃte kāśyāmaṃtakṛto janāḥ || 4.1.32.120 || yatheha mucyate jaṃturgirije madanugrahāt || avimukte mahākṣetre na tathānyatra kutracit || 121 || bahujanmasamabhyāsādyogī mucyeta vā na vā || mṛtamātro vimucyeta kāśyāmekena janmanā || 122 || na sidhyati kalau yogo na sidhyati kalau tapaḥ || nyāyārjitadhanotsargaḥ sadyaḥ sidhyetkalau naraḥ || 123 || na vrataṃ na tapo nejyā na japo na surārcanam || dānameva kalau muktyai kāśīdānairavāpyate || 124 || kalau viśveśvaro devaḥ kalau vārāṇasī purī || kalau bhāgīrathī gaṃgā kalau dānaṃ viśiṣyate || 125 || gaṃgottaravahākāśyāṃ liṃgaṃ viśveśvaraṃ mama || ubhe vimuktide puṃsāṃ prāpye dānabalātkalau || 126 || puṇyavānitaro vāpi mama kṣetrasya sevayā || mukto bhavati deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 127 || avimuktasya māhātmyātpuṇyapāpena karmaṇā || devi prabhavataḥ puṃsāmapijanmaśatārjite || 128 || avimuktaṃ na moktavyaṃ tasmāddevi mumukṣuṇā || hanyamānena bahudhā hyupasargaśatairapi || 129 || vidhāya kṣetrasaṃnyāsaṃ ye vasaṃtīha mānavāḥ || jīvanmuktāstu te devi teṣāṃ vighnaṃ harāmyaham || 4.1.32.130 || na yogināṃ hṛdākāśe na kailāse na maṃdare || tathā vāsaratirme'sti yathā kāśyāṃ ratirmama || 131 || kāśīvāsi jano devi mama garbhe vasetsadā || atastaṃ mocayāmyaṃte pratijñeyaṃ yato mama || 132 || tāmasīṃ prakṛtiṃ prāpya kālo bhūtvā carācaram || grasāmi līlayā devi kāśīṃ rakṣāmi yatnataḥ || 133 || premapātradvayaṃ devi nitarāṃ netaranmama || tvaṃ vā tapodhane gauri kāśī vānaṃdabhūmikā || 134 || vinā kāśī na me sthānaṃ vinā kāśī na me ratiḥ || vinā kāśī na nirvāṇaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 135 || brahmāṃḍagolake yadvanmuktiḥ kāśyāṃ vyavasthitā || aṣṭāṃgayogayuktyā vā na tathā helayā'nyataḥ || 136 || iti bruvāṇo deveśo harikeśamavaikṣata || madhye vanaṃ tapasyaṃtamaśokatarumūlagam|| 137 || śuṣkasnāyupinaddhāsthi saṃcayaṃ niścalākṛtim || valmīkakīṭakākoṭiśoṣitāsṛgasṛgdharam ||138|| nirmāṃsakīkasacayaṃ sphaṭikopalaniścalam || śaṃkhakuṃdeṃdutuhina mahāśaṃkhalasacchriyam|| 139 || satvāvalaṃbitaprāṇamāyuḥśeṣeṇarakṣitam || niḥśvāsocchāsapavanavṛttisūcitajīvitam || 4.1.32.140 || nimeṣonmeṣasaṃcāra piśunīkṛtajaṃtukam || piṃgatārasphuradraśmi netradīpita diṅmukham || 141 || tattapogniśikhādāva cuṃbitamlānakānanam|| tatsaumyadṛksudhāvarṣa saṃsiktā'khilabhūruham || 142 || sākṣāttapasyaṃtamiva tapo dhṛtvā narākṛtim || nirākṛtiṃ nirākāṃkṣaṃ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ ca kāṃcana ||143|| kuraṃgaśāvairgaṇaśo bhramadbhiḥ parivāritam || nitāṃtabhīṣaṇāsyaiśca paṃcāsyaiḥ parirakṣitam || 144 || taṃ tathābhūtamālokya devī devaṃ vyajijñapat || vareṇacchaṃdayeśāmuṃ nijabhaktaṃ tapasvinam || 145 || tvadekacittaṃ tvadadhīnajīvitaṃ tvadekakarmāṇamamuṃ tvadāśrayam || tīvraistapobhiḥ pariśuṣkavigrahaṃ kuruṣva yakṣasya vairaranugraham || 146 || devo vṛṣeṃdrādavaruhya devyā śailādinā dattakarāvalaṃbaḥ || samādhisaṃkocitanetrapatraṃ pasparśa hastena dayārdracetāḥ || 147 || tataḥ sa yakṣo vinimīlya cakṣuṣī tryakṣaṃ puro vīkṣya samakṣamātmanaḥ || udyatsahasrāṃśu sahasratejasaṃ jagāda harṣākula gadgadākṣaram || 148 || jayeśa śaṃbho girijeśa śaṃkara triśūlapāṇe śaśikhaṃḍaśekhara || sparśatkṛpālo tava pāṇipaṃkajaṃ prāpyāmṛtībhūtatanūlato'bhavam || 149 || śrutvoditāṃ tasya maheśvaro giraṃ mṛdvīkayā sāmyamupeyuṣīṃ mṛdu || bhaktasya dhīrasya mahātaponidhe dadau varāṇāṃ nikara tadā mudā || 4.1.32.150 || kṣetrasya yakṣāsya mama priyasya me bhavādhunā daṃḍadharo varānmama || sthirastvamadyādi durātmadaṃḍakaḥ supālakaḥ puṇyakṛtāṃ ca matpriyaḥ || 151 || tvaṃ daṃḍapāṇirbhava nāmato'dhunā sarvāngaṇāñchādhi mamājñayotkaṭān || gaṇāvimau tvāmanuyāyinau sadā nāmnā yathārthau nṛṣu saṃbhramodbhramau || 152 || tvamaṃtyabhūṣāṃ kuru kāśivāsināṃ gale sunīlāṃ bhujageṃdra kaṃkaṇām || bhālesu netrāṃ karikṛttivāsasaṃ vāmekṣaṇālakṣita vāmabhāgām || 153 || maulau lasatpiṃgakapardabhāriṇī vibhūtisaṃkṣālita puṇyavigrahām || ahohimāṃśoḥ kalayā lasacchriyaṃ vṛṣeṃdralīlā gatimaṃdagāminīm || 154 || tvamannadaḥ kāśinivāsināṃ sadā tvaṃ prāṇado jñānada eka eva hi || tvaṃ mokṣado manmukhasūpadeśatastvaṃ niścalāṃ sadvasatiṃ vidhāsyasi || 155 || tvaṃ vighnapūgaiḥ paripīḍya pāpinaḥ saṃbhrātimutpādya vineṣyase bahiḥ || ānīya bhaktānkṣaṇatopidūrato muktiṃ parāṃ dāpayitāsi piṃgala || 156 || tvatsātkṛte kṣetravare hi yakṣarāṭkastvāmanārādhya vimuktibhājanam || sabhājanaṃ pūrvata eva te carettataḥ samarcāṃ mama bhakta ācaret || 157 || tvaṃ grāmavāsaprada eva me pure'dhyakṣastvamedhīha ca daṃḍanāyakaḥ || duṣṭānsamudghāṭaya kāśivairiṇaḥ kāśīṃ purīṃ rakṣa sadā mudānvitaḥ || 158 || pūrṇabhadrasutadaṃḍanāyaka tryakṣayakṣaharikeśa piṃgala || kāśivāsa vasatāṃ sadānnadajñānamokṣadagaṇāgraṇīrbhava || 159 || madbhaktiyuktopi vinā tvadīyāṃ bhaktiṃ na kāśī vasatiṃ labheta || gaṇeṣu deveṣu hi mānaveṣu tadagramānyo bhava daṃḍapāṇe || 4.1.32.160 || jñānodatīrthe vihitodakakriyo yastvāṃ samārādhayitā gaṇeśam || sa eva loke kṛtakṛtyatāmagānmamātulānugrahato'tra puṇyavān || 161 || tvaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi daṃḍapāṇe sadaiva me netrasamakṣamatra || tvaṃ daṃḍayanprāṇabhṛto durīhānihāsvanṝnsvānabhayaṃ diśanvai || 162 || || skaṃda uvāca || || iti dattvā varānvipra girīśo daṃḍapāṇaye || vṛṣeṃdramadhiruhyātha viveśānaṃdakānanam || 163 || kuṃbhodbhava tadārabhya yakṣarāḍdaṃḍanāyakaḥ || purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ samyaganuśāsti nideśataḥ || 164 || ahamapyatra vasatiṃ cakre tadanusūyayā || vasannapi mayā kāśyāṃ yataḥ saṃbhāvito na saḥ || 169 || mune kṣetraṃ yadatyākṣīstvamapyevaṃvidho vaśī || śaṃke tatrāhamevāddhā kāmaṃ tasyaiva vikriyām || 166 || manāgviruddhācaraṇaṃ yadi dvija vilakṣayet || harikeśastadā kāśyāṃ kva sthitiḥ kva ca nirvṛtiḥ || 167 || daṃḍapāṇimanārādhya kaḥ kāśyāṃ sukhamāpnuyāt || pravivikṣurahaṃ kāśīṃ dūragopi bhajāmi tam || 168 || ratnabhadrāṃgajodbhūtaṃ pūrṇabhadrasuto ttama || nirvighnaṃ kuru me yakṣa kāśīvāsaṃ śivāptaye || 169 || dhanyo yakṣaḥ pūrṇabhadro dhanyā kāṃcanakuṃḍalā || yayorjaṭharapīṭhebhūrdaṃḍapāṇe mahāmate || 4.1.32.170 || jaya yakṣapate dhīra jaya piṃgalalocana || jaya rpigajaṭābhāra jaya daṃḍa mahāyudha || 171 || avimukta mahākṣetra sūtradhārogratāpasa || daṃḍanāyaka bhīmāsya jaya viśveśvarapriya || 172 || saumyānāṃ saumyavadana bhīṣaṇānāṃ bhayānaka || kṣetrapāpadhiyāṃ kāla mahākālamahāpriya || 173 || jayaprāṇada yakṣeṃdra kāśīvāsānnamokṣada || mahāratnasphuradraśmi cayacarcita vigraha || 174 || mahāsaṃbhrātijanaka mahodbhrāṃti pradāyaka || abhaktānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ saṃbhrātyudbhrāṃti nāśaka || 175 || prāṃtanepathyacatura jayajñānanidhiprada || jayagaurīpadābjāle mokṣekṣaṇavicakṣaṇa || 176 || yakṣarājāṣṭakaṃ puṇyamidaṃ nityaṃ trikālataḥ || japāmi maitrāvaruṇe vārāṇasyāptikāraṇam || 177 || daṃḍapāṇyaṣṭakaṃ dhīmāñjapanvighnairna jātucit || śraddhayā paribhūyeta kāśīvāsaphalaṃ labheta || 178 || prādurbhāvaṃ daṃḍapāṇeḥ śṛṇvantotramidaṃ gṛṇan || vipattimanyataḥ prāpya kāśīṃ janmāṃtare labhet || 179 || śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ daṃḍapāṇisamudbhavam || paṭhitvā pāṭhayitvāpi na rvighrairabhibhūyatai || 4.1.32.180 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe daṃḍapāṇiprādurbhāvo nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
<4.1.33>
|| agastya uvāca || || skaṃdajñānodatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vada sāṃpratam || jñānavāpīṃ praśaṃsaṃti yataḥ svargaukasopyalam ||1|| || skaṃda uvāca || || ghaṭodbhava mahāprājña śṛṇu pāpapraṇodinīm || jñānavāpyāḥ samutpattiṃ kathyamānāṃ mayādhunā ||2|| anādisiddhe saṃsāre purā devayuge mune || prāptaḥ kutaścidīśānaścaransvairamitastataḥ || 3 || na varṣaṃti yadābhrāṇi na prāvartaṃta nimragāḥ || jalābhilāṣo na yadā snānapānādi karmaṇi || 4 || kṣārasvādūdayoreva yadāsījjaladarśanam || prathivyāṃ narasaṃcāre vatarmāne kvacitkvacit || 5 || nirvāṇakamalākṣetraṃ śrīmadānaṃdakānanam || mahāśmaśānaṃ sarveṣāṃ bījānāṃ paramūṣaram || 6 || mahāśayanasuptānāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ pratibodhakam || saṃsārasāgarāvarta patajjaṃtutaraṃḍakam || 7 || yātāyātātisaṃkhinna jaṃtuviśrāmamaṃḍapama || anekajanmaguṇita karmasūtracchidākṣuram || 8|| saccidānaṃdanilayaṃ parabrahmarasāyanam || sukhasaṃtānajanakaṃ mokṣasādhanasiddhidam || 9 || praviśya kṣetrametatsa īśāno jaṭilastadā || lasattriśūlavimalaraśmijālasamākulaḥ || 4.1.33.10 || āluloke mahāliṃgaṃ vaikuṃṭhaparameṣṭhinoḥ || mahāhamahamikāyāṃ prādurāsa yadāditaḥ || 11 || jyotirmayībhirmālābhiḥ paritaḥ pariveṣṭitam || vṛṃdairvṛṃdārakarṣīṇāṃ gaṇānāṃ ca niraṃtaram || 12 || siddhānāṃ yogināṃ stomairarcyamānaṃ niraṃtaram || gīyamānaṃ ca gaṃdharvaiḥ stūyamānaṃ ca cāraṇaiḥ || 13 || aṃgahārairapsarobhiḥ sevyamānamanekadhā || nīrājyamānaṃ satataṃ nāgībhirmaṇidīpakaiḥ || 14 || vidyādharīkinnarībhistrikālaṃ kṛtamaṃḍanam || amarīcamarīrāji vījyamānamitastataḥ || 15 || asyeśānasya talliṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvecchetyabhavattadā || snapayāmi mahalliṃgaṃ kalaśaiḥ śītalairjalaiḥ || 16 || cakhāna ca triśūlena dakṣiṇāśopakaṃṭhataḥ || kuṃḍaṃ pracaṃḍavegena rudrorudravapurdharaḥ || 17 || pṛthivyāvaraṇāṃbhāṃsi niṣkrāṃtāni tadā mune ||
