bhūpramāṇāddaśaguṇairyairiyaṃ vasudhāvṛtā || 18 || tairjalaiḥ snāpayāṃcakre tvatspṛṣṭairanyadehibhiḥ tuṣārairjāḍyavidhurairjaṃjapūkaughahāribhiḥ || 19 || sanmanobhirivātyacchairanacchairvyomavartmavat || jyotsnāvadujjvalacchāyaiḥ pāvanaiḥ śaṃbhunāmavat || 4.1.33.20 || pīyūṣavatsvādutaraiḥ sukhasparśairgavāṃgavat || niṣpāpadhīvadgaṃbhīraistaralaiḥ pāpiśarmavat || 21 || vijitābjamahāgaṃdhaiḥ pāṭalāmodamodibhiḥ || adṛṣṭapūrvalokānāṃ manonayanahāribhiḥ || 22 || ajñānatāpasaṃtapta prāṇiprāṇaikarakṣibhiḥ || paṃcāmṛtānāṃ kalaśaiḥ snapanātiphalapradaiḥ || 23 || śraddhopasparśi dṛdayaliṃga tritayahetubhiḥ || ajñānatimirārkābhairjñānadāna nidāyakaiḥ||24|| viśvabharturumāsparśasukhātisukhakāribhiḥ || mahāvabhṛthasusnāna mahāśuddhividhāyibhiḥ || 25 || sahasradhāraiḥ kalaśaiḥ sa īśāno ghaṭodbhava || sahasrakṛtvaḥ snapayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 26|| tataḥ prasanno bhagavānviśvātmā viśvalocanaḥ || tamuvāca tadeśānaṃ rudraṃ rudravapurdharam || 27 || tava prasannosmīśāna karmaṇānena suvrata || guruṇānanyapūrveṇa mamātiprītikāriṇā || 28 || tatastvaṃ jaṭileśāna varaṃ brūhi tapodhana || adeyaṃ na tavāstyadya mahodyamaparāyaṇa || 29 || || īśāna uvāca || || yadi prasanno deveśa varayogyosmyahaṃ yadi || tadetadatulaṃ tīrthaṃ tava nāmnāstu śaṃkara || 4.1.33.30 || ||viśveśvara uvāca || trilokyāṃ yāni tīrthāni bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ sthitānyapi || tebhyokhilebhyastīrthebhyaḥ śivatīrthamidaṃ param || 31 || śivajñānamiti brūyuḥ śivaśabdārthaciṃtakāḥ || tacca jñānaṃ dravībhūtamiha me mahimodayāt || 32 || ato jñānoda nāmaitattīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || asya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate| || 33 || jñānodatīrthasaṃsparśādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || sparśanācamanābhyāṃ ca rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ || 34 || phalgutīrthe naraḥ snātvā saṃtarpya ca pitāmahān || yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tadatra śrāddhakarmaṇā || 35 || gurupuṣyāsitāṣṭamyāṃ vyatīpāto yadā bhavet || tadātra śrāddhakaraṇādgayākoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 36 || yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti pitṝnsaṃtarpya puṣkare || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ jñānatīrthe tilodakaiḥ || 37 || sannihatyāṃ kurukṣetre tamograste vivasvati || yatphalaṃ piṃḍadānena tajjñānode dine dine||38|| piṃḍanirvapaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ jñānatīrthe sutaiḥ kṛtam|| modaṃte śivaloke te yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 39 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmupavāsī narottamaḥ || prātaḥ snātvātha pītāṃbhastvaṃtarliṃgamayo bhavet || 4.1.33.40 || ekādaśyāmupoṣyātra prāśnāti culukatrayam || hṛdaye tasya jāyaṃte trīṇi liṃgānyasaṃśayam ||41|| īśānatīrthe yaḥ snātvā viśeṣātsomavāsare ||| saṃtarpya devarṣi pitṝndattvā dānama svaśaktitaḥ || 42 || tataḥ samarcya śrīliṃgaṃ mahāsaṃbhāravistaraiḥ || atrāpi dattvā nānārthānkṛtakṛtyobhavennaraḥ || 43 || upāsya saṃdhyāṃ jñānode yatpāpaṃ kālalopajam | kṣaṇena tadapākṛtya jñānavāñjāyate dvijaḥ || 44 || śivatīrthamidaṃ proktaṃ jñānatīrthamidaṃ śubham || tārakākhyamidaṃ tīrthaṃ mokṣatīrthamidaṃ dhuvam || 45 || smaraṇādapi pāpaugho jñānodasya kṣayeddhruvam || darśanātsparśanātsnānātpānāddharmādisaṃbhavaḥ || 46 || ḍākinīśākinī bhūtapretavetālarākṣasāḥ || grahāḥ kūṣmāṃḍajhoṭiṃgāḥ kālakarṇī śiśugrahāḥ || 47 || jvarāpasmāravisphoṭadvitīyakacaturthakāḥ || sarve praśamamāyāṃti śivartārthajalekṣaṇāt|| || 48 || jñānodatīrthapānīyairliṃgaṃ yaḥ snāpayetsudhīḥ || sarvatīrthodakaistena dhruvaṃ saṃsnāpitaṃ bhavet || 49 || jñānarūpoha mevātra dravamūrtiṃ vidhāya ca || jāḍyavidhvaṃsanaṃ kuryāṃ kuryāṃ jñānopadeśanam || 4.1.33.50 || iti dattvā varāñchaṃbhustatraivāṃtaradhīyata || kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ sopyamaṃstatriśūlabhṛt || 51 || īśāno jaṭilo rudrastatprāśya paramodakam|| avāptavānparaṃ jñānaṃ yena nirvṛtimāptavān|| 52 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kalaśodbhava citrārthamitihāsaṃ purātanam || jñānavāpyāṃ hi yadvṛttaṃ tadākhyāmi niśāmaya || 53 || harisvāmīti vikhyātaḥ kāśyāmāsīdvijaḥ purā || tasyaikā tanayā jātā rūpeṇā'pratimā bhuvi || 54 || na samā śīlasaṃpattyā tasyā kācana bhūtale || kalākalāpakuśalā svareṇajitakokilā || 55 || na nārī tādṛgastīha nā bharī kinnarī na ca || vidyādharī na no nāgī gaṃdharvī nāsurī na ca || 56 || sarvasauṃdaryanilayā sarvalakṣaṇasatkhaniḥ || adhiśete dhruvaṃ dhvāṃtaṃ tanmauliṃ bradhna sādhvasāt ||97|| tadāsya śaraṇaṃ yāto manye darśabhayācchaśī || divāpi na tyajettāṃ tu trastaścaṃḍamarīcitaḥ || 58 || tadbhrūrbhramararājīva gaṃḍapatralatāṃtare || udaṃcannyaṃcaduḍḍīna gaterabhyāsabhājinī || 59 || taccārulocanakṣetre vicaraṃtau ca khaṃjanau || sadaiva śāradīṃ prītiṃ nirviśete nijecchayā || 4.1.33.60 || sudatyā radanaśreṇī chedeṣu viṣameṣuṇā || vihitā kāṃcanī rekhā kveṃdāvetāvatī kalā || 61 || prāyo madana bhūpāla harmya ratnāṃtare śubhe || jitapravālasucchāye tasyā radanavāsasī ||62|| svarge martye ca pātāle naiṣā rekhā kvacitstriyām|| tatkaṃṭharekhātritaya vyājena śapate smaraḥ || 63 || śaṃke citta bhuvo rājño lasatpaṭakuṭīdvayam || anarghyaratnakośāḍhyaṃ tamyā vakṣoruhadvayam || 64 || anaṃgabhū niyamato'dṛśye madhye natabhruvaḥ || romālīlakṣikāmūrdhvāmiva yaṣṭiṃ vidhirvyadhāt || 65 || tasyā nābhīdarīṃ prāpya kaṃdarpo'naṃgatā gataḥ || punaḥ prāptumivāṃgāni tapyate paramaṃ tapaḥ || 66 || guruṇaitannitaṃbena mahāmanmatha dīkṣayā || bhuvi ke ke yuvāno na svādhīnā prāpitādṛśām || 67 || ūrustaṃbhena caitasyāḥ staṃbhavatkasyano manaḥ || tastaṃbhena mune vāpi suvṛttena suvartanam || 68 || pādāṃguṣṭhanakhajyotiḥ prabhayā kasya na prabhā || vivekajanitā'dhvaṃsi mune tasyā mṛgīdṛśaḥ || || 69 || sā pratyahaṃ jñānavāpyāṃ snāyaṃ snāyaṃ śivālaye || saṃmārjanādi karmāṇi kurute'nanyamānasā || 4.1.33.70 || tatpādapratibiṃbeṣu rekhā śaṣpāṃkuraṃ caran || nānyadvanāṃtaraṃ yāti kāśyāṃ yūnāṃ manomṛgaḥ || 71 || tadāsya paṃkajaṃ hitvā yūnāṃ netrālimālayā || na latāṃtaramāsevi apyāmodaprasūnayuk || 72 || sulocanāpi sā kanyā prekṣetāsyaṃ na kasyacit || suśravā api sā bālā nādatte kasyacidvacaḥ || 73 || suśīlā śīlasaṃpannā rahastadvirahāturaiḥ || prārthitāpi surūpāḍhyairnābhilāṣaṃ babaṃdha sā || 74 || dhanaistasyājanetāpi yuvabhiḥ prārthito bahu || nāśakattāṃ sulīlāṃ sadātuṃ śīlorjitaśriyam || 75 || jñānodatīrthabhajanātsā suśīlā kumāgkiā || bahiraṃtastadā'drākṣītsarvaliṃgamayaṃ jagata || 76 || kadācidekadā tāṃ tu prasuptāṃ sadanāṃgaṇe || mohito rūpasaṃpattyā kaścidvidyādharo'harat || 77 || vyomavartmanitāṃ rātrau yāvanmalayaparvatam || sa ninīṣati tāvacca vidyunmālī samāgataḥ || 78 || rākṣaso bhīṣaṇavapuḥ kapālakṛtakuṃḍalaḥ || vasārudhiraliptāṃgaḥ śmaśrulaḥ piṃgalocanaḥ || 79 || rākṣasa uvāca || || mamadṛggocaraṃ yāto vidyādharakumāraka || adya tvāmetayā sārdhaṃ preṣayāmi yamālayam||4.1.33.80|| iti śrutvātha sā vākyaṃ vyāghrāghrātā mṛgī yathā || cakaṃpe'tīva saṃbhītā kadalīdalavanmuhuḥ || 81 || nijaghāna triśūlena rakṣo vidyādharaṃ ca tam || vidyādharakumāropi nitarāṃ madhurākṛtiḥ || 82 || tadbhīṣaṇatriśūlena bhinnosko mahābalaḥ || jaghāna muṣṭighātena vajrapātopamena tam || 83 || naramāṃsavasāmattaṃ vidyunmālinamāhave || cūrṇito muṣṭipātena so'patadvasudhātale || 84 || rākṣaso mṛtyuvaśago vajreṇeva mahīdharaḥ || vidyādharopi tacchūlaghātena vikalīkṛtaḥ || 85 || uvāca gadgadaṃ vākyaṃ vighūrṇita vilocanaḥ || priye mudhā samānītā suśityardhoktimuccaran || 86 || jahau prāṇānraṇe vīrastāṃ priyāṃ paritaḥ smaran || 87 || ananyapūrvasaṃsparśa sukhaṃ samanubhūya sā || tameva ca patiṃ matvā cakre śokāgnisāttanum || 88 || liṃgatrayaśarīriṇyāstasyāḥ sānnidhyataḥ sa hi || divyaṃ vapuḥ samāsādya rākṣasastridivaṃ yayau || 89 || raṇe paṇīkṛtaprāṇo vidyādharasutopi saḥ || aṃte priyāṃ smaranprāpa janurmalayaketutaḥ || 4.1.33.90 || dhyāyaṃtī sāpi taṃ bālā vidyādharakumārakam|| virahāgnau visṛṣṭāsuḥ karṇāṭe janmabhāgabhūt ||91|| suto malayaketostāṃ kālena pariṇītavān || mālyaketuranaṃgaśrīḥ pitrā dattāṃ kalāvatīm || 92 || sāpi prāgvāsanāyogālliṃgārcanaratā satī || hitvā malayajakṣodaṃ vibhūtiṃ bahvamaṃsta vai|| || 93 || muktā vaidūrya māṇikya puṣparāgebhya eva sā || mene rudrākṣanepadhyamanarghyaṃ garbhasuṃdarī || 94 || kalāvatī mālyaketuṃ patiṃ prāpya pativratā || apatyatritayaṃ lebhe divyabhogasamṛddhibhāk || 95 || ekadā kaścidaudīcyo mālyaketuṃ nareśvaram || citrakṛccitrapaṭikāṃ citrāṃ darśitavānatha || 96 || tāṃ tu citrapaṭīṃ rājā kalāvatyai samarpayat || sātha citrapaṭīṃ ramyāṃ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhā || 97 || muhurmuhuḥ prapaśyaṃtī rahasi prāṇadevatām || visasmāra svamapi ca samādhistheva yoginī || 98 || kṣaṇamunmīlya nayane kṛtvā netrātithiṃ paṭīm || tarjanyagramathotkṣipya svātmānaṃ samabodhayat ||99|| saṃbhedoyamase ramya upalolārkamagrataḥ || upaśrīkeśavapadaṃ varaṇaiṣā saridvarā ||4.1.33.100|| svageṃ prārthitasaṃsparśā saiṣā svargataraṃgiṇī || udagvahābhilaṣyaṃti yāṃ divodyusadaḥ sadā ||101|| alakṣyāmokṣalakṣmī ryā vedāṃte paripaṭhyate || vimuktaye satāṃ saiṣā śrīmatī maṇikarṇikā || 102 || maraṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ yatra saphalaṃ yatra jīvitam || svargastṛṇāyate yatra saiṣā śrīmaṇikarṇikā|| || 103 || yatra saṃpattisaṃbhārānviśrāṇya nidhanecchayā || yativrataṃ samālaṃbya tiṣṭhate mūlakaṃdabhuk || 104 || yatra trimārgaṃ gāṃgaṃ gāṃ mārgamāṇomṛtānharaḥ || svamaulibālacaṃdreṇa muktimārgaṃ pradarśayan || 105 || saṃsāraṃ yatra durvāraṃ pratārayati śaṃkaraḥ || mṛtā apyamṛtāyaṃte karṇadhārādyato narāḥ || 106 || saṃsārāsārapadavī yatra syādadavīyasī || karṇe japānmaheśānātkaruṇā varuṇālayāt || 107 || aneka bhavasaṃbhūta prabhūta sukṛtairnarāḥ || karṇe japaṃ bhavaṃ yatra labhaṃte te bhavāpaham || 108 || svīkṛtya kṣetrasaṃnyāsaṃ yadbalena mahādhiyaḥ || tṛṇaṃ kṛtātaṃ manyaṃte seyaṃ śrīmaṇikarṇikā || 109 || tṛṇīkṛtya nijaṃ dehaṃ yatra rājarṣisattamaḥ || hariścaṃdraḥ sapatnīko vyakrīṇādbhūrayaṃ hi sā || 4.1.33.110 || abhilaṣyaṃti yatratyamapi vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ || saikataṃ mṛdulaṃ talpaṃ saiṣā śrīmaṇikarṇikā || || 111 || aneka janma janita karmasūtraniyaṃtraṇam || unmucya yatra muktāḥ syuḥ saiṣā śrīmaṇikarṇikā || 112 || satyaloke'pi ye lokāste'rthayaṃti niraṃtaram || yāmaho dīrghanidrāyai seyaṃ śrīmaṇikarṇikā || 113 || ayaṃ hi sa kulastaṃbho yatra śrīkālabhairavaḥ || kṣetrapāpakṛtaḥ śāsti darśayaṃstīvrayātanām || 114 || anyatra vihitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyetkāśīnirīkṣaṇāt || kāśyāṃ kṛtānāṃ pāpānāṃ dāruṇeyaṃ tu yātanā ||115|| kapālamocanaṃ tīrthametattadapi pāvanam || kapālaṃ patitaṃ yatra vidherbhairavapāṇitaḥ || 116 || ṛṇatrayādvimucyaṃte yatra snātā narotamāḥ || tīrthaṃ viśuddhijanakaṃ tadetadṛṇamocanam || 117 || praṇavākhyaṃ paraṃbrahma yatra nityaṃ prakāśate || sapaṃcāyatanopeta oṃkāreśoyamadbhutaḥ || 118 || aśca uśca makāraśca nādobiṃduśca paṃcamaḥ || paṃcātmakaṃ paraṃbrahma yatra nityaṃ prakāśate ||119|| eṣā matsyodarī ramyā yatsnāto mānavottamaḥ || māturjātūdaradarīṃ na viśedeṣa niścayaḥ ||4.1.33.120|| trilocanoyaṃ bhagavānkuryādeva trilocanam|| nijabhaktaṃ kṛpāyuktastvapi deśātaṃra sthitam || 121 || asau kāmeśvaro devo yaḥ kāmānpūrayetsatām || durvāsā api yatrāpa nijakāmamahodayam || 122 || svayaṃ līno maheśotra bhaktakāmasamṛddhaye || tasmātsvarlīnasaṃjñāsya devadevasya śūlinaḥ || 123 || vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevo yaḥ purāṇeṣu paṭhyate || kṣetrābhimānī bhagavāṃstatprāsādoyamadbhutaḥ || 124 || asau skaṃdeśvaro devaḥ śraddhayā yadvilokanāt || ājanmabrahmacaryasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 125 || vināyakeśvaraścāyaṃ sarvasiddhi pradāyakaḥ || yatsevayā praṇaśyaṃti nṛṇāṃ sarve vināyakāḥ ||126|| iyaṃ vārāṇasī devī sākṣānmūrttimayī śubhā || yasyā vilokanātpuṃsāṃ bhūyo no garbhasaṃbhavaḥ|| ||127|| pārvatīśvaraliṃgasya mahadāyatanaṃ tvidam || yatra nityaṃ maheśāno gauryā saha vimuktidaḥ ||128|| eṣa bhṛṃgīśvaraḥ śrīmānmahāpātakanāśanaḥ || jīvanmukto'bhavadbhṛṃgī yasya liṃgasya sevayā || 129 || caturvedeśvaraścaiṣa caturvedadharo vidhiḥ || labhedyadvīkṣaṇādvipro vedādhyayanajaṃ phalam || 4.1.33.130 || yajñaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ caitalliṃgaṃ yajñeśvarābhidham || yadarcanāllabhenmartyaḥ sarvayāgaphalaṃ mahat || 131 || purāṇeśvara nāmaitalliṃgamaṣṭādaśāṃgulam || aṣṭādaśānāṃ vidyānāṃ syādādhāro yadīkṣaṇāt || 132 || dharmaśāstreśvaraścāyaṃ smṛtibhiśca pratiṣṭhitaḥ || smṛtyadhyayanajaṃ puṇyaṃ yadvilokanato bhavet || 133 || sārasvatamidaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvajāḍyavināśakṛt || sarvatīrtheśvaraṃ liṃgametatsadyo viśuddhidam ||134|| śaileśvarasya liṃgasya maṃḍapoyaṃ mahādbhutaḥ || sarveṣāṃ ratnajātānāṃ yo bibharti parāṃ śriyam || 135 || saptasāgarasaṃjñaṃ vai liṃgametanmanoharam || yadvīkṣaṇāllabhenmartyaḥ saptābdhisnānajaṃ phalam || 136 || asau maṃtreśvaraḥ śrīmānmaṃtrajāpyaphalapradaḥ || saptakoṭimahāmaṃtraiḥ sthāpito yaḥ purā yuge ||137|| tripureśasya liṃgasya puraḥ kuṃḍamidaṃ mahat || tripuraiḥ khānitaṃ pūrvaṃ tripurāripriyaṃ param ||138|| idaṃ vāṇeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sahasrabhujapūjitam || dvibhujasyāpi bāṇasya sahasrabhujahetukam || 139 || vairocaneśvaraścaiṣa puraḥ prahlādakeśavāt || balikeśavanāmāsāveṣa nāradakeśavaḥ || 4.1.33.140 || ādikeśava pūrveṇa tvayamādityakeśavaḥ || bhīṣmakeśavanāmāsau dattātreyeśvarastvayam || 141 || dattātreyeśvarātpūrvameṣa ādi gadādharaḥ || bhṛgukeśavanāmāsāveṣa vāmanakeśavaḥ || 142 || naranārāyaṇāvetau yajñavārāhakeśavaḥ || vidāranārasiṃhoyaṃ gopīgoviṃda eṣa ha || 143 || eṣa lakṣmīnṛsiṃhasya prāsādo ratnaketanaḥ || yasya prasādātprahlādaḥ padamaiṃdramavāptavān || 144 || akharvasiddhidaḥ puṃsāmeṣa kharvavināyakaḥ || śeṣamādhavanāmāsau śeṣeṇa sthāpitaḥ purā ||145|| yasya bhaktā na dahyaṃte tvapi saṃvartavahninā || śaṃkhamādhavanāmāsau śaṃkhaṃ hatvātra saṃsthitaḥ ||146|| idaṃ sārasvataṃ srotaḥ paraṃ brahmarasāyanam || sarasvatyā mahānadyāḥ saṃgamo yatra gaṃgayā || 147 || yatrāplutā narā bhūyaḥ saṃbhavaṃti na bhūtale || śrībiṃdumādhavastveṣa sākṣāllakṣmīpatiḥ paraḥ || 148 || śraddhayā yaṃ namanmartyo na vasedgarbhaveśmani || na dāridryamavāpnoti vyādhibhirnābhibhūyate || 149 || biṃdumādhavabhakto yastaṃ yamopi namasyati || praṇavātmā ya eko'sti nādabiṃdu svarūpadhṛk ||4.1.33.150|| amūrtaṃ yatparaṃ brahma biṃdumādhava eva saḥ || etatpaṃcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ paṃcabrahmātmasaṃjñakam ||151|| yatra snāto na gṛhṇīyāccharīraṃ pāṃcabhautikam || eṣā sā maṃgalāgaurī kāśyāṃ paramamaṃgalam || 152 || yatprasādādavāpnoti naro'tra ca paratra ca || mayūkhādityasaṃjñoyaṃ raśmimālī tamopahaḥ || 153 || gabhastīśo mahāliṃgametaddivyamahaḥpradam || mṛkaṃḍusūnunāpyatra tapastaptaṃ purā mahat || 154 || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya paramaṃ svanāmnāyuḥpradaṃ param || kiraṇeśvaranāmaitalliṃgaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 155 || sakṛnna tamidaṃ lokaṃ nayetkiraṇamālinaḥ || dhautapāpeśvaraṃ liṃgametatpātakadhāvanam || 156 || nirvāṇanarasiṃhoyaṃ bhaktanirvāṇakāraṇam || maṇipradīpanāgoyaṃ mahāmaṇivibhūṣaṇaḥ || 157 || yadarcanānnaro jātu na nāgaiḥ paribhūyate || kapileśamidaṃ liṃgaṃ kapilena pratiṣṭhitam|| || 158 || mucyaṃte kapayopyasya darśanātkimu mānavāḥ || priyavrateśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mahadetatprakāśate ||159 || yasyārcanāllabhejjaṃtuḥ priyatvaṃ sarvajantuṣu || idamāyatanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ maṇimāṇikyanirmitam || 4.1.33.160 || śrīmataḥ kālarājasya kalikālārtihāriṇaḥ || nijabhaktaṃ janaṃ pāti yaḥ pāpātpāpabhakṣaṇaḥ || 161 || kṣetravighnakarānpāpānyātayanyātanā śataiḥ || iyaṃ maṃdākinī ramyā tapastaptumihāgatā || 162 || kāśīvāsasukhaṃ prāpya nādyāpi divamīhate || snātvātra saṃtarpya pitṝñchrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || 163 || naro na narakaṃ paśyedapi duṣkṛtakarmakṛt || yāni kāni ca liṃgāni kāśyāṃ saṃti sahasraśaḥ || 164 || ratnabhūtamidaṃ teṣu liṃgaṃ ratneśvarābhidham || ratneśvaraprasādena bhuktvā ratnānyanekaśaḥ || 165 || puruṣārthamahāratnaṃ nirvāṇaṃ ko na labdhavān || kṛttivāseśvarasyaiṣā mahāprāsādanirmitiḥ || || 166 || yāṃ dṛṣṭvāpi naro dūrātkṛttivāsaḥ padaṃ labhet || sarveṣāmapi liṃgānāṃ maulitvaṃ kṛttivāsasaḥ || 167 || oṃkāreśaḥ śikhā jñeyā locanāni trilocanaḥ || gokarṇabhārabhūteśau tatkarṇau parikīrtitau ||168|| viśveśvarāvimuktau ca dvāvetau dakṣiṇau karau || dharmeśamaṇikarṇeśau dvau karau dakṣiṇetarau || 169 || kāleśvarakapardīśau caraṇāvatinirmalau || jyeṣṭheśvaro nitaṃbaśca nābhirvai madhyameśvaraḥ || 4.1.33.170 || kapardosya mahādevaḥ śirobhūṣā śrutīśvaraḥ || caṃdreśo hṛdayaṃ tasya ātmā vīreśvaraḥ paraḥ || 171 || liṃgaṃ tasya tu kedāraḥ śukraṃ śukreśvaraṃ viduḥ || anyāni yāni liṃgāni paraḥ koṭi śatāni ca || 172 || jñeyāni nakhalomāni vapuṣo bhūṣaṇānyapi || yāvetau dakṣiṇau hastau nityanirvāṇadau hi tau || 173 || jaṃtūnāmabhayaṃ dattvā patatāṃ mohasāgare || iyaṃ durgā bhagavatī pitṛliṃgamidaṃ param || 174 || iyaṃ hi citraghaṃṭeśī ghaṃṭākarṇa hradastvayam || iyaṃ sā lalitā gaurī viśālākṣīyamadbhutā || 175 || āśāvināyakastveṣa dharmakūpoyamadbhutaḥ || yatra piṃḍānnaro dattvā pitṝnbrahmapadaṃ nayet || 176 || eṣā viśvabhujā devī viśvaikajananī parā || asau baṃdī mahādevī nityaṃ trailokyavaṃditā || 177 || nigaḍasthānapi janānpāśānmocayati smṛtā|| daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthametattrailokyavaṃditam || 178 || yatrāhutitrayeṇāpi agnihotraphalaṃ labhet || prayāgākhyamidaṃ srotaḥ sarvatīrthottamottamam||179|| aśokākhyamidaṃ tīrthaṃ gaṃgākeśava eṣa vai|| mokṣadvāramidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svarga dvāramidaṃ viduḥ || 4.1.33.180 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe jñānavāpīvarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||33||
<4.1.34>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || punardadarśa tanvaṃgī citrapaṭyāṃ ghaṭodbhava || svargadvārātpurobhāge śrīmatīṃ maṇikarṇikām || 1 || saṃsārasarpadaṣṭānāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ yatra śaṃkaraḥ || apasavyena hastena brūte brahmaspṛśañchrutim || 2 || na kāpilena yogena na sāṃkhyena na ca vrataiḥ || yā gatiḥ prāpyate puṃbhistāṃ dadyānmokṣabhūriyam || 3 || vaikuṃṭhe viṣṇubhavane viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || japeyuḥ satataṃ muktyai śrīmatīṃ maṇikarṇikām ||4|| hutvāgnihotramapi ca yāvajjīvaṃ dvijottamāḥ || aṃte śrayaṃte muktyai yāṃ seyaṃ śrīmaṇikarṇikā || 5 || vedānpaṭhitvā vidhivadbrahmayajñaratā bhuvi || yāṃ śrayaṃti dvijā muktyai seyaṃ śrīmaṇikarṇikā || 6 || iṣṭvā kratūnapi nṛpā bahūnparyāptadakṣiṇān || śrayaṃte śreyase dhanyāḥ prāṃte'dhimaṇikarṇikam || 7 || sīmaṃtinyopi satataṃ pativrataparāyaṇāḥ || muktyai patimanuvrajya śrayaṃti maṇikarṇikām || 8 || vaiśyā api ca sevaṃte nyāyopārjitasaṃpadaḥ || dhanāni sādhusātkṛtvā prāṃte śrīmaṇikarṇikām|| 9 || tyaktvā putrakalatrādi sacchūdrā nyāyamārgagāḥ || nirvāṇaprāptaye caināṃ bhajeyurmaṇikarṇikām || 4.1.34.10 || yāvajjīvaṃ caraṃtopi brahmacarya jiteṃdriyāḥ || niḥśreyase śrayaṃtyenāṃ śrīmatīṃ maṇikārṇakām || 11 || atithīnapi saṃtarpya paṃcayajñaratā api || gṛhasthāśramiṇo nemāṃ tyajeyurmaṇikarṇikām ||12|| vānaprasthāśramayujo jñātvā nirvāṇasādhanam || sanniyamyeṃdriyagrāmaṃ maṇikarṇīmupāsate || 13 || ananyasādhanāṃ muktiṃ jñātvā śāstrairanekadhā || mumukṣubhistvekadaṃḍaiḥ sevyate maṇikarṇikā || 14 || daṃḍayitvā manovācaṃ kāyaṃ nityaṃ tridaṃḍinaḥ || naiḥśreyasīṃ śriyaṃ prāptuṃ śrayaṃte maṇikarṇikām || 15 || saṃnyastākhilakarmāṇo daṃḍayitvā calaṃ manaḥ || ekadaṃḍavratā muktyai bhajeyurmaṇikarṇikām || 15 || śikhī muṃḍī jaṭī vāpi kaupīnī vā digaṃbaraḥ || mumukṣuḥ ko na seveta muktidāṃ maṇikarṇikām ||17|| | tapaḥkartuṃ na śaktā ye dānaṃ vā dātumakṣamāḥ || yogābhyāsa vihīnā ye teṣāmeṣā vimuktidā || 18 || saṃtyupāyāḥ sahasraṃ tu muktaye na tathā mune || helayaiṣā yathā dadyānnirvāṇaṃ maṇikarṇikā || 19 || anaśanavratabhṛte trikālābhyavahāriṇe || prāṃte dadyātsamāṃ muktimubhābhyāṃ maṇikarṇikā || 4.1.34.20 || yathoktamācaredeko niṣṭhā pāśupataṃvratam || niraṃtaraṃ smaredeko hṛdyenāṃ maṇikarṇikām || 21 || dṛṣṭātra vapuṣaḥ pāte dvayośca sadṛśī gatiḥ || tasmātsarvavihāyāśu sevyaiṣā maṇikarṇikā || || 22 || svargadvāre viśeyurye vigāhya maṇikarṇikām || teṣāṃ vidhūtapāpānāṃ kāpi svargo na dūrataḥ || 23 || svargadvāḥ svargabhūreṣā mokṣabhūrmaṇikarṇikā || svargāpavargāvatraiva nopariṣṭānna cāpyadhaḥ ||24|| dattvā dānānyanekāni vigāhya maṇikarṇikām || svargadvāraṃ praviṣṭā ye na te nirayagāminaḥ ||25|| svargāpavargayorarthaḥ kovidaiśca nirūpitaḥ || svargaḥ sukhaṃ samuddiṣṭamapavargo mahāsukham || 26 || maṇikarṇyupaviṣṭasya yatsukhaṃ jāyate sataḥ || siṃhāsanopaviṣṭasya tatsukhaṃ kva śatakratoḥ || 27 || mahāsukhaṃ yaduddiṣṭaṃ samādhau vismṛtātmanām || śrīmatyāṃ maṇikarṇyāṃ tatsahajenaiva jāyate || 28 || svargadvārātpurobhāge devanadyāśca paścime || saubhāgyabhāgyaikanidhiḥ kācidekā mahāsthalī || 29 || yāvaṃto bhāsvataḥ sparśādbhāsaṃte saikatāḥ kaṇāḥ || tāvaṃto druhiṇā jagmurnaityeṣā maṇikarṇikā || 4.1.34.30 || saṃti tīrthāni tāvaṃti parito maṇikarṇikām || yāvadbhistilamātrāpi na bhūmirviralīkṛtā || 31 || yadanvaye kopi muktaḥ saṃprāpya maṇikarṇikām || tadvaṃśyāstatprabhāveṇa mānyāḥ svargaukasāmapi || 32|| tarpitāḥ pitaro yena saṃprāpya maṇikarṇikām|| saptasapta tathā sapta pūrvajāstena tāritāḥ || 33 || āmadhyāddevasarita ā hariścaṃdramaḍapāt || ā gaṃgā keśavādā ca svardvārānmaṇikarṇikā || || 34 || etadrajaḥkaṇatulāṃ trilokyapi na gacchati || etatprāptyai prayatate trilokastho'khilo bhavī ||35|| kalāvatī citrapaṭīṃ paśyaṃtītthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || jñānavāpīṃ dadarśātha śrīviśveśvaradakṣiṇe || 36 || yadaṃbusatataṃ rakṣeddurvṛttāddaṃḍanāyakaḥ || saṃbhramo vibhramaścāsau dattvā bhrātiṃ garīyasīm || 37 || yoṣṭamūrtirmahādevaḥ purāṇe paripaṭhyate || tasyaiṣāṃbumayī mūrtirjñānadā jñānavāpikā|| 38 || netrayoratithīkṛtya jñānavāpī kalāvatī || kadaṃbakusumākārāṃ babhāra kṣaṇatastanum || || 39 || aṃgāni vepathuṃ prāpuḥ svinnā bhālasthalī bhṛśam || harṣavāṣpāṃbukalile jāte tasyā vilocane || 4.1.34.40 || tastaṃbha gātralatikā mukhavaivarṇyamāpa ca || svarotha gadgado jāto vyabhraṃśattatkarātpaṭī || 41 || sākṣaṇaṃ svaṃ visasmāra kāhaṃ kvāhaṃ na vetti ca || sauṣuptāyāṃ daśāyāṃ ca paramātmeva niścalā || 42 || atha tatparicāriṇyastvaramāṇā itastataḥ || kiṃ kiṃ kimetadetatkiṃ pṛcchaṃti sma parasparam || 43 || tadavasthāṃ samālokya tāṃ tāścaturacetasaḥ || vijñāya sāttvikairbhāvairidamūcūḥ parasparam || 44 || bhavāṃtare premapātrametayaikṣitu kiṃcana || cirāttena ca saṃgatya sukhamūrcchāmavāpa ha || 45 || athanetthaṃ kathamiyamakāṃḍātparyamūmuhat || prekṣamāṇā rahaścitrapaṭīmati paṭīyasīm||46|| tanmohasya nidānaṃ tāḥsamyageva vicārya ca || upacerurmahāśāṃtairupacārairanākulam || 47 || kācittāṃ vījayāṃcakre kadalītālavṛṃtakaiḥ || bisinīvalayairanyā dhanyāṃ tāṃ paryabhūṣayat || 48 || amaṃdaiścaṃdanarasairabhyaṣiṃcadamuṃ parā || aśokapallavairasyāḥ kācicchokamanīnaśat || 49 || dhārāmaṃḍapadhārāṃbusīkaraistattanūlatām || iṣṭārthavirahaglānāṃ siṃcayāmāsa kācana || 4.1.34.50 || jalārdravāsasā kācidetasyāstanumāvṛṇot || karpūrakṣodajālepairanyāstāmanvalepayan || 51 || padminīdalaśayyā ca kācityaracayanmṛdum || kācitkuliśanepathyaṃ dūrīkṛtya tadaṃgataḥ || 52 || muktākalāpaṃ racayāṃcakre vakṣojamaṃḍale || kācicchaśimukhī tāṃ tu caṃdrakāṃtaśilātale || 53 || svāpayāmāsa tanvaṃgīṃ sravacchītāṃbuśītale || dṛṣṭvopacāryamāṇāṃ tāmitthaṃ buddhiśarīriṇī || 54 || atitāpaparītāṃgī tāḥ sakhīḥ pratyabhāṣata || etasyāstāpaśāṃtyarthaṃ jānehaṃ paramauṣadham || 55 || upacārānimānsavārndūrī kuruta mā ciram || apatāpāṃ karomyenāṃ sadyaḥ paśyata kautukam ||56|| dṛṣṭvā citrapaṭīmeṣā sadyo vihvalatāmagāt || atraiva kācidetasyāḥ premabhūrasti niścitam ||57|| ataścitrapaṭīsparśātparitāpaṃ vihāsyati || vākyādbuddhiśarīriṇyāstatastatparicārikāḥ || 58 || nidhāya tatpuraḥ procuḥ paṭīṃ paśya kalāvati || tavānaṃdakarī yatra kācidastīṣṭadevatā || || 59 || sāpīṣṭadevatānāmnā tatpaṭīdarśanena ca || sudhāsekamiva prāpya mūrchāṃ hitvotthitā drutam || 4.1.34.60 || avagrahaparimlānā varṣāsārairivauṣadhīḥ || punarālokayāṃcakre jñānadāṃ jñānavāpikām || 61 || spṛṣṭvā kalāvatī tāṃ tu vāpīṃ citragatāmapi || lebhe bhavāṃtarajñānaṃ yathāsītpūrvarjanmani || 62 || punarvicārayāṃcakre vāpī māhātmyamuttamam|| aho citragatāpīyaṃ saṃspṛṣṭā jñānavāpikā || 63 || jñānaṃ me janayāmāsa bhavāṃtara samudbhavam || atha tāsāṃ puro hṛṣṭā kathayāmāsa suṃdarī ||64|| nijaṃ prāgbhava vṛttāṃtaṃ jñānavāpīprabhāvajam || || kalāvatyuvāca || || etasmājjanmanaḥ pūrvamahaṃ brāhmaṇakanyakā || 65 || upaviśveśvaraṃ kāśyāṃ jñānavāpyāṃ rame mudā || janako me harisvāmī janayitrī priyaṃvadā || 66 || ākhyā mama suśīleti māṃ ca vidyādharo'harat || madhyemārgaṃ niśīthetha tadopa malayācalam || 67 || rakṣasā sahato vīro rākṣasaṃ sa jaghānaha || rakṣopi muktaṃ śāpāttu divyavapuravāpa ha || 68 || avāpa janmagaṃdharvastvasau malayaketutaḥ || karṇāṭanṛpateḥ kanyā babhūvāhaṃ kalāvatī || 69 || iti jñānaṃ mamodbhūtaṃ jñānavāpīkṣaṇātkṣaṇāt || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā sāpi buddhiśarīriṇī || 4.1.34.70 || tāśca tatparicāriṇyaḥ prahṛṣṭāsyāstadā'bhavan || procustāṃ praṇipatyātha puṇyaśīlāṃ kalāvatīm || 71 || aho kathaṃ hi sā labhyā yatprabhāvoyamīdṛśaḥ || dhigjanma teṣāṃ martye'sminyairnaikṣi jñānavāpikā || 72 || kalāvati namastubhyaṃ kurunopi samīhitam || janiṃ saphalayāsmākaṃ naya naḥ prārthya bhūpatim || 73 || ayaṃ ca niyamosmākamadyārabhya kalāvati || nirvekṣyāmo mahābhogāndṛṣṭvā tāṃ jñānavāpikām || 74 || avaśyaṃ jñānavāpī sā nāmnā bhavitumarhati || citraṃ citragatāpīha yā tava jñānadāyinī || 75 || oṃkṛtya tāsāṃ vākyaṃ sā svākāraṃ parigopya ca || priyāṇi kṛtvā bhūbhartuḥ prastāvajñā vyajijñapat || 76 || kalāvatyuvāca || jīviteśa na me tvattaḥ kiṃcitpriyataraṃ kvacit || tvāmāsādya patiṃ rājanprāptāḥ sarve manorathāḥ || 77 || eko manorathaḥ prārthyo mamāstyatrāryaputraka || vicārapathamāpannastavāpi sa mahāhitaḥ || 78 || mama tu tvadadhīnāyāḥ suduṣprāpataro mahān || tava svādhīnavṛttestu siddhaprāyo manorathaḥ || 79 || prāṇeśa kiṃ bahūktena yadi prāṇaiḥ prayojanam || tadābhilaṣitaṃ dehi prāṇā yāsyaṃtyathānyathā || 4.1.34.80 || prāṇebhyopi garīyasyāstasyā vākyaṃ niśamya saḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ rājā tasyāḥ svasyāpi ca priyam || 81 || rājovāca || || nāhaṃ priye tavādeyamiha paśyāmi bhāmini || prāṇā api mama krītāstvayā śīlakalāguṇaiḥ || 82 || avilaṃbitamācakṣva kṛtaṃ viddhi kalāvati || bhavadvidhānāṃ sādhvīnāmanye'prāpyaṃ na kiṃcana|| 83 || kaḥ prārthyaḥ prārthanīyaṃ kiṃ ko vā prārthayitā priye|| na pṛthagjanavatkiṃcidvartanaṃ nau kalāvati || 84 || deśaḥ kośo balaṃ durgaṃ yadanyadapi bhāmini || tattvadīyaṃ na me kiṃcitsvāmyamātramihāsti me || 85 || tacca svāmyaṃ mamānyatra tvadṛte jīviteśvari || rājyaṃ tyajeyaṃ tvadvākyāttṛṇīkṛtyāpi mānini || 86 || mālpaketormahījāneriti vākyaṃ niśamya sā || prāha gaṃbhīrayā vācā vacaścāru kalāvatī || 87 || kalāvatyuvāca || nātha prajāsṛjāpūrvaṃ sṛṣṭā nānāvidhāḥ prajāḥ || prajāhitāya saṃsṛṣṭaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 88 || tadvihīnājanirapi jala budbudavanmudhā || tasmādekopi saṃsādhyaḥ paratreha ca śarmaṇe || 89 || yatrānukūlyaṃ daṃpatyostrivargastatra vardhate || yaducyate purāvidbhiriti tattathyamīkṣitam ||4.1.34.90|| madvidhānā tu dāsīnāṃ śataṃ te'stīha maṃdire || tathāpi nitarāṃ prema svāmino mayi dṛśyate || 91 || tava dāsyapi bhogāḍhyā kimutāṃkasthalīcarī || tatrāpyananyasaṃpattistatra svādhīnabhartṛtā || 92 || vipaścitsaṃcayedarthāniṣṭāpūrtāya karmaṇe || taporthamāyurnirvighnaṃ dārāṃścāpatyalabdhaye || 93 || tavaitatsarvamastīha viśveśānugrahātpriya || pūraṇīyo'bhilāṣo me yadi tadvacamyahaṃ śṛṇu || 94 || tūrṇaṃ prahiṇu māṃ nātha viśvanāthapurīṃ prati || prāṇāḥ prayātā prāgeva vapuḥ śeṣāsmi kevalam || 95 || mālyaketuḥ kalāvatyā ityākarṇya vacaḥ sphuṭam || kṣaṇaṃ vicārya svahṛdi rājā provāca tāṃ priyām || 96 || priye kalāvati yadi tava gaṃtavyameva hi || rājyalakṣmyānayā kiṃ me calayā tvadvihīnayā || 97 || na rājyaṃ rājyamityāhū rājyaśrīḥ preyasī dhruvam || saptāṃgamapi tadrājyaṃ tayā hīnaṃ tṛṇāyate || 98 || niḥsapatnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhuktvā bhogānniraṃtaram || hṛṣīkārthāḥ kṛtārthāśca vidhṛtā ādhṛtiḥ priye || 99 || apatyānyapi jātāni kiṃ kartavyamihāsti me || avaśyameva gaṃtavyā''vābhyāṃ vārāṇasī purī || 4.1.34.100 || mālyaketuḥ priyāmitthamāśvāsya kṛtaniścayaḥ || samāhūya ca devajñānprakṛtīḥ paripūjya ca || 101 || putre rājyaṃ nidhāyātha rājā kāśīṃ pratasthivān || ratnajātaṃ kiyadapi putrādarthaṃ pragṛhya ca || 102 || dṛṣṭvā viśveśvarapurīṃ hṛṣṭaromā nareśvaraḥ || mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ saṃsārāṃbudhipāragam || 103 || prāgjanmavāsanāyogātsāpi rājñī kalāvatī || grāmāṃtarādāgateva purīmārgānavaitsvayama || 104 || maṇikarṇyāmathasnātvā bhūri dattvā tato vasu || viśveśamarcayitvātha ratnajātairanekaśaḥ || 105 || dattvā tatrāpi ratnāni gajānaśvāngavāṃ vrajam || dukūlāni vicitrāṇi pūjopakaraṇāni ca || 106 || suvarṇarūpyakalaśāndīpī darpaṇa cāmarān || dhvajastaṃbha patākāśca vicitrollocakāni ca || 107 || atha pradakṣiṇīkṛtya muktimaṃḍapamāviśat || tatra dharmakathāṃ śrutvā dattvā tatrāpi saddhanam || 108 || sāyaṃtanīṃ mahāpūjāṃ punaḥ kṛtvā kṣitīśvaraḥ || tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tauryatrika mahotsavaiḥ ||109|| atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtvā śaucācamakriyām || rājñyā vinirdiṣṭapathā jñānavāpīṃ nṛpo yayau ||4.1.34.110|| nṛpaḥ sārdhaṃ kalāvatyā tatra sasnau prahṛṣṭavat || atha piṃḍānsanirvāpya saṃtarpya śraddhayā pitṝn || 111 || tatra rūpya suvarṇādi pātrebhyaḥ pratipādya ca || dīnāṃdha kṛpaṇānāthānmahārhai ratnajātakaiḥ || 112 || prīṇayitvā narapatiḥ pāraṇāṃ kṛtavāṃstataḥ || saṃskārya ratnasopānairjñānavāpī kalāvatī || 113 || ābabaṃdha ratiṃ tatra saha bhartrā tapasvinī || ekāṃtaropavāsaiśca kadācicca tryahovrataiḥ || 114 || ṣaḍahobhojanaiścāpi pakṣārdhaniyamairatha || pakṣāṃtaropavāsaiśca māsopavasanādibhiḥ || 115 || cāṃdrāyaṇavrataiḥ kṛcchrairbhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇairapi || nināya kṣaṇavatkālamāyuḥśeṣasya sānaghā || 116 || ekadā jñānavāpyāṃ tu prātaḥ snātvopaviṣṭayoḥ || āgatya jaṭilaḥ kaścidvibhūtiṃ dattavānkare || 117 || uvāca ca prasannāsya āśīrbhirabhinadya ca || uttiṣṭhataṃ prakurutaṃ mahānepathyamadya vai || 118 || tārakodaya saṃprāptirbhavitrī vāṃ kṣaṇādiha || yāvaditthaṃ samācaṣṭa jaṭilo'gre tayorvacaḥ || 119 || tāvadvimānamāpannaṃ sakvaṇatkiṃkiṇīgaṇam || paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ candramaulirathorathāt || 4.1.34.120 || uttīrya tacchrutipuṭe kimapi svayamādiśat || anākhyaṃ yatparaṃjyotiruccakrāma ca tatkṣaṇāt || 121 || udyotayannabhovartma devopi svālayaṃ yayau || || skanda uvāca || || tadā prabhṛti loke'tra jñānavāpī viśiṣyate || 122 || sarvebhyastīrtharmukhyebhyaḥ pratyakṣa jñānadā mune || sarvajñānamayī caiṣā sarvaliṃgamayī śubhā || 123 || sākṣācchivamayī mūrtirjñānakṛjjñānavāpikā || santi tīrthānyanekāni sadyaḥ śucikarāṇyapi || 124 || paraṃtu jñānavāpyā hi kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || jñānavāpyāḥ samutpattiṃ yaḥ śroṣyati samāhitaḥ || na tasya jñānavibhraṃśo maraṇe jāyate kvacit || 125 || mahākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam|| mahādevasya gauryāśca mahāprītivivardhanam || 126 || paṭhitvā pāṭhayitvā vā śrutvā vā śraddhayānvitaḥ || jñānavāpyāḥ śubhākhyānaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || 127 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe jñānavāpīpraśaṃsanaṃ nāma catustriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
<4.1.35>
|| kuṃbhayoniruvāca || || avimuktaṃ mahākṣetraṃ paranirvāṇakāraṇam || kṣetrāṇāṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam || 1 || śmaśānānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śmaśānaṃ paramaṃ mahat || pīṭhānāṃ paramaṃ pīṭhamūṣarāṇāṃ mahoṣaram || 2 || dharmābhilāṣibuddhīnāṃ dharmarāśikaraṃ param || arthārthināṃ śikhiratha paramārtha prakāśakam || 3 || kāmināṃ kāmajananaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ ca mokṣadam || śrūyate yatra yatraitattatra tatra parāmṛtam || 4 || kṣetraikadeśavartinyā jñānavāpyāḥ kathāṃ parām || śrutvemāmiti manyehaṃ gaurīhṛdayanaṃdana || 5 || aṇupramāṇamapi yā madhye kāśivikāsinī || mahī mahīyasī jñeyā sā siddhyai na mudhā kvacit || 6 || kiyaṃti saṃti tīrthāni neha kṣoṇītale'khile || paraṃ kāśīrajomātra tulāsāmyaṃ kva teṣvapi || 7 || kiyaṃtyo na sravaṃtyotra ratnākara mudāvahāḥ || paraṃ svargataraṃgiṇyāḥ kāśyāṃ kā sāmyamudvahet || 8 || kiyaṃti saṃti no bhūmyāṃ mokṣakṣetrāṇi ṣaṇmukha || paraṃ manye'vimuktasya koṭyaṃśopi na teṣvaho || 9 || gaṃgā viśveśvaraḥ kāśī jāgarti tritayaṃ yataḥ || tatra naiḥśreyasī lakṣmīrlabhyate citramatra kim || 4.1.35.10 || kathameṣā trayī skaṃda prāpyate niyataṃ naraiḥ || tiṣye yuge viśeṣeṇa nitarāṃ caṃcaleṃdriyaiḥ || 11 || tapastādṛkkva vā tiṣye tiṣye yogaḥ kva tādṛśaḥ || kva vā vrataṃ kva vā dānaṃ tiṣye mokṣastvataḥ kutaḥ || 12|| vināpi tapasā skaṃda vināyogena ṣaṇmukha || vinā vratairvinā dānaiḥ kāśyāṃ mokṣastvayeritaḥ || 13 || kiṃ kimācaratā skaṃda kāśī prāpyeta tadvada || manye vinā sadācāraṃ na siddhyeyurmanorathāḥ || 14 || ācāraḥ paramo dharma ācāraḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ || ācārādvardhate hyāyurācārātpāpasaṃkṣayaḥ || 15 || ācārameva prathamaṃ tasmādācakṣva ṣaṇmukha || devadevo yathā prāha tavāgre tvaṃ tathā vada || 16 || || skaṃda uvāca|| || mitrāvaruṇajākhyāmi sadācāraṃ satāṃ hitam || yadācarannaro nityaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||17|| sthāvarāḥ kṛmayo'bjāśca pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo narāḥ || krameṇa dhārmikāstvete hyetebhyo dhārmikāḥ surāḥ || 18 || sahasrabhāgaḥ prathamā dvitīyonukramāttathā || sarva ete mahābhāgā yāvanmukti samāśrayāḥ || 19 || caturṇāmapi bhūtānāṃ prāṇino'tīva cottamāḥ || prāṇibhyāmapi mune śreṣṭhāḥ sarve buddhyupajīvinaḥ || 4.1.35.20 || matimadbhyo narāḥ śreṣṭhāstebhyaḥ śreṣṭhāstu vāḍavāḥ || viprebhyopi ca vidvāṃso vidvadbhyaḥ kṛtabuddhayaḥ || 21 || kṛtadhībhyopi kartāraḥ kartṛbhyo brahmatatparāḥ || na teṣāmarcanīyo'nyastriṣu lokeṣu kuṃbhaja || 22 || anyonyamarcakāste vai tapovidyā'viśeṣataḥ || brāhmaṇo brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaḥ sarvabhūteśvaro yataḥ || 23 || ato jagatsthitaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇo'rhati nāparaḥ || sadācāro hi sarvārho nācārādvicyutaḥ punaḥ || tasmādvipreṇa satataṃ bhāvyamācāraśīlinā || 24 || vidveṣa rāgarahitā anutiṣṭhaṃti yaṃ mune || vidvāṃsastaṃ sadācāraṃ dharmamūlaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ||25|| lakṣaṇaiḥ parihīnopi samyagācāratatparaḥ || śraddhāluranasūyuśca naro jīvetsamāḥ śatama || 26 || śrutismṛtibhyāmuditaṃ sveṣu sveṣu ca karmasu || sadācāraṃ niṣeveta dharmamūlamataṃdritaḥ || 27 || durācārarato loke garhaṇīyaḥ pumānbhavet || vyādhibhiścābhibhūyeta sadālpāyuḥ suduḥkhabhāk || 28 || tyājyaṃ karma parādhīnaṃ kāyamātmavaśaṃ sadā || duḥkhī yataḥ parādhīnaḥ sadaivātmavaśaḥ sukhī || 29 || yasminkarmaṇyaṃtarātmā kriyamāṇe prasīdati || tadeva karma kartavyaṃ viparītaṃ na ca kvacit || 4.1.35.30 || prathamaṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ proktā yanniyamā yamāḥ || atasteṣveva vai yatnaḥ kartavyo dharmamicchatā || 31 || satyaṃ kṣamārjavaṃ dhyānamānṛśaṃsyamahiṃsanam || damaḥ prasādo mādhuryaṃ mṛduteti yamā daśa || 32 || śaucaṃ snānaṃ tapo dānaṃ maunejyādhyayanaṃ vratam || upoṣaṇopastha daṃḍau daśaite niyamāḥ smṛtāḥ || 33 || kāmaṃ krodhaṃ madaṃ mohaṃ mātsaryaṃ lobhameva ca || amūnṣaḍvai(?)riṇo jitvā sarvatra vijayī bhavet || 34 || śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sa cinuyāddharmaṃ valmīka śṛṃgavat || parapīḍāmakurvāṇaḥ paralokasahāyinam || 35 || dharma eva sahāyī syādamutra na paricchadaḥ || pitṛ mātṛ suta bhrātṛ yoṣidbaṃdhujanādikaḥ || 36 || jāyate caikalaḥ prāṇī pramriyeta tathaikalaḥ || ekalaḥ sukṛtaṃ bhuṃkte bhuṃkte duṣkṛtamekalaḥ || 37 || dehaṃ paṃcatvamāpannaṃ tyaktvā kau kāṣṭhaloṣṭhavat || bāṃdhavā vimukhā yāṃti dharmo yāṃtamanuvrajet ||38|| kṛtī saṃcinuyāddharmaṃ tato'mutra sahāyinam || dharmaṃ sahāyinaṃ labddhvā saṃtareddustaraṃ tamaḥ || 39 || saṃbaṃdhānācarennityamuttamairuttamaiḥ sudhīḥ || adhamānadhamāṃstyaktvā kulamutkarṣatāṃ nayet|| 4.1.35.40 || uttamānuttamāneva gacchanhīnāṃśca varjayan || brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhatāmeti pratyavāye na śūdratām || 41 || anadhyayanaśīlaṃ ca sadācāravilaṃghinam|| sālasaṃ ca durannādaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bādhateṃ'takaḥ || 42 || tato'bhyasetprayatnena sadācāraṃ sadā dvijaḥ || tīrthānyapyabhilaṣyaṃti sadācārisamāgamam|| 43 || rajanīprāṃtayāmārdhaṃ bāhmaḥ samaya ucyate || svahitaṃ ciṃtayetprājñastasmiṃścotthāya savardā || 44 || gajāsyaṃ saṃsmaredādau tata īśaṃ sahāṃbayā|| śrīraṃgaṃ śrīsametaṃ tu brahmāṇyā kamalodbhavam|| 45 || iṃdrādīnsakalāndevānvasiṣṭhādīnmunīnapi || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ śrīśailādyakhilāngirīn || 46 || kṣīrodādīnsamudrāṃśca mānasādi sarāṃsi ca || vanāni naṃdanādīni dhenūḥ kāmadughādikāḥ || 47 || kalpavṛkṣādi vṛkṣāṃśca dhātūnkāṃcanamukhyataḥ || divyastrīrurvaśīmukhyā garuḍādīnpatattriṇaḥ || 48 || nāgāśca śeṣapramukhāngajānairāvatādikān|| aśvānuccaiḥśravo mukhyānkaustubhādīnmaṇīñchubhān || 49 || smaredaruṃdhatīmukhyāḥ pativratavatīrvadhūḥ || naimiṣādīnyaraṇyāni purīḥ kāśīpurīmukhāḥ || 4.1.35.50 || viśveśādīni liṃgāni vedānṛkpramukhānapi || gāyatrīpramukhānmaṃtrānyoginaḥ sanakādikān || 51 || praṇavādimahābījaṃ nāradādīṃśca vaiṣṇavān || śivabhaktāṃśca bāṇādīnprahlādādīndṛḍhavratān || 52 || vadānyāṃśca dadhīcyādīnhariścaṃdrādi bhūpatīn || jananī caraṇau smṛtvā sarvatīrthottamottamau || 53 || pitaraṃ ca gurūṃścāpi hṛdi dhyātvā prasannadhīḥ || tataścāvaśyakaṃ kartuṃ nairṛtīṃ diśamāśrayet || 54 || grāmāddhanuḥśataṃ gacchennagarācca caturguṇam || tṛṇairācchādya vasudhāṃ śiraḥ prāvṛtya vāsasā ||55 || karṇopavītyudagvaktro divase saṃdhyayorapi || viṇmūtre visṛjenmaunī niśāyāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 56 || na tiṣṭhannāpsu no vipra go vahnyanila saṃmukhaḥ || na phālakṛṣṭe bhūbhāge na rathyāsevyabhūtale || 57 || nālokayeddiśobhāgāñjyotiścakraṃ nabhomalam || vāmena pāṇinā śiśnaṃ dhṛtvottiṣṭhetprayatnavān || 58 || atho mṛdaṃ samādāya jaṃtukarkaravarjitām || vihāya mūṣakotkhātāṃ śaucocchiṣṭāṃ ca nākulām || 59 || guhye dadyānmṛdaṃ caikāṃ pāyau paṃcāṃbusāṃ tarāḥ || daśa vāmakare cāpi sapta pāṇidvaye mṛdaḥ || 4.1.35.60 || ekaikāṃ pādayordadyāttisraḥ pāṇyormṛdastathā || itthaṃ śaucaṃ gṛhī kuryādgaṃdhalepakṣayāvadhi || 61 || kramāddvaiguṇyametasmādbrahmacaryādiṣu triṣu || divāvihita śaucasya rātrāvardhaṃ samācaret || 62 || rujyardhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ca pathi caurādi bādhite || tadardhaṃ yoṣitāṃ cāpi susthe nyūnaṃ na kārayet ||63|| api sarvanadītoyairmṛtkūṭaiścāpi gomayaiḥ || āpādamācaracchaucaṃ bhāvaduṣṭo na śuddhibhāk ||64|| ārdradhātrīphalonmānā mṛdaḥ śauce prakīrtitāḥ|| sarvāścāhutayopyevaṃ grāsāścāṃdrāyaṇepi ca || prāgāsya udagāsyovā sūpaviṣṭaḥ śucau bhuvi|| upaspṛśedvihīnāyāṃ tuṣāṃgārāsthibhasmabhiḥ || 66|| anuṣṇābhiraphenābhiradbhirhṛdgābhiratvaraḥ || brāhmaṇo brāhmatīrthena dṛṣṭipūtābhirācamet || 67|| kaṃṭhagābhirnṛpaḥ śuddhyettālugābhistathorujaḥ || strīśūdrāvāsya saṃsparśamātreṇāpi viśuddhyataḥ || 68 || śiraḥ prāvṛtya kaṃṭhaṃ vā jale muktaśikho'pi ca || akṣālitapadadvaṃdva ācāṃtopyaśucirmataḥ || 69 || triḥ pītvāṃbu viśuddhyarthaṃ tataḥ khāni viśodhayet || aṃguṣṭhamūladeśena dvirdviroṣṭhādharau spṛśet || 4.1.35.70 || aṃgulībhistribhiḥ paścātpunarāsyaṃ spṛśetsudhīḥ || tarjanyaṃguṣṭhakoṭyā ca ghrāṇaraṃdhre punaḥ punaḥ || 71 || aṃguṣṭhānāmikāgrābhyāṃ cakṣuḥ śrotre punaḥ punaḥ || kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhayogena nābhiraṃdhramupaspṛśet || 72 || spṛṣṭvā talena hṛdayaṃ samastābhiḥ śiraḥ spṛśet || aṃgulyagraistathā skaṃdhau sāṃbu sarvatra saṃspṛśet || 73 || ācāṃtaḥ punarācāmetkṛte rathyopasarpaṇe || snātvā bhuktvā payaḥ pītvā prāraṃbhe śubhakarmaṇām || 74 || suptvā vāsaḥ parīdhāya tathā dṛṣṭvāpyamaṃgalam || pramādādaśuciṃ spṛṣṭvā dvirācāṃtaḥ śucirbhavet || 75 || atho mukhaviśuddhyarthaṃ gṛhṇīyāddaṃtadhāvanam || ācāṃtopyaśuciryasmādakṛtvā daṃtadhāvanam|| 76 || pratipaddarśaṣaṣṭhīṣu navamyāṃ ravivāsare || daṃtānāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃyogo dahedāsaptamaṃ kulam || 77|| alābhe daṃtakāṣṭhānāṃ niṣiddhe vātha vāsare || gaṃḍūṣā dvādaśa grāhyā mukhasya pariśuddhaye || 78 || kaniṣṭhāgra parīmāṇaṃ satvacaṃ nirvraṇaṃ ṛjum || dvādaśāṃgulamānaṃ ca sārdhaṃ syāddaṃtadhāvanam || 79 || ekaikāṃgulahrāsena varṇeṣvanyeṣu kīrtitam || āmrāmrātaka dhātrīṇāṃ kaṃkola khadirodbhavam || 4.1.35.80 || śamyapāmārgakharjūrīśeluśrīparṇipīlujam|| rājādanaṃ ca nāraṃgaṃ kaṣāyakaṭukaṃṭakam||81|| kṣīravṛkṣodbhavaṃ vāpi praśastaṃ daṃtadhāvanam|| jihvollekhanikāṃ cāpi kuryāccāpākṛtiṃ śubhām|| 82|| annādyāya vyūhadhvaṃ somorājāya mā gamat || same mukhaṃ pramārkṣyate yaśasā ca bhagena ca || 83 || āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśu vasūni ca || brahma prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvanno dehi vanaspate || 84 || maṃtrāvetau samuccārya yaḥ kuryāddaṃtadhāvanam || vanaspatigataḥ somastasya nityaṃ prasīdati || 85 || mukhe paryuṣite yasmādbhavedaśucibhāgnaraḥ || tataḥ kuryātprayatnena śuddhyarthaṃ daṃtadhāvanam || 86 || upavāsepi no duṣyeddaṃtadhāvanamaṃjanam || gaṃdhālaṃkārasadvastrapuṣpamālānulepanam || 87 || prātaḥsaṃdhyāṃ tataḥ kuryāddaṃtadhāvanapūrvikām || prātaḥsnānaṃ caritvā ca śuddhe tīrthe viśeṣataḥ || 88 || prātaḥsnānādyataḥśuddhyetkāyoyaṃ malinaḥ sadā || chidrito navabhiśchidraiḥ sravatyeva divāniśam || 89 || utsāha medhā saubhāgya rūpa saṃpatpravartakam || manaḥ prasannatāhetuḥ prātaḥsnānaṃ praśasyate || 4.1.35.90 || prasveda lālādyāklinno nidrādhīno yato naraḥ || prātaḥsnānāttatorhaḥ syānmaṃtrastotrajapādiṣu||91|| prātaḥprātastu yatsnānaṃ saṃjāte cāruṇodaye || prājāpatyasamaṃ prāhustanmahāghavighātakṛt || 92 || prātaḥsnānaṃ haretpāpamalakṣmīṃ glānimeva ca || aśucitvaṃ ca duḥsvapnaṃ tuṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ prayacchati || 93 || nopasarpaṃti vai duṣṭāḥ prātaḥsnāyijana kvacit || dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaṃ yasmātprātaḥsnānaṃ samācaret || 94 || prasaṃgataḥ snānavidhiṃ vakṣyāmi kalaśodbhava || vidhisnānaṃ yataḥ prāhuḥ snānācchataguṇottaram || 95 || viśuddhāṃ mṛdamādāya barhīṃṣi tila gomayam || śucau deśe paristhāpya tvācamya snānamācaret || 96 || upagrahī baddhaśikho jalamadhye samāviśet || urum̐ hīti maṃtreṇa toyamāvartya sṛṣṭitaḥ || 97 || ye te śataṃ tato japtvā toyasyāmaṃtraṇāya ca || sumitriyā no maṃtreṇa pūrvaṃ kṛtvā jalāṃjalim || kṣipeddveṣyaṃ samuddiśya japandurmitriyā iti || 98 || idaṃ viṣṇurimaṃ japtvā liṃpedaṃgāni mṛtsnayā || mṛdaikayā śiraḥ kṣālya dvābhyāṃ nābhestathopari || 99 || nābheradhastu tisṛbhiḥ pādau ṣaḍbhirviśodhayet || || majjetpravāhābhimukha āpo asmānimaṃ japan ||4.1.35.100|| udidābhyaḥ śuciriti maṃtra unmajjane mataḥ || mānastoka imaṃ japtvā liṃpedgātrāṇi gomayaiḥ || 101 || imaṃ me varuṇetyādi maṃtraḥ svātmābhiṣecanam || tattvāyāmi tathātvannaḥ satvaṃ naścāpyuduttamam || 102 || dhāmnodhāmnastathā māpo mauṣadhīriti saṃjapet || yadāhuraghnyā muṃcaṃtu meti cāvabhṛtheti ca || 103 || abdaivatā ime maṃtrāḥ proktāḥ svātmābhiṣecane || praṇavena tato vipro mahāvyāhṛtibhistataḥ || 104 || ātmānaṃ pāvayedvidvāngāyatryā ca tataḥ kṛtī || āpo hiṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ pratyṛcaṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam || 105 || etepi pāvanā maṃtrā idamāpo haviṣmatīḥ || devīrāpa apo devā drupadādiva saṃjñakāḥ || 106 || śanno devīrapodevīstathāpām̐rasamityapi || punaṃtu meti ca nava pāvamānyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 107 || tato'ghamarṣaṇaṃ japtvā drupadāṃ ca tato japet || prāṇāyāmaṃ ca vidhivadathavāṃtarjale japet || 108 || praṇavaṃ trirjapedvāpi viṣṇuṃ vā saṃsmaretsudhīḥ|| snātvetthaṃ vastramāpīḍya gṛhṇīyāddhautavāsasī || 109 || ācamya ca tataḥ kuryātprātaḥsaṃdhyāṃ kuśānvitām|| yo na saṃdhyāmupāsīta brāhmaṇo hi viśeṣataḥ || 4.1.35.110 || sa jīvanneva śūdrastu mṛtaḥ śvā jāyate dhruvam || saṃdhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu || 111 || yadanyatkurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet || praṇavaṃ prāgdiśi smṛtvā tato dattvā kuśāsanam || 112 || catuḥsraktirimaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhitvā nānyadṛṅmanāḥ || 113 || prāṅmukho baddhacūḍo vāpyupaviṣṭa udaṅmukhaḥ || pradakṣiṇaṃ svamabhyukṣya prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret || 114 || gāyatrīṃ śirasā sārdhaṃṃ saptavyāhṛtipūrvikām || trirjapetsadaśoṃkāraḥ prāṇāyāmoyamucyate ||115|| prāṇāyāmāṃścaranvipro niyateṃdriya mānasaḥ || ahorātrakṛtaiḥ pāpairmukto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||116|| daśadvādaśa saṃkhyā vā prāṇāyāmāḥ kṛtā yadi || niyamya mānasaṃ tena tadā taptaṃ mahattapaḥ || 117 || savyāhṛti praṇavakāḥ prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa || api bhrūṇahanaṃ māsātpunaṃtyaharahaḥ kṛtāḥ || 118 || yathā pārthivadhātūnāṃ dahyaṃte dhamanānmalāḥ || tatheṃdriyaiḥ kṛtā doṣā jvālyaṃte prāṇasaṃyamāt || 119 || ekaṃ saṃbhojya vidhivadbrāhmaṇaṃ yatphalaṃ labhet || prāṇāyāmairdvādaśabhistatphalaṃ śraddhayāpyate || 4.1.35.120 || vedādi vāṅmayaṃ sarvaṃ praṇave yatpratiṣṭhitam|| tataḥ praṇavamabhyasyedvedādiṃ vedajāpakaḥ || 121 || praṇave nityayuktasya saptasu vyāhṛtiṣvapi || tripadāyāṃ tu gāyatryāṃ na bhayaṃ jāyate kvacit ||122|| ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmaḥ paraṃ tapaḥ || gāyatryāstu paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ kalaśodbhava || 123 || karmaṇā manasā vācā yadrātrau kurutetvagham || uttiṣṭhanpūrvasaṃdhyāyāṃ prāṇāyāmairviśodhayet|| 124|| yadahnā kurute pāpaṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || āsīnaḥ paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ tatprāṇāyāmato haret || 125 || pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ japaṃstiṣṭhetsāvitrīmārkadarśanāt || paścimāṃ tu samāsīnaḥ samyagṛkṣavibhāvanāt || 126 || pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ japaṃstiṣṭhannaiśameno vyapohati || paścimāṃ tu samāsīno malaṃ haṃti divākṛtam || 127 || nopatiṣṭhettu yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yastu paścimām || sa śūdravadbahiṣkāryaḥ sarvasmāddvijakarmaṇaḥ || 128 || apāṃ samīpamāsādya nityakarma samācaret || gāyatrīmapyadhīyīta gatvāraṇyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 129 || gṛhādbahuguṇā yasmātsaṃdhyā bahirupāsitā || gāyatryabhyāsamātropi varaṃ vipro jiteṃdriyaḥ || 4.1.35.130 || trivedyapi ca no mānyaḥ sarvabhuksarvavikrayī || savitā devatā yasyā mukhamagnistripācca yā || 131 || viśvāmitre ṛṣiśchaṃdo gāyatrī sā viśiṣyate || gāyatrīmuṣasi dhyāyellohitāṃ brahmadaivatām || 132 || haṃsārūḍhāmaṣṭavarṣāṃ raktasraganulepanām || ṛksvarūpāmabhayadāmakṣamālāvalaṃbinīm || 133 || vyāsarṣiṇā stūyamānāṃ chaṃdasānuṣṭubhāyutām || etaddhyānāduṣardevyā naiśameno vyapohati || 134 || sūryaśceti ca maṃtreṇa syādācamanamuttamam || āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhirmārjanaṃ tu tataścaret || 135 || bhūmau śirasi cākāśa ākāśe bhuvi mastake || mastake ca tathākāśe bhūmau ca navadhā kṣipet || 136 || bhūmiśabdena caraṇāvākāśaṃ hṛdayaṃ smṛtam || śirasyeva śiraḥ śabdo mārjanajñairudāhṛtaḥ || 137 || vāruṇādapi cāgneyādvāyavyādapi caiṃdrataḥ || maṃtrasnānādapi paraṃ brāhmaṃ snānamidaṃ param || 138 || brāhmasnānena yaḥ snātaḥ sa bāhyābhyaṃtare śuciḥ || sarvatra cārhatāmeti devapūjādikarmaṇi ||139 || naktaṃ dinaṃ nimajjyāpsu kaivartāḥ kimu pāvanāḥ || śataśopi tathā snātā na śuddhā bhāvadūṣitā || 4.1.35.140 || aṃtaḥkaraṇaśuddhā ye tānvibhūtiḥ pavitrayet || kiṃ pāvanāḥ prakīrtyaṃte rāsabhā bhasmadhūsarāḥ || 141 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sa sarvamalavarjitaḥ || tena kratuśatairiṣṭaṃ ceto yasyeha nirmalam || 142 || tadeva nirmalaṃ ceto yathāsyāttanmune śṛṇu || viśveśaścetprasannaḥ syāttadā syānnānyathā kvacit || 143 || tasmāccetoviśuddhyarthaṃ kāśīnāthaṃ samāśrayet || tadāśrayeṇa niyataṃ saṃkṣīyaṃte manomalāḥ || 144 || saṃkṣīṇamāna sa malo viśveśānu grahātparāt || idaṃ śarīramutsṛjya paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 145 || viśveśānugrahe hetuḥ sadācāro mato nṛṇām || śrutismṛtibhyāmuditaṃ tasmāttamanu saṃśrayet || || 146 || drupadāṃ tu tato japtvā jalamādāya pāṇinā || kuryādṛtaṃ ca maṃtreṇa vidhijñastvaghamarṣaṇam || 147 || nimajjyāpsu ca yo vidvāñjapettriraghamarṣaṇam || yathāśvamedhāvabhṛthastasya syāttattathā dhruvam || 148 || jale vāpi sthale vāpi yaḥ kuyārdaghamaṣarṇam || tasyāghaugho vinaśyeta yathā sūryodaye tamaḥ || 149 || imaṃ maṃtraṃ tataścoktvā kuryādācamanaṃ dvijaḥ || ācāryāḥ kecidicchaṃti śākhābhedena cāpare || 4.1.35.150 || aṃtaścarasi bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ viśvatomukhaḥ || tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotīraso'mṛtam || 151 || gāyatrīṃ śirasā hīnāṃ mahāvyāhṛtipūrvikām || praṇavādyāṃ japaṃstiṣṭhankṣipedaṃbhoṃjali trayam || 152 || tena vajrodakenāśu maṃdehā nāma rākṣasāḥ || sūryārayaḥ pralīyaṃte śailā vajrahatā iva ||153|| vivasvataḥ sahāyārthaṃ yo dvijo nāṃjalitrayam || kṣipenmaṃdehanāśāya sopi maṃdehatāṃ vrajet||154|| prātastāvajjapaṃstiṣṭhedyāvatsūryasya darśanam|| upaviṣṭo japetsāyamṛkṣāṇāmāvilokanāt||155|| kālalopo na kartavyo dvijena svahitepsunā|| ardhodayāsta samaye tasmādvajrodakaṃ kṣipet ||156 || vidhināpi kṛtā saṃdhyā kālātītā'phalā bhavet || ayameva hi dṛṣṭāṃto vaṃdhyā strī maithunaṃ yathā ||157|| jalaṃ vāmakare kṛtvā yāsaṃdhyā caritā dvijaiḥ || vṛṣalī sā parijñeyā rakṣogaṇa mudāvahā ||158|| udvayaṃ tamudutyaṃ ca citraṃ deveti tatparam || taccakṣurityupasthānamaṃtrā bradhnasya siddhidāḥ ||159|| sahasrakṛtvo gāyatryāḥ śatakṛtvothavā punaḥ || daśakṛtvotha devyaiva kuryātsaurīmupasthitim || 4.1.35.160 || sahasraparamāṃ devīṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām || gāyatrīṃ yo japedvipro na sa pāpaiḥ pralipyate || 161 || vibhrāḍityanuvākaṃ vā sūktaṃ vā pauruṣaṃ japet || śivasaṃkalpamathavā brāhmaṇaṃ maṃḍalaṃ tu vā || 162 || etāni copasthānāni raviprītikarāṇi ca || raktacaṃdanamiśrādbhirakṣataiḥ kusumaiḥ kuśaiḥ ||163|| vedoktairāgamoktairvā maṃtrairarghaṃ pradāpayet || arcitaḥ savitā yena tena trailokyamarcitam||164|| arcitaḥ savitā sūte sutānpaśu vasūni ca || vyādhīnhareddadātyāyuḥ pūrayedvāṃchitānyapi || 165 || ayaṃ hi rudra ādityo harireṣa divākaraḥ || ravirhiraṇyagarbhosau trayīrūpoyamaryamā || 166 || ravestu toṣaṇāttuṣṭā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || iṃdrādayokhilā devā marīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ || 167 || mānavā manumukhyāśca somapādyāḥ pitāmahāḥ || raverarcāṃ vidhāyetthaṃ tatastarpaṇamārabhet || 168 || darbhānagarbhānādāya nava sapta ca paṃca vā || sāgrānsamūlānacchinnāndvijo dakṣiṇapāṇinā || 169 || anvārabdhena savyena tarpayetṣaḍvināyakān || brahmādīnakhilāndevānmarīcyādīṃstathā munīn || 4.1.35.170 || caṃdanāgurukastūrī gaṃdhavatkusumairapi || tarpayecchucibhistoyaistṛpyaṃtviti samuccaran || 171 || sanakādīnmanuṣyām̐śca nivītī tarpayedyavaiḥ || aṃguṣṭhadvayamadhye tu kṛtvā darbhānṛjūndvijaḥ || 172 || kavyavāḍanalādīṃśca pitṝndivyānpratarpayet || prācīnāvītiko darbhairdviguṇaistilamiśritaiḥ || 173 || ravau śukre trayodaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ niśi saṃdhyayoḥ || śreyorthī brāhmaṇo jātu na kuryāttilatarpaṇam || 174 || yadi kuryāttataḥ kuryācchuklaireva tilaiḥ kṛtī || caturdaśa yamānpaścāttarpayennāma uccaran || 175 || tataḥ svagotramuccārya tarpayetsvapitṝnmudā || savyajānunipātena pitṛtīrthena vāgyataḥ || 176 || ekaikamaṃjaliṃ devā dvau dvau tu sanakādikāḥ || pitarastrīnpravāṃchaṃti striya ekaikamaṃjalim || 177 || aṃgulyagre bhaveddaivamārṣamaṃguli mūlagam || brāhmamaṃguṣṭhamūle tu pāṇimadhye prajāpateḥ || 178 || madhyeṃguṣṭhapradeśinyoḥ pitryaṃ tīrthaṃ pracakṣate || navarcamuccaranvidvānvidadhyātpitṛtarpaṇam || 179 || udīratāmagiṃrasa āyaṃtuna itīṣyate || ūrjaṃ vahaṃtī pitṛbhyaḥ svadhāyibhyastataḥ paṭhet || 4.1.35.180 || ye ceha pitarastadvanmadhuvātā iti tṛcam || namo vaḥ pitaraścoktvā paṭhansiṃcejjalaṃ bhuvi || 181 || ābrahmastaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ || tṛpyaṃtu pitaraḥ sarve mātṛmātāmahādayaḥ ||182 || atītakulakoṭīnāṃ saptadvīpa nivāsinām || ābrahmabhuvanāllokādidamastu tilodakam || 183 || ye cāsmākaṃ kule jātā aputrā gotriṇo mṛtāḥ || sarve te tṛptimāyāṃtu vastraniṣpīḍanodakaiḥ ||184 || agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vedābhyāsaṃ tataścaret || śrutyabhyāsaḥ paṃcadhā syātsvīkārorthavicāraṇam || 185 || abhyāsaśca japaścāpi śiṣyebhyaḥ pratipādanam || labdhasya pratipālārthamalabdhasya ca labdhaye || 186 || dātāraṃ samupeyādvai svagurutvaṃ ca vardhayet || prātaḥkṛtyamidaṃ proktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ dvijottama || 187 || athavā prātarutthāya kṛtvāvaśyakameva ca || śaucācamanamādāya bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam || 188 || viśodhya sarvagātrāṇi prātaḥsaṃdhyāṃ samācaret || vedārthānadhigacchecca śāstrāṇi vividhānyapi || 189 || adhyāpayecchucīñśiṣyānhitānmedhāsamanvitān || upeyādīśvaraṃ caiva yogakṣemādi siddhaye || 4.1.35.190 || tato madhyāhnasiddhyarthaṃ pūrvoktaṃ snānamācaret || snātvā mādhyāhnikā saṃdhyāmupāsīta vicakṣaṇaḥ || 191 || navayauvanabhinnāṃgīṃ śuddhasphaṭikanirmalām || triṣṭupchaṃdaḥ samāyuktāṃ sāvitrīṃ rudradaivatām || 192 || kaśyaparṣisamāyuktāṃ yajurvedasvarūpiṇīm || tryakṣarāṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhāṃ bhaktābhayakarāṃ parām || 193 || devatāṃ paripūjyātha naityikaṃ vidhimācaret || pacanāgniṃ samujjvālya vaiśvadevaṃ samācaret || 194 || niṣpāvānkodravānmāṣānkalāyāṃścaṇakāṃstyajet || tailapakvaṃ ca pakvānnaṃ sarvaṃ lavaṇayuktyajet || 195 || āḍhakīśca masūrāṃśca vartulānvaraṭāṃstathā || bhuktaśeṣaṃ paryuṣitaṃ vaiśvadeve vivarjayet || 196 || darbhapāṇiḥ samācamya prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca || pṛṣṭho divīti maṃtreṇa paryukṣaṇamathācaret || 197 || pradakṣiṇaṃ ca paryukṣya triḥparistīrya vai kuśān || eṣo ha deva maṃtreṇa kuryādvahniṃ susaṃmukham || 198 || vaiśvānaraṃ samabhyarcya sājyapuṣpākṣatairatha || bhūrādyāścāhutīstisraḥ svāhāṃtāḥ praṇavādikāḥ || 199 || oṃbhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥsvāheti vipro dadyāttathāhutim || tathā devakṛtasyādyā juhuyācca ṣaḍāhutīḥ || 4.1.35.200 || yamāya tūṣṇīmekāṃ ca tathā sviṣṭakṛtīdvayam || viśvebhyaścāpi devebhyo bhūmau dadyāttato balim || 201 || sarvebhyaścāpi bhūtebhyo namo dadyāttaduttare || taddakṣiṇe pitṛbhyaśca prācīnāvītiko dadet || 202 || nirṇejanodakānnaṃ caiśānyāṃ vai yakṣmaṇe'rpayet || tato brahmādi devebhyo namo dadyāttaduttare || 203 || nivītī sanakādibhyaḥ pitṛbhyastvapasavyavān || haṃtaḥ ṣoḍaśabhirgrāsaścaturbhiḥ puṣkalaṃ smṛtam || 204 || grāsamātrābhavedbhikṣā gṛhasthasukṛtapradā || adhvagaḥ kṣīṇavṛttiśca vidyārthī gurupoṣakaḥ || 205 || yatiśca brahmacārī ca ṣaḍete dharmabhikṣukāḥ || atithiḥ pathiko jñeyo 'nūcānaḥ śrutipāragaḥ || 206 || mānyāvetau gṛhasthānāṃ brahmalokamabhīpsatām || api śvapāke śuni vā naivānnaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 207 || annārthini samāyāte pātrāpātraṃ na ciṃtayet || śunāṃ ca patitānāṃ ca śvapacāṃ pāparogiṇām|| 208 || kākānāṃ ca kṛmīṇāṃ ca bahirannaṃ kiredbhuvi || aiṃdravāruṇavāyavyāḥ saumyā vai nairṛtāśca ye || 209 || pratigṛhṇaṃtvimaṃ piṃḍaṃ kākā bhūmau mayārpitam || dvau śvānau śyāmaśabalau vaivasvatakulodbhavau || 4.1.35.210 || tābhyāṃ piṃḍaṃ pradāsyāmi syātāmetāvahiṃsakau || devā manuṣyāḥ paśavo rakṣo yakṣoragāḥ khagāḥ || 211 || daityāḥ siddhāḥ piśācāśca pretā bhūtāśca dānavāḥ || tṛṇāni taravaścāpi maddattānnābhilāṣukāḥ || 212 || kṛmi kīṭa pataṃgādyāḥ karmabaddhā bubhukṣitāḥ || tṛptyarthamannaṃ hi mayā dattaṃ teṣāṃ mudestu vai || 213 || itthaṃ bhūtabaliṃ dattvā kālaṃ godohamātrakam || pratīkṣyātithimāyāṃtaṃ viśedbhojyagṛhaṃ tataḥ || 214 || adattvā vāyasabaliṃ nityaśrāddhaṃ samācaret || nityaśrāddhe svasāmarthyāttrīndvāvekamathāpi vā || 215 || bhojayetpitṛyajñārthaṃ dadyāduddhṛtya durbalaḥ || nityaśrāddhaṃ daivahīnaṃ niyamādivivarjitam || 216 || dakṣiṇārahitaṃ tvetaddātṛbhoktṛ vratojjhitam || pitṛyajñaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ svasthabuddhiranāturaḥ || 217 || aduṣṭāsanamadhyāsya bhuṃjīta śiśubhiḥ saha || sugaṃdhiḥ sumanāḥ sragvī śucivāso dvayānvitaḥ || 218 || prāgāsya udagāsyo vā bhuṃjīta pitṛsevitam || 219 || vidhāyānnamanagnaṃ tadupariṣṭādadhastathā || āpośanavidhānena kṛtvāśnīyātsudhīrdvijaḥ ||4.1.35.220|| pradadyādbhuvaḥpataye bhuvanapataye tathā|| bhūtānāṃpataye svāhetyuktvā bhūmau balitrayam ||221|| sakṛccāpa upaspṛśya prāṇādyāhutipaṃcakam || dadyājjaṭharakuṃḍāgnau darbhapāṇiḥ prasannadhīḥ || 222 || darbhapāṇistu yo bhuṃkte tasya doṣo na vidyate || keśakīṭādi saṃbhūtastadaśnīyātsadarbhakaḥ || 223 || yāvadrucyannamaśnīyānna brūyāttadguṇāguṇān || bhuṃjate pitarastāvadyāvannoktā guṇāguṇāḥ || 224 || ato maunena yo bhuṃkte sa bhuṃkte kevalāmṛtam || anupīya tataḥ kṣīraṃ takraṃ pānīyameva vā || 225 || amṛtāpidhānamasītyevaṃ prāśyodakaṃ sakṛt || pītaśeṣaṃ kṣipedbhūmau toyaṃ maṃtramimaṃ paṭhan|| 226 || aprakṣālitahastasya dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhamūlataḥ || raurave'puṇyanilaye padmārbudanivāsinām || 227 || ucchiṣṭodakamicchūnāmakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatām || || 228 || punarācamya medhāvī śucirbhūtvā prayatnataḥ || hastenodakamādāya maṃtrametamudīrayet||229|| aṃguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣastvaṃguṣṭhaṃ ca samāśritaḥ || īśaḥ sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ prīṇāti viśvabhuk || 4.1.35.230 || ityannaṃ parisaṃkalpya prakṣālya caraṇau karau || tatonnapariṇāmārthaṃ maṃtrānetānudīrayet || 231 || agnirāpyāyayandhātūnpār thivānpavaneritaḥ || dattāvakāśo nabhasā jarayatvastu me sukham ||232|| prāṇāpānasamānānāmudānavyānayostathā|| annapuṣṭikaraṃ cāstu mamāstvavyāhataṃ sukham || 233|| samudro vaḍavāgniśca bradhno bradhnasyanaṃdanaḥ || mayābhyavahṛtaṃ yattadaśeṣaṃ jarayaṃtvime || 234 || mukhaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā purāṇaśravaṇādibhiḥ || ativāhya divāśeṣaṃ tataḥ saṃdhyāṃ samārabhet || 235|| gṛhe goṣṭhe nadītīre saṃdhyā daśaguṇā kramāt || saṃbhede syācchataguṇā hyanaṃtā śivasannidhau || 236 || upāsitā bahiḥ saṃdhyā divāmaithunapātakam || śamayedanṛtoktāghaṃ madyagaṃdhajameva ca || 237 || sāmavedasvarūpāṃ ca vasiṣṭharṣi samāyutām || kṛṣṇāṃgīṃ kṛṣṇavasanāṃ manākskhalita yauvanām || 238 || sarasvatīṃ tārkṣyayānāṃ vighnaghnīṃ viṣṇudaivatām || jagatīcchaṃdasā yuktāṃ dhyāyedekākṣarāṃ parām || 239 || agniśceti ca maṃtreṇa vidhāyācamane sudhīḥ || paścimāsyo japettāvadyāvannakṣatradarśanam || 4.1.35.240 || atithiṃ sāyamāyāṃtamapivāgbhūtṛṇodakaiḥ || saṃbhāvya parikalpyetthaṃ niśaḥprākpraharaṃ sudhīḥ || 241 || itthaṃ divākarma kṛtvā śruteḥ paṭhanapāṭhanaiḥ || ekakāṣṭhamayīṃ śayyāṃ nātitṛptotha saṃviśet || 242 || uddeśataḥ samākhyāto hyeṣa nityatamo vidhiḥ || itthaṃ samācaranvipro nāvasīdati karhicit || 243 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāharasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe sadācāro nāma paṃcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || ||
<4.1.36>
skaṃda uvāca || || punarviśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi sadācārasya kuṃbhaja || yaṃ śrutvāpi naro dhīmānnājñānatimiraṃ viśet || 1 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstrayo varṇā dvijāḥ smṛtāḥ || prathamaṃ mātṛto jātā dvitīyaṃ copanāyanāt || 2 || eṣāṃ kriyāniṣekādi śmaśānāṃtā ca vaidikī|| ādadhīta sudhīrgarbhamṛtaumūlaṃ maghāṃ tyajet || 3 || spaṃdanātprākpuṃsavanaṃ sīmaṃtonnayanaṃ tataḥ || māsi ṣaṣṭhe'ṣṭame vāpi jātetho jātakarma ca || 4 || nāmāhnyekādaśe gehāccaturthemāsi niṣkramaḥ || māsennaprāśanaṃ ṣaṣṭhe cūḍābde vā yathākulam || 5 || śamameno vrajedevaṃ baijaṃ garbhajamave ca || strīṇāmetāḥ kriyāstūṣṇīṃ pāṇigrāhastu maṃtravān || 6 || saptamethāṣṭamevābde sāvitrīṃ brāhmaṇorhati || nṛpastvekādaśe vaiśyo dvādaśe vā yathākulam || 7 || brahmatejobhivṛddhyarthaṃ viprobdepaṃcamerhati || ṣaṣṭhe balārthī nṛpatirmaujīṃ vaiśyoṣṭame dhriyet || 8 || mahāvyāhṛtipūrvaṃ ca vedamadhyāpayedguruḥ || upanīya ca taṃ śiṣyaṃ śaucācāre ca yojayet ||9|| pūrvoktavidhinā śaucaṃ kuryādācamanaṃ tathā || daṃtāñjihvāṃ viśodhyātha kṛtvā malaviśodhanam ||4.1.36.10|| snātvāṃbudaivatairmaṃtraiḥ prāṇānāyamya yatnataḥ || upasthānaṃ raveḥ kṛtvā saṃdhyayorubhayorapi || 11 || agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānabhivādayet || bruvannamuka gotrohamabhivādaya ityapi || 12 || abhivādanaśīlasya vṛddhasevāratasya ca || āyuryaśobalaṃ buddhirvardhate'harahodhikam || 13 || adhīte guruṇā hūtaḥ prāptaṃ tasmai nivedayet || karmaṇā manasā vācā hitaṃ tasyācaretsadā || 14 || adhyāpyādharmatonārthātsādhvāptajñānavittadāḥ || śaktāḥ kṛtajñāḥ śucayo'drohakāścānasūyakāḥ || 15 || dhārayenmekhalādaṃḍopavītājinameva ca || aniṃdyeṣu caredbhaikṣyaṃ brāhmaṇeṣvātmavṛttaye || 16 || brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāmādimadhyāvasānataḥ || bhaikṣyacaryā krameṇa syādbhavacchabdopalakṣitā || 17 || vāgyato gurvanujñāto bhuṃjītānnamakutsayan || ekānnaṃ na samaśnīyācchrāddhe'śnīyāttathāpadi || 18 || anārogyamanāyuṣyamasvargyaṃcātibhojanam || apuṇyaṃ lokavidviṣṭaṃ tasmāttatparivarjayet || 19 || na dvirbhuṃjīta caikasmindivā kvāpi dvijottamaḥ || sāyaṃprātardvijo'śnīyādagnihotravidhānavit || 4.1.36.20 || madhumāṃsaṃ prāṇihiṃsāṃ bhāskarālokanāṃjane || striyaṃ paryuṣitocchiṣṭaṃparivādaṃ vivajaryet || 21 || aupanāyanikaḥ kālo brahmakṣatra viśāṃ paraḥ || ā ṣoḍaśādādvāviṃśādā caturviṃśadabdataḥ || 22 || itopyūrdhvaṃ na saṃskāryāḥ patitā dharmavarjitāḥ || vrātyastomena yajñena tatpātityaṃ parivrajet || 23 || sāvitrīpatitaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃbaṃdhaṃ na samācaret || aiṇaṃ ca rauravaṃ vāstaṃ kramāccarma dvijanmanām ||24|| vasīrannānupūrvyeṇa śāṇa kṣaumāvikāni ca|| dvijasya mekhalā mauṃjī maurvī ca bhujajanmanaḥ || bhavettrivṛtsamāślakṣṇā viśastu śaṇatāṃtavī || 25 || muṃjābhāve vidhātavyā kuśāśmaṃtakabalvajaiḥ || graṃthinaikena saṃyuktā tribhiḥ paṃcabhireva vā || 26 || upavītakrameṇa syātkārpāsaṃ śāṇamāvikam || trivṛdūrdhvavṛtaṃ tacca bhavedāyurvivṛddhaye || 27 || bilvapālāśayordaṃḍo brāhmaṇasya nṛpasya tu || nyagrodhabāladalayoḥ pīlūduṃbarayorviśaḥ || 28 || āmauliṃ vā''lalāṭaṃvā''nāsamūrdhvapramāṇataḥ || brahmakṣatraviśāṃ daṃḍastvagāḍhyonāgnidūṣitaḥ || 29 || pradakṣiṇaṃ parītyāgnimupasthāya divākaram || daṃḍājinopavītāḍhyaścaredbhaikṣyaṃ yathoditam || 4.1.36.30 || mātṛmātṛṣvasṛsvasṛpitṛsvasṛpuraḥsarāḥ || prathamaṃ bhikṣaṇīyāḥ syuretāyācana no vadet|| 31 || yāvadvedamadhīte ca caranvedavratāni ca || brahmacārī bhavettāvadūrdhvaṃ snāto gṛhī bhavet || 32 || proktosāvupakurvāṇo dvitīyastatra naiṣṭhikaḥ || tiṣṭhettāvadgurukule yāvatsyādāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ || 33 || gṛhāśramaṃ samāśritya yaḥ punarbrahmacaryabhāk|| nāsau yatirvanastho vā syātsarvāśramavarjitaḥ || 34 || anāśramī na tiṣṭheta dinamekamapi dvijaḥ || āśramaṃ tu vinā tiṣṭhanprāyaścittī yato hi saḥ ||35|| japaṃ homaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam|| kurvāṇothāśramabhraṣṭo nāsau tatphalamāpnuyāt || || 36|| mekhalājinadaṃḍāśca liṃgaṃ syādbrahmacāriṇaḥ || gṛhiṇo vedayajñādi nakhalomavanasthiteḥ || 37 || tridaṃḍādi yateruktamupalakṣaṇamatra vai || etallakṣaṇahīnastu prāyaścittī dine dine || 38 || jīrṇaṃ kamaṃḍaluṃ daṃḍamupavītājine api || apsveva tāni nikṣipya gṛhṇītānyacca maṃtravat || 39 || vidadhyātṣoḍaśe varṣe keśāṃtakarma ca kramāt || dvāviṃśe ca caturviṃśe gārhasthya pratipattaye || 4.1.36.40 || tapo yajña vratebhyaśca sarvasmācchubhakarmaṇaḥ || dvijātīnāṃ śrutirhyekā heturniśreyasa śriyaḥ || 41 || vedāraṃbhe visarge ca vidadhyātpraṇavaṃ sadā || aphalo'noṃkṛto yasmātpaṭhitopi na siddhaye || 42 || vedasya vadanaṃ proktaṃ gāyatrī tripadā parā || tisṛbhiḥ praṇavādyābhirmahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ saha || 43 || sahasraṃ sādhikaṃ kiṃcittrikamaitajjapanyamī || māsaṃ bahiḥ pratidinaṃ mahāghādapi mucyate || 44 || atyabdamiti yobhyasyetpratighasramananyadhīḥ || sa vyomamūrtiḥ śuddhātmā paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 45 || trivarṇamayamoṃkāraṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti trayam || pādatrayaṃ ca sāvitryāstrayovedā adūduhan || 46 || etadakṣaramenāṃ ca japedvyāhṛtipūrvikām || saṃdhyayorvedavidvipro vedapuṇyena yujyate || 47 || vidhikratordaśaguṇaṃ japasyaphalamaśnute || vidhikratordaśaguṇo japakraturudīritaḥ || 48 || upāṃśustacchataguṇaḥ sahasro mānasastataḥ || 49 || adhītyavedānvedau vā vedaṃ vā śaktito dvijaḥ || suvarṇapūrṇa dharaṇī dānasya phalamaśnute || 4.1.36.50 || śrutimeva sadābhyasyettapastaptuṃ dvijottamaḥ || śrutyabhyāso hi viprasya paramaṃ tapa ucyate || 51 || hitvā śruteradhyayanaṃ yonyatpaṭhitumicchati || sa dogdhrīṃ dhenumutsṛjya grāmakroḍīṃ dudhukṣati || 52 || upanīya ca vai śiṣyaṃ vedamadhyāpayeddvijaḥ || sakalpaṃ sarahasyaṃ ca tamācāryaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 53 || yodhyāpayedekadeśaṃ śruteraṃgānyathāpi vā || vṛttyarthaṃ sa upādhyāyo vidvadbhiḥ parigīyate || 54 || yathāvidhi niṣekādi yaḥ karma kurute dvijaḥ || saṃbhāvayettathānnena guruḥ sa iha kīrtyate || 59 || agnyādheyaṃ pākayajñānagniṣṭomādikānmakhān || yaḥ karoti vṛto yasya sa tasyarttvigihocyate || 56 || upādhyāyāddaśācārya ācāryāttu śataṃ pitā || sahasraṃ tu piturmātā gauraveṇātiricyate || 57 || viprāṇāṃ jñānato jyaiṣṭhyaṃ bāhujānāṃ tu vīryataḥ || vaiśyānāṃ dhānyadhanataḥ pajjātānāṃ tu janmataḥ || 58 || yathā dārumayo hastī yathā kṛttimayo mṛgaḥ || tathā vipro'nadhīyānastrayo'mī nāmadhāriṇaḥ || 59 || svapne siktvā brahmacārī dvijaḥ śukramakāmataḥ || snātvārkamarcayitvā triḥ punarmāmityṛcaṃ japet || 4.1.36.60 || svadharmaniratānāṃ ca vedayajñakriyāvatām || brahmacārī caredbhaikṣyaṃ veśmasuprayato'nvaham || 61 || akṛtvā bhaikṣyacaraṇamasamidhya hutāśanam || anāturaḥ saptarātramavakīrṇi vrataṃ caret || 62 || yatheṣṭaceṣṭo nabhavedgurornayanagocare || na nāmaparigṛhṇīyātparokṣepyaviśeṣaṇam || 63 || guruniṃdābhavedyatra parivādastu yatra ca || śrutī pidhāya vāstheyaṃ yātavyaṃ vā tatonyataḥ || 64 || kharo guroḥ parīvādācchvā bhavedguruniṃdakaḥ || matsarī kṣudrakīṭaḥsyātparibhoktā bhavetkṛmiḥ || 65 || nābhivādyā guroḥ patnī spṛṣṭvāṃghrī yuvatī satī || kvāpi viṃśativarṣeṇa jñātṛṇā guṇadoṣayoḥ || 66 || svabhāvaścaṃcalaḥ strīṇāṃ doṣaḥ puṃsāmataḥ smṛtaḥ || pramadāsu pramādyaṃti kvacinnaiva vipaścitaḥ || 67 || vidvāṃsamapyavidvāṃsaṃ yatastādharṣayaṃtyalam || svavaśaṃ vāpi kurvaṃti sūtrabaddhaśakuṃtavat || 68 || na mātrā na duhitrā vā na svasraikāṃtaśīlatā || balavaṃtīdriyāṇyatra mohayaṃtyapi kovidān || 69 || prayatnena khananyadvadbhūmervāryadhigacchati || śuśrūṣayā gurostadvadvidyā śiṣyodhigacchati||4.1.36.70|| śayānamabhyudayate bradhnaścedbrahmacāriṇam || pramādādatha nimlocejjapannapavaseddinam || 71 || sutasya saṃbhave kleśaṃ sahete pitarau ca yat || śakyā varṣaśatenāpi no kartuṃ tasya niṣkṛtiḥ || 72 || atastayoḥ priyaṃ kuryādgurorapi ca sarvadā || triṣu teṣu sutuṣṭeṣu tapaḥ sarvaṃ samāpyate || 73 || teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ śuśrūṣā paramaṃ tapa ucyate || tānatikramya yaḥ kuryāttannasiddhyetkadācana || 74 || trīnevāmūnsamārādhya trīm̐llokānsa jayetsudhīḥ || devavaddivi dīvyeta teṣāṃ toṣaṃ vivardhayan || 75 || bhūrlokaṃ jananī bhaktyā bhuvarlokaṃ tathā pituḥ || guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇāttadvatsvarlokaṃ ca jayetkṛtī || 76 || etadeva nṛṇāṃ proktaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || yadeteṣāṃ hi saṃtoṣa upadharmonya ucyate || 77 || adhītya vedānvedau vā vedaṃ vāpi kramāddvijaḥ || apraskhaladbrahmacaryo gṛhāśramamathāśrayet || 78 || avipluta brahmacaryo viśveśānugrahādbhavet || anugrahaśca vaiśveśaḥ kāśīprāptikaraḥ paraḥ || 79 || kāśīprāptyā bhavejjñānaṃ jñānānnirvāṇamṛcchati || nirvāṇārthaṃ prayatno hi sadācārasya dhīmatām || 4.1.36.80 || sadācāro gṛhe yadvanna tathāstyāśramāṃtare || vidyājātaṃ paṭhitvāṃte gṛhasthāśramamāśrayet || 81 || gṛhāśramātparaṃ nāsti yadi patnīvaśaṃvadā || ānukūlyaṃ hi daṃpatyostrivargodaya hetave || 82 || ānukūlyaṃ kalatraṃ cettridivenāpi kiṃ tataḥ || prātikūlyaṃ kalatraṃ cennarakeṇāpi kiṃ tataḥ || 83 || gṛhāśramaḥ sukhārthāya bhāryāmūlaṃ ca tatsukham || sā ca bhāryā vinītāyā trivargo vinayo dhuvam || 84 || jalaukayopamīyaṃte pramadā maṃdabuddhibhiḥ || mṛgīdṛśāṃ jalaukānāṃ vicārānmahadataṃram || 85 || jalaukā kevalaṃ raktamādadānā tapasvinī || pramadā sarvadā datte cittaṃ vittaṃ balaṃ sukham || 86 || dakṣā prajāvatī sādhvī priyavākca vaśaṃvadā || guṇairamībhiḥ saṃyuktā sā śrīḥ strīrūpadhāriṇī || 87|| guroranujñayā snātvā vrataṃ vedaṃ samāpya ca || udvaheta tato bhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ sādhulakṣaṇām || 88 || jane tu rasagotrāyā māturyāpyasapiṃḍakā || dārakarmaṇi yogyā sā dvijānāṃ dharmavṛddhaye ||89|| strīsaṃbaṃdhepyapasmāri kṣayi śvitri kulaṃ tyajet || abhiśastisamāyuktaṃ tathā kanyāprasūṃ tyajet ||4.1.36.90|| rogahīnāṃ bhrātṛmatīṃ svasmātkiṃcillaghīyasīm || udvaheta dvijo bhāryāṃ saumyāsyāṃ mṛdubhāṣiṇīm ||91|| na parvatarkṣavṛkṣāhvāṃ na nadīsarpanāmikām || na pakṣyahipreṣyanāmnīṃ saumyākhyāmudvahetsudhīḥ ||92|| na cātiriktahīnāṃgīṃ nātidīrghāṃ na vā kṛśām || nālomikāṃ nātilomāṃ nāsnigdhasthūlamaulijām || 93 || mohātsamupayaccheta kulahīnāṃ na kanyakām || hīnopayamanādyāti saṃtānamapi hīnatām ||94|| lakṣaṇāni parīkṣyādau tataḥ kanyāṃ samudvahet || sulakṣaṇā sadācārā patyurāyurvivardhayet ||95|| brahmacāri samācāra iti te samudī ritaḥ || ghaṭodbhava prasaṃgena strīlakṣaṇamatha bruve||96|| iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe ṣaṭtriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||36||
<4.1.37>
skaṃda uvāca || || sadā gṛhī sukhaṃ bhuṃkte strī lakṣaṇavatī yadi || ataḥ sukhasamṛddhyarthamādau lakṣaṇamīkṣayet || 1 || vapurāvartagaṃdhāścacchāyā satvaṃ svaro gatiḥ || varṇaścetyaṣṭadhā proktā budhairlakṣaṇabhūmikā || 2 || āpādatalamārabhya yāvanmauliruhaṃ kramāt || śubhāśubhāni vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇāni mune śṛṇu || 3 || ādau pādatalaṃ rekhāstatoṃguṣṭhāṃgulī nakhāḥ || pṛṣṭhagulphadvayaṃ pārṣṇī jaṃghe romāṇi jānunī || 4 || ūrū kaṭī nitaṃbasphigbhago jaghana bastike || nābhiḥ kukṣidvayaṃ pārśvodaramadhya valitrayam || 5 || romālī hṛdayaṃ vakṣo vakṣojadvayacūcukam || jatruskaṃdhāṃ sakakṣādormaṇibaṃdha karadvayam | 6 || pāṇipṛṣṭhaṃ pāṇitalaṃ rekhāṃguṣṭhāṃgulī nakhāḥ || pṛṣṭhiḥ kṛkāṭikā kaṃṭhe cibukaṃ ca hanudvayam || 7 || kapolau vaktramadharottaroṣṭhau dvijajihvikāḥ || ghaṃṭikā tāluhasitaṃ nāsikākṣutamakṣiṇī || 8 || pakṣma bhrūkarṇabhālāni mauli sīmaṃtamaulijāḥ || ṣaṣṭiḥ ṣaḍuttarāyoṣidaṃgalakṣaṇasatkhaniḥ || 9 || strīṇāṃ pādatalaṃ snigdhaṃ māṃsalaṃ mṛdulaṃ samam || asvedamuṣṇamaruṇaṃ bahubhogocitaṃ smṛtam || 4.1.37.10 || rūkṣaṃ vivarṇaṃ paruṣaṃ khaṃḍitapratibiṃbakam || śūrpākāraṃ viśuṣkaṃ ca duḥkhadaurbhāgyasūcakam || 11 || cakra svastika śaṃkhābja dhvajamīnātapatravat || yasyāḥ pādatale rekhā sā bhavetkṣitipāṃganā || 12 || bhavedakhaṃḍabhogāyorddhvāmadhyāṃgulisaṃgatā || rekhākhu sarpakākābhā duḥkhadāridryasūcikā || 13 || unnato māṃsaloṃguṣṭho vartulotulabhogadaḥ || vakro hrasvaśca cipiṭaḥ sukhasaubhāgyabhaṃjakaḥ || 14 || vidhavā vipulena syāddīrghāṃguṣṭhena durbhagā || mṛdavoṃgulayaḥ śastā ghanāvṛttāḥ samunnatāḥ ||15|| dīrghāṃgulībhiḥ kulaṭā kṛśābhiratinirdhanā || hrasvāyuṣyā ca hrasvābhirbhugnābhirbhugnavartinī || 16 || cipiṭābhirbhaveddāsī viralābhirdaridriṇī || parasparaṃ samārūḍhāḥ pādāṃgulyo bhavaṃti hi || 17 || hatvā bahūnapi patīnparapreṣyā tadā bhavet || yasyāḥ pathi samāyāṃtyā rajobhūmeḥ samucchalet || 18 || sā pāṃsulā prajāyeta kulatrayavināśinī || yasyāḥ kaniṣṭhikā bhūmiṃ na gacchaṃtyāḥ parispṛśet || 19 || sā nihatya patiṃ yoṣā dvitīyaṃ kurute patim || anāmikā ca madhyā ca yasyā bhūmiṃ na saṃspṛśet || 4.1.37.20 || patidvayaṃ nihaṃtyādyā dvitīyā ca patitrayam || patihīnatvakāriṇyau hīne te dve ime yadi || 21 || pradeśinī bhavedyasyā aṃguṣṭhāvyatirekiṇī || kanyaiva kulaṭā sā syādeṣa eva viniścayaḥ || 22 || snigdhāḥ samunnatāstāmrā vṛttāḥ pādanakhāḥ śubhāḥ || 23 || rājñītvasūcakaṃ strīṇāṃ pādapṛṣṭhaṃ samunnatam || asvedamaśirāḍhyaṃ ca masṛṇaṃ mṛdumāṃsalam || 24 || daridrā madhyanamreṇa śirālena sadādhvagā || romāḍhyena bhaveddāsī nirmāṃsena ca durbhagā || 25 || gūḍhau gulphau śivāyoktāvaśirālau suvartulau || sthapuṭau śithilau dṛśyau syātāṃ daurbhāgyasūcakau || 26 || samapārṣṇiḥ śubhā nārī pṛthupārṣṇiśca durbhagā || kulaṭonnatapārṣṇi syāddīrghapārṣṇiśca duḥkhabhāk || 27 || romahīne same snigdhe yajjaṃghe kramavartule || sā rājapatnī bhavati viśiresumanohare || 28 || ekaromā rājapatnī dviromā ca sukhāvahā || triromā romakūpeṣu bhavedvaidhavyaduḥkhabhāk || 29 || vṛttaṃ piśitasaṃlagnaṃ jānuyugmaṃ praśasyate || nirmāṃsaṃ svairacāriṇyā daridrā yāśca viślatham || 4.1.37.30 || viśiraiḥ karabhākārairūrubhirmasṛṇairghanaiḥ || suvṛttairomarahitairbhaveyurbhūpavallabhāḥ || 31 || vaidhavyaṃ romaśairuktaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ cipiṭairapi || madhyacchidrairmahāduḥkhaṃ dāridryaṃ kaṭhinatvacaiḥ || 32 || caturbhiraṃgulaiḥ śastā kaṭirviṃśatisaṃyutaiḥ || samunnatanitaṃbāḍhyā caturasrā mṛgīdṛśām || 33 || vinatā cipiṭā dīrghā nirmāṃsāsaṃkaṭākaṭiḥ || hrasvā romayutā nāryā duḥkhavaidhavyasūcikā || 34 || nitaṃbabiṃbo nārīṇāmunnato māṃsalaḥ pṛthuḥ || mahābhogāya saṃproktastadanyo'śarmaṇe mataḥ || 35 || kapitthaphalavadvṛttau mṛdulau māṃsalau ghanau || sphicau valivinirmuktau ratisaukhyavivardhanau|| 36 || śubhaḥ kamaṭhapṛṣṭhābho gajaskaṃdhopamo bhagaḥ || vāmonnatastu kanyājaḥ putrajo dakṣiṇonnataḥ ||37|| ākhuromā gūḍhamaṇiḥ suśliṣṭaḥ saṃhataḥ pṛthuḥ || tuṃgaḥ kamalaparṇābhaḥ śubhośvatthadalākṛtiḥ || 38 || kuraṃgakhurarūpoyaścullikodarasannibhaḥ || romaśo vivṛtāsyaśca dṛśyanāsotidurbhagaḥ || 39 || śaṃkhāvarto bhago yasyāḥ sā garbhamiha necchati || cipiṭaḥ kharparākāraḥ kiṃkarī padado bhagaḥ ||4.1.37.40||| vaṃśavetasapatrābho gajaromoccanāsikaḥ || vikaṭaḥ kuṭilākāro laṃbagallastathā'śubhaḥ||41|| bhagasya bhālaṃ jaghanaṃ vistīrṇaṃ tuṃgamāṃsalam || mṛdulaṃ mṛdulomāḍhyaṃ dakṣiṇāvartamīḍitam || 42 || vāmāvartaṃ ca nirmāṃsaṃ bhugnavaidhavyasūcakam || saṃkaṭasthapuṭaṃ rūkṣaṃ jaghanaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sadā || 43 || bastiḥ praśastā vipulā mṛdvīstokasamunnatā || romaśā ca śirālā ca rekhāṃkā naiva śobhanā || 44 || gaṃbhīrā dakṣiṇāvartā nābhī syātsukhasaṃpade || vāmāvartā samuttānā vyaktagraṃthirna śobhanā || 45 || sūte sutānbahūnnārī pṛthukukṣiḥ sukhāspadam || kṣitīśaṃ janayetputraṃ maṃḍūkābhena kukṣiṇā || 46 || unnatena valībhājā sāvartenāpi kukṣiṇā || vaṃdhyā pravrajitā dāsī kramādyoṣā bhavediha || 47 || samaiḥ samāṃsairmṛdubhiryoṣinmagnāsthibhiḥ śubhaiḥ || pārśveḥ saubhāgyasukhayornidhānaṃ syādasaṃśayam || 48 || yasyādṛśya śire pārśve unnate romasaṃyute || nirapatyā ca duḥśīlā sā bhavedduḥkhaśevadhiḥ || 49 || udareṇātitucchena viśireṇa mṛdutvacā || yoṣidbhavati bhogāḍhyā nityaṃ miṣṭānnasevinī || 4.1.37.50 || kuṃbhākāraṃ daridrāyā jaṭharaṃ ca mṛdaṃgavat || kūṣmāṃḍābhaṃ yavābhaṃ ca duṣpūraṃ jāyate striyāḥ || 51 || suviśālodarī nārī nirapatyā ca durbhagā || pralaṃbajaṭharā haṃti śvaśuraṃ cāpi devaram || 52 || madhyakṣāmā ca subhagā bhogāḍhyā savalitrayā || ṛjvī tanvī ca romālī yasyāḥ sā śarmanarmabhūḥ || 53 || kapilā kuṭilā sthūlā vicchinnā romarājikā || caura vaidhavya daurbhāgyaṃ vidadhyādiha yoṣitām || 54 || nirlomahṛdayaṃ yasyāḥ samaṃ nimnatva varjitam || aiśvaryaṃ cāpyavaidhavyaṃ priyaprema ca sā labhet || 55 || vistīrṇahṛdayā yoṣā puṃścalī nirdayā tathā || udbhinnaromahṛdayā patiṃ haṃti viniścitam || 56 || aṣṭādaśāṃgulatatamuraḥ pīvaramunnatam || sukhāya duḥkhāya bhavedromaśaṃ viṣamaṃ pṛthu || 57 || ghanau vṛttau dṛḍhau pīnau samau śastau payodharau || sthūlāgrau viralau śuṣkau vāmorūṇāṃ na śarmadau || 58 || dakṣiṇonnata vakṣojā putriṇī tvagraṇīrmatā || vāmonnatakucā sūte kanyāṃ saubhāgyasuṃdarīm || 59 || araghaṭṭaghaṭītulyau kucau dauḥśīlyasūcakau || pīvarāsyau sāṃtarālau pṛthūpāṃtau na śobhanau || 4.1.37.60 || mūle sthūlau kramakṛśāvagre tīkṣṇau payodharau || sukhadau pūrvakāle tu paścādatyaṃta duḥkhadau ||61|| sudṛḍhaṃ cūcukayugaṃ śastaṃ śyāmaṃ suvartulam || aṃtarmagnaṃ ca dīrghaṃ ca kṛśaṃ kleśāya jāyate || 62 || pīvarābhyāṃ ca jatrubhyāṃ dhanadhānyanidhirvadhūḥ || ślathāsthibhyāṃ ca nimnābhyāṃ viṣamābhyāṃ daridriṇī || 63 || abaddhāvanatau skaṃdhāvadīrghāvakṛśau śubhau || vakrau sthūlau ca romāḍhyau preṣya vaidhavyasūcakau || 64 || nigūḍhasaṃdhī srastāgrau śubhāvaṃsau susaṃhatau || vaidhavyadau samuccāgrau nirmāṃsāvatiduḥkhadau || 65 || kakṣesu sūkṣmarome tu tuṃge snigdhe ca māṃsale || śastena śaste gaṃbhīre śirāle svedamedure || 66 || syātāṃ doṣau sunirdoṣau gūḍhāsthi graṃthikomalau || viśirau ca viromāṇau saralau hariṇīdṛśām || 67 || vaidhavyaṃ sthūlaromāṇau hrasvau daurbhāgyasūcakau || parikleśāya nārīṇāṃ paridṛśyaśirau bhujau || 68 || aṃbhoja mukulākāramaṃguṣṭhāṃgulisaṃmukham || hastadvayaṃ mṛgākṣīṇāṃ bahubhogāya jāyate || 69 || mṛdumadhyonnataṃ raktaṃ talaṃ pāṇyoraraṃdhrakam || praśastaṃ śastarekhāḍhyamalparekhaṃ śubhaśriyam || 4.1.37.70 || vidhavā bahurekheṇa virekheṇa daridriṇī || bhikṣukī suśirāḍhyena nārī karatalena vai || 71 || viroma viśiraṃ śastaṃ pāṇipṛṣṭhaṃsamunnatam || vaidhavyaheturomāḍhyaṃ nirmāṃsaṃ snāyumattyajet || 72 || raktā vyaktā gabhīrā ca snigdhā pūrṇā ca vartulā || kararekhāṃganā yāḥ syācchubhā bhāgyānusārataḥ || 73 || matsyena subhagā nārī svastikena vasupradā|| padmena bhūpateḥ patnī janayedbhūpatiṃ sutam || 74 || cakravartistriyāḥ pāṇau naṃdyāvartaḥ pradakṣiṇaḥ || śaṃkhātapatraka maṭhā nṛpamātṛtvasūcakāḥ || 75 || tulāmānākṛtīrekhe vaṇikpatnītvahetuke || gajavājivṛṣākārāḥ kare vāme mṛgīdṛśām || 76 || rekhā prāsādavajrābhā brūyustīrthakaraṃ sutam || kṛṣīvalasya patnī syācchakaṭena yugena vā || 77 || cāmarāṃkuśakodaṃḍai rājapatnī bhaveddhruvam || aṃguṣṭhamūlānnirgatya rekhā yāti kaniṣṭhikām|| 78 || yadi sā patihaṃtrī syāddūratastāṃ tyajetsudhīḥ || triśūlāsigadāśakti duṃdubhyākṛti rekhayā || nitaṃbinī kīrtimatī tyāgena pṛthivītale || 79 || kaṃka jaṃbūka maṃḍūka vṛka vṛścika bhoginaḥ || rāsabhoṣṭra biḍālāḥ syuḥ karasthā duḥkhadāḥ striyāḥ || 4.1.37.80 || śubhadaḥ saraloṃguṣṭho vṛtto vṛttanakho mṛduḥ || 81 || aṃgulyaśca suparvāṇo dīrghāvṛttāḥ kramātkṛśāḥ || cipiṭāḥsthapuṭā rūkṣāḥ pṛṣṭharomayujo'śubhāḥ||82 || atihrasvāḥ kṛśā vakrā viralā rogahetukāḥ || duḥkhāyāṃgulayaḥ strīṇāṃ bahuparvasamanvitāḥ || 83 || aruṇāḥ saśikhāstuṃgāḥ karajāḥ sudṛśāṃśubhāḥ || nimnā vivarṇāḥ śuktyābhāḥ pītā dāridryadāyakāḥ || 84 || nakheṣu biṃdavaḥ śvetāḥ prāyaḥ syuḥ svairiṇī striyāḥ || puruṣā api jāyaṃte duḥkhinaḥ puṣpitairnakhaiḥ || 85 || aṃtarnimagnavaṃśāsthiḥ pṛṣṭhiḥ syānmāṃsalā śubhā || pṛṣṭhena romayuktena vaidhavyaṃ labhate dhruvam || 86 || bhugnena vinatenāpi saśireṇāpi duḥkhitā || ṛjvī kṛkāṭikā śreṣṭhā samāṃsā ca samunnatā|| 87 || śuṣkā śirālā romāḍhyā viśālā kuṭilāśubhā|| māṃsalo vartulaḥ kaṃṭhaḥ praśastaścaturaṃgulaḥ || 88 || śastā grīvā trirekhāṃkā tvavyaktāsthiḥ susaṃhatā || nirmāṃsā cipiṭā dīrghāsthapuṭā na śubhapradā || 89 || sthūlagrīvā ca vidhavā vakragrīvā ca kiṃkarī || vaṃdhyā dvicipiṭagrīvā hrasvagrīvā ca niḥsutā ||4.1.37.90 || cibukaṃdvayaṃgulaṃ śastaṃ vṛttaṃ pīnaṃ sukomalam || sthūlaṃ dvidhā saṃvibhaktamāyataṃ romaśaṃ tyajet || 91 || hanuścibukasaṃlagnā nirlomā sughanāśubhā || vakrā sthūlā kṛśā hrasvā romaśā na śubhapradā || 92 || śastau kapolau vāmākṣyāḥ pīnau vṛttau samunnatau || romaśau paruṣau nimnau nirmāṃsau parivarjayet || 93 || samaṃ samāṃsaṃ susnigdhaṃ svāmodaṃ vartulaṃ mukham || janetṛvadanacchāyaṃ dhanyānāmiha jāyate || 94 || pāṭalo vartulaḥ snigdho lekhābhūṣitamadhyabhūḥ || sīmaṃtinī nāmadharo dharājāni priyo bhavet || 95 || kṛśaḥ pralaṃbaḥ sphuṭito rūkṣo daurbhāgyasūcakaḥ || śyāvaḥ sthūlo'dharoṣṭhaḥ syādvaidhavya kalahapradaḥ || 96 || masṛṇo mattakāśinyāścottaroṣṭhaḥ subhogadaḥ || kiṃcinmadhyonnato'romā viparīto viruddhakṛt || 97 || gokṣīrasannibhāḥ snigdhā dvātriṃśaddaśanāḥ śubhāḥ || adhastādupariṣṭācca samāḥ stokasamunnatāḥ || 98 || pītāḥ śyāvāśca daśanāḥ sthūlādīrghādvipaṃktayaḥ || śuktyākārāśca viralā duḥkhadaurbhāgyakāraṇam || 99 || adhastādadhikairdaṃtairmātaraṃ bhakṣayetsphuṭam || patihīnā ca vikaṭaiḥ kulaṭā viralairbhavet || 4.1.37.100 || jihveṣṭamiṣṭabhoktrī syācchoṇāmṛdvī tathāsitā || duḥkhāya madhyasaṃkīrṇā purobhāgasavistarā || 101 || sitayā toyamaraṇaṃ śyāmayā kalahapriyā | daridriṇī māṃsalayā laṃbayā'bhakṣyabhakṣiṇī || 102 || viśālayā rasanayā pramadātipramādabhāk || snigdhaṃ kokanadābhāsaṃ praśastaṃ tālukomalam || 103 || site tāluni vaidhavyaṃ pīte pravrajitā bhavet|| kṛṣṇe'patyaviyogārtā rūkṣe bhūrikuṭuṃbinī || 104 || kaṃṭhe sthūlā suvṛttā ca kramatīkṣṇā sulohitā || apralaṃbā śubhā ghaṃṭī sthūlā kṛṣṇā ca duḥkhadā || 105 || alakṣitadvijaṃ kiṃcitkiṃcitphulla kapolakam || smitaṃ praśastaṃ sudṛśāmanimīlitalocanam || 106 || samavṛttapuṭānāsā laghucchidrā śubhāvahā || sthūlāgrā madhyanamrā ca na praśastā samunnatā || 107 || ākuṃcitāruṇāgrā ca vaidhavyakleśadāyinī || parapreṣyā ca cipiṭā hrasvā dīrghā kalipriyā || 108 || dīrghāyuḥ kṛtkṣutaṃ dīrghaṃ yugapaddvitripiṃḍitam || lalanā locane śaste raktāṃte kṛṣṇatārake || 109|| gokṣīravarṇaviśade susnigdhe kṛṣṇapakṣmaṇī || unnatākṣī na dīrghāyurvṛttākṣī kulaṭā bhavet || 4.1.37.110 || meṣākṣīmahiṣākṣī ca kekarākṣī na śobhanā || kāmagṛhīlā nitarāṃ gopiṃgākṣī sudurvṛtā || 111 || pārāvatākṣī duḥśīlā raktākṣī bhartṛghātinī || koṭarā nayanā duṣṭā gajanetrā na śobhanā || 112 || puṃścalī vāmakāṇākṣī vaṃdhyā dakṣiṇakāṇikā || madhupiṃgākṣī ramaṇī dhanadhānyasamṛddhibhāk || 113 || pakṣmabhiḥ sughanaiḥ snigdhaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ subhāgyabhāk || kapilairviralaiḥ sthūlairniṃdyā bhavati bhāminī || 114 || bhruvau suvartule tanvyāḥ snigdhe kṛṣṇe asaṃhate || praśaste mṛduromāṇau subhruvaḥ kārmukākṛtī || 115 || khararomā ca pṛthulā vikīrṇā saralā striyāḥ || na bhrūḥ praśastā militā dīrgharomā ca piṃgalā || 116 || laṃbau karṇau śubhāvartau sukhadau ca śubhapradau || śaṣkulīrahitau niṃdyau śirālau kuṭilau kṛśau || 117 || bhālaḥ śirāvirahito nirlomārdheṃdu sannibhaḥ || animnastryaṃgulo nāryāḥ saubhāgyārogyakāraṇam || 118 || vyakta svastikarekhaṃ ca lalāṭaṃ rājyasaṃpade || pralaṃbaṃ mastakaṃ yasyā devaraṃ hanti sā dhruvam || 119 || romaśena śirālena prāṃśunā rogiṇī matā || 4.1.37.120 || sīmantaḥ saralaḥ śasto mauliḥ śastaḥ samunnataḥ || gajakuṃbhanibhāvṛttaiḥ saubhāgyaiśvaryasūcakaiḥ || 121 || sthūlamūrdhā ca vidhavā dīrghaśīrṣā ca baṃdhakī || viśālenāpi śirasā bhaveddaurbhāgyabhājanam || 122 || keśā alikulacchāyāḥ sūkṣmāḥ snigdhāḥ sukomalāḥ || kiṃcidākuṃcitāgrāśca kuṭilāścātiśobhanāḥ || 123 || paruṣāḥ sphuṭitāgrāśca viralāśca śiroruhāḥ || piṃgalā laghavo rūkṣā duḥkhadāridryabaṃdhadāḥ || 124 || bhruvorantarlalāṭe vā maśako rājyasūcakaḥ || vāme kapole maśakaḥ śoṇo miṣṭānnadaḥ striyāḥ || 125 || tilakaṃ lāṃchanaṃ vāpi hṛdi saubhāgyakāraṇam || yasyā dakṣiṇavakṣoje śoṇe tilakalāṃchane || 126 || kanyā catuṣṭayaṃ sūte sūte sā ca sutatrayam || tilakaṃ lāṃchanaṃ śoṇaṃ yasyā vāme kuce bhavet || 127 || ekaṃ putraṃ prasūyādau tataḥ sā vidhavā bhavet || guhyasya dakṣiṇe bhāge tilakaṃ yadi yoṣitaḥ || 128 || tadā kṣitipateḥ patnī sūte vā kṣitipaṃ sutam || nāsāgre maśakaḥ śoṇo mahiṣyā eva jāyate|| 129 || kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva bhartṛghnyāḥ puṃścalyāśca prakīrtitaḥ || nābheradhastāttilakaṃ maśako lāṃchanaṃ śubham || 4.1.37.130 || maśakastilakaṃ cihnaṃ gulphadeśe daridrakṛta || kare karṇe kapole vā kaṇṭhe vāme bhavedyadi || 131 || eṣāṃ trayāṇāmekaṃ tu prāggarbhe putradaṃ bhavet || bhālagena triśūlena nirmitena svayaṃbhuvā || 132 || nitaṃbinī sahasrāṇāṃ svāmitvaṃ yoṣidāpnuyāt || suptā parasparaṃ yātu daṃtānkiṭikiṭāyate || 133 || sulakṣmāpi na sā śastā yā kiṃcitpralapettathā || pāṇau pradakṣiṇāvarto dharmyo vāmo na śobhanaḥ || 134 || nābhau śrutāvurasi vā dakṣiṇāvarta īḍitaḥ || sukhāya dakṣiṇāvartaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśasya dakṣiṇe || 135 || antaḥpṛṣṭhaṃ nābhisamo bahvāyuḥ putravardhanaḥ || rājapatnyāḥ pradṛśyeta bhagamaulau pradakṣiṇaḥ || 136 || sacecchakaṭabhaṃgaḥsyādbahvapatyasukhapradaḥ || kaṭigo guhyavedhena patyapatyanipātanaḥ || 137 || syātāmudaravedhena pṛṣṭhāvartau na śobhanau || ekena haṃti bhartāraṃ bhavedanyena puṃ ścalī || 138 || kaṇṭhago dakṣiṇāvarto duḥkhavaidhavyahetukaḥ || sīmantetha lalāṭe vā tyājyo dūrātprayatnataḥ || 139 || sā patiṃ haṃti varṣeṇa yasyā madhye kṛkāṭikam|| pradakṣiṇo vā vāmo vā romṇāmāvarttakaḥ striyāḥ || 4.1.37.140 || eko vā mūrdhani dvau vā vāme vāmagatī yadi || ādaśāhaṃ patighnau tau tyājyau dūrātsubuddhinā || 141 || kaṭyāvartā ca kulaṭā nābhyāvartā pativratā || pṛṣṭhāvartā ca bhartṛghnī kulaṭā vātha jāyate || 142 || skaṃda uvāca || sulakṣaṇāpi duḥśīlā kulakṣaṇa śiromaṇiḥ || alakṣaṇāpi sā sādhvī sarvalakṣaṇabhūstu sā|| 143 || sulakṣaṇā sucāritrā svādhīnā patidevatā || viśveśānugrahādeva gṛhe yoṣidavāpyate || 144 || alakṛtāḥ svavāsinyo yābhiḥ prāktanajanmani || nānāvidhairalaṃkāraistāḥ surūpā bhavaṃti hi || 145 || sutīrtheṣu vapuryābhiḥ kṣayitaṃ vā vihāyitam || tā lāvaṇyataraṃgiṇyo bhavaṃtīha sulakṣaṇāḥ || 146 || arcitā jagatāṃ mātā yābhirmṛḍavadhūriva || tā bhavaṃti sucāritrā yoṣāḥ svādhīnabha rtṛkāḥ || 147|| svādhīna patikānāṃ ca suśīlānāṃ mṛgīdṛśām || svargāpavargāvatraiva sulakṣaṇa phalaṃ hi tat || 148 || sulakṣaṇaiḥ sucaritairapi maṃdāyuṣaṃ patim || dīrghāyuṣaṃ prakurvaṃti pramadāḥ pramadāspadam || 149 || ataḥ sulakṣaṇā yoṣā pariṇeyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || lakṣaṇāni parīkṣyādau hitvā durlakṣaṇānyapi || 4.1.37.150 || lakṣaṇāni mayoktāni sukhāya gṛhamedhinām|| vivāhānapi vakṣyāmi tannibodha ghaṭodbhava || 151 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe strīlakṣaṇavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
<4.1.38>
