skaṃda uvāca || vivāhā brāhma daivārṣāḥ prājāpatyāsurau tathā || gāṃdharvo rākṣasaścāpi paiśāco'ṣṭama ucyate || 1 || sa brāhmo varamāhūya yatra kanyā svalaṃkṛtā || dīyate tatsutaḥ pūyātpuruṣānekaviṃśatim || 2 || yajñasthāyartvije daivastajjaḥpāti caturdaśa || varādādāya godvaṃdvamārṣastajjaḥ punāti ṣaṭ || 3 || sahobhau caratāṃ dharmamityuktvā dīyaterthine || yatra kanyā prājāpatyastajjo vaṃśānpunāti ṣaṭ || 4 || catvāra ete viprāṇāṃ dharmyāḥ pāṇigrahāḥ smṛtāḥ || āsuraḥ krayaṇāddravyairgāṃdharvonyonya maitrataḥ || 5 || prasahyakanyāharaṇādrākṣaso niṃditaḥ satām || chalena kanyāharaṇātpaiśāco garhito'ṣṭamaḥ || 6 || prāyaḥ kṣatraviśoruktā gāṃdharvāsurarākṣasāḥ || aṣṭamastveṣa pāpiṣṭhaḥ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ ca saṃbhavet || 7 || savarṇayā karo grāhyo dhāryaḥ kṣatriyayā śaraḥ || pratodo vaiśyayā dhāryo vāsoṃtaḥ pajjayā tathā || 8 || asavarṇastveṣa vidhiḥ smṛto dṛṣṭaśca vedane || savarṇābhistu sarvābhiḥ pāṇirgrāhyastvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 9 || dharmyairvivāhairjāyaṃte dharmyā eva śatāyuṣaḥ || adharmyairdharmarahitā maṃdabhāgyadhanāyuṣaḥ || 4.1.38.10 || ṛtukālābhigamanaṃ dharmoyaṃ gṛhiṇaḥ paraḥ || strīṇāṃ varamanusmṛtya yathākāmyathavā bhavet || 11 || divābhigamanaṃ puṃsāmanāyuṣyaṃ paraṃ matam || śrāddhāhaḥ sarvaparvāṇi yatnāttyājyāni dhīmatā || 12 || tatra gacchanstriyaṃ mohāddharmātpracyavate parāt || 13 || ṛtukālābhigāmī yaḥ svadāranirataśca yaḥ || sa sadā brahmacārī ca vijñeyaḥ sadgṛhāśramī || 14|| ṛtuḥ ṣoḍaśayāminyaścatasrastā sugarhitāḥ || putrāstāsvapi yā yugmā ayugmāḥ kanyakā prajāḥ || 15 || tyaktvā caṃdramasaṃ duḥsthaṃ maghāṃ pauṣṇaṃ vihāya ca || śuciḥ sannirviśetpatnīṃ punnāmarkṣe viśeṣataḥ || śuciṃ putraṃ prasūyeta puruṣārthaprasādhakam || 16 || ārṣe vivāhe godvaṃdvaṃ yaduktaṃ tanna śasyate || śulkamaṇvapi kanyāyāḥ kanyā vikrayapāpakṛt || 17 || apatyavikrayī kalpaṃ vasedviṭkṛmibhojane || ato nāṇvapi kanyāyā upajīvetpitā dhanam || 18 || strīdhanānyupajīvaṃti ye mohādiha bāṃdhavāḥ || na kevalaṃ nirayagāsteṣāmapi hi pūrvajāḥ || 19 || patyā tuṣyati yatra strī tuṣyedyatra striyā patiḥ || tatra tuṣṭā mahālakṣmīrnivaseddānavā'riṇā || 4.1.38.20 || vāṇijyaṃ nṛpateḥ sevā vedānadhyāpanaṃ tathā || kuvivāhaḥ kriyālopaḥ kule patanahetavaḥ || 21 || kuryādvaivāhike vahnau gṛhyakarmānvahaṃ gṛhī || paṃcayajñakriyāṃ cāpi paktiṃ dainaṃdinīmapi || 22 || gṛhasthāśramiṇaḥ paṃca sūnā karma dine dine || kaṃḍanī peṣaṇī cullī hyudakuṃbhastu mārjanī || 23 || tāsāṃ ca paṃcasūnānāṃ nirākaraṇahetavaḥ || kratavaḥ paṃca nirdiṣṭā gṛhi śreyobhivardhanāḥ || 24 || pāṭhanaṃ brahmayajñaḥ syāttarpaṇaṃ ca pitṛ kratuḥ || homo daivo balirbhauto'tithyarcā nṛkratuḥ kramāt || 25 || pitṛprītiṃ prakurvāṇaḥ kurvīta śrāddhamanvaham || annodakapayomūlaiḥ phalairvāpi gṛhāśramī||26|| godānena ca yatpuṇyaṃ pātrāya vidhipūrvakam || satkṛtya bhikṣave bhikṣāṃ dattvā tatphalamāpnuyāt || 27 || tapovidyāsamiddīpte hutaṃ viprāsya pāvake || tārayedvighnasaṃghebhyaḥ pāpābdherapi dustarāt || 28 || anarcito'tithirgehādbhagnāśo yasya gacchati || ājanmasaṃcitātpuṇyātkṣaṇātsa hi bahirbhavet || 29 || sāṃtvapūrvāṇi vākyāni śayyārthe bhūstṛṇodake || etānyapi pradeyāni sadābhyāgata tuṣṭaye || 4.1.38.30 || gṛhasthaḥ parapākādī pretya tatpaśutāṃ vrajet || śreyaḥ parānnapuṣṭasya gṛhṇīyādannado yataḥ || 31 || ādityoḍho'tithiḥ sāyaṃ satkartavyaḥ prayatnataḥ || asatkṛtonyato gacchanduṣkṛtaṃ bhūri yacchati || 32 || bhuṃjāno'tithiśeṣānnamihāyurdhanabhāgbhavet || praṇodyātithimannāśī kilbiṣī ca gṛhāśramī || 33 || vaiśvadevāṃta saṃprāptaḥ sūryoḍho vātithiḥ smṛtaḥ|| na pūrvakāla āyāto na ca dṛṣṭacaraḥ kvacit || 34 || balipātrakare vipre yadyanyotithirāgataḥ || adattvā taṃ baliṃ tasmai yathāśaktyānnamarpayet || 35 || kumārāśca svavāsinyo garbhiṇyo'tirujānvitāḥ || atitherāditopyete bhojyā nātra vicāraṇā || 36 || pitṛdevamanuṣyebhyo dattvāśnātyamṛtaṃ gṛhī || svārthaṃ pacannaghaṃ bhuṃkte kevalaṃ svodaraṃbhariḥ || 37 || mādhyāhnikaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ gṛhasthaḥ svayamācaret || patnī sāyaṃ baliṃ dadyātsiddhānnairmaṃtravarjitam || 38 || etatsāyaṃtanaṃ nāma vaiśvadevaṃ gṛhāśrame || sāyaṃprātarbhavedeva vaiśvadevaṃ prayatnataḥ || 39 || vaiśvadevena ye hīnā ātithyena vivarjitāḥ || sarve te vṛṣalā jñeyāḥ prāptavedā api dvijāḥ || 4.1.38.40 || akṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tu bhuṃjate ye dvijādhamāḥ || iha lokennahīnāḥ syuḥ kākayoniṃ vrajaṃtyatha || 41 || vedoditaṃ svakaṃ karma nityaṃ kuryādataṃdritaḥ || taddhi kurvanyathāśakti prāpnuyātsadgatiṃ parām || 42 || ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamyorvasetpāpaṃ taile māṃse sadaiva hi || paṃcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathaiva ca bhagekṣure || 43 || udayaṃ taṃ na cekṣeta nāstaṃ yaṃtaṃ na madhyagam || na rāhuṇopasṛṣṭaṃ ca nāṃbusaṃsthaṃ divākaram|| 44 || na vīkṣetātmamanorūpamāśudhāvenna varṣati || nollaṃghayedvatsataṃtrīṃ na nagno jalamāviśet || 45 || devatāyatanaṃ vipraṃ dhenuṃ madhumṛdaṃ ghṛtam || jātivṛddhaṃ vayovṛddhaṃ vidyāvṛddhaṃ tapasvinam || 46 || aśvatthaṃ caityavṛkṣaṃ ca guruṃ jalabhṛtaṃ ghaṭam || siddhānnaṃ dadhisiddhārthaṃ gacchankuryātpradakṣiṇam || 47 || rajasvalāṃ na seveta nāśnīyātsaha bhāryayā|| ekavāsā na bhuṃjīta na bhuṃjītotkaṭāsane|| 48 || nāśnaṃtīṃ strīṃ samīkṣeta tejaskāmo dvijottamaḥ || asaṃtarpya pitṝndevānnādyādannaṃ navaṃ kvacit || 49 || pakvānnaṃ cāpi no māṃsaṃ dīrghakālaṃ jijīviṣuḥ || na mūtraṃ govraje kuryānna valmīke na bhasmani || 4.1.38.50 || na garteṣu sasatveṣu na tiṣṭhanna vrajannapi || goviprasūryavāyvagni caṃdrarkṣāṃbu gurūnapi || 51 || abhipaśyanna kurvīta malamūtravisarjanam|| tiraskṛtyāvaniṃ loṣṭakāṣṭhaparṇatṛṇādibhiḥ || 52 || prāvṛtya vāsasā mauliṃ maunī viṇmūtramutsṛjet || yathāsukhamukho rātrau dinecchāyāṃdhakārayoḥ || 53 || bhītiṣu prāṇabādhāyāṃ kuryānmalavisarjanam || mukhenopadhamennāgniṃ nagnāṃ nekṣeta yoṣitam || 54 || nāṃghrī pratāpayedagnau na vastvaśuci nikṣipet|| prāṇihiṃsāṃ na kurvīta nāśnīyātsam̐dhyayordvayoḥ||55|| na saṃviśeta saṃdhyāyāṃ pratyaksaumyaśirā api|| viṇmūtraṣṭhīvanaṃ nāpsu kuryāddīrghajijīviṣuḥ|| 56|| nācakṣīta dhayaṃtīṃ gāṃ neṃdracāpaṃ pradarśayet|| naikaḥ supyātkvacicchūnye na śayānaṃ prabodhayet|| 57|| paṃthānaṃ naikalo yāyānna vāryaṃjalinā pibet || na divodbhūta sāraṃ ca bhakṣayeddadhino niśi || 58 || strīdharmiṇyā nābhivadennādyādātṛpti rātriṣu || tauryatrika priyo na syātkāṃsye pādau na dhāvayet || 59 || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā para śrāddhe yo'śnīyājjñānavarjitaḥ || dātuḥ śrāddhaphalaṃ nāsti bhoktā kilbiṣabhugbhavet || 4.1.38.60 || na dhārayedanyabhuktaṃ vāsaśco pānahāvapi || na bhinna bhājaneśnīyānnāsītāgnyādi dūṣite|| 61|| ārohaṇaṃ gavāṃ pṛṣṭhe pretadhūmaṃ sarittaram|| bālātapaṃ divāsvāpaṃ dyajeddīrghaṃ jijīviṣuḥ|| 62|| snātvā na mārjayedgātraṃ visṛjenna śikhāṃ pathi|| hastau śiro na dhunuyānnākarṣedāsanaṃ padā|| 63|| notpāṭayellomanakhaṃ daśanena kadācana|| karajaiḥ karajacchedaṃ tṛṇacchedaṃ vivarjayet||64|| śubhāyana yadāyatyāṃ tyajettatkarma yatnataḥ|| advāreṇa na gaṃtavyaṃ svaveśmaparaveśmanoḥ|| 65|| krīḍennākṣaiḥ sahāsīta na dharmaghnairna rogibhiḥ || na śayīta kvacinnagnaḥ pāṇau bhuṃjīta naiva ca || 66 || ārdrapādakarāsyośnandīrghakālaṃ ca jīvati || saṃviśennārdracaraṇo nocchiṣṭaḥ kvacidāvrajet || 67 || śayanastho na cāśnīyānnapibenna japeddvijaḥ || sopānatkaścanācāmenna tiṣṭhandhārayā pibet || 68 || sarvaṃ tilamayaṃ nādyātsāyaṃ śarmābhilāṣukaḥ|| na nirīkṣeta viṇmūtre nocchiṣṭaḥ saṃspṛśecchiraḥ || 69 || nādhitiṣṭhettuṣāṃgāra bhasmakeśakapālikāḥ || patitaiḥ saha saṃvāsaḥ patanāyaiva jāyate || 4.1.38.70 || śrāvayedvaidikaṃ maṃtraṃ na śūdrāya kadācana || brāhmaṇyāddhīyate vipraḥ śūdro dharmācca hīyate || 71 || dharmopadeśaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ svaśreyaḥ pratighātayet || dvijaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ dharmaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ hi paro mataḥ || 72 || kaṃḍūyanaṃ hi śirasaḥ pāṇibhyāṃ na śubhaṃ matam || ātāḍanaṃ karābhyāṃ ca krośanaṃ keśaluṃcanam ||73 || aśāstravartino bhūpāllubdhātkṛtvā pratigraham || brāhmaṇaḥ sānvayo yāti narakānekaviṃśatim || 74 || akālavidyutstanite varṣartau pāṃsuvarṣaṇe || mahāvātadhvanau rātrāvanadhyāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 75 || ulkāpāte ca bhūkaṃpe digdāhe madhyarātriṣu || saṃdhyayorvṛṣalopāṃte rājñorāhośca sūtake || 76 || darśāṣṭakāsu bhūtāyāṃ śrāddhikaṃ pratigṛhya ca || pratipadyapi pūrṇāyāṃ gajoṣṭrābhyāṃ kṛtāṃtare || 77 || kharoṣṭrakroṣṭra virute samavāye rudatyapi || upākarmaṇi cotsarge nāvimārge tarau jale || 78 || āraṇyakamadhītyāpi bāṇasāmnorapi dhvanau || anadhyāyeṣu caiteṣu nādhīyīta dvijaḥ kvacit || 79 || kṛtāṃtarāyo na paṭhedbhekākhu śvāhi babhrubhiḥ || bhūtāṣṭamyoḥ paṃcadaśyorbrahmacārī sadā bhavet || 4.1.38.80 || anāyuṣyakaraṃ caiva paradāropasarpaṇam || tasmāttaddūratastyājyaṃ vairiṇāṃ copasevanam || 81 || pūrvarddhibhiḥ parityaktamātmānaṃ nāvamānayet || sadodyamavatāṃ yasmācchriyo vidyā na durlabhāḥ || 82 || satyaṃ brūyātpriyaṃ brūyānnabrūyātsatyamapriyam || priyaṃ ca nānṛtaṃ brūyādeṣa dharmo ghaṭodbhava || 83 || bhadrameva vadennityaṃ bhadrameva viciṃtayet || bhadraireveha saṃsargo nābhadraiśca kadācana || 84 || rūpavittakulairhīnānsudhīrnādhikṣipennarān || puppavaṃtau na cekṣeta tvaśucirjyotiṣāṃ gaṇam || 85 || vācovegaṃ manovegaṃ jihvāvegaṃ ca varjayet || utkoca dyūta dautyārta dravyaṃ dūrātparityajet ||86|| gobrāhmaṇāgnīnucchiṣṭa pāṇinā naiva saṃspṛśet|| na spṛśedanimitte nakhāni svāni tvanāturaḥ || 87 || guhyajānyapi lomāni tatsparśādaśucirbhavet || pādadhautodakaṃ mūtramucchiṣṭānnodakāni ca|| 88|| niṣṭhīvanaṃ ca śleṣmāṇaṃ gṛhāddūraṃ vinikṣipet || aharniśaṃ śruterjāpyācchaucācāraniṣevaṇāt || adrohavatyā buddhyā ca pūrvaṃ janma smareddvijaḥ || 89 || vṛddhānprayatnādvaṃdeta dadyātteṣāṃ svamāsanam || vinamradhamanistasmādanuyāyāttataśca tān ||4.1.38.90 || śruti bhūdeva devānāṃ nṛpa sādhu tapasvinām|| pativratānāṃ nārīṇāṃ niṃdāṃ kuryānna karhicit|| 91 || na manuṣyastutiṃ kuryānnātmānamapamānayet || abhyudyataṃ na praṇudetparamarmāṇi noccaret || 92|| adharmādedhate pūrvaṃ vidveṣṭṝnapi saṃjayet|| sarvatobhadramāpyāpi tato naśyecca sānvayaḥ || 93 || uddhṛtya paṃca mṛtpiṃḍānsnāyātparajalāśaye || anuddhṛtya ca tatkarturenasaḥ syātturīyabhāk || 94 || śraddhayā pātramāsādya yatkiṃciddīyate vasu || deśe kāle ca vidhinā tadānaṃtyāya kalpate || 95 || bhūprado maṃḍalādhīśaḥ sarvatrasukhinonnadāḥ || toyadātā sadā tṛpto rūpavānrūpyado bhavet || 96 || pradīpado nirmalākṣo godātā'ryamalokabhāk || svarṇadātā ca dīrghāyustiladaḥ syāttu suprajāḥ || 97 || veśmado 'tyuccasaudheśo vastradaścaṃdralo kabhāk || hayaprado divyayāno lakṣmīvānvṛṣabhapradaḥ || 98|| subhāryaḥ śibikā dātā suparyaṃka pradopi ca || dhānyaiḥ samṛddhimānnityamabhayaprada īśitā ||99|| brahmado brahmalokejyo brahmadaḥ sarvado mataḥ || upāyenāpi yo brahma dāpayetsopi tatsamaḥ || 4.1.38.100 || śraddhayā pratigṛhṇāti śraddhayā yaḥ prayacchati || svargiṇau tāvubhau syātāṃ patato'śraddhayātyadhaḥ || 101 || anṛtena kṣaredyajñastapo vismayataḥ kṣaret || kṣaretkīrtanatodānamāyurviprāpavādataḥ || 102 || gaṃdhapuṣpakuśāñchayyāṃ śākaṃ māṃsaṃ payo dadhi || maṇi matsya gṛhaṃ dhānyaṃ grāhyametadupasthitam || 103 || madhūdakaṃ phalaṃ mūlamedhāṃsyabhayadakṣiṇā || abhyudyatāni grāhyāṇi tvetānyapinikṛṣṭataḥ || 104 || dāsa nāpita gopāla kulamitrārdhasīriṇaḥ || bhojyānnāḥ śūdravargemī tathātmavinivedakaḥ || 105 || itthamānṛṇyamāsādya devarṣipitṛjādṛṇāt || mādhyasthyamāśrayedgehe sute viṣvagvisṛjya ca || 106 || gehepi jñānamabhyasyetkāśīṃ vātha samāśrayet || samyagjñānena vā muktiḥ kiṃvā viśveśaveśmani || 107 || samyagjñānaṃ bhavetpuṃsāṃ kuta ekena janmanā || vārāṇasyāṃ dhruvā muktiḥ śarīratyāgamātrataḥ || 108 || adya śvo vā paraśvo vā kālādvātha paraḥśatāt || satvaro gatvaro dehaḥ kāśyāṃ cedamṛtī bhavet || 109 || sā ca vārāṇasī labhyā sadācāravatā sadā || manasāpi sadācāramato vidvānna laṃghayet || 4.1.38.110 || ākarṇyeti tatogastyaḥ punaḥ prāha ṣaḍānanam || punaḥ kāśīṃ samācakṣva sadācāreṇa yāpyate || || 111 || kāni kāni ca liṃgāni skaṃda jñānapradāni ca || vārāṇasyāṃ paribrūhi tāni me paripṛcchataḥ || 112 || vinā kāśīṃ na me prītirvinākāśīṃ na me ratiḥ || citraputrakavaccāsmi vinā kāśī ṣaḍānana || 113 || na nidrāmi na jāgarmi nāśnāmi na pibāmyapaḥ || kāśīṃ dvyakṣarapīyūṣaṃ pibāmi hi ca kevalam || 114 || iti śrutvā vacaḥ skaṃdo maitrāvaruṇibhāṣitam || avimuktasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ samupacakrame || 115 || iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe sadācāravarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||
<4.1.39>
skaṃda uvāca || śṛṇvagastya mahābhāga kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || naiḥśreyasyāḥ śriyohetumavimukta samāśrayām || 1 || paraṃ brahma yadāmnātaṃ niṣprapaṃcaṃ nirātmakam || nirvikalpaṃ nirākāramavyaktaṃ sthūlasūkṣmavat || 2 || tadetatkṣetramāpūrya sthitaṃ sarvagamapyaho || kimanyatra na śaktosau jaṃtūnmocayituṃ bhavāt || 3 || bhavo dhruvaṃ yadatraiva mocayettaṃ niśāmaya || mahatyā yogayuktyā vā mahādānairakāmikaiḥ || 4 || sumahadbhistapobhirvā śivonyatra vimocayet || yogayuktiṃ na mahatīṃ na dānāni mahāṃti ca || 5 || na tapāṃsyatidīrghāṇi kāśyāṃ muktyai śivorthayet || viyunakti na yatkāśyā upasarge mahatyapi || 6 || ayameva mahāyoga upayogastvihā paraḥ || niyamena tu viśveśe puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ jalam || 7 || yaddattaṃ sumanovṛttyā mahādānaṃ tadatra vai || muktimaṃḍapikāyāṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ yatsthiramāsyate || 8 || snātvā gaṃgāmṛte śuddhe tapa etadihottamam || satkṛtya bhikṣave bhikṣā yatkāśyāṃ paridīyate || tulā puruṣa etasyāḥ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm || 9 || hṛdi saṃciṃtya viśveśaṃ kṣaṇaṃ yadvinimīlyate|| devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge mahāyogoyamuttamaḥ || 4.1.39.10 || idameva tapotyugraṃ yadiṃdriya vilolatām || niṣidhya sthīyate kāśyāṃ kṣuttāpādyavamanya ca || 11 || māsi māsi yadāpyeta vratāccāṃdrāyaṇātphalam || anyatra tadihāpyeta bhūtāyāṃ naktabhojanāt || 12 || māsopavāsādanyatra yatphalaṃ samupārjyate || śraddhayaikopavāsena tatkāśyāṃ syādasaṃśayam||13|| cāturmāsya vratātproktaṃ yadanyatra mahāphalam || ekādaśyupavāsena tatkāśyāṃ syādasaṃśayam || 14 || ṣaṇmāsānna parityāgādyadanyatra phalaṃ labhet|| śivarātryupavāsena tatkāśyāṃ jāyate dhruvam || 15 || varṣaṃ kṛtvopavāsāni labhedanyatra yadvratī || tatphalaṃ syāttrirātreṇa kāśyāmavikalaṃ mune || 16 || māsimāsi kuśāgrāṃbu pānādanyatra yatphalam || kāśyāmuttaravāhinyāmekena culukena tat || 17 || anaṃto mahimā kāśyāḥ kastaṃ varṇayituṃ prabhuḥ || vipattimicchato jaṃtoryatrakarṇe japaḥ śivaḥ || 18 || śaṃbhustatkiṃcidācaṣṭe mriyamāṇasya janminaḥ || karṇe'kṣaraṃ yadākarṇya mṛtopyamṛtatāṃ vrajet || 19 || smāraṃ smāraṃ smararipoḥ purīṃ tvamiva śaṃkaraḥ || adunonmaṃdaraṃ yāto bahuśastadavāptaye ||4.1.39.20|| agastya uvāca || svakāryanipuṇaiḥ svāmingīrvāṇairatidāruṇaiḥ || tyājitohaṃ purīṃ kāśīṃ haro tyākṣītkutaḥ prabhuḥ || 21 || parādhīnohamiva kiṃ devadevaḥ pinākavān || kāśikāṃ so'tyajatkasmānnirvāṇamaṇirāśikām || 22 || || skaṃda uvāca || || mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhūta kathayāmi kathāmimām || tatyāja ca yathā sthāṇuḥ kāśīṃ vidhyuparodhataḥ || 23 || prārthitastvaṃ yathā lekhaiḥ paropakṛtaye mune || druhiṇena tathā rudraḥ svarakṣaṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ || 24 || || agastya uvāca || || kathaṃ sa bhagavānrudro druhiṇena kṛpāṃbudhiḥ || prārthitobhūtkimarthaṃ ca tanme brūhi ṣaḍānana || 25 || || skaṃda uvāca || || pādmekalpe purāvṛtte manoḥ svāyaṃbhuveṃtare || anāvṛṣṭirabhūdvipra sarvabhūtaprakaṃpinī || 26 || tayā tu ṣaṣṭihāyinyā pīḍitāḥ prāṇino'khilāḥ || kecidaṃbudhitīreṣu giridroṇīṣu kecana || 27 || mahānimneṣu kaccheṣu munivṛttyā janāḥ sthitāḥ || araṇyānyavanirjātā grāmakharvaṭa varjitā || 28 || kravyādā eva sarveṣu nagareṣu pureṣu ca || āsannabhraṃliho vṛkṣāḥ sarvatra kṣoṇimaṃḍale || 29 || caurā eva mahācaurairulluṭhyaṃta itastataḥ || māṃsavṛttyopajīvaṃti prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣiṇaḥ || 4.1.39.30 || arājake samutpanne loke'tyāhitaśaṃsini || prayatno viphalastvāsītsṛṣṭeḥ sṛṣṭikṛtastadā || 31 || ciṃtāmavāpa mahatī jagadyoniḥ prajākṣayāt || prajāsu kṣīyamāṇāsu kṣīṇā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 32|| tāsu kṣīṇāsu saṃkṣīṇāḥ sarve yajñabhujo'bhavan || tataściṃtayatā sraṣṭrā dṛṣṭo rājarṣisattamaḥ || 33 || avimukte mahākṣetre tapasyanniścaleṃdriyaḥ || manoranvayajo vīraḥ kṣātro dharma ivoditaḥ || 34 || ripuṃjaya iti khyāto rājā parapuraṃjayaḥ || atha brahmā tamāsādya bahugauravapūrvakam || 35 || uvāca vacanaṃ rājanripuṃjaya mahāmate || ilāṃ pālaya bhūpāla sasamudrādrikānanām || 36 || nāgakanyāṃ nāgarājaḥ patnyarthaṃ te pradāsyati || anaṃgamohinīṃ nāmnā vāsukiḥ śīlabhūṣaṇām || 37 || divopi devā dāsyaṃti ratnāni kusumāni ca || prajāpālanasaṃtuṣṭā mahārāja pratikṣaṇam || 38 || divodāsa iti khyātamato nāma tvamāpsyasi || matprabhāvācca nṛpate divyaṃ sāmarthyamastu te || 39 || parameṣṭhivacaḥ śrutvā tatosau rājasattamaḥ || vedhasaṃ bahuśaḥ stutvā vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 4.1.39.40 || ||rājovāca || || pitāmaha mahāprājña janākīrṇe mahītale || kathaṃ nānye ca rājāno māṃ kathaṃ kathyate tvayā || 41 || || brahmovāca || || tvayi rājyaṃ prakurvāṇe devo vṛṣṭiṃ vidhāsyati|| pāpaniṣṭhe ca vai rājñi na devo varṣate punaḥ || 42 || || rājovāca || || pitāmaha mahāmānya trilokī karaṇakṣama|| mahāprasāda ityājñāṃ tvadīyāṃ mūrdhnyupādade || 43 || kiṃcidvijñaptukāmohaṃ tanmadarthaṃ karoṣi cet || tataḥ karomyahaṃ rājyaṃ pṛthivyāmasapatnavat || 44 || || brahmovāca || avilaṃbena tadbrūhi kṛtaṃ manyasva pārthiva || yatte hṛdi mahābāho tavādeyaṃ na kiṃcana || 45 || || rājovāca || || yadyahaṃ pṛthivīnāthaḥ sarvalokapitāmaha || tadādiviṣa(pa?)do devā divi tiṣṭhaṃtu mā bhuvi || 46 || deveṣu divitiṣṭhatsu mayi tiṣṭhati bhūtale || asapatnena rājyena prajāsaukhyamavāpsyati || 47 || tatheti viśvasṛkprokto divodāso nareśvaraḥ || paṭahaṃ ghoṣayāṃcakre divaṃ devā vrajaṃtviti || 48 || mā gacchaṃtviha vai nāgā narāḥ svasthā bhavaṃtvitaḥ || mayi praśāsati kṣoṇīṃ surāḥ svasthā bhavaṃtviti || 49 || etasminnaṃtare brahmā viśveśaṃ praṇipatya ha || yāvadvijñaptukāmobhūttāvadīśobravīdvidhim || 4.1.39.50 || lokeśvara samāyāhi maṃdaro nāma bhūdharaḥ || kuśadvīpādihāgatya tapastapyeta duṣkaram || 51 || yāvastasmai varaṃ dātuṃ bahukālaṃ tapasyate || ityuktvā pārvatīnātho naṃdibhṛṃgipurogamaḥ || 52 || jagāma vṛṣamāruhya maṃdaro yatra tiṣṭhati || uvāca ca prasannātmā devadevo vṛṣadhvaja ||53|| uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te varaṃ brūhi dharottama || sotha śrutvā maheśānaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam|| || 54 || praṇamya bahuśo bhūmāvadriretadvyajijñapat || līlāvigrahabhṛcchaṃbho praṇataika kṛpānidhe || 55 || sarvajñopi kathaṃ nāma na vettha mama vāṃchitam || śaraṇāgatasaṃtrāṇa sarvavṛttāṃtakovida || 56 || sarveṣāṃ hṛdayānaṃda śarvasarvagasarvakṛt || yadi deyo varo mahyaṃ svabhāvādṛṣadātmane ||57 || yācakāyātiśocyāya praṇatārtiprabhaṃjaka || tato'vimuktakṣetrasya sāmyaṃ hyabhilaṣāmyaham || 58 || kuśadvīpa umā sārdhaṃ nāthādya saparicchadaḥ || manmaulau vihitāvāsaḥ prayātveṣa varo mama || 59 || sarveṣāṃ sarvadaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ yāvadviciṃtayet || vijñātāvasaro brahmā tāvacchaṃbhuṃ vyajijñapat|| praṇamyāgresaro bhūtvā maulau baddhakaradvayaḥ || 4.1.39.60 || || brahmovāca || || viśveśa jagatāṃnātha patyā vyāpāritosmyaham || kṛtaprasādena vibho sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ caturvidhām || 61 || prayatnena mayā sṛṣṭā sā sṛṣṭistvadanujñayā || avṛṣṭyā ṣaṣṭihāyinyā tatra naṣṭā'prajā bhuvi || 62 || arājakaṃ mahaccāsīdduravasthamabhūjjagat || tato ripuṃjayo nāma rājarṣirmanuvaṃśajaḥ || 63 || mayābhiṣikto rājarṣiḥ prajāḥ pātuṃ nareśvaraḥ || cakāra samayaṃ sopi mahāvīryo mahātapāḥ ||64|| tavājñayā cetsthāsyaṃti sarve diviṣado divi || nāgaloke tathā nāgāstato rājyaṃ karomyaham || || 65 || tatheti ca mayā proktaṃ pramāṇīkriyatāṃ tu tat || maṃdarāya varo datto bhavedevaṃ kṛpānidhe || 66 || tasya rājñaḥ prajāstrātuṃ bhūyāccaiṣa manorathaḥ || mama nāḍīdvayaṃ rājyaṃ tasyāpi ca śatakratoḥ || 67 || martyānāṃ gaṇanā kveha nimeṣārdha nimeṣiṇām|| devopi nirmalaṃ matvā maṃdaraṃ cārukaṃdaram ||68|| vidheśca gauravaṃ rakṣaṃstathorī kṛtavānharaḥ || jaṃbūdvīpe yathā kāśī nirvāṇapadadā sadā ||69|| tathā bahutithaṃ kālaṃ dvīpobhūtsopi maṃdaraḥ || yiyāsunā ca devena maṃdaraṃ citrakaṃdaram ||4.1.39.70|| nijamūrtimayaṃ liṃgamavijñātaṃ vidherapi || sthāpitaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ sthāpakebhyaḥ samarpitum || 71 || vipannānāṃ ca jaṃtūnāṃ dātuṃ naiḥśreyasīṃ śriyam || sarveṣāmiha saṃsthānāṃ kṣetraṃ caivābhirakṣitum|| 72 || maṃdarādrigatenāpi kṣetraṃ naitatpinākinā || vimuktaṃ liṃgarūpeṇa avimuktamataḥ smṛtam || 73 || purā naṃdavanaṃ nāma kṣetrametatprakīrtitam|| avimuktaṃ tadārabhya nāmāsya prathitaṃ bhuvi || 74 || nāmāvimuktamabhavadubhayoḥ kṣetraliṃgayoḥ || etaddvayaṃ samāsādya na bhūyo garbhabhāgbhavet || 75 || avimukteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣetre'vimuktake || vimukta eva bhavati sarvasmātkarmabaṃdhanāt || 76 || arcaṃti viśve viśveśaṃ viśveśorcati viśvakṛt || avimukteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ bhuvimuktipradāyakam || 77 || purā na sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ kasyacitkenacitkvacit || kimākṛti bhavelliṃgaṃ naitadvettyapi kaścana || 78 || ākāramavimuktasya dṛṣṭvā brahmācyutādayaḥ || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsurvasiṣṭhādyāstathaṣaryaḥ || 79 || ādiliṃgamidaṃ proktamavimukteśvaraṃ mahat || tato liṃgāṃtarāṇyatra jātāni kṣitimaṃḍale || 4.1.39.80 || avimukteśa nāmāpi śrutvā janmārjitādaghāt || kṣaṇānmukto bhavenmartyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||81 || avimukteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ smṛtvā dūragatopi ca || janmadvayakṛtātpāpātkṣaṇādeva vimucyate ||82|| avimukte mahākṣetre'vimuktamavalokya ca || trijanmajanitaṃ pāpaṃ hitvā puṇyamayo bhavet || 83 || yatkṛtaṃ jñānavibhraṃśādenaḥ paṃcasu janmasu || avimukteśa saṃsparśāttatkṣayedeva nānyathā || 84 || arcayitvā mahāliṃgamavimukteśvaraṃ naraḥ || kṛtakṛtyo bhavedatra na ca syājjanmabhākkutaḥ || 85 || stutvā natvārcayitvā ca yathāśakti yathāmati || avimukte vimukteśaṃ stūyate namyate'rcyate ||86|| anādimadidaṃ liṃgaṃ svayaṃ viśveśvarārcitam || kāśyāṃ prayatnataḥ sevyamavimuktaṃ vimuktaye || 87 || saṃti liṃgānyanekāni puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca || āyāṃti tāni liṃgāni māghīṃ prāpya catudarśīm|| 88 || kṛṣṇāyāṃ māghabhūtāyāmavimukteśa jāgarāt || sadā vigatanidrasya yogino gatibhāgbhavet || 89 || nānāyatanaliṃgāni caturvargapradānyapi || māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmavimuktamupāsate || 4.1.39.90 || kiṃ bibheti naro dhīraḥ kṛtādaghaśiloccayāt || avimukteśa liṃgasya bhakti vajradharo yadi || 91 || kvāvimuktaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ caturvargaphalodayam || kva pāpi pāpaśailo'lpo yaḥkṣayennāmasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 92 || avimukte mahākṣetre viśveśasamadhiṣṭhite || yairna dṛṣṭaṃ vimūḍhāste'vimuktaṃ liṃgamuttamam || 93 || draṣṭāramavimuktasya dṛṣṭvā daṃḍadharo yamaḥ || dūrādeva praṇamati prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ || 94 || dhanyaṃ tannetranirmāṇaṃ kṛtakṛtyau tu tau karau || avimukteśvaraṃ yena yābhyāmaikṣiṣṭa yaḥ spṛśet || 95 || trisaṃdhyamavimukteśaṃ yo japenniyataḥ śuciḥ || dūradeśavipannopi kāśīmṛtaphalaṃ labhet || 96 || avimuktaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā grāmāṃtaraṃ vrajet|| labdhāśukāryasaṃsiddhiṃ kṣemeṇa praviśedgṛham||97|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśī khaṃḍe pūrvārddhe avimukteśāvirbhāvonāmaikonacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||39||
<4.1.40>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || avimukteśa māhātmyaṃ varṇitaṃ tegrato mayā || atho kimasi śuśrūṣuḥ kathayiṣyāmi tatpunaḥ || 1 || || agastya uvāca || || avimukteśa māhātmyaṃ śrāvaṃ śrāvaṃ śrutī mama || atīva suśrute jāte tathāpi na dhinomyaham || 2 || avimukteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kṣetraṃ cāpyavimuktakam || etayostu kathaṃ prāptirbhavetṣaṇmukha tadvada || 3 || || skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇu kuṃ bhaja vakṣyāmi yathā prāptirbhavediha || svaśreyo dāturetasyā vimuktasya mahāmate || 4 || samīhitārtha saṃsiddhirlabhyate puṇyabhārataḥ || tacca puṇyaṃ bhavedvipra śrutivartmasabhājanāt ||5|| śrutivartmajuṣaḥ puṃsaḥ saṃsparśānnaśyato mune || kalikālāvapi sadā chidraṃ prāpya jighāṃsataḥ ||6|| varjitasya vidhānena proktasyākaraṇena vai || kalikālāvapi hato brāhmaṇaṃ raṃdhradarśanāt || 7 || niṣiddhācaraṇaṃ tasmātkathayiṣye tavāgrataḥ || taddūrataḥ parityajya naro na nirayī bhavet || 8 || palāṃḍuṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca śeluṃ laśuna gṛṃjane || gopīyūṣaṃ taṃḍulīyaṃ varjyaṃ ca kavakaṃ sadā || 9 || vraścanānvṛkṣaniryāsānpāyasāpūpaśaṣkulīḥ || adevapitryaṃ palalamavatsāgopayastyajet || 4.1.40.10 || paya aikaśaphaṃ heyaṃ tathā krāmelakāvikam || rātrau na dadhi bhoktavyaṃ divā na navanītakam || 11 || ṭiṭṭibhaṃ kalaviṃkaṃ ca haṃsaṃ cakraṃ plavaṃbakam || tyajenmāṃsāśinaḥ sarvānsārasaṃ kukkuṭaṃ śukam || 12 || jālapādānkhaṃjarīṭānbuḍitvā matsyabhakṣakān || matsyāśī sarvamāṃsāśī tanmatsyānsarvathā tyajet|| 13 || havyakavyaniyuktau tu bhakṣyau pāṭhīnarohitau|| māṃsāśibhistvamī bhakṣyāḥ śaśa śallaka kacchapāḥ ||14|| śvāvidgodhe praśaste ca jñātāśca mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ || āyuṣkāmaiḥ svargakāmaistyājyaṃ māṃsaṃ prayatnataḥ || 15 || yajñārthaṃ paśuhiṃsā yā sā svargyā netarā kvacit || tyajetparyuṣitaṃ sarvamakhaṃḍasneha varjitam|| 16 || prāṇātyaye kratau śrāddhe bhaiṣaje viprakāmyayā|| alaulyamitthaṃ palalaṃ bhakṣayannaiva doṣabhāk || 17 || na tādṛśaṃ bhavetpāpaṃ mṛgayāvṛttikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || yādṛśaṃ bhavati pretya laulyānmāṃsopasevinaḥ || 18 || makhārthaṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭāḥ paśu druma mṛgauṣadhīḥ || nighnannahiṃsako viprastāsāmapi śubhā gatiḥ || 19 || pitṛdevakratukṛte madhuparkārthameva ca || tatra hiṃsāpyahiṃsā syāddhiṃsānyatra sudustarā || 4.1.40.20 || yo jaṃtūnātmapuṣṭyarthaṃ hinasti jñānadurbalaḥ || durācārasya tasyeha nāmutrāpi sukhaṃ kvacit|| 21 || bhoktānumaṃtā saṃskartā krayivikrayi hiṃsakāḥ || upahartā ghātayitā hiṃsakāścāṣṭadhā smṛtāḥ || 22 || pratyabdamaśvamedhena śataṃ varṣāṇi yo yajet || amāṃsabhakṣako yaśca tayoraṃtyo viśiṣyate || 23 || yathaivātmā parastadvaddraṣṭavyaḥ sukhamicchatā || sukhaduḥkhāni tulyāni yathātmani tathā pare || 24 || sukhaṃ vā yadi vā cānyadyatkiṃcitkriyate pare|| tatkṛtaṃ hi punaḥ paścātsarvamātmani saṃbhavet || 25 || na kleśena vinā dravyamarthahīne kutaḥ kriyāḥ || kriyāhīne kuto dharmo dharmahīne kutaḥ sukham || || 26 || sukhaṃ hi sarvairākāṃkṣyaṃ tacca dharmasamudbhavam|| tasmāddharmotra kartavyaścāturvarṇyena yatnataḥ || 27 || nyāyāgatena dravyeṇa kartavyaṃ pāralaukikam || dānaṃ ca vidhinā deyaṃ kāle pātre ca bhāvataḥ || 28 || vidhihīnaṃ tathā'pātre yo dadāti pratigraham || na kevalaṃ hi tadyāti śeṣaṃ tasya ca naśyati || 29 || vyasanārthe kuṭuṃbārthe yadṛṇārthe ca dīyate || tadakṣayaṃ bhavedatra paratra ca na saṃśayaḥ ||4.1.40.30|| mātāpitṛvihīnaṃ yo mauṃjīpāṇigrahādibhiḥ || saṃskārayennijairarthaistasya śreyastvanaṃtakam || ||31 || agnihotrairna tacchreyo nāgniṣṭomādibhirmakhaiḥ || yacchreyaḥ prāpyate martyairdvije caike pratiṣṭhite || 32 || yo hyanāthasya viprasya pāṇiṃ grāhayate kṛtī || iha saukhyamavāpnoti sokṣayaṃ svargamāpnuyāt || 33 || pitṛgehe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyedasaṃskṛtā || bhrūṇahā tatpitā jñeyo vṛṣalī sāpi kanyakā || 34 || yastāṃ pariṇayenmohātsa bhavedvṛṣalīpatiḥ || tena saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tyājyamapāṅkteyena sarvadā || 35 || vijñāya doṣamubhayoḥ kanyāyāśca varasya ca || saṃbaṃdhaṃ racayetpaścādanyathā doṣabhākpitā || 36 || striyaḥ pavitrāḥ satataṃ naitā duṣyaṃti kenacit || māsimāsi rajastāsāṃ duṣkṛtānyapakarṣati || 37 || pūrvaṃ striyaḥ surairbhuktāḥ somagaṃdharva vahnibhiḥ || bhuṃjate mānuṣāḥ paścānnaitāduṣyaṃ ti kenacit || 38 || strīṇāṃ śaucaṃ dadau somaḥ pāvakaḥ sarvamedhyatām || kalyāṇavāṇīṃ gaṃdharvāstena medhyāḥ sadā striyaḥ || 39 || kanyāṃ bhuṃkte rajaḥkāle'gniḥ śaśī lomadarśane || stanodbhedeṣu gaṃdharvāstatprāgeva pradīyate ||4.1.40.40|| dṛśyaromātvapatyaghnī kulaghnyudgatayauvanā || pitṛghnyāviṣkatarajāstatastāḥ parivarjayet ||41|| kanyādānaphalaprepsustasmādda dyādanagnikām || anyathā na phalaṃ dātuḥ pratigrāhī patedadhaḥ ||42|| kanyāmabhuktāṃ somādyairdadaddānaphalaṃ labhet|| devabhuktāṃ dadaddātā na svargamadhigacchati ||43|| śayanāsanayānāni kuṇapaṃ strīmukhaṃ kuśāḥ|| yajñapātrāṇi sarvāṇi na duṣyaṃti budhāḥ kvacit || 44 || vatsaḥ prasravaṇe madhye śakuniḥ phalapātane || nāryo ratiprayogeṣu śvā mṛga grahaṇe śuciḥ || 41| ajāśvayormukhaṃ medhyaṃ gāvo medhyāstu pṛṣṭhataḥ || pādato brāhmaṇā medhyāḥ striyo medhyāstu sarvataḥ || 45 || balātkāropabhuktā vā corahastagatāpi vā || na tyājyā dayitā nārī nāsyāstyāgo vidhīyate || 47 || āmlena tāmraśuddhiḥ syācchuddhiḥ kāṃsyasya bhasmanā || saṃśuddhī rajasā nāryāstaṭinyā vegataḥ śuciḥ ||48|| manasāpi hi yā neha ciṃtayetpuruṣāṃtaram || somayā saha saukhyāni bhuṃkte cātrāpi kīrtibhāk||49|| pitā pitāmaho bhrātā sakulyo jananī tathā || kanyāpradaḥ pūrvanāśe prakṛtisthaḥ paraḥparaḥ || 4.1.40.50 || aprayacchansamāpnoti bhūṇahatyāmṛtāvṛtau || svayaṃ tvabhāve dātṝṇāṃ kanyā kuryātsvayaṃ varam|| || 51 || hṛtādhikārāṃ malināṃ piṃḍamātropajīvinīm|| paribhūtāmadhaḥśayyāṃ vāsayedvyabhicāriṇīm || 52 || vyabhicārādṛtau śuddhirgarbhe tyāgo vidhīyate || garbhabhartṛvadhādau tu mahatyapi ca kalmaṣe || 53 || śūdrasya bhāryā śūdraiva sā ca svā ca viśaḥ smṛte || te ca svā caiva rājñastu tāśca svācāgrajanmanaḥ || 54 || āropya śūdrāṃ śayane vipro gacchedadhogatim|| utpādya putraṃ śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate|| 55 || daivapitryātitheyāni tatpradhānāni yasya tu || devādyāstanna cāśnaṃti sa ca svargaṃ na gacchati || 56 || jāmayo yāni gehāni śapaṃtyapratipūjitāḥ || kṛtyābhirnihatānīva naśyeyustānyasaṃśayam || 57 || tadabhyarcyāḥ suvāsinyo bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ || bhūtikāmairnarairnityaṃ satkāreṣūtsaveṣu ca ||58|| yatra nāryaḥ pramuditā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ || ramaṃte devatāstatra syustatra saphalāḥ kriyāḥ || 59 || yatra tuṣyati bhartrā strī striyā bhartā ca tuṣyati || tatra veśmani kalyāṇaṃ saṃpadyeta pade pade ||4.1.40.60|| ahutaṃ ca hutaṃ caiva prahutaṃ prāśitaṃ tathā || brāhmaṃ hutaṃ paṃcamaṃ ca paṃcayajñā ime śubhāḥ || 61 || japo'hutohuto homaḥ prahuto bhautiko baliḥ || prāśitaṃ pitṛsaṃtṛptirhutaṃ brāhmaṃ dvijārcanam || 62 || paṃcayajñānimānkurvanbrāhmaṇo nāvasīdati || eteṣāmananuṣṭhānātpaṃcasūnā avāpnuyāt || 63 || brāhmaṇaṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchedbāhujātamanāmayam|| vaiśyaṃ sukhaṃ samāgamya śūdraṃ saṃtoṣameva ca || 64 || jātamātraḥ śiśustāvadyāvadaṣṭau samāḥ smṛtāḥ || bhakṣyābhakṣyeṣu no duṣyedyāvannaivopanīyate || 65 || bharaṇaṃ poṣyavargasya dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalodayam || pratyavāyo hyabharaṇe bhartavyastatprayatnataḥ || 66 || mātāpitāgurupatnīḥ tvapatyāni samāśritāḥ || abhyāgatotithiścāgniḥ poṣyavargā amī nava || 67 || sa jīvati pumānyo'tra bahubhiścopajīvyate || jīvanmṛtotha vijñeyaḥ puruṣaḥ svodaraṃbhariḥ || 68 || dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyo dātavyaṃ bhūtikāmyayā || adattadānā jāyaṃte parabhāgyopajīvinaḥ ||69|| vibhāgaśīlasaṃyukto dayāvāṃśca kṣamāyutaḥ || devatātithibhaktastu gṛhastho dhārmikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||4.1.40.70|| śarvarīmadhya yāmau yau hutaśeṣaṃ ca yaddhaviḥ || tatra svapaṃstadaśnaṃśca brāhmaṇo nāvasīdati || 71 || navaitāni gṛhasthasya kāryāṇyabhyāgate sadā || sudhā vyayāni yatsaumyaṃ vākyaṃ cakṣurmanomukham || 72 || abhyutthānamihāyāta sasnehaṃ pūrvabhāṣaṇam|| upāsanamanuvrajyā gṛhasthonnati hetave || 73 || tatheṣadvyayayuktāni kāryāṇyetāni vai nava || āsanaṃ pādaśaucaṃ ca yathāśaktyāśanaṃ kṣitiḥ || 74 || śayyātṛṇajalābhyaṃga dīpā gārhasthya siddhidāḥ || tathā nava vikarmāṇi tyājyāni gṛhamedhinām||75|| paiśunyaṃ paradārāśca drohaḥ krodhānṛtāpriyam || dveṣo daṃbhaśca māyā ca svargamārgārgalāni hi || 76 || navāvaśyakakarmāṇi kāryāṇi prativāsaram || snānaṃ saṃdhyā japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam || 77 || veśvadevaṃ tathātithyaṃ navamaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || nava gopyāni yānyatra mune tāni niśāmaya || 78 || janmarkṣaṃ maithunaṃ maṃtro gṛhacchidraṃ ca vaṃcanam || āyurdhanāpamānaṃ strī na prakāśyāni sarvathā || 79 || navaitāni prakāśyāni rahaḥ pāpamakutsitam || prāyogyamṛṇaśuddhiśca sānvayaḥ krayavikrayau || kanyādānaṃ guṇotkarṣo nānyatkenāpi kutracit || 4.1.40.80 || pātra mitra vinīteṣu dīnānāthopakāriṣu || mātāpitugurūṣvetannavakaṃ dattamakṣayam || 81 || niṣphalaṃ navasūtsṛṣṭaṃ cāṭacāraṇataskare || kuvaidye kitave dhūrte śaṭhe malle ca baṃdini || 82 || āpastvapi na deyāni navavastūni sarvathā || anvaye sati sarvasvaṃ dārāṃśca śaraṇāgatān || 83 || nyāsādhīkulavṛttiṃ ca nikṣepaṃ strīdhanaṃ sutam|| yo dadāti sa mūḍhātmā prāyaścittairviśudhyati || 84 || etannavānāṃ navakaṃ jñātvā priyamavāpnuyāt || anyacca navakaṃ vacmi sarveṣāṃ svargamārgadam || 85 || satyaṃ śaucamahiṃsā ca kṣāṃtirdānaṃ dayā damaḥ || asteyamiṃdriyākocaḥ sarveṣāṃ dharmasādhanam || 86 || abhyasya navatiṃ caitāṃ svargamārgapradīpikām|| satāmabhimatāṃ puṇyāṃ gṛhastho nāvasīdati || 87 || jihvā bhāryā suto bhrātā mitra dāsa samāśritāḥ || yasyaite vinayāḍhyāśca tasya sarvatra gauravam|| 88 || pānaṃ durjana saṃsargaḥ patyā ca virahoṭanam || svapnonyagṛhavāsaśca nārīṇāṃ dūṣaṇāni ṣaṭ ||89|| samarghaṃ dhānyamuddhatya maharghaṃ yaḥ prayacchati|| sa hi vārdhuṣiko nāma tasyānnaṃ naiva bhakṣayet || ||4.1.40.90|| agre māhiṣikaṃ dṛṣṭvā madhye ca vṛṣalīpatim|| aṃte vārdhuṣikaṃ caiva nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ || 91 || mahiṣītyucyate nārī yā ca syādvyabhicāriṇī || tāṃ duṣṭāṃ kāmayedyastu sa vai māhiṣikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||92|| sva vṛṣaṃ yā parityajya paravṛṣe vṛṣāyate|| vṛṣalī sā hi vijñeyā na śūdrī vṛṣalī bhavet || 93 || yāvaduṣṇaṃ bhavatyannaṃ yāvanmaunena bhujyate || tāvadaśnaṃti pitaro yāvannoktā havirguṇāḥ || 94 || vidyāvinayasaṃpanne śrotriye gṛhamāgate || krīḍaṃtyauṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 95|| bhraṣṭaśaucavatācāre vipre vedavivarjite || rodityannaṃ dīyamānaṃ kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 96 || yasya koṣṭhagataṃ cānnaṃ vedābhyāsena jīryati || sa tārayati dātāraṃ daśapūrvāndaśāparān || 97 || na strīṇāṃ vapanaṃ kāryaṃ na ca gāḥ samanuvrajet || na ca rātrau vasedgoṣṭhe na kuryādvaidikīṃ śrutim || 98 || sarvānkeśānsamuddhṛtya cchedayedaṃguladvayam || evameva tu nārīṇāṃ śiraso muṃḍanaṃ bhavet || 99 || rājā vā rājaputro vā brāhmaṇo vā bahuśrutaḥ || akārayitvā vapanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet || || 4.1.40.100 || keśānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya dviguṇaṃ vratamādiśet || dviguṇā dakṣiṇā deyā brāhmaṇe vedapārage || 101 || yo'gṛhītvā vivāhāgniṃ gṛhastha iti manyate || annaṃ tasya na bhoktavyaṃ vṛthā pāko hi sa smṛtaḥ || 102 || dārāgnihotra dīkṣāṃ ca kurute yo'graje sthite || parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittistu pūrvajaḥ || 103 || parivittiḥ parivettā yayā ca parividyate || sarve te narakaṃ yāṃti dātṛyājakapaṃcamāḥ || 104 || klībe deśāṃtarasthe ca mūke pratrajite jaḍe || kubje kharve ca patite na doṣaḥ parivedane || 105 || vedākṣaraṇi yāvaṃti niyuṃjyādarthakāraṇe || tāvatīrvai bhrūṇahatyā vedavikrayakṛllabhet || 106 || yastu pravrajito bhūtvā sevate maithunaṃ punaḥ || ṣaṣṭirvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ || 107 || śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaḥ śūdreṇa ca sahāsanam || śūdrādvidyāgamaḥ kaścijjvalaṃtamapi pātayet || 108 || śūdrādāhṛtya nirvāpaṃ ye pacaṃtyabudhā dvijāḥ || te yāṃti narakaṃ ghoraṃ brahmatejovivarjitāḥ || 109 || mākṣikaṃ phāṇitaṃ śākaṃ gorasaṃ lavaṇaṃ ghṛtam || hastadattāni bhuktāni dinamekamabhojanam || || 4.1.40.110 || hastadattāśca ye snehā lavaṇaṃ vyajanāni ca || dātāraṃ nopatiṣṭhaṃte bhoktā bhuṃkte tu kilbiṣam || 111 || āyasenaiva pātreṇa yadannamupadīyate || bhoktā tadviṭsamaṃ bhuṃkte dātā ca narakaṃ vrajet || 112 || aṃgulyā daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ ca pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ ca yat || mṛttikābhakṣaṇaṃ yacca samaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ || 113 || pānīyaṃ pāyasaṃ bhaikṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ lavaṇameva ca || hastadattaṃ na gṛhṇīyāttulyagomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ || 114 || agrato nivasenmūrkho dūrataśca guṇānvitaḥ || guṇānvitāya dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhe vyatikramaḥ ||115|| brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti vipre vedavivarjite || jvalaṃtamagnimutsṛjya nahi bhasmani hūyate || 116 || sannikṛṣṭamadhīyānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yo vyatikramet || bhojane caiva dāne ca dahedāsaptamaṃ kulam || 117 || gorakṣakānvāṇijakāṃstathā kārukuśīlavān || preṣyānvārdhuṣikāṃścaiva viprāñśūdravadācaret ||118|| devadravyavibhāgena brahmasva haraṇena ca || kulānyāśu vinaśyaṃti brāhmaṇātikrameṇa ca || 119 || mā dehīti ca yo brūyādgavāgnibrāhmaṇeṣu ca || tiryagyoniśataṃ gatvā cāṃḍāleṣvabhijāyate || 4.1.40.120 || vācā yacca pratijñātaṃ karmaṇānopapāditam || ṛṇaṃ taddharmasaṃyuktamihaloke paratra ca || 121 || vighasāśī bhavennityaṃ nityaṃ cāmṛtabhojanaḥ || yajñaśeṣo'mṛtaṃbhuktaśeṣaṃ tu vighasaṃ viduḥ || 122 || savyādaṃsātparibhraṣṭe nābhideśe vyavasthite || vastre sa ekavāsāstaṃ deve pitrye ca varjayet || 123 || yadeva tarpayatyadbhiḥ pitṝnsnātvā dvijottamaḥ || tenaiva sarvamāpnoti pitṛyajñakriyāphalam || 124 || hastau prakṣālya gaṃḍūṣaṃ yaḥ pibedbhojanottaram|| daivaṃ pitryaṃ tathātmānaṃ trayaṃ sa upaghātayet || 125 || gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca yadannaṃ grāmayājake || strīṇāṃ prathamagarbheṣu bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ careta || 126 || pakṣe vā yadi vā māse yasya gehetti na dvijaḥ || bhuktvā durātmanastasya careccāṃdrāyaṇavratam|| 127 || satriṇāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ ca yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām || eteṣāṃ sūtakaṃ nāsti ṛtvijāṃ karmakurvatām || 128 || ajīrṇe'bhyudite vāte śmaśrukarmaṇi maithune || duḥsvapne durjanasparśe snānameva vidhīyate || 129 || caityavṛkṣaṃ citiṃ yūpaṃ śivanirmālyabhojinam || vedavikrayiṇaṃ spṛṣṭvā sacailo jalamāviśet || 4.1.40.130 || agnyagāre gavāṃ goṣṭhe deva brāhmaṇasannidhau || svādhyāye bhojane pāne pāduke vai visarjayet || 131 || khalakṣetragataṃ dhānyaṃ kūpavāpīṣu yajjalam || agrāhyādapi tadgrāhyaṃ yacca goṣṭhagataṃ payaḥ || 132 || yadveṣṭitaśirā bhuṃkte yo bhuṃkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || sopānatkaśca yadbhuṃkte tadvai rakṣāṃsi bhuṃjate || 133 || yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasāḥ krūrakarmiṇaḥ || haraṃti rasamannasya maṃḍalena vivarjitam ||134|| brahmādyāśca surāḥ sarve vasiṣṭhādyā maharṣayaḥ || maṃḍalaṃ copajīvaṃti tataḥ kurvīta maṃḍalam || 135 || brāhmaṇe caturasraṃ syāttryasraṃ vai bāhujanmanaḥ || vartulaṃ ca viśaḥ proktaṃ śūdrasyābhyukṣaṇaṃ smṛtam || 136 || notsaṃge bhojanaṃ kṛtvā no pāṇau naiva karpaṭe || nāsanena ca śayyāyāṃ bhuṃjīta na malārditaḥ || 137 || dharmaśāstra rathārūḍhā vedakhaḍgadharā dvijāḥ || krīḍārthamapi yadbrūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ || 138 || rātrau dhānā dadhiyutaṃ dharmakāmo na bhakṣayet || aśnato dharmahāniḥ syādvyādhibhiścopapīḍyate || 139 || phāṇitaṃ gorasaṃ toyaṃ lavaṇaṃ madhukāṃjikam || hastena brāhmaṇo dattvā kṛcchraṃ cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret || 4.1.40.140 || gaṃdhābharaṇamālyāni yaḥ prayacchati dharmavit || sasugaṃdhiḥ sadā hṛṣṭo yatrayatropajāyate || 141 || nīlīraktaṃ tu yadvastraṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet || strīṇāṃ krīḍārthasaṃyoge śayanīyena duṣyati || 142 || pālanādvikrayāccaiva tadvṛtterupajīvanāt || apavitro bhavedviprastribhiḥ kṛcchrairviśudhyati || 143 || snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam || vṛthā tasya mahāyajñā nīlī vāso bibharti yaḥ || 144 || nīlīraktaṃ yadāvastraṃ vipraḥ svāṃgeṣu dhārayet || taṃ tu saṃtatisaṃkhyāke narake sa vaseddhruvam || 145 || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā paṃcagavyena śudhyati || 146 || nīlīraktena vastreṇa yadannamupakalpayet || bhoktā viṣṭhāsamaṃ bhuṃkte dātā ca narakaṃ vrajet || 147 || amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣattriyānnaṃ payaḥ smṛtam || vaiśyasya cānnamevānnaṃ śūdrasya rudhiraṃ smṛtam || 148 || vaiśvadevena homena devatābhyarcanairjapaiḥ || amṛtaṃ tena viprānnamṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃskṛtam || 149 || vyavahārānurūpeṇa nyāyena tu yadarjanam || kṣatriyasya payastena prajāpālanato bhavet || 4.1.40.150 || praharānaddhavāhādyadannamutpādya yacchati || sītāyajñavidhānena vaiśyānnaṃ tena saṃskṛtam || 151 || ajñānatimirāṃdhasya madyapānaratasya ca || rudhiraṃ tena śūdrānnaṃ vedamaṃtravivarjitam || 152 || na vṛthā śapathaṃ kuryātsvalpepyarthe narottamaḥ || vṛthā hi śapathaṃ kurvanpretya ceha vinaśyati || 153 || kāminīṣu vivāhe ca gavāṃ bhukte dhanakṣaye || brāhmaṇābhyupapattau ca śapathairnāsti pātakam ||154|| satyena śāpayedvipraṃ kṣatriyaṃ vāhanāyudhaiḥ || gobījakāṃcanairvaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ sarvaistu pātakaiḥ ||155|| agniṃ vā hārayedenamapsu cainaṃ nimajjayet || sparśayetputradārāṇāṃ śirāṃsyenaṃ ca vā pṛthak || 156 || na yamaṃ yamamityāhurātmā vai yama ucyata || ātmā saṃyamito yena taṃ yamaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati || 157 || na nistriṃśastathā tīkṣṇaḥ phaṇī vā duratikramaḥ || ripurvā nityasaṃkuddho yathātmā duradhiṣṭhitaḥ || 158 || ekaḥ kṣamāvatāṃ doṣo na dvitīyaḥ kathaṃcana || yadenaṃ kṣamayā yuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥ || 159 || na śabdaśāstrābhiratasya mokṣo na caiva ramyā vasathapriyasya || na bhojanācchādana tatparasya na lokavitta grahaṇe ratasya || 4.1.40.160 || ekāṃtaśīlasya sadaiva tasya sarveṃdriyaprīti nivartakasya || svādhyāyayoge gatamānasasya mokṣo dhuvaṃ nityamahiṃsakasya || 161 || kvaikāṃtaśīlatvamihāsti puṃsaḥ kva ceṃdriyaprītinivṛttirasti || kva yogayuktiḥ kva ca daivatejyā kāśyāṃ vinaibhiḥ sahajena muktiḥ ||162 || viśveśa saṃśīlanamevayogastapaśca viśveśapurīnivāsaḥ || vratāni dānaṃ niyamā yamāśca snānaṃ dyunadyāṃ yadudagvahāyām ||163|| || skaṃda uvāca || || nyāyāgatadhanastattvajñānaniṣṭhotithipriyaḥ || śrāddhakṛtsatyavādī ca gṛhasthopīha mucyate ||164|| dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇārthibhyo dattvānnāni viśeṣataḥ || kṛtvā gārhyāṇi karmāṇi gṛhasthaḥ śreya āpnuyāt || 165 || itthamācaratāṃ puṃsāṃ kāśīnāthaḥ prasīdati || kāśīnāthaprasādena kāśīprāptistu mokṣakṛt || 166 || sa sarvatīrthasusnātaḥ sa sarvakratudīkṣitaḥ || sa dattasarvadānastu kāśī yena niṣevitā || 167 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvāddhe gṛhasthadharmākhyānaṃnāma catvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||40|| ||cha||
<4.1.41>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || uṣitvaivaṃ gṛhe vipro dvitīyādāśramātparam || valīpalitasaṃyuktastṛtīyāśramamāviśet || 1 || apatyāpatyamālokya grāmyāhārānvisṛjya ca || patnīṃ putreṣu saṃtyajya patnyā vā vanamāviśet || 2 || vasānaścarmacīrāṇi sāgnirmunyannavartanaḥ || jaṭī sāyaṃprage snāyī śmaśrulonakhalomabhṛt ||3|| śākamūlaphalairvāpi paṃcayajñanna hāpayet || ammūlaphalabhikṣābhirarcayedbhikṣukātithīn || 4 || anādātā ca dātā ca dāṃtaḥ svādhyāyatatparaḥ || vaitānikaṃ ca juhuyādagnihotraṃ yathāvidhi || 5 || munyannaiḥ svayamānītaiḥ puroḍāśāṃśca nirvapet || svayaṃkṛtaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ khādetsnehaṃ phalodravam || 6 || varjayeccheluśigrū ca kavakaṃ palalaṃ madhu || munyannamāśvinemāsi tyajedyatpūrvasaṃcitam ||7|| grāmyāṇi phalamūlāni phālajānnaṃ ca saṃtyajet || daṃtolūkhalako vā syādaśmakuṭṭotha vā bhavet || 8 || sadyaḥ prakṣālako vā syādathavā māsasaṃcayī || triṣaḍdvādaśamāsānnaphalamūlādisaṃgrahī ||9|| naktāśye kāṃtarāśī vā ṣaṣṭhakālāśanopi vā || cāṃdrāyaṇavratī vā syātpakṣabhugvātha māsabhuk|| ||4.1.41.10|| vaikhānasa matasthastu phalamūlāśanopi vā || tapasā śoṣayeddehaṃ pitṝndevāṃśca tarpayet || 11 || agnimātmani cādhāya vicaredaniketanaḥ || bhikṣayetprāṇayātrārthaṃ tāpasānvanavāsinaḥ || 12 || grāmādānīya vāśnīyādaṣṭau grāsānvasanvane || itthaṃ vanāśramī vipro brahmaloke mahīyate || 13 || ativāhyāyuṣobhāgaṃ tṛtīyamiti kānane || āyuṣastu turīyāṃśe tyaktvā saṃgānparivrajet || 14 || ṛṇatrayamasaṃśodhya tvanutpādya sutānapi || tathā yajñānaniṣṭvā ca mokṣamicchanvrajatyadhaḥ || 15 || manāgapi na bhūtānāṃ yasmādutpadyate bhayam || sarvabhūtāni tasyeha prayacchaṃtyabhayaṃ sadā || 15 || eka eva carennityamanagniraniketanaḥ || siddhyarthamasahāyaḥ syādgrāmamannārthamāśrayet ||17|| jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ vātha nābhikāṃkṣetkvacidyatiḥ || kālameva pratīkṣeta nirdeśaṃ bhṛtako yathā||18|| sarvatra mamatā śūnyaḥ sarvatra samatāyutaḥ || vṛkṣamūlaniketaśca mumukṣuriha śasyate ||19|| dhyānaṃ śaucaṃ tathā bhikṣā nityamekāṃtaśīlatā || yateścatvārikarmāṇi paṃcamaṃ nopapadyate || 4.1.41.20 || vārṣikāṃścaturomāsānviharenna yatiḥ kvacit || bījāṃkurāṇāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ hiṃsā tatra yato bhavet || 21 || gacchetpariharanjantūnpibetkaṃ vastraśodhitam|| vācaṃ vadedanudvegāṃ na krudhyetkenacitkvacit || 22 || caredātmasahāyaśca nirapekṣo nirāśrayaḥ || nityamadhyātmanirato nīcakeśa nakho vaśī || 23 || kusuṃbhavāsā daṃḍāḍhyo bhikṣāśī khyātivarjitaḥ || alābudārumṛdveṇu pātraṃ śastaṃ na paṃcamam || 24 || na grāhyaṃ taijasaṃ pātraṃ bhikṣukeṇa kadācana || varāṭake saṃgṛhīte tatratatra dinedine ||25|| gosahasravadhaṃ pāpaṃ śrutireṣā sanātanī || hṛdi sasneha bhāvena ceddrakṣetstriyamekadā || 26 || koṭidvayaṃ brahmakalpaṃ kuṃbhīpākī na saṃśayaḥ || ekakālaṃ caredbhaikṣaṃ na kuryāttatra vistaram || 27 || vidhūmesanna musale vyaṃgāre bhuktavajjane || vṛtte śarāvasaṃpāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ caredyatiḥ || 28 || alpāhāro rahaḥsthāyī ttviṃdriyārtheṣvalolupaḥ || rāgadveṣavirnirmukto bhikṣurmokṣāya kalpate || 29 || āśrame tu yatiryasya muhūrtamapi viśramet || kiṃ tasyānekataṃtreṇa kṛtakṛtyaḥ sa jāyate || 4.1.41.30 || saṃcitaṃ yadgrahasthena pāpamāmaraṇāṃtikam || nirdhakṣyati hi tatsarvamekarātroṣito yatiḥ ||31|| dṛṣṭvā jarābhibhavanamasahyaṃ rogapīḍitam || dehatyāgaṃ punargarbhaṃ garbhakleśaṃ ca dāruṇam ||32|| nānāyoni nivāsaṃ ca viyogaṃ ca priyaiḥ saha || apriyaiḥ saha saṃyogamadharmādduḥkhasaṃbhavam || 33 || punarnirayasaṃvāsaṃnānānarakayātanāḥ || karmadoṣasamudbhūtā nṛṇāṃgatiranekadhā || 34 || deheṣvanityatāṃ dṛṣṭvā nityatā paramātmanaḥ || kurvīta muktaye yatnaṃ yatrayatrāśrame rataḥ || 35 || karapātrīti vikhyātā bhikṣāpātravivarjitā || teṣāṃ śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bhavatyeva dinedine || 36 || āśramāṃścaturastvevaṃ kramādāsevya paṃḍitaḥ || nirdvaṃdvastyaktasaṃgaśca brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 37 || asaṃyataḥ kubuddhīnāmātmā baṃdhāya kalpate || dhīmadbhiḥ saṃyataḥ sopi padaṃ dadyādanāmayam ||38|| śruti smṛti purāṇaṃ ca vidyopaniṣadastathā || ślokāḥ maṃtrāṇi bhāṣyāṇi yaccānyadvāṅmayaṃ kvacit || 39 || vedānuvacanaṃ jñātvā brahmacarya tapo damaḥ || śraddhopavāsaḥ svātaṃtryamātmanojñānahetavaḥ || 4.1.41.40 || sa hi sarvairvijijñāsya ātmaivāśramavartibhiḥ || śrotavyastvatha maṃtavyo draṣṭavyaśca prayatnataḥ ||41|| ātmajñānena muktiḥ syāttacca yogādṛte nahi|| sa ca yogaściraṃ kālamabhyāsādeva sidhyati || 42 || nāraṇyasaṃśrayādyogo na nānāgraṃtha ciṃtanāt|| na dānairna vratairvāpi na tapobhirna vā makhaiḥ || 43 || na ca padmāsanādyogo na vā ghrāṇāgravīkṣaṇāt || na śauce na na maunena na maṃtrārādhanairapi || 44 || abhiyogātsadābhyāsāttatraiva ca viniścayāt || punaḥpunaranirvedātsidhyedyogo na cānyathā || 45 || ātmakrīḍasya satataṃ sadātmamithunasya ca || ātmanyeva su tṛptasya yogasiddhirna dūrataḥ || 46 || atrātmavyatirekeṇa dvitīyaṃ yo na paśyati || ātmārāmaḥ sa yogīṃdro brahmībhūto bhavediha || 47 || saṃyogastvātmamanasoryoga ityucyate budhaiḥ || prāṇāpānasamāyogo yoga ityapi kaiścana || 48 || viṣayeṃdriya saṃyogo yoga ityapyapaṃḍitaiḥ || viṣayāsaktacittānāṃ jñānaṃ mokṣaśca dūrataḥ || 49 || durnivārā manovṛttiryāvatsā na nivartate || kiṃ vadaṃtyapiyogasya tāvannedīyasī kutaḥ || 4.1.41.50 || vṛttihīnaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā kṣetrajñe paramātmani || ekīkṛtya vimucyeta yogayuktaḥ sa ucyate || 51 || bahirmukhāni sarvāṇi kṛtvā khānyaṃtarāṇi vai || manasyeveṃdriyagrāmaṃ manaścātmani yojayet || 52 || sarvabhāvavinirmuktaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ brahmaṇi nyaset || etaddhyānaṃ ca yogaśca śeṣonyo graṃthavistaraḥ || 53 || yannāsti sarvalokeṣu tadastīti virudhyate || kathyamānaṃ tadanyasya hṛdayenāvatiṣṭhate || 54 || svasaṃvedyaṃ hi tadbrahma kumārī strī sukhaṃ yathā || ayogī naiva tadvetti jātyaṃdha iva vartikām || 55 || nityābhyasanaśīlasya svasaṃvedyaṃ hi tadbhavet || tatsūkṣmatvādanirdeśyaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam || 56 || kṣaṇamapyekamudakaṃ yathā na sthiratāmiyāt || vātāhataṃ yathā cittaṃ tasmāttasya na viśvaset || 57 || ato'nilaṃ niruṃdhīta cittasya sthairya hetave || marunnirodhanārthāya ṣaḍaṃgaṃ yogamabhyaset || 58 || āsanaṃ prāṇasaṃrodhaḥ pratyāhāraśca dhāraṇā || dhyānaṃ samādhiretāni yogāṃgāni bhavaṃti ṣaṭ || 59 || āsanānīha tāvaṃti yāvaṃtyo jīvayo nayaḥ || siddhāsanamidaṃ proktaṃ yogino yogasiddhidam||4.1.41.60|| etadabhyasanānnityaṃ varṣmadārḍhyamavāpnuyāt|| || 61 || dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇaṃ nyasya vāmorūpari yogavit || yāmyorūpari vāmaṃ ca padmāsanamidaṃ viduḥ || 62 || karābhyāṃ dhārayetpaścādaṃguṣṭhau dṛḍhabaṃdhavit|| bhavetpadmāsanādasmādabhyāsāddṛḍhavigrahaḥ || 63 || athavā hyāsane yasminsukhamasyopajāyate || svastikādau tadadhyāsya yogaṃ yuṃjīta yogavit || 64 || na toyavahnisāmīpye na jīrṇāraṇyagoṣṭhayoḥ || na daṃśamaśakākīrṇe na caitye na ca catvare || 69 || keśabhasmatuṣāṃgāra kīkasādi pradūṣite || nābhyasetpūtigaṃdhādau na sthāne janasaṃkule ||66 || sarvabādhāvirahite sarveṃdriyasukhāvahe || manaḥprasādajanane sragdhūpāmodamodite || 67 || nātitṛptaḥ kṣudhārto na na viṇmūtraprabādhitaḥ || nādhvakhinno na ciṃtārto yogaṃ yuṃjīta yogavit || || 68 || ūrusthottānacaraṇaḥ savyenyasyottaraṃ karam || uttānaṃ kiṃcidunnamya vaktraṃ viṣṭabhya corasā || 69 || nimīlitākṣaḥ sattvastho daṃtairdaṃtānna saṃspṛśet || tālusthācalajihvaśca saṃvṛtāsyaḥ suniścalaḥ || 4.1.41.70 || sanniyamyeṃdriyagrāmaṃ nātinīcocchritāsanaḥ || madhyamaṃ cottamaṃ cātha prāṇāyāmamupakramet || 71 || cale'nile calaṃ sarvaṃ niścale tatra niścalam || sthāṇutvamāpnuyādyogī tato'nilaniruṃdhanāt || 72 || yāvaddehe sthitaḥ prāṇo jīvitaṃ tāvaducyate || nirgate tatra maraṇaṃ tataḥ prāṇaṃ niruṃdhayet || 73 || yāvadbaddho maruddehe yāvacceto nirāśrayam || yāvaddṛṣṭirbhuvormadhye tāvatkālabhayaṃ kutaḥ ||74|| kālasādhvasatobrahmā prāṇāyāmaṃ sadācaret || yoginaḥ siddhimāpannāḥ samyakprāṇaniyaṃtraṇāt || 75 || maṃdo dvādaśamātrastu mātrā laghvakṣarā matā || madhyamo dviguṇaḥ pūrvāduttamastriguṇastataḥ ||76|| svedaṃ kaṃpaṃ viṣādaṃ ca janayetkramaśastvasau || prathamena jayetsvedaṃ dvitīyena tu vepathum ||77|| viṣādaṃ hi tṛtīyena siddhaḥ prāṇotha yoginaḥ || bhavetkramātsanniruddhaḥ siddhaḥ prāṇotha yoginā || krameṇa sevyamānosau nayate yatra cecchati || || 78 || haṭhānniruddhaprāṇoyaṃ romakūpeṣu niḥsaret || dehaṃvidārayatyeṣa kuṣṭhādijanayatyapi || 79 || tatpratyāyayitavyosau krameṇāraṇyahastivat || vanyo gajo gajārirvā krameṇa mṛdutāmiyāt || 4.1.41.80 || karoti śāstṛnirdeśaṃ na ca taṃ parilaṃghayet || tathā prāṇo hadisthoyaṃ yoginākramayogataḥ || gṛhītaḥ sevyamānastu viśraṃbhamupagacchati || 81 || ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulo haṃsaḥ prayāṇaṃ kurute bahiḥ || savyāpasavyamārgeṇa prayāṇātprāṇa ucyate || 82 || śuddhimeti yadā sarvaṃ nāḍīcakra manākulam || tadaiva jāyate yogī kṣamaḥ prāṇanirodhane || 83 || dṛḍhāsano yathāśakti prāṇaṃ caṃdreṇa pūrayet || recayedatha sūryeṇa prāṇāyāmoyamucyate || 84 || sravatpīyūṣadhāraughaṃ dhyāyaṃścaṃdrasamanvitam || prāṇāyāmena yogīṃdraḥ sukhamāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt || 85 || raviṇā prāṇamākṛṣya pūrayedaudarīṃ darīm || kuṃbhayitvā śanaiḥ paścādyogī caṃdreṇa recayet || 86 || jvalajvalanapuṃjābhaṃ śīlayannuṣmaguṃ hṛdi || anena yāmyāyāmena yogīṃdraḥ śarmabhāgbhavet || 87 || itthaṃ māsatrayābhyāsādubhayāyāmasevanāt || śuddhanāḍīgaṇo yogī siddhaprāṇobhidhīyate || 88 || yatheṣṭaṃ dhāraṇaṃ vāyoranalasya pradīpanam || nādābhivyaktirārogyaṃ bhavennāḍīviśodhanāt || 89 || prāṇodehagatovāyurāyāmastannibaṃdhanam || ekaśvāsamayī mātrā prāṇāyāmo nirucyate || 4.1.41.90 || prāṇāyāme'dhame gharmaḥ kaṃpo bhavati madhyame || uttiṣṭheduttame deho baddhapadmāsano muhuḥ || 91 || prāṇāyāmairdaheddoṣānpratyāhāreṇa pātakam || manodhairyaṃ dhāraṇayā dhyāneneśvaradarśanam ||92|| samādhinā labhenmokṣaṃ tyaktvā dharmaṃ śubhāśubham || āsanena vapurdārḍhyaṃ ṣaḍaṃgamiti kīrtitam || 93 || prāṇāyāmadviṣaṭkena pratyāhāra udāhṛtaḥ || pratyāhārairdvādaśabhirdhāraṇā parikīrtitā || 94 || bhavedīśvarasaṃgatyai dhyānaṃ dvādaśadhāraṇam || dhyānadvādaśakenaiva samādhirabhidhīyate || 95 || samādheḥ parato jyotiranaṃtaṃ svaprakāśakam || tasmindṛṣṭe kriyākāṃḍaṃ yātāyātaṃ nivartate || 96 || pavane vyomasaṃprāpte dhvanirutpadyate mahān || ghaṃṭādīnāṃ pravādyānāṃ tataḥ siddhiradūrataḥ || 97 || prāṇāyāmena yuktena sarvavyādhikṣayobhavet || ayuktābhyāsayogena sarvavyādhisamudbhavaḥ || 98 || hikkā śvāsaśca kāsaśca śiraḥ karṇākṣivedanāḥ || . bhavaṃti vividhā doṣāḥ pavanasya vyatikramāt || 99 || yuktaṃ yuktaṃ tyajedvāyuṃ yuktaṃyuktaṃ ca pūrayet || yuktaṃyuktaṃ ca badhnīyāditthaṃ sidhyati yogavit || 4.1.41.100 || iṃdriyāṇāṃ hi caratāṃ viṣayeṣu yadṛcchayā || yatpratyāharaṇaṃ yuktyā pratyāhāraḥ sa ucyate || 101 || pratyāharati yaḥ khāni kūrmoṃgānīva sarvataḥ || pratyāhṛti vidhānena sa syādvigatakalmaṣaḥ || 102 || nābhideśe vasedbhānustāludeśe ca caṃdramāḥ || varṣatyadhomukhaścaṃdro grasedūrdhvamukho raviḥ || 103 || karaṇaṃ tacca kartavyaṃ yena sā prāpyate sudhā || ūrdhvanābhiradhastālurūrdhvaṃ bhānuradhaḥśaśī || karaṇaṃ viparītākhyamabhyāsādeva jāyate || 104 || kākacaṃcuvadāsyena śītalaṃ śītalaṃ pibet || prāṇaṃ prāṇavidhānajño yogī bhavati nirjaraḥ ||105|| rasanāṃ tāluvivare nidhāyordhvamukho'mṛtam || dhayannijarratāṃ gacchedāṣaṇmāsānna saṃśayaḥ || 106 || ūrdhvajihvaḥ sthiro bhūtvā somapānaṃ karoti yaḥ || māsārdhena na saṃdeho mṛtyuṃ jayati yogavit || 107 || saṃpīḍya rasanāgreṇa rājadaṃtabilaṃ mahat || dhyātvā sudhāmayīṃ devīṃ ṣaṇmāsena kavirbhavet || 108 || amṛtāpūrṇadehasya yogino dvitrivatsarāt || ūrdhvaṃ pravartate reto hyaṇimādiguṇodayam|| 109 || nityaṃ somakalāpūrṇaṃ śarīraṃ yasya yoginaḥ || takṣakeṇāpi daṣṭasya viṣaṃ tasya na sarpati||4.1.41.110|| āsanena samāyuktaḥ prāṇāyāmena saṃyutaḥ || pratyāhāreṇa saṃpanno dhāraṇāmatha cābhyaset || 111 || hṛdaye paṃcabhūtānāṃ dhāraṇāṃ yaḥ pṛthakpṛthak || manaso niścalatvena dhāraṇā sābhidhīyate || 112 || haritālanibhāṃ bhūmiṃ sa lakārāṃ savedhasam || catuṣkoṇāṃ hṛdi dhyāyedeṣā syātkṣitidhāraṇā || 113 || kaṃṭheṃ'butattvamardheṃdunibhaṃ viṣṇusamanvitam || vakārabījaṃ kuṃdābhaṃ dhyāyannaṃbujayediti || 114 || tālusthamiṃdragopābhaṃ trikoṇaṃ rephasaṃyutam || rudreṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ tejo dhyātvā vahniṃ jayediti || 115 || vāyutattvaṃ bhruvormadhye vṛttamaṃjanasannibham || yaṃbījamīśadaivatyaṃ dhyāyanvāyuṃ jayediti || 116 || ākāśaṃ ca marīcivārisadṛśaṃ yadbrahmaraṃdhrasthitaṃ yannāthena sadāśivena sahitaṃ śāṃtaṃ hakārākṣaram || prāṇaṃ tatra vinīya paṃcaghaṭikaṃ ciṃtānvitaṃ dhārayedeṣā mokṣakapāṭapāṭanapaṭuḥ proktā nabhodhāraṇā || 117 || staṃbhanīplāvanīcaiva dahanībhrāmaṇī tathā || śamanī ca bhavaṃtyetā bhūtānāṃ paṃca dhāraṇāḥ || 118 || dhyai ciṃtāyāṃ smṛto dhātuściṃtā tattve suniścalā || etaddhyānamiha proktaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ dvidhā || 119 || saguṇaṃ vaṇarbhedena nirguṇaṃ kevalaṃ matam || samaṃtraṃ saguṇaṃ viddhi nirguṇaṃ maṃtravarjitam || 4.1.41.120 || aṃtaśceto bahiścakṣuravasthāpya sukhāsanam|| samatvaṃ ca śarīrasya dhyānamudrātisiddhidā || 121 || nāśvamedhena tatpuṇyaṃ na ca vai rājasūyataḥ || yatpuṇyamekadhyānena labhedyogī sthirāsanaḥ || 122 || śabdādīnāṃ ca tanmātrā yāvatkarṇādiṣu sthitā || tāvadeva smṛtaṃ dhyānaṃ syātsamādhirataḥ param || 123 || dhāraṇā paṃcanāḍīkā dhyānaṃ syātṣaṣṭināḍikam || dinadvāśakena syātsamādhiriha bhaṇyate || 124 || jalasaiṃdhavayoḥ sāmyaṃ yathā bhavati yogataḥ || tathātmamanasoraikyaṃ samādhiriha bhaṇyate || 125 || yadā saṃkṣīyate prāṇo mānasaṃ ca pralīyate || tadā samarasatvaṃ yatsa samādhirihocyate || 126 || yatsamatvaṃ dvayoratra jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ || sanaṣṭasarvasaṃkalpaḥ samādhirabhidhīyate || 127 || nātmānaṃ na paraṃ vetti na śītaṃ noṣmameva ca || samādhiyukto yogīṃdro na sukhaṃ na sukhetarat || 128 || kālyate naiva kālena lipyate naiva karmaṇā || bhidyate na ca śastrāstrai yogī yuktaḥ samādhinā || 129 || yuktāhāravihāraśca yuktaceṣṭo hi karmasu || yuktanidrāvabodhaśca yogī tattvaṃ prapaśyati || 4.1.41.130 || tattvavijñānamānaṃdaṃ brahma brahmavido viduḥ || hetudṛṣṭāṃta rahitaṃ vāṅmanobhyāmagocaram || 131 || tatra yogī nirālaṃbe nirātaṃke nirāmaye || ṣaḍaṃgayogavidhinā parebrahmaṇi līyate||132|| yathā ghṛte ghṛtaṃ kṣiptaṃ ghṛtameva hi tadbhavet || kṣīrekṣīraṃ tathā yogī tatra tanmayatāṃ vrajet || 133 || anasaṃjātapānīyairvidadhyādaṃgamardanam || tyajetkaduṣṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ kṣīrabhojī sadā bhavet || 134 || brahmacārī jitakrodho jitalobho vimatsaraḥ || abdamitthaṃ sadābhyāsātsa yogīti nigadyate || 135 || mahāmudrāṃ nabhomudrāmuḍḍīyānaṃ jalaṃdharam || mūlabaṃdhaṃ tu yo vetti sa yogī yogasiddhibhāk || 136 || śodhanaṃ nāḍījālasya ghaṭanaṃ caṃdrasūryayoḥ || rasānāṃ śoṣaṇaṃ samyaṅmahāmudrābhidhīyate || 137 || yoniṃ vāmāṃghriṇā''pīḍya kṛtvā vakṣasthale hanum || hastābhyāṃ prasṛtaṃ pādaṃ dhārayeddakṣiṇaṃ ciram || 138 || prāṇena kukṣimāpūrya ciraṃ saṃrecayecchanaiḥ || eṣā proktā mahāmudrā mahāghaughavināśinī || 139 || caṃdrāṃge tu samabhyasya sūryāṃge punarabhyaset|| yāvattulyā bhavetsaṃkhyā tato mudrāṃ visarjayet || 4.1.41.140 || na hi pathyamapathyaṃ vā rasāḥ sarvepi nīrasāḥ || api ghoraṃ viṣaṃ pītaṃ pīyūṣamivajīryati || 141 || kṣayakuṣṭhagudāvarta gulmājīrṇapurogamāḥ || tasya doṣāḥ kṣayaṃ yāṃti mahāmudrāṃ ca yobhyaset || 142 || kapālakuhare jihvā praviṣṭā viparītagā || bhruvoraṃtargatā dṛṣṭirmudrā bhavati khecarī || 143 || na pīḍyate śaraugheṇa na ca lipyeta karmaṇā || bādhyate na sa kālena yo mudrāṃ vetti khecarīm || 144 || cittaṃ carati khe yasmā jihvā carati khe gatā || tenaiṣā khecarī nāma mudrā siddhairniṣevitā || 145 || yāvadbiṃduḥ sthito dehe tāvanmutyubhayaṃ kutaḥ || yāvadbaddhā nabhomudrā tāvadbiṃdurna gacchati || 146 || uḍḍīnaṃ kurute yasmādahorātraṃ mahākhagaḥ || uḍīyānaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ tatra baṃdho vidhīyate || 147 || jaṭhare paścimaṃ tānaṃ nābherūrdhvaṃ ca dhārayet || uṅḍīyāno hyayaṃ baṃdho mṛtyorapi bhayaṃ tyajet || 148 || badhnāti hi śirājālamadhogāmi nabhojalam || eṣa jālaṃdharo baṃdhaḥ kaṃṭhe duḥkhaughanāśanaḥ || 149 || jālaṃdhare kṛte baṃdhe kaṃṭhasakocalakṣaṇe || na pīyūṣaṃ patatyagnau na ca vāyuḥ pradhāvati ||4.1.41.150|| pārṣṇibhāgena saṃpīḍya yonimākuṃcayedgudam|| apānamūrdhvamākṛṣya mūlabaṃdho vidhīyate|| 151 || apānaprāṇayoraikye kṣayo mūtrapurīṣayoḥ || yuvā bhavati vṛddhopi satataṃ mūlabaṃdhanāt || 152 || prāṇāpānavaśo jīvaḥ ūrddhvādhaḥ paridhāvati || vāmadakṣiṇamārgeṇa caṃcalo na sthitiṃ labhet || 153|| guṇabaddho yathā pakṣī gatopyākṛṣyate punaḥ || guṇairbaddhastathā jīvaḥ prāṇāyāmena kṛṣyate || 154 || apānaḥ karṣati prāṇaṃ prāṇopānaṃ ca karṣati || ūrdhvādhaḥ saṃsthitāvetau saṃyojayati yogavit || 155 || hakāreṇa bahiryāti sakāreṇa viśetpunaḥ|| haṃsahaṃsetyato maṃtraṃ jīvo japati sarvadā || 156 || ṣaṭśatāni divārātrau sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ || etatsaṃkhyānvitaṃ maṃtraṃ jīvo japati sarvadā || || 157 || ajapā nāma gāyatrī yogināṃ mokṣadāyinī || asyāḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 158 || aṃtarāyā bhavaṃtīha yogino yogahānidāḥ || śrūyate dūragā vārtā dūrasthaṃ dṛśyate puraḥ || 159 || yojanānāṃ śataṃ yātuṃ śaktiḥsyānnimiṣārdhataḥ|| aciṃtitāni śāstrāṇi kaṃṭhapāṭhī bhavaṃti hi ||4.1.41.160|| dhāraṇāśa ktiratyugrā mahābhāro laghurbhavet || kṣaṇaṃ kṛśaḥ kṣaṇaṃ sthūlaḥ kṣaṇamalpaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mahān || 161 || parakāyaṃ praviśati tiraścāṃ vetti bhāṣitam || divyagaṃdhaṃ tanau dhatte divyāṃ vāṇīṃ pravakti ca || 162 || prārthyate divyakanyābhirdivyaṃ dhārayate vapuḥ || ityādayoṃtarāyāḥ syuryogasaṃsiddhisūcakāḥ || 163 || yadyebhiraṃtarāyairna kṣipyate'syeha mānasam || tadagre tatsamāpnoti padaṃ brahmādi durlabham || 164 || yatprāpya na nivarteta yatprāpya na ca śocati || tallabhyate ṣaḍaṃgena yogena kalaśodbhava || 165 || ekena janmanā yogaḥ kathamitthaṃ prasidhyati || ṛte ca yogasaṃsiddheḥ kathaṃ muktirihāpyate || 166 || ubhe eva hi nirvāṇavartmanī kila kuṃbhaja || kiṃ vā kāśyāṃ tanutyāgaḥ kiṃ vā yogoyamīdṛśaḥ ||167|| caṃcaleṃdriyavṛttitvātkalikalmaṣajṛṃbhaṇāt || alpāyuṣāṃ tathā nṛṇāṃ kveha yoga mahodayaḥ ||168|| ataeva hi jaṃtūnāṃ mahodayapadapradaḥ || sadaiva sa dayāvārdhiḥ kāśyāṃ viśveśvaraḥ sthitaḥ || 169 || kāśyāṃ sukhena kaivalyaṃ yathālabhyeta jaṃtubhiḥ || yogayuktyādyupāyaiśca na tathānyatra kutracit || 4.1.41.170 || kāśyāṃ svadehasaṃyogaḥ samyagyoga udāhṛtaḥ || mucyate neha yogena kṣipramanyena kenacit || 171 || viśveśvaro viśālākṣī dyunadīkālabhairavaḥ || śrīmānḍhuṃḍhirdaṃḍapāṇiḥ ṣaḍaṃgo yoga eṣa vai || 172 || etatṣaḍaṃgayo yogaṃ nityaṃ kāśyāṃ niṣevate || saṃprāpya yoganidrāṃ sa dīrghāmamṛtamaśnute || 173 || oṃkāraḥ kṛttivāsāśca kedāraśca triviṣṭapaḥ || vīreśvarothaviśveśaḥ ṣaḍaṃgoyamihāparaḥ || 174 || pādodakāsisaṃbheda jñānodamaṇikarṇikāḥ || ṣaḍaṃgoyaṃ mahāyogo brahmadharmahradāvapi || 175 || ṣaḍaṃgasevanādasmādvārāṇasyāṃ narottama || na jātu jāyate jaṃturjananī jaṭhare punaḥ || 176 || gaṃgāsnānaṃ mahāmudrā mahāpātakanāśanī || etanmudrākṛtābhyāsopyamṛtatvamavāpnuyāt ||177|| kāśīvīthiṣu saṃcāro mudrā bhavati khecarī|| khecaro jāyate nūnaṃ khecaryā mudrayānayā ||178|| uḍḍīya sarvato deśādyānaṃ vārāṇasīṃ prati || uṅḍīyāno mahābaṃdha eṣa muktyai prakalpate || 179 || jalasya dhāraṇaṃ mūrdhni viśveśa snānajanmanaḥ || eṣa jālaṃdharo baṃdhaḥ samastasuradurlabhaḥ || 4.1.41.180 || vṛto vighnaśatenāpi yanna kāśīṃ tyajetsudhīḥ || mūlabaṃdhaḥ smṛto hyeṣa duḥkhamūlanikṛṃtanaḥ || 181 || iti yogaḥ samākhyāto mayā te dvividho mune || saṣaḍaṃgaḥ samudraśca muktaye śaṃbhubhāṣitaḥ || 182 || yāvanneṃdriya vaiklavyaṃ yāvadvyādhirna bādhate || yāvatkālavilaṃbosti tāvadyogarato bhavet || 183 || ubhayoryogayormadhye kāśīyogoyamuttamaḥ || kāśīyogaṃ samabhyasya prāpnuyādyogamuttamam || 184 || ādhivyādhisahāyinyā jarayā mṛtyuliṃgayā || kālaṃ nikaṭato jñātvā kāśīnāthaṃ samāśrayeta || 185 || kāśīnāthaṃ samāśritya kutaḥ kālabhayaṃ nṛṇām || kruddhopi jīvahṛtkālastacca kāśyāṃ sumaṃgalam || 186 || ātithyenehasiyathā pratīkṣetātithiṃ kṛtī || kāśyāṃ kālaṃ tathāyāṃtaṃ bhāgyavānsaṃpratīkṣate || 187 || kaliḥ kālaḥ kṛtaṃkarma trikaṃṭakamitīritam || etattrayaṃ na prabhavedānaṃdavanavāsinām ||188|| anyatrātarkitaḥ kālaḥ kalayiṣyatyasaṃśayam || kālādabhayamiccheccettataḥ kāśīṃ samāśrayet || 189 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe yogākhyānaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||41 ||
<4.1.42>
|| agastiruvāca || || kathaṃ nikaṭataḥ kālo jñāyate haranaṃdana || tāni cihnāni katicidbrūhi me paripṛcchataḥ || 1 || || kumāra uvāca || || vadāmi kālacihnāni jāyaṃte yāni dehinām || mṛtyau nikaṭamāpanne mune tāni niśāmaya || 2|| yāmyanāsāpuṭe yasya vāyurvāti divāniśam || akhaṃḍameva tasyāyuḥ kṣayatyabdatrayeṇa hi || 3 || ahorātraṃ tryahorātraṃ ravirvahati saṃtatam || abdamekaṃ ca tasyeha jīvanāvadhirucyate || 4 || vahennāsāpuṭayuge daśāhāni niraṃtaram || vātaścetsaha saṃkrāṃtistayā jīveddinatrayam || 5 || nāsāvartma dvayaṃ hitvā mātariśvā mukhādvahet || śaṃseddinadvayādarvākprayāṇaṃ tasya cādhvani || 6 || akasmādevayatkāle mṛtyuḥ sannihito bhavet || ciṃtanīyaḥ prayatnena sa kālo mṛtyubhīruṇā || 7 || sūrye saptamarāśisthe janmarkṣasthe niśākare || pauṣṇaḥ sa kālo draṣṭavyo yadā yāmye ravirvahet || 8 || akasmādvīkṣate yastu puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṃgalam || tasminneva kṣaṇe'rūpaṃ sa jīvedvatsaradvayam || 9 || yasya bījaṃ malaṃ mūtraṃ kṣutaṃ mūtraṃ malaṃ tu vā || ihaikadā patedyasya abdaṃ tasyāyuriṣyate || 4.1.42.10 || iṃdranīlanibhaṃ vyomni nāgavṛṃdaṃ ya īkṣate || itastataḥ prasṛmaraṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ na sa jīvati |||1|| vyabhrehni vāripūrṇāsyaḥ pṛṣṭhīkṛtya divākaram || phūtkṛtyāśviṃdracāpaṃ na paśyetṣaṇmāsajīvitaḥ || 12 || aruṃdhatīṃ dhruvaṃ caiva viṣṇostrīṇipadāni ca || āsannamṛtyurnopaśyeccaturthaṃ mātṛmaṃḍalam ||13|| aruṃdhatī bhavejjihvā dhruvo nāsāgramucyate || viṣṇoḥ padāni bhrūmadhye netrayormātṛmaṃḍalam || 14 || vetti nīlādivarṇasya kaṭamlādirasasyahi || akasmādanyathābhāvaṃ ṣaṇmāsena sa mṛtyubhāk ||15|| ṣaṇmāsamṛtyormartyasya kaṃṭhoṣṭharasanā radāḥ || śuṣyaṃti satataṃ tadvadvicchāyāstālupaṃcamāḥ ||16|| retaḥ karajanetrāṃtā nīlimānaṃ bhajaṃti cet || tarhi kīnāśanagarīṃ ṣaṣṭhemāsi vrajennaraḥ || 17 || saṃpravṛtte nidhuvane madhyeṃte kṣauti cennaraḥ || niścitaṃ paṃcame māsi dharmarājātithirbhavet || 16 || drutamāruhyaśaraṭhastrivarṇo yasya mastake || prayāti yāti tasyāyuḥ ṣaṇmāsena parikṣayam || 19 || susnātasyāpi yasyāśu hṛdayaṃ pariśuṣyati || caraṇau ca karau vāpi trimāsaṃ tasya jīvitam || 4.1.42.20 || pratibiṃbaṃ bhavedyasya padakhaṃḍapadākṛti || pāṃsau vā kardame vāpi paṃcamāsānsa jīvati || 21 || chāyā prakaṃpate yasya dehabaṃdhepi niścale || kṛtāṃtadūtā badhnaṃti caturthe māsi taṃ naram || 22 || nijasya pratibiṃbasya nīrājyamukurādiṣu || uttamāṃgaṃ na yaḥ paśyetsamāsena vinaśyati || 23 || matirbhraśyetskhaledvāṇī dhanuraidraṃ nirakṣitai || rātrau caṃdradvayaṃ cāpi divā dvau ca divākarau || 24 || divā ca tārakācakraṃ rātrau vyomavitārakam || yugapacca caturdikṣu śākraṃ kodaṃḍamaṃḍalam || 25 || bhūruhe bhūdharāgre ca gaṃdharvanagarālayam || divāpiśāca nṛtyaṃ ca ete paṃcatvahetavaḥ ||26|| sarveṣveteṣu cihneṣu yadyekamapi vīkṣate || tadā māsāvadhiṃ mṛtyuḥ pratīkṣeta na cādhikam || 27 || karāvaruddha śravaṇaḥ śṛṇoti na yadā dhvanim || sthūlaḥ kṛśaḥ kṛśasthūlastadāmāsānnivartate || 28 || yaḥ paśyedātmanaśchāyāṃ dakṣiṇāśā samāśritām || dināni paṃca jīvitvā paṃcatvamupayāti saḥ || 29 || prohyate bhakṣyate vāpi piśācāsuravāyasaiḥ || bhūtaiḥ pretaiḥ śvabhirgṛdhrairgomāyukharasūkaraiḥ || 4.1.42.30 || rāsabhaiḥ karabhaiḥ kīśaiḥ śvenairaśvatarairbakaiḥ || svapne sa jīvitaṃ tyaktvā varṣāṃte yamamīkṣate || 31 || gaṃdhapuṣpāṃśukaiḥ śoṇaiḥ svāṃ tanuṃ bhūṣitāṃ naraḥ || yaḥ paśyetsvapnasamaye so'ṣṭau māsānanityaho || 32 || pāṃsurāśi ca valmīkaṃ yūpadaṃḍamathāpi vā || yodhirohati vai svapne sa ṣaṣṭhe māsi naśyati || 33 || rāsabhārūḍhamātmānaṃ tailābhyaktaṃ ca muṃḍitam || nīyamānaṃ yamāśāṃ yaḥ svapne paśyetsvapūrvajān || 34 || svamaulau svatanau vāpi yaḥ paśyetsvapnago naraḥ || tṛṇāni śuṣkakāṣṭhāni ṣaṣṭhe māsi na tiṣṭhati || 35 || lohadaṃḍadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇavāsasam || svayaṃ yogre sthitaṃ paśyetsa trīnmāsānna laṃghayet || 36 || kālī kumārī yaṃ svapne badnīyādbāhu pāśakaiḥ || sa māsena samīkṣeta nagarīṃśamanoṣitām || 37 || naro yo vānarārūḍho yāyātprācīdiśaṃ svapan || dinaiḥ sa paṃcabhireva paśyetsaṃyaminīṃ purīm ||38|| kṛpaṇopi vadānyaḥ syādvadānyaḥ kṛpaṇo yadi || prakṛtervikṛtiścetsyāttadā paṃcatvamṛcchati ||39|| etāni kālacihnāni saṃtyanyāni bahūnyapi || jñātvābhyasennaro yogamathavākāśikāṃ śrayet || 4.1.42.40 || na kālavaṃcanopāyaṃ munenyamavayāmyaham || vinā mṛtyujayaṃ kāśīnāthaṃ garbhāvarodhakam || 41 || tāvadgarjaṃti pāpāni tāvadgarjedyamo nṛpaḥ || yāvadviśveśaśaraṇaṃ naro na nirato vrajet || 42 || prāptaviśveśvarāvāsaḥ pītottaravahāpayāḥ || spṛṣṭa viśveśasalliṃgaḥ kaśca yāti na vaṃdyatām || 43 || kariṣyetkupitaḥkālaḥ kiṃkāśīvāsināṃ nṛṇām || kāle śivaḥ svayaṃ karṇe yatra maṃtropadeśakaḥ || 44 || yathā prayāti śiśutā kaumāraṃ ca yathā gatam || satvaraṃ gatvaraṃ tadvadyauvanaṃ cāpi vārdhakama || 45 || yāvannahi jarākrāṃtiryāvanneṃdriyavaiklavam || tāvatsarvaṃ phalgurūpaṃ hitvā kāśīṃ śrayetsudhīḥ || 46 || anyāni kālalakṣmāṇi tiṣṭhaṃtu kalaśodbhava || jaraiva prathamaṃ lakṣma citraṃ tatrāpi bhīrnahi || 47 || parābhūto hi jarayā sarvaiśca paribhūyate || hṛtatāruṇyamāṇikyo dhanahīnaḥ pumāniva || 48 || sutāvākyaṃ na kurvaṃti patnī premāpi muṃcati || bāṃdhavā naiva manyaṃte jarasāśleṣitaṃ naram || 49 || āśliṣṭaṃ jarayā dṛṣṭvā parayoṣidviśaṃkitā || bhavetparāṅmukhī nityaṃ praṇayinyapi kāminī || 4.1.42.50 || na jarā sadṛśo vyādhirna duḥkhaṃ jarayā samam || kārayitryapamānasya jaraiva maraṇaṃ nṛṇām || 51 || na jīyate tathā kālastapasā yogayuktibhiḥ || yathā cireṇakālena kāśīvāsādvijīyate || 52 || vināyajñairvinādānairvinā vratajapādibhiḥ || vinātipuṇyasaṃbhāraiḥ kaḥ kāśīṃ prāptumīhate || 53 || kāśīprāptirayaṃ yogaḥkāthīprāptiridaṃ tapaḥ || kāśīprāptiridaṃ dānaṃ kāśīprāptiḥ śivaikatā || 54 || kaḥ kalikothavā kālaḥ kā jarā kiṃ ca duṣkṛtam || kā rujaḥ keṃtarāyā vā śritā vārāṇasī yadi || 55 || kalistāneva bādheta kālastāṃśca jighāṃsati || 56|| enāṃsi tāṃśca bādhaṃte ye na kāśīṃ samāśritāḥ || kāśīsamāśritā yaiśca yaiśca viśveśvarorcitaḥ || tārakaṃ jñānamāsādya te muktāḥ karmapāśataḥ || || 57 || dhanino na tathā saukhyaṃ prāpnuvaṃti narāḥ kvacit || yathā nidhanataḥ kāśyāṃ labhate sukhamavyayam || 58 || varaṃ kāśīsamāvāsī nāsīno dyusadāṃ padam|| duḥkhāṃtaṃ labhate pūrvaḥ sukhāṃtaṃ labhate paraḥ || 59 || sthitopi bhagavanīśo maṃdaraṃ cārukaṃdaram || kāśīṃ vinā ratiṃ nā''pa divodāsanṛpoṣitām || 4.1.42.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe kālavaṃcanopāyonāma dvicatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 42 ||
<4.1.43>
|| agastiruvāca || || divodāsaṃ narapatiṃ kathaṃ devastrilocanaḥ || kāśīṃ saṃtyājayāmāsa kathamāgācca maṃdarāt || etadākhyānamākhyāhi śrotṝṇāṃ pramude bhagoḥ || 1 || || skaṃda uvāca || || maṃdaraṃ gatavāndevo brahmaṇo vākya gauravāt || tapasā tasya saṃtuṣṭo maṃdarasyaiva bhūbhṛtaḥ || 2 || gate viśveśvare deve maṃdaraṃ girisuṃdaram || giriśena samaṃ jagmurapi sarve divaukasaḥ || 3 || kṣetrāṇi vaiṣṇavānīha tyaktvā viṣṇurapi kṣiteḥ || prayāto maṃdaraṃ yatra devadeva umādhavaḥ || 4 || sthānāni gāṇapatyāni gaṇeśopi tato vrajat || hitvāhamapi vipreṃdra gatavānmaṃdaraṃ prati || 5 || sūraḥ saurāṇi saṃtyajya gataścāyatanādaram || svaṃsvaṃ sthānaṃ kṣitau tyaktvā yayuranyepi nirjarāḥ || 6|| gateṣu devasaṃgheṣu pṛthivyāḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || cakāra rājyaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ divodāsaḥ pratāpavān || 7 || vidhāya rājadhānīṃ sa vārāṇasyāṃ suniścalām || edhāṃ cakre mahābuddhiḥ prajādharmeṇa pālayan || 8 || sūryavatsa pratapitā durhṛdāṃ hṛdi netrayoḥ || somavatsuhṛdāmāsīnmānaseṣu svakeṣva'pi || 9 || akhaṃḍamākhaṃḍalavatkodaṃḍakalayanraṇe || palāyamānairālokiśatrusainyabalāhakaiḥ || 4.1.43.10 || sa dharmarājavajjāto dharmādharmavivecakaḥ || adaṃḍyānmaṇḍayanrājā daṃḍyāṃśca paridaṃḍayan || 11 || dhanaṃjaya ivādhākṣītparāraṇyānyanekaśaḥ || pāśīva pāśayāṃcakre vairicakraṃ vidūragaḥ || 12 || sobhūtpuṇyajanādhīśo ripurākṣasavardhanaḥ || jagatprāṇasamānaśca jagatprāṇanatatparaḥ ||13|| rājarājaḥ sa evābhūtsarveṣāṃ dhanadaḥ satām || sa eva rudramūrtiśca prekṣiṣṭa ripubhī raṇe || 14 || viśveṣāṃ sa hi devānāṃ tapasā rūpadhṛgyataḥ || viśvedevāstatastaṃ tu stuvaṃti ca bhajaṃti ca || 15 || asādhyaḥ sa hi sādhyānāṃ vasubhyo vasunādhikaḥ || grahāṇāṃ vigrahadharo dasrato'jasrarūpabhāk || 16 || marudgaṇānagaṇayaṃstuṣitāṃstoṣayanguṇaiḥ || sarvavidyādharo yastu sarvavidyādhareṣvapi || 17 || agarvāneva gaṃdharvānyaścakre nijagītibhiḥ || rarakṣuryakṣarakṣāṃsi taddurgaṃ svargasodaram || 18 || nāgānāgāṃsi cakruśca tasya nāgabalīyasaḥ || danujāmanujākāraṃ kṛtvā taṃ ca siṣevire || 19 || jātā guhyacarā yasya guhyakāḥ parito nṛṣu || saṃseviṣyāmahe rājannasurāstvāṃ svavaibhavaiḥ || 4.1.43.20 || vayaṃ yatastvadviṣaye surāvāso'pi durlabhaḥ || aśikṣayatkṣitipateriha yasya turaṃgamān || āśugaścāśugāmitvaṃ pāvamāne pathisthitaḥ || 21 || agajānyasya tu gajānnagavarṣmasuvarṣmaṇaḥ || ajasra dānino dṛṣṭvā bhavannanyepi dāninaḥ || 22 || sadojire ca boddhāro yoddhāraścaraṇājire || na yasya śāstrairvijitā na śastraiḥ kenacitkvacit || 23 || na netraviṣaye jātā viṣaye yasyabhūbhṛtaḥ || sadā naṣṭapadā dveṣyāstadā'naṣṭapadāḥ prajāḥ || 24 || kalāvāneka evāsti tridivepi divaukasām || tasya kṣoṇibhṛtaḥ kṣoṇyāṃ janāḥ sarve kalālayāḥ || 25 || eka eva hi kāmosti svarge sopyaṃgavarjitaḥ || sāṃgopāṃgāśca sarveṣāṃ sarve kāmā hi tadbhuvi ||26|| tasyopavartanepyeko na śruto gotrabhitkvacit || svarge svargasadāmīśo gotrabhitparikīrtitaḥ || 27 || kṣayī ca tasya viṣaye kopyākarṇi na kenacit || triviṣṭape kṣapānāthaḥ pakṣepakṣe kṣayīṣyate || 28 || nāke navagrahāḥ saṃti deśāstasyā'navagrahāḥ || 29 || hiraṇyagarbhaḥ svarlokepyeka eva prakāśate || hiraṇyagarbhāḥ sarveṣāṃ tatpaurāṇāmihālayāḥ || 4.1.43.30 || saptāśva ekaḥ svarloke nitarāṃ bhāsateṃ'śumān || sadaṃśukāḥ pratidinaṃ bahvaśvāstatpuraukasaḥ || 31 || sadapsarā yathāsvarbhūstatpuryapisadapsarāḥ || ekaiva padmā vaikuṃṭhe tasya padmākarāḥ śatam || || 32 || anītayaśca tadgrāmānārājapuruṣāḥ kvacit || gṛhegṛhetra dhanadā nāka eko'lakāpatiḥ || 33 || divodāsasya tasyaivaṃ kāśyāṃ rājyaṃ praśāsataḥ || gataṃ varṣaṃ dinaprāyaṃ śaradāmayutāṣṭakam || 34 || gīrvāṇā vipratīkāramatha tasya cikīrṣavaḥ || guruṇā maṃtrayāṃcakrurdharmavartmānuyāyinaḥ ||35|| bhavādṛśāmiva mune prāyaśo dharmacāriṇām || vibudhā vidadhatyeva mahatīrāpadāṃtatīḥ ||36|| yadyapyasau dharādhīśo vyādhinoddurdharādhvaraiḥ || tānadhvarabhujo'tyaṃtaṃ tathāpi suhṛdo na te || 37 || svabhāva eva dyusadāṃ parotkarṣāsahiṣṇutā || bali bāṇa dadhīcyādyairaparāddhaṃ kimatra taiḥ ||38|| aṃtarāyā bhavaṃtyeva dharmasyāpi padepade || tathāpi na nijo dharmo dharmadhībhirvimucyate || 39 || adharmiṇaḥ samedhaṃte dhanadhānyasamṛddhibhiḥ || adharmādeva ca paraṃ samūlaṃ yāṃtyadhogatim || 4.1.43.40 || prajāḥ pālayatastasya putrāniva nijaurasān || ripuṃjayasya nālpopi babhūvādharmasaṃgrahaḥ ||41|| ṣāḍguṇyavedinastasya triśaktyūrjitacetasaḥ || caturopāyavittasya na raṃdhraṃ vividuḥ surāḥ || 42 || buddhimaṃtopi vibudhā vipratīkartumudyatāḥ || manāgapi na saṃśekurapakartuṃ tadīśituḥ || 43 || ekapatnīvratāḥ sarve pumāṃsastasya maṃḍale || nārīṣu kācinnaivāsīdapativratadharmiṇī || 44 || anadhīto na viprobhūdaśūronaiva bāhujaḥ || vaiśyonabhijño naivāsīdarthopārjanakarmasu ||45|| ananyavṛttayaḥ śūdrā dvijaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ prati || tasya rāṣṭre samabhavandivodāsasya bhūpateḥ || 46 || avipluta brahmacaryāstadrāṣṭre brahmacāriṇaḥ || nityaṃ gurukulādhīnā vedagrahaṇatatparāḥ || 47 || ātithyadharmapravaṇā dharmaśāstravicakṣaṇāḥ || nityasādhusamācārā gṛhasthāstasya sarvataḥ || 48 || tṛtīyāśramiṇo yasminvanavṛttikṛtādarāḥ || niḥspṛhā grāmavārtāsu vedavartmānusāriṇaḥ || 49 || sarvasaṃgavinirmuktā nirmuktā niṣparigrahāḥ || vāṅmanaḥkarmadaṃḍāḍhyā yatayo yatra niḥspṛhāḥ || 4.1.43.50 || anyenulomajanmānaḥ pratilo mabhavā api || svapāraṃparyato dṛṣṭaṃ manāgvartma na tatyajuḥ || 51 || anapatyā na tadrāṣṭre dhanahīnopi kopi na || avṛddhasevī no kaścidakāṃḍamṛtibhākca na || 52 || na cāṭā naiva vācāṭā vaṃcakā no na hiṃsakāḥ || na pāṣaṃḍā na vai bhaṃḍā na raṃḍā na ca śauṃḍikāḥ ||53|| śrutighoṣo hi sarvatra śāstravādaḥ padepade || sarvatra subhagālāpā mudāmaṃgalagītayaḥ ||54 || vīṇāveṇupravādāśca mṛdaṃgā madhurasvanāḥ || somapānaṃ vinānyatra pānagoṣṭhī na karṇagā ||55|| māṃsāśinaḥ puroḍāśe naivānyatra kadācana || na durodariṇo yatra nādhamarṇā na taskarāḥ || 56 || putrasya pitroḥ padayoḥ pūjanaṃ devapūjanam || upavāso vrataṃ tīrthaṃ devatārādhanaṃ param || 57 || nārīṇāṃ bhartṛpad yorarcanaṃ tadvacaḥśrutiḥ || samarcayaṃti satatamanujā nijamagrajam || 58 || saparyayaṃti muditā bhṛtyāḥ svāmipadāṃbujam || hīnavarṇairagravarṇo varṇyate guṇagauravaiḥ || 59 || varivasyaṃti bhūyopi trikālaṃ kāśidevatāḥ || sarvatra sarve vidvāṃsaḥ samarcyaṃte manorathaiḥ || 4.1.43.60 || vidvadbhiśca taponiṣṭhāstaponiṣṭhairjiteṃdriyāḥ || jiteṃdriyairjñānaniṣṭhā jñānibhiḥ śivayoginaḥ || 61 || maṃtrapūtaṃ mahārhaṃ ca vidhiyuktaṃ susaṃskṛtam || vāḍavānāṃ mukhāgnau ca hūyate'harniśaṃ haviḥ || 62 || vāpīkūpataḍāgānāmārāmāṇāṃ padepade || śucibhirdravyasaṃbhāraiḥ kartāro yatra bhūriśaḥ || 63 || yadrāṣṭre hṛṣṭapuṣṭāśca dṛśyaṃte sarvajātayaḥ || aniṃdyasevā saṃpannā vināmṛgayu saunikān || 64 || itthaṃ tasya mahījāneḥ sarvatra śucivartinaḥ || unmiṣaṃtopyanimiṣā manākchidraṃ na lebhire || 65 || athovācāmara gururdevānapacikīrṣukān || tasminrājani dharmiṣṭhe variṣṭhe maṃtravediṣu ||68|| || gururuvāca || || saṃdhivigrahayānāsti saṃ śrayaṃ dvaidhabhāvanam || yathā sa rājā saṃvetti na tathātrāpi kaścana || 67 || upāyopyeka evāsti caturṣviha divaukasaḥ || bhedo nāma sa cetsidhyettapobalini tatra hi ||68|| tena yadyapi bhūbhartrā bhūmerdevā vivāsitāḥ || tathāpi bhūriśastatra saṃtyasmatpakṣapātinaḥ || 69 || kālo nimiṣamātropi yānvinā na sukhaṃ vrajet || asmākamapi tasyāpi saṃti te tatra mānitāḥ || 4.1.43.70 || aṃtarbahiścarā nityaṃ sarvaviśraṃbha bhūmayaḥ || samāgateṣu teṣvatra sarvaṃ naḥ setsyati priyam || 71 || samākarṇya ca te sarve tridaśā gīṣpatīritam || nirṇītavaṃtastasyārthaṃ tasmādaṃtarbahiścarān || abhinaṃdyātha taṃ sarve procuritthaṃ bhavediti || 72 || tataḥ śakraḥ samāhūya vītihotraṃ puraḥsthitam || ūce madhurayā vācā bahumānapuraḥsaram || 73 || havyavāhana yā mūrtistava tatra pratiṣṭhitā || tāmupāsaṃhara kṣipraṃ viṣayāttasya bhūpateḥ || || 74 || samāgatāyāṃ tanmūrtau sarvānaṣṭāgrayaḥ prajāḥ || havyakavyakriyāśūnyā virajiṣyaṃti rājani || 75 || prajāsu ca viraktāsu rājyakāmadughāsu vai || kṛcchreṇopārjito'pārtho rājaśabdo bhaviṣyati || 76 || prajānāṃ raṃjanādrājā yeyaṃ rūḍhirupārjitā || tasyāṃ rūḍhyāṃ pranaṣṭāyāṃ rājyameva vinaṃkṣyati || 77 || prajāvirahito rājā kośadurgabalādibhiḥ || samṛddhopyacirānnaśyetkūlasaṃstha iva drumaḥ || 78 || trivargasādhanāhetuḥ prākprajaiva mahīpateḥ || kṣīṇavṛttyāṃ prajāyāṃ vai trivargaḥ kṣīyate svayam || 79 || kṣīṇe trivarge saṃkṣīṇā gatirlokadvayātmikā || 4.1.43.80 || itīṃdravacanādvahnirahnāya kṣoṇimaṃḍalāt || ācakarṣa nijāṃ mūrtiṃ yogamāyā balānvitaḥ || 81 || ninye na kevalaṃ tretāṃ jāṭharāgnimapi prabhuḥ || vajriṇo vacasā vahnirnijaśaktisamanvitam || 82 || vahnau svarlokamāpanne jāte madhyaṃdine nṛpaḥ || kṛtamādhyāhnikastūrṇaṃ prāviśadbhojyamaṃḍapam || 83 || mahānasādhikṛtayo vepamānāstato muhuḥ || kṣudhārtamapi bhūpālamidaṃ maṃdaṃ vyajijñapan || 84 || sūpakārā ūcuḥ || atyahaskaratejaska pratāpavijitānala || kiṃcidvijñaptukāmāḥ smopyakāṃḍeraṇapaṃḍita || 85 || yadi viśruṇayedrājanbhavānabhayadakṣiṇām || tadā vijñāpayiṣyāmaḥ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭāḥ || 86 || bhrūsaṃjñayākṛtādeśāḥ praśastāsyenabhūbhujā || mṛdu vijñāpayāṃcakruḥ pākaśālādhikāriṇaḥ || 87 || na jānīmo vayaṃ nātha tvatpratāpabhayārditaḥ || kusṛtyātha kayā vidvānnaṣṭo vaiśvānaraḥ purāt || 88 || kṛśānau kṛśatāṃ prāpte kathaṃ pākakriyā bhavet || tathāpi sūryapākena siddhā paktirhi kācana || 89 || prabhorādeśamāsādya tāmihaivānayāmahe || manyāmahe ca bhūjāne paktiradyatanī śubhā || 4.1.43.90 || śrutvāṃdhasikavākyaṃ sa mahāsattvo mahāmatiḥ || nṛpatiściṃtayāmāsa devānāṃ vai kṛtaṃ tvidam || 91 || kṣaṇaṃ saṃśīlayaṃstatra dadarśa tapasobalāt || na kevalaṃ jahau gehaṃ hutabhukcaudarīrdarīḥ || 92 || apyahāsīditolokājjagāma ca surālayam || bhavatviha hi kā hānirasmākaṃ jvalane gatai || 93 || teṣāmevavicārācca hānireṣā suparvaṇām || tadbalena ca kiṃ rājyaṃ mayedamurarīkṛtam || 94 || pitāmahena mahato gauravātpratipāditam || iti ciṃtayatastasya madhyalokaśatakratoḥ || 95 || paurāḥ samāgatā dvāri saha jānapadairnaraiḥ || dvāsthena cājñayā rājñastatasteṃtaḥ praveśitāḥ || 96 || dattvopadaṃ yathārhaṃ te praṇemuḥ kṣoṇivajriṇam || kecitsaṃbhāṣitā rājñādarasodarayā girā || 97 || kecicca samudā dṛṣṭyā kecicca karasaṃjñayā || visarjitā sanā rājñā bahumānapuraḥsaram || 98 || tejire bhejire sarve ratnārciḥ parisevite || vijitāmodasaṃdohe surānokahasaurabhaiḥ || rājñaḥ śataśalākasthacchatrasyacchāyayāśubhe || 99 || viśāṃpatirathovāca tanmukhacchāyayeritam || vijñāya tadabhiprāyamalaṃbhītyā puraukasaḥ || 4.1.43.100 || vikārakāribhirlekhairyadinīto'nalo bhuvaḥ || etāvataiva kiṃ siddhayenmayi teṣāṃ parābhavaḥ || 101 || cikīrṣurahamevāsaṃ paurāḥ kāryamidaṃpurā || paraṃ hyupekṣitaprāyaṃ diṣṭyā taiḥ smāritaṃ cirāt || 102 || gato'nalo'bhavadbhadraṃ jagatprāṇopi yātvitaḥ || varuṇaḥ puṣpavaṃtābhyāmavilaṃbaṃ prayātvitaḥ || 103 || ahameva hi parjanyo bhaviṣyāmi tapobalāt || mude janapadānāṃ ca sarvasasyasamṛddhidaḥ || 104 || tapoyogabalenāhamātmānaṃ parikalpya ca || tridhāvahnisvarūpeṇa paktīṣṭivyuṣṭikṛttamaḥ || 105|| aṃtarbahiśca yo dvedhā nabhasvatpadavī dadhat || sarveṣāmeva vetsyāmi tvaṃtaḥkaraṇaceṣṭitam || 106 || vidhāya cāṃbhasīṃ mūrtiṃ sarvajīvaikajīvanīm || prajāḥ saṃjīvayipyāmi kiṃ jaḍairviṣaye mama || 107 || yadā khe tamasā paurā grasyete śaśibhāskarau || tadā na kiṃ vinā tābhyāṃ jīvāmaḥ kṣitimaṃḍale || 108 || śriyaṃ cāṃdramasīṃ prāpya hlādayiṣyāmyahaṃ prajāḥ || niśācareṇa kimiha kṣayiṇā ca kalaṃkinā || 109 || asmatkule mūlabhūto bhāskaro mānya eva naḥ || sa tiṣṭhatu sukhenātra yātāyātaṃ karotu ca || 4.1.43.110 || sa eko jagatāmātmā viśeṣātkuladevatā || sopakartuṃ na vettyeva tasyedaṃ vratamuttamam || 111 || iti narapativāksudhārasaughaṃ śrutipuṭakaiḥ paripīya pauravargaḥ || vikasitavadanāṃbujo jagāmanijanijamālayamādhimuktacittaḥ || 112 || kṣitipatirapi tattathā vidhāya tapasosādhyamihāsti kiṃ trilokyām || ativahnyarkamasau dadhaccatejo dyusadāṃ śalyamivoccakairbabhūva || 113 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpuraṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe divodāsapratāpavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||43||
<4.1.44>
|| skaṃda uvāca || atha maṃdarakaṃdarodarollasada samadyuti ratnamaṃdire || paritaḥ samadhiṣṭhitāmare nijaśikharairvasanīkṛtāṃbare || 1 || nivasañjagadīśvaro haraḥ kṛśarajanīśa kalāmanoharaḥ ||| labhate sma na śarma śaṃkaraḥ prasaratkāśiviyogaja jvaraḥ || 2 || virahānalaśāṃtaye tadā samalepi tripurāriṇāpi yaḥ || malayodbhava paṃka eṣa sa pratipedehyadhunā pipāṃsutām | 3 paritāpaharāṇi padminīnāṃ mṛdulānyapi kaṃkaṇīkṛtāni || gaditāni yadīśvareṇa sarpāstadabhūtsatyamahomaheśvarecchā || 4 || yadu dugdhanidhiṃ nimathyadevairmṛdusāraḥ samakarṣi pūrṇacaṃdraḥ || sa babhūva kṛśo viyogatapteśvaramūrdhoṣmaparikṣaraccharīraḥ || 5 || yadadīdharadeṣa jātatāpaḥ pṛthule maulijaṭāni kuṃjakoṇe || paritāpaharāṃ harastadānīṃ dyunadīṃ tāmadhunāpi nojjihīte|| 6 || mahato virahasya śaṃkaraḥ prasabhaṃtasyavaśī vaśaṃgataḥ || vividena suraiḥ sadogatairapi saṃvītasutāpaveṣṭitaḥ || 7 || aticitramidaṃ yadātmanā śucirapyeṣa kṛpīṭayoninā || svapurīvirahodbhavena vai paritāpyeta jagattrayeśvaraḥ || 8 || nijabhālatalaṃ kalānidheḥ kalayā nityamalaṃkaroti yaḥ || sa tadīśvaramapyatāpayadvidhureko viparīta eva tu || 9 || garalaṃ galanālikātale vilasedasya na tena tāpitaḥ || amṛtāṃśu tuṣāradīdhiti pracayaireva tu tāpito'dbhutam || 4.1.44.10 || vilasaddharicaṃdanodakacchaṭayā tadvirahāpanuttaye || hṛdayā hi tayāpyadūyata prasaradbhogiphaṭābhavairna tu ||11|| sakalabhramameṣa nāśayetsragahitvādyapadeśajaṃ haraḥ || idamadbhutamasya yadbhramaḥ sphuṭamālyepi mahāhisaṃbhavaḥ ||12|| smṛtimātrapathaṃgatopi yastrividha tāpamapākarotyalam|| sa hi kāśiviyogatāpitaḥ svagataṃ kiṃcidajalpadityajaḥ || 13 || api kāśi samāgato'nilo yadi gātrāṇi pariṣvajenmama || davathuḥ pariśāṃtimeti tannahi mānī parigāhanairapi || 14 || agamiṣyadahokathaṃ satāpo nanu dakṣāṃgajayāya edhitaḥ || mamajīvātulatā jhaṭityalaṃ hyabhaviṣyanna himādrijā yadi || 15 || na tathojjhitadehayātayā mama dakṣodbhavayāmano'dunot || avimuktaviyogajanmanāpari dūyeta yathā mahoṣmaṇā || 16 || ayi kāśi mudā kadā punastava lapsye sukhamaṃgasaṃgajam || atiśītalitāni yena me'dbhutagātrāṇi bhavaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 17 || ayi kāśi vināśitāghasaṃghe tavaviśleṣajaāśuśukṣaṇiḥ || amṛtāṃśukalāmṛdudravairaticitraṃhaviṣeva vardhate || 18 || agamanmama dakṣajā viyogajo davathuḥ prāgghimavatsutauṣadhena || adhunā khalu naiva śāṃtimīyāṃ yadi kāśīṃ na vilokayehamāśu || 19 || manaseti gṛṇaṃstadā śivaḥ sutarāṃ saṃvṛtatāpavaikṛtaḥ || jagadaṃbikayā dhiyāṃ jananyā kathamapyeṣa viyukta ityamāni || 4.1.44.20 || priyayā vapuṣordhayānayāpyaparijñāta viyogakāraṇaḥ || vacanairupacaryate sma sapraṇataprāṇinidāghadāraṇaḥ || 21 || || śrīpārvatyuvāca || || tava sarvaga sarvamasti haste vilasadyoga viyoga eva kaste || tava bhūtiraho vibhūtidātrī sakalāpatkalikāpi bhūtadhātrī || 22 || tvadanīkṣaṇataḥ kṣaṇādvibho pralayaṃ yāṃti jagaṃti śocyavat || cyavate bhavataḥ kṛpālavāditaropīśanayastvayoṃkṛtaḥ || 23 || bhavataḥ paritāpahetavo na bhavaṃtīṃdu divākarāgnayaḥ ||
