nayanāniyatastrinetra te'mī praṇayinyastilasajjalā ca maulau || 24 || bhujagābhujagāḥ sadaiva te'mī na viṣaṃ saṃkramate ca nīlakaṃṭha || ahamasmi ca vāmadeva vāmā tava vāmaṃvapuratra cittayuktā ||25|| iti saṃsṛtisaṃbījajananyābhihite hite || girāṃ niguṃphe giriśo vaktumapyādade giram || 26 || || īśvara uvāca || || ayi kāśītyaṣṭamūrtirbhavo bhāvāṣṭakobhavat || satvaraṃ śivayājñāyi dhruvaṃ kāśyāhṛtoharaḥ ||27|| athabālasakhī bhūta tattatkānanavīrudham || śivāprastāvayāṃcakre vimuktāṃ muktidāṃ purīm ||28|| || pārvatyuvāca || || gaganatalamilitasalile pralayepi bhava triśūlapari vidhṛtām || kṛtapuṃḍarīkaśobhāṃ smaraharakāśīṃ purīṃ yāvaḥ ||29|| dharādhareṃdrasya dharātisuṃdarā na māṃ tathāsyāpi dhinoti dhūrjaṭe|| dharāgatāpīha na yā dhruvaṃdharā purīdhurīṇā tava kāśikā yathā||4.1.44.30|| na yatra kāśyāṃ kalikālajaṃ bhayaṃ na yatra kāśyāṃ maraṇātpunarbhavaḥ|| na yatra kāśyāṃ kaluṣodbhavaṃ bhayaṃ kathaṃ vibho sā nayanātithirbhavet ||31|| kimatra no saṃti puraḥ sahasraśaḥ padepade sarvasamṛddhibhūmayaḥ || paraṃ na kāśī sadṛśīdṛśoḥ padaṃ kvacidgatā me bhavatā śape śiva || 32 || triviṣṭape saṃti na kiṃ puraḥ śataṃ samastakautūhalajanmabhūmayaḥ || tṛṇī bhavaṃtīha ca tāḥ puraḥpuraḥ padaṃ purāre bhavato bhavadviṣaḥ ||33|| na kevalaṃ kāśiviyogajo jvaraḥ prabādhate tvāṃ tu tathā yathātra mām || upāya eṣotra nidāghaśāṃtaye purī tu sā vā mamajanmabhūratha || 34 || mayā na mene mamajanmabhūmikā viyogajanmā paridāghaīśitaḥ || avāpyakāśīṃ paritaḥ praśāṃtidāṃ samastasaṃtāpavighātahetukām || 35 || na mokṣalakṣmyotra samakṣamīkṣitāstanūbhṛtā kenacideva kutracit || avaimyahaṃ śarmada sarvaśarmadā sarūpiṇī muktirasau hi kāśikā || 36 || na muktirastīha tathā samādhinā sthireṃdriyatvojjhita tatsamādhinā || kratukriyābhirna na vedavidyayā yathā hi kāśyāṃ parihāya vigraham ||37|| na nākaloke sukhamasti tādṛśaṃ kutastu pātālatale'tisuṃdare || vārtāpi martye sukhasaṃśrayā kva vā kāśyāṃ hi yādṛktanumātradhāriṇi || 38 || kṣetre triśūlinbhavato'vimukte vimuktilakṣmyā na kadāpi mukte || manopi yaḥ prāṇivaraḥ prayuṃkte ṣaḍaṃgayogaṃ sa sadaiva yuṃkte || 39 || ṣaḍaṃgayogānnahi tādṛśī nṛbhiḥ śarīrasiddhiḥ sahasātra labhyate || sukhena kāśīṃ samavāpya yādṛśīdṛśau sthirīkṛtya śiva tvayi kṣaṇam || 4.1.44.40 || varaṃ hi tiryaktvamabuddhivaibhavaṃ na mānavatvaṃ bahubuddhibhājanam || akāśisaṃdarśananiṣphalodayaṃ samaṃtataḥ puṣkarabudbudopamam || 41 || dṛśau kṛtārthe kṛtakāśidarśane tanuḥkṛtārthā śivakāśivāsinī || manaḥkṛtārthaṃ dhṛtakāśisaṃśrayaṃ mukhaṃ kṛtārthaṃ kṛtakāśisaṃmukham || 42 || varaṃ hi tatkāśirajoti pāvanaṃ rajastamodhvaṃsi śaśiprabhojjvalam || kṛtapraṇāmairmaṇikarṇikā bhuve lalāṭagaṃyadbahumanyate suraiḥ || 43 || na devaloko na ca satyaloko na nāgaloko maṇikarṇikāyāḥ || tulāṃ vrajedyatra mahāprayāṇakṛcchrutirbhavedbrahmarasāyanāspadam ||44|| mahāmahobhūrmaṇikarṇikāsthalī tamastatiryatra sameti saṃkṣayam || paraḥ śatairjanmabhiredhitāpi yā divākarāgnīṃdukarairanigrahā || 45 || kimu nirvāṇapadasya bhadrapīṭhaṃ mṛdulaṃ talpamathonumokṣalakṣmyāḥ || athavā maṇikarṇikāsthalī paramānaṃdasukaṃdajanmabhūmiḥ || 46 || samatītavimuktajaṃtusaṃkhyā kriyate yatra janaiḥ sukhopaviṣṭaiḥ || vilasaddyuti sūkṣmaśarkarābhiḥ svavapuḥpātamahotsavābhilāṣaiḥ || 47 || || skaṃda uvāca || || aparṇāparivarṇyeti purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ mune || punarvijñāpayāmāsa kāśīprāptyai pinākinam|| 48 || śrīpārvatyuvāca || || pramathādhipa sarveśa nityasvādhīnavartana || yathānaṃdavanaṃ yāyāṃ tathā kuru varaprada|| 49 || skanda uvāca|| || jitapīyūṣamādhuryāṃ kāśīstavanasuṃdarīm || athākarṇyāhamudito giriśo girijāṃ giram || 4.1.44.50 || śrīdevadeva uvāca || || ayi priyatame gauri tvadvā gamṛtasīkaraiḥ || āpyāyitosmi nitarāṃ kāśīprāptyai yatedhunā || 51 || tvaṃ jānāsi mahādevi mama yattanmahadvratam|| abhuktapūrvamanyena vastūpāśnāmi netarat ||52|| pitāmahasya vacanāddivodāse mahīpatau|| dharmeṇa śāsati purīṃ ka upāyo vidhīyatām ||53|| kathaṃ sa rājā dharmiṣṭhaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ || viyojyate puraḥ kāśyā divodāso mahīpatiḥ||54|| adharmavartino yasmādvighnaḥ syānnetarasya tu || tasmātkaṃ preṣayāmīśe yastaṃ kāśyā viyojayet ||55|| dharmavartmānusaratāṃ yo vighnaṃ samupācaret || tasyaiva jāyate vighnaḥ pratyuta premavardhini ||56 || vinācchidreṇa taṃ bhūpaṃ notsādayitumutsahe || mayaiva hi yato rakṣyāḥ priye dharmadhuraṃdharāḥ || 57 || na jarā tamatikrāmenna taṃ mṛtyurjirghāṃsati || vyādhayastaṃ na bādhaṃte dharmavartmabhṛdatrayaḥ || 58 || iti saṃciṃtayandevo yoginīcakramagrataḥ || dadarśātimahāprauḍhaṃ gāḍhakāryasya sādhanam ||59|| atha devyā samālocya vyomakeśo mahāmune || yoginīvṛṃdamāhūya jagau vākyamidaṃ haraḥ || 4.1.44.60 || satvaraṃ yāta yoginyo mama vārāṇasīṃ purīm|| yatra rājā divodāso rājyaṃ dharmeṇa śāstyalam || 61 || svadharmavicyutaḥ kāśīṃ yathā tūrṇaṃ tyajennṛpaḥ || tathopacarata prājñā yogamāyābalānvitāḥ ||62|| yathā punarnavīkṛtya purīṃ vārāṇasīmaham || itaḥ prayāmi yoginyastathā kṣipraṃ vidhīyatām || 63 || iti prasādamāsādya śāsanaṃ śirasā vahan|| kṛtapraṇāmo niryāto yoginīnāṃ gaṇastataḥ || 64 || yayurākāśamāviśya manasopya tiraṃhasā || parasparaṃ bhāṣamāṇā yoginyastā mudānvitāḥ ||65|| adya dhanyatarāḥ smo vai devadevena yatsvayam || kṛtaprasādāḥ prahitāḥ śrīmadānaṃdakānanam||66|| adya sadyo mahālābhāvabhūtāṃ notidurlabhau || trinetrarājasaṃmānastathā kāśī vilokanam || 67 || iti muditamanāḥ sa yoginīnāṃ nikuraṃvastvathamaṃdarādrikuṃjāt || nabhasi laghukṛtaprayāṇavego nayanātithyamalaṃbhayatpurīṃ tām || 68 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūvārddhe kāśīvarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
<4.1.45>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || atha tadyoginīvṛṃdaṃ dūrāddṛṣṭiṃ prasārya ca || svanetradairghyanirmāṇaṃ praśaśaṃsa phalānvitam || 1 || divyaprāsādamālānāṃ patākāścalapallavāḥ || sādaraṃ dūramārgasthānpāṃthānāhvayatīriva ||2|| caṃcatprāsādamāṇikyairvijṛṃbhitamarīcibhiḥ || sunīlamapi ca vyomavīkṣyamāṇaṃ sunirmalam || 3 || devatvaṃ māyayācchādya veṣaṃ kārpaṭikocitam || vidhāya kāśīmaviśadyoginīcakramakramam || 4 || kāciccayoginī bhūtā kācijjātā tapasvinī || kācidbabhūva sairaṃdhrī kācinmāsopavāsinī ||5|| mālākāravadhūḥ kācitkācinnāpitasuṃdarī || sūtikarmavicārajñā 'parā bhaiṣajyakovidā || 6 || vaiśyā ca kācidabhavatkrayavikrayacaṃcurā || vyālagrāhiṇyabhūtkāciddāsīdhātrī ca kācana || 7 || ekā ca nṛtyakuśalā tvanyā gānaviśāradā || aparā veṇuvādajñā parā vīṇādharābhavat || 8 || mṛdaṃgavādanajñānyā kācittāla kalāvatī || kācitkārmaṇatattvajñā kācinmauktikaguṃphikā || 9 || gaṃdhabhāgavidhijñānyā kācidakṣakalālayā || ālāpollāsakuśalā kāciccatvaracāriṇī || 4.1.45.10 || vaṃśādhirohaṇe dakṣā rajjumārgeṇa cetarā || kācidvātulaceṣṭā'bhūtpathi cīvaraveṣṭanā || 11 || apatyadā'napatyānāṃ parā tatrapure'vasat || kācitkarāṃghrirekhāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni ciketi ca || 12 || citralekhana naipuṇyātkācijjanamanoharā || vaśīkaraṇamaṃtrajñā kācittatra cacāra ha || 13 || guṭikāsiddhidā kācitkācidaṃjanasiddhidā || dhātuvādavidagdhānyā pādukāsiddhidā parā || 14 || agnistaṃbha jalastaṃbha vākstaṃbhaṃ cāpyaśikṣayat || khecarītvaṃ dadau kācidadṛśyatvaṃ parā dadau || 15 || kācidākarpaṇīṃ siddhiṃ dadāvuccāṭanaṃ parā || kācinnijāṃgasauṃdarya yuvacittavimohinī || 16 || ciṃtitārthapradā kācitkācijjyotiḥ kalāvatī || ityādi veṣabhāṣābhiranukṛtya samaṃtataḥ || 17 || pratyaṃgaṇaṃ pratigṛhaṃ prāviśadyoginīgaṇaḥ || itthamabdaṃcaraṃtyastā yoginyo'harniśaṃ puri ||18|| na cchidraṃ lebhire kvāpi nṛpavighnacikīrṣavaḥ || tataḥ sametya tāḥ sarvā yoginyo vaṃdhyavāṃchitāḥ || tasthuḥ saṃmaṃtrya tatraiva na gatā maṃdaraṃ punaḥ || 19 || prabhukāryamaniṣpādya sadaḥ saṃbhāvanaidhitaḥ || kaḥ puraḥ śaknuyātsthātuṃ svāmino kṣatavigrahaḥ ||4.1.45.20|| anyacca ciṃtitaṃ tābhiryoginībhiridaṃ mune || prabhuṃ vināpi jīvāmo na tu kāśīṃ vinā punaḥ || 21 || prabhūruṣṭopi sadbhṛtye jīvikāmātrahārakaḥ || kāśīharetkarādbhraṣṭā puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 22 || nādyāpi kāśīṃ saṃtyajya tadārabhya mahāmune || yoginyonyatra tiṣṭhaṃti caraṃtyopi jagattrayam|| 23 || prāpyāpi śrīmatīṃ kāśīṃ yastitikṣati durmatiḥ || sa eva pratyuta tyakto dharmakāmārthamuktibhiḥ ||24|| kaḥ kāśīṃ prāpya durbuddhiraparatra yiyāsati|| mokṣanikṣepa kalaśīṃ tucchaśrīkṛtamānasaḥ || 25 || vimukhopīśvarosmākaṃ kāśīsevanapuṇyataḥ || saṃmukho bhavitā puṇyaṃ kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma tadvayam || 26 || dinaiḥ katipayaireva sarvajñopi sameṣyati || vinā kāśīṃ na ramate yato'nyatra trilocanaḥ || 27 || śaṃbhoḥ śaktiriyaṃ kāśī kācitsarvairagocarā || śaṃbhureva hi jānīyādetasyāḥ paramaṃ sukham || || 28 || iti niścitya manasi śaṃbhorānaṃdakānane || atiṣṭhadyoginīvṛṃdaṃ kayācinmāyayāvṛtam || 29 || vyāsa uvāca || || itthaṃ samākarṇya muniḥ punaḥ papraccha ṣaṇmukham || kāni kāni ca nāmāni tāsāṃ tāni vadeśvara || 4.1.45.30 || bhajanādyoginīnāṃ ca kāśyāṃ kiṃ jāyate phalam || kasminparvaṇi tāḥ pūjyāḥ kathaṃ pūjyāśca tadvada || 31 || śrutvetipraśnamaumeyo yoginīsaṃśrayaṃ tataḥ || pratyuvāca mune vacmi śṛṇotvavahito bhavān || 32 || || skaṃda uvāca || || nāmadheyāni vakṣyāmi yoginīnāṃ ghaṭodbhava|| ākarṇya yāni pāpāni kṣayaṃti bhavināṃ kṣaṇāt||33|| gajānanā siṃhamukhī gṛdhrāsyā kākatuṃḍikā|| uṣṭragrīvā hayagrīvā vārāhī śarabhānanā ||34|| ulūkikā śivārāvā mayūrī vikaṭānanā || aṣṭavaktrā koṭarākṣī kubjā vikaṭalocanā ||35|| śuṣkodarī lalajjihvā śvadaṃṣṭrā vānarānanā || ṛkṣākṣī kekarākṣī ca bṛhattuṃḍā surāpriyā || 36 || kapālahastā raktākṣī śukī śyenī kapotikā || pāśahastā daṃḍahastā pracaṃḍā caṃḍavikramā || 37 || śiśughnī pāpahaṃtrī ca kālī rudhirapāyinī || vasādhayā garbhabhakṣā śavahastāṃtramālinī ||38|| sthūlakeśī bṛhatkukṣiḥ sarpāsyā pretavāhanā || daṃdaśūkakarā krauṃcī mṛgaśīrṣā vṛṣānanā || 39 || vyāttāsyā dhūmaniḥśvāsā vyomaikacaraṇordhvadṛk || tāpanī śoṣaṇīdṛṣṭiḥ koṭarī sthūlanāsikā || 4.1.45.40 || vidyutprabhā balākāsyā mārjārī kaṭapūtanā || aṭṭāṭṭahāsā kāmākṣī mṛgākṣī mṛgalocanā ||41|| nāmānīmāni yo martyaścatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ dinedine || japettrisaṃdhyaṃ tasyeha duṣṭabādhā praśāmyati || 42 || na ḍākinyo na śākinyo na kūṣmāṃḍā na rākṣasāḥ || tasya pīḍāṃ prakurvaṃti nāmānīmāni yaḥ paṭhet || 43 || śiśūnāṃ śāṃtikārīṇi garbhaśāṃtikarāṇi ca || raṇe rājakule vāpi vivāde jayadānyapi || 44 || labhedabhīpsitāṃ siddhiṃ yoginīpīṭhasevakaḥ || maṃtrāṃtarāṇyapi japaṃstatpīṭhe siddhibhāgbhavet || 45 || balipūjopahāraiśca dhūpadīpasamarpaṇaiḥ || kṣipraṃ prasannā yoginyaḥ prayaccheyurmanorathān || 46 || śaratkāle mahāpūjāṃ tatra kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || havīṃṣi hutvā maṃtrajño mahatīṃ siddhimāpnuyāt || 47 || ārabhyāśvayujaḥśuklāṃ tithiṃ pratipadaṃ śubhām || pūjayennavamīyāvannaraściṃtitamāpnuyāt || 48 || kṛṣṇapakṣasya bhūtāyāmupavāsī narottamaḥ || tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā mahatīṃ siddhimāpnuyāt || 49 || praṇavādicaturthyantairnāmabhirbhaktimānnaraḥ || pratyekaṃ havanaṃ kṛtvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ niśi || 4.1.45.50 || sasarpiṣā guggulunā laghukoli pramāṇataḥ || yāṃ yāṃ siddhimabhīpseta tāṃtāṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||51|| caitrakṛṣṇapratipadi tatra yātrā prayatnataḥ || kṣetravighnaśāṃtyarthaṃ kartavyā puṇyakṛjjanaiḥ || 52 || yātrā ca sāṃvatsarikīṃ yo na kuryādavajñayā || tasya vighnaṃ prayacchaṃti yoginyaḥ kāśivāsinaḥ || 53 || agre kṛtvā sthitāḥ sarvāstāḥ kāśyāṃ maṇikarṇikām || tannamaskāramātreṇa naro vighnairna bādhyate || 54 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe ṣaṣṭiyoganyāgamanaṃnāma paṃcacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
<4.1.46>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || gatetha yoginīvṛṃde devadevo ghaṭodbhava || kāśīpravṛttiṃ jijñāsuḥ prāhiṇodaṃśumālinam ||1|| devadeva uvāca || || saptāśva tvarito yāhi purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām || yatrāsti sa divodāso dharmamūrtirmahīpatiḥ || 2 || tasya dharmavirodhena yathātatkṣetramudvaset || tathā kuruṣva bho kṣipraṃ māvamaṃsthāśca taṃ nṛpam || 3 || dharmamārga pravṛttasya kriyate yāvamānanā || sā bhavedātmano nūnaṃ mahadenaśca jāyate || 4 || tavabuddhivikāsena cyavate cetsa dharmataḥ || tadā sā nagarī bhāno tvayodvāsyā'sahaiḥ karaiḥ || 5 || kāmakrodhau lobhamohau matsarāhaṃkṛtī api || te tatra na bhavetāṃ yattatkālopi na taṃ jayet || 6 || yāvaddharme sthirābuddhiryāvaddharmesthiraṃ manaḥ || tāvadvighnodayaḥ kvāsti vipadyapi rave nṛṣu || 7 || sarveṣāmiha jaṃtūnāṃ tvaṃ vetsi bradhnaceṣṭitam || ataeva jagaccakṣurvraja tvaṃ kāryasiddhaye || 8 || ravirādāya devājñāṃ mūrtimanyāṃ prakalpya ca || nabhodhvagāmahorātraṃ kāśīmabhimukho'bhavat || 9 || manasātīvalolo'bhūtkāśīdarśanalālasaḥ || sahasracaraṇopyaicchattadā khe naikapādatām || 4.1.46.10 || haṃsatvaṃ tasya sūryasya tadā saphalatāmagāt || sadā nabhodhvanīnasya kāśīṃ prati yiyāsataḥ || 11 || atha kāśīṃ samāsādya raviraṃtarbahiścaran || manāgapi na tadbhūpe dharmadhvastimavekṣata ||12|| vibhāvasurvasankāśyāṃ nānārūpeṇa vatsaram || kvacinnāvasaraṃ prāpa tatra rājñi sudharmiṇi || 13 || kadācidatithirbhūto durlabhaṃ prārthayanraviḥ || na tasya rājño viṣaye durlabhaṃ kiṃcidaikṣata || 14 || kadācidyācako jāto bahudopi kadāpyabhūt || kadāciddīnatāṃ prāptaḥ kadācidgaṇakopyabhūt || 15 || vedabāhyāṃ kriyāṃ cāpi kadācitpratyapādayat|| kadācitsthāpayāmāsa dṛṣṭapratyayamaihikam ||16|| kadācijjaṭilo jātaḥ kadācicca digaṃbaraḥ || sa kadācijjāṃguliko viṣavidyāviśāradaḥ|| || 17 || sarvapāṣaṃḍadharmajñaḥ kadācidbrahmavādyabhūt || aiṃdrajālika āsīcca kadācidbhrāmayañjanān || 18 || nānāvratopadeśaiśca kadācitsa pativratāḥ || kṣobhayāmāsa bahuśaḥ sadṛṣṭāṃta kathānakaiḥ || 19 || kāpālika vratadharaḥ kadāciccābhavaddvijaḥ || kadācidapi vijñānī dhātuvādī kadācana || 4.1.46.20 || kvacidvipraḥ kvacidrājaputro vaiśyoṃtyajaḥ kvacita || brahmacārī kvacidabhūdgṛhī vanacaraḥ kvacit || 21 || yatiḥ kadāciditi sarūpairabhrāmayajjanān || sarvavidyāsu kuśalaḥ sarvajñaścābhavatkvacit || 22 || iti nānāvidhai rūpaiścarankāśyāṃ graheśvaraḥ || na kadāpi jane kvāpi cchidraṃ prāpa kadācana || 23 || tato niniṃda cātmānaṃ ciṃtārtaḥ kaśyapātmajaḥ || dhikparapreṣyatāṃ yasyāṃ yaśo labhyeta na kvacit || 24 || || mārtaṃḍa uvāca || || maṃdaraṃ yadi yāmyadya sadyastatkruddhyatīśvaraḥ || aniṣpāditakāryārthe mayi sāmānyabhṛtyavat || ||25 || kopamapyurarīkṛtya yadi yāyāṃ kathaṃcana || kathaṃ tiṣṭhe purastasya tarhi vai mūḍhabhṛtyavat || 26 || athoṃkṛtyāvahelaṃ vā yāmi cecca kathaṃcana || krodhānnirīkṣettryakṣo māṃ viṣaṃ peyaṃ tadā mayā || 27 || harakopānale nūnaṃ yadi yātaḥ pataṃgatām || pitāmahopi māṃ trātuṃ tadā śakṣyati nasphuṭam || 28 || sthāsyāmyatraiva tannityaṃ na tyakṣyāmi kadācana || kṣetrasaṃnyāsavidhinā vārāṇasyāṃ kṛtāśramaḥ || 29 || puraḥ purāreḥ kāyārthamanivedyeha tiṣṭhataḥ || yatpāpaṃ bhāvi me tasya kāśīpāpasyaniṣkṛtiḥ ||4.1.46.30|| anyānyapi ca pāpāni mahāṃtyalpāni yāni ca || kṣayaṃti tāni sarvāṇi kāśīṃ praviśatāṃ satām ||31|| buddhipūrvaṃ mayā caitanna pāpaṃ samupārjitam || purāriṇaiva hi purā''śāsi dharmo hi rakṣyatām || 32 || dharmo hi rakṣito yena dehe satvaragatvare || trailokyarakṣitaṃ tena kiṃ kāmārthaiḥ surakṣitaiḥ ||33 || rakṣaṇīyo yadi bhavetkāmaḥ kāmāriṇā katham || kṣaṇādanaṃgatāṃ nīto bahūnāṃ sukhakāryapi ||34|| arthaścetsarvathārakṣya iti kaiścidudāhṛtam|| tatkathaṃ na hariścaṃdro'rakṣatkuśikanaṃdane || 35 || dharmastu rakṣitaḥ sarvairapidehavyayena ca || śibiprabhṛtibhūpālairdadhīcipramukhairdvijaiḥ || 36 || ayameva hi vai dharmaḥ kāśīsevanasaṃbhavaḥ || ruṣitādapi rudrānmāṃ rakṣiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 37 || avāpya kāśīṃ duṣprāpāṃ ko jahāti sacetanaḥ || ratnaṃ karasthamutsṛjya kaḥ kācaṃ saṃjighṛkṣati || 38 || vārāṇasīṃ samutsṛjya yastvanyatra yiyāsati || hatvā nidhānaṃ pādena sorthamicchati bhikṣayā || 39 || putramitrakalatrāṇi kṣetrāṇi ca dhanāni ca || pratijanmeha labhyaṃte kāśyekā naiva labhyate || 4.1.46.40 || yena labdhā purī kāśī trailokyoddharaṇakṣamā || trailokyaiśvaryaduṣprāpaṃ tena labdhaṃ mahāsukham || 41 || kupitopi hi me rudrastejohāniṃ vidhāsyati || kāśyāṃ ca lapsye tattejo yadvai svātmāvabodhajam || 42 || itarāṇīha tejāṃsi bhāsaṃte tāvadeva hi || khadyotābhāni yāvanno jṛṃbhate kāśijaṃ mahaḥ || 43 || iti kāśīprabhāvajño jagaccakṣustamonudaḥ || kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānaṃ kāśīpuryāṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 44 || lolārka uttarārkaśca sāṃbādityastathaiva ca || caturtho drupadādityo mayūkhāditya eva ca || 45 || khakholkaścāruṇādityo vṛddhakeśavasaṃjñakau || daśamo vimalādityo gaṃgādityastathaiva ca || || 46 || dvādaśaśca yamādityaḥ kāśipuryāṃ ghaṭodbhava || tamo'dhikebhyo duṣṭebhyaḥ kṣetraṃ rakṣaṃtyamī sadā || 47 || tasyārkasya manololaṃ yadāsītkāśidarśane || ato lolārka ityākhyā kāśyāṃ jātā vivasvataḥ || 48 || lolārkastvasisaṃbhede dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśisthitaḥ || yogakṣemaṃ sadā kuryātkāśīvāsi janasya ca || || 49 || mārgaśīrṣasya saptamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā ravivāsare || vidhāya vārṣikīṃ yātrāṃ naraḥ pāpai pramucyate || 4.1.46.50 || kṛtāni yāni pāpāni naraiḥ saṃvatsarāvadhi || naśyaṃti kṣaṇatastāni ṣaṣṭhyarke loladarśanāt || 51 || naraḥ snātvāsisaṃbhede saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || śrāddhaṃ vidhāya vidhinā pitrānṛṇyamavāpnuyāt ||52|| lolārkasaṃgame snātvā dānaṃ homaṃ surārcanam || yatkiṃcitkriyate karma tadānaṃtyāya kalpate || 53 || sūryoparāge lolārke snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || kurukṣetrāddaśaguṇā bhavaṃtīha na saṃśayaḥ || 54 || lolārke rathasaptamyāṃ snātvā gaṃgāsisaṃgame || saptajanmakṛtaiḥ pāpairmukto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 55 || pratyarkavāraṃ lolārkaṃ yaḥ paśyati śucivrataḥ || na tasya duḥkhaṃ lokesminkadācitsaṃbhaviṣyati||56|| na tasya duḥkhaṃ no pāmā na dadrurna vicarcikā || lolārkamarke yaḥ paśyettatpādodakasevakaḥ || 57 || vārāṇasyāmuṣitvāpi yo lolārkaṃ na sevate || sevaṃte taṃ naraṃ nūnaṃ kleśāḥ kṣudvyādhisaṃbhavāḥ || 58 || sarveṣāṃ kāśitīrthānāṃ lolārkaḥ prathamaṃ śiraḥ || tatoṃ'gānyanyatīrthāni tajjalaplāvitānihi || 59 || tīrthāṃtarāṇi sarvāṇi bhūmīvalayagānyapi || asisaṃbhedatīrthasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 4.1.46.60 || sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ snānādyallabhyate phalam || tatphalaṃ samyagāpyeta narairgaṃgāsisaṃgame || 61 || nārthavādoyamuditaḥ stutivādo na vai mune || satyaṃ yathārthavādoyaṃ śraddheyaḥ sadbhirādarāt || 62 || yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣādyatra svargataraṃgiṇī || mithyā tatrānumanyaṃte tārkikāścānusūyakāḥ || 63 || udāharaṃti ye mūḍhāḥ kutarkabaladarpitāḥ || kāśyāṃ sarverthavādoyaṃ te viṭkīṭā yugeyuge || 64 || kasyacitkāśitīrthasya mahimno mahatastulām|| nādhirohenmune nūnamapi trailokyamaṃḍapaḥ || 65 || nāstikā vedabāhyāśca śiśnodaraparāyaṇāḥ || aṃtyajātāśca ye teṣāṃ puraḥ kāśī na varṇyatām || 66 || lolārkakaraniṣṭaptā asidhāra vikhaṃḍitāḥ || kāśyāṃ dakṣiṇadigbhāge na viśeyurmahāmalāḥ ||67|| mahimānamimaṃ śrutvā lolārkasya narottamaḥ || na duḥkhī jāyate kvāpi saṃsāre duḥkhasāgare || 68 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe lolārkavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 46 ||
<4.1.47>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || athottarasyāmāśāyāṃ kuṃḍamarkākhyamuttamam || tatra nāmnottarārkeṇa raśmimālī vyavasthitaḥ || 1 || tāpayanduḥkhasaṃghātaṃ sādhūnāpyāyayanraviḥ || uttarārko mahātejāḥ kāśīṃ rakṣati sarvadā || 2 || tatretihāso yo vṛttastaṃ niśāmaya suvrata || vipraḥ priyavrato nāma kaścidātreya vaṃśajaḥ || 3 || āsītkāśyāṃ śubhācāraḥ sadātithijanapriyaḥ || bhāryā śubhavratā tasya babhūvātimanoharā || 4 || bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇaratā gṛhakarmasupeśalā || tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa kanyāmekāṃ sulakṣaṇām || 5 || mūlarkṣaprathamepāde tathā keṃdre bṛhaspatau || vavṛdhe sā gṛhe pitroḥ śukle pakṣe yathā śaśī || 6 || surūpā vinayācārā pitrośca priyakāriṇī || atīva nipuṇā jātā gṛhopaskaramārjane || 7 || yathāyathā samaidhiṣṭa sā kanyā pitṛmaṃdire || tathātathā pitustasyāściṃtā saṃvavṛdhetarām || 8 || kasmai deyā varā kanyā suramyeyaṃ sulakṣaṇā || asyā anuguṇo labhyaḥ kva mayā vara uttamaḥ || 9 || kulena vayasā cāpi śīlenāpi śrutena ca || rūpeṇārthenasaṃyuktaḥ kasmai dattā sukhaṃ labhet || 4.1.47.10 || iti ciṃtayatastasya jvarobhūdatidāruṇaḥ || yaściṃtākhyo jvaraḥ puṃsāmauṣadhairnāpi śāmyati || 11 || tanmūlarkṣavipākena ciṃtākhyena jvareṇa ca || sa vipraḥ paṃcatāṃ prāptastyaktvā sarvaṃ gṛhādikam || 12 || pitaryuparate tasyāḥ kanyāyāḥ sā jananyapi || śubhavratā parityajya tāṃ kanyāṃ patimanvagāt || 13 || dharmoyaṃ sahacāriṇyā jīvatājīvatāpi vā || patyā sahaiva sthātavyaṃ pativratayujā sadā || 14 || nāpatyaṃ pāti no mātā na pitā naiva bāṃdhavāḥ || patyuścaraṇaśuśrūṣā pāyādvai kevalaṃ striyam ||15|| sulakṣaṇāpi duḥkhārtā pitroḥ paṃcatvamāptayoḥ || aurdhvadaihikamāpādya daśāhaṃ vinivartya ca || || 16 || ciṃtāmavāpa mahatīmanāthā dainyamāgatā || kathamekākinī pitrā mātrāhīnā bhavāṃbudheḥ || 17 || dustaraṃ pāramāpsyāmi strītvaṃ sarvābhibhāvi yat || na kasmaicidvarāyāhaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ pratipāditā || 18 || tadadattā kathaṃ svairamahamanyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe || vṛtopi na kulīnaścedguṇavānna ca śīlavān || 19 || svādhīnopi na tattena vṛtenāpi hi kiṃ bhavet || iti saṃciṃtayaṃtī sā rūpaudāryaguṇānvitā || 4.1.47.20 || yuvabhirbahubhirnityaṃ prārthitāpi muhurmuhuḥ || na kasyāpi dadau bālā praveśaṃ nija mānase || 21 || pitroruparatiṃ dṛṣṭvā vātsalyaṃ ca tathāvidham || niniṃda bahudhātmānaṃ saṃsāraṃ ca niniṃda ha || 22 || yābhyāmutpāditā cāhaṃ yābhyāṃ ca paripālitā || pitarau kutra tau yātau dehino dhiganityatām || 23 || aho dehopyahoṃgatvaṃ yathā pitroḥ puro mama || iti niścitya sā bālā vijiteṃdriya mānasā || 24 || brahmacaryaṃ dṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā tapa ugraṃ cacāra ha || uttarārkasya devasya samīpe sthiramānasā ||25|| tasyāṃ tapasyamānāyāmekācchāgī laghīyasī || tatra pratyahamāgatya tiṣṭhettatpurato'calā ||26|| tṛṇaparṇādikaṃ kiṃcitsāyamabhyavahṛtya sā || tatkuṃḍapītapānīyā svasvāmisadanaṃ vrajet || 27 || tata itthaṃ vyatītāsu paṃcaṣā susamāsu ca || līlayā vicarandevastatra devyā sahāgataḥ || 28 || sannidhāvuttarārkasya tapasyatīṃ sulakṣaṇām || sthāṇuvanniścalāṃ sthāṇuradrākṣīttapasā kṛśām ||29|| tato girijayā śaṃbhurvijñaptaḥ karuṇātmanā || vareṇānugṛhāṇemāṃ baṃdhuhīnāṃ sumadhyamām || 4.1.47.30 || śarvāṇīgiramākarṇya tataḥ śarvaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ || samādhimīlitākṣīṃ tāmuvāca varado haraḥ || 31 || sulakṣaṇe prasannosmi varaṃ varaya suvrate || ciraṃ khinnāsi tapasā kaste'stīha manorathaḥ ||32|| sāpi śaṃbhorgiraṃ śrutvā mukhapīyūṣavarṣiṇīm || mahāsaṃtāpaśamanīṃ locane udamīlayat||33|| tryakṣaṃ pratyakṣamāvīkṣya varadānonmukhaṃ puraḥ || devīṃ ca vāmabhāgasthāṃ praṇanāma kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 34 || kiṃ vṛṇe yāvaditthaṃ sā ciṃtayeccārumadhyamā || tāvattayāniraikṣiṣṭa varākī barkarī puraḥ || 35 || ātmārthaṃ jīvalokesminko na jīvati mānavaḥ || paraṃ paropakārārthaṃ yo jīvati sa jīvati || 36 || anayā mattapovṛtti sākṣiṇyā bahvanehasam || asevyahaṃ tadetasyai varayāmi jagatpatim || 37 || parāmṛśya manasyetatprāha tryakṣaṃ sulakṣaṇā || kṛpānidhe mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama || || 38 || ajaśāvī varākyeṣā tarhi prāganugṛhyatām || vaktuṃ paśutvānnovetti kiṃcinmadbhaktipeśalā || 39 || iti vācaṃ niśamyeśaḥ paropakṛtiśālinīm|| sulakṣaṇāyā nitarāṃ tutoṣa praṇatārtihā || 4.1.47.40 || devadavastataḥ prāha devi paśya girīṃdraje || sādhūnāmīdṛśī buddhiḥ paropakaraṇorjitā || 41 || te dhanyāḥ sarvalokeṣu sarvadharmāśrayāśca te || yataṃte sarvabhāvena paropakaraṇāya ye ||42|| saṃcayāḥ sarvavastūnāṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhati no kvacit || suciraṃ tiṣṭhate caikaṃ paropakaraṇaṃ priye ||43|| dhanyā sulakṣaṇā caiṣā yogyā'nugrahakarmaṇi || brūhi devi varo deyaḥ ko'syaicchāgyai ca kaḥ priye || 44 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || sarvasṛṣṭikṛtāṃ kartaḥ sarvajñapraṇatārtihan || sulakṣaṇā śubhācārā sakhī mestu śubhodyamā || 45 || yathā jayā ca vijayā yathā caiva jayaṃtikā || śubhānaṃdā sunaṃdā ca kaumudī ca yathormilā || 46 || yathā caṃpakamālā ca yathā malayavāsinī || karpūralatikā yadvadgaṃdhadhārā yathā śubhā || 47 || aśokā ca viśokā ca yathā malayagaṃdhinī || yathā caṃdananiḥśvāsā yathā mṛgamadottamā || 48 || yathā ca kokilālāpā yathā madhurabhāṣiṇī || gadyapadyanidhiryadvadanuktajñā yathā ca sā || 49 || dṛgaṃcaleṃgitajñā ca yathā kṛtamanorathā || gānacittaharā yadvattathāstveṣā sulakṣaṇā || 4.1.47.50 || atipriyā bhavitrī me yadbāla brahmacāriṇī || anenaiva śarīreṇa divyāvayavabhūṣaṇā || || 51 || divyāṃbarā divyagaṃdhā divyajñānasamanvitā || samayā māṃ sadaivāstāṃ caṃcaccāmaradhāriṇī || 52 || eṣāpi kāśirājasya kumāryastviha barkarī || atraiva bhogānsaṃprāpya muktiṃ prāpsyatyanuttamām || 53 || anayā tvarkakuṃḍesminpuṣye māsi raverdine || snātaṃ tvanudite sūrye śītādakṣubdhacittayā || 54 || rājaputrī tataḥ puṇyādastveṣā śubhalocanā || varadānaprabhāveṇa tava viśveśvara prabho || 55 || barkarīkuṃḍamityākhyā tvarkakuṃḍasya jāyatām || etasyāḥ pratimā pūjyā bhaviṣyatyatra mānavaiḥ || 96 || uttarārkasya devasya puṣye māsi raverdine || kāryā sā vatsarīyātrā na taiḥ kāśīphalepsubhiḥ ||57|| mṛḍānyābhihi taṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvaitadviśvago vibhuḥ || viśvanātho viveśātha prāsādaṃ svamatarkitaḥ || 58 || || skaṃda uvāca || || lolārkasya ca māhātmyamuttarārkasya ca dvija || kathitaṃ te mahābhāga sāṃbādityaṃ niśāmaya || 59 || śrutvaitatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ śubhaṃ lolottarārkayoḥ || vyādhibhirnābhibhūyeta na dāridryeṇa bādhyate || 4.1.47.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe uttarārkavarṇanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
<4.1.48>
skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇuṣva maitrāvaruṇe dvāravatyāṃ yadūdvahaḥ || dānavānāṃ vadhārthāya bhuvobhārāpanuttaye || 1 || āvirāsītsvayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavartmapratāpavān || vāsudevo jagaddhāma devakyā vasudevataḥ||2|| sāśītilakṣaṃ tasyāsankumārā arkavarcasaḥ || svarge pitādṛśā bālāḥ suśīlā na hi kuṃbhaja || 3 || atīvarūpasaṃpannā atīva sumahābalāḥ || atīva śastraśāstrajñā atīva śubhalakṣaṇāḥ || 4 || tāṃdraṣṭuṃ mānasaḥ putro brahmaṇastapasāṃnidhiḥ || kṛtavalkalakaupīno dhṛta kṛṣṇājināṃbaraḥ ||||| gṛhītabrahmadaṃḍaśca trivṛnmauṃjī sumekhalaḥ || urasthalastha tulasī mālayā samalaṃkṛtaḥ || 6 || gopīcaṃdananiryāsa lasadaṃgavilepanaḥ || tapasā kṛśasarvāṃgo mūrto jvalanavajjvalan ||7|| ājagāmāṃbaracaro nārado dvārakāpurīm || viśvakarmavinirmāṇāṃ jitasvargapurīśriyam ||8|| taṃdṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ sarve vinamratarakaṃdharāḥ || prabaddha mūrdhāṃjalayaḥ praṇemurvṛṣṇinaṃdanāḥ || 9 || sāṃbaḥ svarūpasauṃdarya garvasarvasvamohitaḥ || na nanāma muniṃ tatra hasaṃstadrūpasaṃpadam || 4.1.48.10 || sāṃbasya tamabhiprāyaṃ vijñāya sa mahāmuniḥ || viveśa sumahāramyaṃ nāradaḥ kṛṣṇamaṃdiram || 11 || kṛṣṇotha dṛṣṭvā''gacchaṃtaṃ pratyudgamya ca nāradam || madhuparkeṇa saṃpūjya svāsane copaveśayat || 12 || kṛtvā kathā vicitrārthāstata ekāṃtavartinaḥ || kṛṣṇasya karṇe'kathayannāradaḥ sāṃbaceṣṭitam || 13 || avaśyaṃ kiṃcidatrā'sti yaśodānaṃdavardhana || prāyaśastanna ghaṭate'saṃbhāvyaṃ nātha vāstriyām || 14 || yūnāṃ tribhuvanasthānāṃ sāṃbo'tīva surūpavān || svabhāvacaṃcalākṣīṇāṃ cetovṛttiḥ sucaṃcalā || 15 || apekṣaṃte na mugdhākṣyaḥ kulaṃ śīlaṃ śrutaṃ dhanam || rūpameva samīkṣaṃte viṣameṣu vimohitāḥ ||16|| athavā viditaṃ no te vallavīnāṃ viceṣṭitam || vināṣṭaunāyikāḥ kṛṣṇa kāmayaṃte'balāhyamum || 43 || vāmabhruvāṃ svabhāvācca nāradasya ca vākyataḥ || vijñātā''khilavṛttāṃtastathyaṃ kṛṣṇopyamanyata || 18 || tāvaddhairyaṃcalākṣīṇāṃ tāvaccetovivekitā || yāvannārthī viviktastho vivikterthini nānyathā || 19|| itthaṃ vivecayaṃścitte kṛṣṇaḥ krodhanadīrayam || vivekasetunā''stabhya nāradaṃ prāhiṇotsudhīḥ ||4.1.48.20|| sāṃbasya vaikṛtaṃ kiṃcitkvacitkṛṣṇonavaikṣata|| gate devamunau tasminvīkṣamāṇopyaharniśam ||21|| kiyatyapi gate kāle punarapyāyayau muniḥ || madhye līlāvatīnāṃ ca jñātvā kṛṣṇamavasthitam || 22 || bahiḥ krīḍaṃtamāhūya sāṃbamityāha nāradaḥ || yāhi kṛṣṇāṃtikaṃ tūrṇaṃ kathayāgamanaṃ mama ||23 || sāṃbopi yāmi noyāmi kṣaṇamitthamaciṃtayat || kathaṃ rahaḥstha pitaraṃ yāmi straiṇasakhaṃprati || 24 || na yāmi ca kathaṃ vākyādasyāhaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ || jvaladaṃgārasaṃkāśa sphuratsarvāṃgatejasaḥ || 25|| praṇamatsukumāreṣu vrīḍitoyaṃ mayaikadā || idānīmapi no yāyāmasya vākyānmahāmuneḥ || 26 || atyāhitaṃ tadastīha tadāgodvayadarśanāt || pituḥ kopopi suślāghyo mayi no brāhmaṇasya tu || 27|| brahmakopāgninirdagdhāḥ prarohaṃti na jātucit || aparāgnivinirdagdhāro haṃte dāvadagdhavat || 28|| iti dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ sāṃbo'viśadaṃtaḥpuraṃpituḥ || madhye straiṇasabhaṃkṛṣṇaṃ yāvajjāṃbavatīsutaḥ || 29 || dūrātpraṇamya vijñaptiṃ sa cakāra saśaṃkitaḥ || tāvattamanvagacchacca nāradaḥ kāryasiddhaye || 4.1.48.30 || sasaṃbhramotha kṛṣṇopi dṛṣṭvā sāṃbaṃ ca nāradam || samuttasthau paridadhatpītakauśeyamaṃbaram || 31 || utthite devakīsūnau tāḥ sarvā api gopikāḥ || vilajjitāḥ samuttasdhurgṛhṇaṃtyaḥ svaṃsvamaṃbaram || 32 || mahārhaśayanīye taṃ haste dhṛtvā mahāmunim || samupāveśayatkṛṣṇaḥ sāṃbaśca krīḍituṃ yayau || 33 || tāsāṃ skhalitamālokya tiṣṭhaṃtīnāṃ puro muniḥ || kṛṣṇalīlādravībhūtavarāṃgānāṃ jagau harim || 34 || paśyapaśya mahābuddhe dṛṣṭvā jāṃbavatīsutam || imāḥ skhalitamāpannāstadrūpakṣubdhacetasaḥ || 35 || kṛṣṇopi sāṃbamāhūya sahasaivāśapatsutam || sarvā jāṃbavatītulyāḥ paśyaṃtamapi durvidheḥ || 36 || yasmāttvadrūpamālokya gopālyaḥ skhalitā imāḥ || tasmātkuṣṭhī bhava kṣipramakāṃḍāgamanena ca || 37 || vepamāno mahāvyādhibhayātsāṃbopi dāruṇāt || kṛṣṇaṃ prasādayāmāsa bahuśaḥ pāpaśāṃtaye|| 38 || kṛṣṇopyanena saṃjānansāṃbaṃ svasutamaurasam || abravītkuṣṭhamokṣāya vraja vaiśveśvarīṃ purīm || 39 || tatra bradhnaṃ samārādhya prakṛtiṃ svāmavāpsyasi || mahainasāṃ kṣayo yatra nāsti vārāṇasīṃ vinā || 4.1.48.40 || yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣādyatra svargāpagā ca sā || yeṣāṃ mahainasāṃ dṛṣṭā munibhirnaiva niṣkṛtiḥ || teṣāṃ viśuddhirastyeva prāpya vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 41 || na kevalaṃ hi pāpebhyo vārāṇasyāṃ vimucyate || prākṛtebhyopi pāpebhyo mucyate śaṃkarājñayā || 42 || purā purāriṇā sṛṣṭamavimuktaṃ vimuktaye || sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ kṛpayāṃte tanutyajām || 43 || tatrānaṃdavane śaṃbhostavaśāpa nirākṛtiḥ || sāṃba tattveritaṃ yāhi nānyathā śāpanirvṛtiḥ || 44 || tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samāpṛcchya karmanirmuktaceṣṭitaḥ || nāradaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ sanyayāvākāśavartmanā || 45 || sāṃbo vārāṇasīṃ prāpya samārādhyāṃśumālinam || kuṃḍaṃ tatpṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā nijāṃ prakṛtimāptavān ||46 || sāṃbādityastadārabhya sarvavyādhiharo raviḥ || dadāti sarvabhaktebhyo'nāmayāḥ sarvasaṃpadaḥ || 47 || sāṃbakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā ravivāre'ruṇodaye|| sāṃbādityaṃ ca saṃpūjya vyādhibhirnābhibhūyate || 48 || na strī vaidhavyamāpnoti sāṃbādityasya sevanāt || vaṃdhyā putraṃ prasūyeta śuddharūpasamanvitam || 49 || śuklāyāṃ dvija saptamyāṃ māghe māsi raverdine || mahāparva samākhyātaṃ raviparva samaṃ śubham || 4.1.48.50 || mahārogātpramucyeta tatra snātvāruṇodaye || sāṃbādityaṃ prapūjyāpi dharmamakṣayamāpnuyāt || 51 || sannihatyāṃ kurukṣetre yatpuṇyaṃ rāhudarśane || tatpuṇyaṃ ravisaptamyāṃ māghe kāśyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 52 || madhaumāsi ravervāre yātrā sāṃvatsarī bhavet || aśokaistatra saṃpūjya kuṃḍe snātvā vidhānataḥ || 53 || sāṃbādityaṃ naro jātu na śokairabhibhūyate || saṃvatsarakṛtātpāpādbahirbhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 54 || viśveśātpaścimāśāyāṃ sāṃbenātra mahātmanā || samyagārādhitā mūrtirādityasya śubhapradā || 55 || iyaṃ bhaviṣyā tanmūrtiragaste tvatpuro'kathi || tāmabhyarcya namaskṛtya kṛtvāṣṭau ca pradakṣiṇāḥ || naro bhavati niṣpāpaḥ kāśīvāsa phalaṃ labhet || 56 || sāṃbādityasya māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ te mahāmate || yacchrutvāpi naro jātu yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 57 || idānīṃ draupadādityaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tenagha || tathā draupadaādityaḥ saṃsevyo bhaktasiddhidaḥ || 58 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe pūrvārddhe sāṃbādityamāhātmyakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||48||
<4.1.49>
sūta uvāca || || pārāśaryamune vyāsa kumāraḥ kuṃbhajanmane || yadāvadatkathāmetāṃ tadā kva drupadātmajā || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || purāṇasaṃhitāṃ sūta brūte traikālikīṃ kathām || saṃdeho nātra kartavyo yatastadgocarokhilam ||2|| || skaṃda uvāca|| || ākarṇaya mune pūrvaṃ paṃcavaktro haraḥ svayam || pṛthivyāṃ paṃcadhā bhūtvā prādurāsījjagaddhitaḥ ||3|| umāpi ca jagaddhātrī drupadasya mahībhujaḥ || yajato vahnikuṃḍācca prāduścakreti suṃdarī || 4 || paṃcāpi pāṃḍutanayāḥ sākṣādrudravapurdharāḥ || avateruriha svargādduṣṭasaṃhārakārakāḥ || 5 || nārāyaṇopi kṛṣṇatvaṃ prāpya tatsāhacaryakṛt || udvṛttavṛttaśamanaḥ sadvṛttasthitikārakaḥ || || 6 || pratapaṃtaḥ pṛthivyāṃ te pārthāśceruḥ pṛthakpṛthak || udayānudayau tasminsaṃpadāṃ vipadāmapi || 7 || kadācitte mahāvīrā bhrātṛvyapratipāditām || vipattimāpya mahatīṃ babhūvuḥ kānanaukasaḥ || 8 || pāṃcālyapi ca tatpatnī pativyasanatāpitā || dharmajñā prāpya tanvaṃgī bradhnamārādhayadbhṛśam || 9 || ārādhitotha savitā tayā drupadakanyayā || sadarvī sapidhānāṃ ca sthālikāmakṣayāṃ dadau || 4.1.49.10 || uvāca ca prasannātmā bhāskaro drupadātmajām || 23|| ārādhayaṃtīṃ bhāvena sarvatra śucimānasām || 11 || sthālyaitayā mahābhāge yāvaṃto'nnārthino janāḥ || tāvaṃtastṛptimāpsyaṃti yāvacca tvaṃ na bhokṣyase || 12 || bhuktāyāṃ tvayi riktaiṣā pūrṇabhaktā bhavipyati || rasavadvyaṃjananidhiricchābhakṣyapradāyinī || 13 || itthaṃ varastayā labdhaḥ kāśyāmādityato mune || aparaśca varo dattastasyai devena bhāsvatā || 14 || || raviruvāca || || viśveśāddakṣiṇebhāge yo māṃ tvatpurataḥ sthitam || ārādhayiṣyati naraḥ kṣudbādhā tasya naśyati || 15 || anyaśca me varo datto viśveśena pativrate || tapasā parituṣṭena taṃ niśāmaya vacmi te || 16 || prāgrave tvāṃ samārādhya yo māṃ drakṣyati mānavaḥ || tasya tvaṃ duḥkhatimiramapānuda nijaiḥ karaiḥ || 17 || ato dharmāpriye nityaṃ prāpya viśveśvarādvaram || kāśīsthitānāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ nāśayāmyaghasaṃcayam || 18 || ye māmatra bhajiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ || tvadvarodyatapāṇiṃ ca teṣāṃ dāsyāmi ciṃtitam || 19 || bhavatīṃ matsamīpasthāṃ yudhiṣṭhirapativratām || viśveśāddakṣiṇebhāge daṃḍapāṇeḥ samīpataḥ || 4.1.49.20 || yercayiṣyaṃti bhāvena puruṣā vāstriyopi vā || teṣāṃ kadācinno bhāvi bhayaṃ priyaviyogajam || 21 || na vyādhijaṃ bhayaṃ kvāpi na kṣuttṛḍdoṣasaṃbhavam || draupadīkṣaṇataḥ kāśyāṃ tava dharmapriyenaghe || 22 || iti dattvā varāndeva ādityaḥ sarvadaḥ satām || śaṃbhumārādhayāmāsa dharmaṃ draupadyupāyayau || 23 || ādityasya kathāmetāṃ draupadyārādhitasya vai || yaḥ śroṣyati naro bhaktyā tasyainaḥ kṣayameṣyati || 24 || skaṃda uva|ca || || draupadādityamāhātmyaṃ saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ mayā || mayūkhādityamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇvidānīṃ ghaṭodbhava || 25 || purā paṃcanade tīrthe triṣulokeṣu viśrute || sahasraraśmirbhagavāṃstapastepe sudāruṇam || 26 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ gabhastīśvara saṃjñitam || gaurīṃ ca maṃgalā nāmnīṃ bhaktamaṃgaladāṃ sadā || 27 || divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu śatena guṇitaṃ mune || ārādhayañśivaṃ somaṃ somārdhakṛtaśekharam || 28 || svarūpatastu tapanastrilokītāpanakṣamaḥ || tatotitīvra tapasā jajvāla nitarāṃ mune || 29 || mayūkhaistatra savitustrailokyadahanakṣamaiḥ || tataṃ samastaṃ tatkāle dyāvābhūmyoryadaṃtaram || 4.1.49.30 || vaimānikairviṣṇupade tatyaje ca gatāgatam || tīvre pataṃgamahasi pataṃgatvabhayādiva || 31 || mayūkhā eva dṛśyaṃte tiryagūrdhvamadhopi ca|| ādityasya na cādityo nīpapuṣpasthiteriva|| 32|| tasyavai mahasāṃ rāśestaporāśestaporciṣām|| cakaṃpe sādhvasāttīvrā trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 33 || sūrya ātmāsya jagato vedeṣu paripaṭhyate || sa eva cejvālayitā ko nastrātā bhavediha || 34 || jagaccakṣurasau sūryo jagadātmaiṣa bhāskaraḥ || jagadyoyanmṛtaprāyaṃ prātaḥprātaḥ prabodhayet || 35 || tamoṃdhakūpapatitamudyanneṣa dinedine || prasārya paritaḥ pāṇīnprāṇijātaṃ samuddharet || 36 || udite'trodimo nityamastaṃ yātyastamāpnumaḥ || udaye'nudaye tasmādasmākaṃ kāraṇaṃ raviḥ || 37 || iti vyākulitaṃ viśvaṃ paśyanviśveśvaraḥ svayam || viśvatrātā varaṃ dātuṃ saṃjagme tigmaraśmaye || 38 || mayūkhamālinaṃ śaṃbhurālokyāti suniścalam || samādhi vismṛtātmānaṃ visismāya tapaḥ prati || 39 || uvāca ca prasannātmā śrīkaṃṭhaḥ praṇatārtihṛt || alaṃ taptvā varaṃ brūhi dyumaṇe mahasāṃ nidhe || 4.1.49.40 || niruddheṃdriyavṛttitvādbradhno dhyānasamādhinā || na jagrāha vacaḥ śaṃbhordvitriruktopyakarṇavat || 41 || kāṣṭhībhūtaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā śivaḥ pasparśa pāṇinā || mahātapaḥ samudbhūta saṃtāpāmṛtavarṣiṇā || 42 || tata unmīlayāṃcakre locane viśvalocanaḥ || tasyodayamiva prāpya prage paṃkajinīvanī ||43|| parivyapetasaṃtāpastapanaḥ sparśanādvibhoḥ || avagrahitasasyaśrīrullalāsa yathāṃbudāt || 44 || mitro netrātithīkṛtya tryakṣaṃ pratyakṣamagrataḥ || daṃḍavatpraṇanāmoccaistuṣṭāva ca pinākinam || 45 || || raviruvāca || || devadeva jagatāṃpate vibho bharga bhīma bhava caṃdrabhūṣaṇa || bhūtanātha bhavabhītihāraka tvāṃ natosmi natavāṃchitaprada || 46|| caṃdracūḍamṛḍa dhūrjaṭe hara tryakṣa dakṣa śatataṃtuśātana|| śāṃtaśāśvata śivāpate śiva tvāṃ natosmi natavāṃchitaprada || 47 || nīlalohita samīhitārtha dahe(?)dvyekalocana virūpalocana || vyomakeśapaśupāśanāśana tvāṃ natosmi natavāṃchitaprada || 48 || vāmadevaśitikaṃṭhaśūlabhṛccaṃdraśekhara phaṇīṃdrabhūṣaṇa|| kāmakṛtpaśupate maheśvara tvāṃ natosmi natavāṃchitaprada||49|| tryaṃbaka tripurasūdaneśvara trāṇakṛttrinayanatrayīmaya|| kālakūṭa dalanāṃtakāṃtaka tvāṃ natosmi natavāṃchitaprada || 4.1.49.50 || śarvarīrahitaśarvasarvagasvargamārgasukhadāpavargada || aṃdhakāsuraripo kapardabhṛttvāṃ natosmi natavāṃchitaprada ||51|| śaṃkarogragirijāpate pate viśvanāthavidhiviṣṇu saṃstuta || vedavedyaviditā'khileṃgi tatvāṃ natosmi natavāṃchitaprada ||52|| viśvarūpapararūpa varjitabrahmajihmarahitāmṛtaprada || vāṅamanoviṣayadūradūragatvāṃ natosmi natavāṃchitaprada || 53 || itthaṃ parītya mārtaṃḍo mṛḍaṃ devaṃ mṛḍānikām || atha tuṣṭāva prītātmā śivavāmārdhahāriṇīm|| 54 || raviruvāca || || devi tvadīyacaraṇāṃbujareṇugaurīṃ bhālasthalīṃ vahati yaḥ praṇatipravīṇaḥ || janmāṃtarepi rajanīkaracārulekhā tāṃ gaurayatyatitarāṃ kila tasya puṃsaḥ || 55 || śrīmaṃgale sakalamaṃgalajanmabhūme śrīmaṃgale sakalakalmaṣatūlavahne|| śrīmaṃgale sakaladānavadarpahaṃtri śrīmaṃgale'khilamidaṃ paripāhi viśvam||56|| viśveśvari tvamasi viśvajanasya kartrī tvaṃ pālayitryasi tathā pralayepihaṃtrī || tvannāmakīrtanasamullasadacchapuṇyā srotasvinī harati pātakakūlavṛkṣān ||57|| mātarbhavāni bhavatī bhavatīvraduḥkhasaṃbhārahāriṇi śaraṇyamihāsti nānyā || dhanyāsta eva bhuvaneṣu ta eva mānyā yeṣu sphurettavaśubhaḥ karuṇākaṭākṣaḥ || 58 || ye tvā smaraṃti satataṃ sahajaprakāśāṃ kāśīpurīsthitimatīṃ natamokṣalakṣmīm || tānsaṃsmaretsmaraharo dhṛtaśuddhabuddhīnnirvāṇarakṣaṇavicakṣaṇapātrabhūtān ||59|| mātastavāṃghriyugalaṃ vimalaṃ hṛdisthaṃ yasyāsti tasya bhuvanaṃ sakalaṃ karastham || yo nāmateja eti maṃgalagauri nityaṃ siddhyaṣṭakaṃ na parimuṃcati tasya geham || 4.1.49.60 || tvaṃ devi vedajananī praṇavasvarūpā gāyatryasi tvamasi vai dvijakāmadhenuḥ || tvaṃ vyāhṛtitrayamihā'khilakarmasiddhyai svāhāsvadhāsi sumanaḥ pitṛtṛptihetuḥ || 61 || gauri tvameva śaśimaulini vedhasi tvaṃ sāvitryasi tvamasi cakriṇi cārulakṣmīḥ || kāśyāṃ tvamasyamalarūpiṇi mokṣalakṣmīstvaṃ me śaraṇyamiha maṃgalagauri mātaḥ || 62 || stutveti tāṃ smaraharārdhaśarīraśobhāṃ śrīmaṃgalāṣṭaka mahāstavanena bhānuḥ || devīṃ ca devamasakṛtparitaḥ praṇamya tūṣṇīṃ babhūva savitā śivayoḥ purastāt || 63 || || devadeva uvāca || || uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te prasannosmi mahāmate || mitramannetrago nityaṃ prapaśye taccarācaram || 64 || mama mūrtirbhavānsūrya sarvajño bhava sarvagaḥ || sarveṣāṃ mahasāṃ rāśiḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvakarmavit || 65 || sarveṣāṃ sarvaduḥkhāni bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ nirākuru || tvayā nāmnāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā yadaṣṭakamudīritam || 66 || anena māṃ pariṣṭutya naro madbhaktimāpsyati || aṣṭakaṃ maṃgalāgauryā maṃgalāṣṭakasaṃjñakam || 67 || anena maṃgalāgaurīṃ stutvā maṃgalamāpsyati || catuḥṣaṣṭyaṣṭakaṃ stotraṃ maṃgalāṣṭakameva ca || 68 || etatstotravaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || dūradeśāṃtarasthopi japannityaṃ narottamaḥ ||69|| trisaṃdhyaṃ pariśuddhātmā kāśīṃ prāpsyati durlabhām || anena stotrayugmena japtena pratyahaṃ nṛbhiḥ ||4.1.49.70|| dhruvadainaṃdinaṃ pāpaṃ kṣālitaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || na tasya dehino dehe jātu citkilbiṣasthitiḥ ||71|| trikālaṃ yojayennityametatstotradvayaṃśubham || kiṃjaptairbahubhiḥ stotraiścaṃcalaśrīpradairnṛṇām || 72 || etatstotradvayaṃ dadyātkāśyāṃ naiḥśreyasīṃ śriyam || tasmātsarvaprayatnena mānavairmokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 73 || etatstotradvayaṃ japyaṃ tyaktvā stotrāṇyanekaśaḥ || prapaṃca āvayoreva sarva eṣa carācaraḥ || 74 || tadāvayoḥstavādasmānniṣprapaṃco jano bhavet || samṛddhimāpya mahatīṃ putrapautravatīmiha || 75 || aṃte nirvāṇamāpnoti japanstotramidaṃ naraḥ || anyacca śṛṇu saptāśva graharāja divākara || || 76 || tvayā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ gabhastīśvarasaṃjñitam || sevitaṃ bhaktibhāvena sarvasiddhisamarpakam || 77|| tvayā gabhastimālābhiścāṃpeyāṃbujakāṃtibhiḥ || yadarcitvaiśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sarvabhāvena bhāskara || 78 || gabhastīśvara ityākhyāṃ tato liṃgamavāpsyati || arcayitvā gabhastīśaṃ snātvā paṃcanade naraḥ || 79 || na jātu jāyate māturjaṭhare dhūtakalmaṣaḥ || imāṃ ca maṃgalāgaurīṃ nārī vā puruṣopi vā || 4.1.49.80 || caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāmupoṣaṇaparāyaṇaḥ || mahopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya dukūlābharaṇādibhiḥ || 81 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gītanṛtyakathādibhiḥ || prātaḥ kumārīḥ saṃpūjya dvādaśācchādanādibhiḥ || 82 || saṃbhojyaparamānnādyairdattvānyebhyopi dakṣiṇām || homaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena jātavedasa ityṛcā || 83 || aṣṭottaraśatābhiśca tilājyāhutibhiḥ prage || ekaṃ gomithunaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine ||84 || śraddhayā samalaṃkṛtya bhūṣaṇairdvijadaṃpatī || bhojayitvā mahārhānnaiḥ prīyetāṃ maṃgaleśvarau || 85 || iti maṃtraṃ samuccārya prātaḥ kṛtvātha pāraṇam || na durbhagatvamāpnoti na dāridryaṃ kadācana || 86 || na vai saṃtānavicchittiṃ bhogocchittiṃ na jātucit || strī vaidhavyaṃ na cāpnoti na nāyoṣidviyogabhāk || 87 || pāpāni vilayaṃ yāṃti puṇyarāśiśca labhyate || api vaṃdhyā prasūyeta kṛtvaitanmaṃgalāvratam || 88 || etadvratasya karaṇātkurūpatvaṃ na jātucit || kumārī viṃdatetyaṃtaṃ guṇarūpayutaṃ patim ||89|| kumāropi vrataṃ kṛtvā viṃdati striyamuttamām || saṃti vratāni bahuśo dhanakāmapradāni ca ||4.1.49.90|| nāpnuyurjātucittāni maṃgalāvratatulyatām || kartavyā cābdikī yātrā madhau tasyāṃ tithau naraiḥ || 91 || sarvavighnapraśāṃtyarthaṃ sadā kāśīnivāsibhiḥ || aparaṃ dyumaṇe vacmi tava cātra tapasyataḥ || 92 || mayūkhā eva khe dṛṣṭā na ca dṛṣṭaṃ kalevaram || mayūkhāditya ityākhyā tataste ditinaṃdana || 93 || tvadarcanānnṛṇāṃ kaścinna vyādhiḥ prabhaviṣyati || bhaviṣyati na dāridryaṃ ravivāre tvadīkṣaṇāt || 94 | | itthaṃ mayūkhādityasya śivo dattvā bahūnvarān || tatraivāṃtarhito bhūto ravistatraiva tasthivān || 95 || śrutvākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ mayūkhādityasaṃśrayam || draupadādityasahitaṃ naro na nirayaṃ vrajet ||96|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṇḍe pūrvārddhe draupadādityamayūkhādityayorvarṇanaṃ nāmaikonapaṃcāśattamodhyāyaḥ || 49 || ||
<4.1.50>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || vārāṇasyāṃ tathādityā ye cānye tānvadāmyataḥ || kalaśodbhava te prītyā sarve sarvāghanāśanāḥ || 1 || khakholko nāma bhagavānāditya parikīrtitaḥ || triviṣṭapottare bhāge sarvavyādhivighātakṛt || 2 || yathā khakholka ityākhyā tasyādityasya tacchṛṇu || purā kadrūśca vinatā dakṣasya tanaye śubhe || ||3|| kaśyapasya ca te patnyau mārīceḥ prākprajāpateḥ || krīḍaṃtyāvekadānyonyaṃ mune te ūcatustviti || 4 || || kadrūruvāca || || vinate tvaṃ vijānāsi yadi tadbrūhi megrataḥ|| akhaṃḍitā gatistesti yato gaganamaṃḍale || 5 || yosāvuccaiḥśravā vājī śrūyate savitūrathe || kiṃ rūpaḥsosti śabalo dhavalo vā vadāśu me || 6 || paṇaṃ ca kuru kalyāṇi tubhyaṃ yo rocatenaghe || evameva na yātyeṣa kālakrīḍanakaṃ vinā ||7|| || vinatovāca || || kiṃ paṇena bhaginyatra kathayāmyevameva hi || tvajjaye kā ca me prītirmajjaye kiṃ nu te sukham || 8 || jñātvā paṇo na kartavyo mithaḥ snehamabhīpsatā || dhruvamekasya vijaye krodhonsyeha jāyate ||9|| kadrūruvāca || krīḍeyaṃ nātra bhagini kāraṇaṃ kimapi krudhaḥ || khelasya vyavahāroyaṃ paṇe yatkiṃciducyate || 4.1.50.10 || || vinatovāca || || tathā kuru yathā prītistavāsti pavanāśini || atha tāṃ vinatāmāha kadrūḥ kuṭilamānasā || 11 || tasyāstu sā bhaveddāsī parājīyeta yā yayā || asminpaṇe imāḥ sarvāḥ sakhyaḥ sākṣiṇya eva nau || 12 || ityanyonyaṃ paṇīkṛtya sarpiṇyapi patattriṇī || uvāca karburaṃ kadrūraśvaṃ śvetaṃ garutmatī || 13 || kadāgaṃtavyamiti ca cakrāte te gamāvadhim || jagmatuśca viramyātha krīḍanātsvasvamālayam || 14 || vinatāyāṃ gatāyāṃ tu kadrūrāhūya cāṃgajān || uvāca yāta vai putrā drutaṃ vacanato mama || 15|| turaṃgamuccaiḥśravasaṃ prodbhūtaṃ kṣīranīradheḥ || surāsurairmathyamānānmaṃdarāghātasādhvasāt || 16 || kāryakāraṇarūpasya sādṛśyamadhigacchati || atastaṃ kṣīravarṇābhaṃ kalmāṣayata putrakāḥ || 17 || tasya vāladhimadhyāsya kṛṣṇakuṃtalatāṃ gatāḥ || tathā tadaṃgalomāni vidhattaviṣasītkṛtaiḥ || 18 || iti śrutvā vaco mātuḥ kādraveyāḥ parasparam || saṃmaṃtrya mātaraṃ procuḥ kadrūṃ kadrūpamāgatāḥ || 19 || || nāgā ūcuḥ || || mātarvayaṃ tvadāhvānādvihāya krīḍanaṃ balāt || prāptāḥ prahṛṣṭā mṛṣṭānnaṃ dāsyatyadya prasūriti || 4.1.50.20 || mṛṣṭaṃ tiṣṭhatu taddūraṃ viṣādapyadhikaṃ kaṭu || tattvayā vādiyanmaṃtrairauṣadhairnopaśāmyati || 21 || vayaṃ na yāmo yadbhāvyaṃ tadasmākaṃ bhavatviha || iti proktaṃ viṣāsyaistaistadā kuṭilagāmibhiḥ || 22 || || skaṃda uvāca || || anyepi ye kuṭilagāḥ pararaṃdhraniṣeviṇaḥ || akarṇāḥ kūrahṛdayāḥ pitarau vrīḍayaṃti te || 23 || pitrorgiraṃ nirākṛtya ye tiṣṭheyuḥ sudurmadāḥ || atyāhitamiha prāpya gaccheyuste'cirāllayam || 24 || teṣāṃ vacanamākarṇya nayāma iti soragī || śaśāpa tānkrudhāviṣṭā nāgāṃścāgaḥ samāgatān || 25 || tārkṣyasya bhakṣyā bhavata yūyaṃ madvākyalaṃghanāt || jātamātrāśca sarpiṇyo bhakṣayaṃtu svabālakān || 26 || iti śāpānalādbhītaiḥ kaiścitpātālamāśritam || jijīviṣubhiranyaiśca dvitraiścakre prasūvacaḥ || 27 || te pucchamauccaiḥśravasamadhigamya mahādhiyaḥ || sunīlacikurābhāsaṃ cakruraṃgaṃ ca karburam || 28 || tatkṣveḍānala dhūmaughaiḥ phūtkārabharaniḥsṛtaiḥ|| mātṛvākkṛtijāddharmānna dagdhā bhānubhānubhiḥ || 29 || vinatāpṛṣṭhamāruhya kadrūḥ snehavaśāttataḥ || viyanmārgamalaṃkṛtya dadarśoṣṇāṃśumaṃḍalam || 4.1.50.30 || tigmaraśmiprabhāveṇa vyākulībhūtamānasā || kadrustataḥ khagīṃ prāha visrabdhaṃ vinate vraja || 31 || uṣṇagoruṣṇagobhirme tāpyate nitarāṃ tanuḥ || visrabdhāhaṃ svabhāvena tvaṃ sāpekṣāhi sarvataḥ || || 32 || svarūpeṇa pataṃgī tvaṃ pataṃgosau sahasraguḥ || ataeva na te bādhā gagane tāpasaṃbhavā || 33 || viyatsarasi haṃsoyaṃ bhavatī haṃsagāminī || caṃḍaraśmipratāpāgnistvāmato neha bādhate || 34 || khagīmudgīyamānāṃ khe punarūce bileśayā || trāhitrāhi bhaginyatra yāvonyatra viyatpathaḥ || 35 || vinate vinatāṃ māṃ tvaṃ kiṃ nāvasi patattriṇī || tava dāsī bhaviṣyāmi tvaducchiṣṭaniṣeviṇī ||36 || yāvajjīvamahaṃ bhūyāṃ tvatpādodakapāyinī || khakholkāni patedeṣā bhṛśagadgadabhāṣiṇī |||| 37 || mūrcchāṃ gatavatī pakṣapuṭau dhṛtvā biḍoragī|| sakhyulkāni patedeṣā vaktavye tviti saṃbhramāt || 38 || khakholketi yaduktā gīḥ kadrvā saṃbhrātacetasā || tadā khakholkanāmārkaḥ stuto vinatayā bahu || 39 || manāgatigmatāṃ prāpte khe prayāti vivasvati || tābhyāṃ turaṃgamo darśi kiṃcitkirmīravānrathe || 4.1.50.40 || uktā vinatayaivaiṣā tāpopahatalocanā || krūrā sarīsṛpī satyavādinyā viśvamānyayā || 41 || kadru tvayā jitaṃ bhadre yata uccaiḥśravā hayaḥ || caṃdraraśmiprabhopyeṣa kalmāṣa iva bhāsate || 42 || vidhirbalīyānbhujagi citraṃ jayaparājaye || krūropi vijayī kvāpi tvakrūropi parājayī || 43 || vinatāvinatādhārā vadaṃtīti yathāgatam || kadrūniveśanaṃ prāptā tasyā dāsyamacīkarat ||44|| kadācidvinatādarśi suparṇanāśrulocanā || vicchāyā malinā dīnā dīrghaniḥśvāsavatyapi || || 45 || suparṇa uvāca || || prātaḥprātaraho mātaḥ kva yāsi tvaṃ dinedine || sāyamāyāsi ca kuto vicchāyā dīnamānasā || 46 || kuto niḥśvasisi proccairaśrupūrṇa vilocanā || yathā klībasutā yoṣidyathāpati tiraskṛtā ||47|| brūhi mātarjhaṭityadya kuto dūnāsi pattriṇi || mayi jīvati te bāle kālepi kṛtasādhvase|| || 48 || aśrunirmāṇakaraṇe kāraṇaṃ kiṃ tapasvini || sucaritrā sunārīṣu nāmaṃgalamiheṣyate || 49 || dhiktāṃśca putrānyanmātā teṣu jīvatsu duḥkhabhāk || varaṃ vaṃdhyaiva sā yasyāḥ sutā vaṃdhyamanorathāḥ ||4.1.50.50 || ityūrjasvalamākarṇya vacaḥ sūnorgarutmataḥ || vinatā prāha taṃ putraṃ mātṛbhaktisamanvitam || 51 || ahaṃ dāsyasmi re bāla kadrvāśca krūracetasaḥ || pṛṣṭhe vahāmi tāṃ nityaṃ tatputrānapi putraka||52|| kadācinmaṃdaraṃ yāmi kadācinmalayācalam || kadācidaṃtarīpeṣu careyaṃ tadudanvatām || || 53 || yatrayatra nayeyuste kādraveyāḥ sudurmadāḥ || vrajeyaṃ tatratatrāhaṃ tadadhīnā yataḥ suta || 54|| garuḍa uvāca || || dāsītvakāraṇaṃ mātaḥ kiṃ te jātaṃ sulakṣaṇe || dakṣaprajāpateḥ putri kaśyapasyapriye'naghe || 55 || vinatovāca garuḍaṃ purāvṛttamaśeṣataḥ || dāsītvakāraṇaṃ yadvadādityāśvavilokanam || 56 || śrutveti garuḍaḥ prāha mātaraṃ satvaraṃ vraja|| pṛcchādya mātastānduṣṭānkādraveyānidaṃ vacaḥ ||57|| yaddurlabhaṃ hi bhavatāṃ yatrātyaṃtaruciśca vaḥ || maddāsītvavimokṣāya tadyācadhvaṃ dadāmyaham|| || 58 || tathākarocca vinatā tepi śrutvā tadīritam || sarpāḥ saṃmaṃtrya tāṃ procurvinatāṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || 59 || mātṛśāpavimokṣāya yadi dāsyati naḥ sudhām || tadā samīhitaṃ testu na dāsyatyatha dāsyasi || 4.1.50.60 || ityoṃkṛtya samāpṛcchya kadrūṃ drutagatiḥ khagī || garutmaṃtaṃ samācaṣṭa dṛṣṭvā saṃhṛṣṭamānasam || 61 || nāgāṃtakastataḥ prāha mātaraṃ ciṃtayāturām || ānītaṃ viddhi pīyūṣaṃ mātarme dehi bhojanam|| 62 || vinatā prāha taṃ putraṃ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhā || bhoḥ suparṇārṇavaṃ tūrṇaṃ yāhi maṃgalamastu te || 63 || saṃti tatrāpi bahuśo niṣādā matsyaghātinaḥ || velātaṭanivāsāśca tānbhakṣaya durātmanaḥ || 64 || paraprāṇairnijaprāṇānye puṣṇaṃtīha durdhiyaḥ || śāsanīyāḥ prayatnena śreyastacchāsanaṃ param || 65 || bahuhiṃsākṛtāṃ hiṃsā bhavetsvargasya sādhanam || vihiṃsiteṣu duṣṭeṣu rakṣyate bhūriśo yataḥ ||66|| niṣādeṣvapi cedvipraḥ kaścidbhavati putraka || saṃrakṣaṇīyo yatnena bhakṣaṇīyo na karhicit || 67 || || garuḍa uvāca || || matsyādināṃ vasanmadhye kathaṃ jñeyo dvijo mayā || abhakṣyo yastvayā proktastaccihnaṃ kiṃ canāttha me || 68 || || vinatovāca || yajñasūtraṃ gale yasya sottarīyaṃ sunirmalam || nityadhautāni vāsāṃsi bhālaṃ tilaka lāṃchitam ||69|| sapavitrau karau yasya yannīvī kuśagarbhiṇī|| yanmauliḥ saśikhāgraṃthiḥ sa jñeyo brāhmaṇastvayā || 4.1.50.70 || uccaredṛgyajuḥsāmnāmṛcamekāmapīha yaḥ || gāyatrīmātramaṃtropi sa vijñeyo dvijastvayā || 71 || garuḍa uvāca || madhye sadā niṣādānāṃ yo vasejjanani dvijaḥ || tasyaiteṣvekamapyeva na manye lakṣmabodhakam || 72 || lakṣmāṃtaraṃ samācakṣva dvijabodhakaraṃ prasūḥ || yena vijñāya taṃ vipraṃ tyajeyamapi kaṃṭhagam || 73 || tacchrutvā vinatā prāha yaste kaṃṭhagatoṃ'gaja || khadirāṃgāravaddahyāttamapākuru dūrataḥ || 74 || dvijamātrepi yā hiṃsā sā hiṃsā kuśalāya na || deśaṃ vaṃśaṃ śriyaṃ svaṃ ca nirmūlayati kālataḥ || 75 || niśamya kāśyapiritiprasūpādaupraṇamya ca || gṛhītāśīryayau śīghraṃ khamārgeṇa khageśvaraḥ ||76|| dūrādālokayāṃcakre niṣādānmatsyajīvinaḥ || pakṣau vidhūya pakṣīṃdro rajasāpūrya rodasī || 77 || aṃdhīkṛtya diśobhāgānabdhirodhasyupāviśat || vyādāya vadanaṃ ghoraṃ mahākaṃdarasannibham || 78 || kāṃdiśīkā niṣādāstu viviśustatra ca svayam || manvāneṣvatha paṃthānaṃ teṣu kaṃṭhaṃ viśatsvapi ||79 || jajvāleṃgalasaṃsparśo dvijastatkaṃṭhakaṃdalīm || prākpraviṣṭānatho tārkṣyo niṣādānaudarīṃ darīm || 4.1.50.80 || praveśya kaṃṭhatālusthaṃ taṃ vijñāya dvijasphuṭam || bhayādudagirattūrṇaṃ mātṛvākyena yaṃtritaḥ || 81 || tamudgīrṇaṃ naraṃ dṛṣṭvā pakṣirāṭsamabhāṣata || kastvaṃ jātyāsi nigada mama kaṃṭhavidāhakṛt || 82 || sa tadāheti viprohaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ sangaruḍāgrataḥ || vasāmyeṣu niṣādeṣu jātimātropajīvakaḥ || 83 || taṃ preṣya garuḍo dūraṃ bhakṣayitvātha bhūriśaḥ || nabho vikṣobhayāṃcakre pralayānila sannibhaḥ || 84 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tigmatejaskaṃ jvālātatadigaṃtaram || jvaladdāvānalaṃ śailamiva bibhyurdivaukasaḥ || || 85 || te sannahyaṃta yuddhāya sajjīkṛta balāyudhāḥ || adhyāsya vāhanānyāśu sarve varmabhṛtaḥ surāḥ || 86 || tiryaggatīravirnāyaṃ nāyamagniḥ sadhūmavān || kṣaṇaprabhāpyasau naiva ko naḥ sammukha etyasau || 87 || na daityeṣu prabhedṛksyānnākṛtirdānaveṣviyam|| mahāsādhvasadaḥ koyamasmākaṃ hṛtprakaṃpanaḥ || 88 || yāvatsaṃbhāvayaṃtīti nītijñā api nirjarāḥ || tāvaddudhāva svau pakṣau pakṣirājo mahābalaḥ || 89 || nipetuḥ pakṣavātena sāyudhāśca savāhanāḥ || na jñāyaṃte kva saṃprāptā vātyayā pārṇatārṇavat || 4.1.50.90 || atha teṣu praṇaṣṭeṣu buddhyā vijñāya pakṣirāṭ || kośāgāraṃ sudhāyāḥ sa tatrāpaśyacca rakṣiṇaḥ || 91 || śastrāstrodyatapāṇīṃstānsurānādhūya sarvaśaḥ || dadarśa kartarīyaṃtramamṛtoparisaṃsthitam || 92 || manaḥpavanavegena bhramamāṇaṃ mahārayam || apispṛśaṃtaṃ maśakaṃ yatkhaṃḍayati koṭiśaḥ || 93 || upopaviśya pakṣīṃdrastasya yaṃtrasya nirbhayaḥ || kṣaṇaṃ vicārayāmāsa kimatra karavāṇyaho || 94 || spraṣṭuṃ na labhyate caitadvātyā na prabhavediha || ka upāyotra kartavyo vṛthā jāto mamodyamaḥ || 95 || na balaṃ prabhavedatra na kiṃcidapi pauruṣam || aho prayatno devānāmetatpīyūṣarakṣaṇe ||96|| yadi me śaṃkare bhaktirnirdvaṃdvātīva niścalā || tadā sa devadevo māṃ viyunaktu mahā'dhiyā ||97|| yadyahaṃ mātṛbhaktosmi svāminaḥ śaṃkarādapi || tadā me buddhiratrāstu pīyūṣaharaṇaṃ kṣamā || 98 || ātmārthaṃ nodyamaścāyaṃ hṛtstho vettīti viśvagaḥ || māturdāsyavimokṣāya yatehamamṛtaṃ prati || 99 || jaritau pitarau yasya bālāpatyaśca yaḥ pumān || sādhvī bhāryā ca tatpuṣṭyai doṣo'kṛtyepi tasya na || 4.1.50.100 || iti ciṃtayatastasya buddhirāsīnmahātmanaḥ || 101 || dehaṃ cakāra sotyaṃtamaṇīyāṃsamaṇorapi || paramāṇusahasrāṃśaṃ kṛtvā rūpaṃ mahādbhutam || 102 || praviśya kartarīyaṃtramadhodehasya lāghavāt || bibhyattadyaṃtrato dehaṃ vaṃcayanvāyukhaṃḍanāt || mūlamutpāṭya tarasā gṛhītvā'mṛtabhājanam || 103 || niryayau pāvane mārge krośatsu svargasadmasu || 104 || tathā vaikuṃṭhanāthaṃ te gatvā procuḥ sudhābhujaḥ || nirjitya nīyate cakrinsudhā no jīvitaṃ param || 105 || ityākarṇya haristebhyo'bhayaṃ dattvā tvarāyutaḥ || kṛtvā yuddhaṃ ca sumahadviṃśārkaghaṭikādvayam || || 106 || śuṃbhadevyoryathāsūta garuḍastatra cādhikaḥ || tadā prasanno bhagavānmahāyuddhena sarvadaḥ || 107 || gatvā garuḍamāhedaṃ prasannosmi khageśvara || varaṃ vṛṇīhi bhadraṃ te jitavṛṃdāravṛṃdaka|| 108 || hasitvā garuḍaḥ prāha viśvarūpaṃ janārdanam || ahameva prasannosmi tvaṃ prārthaya varadvayam || 109 || tataḥ kaiṭabhajitprāha vainateyaṃ mudānvitaḥ || vṛtaṃvṛtaṃ mahodāra dehidehi varadvayam || 4.1.50.110 || iti viṣṇūditaṃ śrutvā prahasannāha pakṣirāṭ || kiṃ vilaṃbena tadbrūhi dattaṃ dattaṃ varadvayam || 111 || alabdhalābhe saṃjāte dyūtādi vijayodaye || dātavyaṃ sudhiyāpātre sadā lābhajayau kva vā || 112 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || balavānasi pakṣīṃdra tanme vāhanatāṃ vraja || eko varoyaṃ varada dvitīyaṃ śṛṇu kāśyapa || 113 || darśayitvāmṛtaṃ prājña mātṛdāsyavimokṣakam || dvijihvebhyaḥ kuru tathā drāgaśnaṃti na te yathā || 114 || deyā sudhā sudhābhugbhyo dvitīyostu varo mama || tatheti sa pratijñāya niryayau pakṣirāḍdivaḥ || 115 || sa mātaraṃ vinirmocya dāsyātkāśyapanaṃdanaḥ || nāgānāṃ purato dhṛtvā mahāmṛtakamaṃḍalum || 116 || amṛtaṃ pātukāmāṃstānityācaṣṭa mahāmatiḥ || nāgāḥ śucitvamāsādya bhoktavyaiṣā sudhā śubhā || 117 || nocedaśucibhiḥ spṛṣṭā snānādi parivarjitaiḥ || yāsyatyadṛśyatāmeṣā sudhā'nimiṣarakṣitā|| 118|| sāmānyamapi yadrakṣyaṃ spṛśyate'śucibhiḥ kvacit || haraṃti tadrasaṃ devāstacca tiṣṭhati nīrasam || 119 || ityuktvā sahito mātrā vainateyo viniryayau || kuśāsane ca tairukto dhṛtvā pīyūṣabhājanam || 4.1.50.120 || yāvatsnātuṃ gatāḥ sarpāstāvatpīyūṣabhājanam || ādāya viṣṇunā dattaṃ devebhya iva jīvitam || 121 || āgatya bhujagāḥ snātvā na dṛṣṭvāmṛtabhājanam || aho pratāritā nītamamṛtaṃ ceti cukruśuḥ || 122 || tataḥ paryalihandarbhānpīyūṣasparśakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || āstāṃ tāvatsudhā dūraṃ jihvāsteṣāṃ dvidhābhavan || 123 || anyepyanyāyalabdhārthaṃ ye bubhukṣaṃti kevalam || tanno pariṇatiṃ gacchedbhoktuṃ vātairna labhyate|| || 124 || nyāyādhvasthena tārkṣyeṇa sudhā prāptātidurlabhā || labdhāpyanyāyato nāgairdṛṣṭamātrā kṣaṇādgatā ||125|| atha dāsyādvinirmuktā vinatovāca khecaram || putra kāśīṃ prayāsyāmi dāsyapāpāpanuttaye || 126 || tāvatpāpāni jṛṃbhaṃte nānājanmārjitānyapi || yāvatkāśī na hṛtsaṃsthā punarbhavavighātinī|| 127 || kāśīsmaraṇamātreṇa kiṃ citraṃ yadaghaṃ vrajet || garbhavāsopi naśyeta viśveśānugrahātparāt || 128 || yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣāttārāpativibhūṣaṇaḥ || tārayettārakadroṇyā dustarādbhavasāgarāt || 129 || viśveśānugṛhītānāṃ vicchinnākhilakarmaṇām || bhavetkāśīṃ prati matirnetareṣāṃ kadācana || 4.1.50.130 || kāśīṃ prati mano yeṣāṃ niḥśeṣakṣālitainasām || ta eva mānavā loke satyaṃ nṛpa śavopare || 131 || taireva kālo vijitasta eva hi gatainasaḥ || apunargarbhavāsāste prāptā vārāṇasīha yaiḥ || || 132|| śreyasāṃ bhājanaṃ caitannṛjanmana mudhā nayet|| devānāmapiduṣprāpyaṃ kāśīsaṃdarśanādṛte || 133 || kaḥ kaliḥ kothavā kālaḥ kiṃ vā karmāṇyanekadhā || parānaṃdapradaṃ kṣetramavimuktaṃ yadīkṣitam || 134 || te garbhavāse tiṣṭhaṃti punaste garbhavāsinaḥ|| ye na garbhavanacchetrīṃ sevaṃte varaṇāmasim||135|| niśamyeti vacaḥ prāha tārkṣyo natvātha mātaram|| ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi kāśīṃ draṣṭuṃ śivārcitām || 136|| māturājñāmatha prāpya jananyā saha pakṣirāṭ || kṣaṇādvārāṇasīṃ prāpa mokṣanikṣepabhūmikām || 137 || ubhāvapi ca tepāte tapa ugraṃ mahāmatī || saṃsthāpya śāṃbhavaṃ liṃgaṃ patattrīṃdro'caleṃdriyaḥ || 138 || nāmnā khakholkamādityaṃ saṃsthāpya vinatā śubham || acireṇaiva kālena mahatastapasastayoḥ ||139|| kāśyāṃ prasannau saṃjātau devau śaṃkarabhāskarau || garuḍasthāpitālliṃgādāvirāsīdumāpatiḥ || 4.1.50.140 || garuḍāya varānprādātsa bahūnatidurlabhān|| khageṃdra mama bhaktosi tava jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati || 141 || vetsyasi tvaṃ rahasyaṃ me yanna jñātaṃ surairapi || tvayaitatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ garuḍeśvarasaṃjñitam || 142 || paramajñānadaṃ puṃsāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ samarcitam || anyacca śṛṇu pakṣīṃdra hitaṃ te vacmi sāṃpratam || 143 || asāvahaṃ sa vai viṣṇurmāstu te bhedadṛkca nau || evaṃ tasyaiva pakṣīṃdra daityeṃdra balahāriṇa || 144 || prāpya satpatratāṃ patriṃstvamapyarcyo bhaviṣyasi || iti dattvā varaṃ śaṃbhuḥ svabhaktāya garutmate || 145 || tatraivāṃtarhito jāto garuḍopi hariṃ yayau || hare rathatvaṃ saṃprāpya sopi pūjyo'bhavadbhuvi || 146 || tapasyaṃtīmathālokya kadācidvinatāṃ prabhuḥ || śivasyaiva parāmūrtiḥ khakholko nāma bhāskaraḥ || 147 || dattvā varaṃ ca pāpaghnaṃ śivajñānasamanvitam || kāśīvāsijanāneka bhavapāpakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 148 || vinatāditya ityākhyaḥ khakholkastatra saṃsthitaḥ || itthaṃ khakholka ādityaḥ kāśīvighnatamoharaḥ || 149 || tasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || kāśyāṃ paiśaṃgile tīrthe khakholkasya vilokanāt || naraściṃtitamāpnoti nīrogo jāyate kṣaṇāt || 4.1.50.150 || naraḥ śrutvaitadākhyānaṃ khakholkādityasaṃbhavam || garuḍeśena sahitaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 151 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṇḍe pūrvārddhe khakholkāditya garuḍeśayorvarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 || iti kāśīkhaṃḍapūrvārdhaṃ samāptam || || cha || || cha || || cha ||
<4.2.51>
|| atha śrīkāśīkhaṃḍottarārdhaṃ prārabhyate || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || agastiruvāca || || pārvatī hṛdayānaṃda sarvajñāṃgabhava prabho || kiṃcitpraṣṭumanāḥ svāmiṃstadbhavānvaktumarhati || 1 || dakṣa prajāpateḥ putrī kaśyapasya parigrahaḥ || garutmataḥ prasūḥ sādhvī kuto dāsyamavāpa sā || 2 || || skaṃda uvāca || || haṃjikātvaṃ yathā prāptā vinatā sā tapasvinī || tadapyahaṃ samākhyāmi niśāmaya mahāmate || 3 || kadrūrajījanatputrāñśataṃ kaśyapataḥ purā || ulūkamaruṇaṃ tārkṣyamasūta vinatā trayam || 4 || kauśiko rājyamāpyāpi śreṣṭhatvātpakṣiṇāṃ mune || nirguṇatvācca taiḥ sarvaiḥ sa rājyādavaropitaḥ || 5 || krūrākṣoyaṃ divāṃdhoyaṃ sadā vakranakhastvasau || atīvodvegajanakaṃ sarveṣāmasya bhāṣaṇam || 6 || itthaṃ tasya guṇagrāmānvikathya bahuśaḥ khagāḥ || nādyāpi vṛṇvate rājye kamapi svairacāriṇaḥ || 7 || kauśiketha tathāvṛtte putravīkṣaṇalālasā || aṃḍaṃ prasphoṭayāmāsa madhyamaṃ vinatā tadā || 8 || pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu prasphoṭya ghaṭasaṃbhava || tadabheditayautsukyādaṃḍamaṣṭamake śate || 9 || tāvatsarvāṇi gātrāṇi tasyātimahasaḥ śiśoḥ || ūrvoruparisiddhāni daṃḍāṃtarnivāsinaḥ || 4.2.51.10 || aṃḍānnirgatamātreṇa krodhāruṇamukhaśriyā || ardhaniṣpannadehena śiśunā śāpitā prasūḥ || 11 || janayitri tvayā dṛṣṭvā kādraveyānsvalīlayā || khelato māturutsaṃge yadaṃḍaṃ vyādhita dvidhā || 12 || tadaniṣpanna sarvāṃgaḥ śapāmi tvā vihaṃgame || teṣāmevaidhi dāsī tvaṃ sapatnyaṃga bhuvāmiha || 13 || vepamānātha tacchāpādidaṃ provāca pakṣiṇī || anūro brūhi me śāpāvasānaṃ māturaṃgaja || 14 || || anūruruvāca || aṃḍaṃ tṛtīyaṃ mā bhiṃdhi hyaniṣpannaṃ mameva hi || asminnaṃḍe bhaviṣyo yaḥ sa te dāsyaṃ hariṣyati || 15 || ityuktvā soruṇogacchaduḍḍīyānaṃdakānanam || yatra viśveśvaro dadyādapi paṃgoḥ śubhāṃ gatim|| 16 || etatte pṛcchataḥ khyātaṃ vinatā dāsyakāraṇam|| mune prasaṃgato vacmi aruṇādityasaṃbhavam || 17 || anūrutvādanūruryoruṇaḥ krodhāruṇo yataḥ || vārāṇasyāṃ tapastaptvā tenārādhi divākaraḥ || 18 || sopi prasanno dattvātha varāṃstasmā anūrave || ādityastasya nāmnābhūdaruṇāditya ityapi || 19 || || arka uvāca || tiṣṭhānūro mama rathe sadaiva vinatātmaja || jagatāṃ ca hitārthāya dhvāṃtaṃ vidhvaṃsayanpuraḥ || 4.2.51.20 || atra tvatsthāpitāṃ mūrtiṃ ye bhajiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevottare teṣāṃ kuto bhayam || 21 || yercayiṣyaṃti satatamaruṇādityasaṃjñakam || māmatra teṣāṃ no duḥkhaṃ na dāridryaṃ na pātakam|| 22 || vyādhibhirnābhibhūyaṃte no pasargaiśca kaiścana || śokāgninā na dahyaṃte hyaruṇādityasevanāt || 23 || atha syaṃdanamāropya nītavānaruṇaṃ raviḥ || adyāpi sa rathe saure prātareva samudyati || 24 || yaḥ kuryātprātarutthāya namaskāraṃ dinedine || aruṇāya sasūryāya tasya duḥkhabhayaṃ kutaḥ || 25 || aruṇādityamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ śroṣyati narottamaḥ || na tasya duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcidbhaviṣyati kadācana || 26 || skaṃda uvāca || vṛddhādityasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu te kathayāmyaham|| yasya śravaṇamātreṇa naro no duṣkṛtaṃ bhajet ||27 || purātra vṛddhahārīto vārāṇasyāṃ mahātapāḥ || mahātapaḥ samṛddhyarthaṃ samārādhitavānravim || 28 || mūrtiṃ saṃsthāpya śubhadāṃ bhāsvataḥ śubhalakṣaṇām || dakṣiṇena viśālākṣyā dṛḍhabhaktisamanvitaḥ || 29 || tuṣṭastasmai varaṃ prādādbradhno vṛddhatapasvine || alaṃ vilaṃbya yācasva kaste deyo varo mayā || 4.2.51.30 || sotha prasannāddyumaṇeravṛṇīta varaṃ muniḥ || yadi prasanno bhagavānyuvatvaṃ dehi me punaḥ|| 31 || tapaḥkaraṇa sāmarthyaṃ sthavirasya na me yataḥ || punastāruṇyamāptohaṃ cariṣyāmyuttamaṃ tapaḥ ||32|| tapa eva paro dharmastapa eva paraṃ vasu || tapa eva paraḥ kāmo nirvāṇaṃ tapa eva hi || 33 || ṛtena tapasaḥ kvāpi labhyā aiśvaryasaṃpadaḥ || padaṃ dhruvādibhiḥ prāpi kevalaṃ tapaso balāt || 34 || tatastapaścariṣyāmi lokadvayamahattvadam || prāpya tvadvaradānena yauvanaṃ sarvasaṃmatam || 383 || dhigjarāṃprāṇināmatra yayā sarvo virajyati || jarātureṃdriyagrāme striyopi nayataḥ svasāt || 36 || varaṃ maraṇamevāstu mā jarāstvatiśocyakṛt || kṣaṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca maraṇaṃ jarā duḥkhaṃ kṣaṇekṣaṇe ||37|| kāṃkṣaṃti dīrghatapase ciramāyurjiteṃdriyāḥ || dhanaṃ dānāya putrāya kalatraṃ muktaye dhiyam|| 38 || vṛddhasyavārdhakaṃ bradhnastatkṣaṇādapahṛtya vai || dadau ca cārutā hetuṃ tāruṇyaṃ puṇyasādhanam ||39|| evaṃ sa vṛddhahārīto vārāṇasyāṃ mahāmuniḥ || saṃprāpya yauvanaṃ bradhnāttapa ugraṃ cacāra ha ||4.2.51.40|| vṛddhenārādhito yasmāddhārītena tapasvinā || ādityo vārdhakaharo vṛddhādityastataḥ smṛtaḥ || 41 || vṛddhādityaṃ samārādhya vārāṇasyāṃ ghaṭodbhava || jarā durgati rogaghnaṃ bahavaḥ siddhimāgatāḥ || 42 || vṛddhādityaṃ namaskṛtya vārāṇasyā ravau naraḥ || labhedabhīpsitāṃ siddhiṃ na kvaciddurgatiṃ labhet || 43 || || skaṃda uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇu mune keśavādityamuttamam || yathā tu keśavaṃ prāpya savitā jñānamāptavān || 44 || vyomni saṃcaramāṇena saptāśvenādikeśavaḥ || ekadā darśibhāvena pūjayam̐lliṃgamaiśvaram || 45 || kautukādiva uttīrya hare ravirupāviśat || niḥśabdo niścalaḥ svastho mahāścaryasamanvitaḥ || 46 || pratīkṣamāṇovasaraṃ kiṃcitpraṣṭumanā harim || hariṃ visarjitārcaṃ ca praṇanāma kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 47 || svāgataṃ te hariḥ prāha bahumānapuraḥsaram || svābhyāśaṃ āsayāmāsa bhāsvaṃtaṃ natakaṃdharam|| 48|| athāvasaramālokya lokacakṣuradhokṣajam || natvā vijñāpayāmāsa kṛtānujño'surāriṇā || 49 || || raviruvāca || || aṃtarātmāsi jagatāṃ viśvaṃbhara jagatpate || tavāpi pūjyaḥ kopyasti jagatpūjyātra mādhava || 4.2.51.50 || tvattaścāvirbhavedetattvayi sarvaṃ pralīyate || tvameva pātā sarvasya jagato jagatāṃnidhe || 51 || ityāścaryaṃ samālokya prāptosmyatra tavāṃtikam || kimidaṃ pūjyate nātha bhavatā bhavatāpahṛt || 52 || iti śrutvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ sahasrāṃśorudīritam || uccairmāśaṃsa saptāśvaṃ vārayankarasaṃjñayā || 53 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || devadevo mahādevo nīlakaṃṭha umāpatiḥ || eka eva hi pūjyotra sarvakāraṇakāraṇam || 54 || atra trilocanādanyaṃ samarcayatiyolpadhīḥ || salocanopi vijñeyo locanābhyāṃ vivarjitaḥ ||55|| eko mṛtyuṃjayaḥ pūjyo janmamṛtyujarāharaḥ || mṛtyuṃjayaṃ kilābhyarcya śveto mṛtyuṃjayobhavat || 56 || kālakālaṃ samārādhya bhṛṃgī kālaṃ jigāyavai || śailādimapi tatyāja mṛtyurmṛtyuṃjayārcakam ||57|| vijigye tripuraṃ yastu helayaikeṣu mokṣaṇāt || taṃ samabhyarcya bhūteśaṃ ko na pūjyatamo bhavet ||58|| trijagajjayino hetostryakṣasyārādhanaṃ param || ko nārādhayati bradhnasārasya smaravidviṣaḥ || 59 || yasyākṣipakṣmasaṃkocājjagatsaṃkocametyadaḥ || vikasvaraṃ vikāsācca kasya pūjyatamo na saḥ || 4.2.51.60 || śaṃbhorliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || prāpnotyatra pumānsadyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 61 || samarcya śāṃbhavaṃ liṃgamapijanmaśatārjitam || pāpapuṃjaṃ jahātyeva pumānatra kṣaṇāddhruvam || 62 || kiṃkiṃ na saṃbhavedatra śivaliṃgasamarcanāt || putrāḥ kalatra kṣetrāṇi svargo mokṣopyasaṃśayam || 63 || trailokyaiśvaryasaṃpattirmayā prāptā sahasrago || śivaliṃgārcanādekātsatyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 64 || ayameva paroyogastvidameva paraṃ tapaḥ || idameva paraṃ jñānaṃ sthāṇuliṃgaṃ yadarcyate || 65|| yairliṃgaṃ sakṛdapyatra pūjitaṃ pārvatīpateḥ || kuto duḥkhabhayaṃ teṣāṃ saṃsāre duḥkhabhājane || 66 || sarvaṃ parityajya rave yo liṃgaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || na taṃ pāpāni bādhaṃte mahāṃtyapi divākara || 67 || liṃgārcane bhavedvṛddhisteṣāmevātra bhāskara || yeṣāṃ punarbhavacchedaṃ cikīrṣati maheśvaraḥ ||68|| na liṃgārādhanātpuṇyaṃ triṣulokeṣu cāparam || sarvatīrthābhiṣekaḥ syālliṃgasnānāṃbu sevanāt || 69 || tasmālliṃgaṃ tvamapyarka samarcaya maheśituḥ || saṃprāptaṃ paramāṃ lakṣmīṃ mahātejobhi jṛṃbhaṇīm || 4.2.51.70 || iti śrutvā harervākyaṃ tadārabhya sahasraguḥ || vidhāya sphāṭikaṃ liṃgaṃ munedyāpi samarcayet || 71 || gurutvena tadākalya vivasvānādikeśavam || tatropatiṣṭhatedyāpi uttareṇādikeśavāt || 72 || ataḥ sa keśavādityaḥ kāśyāṃ bhaktatamonudaḥ || samarcitaḥ sadā deyānmanaso vāṃchitaṃ phalam || 73 || keśavādityamārādhya vārāṇasyāṃ narottamaḥ || paramaṃ jñānamāpnoti yena nirvāṇabhāgbhavet || 74 || tatra pādodake tīrthekṛtasarvodakakriyaḥ || vilokya keśavādityaṃ mucyate janmapātakaiḥ || 75 || agaste rathasaptamyāṃ ravivāro yadāpyate || tadā pādodake tīrthe ādikeśava sannidhau ||76|| snātvoṣasi naro maunī keśavādityapūjanāt || saptajanmārjitātpāpānmukto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 77|| yadyajjanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mayā saptasu janmasu || tanme rogaṃ ca śokaṃ ca mākarī haṃtu saptamī || 78 || etajjanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yacca janmāṃtarārjitam || manovākkāyajaṃ yacca jñātājñāte ca ye punaḥ || 79 || iti saptavidhaṃ pāpaṃ snānānme saptasaptike || saptavyādhisamāyuktaṃ hara mākari saptami || 4.2.51.80 || etanmaṃtratrayaṃ japtvā snātvā pādodake naraḥ || keśavādityamālokya kṣaṇānniṣkaluṣo bhavet || 81 || keśavādityamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇvañśraddhāsamanvitaḥ || naro na lipyate pāpaiḥ śivabhaktiṃ ca viṃdati || 82 || || skaṃda uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇu mune vimalādityamuttamam || harikeśavane ramye vārāṇasyāṃ vyavasthitam|| 83 || uccadeśebhavatpūrvaṃ vimalo nāma bāhujaḥ || sa prāktanātkarmayogādvimale pathyapi sthitaḥ || 84 || kuṣṭharogamavāpyoccaistyaktvā dārāngṛhaṃ vasu || vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya bradhnamārādhayatsudhīḥ || 85 || karavīrairjapābhiśca gaṃdhakaiḥ kiṃśukaiḥ śubhaiḥ || raktotpalairaśokaiśca sa samānarca bhāskaram || 86 || vicitraracanairmālyaiḥ pāṭalācaṃpakodbhavaiḥ || kuṃkumāgurukarpūramiśritaiḥ śoṇacaṃdanaiḥ || 87 || devamohanadhūpaiśca bahvāmodatatāṃbaraiḥ || karpūravartidīpaiśca naivedyairghṛtapāyasaiḥ || 88 || arghadānaiśca vidhivatsaureḥ stotrajapairapi || evaṃ samārādhayatastasyārko varadobhavat || 89 || uvāca ca varaṃ brūhi vimalāmalaceṣṭita || kuṣṭhaśca te prayātveṣa prārthayānyaṃ varaṃ punaḥ || 4.2.51.90 || ākarṇya vimalaścetthamālāpaṃ raśmimālinaḥ || praṇato daṃḍavadbhūmau saṃprahaṣṭatanūruhaḥ | 91 || śanairvijñāpayāṃcakra ekacakrarathaṃ ravim || jagaccakṣurameyātmanmahādhvāṃtavidhūnana || 92 || yadi prasanno bhagavanyadi deyo varo mama || tadā tvadbhaktiniṣṭhā ye kuṣṭhaṃ māstu tadanvaye || 93 || anyepi rogā mā saṃtu māstu teṣāṃ daridratā || māstu kaścana saṃtāpastvadbhaktānāṃ sahasrago || 94 || | śrīsūrya uvāca || || tathāstviti mahāprājña śṛṇvanyaṃ varamuttamam || tvayeyaṃ pūjitā mūrtirevaṃ kāśyāṃ mahāmate || 95 || asyāḥ sānnidhyamatrāhaṃ na tyakṣyāmi kadācana || prathitā tava nāmnā ca pratimaiṣā bhaviṣyati ||96|| vimalāditya ityākhyā bhaktānāṃ varadā sadā || sarvavyādhi nihaṃtrī ca sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī ||97|| iti dattvā varānsūryastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || vimalo nirmalatanuḥ sopi svabhavanaṃ yayau || 98 || itthaṃ sa vimalādityo vārāṇasyāṃ śubhapradaḥ || tasya darśanamātreṇa kuṣṭharogaḥ praṇaśyati ||99|| yaścaitāṃ vimalādityakathāṃ vai śṛṇuyānnaraḥ || prāpnoti nirmalāṃ śuddhiṃ tyajyate ca manomalaiḥ ||4.2.51.100|| || skaṃda uvāca || || gaṃgādityosti tatrānyo viśveśāddakṣiṇena vai || tasya darśanamātreṇa naraḥ śuddhimiyādiha || 101 || yadā gaṃgā samāyātā bhagīrathapuraskṛtā || tadā gaṃgāṃ pariṣṭotuṃ ravistatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 102 || adyāpyaharniśaṃ gaṃgāṃ saṃmukhīkṛtya bhāskaraḥ || pariṣṭauti prasannātmā gaṃgābhaktavarapradaḥ || 103 || gaṃgādityaṃ samārādhya vārāṇasyāṃ narottamaḥ || durgatiṃ jātu na kvāpi labhate na ca rogabhāk || 104 || || skaṃda uvāca || anyacchṛṇu mahābhāga yamādityasya saṃbhavam|| yacchrutvāpi naro jātu yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 105 || yameśātpaścime bhāge vīreśātpūrvato mune || yamādityaṃ naro dṛṣṭvā yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 106 || yamatīrthe naraḥ snātvā bhūtāyāṃ bhaumavāsare || yameśvaraṃ vilokyāśu sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 107 || yamatīrthe yamaḥ pūrvaṃ taptvā suvimalaṃ tapaḥ || yameśaṃ ca yamādityaṃ pratyaṣṭhādbhaktasiddhidam || 108 || yamena sthāpito yasmādādityastatra kuṃbhaja || ataḥ sa hi yamādityo yāmīṃ harati yātanām || 109 || yameśaṃ ca yamādityaṃ yamena sthāpitaṃ naman || yamatīrthe kṛtasnāno yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 4.2.51.110 || yamatīrthe caturdaśyāṃ bharaṇyāṃ bhaumavāsare || tarpaṇaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ ca kṛtvā pitranṛṇī bhavet || 111 || abhilaṣyaṃti satataṃ pitaro narakaukasaḥ || bhaumai bharaṇyāṃ bhūtāyāṃ yadi yogoyamuttamam || 112 || kāśyāṃ kaścidyame tīrthe kṛtvā snānaṃ mahāmatiḥ || api yastarpaṇaṃkuryātsatilaṃ no vimuktaye || 113 || kiṃ gayā gamanaiḥ puṃsāṃ kiṃ śrāddhairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ || yadi kāśyāṃ yame tīrthe yogesmiñśrāddhamāpyate|| 114 || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yame tīrthe pūjayitvā yameśvaram || yamādityaṃ namaskṛtya pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet ||115|| || skaṃda uvāca || || iti te dvādaśādityāḥ kathitā pāpanāśanāḥ || yatsaṃbhavaṃ samākarṇya naro na nirayī bhavet|| 116 || anyepi saṃti ghaṭaja ravibhaktairanekaśaḥ || kāśyāṃ saṃsthāpitāḥ sūryā guhyakārkādayaḥ kila || 117 || śrutvādhyāyānimānpuṇyāndvādaśādityasūcakān || śrāvayitvāpi no martyo durgatiṃ yāti kutracit || 118 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuttarārddhe catutheṃ kāśīkhaṇḍe aruṇavṛddhakeśavavimalagaṃgāyamādityavarṇanaṃnāmaikapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 51 || || cha ||
<4.2.52>
skaṃda uvāca || || gabhastimālinigate kāśīṃ trailokyamohinīm || punaściṃtāmavāpoccairmaṃdarastho mune haraḥ || 1 || nādyāpyāyāṃti yoginyo nādyāpyāyāti tigmaguḥ || pravṛttirapi me kāśyāścitramatyaṃta durlabhā ||2|| kimatra citraṃ yatkāśī madīyamapimānasam || niścalaṃ caṃcalayati gaṇanā ketaresure ||3|| adhākṣipamahaṃ kāmaṃ trijagajjittvaraṃdṛśā || aho kāśyabhilāṣotra māmeva dunuyāttarām||4|| kāśīpravṛttimanveṣṭuṃ kaṃ vā prahiṇuyāmitaḥ || jñātuṃ ka eva nipuṇo yataḥ sa caturānanaḥ || 5 || ityāhūya vidhātāraṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram || tatropaveśya śrīkaṃṭhaḥ provāca caturānanam || 6 || yoginyaḥ preṣitāḥ pūrvaṃ preṣitotha sahasraguḥ || nādyāpi te nivartaṃte kāśyāḥ kalaśasaṃbhava || 7 || sā samutsukayetkāśī lokeśa mama mānasam || prākṛtasya janasyeva caṃcalākṣīva kācana || 8 || maṃdaretra ratirme na bhṛśaṃ suṃdarakaṃdare || anacchatucchapānīye nakrasyevālpapalvale || 9 || nā bādhiṣṭa tathā māṃ sa tāpo hālāhalodbhavaḥ || kāśīvirahajanmātra yathā māmatibādhate || 4.2.52.10 || śītaraśmiḥ śiraḥsthopi varṣanpīyūṣasīkaraiḥ || kāśīviśleṣajaṃ tāpaṃ nāho gamayituṃ prabhuḥ || 11 || vidhe vidhehi me kāryamārya dhurya mahāmate || yāhi kāśīmitastūrṇaṃ yatasva ca mamehite || 12 || brahmaṃstvameva tadvetsi kāśī tyajanakāraṇam || maṃdopi na tyajetkāśīṃ kimu yo vetti kiṃcana ||13|| adyaiva kiṃ na gaccheyaṃ kāśīṃ brahmansvamāyayā || divodāsaṃ svadharmasthaṃ na tūllaṃghitumutsahe || 14|| vidhe sarvavidheyāni tvameva vidadhāsi yat || iti ceti ca vaktavyaṃ tvayyapārthamatokhilam ||15|| ariṣṭaṃ gaccha paṃthāste śubhodarko bhavatvalam|| ādāyājñāṃ vidhi mūrdhni yayau vārāṇasīṃ mudā ||16|| sitahaṃsarathastūrṇaṃ prāpya vārāṇasīṃ purīm || kṛtakṛtyamivātmānamamanyata tadātmabhūḥ || || 17 || haṃsayānaphalaṃ medya jātaṃ kāśīsamāgame || kāśī prāptau yataḥ proktā aṃtarāyāḥ padepade || 18 || dṛśi dhāturabhūdya madṛśo prāpya sānvayaḥ || spaṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ prāptā yadeṣā''naṃdavāṭikā || 19 || svayaṃ siṃcati yā madbhiḥ svābhiḥ svargataraṃgiṇī || yatrānaṃdamayā vṛkṣā yatrānaṃdamayā janāḥ|| 4.2.52.20 || nirviśaṃti sadā kāśyāṃ phalānyānaṃdavaṃtyapi|| sadaivānaṃdabhūḥ kāśī sadaivānaṃdadaḥ śivaḥ || 21 || ānaṃdarūpā jāyaṃte tena kāśyāṃ hi jaṃtavaḥ || caraṇau carituṃ vittastāveva kṛtināmiha || || 22 || caraṇau vicaretāṃyau viśvabhartṛ purī bhuvi || tāveva śravaṇau śrotuṃ saṃvidā te bahuśrutau || 23 || iha śrutimatāṃ puṃsāṃ yābhyāṃ kāśī śrutā sakṛt || tadeva manute sarvaṃ manastviha manasvināma || 24 || yenānumanyate caiṣā kāśī sarvapramāṇabhūḥ || buddhirbudhyati sā sarvamiha buddhimatāṃ satām || yayaitaddhūrjaṭerdhāma dhṛtaṃ sva viṣayīkṛtam || 25 || varaṃ tṛṇāni dhānyāni tāni vātyāhatānyapi || kāśyāṃ yānyā pataṃtīha na janāḥ kāśyadarśanāḥ || 26 || | adya me saphalaṃ cāyuḥ parārdhadvaya saṃmitam || yasminsati mayā prāpi duṣprāpā kāśikā purī || 27 || aho me dharmasaṃpattirahome bhāgyagauravam || yadadrākṣiṣamadyāhaṃ kāśīṃ sucira ciṃtitām || 28 || adya me svatapo vṛkṣo manorathaphalairalam || śivabhaktyaṃbunā siktaḥ phalitoti bṛhattaraiḥ || 29 || mayā vyadhāyi bahudhā sṛṣṭiḥ sṛṣṭiṃ vitanvatā || paramanyādṛśī kāśī svayaṃ viśveśa nirmitiḥ|| 4.2.52.30 || iti hṛṣṭamanā vedhā dṛṣṭvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpeṇa rājānaṃ ca dadarśa ha || 31 || jalārdrākṣatapāṇiśca svastyuktvā pṛthivībhuje || kṛtapraṇāmo rājñātha bheje taddattamāsanam ||32|| kṛtamāno nṛpatinā sobhyutthānāsanādibhiḥ || vipro vyajijñapadbhūpaṃ pṛṣṭāgamanakāraṇam || 33 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || bhūpāla bahukālīnosmyahamatra ciraṃtanaḥ || tvaṃ tu māṃ naiva jānāsi jāne tvāṃ hi ripuṃjayam || || 34 || paraḥśatā mayā dṛṣṭā rājāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ || vijitānekasaṃgrāmā yāyajūkā jiteṃdriyāḥ || 35 || viniṣkṛtāriṣaḍvargāḥ suśīlāḥ sattvaśālinaḥ || śrutasyapāradṛśvāno rājanītivicakṣaṇāḥ || 36 || dayādākṣiṇyanipuṇāḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ || kṣamayā kṣamayātulyā gāṃbhīryajitasāgarāḥ || 37 || jitaroṣarayāḥ śūrāḥ saumyasauṃdaryabhūmayaḥ || ityādi guṇasaṃpannāḥ susaṃcitayaśodhanāḥ ||38|| paraṃ dvitrāḥ pavitrā ye rājarṣe tava sadguṇāḥ || teṣveṣu rājasu mama prāyaśo na dṛśaṃ gatāḥ || 39 || prajānijakuṭuṃbastvaṃ tvaṃ tu bhūdevadaivataḥ || mahātapaḥ sahāyastvaṃ pathānānye tathā nṛpāḥ || 4.2.52.40 || dhanyo mānyosi ca satāṃ pūjanīyosi sadguṇaiḥ || devā api divodāsa tvattrāsānna vimārgagāḥ || 41 || kiṃ naḥ stutyā tava nṛpa dvijānāmaspṛhāvatām || kiṃ kurmastvadguṇagrāmāḥ stāvakānnaḥ prakurvate ||42|| goṣṭhī tiṣṭhatviyaṃ tāvatprastutaṃ staumi sāṃpratam || yaṣṭukāmosmyahaṃ rājaṃstvāṃ sahāyamato vṛṇe ||43|| tvayā rājanvatī caiṣā'vaniḥ sarvardhibhājanam || ahaṃ cāstidhano rājannyāyopāttamahādhanaḥ ||44|| iyaṃ ca rājadhānī te karmabhūmāvanuttamā || yasyāṃ kṛtānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ saṃvartepi na saṃkṣayaḥ ||49|| saṃcitaṃ yaddhanaṃ puṃbhirnayasanmārgagāmibhiḥ || tatkāśyāṃ viniyujyeta kleśāyetarathā bhavet ||46|| mahimānaṃ paraṃ kāśyāḥ kopi veda na bhūpate || ṛte trinayanācchaṃbhoḥ sarvajñānapradāyinaḥ ||47|| manye dhanyatarosi tvaṃ bahujanmaśatārjitaiḥ || sukṛtaiḥ pāsi yatkāśīṃ viśvabhartuḥ parāṃ tanum || 48|| kāśī trijagatīsārastrivedī sāra eva vai || trivargottarasāraśca nirṇīteti maharṣibhiḥ || 49|| viśveśānugraheṇaiva tvayaiṣā pālyate purī || ekasyāpyavanātkāśyāṃ trailokyamavitaṃ bhavet ||4.2.52.50|| anyacca te hitaṃ vacmi yadi te rocate'nagha || prīṇanīyaḥ sadaivaiko viśveśaḥ sarvakarmabhiḥ || 51 || anyadevadhiyā rājanviśveśaṃ paśya mā kvacit || brahmaviṣṇviṃdra caṃdrārkā krīḍeyaṃ tasya dhūrjaṭeḥ || || 52 || viprairudarkamicchadbhiḥ śikṣaṇīyā yato nṛpāḥ || atastava hitaṃ khyātaṃ kiṃ vā me ciṃtayānayā || 53 || iti joṣaṃ sthitaṃ vipraṃ pratyuvāca nṛpottamaḥ || sarvaṃ mayā hṛdi dhṛtaṃ yattvayoktaṃ dvijottama || 54 || || rājovāca || || ahaṃ yiyakṣamāṇasya tava sāhāyyakarmaṇi || dāsosmi yajñasaṃbhārānnayameko śato'khilān || 55 || yadasti mekhilaṃ tatra saptāṃgepi bhavānprabhuḥ || yajasvaikamanābrahmansiddhaṃ manyasva vāṃchitam || 56 || rājyaṃ karomi yadbrahmansvārthaṃ tanna manāgapi || putraiḥ kalatrairdehenaparopakṛtaye yate || 57|| rājñāṃ kratukriyābhyopi tīrthebhyopi samaṃtataḥ || prajāpālanamevaiko dharmaḥ prokto manīṣibhiḥ || 58 || prajāsaṃtāpajovahnirvajrāgnerapi dāruṇaḥ || dvitrāndahati vajrāgniḥ pūrvo rājyaṃ kulaṃ tanum || 59 || yadāvabhṛthasisrāsurbhaveyaṃ dvijasattama || tadā viprapadāṃbhobhirabhiṣekaṃ karomyaham || 4.2.52.60 || havanaṃ brāhmaṇamukhe yatkaromi dvijottama || manye kratukriyābhyopi tadviśiṣṭaṃ mahāmate ||61|| abhilāṣeṣu sarveṣu jāgartyeko hṛdīha me || adyāpi mārgaṇaḥ kopi draṣṭavyaḥ svatanorapi || 62 || aho ahobhirbahubhiḥ phalito me manorathaḥ || yattvaṃ medya gṛhe prāptaḥ kiṃcitprārthayituṃ dvija || 63 || ekāgramānaso vipra yajñānvipuladakṣiṇān || bahūnyajakṛtaṃ viddhi sāhāyyaṃ sarvavastuṣu || 64 || iti rājño mahābuddherdharmaśīlasya bhāṣitam || śrutvā tuṣṭamanāḥ sraṣṭā kratusaṃbhāramāharat || 65 || sāhāyyaṃ prāpya rājarṣerdivodāsasya padmabhūḥ || iyāja daśabhiḥ kāśyāmaśvamedhairmahāmakhaiḥ ||66 || adyāpi homadhūmoghairyadvyāptaṃ gaganāṃtaram || tadā prabhṛti na vyoma nīlimānaṃ jahātyadaḥ || 67 || tīrthaṃ daśāśvamedhākhyaṃ prathitaṃ jagatītale || tadā prabhṛti tatrāsīdvārāṇasyāṃ śubhapradam || 68 || purā rudrasaro nāma tattīrthaṃ kalaśodbhava || daśāśvamedhikaṃ paścājjātaṃ vidhiparigrahāt || 69 || svardhunyatha tataḥ prāptā bhagīrathasamāgamāt || atīva puṇyavajjātamatastattīrthamuttamam ||4.2.52.70|| vidhirdaśāśvamedheśaṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya tatra vai|| sthitavānna gatodyāpi kvāpi kāśīṃ vihāya tu || 71 || rājño dharmaratestasya cchidraṃ nāvāpa kiṃcana || ataḥ purāreḥ purato vrajitvā kiṃ vadedvidhiḥ || 72 || kṣetraprabhāvaṃ vijñāya dhyāyanviśveśvaraṃ śivam || brahmeśvaraṃ ca saṃsthāpya vidhistatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 73 || parātanuriyaṃ kāśī viśveśasyeti niścitam || asyāḥ saṃsevanācchaṃbhurna kupyati puro mayi || 74 || kaḥ prāpya kāśīṃ durmedhāḥ punastyaktumiheha te || anekajanmajanitakarmanirmūlanakṣamām || 75 || viśvasaṃtāpasaṃhartuḥ sthāne viśvapatestanuḥ || saṃtāpyatetarāṃ kāśyā viśleṣaja mahāgninā || 76 || prāpya kāśīṃ tyajedyastu samastāghaughanāśinīm|| nṛpaśuḥ sa parijñeyo mahāsaukhyaparāṅamukhaḥ || 77 || nirvāṇalakṣmīṃ yaḥ kāṃkṣettyaktvā saṃsāradurgatim || tena kāśī na saṃtyājyā yadyāptaiśādanugrahāt || 78 || yaḥ kāśīṃ saṃparityajya gacchedanyatra durmatiḥ || tasya hastatalādgaccheccaturvargaphalodayaḥ || 79 || nibarhaṇī madhaughasya supuṇya paribṛṃhiṇīm || kaḥ prāpya kāśīṃ durmedhāstyajenmokṣasukhapradām|| 4.2.52.80 || satyaloke kva tatsaukhyaṃ kva saukhyaṃ vaiṣṇave pade || yatsaukhyaṃ labhyate kāśyāṃ nimeṣārdhaniṣevaṇāt || 81 || vārāṇasīguṇagaṇānnirṇīya druhiṇastviti || vyāvṛtya maṃdaragiriṃ na punaḥ pratyagānmune ||82|| || skaṃda uvāca || || mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra mahimānaṃ bravīmi te || || kāśyāṃ daśāśvamedhasya sarvatīrthaśiromaṇeḥ || 83 || daśāśvamedhikaṃ prāpya sarvatīrthottamottamam || yatkiṃcitkriyate karma tadakṣayamiheritam || 84 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo de vatārcanam || saṃdhyopāstistarpaṇaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ pitṛsamarcanam||85|| daśāśvamedhike tīrthe sakṛtsnātvā narottamaḥ |9| dṛṣṭvā daśāśvamedheśaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||86|| jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe prāpya pratipadaṃ tithim || daśāśvamedhike snātvā mucyate janmapātakaiḥ || 87 || jyeṣṭhe śukla dvitīyāyāṃ snātvā rudrasarovare || janmadvayakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 88 || evaṃ sarvāsu tithiṣu kramasnāyī narottamaḥ || āśuklapakṣadaśami pratijanmāghamutsṛjet || 89 || tithiṃ daśaharāṃ prāpya daśajanmāghahāriṇīm || daśāśvamedhike snāto yāmīṃ paśyenna yātanām ||4.2.52.90|| liṃgaṃ daśāśvamedheśaṃ dṛṣṭvā daśaharā tithau || daśajanmārjitaiḥ pāpaistyajyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 91 || snāto daśaharāyāṃ yaḥ pūjayelliṃgamuttamam || bhaktyā daśāśvamedheśaṃ na taṃ garbhadaśā spṛśet ||92|| jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe pakṣaṃ rudrasare naraḥ || kurvanvai vārṣikīṃ yātrāṃ na vighnairabhibhūyate||93|| daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthairyatphalaṃ samyagāpyate || daśāśvamedhe tannūnaṃ snātvā daśaharā tithau || 94 || svardhunyāḥ paścime tīre natvā daśahareśvaram || na durdaśāmavāpnoti pumānpuṇyatamaḥ kvacit || 95 || yatkāśyāṃ dakṣiṇadvāramaṃtargehasya kīrtyate || tatra brahmeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmaloke mahīyate || 96 || iti brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa vārāṇasyāṃ mahādhiyā || druhiṇena sthitaṃ tāvadyāvadviśveśvarāgamaḥ || 97 || divodāsopi rājeṃdro vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpiṇe || brahmaṇe kṛtayajñāya brahmaśālāmakalpayat|| 98 || brahmeśvarasamīpe tu brahmaśālā manoharā || brahmā tatrāvasadvyoma brahmaghoṣairninādayan || 99 || iti te kathito brahmanmahimātimahattaraḥ || daśāśvamedhatīrthasya sarvāghaughavināśanaḥ || 4.2.52.100 || śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ śrāvayitvā tathaiva ca || brahmalokamavāpnoti śraddhayā mānavottamaḥ || 101 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuttarārddhe caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe daśāśvamedhavarṇanaṃnāma dvipaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 || |||cha|||
<4.2.53>
