|| agastiruvāca || || apūveṃyaṃ kathā khyātā brahmaṇo brahmavittama || kiṃ cakāra punaḥ śaṃbhustatra brahmaṇyapi sthite || 1 || || skaṃda uvāca || śṛṇvagastya mahābhāga kāśyāṃ brahmaṇyapisthite || giriśaściṃtayāmāsa bhṛśamudvignamānasaḥ || 2 || purī sā yādṛśī kāśī vaśīkaraṇabhūmikā || na tādṛśīdṛśīhāsītkvacinme prāyaśo dhruvam || 3 || yo yo yāti purīṃ tāṃ tu sa sa tatraiva tiṣṭhati || abhūvannanuyoginyo'yoginyaḥ kāśisaṃgatāḥ || 4 || akiṃcitkaratāṃ prāptaḥ sa sahasrakaropyaram || vidhirvidhānadakṣopi na me sa savidhobhavat || 5 || ciṃtayanniti deveśo gaṇānāhūya bhūriśaḥ || preṣayāmāsa bho yāta kṣipraṃ vārāṇasīṃ purīm ||6|| kiṃ kurvaṃti tu yoginyaḥ kiṃ karoti sa bhānumān || gatvā vitta tvarāyuktā vidhiśca vidadhāti kim || 7 || nāmagrāhaṃ tataḥ'praiṣīdbahumāna puraḥsaram|| śaṃkukarṇa mahākāla ghaṭākarṇa mahodara ||8|| somanaṃdinnaṃdiṣeṇa kāla piṃgala kukkuṭa || kuṃḍodara mayūrākṣa bāṇa gokarṇa tāraka || 9 || tilaparṇa smṛlakarṇa dṛmicaṃḍa prabhāmaya || sukeśa viṃdate chāga kapardinpiṃgalākṣaka || 4.2.53.10 || vīrabhadra kirātākhya caturmukha nikuṃbhaka || paṃcākṣabhārabhūtākhya tryakṣa kṣemaka lāṃgalin||11|| virādha sumukhāṣāḍhe bhavaṃto mama sūnavaḥ || yathemau skaṃdaheraṃbau naigameyo yathā tvayam ||12|| yathā śākhaviśākhau ca yathemau naṃdibhṛṃgiṇau || bhavatsu vidyamāneṣu mahāvikramaśāliṣu || 13 || kāśīpravṛttiṃ no jāne divodāsanṛpasya ca || yoginyarkavidhīnāṃ ca taddvau yātaṃ bhavatsvamū || 14 || śaṃkukarṇamahākālau kālasyāpi prakaṃpanau || jñātuṃ vārāṇasīvārtāmāyātaṃ catvarānvitau || 15 || kṛtapratijñau to(?) tūrṇaṃ prāpya vārāṇasīṃ purīm || śaṃkukarṇamahākālau vismṛtya śāṃbhavīṃ giram || 16 || yathaiṃdrajālikīṃ dṛṣṭvā māyāmiha vicakṣaṇaḥ || kṣaṇena mohamāyāti kāśīṃ vīkṣya tathaiva tau || 17 || aho mohasya māhātmyamaho bhāgyaviparyayaḥ || nirvāṇarāśiṃ yatkāśīṃ prāpya yāṃtyanyato'budhāḥ || 18 || tatyaje yairiyaṃ kāśī mahāśīrvādabhūbhikā || teṣāṃ karatalānmuktiḥ prāptāpi parito gatā || 19 || yatra sarvāvabhṛthataḥ snānamātraṃ viśiṣyate || apyuṣṇīkṛtapānīyaistāṃ kāśīṃ kaḥ parityajet || 4.2.53.20 || yatraikapuṣpadānena śivaliṃgasya mūrdhani || daśasauvarṇikaṃ puṇyaṃ kastāṃ kāśīṃ parityajet || 21 || yatra daṃḍapraṇāmena apyekena śivāgrataḥ || tucchameṃdrapadaṃprāhustāṃ kāśīṃ ko vimuṃcati || 22 || yatraikadvijamātraṃ tu bhojayitvā yathecchayā || vājapeyādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ tāṃ kāśīṃ ko vimuṃcati || 23 || ekāṃ gāṃ yatra dattvā vai vidhivadbrāhmaṇāya vai || labhedayuta gopuṇyaṃ kastāṃ kāśīṃ tyajetsudhīḥ || 24 || ekaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yatra saṃsthāpitaṃ bhavet || api trailokyamakhilaṃ tāṃ kāśīṃ kaḥ samujjhati || 25 || pariniścitya tāvitthaṃ liṃge saṃsthāpya puṇyade || tatraiva saṃsthitiṃ prāptau kāśīṃ nādyāpi muṃcataḥ || 26 || śaṃkukarṇeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ śaṃkukarṇa ga ṇārcitam || dṛṣṭvā na jāyate jaṃturjātu māturmahodare || 27 || viśveśādvāyudigbhāge śaṃkukarṇeśvaraṃ naraḥ || saṃpūjya na viśedatra ghore saṃsārasāgare || 28 || mahākāleśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mahākālagaṇārcitam || arcayitvā ca natvā ca stutvā kālabhayaṃ kutaḥ || 29 || || skaṃda uvāca || || śaṃkukarṇe mahākāle ciraṃtana vilaṃbite || jñātvā sarvajñanāthotha prāhaipīdaparau gaṇau || 4.2.53.30 || ghaṃṭākarṇa tvamāgaccha mahodara mahāmate || kāśīṃ yātaṃ yuvāṃ tūrṇaṃ jñātuṃ tatratya ceṣṭitam ||31|| ityagaste gaṇau tau tu gatvā kāśīṃ mahāpurīm|| vyāvṛtyādyāpi no yātau kvāpi tatraiva saṃsthitau || 32 || ghaṃṭākarṇeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ ghaṃṭākarṇa gaṇottamaḥ || kāśyāṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivatsvayaṃ tatraiva nirvṛtaḥ || 33 || kuṃḍaṃ tatraiva saṃsthāpya liṃgasnapanakarmaṇe || nādyāpi sa tyajetkāśīṃ dhyāyam̐lliṃgaṃ tathaiva hi || 34 || mahodaropi tatprācyāṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || mahodareśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dhyāyedadyāpi kuṃbhaja || 35 || mahodareśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vārāṇasyāṃ dvijottama || kadācidapi vai mātuḥ praviśennaudarīṃ darīm || || 36 || ghaṃṭākarṇa hrade snātvā dṛṣṭvā vyāseśvaraṃ vibhum || yatra kutra vipannopi vārāṇasyāṃ mṛto bhavet||37|| ghaṃṭākarṇe mahātīrthe śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || api durgatimāpannānuddharetsaptapūrvajān || 38 || nimajjyādyāpi tatkuṃḍe kṣaṇa yovahito bhavet || viśveśvaramahāpūjā ghaṃṭārāvāñśṛṇoti saḥ ||39|| vadaṃti pitaraḥ kāśyāṃ ghaṃṭākarṇemalejale|| dātā tilodakasyāpi vaṃśe naḥ kopi jāyate||4.2.53.40|| yadvaṃśyā munayaḥ kāśyāṃ ghaṃṭākarṇe mahāhrade|| kṛtodakakriyāḥ prāptāḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ ghaṭodbhava ||41|| || skaṃda uvāca|| || ghaṃṭākarṇe gaṇe yāte prayāte ca mahodare || visismāya smaradveṣṭā maulimāṃdolayanmuhuḥ ||42|| uvāca ca manasyeva haraḥ smitvā punaḥpunaḥ || mahāmohanavidyāsi kāśi tvāṃ paryavaimyaham || 43 || purāvidaḥ praśaṃsaṃti tvāṃ mahāmohahāriṇīm || kāśīṃtviti na jānaṃti mahāmohanabhūriyam || 44 || preṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ sarvānbhavatī mohayiṣyati || iti samyagvijānāmi kāśi tvāṃ mohanoṣadhim || 49 || tathāpi preṣayiṣyāmi yāvānmesti paricchadaḥ || nodyamādviramaṃtīha jñāninaḥ sādhyakarmaṇi || 46 || nodyamādviratiḥ kāryā kvāpi kārye vicakṣaṇaiḥ || pratikūlopi khidyeta vidhistatsatatodyamāt || 47 || śītoṣṇabhānū svarbhānu grastāvapi nabhoṃgaṇe || gatiṃ na tyajatodyāpi prakrāṃtavya kṛtodyamau || 48 || ekatra haṃti kāryāṇi prātikūlyādvidhirmuhuḥ || ekatrakaraṇīyāni setsyaṃtyatra bhṛśodyamāt || 49 || daivaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ karma kathyate netaratpunaḥ || tannirākaraṇe yatnaḥ svayaṃ kāryo vipaścitā || 4.2.53.50 || bhājanopasthitaṃ daivādbhojyaṃ nāsyaṃ svayaṃ viśet || hastavaktrodyamāttacca praviśedaudarīṃ darīm || 51 || ityudyamaṃ samarthyeśo niścitaṃ daivajitvaram || punaśca preṣayāṃcakre gaṇānpaṃcamahārayān || 52 || somanaṃdī naṃdiṣeṇaḥ kālapiṃgalakukkuṭāḥ || tedyāpi na nivartaṃte kāśyāṃ jīvāmṛtā yathā ||53|| tepi svanāmnā liṃgāni śaṃbhusaṃtuṣṭi kāmyayā|| pratiṣṭhāpya sthitāḥ kāśyāṃ viśvanirvāṇajanmani || 54 || somanaṃdīśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ naṃdavane param || somaloke parānaṃdaṃ prāpnuyādbhaktimānnaraḥ || 55 || taduttare vilokyātha naṃdiṣeṇeśvaraṃ naraḥ || ānaṃdasenāṃ saṃprāpya jayenmṛtyumapi kṣaṇāt || 56 || kāleśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ gaṃgāyāḥ paścimottare || praṇamya kālapāśena no badhyeta kadācana || || 57 || piṃgaleśvaramabhyarcya kāleśātkiṃciduttare || labhate piṃgalajñānaṃ yena tanmayatāṃ vrajet || 58 || kukkuṭeśvara liṃgasya yetra bhaktiṃ vitanvate || kukkuṭāṃḍākṛtestasya na te garbhamavāpnuyuḥ || 59 || || skaṃda uvāca || || somanaṃdi prabhṛtiṣu mune paṃcagaṇeṣvapi || ānaṃdakānanaṃ prāpya sthiteṣu sthāṇurabravīt || 4.2.53.60 || kāryamasmākamevaitadyadi samyagvimṛśyate || anenopādhināpyete tatra tiṣṭhaṃtu māmakāḥ || 61 || pramatheṣu praviṣṭeṣu māyāvīryamahatsvapi || ahameva praviṣṭosmi vārāṇasyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 62 || krameṇa preṣayiṣyāmi yosti me svaparicchadaḥ || tatra sarveṣu yāteṣu tato yāsyāmyahaṃ punaḥ || 63 || saṃpradhāryeti hṛdaye devadevena śūlinā || praiṣiṣṭa pramathānāṃ tu tato gaṇacatuṣṭayam || 64 || kuṃḍodaro mayūrākhyo bāṇo gokarṇa eva ca || māyābalaṃ samāśritya kāśīṃ praviviśurgaṇāḥ || 65 || kṛtvopāyaśataṃ taistu divodāsasya saṃbhrame yadaikopi samartho na tadā tatraiva saṃsthitam ||66|| aparādhaśateṣvīśaḥ kena tuṣyati karmaṇā || saṃpradhāryeti te cakrurliṃgārādhanamuttamam || 67 || ekasmiñśāṃbhave liṃge vidhinātra samarcite || kṣamettryakṣoparādhānāṃ śataṃ mokṣaṃ ca yacchati ||68|| na tuṣyati tathā śaṃbhuryajñadānatapovrataiḥ || yathā tuṣyetsakṛlliṃge vidhinābhyarcite sati || 69 || liṃgārcanavidhānajño liṃgārcanarataḥ sadā || tryakṣa eva sa vijñeyaḥ sākṣāddvyakṣopi mānavaḥ || 4.2.53.70 || na gośatapradānena na svarṇaśatadānataḥ || tatphalaṃ labhyate puṃbhiryatsakṛlliṃgapūjanāt || 71 || aśvamedhādibhiryāgairna tatphalamavāpyate || yatphalaṃ labhyate martyairnityaṃ liṃgaprapūjanāt || 72 || snāpayitvā vidhānena yo liṃgasnapanodakam || triḥ pibettrividhaṃ pāpaṃ tasyehāśu praṇaśyati || 73 || liṃga snapanavārbhiryaḥ kuryānmūrdhnyabhiṣecanam || gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ tasya jāyatetra vipāpmanaḥ || 74 || liṃgaṃ samarcitaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaḥ kuryātpraṇatiṃ sakṛt || saṃdeho jāyate tasya punardehanibaṃdhane || 75 || liṃgaṃ yaḥ sthāpayedbhaktyā saptajanmakṛtādaghāt || mucyate nātra saṃdeho viśuddhaḥ svargabhāgbhavet || || 76 || vicāryeti gaṇaiḥ kāśyāṃ svāmidrohopaśāṃtaye || pratiṣṭhitāni liṃgāni mahāpātakabhiṃdyapi || 77 || kuṃḍodareśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā lolārkasannidhau || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||78|| kuṃḍodareśvarālliṃgātpratīcyāmasirodhasi || mayūreśvaramabhyarcya na garbhaṃ pratipadyate ||79|| mayūreśapratīcyāṃ ca liṃgaṃ bāṇeśvaraṃ mahat || tasya darśanamātreṇa sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 4.2.53.80 || gokarṇeśaṃ mahāliṃgamaṃtageṃhasya paścime || dvāre samarcya vai kāśyāṃ na vighnairabhibhūyate || 81 || gokarṇeśvara bhaktasya paṃcatva samaye sati || jñānabhraṃśo na jāyeta kvacidapyaṃtamṛcchataḥ ||82|| || skaṃda uvāca || || cirayatsugaṇeṣveṣu caturṣvapigaṇeśvaraḥ || mahimānaṃ mahattvaṃ tu tatkāśyāḥ paryavarṇayat || 83 || vaiṣṇavyā māyayā viśvaṃ bhrāmyetātra yayākhilam|| dhruvaṃ mūrtimatī saiṣā kāśī viśvaikamohinī || 84 || apāsya sodarāndārānputraṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ vasu || apyaṃgīkṛtya nidhanaṃ sarve kāśīmupāsate || 85|| maraṇādapi no kāśyāṃ bhayaṃ yatra manāgapi || gaṇāstatra tu tiṣṭhaṃtaḥ kuto mattopi bibhyati || 86 || maraṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ yatra vibhūtiryatra bhūṣaṇam || kaupīnaṃ yatra kauśeyaṃ kāśī kutropamīyate || 87 || nirvāṇaramaṇī yatra raṃkaṃ vā'raṃkameva vā || brāhmaṇaṃ vā śvapākaṃ vā vṛṇīte prāṃtyabhūṣaṇam || 88 || mṛtānāṃ yatra jaṃtūnāṃ nirvāṇapadamṛcchatām || koṭyaṃśenāpi na samā api śakrādayaḥ surāḥ || 89 || yatra kāśyāṃ mṛto jaṃturbrahmanārāyaṇādibhiḥ || prabaddha mūrdhāṃjalibhirnamasyetātiyatnataḥ || 4.2.53.90 || yatra kāśyāṃ śavatvepi jaṃturnāśucitāṃ vrajet || atastatkarṇasaṃsparśaṃ karomyahamapi svayam || 91 || yastu kāśīti kāśīti dvistrirjapati puṇyavān || api sarvapavitrebhyaḥ sa pavitrataro mahān || 92 || yena kāśī hṛdi dhyātā yena kāśīha sevitā || tenāhaṃ hṛdi saṃdhyātastenāhaṃ sevitaḥ sadā || 93 || kāśīṃ yaḥ sevate jaṃturnirvikalpena cetasā || tamahaṃ hṛdaye nityaṃ dhārayāmi prayatnataḥ || 94 || svayaṃ vastumaśaktopi vāsayettīrthavāsinam || apyekamapi mūlyena sa vastuḥphalabhāgdhruvam || 95 || kāśyāṃ vasaṃti ye dhīrā āpaṃcatva viniścayāḥ || jīvanmuktāstu te jñeyā vaṃdyāḥ pūjyāsta eva hi || 96 || itthaṃ vimṛśya bahuśaḥ sthāṇurvārāṇasīguṇān || gaṇānanyānsamāhūya prāhiṇotprītipūrvakam || ||97|| tārakatvaṃ samāgaccha gacchāti svacchamānasa || divodāso vṛṣāvāso yāmadhīṣṭe varāṃ purīm ||98|| tilaparṇa sdhūlakarṇa dṛmicaṃḍa prabhāmaya || sukeśa viṃdate chāga kapardinpiṃgalākṣaka ||99|| vīrabhadra kirātākhya caturmukha nikuṃbhaka || paṃcākṣa bhārabhūtākhya tryakṣa kṣemakalāṃgalin || 4.2.53.100 || virādha sumukhāṣāḍhe yāṃtu sarve pṛthakpṛthak || ete gaṇā mahābhāgāḥ svāmibhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ ||101|| kṛtvā māyā bahuvidhā bahurūpā vicakṣaṇāḥ|| animeṣekṣaṇāstasthuḥ kṣoṇīśacchidrakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||102|| aparujñāta tacchidrā vidrāvitayaśodhanāḥ|| āḥ kimetadahojātaṃ niniṃduḥ svamitīha te ||103|| gaṇā ūcuḥ || || dhigasmānsvāminā nityaṃ kṛtasaṃbhāvanānmuhuḥ || manuṣyamātramapyatra yairekaṃ na vaśīkṛtam || 104 || bahumānena dānena sauhārdena mahīyasā || kṛtaprasādāṃstryakṣeṇa dhiṅnastatkāryavaṃcakān ||105|| kā gatirno bhavitrīha svāmikṛtyapramādinām || aṃdhaṃ tamomaye loke dhruvaṃ vāso bhaviṣyati || 106 || akṛtasvāmikāryāṇāmaho jīvitadhāriṇām|| akṣateṃdriyavṛttīnāṃ durgatiśca pade pade || 107 || labdhasaṃbhāvanānāṃ ca nyakkṛtasvāmikarmaṇām || bhṛtyānāṃ bhūribhājāṃ ca bhaṃgurāḥ syurmanorathāḥ || 108 || aniṣpāditakāryārthā ye mukhaṃ prekṣayaṃtyaho || apatrapāḥ puro bhartustairbhūrbhāravatītviyam||109|| nādrīṇāṃ na samudrāṇāṃ na drumāṇāṃ mahīyasām || bhūtadhātryāstathā bhāro yathā svāmidruhāṃ mahān || 4.2.53.110 || aho paurāṇikī gāthā smṛtāsmābhiraniṃditā || tadarthamavalaṃbyeha sthāsyāmaḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ || 111 || anākalitapuṇyānāṃ parikṣīṇadhanāyuṣām || sarvopāyavihīnānāṃ gatirvārāṇasīpurī || 112 || apuṇyabhārakhinnānāṃ paścāttāpamupeyuṣām|| viṣvagūrdhvagatīnāṃ ca gatirvārāṇasīpurī || 113 || svāmidruhaḥ kṛtaghnāśca ye ca viśraṃbhaghātakāḥ || teṣāṃ kvāpi gatirnāsti muktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 114 || itthaṃ niścitya gāthārthaṃ pramathā avatasthire || avijñātasvarūpāśca divodāsena bhūbhujā || || 115 || na bubodha sa bhūpālo nitarāṃ buddhimānapi || vibudhānvividhākāraiḥ sthitānīśaprabhāvataḥ || 116 || citraṃ na citraguptopi vetti vārāṇasīsthitān|| jaṃtūnkā gaṇanānyeṣāṃ martyalokanivāsinām || 117 || avicchinna prabhāvāṇāmaparicchinna tejasām || kṛtaliṃgapratiṣṭhānāṃ nāṃtaṃ prāpnoti dharmarāṭ || 118 || iti te pramathāḥ sarve ghaṭodbhava mahāmune || kṛtaliṃgārcanāḥ kāśīṃ nādyāpyujjhaṃti śarmadām || 119 || tārakeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ tārakākhyo gaṇottamaḥ || tārakajñānadaṃ puṃsāṃ mune'dyāpi samarcayet || 4.2.53.120 || tārakeśvaraliṃgasya kṛtvā bhaktisuniścalām || sukhena tārakajñānaṃ labhyate tairnarottamaiḥ ||121|| tilaparṇeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tilaparṇa pratiṣṭhitam || tilapramāṇamapyatra dṛṣṭvā pāpaṃ na saṃbhavet || 122 || sthūlakarṇeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ paripūjya narottamaḥ || na durgatimavāpnoti puṇyamāpnoti cottamam || || 123 || dṛmicaṃḍeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tathā liṃgaṃ prabhāmayam || ārādhya tatpratīcyāṃ ca na pāpairabhibhūyate || 124|| prabhāmayeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvānyatrāpi saṃsthitaḥ || prabhāmayena yānena śivaloke vrajetsudhīḥ || 125 || sukeśeśvaramabhyarcya harikeśavane naraḥ || ṣāṭkauśikamayaṃ dehaṃ dhārayenna punaḥpunaḥ || 126 || viṃdatīśaṃ narobhyarcya bhīmacaṃḍī samīpataḥ || tyaktvā pracaṃḍamapyeno mokṣaṃ viṃdati śāśvatam || 127 || chāgaleśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ pitrīśvarasamīpagam || vilokya paśuvatkopi na pāpaṃ prākṛtaṃ spṛśet || 128 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṇḍe uttarārddhe vārāṇasīvarṇanaṃ gaṇapreṣaṇaṃ nāma tripaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 || ||
<4.2.54>
skaṃda uvāca || || kuṃbhasaṃbhava vakṣyāmi śṛṇotvavahito bhavān || kapardīśasya liṃgasya mahāmāhātmyamuttamam || 1 || kapardī nāma gaṇapaḥ śaṃbhoratyaṃtavallabhaḥ || pitrīśāduttare bhāge liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya śāṃbhavam ||2|| kuṃḍaṃ cakhāna tasyāgre vimalodaka saṃjñakam || yasya toyasya saṃsparśādvimalo jāyate naraḥ || 3 || itihāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi tatra tretāyuge purā || yathāvṛttaṃ kuṃbhayone śravaṇātpātakāpaham || 4 || ekaḥ pāśupata śreṣṭho vālmīkiriti saṃjñitaḥ || tapaścacāra sa muniḥ kapardīśaṃ samarcayan || 5 || ekadā sa hi hemaṃte mārge māsi tapodhanaḥ || snātvā tatra mahātīrthe madhyāhne vimalodake || 6 || cakāra bhasmanā snānamāpādatalamastakam || liṃgasya dakṣiṇebhāge kṛtamādhyāhnikakriyaḥ || 7 || nyastamastakapāṃsuśca saṃdhyāmādhyātmikīṃ smaran || japanpaṃcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ dhyāyandevaṃ kapardinam || 8 || kṛtvā saṃhāramārgeṇa sapramāṇaṃ pradakṣiṇām || huḍuṃkṛtya huḍuṃkṛtya huḍuṃkṛtya triruccakaiḥ || 9 || praṇavaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā ṣaḍjādisvarabhedataḥ || gītaṃ vidhāya sānaṃdaṃ sanṛtyaṃ hastakānvitam || 4.2.54.10 || aṃgahārairmanohāri cārī maṃḍalasaṃyutam || kṣaṇaṃ tatra sarastīre upaviṣṭo mahātapāḥ || 11 || adrākṣīdrākṣasaṃ ghoramatīva vikṛtākṛtim || śuṣkaśaṃkhakapolāsyaṃ nimagnā piṃgalocanam ||12|| rūkṣasphuṭitakeśāgraṃ mahālaṃba śirodharam || atīva cipiṭa ghrāṇaṃ śuṣkauṣṭhamatidaṃturam || 13 || mahāviśālamauliṃ ca prordhvībhūtaśiroruham || pralaṃbakarṇapālīkaṃ piṃgalaśmaśrubhīṣaṇam || || 14 || pralaṃbita lalajjihvamatyutkaṭa kṛkāṭikam || sthūlāsthi jatru saṃsthānaṃ dīrghaskaṃdhadvayotkaṭam || 15 || nimagnakakṣākuharaṃ śuṣkahrasva bhujadvayam || viralāṃgulihastāgraṃ natapīna nakhāvalim || 16 || viśuṣka pāṃsulotkroḍaṃ pṛṣṭhalagnodaratvacam || kaṭītaṭena vikaṭaṃ nirmāṃsatrikabaṃdhanam || 17 || pralaṃba sphigyugayutaṃ śuṣkamuṣkālpamehanam || dīrghanirmāṃsalorūkaṃ sthūlajānvasthipaṃjaram || 18 || asthicarmāvaśeṣaṃ ca śirājālitavigraham || śirālaṃ dīrghajaṃghaṃ ca sthūlagulphāsthibhīṣaṇam || 19 || ativistṛta pādaṃ ca dīrghavakrakṛśāṃgulim || asthicarmāvaśeṣeṇa śirātāḍitavigraham || 4.2.54.20 || vikaṭaṃ bhīṣaṇākāraṃ kṣutkṣāmamatilomaśam || dāvadagdhadrumākāramati caṃcalalocanam|| 21 || mūrtaṃ bhayānakamiva sarvaprāṇibhayapradam || hṛdayākaṃpanaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ pretaṃ vṛddhatāpasaḥ || atidīnānanaṃ kastvamiti dhairyeṇa pṛṣṭavān|| 22 || kutastvamiha saṃprāptaḥ kasmātte gatirīdṛśī || anukrośadhiyārakṣaḥ pṛcchāmi vada nirbhayam || 23 || asmākaṃ tāpasānāṃ ca na bhayaṃ tvadvidhānmanāk || śivanāmasahasrāṇāṃ vibhūtikṛtavarmaṇām || 24 || tāpasodīritamiti tadrakṣaḥ prītipūvarkam || niśamya prāṃjaliḥ prāha taṃ kṛpāluṃ tapodhanam || 25 || || rākṣasa uvāca || anukrośosti yadi te bhagavaṃstāpasottama || svavṛttāṃtaṃ tadā vacmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ kṣaṇam || 26 || pratiṣṭhānābhidhānosti deśo godāvarī taṭe || tīrthapratigraharucistatrāsaṃ brāhmaṇastvaham || 27 || tena karmavipākena prāptosmi gatimīdṛśīm || marusthale mahāghore tarutoyavivarjite || 28 || gato bahutaraḥ kālastatra me vasato mune || kṣudhitasya tṛṣārtasya śītatāpasahasya ca || 29 || varṣatyapi mahāmeghe dhārāsārairdivāniśam || prāvṛṭkāle'nile vāti kiṃcitprāvaraṇaṃ na me || 4.2.54.30 || parvaṇyadattadānā ye kṛtatīrthapratigrahāḥ || ta imāṃ yonimṛcchaṃti mahāduḥkha nibaṃdhanīm || 31 || gate bahutithe kāle marubhūmau mune mayā || dṛṣṭo brāhmaṇadāyāda ekadā kaścidāgataḥ || 32 || sūryodayamanuprāpya saṃdhyāvidhivivarjitaḥ || kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣe tu śaucācamanavarjitaḥ || 33 || muktakacchamaśaucaṃ ca saṃdhyākarmavivarjitam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā taccharīrehaṃ saṃkrāṃto bhogalipsayā || 34 || sa dvijo maṃdabhāgyānme kenacidvaṇijā saha || arthalobhena saṃprāptaḥ purīṃ puṇyāmimāṃ mune ||35|| aṃtaḥpuri praviṣṭobhūtsa dvijo munisattama || taccharīrādbahirbhūtastvahaṃ pāpaiḥ samaṃ kṣaṇāt ||36|| praveśo nāsti cāsmākaṃ pretānāṃ tapasāṃ nidhe || mahatāṃ pātakānāṃ ca vārāṇasyāṃ śivājñayā ||37|| adyāpi tāni pāpāni tadbahirnirgamecchayā || bahireva hi tiṣṭhaṃti sīmni pramathasādhvasāt ||38|| adya śvo vā paraśvo vā sa bahirnirgamiṣyati || ityāśayā sthitāḥ smo vai yāvadadya tapodhana || 39 || nādyāpi sa bahirgacchennādyāpyāśā prayāti naḥ || ityāsmahe nirādhārā āśāpāśa niyaṃtritāḥ || 4.2.54.40 || citramadyatanaṃ vacmi tapasviṃstanniśāmaya || atīva bhāvi kalyāṇamiti manye'dhunaiva hi || 41 || āprayāgaṃ pratidinaṃ prayāmaḥ kṣudhitā vayam|| āhārakāmyayā kvāpi paraṃ no kiṃcidāpnumaḥ || 42 || saṃti sarvatra phalinaḥ pādapāḥ pratikānanam || jalāśayāśca svacchāpāḥ saṃti bhūmyāṃ padepade || 43 || anyānyapi ca bhakṣyāṇi sarveṣāṃ sulabhānyaho || pānānyapi vicitrāṇi saṃti bhūyāṃsi sarvataḥ || 44 || paraṃ no dṛggatānyeva dūre dūre vrajaṃtyaho || daivādadyaikamāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā kārpaṭikaṃ mune ||45|| tasyāṃtikamahaṃ prāptaḥ kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ || prasahya bhakṣayāmyenamiti matvā tvarānvitaḥ || 46 || yāvattaṃ tu jighṛkṣāmi tāvattadvadanāṃbujāt || śivanāmapavitrā vāṅniragādvighnahāriṇī || 47 || śivanāmasmaraṇato madīyamapi pātakam || maṃdībhūtaṃ tatastena praveśaṃ labdhavānaham || 48 || sīmasthaiḥ pramathairnāhaṃ sadyo dṛggocarīkṛtaḥ || śivanāmaśrutau yeṣāṃ tānna paśyedyamopi yat || 49 || aṃtargehasya sīmānaṃ prāptastena sahādhunā || sa tu kārpaṭiko madhyaṃ praviṣṭohamihasthitaḥ || 4.2.54.50 || ātmānaṃ bahumanyehaṃ tvāṃ vilokyādhunā mune || māmuddhara kṛpālo tvaṃ yonerasmātsadāruṇāt || 51 || iti pretavacaḥ śrutvā sa kṛpālustapodhanaḥ || manasā ciṃtayāmāsa dhiṅnijārthodyamānnarān || 52 || svodaraṃ bhara yaḥ sarve paśupakṣimṛgādayaḥ || sa eva dhanyaḥ saṃsāre yaḥ parārthodyataḥ sadā ||53|| tapasādya nijenāhaṃ pretametamaghāturam|| māmeva śaraṇaṃ prāptamuddhariṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 54 || vimṛśyeti sa vai citte piśācaṃ prāha sattamaḥ || vimalode sarasyasminsnāhi re pāpanuttaye || 55 || piśāca te piśācatvaṃ tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || kapardīśekṣaṇādadya kṣaṇātkṣīṇaṃ vinaṃkṣyati || 56 || śrutveti sa munervākyaṃ pretaḥ prāha praṇamya tam|| prītātmā prītamanasaṃ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ ||57|| pānīyaṃ pātumapi no labheyaṃ munisattama | snānasya kā kathā nātha rakṣeyurjaladevatāḥ ||58|| pānasyāpyatra kā vārtā jalasparśopi durlabhaḥ || iti pretoktamākarṇya sa bhṛśaṃ prītimānabhūt || 59 || uvāca ca tapasvī taṃ jagaduddharaṇakṣamaḥ || gṛhāṇemāṃ vibhūtiṃ tvaṃ lalāṭaphalake kuru || 4.2.54.60 || asmādvibhūtimāhātmyātpreta kopi na kutracit || bādhā karoti kasyāpi mahāpātakinopyaho ||61 || bhālaṃ vibhūtidhavalaṃ vilokya yamakiṃkarāḥ || pāpinopi palāyaṃte bhītāḥ pāśupatāstrataḥ || 62 || asthidhvajāṃkitaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā pāṃthā jalāśayam || dūraṃ yaṃti tathā bhasma bhālāṃkaṃ yamakiṃkarāḥ || 63 || kṛtabhūti tanutrāṇaṃ śivamaṃtrairnarottamam || nopasarpaṃti niyatamapi hiṃsrāḥ samaṃtataḥ || 64 || bhaktyā bibharti yo bhasma śivamaṃtrapavitritam || bhāle vakṣasi dormūle na taṃ hiṃsaṃti hiṃsakāḥ || 65 || sarvebhyo duṣṭasattvebhyo yato rakṣedaharniśam || rakṣatyeṣā tataḥ proktā vibhūtirbhūtikṛdyataḥ || 66 || bhāsanādbhartsanādbhasma pāṃsuḥ pāṃsutvadāyataḥ || pāpānāṃ kṣāraṇātkṣāro budherevaṃ nirucyate || 67 || gṛhītvā dhāramadhyātsa bhasma pretakare'rpayat || sopyādarātsamādāya bhāladeśe nyaveśayat || 68 || vibhūtidhāriṇaṃ vīkṣya piśācaṃ jaladevatāḥ || jalāvagāhanaparaṃ vārayāṃcakrire na tam || 69 || snātvā pītvā sa nirgacchedyāvattasmājjalāśayāt ||. tāvatpaiśācyamagamaddivyadehamavāpa ca || 4.2.54.70|| divyamālāṃbaradharo divyagaṃdhānulepanaḥ || divyayānaṃ samāruhya vartma prāptotha pāvanam || 71 | | gacchatā tena gagane sa tapasvī namaskṛtaḥ || proccaiḥ provāca bhagavanmocitosmi tvayānagha || 72 || tasmātkadaryayonitvādatīva pariniṃditāt || asya tīrthasya māhātmyāddivyadehamavāptavān ||73|| piśācamocanaṃ tīrthamadyārabhya samākhyayā || anyeṣāmapi paiśācyamidaṃ snānāddhariṣyati ||74|| asmiṃstīrthe mahāpuṇye ye snāsyaṃtīha mānavāḥ || piṃḍāṃśca nirvapiṣyaṃti saṃdhyātarpaṇapūrvakam || 75 || daivātpaiśācyamāpannāsteṣāṃ pitṛpitāmahāḥ || tepi paiśācyamutsṛjya yāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim || 76|| adyaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ mārgemāsi taponidhe || atra snānādikaṃ kāryaṃ paiśācyaparimocanama ||77 || imāṃ sāṃvatsarīṃ yātrāṃ ye kariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || tīrthapratigrahātpāpānniḥsariṣyaṃti te narāḥ||78|| piśācamocane snātvā kapardīśaṃ samarcya ca || kṛtvā tatrānnadānaṃ ca naronyatrāpi nirbhayāḥ || 79 || mārgaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ kapardīśvara saṃnidhau || snātvānyatrāpi maraṇānna paiśācyamavāpnuyuḥ || 4.2.54.80 || ityuktvā divyapuruṣo bhūyobhūyo namasya tam || tapodhanaṃ mahābhāgo divyāṃ gatimavāptavān ||81|| tapodhanopi taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ ghaṭodbhava || kapardīśvaramārādhya kālānnirvāṇamāptavān || 82 || piśācamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ tadārabhya mahāmune || vārāṇasyāṃ parāṃ khyātimagamatsarvapāpahṛt || || 83 || paiśācamocane tīrthe saṃbhojya śivayoginam || koṭibhojyaphalaṃ samyagekaika parisaṃkhyayā || 84 || śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ naro niyatamānasaḥ || bhūtaiḥ pretaiḥ piśācaiśca kadācinnābhibhūyate || 85 || bālagrahābhibhūtānāṃ bālānāṃ śāṃtikārakam || paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnena mahākhyānamidaṃ param || 86 || idamākhyānamākarṇya gacchandeśāṃtaraṃ naraḥ || coravyāghrapiśācādyairnābhibhūyeta kutracit || 87 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārddhe piśācamocanamahimākathanaṃ nāma catuṣpaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||54||
<4.2.55>
|| skaṃda uvāca || anyepi ye gaṇāstatra kāśyāṃ liṃgāni cakrire || tāṃśca te kathayiṣyāmi kuṃbhayone niśāmaya || 1 || gaṇena piṃgalākhyena piṃgalākhyeśasaṃjñitam || liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ śaṃbhoḥ kapardīśādudagdiśi ||2|| tasya darśanamātreṇa pāpānāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ || vīrabhadro mahāprīto devadevasya śūlinaḥ || 3 || vīrabhadreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dhyāyedadyāpi niścalaḥ || tasya darśanamātreṇa vīrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 4 || avimukteśvarātpaścādvīrabhadreśvaraṃ naraḥ || samarcya na raṇe bhaṃgaṃ kadācidapi cāpnuyāt || 5 || vīrabhadraḥ svayaṃ sākṣādvīramūrtidharo mune || saṃharedviprasaṃghātamavimuktanivāsināma || 6 || bhadrayā bhadrakālyā ca bhāryayā śubhayā yutam || vīrabhadraṃ narobhyarcya kāśīvāsaphalaṃ labhet || 7 || kirātena kirāteśaṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam || kedārāddakṣiṇe bhāge bhaktānāmabhayapradam || 8 || caturmukho gaṇaḥ śrīmānvṛddhakāleśa sannidhau || caturmukheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dhyāyedadyāpi niścalaḥ || 9 || bhaktāścaturmukheśasya caturānanavaddivi || pūjyaṃte surasaṃghātaiḥ sarvabhogasamanvitāḥ|| 4.2.55.10|| nikuṃbheśvaramālokya nikuṃbhagaṇapūjitam || pūjayitvā vrajangrāmaṃ kāryasiddhimavāpnuyāt || kubereśa samīpetu śivaloke mahīyate || 11 || paṃcākṣeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ mahādevasya dakṣiṇe || samabhyarcya naraḥ kāśyāṃ jātismṛtimavāpnuyāt || 12 || bhārabhūteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ bhārabhūtagaṇārcitam|| aṃtargṛhottaradvāri dhyātvā śivapure vaset || 13 || bhārabhūteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ yaiḥ kāśyāṃ na vilokitam || bhārabhūtāḥ pṛthivyāste'vakeśina iva drumāḥ || 14 || gaṇena tryakṣasaṃjñena liṃgaṃ tryakṣeśvaraṃ param || trilocanapurobhāge śīlyetādyāpi kuṃbhaja || 15 || tasya liṃgasya ye bhaktāste tu dehāvasānataḥ || tryakṣā eva prajāyaṃte nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 16 || kṣemako nāma gaṇapaḥ kāśyāṃ mūrtidharaḥ svayam || viśveśvaraṃ sarvagataṃ dhyāyedadyāpi niścalaḥ ||17|| kṣemakaṃ pūjayedyastu vārāṇasyāṃ mahāgaṇam || vighnāstasya pralīyaṃte kṣemaṃ syācca padepade || 18 || deśāṃtaraṃ gato yastu tasyāgamanakāmyayā || kṣemakaṃ pūjanīyotra kṣemeṇāśu sa āvrajet ||19|| lāṃgalīśvaramālokya liṃgaṃ lāṃgalinārcitam || viśveśāduttarebhāge na naro rogabhāgbhavet ||4.2.55.20 || lāṃgalīśaṃ sakṛtpūjya paṃcalāṃgaladānajam || phalaṃ prāpnotyavikalaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ param || 21 || virādheśvaramārādhya virādhagaṇapūjitam|| sarvāparādhayuktopi nāparādhyati kutracit || 22 || dinedineparādho yaḥ kriyate kāśivāsibhiḥ || sa yāti saṃkṣayaṃ kṣipraṃ virādheśa samarcanāt || 23 || nairṛte daṃḍhapāṇastu virādheśaṃ prayatnataḥ|| natvā sarvāparādhebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ||24|| sumukheśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sumukhākhyagaṇārcitam || paścimābhimukhaṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 25 || snātvā pilipilā tīrthe sumukheśaṃ vilokya ca || sadaiva sumukhaṃ paśyeddharmarājaṃ na durmukham || 26 || āṣāḍhinārcitaṃ liṃgamāṣāḍhīśvarasaṃjñakam || dṛṣṭvāṣāḍhayāṃ naro bhaktyā sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 27 || udīcyāṃ bhārabhūteśādāṣāḍhīśaṃ samarcayan || āṣāḍhyāṃ paṃcadaśyāṃ vai na pāpaiḥ paritapyate || 28 || śuciśuklacaturdaśyāṃ paṃcadaśyāmathāpi vā || kṛtvā sāṃvatsarīṃ yātrāmanenā jāyate naraḥ || 29 || || skaṃda uvāca || || mune gaṇeṣu caiteṣu vārāṇasyāṃ sthiteṣviti || svanāmnā sthāpya liṃgāni viśveśaparituṣṭaye || || 4.2.55.30 || viśveśaściṃtayāṃ cakre punaḥ kāśīpravṛttaye || kaṃ vā hitaṃ prahityādya nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ bhaje || 31 || yoginyastigmagurvedhāḥ śaṃkukarṇamukhāgaṇāḥ || vyāvṛttyanāgatāḥ kāśyāḥ siṃdhugā iva siṃdhavaḥ || 32 || dhuvaṃ kāśyāṃ praviṣṭā ye te praviṣṭā mamodare || teṣāṃ vinirgamo nāsti dīptegnau haviṣāmiva || 33 || yeṣāṃ hi saṃsthitiḥ kāśyāṃ liṃgārcanaratātmanām || ta eva mama liṃgāni jaṃgamāni na saṃśayaḥ || 34 || sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ kāśyāmacetanasacetanāḥ || sarve mamaiva liṃgāni tebhyo druhyaṃti durdhiyaḥ || 35 || vāci vārāṇasī yeṣāṃ śrutau vaiśveśvarī kathā || ta eva kāśī liṃgāni varāṇyarcyānyahaṃ yathā || 36 || vārāṇasīti kāśīti rudrāvāsa iti sphuṭam || mukhādvinirgataṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ na prabhavedyamaḥ || 37 || ānaṃdakānanaṃ prāpya ye nirānaṃdabhūmikām || anyāṃ hṛdāpi vāṃchaṃti nirānaṃdāḥ sadātra te || 38 || adyaiva vāstumaraṇaṃ bahukālāṃtarepi vā|| kalikāla bhiyā puṃsāṃ kāśī tyājyā na karhicit || 39 || avaśyaṃbhāvino bhāvā bhaviṣyaṃti padepade || salakṣmīnilayāṃ kāśīṃ te tyajaṃti kuto dhiyaḥ || 4.2.55.40 || varaṃ vighnasahasrāṇi soḍhavyāni padepade || kāśyāṃ nānyatra nirvighnaṃ vāṃchedrājyamapi kvacit || 41 || kiyannimeṣasaṃbhogyāḥ saṃti lakṣmyāḥ padepade || paraṃ niraṃtarasukhā'mutrāpyatrāpi kā śikā || 42 || viśvanātho hyahaṃ nāthaḥ kāśikāmuktikāśikā || sudhātaraṃgā svargaṃgā trayyeṣā kinna yacchati || 43 || paṃcakrośyāparimitā tanureṣā purī mama || avicchinnapramāṇardhirbhaktanirvāṇakāraṇam || 44 || saṃsārabhārakhinnānāṃ yātāyātakṛtāṃ sadā || ekaiva me purī kāśī dhruvaṃ viśrāmabhṛmikā || 45 || maṃḍapaḥ kalpavallīnāṃ manorathaphalairalam || phalitaḥ kāśikākhyoyaṃ saṃsārādhvajuṣāṃ sadā || 46 || cakravarteriyaṃ chatraṃ vicitraṃ sarvatāpahṛt || kāśīnirvāṇarājasya mamaśūlocca daṃḍavat || 47 || nirvāṇalakṣmīṃ ye puṇyāḥ parivāṃchaṃti līlayā || niraṃtarasukhaprāptyai kāśī tyājyā na tai nṛbhiḥ || 48 || mamānaṃdavane ye vai niraṃ tara vanaukasaḥ || mokṣalakṣmīphalānyatra susvādūni labhaṃti te ||49|| nirmamaṃ cāpi nirmohaṃ yā māmapi vimohayet || kairna saṃsmaraṇīyā sā kāśī viśvavimohinī|| || 4.2.55.50 || nāmāpi madhuraṃ yasyāḥ parānaṃdaprakāśakam || kāśyāḥ kāśīti kāśīti sā kaiḥ puṇyairna japyate || 51 || kāśīnāmasudhāpānaṃ ye kurvaṃti niraṃtaram || teṣāṃ vartma bhavatyeva sudhāma vasudhāmayam || 52 || mamatārahitasyāpi mama sarvātmano dhruvam || ta eva māmakā loke ye kāśīnāma jāpakāḥ || 53 || rahasyamiti vijñāya vārāṇasyā gaṇeśvaraiḥ || sabrahmayoginī bradhraiḥ sthitaṃ tatraiva nānyathā || 54 || anyathā tāśca yoginyaḥ saraviḥ sapitāmahaḥ || te gaṇā māṃ parityajya kathaṃ tiṣṭheyuranyataḥ || 55 || atīva bhadraṃ saṃjātaṃ kāśyāṃ tiṣṭhatsu teṣu hi || ekopi bheda prabhavedrājye rājyāṃtaraṃ vinā || 56 || labdhapraveśāstāvaṃtaste sarve matsvarūpiṇaḥ || yatiṣyaṃti yatovaśyaṃ madāgamanahetave ||57|| anyānapi preṣayāmi matpārśvaparivartinaḥ || ye te tatra sthitāḥ śreṣṭhā apigaṃtāsmyahaṃ tataḥ || 58 || vicāryeti mahādevaḥ samāhūya gajānanam || prāhiṇotkathayitveti gaccha kāśīmitaḥ suta || 59 || tatrasthitopi saṃsiddhayai yatasva sahito gaṇaiḥ || nirvighnaṃ kuru cāsmākaṃ nṛpe vighnaṃ samācara || 4.2.55.60 || ādhāya śāsanaṃ mūrdhni gaṇādhīśotha dhūrjaṭeḥ || pratasthe tvaritaḥ kāśīṃ sthitijñaḥ sthitihetave ||61|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe uttarārddhe kāśīvarṇana gaṇeśapreṣaṇaṃ nāma paṃcapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||55||
<4.2.56>
||skaṃda uvāca|| || atheśājñāṃ samādāya gajavaktraḥ pratasthivān || śaṃbhoḥ kāśyāgamopāyaṃ ciṃtayanmaṃdarādritaḥ || 1 || prāpya vārāṇasīṃ tūrṇamāśu syaṃdanago vibhuḥ || vāḍavīṃ mūrtimālaṃbya prāviśacchakunaiḥ stutaḥ || 2 || nakṣatrapāṭhako bhūtvā vṛddhaḥ pratyavarodhagaḥ || cacāra madhye nagaraṃ paurāṇāṃ prītimāvahan ||3|| svayameva niśābhāge svapnaṃ saṃdarśayannṛṇām || prātasteṣāṃ gṛhāngatvā teṣāṃ vakti balābalam || 4 || bhavadbhiradya rātrau yaddṛṣṭaṃ svapnaviceṣṭitam || bhavatkautūhalotpattyai tadeva kathayāmyaham || 5 || svapatā bhavatā rātrau turye yāme mahāhradaḥ || adarśi tatra ca bhavānmajjanmajjaṃstaṭaṃgataḥ || 6 || tadaṃbupicchile paṃke magnonmagnosi bhūriśaḥ || duḥsvapnasyāsya ca mahānvipākoti bhayapradaḥ || 7 || kāṣāyavasano muṃḍaḥ praikṣyaho bhavatāpi yaḥ || paritāpaṃ mahāneṣa janayiṣyati dāruṇam || 8 || rātrau sūryagraho dṛṣṭo mahāniṣṭakaro dhruvam || aiṃdradhanurdvayaṃ rātrau yadaloki na tacchubham || 9 || pratīcyāṃ ravirāgatya prodyaṃtaṃ vyomni śītagum || pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe tadrājyabhayasūcakam || 4.2.56.10 || yugapatketuyugalaṃ yudhyamānaṃ parasparam || yadadarśi na tadbhadraṃ rāṣṭrabhaṃgāya kevalam || 11 || viśīryatkeśadaśanaṃ nīyamānaṃ ca dakṣiṇe || ātmānaṃ yatsamadrākṣīḥ kuṭuṃbasyāpi bhīṣaṇam || 12 || prāsādadhvajabhaṃgoyastvayaikṣata niśākṣaye || rājyakṣayakaraṃ viddhi mahotpātāya niścitam || 13 || nagarī plāvitā svapne taraṃgaiḥ kṣīranīradheḥ || pakṣaistricaturaiḥ śaṃke mahāśaṃkāṃ puraukasām || 14 || svapne vānarayānena yattvamūḍhosi dakṣiṇām || atastadvaṃcanopāyaḥ puratyāgo mahāmate || 15 || rudatī yā tvayā dṛṣṭā mahilaikā niśātyaye || muktakeśī vivasanā sā nārī śrīrivodgatā || 16 || devālayasya kalaśo yattvayā vīkṣitaḥ patan || dinaiḥ katipayaireva rājyabhaṃgo bhaviṣyati || 17 || purī parivṛtā svapne mṛgayūthaiḥ samaṃtataḥ || rorūyamāṇairatyarthaṃ māsenaivodvasī bhavet || 18 || ātāyiyūkagṛdhrādyaiḥ purīmuparicāribhiḥ || sūcyatetyāhitaṃ kiṃciddhruvamatra nivāsinām ||19|| svapnotpātāniti bahūñśaṃsañśaṃsannitastataḥ || bahūnuccāṭayāṃcakre sa vighneśaḥ puraukasaḥ || 4.2.56.20 || keṣāṃcitpurato vādīdgrahacāraṃ pradarśayan || ekarāśisthitāḥ sauri sitabhaumā na śobhanāḥ || 21 || soyaṃ dhūmagraho vyomni bhittvā saptarṣimaṃḍalam || prayātaḥ paścimāmāśāṃ sa nāśāya viśāṃpateḥ || 22 || aticāragato maṃdaḥ punarvakrādhva saṃsthitaḥ || pāpagrahasamāyukto na yuktoyamiheṣyate || 23 || vyatīte vāsare yoyaṃ bhūkaṃpaḥ samapadyata || kaṃpaṃ janayate'tīva hṛdo mepi puraukasaḥ || 24 || udīcyādakṣiṇāśāyāṃ yeyamulkā pradhāvitā || vilīnā ca viyatyeva sa nirghātaṃ na sā śubhā || 25 || unmūlito mahāmūlo mahānilarayeṇa yaḥ || catvare caityavṛkṣoyaṃ mahotpātaṃ praśaṃsati || 26 || sūryodayamanuprāpya prācyāṃ śuṣkatarūpari || karaṭo rāraṭītyeṣa kaṭūtkaṭa bhayapradaḥ || 27 || madhye vipaṇi yatūrṇaṃ kauciccāraṇyacāriṇau || mṛgau mṛgayatāṃ yātau paurāṇāṃ purato'hitau ||28|| rasālaśālamukulaṃ vīkṣyate yaccharadyadaḥ || mahākālabhayaṃ manyepyakālepi puraukasām || 29 || sādhvasaṃjanayitveti keciduccāṭitāḥ puraḥ || tena vighnakṛtāpaurāḥ kapaṭadvijarūpiṇā|| 4.2.56.30 || atha madhyevarodhaṃ sa praviśya nijamāyayā || dṛṣṭārthameva kathayanstrīṇāṃ visraṃbhabhūrabhūt ||31|| tava putraśataṃ jajñe saptonaṃ śubhalakṣaṇe || teṣvekasturagārūḍho bāhyālyāṃ patito mṛtaḥ || 32 || aṃtarvatnī tviyaṃ kanyā janayiṣyati śobhanām || eṣā hi durbhagā pūrvaṃ sāṃprataṃ subhagā'bhavat || 33 || asau hi rājño rājñīnāmatyaṃtamihavallabhā|| muktālaṃkṛtiretasyai rājñā dattā nijorasaḥ || 34 || paṃcasaptadinānyeva jātānītīha tarkyate || asyai rājñā prasādena grāmau dātumudīritau || 35|| iti dṛṣṭārthakathanai rājñīmānyobhavaddvijaḥ || varṇayaṃti ca tā rājñaḥ parokṣepi guṇānbahūn || 36 || aho yādṛgasau vipraḥ sarvatrātivicakṣaṇaḥ || suśīlaśca surūpaśca satyavāṅmitabhāṣaṇaḥ || 37 || alolupa udāraśca sadācāro jiteṃdriyaḥ || api svalpena saṃtuṣṭaḥ pratigrahaparāṅmukhaḥ || 38 || jitakrodhaḥ prasannāsyastvanasūyuravaṃcakaḥ || kṛtajñaḥ prītisumukhaḥ parivādaparāṅmukhaḥ ||39|| puṇyopadeṣṭā puṇyātmā sarvavrataparāyaṇaḥ || śuciḥ śucicaritraśca śrutismṛtiviśāradaḥ || || 4.2.56.40 || dhīraḥ puṇyetihāsajñaḥ sarvadṛksarvasaṃmataḥ || kalākalāpakuśalo jyotiḥśāstraviduttamaḥ || 41 || kṣamī kulīno'kṛpaṇo bhoktā nirmalamānasaḥ || ityādi guṇasaṃpannaḥ kopi kvāpi na dṛggataḥ || 42 || itthaṃ tāstadguṇagrāmaṃ varṇayaṃtyaḥ padepade || kālaṃ vinodayaṃti sma aṃtaḥpuracarāḥ striyaḥ || 43|| ekadāvasaraṃ prāpya divodāsasya bhūbhujaḥ || rājñī līlāvatī nāma rājñe taṃ vinyavedayat || 44 || rājanvṛddho guṇairvṛddho brāhmaṇaḥ suvicakṣaṇaḥ || ekosti sa tu draṣṭavyo mūrto brahmanidhiḥ paraḥ || 45 || rājñī rājñā kṛtānujñā sakhīṃ preṣya vicakṣaṇām || ānināya ca taṃ vipraṃ brāhmaṃ teja ivāṃgavat || 46 || rājāpi dūrādāyāṃtaṃ ta vilokyamahīsuram || yatrākṛtirguṇāstatra jaharṣeti vadanhṛdi || 47 || padairdvitrairnṛpatinā kṛtābhyutthānasatkṛtiḥ || caturnigamajābhiḥ sa tamāśīrbhiranaṃdayat || 48 || kṛtapraṇāmo rājñā sa sādaraṃ dattamāsanam || bhejetha kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ sa rājñā tena bhūpatiḥ || 49 || parasparaṃ kuśalinau kuśalau ca kathāgame || praśnottarābhyāṃ saṃtuṣṭau dvijavarya kṣamābhṛtau || 4.2.56.50 || kathāvasāne rājñātha gehaṃ visasṛje dvijaḥ || labdhamānamahāpūjaḥ sa svamāśramamāviśat || 51 || gate'tha svāśramaṃ vipre divodāso nareśvaraḥ || līlāvatyāḥ puro vipraṃ varṇayāmāsa bhūriśaḥ || 52 || mahādevi mahāprājñe līlāvati guṇapriye || yathāśaṃsi tathā viprastatopi guṇavattaraḥ || 53 || atītaṃ vetti sakalaṃ vartamānamavaiti ca || praṣṭavyaḥ prātarāhūya bhaviṣyaṃ kiṃcideṣa vai || 54 || mahāvibhava saṃbhārairmahābhogairanekadhā || vyuṣṭāyāṃ sa nṛpo rātryāṃ prātarāhūtavāndvijam || 55 || satkṛtya taṃ dvijaṃ bhaktyā dukūlādi pradānataḥ || ekāṃte taṃ dvijaṃ rājā papraccha nijahṛtsthitam ||56|| ||rājovāca || || dvijavaryo bhavānekaḥ pratibhātīti niścitam || yathātattvavatī te dhīrna tathānyasya me matiḥ ||57|| dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ tu mahāprājñaṃ śāṃtaṃ dāṃtaṃ taponidhim || kiṃcitpraṣṭumanā vipra tadākhyāhi yathārthavat || 58 || śāsiteyaṃ mayā pṛthvī na tathānyaistu pārthivaiḥ || yāvadbhūti mayā bhuktā divyā bhogā anekadhā ||59|| nijaurasebhyopyadhikaṃ rātriṃdivamataṃdritam || vinirjitya haṭhādduṣṭānprajeyaṃ paripālitā ||4.2.56.60|| dvijapādārcanātkiṃcitsukṛtaṃ vedmi nāparam || anenāparikathyena kathiteneha kiṃ mama || 61 || nirvismamiva me cetaḥ sāṃprataṃ sarvakarmasu || vicāryārya śubhodarkamata ākhyāhi sattama ||62|| || dvija uvāca || || api svalpataraṃ kṛtyaṃ yadbhavedbhūbhujāmiha || ekāṃte tattu pṛṣṭena vaktavyaṃ sudhiyā sadā || 63 || amātyenāpyapṛṣṭena na vaktavyaṃ nṛpāgrataḥ || mahāpamānabhītena stokamapyatra kiṃcana || 64 || pṛṣṭaścetkathayāmīha mā tatra kuru saṃśayam || tatkṛte tava gaṃtā vai mano nirvedakāraṇam ||65|| śṛṇu rājanmahābuddhe nāyathārthaṃ bravīmyaham || vikrāṃtosyatiśūrosi bhāgyavānasi sarvadā || 66 || puṇyena yaśasā buddhyā saṃpannosti bhavānyathā || manye tathāmarāvatyāṃ tridaśeśopi naiva hi || 67 || sudhiyā tvāṃ guruṃ manye prasādena sudhākaram || tejasāsti bhavānarkaḥ pratāpenāśuśukṣaṇiḥ ||68|| prabhaṃjano balenāsi śrīdosi śrīsamarpaṇaiḥ || śāsanena bhavānrudro nirṛtistvaṃ raṇāṃgaṇe ||69 || duṣṭapāśayitā pāśī yamo niyamane'satām || iṃdanāttvaṃ maheṃdrosi kṣamayā tvamasi kṣamā || 4.2.56.70 || maryādayā bhavānabdhirmahattve himavānasi || bhārgavo rājanītyāsi rājyena manunā samaḥ || 71 || saṃtāpahartāṃbudavatpavitro gāṃganāmavat || sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ kāśīva sugatipradaḥ ||72|| rudraḥ saṃhārarūpeṇa pālanena caturbhujaḥ || vidhivattvaṃ vidhātāsi bhāratī te mukhāṃbuje || 73 || tvatpāṇipadme kamalā tvatkrodhesti halāhalaḥ || amṛtaṃ tava vāgeva tvadbhujāvaśvinīsutau || 74 || tatkiṃ yattvayi bhūjānau sarvadevamayo hyasi || tasmāttava śubhodarko mayā jñātosti tattvataḥ || 75 || ārabhyādya dinādbhūpa brāhmaṇo'ṣṭādaśehani || udīcyaḥ kaścidāgatya dhruvaṃ tvāmupadekṣyati||76|| tasya vākyaṃ tvayā rājankartavyamavicāritam || tataste hṛtsthitaṃ sarvaṃ setsyatyeva mahāmate || 77 || ityuktvā pṛcchya rājānaṃ labdhānujño dvijottamaḥ || viveśa svāśramaṃ tuṣṭo nṛpopyāścaryavānabhūt || 78 || itthaṃ vighnajitā sarvā purī svātmavaśīkṛtā || sapaurā sāvarodhā ca sanṛpā nijamāyayā || 79 || kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ tato matvā sa vighnajit || vidhāya bahudhātmānaṃ kāśyāṃ sthitimavāpa ca || 4.2.56.80 || yadā sa na divodāsaḥ prāgāsītkuṃbhasaṃbhava || tadātanaṃ nijaṃ sthānamalaṃcakre gaṇādhipaḥ || 81 || divodāse narapatau viṣṇunoccāṭite sati || punarnavīkṛtāyāṃ ca nagaryāṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 82 || svayamāgatya devena maṃdarātsuṃdarāṃ purīm || vārāṇasīṃ prathamatastuṣṭuve gaṇanāyakam || 83 || || agastya uvāca || || kathaṃ stuto bhagavatā devadevena vighnajit || kathaṃ ca bahudhātmānaṃ sa cakāra vināyakaḥ || 84 || kenakena sa vai nāmnā kāśipuryāṃ vyavasthitaḥ || iti sarvaṃ samāsena kathayasva ṣaḍānana || 85 || ityudīritamākarṇya kuṃbhayoneḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ || yathāvatkathayāmāsa gaṇarāja kathāṃ śubhām || 86 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārddhe gaṇeśamāyā prapaṃco nāma ṣaṭpaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 56||
<4.2.57>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || viśveśo viśvayā sārdhaṃ mayā ca munisattama || mahāśākhaviśākhābhyāṃ naṃdibhṛṃgipurogamaḥ || 1 || naigameyena sahito rudraiḥ sarvatra saṃvṛtaḥ || devarṣibhiḥ samāyuktaḥ sanakādyairabhiṣṭutaḥ || 2 || samastāyatanādhīśairdikpālairabhinaṃditaḥ || tīrthairdarśita tīrthaśca gaṃdharvairgītamaṃgalaḥ || 3 || kṛtapūjopsarobhiśca nṛtyahastakapallavaiḥ || viyatyanāhatairvādyaiḥ samaṃtādanumoditaḥ || 4|| ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmanirghoṣairbadhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ|| kṛtastutiścāraṇaughairvimānairabhitovṛtaḥ || 5 || triviṣṭapa vadhūmuṣṭibhraṣṭairlājairitastataḥ || abhivṛṣṭo mahādevaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || 6 || dattamālyopahāraśca bahuvidyādharī gaṇaiḥ || yakṣaguhyakasiddhaiśca khecarairabhinaṃditaḥ || 7 || kṛtapraveśa śakuno mṛgaiḥ śakunibhiḥ puraḥ || kiṃnarībhiḥ prahaṣṭāsyaiḥ kiṃnarairupavarṇitaḥ || 8 || viṣṇunā ca mahālakṣmyā brahmaṇā viśvakarmaṇā || naṃdinātha gaṇeśena āviṣkṛtamahotsavaḥ || 9 || nāgāṃganābhiḥ paritaḥ kṛtanīrājanāvidhiḥ || praviveśa mahādevaḥ purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām || 4.2.57.10 || paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāmavaruhya vṛṣeṃdrataḥ || pariṣvajya gaṇādhīśaṃ provāca vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 11 || yadahaṃ prāptavānasmi purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām || mayāpyatīva duṣprāpyāṃ sa prasādo sya vai śiśoḥ || 12 || yadduṣprasādhyaṃ hi piturapi trijagatītale || tatsūnunā susādhyaṃ syādatra dṛṣṭāṃtatā mayi || 13 || anena gajavaktreṇa svabuddhivibhaveriha || kāśīprāptiryathā me syāttathā kiṃcidanuṣṭhitam || 14 || putravānahamevāsmi yacca me ciraciṃtitam || svapauruṣeṇa kṛtavānabhilāṣaṃ karasthitam || 15 || ityuktvā tripurīhartā puruhūtādibhiḥ stutaḥ || parituṣṭāvasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ spaṣṭagīrbhirgajānanam || 16 || || śrīkaṃṭha uvāca || || jaya vighnakṛtāmādya bhaktanirvighnakāraka || avighnavighnaśamana mahāvighnaikavighnakṛt || 17 || jaya sarvagaṇādhīśa jaya sarva gaṇāgraṇīḥ || gaṇapraṇatapādābja gaṇanātītasadguṇa || 18 || jaya sarvaga sarveśa sarvabuddhyekaśevadhe || sarvamāyāprapaṃcajña sarvakarmāgrapūjita || 19 || sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalya jaya tvaṃ sarvamaṃgala || amaṃgalopaśamana mahāmaṃgalahetuka || 4.2.57.20 || jaya sṛṣṭikṛtāṃ vaṃdya jaya sthitikṛtānata || jaya saṃhṛtikṛtstutya jayasatkarmasiddhida || 21 || siddhavaṃdyapadāṃbhoja jayasiddhividhāyaka || sarvasiddhyekanilaya mahāsiddhyṛddhisūcaka ||22|| aśeṣaguṇanirmāṇa guṇātīta guṇāgraṇī || paripūrṇacaritrārtha jaya tvaṃ guṇavarṇita || 23 || jaya sarvabalādhīśa balārāti balaprada || balākojjvala daṃtāgra bālābālaparākama || 24 || anaṃtamahimādhāra dharādhara vidāraṇa|| daṃtāgraprotāṃ daṅnāga jayanāgavibhūṣaṇa|| 25|| ye tvāṃnamaṃti karuṇāmaya divya mūrte sarvainasāmapi bhuvo bhuvimuktibhājaḥ|| teṣāṃ sadaiva harasīhamahopasargānsvargāpavargamapi saṃpradadāsi tebhyaḥ || 26 || ye vighnarāja bhavatā karuṇākaṭākṣaiḥ saṃprekṣitāḥ kṣititale kṣaṇamātramatra || teṣāṃ kṣayaṃti sakalānyapikilviṣāṇi lakṣmīḥ kaṭākṣayatitānpuruṣottamānhi || 27 || ye tvāṃ stuvaṃti natavighnavighātadakṣa dākṣāyaṇīhṛdayapaṃkajatigmaraśme || śrūyaṃta eva ta iha prathitā na citraṃ citraṃ tadatra gaṇapā yadaho ta eva || 28 || ye śīlayaṃti satataṃ bhavatoṃghriyugmaṃ te putrapautradhanadhānyasamṛddhibhājaḥ || saṃśīlitāṃghrikamalā bahubhṛtyavargairbhūpālabhogyakamalāṃ vimalāṃ labhaṃte || 29 || tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ paramakāraṇakāraṇānāṃ vedyosi vedaviduṣāṃ satataṃ tvamekaḥ || tvaṃ mārgaṇīyamasi kiṃcana mūlavācāṃ vācāmagocaracarācaradivyamūrte || 4.2.57.30 || vedā vidaṃti na yathārthatayā bhavaṃtaṃ brahmādayopi na carācara sūtradhāra || tvaṃ haṃsi pāsi vidadhāsi samastamekaḥ kastestutivyatikaro manasāpyagamya || 31 || tvadduṣṭadṛṣṭiviśikhairnihatānnihanmi daityānpurāṃdhakajalaṃdharamukhyakāṃśca|| kasyāsti śaktiriha yastvadṛtepi tucchaṃ vāṃchedvidhātu miha siddhidakāryajātam || 32 || anveṣaṇe ḍhuṃḍhirayaṃ prathitostidhātuḥ sarvārthaḍhuṃḍhitatayā tava ḍhuṃḍhi nāma || kāśīpraveśamapi ko labhatetra dehī toṣaṃ vinā tava vināyakaḍhuṃḍhirāja || 33 || ḍhuṃḍhe praṇamyapuratastavapādapadmaṃ yo māṃ namasyati pumāniha kāśivāsī || tatkarṇamūlamadhigamya purā diśāmi tatkiṃcidatra na punarbhavatāsti yena || 34 || snātvā naraḥ prathamato maṇikarṇikāyāmuddhūlitāṃghriyugalastu sacailamāśu || devarṣimānavapitṝnapi tarpayitvā jñānodatīrthamabhilabhya bhajettatastvām || 35 || sāmodamodakabharairvaradhūpadīpairmālyaiḥ sugaṃdhabahulairanulepanaiśca || saṃprīṇyakāśinagarīphaladānadakṣaṃ proktvātha māṃ ka iha sidhyati naiva ḍhuṃḍhe || 36 || tīrthāṃtarāṇi ca tataḥ kramavarjitopi saṃsādhayanniha bhavatkaruṇākaṭākṣaiḥ || dūrīkṛtasvahitaghātyupasargavargo ḍhuṃḍhe labhedavikalaṃ phalamatra kāśyām|| 37 || yaḥ pratyahaṃ namati ḍhuṃ ḍhivināyakaṃ tvāṃ kāśyāṃ prage pratihatākhilavighnasaṃghaḥ || no tasya jātu jagatītalavarti vastu duṣprāpamatra ca paratra ca kiṃcanāpi || 38 || yo nāma te japati ḍhuṃḍhivināyakasya taṃ vai japaṃtyanudinaṃ hṛdi siddhayoṣṭau || bhogānvibhujya vividhānvibudhopabhogyānnirvāṇayā kamalayā vriyate sa cāṃte || 39 || dūre sthitopyaharahastava pādapīṭhaṃ yaḥ saṃsmaretsakalasiddhida ḍhuṃḍhirāja || kāśīsthite ravikalaṃ saphalaṃ labheta naivānyathā na vitathā mama vākkadācit || 4.2.57.40 || jāne vighnānasaṃkhyātānvinihaṃtumanekadhā || kṣetrasyāsya mahābhāga nānārūpairihasthitaḥ || 41 || yāni yāni ca rūpāṇi yatrayatra ca tenagha || tāni tatra pravakṣyāmi śṛṇvaṃtvete divaukasaḥ || 42 || prathamaṃ ḍhuṃḍhirājosi mama dakṣiṇato manāk || āḍhuṃḍhya sarvabhaktebhyaḥ sarvārthānsaṃprayacchasi || 43 || aṃgāravāsaravatīmiha yaiścaturthīṃ saṃprāpya modakabharaiḥ parimodavadbhiḥ || pūjā vyadhāyi vividhā tava gaṃdhamālyaistānatra putravidadhāmi gaṇāngaṇeśa || 44 || ye tvāmiha prati caturthi samarcayaṃti ḍhuṃḍhe vigāḍhamatayaḥ kṛtinasta eva || sarvāpadāṃ śirasi vāmapadaṃ nidhāya samyaggajānana gajānanatāṃ labhaṃte || 45 || māghaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu naktavrataparāyaṇāḥ || ye tvāṃ ḍhuṃḍhercayiṣyaṃti te'rcyāḥ syurasuradruhām ||46|| vidhāya vārṣikīṃ yātrāṃ caturthīṃ prāpya tāpasīm || śuklāṃ śuklatilairbaddhvā prāśnīyāllaḍḍukānvratī || 47 || kāryā yātrā prayatnena kṣetrasiddhimabhīpsubhiḥ || tasyāṃ caturthyāṃ tvatprītyai ḍhuṃḍhe sarvopasargahṛt || 48 || tāṃ yātrāṃ nātrayaḥ kuryānnaivedyatilalaḍukaiḥ || upasargasahasraistu sa haṃtavyo mamājñayā || 49 || homaṃ tilājyadravyeṇa yaḥ kariṣyati bhaktitaḥ || tasyāṃ caturthyāṃ maṃtrajñastasya maṃtraḥ prasetsyati || 4.2.57.50 || vaidiko'vaidiko vāpi yo maṃtraste gajānana || japtastvatsaṃnidhau ḍhuṃḍhe siddhiṃ dāsyati vāṃchitām || 51 || || īśvara uvāca || imāṃ stutiṃ mamakṛtiṃ yaḥ paṭhiṣyati sanmatiḥ || na jātu taṃ tu vighnaughāḥ pīḍayiṣyaṃti niścitam || 52 || ḍhauṃḍhīṃ stutimimāṃ puṇyāṃ yaḥ paṭheḍḍhuṃḍhi saṃnidhau || sānnidhyaṃ tasya satataṃ bhajeyuḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ || 53 || imāṃ stutiṃ naro japtvā paraṃ niyatamānasaḥ || mānasairapi pāpaistairnābhibhūyeta karhicit||54|| putrānkalatraṃ kṣetrāṇi varāśvānvaramaṃdiram|| prāpnuyācca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ḍhuṃḍhistotraṃ japannaraḥ || 55 || sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ nāma stotrametanmayeritam || prajaptavyaṃ prayatnena muktikāmena sarvadā ||56|| japtvā stotramidaṃ puṇyaṃ kvāpi kārye gamiṣyataḥ || puṃsaḥ puraḥ sameṣyaṃti niyataṃ sarvasiddhayaḥ ||57|| anyacca kathayāmyatra śṛṇvaṃtvete divaukasaḥ || ḍhuṃḍhinā kṣetrarakṣārthaṃ yatrayatra sthitiḥ kṛtā || 58 || kāśyāṃ gaṃgāsi saṃbhede nāmatorkavināyakaḥ || dṛṣṭorkavāsare puṃbhiḥ sarvatāpapraśāṃtaye || 59 || durgo nāma gaṇādhyakṣaḥ sarvadurgatināśanaḥ || kṣetrasya dakṣiṇe bhāge pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 4.2.57.60 || bhīmacaṃḍī samīpe tu bhīmacaṃḍavināyakaḥ || kṣetranairṛtadeśastho dṛṣṭo haṃti mahābhayam || 61 || kṣetrasya paścime bhāge sa dehalivināyakaḥ || sarvānnivārayedvighnānbhaktānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 62 || kṣetravāyavyadigbhāge uddaṃḍākhyo gajānanaḥ || uddaṃḍānapi vighnaughānbhaktānāṃ daṃḍayetsadā || 63 || kāśyāḥ sadottarāśāyāṃ pāśapāṇirvināyakaḥ || vināyakānpāśayati bhaktyā kāśīnivāsinām || 64 || gaṃgāvaraṇayoḥ saṃge ramyaḥ kharvavināyakaḥ || akharvānapi vighnaughānbhaktānāṃ kharvayetsatām || 65 || prācyāṃ tu kṣetrarakṣārthaṃ siddhaḥ siddhivināyakaḥ || paścime yamatīrthasya sādhakakṣiprasiddhidaḥ || 66 || bāhyāvaraṇagāścaite kāśyāmaṣṭau vināyakāḥ || uccāṭayatyabhaktāṃśca bhaktānāṃ sarvasiddhidāḥ || 67 || dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva ye rakṣaṃti vināyakāḥ || avimuktamidaṃ kṣetraṃ tānahaṃ kathayāmyataḥ || 68 || svardhunyāḥ paścime kūle uttarerkavināyakāt || laṃbodaro gaṇādhyakṣaḥ kṣālayedvighnakardamam ||69|| tatpaścimekūṭadaṃta udagdurgavināyakāt || durgopasargasaṃhartā rakṣetkṣetramidaṃ sadā || || 4.2.57.70 || bhīmacaṃḍa gaṇādhyakṣātkiṃcidīśānadiggataḥ || kṣetrarakṣogaṇādhyakṣaḥ pūjyaḥ śālakaṭaṃkaṭaḥ || 71 || prācyā dehalivighneśātkūśmāṃḍākhyo vināyakaḥ || pūjanīyaḥ sadā bhaktermahotpāta praśāṃtaye || 72 || uddaṃḍākhyādgaṇapaterāśuśukṣaṇidiksthitaḥ || mahāprasiddhaḥ saṃpūjyo bhaktairmuṃḍavināyakaḥ || 73 || pātāle tasya dehosti muṃḍaṃ kāśyāṃ vyavasthitama || ataḥ sa gīyate kāśyāṃ devo muṃḍavināyakaḥ || 74 || pāśapāṇergaṇeśānāddakṣiṇe vikaṭadvijam || pūjayitvā gaṇapatiṃ gāṇapatyapadaṃ labhet || 75 || kharvākhyānnairṛtebhāge rājaputro vināyakaḥ || bhraṣṭarājyaṃ ca rājānaṃ rājānaṃ kurute'rcitaḥ || 76 || gaṃgāyāḥ paścime kūle praṇavākhyo gaṇādhipaḥ || avācyāṃ rājaputrācca praṇataḥ praṇayeddivam || 77 || dvitīyāvaraṇe kāśyāmaṣṭāvete vināyakāḥ || utsādayeyurvighnaughānkāśī sthitinivāsinām || 78 || kṣetre tṛtīyāvaraṇe kṣetrarakṣākṛtaḥ sadā || ye vighnarājāḥ saṃtīha te vaktavyā mayādhunā || 79 || udagvahāyāḥ svardhunyā ramye rodhasi vighnarāṭ || laṃbodarādudīcyāṃ tu vakratuṃḍoghasaṃghahṛt || 4.2.57.80 || kūṭadaṃtādgaṇapaterudīcyāmekadaṃtakaḥ || sadopasargasaṃsargātpāyādānaṃdakānanam || 81 || kāśībhayaharo nityamaiśyāṃ śālakaṭaṃkaṭāt || trimukho nāma vighneśaḥ kapisiṃhadvipānanaḥ ||82|| kūśmāṃḍātpūrvadigbhāge paṃcāsyo nāma vighnarād || paṃcāsyasyaṃdanavaraḥ pāti vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 83 || heraṃbākhyaḥ sadāgneyyāṃ pūjyo muṃḍavināyakāt || aṃbāvatpūrayetkāmānsarveṣāṃ kāśivāsinām || 84 || avācyāmarcayeddhīmānsiddhyai vikaṭadaṃtataḥ || vighnarājaṃ gaṇapatiṃ sarvavighnavināśanam || 85 || vināyakādrājaputrātkiṃcidrakṣodiśisthitaḥ || varadākhyo gaṇādhyakṣaḥ pūjyo bhaktavarapradaḥ || 86 || yāmyāṃ praṇavavighneśādgaṇeśo modakapriyaḥ || pūjyaḥ piśaṃgilā tīrthe devanadyāstaṭe śubhe || 87 || caturthāvaraṇe kāśyāṃ bhaktavighnavināśakāḥ || draṣṭavyā hṛṣṭacetobhiḥ spaṣṭamaṣṭau vināyakāḥ || 88 || vakratuṃḍādudagdiksthaḥ svaḥsiṃdho rodhasisthitaḥ || vināyakostyabhayadaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhayanāśanaḥ || 89 || kauberyāmekadaśanātsiṃhatuṃḍo vināyakaḥ || upasargagajānhaṃti vārāṇasi nivāsinām || 4.2.57.90 || kūṇitākṣo gaṇādhyakṣastrituṃḍādīśa diksthitaḥ || mahāśmaśānaṃ satataṃ pāyādduṣṭakudṛṣṭitaḥ || 91 || prācyāṃ paṃcāsyataḥ pāyātpurīṃ kṣipraprasādanaḥ || kṣipraprasādanārcātaḥ kṣipraṃ sidhyaṃti siddhayaḥ || 92 || heraṃbādvahnidigbhāge ciṃtāmaṇi vināyakaḥ || bhaktaciṃtāmaṇiḥ sākṣācciṃtitārtha samarpakaḥ || 93 || vighnarājādavācyāṃ tu daṃtahasto gaṇeśvaraḥ || likhedvighnasahasrāṇi nṛṇāṃ vārāṇasīdruhām || || 94 || varadādyātudhānyāṃ ca yātudhānagaṇāvṛtaḥ || devaḥ piciṃḍilo nāma purīṃ rakṣedaharniśam || 95 || dṛṣṭaḥ pilipilātīrthe dakṣiṇe modakapriyāt || uddaṃḍa muṃḍo heraṃbo bhaktebhyaḥ kiṃ na yacchati || 96 || prākāre paṃcame kāśyāṃ dvicatuṣka vināyakāḥ || kurvaṃti rakṣāṃ kṣetrasya ye tānatra bravīmyaham || 97 || tīre svargataraṃgiṇyā uttare cābhayapradāt || sthūladaṃto gaṇeśānaḥ sthūlāḥ siddhīrdiśetsatām || 98 || siṃhatuḍādudagbhāge kalipriya vināyakaḥ || kalahaṃ kārayennityamanyonyaṃ tairthikadruhām || 99 || kūṇitākṣāttathaiśānyāṃ caturdaṃto vināyakaḥ || tasya darśanamātreṇa vighnasaṃghaḥ kṣayetsvayam || 4.2.57.100 || kṣipraprasādanādaiṃdryāṃ dvituṃḍo gaṇanāyakaḥ || agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścāpi bibharti sadṛśīṃ śriyam || 101 || tasya saṃdarśanātpusāṃ bhavecchrīḥ sarvatomukhī || jyeṣṭho nāma gaṇādhyakṣo jyeṣṭho me putrasaṃpadi || 102 || jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ saṃpūjyo jyeṣṭhatāptaye || sthito vahnidiśo bhāge ciṃtāmaṇi vināyakāt || 103 || daṃtahastādyamāśāyāṃ pūjyo gajavināyakaḥ || tasya saṃpūjanādbhaktyā gajāṃtā śrīravāpyate || 104 || piciṇḍilādgaṇapateryāmyāṃ kālavināyakaḥ || bhayaṃ na kālakalitaṃ tasya saṃsevanānnṛṇām|| 105 || uddaṃḍamuṃḍādgaṇapātkī nāśadiśi saṃsthitam || nāgeśaṃ gaṇapaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāgaloke mahīyate || 106 || atha ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇagāḥ procyaṃte vighnanāyakāḥ || teṣāṃ nāmaśravādeva puṃsāṃ siddhiḥ prajāyate || 107 || maṇikarṇo gaṇapatiḥ prācyāṃ vighnavighātakṛt || āśāvināyako vahnyāṃ bhaktāśāṃ pūrayansthitaḥ || 108 || yāmyāṃsṛṣṭigaṇeśaśca sṛṣṭisaṃhārasūcakaḥ || nairṛtyāṃ yakṣavighneśaḥ sarvavighnaharaḥ paraḥ || 109 || pratīcyāṃ gajakarṇaśca sarveṣāṃ kṣemakārakaḥ || citraghaṃṭo gaṇapatirvāyavyāṃ pālayetpurīm || 4.2.57.110 || sthūlajaṃghaudīcyāṃ ca śamayecchamināmagham || aiśyāmaiśīpurīṃ pāyātsamaṃgalavināyakaḥ || 111 || yamatīrthādudīcyāṃ ca pūjyo mitravināyakaḥ || saptamāvaraṇe ye ca tāṃśca vakṣye vināyakān || 112 || modādyāḥ paṃcavighneśāḥ ṣaṣṭho jñānavināyakaḥ || saptamo dvāravighneśo mahādvārapuraścaraḥ || 113 || aṣṭamaḥ sarvakaṣṭaughānavimuktavināyakaḥ || avimukte mama kṣetre haretpraṇatacetasām ||114|| ṣaṭpaṃcāśadgajamukhānetānyaḥ saṃsmariṣyati|| dūradeśāṃtarasthopi sa mṛto jñānamāpnuyāt || 115 || ḍhuṃḍhistutiṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ ṣaṭpaṃcāśadgajānanām || yaḥ paṭhiṣyati puṇyātmā tasya siddhiḥ padepade || 116 || ime gaṇeśvarāḥ sarve smartavyā yatra kutracit || mahāvipatsamudrāṃtaḥ pataṃtaṃ pāṃti mānavam ||117|| iti stutiṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ śrutvā caitānvināyakān || jātuvighnairnabādhyeta pāpebhyopi prahīyate || 118 || ityuktvā devadevopi mahotsavitamānasaḥ || kṛtābhiṣeko brahmādyaistebhyo dattvābhivāṃchitam|| 119 || saṃprasādya yathāyogaṃ sarvānucita caṃcuraḥ || aviśadrājasadanaṃ viśvakarmavinirmitam || 4.2.57.120 || || skaṃda uvāca || evaṃ stuto bhagavatā devadevena vighnajit || itthaṃ ca bahudhātmānaṃ sa cakāra vināyakaḥ || 121 || etāni tasya nāmāni ḍhuṃḍhirājasya kuṃbhaja || japitvā yāni manujo lapsyate nijavāṃchitam|| 122 || anyepi tatra vai bhedāstasya ḍhuṃḍhergaṇeśituḥ || bhaktaiḥ samarcitā bhaktyā hyasaṃkhyātāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 123 || bhagīrathagaṇādhyakṣo hariścaṃdravināyakaḥ || kapardākhyo gaṇapatistathā biṃduvināyakaḥ || 124 || ityādyāstatra vighneśāḥ pratibhaktapratiṣṭhitāḥ || teṣāmapyarcanātpuṃsāṃ jāyaṃte sarvasaṃpadaḥ || 125 || śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ naraḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ || sarvavighnānsamutsṛjya labhate vāṃchitaṃ padam || 126 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe uttarārddhe ḍhuṃḍhivināyakaprādurbhāvo nāma saptapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||
<4.2.58>
|| agastya uvāca || kiṃ cakāra haraḥ skaṃda maṃdarādrigatastadā || vilaṃbamālaṃbayati tasminnapi gajānane || 1 || || skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇvagastya kathāṃ puṇyāṃ kathyamānāṃ mayādhunā|| vārāṇasyekaviṣayāmaśeṣāghaughanāśinīm ||2 || karīṃdravadane tatra kṣetravarye'vimuktake|| vilaṃbabhājitryakṣeṇa praikṣikṣipramadhokṣajaḥ || 3 || proktotha bahuśaśceti bahumānapuraḥsaram || tathā tvamapi mākārṣīryathā prākprasthitaiḥ kṛtam || 4 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || udyamaḥ prāṇibhiḥ kāryo yathābuddhi balābalam || paraṃ phalaṃti karmāṇi tvadadhīnāni śaṃkara || 5 || acetanāni karmāṇi svataṃtrāḥ prāṇinopi na || tvaṃ ca tatkarmaṇāṃ sākṣī tvaṃ ca prāṇipravartakaḥ || 6 || kiṃtu tvatpādabhaktānāṃ tādṛśī jāyate matiḥ || yayā tvameva kathayeḥ sādhvanenatvanuṣṭhitam || 7 || yatkiṃcidiha vai karmastokaṃ vā'stokameva vā || tatsiddhyatyeva giriśa tvatpādasmṛtyanuṣṭhitam || 8 || susiddhamapi vai kāryaṃ subuddhyāpi svanuṣṭhitam || atvatpadasmṛtikṛtaṃ vinaśyatyeva tatkṣaṇāt || 9 || śaṃbhunā preṣitenādya sūdyamaḥ kriyate mayā || tvadbhaktisaṃpattimatāṃ saṃpannaprāya eva naḥ || 4.2.58.10 || atīva yadasādhyaṃ syātsvabuddhibalapauruṣaiḥ || tatkāryaṃ hi susiddhaṃ syāttvadanudhyānataḥ śiva || 11 || yāṃti pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ye bhavaṃtaṃ bhavaṃ vibho || bhavaṃti teṣāṃ kāryāṇi purobhūtāni te bhayāt || 12 || jātaṃ viddhi mahādeva kāryametatsuniścitam || kāśīprāveśikaściṃtya śubhalagnodayaḥ param || 13 || athavā kāśisaṃprāptau na ciṃtyaṃ hi śubhāśubham || tadaiva hi śubhaḥ kālo yadaivāpyeta kāśikā || 14 || śaṃbhuṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ || pratasthe'tha salakṣmīko maṃdarādgaruḍadhvajaḥ || 15 || dṛśoratithitāṃ nītvā viṣṇurvārāṇasīṃ tataḥ || puṃḍarīkākṣa ityākhyāṃ saphalīkṛtavānmudā || 16 || gaṃgāvaraṇayorviṣṇuḥ saṃbhede svacchamānasaḥ || prakṣālya pāṇicaraṇaṃ sacailaḥ snātavānatha ||17|| tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ pādodakamitīritam || pādau yadādau śubhadau kṣālitau pītavāsasā || 18 || tatra pādodake tīrthe ye snāsyaṃtīha mānavāḥ || teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipraṃ pāpaṃ saptabhavārjitam || 19 || tatra śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā dattvā caiva tilodakam|| saptasapta tathā sapta svavaṃśyāṃstārayiṣyati || 4.2.58.20 || gayāyāṃ yādṛśī tṛptirlabhyate prapitāmahaiḥ || tīrthe pādodake kāśyāṃ tādṛśī labhyate dhruvam || 21 || kṛtapādodaka snānaṃ pītapādodakodakam || dattapādodapānīyaṃ naraṃ na nirayaḥ spṛśet || 22 || viṣṇupādodake tīrthe prāśya pādodakaṃ sakṛt || jātucijjananīstanyaṃ na pibediti niścitam || 23 || sacakra śālagrāmasya śaṃkhena snāpitasya ca || adbhiḥ pādodakasyāṃbu pibannamṛtatāṃ vrajet || 24 || viṣṇupādodake tīrthe viṣṇupādodakaṃ pibet || yadi tatsudhayā kiṃ nu bahukālīnayātayā || 25 || kāśyāṃ pādodake tīrthe yaiḥ kṛtā nodakakriyāḥ || janmaiva viphalaṃ teṣāṃ jalabudbuda saśriyām ||26|| kṛtanityakriyo viṣṇuḥ salakṣmīkaḥ sakāśyapiḥ || upasaṃhṛtya tāṃ mūrtiṃ trailokyavyāpinīṃ tathā || 27 || vidhāya dārṣadīṃ mūrtiṃ svahastenādikeśavaḥ || svayaṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa sarvasiddhisamṛddhidām || 28 || ādikeśavanāmnīṃ tāṃ śrīmūrtiṃ pārameśvarīm || saṃpūjya martyo vaikuṃṭhaṃ manyate svagṛhāṃgaṇam || 29 || śvetadvīpa iti khyātaṃ tatsthānaṃ kāśisīmani || śvetadvīpe vasaṃtyeva narāstanmūrtisevakāḥ || 4.2.58.30 || kṣīrābdhisaṃjñaṃ tatrānyattīrthaṃ keśavatogrataḥ || kṛtodakakriyastatra vasetkṣīrābdhirodhasi || 31 || tatra śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā gāṃ dattvā ca payasvinīm || yathoktasarvābharaṇāṃ kṣīrode vāsayetpitṝn || 32 || ekottaraśataṃ vaṃśyānnavetpāyasa kardamam || kṣīrodarodhaḥ puṇyātmā bhaktyā tatraikadhenudaḥ ||33|| bahvīśca naicikīrdattvā śraddhayātra sadakṣiṇāḥ || śayyottarāṃśca pratyekaṃ pitṝṃstatra suvāsayet||34|| kṣīrodāddakṣiṇe tatra śaṃkhatīrthamanuttamam || tatrāpi saṃtarpyapitṝnviṣṇulokemahīyate || 35 || tadyāmyāṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca pitṝṇāmapi durlabham || tatrāpi vihitaśrāddho mucyate paitṛkādṛṇāt ||36|| tatsaṃnnidhau gadātīrthaṃ viṣvagādhinibarhaṇam || tāraṇaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ vai kāraṇaṃ cainasāṃ kṣaye || 37 || padmatīrthaṃ tadagre tu tatra snātvā narottamaḥ || pitṝnsaṃtarpya vidhinā padmayāneva hīyate || 38 || tatraiva ca mahālakṣmyāstīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || svayaṃ yatra mahālakṣmīḥ snātā trailokyaharṣadā ||39|| tatra tīrthe kṛtasnāno dattvā ratnāni kāṃcanam || paṭṭāṃbarāṇi viprebhyo na lakṣmyā parihīyate ||4.2.58.40|| yatrayatra hi jāyeta tatratatra samṛddhimān || pitaropi hi suśrīkāstasya syustīrthagauravāt ||41|| tatrāsti hi mahālakṣmyā mūrtistrailokyavaṃditā || tāṃ praṇamya naro bhaktyā na rogī jāyate kvacit || 42 || nabhasya bahulāṣṭamyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi|| samabhyarcya mahālakṣmīṃ vratī vrataphalaṃ labhet || 43 || tārkṣya tīrthaṃ hi tatrāsti tārkṣyakeśavasannidhau|| tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā saṃsārāhiṃ na paśyati || 44 || tadagre nāradaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || brahmavidyopadeśaṃ ca prāptavānyatra nāradaḥ ||45|| tatra snāto naraḥ samyagbrahmavidyāmavāpnuyāt || keśavāttena tatroktaḥ kāśyāṃ nāradakeśavaḥ ||46 || arcayitvā naro bhaktyā devaṃ nāradakeśavam || jananyā jaṭharaṃ pīṭhamadhyāste na kadācana || 47 || prahlādatīrthaṃ tasyāgre yatra prahlādakeśavaḥ || tatra śrāddhādikaṃ kṛtvā vipṇuloke mahīyate || 48 || āṃbarīṣamahātīrthamaghaghnaṃ tasya sannidhau || tatraudakīṃ kriyāṃ kurvanniṣkāluṣyaṃ labhennaraḥ ||49|| ādityakeśavaḥ pūjya ādikeśava pūrvataḥ || tasya saṃdarśanādeva mucyate coccapātakaiḥ || || 4.2.58.50 || dattātreyeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tatraivādigadādharaḥ || pitṝnsaṃtarpya tatraiva jñānayogamavāpnuyāt ||51 || bhṛgukeśavapūrveṇa tīrthaṃ vai bhārgavaṃ param || tatra snāto naraḥ prājño bhavedbhārgavavatsudhīḥ || 52 || tatra vāmanatīrthaṃ ca prācyāṃ vāmanakeśavāt || pūjayitvā ca taṃ viṣṇuṃ vasedvāmanasannidhau || 53 || naranārāyaṇaṃ tīrthaṃ naranārāyaṇātpuraḥ || tatra tīrthe kṛtasnāno naro nārāyaṇo bhavet || 54 || yajñavārāha tīrthaṃ ca tadagre pāpanāśanam || pratimajjanatastatra rājasūya kratoḥ phalam || 55 || vidāranārasiṃhākhyaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ sunirmalam || snāto vidārayettatra pāpaṃ janmaśatārjitam || 56 || gopigoviṃda tīrthaṃ ca gopigoviṃdapūrvataḥ || snātvā tatra samabhyarcya viṣṇuṃ viṣṇupriyo bhavet || 57 || tīrthaṃ lakṣmīnṛsiṃhākhyaṃ gopigoviṃda dakṣiṇe || na lakṣmyā tyajyate kvāpi tattīrthaṃ parimajjanāt || 58 || tadagre śeṣatīrthaṃ ca śeṣamādhavasannidhau || tarpitānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca yatra tṛptirna śiṣyate || 59 || śaṃkhamādhavatīrthaṃ ca tadavācyāṃ sunirmalam || kṛtodako narastatra bhavetpāpopi nirmalaḥ || 4.2.58.60 || tadagre ca hayagrīvaṃ tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam || tatra snātvā hayagrīvaṃ keśavaṃ paripūjya ca || 61 || piṃḍaṃ ca tatra nirvāpya hayagrīvasya sannidhau || || hāyagrīvīṃ śriyaṃ prāpya samucyeta sapūrvajaḥ || 62 || || skaṃda uvāca || || prasaṃgato mayaitāni tīrthāni kathitāni te || bhūmau tilāṃtarāyāṃ yattatra tīrthānyaneśaḥ || 63 || uddiṣṭānāṃ tu tīrthānāmeteṣāṃ kalaśodbhava || nāmamātramapi śrutvā niṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ || idānīṃ prastutaṃ vipra śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tegrataḥ || vaikuṃṭhanātho yaccakre śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 65 || tasyāṃ mūrtau samāveśya kaiśavyāmatha keśavaḥ || śaṃbhoḥ kārye kṛtamanā aṃśāṃśāṃśena nirgataḥ || 66 || || agastya uvāca || || aṃśāṃśāṃśena niścakre kuto bhoścakrapāṇinā || kva nirgataṃ ca hariṇā prāpya kāśīṃ ṣaḍānana || 67 || || skaṃda uvāca || || sāmastyena yadarthaṃ na nirgataṃ viṣṇunā mune || bruve tatkāraṇamiti kṣaṇamātraṃ niśāmaya || 68 || saṃprāpya puṇyasaṃbhāraiḥ prājño vārāṇasīṃ purīm || na tyajetsarvabhāvena mahālābhairapīritaḥ || 69 || ataḥ pratikṛtiḥ svīyā tatra kāśyāṃ murāriṇā || pratitasthe kalaśajastokāṃśena ca nirgatam || 4.2.58.70 || kiṃcitkāśyā udīcyāṃ ca gatvā devena cakriṇā || svasthityai kalpitaṃ sthānaṃ dharmakṣetramitīritam || 71 || tatastu saugataṃ rūpaṃ śiśrāya śrīpatiḥ svayam || atīva suṃdarataraṃ trailokyasyāpimohanam || 72 || śrīḥ parivrājikā jātā nitarāṃ subhagākṛtiḥ || yāmālokya jagatsarvaṃ citranyastamivāsthitam || 73 || viśvayoniṃ jagaddhātrīṃ nyastahastāgrapustakām || garutmānapi tacchiṣyo jāto lokottarākṛtiḥ || 74 || atyadbhuta mahāprājño niḥspṛhaḥ sarvavastuṣu || guruśuśrūṣaṇaparo nyastahastāgrapustakaḥ || 75 || apṛcchatparamaṃ dharmaṃ saṃsāravinimocakam || ācāryavaryaṃ saumyāsyaṃ prasannātmānamuttamam || 76 || dharmārthaśāstrakuśalaṃ jñānavijñānaśālinam || susvaraṃ supadavyakti susnigdhamṛdubhāṣiṇam || 77 || staṃbhanoccāṭanākṛṣṭi vaśīkarmādikovidam || vyākhyānasamayākṛṣṭa pakṣiromāṃcakāriṇam || 78 || pītatadgītapīyūṣa mṛgapūgairupāsitam || mahāmodabharākrāṃta vātacāṃcalyahāriṇam|| 79 || vṛkṣairapi patatpuṣpacchalaiḥkṛtasamarcanam || tataḥprovāca puṇyātmā puṇyakīrtiḥ sa saugataḥ || 4.2.58.80 || śiṣyaṃ vinayakīrtiṃ taṃ mahāvinayabhūṣaṇam||81|| || puṇyakīrtiruvāca || || tvayā vinayakīrte yo dharmaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ || vakṣyāmyahamaśeṣeṇa śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ mahāmate || 52 || anādisiddhaḥ saṃsāraḥ kartṛkarmavivarjitaḥ || svayaṃ prādurbhavedeṣa svayameva vilīyate || 83 || brahmādistaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ yāvaddehanibaṃdhanam || ātmaivaikeśvarastatra na dvitīyastadīśitā ||84 || yadbrahmaviṣṇurudrādyāstathākhyā dehināmimāḥ || ākhyā yathāsmadādīnāṃ puṇyakīrtyādirucyate|||85|| deho yathā smadādīnāṃ svakālena vilīyate || brahmādi maśakāṃtānāṃ svakālāllīyate tathā ||86 || vicāryamāṇe dehesminnakiṃcidadhikaṃ kvacit || āhāro maithunaṃ nidrā bhayaṃ sarvatra yatsamam|| 87 || nijāhāraparīmāṇaṃ prāpya sarvopi dehabhṛt || sadṛśīmeva saṃtṛptiṃ prāpnuyānnādhiketarām || 88 || yathā vitṛṣitāḥ syāma pītvā peyaṃ mudā vayam || tṛṣitāstu tathānyepi na viśeṣolpakodhikaḥ ||89|| saṃtu nāryaḥ sahasrāṇi rūpalāvaṇyabhūmayaḥ || paraṃ nidhuvane kāle hyekaivehopayujyate || 4.2.58.90 || aśvāḥ paraḥ śatāḥ saṃtu saṃtvanekepyanekaṣāḥ || adhirohe tathāpyeko na dvitīyastathātmanaḥ || 91 || paryaṃkaśāyināṃ svāpe sukhaṃ yadupapadyate || tadeva saukhyaṃ nidrāyāmiha bhūśāyināmapi || 92 || yathaiva maraṇādbhītirasmadādi vapuṣmatām || brahmādikīṭakāṃtānāṃ tathā maraṇato bhayam || 93 || sarvetanubhṛtastulyā yadi buddhyā vicāryate || idaṃ niścitya kenāpi no hiṃsyaḥ kopi kutracit || 94 || dharmo jīvadayā tulyo na kvāpi jagatītale || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryā jīvadayā nṛbhiḥ || 95 || ekasminrakṣite jīve trailokyaṃ rakṣitaṃ bhavet || ghātite ghātitaṃ tadvattasmādrakṣenna ghātayet || 96 || ahiṃsā paramo dharma ihoktaḥ pūrvasūribhiḥ || tasmānna hiṃsā kartavyā narairnarakabhīrubhiḥ || 97 || na hiṃsā sadṛśaṃ pāpaṃ trailokye sacarācare || hiṃsako narakaṃ gacchetsvargaṃ gacchedahiṃsakaḥ || 98 || saṃti dānānyanekāni kiṃ taistuccha phalapradaiḥ || abhīti dānasadṛśaṃ paramekamapīha na ||99|| iha catvāri dānāni proktāni paramarṣibhiḥ || vicārya nānāśāstrāṇi śarmaṇetra paratra ca ||4.2.58.100|| bhītebhyaścābhayaṃ deyaṃ vyādhitebhyastathauṣadham || deyā vidyārthināṃ vidyā deyamannaṃ kṣudhāture || 101 || aviciṃtya prabhāvaṃ hi maṇimaṃtrauṣadhībalam || tadabhyasyaṃ prayatnena nānārthopārjanāya vai || 102 || arthānupārjya bahuśo dvādaśāyatanāni vai || paritaḥ paripūjyāni kimanyairiha pūjitaiḥ || 103 || paṃcakarmeṃdriyāṇyeva paṃcabuddhīṃdriyāṇi ca || manobuddhiriha proktaṃ dvādaśāyatanaṃ śubham || 104 || ihaiva svarganarakau prāṇināṃ nānyataḥ kvacit || sukhaṃ svargaḥ samākhyāto duḥkhaṃ naraka eva hi || 105 || sukheṣu bhujyamāneṣu yatsyāddeha visajarnam || ayameva paro mokṣo na mokṣo'nyaḥ kvacitpunaḥ || 106 || vāsanāsahitakleśa samucchede sati dhruvam || vijñāno paramo mokṣo vijñeyastattvaciṃtakaiḥ || 107 || prāmāṇikī śrutiriyaṃ procyate vedavādibhiḥ || na hiṃsyātsarvabhūtāni nānyā hiṃsāpravartikā || 108 || agnīṣomīyamiti yā bhrāmikā sā'satāmiha|| na sā pramāṇaṃ jñātṝṇāṃ paśvālaṃbhanakārikā || 109 || vṛkṣāṃśchittvā paśūnhatvā kṛtvā rudhirakardamama || dagdhvā vahnau tilājyādi citraṃ svargo'bhilapyate || 4.2.58.110 || ityevaṃ dharmajijñāsāṃ puṇyakīrtau prakurvati || pāraṃparyeṇa tacchrutvā paurā yātrāṃ pracakrire ||111|| parivrājika yāpyevaṃ samākṛṣṭāḥ purāṃganāḥ || tayā vijānakaumudyā sarvavidyāvidagdhayā || 112 || tatastāsāṃ purastātsā bauddhadharmānavīvadat || dṛṣṭārthapratyayakarāndehasaukhyaikasādhanāna || 113 || || vijñānakaumudyuvāca || || ānaṃdaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ śrutyaivaṃ yannigadyate || tattathaiveha maṃtavyaṃ mithyā nānātvakalpanā ||114|| yāvatsvasthamidaṃ varṣma yāvanneṃdriyaviklavaḥ || yāvajjarā ca dūresti tāvatsaukhyaṃ prasādhayet || 115|| asvāsthyeṃdriyavaikalye vārdhake tu kutaḥ sukham || śarīramapi dātavyamarthibhyotaḥ sukhepsubhiḥ|| 116 || yācamānamanovṛtti prīṇaneyasya no janiḥ || tena bhūrbhāravatyeṣā samudrāgadrumairnahi|| 117 || satvaro gatvaro dehaḥ saṃcayāḥ saparikṣayāḥ || iti vijñāya vijñātā dehe saukhyaṃ prasādhayet || 118 || śva vāyasa kṛmīṇāṃ ca pratibhojyamidaṃ vapuḥ || bhasmāṃtaṃ taccharīraṃ ca vede satyaṃ prapadyate || 119 || mudhā jātivikalpoyaṃ lokeṣu parikalpyate || mānuṣye sati sāmānye kodhamaḥ kotha cottamaḥ || 4.2.58.120 || brahmādi sṛṣṭireṣeti procyate vṛddhapūruṣaiḥ || tasya sraṣṭuḥ sutau dakṣa marīcī ceti viśrutau || 121 || mārīcinā kaśyapena dakṣakanyāḥ sulocanāḥ || dharmyeṇa kila mārgeṇa pariṇītāstrayodaśa || 122 || apīdānīṃtanairmartyairalpabuddhiparākramaiḥ|| ayaṃ gamyastvagamyoyaṃ vicāraḥ kriyate mudhā || 123 || mukhabāhūrupajjātaṃ cāturvarṇyamihoditam || kalpaneyaṃ kṛtā pūrvairna ghaṭeta vicārataḥ || 124 || ekasyāṃ ca tanau jātā ekasmādyadi vā kvacit || catvārastanayāstatkiṃ bhinnavarṇatvamāpnuyuḥ || 125 || varṇāvarṇavivekoyaṃ tasmānna pratibhāsate|| ato bhedo na maṃtavyo mānuṣye kenacitkvacit || || 126 || vijñānakaumudīvāṇīmityākarṇya purāṃganāḥ || bharttṛśuśrūṣaṇavatīṃ vijahurmatimuttamām || 127 || abhyasyākarṣaṇīṃ vidyāṃ vaśīkṛtimatīmapi || puruṣāḥ saphalīcakruḥ paradāreṣu mohitāḥ || 128 || aṃtaḥpuracarā nāryastathā rājakumārakāḥ || paurāḥ purāṃganāścāpi sarve tābhyāṃ vimohitāḥ || 129 || vaṃdhyānāṃ cāpi vaṃdhyātvaṃ sā parivrājikāharat || taistaiśca kārmaṇopāyairasau bhāgyavatīḥ striyaḥ || 4.2.58.130 || saubhāgyabhāgyasaṃpannā vyadhādvijñānakaumudī || kasyaicidaṃjanaṃ dattaṃ kasyaicittilakauṣadham || 131 || vaśīkaraṇamaṃtraiśca tathā bahvyopi dīkṣitāḥ || maṃtrāñjapeyuḥ kāścicca yaṃtrāṇyanyā likhaṃti ca ||132|| kāścijjuhvati kuṃḍāgnau nānādravyāṇi niścalāḥ || evaṃ sarveṣu paureṣu nijadharmeṣu sarvathā || parāṅmukheṣu jāteṣu prollalāsa vṛṣetaraḥ || 133 || siddhayokṛṣṭapacyādyā naṣṭā enaḥ praveśanāt || āsītkuṃṭhitasāmarthyo nṛpopi sa manāṅmanāk || 134 || dūrasthitopi vighneśo nṛpaṃ nirviṇṇamānasam || cakāra rājyakaraṇe ḍhuṃḍhirājo ripuṃjayam || 135 || ajīgaṇaddivodāsopyaṣṭādaśa dināvadhim || kadā gaṃtā sa vai vipro yo māṃ samupadekṣyati || 136 || itthamaṣṭādaśe prāpte divase divaseśvare || prāpte madhyaṃ nabhobhāgaṃ dvāraṃ prāpto dvijottamaḥ || 137 || sa eva puṇyakīrtyākhyo dharmakṣetrādadhokṣajaḥ || dvijaveṣaṃ samālaṃbya samāyāto nṛpāṃtikam || 138 || dvitraiḥ pavitrairbahudhā jayajīveti vādibhiḥ || sametaḥ sa ito vipro mūrtimāniva pāvakaḥ || 139 || vilokya taṃ samāyātaṃ dūrādutkaṃṭhito nṛpaḥ || mene bhavedgururayaṃ yukto madupadeśane || 4.2.58.140 || abhigamya ca taṃ rājā praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ || gṛhīta svastivacano nināyāṃtaḥpuraṃ dvijam || 141 || madhuparkeṇa vidhinā taṃ saṃpūjya janādhipaḥ || vyapetādhvaśramaṃ svasthaṃ prollasanmukhapaṃkajam || 142 || nivedya khādyavastūni kṛtakṛtya kriyāvidhim || paritṛptaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ papraccha brāhmaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ || 143 || || rājovāca || || khinnosmi vipravaryāhaṃ rājyabhāraṃ samudvahan || khedo nāstyeva hi paraṃ vairāgyamiva jāyate || 144 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ me nirvṛtirbhavet || pakṣadvayyeva yāteti mama ciṃtayato dvija ||145|| asīmaṃ sukhasaṃtānaṃ bhuktaṃ rājyaṃ mayā dvija || parikṣīṇavipakṣaṃ ca tryakṣaiśvaryamiva sphuṭam || 146 || svasāmarthyādahaṃ jātaḥ parjanyāgnyanilātmakaḥ || prajāśca pālitāḥ samyakputrā iva nijaurasāḥ || 147|| tarpitāścāpi bhūdevā vasubhiśca dinedine|| ekamevāparāddhaṃ ca mayā rājyaṃ praśāsatā || 148 || devāstṛṇīkṛtāḥ sarve svatapobaladarpataḥ || tacca prajopakārārthaṃ na svārthaṃ bhavatā śape || 149 || adhunā gururedhitvaṃ mama bhāgyodayāgataḥ || rājyaṃ tu prakaromyevaṃ nyakkṛtāṃtakasādhvasam || 4.2.58.150 || akālakālakalanaṃ mama rājye na kutracit || jarāvyādhidaridrebhyo mamarājyepi no bhayam || 151 || kopi dharmetarāṃ vṛttiṃ na śrayenmayi śāsati || dharmodayājanāḥ sarve sarve saṃti sukhodayāḥ || 152 || sadvidyāvyasanāḥ sarve sarvesanmārga caṃcurāḥ || athavā yadi kalpāṃtaṃ tiṣṭhedāyustatopi kim || 153 || sarve bhogyāstathā bhāṃti yathā carvita carvaṇam || kiṃ piṣṭapeṣaṇenātra rājyena dvijapuṃgava || 154 || kimapyupadiśa prājña garbhavāsopaśāṃtaye || athavā tvāṃ prapannasya mama kiṃ ciṃtanairimaḥ || 155 || yadeva kathayasyadya tatkariṣyāmyasaṃśayam || tvadvilokanamātreṇa sarva eva manorathāḥ || 156 || anyeṣāmapi jāyaṃte jātaprāyā mamaiva tu || jāne devavirodhena ke ke na pralayaṃ gatāḥ || 157 || avaṃtopi prajāḥ svīyā nijadharmamanuvratāḥ || purā te tripurāḥ śūrāḥ śivabhaktiparā api || 158 || dharāmayaṃ rathaṃ kṛtvā dhanuḥ kṛtvā himācalam || vedāṃśca vājinaḥ kṛtvā guṇaṃ kṛtvā ca vāsukim || 159 || viriṃciṃ sārathiṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā viṣṇuṃ ca pattriṇam|| rathacakre puṣpavaṃtau pratodaṃ praṇavātmakam || 4.2.58.160 || tārāgrahamayānkīlānvarūthaṃ gaganātmakam || dhvajadaṃḍasumeruṃ ca prāṃśukalpataruṃ dhvajam || 161 || yoktrāṇi cakṣuḥśravasaśchaṃdāsyaṃgāni rakṣakān || bhallaṃ kālāgnirudrākhyaṃ puṃkhīkṛtya prabhaṃjanam || 162 || hareṇaikeṣupātena līlayā bhasmasātkṛtāḥ || baliryajñakṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛtvā kapaṭakharvatām || 163 || pātālaṃ gamitaḥ pūrvaṃ hariṇā vikramaistribhiḥ || vṛttavānapi vai vṛtraḥ sutrāmṇā vinisūditaḥ ||164|| dadhīcirapi vipreṃdro devairasthikṛte hataḥ || pūrvavairamanusmṛtya jayārthaṃ yudhyato hareḥ || kuśāstrairvijitasyājau tenaiva ca dadhīcinā || 165 || śivabhaktasya bāṇasya doḥsahasraṃ purā hariḥ || ciccheda saṃkhye kiṃ tenāparāddhaṃ sādhuvartinā || 166 || tasmādvirodho bhadrāya na bhaveddevataiḥ saha || devebhyo madbhayaṃ nāsti satpathīnasya vai manāk || 167 || yajñairdevatvamāpannā gīrvāṇā vāsavādayaḥ || yajñairdānaistapobhiśca tebhyopyādhikyamasti me || 168 || astu nyūnatvamādhikyaṃ kimanenādhunā mama || iṃdriyoparamaḥ prāptaḥ sukhadastavadarśanāt || 169 || idānīṃ diśa me tāta karmanirmūlanakṣamam || upāyaṃ tvamupāyajña yena nirvṛtimāpnuyām || 4.2.58.170 || || skaṃda uvāca || || gaṇeśāveśavaśato rājñeti yadudīritam || tadākarṇya hṛṣīkeśaḥ prāha brāhmaṇaveṣabhṛt || 171 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || sādhusādhu mahāprājña nṛpacūḍāmaṇe'nagha || mayā yadupadeṣṭavyaṃ tattvayaiva nirūpitam || 172 || tvamādāveva nirvṛttaḥ paraṃ me mānado hyasi || kṣāliteṃdriyapaṃkaśca sutapaḥ svacchavāribhiḥ || 173 || yaduktaṃ bhavatā bhūpa tatsarvaṃ tathyameva hi || tava śaktiṃ ca jānāmi viraktiṃ ca mahāmate || 174 || na bhavatsadṛśo rājā bhuvi bhūto bhaviṣyati || rājyaṃ bhoktuṃ tvayājñāyi yuktaṃ yattu mumukṣasi || 175 || virodhepi hi devānāṃ tvayā nāpakṛtaṃ kvacit || dharmetarapraveśaśca tava rāṣṭrepi nobhavat || 176 || pravartitābhirbhavatā prajābhiryadanuṣṭhitam || dharme dharmaṃ svadharmajña tena tṛptā divaukasaḥ || 177 || eka eva hi te doṣo hṛdi me pratibhāsate || kāśyā viśveśvaro dūraṃ yatkṛto bhavatā kila || 178 || mahāṃtamaparādhaṃ te jāne bhūjāni sattama || imaṃ tatpāpaśāṃtyai ca vacmyupāyaṃ mahattaram || 179 || saṃkhyāsti yāvatī dehe dehino romasaṃbhavā || tāvatopyaparādhā vai yāṃti liṃga pratiṣṭhayā || 4.2.58.180 || ekaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yena liṃgamatreśabhaktitaḥ || tenātmanā samaṃ viśvaṃ jagadetatpratiṣṭhitam || 181 || ratnākare ratnasaṃkhyā saṃkhyāvidbhirapīṣyate || liṃgapratiṣṭhā puṇyasya na tu saṃkhyeti likhyate || 182 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kuru liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || tayā liṃga pratiṣṭhityā kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi ||183|| ityuktvā brāhmaṇo dadhyau kṣaṇaṃ niścalamānasaḥ || uvāca ca prahṛṣṭāsyo rājānaṃ pāṇinā spṛśan || 184 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || anyacca kiṃcitpaśyāmi bhūpāla jñānacakṣuṣā || śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā tadapi prājñasattama || 185 || dhanyosi kṛtakṛtyosi mānyosi mahatāmapi || japyaṃ ca tava nāmeha prātaḥ śubhaphalepsunā || || 186 || divodāsa tvadabhyāśādapi dhanyatarā vayam || tepi dhanyatarā martye ye tvadākhyāṃ pracakṣate ||187|| smāyaṃ smāyaṃ jagau vipro maulimāṃdolayanmuhuḥ || hṛdyeva bahuśo hṛṣṭaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || 188 || aho bhāgyodayaścāsya aho nairmalyamasya vai || yadenamaniśaṃ dhyāyeddhyeyo viśveśvaro'khilaiḥ || 189 || aho udarka etasya na kaiścitpratipadyate || asmākamapi yaddūramadavīyastadasya yat || 4.2.58.190 || hṛdyālocyeti viprotha varṇayitvā kṣitīśvaram || āviścakāra tatsarvaṃ yatsamādhāvalokayat || 191 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || rājaṃstavādya phalito manoratha mahādrumaḥ || anenaiva śarīreṇa tvaṃ gatāsi paraṃ padam || 192 || yathā viśveśvaro nityaṃ tvāmeva hṛdi śīlayet || tathāsmadādīnapi na dvijāṃstatpādalocanān || 193 || kṛtaliṃgapratiṣṭhaṃ tvāṃ saptame hyadya vāsarāt || divyavimānamāgatya netumeṣyati śāṃbhavam || 194 || rājaṃstvaṃ vetsi kasyāyaṃ vipākaḥ sukṛtasya te || vārāṇasyāḥ puraḥ samyaksevanādityavaimyaham || 195 || ekamapyatra yaḥ pāyādvārāṇasyāṃ sthitaṃ janam || tasyāpyevaṃ vipākosti dehāṃte rājasattama || 196 || iti śrutvā sa rājarṣirdivodāsaḥ pratāpavān || brāhmaṇāya saśiṣyāya prādātprītobhivāṃchitam ||197|| atha saṃprīṇitaṃ vipraṃ praṇamya ca muharmuhuḥ || provāca rājā saṃhṛṣṭastāritosmi bhavārṇavāt ||198|| brāhmaṇopi prahṛṣṭātmā paripūrṇamanorathaḥ || samāpṛcchya mahīnāthaṃ sveṣṭaṃ deśaṃ jagāma ha||199|| vilokya kāśīṃ parito māyādvijavapurhariḥ|| bhūyobhūyo vicāryāpi kimatrātīva pāvanam||4.2.58.200|| sthānaṃ yaccāhamadhyāsya nijabhaktānaśeṣataḥ || neṣyāmi paramaṃ dhāma viśveśānugrahātparāt||201|| saṃpradhāryeti bhagavāndṛṣṭvā pāṃcanadaṃ hradam|| tatra kṛtvā vidhisnānaṃ tatastatraiva saṃsthitaḥ||202|| pratīkṣamāṇo lakṣmīśo maṃkṣutryakṣasamāgamam || tārkṣyaṃ prasthāpayāṃcakre rājavṛttāṃtavedinam || 203 || divodāsopi rājeṃdro vipreṃdraṃ parivarṇayan || āhūya prakṛtīḥ sarvāḥ sāmātyānmaṃḍaleśvarān || 204 || adhyakṣānapi sarvāṃśca kośāśvebhādideśitān || putrānpaṃcaśataṃ prāgryaṃ sutaṃ ca samaraṃjayam || 205 || purohitaṃ pratīhāramṛtvijogaṇakāndvijān || sāmaṃtānrājaputrāṃśca sūpakārāṃścikitsakān || 206 || vaideśikānapi bahūnnānākāryasamāgatān || sāṃtapurāṃ ca mahiṣīṃ vṛddhagopālabālakān || 207 || sarvānprovāca hṛṣṭātmā prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ || yathā sa brāhmaṇaḥ prāha dinasaptāvadhi sthitim || 208 || āścaryaṃ teṣu śṛṇvatsu viṣaṇṇavadaneṣu ca || svayaṃ rājagṛhaṃ nītvā kumāraṃ samaraṃjayam || 209 || abhiṣicya mahābuddhiḥ paurāñjānapadānapi || prasādīkṛtya puṇyātmā punaḥ kāśīmagānnṛpaḥ || 4.2.58.210 || āgatya kāśīṃ medhāvī sa bhūpālo ripuṃjayaḥ || prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa svardhunyāḥ paścime taṭe || 211 || ripūnpramathya samare yāvatī śrīrupārjitā || tāvatyā sa hi bhūpālaḥ śivālayamacīklṛpat || 212 || bhūpālalakṣmīrakhilā yattatra viniyojitā || bhūpālaśrīriti khyātā tataḥ sābhūrabhūcchubhā || || 213 || divodāseśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya ripuṃjayaḥ || kṛtakṛtyamivātmānamamanyata nareśvaraḥ || 214 || athaikasmindine rājā talliṃgaṃ vidhipūrvakam || samabhyarcya namaskṛtya yāvattuṣṭāva tuṣṭidam || 215 || tāvannabhoṃgaṇādāśu divyaṃ yānamavātarat || pārṣadaiḥ paritaḥ kīrṇaṃ śūlakhaṭvāṃgapāṇibhiḥ || 216 || atyādityāgnitejobhirbhālanetraiḥ kapardibhiḥ || śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśairaṃgairdīptanabhoṃgaṇaiḥ || 217 || vibhūṣāhi phaṇāratna jyotiḥ pūjita vigrahaiḥ || nityaprakāśasaṃtrasta tamaḥśrita śirodharaiḥ || 218 || cāmaravyagrahastāgra rudrakanyāśatāvṛtam || atha pāriṣadai rājā divyasraganulepanaiḥ ||219|| divyairdukūlanepathyairalaṃcakre mudānvitaiḥ || trinetrīkṛtasadbhāla śyāmīkṛtaśirodharam || 4.2.58.220 || sugaurīkṛtasarvāṃgaṃ kapardīkṛta maulijam || caturbhujīkṛtatanuṃ bhūṣaṇīkṛtapannagam || 221 || caṃdrārdhīkṛtamūrdhānaṃ ninyustaṃ pārṣadā divam|| 222 || tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ bhūpālaśrīriti śrutam || tatra śrāddhādikaṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dattvā svaśaktitaḥ || 223 || divodāseśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā samabhyarcya ca bhaktitaḥ || rājñaścākhyāyikāṃ śrutvā na naro garbhamāviśet || 224 || ākhyānametannṛpaterdivodāsasya pāvanam || paṭhitvā pāṭhayitvāpi naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 225 || divodāsaśubhākhyānaṃ śrutvā yaḥ samaraṃ viśet || na jātu jāyate tasya bhayaṃ vairikṛtaṃ kvacit || 226 || divodāsa kathā puṇyā mahotpāta nikṛṃtanī || paṭhanīyā prayatnena sarvavighnopaśāṃtaye || 227 || nāvṛṣṭirjāyate tatra nākālamaraṇādbhayam || daivodāsī kathā yatra sarvapātakanāśinī || 228 || asyākhyānasya paṭhanādviṣṇoriva manorathāḥ || saṃpūrṇatāṃ gamiṣyaṃti śaṃbhościṃtitakāriṇaḥ ||229|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe uttarārddhe divodāsanirvāṇaprāptirnāmāṣṭapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||58||
<4.2.59>
agastya uvāca || || sarvajña hṛdayānaṃda gaurīcuṃbitamūrdhaja || tārakāṃtaka ṣaḍvaktra tāriṇe bhadrakāriṇe || || 1 || sarvajñānanidhe tubhyaṃ namaḥ sarvajñasūnave || sarvathā jitamārāya kumārāya mahātmane ||2|| kāmārimardhanārīśaṃ vīkṣya kāmakṛtaṃ kila || yo jigāya kumāropi māraṃ tasmai namostu te || 3 || yaduktaṃ bhavatā skaṃda māyādvijavapurhariḥ || kāśyāṃ paṃcanadaṃ tīrthamadhyāsātīva pāvanam|| 4 || bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ pradeśeṣu kāśīparamapāvanam|| tatrāpi hariṇājñāyi tīrthaṃ paṃcanadaṃ param || 5 || kutaḥ paṃcanadaṃ nāma tasya tīrthasya ṣaṇmukha || kutaśca sarvatīrthebhyastadāsītpāvanaṃ param || 6 || kathaṃ ca bhagavānviṣṇuraṃtarātmā jagatpatiḥ || sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ pātā kartā hartā ca līlayā || 7 || arūpo rūpamāpanno hyavyakto vyaktatāṃ gataḥ || nirākāropi sākāro niṣprapaṃcaḥ prapaṃcabhāk || 8 || ajanmānekajanmā ca tvanāmāsphuṭanāmabhṛt|| nirālaṃbo'khilālaṃbo nirguṇopi guṇāspadam || 9 || ahṛṣīkohṛṣīkeśo pyanaṃghrirapisarvagaḥ || upasaṃhṛtya rūpaṃ svaṃ sarvavyāpī janārdanaḥ || 4.2.59.10 || sthitaḥ sarvātmabhāvena tīrthe paṃcanade pare || etadākhyāhi ṣaḍvaktra paṃcavaktrādyathā śrutam ||11|| skaṃda uvāca || || kathayāmi kathāmetāṃ namaskṛtya maheśvaram || sarvāghaugha praśamanīṃ sarvaśreyovidhāyinīm || 12 || yathā paṃcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ kāśyāṃ prathitimāgatam || yannāmagrahaṇādeva pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā || 13 || prayāgopi ca tīrtheśo yatra sākṣātsvayaṃ sthitaḥ || pāpināṃ pāpasaṃghātaṃ prasahya nijatejasā || 14 || haraṃti sarvatīrthāni prayāgasya balena hi || tāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni māghe makarage ravau || 15 || pratyabdaṃ nirmalāni syustīrtharāja samāgamāt || prayāgaścāpi tīrtheṃdraḥ sarvatīrthārpitaṃ malam || 16 || mahāghināṃ mahāghaṃ ca haretpāṃcanadādbalāt || yaṃ saṃcayati pāpaughamāvarṣaṃ tīrthanāyakaḥ || tamekamajjanādūrje tyajetpaṃcanade dhruvam || 17 || yathā paṃcanadotpattistathā ca kathayāmyaham || niśāmaya mahābhāga mitrāvaruṇanaṃdana || 18 || purā vedaśirā nāma munirāsīnmahātapāḥ || bhṛguvaṃśa samutpanno mūrto veda ivāparaḥ || 19 || tapasyatastasya muneḥ purodṛggocaraṃ gatā || śucirapsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā rūpalāvaṇyaśālinī || 4.2.59.20 || tasyā darśanamātreṇa parikṣubdhaṃ munermanaḥ || caskaṃda sa munistūrṇaṃ sātha bhītā varāpsarāḥ || 21 || dūrādeva namaskṛtya tamṛṣiṃ sābhyabhāṣata || atīva vepamānāṃgī śucistacchāpabhītitaḥ || 22 || nāparādhnomyahaṃ kiṃcinmahogratapasāṃnidhe || kṣaṃtavyaṃ me kṣamādhāra kṣamārūpāstapasvinaḥ || 23 || munīnāṃ mānasaṃ prāyo yatpadmādapi tanmṛdu || striyaḥ kaṭhorahṛdayāḥ svarūpeṇaiva sattama || 24 || iti śrutvā vacastasyāḥ śucerapsaraso muniḥ || vivekasetunā staṃbhīnmahāroṣanadīrayam || 25 || uvāca ca prasannātmā śuce śucirasi dhruvam || na me'lpopi hi doṣotra na te doṣosti suṃdari || || 26 || vahnisvarūpā lalanā navanīta samaḥ pumān || anabhijñā vadaṃtīti vicārānmahadaṃtaram || 27 || snihyeduddhṛtasāropi vahneḥ saṃsparśamāpya vai || citraṃ stryākhyā samādānātpumānsnihyati dūrataḥ || 28 || ataḥ śuce na bhetavyaṃ tvayā śuci manogate || atarkitopasthitayā tvayā ca skhalitaṃ mayā || 29 || skhalanānna tathā hānirakāmāttapaso muneḥ || yathā kṣaṇāṃdhīkaraṇāddhāniḥ koparayādareḥ || 4.2.59.30 || kopāttapaḥ kṣayaṃ yāti saṃcitaṃ yatsukṛcchrataḥ || yathābhrapaṭalaṃ prāpya prakāśaḥ puṣpavaṃtayoḥ || 31 || anarthakāriṇaḥ krodhātkvārthānāṃparijṛbhaṇam || kva vā khalajanotsedhātsādhūnāṃ parivardhanam || 32 || amarṣe karṣati mano manobhū saṃbhavaḥ kutaḥ || vidhuṃtude tudatyuccairvidhuṃ kutrāsti kaumudī || 33 || jvalato roṣadāvāgneḥ kva vā śāṃtitaroḥ sthitiḥ || dṛṣṭā kenāpi kiṃ kvāpi siṃhātkalabhasusthatā || 34 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pratīpaḥ pratighātukaḥ || caturvargasya dehasya pariheyo vipaścitā || 35 || idānīṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi kartavyaṃ yattvayā śuce || amoghabījā hi vayaṃ tadbījamurarī kuru || 36 || etasminrakṣite vīrye pariskanne tvadīkṣaṇāt || tvayā tava bhavitrekaṃ kanyāratnaṃ mahāśuci || 37 || ityuktā tena muninā punarjāteva sāpsarāḥ || mahāprasāda ityuktvā muneḥ śukramajīgilat || 38 || atha kālena divyastrī kanyāratnamajījanat || atīva nayanānaṃdi nidhānaṃ rūpasaṃpadām || 39 || tasyaiva vedaśirasa āśrame tāṃ nidhāya sā || śucirapsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā jagāma ca yathepsitam ||4.2.59.40|| tāṃ ca vedaśirāḥ kanyāṃ snehena samavardhayat || kṣīreṇa svāśramasthāyā hariṇyā hariṇīkṣaṇām ||41|| munirnāma dadau tasyai dhūtapāpeti cārthavat || yannāmoccāraṇenāpi kaṃpate pātakāvalī ||42|| sarvalakṣaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ sarvāvayava suṃdarīm || munistatyāja notsaṃgātkṣaṇamātramapi kvacit || 43 || dinedine vardhamānāṃ tāṃ paśyanmumude bhṛśam || kṣīranīradhivadramyāṃ niśi cāṃdramasīṃ kalām || 44 || athāṣṭavārṣikīṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kanyāṃ sa munīśvaraḥ || kasmai deyeti saṃcitya tāmeva samapṛcchata || 45|| || vedaśirā uvāca || || ayi putri mahābhāge dhūtapāpe śubhekṣaṇe || kasmai dadyāvarāya tvāṃ
