tvamevākhyāhi taṃ varam || 46 || atisnehārdracittasya janetuśceti bhāṣitam || niśamya dhūtapāpā sā provāca vinatānanā || 47 || || dhūtapāpovāca|| || janetaryadyahaṃ deyā suṃdarāya varāya te || tadā tasmai prayaccha tvaṃ yamahaṃ kathayāmi te || 48 || tubhyaṃ ca rocate tāta śṛṇotvavahito bhavān || sarvebhyotipavitro yo yaḥ sarveṣāṃ namaskṛtaḥ || 49|| sarve yamabhilaṣyaṃti yasmātsarvasukhodayaḥ || kadācidyo na naśyeta yaḥ sadaivānuvartate || 4.2.59.50 || ihāmutrāpi yo rakṣenmahāpadudayāddhruvam || sarve manorathā yasmātparipūrṇā bhavaṃti hi || 51 || dinedine ca saubhāgyaṃ vardhate yasya sannidhau || nairaṃtaryeṇa yatsevāṃ kurvato na bhayaṃ kvacit || 52 || yannāmagrahaṇādeva kepi vādhāṃ na kurvate || yadādhāreṇa tiṣṭhaṃti bhuvanāni caturdaśa || 53 || evamādyā guṇā yasya varasya varaceṣṭitam || tasmai prayaccha māṃ tāta mama tepīhaśarmaṇe || 54 || etacchrutvāpi tā tasyā bhṛśaṃ mudamavāpa ha || dhanyosmi dhanyā me pūrve yeṣāmaiṣā sutānvaye || 55 || dhruvā hi dhūtapāpāsau yasyā īdṛgvidhā matiḥ || īdṛgvidhairguṇagaṇairgarimṇā kotra vai bhavet || 56 || athavā sa kathaṃ labhyo vinā puṇyabharodayam || iti kṣaṇaṃ samādhāya manaḥ sa munipuṃgavaḥ || 57 || jñānena taṃ samālocya varamīdṛgguṇodayam || dhanyāṃ kanyāṃ babhāṣetha śṛṇu vatse śubhaiṣiṇi || 58 || || pitovāca || || varasya ye tvayā proktā guṇā ete vicakṣaṇe || eṣāṃ guṇānāmādhāro varostīti viniścitam || 59 || paraṃ sa sukhalabhyo na nitarāṃ subhagākṛtiḥ || tapaḥ paṇena sa krayyaḥ sutīrthavipaṇau kvacit || 4.2.59.60 || tīrthabhāraiḥ sa sulabho na kaulīnyena kanyake || na vedaśāstrābhyasanairna caiśvaryabalena vai || 61 || na sauṃdaryeṇa vapuṣā na buddhyā na parākramaiḥ || ekayaiva manaḥ śuddhyā karaṇānāṃ jayena ca || 62 || mahātapaḥ sahāyena damadānadayāyujā || labhyate sa mahāprājño nānyathā sadṛśaḥ patiḥ || 63 || iti śrutvātha sā kanyā pitaraṃ praṇipatya ca || anujñāṃ prārthayāmāsa tapase kṛtaniścayā || 64 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kṛtānujñā janetrā sā kṣetre paramapāvane || tapastatāpa paramaṃ yadasādhyaṃ tapasvibhiḥ || 65 || kva sā bālātimṛdvaṃgī kva ca tattādṛśaṃ tapaḥ || kaṭhoravarṣmasaṃsādhyamaho saccetaso dhṛtiḥ || 66 || dhārāsārā suvarṣāsu mahāvātavatīṣvalam || śilāsu sāvakāśāsu sā bahvīranayanniśāḥ || 67 || śrutvā garjaravaṃ ghoraṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyuccamatkṛtīḥ || āsārasīkaraiḥ klinnā na cakaṃpe manākca sā || 68 || taḍitsphuraṃtītvasakṛttamisrāsu tapovane || yātāyātaṃ karotīva draṣṭuṃ tattapasaḥ sthitim ||69|| tapartureva sākṣācca kumārī kaitavātkila|| paṃcāgnīnparidhāyātra tapasyati tapovane||4.2.59.70|| jalābhilāṣiṇī bālā na manāgapi sā pibat|| kuśāgratoyapṛṣataṃ paṃcāgniparitāpitā||71|| romāṃca kaṃcukavatī vepamānatanucchadā|| paryakṣipatkṣapāḥ kṣāmā tapasā haimanīśca sā ||72|| niśīthinīṣu śiśire śrayaṃtī sārasaṃ rasam || mene sā sārasaiḥ keyamudyatādyeti padminī || 73 || manasvināmapi manorāgatāṃ sṛjate madhau || tadoṣṭhapallavādrāgo jahre mākaṃdapallavaiḥ || 74 || vasaṃte nivasaṃtī sā vane bālācalaṃmanaḥ || cakre tapasyapi śrutvā kokilā kākalīravam || 75 || baṃdhujīve'dhararuciṃ kalahaṃse kalāgatīḥ || nikṣepamiva sā kṣiptvā śaradyāsīttaporatā|| 76 || apāstabhogasaṃparkā bhogināṃ vṛttimāśritā || kṣududbodhanirodhāya dhūtapāpā tapasvinī || || 77 || śāṇena maṇivallīḍhā kṛśāpyāyādanarghatām || tathāpi tapasā kṣāmā didīpe tattanustarām || 78 || nirīkṣya tāṃ tapasyaṃtīṃ vidhiḥ saṃśuddhamānasām || upetyovāca suprajñe prasannosmi varaṃ vṛṇu || 79 || sā caturvaktramālokya haṃsayānoparisthitam || praṇamya prāṃjaliḥ prītā provācātha prajāpatim || 4.2.59.80 || || dhūtapāpovāca || || pitāmaha varo mahyaṃ yadi deyo varaprada || sarvebhyaḥ pāvanebhyopi kuru māmatipāvanīm || 81 || sraṣṭā tadiṣṭamākarṇya nitarāṃ tuṣṭamānasaḥ || pratyuvācātha tāṃ bālāṃ vimalāṃ vimaleṣiṇīm || 82 || || brahmovāca || || dhūtapāpe pavitrāṇi yāni saṃtyatra sarvataḥ || tebhyaḥ pavitramatulaṃ tvamedhi varato mama || 83 || tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca saṃti tīrthāni kanyake || divi bhuvyaṃtarikṣe ca pāvanānyuttarottaram || 84 || tāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni tvattanau pratiloma vai || vasaṃtu mama vākyena bhava sarvātipāvanī || 85 || ityuktvāṃtardadhe vedhāḥ sāpi nirdhūtakalmaṣā || dhūtapāpoṭajaṃ prāptātho vedaśirasaḥ pituḥ || 86 || kadācittāṃ samālokya khelaṃtīmuṭajājire || dharmastattapasākṛṣṭaḥ prārthayāmāsa kanyakām || 87 || ||dharma uvāca || || pṛthuśroṇi viśālākṣi kṣāmodari śubhānane || krītaḥ svarūpasaṃpattyā tvayāhaṃ dehi me rahaḥ || 88 || nitarāṃ bādhate kāmastvatkṛte māṃ sulocane || ajñātanāmnā sā tena prārthitetyasakṛdgrahaḥ || 89 || uvāca sā pitā dātā taṃ prārthaya sudurmate || pitṛpradeyā yatkanyā śrutireṣā sanātanī || 4.2.59.90 || niśamyeti vaco dharmo bhāvinorthasya gauravāt || punarnibaṃdhayāṃcakre 'padhṛtirdhṛtiśālinīm || 91 || || dharma uvāca || || na prārthayehaṃ subhage pitaraṃ tava suṃdari || gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena kuru me tvaṃ samīhitam || 92 || iti nirbaṃdhavadvākyaṃ sā niśamya kumārikā || pituḥ kanyāphalaṃditsuḥ punarāheti taṃ dvijam || 93 || are jaḍamate mā tvaṃ punarbrūhīti yāhyataḥ || ityuktopi kumāryā sa nātiṣṭhanmadanāturaḥ || 94 || tataḥ śaśāpa taṃ bālā prabalā tapaso balāt || jaḍosi nitarāṃ yasmājjalādhāro nado bhava || 95 || iti śaptastayā sotha tāṃ śaśāpa krudhānvitaḥ || kaṭhorahṛdaye tvaṃ tu śilā bhava sudurmate || 96 || || skaṃda uvāca || || ityanyonyasya śāpena mune dharmo nado'bhavat || avimukte mahākṣetre khyāto dharmanado mahān || 97 || sāpyāha pitaraṃ trastā svaśilātvasya kāraṇam|| dhyānena dharmaṃ vijñāya muniḥ kanyāmathābravīt || 98 || mā bhaiḥ putri kariṣyāmi tava sarvaṃ śubhodayam || tacchāpo nānyathā bhūyāccaṃdrakāṃtaśilā bhava || 99 || caṃdrodayamanuprāpya dravībhūtatanustataḥ || dhunī bhava sute sādhvi dhūtapāpeti viśrutā || 4.2.59.100 || sa ca dharmanadaḥ kanye tava bhartā suśobhanaḥ || tairguṇaiḥ paripūrṇāṃgo ye guṇāḥ prārthitāstvayā || 101 || anyacca śṛṇu sadbuddhe mamāpi tapaso balāt || dvairūpyaṃ bhavatorbhāvi prākṛtaṃ ca dravaṃ ca vai || 102 || ityāśvāsya pitā kanyāṃ dhūtapāpāṃ paraṃtapa || caṃdrakāṃtaśilābhūtāmanujagrāha buddhimān ||103|| tadārabhya mune kāśyāṃ khyāto dharmanado hradaḥ || dharmo dravasvarūpeṇa mahāpātakanāśanaḥ || 104 || dhunī ca dhūtapāpā sā sarvatīrthamayī śubhā || harenmahāghasaṃghātānkūlajāniva pādapān || || 105 || tatra dharmanade tīrthe dhūtapāpā samanvite || yadā na svardhunī tatra tadā bradhnastapo vyadhāt || 106 || gabhastimālī bhagavāngabhastīśvara sannidhau || śīlayanmaṃgalāṃ gaurīṃ tapa ugraṃ cacāra ha || 107 || nāmnā mayūkhādityasya tīrthe tatra tapasyataḥ || kiraṇebhyaḥ pravavṛte mahāsvedotikhedataḥ || 108 || kiraṇebhyaḥ pravṛttāyā mahāsvedasya saṃtatiḥ || tataḥ sā kiraṇānāma jātā puṇyā taraṃgiṇī||9|| mahāpāpāṃdhatamasaṃ kiraṇākhyā taraṃgiṇī|| dhvaṃsayetsnānamātreṇa militā dhūtapāpayā ||4.2.59.110|| ādau dharmanadaḥ puṇyo miśrito dhūtapāpayā || yayā dhūtāni pāpāni sarvatīrthīkṛtātmanā || 111 || tatopi militāgatya kiraṇā raviṇaidhitā || yannāmasmaraṇādeva mahāmohoṃdhatāṃ vrajet||112|| kiraṇā dhūtapāpe ca tasmindharmanade śubhe || sravaṃtyau pāpasaṃhartryau vārāṇasyāṃ śubhadrave || 113 || tato bhāgīrathī prāptā tena dailīpinā saha || bhāgīrathī samāyātā yamunā ca sarasvatī || 114 || kiraṇā dhūtapāpā ca puṇyatoyā sarasvatī || gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva paṃcanadyotra kīrtitāḥ || 115 || ataḥ paṃcanadaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || tatrāpluto na gṛhṇīyāddehaṃ nā pāṃcabhautikam || 116 || asminpaṃcanadīnāṃ ca saṃbhedeghaughabhedini || snānamātrātprayātyeva bhittvā brahmāṃḍamaṃḍapam || 117 || tīrthāni saṃti bhūyāṃsi kāśyāmatra padepade || na paṃcanadatīrthasya koṭyaṃśena samānyapi || 118 || prayāge māghamāse tu samyaksnātasya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ syāddinaikena kāśyāṃ paṃcanade dhruvam || 119 || snātvā paṃcanade tīrthe kṛtvā ca pitṛtarpaṇam || biṃdumādhavamabhyarcya na bhūyo janmabhāgbhavet || 4.2.59.120 || yāvatsaṃkhyāstilādattāḥ pitṛbhyo jalatarpaṇe || puṇye paṃcanade tīrthe tṛptiḥ syāttāvadābdikī || 121 || śraddhayā yaiḥ kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ tītheṃ paṃcanade śubhe || teṣāṃ pitāmahā muktā nānāyoni gatā api || 122 || yamaloke pitṛgaṇairgātheyaṃ parigīyate || mahimānaṃ pāṃcanadaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrāddhavidhānataḥ ||23|| asmākamapi vaṃśyotra kaścicchrāddhaṃ kariṣyati || kāśyāṃ paṃcanadaṃ prāpya yena mucyāmahe vayam|| 124 || iyaṃ gāthā pratidinaṃ śrāddhadevasya sannidhau || pitṛbhiḥ parigīyeta kāśyāṃ paṃcanadaṃ prati || 125 || tatra paṃcanade tīrthe yatkiṃciddīyate vasu || kalpakṣayepi na bhavettasya puṇyasya saṃkṣayaḥ ||126|| vaṃdhyāpi varṣaparyaṃtaṃ snātvā paṃcanade hrade || samarcya maṃgalāṃ gauṃrīṃ putraṃ janayati dhruvam || 127 || jalaiḥ pāṃcanadaiḥ puṇyairvāsasā pāriśodhitaiḥ || mahāphalamavāpnoti snapayitveṣṭadevatām || 128 || paṃcāmṛtānāṃ kalaśairaṣṭottaraśatonmitaiḥ || tulitodhikatāṃ yāto biṃduḥ paṃcanadāṃbhasaḥ ||129|| paṃcakūrcena pītena yātra śuddhirudāhṛtā || sā śuddhiḥ śraddhayā prāśya biṃduṃ pāṃcanadāṃbhasaḥ || 4.2.59.130 || bhavedavabhṛthasnānādrājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ || yatphalaṃ tacchataguṇaṃ snānātpāṃcanadāṃbhasā ||131|| rājasūyāśvamedhau ca bhavetāṃ svargasādhanam || ābrahmaghaṭikādvaṃdvaṃ muktyai pāṃcanadāplutiḥ ||132|| svargarājyābhiṣekopi na tathā saṃmataḥ satām || abhiṣekaḥ pāṃcanado yathānalpasukhapradaḥ ||133|| varaṃ vārāṇasīṃ prāpya bhṛtyaḥ paṃcanadokṣiṇām || nānyatra sevakībhūta bhūpakoṭirnareśvaraḥ || 134 || yairna paṃcanade snātaṃ kārtike pāpahāriṇi || te'dyāpi garbhe tiṣṭhaṃti punaste garbhavāsinaḥ || 135 || kṛte dharmanadaṃ nāma tretāyāṃ dhūtapāpakam || dvāpare biṃdutīrthaṃ ca kalau paṃcanadaṃ smṛtam|| 136 || śataṃ samāstapastaptvā kṛte yatprāpyate phalam || tatkārtike paṃcanade sakṛtsnānena labhyate || 137 || iṣṭāpūrteṣu dharmeṣu yāvajanmakṛteṣu yat || anyatra syātphalaṃ tatsyādūrje dharmanadāplavāt || 138 || na dhūtapāpa sadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ kvāpi mahītale || yadekasnānato naśyedaghaṃ janmatrayārjitam || 139 || biṃdutīrthe naro dattvā kāṃcanaṃ kṛṣṇalonmitam || na daridro bhavetkvāpi na svarṇena viyujyate || 4.2.59.140 || gobhūtilahiraṇyāśva vāsonnasragvibhūṣaṇam || yatkiṃcidbiṃdutīrthetra dattvākṣayamavāpnuyāt || 141 || ekāmapyāhutiṃ dattvā samiddhegnau vidhānataḥ || puṇye dharmanade tīrthe koṭihomaphalaṃ labhet || 142 || na paṃcanadatīrthasya mahimānamanaṃtakam || kopi varṇayituṃ śaktaścaturvarga śubhaukasaḥ || 143 || śrutvākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ śrāvayitvāpi bhaktitaḥ || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 144 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturtheṃ kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe paṃcanadāvirbhāvo nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
<4.2.60>
skaṃda uvāca || uktā paṃcanadotpattirmitrāvaruṇanaṃdana || idānīṃ kathayiṣyāmi mādhavāviṣkṛtiṃ parām || 1 || yāṃ śrutvā śraddhayā dhīmānpāpebhyo mucyate kṣaṇāt || na ca śriyā viyujyeta saṃyujyeta vṛṣeṇa ca || 2 || āgatya maṃdarādadrerupeṃdraścaṃdraśekharam || āpṛcchya tārkṣyarathagaḥ kṣaṇādvārāṇasīṃ purīm|| 3 || divo dāsaṃ mahīpālaṃ samuccāṭya svamāyayā || sthitvā pādodake tīrthe keśavākhya svarūpataḥ || 4 || mahimānaṃ paraṃ kāśyāṃ vicārya suvicārya ca || dṛṣṭvā paṃcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ parāṃ mudamavāpa ha || 5 || uvāca ca prasannātmā puṃḍarīkavilocanaḥ || agaṇyā api vaikuṃṭha guṇā vigaṇitā mayā || 6 || kva kṣīranīradhau saṃti tāvaṃto nirmalā guṇāḥ || yāvaṃto vijayaṃ tetra kāśyāṃ paṃcanade hrade || 7 || śvetadvīpepi sāmagrī kva guṇānāṃ garīyasī || īdṛśī yādṛśī kāśyāṃ dhūtapāpesti pāvanī || 8 || mude kaumodakī sparśastathā na mama jāyate || dhūtapāpāṃbu saṃparko yathā bhavati sarvathā || 9 || na kṣīranīradhijayā sukhaṃ me śliṣṭagātrayā || tathā bhavedyathātra syātspṛṣṭayā dhūtapāpayā || 4.2.60.10 || itthaṃ paṃcanade tīrthe kṣīranīradhijādhavaḥ || saṃpreṣya tārkṣyaṃ tryakṣāgre vṛttāṃtaviniveditum || 11 || ānaṃdakānanabhavaṃ divodāsa kṣamāpateḥ || saṃvarṇayanguṇagrāmaṃ puṇyaṃ pāṃcanadodbhavam || 12 || sukhopaviṣṭaḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sudṛṣṭirviṣṭaraśravāḥ || dṛṣṭavāṃstapasā juṣṭamapuṣṭāṃgaṃ tapodhanam || 13 || sa ṛṣistaṃ samabhyetya puṃḍarīkākṣamacyutam || upopaviṣṭakamalaṃ vanamālāvirājitam || 14 || śaṃkhapadmagadācakra caṃcatkaracatuṣṭayam || kaustubhodbhāsitoraskaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam || 15 || sunīleṃdīvararuciṃ susnigdha madhurākṛtim || nābhīhradalasatpadma supāṭalaradacchadam || 16 || dāḍimībījadaśanaṃ kirīṭadyotitāṃbaram || deveṃdravaṃditapadaṃ sanakādipariṣṭutam || 17 || divyarṣibhirnāradādyaiḥ parigītamahodayam || prahlādādyairbhāgavataiḥ parinaṃditamānasam || 18 || dhṛtaśārṅgadhanurdaṃḍaṃ daṃḍitākhiladānavam|| madhukaiṭabhahaṃtāraṃ kaṃsavidhvaṃsasūcakam|| 19 || kaivalyaṃ yatparaṃ brahma nirākāramagocaram || taṃ puṃ mūrtyā pariṇataṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktihetutaḥ ||4.2.60.20|| vedāviduryadākāraṃ naivopaniṣadoditam|| brahmādyā na ca gīrvāṇāścakre netrātithiṃ satam ||21|| praṇanāma mudāyuktaḥ kṣitivinyastamastakaḥ || sa ṛṣistaṃ hṛṣīkeśamagnibiṃdurmahātapāḥ || 22 || tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā maulibaddhakarāṃjaliḥ || adhyastavistīrṇaśilaṃ balidhvaṃsinamacyutam || 23 || tatra paṃcanadābhyāśe mārkaṃḍeyādi sevite || goviṃdamagnibiṃduḥ sa stutavāṃstuṣṭamānasaḥ || 24 || || agnibiṃduruvāca || || oṃ namaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣa bāhyāṃtaḥ śaucadāyine || sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt || 25 || namāmi te padadvaṃdvaṃ sarvadvaṃdvanivārakam || nirdvaṃdvayā dhiyā viṣṇo jiṣṇvādi suravaṃdita || 26 || yaṃ stotuṃ nādhigacchaṃti vāco vācaspaterapi || tamīṣṭe ka iha stotuṃ bhaktiratra balīyasī || 27 || api yo bhagavānīśo manaḥprācāmagocaraḥ || samādṛśairalpadhībhiḥ kathaṃ stutyo vacaḥ paraḥ || 28 || yaṃ vāco na viśaṃtīśaṃ manatīha mano na yam || mano girāmatītaṃ taṃ kaḥ stotuṃ śaktimānbhavet || 29 || yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedāḥ sa ṣaḍaṃgapadakramāḥ || tasya devasya mahimā mahānkairavagamyate || 4.2.60.30 || ataṃdritamanobuddhīṃdriyā yaṃ sanakādayaḥ || dhyāyaṃtopi hṛdākāśe na viṃdaṃti yathārthataḥ || 31 || nāradādyairmunivarairābāla brahmacāribhiḥ || gīyamānacaritropi na samyagyodhigamyate || 32 || taṃsūkṣmarūpamajamavyayamekamādyaṃ bahmādyagocaramajeyamanaṃtaśaktim || nityaṃ nirāmayamamūrtamaciṃtyamūrtiṃ kastvāṃ carācara carācarabhinna vetti || 33 || ekaikameva tava nāmaharenmurāre janmārjitāghamaghināṃ ca mahāpadāḍhyam || dadyātphalaṃ ca mahitaṃ mahato makhasya japtaṃ mukuṃdamadhusūdanamādhaveti || 34 || nārāyaṇeti narakārṇava tāraṇeti dāmodareti madhuheti caturbhujeti || viśvaṃbhareti virajeti janārdaneti kvāstīha janma japatāṃ kva kṛtāṃtabhītiḥ || 35 || ye tvāṃ trivikrama sadā hṛdi śīlayaṃti kādaṃbinī rucira rociṣamaṃbujākṣam || saudāmanīvilasitāṃśukavītamūrte tepi spṛśaṃti tava kāṃtimaciṃtyarūpām || 36 || śrīvatsalāṃchanaharecyutakaiṭabhāre goviṃdatārkṣya rathakeśavacakrapāṇe || lakṣmīpate danujasūdana śārṅgapāṇe tvadbhaktibhāji na bhayaṃkvacidasti puṃsi ||37|| yairarcitosi bhagavaṃstulasīprasūnairdūrīkṛtaiṇamadasaurabhadivyagaṃdhaiḥ || tānarcayaṃti divi devagaṇāḥsamastā maṃdāradāmabhiralaṃ vimalasvabhāvān || 38 || yadvāci nāma tava kāmadamabjanetra yacchrotrayostava kathā madhurākṣarāṇi || yaccittabhittilikhitaṃ bhavatosti rūpaṃ nīrūpabhūpapadavī nahi tairdurāpā || 39 || ye tvāṃ bhajaṃti satataṃ bhuviśeṣaśāyiṃstāñchrīpate pitṛpatīṃdra kuberamukhyāḥ || vṛṃdārakā divi sadaiva sabhājayaṃti svargāpavargasukhasaṃtatidānadakṣa || 4.2.60.40 || ye tvāṃ stuvaṃti satataṃ divitānstuvaṃti siddhāpsaromaragaṇā lasadabjapāṇe || viśrāṇayatyakhilasiddhidakovinā tvāṃ nirvāṇacārukamalāṃ kamalāyatākṣa || 41 || tvaṃ haṃsi pāsi sṛjasi kṣaṇataḥ svalīlā līlāvapurdhara viriṃcinatāṃghriyugma|| viśvaṃ tvameva paraviśvapatistvameva viśvasyabījamasi tatpraṇatosmi nityam || 42 || stotā tvameva danujeṃdraripo stutistvaṃ stutyastvameva sakalaṃ hi bhavānihaikaḥ || tvatto na kiṃcidapi bhinnamavaimi viṣṇo tṛṣṇāṃ sadā kṛṇuhi me bhavajāṃbhavāre || 43 || iti stutvā hṛṣīkeśamagnibiṃdurmahātapāḥ || tasthau tūṣṇīṃ tato viṣṇuruvāca varado munim || 44 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || agnibiṃdo mahāprājña mahatā tapasāṃnidhe || varaṃ varaya suprītastavādeyaṃ na kiṃcana ||45|| agnibiṃduruvāca || || yadi prītosi bhagavanvaikuṃṭheśa jagatpate || kamalākāṃta taddehi yadiha prārthayāmyaham|| || 46 || kṛtānujñotha hariṇā bhrūbhaṃgena sa tāpasaḥ || kṛtapraṇāmo hṛṣṭātmā varayāmāsa keśavam || 47 || bhagavansarvagopīha tiṣṭha paṃcanade hrade || hitāya sarva jaṃtūnāṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 48 || lakṣmīśe na varo mahyameṣa deyo'vicārataḥ || nānyaṃ varaṃ samīhehaṃ bhaktiṃ ca tvapadāṃbuje || 49 || iti śrutvā varaṃ tasyāgnibiṃdormadhusūdanaḥ || prītaḥ paropakārārthaṃ tathetyāhābdhijāpatiḥ || 4.2.60.50 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || agnibiṃdo muniśreṣṭha sthāsyāmyahamiha dhruvam || kāśībhaktimatāṃ puṃsāṃ muktimārgaṃ samādiśan || 51 || mune punaḥ prasannosmi varaṃ brūhi dadāmi te || atīva mama bhaktosi bhaktistestu dṛḍhā mayi || 52 || ādāveva hi tiṣṭhāsurahamatra taponidhe || tatastvayā samabhyarthi sthāsyāmyatra sadaiva hi || 53 || prāpya kāśīṃ sudurmedhāḥ kastyajejjñānavānyadi || anarghyaṃ prāpya māṇikyaṃ hitvā kācaṃ ka īhate || 54 || alpīyasā śrameṇeha vapuṣo vyayamātrataḥ || avaśyaṃ gatvarasyāśu yathāmuktistathā kva hi || 55 || vinimayya jarājīrṇaṃ dehaṃ pārthivamatra vai || prājñāḥ kimu na gṛhṇīyuramṛtaṃ nairjaraṃ vapuḥ || 56 || na tapobhirna vā dānairna yajñairbahudakṣiṇaiḥ || anyatra labhyate mokṣo yathā kāśyāṃ tanu vyayāt || 57 || api yogaṃ hi yuṃjānā yogino yatamānasāḥ || naikenajanmanā muktāḥ kāśyāṃ muktā vapurvyayāt || 58 || idameva mahādānamidameva mahattapaḥ || idameva vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yatkāśyāṃ mriyate tanuḥ || 59 || sa eva vidvāñjagati sa eva vijiteṃdriyaḥ || sa eva puṇyavāndhanyo labdhvā kāśīṃ na yastyajet || 4.2.60.60 || tāvatsthāsyāmyahaṃ cātra yāvatkāśī mune tviha || pralayepi na nāśosyāḥ śivaśūlāgra susthiteḥ || 61 || ityākarṇya giraṃ viṣṇoragnibiṃdurmahāmuniḥ || prahṛṣṭaromā provāca punaranyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe || 62 || māpate mama nāmnātra tīrthe paṃcanade śubhe || abhaktebhyopi bhaktebhyaḥ sthito muktiṃ sadādiśa || 63 || yetra paṃcanade snātvā gatvā deśāṃtareṣvapi || narā paṃcatvamāpannā muktiṃ tebhyopi vai diśa || 64 || yetu paṃcanade snātvā tvāṃ bhajiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || calācalāpi dvairūpā mā tyākṣīcchrīśca tānnarān || 65 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || evamastvagnibiṃdotra bhavatā yadvṛtaṃmune|| tvannāmno'rdhena me nāma mayā saha bhaviṣyati ||66|| biṃdumādhava ityākhyā mama trailokyaviśrutā || kāśyāṃ bhaviṣyati mune mahāpāpaugha ghātinī || 67 || ye māmatra narāḥ puṇyāḥ puṇye paṃcanade hrade || sadā saparyayiṣyaṃti teṣāṃ saṃsārabhīḥ kutaḥ || 68 || vasusvarūpiṇī lakṣmīrlakṣmīrnirvāṇasaṃjñikā || tatpārśvagā sadā yeṣāṃ hṛdi paṃcanade hyaham || 69 || yairna paṃcanadaṃ prāpya vasubhiḥ prīṇitā dvijāḥ || āśulabhyavipattīnāṃ teṣāṃ tadvasuroditi || 4.2.60.70 || ta eva dhanyā lokesminkṛtakṛtyāsta eva hi || prāpya yairmama sāṃnidhyaṃ vasavo mama sātkṛtāḥ ||71 || biṃdutīrthamidaṃ nāma tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati || agnibiṃdo muniśreṣṭha sarvapātakanāśanam || 72 || kārtike biṃdutīrthe yo brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ || snāsyatyanudite bhānau bhānujāttasya bhīḥ kutaḥ||73|| api pāpasahasrāṇi kṛtvā mohena mānavaḥ || ūrje dharmanade snāto niṣpāpo jāyate kṣaṇāt || '74 || yāvatsvasthosti dehoyaṃ yāvanneṃdriyaviklavaḥ || tāvadvratāni kurvīta yato dehaphalaṃ vratam || 75 || ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca || upavāsena dehoyaṃ saṃśodhyo śucibhājanam || 76 || kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇādīni kartavyāni prayatnataḥ || aśuciḥ śucitāmeti kāyo yadvratadhāraṇāt || 77 || vrataiḥ saṃśodhite dehe dharmo vasati niścalaḥ || arthakāmau sanirvāṇau tatra yatra vṛṣa sthitiḥ || 78 || tasmādvratāni satataṃ caritavyāni mānavaiḥ || dharmasānnidhya kartṛṇi caturvargaphalepsubhiḥ || 79 || sadā kartuṃ na śaknoti vratāni yadi mānavaḥ || cāturmāsyamanuprāpya tadā kuryātprayatnataḥ || 4.2.60.80 || bhūśayyā brahmacaryaṃ ca kiṃcidbhakṣyaniṣedhanam || ekabhaktādi niyamo nityadānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 81 || purāṇaśravaṇaṃ caiva tadarthācaraṇaṃ punaḥ || akhaṃḍadīpodbodhaśca mahāpūjeṣṭadaivate || 82 || prabhūtāṃkurabījāḍhye deśe cāpi gatāgatam || yatnena varjayeddhīmānmahādharmavivṛddhaye || 83 || asaṃbhāṣyā na saṃbhāṣyāścāturmāsya vratasthitaiḥ || maunaṃ cāpi sadā kāryaṃ tathyaṃ vaktavyameva vā ||84|| niṣpāvāṃśca masūrāṃśca kodravānvarjayedvratī || sadā śucibhirāstheyaṃ spraṣṭavyo nāvratī janaḥ || 85 || daṃtakeśāṃbarādīni nityaṃ śodhyāni yatnataḥ || aniṣṭaciṃtā no kāryā vratinā hṛdyapi kvacit || 86 || dvādaśasvapi māseṣu vratino yatphalaṃ bhavet || cāturmāsyavratabhṛtāṃ tatphalaṃ syādakhaṃḍitam || 87 || caturṣvapi ca māseṣu na sāmarthyaṃ vrate yadi || tadorje vratinā bhāvyamapyabdaphalamicchatā || 88 || avrataḥ kārtiko yeṣāṃ gato mūḍhadhiyāmiha || teṣāṃ puṇyasya leśopi na bhavetsūkarātmanām || 89 || kṛcchraṃ vā cātikṛcchraṃ vā prājāpatyamathāpi vā || saṃprāpte kārtike māsi kuryācchaktyāti puṇyavān || 4.2.60.90 || ekāṃtaraṃ vrataṃ kuryāttrirātra vratameva vā || paṃcarātraṃ saptarātraṃ saṃprāpte kārtike vratī || 91 || pakṣavrataṃ vā kurvīta māsopoṣaṇameva vā || norjo vaṃdhyo vidhātavyo vratinā kenacitkvacit || 92|| śākāhāraṃ payohāraṃ phalāhāramathāpi vā || caredyavānnāhāraṃ vā saṃprāpte kārtike vratī ||93|| nityanaimittikaṃ snānaṃ kuryādūrje vratī naraḥ || brahmacaryaṃ caredūrje mahāvrataphalārthavān || 94 || bāhulaṃ brahmacaryeṇa yaḥ kṣipecchucimānasaḥ || samastaṃ hāyanaṃ tena brahmacaryakṛtaṃ bhavet ||95|| yastu kārtikikaṃ māsamupavāsaiḥ samāpayet || apyabdamapi teneha bhavetsamyagupoṣitam || 96 | śākāhārapayohārairūrjoṃ yairativāhitaḥ || akhaṃḍitā śarattena tadāhāreṇa yāpitā || 97 || patrabhojī bhavedūrje kāṃsyaṃ tyājyaṃ prayatnataḥ || yo vratī kāṃsyabhojī syānna tadvrataphalaṃ labhet ||98|| kāṃsyasya niyame dadyātkāṃsyaṃ sarpiḥ prapūritam || ūrje na bhakṣayetkṣaudramatikṣudragatipradam || 99 || madhutyāge ghṛtaṃ dadyātpāyasaṃ ca saśarkaram || abhyaṃge'bhyavahāre ca tailamūrje vivarjayet ||4.2.60.100|| bhūyātsa nārakī dehī tatrābhyaṃgādyatonagha || tailatyāge tilāndadyāddroṇamātrānsa kāṃcanān || 101 || kārtike matsyabhojī yaḥ sa taimīṃ yonimṛcchati || bāhule māṃsabhojī yaḥ sa kṛmiḥpūyaśoṇite || 102 || māṃsāśinopi ye bhūpāstyajeyustepi kārtike || matsyamāṃsāni saṃtyajya kārttike vratatatparaḥ || 103 || matsyamāṃsādanāddoṣādbahirbhavati niścitam || niyame matsyamāṃsānāṃ dadyātkārtikike vratī || kūśmāṃḍāni samāṣāṇi daśasvarṇayutānyapi || 104 || kārtike mīnabhojī yaḥ sośnātyamṛtamevahi || sughaṃṭāṃ satilāṃ maunī sahiraṇyāṃ pradāpayet || 105 || kārtike lavaṇaṃ tyaktaṃ yena vratabhṛtā satā || tyaktāḥ sarve rasāstena tattyāgī gāṃ pradāpayet || 106 || bhūśayyāṃ kārtike kurvanna bhuvaṃ saṃspṛśedvratī || paryaṃkaṃ bhūśayo dadyātsatūlaṃ sopadhānakam || 107 || dīpaṃ yaḥ kārtike dadyādakhaṃḍaṃ ghṛtavartikam || mohāṃdha tamasaṃ prāpya sa na gacchati durgatim ||108|| yaḥ kuryātkārtike māse rajanyāṃ dīpakaumudīm || tāmisraṃ cāṃdhatāmisraṃ na sa paśyetkadācana ||109|| pāpāṃdhakārasaṃkruddhaḥ kārtike dīpadānataḥ || krodhāṃdhakāritamukhaṃ bhāskariṃ sa na vīkṣate || 4.2.60.110 || sa uddyotamayaṃ paśyettrailokyaṃ sacarācaram || prabodhayenmamāgre yo dīpaṃ sojvalavartikam || 111 || paṃcāmṛtānāṃ kalaśairūrje māṃ snāpayennaraḥ || kṣīrābdhitaṭamāsādya vasetkalpaṃ sa puṇyavān || 112 || pratikṣapaṃ kārtikike kurvañjyotsnāṃ pradīpajām || mamāgre bhaktisaṃyukto garbhadhvāṃtaṃ na saṃviśet || 113 || ājyavartikamūrje yo dīpaṃ megre prabodhayet || buddhibhraṃśaṃ na cāpnoti mahāmṛtyubhaye sati || 114 || kārtike māsi me yātrā yaiḥ kṛtā bhaktitatparaiḥ || biṃdutīrthe kṛtasnānaisteṣāṃ muktirna dūrataḥ || 115 || vratinaḥ kārtike māsi snātasya vidhivanmama || dāmodaragṛhāṇārghyaṃ danujeṃdraniṣūdana || 116 || snāne naimittike kṛṣṇa kārtike pāpaśoṣaṇe || gṛhṇātvarghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rādhayā sahito bhavān || 117 || imau maṃtrau samuccārya yorghyaṃ mahyaṃ prayacchati || suvarṇaratna puṣpāṃbu yujā śaṃkhena puṇyavān || 118 || suvarṇapūrṇapṛthivī saṃkalpodakapūrvakam || tena dattā bhavetsamyaksupātrāya suparvaṇi || 119 || ekādaśīṃ samāsādya prabodhakaraṇīṃ mama || biṃdutīrthakṛtasnāno rātrau jāgaraṇānvitaḥ || 4.2.60.120 || dīpānprobodhya bahuśo mamālaṃkṛtya śaktitaḥ || tauryatrikavinodena purāṇaśravaṇādibhiḥ || 121 || mahāmahotsavaṃ kṛtvā yāvatpūrṇā tithirbhavet || tatrānnadānaṃ bahuśaḥ kṛtvāmatprītaye naraḥ || 122 || mahāpātakayuktopi na viśetpramadodaram || biṃdumādhavanāmānaṃ yo māmatra samarcayet || 123 || biṃdutīrthakṛtasnāno nirvāṇaṃ sa hi viṃdati || ādimādhavanāmāhaṃ pūjyaḥ satyayuge mune || 124 || anaṃtamādhavo jñeyastretāyāṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ || śrīdamādhavasaṃjñohaṃ dvāpare paramārthakṛt||125|| kalau kalimaladhvaṃsī jñeyohaṃ biṃdumādhavaḥ || kalau kalmaṣasaṃpannā na māṃ viṃdaṃti mānavāḥ ||126|| mamaiva māyayā mūḍhā bhedavādaparāyaṇāḥ|| mama bhaktiṃ prakurvāṇā ye viśveśaṃ dviṣaṃti vai || 127 || vidviṣo mama te jñeyāḥ piśācapadagāminaḥ || paiśācīṃ yonimāpyāpi kālabhairavaśāsanāt || 128 || triṃśadvarṣa sahasrāṇi uṣitvā duḥkhasāgare || viśveśānugrahādeva tato mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ || 129 || tasmāddveṣo na kartavyo viśveśe paramātmani || viśveśa dveṣiṇāṃ puṃsāṃ prāyaścittaṃ yato nahi || 4.2.60.130 || manasāpi hi viśveśaṃ vidviṣaṃtīha ye'dhamāḥ || adhyāsateṃdhatāmisraṃ mṛtāstenyatra saṃtatam ||131|| śivaniṃdāparā ye ca ye pāśupataniṃdakāḥ|| vidviṣo mama te jñeyā patato narake'śucau || 132 || aṣṭāviṃśati koṭīṣu narakeṣu krameṇa hi || kalpaṃ kalpaṃ vaseyuste ye viśveśvaraniṃdakāḥ || 133 || viśveśānugrahaṃ prāpya munehamapi muktidaḥ || madbhaktaistadviśeṣeṇa sevyo viśveśvaro'niśam|| 134 || iyaṃ vārāṇasī jñeyā mune pāśupatasthalī || tasmātpaśupatiḥ sevyaḥ kāśyāṃ niśreyasārthibhiḥ || 135 || atra paṃcanade tīrthe snāti viśveśvaraḥ svayam || ūrje sadaiva sagaṇaḥ saskaṃdaḥ saparicchadaḥ || 136 || brahmā savedaḥ samakho brahmāṇyādyāśca mātaraḥ || saptābdhayaḥ sasaritaḥ snāṃtyūrje dhūtapāpake ||137|| sacetanā hi yāvaṃtastrailokye dehadhāriṇaḥ || tāvaṃtaḥ snātumāyāṃti kārtike dhūtapāpake ||138 || yairna paṃcanade snātaṃ prāpya kārtikikaṃ śubham|| jalabududavatteṣāṃ vṛthājanma śarīriṇām||39|| ānaṃdakānanaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ pāṃcanadaṃ tataḥ || tatopi mama sānnidhyamagnibiṃdo mahāmune || 4.2.60.140 || anenaivānumānena viddhi paṃcanadasya vai || mahimānaṃ mahāprājña sarvatīrthottamottamam || 141 || śrutvāpi yaṃ mahāprājño mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate || viṣṇormukhāditi śrutvā sognibiṃdurmahāmuniḥ || 142 || punaḥ praṇamya papraccha biṃdumādhavamacyutam ||143|| agnibiṃduruvāca || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi biṃdumādhava tadvada || katidhā tava rūpāṇi kāśyāṃ saṃti janārdana || 144 || bhaviṣyāṇyapi kānīha tāni me kathayācyuta || yāni saṃpūjyate bhaktāḥ prāpsyaṃti kṛtakṛtyatām || 145 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe biṃdumādhavāvirbhāvonāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
<4.2.61>
|| agastya uvāca || || ṣaḍāsya mādhavākhyānaṃ śrutaṃ me pāpanāśanam || mahimāpi śrutaḥ śreyānsamyakpaṃcanadasya vai || 1 || yadagnibiṃdunā pṛcchi mādhavo daityasūdanaḥ || tasyottaraṃ samākhyāhi yathākhyātaṃ madhudviṣā || 2 || || skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇvagastya maharṣe tvaṃ kathyamānaṃ mayādhunā|| mādhavena yathācakṣi munaye cāgnibiṃdave ||3|| || biṃdumādhava uvāca || ādau pādodake tīrthe viddhi māmādikeśavam || agnibiṃdo mahāprājña bhaktānāṃ muktidāyakam || 4 || avimukte'mṛte kṣetre yercayaṃtyādikeśavam || te'mṛtatvaṃ bhajaṃtyeva sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ || 5 || saṃgameśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyādikeśavaḥ || darśanādaghahaṃ nṛṇāṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ diśetsadā || 6 || yāmyāṃ pādodakācchvetadvīpatīrthaṃ mahattaram || tatrāhaṃ jñānado nṛṇāṃ jñānakeśavasaṃjñakaḥ || 7 || śvetadvīpe naraḥ snātvā jñānakeśavasannidhau || na jñānādbhraśyate kvāpi jñānakeśavapūjanāt || 8 || tārkṣyakeśavanāmāhaṃ tārkṣyatīrthe narottamaiḥ || pūjanīyaḥ sadā bhaktyā tārkṣya vatte priyā mama || 9 || tatraiva nārade tīrthesmyahaṃ nāradakeśavaḥ || brahmavidyopadeṣṭā ca tattīrthāpluta varṣmaṇām ||4.2.61.10|| prahlādatīrthaṃ tatraiva nāmnā prahlādakeśavaḥ || bhaktaiḥ samarcanīyohaṃ mahābhakti samṛddhaye || 11 || tīrtheṃ'barīṣe tatrāhaṃ nāmnaivādityakeśavaḥ || pātakadhvāṃtanicayaṃ dhvaṃsayāmīkṣaṇādapi || 12 || dattātreyeśvarādyāmyāmahamādigadādharaḥ || harāmi tatra bhaktānāṃ saṃsāragadasaṃcayam || 13 || tatraiva bhārgave tīrthe bhṛgukeśava nāmataḥ || kāśīnivāsinaḥ puṃso bibharmi ca manorathaiḥ || 14 || vāmanākhyemahātīrthe manaḥprārthitade śubhe || pūjyohaṃ śubhamicchadbhirnāmnā vāmanakeśavaḥ || 15 || naranārāyaṇe tīrthe naranārāyaṇātmakam || bhaktāḥ samarcya māṃ syurvai naranārāyaṇātmakāḥ || 16 || tīrthe yajñavarāhākhye yajñavārāhasaṃjñakaḥ || naraiḥ samarcanīyohaṃ sarvayajñaphalepsubhiḥ ||17|| vidāranarasiṃhohaṃ kāśīvighnavidāraṇaḥ || tannāmni tīrthe saṃsevyastīrthopadravaśāṃtaye || 18 || gopīgoviṃdatīrthe tu gopīgoviṃdasaṃjñakam || samarcya māṃ naro bhaktyā mama māyāṃ na saṃspṛśet|| 19 || mune lakṣmīnṛsiṃhosmi tīrthe tannāmni pāvane || diśāmi bhaktiyuktebhyaḥ sadānaiḥ śreyasīṃ śriyam || 4.2.61.20 || śeṣamādhavanāmāhaṃ śeṣatīrthe'ghahāriṇi || viśrāṇayāmyaśeṣāśca viśeṣānbhaktaciṃtitān || 21 || śaṃkhamādhavatīrthe ca snātvā māṃ śaṃkhamādhavam || śaṃkhodakena saṃsnāpya bhavecchaṃkhanidheḥ patiḥ ||22|| hayagrīve mahātīrthe māṃ hayagrīvakeśavam || praṇamya prāpnuyānnūnaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃpadam || 23 || bhīṣmakeśavanāmāhaṃ vṛddhakāleśapaścime || upasargānhare bhīṣmānsevito bhaktiyuktitaḥ || 24 || nirvāṇakeśavaścāhaṃ bhaktanirvāṇasūcakaḥ || lolārkāduttarebhāge lolatvaṃ cetaso hare || 25 || vaṃdyastrilokasuṃdaryā yāmyāṃ yo māṃ samarcayet || kāśyāṃ khyātaṃ tribhuvanakeśavaṃ na sa garbhabhāk || 26 || jñānavāpyāḥ purobhāge viddhi māṃ jñānamādhavam || tatra māṃ bhaktitobhyarcya jñānaṃ prāpnoti śāśvatam || 27 || śvetamādhavasaṃjñohaṃ viśālākṣyāḥ samīpataḥ || śvetadvīpeśvaraṃ rūpaṃ kuryāṃ bhaktyā samarcitaḥ || 28 || udagdaśāśvamedhānmāṃ prayāgākhyaṃ ca mādhavam || prayāgatīrthe susnāto dṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 29 || prayāgagamane puṃsāṃ yatphalaṃ tapasi śrutam || tatphalaṃ syāddaśaguṇamatra snātvā mamāgrataḥ || 4.2.61.30 || gaṃgāyamunayoḥ saṃge yatpuṇyaṃ snānakāriṇām || kāśyāṃ matsannidhāvatra tatpuṇyaṃ syāddaśottaram || 31 || dānāni rāhugrasterke dadatāṃ yatphalaṃ bhavet || kurukṣetre hi tatkāśyāmatraiva syāddaśādhikam || 32 || gaṃgottaravahā yatra yamunā pūrvavāhinī || tatsaṃbhedaṃ naraḥ prāpya mucyate brahmahatyayā || 33 || vapanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ ca bhāvataḥ || deyāni tatra dānāni mahāphalamabhīpsunā || 34 || guṇāḥ prajāpatikṣetre ye sarve samudīritāḥ || avimukte mahākṣetre'saṃkhyātāśca bhavaṃti hi || 35 || prayāgeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ tatra tiṣṭhati kāmadam || tatsānnidhyācca tattīrthaṃ kāmadaṃ parikīrtitam || 36 || kāśyāṃ māghaḥ prayāge yairna snāto makarārkagaḥ || aruṇodayamāsādya teṣāṃ niḥśreyasaṃ kutaḥ || 37 || kāśyudbhave prayāge ye tapasi snāṃti saṃyatāḥ || daśāśvamedhajanitaṃ phalaṃ teṣāṃ bhaveddhruvam ||38|| prayāgamādhavaṃ bhaktyā prayāgeśaṃ ca kāmadam || prayāge tapasi snātvā yercayaṃtyanvahaṃ sadā||39|| dhanadhānyasutarddhīste labdhvā bhogānmanoramān || bhuktveha paramānaṃdaṃ paraṃ mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ || 4.2.61.40 || māghe sarvāṇi tīrthāni prayāgamaviyāṃti hi || prācyudīcī pratīcīto dakṣiṇādhastathordhvataḥ || || 41 || kāśīsthitāni tīrthāni mune yāṃti na kutracit || yadi yāṃti tadā yāṃti tīrthatrayamanuttamam || 42 || āyāṃtyūrje paṃcanade prātaḥprātarmamāṃtikam || mahāghaughapraśamane mahāśreyovidhāyini || 43 || prāpya māghamaghāriṃ ca prayāgeśa samīpataḥ || prātaḥprayāge saṃsnāṃti sarvatīrthāni māmanu || 44 || samāsādya ca madhyāhnamabhiyāṃti ca nityaśaḥ || saṃsnātuṃ sarvatīrthāni muktidāṃ maṇikarṇikām || 45 || kāśyāṃ rahasyaṃ paramametatte kathitaṃ mune || yathā tīrthatrayīśreṣṭhā svasvakāle viśeṣataḥ || 46 || anyadrahasyaṃ vakṣyāmi na vācyaṃ yatrakutracit || abhakteṣu sadā gopyaṃ na gopyaṃ bhaktimajjane || 47 || kāśyāṃ sarvāṇi tīrthāni ekaikāduttarottaram || mahaināṃsi prahaṃtyeva prasahya nija tejasā || 48 || etadeva rahasyaṃ te vārāṇasyā udīryate|| utkṣipyaikāṃguliṃ tathyaṃ śreṣṭhaikā maṇikarṇikā ||49|| garjaṃti sarvatīrthāni svasvadhiṣṇyagatānyaho || kevalaṃ balamāsādya sumahanmāṇikarṇikam || 4.2.61.50 || pāpāni pāpināṃ hatvā mahāṃtyapi bahūnyapi || kāśītīrthāni madhyāhne prāyaścittacikīrṣayā || 51 || parvasvaparvasvapi vā nityaṃ niyamavaṃ tyaho || nirmalāni bhavaṃtyeva vigāhya maṇikarṇikām || 52 || viśveśo viśvayā sārdhaṃ sadopamaṇikarṇikam || madhyaṃdinaṃ samāsādya saṃsnāti prativāsaram || 53 || vaikuṃṭhādapyahaṃ nityaṃ madhyāhne maṇikarṇikām || vigāhe padmayā sārdhaṃ mudā paramayā mune || 54 || sakṛnmamākhyāṃ gṛṇatāṃ nirharanyadaghānyaham || harināmasamāpannastadbalānmāṇikarṇikāt || 55 || satyalokātpratidinaṃ haṃ sayānaḥ pitāmahaḥ || mādhyāhnika vidhānāya samāyānmaṇikarṇikām ||56|| iṃdrādyā lokapālāśca marīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ || mādhyāhnikīṃ kriyāṃ kartuṃ samīyurmaṇikarṇikām || 57 || śeṣavāsukimukhyāśca nāgā vai nāgalokataḥ || samāyāṃtīha madhyāhne saṃsnātuṃ maṇikarṇikām || 58 || carācareṣu sarveṣu yāvaṃtaśca sacetanāḥ || tāvaṃtaḥ snāṃti madhyāhne maṇikarṇī jalemale || 59 || ke māṇikarṇikeyānāṃ guṇānāṃ sugarīyasām || śaktā varṇayituṃ viprā'saṃkhyeyānāṃ madādibhiḥ || 4.2.61.60 || cīrṇānyugrāṇyaraṇyeṣu taistapāṃsi tapodhanaiḥ || yairiyaṃ hi samāsādi muktibhūrmaṇikarṇikā || 61 || viśrāṇitamahādānāsta eva narapuṃgavāḥ || carame vayasi prāptā yaireṣā maṇikarṇikā || 62 || cīrṇasarvavratāste tu yathoktavidhinā dhruvam || yaiḥ svatalpīkṛtā māṇikarṇikeyī sthalī mṛduḥ ||63|| ta eva dhanyā martyesminsarvakratuṣu dīkṣitāḥ || tyaktvā puṇyārjitāṃ lakṣmīmaikṣiyairmaṇikarṇikā ||64|| kṛtā nānāvidhā dharmā iṣṭāpūrtāstu tairnṛbhiḥ|| vārdhakaṃ samanuprāpya prāpi yairmaṇikarṇikā || 65 || ratnāni sadukūlāni kāṃcanaṃ gajavājinaḥ || deyāḥ prājñena yatnena sadopamaṇikarṇikam || 66 || puṇyenopārjitaṃ dravyamatyalpamapi yairnaraiḥ || dattaṃ tadakṣayaṃ nityaṃ munedhimaṇikaṇiṃkam || 67 || kuryādyathoktamapyekaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ narottamaḥ || yastena vihito nūnaṃ ṣaḍaṃgo yoga uttamaḥ || 68 || japtvaikāmapi gāyatrīṃ saṃprāpya maṇikarṇikām || labhedayutagāyatrījapanasya phalaṃ sphuṭam || 69 || ekāmapyāhutiṃ prājño dattvopamaṇikarṇikam|| yāvajjīvāgnihotrasya labhedavikalaṃ phalam || 4.2.61.70 || iti śrutvā harervākyamagnibiṃdurmahātapāḥ || praṇipatya mahābhaktyā punaḥ papraccha mādhavam|| || 71 || || agnibiṃduruvāca || viṣṇo kiyatparīmāṇā puṇyaiṣā maṇikarṇikā || brūhi me puṃṅarīkākṣa natvattastattvavitparaḥ || 72 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || āgaṃgā keśavādā ca hariścaṃdrasya maṃḍapāt || āmadhyāddevasaritaḥ svardvārānmaṇikarṇikā || 73 || sthūlametatparīmāṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca pravadāmi te || hariścaṃdrasya tīrthāgre hariścaṃdravināyakaḥ || 74 || sīmāvināyakaścātra maṇikarṇī hradottare || sīmāvināyakaṃ bhaktyā pūjayitvā narottamaḥ ||75 || modakaiḥ sopacāraiśca prāpnuyānmaṇikarṇikām|| hariścaṃdre mahātīrthe tarpayeyuḥ pitāmahān||76|| śataṃ samāḥsu tṛptāḥ syuḥ prayacchaṃti ca vāṃcchitam|| hariścaṃdre mahātīrthe snātvā śraddhānvito naraḥ || 77 || hariścaṃdreśvaraṃ natvā na satyātparihīyate || tataḥ parvatatīrthaṃ ca parvateśvara saṃnidhau || 78 || adhiṣṭhānaṃ mahāmerormahāpātakanāśanam || tatra snātvārcayitveśaṃ kiṃciddattvā svaśaktitaḥ || 79 || adhyāsya meruśikharaṃ divyānbhogānsamaśnute || kaṃbalāśvataraṃ tīrthaṃ parvateśvara dakṣiṇe ||4.2.61.80|| kaṃbalāśvatareśaṃ ca tattīrthātpaścime śubham || tasmiṃstīrthe kṛtasnānastalliṃgaṃ yaḥ samarcayet || 81 || api tasya kule jātā gītajñāḥ syuḥ śriyānvitāḥ || cakrapuṣkariṇī tatra yonicakra nivāriṇī||| 82 || saṃsāracakre gahane yatra snāto viśennanā || cakrapuṣkariṇī tīrtha mamādhiṣṭhānamuttamam || 83 || samāḥ parārdhasaṃkhyātāstatra taptaṃ mahātapaḥ || tatra pratyakṣatāṃ yāto mama viśveśvaraḥ paraḥ || 84|| tatra labdhaṃ mayaiśvaryamavināśi mahattaram || cakrapuṣkariṇī caiva khyātābhūnmaṇikarṇikā || 85 || dravarūpaṃ parityajya lalanārūpadhāriṇī || pratyakṣarūpiṇī tatra mayaikṣi maṇikarṇikā || 86 || tasyā rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhaktānāṃ śubhadaṃ param || yadrūpadhyānataḥ puṃbhirāṣaṇmāsaṃ trisaṃdhyataḥ || 87 || pratyakṣarūpiṇī devī dṛśyate maṇikarṇikā || caturbhujā viśālākṣī sphuradbhālavilocanā || 88 || paścimābhimukhī nityaṃ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭā || iṃdīvaravatīṃ mālāṃ dadhatī dakṣiṇe kare || 89 || varodyate kare savye mātuluṃga phalaṃ śubham || kumārīrūpiṇī nityaṃ nityaṃ dvādaśavārṣikī || 4.2.61.90 || śuddhasphaṭikakāṃtiśca sunīla snigdhamūrddhajā || jitapravālamāṇikya ramaṇīya radacchadā || 91 || pratyagraketakīpuṣpalasaddhammilla mastakā || sarvāṃga muktābharaṇā caṃdrakāṃtyaṃśukāvṛtā || || 92 || puṃḍarīkamayīṃ mālāṃ saśrīkāṃ bibhratī hṛdi || dhyātavyānena rūpeṇa mumukṣubhiraharniśam || 93 || nirvāṇalakṣmībhavanaṃ śrīmatīmaṇikarṇikā || maṃtraṃ tasyāśca vakṣyāmi bhaktakalpadrumābhidham|| yasyāvartanataḥ siddhyedapi siddhyaṣṭakaṃ nṛṇām || 94 || vāgbhavamāyālakṣmīmadanapraṇavānvadetpūrvam || bhāṃtyaṃ biṃdūpetaṃ maṇipadamatha karṇike sahṛtpraṇavapuṭaḥ || 95 || maṃtraḥsuradrumasamaḥ samastasukhasaṃtatiprado japyaḥ || tithibhiḥ parimitavarṇaḥ paramapadaṃ diśati niśitadhiyām || 96 || tārastāratṛtīyo biṃdvaṃtomaṇipadaṃ tataḥ karṇike || praṇavātmipadaṃ kena ma iti manusaṃkhyavarṇamanuḥ || 97 || ayaṃ maṃtro'niśaṃ japyaḥ puṃbhirmuktimabhīpsubhiḥ || homo daśāṃśakaḥ kāryaḥ śraddhābaddhādarairnṛbhiḥ || 98 || pariplutaiḥ puṃḍarīkairgavyena haviṣāsphuṭaiḥ || saśarkareṇa medhāvī sakṣaudreṇa sadāśuciḥ || 99 || trilakṣamaṃtra japyena mṛto deśāṃtareṣvapi || avaśyaṃ muktimāpnoti maṃtrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 4.2.61.100 || sauvarṇīṃ pratimā kāryā navaratnasamanvitā|| pūrvoktarūpasaṃpannā saṃpūjyā sā prayatnataḥ || 101 || saṃpūjyāvā sadā gehe narairmokṣaikakāṃkṣibhiḥ || maṇikarṇyāmathākṣepyā samabhyarcya prayatnataḥ || 102 || saṃsārabhīrubhiḥ puṃbhiḥ śraddhābaddhādarairiha || upāyaḥ samanuṣṭheyo hyapi dūranivāsibhiḥ || 103 || maṇikarṇyāṃ kṛtasnāno maṇikarṇīśa vīkṣaṇāt || jananī jaṭharāvāse vasatiṃ na labhennaraḥ ||104|| maṇikarṇīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃṃ purāsaṃsthāpitaṃ mayā || prāgdvāreṃtargṛhasyātra samarcyo mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ ||105|| tataḥ pāśupataṃ tīrthamavācyāṃ maṇikarṇitaḥ || kṛtodakakriyastatra paśyetpaśupatīśvaram || 106 || yatra pāśupato yoga upadiṣṭaḥ pinākinā || mamāpi vidhimukhyānāṃ surāṇāṃ paśupāśahṛt || || 107 || ataḥ paśupatiryatra liṃgarūpadharaḥ svayam|| paśupāśavimokṣāya nityaṃ kāśyāṃ prakāśate|| 108 || tatra caitra caturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ śucimānasaiḥ || kāryā yātrā prayatnena rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā || 109 || pūjayitvā paśupatimupoṣaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || paśupāśairna badhyaṃte darśe vihitapāraṇāḥ || 4.2.61.110 || rudrāvāsastatastīrthaṃ tīrthātpāśupatātpuraḥ || tatra snātvā narairarcyo rudrāvāseśvaro haraḥ || 111 || maṇikarṇīśvarādyāmyāṃ rudrāvāseśvaraṃ naraḥ || samārādhya vaselloke rudrāvāse na saṃśayaḥ || 112 || viśvatīrthaṃ tato yāmyāṃ viśvaistīrthairadhiṣṭhitam || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā viśvanāthaṃ vilokayet || 113 || viśvāṃ gaurīṃ ca tadanu pūjayitvāti bhaktitaḥ || viśvasya pūjyo bhavati tato viśvamayo bhavet || 114 || muktitīrthaṃ ca tadanu tatrāpi kṛtamajjanaḥ || mokṣeśvaraṃ tatobhyarcya mokṣamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 115 || avimukteśvarātpaścānmokṣeśaṃ vīkṣya mānavaḥ || na punarmānaveloke yātāyātaṃ karotyaho || 116 || avimukteśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ muktitīrthānmanākpare || tatrāplutyāvimukteśamarcayitvā vimucyate || 117 || tatpare tārakaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra viśveśvaraḥ svayam || ācaṣṭe tārakaṃ brahmamṛtakarṇemṛtātmakam || 118 || susnātastārake tīrthe tārakeśvara darśanāt || saṃsārasāgaraṃ tīrtvā tārayetsvapitṝnapi || 119 || tatrābhyāśe skaṃdatīrthaṃ tatrāplutya narottamaḥ || dṛṣṭvā ṣaḍānanaṃ caiva jahyātṣāṭkauśikīṃ tanum || 4.2.61.120 || tārakeśvara pūrveṇa dṛṣṭvā devaṃ ṣaḍānanam || vasetṣaḍānane loke kaumāraṃ vapurudvahan || 121 || ḍhuṃḍhitīrthaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ narastatra kṛtodakaḥ || ḍhuṃḍhiṃ gaṇapatiṃ stutvā na vighnairabhibhūyate || 122 || bhavānītīrthamatulaṃ ḍhuṃḍhitīrthasya dakṣiṇe || tatra snātvā vidhānena bhavānīṃ paripūjya ca || 123|| dukūle ratnanepathyairnaivedyairbahuvistaraiḥ || puṣpairdhūpaiḥ pradīpaiśca bhavānī śo prapūjya ca || 124 || samastamarcitaṃ tena trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || bhavānīśaṃkarau kāśyāmarcitau śraddhayā tu yaiḥ || 125 || caitrāṣṭamyāṃ mahāyātrāṃ bhavānyāḥ kārayetsudhīḥ || aṣṭādhikāḥ prakartavyāḥ śatakṛtvaḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ || 126 || pradakṣriṇīkṛtātena saptadvīpavatī mahī || saśailā sasamudrā ca sāśramā ca sakānanā || 127 || aṣṭau pradakṣiṇā deyāḥ pratyahaṃ tuṣṭitatparaiḥ || namanīyau prayatnena bhavānīśaṃkarau sadā || 128 || bhaktānāṃ kāmadā nityaṃ bhavānī vāsasāṃ pradā || ato bhavānī saṃpūjyā kāśyāṃ tīrthanivāsibhiḥ || 129 || yogakṣemaṃ sadā kuryādbhavānī kāśivāsinām || tasmādbhavānī saṃsevyā satataṃ kāśivāsibhiḥ || 4.2.61.130 || bhikṣaṇīyā sadā bhikṣā bhikṣuṇā mokṣakāṃkṣiṇā || yato bhikṣāpradā kāśyāṃ viśveśasya kuṭuṃbinī || 131 || gṛhamadhyetra viśveśo bhavānī tatkuṭuṃbinī || sarvebhyaḥ kāśisaṃsthebhyo mokṣabhikṣāṃ prayacchati || 132 || duṣprāpamapi yatkiṃcitkāśīkṣetranivāsinām || tatsuprāpyaṃ karotyeva bhavānī pūjitā nṛbhiḥ || 133 || kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau mahāṣṭamyāṃ vratī naraḥ || prātarbhavānīmabhyarcya prāpnuyādvāṃchitaṃ phalam || 134 || śukreśātpaścimāśāyāṃ bhavānīṃ yo'bhivīkṣate || sarve manorathāstasya siddhyaṃtīha na saṃ śayaḥ || 135 || kāśyāṃ sadaiva vastavyaṃ snātavyottaravāhinī || bhavānīśaṃkarau sevyau prāptavye bhuktimuktike || 136 || mātarbhavāni tava pādarajobhavāni mātarbhavāni tavadāsataro bhavāni || mātarbhavāni nabhavāni yathābhavesmiṃstvadbhāgbhavānyanudinaṃ na punarbhavāni || 137 || tiṣṭhatā gacchatā vāpi svapatā jāgratāpi vā || ayamatra sadā japyaḥ sukhāptyai kāśivāsinā || 138 || īśānatīrthaṃ tatraiva bhavānītīrthasannidhau || tatra snāto ya īśānamarcayenna sa janmabhāk || 139 || jñānatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva jñānadaṃ savardā nṛṇām || kṛtābhiṣekastattīrthe dṛṣṭvā jñāneśvaraṃ śivam || 4.2.61.140 || jñānavāpīsamīpastho jñāneśo yaiḥ samarcitaḥ || jñānabhraṃśo na teṣāṃ syādapi paṃcatvamṛcchatām|| 141 || śailāditīrthaṃ tatraiva paramarddhi prakāśakam || tatra śrāddhādikaṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 142 || śailādīśvaramālokya jñānavāpyā udagdiśi || labhedgaṇatvapadavīṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 143 || naṃditīrthādavācyāṃ tu viṣṇutīrthaṃ paraṃ mama || tatra piṃḍānvinirvāpya pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet || 144 || viṣṇutīrthe kṛtasnāno yo māṃ viṣṇuṃ vilokayet || viśveśāddakṣiṇepārśve viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 145 || yaḥ pratyekādaśīṃ prāpya śayanīṃ bodhinīṃ tathā || kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau mama mūrtisamīpataḥ || 146 || prātaḥ samarcya māṃ bhaktyā bhojayitvā dvijānapi || dattvā gāḥ kāṃcanaṃ bhūmiṃ na bhūyo bhūmibhāgbhavet ||147|| kṛtvā tatra vratotsargaṃ vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || samyagvrataphalaṃ dhīmānprāpnotyeva mamājñayā ||148|| mama tīrthādavācyāṃ tu tī rthaṃ paitāmahaṃ śubham || tatra śrāddhavidhānena tarpayitvā pitāmahān||149|| pitāmaheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ brahmanāloparisthitam|| pūjayitvā naro bhaktyā brahmalokamavāpnuyāt || || 4.2.61.150 || brahmasrotaḥ samīpe tu kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham || parāmakṣayatāmeti śubhameva tataścaret || 151 || atyalpamapi yatkarma kṛtamatra śubhāśubham || pralayepi na tasyāsti pralayo munisattama || 152 || nābhitīrthamidaṃ proktaṃ nābhibhūtaṃ yataḥ kṣiteḥ || api brahmāṃḍagolasya nābhireṣā śubhodayā ||153|| sā māṇikarṇikeyīyaṃ nābhirgāṃbhīryabhūmikā || brahmāṃḍagolakaṃ sarvaṃ yasyāmeti layodayam || 154 || brahmanālaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || tatsaṃgame naraḥ snātvā koṭijanma malaṃ haret || 155 || brahmanāle patedyeṣāmapi kīkasamātrakam || brahmāṃḍamaṃḍapāṃtaste na viśaṃti kadācana || 156 || tato bhāgīrathestīrthaṃ brahmanālācca dakṣiṇe || tatra snātvā naraḥ samyaṅmucyate brahmahatyayā || 157 || bhāgīrathīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ svargadvārasya sannidhau || darśanādbrahmahatyāyāḥ puraścaraṇamucyate || 158 || aśubhāṃ gatimāpannā yasya pūrve pitāmahāḥ || tena bhāgīrathī tīrthe tarpaṇīyāḥ prayatnataḥ || 159 || tatra bhāgīrathe tīrthe śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu brahmaloke nayetpitṝn || 4.2.61.160 || taddakṣiṇe mahātīrthaṃ khurakartari saṃjñitam || golokādāgatābhiśca gobhiryatkhurakoṭibhiḥ || 161 || sthapuṭīkṛtabhūbhāgaṃ tatastatkhura kartari || tasmiṃstīrthe kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtapiṃḍodakakriyaḥ || 162 || khurakartarīśaṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā golokamāpnuyāt || godhanairna vimucyeta talliṃgasya samarcanāt ||163|| dakṣiṇe khurakartaryā mārkaṃḍaṃ tīrthamuttamam|| kṛtaśrāddhavidhānaśca tasmiṃstīrthe'ghahāriṇi || 164 || mārkaṃḍeyeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvāyurdīrghamāpnuyāt || brahmatejobhivṛddhiṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca paramāṃ bhuvi || 165 || vasiṣṭhatīrthaṃ paramaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || tarpayitvā pitṝṃstatra vasiṣṭheśaṃ vilokya ca || 166 || naro na lipyate pāpairjanmatrayasamarjitaiḥ || vasiṣṭhaloke vasati brahmateja samanvitaḥ || 167 || tatraivārudhaṃtī tīrthaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavadharnam || pativratābhistattīrthaṃ gāhanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 168 || pauṃścalyajanito doṣastattīrthaparimajjanāt|| kṣaṇādvināśa māgacchedaruṃdhatyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 169 || mārkaṃḍeyeśvarātprācyāṃ vasiṣṭheśvara pūjanāt || niṣpāpo jāyate martyo mahatpuṇyamavāpnuyāt || 4.2.61.170 || mūrtī vasiṣṭhāruṃdhatyostatra pūjye prayatnataḥ|| na strī vaidhavyamāpnoti na pumānstrī viyogitām ||171|| vasiṣṭhatīrthato yāmyāṃ narmadātīrthamuttamam || vidhāya śrāddhaṃ medhāvī narmadeśaṃvilokya ca || 172 || tatra dattvā mahādānaṃ padmayānavimucyate || tatastrisaṃdhyaṃ vai tīrthaṃ trisaṃdhyeśvara pūrvataḥ || 173 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā kṛtvā saṃdhyāṃ vidhānataḥ || saṃdhyākāla vilopotthapātakairnābhibhūyate || 174 || trisaṃdhyeśvaramālokya kṛtasaṃdhyasttrikālataḥ || trivedāvartajaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnuyācchraddhayā dvijaḥ || 175 || tato'nuyoginītīrthaṃ narastatra kṛtāplavaḥ || dṛṣṭvā tu yoginīpīṭhaṃ yogasiddhimavāpnuyāt || 176 || agasti tīrthe tatrāsti mahāghaugha vighātakṛt || tatra snātvā prayatnena dṛṣṭvāgastīcaśvaraṃ vibhum || 177 || agastikuṃḍe ca tataḥ saṃtarpya ca pitāmahān || agastinā sametāṃ ca lopāmudrāṃ praṇamya ca || 178 ||| sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvakleśavivarjitaḥ || gacchetsa pūrvajaiḥ sārdhaṃ śivalokaṃ narottamaḥ ||179|| dakṣiṇe'gastyatīrthācca tīrthamastyatipāvanam|| gaṃgākeśavasaṃjñaṃ ca sarvapātakanāśanam || ||4.2.61.180|| tatra me śubhadāṃ mūrtiṃ mune tattīrthasaṃjñikām || saṃpūjya śraddhayā dhīmānmama loke mahīyate ||181|| tatra piṃḍānvinirvāpya dattvā dānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || śatasāṃvatsarīṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāṃ sa samarpayet || 182 || maṇikarṇī parīmāṇametatte kīrtitaṃ mahat || sīmāvināyakādyāmyāṃ sarvavighnavighātanāt || 183 || vairocaneśvarātprācyāmahaṃ vaikuṃṭhamādhavaḥ || tatra māṃ bhaktitobhyarcya vaikuṃṭhārcāmavāpnuyāt || 184 || vīramādhavasaṃjñohaṃ vīreśātpaścime mune || tatra vratī samabhyarcya na yāmīṃ yātanāṃ labhet || 185 || kālamādhavanāmāhaṃ kālabhairava sannidhau || kaliḥ kālo na kalayenmadbhaktamiti niścitam ||186|| mārgaśīrṣasya śuklāyāmekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ || tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yamaṃ nālokayetkvacit || 187 || nirvāṇanarasiṃhohaṃ pulastīśvaradakṣiṇe || bhakto nirvāṇamāpnoti tanmṛrtinamanādapi ||188|| mahābalanṛsiṃhohamoṃkārātpūrvato mune || dūtānmahābalānyāmyānna paśyettu tadarcakaḥ ||169|| pracaṃḍanarasiṃhohaṃ caṃḍabhairavapūrvataḥ | pracaṃḍamapyaghaṃ kṛtvā niṣpāpmā syāttadarcanāt || 4.2.61.190 || ahaṃ girinṛsiṃhosmi taddehalivināyakāt || prācyāṃ prabalapāpau ghagajānāṃ pravidāraṇaḥ || 191 || mahābhayaharaścāhaṃ narasiṃho mahāmune || pitāmaheśvarātpaścādbhakta sādhvasasādhvasaḥ || 192 || atyugranarasiṃhohaṃ kalaśeśvarapaścime || atyugramapi pāpaughaṃ harāmi śraddhayārcitaḥ || 193 || jvālāmālīnṛsiṃho'haṃ jvālāmukhyāḥ samīpataḥ || saṃjvālayāmi pāpaugha tṛṇāni paripūjitaḥ || || 194 || kolāhalanṛsiṃhosmi daityadānavamardanaḥ || mamanāmasamuccārādaghakolāhalo yataḥ || 195 || kaṃkālabhairavo yatra kāśīrakṣaṇadakṣadhīḥ || tatra māṃ bhaktitobhyarcya nopasargairnirudhyate || 196 || viṭaṃkanarasiṃhosmi nīlakaṃṭheśvarādanu || tatra māṃ śraddhayā pūjya naro bhavati nirbhayaḥ ||197|| anaṃtavāmanaścāhamanaṃ teśvarasannidhau || anaṃtānyapi bhaktasya kaluṣāṇi hare'rcitaḥ || 198|| dadhivāmanasaṃjñohaṃ bhaktānāṃ dadhibhaktadaḥ || yannāmasmaraṇādeva na daridro naro bhavet || 199 || trivikramosmyahaṃ kāśyāmudīcyāṃ ca trilocanāt || dadāmi pūjito lakṣmīṃ harāmi vṛjinānyapi ||4.2.61.200|| balivāmananāmāhaṃ balinā paripūjitaḥ || balibhadreśvarātprācyāṃ bhaktānāṃ balavardhanaḥ || 201 || dakṣiṇe bhavatīrthācca tāmradvīpādihāgataḥ || nāmnā tāmravarāhosmi bhaktānāṃ ciṃtitārthadaḥ || 202 || mune dharaṇivārāhaḥ prayāgeśvarasannidhau || snātvā vārāhatīrthetra dṛṣṭvā māṃ kiṭi rūpiṇam ||203|| saṃpūjya bahubhāvena na viśedyonisaṃkaṭam || tatrālpamapi dattvānnaṃ dharādānaphalaṃ labhet|| || 204 || mahākaluṣagaṃbhīra sāgare nipatañjanaḥ || mama bhaktyuḍupaṃ prāpya pralayepi na majjati || 205 || ahaṃ kokāvarāhosmi kiṭīśvarasamīpataḥ || tatra māṃ pūjayanmartyo labhate ciṃtitaphalam || 206 || nārāyaṇāḥ śataṃ paṃca śataṃ ca jalaśāyinaḥ || triṃśatkamaṭharūpāṇi matsyarūpāṇi viṃśatiḥ || 207 || gopālāśca śataṃ sāṣṭaṃ buddhāḥ saṃti sahasraśaḥ || triṃśatarāmāśca rāmā ekottaraṃśatam || 208 || viṣṇurūposmyahaṃ caiko muktimaṃḍapamadhyataḥ || munekṛtaprasādena viśveśena śritaḥ svayam || 209 || nārāyaṇasvarūpeṇa gaṇāścakragadodyatāḥ || kurvaṃti rakṣāṃ kṣetrasya parito niyutāni ṣaṭ || 4.2.61.210 || sognibiṃduriti śrutvā saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || punaḥ papraccha medhāvī mūrtibhedānvada prabho || 211 || hitāya nijabhaktānāṃ mama saṃdehaśāṃtaye || kati te mūrtayonaṃta kathaṃ jñeyāstathā vada || 212 || ityākarṇya vacastasyāgnibiṃdostapasāṃ nidheḥ || uvāca bhagavānviṣṇurmūrtibhedānanukramāta || 213 || yāñśrutvāpi hi no martyo yamagocaratāṃ vrajet || keśavādīṃścaturviṃśadbhedānāha prajāpatiḥ || 214 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || agnibiṃdo mahāprājña śṛṇu te kathayāmyaham || ādyadakṣiṇahastācca viddhi sṛṣṭikramānmune || 215 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmairmūrtiṃ jānīhi kaiśavīm || pūjitā yā nṛṇāṃ kuryācciṃtitārthamasaṃśayam|| || 216 || madhuhā paricetavyaḥ śaṃkhapadmagadāsibhiḥ || vairiṇo nāśamāyāṃti tanmūrtiparisevanāt || 217 || saṃkarṣaṇaḥ samarcyotra śaṃkhābjārigadāyudhaḥ || tanmūrtipūjanājjātu jaṃturna syātpunarbhavī || 218 || śaṃkhakaumodakīcakrapadmairdāmodarorcyate || dadāti vittaṃ putrāṃśca godhanaṃ dhānyameva hi || 219 || vāmanaḥ śaṃkhacakrābjagadābhirupalakṣitaḥ || lakṣmīvaṃtaṃ janaṃ kuryādgṛhepi paridhāritaḥ || 4.2.61.220 || pāṃcajanyaṃ gadāṃpadmaṃ citramūrti sudarśanam || pradyumnaḥ pūjyate martyairbahudyumnaṃ prayacchati || 221 || ūrdhvavāmakarātsṛṣṭyā viṣṇvādyaṃ ṣaṭkamucyate || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa vilīyaṃtegharāśayaḥ || 222 || śaṃkhāribhyāṃ gadābjābhyāṃ pūjyo viṣṇuḥ śriye naraiḥ || śaṃkhapadmagadācakrairmādhavaḥ paramarddhidaḥ || 223 || dhyeyo'niruddhaḥ saṃsiddhyai śaṃkhābjārigadodyataḥ || śaṃkhena gadayā cakrāṃbujābhyāṃ puruṣottamaḥ || || 224 || adhokṣajo janiharaḥ śaṃkhāryabjagado mune || śaṃkhakaumodakīpadmacakrairdhyeyo janārdanaḥ || 225 || adhovāmakarātsṛṣṭyā ṣaḍagoṃvidādi mūrtayaḥ || śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ goviṃdo bibhṛyātsadā || 226 || śaṃkhapadmagadācakrairarcyo lakṣmyai trivikramaḥ || śaṃkhābjacakraṃ bibhrāṇo gadāvāñśrīdharaḥ śriye || 227 || hṛṣīkeśaśca śaṃkhena gadācakrāṃbujairmataḥ || nṛsiṃhaḥ śaṃkhacakrābhyāṃ padmena gadayohyate ||228|| acyuta śaṃkhabhṛnnityaṃ gadāpadmarathāṃgavān || dakṣiṇādhaḥ karādūhyā vāsudevādayaśca ṣaṭ ||229|| vāsudevaśca śaṃkhāri gadājalajabhṛtsadā|| śaṃkhāṃbuja gadācakrī śreyo nārāyaṇo nṛbhiḥ ||4.2.61.230|| śaṃkhī padmī padmanābho jñeyaścakrī gadī mune || upeṃdraḥ śaṃkhavānnityaṃ gadāri kamalāyudhaḥ || 231 || harirharedaghaṃ śaṃkhī cakrī padmī gadī nṛṇām || śaṃkhena gadayā padmacakrābhyāṃ kṛṣṇa ucyate ||232|| ete bhedā mayā khyātāḥ svamūrtīnāṃ mahāmune || yānvijñāya dhruvaṃ martyo bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca viṃdati || 233 || evaṃ vadati goviṃde munaye cāgnibiṃdave || pakṣīṃdraḥ pakṣavikṣiptavipakṣo'kṣipathaṃ gataḥ || 234 || prāha ca praṇipatyāśu tryakṣasyāgamanaṃ mudā || saṃbhrameṇa hṛṣīkeśaḥ kveśa ityavadattataḥ ||235|| || garuḍa uvāca || || pratyakṣaḥ kriyatāmeṣa mahāvṛṣabhaketanaḥ || yasya dhvajasya ratnārciḥ pūrayedrodasīmimām || 236 || lokalocananirmāṇa saphalīkaraṇakṣamam || koṭimārtaṃḍavidyota pradyotita digānanam || 237 || nirīkṣya puṃḍarīkākṣastryakṣasya vṛṣabhadhvajam || vimānināṃ vimānaughaiḥ parītagaganāṃgaṇam || 238 || mahāvādyani nādaughaiḥpratisvānita kaṃdaram || vidyādharī parikṣipta puṣpāṃjali sugaṃdhitam ||239|| praṇamya dūrādapica saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || abhyutthātuṃ manaścakre śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 4.2.61.240 || agnibiṃdumatha prāha muktidastu mudāṃnidhiḥ || idaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ spṛśāsavyenapāṇinā || 241 || agnibiṃduritiproktaḥ spṛśedyāvatsudarśanam|| tāvatsudarśano jātaḥ paramānugrahāddhareḥ || 242 || || skaṃda uvāca || || jyotīrūpotha sa muniḥ kaustubhe jyotiṣāṃ tanau || ekībhūtaḥ kalaśaja biṃdumādhavasevanāt|| 243 || biṃdumādhavapādābja bhramarīkṛtamānasāḥ || agnibiṃdūpamāṃyāṃti kalaśodbhava niścitam || 244 || kāśyāṃ sadaiva vastavyaṃ draṣṭavyo biṃdumādhavaḥ || śrotavyamidamākhyānaṃ jetavyā jagatāṃgatiḥ ||245|| puṇyā paṃcanadotpattiḥ puṇyā mādhavasaṃkathā || puṇyo vārāṇasī vāsaḥ saṃbhavetpuṇyajanmanām|| 246 || agnibiṃdoḥ stutiṃ yotra mādhavāgre paṭhiṣyati || samṛddhasarvakāmaḥ sa mokṣalakṣmīpatirbhavet || 247 || śrāddhakāle sadā japya midamākhyānamuttamam || dvijānāṃ bhuṃjamānānāṃ purastātparatṛptaye || 248 || japtavyamidamākhyānaṃ parvakāle viroṣataḥ || puṇye paṃcanadābhyāśe puṇyalakṣmīvivṛddhaye || 249 || paṭhitavyaḥ prayatnena biṃdumādhavasaṃbhavaḥ || śrotavyaḥ parayā bhaktyā bhuktimuktisamṛddhaye ||4.2.61.250|| saṃprāpte vāsare viṣṇo rātrau jāgaraṇānvitaḥ || śrutvākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ vaikuṃṭhe vasatiṃ labhet || 251 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpuraṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārddhe biṃdumādhavāvirbhāvo mādhavāgnibiṃdusaṃvāda vaiṣṇavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ || 61 || || ||
<4.2.62>
|| agastya uvāca || śrutvā skaṃda na tṛptosmi tava vaktreritāṃ kathām || atyāścaryakaraṃ proktamākhyānaṃ baiṃdumādhavam || 1 || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi devadevasamāgamam || tārkṣyāttryakṣaḥ samākarṇya divodāsasya ceṣṭitam ||2 || viṣṇumāyāprapaṃcaṃ ca kimāha garuḍadhvajam || ke ke ca śaṃbhunā sārdhaṃ samīyurmaṃdarādgireḥ ||3|| brahmaṇeśaḥ kathaṃ dṛṣṭastrapākulita cakṣuṣā || kimāha deva brahmāṇaṃ kimuktaṃ bhāsvatāpi ca || 4 || yoginībhiḥ kimākhyāyi gaṇāhrīṇāḥ kimabruvan || etadākhyāhi me skaṃda mahatkautūhalaṃ mayi ||5|| imaṃ praśnaṃ niśamyaiśirmuneḥ kalaśajanmanaḥ || pratyuvāca namaskṛtya śivau praṇatasiddhidau||6|| || skaṃda uvāca || || mune śṛṇu kathāmetāṃ sarvapātakanāśinīm|| aśeṣavighnaśamanīṃ mahāśreyobhivardhinīm|| 7 || atha devo'suraripuḥ śrutvā śaṃbhusamāgamam || dvijarājāya sa mudā samadātpāritoṣikam || 8 || āyānaṃ śaṃsate śaṃbhorupavārāṇasipriyam || brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā tataścābhyudyayau hariḥ || 9 || vivasvatā sametaśca tairgaṇaiḥ parito vṛtaḥ || yoginībhiranūdyāto gaṇeśamupasaṃsthitaḥ || 4.2.62.10 || athanetrātithīkṛtya devadevaṃ vṛṣadhvajam || maṃkṣu tārkṣyādavāruhya praṇanāma śriyaḥ patiḥ || 11 || pitāmahopi sthaviro bhṛśaṃ namraśirodharaḥ || praṇatena mṛḍenaiva praṇamanvinivāritaḥ || 12 || svastyabhyuditapāṇiśca rudrasūktairamaṃtrayat || akṣatānyatha sārdrāṇi darśayansaphalānyajaḥ || 13|| mauliṃ pādābjayoḥ kṛtvā gaṇeśaḥ satvaro nataḥ || mūrdhnyupājighrayāṃcakre haro harṣādgajānanam || 14 || abhyupāveśayaccāpi pariṣvajya nijāsane || somanaṃdi prabhṛtayaḥ praṇemurdaṃḍavadgaṇāḥ || 15 || yoginyopi praṇamyeśaṃ cakrurmaṃgalagāyanam || taraṇiḥ praṇanāmātha pramathādhipatiṃ haram || 16 || khaṃḍeṃduśekharaścātha upasiṃhāsanaṃ harim || samupāveśayadvāmapārśve mānapuraḥsaram || 17 || brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge pariviśrāṇitāsanam || dṛṣṭvā saṃbhāvitāḥ sarve śarveṇa praṇatā gaṇāḥ || 18|| maulicālanamātreṇa yoginyopi prasāditāḥ || saṃtoṣito raviścāpi viśeti karasaṃjñayā || 19 || atha śaṃbhuṃ śatadhṛtiḥ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ || parivijñāpayāṃcakre prasannavadanāṃbujam || 4.2.62.20 || || brahmovāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa kṣaṃtavyaṃ girijāpate || vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya yadahaṃ nāgataḥ punaḥ || 21 || prasaṃgatopi kaḥ kāśīṃ prāpya caṃdravibhūṣaṇa || kiṃcidvidhātuṃ śaktopi tyajetsthaviratāṃ dadhat|| 22 || svarūpato brāhmaṇatvādapākartuṃ na śakyate || atha śakto vyapākartuṃ kaḥ puṇye saṃcikīrṣati || 23|| vibhorapi samājñeyaṃ dharmavartmānusāriṇi || na kiṃcidapakartavyaṃ jānatā kenacitkvacita || 24|| kastādṛśi mahījānau puṇyavartmanyataṃdrite || kāśīpāle divodāse manāgapi viruddhadhīḥ ||25|| niśamyeti vacastuṣṭaḥ śrīkaṃṭhoti viśuddhadhīḥ || hasanprovāca dhātāraṃ brahmansarvamavaimyaham ||26|| || devadeva uvāca || || ādau tāvadadoṣaṃ hi brahmatvaṃ brāhmaṇasya te || vājimedhādhvarāṇāṃ ca tatopi daśakaṃ kṛtam || 27 || tatopi vihitaṃ brahmanbhavatā paramaṃ hitam || aparādhasahasrāṇi yalliṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ mama ||28|| yenaikamapi me liṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ yatra kutracit || tasyāparādhaleśopi nāsti sarvāparādhinaḥ || 29|| aparādhasahasrepi brāhmaṇaṃ yoparādhnuyāt || dinaiḥ katipayaireva tasyaiśvaryaṃ vinaśyati || 4.2.62.30 || iti bruvati deveśepyaṃtarucchvasitaṃ gaṇaiḥ || samātṛbhiḥ samaṃtācca vilokyāsyaṃ parasparam || 31 || arkopyavasaraṃ jñātvā natvā śaṃbhuṃ vyajijñapat || prasannāsyamumākāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭacarācaraḥ || 32 || || arka uvāca || || nātha kāśīmito gatvā yathāśakti kṛtopadhiḥ || akiṃcitkaratāṃ prāptaḥ sahasrakaravānapi || 33 || svadharmapālake tasmindivodāse dharāpatau || niścitāgamanaṃ jñātvā devasyāhamiha sthitaḥ ||34|| pratīkṣamāṇo deveśa tvadāmanamuttamam|| vibhajya bahudhātmānaṃ tvadārādhanatatparaḥ || 35 || manorathadrumaścādya phalitaḥ śrīmadīkṣaśāt || kiṃcidbhaktilavāṃbhobhiḥ sikto dhyānena puṣpitaḥ || 36 || ityudīritamākarṇya ravervairavilocanaḥ || provāca devadeveśo nāparādhyasi bhāskara ||37|| mamaiva kāryaṃ vihtiṃ tvaṃ yadatra vyavasthitaḥ || yasyāṃ surapraveśo na tasminrājani śāsati || 38 || iti sūraṃ samāśvāsya devadeva kṛpānidhiḥ || gaṇānāśvāsayāmāsa vrīḍā namraśirodharān ||39|| yoginyopi sudṛṣṭvātha śaṃbhunā saṃprasāditāḥ || trapābharasamākrāṃta kaṃdharā iva saṃ gatāḥ || 4.2.62.40 || tato vyāpārayāṃcakre tryakṣo netrāṇi cakriṇi || harirna kiṃcidapyūce sarvajñāgre mahāmanāḥ || 41 || īśopi śrutavṛttāṃtastārkṣyādgaṇapa śārṅgiṇoḥ || manasaiva prasannobhūnna kiṃcitparyabhāṣata || 42 || etasminnaṃtare prāptā golokātpaṃca dhenavaḥ || sunaṃdā sumanāścāpi suśīlā surabhistathā || || 43 || paṃcamī kapilā cāpi sarvāghaughavighaṭṭinī || vātsalyadṛṣṭyā bhargasya tāsāmūdhāṃsi susruvuḥ||44|| vavarṣuḥ payasāṃ pūraistadūdhāṃsi payodharāḥ || dhārāsārairavicchinnaistāvadyāvaddhrado'bhavat ||45|| payaḥpayodhiriva sa dvitīyaḥ praikṣi pārṣadaiḥ || deveśa samadhiṣṭhānāttattīrthamabhavatparam ||46|| kapilā hrada ityākhyāṃ cakre tasya maheśvaraḥ || tato devājñayā sarve snātāstatra divaukasaḥ || 47 || āvirāsustatastīrthādatha divyapitāmahāḥ || tāndṛṣṭvā te surāḥ sarve tarpayāṃcakrire mudā || 48 || agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapāstathā || ityādyā divyapitarastṛptāḥ śaṃbhuṃ vyajijñapan ||49|| devadeva jagannātha bhaktānāmabhayaprada || asmiṃstīrthe tvadabhyāśājjātā nastṛptirakṣayā || 4.2.62.50 || tasmācchaṃbho varaṃ dehi prasannenāṃtarātmanā || iti divyapitṝṇāṃ sa śrutvā vākyaṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 51 || śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || śarvaḥ sarvapitṝṇāṃ vai paratṛptikaraṃ param || 52 || || śrīdevadeva uvāca || || śṛṇu viṣṇo mahābāho śṛṇu tvaṃ ca pi tāmaha || etasminkāpile tīrthe kāpileya payobhṛte || 53 || ye piṃḍānnirvapiṣyaṃti śraddhayā śrāddhadānataḥ || teṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ saṃtṛptirbhaviṣyati mamājñayā ||54|| anyaṃ viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi mahātṛptikaraṃ param || kuhūsomasamāyoge dattaṃ śrāddhamihākṣayam||55|| saṃvartakāle saṃprāpte jalarāśirjalānyapi || kṣīyaṃte na kṣayatyatra śrāddhaṃ somakuhū kṛtam || 56|| amāsomasamāyoge śrāddhaṃ yadyatra labhyate || tīrthe kāpiladhāresmingayayā puṣkareṇa kim || 57 || gadādharabhavānyatra yatra tvaṃ ca pitāmaha || vṛṣadhvajosmyahaṃ yatra phalgustatra na saṃśayaḥ || 58 || divyāṃtarikṣabhaumāni yāni tīrthāni sarvataḥ || tānyatra nivasiṣyaṃti darśe somadinānvite || 99 || kurukṣetre naimiṣe ca gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || grahaṇe śrāddhato yatsyāttattīrthe vārṣabhadhvaje || 4.2.62.60 || asya tīrthasya nāmāni yāni divya pitāmahāḥ || tānyahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhavatāṃ tṛptidānyalam ||61|| madhusraveti prathamameṣā puṣkariṇī smṛtā || kṛtakṛtyā tato jñeyā tato'sau kṣīranīradhiḥ || 62 || vṛṣabhadhvajatīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ tataḥ || tato gadādharākhyaṃ ca pitṛtīrthaṃ tataḥ param || || 63 || tataḥ kāpiladhāraṃ vai sudhākhaniriyaṃ punaḥ || tataḥ śivagayākhyaṃ ca jñeyaṃ tīrthamidaṃ śubham ||64|| etāni daśa nāmāni tīrthasyāsya pitāmahāḥ || bhavatāṃ tṛptikārīṇi vināpi śrāddhatarpaṇaiḥ || 65 || sūryeṃdu saṃgame yetra pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikāmukāḥ || brāhmaṇānbhojayiṣyaṃti teṣāṃ śrāddhamanaṃtakam || 66 || śrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ saṃtṛptyai dāsyaṃti kapilāṃ śubhām || yetra teṣāṃ pitṛgaṇo vasetkṣīrodarodhasi || 67 || vṛṣotsargaḥ kṛto yaistu tīrthesminvārṣabhadhvaje || aśvamedhapuroḍāśaiḥ pitarastena tarpitāḥ || 68 || gayātoṣṭaguṇaṃ puṇyamasmiṃstīrthe pitāmahāḥ || amāyāṃ somayuktāyāṃ śrāddhaiḥ kāpiladhārike || 69 || yeṣāṃ garbhe'bhavatsrāvo ye' daṃtajananāmṛtāḥ || teṣāṃ tṛptirbhavennūnaṃ tīrthe kāpiladhārike|| 4.2.62.70 || adattamauṃjīdānā ye ye cādāraparigrahāḥ || tebhyo nirvāpitaṃ piṃḍamiha hyakṣayatāṃ vrajet || || 71 || agnidāhamṛtā ye vai nāgnidāhaśca yeṣu vai || te sarve tṛptimāyāṃti tīrthe kāpiladhārike || 72 || aurddhvadaihikahīnā ye ṣoḍaśa śrāddhavarjitāḥ || te tṛptimadhigacchaṃti ghṛtakulyāṃ nivāpataḥ || 73 || aputrāśca mṛtā ye vai yeṣāṃ nāstyukapradaḥ || tepi tṛptiṃ parāṃ yāṃti madhusravasi tarpitāḥ || 74 || apamṛtyumṛtā ye vai coravidyujjalādibhiḥ || teṣāmiha kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ jāyate sugatipradam || 75 || ātmaghātena nidhanaṃ yaiṣāmihavikamarṇām || tepi tṛptiṃ labhaṃtetra piṃḍaiḥ śivagayākṛtaiḥ|| || 76 || pitṛgotre mṛtā ye vai mātṛpakṣe ca ye mṛtāḥ || teṣāmatra kṛtaḥ piṃḍo bhavedakṣayatṛptidaḥ || 77 || patnīvarge mṛtā ye vai mitravarge ca ye mṛtāḥ || te sarve tṛptimāyāṃti tarpitā vārṣabhadhvaje || 78 || brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vaṃśe śūdravaṃśeṃ'tyajeṣu ca || yeṣāṃ nāmagṛhītvātra dīyate te samuddhṛtāḥ || 9 || tiryagyoni mṛtā ye vai ye piśācatvamāgatāḥ || tepyūrdhvagatimāyāṃti tṛptāḥ kāpiladhārike || 4.2.62.80 || ye tu mānuṣalokesminpitaro martyayonayaḥ || te divyayonayaḥ syurvai madhusravasi tarpitāḥ || || 81 || ye divyaloke pitaraḥ puṇyairdevatvamāgatāḥ || te brahmaloke gacchaṃti tṛptāstīrthe vṛṣadhvaje || 82|| kṛte kṣīramayaṃ tīrthaṃ tretāyāṃ madhumatpunaḥ || dvāpare sarpiṣā pūrṇaṃ kalau jalamayaṃ bhavet|| 83 || sīmābahirgatamapi jñeyaṃ tīrthamidaṃ śubham || madhye vārāṇasi śreṣṭhaṃ mama sānnidhyato naraiḥ || 84 || kāśīsthitairyato darśi dhvajo meṣavṛṣalāṃchanaḥ || vṛṣadhvajena nāmnātaḥ sthāsyāmyatra pitāmahāḥ|| 85 || pitāmahena sahito gadādharasamanvitaḥ || raviṇā pārṣadaiḥ sārdhaṃ tuṣṭaye vaḥ pitāmahāḥ || 86 || iti yāvadvaraṃ datte pitṛbhyo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || tāvannadī samāgatya praṇamyeśaṃ vyajijñapat ||87|| || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || vihitaḥ syadanaḥ sajjastatostu vijayodayaḥ || aṣṭau kaṃṭhīravā yatra yatrokṣṇāmaṣṭakaṃ śubham || 88 || yatrebhāḥ paribhāṃtyaṣṭau yatrāṣṭau javino hayāḥ || manaḥ saṃyamanaṃ yatra kaśāpāṇi vyavasthitam || 89 || gaṃgāyamunayorīṣe cakre pavanadevatā || sāyaṃprātarmaye cakre chatraṃ dyaurmaṃḍalaṃ śuci ||4.2.62.90|| tārāvalīmayāḥ kīlā āheyā upanāyakāḥ || śrutayo mārgadarśinyaḥ smṛtayo rathaguptayaḥ || 91 || dakṣiṇādhūrdṛḍhā yatra makhā yatrābhirakṣakāḥ || āsanaṃ praṇavo yatra gāyatrīpādapīṭhabhūḥ || 92 || sāṃgā vyāhṛtayo yatra śubhā sopānavīthikāḥ || sūryācaṃdramasau yatra satataṃ dvārarakṣakau ||93|| agnirmakaratuṃḍaśca rathabhūḥ kaumudīmayī || dhvajadaṃḍo mahāmeruḥ patākā haskaraprabhā || 94 || svayaṃ vāgdevatā yatra caṃcaccāmaradhāriṇī || || skaṃda uvāca || || śailādineti vijñapto devadeva umāpatiḥ || 95 || kṛtanīrājanavidhiraṣṭabhirdevamātṛbhiḥ || pinākapāṇiruttasthau dattahastotha śārṅgiṇā || 96 || ninādo divyavādyānāṃ rodasī paryapūrayat || gītamaṃgalagīrbhiśca cāraṇairanuvardhitaḥ || 97 || tena divyaninādena badhirīkṛtadiṅmukhāḥ || āhūtā iva ājagmurviṣvagbhuvanavāsinaḥ || 98 || devākoṭyastrayastriṃśadgaṇāḥ koṭyayutadvayam || navakoṭyastu cāmuṃḍā bhairavyaḥ koṭisaṃmitāḥ || 99 || ṣaḍānanāḥ kumārāśca mayūravaravāhanāḥ || mamānugāḥ samāyātāḥ koṭayoṣṭau mahābalāḥ || 4.2.62.100 || āyayuḥ koṭayaḥ sapta sphuratparaśupāṇayaḥ || picaṃḍilā mahāvegā vighnavighnā gajānanāḥ || 101 || ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi munayo brahmavādinaḥ || tāvatopi samājagmustatratye gṛhamedhinaḥ || 102 || nāgānāṃ koṭayastisraḥ pātālatalavāsinām || dānavānāṃ ca daityānāṃ dve dve koṭī śivātmanām || 103 || gaṃdharvā niyutānyaṣṭau koṭyardhaṃ yakṣarakṣasām || vidyādharāṇāmayutaṃ niyutadvayasaṃyutam || 104 || tathā ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi divyāścāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ || gomātaro'ṣṭau lakṣāṇi suparṇānyayutāni ṣaṭ || 105 || sāgarāḥ sapta saṃprāptā nānāratnopadapradāḥ || saritāṃ ca sahasrāṇi trīṇi paṃcāyutāni ca || 106 || girayo'ṣṭau sahasrāṇi vanaspatiśatatrayam|| ājagmurdiggajā aṣṭau yatra devaḥ pinākadhṛk ||107|| etaiḥ sametaḥ saṃtuṣṭaḥ pariṣṭuta itastataḥ || śrīkaṃṭho rathamāruhya kāśīṃ prāviśaduttamām |||107||| sa girīṃdrasutastryakṣo mudāṃ dhāma mudāṃ khaniḥ || kāśīṃ praikṣiṣṭa saṃhṛṣṭastriviṣṭapa samutkaṭām ||109|| || skaṃda uvāca || || śrutvākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ koṭijanmāghanāśanam || paṭhitvā pāṭhayitvā ca śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 4.2.62.110 || śrāddhakāle viśeṣeṇa paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || akṣayaṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṛtuṣṭikaraṃ param || 111 || vṛṣabhadhvaja māhātmyaṃ paṭhitvā śivasannidhau || pratyahaṃ varṣamātraṃ tu hyaputraḥ putravānbhavet || 112 || viśveśituḥ saṃpraveśo yaḥ kāśyāṃ samudāhṛtaḥ || paramānaṃdakaṃdasya bījametatsuniścitam || 113 || paṭhitvaitanmudākhyānaṃ praviśedyo navaṃ gṛham || sa sarvasaukhyanilayo bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ||114|| trailokyānaṃdajanakametadākhyānamuttamam || asya śravaṇamātreṇa viśveśaḥ saṃprasīdati || 115 || alabhyalābho devasya jātotra hi yataḥ paraḥ || tataḥ kāśī praveśākhyaṃ japyamākhyānamuttamam || 116 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe uttarārddhe vṛṣabhadhvajaprādurbhāvonāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 || ||
<4.3.63>
agastya uvāca || || dṛṣṭvā kāśīṃ dṛgānaṃdāṃ tārakāre purāriṇā || kimakāri samācakṣva prāptāṃ bahumanorathaiḥ || 1 || || skaṃda uvāca || || pativratāpate 'gastya śṛṇu vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ || mṛgāṃkalakṣmaṇotkaṃṭhaṃ kāśī netrātithīkṛtā || 2 || atha sarvajñanāthena bhaktavatsalacetasā || jaigīṣavyo muniśreṣṭho guhāṃ tastho nirīkṣitaḥ || 3 || yamanehasamārabhya madaṃrādriṃ viniryayau || adrīṃdra sutayā sārdhaṃ rudreṇokṣeṃdragāminā || 4 || taṃ vāsaraṃ puraskṛtya jagrāha niyamaṃ dṛḍham || jaigīṣavyo mahāmedhāḥ kuṃbhayone mahākṛtī ||5|| viṣamekṣaṇa pādābjaṃ samīkṣiṣye yadā punaḥ || tadāṃbuvipruṣamapi bhakṣayiṣyāmi cetyaho ||6|| kutaściddhāraṇāyogādathavā śaṃbhvanugrahāta || anaśnannapibanyogī jaigīṣavyaḥ sthito mune || 7 || taṃ śaṃbhureva jānāti nānyo jānāti kaścana || ataeva tataḥ prāptaḥ prathamaṃ pramathādhipaḥ || 8 || jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ somavārānurādhayoḥ || tatparvaṇi mahāyātrā kartavyā tatra mānavaiḥ || 9 || jyeṣṭhasthānaṃ tataḥ kāśyāṃ tadābhūdapi puṇyadam || tatra liṃgaṃ samabhavatsvayaṃ jyeṣṭheśvarābhidham || 4.2.63.10 || talliṃgadarśanātpuṃsāṃ pāpaṃ janmaśatārjitam || tamorkodayamāpyeva tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati ||11|| jyeṣṭhavāpyāṃ naraḥ snātvā tarpayitvā pitāmahān || jyeṣṭheśvaraṃ samālokya na bhūyo jāyate bhuvi || 12 || āvirāsītsvayaṃ tatra jyeṣṭheśvara samīpataḥ || sarvasiddhipradā gaurī jyeṣṭhāśreṣṭhā samaṃtataḥ || 13 || jyeṣṭhe māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ tatra kāryo mahotsavaḥ || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhaye || 14 || jyeṣṭhāṃ gaurīṃ namaskṛtya jyeṣṭhavāpī pariplutā || saubhāgyabhājanaṃ bhūyādyoṣā saubhāgyabhāgapi|| 15 || nivāsaṃ kṛtavāñśaṃbhustasminsthāne yataḥ svayam || nivāseśa iti khyātaṃ liṃgaṃ tatra paraṃ tataḥ || || 16 || nivāseśvaraliṃgasya sevanātsarvasaṃpadaḥ || nivasaṃti gṛhe nityaṃ nityaṃ pratipadaṃ punaḥ || 17 || kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ vidhānena jyeṣṭhasthāne narottamaḥ || jyeṣṭhāṃ tṛptiṃ dadātyeva pitṛbhyo madhusarpiṣā || 18 || jyeṣṭhatīrthe naraḥ kāśyāṃ dattvā dānāni śaktitaḥ || jyeṣṭhānsvargānavāpnoti naro mokṣaṃ ca gacchati || 19 || jyeṣṭheśvaro rcyaḥ prathamaṃ kāśyāṃ śreyorthibhirnaraiḥ || jyeṣṭhāgaurī tatobhyarcyā sarvajyeṣṭhamabhīpsubhiḥ || 4.2.63.20 || atha naṃdinamāhūya dhūrjaṭiḥ sa kṛpānidhiḥ || śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 21 || || īśvara uvāca || || śailāde praviśāśu tvaṃ guhāstyatra manoharā || tadaṃtaresti me bhakto jaigīṣavyastapodhanaḥ || 22 || mahāniyamavānnaṃdistvagasthisnāyu śeṣitaḥ || tamihānaya madbhaktaṃ maddarśana dṛḍhavratam || 23 || yadāprabhṛtyagāṃ kāśyā maṃdaraṃ sarvasuṃdaram || mahāniyamavāneṣa tadārabhyojjhitāśanaḥ || 24 || gṛhāṇa līlākamalamidaṃ pīyūṣapoṣaṇam || anena tasya gātrāṇi spṛśa sadyaḥ subṛṃhiṇā || 25 || tato naṃdī samādāya tallīlākamalaṃ vibhoḥ || praṇamya devadeveśamāviśadgahvarāṃ guhām ||26|| naṃdī dṛṣṭvātha taṃ tatra dhāraṇādṛḍhamānasam || tapogni pariśuṣkāṃgaṃ kamalena samaspṛśat || 27 || tapāṃte vṛṣṭisaṃyogācchālūra iva koṭare || ullalāsa sa yogīṃdraḥ sparśamātrāttadabjajāt || 28 || atha naṃdī samādāya satvaraṃ munipuṃgavam || devadevasya pādāgre namaskṛtya nyapātayat || 29 || jaigīṣavyotha saṃbhrāṃtaḥ purato vīkṣya śaṃkaram || vāmāṃgasanniviṣṭādritanayaṃ praṇanāma ha || 4.2.63.30 || praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau pariluṭhya samaṃtataḥ || tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā sa muniścaṃdraśekharam ||31|| || jaigīṣavya uvāca || || namaḥ śivāya śāṃtāya sarvajñāya śubhātmane|| jagadānaṃdakaṃdāya paramānaṃdahetave || 32 || arūpāya sarūpāya nānārūpadharāya ca || virūpākṣāya vidhaye vidhiviṣṇustutāya ca ||33|| sthāvarāya namastubhyaṃ jaṃgamāya namostute || sarvātmane namastubhyaṃ namaste paramātmane || 34 || namastrailokyakāmyāya kāmāṃgadahanāya ca || namo śeṣaviśeṣāya namaḥ śeṣāṃgadāya te || || 35 || śrīkaṃṭhāya namastubhyaṃ viṣakaṃṭhāya te namaḥ || vaikuṃṭhavaṃdyapādāya namo'kuṃṭhitaśaktaye ||36|| namaḥ śaktyardhadehāya videhāya sudehine || sakṛtpraṇāmamātreṇa dehidehanivāriṇe|| 37 || kālāya kālakālāya kālakūṭa viṣādine || vyālayajñopavītāya vyālabhūṣaṇadhāriṇe || 38 || namaste khaṃḍaparaśo namaḥ khaṃḍeṃ dudhāriṇe || khaṃḍitāśeṣa duḥkhāya khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇe || 39 || gīrvāṇagītanāthāya gaṃgākallolamāline || gaurīśāya girīśāya giriśāya guhāraṇe || || 4.2.63.40 || caṃdrārdhaśuddhabhūṣāya caṃdrasūryāgnicakṣuṣe || namaste carmavasana namo digvasanāyate || 41 || jagadīśāya jīrṇāya jarājanmaharāya te || jīvāyate namastubhyaṃ jaṃjapūkādihāriṇe || 42 || namo ḍamaruhastāya dhanurhastāya te namaḥ || trinetrāya namastubhyaṃ jagannetrāya te namaḥ || 43 || triśūlavyagrahastāya namastripathagādhara || triviṣṭapādhināthāya trivedīpaṭhitāya ca || 44 || trayīmayāya tuṣṭāya bhaktatuṣṭipradāya ca || dīkṣitāya namastubhyaṃ devadevāya te namaḥ || 45 || dāritāśeṣapāpāya namaste dīrghadarśine || dūrāya duravāpyāya doṣanirdalanāya ca || 46 || doṣākara kalādhāra tyaktadoṣāgamāya ca || namo dhūrjaṭaye tubhyaṃ dhattūrakusumapriya ||47|| namo dhīrāya dharmāya dharmapālāya te namaḥ || nīlagrīva namastubhyaṃ namaste nīlalohita || 48 || nāmamātrasmṛtikṛtāṃ trailokyaiśvaryapūraka || namaḥ pramathanāthāya pinākodyatapāṇaye || || 49 || paśupāśavimokṣāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ || nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa mahāpātakahāriṇe || 4.2.63.50 || parātparāya pārāya parāparaparāya ca || namo'pāracaritrāya supavitrakathāya ca || 51 || vāmadevāya vāmārdhadhāriṇe vṛṣagāmine || namo bhargāya bhīmāya natabhītiharāya ca || 52 || bhavāya bhavanāśāya bhūtānāṃpataye namaḥ || mahādeva namastubhyaṃ maheśa mahasāṃpate || 53 || namo mṛḍānīpataye namo mṛtyuṃjayāya te || yajñāraye namastubhyaṃ yakṣarājapriyāya ca || 54|| yāyajūkāya yajñāya yajñānāṃ phaladāyine || rudrāya rudrapataye kadrudrāya ramāya ca || 55 || śūline śāśvateśāya śmaśānāvanicāriṇe || śivāpriyāya śarvāya sarvajñāya namostu te || 56 || harāya kṣāṃtirūpāya kṣetrajñāya kṣamākara || kṣamāya kṣitihartre ca kṣīragaurāya te namaḥ || 57 || aṃdhakāre namastubhyamādyaṃtarahitāya ca || iḍādhārāya īśāya upedreṃdrastutāya ca || 58 || umākāṃtāya ugrāya namaste ūrdhvaretase || ekarūpāya caikāya mahadaiśvaryarūpiṇe || 59 || anaṃtakāriṇe tubhyamaṃbikāpataye namaḥ || tvamoṃkāro vaṣaṭkāro bhūrbhuvaḥsvastvameva hi ||4.2.63.60|| dṛśyādṛśya yadatrāsti tatsarvaṃ tvamu mādhava || stutiṃ kartuṃ na jānāmi stutikartā tvameva hi || || 61 || vācyastvaṃ vācakastvaṃ hi vākca tvaṃ praṇatosmi te || nānyaṃ vedmi mahādeva nānyaṃ staumi maheśvara || 62 || nānyaṃ namāmi gaurīśa nānyākhyāmādade śiva || mūkonyanāmagrahaṇe badhironyakathāśrutau ||63|| paṃguranyābhigamane'smyaṃdho'nyaparivīkṣaṇe|| eka eva bhavānīśa ekakartā tvameva hi|| 64 || pātā hartā tvamevaiko nānātvaṃ mūḍhakalpanā || atastvameva śaraṇaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ||65|| saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ māmuddhara maheśvara || iti stutvā maheśānaṃ jaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ || 66 || vācaṃyamo bhavatsthāṇoḥ purataḥ sthāṇusannibhaḥ || iti stutiṃ samākarṇya muneścaṃdravibhūṣaṇaḥ || uvāca ca prasannātmā varaṃ brūhīti taṃ munim || 67 || || jaigīṣavya uvāca || || yadi prasanno deveśa tatastava padāṃbujāt || mā bhavāni bhavānīśa dūraṃ dūrapadaprada ||68|| aparaśca varo nātha deyoyamavicārataḥ || yanmayā sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ tatra sānnidhyamastu te ||69|| || īśvara uvāca || || jaigīṣavya mahābhāga yaduktaṃ bhavatānagha || tadastu sarvaṃ tebhīṣṭaṃ varamanyaṃ dadāmi ca || 4.2.63.70 || yogaśāstraṃ mayā dattaṃ tava nirvāṇasādhakam || sarveṣāṃ yogināṃ madhye yogācāryo'stu vai bhavān || 71 || rahasyaṃ yogavidyāyā yathāvattvaṃ tapodhana || saṃvetsyase prasādānme yena nirvāṇamāpsyasi || 72 || yathā nadī yathā bhṛṃgī somanaṃdī yathā tathā || tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi bhakto me jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ || 73 || saṃti vratāni bhūyāṃsi niyamāḥ saṃtyanekadhā || tapāṃsi nānā saṃtyatra saṃti dānānyanekaśaḥ || 74 || śreyasāṃ sādhanānyatra pāpaghnānyapi sarvathā || paraṃ hi paramaścaiṣa niyamo yastvayā kṛtaḥ || 75|| paro hi niyamaścaiṣa māṃ vilokya yadaśyate || māmanālokya yadbhuktaṃ tadbhuktaṃ kevalatvagham || 76 || asamarcya ca yo bhuṅkte patrapuṣpaphalairapi || retobhakṣī bhavenmūḍhaḥ sa janmānyekaviṃśatim || 77 || mahato niyamasyāsya bhavatānuṣṭhitasya vai || nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśī mātrāmapyanye niyamā yamāḥ || 78 || ato maccaraṇābhyāśe tvaṃ nivatsyasi sarvathā || ato naiḥśreyasīṃ lakṣmīṃ tatraiva prāpsyasi dhruvam || 79 || jaigīṣavyeśvaraṃ nāma liṃgaṃ kāśyāṃ sudurlabham || trīṇi varṣāṇi saṃsevya labhedyogaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 4.2.63.80 || jaigīṣavyaguhāṃ prāpya yogābhyasanatatparaḥ || ṣaṇmāsena labhetsiddhiṃ vāñchitāṃ madanugrahāt || 81 || tava liṃgamidaṃ bhaktaiḥ pūjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || vilokyā ca guhā ramyā parāsiddhimabhīpsubhiḥ || 82 || atra jyeṣṭheśvarakṣetre tvalliṃgaṃ sarvasiddhidam || nāśayedaghasaṃghāni dṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ samarcitam || 83 || asmiñjyeṣṭheśvarakṣetre saṃbhojya śivayoginaḥ || koṭibhojyaphalaṃ samyagekaikaparisaṃkhyayā||84 || jaigīṣavyeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || kalau kaluṣabuddhīnāṃ purataśca viśeṣataḥ || 85 || kariṣyāmyatra sāṃnidhyamasmim̐lliṃge tapodhana|| yogasiddhipradānāya sādhakebhyaḥ sadaiva hi ||86|| dade śṛṇu mahābhāga jaigīṣavyāparaṃ varam || tvayedaṃ yatkṛtaṃ stotraṃ yogasiddhikaraṃ param || 87 || mahāpāpaughaśamanaṃ mahāpuṇyapravardhanam || mahābhītipraśamanaṃ mahābhaktivivardhanam || 88 || etatstotrajapātpuṃsāmasādhyaṃ naiva kiṃcana || tasmātsarvaprayatnena japanīyaṃ susādhakaiḥ 4|| 89 || iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai smarāriḥ smeralocanaḥ || dadarśa brāhmaṇāṃ statra sametānkṣetravāsinaḥ || 4.2.63.90 || || skaṃda uvāca || || niśamyākhyānamatulametatprājñaḥ prayatnataḥ || niṣpāpo jāyate martyo nopasargaiḥ prabādhyate ||91 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe jyeṣṭheśākhyānaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||
<4.2.64>
|| agastya uvāca || dṛṣṭvā bhūdevatāḥ śaṃbhuṃ kimācakhyuḥ ṣaḍānana || kānikāni ca liṃgāni tatra tānyapicakṣva me || 1 || jyeṣṭhasthāne mahāpuṇye devadevasya vallabhe || āścaryaṃ kimabhūttatra tadācakṣva ṣaḍānana ||2 || || skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇvagastya yathā pṛcchi bhavatā tadbravīmyaham || maṃdarādriṃ yadā devo gatavānbrahmagauravāt || 3 || tadā nirāśrayā viprāḥ kṣetrasaṃnyāsinonaghāḥ || upākṛtāścāvirataṃ mahākṣetrapratigrahāt || 4 || khātaṃkhātaṃ ca daṃḍāgrairbhūmiṃ kaṃdādivṛttayaḥ || cakruḥ puṣkariṇīṃ ramyāṃ daṃḍakhātābhidhāṃ mune || 5 || tattīrthaṃ paritaḥ sthāpya mahāliṃgānyanekaśaḥ || maheśārādhanaparāstapaścakruḥ prayatnataḥ || 6 || vibhūtidhāriṇo nityaṃ nityarudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ || liṃgapūjāratā nityaṃ śatarudriyajāpinaḥ || 7 || te śrutvā devadevasya punarāgamanaṃ mune || tapaḥkṛśā atitarāmāsurānaṃda medurāḥ || 8 || dvijāḥ paṃcasahasrāṇi carato vipulaṃ tapaḥ || daṃḍakhātānmahātīrthādājagmurdevadarśane || 9 || tīrthānmaṃdākinī nāmno dvijāḥ pāśupatavratāḥ || śivaikārādhanaparāḥ sametā ayutonmitāḥ || 4.2.64.10 || haṃsatīrthātpariprāptā ayutaṃ triśatottaram || śatadurvāsasastīrthādekādaśa śatādhikam || 11 || matsyodaryāḥ parāpetuḥ sahasrāṇi ṣaḍeva hi || kapālamocanātsapta śatānyabhyāgatā dvijāḥ || 12|| ṛṇamocanatastīrthātsahasraṃ dviśatādhikam || vaitaraṇyā api mune dvijānāmayutārdhakam ||13|| tataḥ pṛthūdakātkuṃḍātpṛthunā parikhānitāt || ayāsiṣurdvijānāṃ ca śatānyeva trayodaśa ||14|| tathaivāpsarasaḥ kuṃḍānmenakākhyācchatadvayam || urvaśīkuṃḍataḥ prāptāḥ sahasraṃ dviśatādhikam || 15 || tathairāvatakuṃḍācca brāhmaṇāstriśatāni ca || gaṃdharvāpsarasaḥ sapta śatāni dviśatāni ca || 16 || vṛṣeśatīrthādājagmurnavatiḥ saśatatrayā || yakṣiṇīkuṃḍataḥ prāptāḥ sahasraṃ triśatottaram || 17 || lakṣmītīrthātparaṃ jagmuḥ ṣoḍaśaiva śatāni ca || piśācamocanātsapta sahasrāṇi dvijottamāḥ || 18 || pitṛkuṃḍācchataṃsāgraṃ dhruvatīrthācchatāni ṣaṭ || mānasākhyācca saraso dviśatī saśatatrayā || 19 || brāhmaṇā vāsukihṛdātsahasrāṇi daśaiva tu || tathaivāṣṭaśataṃ draṣṭuṃ jānakīkuṃḍato dvijāḥ || 4.2.64.20 || kāśīnāthamanuprāptāḥ paramānaṃdadāyinam || tathā gautamakuṃḍācca śatāninava cāgatāḥ ||21|| tīrthāddurgatisaṃharturbāhmaṇāḥ pratipedire || ekādaśaśatānyeva draṣṭuṃ devamumāpatim || 22 || asīsaṃbhedamārabhya gaṃgātīrasthitā dvijāḥ || āsaṃgameśvarāttatra pariprāptā ghaṭodbhava || 23 || aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi tathā paṃcaśatānyapi || brāhmaṇāḥ paṃcapaṃcāśadgaṃgātīrātsamāgatāḥ || 24 || sārdradūrvākṣatakaraiḥ sapuṣpaphalapāṇibhiḥ || sugaṃdhamālyahastaiśca brāhmaṇairjayavādibhiḥ || 25 || stuto maṃgalasūktaiśca praṇataśca punaḥpunaḥ || tebhyo dattābhayaḥ śaṃbhuḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ mudā || 26 || tataste brāhmaṇāḥ procuḥ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭāḥ || kṣetre nivasatāṃ nātha sadānaḥ kuśalodayaḥ || 27 || viśeṣataḥ kṛto'smābhiḥ sākṣānnayanagocaraḥ|| tvaṃ yatsvarūpaṃ śrutayo na viduḥ paramārthataḥ || 28 || sadaivākuśalaṃ teṣāṃ ye tvatkṣetraparāṅmukhāḥ || caturdaśāpi vai lokāsteṣāṃ nityaṃ parāṅmukhāḥ || 29 || yeṣāṃ hṛdi sadaivāste kāśītvāśīviṣāṃ gada || saṃsārāśīviṣaviṣaṃ na teṣāṃ prabhavetkvacit || 4.2.64.30 || garbharakṣāmaṇirmaṃtraḥ kāśīvarṇadvayātmakaḥ || yasya kaṃṭhe sadā tiṣṭhettasyākuśalatā kutaḥ || 31 || sudhāṃ pibati yo nityaṃ kāśīvarṇadvayātmikām || sa nairjarīṃ daśāṃ hitvā sudhaiva parijāyate || 32 || śrutaṃ karṇāmṛtaṃ yena kāśītyakṣarayugmakam || na samākaṇaryatyeva sa punargarbhajāṃ kathām|| 33 || kāśī rajopi yanmūrdhni patedapyanilāhatam || caṃdraśekharatanmūrdhā bhaveccaṃdrakalāṃkitaḥ || 34 || prasaṃgatopi yannetrapathamānaṃdakānanam || yātaṃ tetra na jāyaṃte nekṣeranpitṛkāna(va?)nam ||35|| gacchatā tiṣṭhatā vāpi svapatā jāgratāthavā || kāśītyeṣa mahāmaṃtro yena japtaḥ sanirbhayaḥ || 36 || yena bījākṣarayugaṃ kāśīti hṛdi dhāritam || abījāni bhavaṃtyeva karmabījāni tasya vai || 37 || kāśī kāśīti kāśīti japato yasya saṃsthitiḥ || anyatrāpi satastasya puro muktiḥ prakāśate || 38 || kṣemamūrtiriyaṃ kāśī kṣemamūrtirbhavānbhava || kṣemamūrtistripathagā nānyatkṣematrayaṃ kvacit || 39 || brāhmaṇānāmiti vacaḥ kṣetrabhaktivibṛṃhitam || niśamya girijākāṃtastutoṣa nitarāṃ haraḥ || 4.2.64.40 || provāca ca prasannātmā dhanyā yūyaṃ dvijarṣabhāḥ || yeṣāmihedṛśī bhaktirmama kṣetretipāvane || 41 || jāne sattvamayā jātāḥ kṣetrasyāsya niṣevaṇāt || nīrajaskā vitamasaḥ saṃsārārṇavapāragāḥ || 42 || vārāṇasyāstu ye bhaktāste bhaktā mama niścitam|| jīvanmuktā hi te nūnaṃ mokṣalakṣmyā kaṭākṣitāḥ || 43 || yaiśca kāśīsthito jaṃturalpakopi virodhitaḥ || tairvai viśvaṃbharā sarvā mayā saha virodhitā || || 44 || vārāṇasyāḥ stutimapi yo niśamyānumodate || api brahmāṃḍamakhilaṃ dhruvaṃ tenānumoditam ||45|| nivasaṃti hi ye martyā asminnānaṃdakānane || mamāṃtaḥkaraṇe te vai nivaseyurakalmaṣāḥ || 46 || nivasaṃti mama kṣetre mama bhaktiṃ prakurvate || mama liṃgadharā ye tu tānevopadiśāmyaham || 47 || nivasaṃti mama kṣetre mama bhaktiṃ na kurvate || mama liṃgadharā ye no na tānupadiśāmyaham ||48|| kāśī nirvāṇanagarī yeṣāṃ citte prakāśate || te matpuraḥ prakāśaṃte naiḥśreyasyā śriyā vṛtāḥ || 49 || mokṣalakṣmīriyaṃ kāśī na yebhyaḥ parirocate || svarlakṣmīṃ kāṃkṣamāṇebhyaḥ patitāste na saṃśayaḥ || 4.2.64.50 || kāthīṃ saṃkākṣamāṇānāṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || puraḥ kiṃkaravattiṣṭhenmamānugrahato dvijāḥ || 51 || ānaṃdakānane hyatra jvaladdāvānalosmyaham || karmabījāni jaṃtūnāṃ jvālaye na prarohaye || 52 || vastavyaṃ satataṃ kāśyāṃ yaṣṭavyohaṃ prayatnataḥ || jetavyau kalikālau ca raṃtavyā muktiraṃganā |53|| prāpyāpi kāśīṃ durbuddhiryo na māṃ parisevate|| tasya hastagatāpyāśu kaivalyaśrīḥ praṇaśyati || 54 || dhanyā madbhaktilakṣmāṇo brāhmaṇāḥ kāśivāsinaḥ || yūyaṃ yaccetaso vṛtterna dūrehaṃ na kāśikā || 55 || dātavyo vo varaḥ kotra vriyatāṃ me yathāruci || preyāṃso me yato yūyaṃ kṣetrasaṃnyāsakāriṇaḥ || 56 || iti pītvā maheśānamukhakṣīrābdhijāṃ sudhām || paritṛptā dvijāḥ sarve vavrurvaramanuttamam || 57 || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || || umāpate maheśāna sarvajña vara eṣa naḥ || kāśī kadāpi na tyājyā bhavatā bhavatāpahṛt || 58 || vacanādbrāhmaṇānāṃ tu śāpo mā prabhavatviha || kadācidapi keṣāṃcitkāśyāṃ mokṣāṃtarāyakaḥ || 59 || tava pādābuṃjadvaṃdve nirdvaṃdvā bhaktirastu naḥ || ā kalevarapātaṃ ca kāśīvāsostu noniśam ||4.2.64.60|| kimanyena vareṇeśa deya eṣa varo hi naḥ || avadhehyaṃdhakadhvaṃsinvaramanyaṃ vṛṇīmahe || 61 || tava pratinidhī kṛtyāsmābhistvadbhaktibhāvitaiḥ || pratiṣṭhiteṣu liṃgeṣu sānnidhyaṃ bhavato'stviha||62|| śrutveti teṣāṃ vākyāni tathāstviti pinākinā || proce'nyopi varo datto jñānaṃ vaśca bhaviṣyati ||63|| punaḥ provāca deveśo niśāmayata bho dvijāḥ || hitaṃ vaḥ kathayāmyatra tadanuṣṭhīyatāṃ dhruvam || 64 || sevyottaravahā nityaṃ liṃgamarcyaṃ prayatnataḥ || damo dānaṃ dayā nityaṃ kartavyaṃ muktikāṃkṣibhiḥ || 65 || idameva rahasyaṃ ca kathitaṃ kṣetravāsinām || matiḥ
