parahitā kāryā vācyaṃ nodvegakṛdvacaḥ ||66|| manasāpi na kartavyamenotra vijigīṣuṇā|| atratyamakṣayaṃ yasmātsukṛtaṃ sukṛtetaram || 67 || anyatra yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkāśyāṃ pariṇaśyati || vārāṇasyāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpamaṃtargehe praṇaśyati || 68 || aṃtargehe kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ paiśācyanarakāvaham || piśācanarakaprāptirgacchatyeva bahiryadi || 69 || na kalpakoṭibhiḥ kāśyāṃ kṛtaṃ karma pramṛjyate || kiṃtu rudrapiśācatvaṃ jāyate'trāyutatrayam.|| 4.2.64.70. || vārāṇasyāṃ sthito yo vai pātakeṣu rataḥ sadā || yoniṃ prāpyāpi paiśācīṃ varṣāṇāmayutatrayam || 71 || punaratraiva nivasañjñānaṃ prāpsyatyanuttamam || tena jñānetha saṃprāpte(?) mokṣamāpsyatyanuttamam || 72 || (saṃprāṃte) duṣkṛtāni vidhāyeha bahiḥ paṃcatvamāgatāḥ || teṣāṃ gatiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuta dvijasattamāḥ || 73 || yāmākhyā me gaṇāḥ saṃti ghorā vikṛtamūrttayaḥ || mūṣāyāṃ te dhamaṃtyādau kṣetraduṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ || 74 || nayaṃtyanūpaprāyāṃ ca tataḥ prācīṃ durāsadām || varṣākāle durācārānpātayaṃti mahājale || 75 || jalaukābhiḥ sapakṣābhirdaṃdaśūkairjalodbhavaiḥ || durnivāraiśca maśakairdaśyaṃte te divāniśam || 76 || tato yāmairhimartau te nīyaṃte'drau himālaye || aśanāvaraṇairhīnāḥ kleśyaṃte te divāniśam || 77 || marusthale tato grīṣme vārivṛkṣavivarjite || divākarakaraistīvraistāpyaṃte te pipāsitāḥ || 78 || kleśitāste gaṇairugrairyātanābhiḥ samaṃtataḥ || itthaṃ kālamasaṃkhyātamānīyaṃte tatastviha || 79 || nivedayaṃti te yāmāḥ kālarājāṃtike tataḥ || kālarājopi tāndraṣṭvā karmasaṃsmārya duṣkṛtam || 4.2.64.80 || vivastrānkṣuttṛṣārtāṃśca lagnapṛṣṭhodaratvacaḥ || anyai rudrapiśācaiśca sahasaṃyojayatyapi || 81 || tato rudrapiśācāste bhairavānucarāḥ sadā || sahaṃte klamamatyarthaṃ kṣuttṛṣṇogratvasaṃbhavam || 82 || āhāraṃ rudhironmiśraṃ te labhaṃte kadācana || evaṃ tryayutasaṃkhyākaṃ kālaṃ tatrātiduḥkhitāḥ || 83 || śmaśānastaṃbhamabhito nīyaṃte kaṃṭhapāśitāḥ || pipāsitā api na teṃ'busparśamapi cāpnuyuḥ || 84 || atha saṃkṣīṇapāpāste kālabhairavadarśanāt || ihaiva dehino bhūtvā mucyaṃte te mamājñayā || 85 || tasmānna kāmayetātra vāṅmanaḥkarmaṇāpyaghaha(?)m || śucau pathi sadā stheyaṃ mahālābhamabhīpsubhiḥ || 86 || nāvimukte mṛtaḥ kaścinnarakaṃ yāti kilbiṣī || mamānugrahamāsādya gacchatyeva parāṃ gatim || 87 || anāśanaṃ yaḥ kurute madbhakta iha suvrataḥ || na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 88 || aśāśvatamidaṃ jñātvā mānuṣyaṃ bahukilviṣam || avimuktaṃ sadā sevyaṃ saṃsārabhayamocakam || 89 || nānyatpaśyāmi jaṃtūnāṃ muktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || sarvapāpapraśamanīṃ prāyaścittaṃ kalau yuge || 4.2.64.90 || janmāṃtarasahasreṣu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam || avimuktaṃ praviṣṭasya tatsarvaṃ vrajati kṣayam || 91 || janmāṃtarasahasreṣu yuṃjanyogī yadāpnuyāt || tadihaiva paro mokṣo maraṇādadhi gamyate || 92 || tiryagyonigatāḥ sattvā ye vimuktakṛtālayāḥ || kālena nidhanaṃ prāptāstepi yāṃti parāṃ gatim || 93 || avimuktaṃ na sevaṃte ye mūḍhāstamasāvṛtāḥ || viṇmūtraretasāṃ madhye te vasaṃti punaḥ punaḥ || 94 || avimuktaṃ samāsādya yo liṃgaṃ sthāpayetsudhīḥ || kalpakoṭiśatairvāpi nāsti tasya punarbhavaḥ || 95 || grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ kālena patanaṃ dhruvam || avimukte mṛtānāṃ tu patanaṃ naiva vidyate|| 96 || brahmahatyāṃ naraḥ kṛtvā paścātsaṃyatamānasaḥ || prāṇāṃstyajati yaḥ kāśyāṃ sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ || 97 || striyaḥ pativratā yāśca mama bhaktisamāhitāḥ || avimukte mṛtā viprā yāṃti tāḥ paramāṃ gatim || 98 || atrotkramaṇakālehaṃ svayameva dvijottamāḥ || diśāmi tārakaṃ brahma dehī syādyena tanmayaḥ || 99 || manmanā mama bhaktaśca mayi sarvārpitakriyaḥ || yathā mokṣamihāpnoti na tathānyatrakutracit || 4.2.64.100 || maraṇaṃ niścitaṃ jñātvā gatiṃ cāsukharūpiṇīm || calamāgaṃtukaṃ sarvaṃ tataḥ kāśīṃ samāśrayet || 101 || kāśī samāśritā yaistu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || tānatra nirmaladhiyo nivārṇaśrīḥ samāśrayet || 102 || kāśīsthitaikamapi yaḥ prīṇayennyāyajairdhanaiḥ || tena trailokyamakhilaṃ prīṇitaṃ tu mayā saha || 103 || yaḥ prīṇayati puṇyātmā nirvāṇanagarī naram || pumarthena sthiternityaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ prīṇayāmi tam || 104 || divodāsopi rājarṣiḥ kāśīṃ dharmeṇa pālayan || sadeho matpadaṃ prāpto yato na punarāgatiḥ || 105|| atra yogastathā jñānaṃ muktirekena janmanā || ato vimuktamāsādya nānyadgacchettapovanam || 106 || mokṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ jñātvā saṃsāraṃ cātibhīṣaṇam || aśmanā caraṇau hatvā kālamatra pratīkṣayet || 107 || avimuktaṃ parityajya yadā yāsyaṃti durdhiyaḥ || hasiṣyaṃti tadā bhūtānyanyonyakaratāḍanaiḥ || 108 || prāpya vārāṇasīṃ puṇyāṃ siddhikṣetramanuttamam || pariniṣkrāṃtumanyatra kasya jaṃtormatirbhavet || 109 || mahādānena cānyatra yatphalaṃ labhyate naraiḥ || avimukte tu kākiṇyāṃ dattāyāṃ tadavāpyate || 4.2.64.110 || ekaṃ samarcayelliṃgaṃ tapastapyeta cāparaḥ || tayormadhye tu sa śreṣṭho yo liṃgaṃ pūjayediha || 111 || tīrthāṃtare gavāṃ koṭiṃ vidhivadyaḥ prayacchati|| ekāhaṃ yo vasetkāśyāṃ kāśīvāsī tayorvaraḥ|| || 112 || anyatra brāhmaṇānāṃ tu koṭiṃ saṃbhojya yatphalam|| vārāṇasyāṃ tu caikena bhojitena tadāpyate|| 113 || sannihatyāṃ kurukṣetre rāhugraste divākare || tulāpuruṣadānena kāśībhikṣā samā bhavet|| 114 || mameha paramaṃ jyotirāpātālādvyavasthitam || atītya saptalokādīnanaṃtaṃ liṃgarūpadhṛk || 115 || pṛthivyaṃtepi ye liṃgamavimuktaṃ smaraṃti me || kaluṣaiste vimucyaṃte mahadbhiriti niścitam || 116 || asminkṣetre tu ye nāhaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ samarcitaḥ || saṃprāpya tārakaṃ jñānaṃ na sa bhūyobhijāyate || 117 || yo māmiha samabhyarcya mriyatenyatrakutracit || janmāṃtarepi māṃ prāpya sa vimukto bhaviṣyati ||118|| ityuktvā kṣetramāhātmyaṃ dvijānāmagrato haraḥ || paśyatāmeva teṣāṃ tu tatraivāṃtarhitobhavat || 119 || tepi sākṣādvirūpākṣaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtya vāḍavāḥ || prahṛṣṭamanaso'tyaṃtaṃ prayayuḥ svasvamāśrayam || 4.2.64.120 || śaṃbhorvākyaṃ viniścitya sarvajñasya kṛpānidheḥ || tyaktvā kāryāṃtaraṃ viprā liṃgānyeva samarciṣuḥ || 121 || || skaṃda uvāca || || paṭhitvā pāṭhayitvā ca rahasyākhyānamuttamam || śraddhāluḥ pātakairmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 122 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārddhe kṣetrarahasyakathanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||
<4.2.65>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || jyeṣṭheśvarasya parito yāni liṃgāni kuṃbhaja|| tāni paṃcasahasrāṇi munīnāṃ siddhidānyalam || 1 || parāśareśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ jyeṣṭheśāduttare mahat|| tasya darśanamātreṇa nirmalaṃ jñānamāpyate || 2 || tatraiva siddhidaṃ liṃgaṃ māṃḍavyeśvarasaṃjñitam || na tasya darśanājjātu durbuddhiṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 3 || liṃgaṃ ca śaṃkareśākhyaṃ tatraiva śubhadaṃ sadā || bhṛgunārāyaṇastatra bhaktānāṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 4 || jābālīśvara saṃjñaṃ ca liṃgaṃ tatrātisiddhidam || tasya saṃdarśanājjātu na jaṃturdurgatiṃ vrajet || 5 || sumaṃtu muninā śreṣṭhastatrādityaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || tasya saṃdarśanādeva kuṣṭhavyādhiḥ praśāmyati || 6 || bhairevī bhīṣaṇā nāma tatra bhīṣaṇarūpiṇī || kṣetrasya bhīṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayedbhāvatorcitā || 7 || tatropajaṃghane liṃgaṃ karmabaṃdhavimokṣaṇam || nṛbhiḥ saṃsevitaṃ bhaktyā ṣaṇmāsātsiddhidaṃ param||8|| bhāradvājeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ liṃgaṃ mādrīśvaraṃ varam || ekatra saṃsthite dve tu draṣṭavye sukṛtātmanā ||9|| aruṇi sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ tatraiva kalaśodbhava || tasya liṃgasya sevātaḥ sarvāmṛddhimavāpnuyāt||4.2.65.10|| liṃgaṃ vājasaneyākhyaṃ tatrāstyatimanohṛram || tasya saṃdarśanātpuṃsāṃ vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet||11|| kaṇveśvaraṃ śubhaṃ liṃgaṃ liṃgaṃ kātyāyaneśvaram || vāmadeveśvaraṃ liṃgamautathyeśvarameva ca || 12 || hārīteśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca liṃgaṃ vai gālaveśvaram || kuṃbherliṃgaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tathā vai kausumeśvaram || 13 || agnivarṇeśvaraṃ caiva naidhruveśvarameva ca || vatseśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ parṇādeśvarameva ca || 14 || saktuprastheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kaṇādeśaṃ tathaiva ca || anyattatra mahāliṃgaṃ māṃḍūkāya nirūpitam || 15 || vābhraveyeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ śilāvṛttīśvaraṃ tathā || cyavaneśvara liṃgaṃ ca śālaṃkāyanakeśvaram || 16 || kaliṃdameśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ liṃgamakrodhaneśvaram || liṃgaṃ kapotavṛttīśaṃ kaṃkeśaṃ kuṃtaleśvarama || 17 || kaṃṭheśvaraṃ kaholeśaṃ liṃgaṃ tuṃburupūjitam || matageśaṃ marutteśaṃ magadheyeśvaraṃ tathā || 18 || jātūkarṇeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ jaṃbūkeśvarameva ca || jārudhīśaṃ jaleśaṃ ca jālmeśaṃ jālakeśvaram || 19 || evamādīni liṃgāni ayutārdhāni kuṃbhaja || smaraṇāddarśanātsparśādarcanānnamanātstuteḥ || 4.2.65.20 || na jātu jāyate jaṃtoḥ kaluṣasya samudbhavaḥ || eteṣāṃ śubhaliṃgānāṃ jyeṣṭhasthāneti pāvane || 21 || || skaṃda uvāca || || ekadā tatra yadvṛttaṃ jyeṣṭhasthāne mahāmune || tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāghavināśanam || 22 || svairaṃ viharatastatra jyeṣṭhasthāne maheśituḥ || kautukenaiva cikrīḍa śivā kaṃdukalīlayā || 23 || udaṃca nnyaṃcadaṃgānāṃ lāghavaṃ paritanvatī || niḥśvāsāmodamudita bhramarākulitekṣaṇā || 24 || bhraśyaddha mmillasanmālya sthapuṭīkṛta bhūmikā || svidyatkapolapatrālī sravadaṃbukaṇojjvalā || 25 || sphuṭaccolāṃśukapathaniryadaṃgaprabhāvṛtā || ullasatkaṃdukāsphālātiśoṇitakarāṃbujā || 26 || kaṃdukānuga sadṛṣṭi nartita bhrūcalatāṃcalā || mṛḍānī kila khelaṃtī dadṛśe jagadaṃbikā || 27 || aṃtarikṣacarābhyāṃ ca ditijābhyāṃ manoharā || kaṭākṣitābhyāmiva vai samupasthitamṛtyunā || 28 || vidalotpala saṃjñābhyāṃ dṛptābhyāṃ varato vidheḥ || tṛṇīkṛtatrijagatī puruṣābhyāṃ svadorbalāt || 29 || devīṃ parijihīrṣū tau viṣameṣu prapīḍitau || divovateratuḥ kṣipraṃ māyāṃ svīkṛtya śāṃbarīm || 4.2.65.30 || dhṛtvā pāraṣadīṃ mūrtimāyātāvaṃbikāṃtikam || tāvatyaṃtaṃ sudurvṛttāvaticaṃcalamānasā || 31 || sarvajñena parijñātau cāṃcalyāllocanodbhavāt || kaṭākṣitātha devena durgādurgārighātinī || 32||| vijñāya netrasaṃjñāṃ tu sarvajñārdha śarīriṇī || tenaiva kaṃdukenātha yugapannijaghāna tau || 33|| mahābalau mahādevyā kaṃdukena samāhatau|| paribhramya paribhramya tau duṣṭau vinipetatuḥ || 34 || vṛṃtādiva phale pakve tālādanilalolite || daṃbholinā parihate śṛṃgeiva mahāgireḥ || 35 || tau nipātya mahādaityāvakāryakaraṇodyatau || tataḥ pariṇatiṃ yāto liṃgarūpeṇa kaṃdukaḥ ||36|| kaṃdukeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca talliṃgamabhavattadā || jyeṣṭheśvara samīpe tu sarvaduṣṭanivāraṇam ||37|| kaṃdukeśa samutpattiṃ yaḥ śroṣyati mudānvitaḥ || pūjayiṣyati yo bhaktastasya duḥkhabhayaṃ kutaḥ || 38 || kaṃdukeśvara bhaktānāṃ mānavānāṃ nirenasām || yogakṣemaṃ sadā kuryādbhavānī bhayanāśinī || 39 || mṛḍānī tasya liṃgasya pūjāṃ kuryātsadaiva hi || tatraiva devyā sānnidhyaṃ pārvatyā bhaktasiddhidam || 4.2.65.40 || kaṃdukeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ kāśyāṃ yairna samarcitam || kathaṃ teṣāṃ bhavanīśau syātāṃ sarvepsitapradau || 41 || draṣṭavyaṃ ca prayatnena talliṃgaṃ kaṃdukeśvaram || sarvopasargasaṃghātavighātakaraṇaṃ param || 42 || kaṃdukeśvara nāmāpi śrutvā vṛjinasaṃtatiḥ || kṣipraṃ kṣayamavāpnoti tamaḥ prāpyoṣṇaguṃ yathā || 43 || || skaṃda uvāca || || saṃśṛṇuṣva mahābhāga jyeṣṭheśvara samīpataḥ || yadvṛttāṃtamabhūdvipra paramāścaryakṛddhruvam || 44 || daṃḍakhāte mahātīrthe devarṣipitṛtṛptide || tapyamāneṣu vipreṣu niṣkāmaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 45 || daityo duṃdubhinirhrādo duṣṭaḥ prahlādamātulaḥ || devāḥ kathaṃ sujeyāḥ syurityupāyamaciṃtayat || 46 || kiṃ balāśca kimāhārāḥ kimādhārā hi devatāḥ || vicārya bahuśo daityastattvaṃ vijñāya niścitam || 47 || avaśyamagrajanmāno hetavotra vicārataḥ || brāhmaṇānhaṃtumasakṛtkṛtavānudyamaṃ tataḥ || 48 || yataḥ kratubhujo devāḥ kratavo vedasaṃbhavāḥ || te vedā brāhmaṇādhīnāstato devabalaṃ dvijāḥ || 49 || niścitaṃ brāhmaṇādhārāḥ sarve vedāḥ savāsavāḥ || gīrvāṇā brāhmaṇabalā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 4.2.65.50 || brāhmaṇā yadi naṣṭāḥ syurvedā naṣṭāstataḥ svayam || āmnāyeṣu praṇaṣṭeṣu vinaṣṭāḥ śatataṃtavaḥ || 51 || yajñeṣu nāśaṃ gacchatsu hṛtāhārāstataḥ surāḥ || nirbalāḥ sukhajeyāḥ syurjiteṣu tridaśeṣvatha || 52 || ahameva bhaviṣyāmi mānyastrijagatīpatiḥ || āhariṣyāmi devānāmakṣayāḥ sarvasaṃpadaḥ || 53 || nirvekṣyāmi sukhānyeva rājye nihatakaṃṭake || iti niścitya durbuddhiḥ punaściṃtitavānmune || 54 || dvijāḥ kva saṃti bhūyāṃso brahmatejotibṛṃhitāḥ || śrutyadhyayana saṃpannāstapobala samanvitāḥ || 55 || bhūyasāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu sthānaṃ vārāṇasī bhavet || tānādāvupasaṃhṛtya yāmi tīrthāṃtaraṃ tataḥ || 56 || yatrayatra hi tīrtheṣu yatrayatrāśrameṣu ca || saṃti sarve'grajanmānaste mayādyāḥ samaṃtataḥ || 57 || iti duṃdubhinirhrādo matiṃ kṛtvā kulocitām || prāpyāpi kāśīṃ durvṛtto māyāvī nyavadhīddvijān || 58 || samitkuśānsamādātuṃ yatra yāṃti ddhijottamāḥ || araṇye tatra tānsarvānsa bhakṣayati durmatiḥ || 9|| yathā kopi na vettyeva tathācchanno'bhavatpunaḥ || vane vanecaro bhūtvā yādorūpī jalāśaye || 4.2.65.60 || adṛśyarūpī māyāvī devānāmapyagocaraḥ || divādhyānaparastiṣṭhenmunivanmunimadhyagaḥ || 61 || praveśamuṭajānāṃ ca nirgamaṃ ca vilokayan || yāminyāṃ vyāghrarūpeṇa brāhmaṇānbhakṣayedbahūn || 62 || niḥśabdameva nayati natyajedapi kīkasam || itthaṃ nipātitā viprāstena duṣṭena bhūriśaḥ || 63 || ekadā śivarātrau tu bhaktastveko nijoṭaje || saparyāṃ devadevasya kṛtvā dhyānasthitobhavat || 64 || sa ca duṃdubhinirhrāda daityeṃdro baladarpitaḥ || vyāghra rūpaṃ samāsthāya tamādātuṃ matiṃ dadhe ||65|| taṃ bhaktaṃ dhyānamāpannaṃ dṛḍhacittaṃ śivekṣaṇe|| kṛtāstramaṃtravinyāsaṃ taṃ krāṃtumaśakanna saḥ || 66 || atha sarvagataḥ śaṃbhurjñātvā tasyāśayaṃ haraḥ || daityasya duṣṭarūpasya vadhāya vidadhe dhiyam || 67 || yāvadāditsati vyāghrastāvadāvirabhūddharaḥ || jagadrakṣāmaṇistryakṣo bhaktarakṣaṇa dakṣadhīḥ || 68 || rudramāyāṃtamālokya tadbhaktārcita liṃgataḥ || daityastenaiva rūpeṇa vavṛdhe bhūdharopamaḥ || 69 || sāvajñamathasarvajñaṃ yāvatpaśyati dānavaḥ || tāvadāyāṃtamādāya kakṣāyaṃtre nyapīḍayat || 4.2.65.70 || paṃcāsyastvatha paṃcāsyaṃ muṣṭyā mūrdhanyatāḍayat || sa ca tenaiva rūpeṇa kakṣāniṣpeṣaṇena ca ||71 || atyārtamaraṭadvyāghro rodasī paripūrayan || tena nādena sahasā saṃ pravepitamānasāḥ ||72|| tapodhanāḥ samājagmurniśi śabdānusārataḥ || tatreśvaraṃ samālokya kakṣīkṛta mṛgeśvaram||73|| tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatā sarve śarvaṃ jayajayākṣaraiḥ || paritrātā jagattrātaḥ pratyūhāddāruṇāditaḥ ||74 || anugrahaṃ kurudhveśa tiṣṭhātraiva jagadguro || anenaiva hi rūpeṇa vyāghreśa iti nāmataḥ || 75 || kuru rakṣāṃ mahādeva jyeṣṭhasthānasya sarvadā || anyebhyopyupasargebhyo rakṣa nastīrthavāsinaḥ || 76 || iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ devaścaṃdravibhūṣaṇaḥ || tathetyuktvā punaḥ prāha śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 77 || yo māmanena rūpeṇa drakṣyati śraddhayātra vai || tasyopasargasaṃghātaṃ ghātayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 78 || etalliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya yo yāti pathi mānavaḥ || cauravyāghrādisaṃbhūta bhayaṃ tasya kuto bhavet || 79 || maccaritramidaṃ śrutvā smṛtvā liṃgamidaṃ hṛdi || saṃgrāme praviśanmartyo jayamāpnoti nānyathā ||4.2.65.80|| ityuktvā devadevaśastasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yayau || savismayāstato viprāḥ prātaryātā yathāgatam || 81 || || skanda uvāca || || tadā prabhṛti kuṃbhottha liṃgaṃ vyāghreśvarābhidham || jyeṣṭheśāduttarebhāge dṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ bhayāpaham || 82 || vyāghreśvarasya ye bhaktāstebhyo bibhyati kiṃkarāḥ || yāmā api mahākrūrā jayajīveti vādinaḥ|| 83 || parāśareśvarādīnāṃ liṃgānāmiha saṃbhavam || śrutvā naro na lipyeta mahāpātakakardamaiḥ|| 84 || kaṃdukeśa samutpattiṃ vyāghre śāvirbhavaṃ tathā|| samākarṇya naro jātu nopasargaiḥ pradūyate || 85 || uṭajeśvara liṃgaṃ tu vyāghreśātpaścime sthitam || bhaktarakṣārthamudbhūtaṃ syātsamabhyarcya nirbhayaḥ || 86 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṇḍe uttarārdhe parāśareśvarādiliṃgasaṃbhavonāma paṃcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||
<4.2.66>
|| skanda uvāca || || jyeṣṭheśvarasya parito liṃgānyanyāni yāni tu || tāni te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu vātāpitāpana || 1 || jyeṣṭheśāddakṣiṇe bhāge liṃgamapsarasāṃ śubham || tatraivāpsarasaḥ kūpaḥ saubhāgyodakasaṃjñakaḥ || 2 || tatkūpajalasusnāto vilokyāpsaraseśvaram || na daurbhāgyamavāpnoti nārī vā puruṣothavā || 3 || tatraiva kukkuṭeśākhyaṃ liṃgaṃ vāpīsamīpagam|| tasya pūjanataḥ puṃsāṃ kuṭuṃbaṃ parivardhate || 4 || pitāmaheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ jyeṣṭhavāpītaṭe śubham || tatra śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā pitṝṇāṃ mudamarpayet|| 5 || pitāmaheśānnairṛtyāṃ pūjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || gadādhareśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ pitṝṇāṃ paritṛptidam || 6 || diśi puṇyajanākhyāyāṃ liṃgājjyeṣṭheśvarānmune|| vāsukīśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca liṃgamarcyaṃ samaṃtataḥ|| 7 || tatra vāsukikuṃḍe ca snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || sarpabhītiharāḥ puṃsāṃ vāsukīśaprabhāvataḥ|| 8 || yaḥ snāto nāgapaṃcamyāṃ kuṃḍe vāsukisaṃjñite || na tasya viṣasaṃsargo bhavetsarpasamudbhavaḥ|| 9|| kartavyā nāgapañcamyāṃ yātrā varṣāsu tatra vai|| nāgāḥ prasannā jāyaṃte kule tasyāpi sarvadā|| 4.2.66.10|| tatkuṇḍātpaścime bhāge liṃgaṃ vai takṣakeśvaram|| pūjanīyaṃ prayatnena bhaktānāṃ sarvasiddhidam || 11|| munestasyottare bhāge kuṇḍaṃ takṣakasaṃjñitam || kṛtodakakriyastatra na sarpairabhibhūyate|| 12|| tatkuṇḍāduttare bhāge kṣetraṃ kṣemakaraḥ sadā|| bhaktānāṃ sādhvasadhvaṃsī kapālī nāma bhairavaḥ|| 13|| bhairavasya mahākṣetraṃ tadvai sādhakasiddhidam|| tatra saṃsādhitā vidyāḥ ṣaṇmāsātatsiddhimāpnuyuḥ|| 14|| tatra caṇḍī mahāmuṇḍā bhaktavighnopaśāṃtidā| balipūjopahārādyaiḥ pūjyā svābhīṣṭasiddhaye||15|| tasyā yātrāṃ tu yaḥ kuryānmahāṣṭamyāṃ narottamaḥ || yaśasvī putrapautrāḍhyo lakṣmīvām̐ścāpi jāyate || 16 || mahāmuṇḍā pratīcyāṃ tu catuḥsāgaravāpikā || tasyāṃ snāto bhavetsnātaḥ sāgareṣu caturṣvapi || 17 || mahāprasiddhaṃ tatsthānaṃ catuḥsāgarasaṃjñitam|| catvāri tatra liṃgāni sāgaraiḥ sthāpitāni ca || 18 || tasyā vāpyāścaturdikṣu pūjitāni dahaṃtyagham || taduttare mahāliṃgaṃ vṛṣabheśvarasaṃjñitam || 19 || harasya vṛṣabheṇaiva sthāpitaṃ tatsvabhaktitaḥ || tasya darśanataḥ puṃsāṃ ṣaṇmāsānmuktirudbhavet || 4.2.66.20 || vṛṣeśvarādudīcyāṃ tu gaṃdharveśvarasaṃjñitam || gaṃdharvakuṇḍaṃ tatprācyāṃ tatra snātvā narottamaḥ || 21 || gaṃdharveśvaramabhyarcya dattvā dānāni śaktitaḥ || santarpya pitṝdevāṃśca gaṃdharvaiḥ saha modate || 22 || karkoṭanāmā nāgosti gandharveśvarapūrvataḥ || tatra karkoṭavāpī ca liṃgaṃ karkoṭakeśvaram || 23 || tasyāṃ vāpyāṃ naraḥ snātvā karkoṭeśaṃ samarcya ca || karkoṭanāgamārādhya nāgaloke mahīyate || 24 || karkoṭa nāgo yairdṛṣṭastadvāpyāṃ vihitodakaiḥ || kramate na viṣaṃ teṣāṃ dehe sthāvarajaṃgamam || 25 || karkoṭeśātpratīcyāṃ tu dhuṃdhumārīśvarābhidham || talliṃgābhyarcanātpuṃsāṃ na bhavedvairijaṃ bhayam || 26 || purūraveśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tadudīcyāṃ vyavasthitam || draṣṭavyaṃ tatprayatnena caturvargaphalapradam || 27 || diggajenārcitaṃ liṃgaṃ supratīkena tatpuraḥ || supratīkeśvaraṃ nāmnā yaśobalavivardhanam || 28 || saraśca supratīkākhyaṃ tatpuro bhāsate mahat || tatra snātvā ca talliṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā dikpatitāṃ labhet || 29 || tatrāstyekā mahāgaurī nāmnā vijayabhairavī || rakṣārthamuttarādvāri sthitā pūjyeṣṭasiddhaye || 4.2.66.30 || varaṇāyāstaṭe ramye gaṇau huṃḍanamuṃḍanau || kṣetrarakṣāṃ vidhattastau vighnastaṃbhana kārakau || 31 || tau draṣṭavyau prayatnena kṣetranirvighna hetave || huṃḍaneśaṃ muṃḍaneśaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā sukhī bhavet || 32 || skaṃda uvāca || || ilvalāre kathāmekāṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhava || varaṇāyāstaṭe ramye yadvṛtta pūrvamuttamam || 33 || ekadādrīṃdramālokya menā saṃhṛṣṭamānasam || umāṃ saṃsmṛtya niḥśvasya provāceti pativratā || 34 || || menovāca || || āryaputra na jānāmi pravṛttimapi kāṃcana || vivāhasamayādūrdhvaṃ tasyā gauryā girīśvara || 35 || sa vṛṣeṃdragatirdevo bhasmoraga vibhūṣaṇaḥ || mahāpitṛvanāvāso digvāsāḥ kvāsti saṃprati || 36 || aṣṭau yā mātaro dṛṣṭā brāhmī prabhṛtayaḥ priya || svasvarūpāstā manye'haṃ bālikāḥ kaṣṭahetavaḥ || 37 || tasyaikasya na kopyanyostyadvitīyasya śūlinaḥ || tadudaṃtapravṛttyai ca kriyatāmudyamo vibho || 38 || tasyāḥ priyāyā vākyena tadapatyapriyo giriḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ sāsramumā vātsalyasannagīḥ ||39|| || girirāja uvāca || || ahameva gamiṣyāmi tasyā mene gaveṣaṇe || nitarāṃ bādhate prema tadadṛṣṭyagnidūṣitam ||4.2.66.40|| yadā prabhṛti sā gaurī nirgatā mama sadmataḥ || manye mene tadārabhya padmasadmā viniryayau || 41|| tadālāpāmṛtadhayau na me śabdagrahau priye || prāṇeśvari tadārabhya syātāṃ śabdāṃtaragrahau || 42 || jaivātṛkī yatohnaḥ syāddūrībhūtā dṛśormama || aho jaivātṛkī jyotsnā tatohnoti dunoti mām || 43 || ityuktvādāya ratnāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || dharādhareṃdro niryātaḥ śubhalagnabalodaye || 44 || agastya uvāca || || kāni kāni ca ratnāni kiyaṃtyapi ca ṣaṇmukha || yānyādāya pratasthe sa tāni me brūhi pṛcchataḥ || 45 || || skaṃda uvāca || tulā muktāphalānāṃ tu koṭidvaya parīmitāḥ || tathā vāritarāṇāṃ ca hīrakāṇāṃ tulā śatam || 46 || navalakṣādhikaṃ vipra ṣaḍasrāṇāṃ sutejasām || lakṣadvayaṃ vidūrāṇāṃ tulāvimalavarcasāma || 47 || koṭayaḥ padmarāgāṇāṃ paṃcāvaihi tulā mune || puṣparāga tulālakṣaṃ guṇitaṃ navasaṃkhyayā || 48 || tathā gomeda ratnānāṃ tulālakṣamitā munai || iṃdranīlamaṇīnāṃ ca tulāḥ koṭyardha saṃmitāḥ || 49 || garuḍodgāraratnānāṃ tulāḥ prayutasaṃmitāḥ || śuddhavidrumaratnānāṃ tulāśca navakoṭayaḥ || 4.2.66.50 || aṣṭāṃgābharaṇānāṃ ca saṃkhyā kartuṃ na śakyate || vāsasāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ komalānāṃ tathā mune || 51 || cāmarāṇi ca bhūyāṃsi dravyāṇyāmodavaṃti ca || suvarṇadāsadāsyādīnyasaṃkhyātāni vai mune || 52 || sarvāṇyapi samādāya pratasthe bhūdhareśvaraḥ || āgatya varaṇātīraṃ dūrātkāśīmalokayat || 53 || anekaratnanicayaiḥ khacitā'khilabhūmikām || nānāprāsādamāṇikyajyotistatatatāṃbarām || 54 || saudhāgravividhasvarṇakalaśojvaladiṅmukhām || jayaṃtīvaijayaṃtīnāṃ nikaraistridivasthalīm || 55 || mahāsiddhyaṣṭakasyāpi krīḍābhavanamadbhutam || jitakalpadumavanāṃ vanaiḥ sarvaphalāvanaiḥ || 56 || iti kāśīsamṛddhiṃ sa vilokyābhūdvilajjitaḥ || uvāca ca manasyeva bhūdhareṃdra idaṃ vacaḥ || 57 || prāsādeṣu pratolīṣu prākāreṣu gṛheṣu ca || gopureṣu vicitreṣu kapāṭeṣu taṭeṣvapi || 58 || maṇimāṇikyaratnānāmucchalaccārurociṣām || jyotirjālairjaṭilitaṃ yayedamavalokyate || 59 || dyāvābhūmyoraṃtarālaṃ tatheti samavaimyaham || īdṛksaṃpattisaṃbhāraḥ kuverasyāpi no gṛhe || 4.2.66.60 || api vaikuṃṭhabhuvane netarasyeha kā kathā || iti yāvadgirīṃdrosau saṃbhāvayati cetasi || 61 || tāvatkārpaṭikaḥ kaścittallocanapathaṃ gataḥ || āhūya bahumānaṃ tamapṛcchaccācaleśvaraḥ || 62 || || himavānuvāca || || haṃho kārpaṭika śreṣṭha adhyāsvaitadihāsanam || svapurodaṃtamākhyāhi kimapūrvamihādhvaga || 63 || kotra saṃpratyadhiṣṭhātā kimadhiṣṭhātṛ ceṣṭitam || yadi jānāsi tatsarvamihācakṣva mamāgrataḥ || 64 || sopi kārpaṭikastasya girirājasya bhāṣitam || samākarṇya samācaṣṭuṃ mune samupacakrame || 65 || || kārpaṭika uvāca || || ācakṣe śṛṇu rājeṃdra yatpṛṣṭosmi tvayākhilam || ahāni paṃcaṣāṇyeva vyatikrāṃtāni mānada||66|| samāyāte jagannāthe parvateṃdra sutāpatau || suṃdarānmaṃdarādadrerdivodāse gate divi ||67|| yo vai jagadadhiṣṭhātā sodhiṣṭhātātra sarvagaḥ || sarvadṛksarvadaḥ śarvaḥ kathaṃ na jñāyate vibho ||68|| manye dṛṣatsvarūposi dṛṣadopi kaṭhoradhīḥ || yato viśveśvaraṃ kāśyāṃ na vetsi girijāpatim ||69|| svabhāvakaṭhinātmāpi sa varaṃ himavāngiriḥ || prāṇādhika sutā dānādyo dhinodviśvanāyakam || 4.2.66.70 || bibhratsahaja kāṭhinyaṃ jāto gaurīgururguruḥ || śaṃbhuṃ prapūjya sutayā srajā viśvagurorapi || 71 || ceṣṭitaṃ tasya ko veda vedavedyasya ceśituḥ || manāgiti ca jānehaṃ tacceṣṭitamidaṃ jagat ||72|| adhiṣṭhātā mayā khyātastathādhiṣṭhātṛ ceṣṭitam || apūrvaṃ yattvayāpṛṣṭaṃ tadākhyāmi ca tacchṛṇu || 73 || śubhe jyeṣṭheśvarasthāne sāṃprataṃ sa umāpatiḥ || kāśīṃ prāpya mudā tiṣṭhedgirirājāṃgajā sakhaḥ || 74 || || skaṃda uvāca || || yadā yadā sa girijā mṛdunāmākṣarāmṛtam || āviṣkaroti pathiko'drīṃdro hṛṣyettadātadā || 75 || umānāmāmṛtaṃ pītaṃ yeneha jagatītale || na jātu jananīstanyaṃ sa pibetkuṃbhasaṃbhava || 76 || umetidvyakṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ yo'harniśamanusmaret || na smareccitraguptastaṃ kṛtapāpamapi dvija || 77 || punaḥ śuśrāva himavānhṛṣṭaḥ kārpaṭikoditam || || kārpaṭika uvāca || || rājanviśveśvarārtheyaḥ prāsādo viśvakarmaṇā || 78 || nirmīyate sunirmāṇo janmi nirvāṇadāyinaḥ || tadapūrvaṃ na karṇābhyāmapyākarṇitavānaham || 79 || yatrātimitratejobhiḥ śalākābhiḥ samaṃtataḥ || maṇimāṇikyaratnānāṃ prāsādebhittayaḥ kṛtāḥ ||4.2.66.80 || yatra saṃti śataṃ staṃbhā bhāsvaṃto dvādaśottarāḥ || ekaikaṃ bhuvanaṃ dhartumaṣṭāṣṭāviti kalpitāḥ || 81 || caturdaśasu yā śobhā viṣṭapeṣu samaṃtataḥ || tasminvimāne sāstīha śatakoṭiguṇottarā || 82 || caṃdrakāṃtamaṇīnāṃ ca staṃbhādhāra śilāśca yāḥ || citraratnamayaistaṃbhaiḥ staṃbhitāstatprabhābharāḥ || 83 || padmarāgeṃdranīlānāṃ śālīnāḥ śālabhaṃjikāḥ || nīrājayaṃtyahorātraṃ yatra rajapradīpakaiḥ || 84 || sphuratsphaṭikanirmāṇa ślakṣṇa padmaśilātale || anekaratnarūpāṇi vicitrāṇi samaṃtataḥ ||85|| āraktapītamaṃjiṣṭha nīlakirmīravarṇakaiḥ || vinyastānīva bhāsaṃte citre citrakṛtāyataḥ || 86 || dṛkpicchilā vilokyaṃte māṇikyastaṃbharājayaḥ || yato'vimukte svakṣetre mokṣalakṣmyaṃkurā iva || 87 || ratnākarebhyaḥ sarvebhyo gaṇā ratnoccayānbahūn || rāśīṃścakruḥ samānīya yatrādriśikharopamān || 88 || yatra pātālatalato nāgānāṃ kośaveśmataḥ|| gaṇairmaṇigaṇāḥ sarve samāhṛtya girīkṛtāḥ || 89 || śivabhaktaḥ svayaṃ yatra paulastyaḥ svadrikūṭataḥ || koṭihāṭakakūṭāni ānayāmāsa rākṣasaiḥ || 4.2.66.90 || prāsādanirmitiṃ śrutvā bhaktā dvīpāṃtarasthitāḥ || māṇikyāni samājahruryathāsaṃkhyānyaho nṛpa || 91 || ciṃtāmaṇiḥ svayaṃ yatra kamarṇe viśvakarmaṇe || viśrāṇayedahorātraṃ vicitrāṃściṃ titānmaṇīn|| 92 || nānāvarṇapatākāśca yatra kalpamahīruhaḥ || analpāḥ kalpayaṃtyeva nityabhaktisamanvitāḥ || 93 || abdhayo yatra satataṃ dadhikṣīrekṣusarpiṣām || paṃcāmṛtānāṃ kalaśaiḥ snapayaṃti dinedine || 94 || yatra kāmadughā nityaṃ snapayenmadhudhārayā || svadugdhayā svayaṃ bhaktyā viśveśaṃ liṃgarūpiṇam || 95 || gaṃdhasārarasairyaṃ ca sevate malayācalaḥ || karpūraraṃbhā karpūrapūrairbhaktyā niṣevate || 96 || ityādya pūrvaṃ yatrāsti pratyahaṃ śaṃkarālaye || kathaṃ taṃ tvamumākātaṃ na vetsi kaṭhināśaya || 97 || iti tasya samṛddhiṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jāmāturadrirāṭa || trapayā paribhūtobhūnnitarāṃ kuṃbhasaṃbhava || 98 || tasmai kārpaṭikāyātha sa dattvā pāritoṣikam || punaściṃtāparojāto'drirāṭkārpaṭike gate || 99 || uvāceti manasyeva vismayotphullalocanaḥ || aho bhadramidaṃ jātaṃ yattvayā śrāvi śarmabhāk || 4.2.66.100 || yāvatsaṃpattisaṃbhāraḥ śrūyate dṛśyatetra vai || jāmāturatra sadane līlā trijagatīpateḥ || 101 || tataḥ prābhṛtakastuccho nitarāṃ pratibhāti me || kanyārthaṃ yo mayā nīto jāmātuḥ paritoṣakṛt || 102 || ahaṃ manye tathaivāsau yathādarśi mayā purā || vṛddhokṣamātrasaṃpattiḥ sarvakarmaparāṅmukhaḥ || 103 || nainaṃ kopi vijānīyānnānvayosya kadā'cana || nāmāpi yasya naikaṃ ca kiṃdeśīyaśca nohyate || 104 || kiṃvṛttaśca kimācāro nāmamātreṇa ceśvaraḥ || aiśvaryasūcakaṃ vastu yasya kiṃcinna lakṣyate || 105 || sosau nirvāṇasaṃpattiṃ raṃkāyāpi dadātyaho || sumukhaḥ sarvakarmāṇi phalavaṃti karoti saḥ || 106 || vedavedyo hi sarvajño yatsaṃtāno'khilaṃ jagat || yaṃ na kopi hi vedādau vedavedyaḥ sa eṣa vai ||107 || yonabhijñaḥ sadājñātaḥ sa sarvajñoyameva hi || yasyaikamapi no nāma puṃsā jñeyaṃ na kenacit ||108|| sarveṣāṃ sarvanāmāni yasya nāmāni niścitam || sosau hi sarvadeśīyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ ||109|| yasya deśo na vidito yastu vṛttiparāṅmukhaḥ|| ācārahīnamiva yaṃ purā'paśyaṃ kaṭhoradhīḥ || 4.2.66.110 || śrutismṛtī yataḥ sarvamācāraṃ vitta eva hi || nāmamātreṇa niyataṃ yamajñāsiṣamīśvaram || 111 || sākṣādīśvara evaiṣa sonyeṣvaiśvaryasūcakaḥ || api sarvaguṇādhāro guṇātītaḥ parāparaḥ || 112 || arvācīna ihāpyeṣa parācīnaḥ parātparaḥ || bhūdharāṇāmahaṃ nātho viśvanātha umāpatiḥ ||113|| ahaṃ pramitasaṃpattiraprameya dhanohyasau || tucchaprābhṛta kastasmānnedānīmasya darśanam || 114 || kariṣyetha kariṣyāmi vyāvṛttyāgatya karhicit || saṃpradhāryeti manasi sāyaṃ sa ca girīśvaraḥ || 115 || āhūya sarvānanugānpārvatīyānmahābalān || ādiṣṭavānidaṃ vākyaṃ sarve yūyaṃ balādhikāḥ || 116 || kurvaṃtvekaṃ mamādeśaṃ yāvannodyati bhānumān || tāvacchivālayaṃ caikaṃ vidadhatvatra satvaram|| 117|| yasminkṛte kṛtārthaḥ syāmiha loke paratra ca || samāgatyeha kāśyāṃ yaḥ kuryādekaṃ śivālayam || 118 || tena trailokyamakhilaṃ sālayaṃ kṛtameva hi || tena dattāni dānāni mahāṃti vidhipūrvakam || 119 || suparvaṇi supātrāya sutātha śraddhayādhikam || yena svavittamānena dharmopārjita vittataḥ || 4.2.66.120 || kṛtaṃ śaṃbhormahāsadma na taṃ padmā tyajetkvacit || tapāṃsi tena taptāni śīrṇaparṇāśanānyapi || 121 || vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya yenākāri śivālayaḥ || aśeṣāḥ suviśeṣāḍhyā iṣṭāṃstena mahāmakhāḥ|| 122 || ānaṃdakānane yena devadevālayaḥ kṛtaḥ || iti tasya samādeśaṃ samākarṇyānugāstataḥ ||| 123 || cakrurdevālayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yāvadvyuṣṭā na yāminī || tāvacchaileśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ śaileśena pratiṣṭhitam || caṃdrakāṃtamaṇeścaṃcatkāṃtiścetitamaṃḍapam || 124 || alekhayatpraśastiṃ ca praśastākṣaramālinīm || vyācakṣāṇāṃ nijāṃ sarvaṃ gotrebhyopyadhikonnatim || 125 || tato'ruṇodaye jāte snātvā paṃcanade hrade || śailarājaḥ kālarājaṃ namaskṛtya samarcya ca || 126 || tatra rāśiṃ samutsṛjya paritastavarito yayau || pārvatīyairanugataḥ sarvairapi nijālayam || 127 || tataḥ prātaḥ samālokya gaṇau huṃḍanamuṃḍano || hṛṣṭau devālayaṃ ramyaṃ varaṇāyāstaṭe śubhe || 128 || adṛṣṭapūrvadevāya nivedayitumāgatau || tau tu dṛṣṭvā mahādevamumādarśitadarpaṇam || 129 || praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau kṛtāṃjalipuṭau gaṇau || kṛtābhyanujño bhrūkṣepādvijñaptimatha cakratuḥ || 4.2.66.130 || devadeva na jānīvaḥ kenaciddṛḍhabhaktinā || atīva ramyaḥ prāsādo nirmito varaṇātaṭe || 131 || āsāyaṃ naikṣicāvābhyāṃ dṛṣṭodyaiva prage vibho|| gaṇoditamitīśāno niśamyāha girīṃdrajām || 132 || vijñātasarvavṛttāṃtaḥ sarvajñopyanabhijñavat || acaleṃdrāgajeyāvastatprāsādavilokane ||133|| ityuktveśaḥ sagirijo niragātsagaṇo mune|| mahāsyaṃdanamāruhya prāsādaṃ draṣṭumutsukaḥ || 134 || athāluloke giriśaḥ prāsādaṃ varaṇātaṭe || atīva ramyaracanaṃ yāminīmātranirmitam||135 || syaṃdanādavaruhyātha garbhāgāramavīviśat || dadarśa ca mahāliṃgaṃ caṃdrakāṃtaśilāmayam || 136 || dedīpyamānaṃ mahasā mokṣalakṣmyaṃkurākṛti || dṛṣṭiprasādajananaṃ punarjananaśātanam || 137 || kenedaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ yāvajjijñāsatīśvaraḥ || tāvaddarśa purataḥ praśastiṃ kartṛsūcikām||138|| vācayitveva ca manāṅmanasyeva manojahṛt || uvāca devo diṣṭyeti prekṣasvātmapituḥ kṛtim || 139 || umā śrutyeti saṃhṛṣṭā kadaṃbakusumaśriyam || ānaṃdāṃkuralakṣmīvadaṃgeṣu paribibhratī || 4.2.66.140 || tato vyajijñapaddevaṃ devī pādau praṇamya ca || asmim̐lliṃgavare nātha tvayā stheyamaharniśam || 141 || asya liṃgasya ye bhaktā śaileśasya maheśituḥ || tebhyastvaṃ mahatīmṛddhiṃ dāsyasīha paratra ca || 142 || tatheti deva uktvā tāṃ pārvatīṃ punarabravīt || varaṇāyāṃ kṛtasnānaiḥ śaileśo yaiḥ samarcitaḥ || 143 || pitṝnsaṃtarpya ca mudā dattvā dānāni śaktitaḥ || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiratra saṃsāravartmani|| 144 || śailaiśvare mahāliṃge nityaṃ sthāsyāmyahaṃ śubhe || pradāsyāmi parāṃ muktimetalliṃgārcake jane|| 145|| śaileśvaraṃ ye drakṣyaṃti varaṇāyāḥ surodhasi || teṣāṃ kāśyāṃ nivasatāṃ duḥkhaṃ nābhibhaviṣyati || 146|| umayāpi varo dattastatra liṃge ghaṭodbhava || śaileśvarasya ye bhaktāste me putrā na saṃśayaḥ || 147 || || skaṃda uvāva | || iti śaileśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kathitaṃ te mahāmune || idānīṃ kathayiṣyāmi ratneśvarasamudbhavam || 148|| śrutvā śaileśa māhātmyaṃ śraddhayā parayā naraḥ || pāpakaṃcukamutsṛjya śivalokamavāpnuyāt || 149 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśākhaṃḍe uttarārdhe śaileśādi liṃganirṇayonāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||
<4.2.67>
|| agastya uvāca || || ratneśvarasamutpatiṃ kathayasva ṣaḍānana || ratnabhūtaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ yatkāśyāṃ parivarṇyate || 1 || kosya liṃgasya mahimā kenaitacca pratiṣṭhitam || etaṃ vistarato brūhi gaurīhṛdayanaṃdana || 2 || || skaṃda uvāca || ratneśvarasya māhātmyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi te mune|| yathā ca ratnaliṃgasya prādurbhāvo'bhavadbhuvi || 3 || śrutaṃ nāmāpi liṃgasya yasya janmatrayārjitam|| vṛjinaṃ nāśayettasya prādurbhāvaṃ bruve mune || 4|| śailarājena ratnāni yāni puṃjīkṛtānyaho|| uttare kālarājasya tāni tasya girervṛṣāt|| 5 || sarvaratnamayaṃ liṃgaṃ jātaṃ tatsukṛtātmanaḥ || śakracāpasamacchāyaṃ sarvaratnadyutiprabham || 6 || talliṃgadarśanādeva jñānaratnamavāpyate || śaileśvaraṃ samālokya śivau tatra samāgatau || 7|| yatra ratnamayaṃ liṃgamāvirbhūtaṃ svayaṃ mune || tasya sphuratprabhājālaistatamaṃbaramaṃḍalam || 8 || tatra dṛṣṭvā śubhaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvaratnasamudbhavam || bhavānyadṛṣṭapūrvā hi paripapraccha śaṃkaram || 9 || devadeva jagannātha sarvabhaktābhayaprada || kutastyametalliṃgaṃ dvisaptapātālamūlavat || 4.2.67.10 || jvālājaṭilitākāśaṃ prabhābhāsita diṅmukham || kimākhyaṃ kiṃ svarūpaṃ ca kiṃ prabhāvaṃ bhavāṃtaka || 11 || yasya saṃvīkṣaṇādeva manometīva hṛṣṭavat || ihaiva ramate nātha kathayaitatprasādataḥ || 12 || || devadeva uvāca || || śṛṇvaparṇe samākhyāmi yattvayā pṛcchi pārvati || svarūpametalliṃgasya sarvatejonidheḥ param || 13 || tava pitrā himavatā girirājena bhāmini || tvāmuddiśya mahāratnasaṃbhārotrāpyanāyi hi || 14 || atra tāni ca ratnāni rāśīkṛtya himādriṇā || sukṛtopārjitānyeva yayau svasadanaṃ punaḥ || 15 || tavārthaṃ vāmamārthaṃ vā śraddhayā yatsamarpyate || kāśyāṃ tasya parīpāko bhavedīdṛgvidho'naghe || 16 || liṃgaṃ ratneśvarākhyaṃ vai matsvarūpaṃ hi kevalam || asya prabhāvo hi mahānvārāṇasyāmume dhruvam || 17 || sarveṣāmiha liṃgānāṃ ratnabhūtamidaṃ param || ato ratneśvaraṃ nāma paraṃ nirvāṇaratnadam || 18 || anenaiva suvarṇena pitrā rāśīkṛtena ca || prāsādamasya liṃgasya vidhāpaya maheśvari ||19|| liṃgaprāsādakaraṇātkhaṃḍasphuṭita saṃskṛteḥ || liṃgasthāpanajaṃ puṇyaṃ helayaiveha labhyate || 4.2.67.20|| tatheti bhagavatyoktvā gaṇāḥ prāsādanirmitau || somanaṃdi prabhṛtayo 'saṃkhyā vyāpāritā mune || 21 || gaṇaiśca kāṃcanamayo nānākautukacitritaḥ || nirmame yāmamātreṇa prāsādo meruśṛṃgavat ||22|| devī pradṛṣṭavadanā dṛṣṭvā prāsādanirmitim || gaṇebhyo vyataradbhūri samānaṃ pāritoṣikam || 23 || punaśca devī papraccha praṇipātapuraḥsaram || mahimānaṃ mahādevaṃ liṃgasyāsya mahāmune ||24|| || devadeva uvāca || || liṃgaṃ tvanādisaṃsiddhametaddevi śubhapradam || āvirbhūtamidānīṃ ca tvatpituḥ puṇyagauravāt || 25 || guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ kṣetre'smiściṃtitapradam || kalau kaluṣabuddhīnāṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 26 || yathā ratnaṃ gṛhe guptaṃ na kaiścijjñāyate paraiḥ || avimukte tathā liṃgaṃ ratnabhūtaṃ gṛhe mama || 27 || yāni brahmāṃḍamadhyetra saṃti liṃgāni pārvati || tairarcitāni sarvāṇi ratneśo yaiḥ samarcitaḥ||28|| pramādenāpi yairgauri liṃgaṃ ratneśamarcitam || te bhavaṃtyeva niyataṃ saptadvīpeśvarā nṛpāḥ || 29 || trailokye yāni vastūni ratnabhūtāni tāni tu || ratneśvaraṃ samabhyarcya sakṛtprāpnoti mānavaḥ || 4.2.67.30 || pūjayiṣyaṃti ye liṃgaṃ ratneśaṃ kāmavarjitāḥ || te sarve madgaṇā bhūtvā prāṃte drakṣyaṃti māmiha || 31 || rudrāṇāṃ koṭijapyena yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam || tatphalaṃ labhyate devi ratneśasya samarcanāt || 32 || liṃge cānādisaṃsiddhe yadvṛttaṃ tadbravīmi te || itihāsaṃ mahāścaryaṃ sarvapāpanikṛṃtanam || 33 || pureha nartakī kācidāsīnnāṭyārthakovidā || saikadā phālgune māsi śivarātryāṃ kalāvatī ||34|| nanarta jāgaraṃ prāpya jagau gītaṃ ca peśalam || svayaṃ ca vādayāmāsa nānāvādyāni vādyavit ||35|| tena tauryatrikeṇāpi prīṇayitvātha sā naṭī|| ratneśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ deśamiṣṭaṃ jagāma ha || 36 || kāladharmavaśaṃyātā tatra sā varanartakī || sutā gaṃdharvarājasya vasubhūterbabhūva ha || 37 || saṃgītasya savādyasya tasya lāsyasyapuṇyataḥ || tatreśāgre kṛtasyeha jāgare śivarātrije || 38 || ramyā ratnāvalī nāma rūpalāvaṇyaśālinī || kalākalāpakuśalā madhurālāpavādinī || 39 || piturānaṃdakṛnnityaṃ vasubhūterghaṭodbhava || sarvagāṃdharvakuśalā guṇaratnamahākhaniḥ || 4.2.67.40 || mune sakhītrayaṃ tasyāścāru cāturyabhājanam || śaśilekhānaṃgalekhā citralekheti nāmataḥ || 41 || tisṛbhistābhirekatra vāgdevīpariśīlitā || tābhyaḥ sarvāḥ kalāḥ prādātpariprītā sarasvatī || 42 || prāpya ratnāvalī gauri sā janmāṃtaravāsanām || ratneśvarasya liṃgasya jagrāha niyamaṃ śubham || 43|| ratnabhūtasya liṃgasya kāśyāṃ ratneśvarasya vai || nityaṃ saṃdarśanaṃ prāpya vakṣyāmyapi vaco mukhe || 44 || itthaṃ niyamavatyāsītsā gaṃdharvasutottamā || tābhiḥ sakhībhiḥ sahitā nityaṃ liṃgaṃ ca paśyati || 45|| ekadārādhya ratneśaṃ mamaitalliṃgamuttamam || samānarca ca sā bālā ramyayā gītamālayā || 46 || sakhyaḥ pradakṣiṇīkartuṃ liṃgaṃ tisro'pyume gatāḥ || tasyā gītena tuṣṭohaṃ liṃgastho varadobhavam || 47 || yastvayā raṃsyate rātrāvadya gaṃdharvakanyake || tavanāmasamānākhyaḥ sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati || 48 || iti liṃgāṃbudherjātāṃ paripīya vacaḥsudhām || babhūvānaṃdasaṃdoha maṃtharātīva hrīmatī || 49 || gatātha vyomamārgeṇa sakhībhiḥ svapiturgṛham || kathayaṃtī nijodaṃtaṃ tamālīnāṃ puro mudā || 4.2.67.50 || tābhirdiṣṭyeti diṣṭyeti sakhībhiḥ parinaṃditā || adya te vāṃchitaṃ bhāvi ratneśasya samarcanāt || 51 || yadyāyāti sa te rātrāvadya kaumārahārakaḥ || coro bāhulatāpāśaiḥ pāśitavyotiyatnataḥ || 52 || gocarīkriyatesmābhiryathā sa sukṛtaikabhūḥ || prātareva tava preyānratneśādiṣṭa iṣṭakṛt ||53 || yātāsvasmāsu hṛṣṭāsu bhavatī śayagauravāt || aho ratneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtavatyasi || 54 || ahobhāgyodayo nṛṇāmaho puṇyasamucchrayaḥ || ekasyaiva bhavetsiddhiryadekatrāpi tiṣṭhatām || 55 || satyaṃ vadaṃti nāsatyaṃ daivaprādhānyavādinaḥ || daivameva phaledekaṃ nodyamo nāparaṃ balam || 56 || bhavatyā api cāsmākameka eva hi codyamaḥ || paraṃ daivaṃ phalatyekaṃ yathā tava na naḥ puraḥ || 57 || lokānāṃ vyavahāroyamāliproktaprasaṃgataḥ || paraṃ manorathāvāptistava yā saiva naḥ sphuṭam ||58|| iti saṃvyāharaṃtīnāmanaṃtodhvā'titucchavat || kṣaṇāttāsāṃ vyatikrāṃtaḥ prāptāśca svaṃsvamālayam || 59 || atha prātaḥ samutthāya punarekatra saṃgatāḥ || sā ca maunavatī tābhiḥ paribhukteva lakṣitā || || 4.2.67.60 || tūṣṇīṃ prāpyātha kāśīṃ sā snātvā maṃdākinījale || sakhībhiḥ sahitāpaśyalliṃgaṃ ratneśvaraṃ mama || 61 || nirvartya niyamaṃ sātha lajjāmukulitekṣaṇā || nirbaṃdhena vayasyābhiḥ paripṛṣṭā jagāda ha || 62 || || ratnāvalyuvāca || || atha ratneśa yātrāyāḥ prayātāsu svamaṃdiram || bhavatīṣu smaraṃtyeva tadratneśavaco'mṛtam|| 63 || saviśeṣāṃgasaṃskārā'viśaṃ saṃveśamaṃdiram || nidrādaridranayanā tadvilokanalālasā ||64|| balātsvapnadaśāṃ prāptā bhāvinorthasya gauravāt || ātmavismaraṇe hetū tato me dvau babhūvatuḥ || 65 || taṃdrī tadaṃgasaṃsparśau mama bodhāpahārakau || taṃdryā paravaśā cāsaṃ tatastatsparśanena ca || 66 || na jāne tvatha kiṃ vṛttaṃ kāhaṃ kvāhaṃ sa cātha kaḥ || taṃ nirjigamiṣuṃ sakhyo yāvaddhartuṃ prasāritaḥ ||67|| doḥ kaṃkaṇena ripuṇā kvaṇitaṃ tāvadutkaṭam || mahatā siṃjitenāhaṃ tenālpaparibodhitā || 68 || sukhasaṃtānapīyūṣa hrade parinimajya vai || kṣaṇena tadviyogāgnikīlāsu patitā balāt ||69|| kiṃkulīyaḥ sa no vedmi kiṃdeśīyaḥ kimākhyakaḥ || dunoti nitarāṃ sakhyastadviśleṣānalo mahān || 4.2.67.70 || analpotkalitaṃ cetaḥ punastatsaṃgamāśayā || prāṇānāṃ me yiyāsūnāmekameva mahauṣadham || 71 || vayasyā niśibhuktasya tasyaiva punarīkṣaṇam || bhavatīnāmadhīnaṃ ca tatpunardarśanaṃ mama ||72|| kā'līkamālayo vakti snigdhamugdhesakhījane || taddarśanena sthāsyaṃti prāṇā yāsyaṃti cānyathā || 73 || daśamyavasthā sannahyedbādhituṃ mādhunā bhṛśam || iti tasyā giraḥ śrutvā dūnāyā nitarāṃ ca tāḥ || 74 || pravepamānahṛdayāḥ procurvīkṣya parasparam || 75 || || sakhya ūcuḥ || || yasya grāmo na no nāma nānvayo nāpi budhyate || sa kathaṃ prāpyate bhadre ka upāyo vidhīyatām || 76 || iti ratnāvalī śrutvā sasaṃdehāṃ ca tadgiram || vayasyāstadavāptau me yūyaṃ kuṃṭhi mumūrcha ha || 77 || ityardhoktena sā bālā yūyaṃ kuṃṭhitaśaktayaḥ || yadvaktavyaṃ tviti tayā yūyaṃ kuṃṭhīti bhāṣitam || 78 || tatastāstvaritāḥ sakhyaḥ paritāpopahārakān || bahuśaḥ śītalopāyānvyadhurmohapraśāṃtaye || 79 || vyapaiti na yadā mūrchā tattacchītopacārataḥ || tasyāstadaikayānītaṃ ratneśasnapanodakam || 4.2.67.80 || tadukṣaṇātkṣaṇādeva tanmūrchā virarāma ha || suptotthiteva sāvādīnmuhuḥ śivaśiveti ca || 81 || || skadaṃ uvāca || śraddhāvatāṃ svabhaktānāmupasarge mahatyapi || nopāyāṃtaramastyeva vineśa caraṇodakam || 82|| ye vyādhayopi duḥsādhyā bahiraṃtaḥ śarīragāḥ || śraddhayeśodakasparśātte naśyaṃtyeva nānyathā || 83 || sevitaṃ yena satataṃ bhagavaccaraṇodakam|| taṃ bāhyābhyaṃtaraśuciṃ nopasarpati durgatiḥ || 84 || ādhibhautikatāpaṃ ca tāpaṃ vāpyādhidaivikam || ādhyātmikaṃ tathā tāpaṃ harecchrīcaraṇodakam || 85 || vyapetasaṃjvarā cātha gaṃdharvatanayā mune || ucitajñeti hovāca tāḥ sakhīḥ srigdhadho(dhī?)radhīḥ || 86 || || ratnāvalyuvāca || || śaśilekhenaṃgalekhe citralekhe madīhitaṃ || yūyaṃ kuṃṭhitasāmarthyāḥ kuto vastāḥ kalāḥ kva vā ||87|| matpriyaprāptaye samyagupāyo'sti mayekṣitaḥ || ratneśvarānugrahato'nutiṣṭhata hi taṃ hitāḥ || 88 || śaśilekhebhilaṣitaprāptyai lekhāṃstvamālikha || saṃlikhānaṃgalekhe tvaṃ yūnaḥ sarvāvanīcarān || 89 || citrage citralekhe tvaṃ pātālatalaśāyinaḥ || kiṃcidāvirbhavaccāru tāruṇyālaṃkṛtīm̐llikha || 4.2.67.90 || athākaṇyeti tāḥ sakhyastaccāturyaṃ pravarṇya ca || lilikhuḥ kramaśaḥ sakhyo yūno yauvana śevadhīn || 91 || niryatkaumāralakṣmīkānpuṃvattva śrīsamāvṛtān || prātaḥsaṃdhyeva gaṃdharvī nṛpādyāṃstānavaikṣata || 92 || sarvānsuranikāyānsā vyalokata śubhekṣaṇā || na cāṃcalyaṃ jahāvakṣṇosteṣu svarlokavāsiṣu || 93 || tato madhyamalokasthānmunirājakumārakān || vilokyāpi na sā prītiṃ kvāpyāpa premanirbharā || 94 || atha ratnāvalī bālā karṇābhyarṇavilocanā || dṛśau vyāpārayāmāsa balisadmayuvasvapi || 95 || ditijāndanujānvīkṣya sā gaṃdharvī kumārakān || ratiṃ babaṃdha na kvāpi tāpitā mānmathaiḥ śaraiḥ || 96 || sudhākara karaspṛṣṭāpyatidūnāṃgayaṣṭikā || paśyaṃtī nāgayūnaḥ sā kiṃciducchvasitā'bhavat || 97 || bhoginastānvilokyāpi citraṃcitragatānatha || manātsaṃbhuktabhogeva kṣaṇamāsītkumārikā || 98 || yūnaḥ pratyekamadrākṣīdaśeṣāñcheṣa vaṃśajān || takṣakānvayagāṃstadvadatha vāsukigotrajān || 99 || pulīkānaṃta karkoṭa bhadrasaṃtānagānapi || dṛṣṭvā nāgakumārāṃstāñchaṃkhacūḍamathaikṣata || 4.2.67.100 || śaṃkhacūḍekṣaṇādeva parāṃ lajjāṃ babhāra sā || udbhinnapulakāpyāsīdaṃgapratyaṃga saṃdhiṣu || 101 || tattrapābharato'jñāyi tatkaumāraharo varaḥ || tayā vaidagdhyavarayā kṣaṇataścitralekhayā || 102 || atha citrapaṭī citralekhā citrapaṭāṃcalam || parikṣipyāvṛṇottūrṇaṃ parihāsaikapeśalā || 103 || ratnāvalī citralekhāṃ hriyā maunāvalaṃbinī || dṛśā kuṭilayādrākṣītprasphuraddaśanāṃbarā || 104 || kaṭākṣitānaṃgalekhā tayātha śaśilekhayā || citralekhāparikṣipta paṭāṃcalamapākarot || 105 || vasubhūtisutā sātha kanyā ratnāvalī śubhā || śaṃkhacūḍānvavāye taṃ ratnacūḍamavaikṣata || 106 || tadīkṣaṇakṣaṇāddṛṣṭirānaṃdāśrubhirāvṛtā || kapolabhittirabhavatsvedodakaṇikāṃcitā || 107 || cakaṃpe gātralatikā dhṛtaromāṃcakaṃcukā || citranyasteva tastaṃbha kṣaṇaṃ mukulitānanā|| 108 || tataḥ sā citralekhā tāmetyāśvāsayadāturām|| mautsukyaṃ vraja gaṃdharvi siddhastedya manorathaḥ ||109|| etasyāvagataṃ sarvaṃ deśanāmānvayādikam|| mā viṣīdālisulabhastveṣa ratneśvarārpitaḥ ||4.2.67.110|| aho sadṛgvarāvāptyā ratneśenāsi toṣitā || uttiṣṭha yāmaḥ sadanaṃ ratneśaḥ sarvadohinaḥ || 111 || atha devavaśādyāṃtyastā dṛṣṭā gaganādhvagāḥ || subāhunā dānavena pātālatalavāsinā || 112 || gṛhītvā tāścatasropi niragāddānavo gṛham|| harirvikaṭadaṃṣṭrāsyaḥ prāṃtare hariṇīriva || 113 || tāstaṃ vilokya gaṃdharvyo daṃṣṭrāvikaṭitānanam || rudhirāruṇanetraṃ ca jātā vepathubhūmayaḥ || 114 || hā mātarhā pitastrāhi hā vidhe mā vidhehi tat || yadetatkartumārabdhamanāthāsvatiniṣṭhuram || 115 || hā daiva maṃdabhāgyābhiḥ kimasmābhiranuṣṭhitam || sukṛtetaravārtāpi no citte vyāhṛtā kvacit || 116 || śiśukrīḍanakaṃ hitvā hitvā ratneśvarārcanam || pitroḥ svādhīna sacceṣṭā iṣṭaṃ vidmo na kiṃcana ||117|| adhobhuvanagā dīnā hīnānāthena kotra naḥ || trāti trāṇārthinīrbālāḥ śaṃbho ratneśa sarvaga || 118 || itthaṃ gaṃdharvatanayā vilapaṃtīḥ kṛpāturam || śuśrāva nāgarājosau ratnacūḍo mahāmanāḥ || 119 || kosau matsvāmino nāma ratneśasya maheśituḥ || liṃgarājasya gṛhṇāti karmabaṃdhanabhedinaḥ || 4.2.67.120 || punarapyārtarāvaṃ sa śrutvā bālāmukheritam || ratneśa rakṣarakṣeti gṛhītāstro viniryayau ||121 || taṃ vasārasapānena mahāmāṃsaniṣevaṇāt || atyaṃtonmatta duśceṣṭaṃ ratnacūḍo niraikṣata|| 122 || adhyākṣipacca re duṣṭa śiṣṭakanyāpahāraka || maddṛṣṭigocaraṃ yātaḥ kva yāsyasyadya re'dhama || 123 || mama bāṇahataprāṇaḥ prayāṇaṃ kuru durmate || ārtatrāṇodyatamate vaivasvatapuraṃ prati || 124 || ratneśvarasya yairnāma pralayāpadyapi sphuṭam || gṛhītaṃ na bhavādṛgbhyasteṣu bhītirbhayātmasu || 125 || ratneśvaramahānāma kṛtatrāṇāstu ye narāḥ || teṣāṃ janmajarāvyādhi kalikālabhayaṃ kutaḥ ||126|| ityuktvā tā bhayatrastāstanmukhaprahitekṣaṇāḥ || vyāghraghrātā iva mṛgīrmābhaiṣiṣṭetyuvāca saḥ || 127 || ityāśvāsyātha gaṃdharvīḥ sa vai bhujagarājajaḥ || ākarṇapūrṇamākṛṣya kodaṃḍaṃ prāhiṇoccharam || 128 || sopi kruddho danujarāṭpadāspṛṣṭabhujaṃgavat || āviddhya kāladaṃḍābhaṃ parighaṃ vyasṛjanmahat ||129|| hṛdi ratneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ yasya samyagvijṛṃbhate || alātadaṃḍavattasminkāladaṃḍopi jāyate || || 4.2.67.130 || aṃtareva sa ciccheda parighaṃ svamaheṣubhiḥ || durvṛtasya yathehāyurvicchidyetāṃtaraiva hi || 131 || tatosya bāṇaṃ cikṣepa kālānalasamaprabham || sa bāṇastasya hṛdayaṃ praviśya pragaveṣya ca || 132 || prāṇānasya viniryātya svayaṃ tūṇamagātpunaḥ || hṛdisthaṃ tasya daurātmyaṃ sarvaṃ vijñāya tattvataḥ || 33 || digaṃganāpuraḥ khyātumiva nāgāśugo gataḥ || 134 || anyāyopārjitairdravyairyaḥ sukhaṃ bhoktumicchati || tāni dravyāṇi yāṃtyeva sa prāṇāni kutaḥ sukhama || 135 || iti taṃ dānavaṃ hatvā nāgarājo mahābalī || pratyuvācātha tāḥ kanyāḥ kā yūyaṃ kasya cātmajāḥ || 136 || durātmanā kutonena saṃgatā danujanmanā || kva vā ratneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ bhavatībhirvilokitam || 137 || yasya nāmākṣaroccārādvyapeta paramāpadaḥ || yṛyamāśu tadākhyāta yena jānāmi tattvataḥ ||138|| iti śrutvā girastasya nitarāṃ premanirbharāḥ|| parasparaṃ mukhaṃ vīkṣya kosau syāddṛṣṭapūrvavat || 139 || akāraṇa sakhā kosau prāṃtare samupasthitaḥ || nijaprāṇānpaṇīkṛtya yena trātā sma bālikāḥ || 4.2.67.140 || asya saṃdarśanādeva svabhāva capalānyapi || maṃtharāṇīṃdriyāṇistu paripīya sudhāmiva || 141 || yātumanyatra no netre protsahete yathā tathā || anyadvastvaṃtaraṃ prekṣya ramaṇīyataraṃtvapi || 142|| vacaḥpīyūṣamādhurya nitarāṃ prāpya naḥ śrutī || śabdāṃtaragrahāpekṣāṃ na kurvāte svajanmanaḥ || 143 || āpnutaḥ paṃgutāmetau pādau naścaṃcalāvapi || amuṃ yuvānamālokya coraṃ naḥ sanmanomaṇeḥ || 144 || iti bruvaṃtyastā bālāḥ parasparamanulbaṇam || dṛṣṭvāpi citramadhyasthaṃ vividustanna bālikāḥ || 145 || atīva bhīṣaṇākāra danujasyātisādhvasāt || aṃdhībhūtekṣaṇāstaṃ nājñāsiṣurhariṇīkṣaṇāḥ || 146 || ūcuśca taṃ yuvānaṃ tā nijajīvitarakṣiṇam|| yadaṃga bhavatā pṛṣṭaṃ snehanirbharacetasā || 147 || tadācakṣāmahe sarvamavadhehi kṣaṇaṃ manaḥ || iyaṃ gaṃdharvarājasya vasubhūtestanūdbhavā || || 148 || kanyā ratnāvalī nāma guṇaratnamahākhaniḥ || vayaṃ vayasyā etasyāśchāyevānugatāḥ sadā || 149 || ārabhya bālyamapyeṣā liṃgaṃ ratneśvarābhidham || yāṃti pitrāpyanujñātā kāśyāmarcayituṃ sadā || 4.2.67.150 || varopi dattastenāsyai prasannenātha śaṃbhunā || hariṣyatīti yaḥ svapne kaumāraṃ te kumārike || 151 || tava nāmasamānākhyaḥ sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati || yuvānaṃ svapnabhoktāraṃ prāpyāpyeṣā suduḥkhitā ||152|| punastadvirahotthena vahninātīva tāpitā|| kalākauśalyato'smābhiḥ sopi citre pradarśitaḥ || 153 || yasya na grāma nāmāpi nānvayopyavabudhyate || taṃ dṛṣṭvā citralikhitamapyeṣā jīvitā punaḥ || 154 || tato ratneśvaraṃ natvā svagṛhāyotsukābhavat || yāṃtīstato'nayā sārdhaṃ prāṃtare gaganā dhvani || 155|| atarkitā yamaścāsmāndhṛtvā pātālamāviśat || anaṃtaraṃ bhavāneva taṃ vetti danujādhamam || ||156|| aṃga ityeva vṛttāṃto nijo'smābhirudīritaḥ || prasādaṃ kuru cāsmākaṃ puraḥ kosi kṛpānidhe ||157|| yadā prabhṛti cāsmābhiḥ sa dṛṣṭo duṣṭadānavaḥ || tadāprabhṛti no netre vidyuteva hataprabhe || 158 || kāṃdiśīkā bhayatrātarna vidmaḥ kiṃcideva hi || kva vayaṃ kā vayaṃ kastvaṃ kiṃ jātaṃ kiṃ bhaviṣyati || 159 || niśamyeti sa puṇyātmā nāgarājakumārakaḥ || āśvāsya tā bhayatrastāḥ provācedaṃ ca puṇyadhīḥ || 4.2.67.160 || mayā saha samāyāta ratneśaṃ darthayāmi vaḥ || ityāhūya sa tā ninye krīḍāvāpīṃ sukhodakām ||161|| vitritramaṇisopānāṃ haṃsakokakṛtāravām|| kavīnāṃ vāsitavyājātsvāgataṃ kurvatīmiva ||162|| tatra tenābhyanujñātāḥ krīḍāvāpyāṃ nimajjya tāḥ || sacailapuṣpābharaṇāḥ pronmamajjustataḥ punaḥ || 163 || bahirnirgatya gaṃdharvyaḥ paśyaṃtyaḥ sthagitā iva || ratneśālayamālokya kālarājasamīpataḥ || 164|| parasparaṃ tataḥ procurgaṃdharvyo vismitā iva || svapnoyaṃ kiṃ nu vā satyaṃ khelo ratneśvarasya vā || 165 || vayameva hi vā bhrāṃtā gaṃdharvyo na vayaṃ kimu || kimetannaiva jānīma aiṃdrajālika khelavat|| 166|| eṣottaravahā gaṃgā sphuṭameva bhavediha|| śaṃkhacūḍasya vāpyeṣā śaṃkhacūḍālayastvasau || 167 || etatpaṃcanadaṃ tīrthameṣa vāgīśvarālayaḥ || yasya saṃdarśanādeva vāgvibhūtirvijṛṃbhate || 168 || śaṃkhacūḍeśvaraścaiṣa śaṃkhacūḍapratiṣṭhitaḥ || yasya saṃdarśanātpuṃsāṃ na bhayaṃ kālasarpajam || 169 || eṣā maṃdākinī nāma dīrghikā puṇyatoyabhūḥ || yasyāṃ kṛtodakā martyā martyaloke viśaṃti na || 4.2.67.170 || | asāvāśāpurī devī yā stutā tripurāriṇā || tripuraṃ jetukāmena maṃdākinyāstaṭe śubhe || 171 || yādyāpi pūjitā martyairāśāṃ pūrayaterthinām|| maṃdākinyāḥ pratīcyāṃ tu eṣa siddhyaṣṭakeśvaraḥ || 172 || bhavedyasya saparyāto gṛhe siddhyaṣṭakaṃ sphuṭam || kuṃḍasiddhyaṣṭakākhyaṃ ca tatraiva virajodakam || 173 || yatra snātvā kṛtaśrāddho virajasko divaṃ vrajet || mūrtyastāḥ siddhayaścāṣṭau yāḥ kāśyāṃ sarvasiddhidāḥ || 174 || sarvasiddhipradaścāsau mahārājavināyakaḥ || vināyakāḥ praṇaśyaṃti yasmai praṇamatāṃ nṛṇām || 175 || asau siddheśvarasyoccaiḥ prāsādaḥ kāṃcanojjvalaḥ || ratnadhvajapatākāśca siddhiḥ syādyadvilokanāt || 176 || kṣetrasya madhyame || bhāge madhyameśvara eṣa vai || madhyādholokayormadhye na vasedyasya vīkṣaṇāt || 177 || madhyameśaṃ samabhyarcya naro madhyamaviṣṭape || āsamudrakṣitīṃdraḥ syāttato mokṣaṃ ca viṃdati || 178 || airāvateśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatprācyāmiṣṭasiddhikṛt || dṛśyate yatpatākāyāṃ ramya airāvato gajaḥ ||179 || vṛddhakāleśvarasyaiṣa prāsādo ratnanirmitaḥ || | pratidarśaṃ vasedyatra rātrau caṃdraḥ satārakaḥ || 4.2.67.180 || yasya saṃdarśanānnṛṇāṃ na kālaḥ prabhavedbhave || na kaliḥ prabhavetsatyaṃ na ca kalmaṣarāśayaḥ || 181 || iti yāvatkathāṃ cakruḥ saṃbhrāṃtā iva bālikāḥ|| tāvadvasuvibhūtiḥ sa gaṃdharvastvarayā yayau ||182|| nāradācchrutavṛttāṃtaḥ subāhudanujanmanaḥ || ratnāvalī sutā prītā sasakhīkā yathāhṛtā || 183 || ratneśvarātsamāyāṃtī śūnye gaganavartmani || yathānayacca pātālaṃ yathā yuddhamabhūtpunaḥ || 184 || yathā ratneśa bhaktena ratnacūḍena ghātitaḥ || sa subāhurdanujanurmaheṣvāsena ceṣuṇā || 185 || yathā ca pṛṣṭavṛttāṃto vāpīmārgeṇa cānayat || śaṃkhacūḍasya vāpīṃ tāṃ pātāleṣu pravartinīm || 186 || yathā ca prāpya niryātāḥ kāśīṃ dṛṣṭvāpi bālikāḥ || bhṛśaṃ saṃbhrāṃtimāpannāḥ paśyaṃtyopi samutsukāḥ || 187 || dṛṣṭvā gaṃdharvarājastāṃ punarjātāmivātmajām || savayasyāmanāmlānamukhapaṃkajasuśriyam|| 188 || pariṣvajya samāghrāya lalāṭaphalakaṃ muhuḥ || aṃkamāropya papraccha sarvaṃ vṛttāṃtamādarāt||189|| atha sā kathayāmāsa danujāpahṛteḥ kathām|| || ratneśvaraṃ varāvāptiṃ svapnāvasthāṃ vihāya ca||4.2.67.190|| ratnāvalīmanovṛttiṃ vijñāyātha mukheṃgitaiḥ || śaśilekhā samācaṣṭa spaṣṭavarṇaiḥ savistaram|| 191 || tutoṣa nitarāṃ sotha gaṃdharvādhipatiḥ kṛtī || prabhāvaṃ varṇayāmāsa mudā ratneśvarasya ca || 192 || || skaṃda uvāca || || ākarṇaya muniśreṣṭha viṃdhyavṛddhi vivardhana || pratyahaṃ ratnacūḍopi vāpīmārgeṇa saṃyamī ||193|| nāgalokātsamāgatya snātvā maṃdākinī jale || ratneśvaraṃ samabhyarcya ratnāṃjalyaṣṭakena vai || 194 || suvarṇapaṃkajānyaṣṭau samarpayati hṛṣṭavat || ekadā svapnasamaye ratneśo liṃgarūpadhṛk || 195 || ratnacūḍamuvācedaṃ nijabhaktaṃ dṛḍhavratam || dānavena hṛtāṃ kanyāṃ mocayiṣyati yāṃ bhavān || 196 || taṃ dānavaṃ raṇe jitvā sā te patnī bhaviṣyati || iti smaranvaraṃ sotha nāgarājo mahāmanāḥ ||197|| tāṃ kanyāṃ dānavaṃ hatvā vimocya nija vīryataḥ || vāpīmārgeṇa pātālādānināya punarmahīm ||198|| svayaṃ ca sādhayāṃcakre pratyahaṃ niyamaṃ sudhīḥ|| liṃgaṃ samarcayitvātha kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam || 199 || yāvadbahiḥ samāgacchedramyādratneśamaṃḍapāta || tāvadgaṃdharvarājāya tābhiḥ sa vasubhūtaye || 4.2.67.200 || soyaṃ soyaṃ yuvā dhanyastarjanyagreṇa darśitaḥ || gaṃdharvarājastaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāgarājakumārakam|| 201 || atīvasmeranayanaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || manasyenaṃ ca saṃvarṇya tadrūpaṃ savayonvayam|| 202 || dhanyosmyanugṛhītosmi ratneśena varārpaṇāt || kanyā dhanyatarā ceyamanurūposti yatpatiḥ || 203 || saṃpradhāryeti hṛdyenaṃ samākārya ca suṃdaram || pṛṣṭvā tannāmagotraṃ ca gaṇayitvā balābalam || 204 || ratneśvarasya puratastasmai kanyāṃ dadau mudā || nītvā gaṃdharvalokaṃ ca kṛtakautukamaṃgalam || 205 || madhuparkeṇa saṃpūjya pāṇimagrāhayattataḥ || vaivāhikena vidhinā dadau ratnānyanekaśaḥ || 206 || śaśilekhānaṃgalekhā citralekhāpi kuṃbhaja || vijñāpya svajanetāraṃ varayāmāsa taṃ patim ||207 || upayamya catasropi sa gaṃdharvasutāḥ śubhāḥ || ratnacūḍo jagāmātha tābhiḥ svapitṛmaṃdiram || 208 || yathā catasṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ śrutibhiḥ praṇavaḥ śivam || svapitroścaraṇau natvā navoḍhābhiḥ sa nāgarāṭ ||209|| viniveditavṛttāṃto ratneśānugrahasya ca || uvāsa tābhiḥ sasukhaṃ pitṛbhyāmabhinaṃditaḥ ||4.2.67.210|| || īśvara uvāca || || ratneśvarasya liṃgasya mama sthāvararūpiṇaḥ || sarveṣāṃ sarvadasyāsya prabhāvo girije'tulaḥ || 211 || asmim̐lliṃge parāṃ siddhi prāptāḥ siddhāḥ sahasraśaḥ || guptamāsīdidaṃ liṃgamadya yāvatsumadhyame || || 212 || tava pitrā himavatā mama bhaktena sarvathā || puṇyārjitairmahāratnai ratneśaḥ prakaṭīkṛtaḥ || 213 || asmim̐lliṃge mama prītirnitarāmadrirājaje || vārāṇasyāmidaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 214 || nānā ratnāni labhyaṃte ratneśānugrahādume || strīratnaputraratnādi svargamokṣāvapi priye || 215 || yo'tra ratneśvaraṃ natvā mṛto deśāṃtareṣvapi || na sa svargādihāgacchetkalpakoṭiśatairapi ||216|| asitāyāṃ caturdaśyāmupoṣya niśi jāgarāt|| ratneśasannidhau devi mama sānnidhyamāpnuyāt || || 217 || asya liṃgasya pūrveṇa tvayā janmāṃtare priye || dākṣāyaṇīśvaraṃ ligaṃ madbhaktyātra pratiṣṭhitam || 218 || tasya saṃdarśanādeva na naro yāti durgatim || aṃbikā nāma gaurī tvaṃ tatrāhaṃ cāṃbikeśvaraḥ || 219 || mūrtaḥ ṣaḍānanastatra tava putraḥ sumadhyame || etattrayaṃ naro dṛṣṭvā na garbhaṃ praviśedume || 4.2.67.220 || ratneśvarasya māhātmyaṃ mayā te samudīritam || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena kalikalmaṣacetasām || 221 || idaṃ ratneśvarākhyānaṃ yaḥ paṭhiṣyati sarvadā || saputrapautrapaśubhirna viyujyeta karhicit || 222 || śrutvā ratneśvarotpatiṃ setihāsāṃ narottamaḥ || anūḍho labhate satyaṃ kanyāratnaṃ kulocitam || 223 || kanyāpīmaṃ samākarṇya tvitihāsaṃ manoramam || śraddhayā satpatiṃ prāpya bhaviṣyati pativratā || 224 || itihāsamimaṃ śrutvā nārī vā puruṣopivā || na jātviṣṭaviyogāgni tāpena paritapyate ||225|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe ratneśvarapraśaṃsanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||
<4.2.68>
|| skaṃda uvāca || anyacca śṛṇu vipreṃdra vṛttātaṃ tatra saṃbhavam || mahāścaryaprajananaṃ mahāpātakahāri ca || 1 || itthaṃ kathāṃ prakurvāṇe ratnaśesya maheśvare || kolāhalo mahānāsīttrātatrāteti sarvataḥ || 2 || mahiṣāsuraputrosau samāyāti gajāsuraḥ || pramathanpramathānsarvānnijavīrya madoddhataḥ || 3 || yatrayatra dharāyāṃ sa caraṇaṃ pramiṇoti hi || acalollolayāṃcakre tatratatrāsya bhārataḥ || 4 || ūruvegena taravaḥ pataṃti śikharaiḥ saha || yasya dordaṃḍaghātena cūrṇāḥ syuśca śiloccayāḥ || 5 || yasya maulijasaṃgharṣādgha(?)nāvyoma tyajaṃtyapi|| nīlimānaṃ na cādyāpi jahyustakleśasaṃgajam || 6 || yasya niḥśvāsasaṃbhārairuttaraṃgā mahābdhayaḥ || nadyopyamaṃdakallolā bhavaṃti timibhiḥ saha || 7 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi navayasya samucchrayaḥ || tāvāneva hi vistārastanormāyāvinosya hi || || 8 || yannetrayoḥ piṃgalimā tathā taralimā punaḥ || vidyutā nojjhyate'dyāpi soyamāyāti satvaraḥ || 9 || yāṃyāṃ diśaṃ samabhyeti soyaṃ duḥsaha dānavaḥ || sāsā samī bhavedasya sādhvasādiva digdhruvam || 4.2.68.10 || brahmalabdhavaraścāyaṃ tṛṇīkṛtajagattrayaḥ || avadhyohaṃ bhavāmīti strīpuṃsaiḥ kāmanirjitaiḥ || 11 || tatastriśūlahetistamāyāṃtaṃ daityapuṃgavam || vijñāyāvadhyamanyena śūlenābhijaghāna tam || 12 || protastena triśūlena sa ca daityo gajāsuraḥ || chatrīkṛtamivātmānaṃ manyamāno jagau haram || 13 || || gajāsura uvāca || || triśūlapāṇe deveśa jāne tvāṃ smarahāriṇam || tava haste mama vadhaḥ śreyāneva purāṃtaka || 14 || kiṃcidvijñaptumicchāmi avadhehi mameritam|| satyaṃ bravīmi nāsatyaṃ mṛtyuṃjaya vicāraya ||15|| tvameko jagatāṃ vaṃdyo viśvasyopari saṃsthitaḥ || ahaṃ tvadupariṣṭācca sthitosmī ti jitaṃ mayā || 16 || dhanyosmyanugṛhītosmi tvattriśūlāgrasaṃsthitaḥ || kālena sarvairmartavyaṃ śreyase mṛtyurīdṛśaḥ || 17 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devadevaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ || provāca prahasañchaṃbhurghaṭodbhava gajāsuram || 18 || || īśvara uvāca|| || gajāsura prasannosmi mahāpauruṣaśevadhe || svānukūla varaṃ brūhi dadāmi sumate'sura || 19 || ityākarṇya sa daityeṃdraḥ pratyuvāca maheśvaram || || gajāsura uvāca || || yadi prasanno digvāsastadā nityaṃ vasāna me || 4.2.68.20 || imāṃ kṛttiṃ virūpākṣa tvattriśūlāgnipāvitām || svapramāṇāṃ sukhasparśāṃ raṇāṃgaṇapaṇīkṛtām || 21 || iṣṭagaṃdhiḥ sadaivāstu sadaivāstvatikomalā || sadaiva nirmalā cāstu sadaivāstvatimaṃḍanam || 22 || mahātapo'nalajvālāḥ prāpyāpi suciraṃ vibho || na dagdhā kṛttireṣā me puṇyagaṃdhanidhistataḥ || 23 || yadi puṇyavatī naiṣā mamakṛttirdigaṃbara || tadā tvadaṃgasaṃgosyāḥ kathaṃ jāto raṇāṃgaṇe || 24 || anyaṃ ca me varaṃ dehi yadi tuṣṭosi śaṃkara || nāmāstu kṛttivāsāste prārabhyādyatanaṃ dinam || 25 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā tathetyuktvā ca śaṃkaraḥ || punaḥprovāca taṃ daityaṃ bhaktinirmalamānasam || 26 || || īśvara uvāca || || || śṛṇu puṇyanidhe daitya varamanyaṃ sudurlabham || avimukte mahākṣetre raṇa tyakta kalevara ||27|| idaṃ puṇyaśarīraṃ te kṣetresminmuktisādhane || mama liṃgaṃ bhavatvatra sarveṣāṃmuktidāyakam || 28 || kṛttivāseśvaraṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam || sarveṣāmeva liṃgānāṃ śirobhūtamidaṃ varam ||29 || yāvaṃti saṃti liṃgāni vārāṇasyāṃ mahāṃtyapi || uttamaṃ tāvatāmetaduttamāṃgavaduttamam || 4.2.68.30 || mānavānāṃ hitāyātra sthāsyehaṃ saparigrahaḥ || dṛṣṭenānena liṃgena pūjitena stutena ca|| kṛtakṛtyo bhavenmartyaḥ saṃsāraṃ na viśetpunaḥ || 31 || rudrāḥ pāśupatāḥ siddhā ṛṣayastattvaciṃtakāḥ || śāṃtā dāṃtā jitakrodhā nirdvaṃdvā niṣparigrahāḥ || 32 || avimukte sthitā ye tu mama bhaktā mumukṣavaḥ || mānāpamānayostulyāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanāḥ ||33|| kṛttivāseśvare liṃge sthāsyehaṃ tadanugrahe || daśakoṭisahasrāṇi tīrthāni prativāsaram || || 34 || trikālamāgamiṣyaṃti kṛttivāse na saṃśayaḥ || kalidvāparasaṃbhūtā narāḥ kalmaṣabuddhayaḥ || 35 || sadācāravinirmuktāḥ satyaśaucaparāṅmukhāḥ || māyayā daṃbhalobhābhyāṃ mohāhaṃkṛtisaṃyutāḥ || 36 || śūdrānnasevino viprā jihvālā atilālasāḥ || saṃdhyāsnānajapejyāsu dūrīkṛta manodhiyaḥ || 37 || kṛttivāseśvaraṃ prāpya sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ || sukhena mokṣameṣyaṃti yathā sukṛtinastathā || 38 || kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sevyaṃ kāśyāṃ tato naraiḥ || janmāṃtarasahasreṣu mokṣonyatra sudurlabhaḥ || 39 || kṛttivāseśvare liṃge labhyastvekena janmanā || pṛrvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tapodānādibhiḥ śanaiḥ || naśyetsadyo vinaśyeta kṛttivāse śvarekṣaṇāt ||4.2.68.40|| kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ yercayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || praviṣṭāste śarīre me teṣāṃ nāsti punarbhavaḥ ||41|| avimukte'tra vastavyaṃ japtavyaṃ śatarudriyam|| kṛttivāseśvaro devo draṣṭavyaśca punaḥpunaḥ || 42 || saptakoṭimahārudraiḥ sujaptairyatphalaṃ bhavet || tatphalaṃ labhyate kāśyāṃ pūjanātkṛttivāsasaḥ || 43 || māgha kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmupoṣya niśi jāgṛyāt || kṛttivāseśamabhyarcya yaḥ sa yāyātparāṃ gatim|| 44 || śuklāyāṃ paṃcadaśyāṃ yaścaitryāṃ kartā mahotsavam|| kṛttivāseśvare liṃge na sa garbhaṃ pravakṣyete || 45 || kathayitveti deveśastatkṛttiṃ parigṛhya ca || gajāsurasya mahatīṃ prāvṛṇoddharidaṃbaraḥ || 46 || mahāmahotsavo jātastasminnahani kuṃbhaja || kṛttivāsatvamāpede yasmindevo digaṃbaraḥ || 47 || yatracchatrīkṛto daityaḥ śūlamāropya bhūtale || tacchūlotpāṭanājjātaṃ tatra kuṃḍaṃ mahattaram ||48|| tasminkuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā kṛtvā ca pitṛtarpaṇam || kṛttivāseśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet ||49|| skaṃda uvāca || tasmiṃstīrthe tu yadvṛttaṃ tadagaste niśāmaya || kākā haṃsatvamāpannāstattīrthasya prabhāvataḥ || 4.2.68.50 || ekadā kṛttivāse tu caitryāṃ yātrā'bhavatpurā || annaṃ rāśīkṛtaṃ tatra hyupahārasamudbhavam || 51 || bahudevalakairvipra taṃ dṛṣṭvā pakṣiṇo milan || parasparaṃ tadannārthaṃ yudhyaṃto vyomavartmani || 52 || balipuṣṭairapuṣṭāṃgā raṭataḥ karaṭāḥ kaṭu || valibhiścātipuṣṭāṃgairabalāścaṃcubhirhatāḥ || 53 || te hanyamānā nyapataṃstasminkuṃḍe nabhoṃgaṇāt || āyuḥśeṣeṇa saṃtrātā haṃsībhūtāstu vāyasāḥ || 54 || āścaryavaṃtastatratyā yātrāyāṃ militā janāḥ || ūcuraṃgulinirdeśairaho paśyata paśyata || 55 || asmāsu vīkṣamāṇeṣu kākāḥ kuṃḍetra ye patan || dhārtarāṣṭrāstu te jātāstīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 56 || haṃsatīrthaṃ tadārabhya kṛttivāsa samīpataḥ || nāmnā khyātamabhūlloke tatkuṃḍaṃ kalaśodbhava|| || 57 || atīva malinātmāno mahāmalina karmabhiḥ || kṣaṇānnirmalatāṃ yāṃti haṃsatīrthakṛtodakāḥ || 58 || kāśyāṃ sadaiva vastavyaṃ snātavyaṃ haṃsatīrthake || draṣṭavyaḥ kṛttivāseśaḥ prāptavyaṃ paramaṃ padam || 59 || kāśyāṃ liṃgānyanekāni mune saṃti padepade || kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sarvaliṃgaśiraḥ smṛtam || 4.2.68.60 || kṛttivāsaṃ samārādhya bhaktiyuktena cetasā || sarvaliṃgārādhanajaṃ phalaṃ kāśyāmavāpyate || 61 || japo dānaṃ tapo homastarpaṇaṃ devatārcanam || samīpe kṛttivāsasya kṛtaṃ sarvamanaṃtakam || 62 || tīrthaṃ tvanādisaṃsiddhametatkalaśasaṃbhava || punardevasya sānnidhyādāvirāsīnmaheśituḥ || 63 || etāni siddhaliṃgānicchannāni syuryugeyuge || avāpya śaṃbhusānnidhyaṃ punarāvirbhavaṃti hi || 64 || haṃsatīrthasya parito liṃgānāmayutaṃ mune || pratiṣṭhitaṃ munivarairatrāsti dviśatottaram ||65|| ekaikaṃ siddhidaṃ nṛṇāmavimuktanivāsinām || liṃgaṃ kātyāyaneśādi cyavaneśāṃ tameva hi || 66 || lomaśeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ lomaśena pratiṣṭhitam || kṛttivāsaḥ pratīcyāṃ tu taddṛṣṭvā kvāṃtakādbhayam || 67 || mālatīśaṃ śubhaṃ liṃgaṃ kṛttivāsottare mahat || saparyayitvā talliṃgaṃ rājā gajapatirbhavet || 68 || aṃtakeśvara saṃjñaṃ ca liṃgaṃ tadrudradiksthitam || atipāpopi niṣpāpo jāyate tadvilokanāt ||69|| janakeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ tatpārśve jñānadaṃ param || talliṃga varivasyāto brahmajñānamavāpyate ||4.2.68.70 || taduttare mahāmūrtirasitāṃgosti bhairavaḥ || tasya darśanataḥ puṃsāṃ na bhavedyamadarśanam ||71|| śuṣkodarī ca tatrāsti devī vikaṭalocanā || kṛttivāsādudīcyāṃ tu kāśīpratyūha bhakṣiṇī || 72 || agnijihvosti vetālastasyā devyāstu nairṛte || dadāti vāṃchitāṃ siddhiṃ sorcito bhaumavāsare || 73 || vetālakuṃḍaṃ tatrāsti sarvavyādhivighātakṛt || tatkuṃḍodakasaṃsparśādvraṇavisphoṭarugvrajet || 74 || vetālakuṃḍe susnāto vetālaṃ praṇipatya ca || labheta vāṃchitāṃ siddhiṃ durlabhāṃ sarvadehibhiḥ || 75 || gaṇosti tatra dvibhujaścatuṣpātpaṃcaśīrṣakaḥ || tasya saṃvīkṣaṇādeva pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā || 76 || taduttare mune rudraśtuḥśṛṃgosti bhīṣaṇaḥ || tripādastu dviśīrṣā ca hastāḥ syuḥ sapta eva hi |||77 || rorūyate vṛṣākārastridhā baddhaḥ sa kuṃbhaja || kāśīvighrakarā ye ca ye kāśyāṃ pāpabuddhayaḥ || 78 || teṣāṃ ca saṃchidāṃ kartumahaṃ dhṛtakuṭhārakaḥ || ye kāśyāṃ vighnahartāro ye kāśyāṃ dharmabuddhayaḥ || 79 || sudhāghaṭakaraścāhaṃ tadvaṃśapariṣekakṛt || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣarudraṃ vai pūjayitvā tu bhaktitaḥ || 4.2.68.80 || mahāmahopacāraiśca na vighnairabhibhūyate || maṇipradīpo nāgo'sti tasmādrudrādudagdiśi || 81 || maṇikuṃḍaṃ tadagre tu viṣavyādhiharaṃ param || tasminkuṃḍe kṛtasnānastaṃ nāgaṃ parivīkṣya ca || 82 || maṇimāṇikyasaṃpūrṇa gajāśvarathasaṃkulam || strīratnaputraratnaiśca samṛddhaṃ rājyamāpnuyāt || 83 || kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāṃ yairna vilokitam || te martyaloke bhārāya bhuvo bhūtā na saṃśayaḥ || 84 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kṛttivāsaḥ samutpattiṃ ye śroṣyaṃtīha mānavāḥ || talliṃgadarśanācchreyo lapsyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || 85 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarādheṃ kṛttivāsaḥ samudbhavo nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'pyāyaḥ ||68||
<4.2.69>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇvagastya taporāśe kāśyāṃ liṃgāni yāni vai || sevitāni nṛṇāṃ muktyai bhaveyurbhāvitātmanām || 1 || kṛttiprāvaraṇaṃ yatra kṛtaṃ devena līlayā || rudrāvāsa iti khyātaṃ tatsthānaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 2 || sthite tatromayā sārdhaṃ svecchayā kṛttivāsasi || āgatya naṃdī vijñaptiṃ cakre praṇatipūrvakam || 3 || devadeveśa viśveśa prāsādāḥ sumanoharāḥ || sarvaratnamayā ramyāḥ sāṣṭāṣaṣṭirabhūdiha || 4 || bhūrbhuvaḥsvastale yāni śubhānyāyatanāni hi || muktidānyapi tānīha mayānītāni sarvataḥ || 5 || yato yacca samānītaṃ yatra yacca kṛtāspadam || kathayiṣyāmyahaṃ nātha kṣaṇaṃ tadavadhāryatām || 6 || sthāṇurnāma mahāliṃgaṃ devadevasya mokṣadam || kurukṣetrādihodbhūtaṃ kalāśeṣosti tatra vai || 7 || tadagre sannihatyākhyā mahāpuṣkariṇī śubhā || lolārka paścime bhāge kurukṣetrasthalī tu sā || 8 || tatra snātaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ taptaṃ dattaṃ śubhārthibhiḥ || kurukṣetrādbhavetsatyaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇādhikam || 9 || naimiṣāddevadevotra brahmāvartena saṃyutaḥ || tatrāṃśamātraṃ saṃsthāpya kāśyāmāvirabhūdvibho || 4.2.69.10 || ḍhuṃḍhirājottarebhāge siddhidaṃ sādhakasya vai || liṃgaṃ vai devadevākhyaṃ tadagre kūpa uttamaḥ || 11 || 286a brahmāvarta iti khyātaḥ punarāvṛttihṛnnṛṇām || tatkūpādbhiḥ kṛtasnāno devadevaṃ samarcya ca || 12 || tatpuṇyaṃ naimiṣāraṇyātkoṭikoṭiguṇaṃ smṛtam || gokarṇāyatanādatra svayamāvirabhūnmahat || 13 || liṃgaṃ mahābalaṃ nāma sāṃbādityasamīpataḥ || darśanātsparśanādyasya kṣaṇādeno mahābalam || 14 || vātāhatastūlarāśiriva vidrāti dūrataḥ || kapālamocanapuro dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ mahābalam || 15 || mahābalamavāpnoti nivārṇanagaraṃ vrajet || ṛṇamocanataḥ prācyāṃ prabhāsātkṣetrasattamāt || 16 || śaśibhūṣaṇasaṃjñaṃ tu liṃgamatra pratiṣṭhitam || talliṃgasevanānmartyaḥ śāśibhūṣaṇatāṃ vrajet || 17 || prabhāsakṣetrayātrāyāḥ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti koṭikṛt || ujjayinyā mahākālaḥ svayamatrāgato vibhuḥ || 18 || yannāmasmaraṇādeva na bhayaṃ kalikālataḥ || praṇavākhyānmahāliṃgātprācyāṃ kalmaṣanāśanam || 19 || mahākālābhidhaṃ liṃgaṃ darśanānmokṣadaṃ param || ayogaṃdheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ puṣkarāttīrthasattamāt || 4.2.69.20 || āvirāsīdiha mahatpuṣkareṇa sahaiva tu || matsyodaryuttarebhāge dṛṣṭvā 'yogaṃdhamīśvaram || 21 || snātvā'yogaṃdhakuṃḍe tu bhavāttārayate pitṝn || mahānādeśvaraṃ liṃgamaṭṭahāsādihāgatam || 22 || trilocanādudīcyāṃ tu taddṛṣṭamuktaye matam || mahotkaṭeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ marutkoṭādihāgatam || kāmeśvarottare bhāge dṛṣṭaṃ vimalasiddhidam || 23 || viśvasthānādihāyātaṃ liṃgaṃ vai vimaleśvaram || svarlīnātpaścime bhāge dṛṣṭaṃ vimalasiddhidam || 24 || mahāvrataṃ mahāliṃgaṃ maheṃdrādiha saṃsthitam || skaṃdeśvara samīpe tu mahāvrataphalapradam || 25 || vṛṃdārakarṣivṛṃdānāṃ stuvatāṃ prathame yuge || utpannaṃ yanmahāliṃgaṃ bhūmiṃ bhittvā sudurbhidām || 26 || mahādeveti tairuktaṃ yanmanorathapūraṇāta || vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevastadārabhyābhavacca yat || 27 || muktikṣetraṃ kṛtaṃ yena mahāliṃgena kāśikā || avimukte mahādevaṃ yo drakṣyatyatramānavaḥ || 28 || śaṃbhuloke gamastasya yatratatra mṛtasya hi || avimukte prayatnena tatsaṃsevyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 29 || kalpāṃtarepi na tyaktaṃ kadāpyānaṃdakānanam || yena liṃgasvarūpeṇa mahādevena sarvathā || 4.2.69.30 || tatprasādoyamatulaḥ sarvaratnamayaḥ śubhaḥ || hiraṇyagarbhatīrthācca pratīcyāṃ kṣetrarakṣakam || 31 || vārāṇasyāmadhiṣṭhātrī devatā sābhilāṣadā || mahādeveti saṃjñā vai sarvaliṃgasvarūpiṇī || 32 || vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevo dṛṣṭo yairliṃgarūpadhṛk || tena trailokyaliṃgāni dṛṣṭānīha na saṃśayaḥ || 33 || vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevaṃ samabhyarcya sakṛnnaraḥ || ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvacchivaloke vasenmudā ||34|| pavitraparvaṇi sadā śrāvaṇe māsi yatnataḥ || liṃge pavitramāropya mahādeve na garbhabhāk ||35|| pitāmaheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ gayātīrthādihāgatam || phalgruprabhṛtibhistīrthaiḥ sārdhakoṭyaṣṭasaṃmitaiḥ ||36|| dharmeṇa yatra vai taptaṃ yugānāmayutaṃ śatam || sākṣīkṛtya mahāliṃgaṃ śrīmaddharmeśvarābhidham || 37 || pitāmaheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatrābhyarcya naro mudā || triḥsaptakulasaṃyukto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||38|| prayāgāttīrtharājācca śūlaṭaṃko maheśvaraḥ || tīrtharājena sahitaḥ sthita āgatya vai svayam|| 39 || nirvāṇamaṃḍapādramyādavācyāmatinirmalaḥ || prāsādo meruṇā yasya spardhate kāṃcanojvalaḥ || 4.2.69.40 || devenaiva varo datto yatra pūrvaṃ yugāṃtare || pūjyo maheśvaraḥ kāśyāṃ prathamaṃ kaluṣāpahaḥ || 41 || yaḥ prayāga iha snāto namasyati maheśvaram || samabhyarcya vidhānena mahāsaṃbhāravistaraiḥ || 42 || prayāgasnānajātpuṇyācchūlaṭaṃka vilokanāt || sa prāpnuyānna saṃdehaḥ puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇottaram || 43 || śaṃkukarṇānmahākṣetrānmahāteja itīritam || liṃgamāvirabhūdatra mahātejovivṛddhidam || 44 || mahātejonidhistasya prāsādotīvanirmalaḥ || jvālājaṭilitākāśo māṇikyaireva nirmitaḥ || 45 || talliṃgadarśanātsparśātstavanācca samarcanāt || prāpyate tatparaṃ dhāma yatra gatvā na śocate || 46 || vināyakeśvarātpūrvaṃ mahātejaḥ samarcanāt || tejomayena yānena yāti māheśvaraṃ padam || 47 || rudrakoṭisamākhyātāttīrthātparamapāvanāt || mahāyogīśvaraṃ liṃgamāviścakre svayaṃ param || 48 || pārvatīśvara liṃgasya samīpe sarvasiddhikṛt || talliṃgadarśanātpuṃsāṃ koṭiliṃga phalaṃ bhavet || 49 || tatprāsādasya parito rudrāṇāṃ koṭisaṃmitāḥ || prāsādāramyasaṃsthānā nirmitā rudramūrtibhiḥ || 4.2.69.50 || kāśyāṃ rudrasthalī sā tu paṭhyate vedavādibhiḥ|| rudrasthalyāṃ mṛtā ye vai kṛmikīṭapataṃgakāḥ || || 51 || paśupakṣimṛgā martyā mlecchā vāpyatha dīkṣitāḥ || teṣāṃ tu rudrībhūtānāṃ punarāvṛttiratra na || 52 || janmāṃtarasahasreṣu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam || rudrasthalīṃ praviṣṭasya tatsarvaṃ vrajati kṣayam || 53 || akāmo vā sakāmo vā tiryagyonigatopi vā || rudrasthalyāṃ tyajanprāṇānparaṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyāt || 54 || svayamekāṃbarātkṣetrātkṛttivāsā ihāgataḥ || kṛttivāsasi liṃgetra svayameva vyavasthitaḥ || 55 || asminsthāne svabhaktānāṃ sāṃbaḥ sarṣigaṇo vibhuḥ || svayaṃ copadiśedbrahma śrutau śrutibhirīḍitam || 56 || kṣetretra siddhide prāptaścaṃḍīśo marujāṃgalāt || pracaṃḍapāpasaṃghātaṃ khaṃḍayecchatadhekṣaṇāt || 57 || pāśapāṇigaṇādhyakṣa samīpe yaḥ prapaśyati || caṃḍīśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 58 || kālaṃjarānnīlakaṃṭhastiṣṭhedatra svayaṃ vibhuḥ || gaṇeśāddaṃtakūṭākhyātsamīpe bhavanāśanaḥ || 59 || nīlakaṃṭheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāṃ yaiḥ paripūjitam || nīlakaṃṭhāsta eva syustaeva śaśibhūṣaṇāḥ || 4.2.69.60 || kāśmīrādiha saṃprāptaṃ liṃgaṃ vijayasaṃjñitam || sadā vijayadaṃ puṃsāṃ prācyāṃ śālakaṭaṃkaṭāt || 61 || raṇe rājakule dyūte vivāde sarvadaiva hi || vijayo jāyate puṃsāṃ vijayeśa samarcanāt || || 62 || ūrdhvaretāstridaṃḍāyāḥ saṃprāptotra svayaṃ vibhuḥ || kūśmāṃḍakaṃ gaṇādhyakṣaṃ puraskṛtya vyavasthitaḥ || 63 || ūrdhvāṃ gatimavāpnoti vīkṣaṇādūrdhvaretasaḥ || ūrdhvaretasi ye bhaktā na hi teṣāmadhogatiḥ || 64 || maṃḍaleśvarataḥ kṣetrālliṃgaṃ śrīkaṃṭhasaṃjñitam || vināyakānmaṃḍasaṃjñāduttarasyāṃ vyavasthitam || 65 || śrīkaṃṭhasya ca ye bhaktāḥ śrīkaṃṭhā eva te narāḥ || neha śriyā viyujyaṃte na paratra kadācana || 66 || chāgalāṃḍānmahātīrthātkapardīśvavarasaṃjñitaḥ || piśācamocane tīrthe svayamāvirabhūdvibhuḥ || 67 || kapardīśaṃ samabhyarcya na naro nirayaṃ vrajet || na piśācatvamāpnoti kṛtvātrāpyaghamuttamam || 68 || āmrātakeśvarātkṣetrālliṃgaṃ sūkṣmeśa saṃjñitam || svayamabhyāgataṃ cātra kṣetre vai śreyasāṃpade || 69 || vikaṭa dvijasaṃjñasya gaṇeśasya samīpataḥ || dṛṣṭvā sūkṣmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ gatiṃ sūkṣmāmavāpnuyāt||4.2.69.70|| | saṃprāptamiha deveśaṃ jayaṃtaṃ madhukeśvarāt || laṃbodarādgaṇapateḥ purastāttadavasthitam || 71 || jayaṃteśvaramālokya snātvā gaṃgājale śubhe || prāpnuyādvāṃchitāṃ siddhiṃ sarvatra vijayī bhavet || 72 || prāduścakāra deveśaḥ śrīśailāttripurāṃtakaḥ || śrīśailaśikharaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatphalaṃ samudīritam || 73 || tripurāṃtakamālokya tatphalaṃ helayāpyate || viśverātpaścime bhāge tripurāṃtakamīśvaram || 74 || saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā na naro garbhamāviśet || saumyasthānādihāyāto bhagavānkukkuṭeśvaraḥ || || 79 || vakratuṃḍa gaṇādhyakṣa samīpe sopatiṣṭhate || taddarśanādarcanācca karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ ||76|| jāleśvarāttriśūlī ca svayamīśaḥ samāgataḥ || kūṭadaṃtādgaṇapateḥ purastātsarvasiddhidaḥ || 77 || rāmeśvarānmahākṣetrājjaṭīdevaḥ samāgataḥ || ekadaṃtottare bhāge sorcitaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ || 78 || trisaṃdhyātkṣetrato devastryaṃbakosti samāgataḥ || trimukhātpūrvadigbhāge pūjitastryaṃbakatvakṛt || 79 || hareśvaro hariścaṃdrātkṣetrādatra samāgataḥ || hariścaṃdreśvarapuraḥ pūjito jayadaḥ sadā || 4.2.69.80 || iha śarvaḥ samāyātaḥ sthānānmadhyamakeśvarāt || caturvedeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ purodhāya vyavasthitam || 81 || śarvaṃ liṃgaṃ samabhyarcya kāśyāṃ paramasiddhikṛt || na jātu jaṃtupadavīṃ prāpnuyātkvāpi mānavaḥ || 82 || sthaleśvarānmahāliṃgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ paraṃtviha || yatra yajñeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sarvaliṃgaphalapradam || 83 || mahāliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya mahāśraddhāsamanvitaḥ || mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti loketra ca paratra ca || 84 || iha liṃgaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ suvarṇākhyātsamāgatam || yasya saṃdarśanātpuṃsāṃ jñānacakṣuḥ prajāyate || 85|| śaileśvarādavācyāṃ tu sahasrākṣeśvaraṃ vibhum || dṛṣṭvā janmasahasrāṇāṃ śatānāṃ pātakaṃ tyajet || 86 || harṣitāddharṣitaṃ cātra prādurāsīttamoharam || liṃgaṃharṣapradaṃ puṃsāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi || 87 || maṃtreśvara samīpe tu prāsādo harṣiteśituḥ || tadvilokanataḥ puṃsāṃ nityaṃ harṣa paraṃparā || 88 || iha svayaṃ samāyāto rudro rudramahālayāt || yasya darśanato yāṃti rudraloke narāḥ sphuṭam || 89 || yaistu rudreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāmatra samarcitam || te rudrarūpiṇo martyā vijñeyā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4.2.69.90 || tripureśa samīpe tu dṛṣṭvā rudreśvaraṃ vibhum || rudrāsta iva vijñeyā jīvaṃtopi mṛtā api ||91|| āgādiha mahādevo vṛṣeśo vṛṣabhadhvajāt || bāṇeśvarasya liṃgasya samīpe vṛṣadaḥ sadā ||92|| ihāgataṃ tu kedārādīśāneśvara saṃjñitam || taddraṣṭavyaṃ pratīcyāṃ ca liṃgaṃ prahlādakeśavāt|| 93 || īśāneśaṃ samabhyarcya snātvottaravahāṃbhasi || vasedīśānanagare īśānasadṛśaprabhaḥ || 94 || bhairavādbhairavī mūrtiratrāyātā manoharā || saṃhārabhairavo nāma draṣṭavyaḥ sa prayatnataḥ || 95 || pūjanātsarvasiddhyai sa prācyāṃ kharvavināyakāt || saṃhārabhairavaḥ kāśyāṃ saṃharedaghasaṃtatim || 96 || ugraḥ kanakhalāttīrthādāvirāseha siddhidaḥ || tadvilokanato nṛṇāmugraṃ pāpaṃ praṇaśyati || 97 || ugraṃ liṃgaṃ sadā sevyaṃ prācyāmarkavināyakāt || atyugrā api naśyeyurupasargāstadarcanāt || 98 || vastrāpathānmahākṣetrādbhavo nāma svayaṃ vibhuḥ || bhīmacaṃḍī samīpe tu prādurāsīdiha prabho || 99 || bhaveśvaraṃ samabhyarcya bhavenāvirbhavennaraḥ || prabhurbhavati sarveṣāṃ rājñāmājñākṛtāmiha || 4.2.69.100 || devadāruvanāddaṃḍī daṃḍayanpātakāvalīḥ || vārāṇasyāṃ samāgatya sthito liṃgākṛtirvibhuḥ ||101|| prācyāṃ daṃḍīśvaraḥ pūjyaḥ sa dehalivināyakāt || tasyārcanena marttyānāṃ na punarbhava īkṣyate || 102 || bhadrakarṇahradādatra bhadrakarṇahradānvitaḥ|| śivaḥ sākṣādihāyātaḥ sarveṣāṃ śivadorcitaḥ || 103 || uddaṃḍākhyādgaṇapateḥ prācyāṃ tattīrthamuttamam || bhadrakarṇahrade snātvābhyarcya liṃgaṃ śivāhvayam || 104 || sarvatra śivamāpnoti bhadrakarṇeśa pūjanāt || śṛṇuyātsarvabhūtānāṃ bhadraṃ paśyati cākṣibhiḥ|| 105 || śaṃkaraśca hariścaṃdrāttvatpuraḥ pratibhāsate || tatpūjanājjanānāṃ na jananījaṭhare janiḥ || 106 || yamaliṃgānmahātīrthātkālaliṃgamiha sthitam || kalaśeśa iti khyātaṃ caṃdreśātpaścimena ca || 107 || yamatīrthe naraḥ snātvā mitrāvaruṇadakṣiṇe || kālaliṃgaṃ samālokya kalikāla bhayaṃ kutaḥ || 108 || tatra bhaumacaturdaśyāṃ yastu yātrāṃ kariṣyati || api pātaka yuktaḥ sa yamayātrāṃ na yāsyati || 109 || naipālācca mahākṣetrādāyātpaśupatistviha || yatra pāśupato yoga upadiṣṭaḥ pinākinā || 4.2.69.110 || bhavatā devadevena brahmādibhyo vimuktaye || tasya saṃdarśanādeva paśupāśairviyujyate || 111 || karavīrakatīrthācca kapālīśa ihāgataḥ || kapālamocane tīrthe draṣṭavyaḥ sa prayatnataḥ || 112 || tadvilokanamātreṇa brahmahatyā vilīyate|| umāpatirdevikāyā ihāgatya vyavasthitaḥ || 113 || dṛṣṭaḥ paśupatiḥ prācyāṃ haretpāpaṃ cirārjitam || liṃgaṃ maheśvarakṣetrādiha dīpteśa saṃjñitam || 114 || upomāpati tiṣṭheta dīptyai ceha paratra ca || bhuktimukti pra daṃ liṃgaṃ dīpteśaṃ kāśimadhgam ||115|| kāyārohaṇataḥ kṣetrādācāryo nakulīśvaraḥ || śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtastiṣṭhenmahāpāśupatavrataiḥ || 116 || dakṣiṇe hi mahādevādṛṣṭo jñānaṃ prayacchati || ajñānaṃ nāśayetkṣipraṃ garbhasaṃsṛtihetukam || 117 || gaṃgāsāgarataścāyādamareśa itīritam || liṃgaṃ yaddarśanādeva nāmaratvaṃ hi durlabham ||118|| saptagodāvarītīrthāddevo bhīmeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || prakāśate liṃgarūpī bhuktyai muktyai nṛṇāmiha || 119 || nakulīśātpurobhāge dṛṣṭā bhīmeśvaraṃ prabhum|| mahābhīmāni pāpāni praṇaśyaṃti hi tatkṣaṇāt || 4.2.69.120 || bhūteśvarādbhasmagātraṃ prādurāsīdiha svayam || bhīmeśāddakṣiṇe bhāge tadabhyarcya prayatnataḥ || 121 || samyakpāśupatādyo gādabhyastācca samāḥ śatam || yatprāpyate phalaṃ tatsyādbhasmagātravilokanāt || 122 || nakulīśvarato devaḥ svayaṃbhūriti viśrutaḥ || ātmanāprakaṭībhūtaḥ kāśyāṃ liṃgākṛtirharaḥ || 123 || svayaṃbhu liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya snātvā siddhihrade naraḥ || mahālakṣmīśvara puro na bhūyo janmabhāgbhavet || 124 || prayāgatīrthanikaṣā prāsādo vidrumaprabhaḥ || vārāhasya mahāneṣa dharaṇīnāmna eva hi || 125 || viṃdhyaparvatataḥ prāpto devaṃ śrutvā samāgatam|| sagaṇaṃ sarṣidevaṃ ca maṃdarādatra kaṃdarāt||126|| kāśyāṃ dharaṇivārāho draṣṭavyaḥ sa prayatnataḥ|| āpatsamudrasaṃmagnamuddhareccharaṇāgatam|| 127 || karṇikārādgaṇādhyakṣaḥ karṇikāraprasūnaruk|| samarcyoyaṃ gadāhasta upasargasahasrahṛt ||128|| tasmāddharaṇivārāhātpratīcyāṃ diśi saṃsthitam || pūjayitvā gaṇādhyakṣaṃ gāṇapatyapadaṃ labhet || 129 || hemakūṭādvirūpākṣaṃ liṃgamatrāvirāsa ha || maheśvarādavācyāṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ saṃsāratārakam || 4.2.69.130 || gaṃgādvārāddhimastheśaṃ liṃgaṃ himasamaprabham || brahmanālātpratīcyāṃ ca draṣṭavyamiha siddhidam || 131 || gaṇādhipaśca kailāsādgaṇā anye mahābalāḥ || kailāsādreḥ samāyātāḥ saptakoṭimitāḥ prabho || 132 || durgāṇi taiḥ kṛtānīha saptasvargasamāni ca || sadvārāṇi sayaṃtrāṇi kapāṭavikaṭāni ca ||133|| koṭikoṭibhaṭāḍhyāni sarvarddhisahitānyapi || suvarṇarūpyatāmraiśca kāṃsyarītikasīsakaiḥ || 134 || ayaskāṃtena kāṃtāni dṛḍhānyabhraṃlihānyapi || tataḥ śailaṃ mahādurgaṃ taiḥ kāśīparitaḥ kṛtam|| 135 || parikhāpi kṛtā nimnā matsyodaryājalāvilā || matsyodarī dvidhā jātā bahiraṃtaścarā punaḥ || 136 || tacca tīrthaṃ mahatkhyātaṃ militaṃ gāṃgavāribhiḥ || yadā saṃhāramārgeṇa gaṃgābhaḥ prasarediha || 137 || tadā matsyodarī tīrthaṃ labhyate puṇyagauravāt || sūryācaṃdramasoḥ parvatadākoṭiguṇaṃ śatam || 138 || sarvaparvāṇi tatraiva sarvatīrthāni tatra vai || tatraiva sarvaliṃgāni gaṃgāmatsyodarīyataḥ || 139 || matsyodaryāṃ hi ye snātā yatrakutrāpi mānavāḥ || kṛtapiṃḍapradānāste na māturudareśayāḥ || 4.2.69.140 || avimuktamidaṃ kṣetraṃ matsyākāratvamāpnuyāt || paritaḥ svardhunīvāri saṃsāri parivīkṣyate || 141 || matsyodaryāṃ kṛtasnānā ye narāste narottamāḥ || kṛtvāpi bahupāpāni nekṣaṃte bhāskareḥ purīm ||142|| kiṃ snātvā bahutīrtheṣu kiṃ taptvā duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ || yadi matsyodarī snātā kuto garbhabhayaṃ tataḥ|| || 143|| yatrayatra hi liṃgāni nṛdevarṣikṛtānyapi || tatra matsyodarīṃ prāpya susnāto mokṣabhājanam ||144|| saṃti tīrthānyanekāni bhūrbhuvaḥsvargatānyapi || na samāni paraṃ tāni koṭyaṃśenāpi niścitam||145|| itthaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vibho kailāsavāsinā|| gaṇādhipena sumahatsumahodārakarmaṇā||146 || bhūrbhuvaḥsaṃjñakaṃ liṃgaṃ parvatādgaṃdhamādanāt|| svayamāvirabhūdatra tasmātprācyāṃ gaṇādhipāt|| 147 || vilokya bhūrbhuvaṃ liṃgaṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmahaḥ pare || nivasaṃti janāḥ puṇyāḥ suciraṃ divyabhoginaḥ || 148 || hāṭakeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ bhogavatyā samāyutam || saptapātālatalata ihāyātaṃ svayaṃ vibho || 149 || śeṣavāsukimukhyaiśca tatprāsādo mahāniha || maṇimāṇikyaratnaughairniramāyi prayatnataḥ || 4.2.69.150 || talliṃgaṃ hāṭakamayaṃ ratnamālābhirarcitam || īśāneśvarataḥ prācyāṃ pūjanīya prayatnataḥ || || 151 || bhaktito'bhyarcya talliṃgaṃ naraḥ sarvasamṛddhimān || bhuktvā bhogānasaṃkhyātānaṃte nivārṇamṛcchati||152|| ākāśāttārakālligaṃ jyotīrūpamihāgatam|| jñānavāpyāḥ purobhāge talliṃgaṃ tārakeśvaram || || 153|| tārakaṃ jñānamāpyeta talliṃgasya samarcanāt || jñānavāpyāṃ naraḥ snātvā tārakeśaṃ vilokya ca || 154 || kṛtasaṃdhyādi niyamaḥ paritarpya pitāmahān|| dhṛtamaunavrato dhīmānyāvalliṃga vilokanam || 155 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti śāśvatam || prāṃte ca tārakaṃ jñānaṃ yasmājjñānādvimucyate || 156 || kirātācca kirāteśa ihacāvirbabhūva ha || kirātarūpo bhagavānyatra devo'bhavatpurā || 157 || tatkirāteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ bhārabhūteśvarādanu || namaskṛtya naro jātu na māturudareśayaḥ || 158|| laṃkāpuryāḥ samāgacchanmarukeśvarasaṃjñakam || liṃgaṃ yadarcanātpuṃsāṃ na bhayaṃ rakṣasāṃ bhavet || 159 || nairkatyāṃ diśi talliṃgaṃ nirṛteśvarasaṃjñakam || paulastyarāghavātpaścātpūjitaṃ sarvaduṣṭahṛt || 4.2.69.160 || puṇyajalapriyaṃ liṃgaṃ jalaliṃgasthalādapi || āyātaṃ tacca gaṅgāyā jalamadhye vyavasthitam|| 161 || tatprāsādo'dbhutataro madhye gaṃgaṃ nirīkṣyate || sarvadhātumayaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvaratnamayaḥ śubhaḥ || 162 || adyāpi dṛśyate kaiścitpuṇyasaṃbhāragauravāt || śreṣṭhaṃ liṃgamihāyātaṃ tīrthātkoṭīśvarādapi || 163 || koṭiliṃge kṣaṇe puṇyaṃ talliṃgasya nirīkṣaṇāt || śreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭheśvarātpaścācchreṣṭha siddhipradāyakam|| 164 || vaḍavāsyātsamudbhūtaṃ liṃgamatrānaleśvaram || naleśvara purobhāge pūjitaṃ sarvasiddhidam|| 165 || āgatya virajastīrthāddevadevastrilocanaḥ || liṃge tvanādisaṃsiddhe hyavatasthe triviṣṭape || 166 || puṇye pilipilā tīrthe sarveṣāṃ tārakaprade || āviścakre svayadeva oṃkāromarakaṃṭakāt || 167 || tadādyaṃ tārakakṣetraṃ yadā gaṃgā na cāgatā || yadaivāvirabhūtkāśī trailokyoddhaṇāya vai ||168|| tadākṛtimahalliṃgaṃ svayamāvirabhūttataḥ|| mahimānaṃ na tasyānyaḥ parivetti vibhorṛte || 169 || etānyāyatanānīśa ānināya mahāṃti ca || śeṣayitvāṃśamātraṃ ca tasminkṣetre nije nije || 4.2.69.170 || ihāyātāni puṇyāni sarvabhāvena nānyathā|| prāsādāḥ sarvataścaiṣāṃ ramyā abhraṃlihā vibho ||171|| bahudhātumayāścitrāḥ sarvaratnasamujjvalāḥ || yeṣāṃ kalaśamātrasya darśanānmuktirāpyate||172|| śrutvāpi nāma caiteṣāṃ liṃgānāṃ surasattama || api janmasahasrotthāḥ kṣīyaṃte pāparāśayaḥ || 173 || idānīṃ ko nideśotra mayānuṣṭheya īśitaḥ || prasādī kriyatāṃso pi siddho maṃtavya eva hi || 174 || || skaṃda uvāca || || śrutveti naṃdino vākyaṃ devadeveśvaro haraḥ || śraddhā prasādya śailādimidaṃ provāca kuṃbhaja || 175 || || śrīdevadeva uvāca || || sādhūkṛtaṃ tvayā naṃdinsadānaṃda vidhāyaka || vidhehi me nideśaṃ ca caṃḍīrvyāpārayādhunā
