||176|| navakoṭyastu cāmuṃḍāyāyatra nivasaṃti hi || svadevatābhiḥ sahitā bhūtavetāla bhairavaiḥ || 177 || tāḥ purī rakṣaṇārthāya savāhanabalāyudhāḥ || pratidurgaṃ durgarūpāḥ paritaḥ parivāsaya || 178 || || skaṃda uvāca || naṃdinaṃ saṃnideśyeti mṛḍānyā sahito mṛḍaḥ || yayau traiviṣṭapaṃ kṣetraṃ muktibījaprarohaṇam || 179 || śilādatanayopyaiśīṃ mūrddhanyājñāṃ vidhāya ca || āhūya sarvato durgāḥ pratidurgaṃ nyaveśayat || 4.2.69.180 || niśamyādhyāyametaṃ ca puṇyāyatana garbhiṇam|| naraḥ svargāpavargau ca prāpnuyācchraddhayā kramāt || 181 || śrutvāṣṭaṣaṣṭimetāṃ vai mahāyatana saṃśrayām || na jātu praviśenmartyo jananyā jāṭharīṃ darīm || 182 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe uttarārdhe'ṣṭaṣaṣṭyāyatanasamāgamo nāmaikonasaptatitamodhyāyaḥ || 69 || ||
<4.2.70>
agastya uvāca || kātyāyaneya kathaya naṃdinā viśvanaṃdinā || yathā vyāpāritā devyo devadevanideśataḥ || 1 || avimuktasya rakṣārthaṃ yatra yā devatāḥ sthitāḥ || prasādaṃ kuru me deva tāḥ samācakṣva tattvataḥ || 2 || ityagastyuditaṃ śrutvā mahādevatanūdbhavaḥ || kathayāmāsa yā yatra sthitā''naṃdavane mudā || 3 || skaṃda uvāca || || vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī kṣetrasya parameṣṭadā || viśālatīrthaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ kṛtvā pṛṣṭhe vyavasthitā || 4 || snātvā viśālatīrthe vai viśālākṣīṃ praṇamya ca || viśālāṃ labhate lakṣmīṃ paratreha ca śarmadām || 5 || bhādrakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāmupoṣaṇaparairnṛbhiḥ || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau viśālākṣīsamīpataḥ || 6 || prātarbhojyāḥ prayatnena caturdaśakumārikāḥ || alaṃkṛtā yathāśaktyā sragaṃbaravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||7|| vidhāya pāraṇaṃ paścātputrabhṛtyasamanvitaiḥ|| samyagvārāṇasīvāsaphalaṃ labhyeta kuṃbhaja || 8 || tasyāṃ tithau mahāyātrā kāryā kṣetranivāsibhiḥ || upasarga praśāṃtyarthaṃ nirvāṇakamalāptaye || 9 || vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ || dhūpadīpaiḥ śubhairmālyairupahārairmanoharaiḥ ||4.2.70.10|| maṇimuktādyalaṃkārairvicitrolloca cāmaraiḥ || śubhairanupabhuktaiśca dukūlairgaṃdhavāsitaiḥ || 11|| mokṣalakṣmī samṛddhyarthaṃ yatrakutra nivāsibhiḥ || apyalpamapi yaddattaṃ viśālākṣyai narottamaiḥ || 12 || tadānaṃtyāya jāyaṃta mune lokadvayepi hi || viśālākṣī mahāpīṭhe dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ stutam || 13 || mokṣastasya parīpāko nātra kāryā vicāṇā || viśālākṣī samarcāto rūpasaṃpattiyukpatiḥ ||14 || prāpyatetra kumārībhirguṇaśīlādyalaṃkṛtaḥ || gurviṇībhiḥ sutanayo vaṃdhyābhigarbhasaṃbhavaḥ || 15 || asaubhāgyavatībhiśca saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpyate || vidhavābhirna vaidhavyaṃ punarjanmāṃtare kvacit|| || 16 || sīmaṃtinībhiḥ puṃbhirvā paraṃ nirvāṇamicchubhiḥ || śrutā dṛṣṭārcitā kāśyāṃ viśālākṣyabhilāṣadā ||17|| tatonyallalitātīrthaṃ gaṃgākeśavasannidhau || tatrāsti lalitā devī kṣetrarakṣākarī parā || 18 || sā ca pūjyā prayatnena sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhaye || lalitāpūjakānāṃ ca jātu vighno na jāyate || 19 || iṣe kṛṣṇadvitīyāyāṃ lalitāṃ paripūjya vai || nārī vā puruṣo vāpi labhate vāṃchitaṃ padam || 4.2.70.20 || snātvā ca lalitā tīrthe lalitāṃ praṇipatya vai || labhetsarvatra lālityaṃ yadvā tadvā'nulapya ca || 21 || mune viśvabhujā gaurī viśālākṣī puraḥ sthitā || saṃharaṃtī mahāvighnaṃ kṣetrabhaktijuṣāṃ sadā || 22 || śāradaṃ navarātraṃ ca kāryā yātrā prayatnataḥ || devyā viśvabhujāyā vai sarvakāmasamṛddhaye ||23|| yo na viśvabhujāṃ devīṃ vārāṇasyāṃ namennaraḥ || kuto mahopasargebhyastasya śāṃtirdurātmanaḥ || 24 || yaistu viśvabhujā devī vārāṇasyāṃ stutārcitā || na hi tānvighnasaṃghāto bādhate sukṛtātmanaḥ || 25 || anyāsti kāśyāṃ vārāhī kratuvārāhasannidhau || tāṃ praṇamya naro bhaktyā vipadabdhau na majjati || 26 || śivadūtī tu tatraiva draṣṭavyā''padvināśinī || ānaṃdavanarakṣārthamudyacchūlāritarjanī || 27 || vajrahastā tathā caiṃdrī gajarāja rathāsthitā || iṃdreśāddakṣiṇebhāge'rcitā saṃpatkarī sadā || 28 || skaṃdeśvara samīpe tu kaumārī barhiyānagā || prekṣaṇīyā prayatnena mahāphalasamṛddhaye || 29 || maheśvarāddakṣiṇato devī māheśvarī naraiḥ || vṛṣayānavatī pūjyā mahāvṛṣasamṛddhidā || 4.2.70.30 || nirvāṇanarasiṃhasya samīpe mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ || nārasiṃhī samarcyā ca samudyaccakra ramyadoḥ || 31 || haṃsayānavatī brāhmī brahmeśātpaścime sthitā || galatkamaṃḍalujala culakā tāḍitā hitā || 32 || brahmavidyā prabodhārthaṃ kāśyāṃ pūjyā dinedine || brāhmaṇairyatibhirnityaṃ nijatattvāvabodhibhiḥ || 33 || śārṅgacāpavinirmukta maheṣubhiritastataḥ || utsādayaṃtīṃ pratyūhānkāśyāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ śrayet || 34 || pratīcyāṃgopigoviṃdādbhrāmyaccakrocca tarjanīm|| nārāyaṇīṃ yaḥ praṇamettasya kāśyāṃ mahodayaḥ||35|| tato gaurīṃ virūpākṣa devayānyā udagdiśi || pūjayitvā naro bhaktyā vāṃchitāṃ labhate śriyam || 36 || śaileśvarī samabhyarcyā śaileśvara samīpagā || tarjayaṃtī ca tarjanyā saṃsargamupasargajam || 37 || citrakūpe naraḥ snātvā vicitraphalade nṛṇām || citragupteśvaraṃ vīkṣya citraghaṃṭāṃ prapūjya ca || 38 || bahupātakayuktopi tyaktadharmapathopi vā || na citraguptalekhyaḥ syāccitraghaṃṭārcako naraḥ || 39 || yoṣidvā puruṣo vāpi citraghaṃṭāṃ na yorcayet || kāśyāṃ vighnasahasrāṇi taṃ sevaṃte padepade ||4.2.70.40|| caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ kāryā yātrā prayatnataḥ || mahāmahotsavaḥ kāryo niśi jāgaraṇaṃ tathā || 41 || mahāpūjopakaraṇaiścitraghaṃṭāṃ samarcya ca || śṛṇoti nāṃtakasyeha ghaṃṭāṃ mahiṣakaṃṭhagām || 42 || citrāṃgadeśvaraprācyāṃ citragrīvāṃ praṇamya ca || na jātu jaṃturvīkṣeta vicitrāṃ yamayātanām || 43 || bhadrakālīṃ naro dṛṣṭvā nābhadraṃ paśyati kvacit|| bhadranāgasya purato bhadravāpyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ || 44 || harasiddhiṃ prayatnena pūjayitvā narottamaḥ || mahāsiddhimavāpnoti prācyāṃ siddhivināyakāt || 45 || vidhiṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadvividhairupahārakaiḥ || vividhāṃ labhate siddhiṃ vidhīśvarasamīpagām || 46 || prayāgatīrthe susnāto jano nigaḍabhaṃjanīm || sabhājayitvā no jātu nigaḍaiḥ paribādhyate || 47 || bhaumavāre sadā pūjyā devīnigaḍabhaṃjanī || kṛtvaikabhuktaṃ bhaktyātra baṃdīmokṣaṇakāmyayā || 48 || saṃsārabaṃdhavicchittimapi yacchati sārcitā || gaṇanā śṛṃkhalādīnāṃ kā ca tasyāḥ samarcanāt ||49|| dūrasthopi hi yo baṃdhuḥ sopi kṣipraṃ sameṣyati || baṃdī padajuṣāṃ puṃsāṃ śraddhayā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4.2.70.50 || kiṃcinniyamamālaṃbya yadi sā pariṣevitā || kāmānpūrayati kṣipraṃ kāśī saṃdehahāriṇī || 51 || ghanaṭaṃkakarā devī bhaktabaṃdhanabhedinī || kaṃ kaṃ na pūrayetkāmaṃ tīrtharājasamīpagā || 52 || devī paśu'pateḥ paścādamṛteśvara sannidhau || snātvā caivāmṛte kūpe namanīyā prayatnataḥ || 53 || pūjayitvā naro bhaktyā devatāmamṛteśvarīm || amṛtatvaṃ bhajedeva tatpādāṃbuja sevanāt || 54 || dhārayaṃtīṃ mahāmāyāmamṛtasya kamaṃḍalum || dakṣiṇe'bhayadāṃ vāme dhyātvā ko nā'mṛtatvabhāk ||55|| siddhalakṣmī jagaddhātrī pratīcyāmamṛteśvarāt || prapitāmaha liṃgasya purataḥ siddhidārcitā ||56|| prāsādaṃ siddhalakṣmyāśca vilokya kamalākṛtim || lakṣmīvilāsasaṃjñaṃ ca ko na lakṣmīṃ samāpnuyāt ||57|| tataḥ kubjā jaganmātā nalakūvaraliṃgataḥ || pūjanīyā purobhāge prapitāmahapaścime || 58 || upasargā na śeṣāṃśca kubjā harati pūjitā || tasmātkubjā prayatnena pūjyā kāśyāṃ śubhārthibhiḥ || 59 || kubjāṃbareśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ nalakūbara paścime || trilokasuṃdarī gaurī tatrārcyābhīṣṭadāyinī || 4.2.70.60 || trilokasuṃdarī siddhiṃ dadyāttrailokyasuṃdarīm || vaidhavyaṃ nāpyate kvāpi tasyā devyāḥ samarcanāt || 61 || dīptā nāma mahāśaktiḥ sāṃbādityasamīpagā || dedīpyamāna lakṣmīkā jāyaṃte tatsamarcanāt || 62 || śrīkaṃṭha sannidhau devī mahālakṣmīrjagajjaniḥ || snātvā śrīkuṃḍa tīrthe tu samarcyā jagadaṃbikā || 63 || pitṝnsaṃtarpya vidhivattīrthe śrīkuṃḍasaṃjñite || dattvā dānāni vidhivanna lakṣmyā parimucyate || 64 || lakṣmīkṣetraṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ sādhakasyaiva siddhidam || sādhakastatra maṃtrāṃśca naraḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt || 65 || saṃti pīṭhanyanekāni kāśyāṃ siddhikarāṇyapi || mahālakṣmīpīṭhasamaṃ nānyallakṣmīkaraṃ param || 66 || mahālakṣmyaṣṭamīṃ prāpya tatra yātrā kṛtāṃ nṛṇām || saṃpūjiteha vidhivatpadmā sadma na muṃcati || 67 || uttare tu mahālakṣmyā hayakaṃṭhīkuṭhāradhṛk || kāśīvighramahāvṛkṣāṃśchinatti prativāsaram || 68 || kaurmī śaktirmahālakṣmī dakṣiṇe pāśapāṇikā || badhnāti vighnasaṃghātaṃ kṣetrasyāsya pratikṣaṇam|| 69 || sā pūjitāstutā martyaiḥ kṣetrasiddhiṃ prayacchati|| vāyavyāṃ ca śikhī caṃḍī kṣetrarakṣākarī parā || 4.2.70.70 || khādaṃtī vighnasaṃghātaṃ śikhī śabdaṃ karoti ca || tasyāḥ saṃdarśanātpuṃsāṃ naśyaṃti vyādhayokhilāḥ|| 71 || bhīmacaṃḍyuttaradvāraṃ sadā rakṣedataṃdritā || bhīmeśvarasya purataḥ pāśamudgaradhāriṇīm || 72 || bhīmacaṃḍīṃ naro dṛṣṭvā bhīmakuṃḍe kṛtodakaḥ || bhīmākṛtīnna vai paśyedyāmyāndūtānkvacitkṛtī ||73|| chāgavaktreśvarī devī dakṣiṇe vṛṣabhadhvajāt || aharniśaṃ bhakṣayati vighnaughatarupallavān|| || 74 || tasyā devyāḥ prasādena kāśīvāsaḥ pralabhyate || ataśchāgeśvarīṃ devīṃ mahāṣṭamyāṃ prapūjayet ||75|| tālajaṃgheśvarī devī tālavṛkṣakṛtāyudhā || utsādayati vighnaughānānaṃdavana madhyagān || 76 || saṃgameśvara liṃgasya dakṣiṇe vikaṭānanām || tālajaṃgheśvarīṃ natvā na vighnairabhibhūyate ||77|| uddālakeśvarālliṃgāttīrthaṃ uddālakābhidhe || yāmyāṃ ca yamadaṃṣṭrākhyā carvayedvighnasaṃhatim || 78 || praṇatā yamadaṃṣṭrāyaistīrthecoddālakābhidhe || kṛtvāpi pāpasaṃghātaṃ na yamādbibhyatīhate || || 79 || dārukeśvara tīrthe tu dārukeśasamīpataḥ || pātālatāluvadanāmākāśoṣṭhīṃ dharādharām || 4.2.70.80 || kapālakartrīṃ hastāṃ ca brahmāṃḍakavalapriyām || śuṣkodarīṃ snāyubaddhāṃ carmamuṃḍeti viśrutām || 81 || kṣetrasya pūrvadigbhāgaṃ rakṣaṃtī vighnasaṃghataḥ || lasatsahasradordaṃḍāṃ jvalatkekaravīkṣaṇām || 82 || pārāvāraprasṛmara hasta nyastāri modakām || dvīpi kṛttiparīdhānāṃ kaṭukāṭṭāṭṭahāsinīm || 83 || mṛṇālanālavattīvraṃ carvaṃtīmasthi pāpinaḥ || śūlāgraprota durvṛtta kṣetradrohikalevarām || 84 || kapālamālābharaṇāṃ mahābhīṣaṇarūpiṇīm || carmamuṃḍāṃ naro natvā kṣetravighnairna bādhyate || 85 || yathaiva carmamuṃḍaiṣā mahāruṃḍāpi tādṛśī|| etāvāneva bhedosyā ruṃḍasragbhūṣaṇātviyam || 86 || kṣetrarakṣāṃ prakuruta ubhedevyau mahābale || hasaṃtyau karatālībhiranyonyaṃ doḥ prasāraṇāt ||87|| hayagrīveśvare tīrthe lolārkāduttare sadā || mahāruṃḍā pracaṃḍāsyā tiṣṭhate bhaktavighnahṛt ||88|| carmamuṃḍā mahāruṃḍā kathite ye tu devate || tayoraṃtaratastiṣṭheccāmuṃḍā muṃḍarūpiṇī || 89 || etāstisraḥ prayatnena pūjyāḥ kṣetranivāsibhiḥ || dhanadhānyapradāścaitāḥ putrapautrapradā imāḥ || 4.2.70.90 || upasargānamūrghnaṃti dadyurnaiḥśreyasīṃ śriyam || smṛtā dṛṣṭā na tāḥ spṛṣṭāḥ pūjitāḥ śraddhayā naraiḥ || 91 || mahāruṃḍā pratīcyāṃ ca devī svapneśvarī śubhā || bhaviṣyaṃ kathayetsvapne bhaktasyāgre śubhāśubham || 92 || tatra svapneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ devīṃ svapneśvarīṃ tathā|| snātvāsisaṃgame puṇye yasminkasmiṃstithāvapi || 93 || upoṣaṇaparo dhīmānnārīvā puruṣopi vā || saṃpūjya sthaṃḍilaśayaḥ svapne bhāvi vilokayet ||94|| adyāpi pratyayastatra kārya eṣa vijānatā || bhūtaṃ bhāvi bhavatsarvaṃ vadetsvapneśvarī niśi||95|| aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ niśi vā divā|| prayatnataḥ samarcyā sā kāśyāṃ jñānārthibhirnaraiḥ || 96 || svapneśvaryāśca vāruṇyāṃ durgādevī vyavasthitā || kṣetrasya dakṣiṇaṃ bhāgaṃ sā sadaivābhirakṣati || 97 || iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe devatādhiṣṭhānaṃnāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||
<4.2.71>
|| agastya uvāca || || kathaṃ durgeti vai nāma devyā jātaṃmumāsuta || kathaṃ ca kāśyāṃ sā sevyā samācakṣveti māmiha || 1|| || skaṃda uvāca || || kathayāmi mahābuddhe yathā kalaśasaṃbhava || durgā nāmābhavaddevyā yathā sevyā ca sādhakaiḥ || 2 || durgo nāma madādaityo ruru daityāṃgajobhavat|| yaśca taptvā tapastīvraṃ puṃbhyojeyatvamāptavān || 3 || tatastenākhilā lokā bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmukhā api || svasātkṛtā vinirjitya raṇe svabhujasārataḥ || 4 || svayamiṃdraḥ svayaṃ vāyuḥ svayaṃ caṃdraḥ svayaṃ yamaḥ || svayamagniḥ svayaṃ pāśī dhanadobhūtsvayaṃ balī || 5 || svayamīśānarudrārka vasūnāṃ padamādade || tatsādhvasādvimuktāni tapāṃsyati tapasvibhiḥ||6 || na vedādhyayanaṃ cakrurbrāhmaṇāstadbhayāditāḥ || yajñavāṭā vinirdhvastāstadbhaṭairatiduḥsahaiḥ || 7 || vidhvastā bahuśaḥ sādhvyastairamārgakṛtāspadaiḥ || prasabhaṃ ca parasvāni apahṛtya durāsadāḥ || 8 || abhokṣiṣurdurācārāḥ krūrakarmaparigrahāḥ || nadyo vimārgagā āsañjvalaṃti na tathāgnayaḥ||9|| jyotīṃṣi na pradīpyaṃti tadbhayākulitānyaho || digvadhūvasananyāsanvicchāyāni samaṃtataḥ || 4.2.71.10 || dharmakriyāviluptāśca pravṛttāḥ sukṛtetarāḥ || ta eva jaladībhūya vavṛṣurnija līlayā || 11 || sasyāni tadbhayātsūte tvanuptāpi vasuṃdharā|| sadaiva phalino jātāstaravopyavakeśinaḥ ||12|| baṃdīkṛtāḥ surarṣīṇāṃ patnyastenātidarpiṇā || divaukasaḥ kṛtāstena samastāḥ kānanaukasaḥ || 13 || martyā amartyānsvagṛhaṃ prāptānapi bhayārditāḥ || api saṃbhāṣamātreṇa nārccayaṃti vipajjuṣaḥ || 14 || || skaṃda uvāca || na kaulīnyaṃ na sadvṛttaṃ mahattvāya prakalpate || ekameva padaṃ śreyaḥ padabhraṃśo hi lāghavam || 15 || vipadyapi hi te dhanyā na ye dainyapraṇoditāḥ || dhanairmalinacittānāmālabhaṃteṃgaṇaṃ kvacit || 16 || paṃcatvameva hi varaṃ loke lāghavavarjjitam || nāmaratvamapi śreyo lāghavena samanvitam || 17 || ta eva loke jīvaṃti puṇyabhājasta eva vai || vipadyapi na gāṃbhīryaṃ yaccetobdhiḥ parityajet || 18 || kadācitsaṃpadudayaḥ kadācidvipadudgamaḥ || daivāddvayamapi prāpya dhīro dhairyaṃ na hāpayet || 19 || udayānudayau prājñairdraṣṭavyau puṣpavaṃtayoḥ || sadaikarūpatā'tyājyā harṣāharṣau tato'dhruvau || 4.2.71.20 || yastvāpadaṃ samāsādya dainyagrasto vipadyate || tasya lokadvayaṃ naṣṭaṃ tasmāddainyaṃ vivarjayet || 21 || āpadyapi hi ye dhīrā iha loke paratra ca || na tānpunaḥ spṛśedāpattaddhairyeṇāvadhīritā || 22 || bhraṣṭarājyāśca vibudhā maheśaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || sarvajñena tato devīpreritā'suramardane ||23|| māheśvarīṃ samāsādya bhavānyājñāṃ prahṛṣṭavat || amartyāyā'bhayaṃ dattvā samarāyopacakrame ||24|| kālarātrīṃ samāhūya kāṃtyā trailokyasuṃdarīm || preṣayāmāsa rudrāṇī tamāhvātuṃ suradruham || 25 || kālarātrī samāsādya taṃ daityaṃ duṣṭaceṣṭitam || uvāca daityādhipate tyaja trailokyasaṃpadam || 26 || trilokīṃ labhatāmiṃdrastvaṃ tu yāhi rasātalam || pravartaṃtāṃ kriyāḥ sarvā vedoktā vedavādinām || 27 || atha cedgarvaleśo'sti tadāyāhi samājaye || athavā jīvitākāṃkṣī tadiṃdraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja || 28 || iti vaktuṃ mahādevyā mahāmaṃgalarūpayā || tvadaṃtike preṣitāhaṃ mṛtyuste tadupekṣayā ||29|| ato yaducitaṃ kartuṃ tadvidhehi mahāsura || paraṃ hitaṃ cecchṛṇuyājjīvagrāhaṃ tato vraja || 4.2.71.30 || ityākarṇya vaco devyā mahākālyāḥ sa daityarāṭ || prajajvāla tadā krodhādgṛhyatāṃ gṛhyatāmiyam || 31 || trailokyamohinī hyeṣā prāptā madbhāgyagauravaiḥ || trailokyarājyasaṃpatti vallyāḥ phalamidaṃ mahat || 32 || etadarthaṃ hi devarṣi nṛpā baṃdī kṛtā mayā || anāyāsena me prāptā gṛhameṣā śubhodayāt || 33 || avaśyaṃ yasya yogyaṃ yattattasyehopatiṣṭhate || araṇye vā gṛhe vāpi yato bhāgyasya gauravāt || 34 || aṃtaḥpuracarā etāṃ nayaṃtvaṃtaḥpuraṃ mahat || anayā sadalaṃ kṛtyā mama rāṣṭramalaṃkṛtam || 35 || aho mahodayaścādya jāto mama mahāmate || kevalaṃ na mamaikasya sarvadaityānvayasya ca || 36 || nṛtyaṃtu pitaraścādya modaṃtāṃ bāṃdhavāḥ sukham || mṛtyuḥ kāloṃ'tako devāḥ prāpnuvaṃtvadya me bhayam || 37 || iti yāvatsamāyātāstāṃ netuṃ sauvidallakāḥ || tāvattayā kālarātryā pratyukto daityapuṃgavaḥ|| || 38 || || kālarātryuvāca || || daityarāja mahāprājña naitadyuktaṃ bhavādṛśām || vayaṃ dūtyaḥ paravaśā rājanītividuttama || 39 || alpopi dūtasaṃbādhāṃ na vidadhyātkadācana || kiṃ punarye bhavādṛkṣā mahāṃto balino'dhipāḥ || 4.2.71.40 || dūtīṣu konurāgoyaṃ mahārājālpikāsviha || anāyāsena ca vayamāyāsyāmastadāgamāt || 41 || vijitya samare tāṃ tu svāminīṃ mama daityapa || mādṛśīnāṃ sahasraṇi paribhuṃkṣva yathecchayā ||42|| adyaiva te mahāsaukhyaṃ bhāvitasyāvilokanāt|| bāṃdhavānāṃ sukhaṃ tedya bhavitā saha pūrvajaiḥ || 43 || saṃpatsyaṃte'dya te kāmāḥ sarve ye ciraciṃtitāḥ || abalā sā ca mugdhā ca tasyāstrātā na kaścana || 44 || sarvarūpamayī caiva tāṃ bhavāndraṣṭumarhati || ahaṃ hi darśayiṣyāmi yatra sā'sti jagatkhaniḥ || 45 || dhṛtāyāmapi caikasyāṃ kaste kāmo bhaviṣyati || ahaṃ te sannidhiṃ naiva tyakṣyāmyadya dināvadhi || 46 || tato nivārayaitānmāmāditsūnsauvidallakān || iti śrutvā vacastasyāḥ sa kāmakrodhamohitaḥ || 47 || tāmeva bahvamaṃstaikāṃ dūtīṃ mṛtyorivāsuraḥ || śuddhāṃtarakṣiṇaścaitāṃ śuddhāṃ taṃ prāpayaṃtvaram || 48 || iti tena samādiṣṭāḥ sarve varpavarā mune || tāṃ dhartumudyamaṃ cakrurbalena balavattarāḥ || 49 || sā tānbhasmīcakārāśu huṃkārajanitāgninā || tato daityapatiḥ kruddho dṛṣṭvā tānbhasmasātkṛtān || 4.2.71.50 || kṣaṇenaiva tayā dūtyā daittyāstryayutasaṃmitān || dṛśā vyāpārayāmāsa durdharaṃ durmukhaṃ kharam || 51 || sīrapāṇiṃ pāśapāṇiṃ sureṃdradamanaṃ hanum || yajñāriṃ khaṅgalomānamugrāsyaṃ devakaṃpanam || || 52 || baddhvā pāśairimāṃ duṣṭāmānayaṃtvāśu dānavāḥ || vidhvastakeśaveśāṃ ca vistrastāṃbarabhūṣaṇām || 53 || iti daityādhipādeśāddurdharapramukhāstataḥ || pāśāsimudgaradharāstāmādātuṃ kṛtodyamāḥ || 54 || girīṃdraguruvarṣmāṇaḥ śastrāstrodyatapāṇayaḥ || digaṃtaṃ te pariprāptāstaducchvāsānilāhatāḥ || 55 || teṣūḍḍīneṣu daityeṣu śatakoṭimiteṣu ca || nirjagāma tataḥ sā tu kālarātrirnabhodhvagā || 56 || tatastāṃ tu viniryāṃtīmanujagmurmahāsurāḥ|| koṭikoṭisahasrāṇi pūrayitvā tu rodasī || 57 || durgonāma mahādaityaḥ śatakoṭi rathāvṛtaḥ || gajānāmarbudaśatadvayenapārivāritaḥ || 58 || koṭyarbudena sahito hayānāṃ vātaraṃhasām || padātibhirasaṃkhyātaiḥ paccūrṇitaśiloccayaiḥ || 59 || udāyudhairmahābhīmaiḥkṛtatrijagatībhayaiḥ || sametaḥ sa mahādaityo durgaḥ kruddho viniryayau || 4.2.71.60 || atha dṛṣṭvā mahādevī viṃdhyācalakṛtālayām || āgatya kālarātryāṃ ca nivedita tadāgasam || 61 || mahābhujasahasrāḍhayāṃ mahātejobhibṛṃhitām || tattadghorapraharaṇāṃ raṇakautukasādarām || 62 || praudyaccaṃdrasahasrāṃśu nirmārjita śubhānanām || lāvaṇyavārdhi nirgacchaccaṃcaccaṃdraikacaṃdrikām || 63 || mahāmāṇikyanicaya rociḥkhacitavigrahām || trailokyaramyanagarī suprakāśapradīpikām ||64|| haranetrāgninirdagdha kāmajīvātuvīrudham || lasatsauṃdaryasaṃbhāra jaganmohamahauṣadhim || 65 || viṣameṣu śarairbhinnahṛdayo daityapuṃgavaḥ || ādiṣṭavānmahāsainyanāyakānupraśāsanaḥ || 66 || ayi jaṃbha mahājaṃbha kujaṃbha vikaṭānana || laṃbodara mahākāya mahādaṃṣṭra mahāhano || 67 || piṃgākṣa mahiṣagrīva mahogrātyugravigraha || krūrākṣa krodhanākraṃda saṃkraṃdana mahābhaya || 68 || jitāṃtaka mahābāho mahāvaktra mahīdhara || duṃdubhe duṃdubhirava mahāduṃdubhināsika || 69 || ugrāsya dīrghadaśanamevakeśa vṛkānana || siṃhāsya sūkaramukha śivārāva mahotkaṭa || 4.2.71.70 || śukatuṃḍa pracaṃḍāsya bhīmākṣa kṣudamānasa || ulūkanetra kaṃkāsya kākatuṃḍa karālavāk ||71|| dīrghagrīva mahājaṃgha kramelaka śirodhara || raktabiṃdo japānetra vidyujjihvāgnitāpana || 72 || dhūmrākṣa dhūmaniḥśvāsa caṃḍacaṃḍāṃśutāpana || mahābhīṣaṇamukhyāśca śṛṇvaṃtvājñāṃ mamādarāt || 73 || bhavatsveteṣu cānyeṣu etāṃ viṃdhyavāsinīm|| dhṛtyāneṣyati buddhyā vā balenāpi cchalena vā ||74|| tasyāhamiṃdrapadavīmadya dāsyāmyasaṃśayam|| dṛṣṭvaitāṃ suṃdarīmadya mano me vyākulaṃ bhavet || 72|| yāṃtu kṣipraṃ nayāvanme paṃceṣu śarapīḍitam || manovihvalatāṃ gacchedetatprāpterabhāvataḥ ||76|| ityākarṇya vacastasya durgasya danujeśituḥ || procuḥ sarve tadā daityāḥ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭāḥ || 77 || avadhehi mahārāja kimetatkarmaduṣkaram || anāthāyāstathaikasyā abalayā viśeṣataḥ || 78|| asyā ānayane koyaṃ mahāyatnavidhiḥ prabho || ko'smānpralayakālāgnimahājvālāvalīsamān || 79 || saheta triṣu lokeṣu tvatprasādātkṛtodyamān || yadyādeśo bhavedadya tadeṃdraṃ sa marudgaṇam || 4.2.71.80 || sāṃtaḥpuraṃ samānīya kṣipnumastvatpadāgrataḥ || bhūrbhuvaḥsvaridaṃ sarvaṃ tvadājñāvaśavartitam || 81 || maharjanastapaḥsatyalokāstvadadhikāriṇaḥ || tatrāpyasādhyaṃ nāsmākaṃ tvannideśānmahāsura || 82 || vaikuṃṭhanāyako nityaṃ tvadājñāparipālakaḥ || yāni ramyāṇi ratnāni tāni saṃpreṣayanmudā ||83|| asmābhireva saṃtyaktaḥ kailāsādhipatiḥ sa vai || vipāśī cātiniḥsvatvādbhasmakṛttyahibhūṣaṇaḥ|| 84 || ardhāṃgenāsmadbhayato yoṣidekā nigūhitā || tasya grāmepi sakale dvitīyo na catuṣpadaḥ || 85 || eko'jaradgavaḥ sopi nānyasmātparijīvati || śmaśānavāsinaḥ sarve sarve kaupīnavāsasaḥ ||86|| sarve vibhūtidhavalā sarvepyeka kaparddinaḥ || samaste nagare tasya vasaṃtyevaṃvidhā gaṇāḥ||87|| teṣāṃ gaṇānāṃ kiṃ kurmo daridrāṇāṃ vayaṃ vibho || samudrā ratnasaṃbhāraṃ pratyahaṃ preṣayaṃti ca || 88 || nāgā varākāścāsmākaṃ sāyaṃsāyaṃ svayaṃ prabho || pradīpayaṃti satataṃ phaṇā ratnapradīpakān || 89 || kalpadrumaḥ kāmagavī ciṃtāmaṇigaṇā bahu || tava prasādādasmākamapi tiṣṭhaṃti veśmasu || 4.2.71.90 || vāyurvyajanatāṃ yātastvāṃ seveta prayatnataḥ || svacchānyaṃbūni varuṇaḥ pratyahaṃ pūrayatyaho || 91 || vāsāṃsi kṣālayedagniścaṃdraśchatradharaḥ svayam || sūryaḥ prakāśayennityaṃ krīḍāvāpyaṃbujāni ca ||92|| kastvatprasādaṃ nekṣeta martyāmartyorageṣu ca || sarve tvāmupajīvaṃti surā'surakhagādayaḥ || || 93 || paśya naḥ pauruṣaṃ rājannānayāmo balādimām|| ityuktvā yugapatsarve kṣubdhāstoyadhayo yathā ||94|| saṃvartakālamāsādya plāvituṃ jagatīmimām|| raṇatūrya ninādaśca samuttasthau samaṃtataḥ || 95 || romāṃcitā yacchravaṇātkātarā apyakātarāḥ || tato devā bhayatrastāścakaṃpe ca vasuṃdharā || 96 || kṣubdhā aṃbudhayaḥ sarve peturnakṣatramālikāḥ || rodasīmaṃḍalaṃ vyāptaṃ tena tūryaraveṇa vai || 97 || tato bhagavatī devī svaśarīrasamudbhavāḥ || śaktīrutpādayāmāsa śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||98|| tābhiḥ śaktibhireteṣāṃ balināṃ ditijanmanām || pratyekaṃ parito ruddha udvelaḥ sainyasāgaraḥ || 99 || śastrāstrāṇi mahādaityairyānyutsṛṣṭāni saṃgare|| tābhiḥ śaktibhirugrāṇi tṛṇīkṛtyojjhitānyaram || 4.2.71.100 || tatotikopapūrṇāste jaṃbhamukhyāḥ surārayaḥ || asi cakra bhuśuṃḍībhirgadāmudgaratomaraiḥ || 101 || bhiṃdipālaiśca parighaiḥ kuṃtaiḥ śalyaiśca śaktibhiḥ || ardhacaṃdraiḥ kṣurapraiśca nārācaiśca śilīmukhaiḥ || 102 || mahābhallaiḥ paraśubhirbhiṃdurairmarmabhedibhiḥ || vṛkṣopalamahāvarṣairvavṛṣurjaladā iva || 103 || atha sā viṃdhyanilayā mahāmāyā maheśvarī || ādāyoddaṃḍakodaṃḍaṃ vāyavyāstreṇa helayā || 104 || daityāstraśastrajālāni paricikṣepa dūrataḥ || tato mahāsuro durgo vīkṣya sainyaṃ nirāyudham || 105 || jvalaṃtīṃ śaktimādāya tāṃ devīṃ prati so'kṣipat || tāṃ tu śaktiṃ samāyāṃtīṃ mahāvegavatīṃ raṇe || 106 || nijacāpavinirmuktairbāṇaiścūrṇī cakāra sā || bhagnāṃ śaktiṃ samālokya tato durgo mahāsuraḥ || 107 || cakraṃ ca preṣayāmāsa daityacakrātiharṣadam || tacca devyā śaraśatairaṃtaraivāṇuvatkṛtam || 108 || tataḥ śārṅgaṃ samādāya dhanuḥ śakradhanuryathā || hṛdi vivyādha bāṇena tāṃ devīmamarārdanaḥ || 109 || sa ca bāṇastayā devyā nija bāṇairmahājavaiḥ || nivāritopi vegena tāṃ devīmabhyagānmune || 4.2.71.110 || tataḥ kodaṃḍadaṃḍena āṣugena tamāśugam || hatvā nivārayāmāsa kāladaṃḍamivāparam || 111 || tasminvimukhatāṃ yāte mārgaṇe durgamāsuraḥ || kruddhaḥ śūlaṃ samādāya saṃvartānalasuprabham || 112 || mahāvegana cikṣepa tāṃ devīmabhi daityapaḥ || parāpatacca tacchūlaṃ nijaśūlena caṃḍikā || 113 || aṃtaraiva praciccheda saha daityajayāśayā || tasminnapi mahāśūle devīśūlāvahelite || 114 || gadāmādāya daityeṃdraḥ sahasābhipapāta ha || ājaghāna ca taṃ devīṃ bhujamūle mahābalaḥ || 115 || sāpi devī bhujaṃ prāpya girīṃdraśikharākṛtiḥ || gadāśuparipusphoṭa śatadhā ca sahasradhā || 116 || tadā devyā sa daityeṃdro vāmapādatalena hi || ātāḍitaḥ papātorvyāṃ hṛdi gāḍhaṃ prapīḍitaḥ ||117|| tatkṣaṇādeva daityeṃdraḥ patitvā punarutthitaḥ || babhūva sahasā dṛśyo dīpo vātahato yathā || 118 || tāvañjagajjananyātāḥ preritā nija śaktayaḥ || vicerurdaityasainyeṣu saṃvarte mṛtyusainyavat || 119 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe durgaparākramo nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 71 ||
<4.2.72>
|| agastya uvāca || pārvatīhṛdayānaṃda skaṃda sarvajñanaṃdana || kāḥ kāstu śaktayastā vai tāsāṃ nāmāni me vada ||1|| || skaṃda uvāca || || tāsāṃ paramaśaktīnāmumāvayavasaṃbhuvām || ākhyāmyākhyāṃ śṛṇu mune kuṃbhasaṃbhava tattvataḥ || 2 || trailokyavijayā tārā kṣamā trailokyasuṃdarī || tripurā trijaganmātā bhīmā tripurabhairavī || 3 || kāmākhyā kamalākṣī ca dhṛtistripuratāpanī || jayā jayaṃtī vijayā jaleśī cāparājitā |4|| śaṃkhinī gajavaktrā ca mahiṣaghnī raṇapriyā || śubhānaṃdā koṭarākṣī vidyujjihvā śivāravā || 5 || trinetrā ca trivaktrā ca tripadā sarvamaṃgalā || huṃkārahetistāleśī sarpāsyā sarvasuṃdarī || 6 || siddhirbuddhiḥ svadhā svāhā mahānidrā śarāśanā || pāśapāṇiḥ kharamukhī vajratārā ṣaḍānanā|| 7 || mayūravadanā kākī śukī bhāsī garutmatī || padmāvatī padmakeśī padmāsyā padmavāsinī || 8 || akṣarā tryakṣarā taṃtuḥ praṇaveśī svarātmikā || trivargā garvarahitā ajapā japahāriṇī || 9 || japasiddhistapaḥsiddhiryogasiddhiḥ parāmṛtā || maitrīkṛnmitranetrā ca rakṣoghnī daityatāpanī || 4.2.72.10 || staṃbhanī mohanīmāyā bahumāyā balotkaṭā || uccāṭanī maholkāsyā danujeṃdrakṣayaṃkarī ||11|| kṣemakarī siddhikarī chinnamastā śubhānanā || śākaṃbharī mokṣalakṣmīstrivargaphaladāyinī || 12 || vārtālī jaṃbhalī klinnā aśvārūḍhā sureśvarī || jvālāmukhī prabhṛtayo navakoṭyau mahābalāḥ || 13 || balāni balināṃ tābhirdānavānāṃ svalīlayā || saṃkṣiptā nijagaṃtīva pralayānalahetebhiḥ || 14 || tāvatsa durgo daityeṃdraḥ payodāṃtarato balī || cakāra karakāvṛṣṭiṃ vātyā vegavatīṃ bahu ||15|| tato bhagavatī devī śoṣaṇāstra prayogataḥ || vṛṣṭiṃ nivārayāmāsa savarṣopalamayī kṣaṇāt || 16 || yoṣinmanorathavatī ṣaṃḍhaṃ prāpya yathā'phalā || sā daityakarakāvṛṣṭirdevīṃ prāpya tathābhavat || 17 || atha daiteyarājena bāhusaṃkarṣakopataḥ || utpāṭya śailaśikharaṃ parikṣiptaṃ nabhoṃgaṇāt || 18 || adreḥ śṛṃgaṃ suvistīrṇamāpatatparivīkṣya sā || śatakoṭiprahāreṇa koṭiśaḥ sakalaṃ vyadhāt || 19 || āṃdolya maulimasakṛtkuṃḍalābhyāṃ virājitam|| gajībhūyāśu dudrāva tāṃ devīṃ samare'suraḥ ||4.2.72.20|| śailākāraṃ tamāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavatī gajam || baddhvā pāśena javataḥ khaṅgena karamacchinat || 21 || tatotyaṃtaṃ sa cītkṛtya devyākṛttakaraḥkarī || akiṃcitkaratāṃ prāpya māhiṣaṃ vapurādade || 22 || acalāṃ sacalāṃ sarvāṃ sa cakre suraghātataḥ || śiloccayāṃśca bahuśaḥ śṛṃgābhyāṃ sokṣipadbalī ||23|| niḥśvāsavātanihatāḥ petururvyāṃ mahādrumāḥ || udvelitāḥ samabhavansaptāpi jalarāśayaḥ ||54|| mahāmahiṣarūpeṇa tena trailokyamaṃḍapaḥ || āṃdolitoti balinā yugāṃte vātyayā yathā || 25 || brahmāṃḍamapyakāṃḍena tadbhayena samākulam || dṛṣṭvā bhagavatī kruddhā triśūlena jaghāna tam || 26 || triśūlaghātavibhrāṃtaḥ patitvā punarutthitaḥ || taṃ tyaktvā māhiṣaṃ veṣamabhūdbāhusahasrabhṛt || 27 || sa durgo nitarāṃ durgo vibabhau samarājire|| āyudhānāṃ sahasrāṇi bibhratkālāṃtakopamaḥ || 28 || atha tūrṇaṃ sa daityeṃdrastāṃ devīṃ raṇakovidām || mahābalaḥ pragṛhyāśu nītavānāngaganāṃgaṇam || || 29 || tato nabhoṃgaṇāddūrātkṣiptvā sa jagadaṃbikām || kṣaṇātkalaṃbajālena cchādayāmāsa vegavān || 4.2.72.30 || athāṃtarikṣagā devī tasya mārgaṇamadhyagā || vidyunmāleva vibabhau mahābhrapaṭalīdhṛtā ||31|| taṃ vidhūya śaratrātaṃ nijeṣu nikarairalam || maheṣuṇātha vivyādha sā taṃ daityajaneśvaram || 32 || hṛdi viddhastayā devyā sa ca tena maheṣuṇā || vyāghūrṇamānanayanaḥ kṣitimāpāti vihvalaḥ ||33|| mahārudhiradhārābhiḥ sravaṃtīṃ ca pravartayan || tasminnipatite durge mahādurgaparākrame|| ||34 || devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ prahṛṣṭāni jagaṃti ca || sūryācaṃdramasau sāgnī tejo nijamavāpatuḥ || 35 || puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ prakurvaṃtaḥ prāptā devā maharṣibhiḥ || tuṣṭuvuśca mahādevīṃ mahāstutibhirādarāt || 36 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namo devi jagaddhātri jagattrayamahāraṇe || maheśvara mahāśakte daityadrumakuṭhārake || 37 || trailokyavyāpini śive śaṃkhacakragadādhari || svaśārṅgavyagrahastāgre namo viṣṇusvarūpiṇi || 38 || haṃsayāne namastubhyaṃ sarvasṛṣṭividhāyini|| prācāṃ vācāṃ janmabhūme caturānanarūpiṇi|| 39 || tvamaiṃdrī tvaṃ ca kauberī vāyavī tvaṃ tvamaṃbupā || tvaṃ yāmī nairṛtī tvaṃ ca tvamaiśī tvaṃ ca pāvakī || 4.2.72.40 || śaśāṃkakaumudī tvaṃ ca saurī śaktistvameva ca || sarvadevamayī śaktistvameva parameśvarī || 41 || tvaṃ gaurī tvaṃ ca sāvitrī tvaṃ gāyatrī sarasvatī || prakṛtistvaṃ matistvaṃ ca tvamahaṃkṛtirūpiṇī || || 42 || cetaḥ svarūpiṇī tvaṃ vai tvaṃ sarveṃdriyarūpiṇī || paṃcatanmātrarūpā tvaṃ mahābhūtātmikeṃbike || 43 || śabdādi rūpiṇī tvaṃ vai karaṇānugrahā tvamu || brahmāṃḍakartrī tvaṃ devi brahmāṃḍāṃtastvameva hi || 44 || tvaṃ parāsi mahādevi tvaṃ ca devi parāparā || parāparāṇāṃ paramā paramātmasvarūpiṇī || 45 || sarvarūpā tvamīśāni tvamarūpāsi sarvage || tvaṃ cicchaktirmahāmāye tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhāmṛte || 46 || vaṣaḍvauṣaṭsvarūpāsi tvameva praṇavātmikā || sarvamaṃtramayī tvaṃ vai brahmādyāstvatsamudbhavāḥ || 47 || caturvargātmikā tvaṃ vai caturvargaphalodaye || tvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ viśvaṃ tvayi sarvaṃ jagannidhe || 48 || yaddṛśyaṃ yadadṛśyaṃ ca sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpataḥ || tatra tvaṃ śaktirūpeṇa kiṃcinna tvadṛte kvacit || 49 || mātastvayādya vinihatya mahāsureṃdraṃ durgaṃ nisargavibudhārpitadaityasainyam || trātāḥ sma devi satataṃ namatāṃ śaraṇye tvatto'paraḥ ka iha yaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ || 4.2.72.50 || loke ta eva dhanadhānyasamṛddhibhājaste putrapautrasukalatra sumitravaṃtaḥ || teṣāṃ yaśaḥ prasaracaṃdrakarāvadātaṃ viśvaṃ bhavedbhavasi yeṣu sudṛktvamīśe || || 51 || tvadbhakticetasi janena vipattileśaḥ kleśaḥ kva vānubhavatī natikṛtsu puṃsu || tvannāmasaṃsṛtijuṣāṃ sakalāyuṣāṃ kva bhūyaḥ punarjaniriha tripurāripatni || 52 || citraṃ yadatra samare sa hi durgadaityastvaddṛṣṭipātamadhigamya sudhānidhānam|| mṛtyorvaśatvamagamadviditaṃ bhavāni duṣṭopi te dṛśigataḥ kugatiṃ na yāti || 53 || tvacchastravahniśalabhatvamitā apīha daityāḥ pataṃgarucimāpya divaṃ vrajaṃti || saṃtaḥ khaleṣvapi na duṣṭadhiyo yataḥ syuḥ sādhuṣviva praṇayinaḥ svapathaṃ diśaṃti || 54 || prācyāṃ mṛḍāni paripāhi sadā natānno yāmyāmava pratipadaṃ vipado bhavāni || pratyagdiśi tripuratāpana patni rakṣa tvaṃ pāhyudīci nijabhaktajanānmaheśi || 55 || brahmāṇi rakṣa satataṃ natamaulideśaṃ tvaṃ vaiṣṇavi pratikulaṃ paripālayādhaḥ || rudrāgni nairṛti sadāgati dikṣu pāṃtu mṛtyuṃjayā trinayanā tripurā triśaktyaḥ || 56 || pātu triśūlamamale tava maulijānno bhālasthalaṃ śaśikalā mṛdumābhruvau ca || netre trilocanavadhūrgirijā ca nāsāmoṣṭhaṃ jayā ca vijayātvadharapradeśam || 57 || śrotradvayaṃ śrutiravā daśanāvaliṃ śrīścaṃḍī kapolayugalaṃ rasanāṃ ca vāṇī || pāyātsadaiva cibukaṃ jayamaṃgalā naḥ kātyāyanī vadanamaṃḍalameva sarvam || 58 || kaṃṭhapradeśamavatādiha nīlakaṃṭhī bhūdāraśaktiraniśaṃ ca kṛkāṭikāyām || kaurmyaṃ sadeśamaniśaṃ bhujadaṃḍamaiṃdrī padmā ca pāṇiphalakaṃ natikāriṇāṃ naḥ || 59 || hastāṃgulīḥ kamalajā virajānakhāṃśca kakṣāṃtaraṃ taraṇimaṃḍalagā tamoghnī || vakṣaḥsthalaṃ sthalacarī hṛdayaṃ dharitrī kuśidvayaṃ tvavatu naḥ kṣaṇadācaraghnī ||4.2.72.60|| avyātsadā daradarīṃ jagadīśvarī no nābhiṃ nabhogatirajātvatha pṛṣṭhadeśam || pāyātkaṭiṃ ca vikaṭā paramāsphicau no guhyaṃ guhāraṇirapānamapāya haṃtrī ||61 || ūrudvayaṃ ca vipulā lalitā ca jānū jaṃghe javā'vatu kaṭhoratarātra gulphau|| pādau rasātalacarāṃgulideśamugrā cāṃdrī nakhāntpadatalaṃ talavāsinī ca ||62|| gṛhaṃ rakṣatu no lakṣmīḥ kṣetraṃ kṣemakarī sadā || pātu putrānpriyakarī pāyādāyuḥ sanātanī || 63 || yaśaḥ pātu mahādevī dharmaṃ pātu dhanurdharī || kuladevī kulaṃ pātu sadgatiṃ sadgatipradā || 64 || raṇe rājakule dyūte saṃgrāme śatrusaṃkaṭe || gṛhe vane jalādau ca śarvāṇī sarvato'vatu || 65 || iti stutvā jagaddhātrīṃ praṇemuśca punaḥpunaḥ || sarve savāsavā devāḥ sarṣigaṃdharvacāraṇāḥ || 66 || tatastuṣṭā jaganmātā tānāha surasattamān || svādhikārānsurāḥ sarve śāsatu prāgyathāyathā || 67|| tuṣṭāhamanayā stutyā nitarāṃ tu yathārthayā || varamanyaṃ pradāsyāmi tacchṛṇudhvaṃ surottamāḥ || 68 || || durgovāca || || yaḥ stoṣyati tu māṃ bhaktyā naraḥ stutyānayā śuciḥ || tasyāhaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi vipadaṃ ca pade pade ||69|| etatstotrasya kavacaṃ paridhāsyati yo naraḥ || tasya kvacidbhayaṃ nāsti vajrapaṃjaragasya hi ||4.2.72.70|| adyaprabhṛti me nāma durgeti khyātimeṣyati || durgadaityasya samare pātanādati durgamāt||71|| ye māṃ durgāṃ śaraṇagā na teṣāṃ durgatiḥ kvacit || durgāstutiriyaṃ puṇyā vajrapaṃjarasaṃjñikā ||72|| anayā kavacaṃ kṛtvā mā bibhetu yamādapi || bhūtapretapiśācāśca śākinīḍākinī gaṇāḥ||73|| jhoṭiṃgā rākṣasāḥ krūrā viṣa sarpāgni dasyavaḥ || vetālāścāpi kaṃkāla grahā bālagrahā api||74|| vātapittādi janitāstathā ca viṣamajvarāḥ || dūrādeva palāyaṃte śrutvā stutimimāṃ śubhām ||75|| vajrapaṃjara nāmaitatstotraṃ durgāpraśaṃsanam || etatstotrakṛtatrāṇe vajrādapi bhayaṃ nahi || 76 || aṣṭajaptena cānena yobhimaṃtrya jalaṃ pibet || tasyodaragatāpīḍā kvāpi no saṃbhaviṣyati||77|| garbhapīḍā tu no jātu bhaviṣyatyabhimaṃtraṇāt || bālānāṃ paramā śāṃtiretatstotrāṃbupānataḥ || 78 || yatra sānnidhyametasya stavasyeha bhaviṣyati || etāstu śaktayaḥ sarvā sarvatra sahitā mayā || 79 || rakṣāṃ parikariṣyaṃti madbhaktānāṃ mamājñayā || iti dattvā varāndevī devebhyo tarhi tā tadā || 4.2.72.80 || tepi svargaukasaḥ sarve svaṃsvaṃ svargaṃ yayurmudā || || skaṃda uvāca || itthaṃ durgābhavannāma tayā devyā mahāmune || kāśyāṃ sevyā yathā sā ca tacchṛṇuṣva vadāmi te ||81|| aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ bhaumavāre viśeṣataḥ || saṃpūjyā satataṃ kāśyāṃ durgā durgatināśinī || 82 || navarātraṃ prayatnena pratyahaṃ sā samarcitā || nāśayiṣyati vighnaughānsumatiṃ ca pradāsyati || 83 || mahāpūjopahāraiśca mahābalinivedanaiḥ || dāsyatyabhīṣṭadā siddhiṃ durgā kāśyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 84 || pratisaṃvatsaraṃ tasyāḥ kāryā yātrā prayatnataḥ || śāradaṃ navarātraṃ ca sakuṭuṃbaiḥ śubhārthibhiḥ ||85|| yo na sāṃvatsarīṃ yātrāṃ durgāyāḥ kurute kudhīḥ || kāśyāṃ vighna sahasrāṇi tasya syuśca padepade || 86 || durgākuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā sarvadurgārtihāriṇīm || durgāṃ saṃpūjya vidhivannavajanmāghamutsṛjet || 87 || sā durgāśaktibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kāśīṃ rakṣati sarvataḥ || tāḥ prayatnena saṃpūjyā kālarātrimukhā naraiḥ ||88|| rakṣaṃti kṣetrametadvai tathānyā navaśaktayaḥ || upasargasahasrebhyastā vaidigdevatākramāt || 89 || śatanetrā sahasrāsyā tathāyutabhujāparā || aśvārūḍhā gajāsyā ca tvaritā śavavāhinī || 4.2.72.90 || viśvā saubhāgyagaurī ca sṛṣṭāḥ prācyādimadhyataḥ || etā yatnena saṃpūjyāḥ kṣetrarakṣaṇadevatāḥ ||91|| tathaiva bhairavāścāṣṭau dikṣvaṣṭāsu pratiṣṭhitāḥ || rakṣaṃti satataṃ kāśīṃ nirvāṇaśrīniketanam || 92 || ruruścaṃḍositāṃgaśca kapālī krodhanastathā || unmattabhairavastadvatkramātsaṃhārabhīṣaṇau || 93 || catuḥṣaṣṭistu vetālā mahābhīṣaṇamūrtayaḥ || ruṃḍamuṃḍasrajaḥ sarve kartrīkharparapāṇayaḥ || 94 || śvavāhanā raktamukhā mahādaṃṣṭrā mahābhujāḥ || nagnā vimuktakeśāśca pramattā rudhirāsavaiḥ || 95 || nānārūpadharāḥ sarve nānāśastrāstra pāṇayaḥ || tadākāraiśca tadbhṛtyaiḥ koṭiśaḥ parivāritāḥ || 96 || vidyujjihvo lalajjihvaḥ krūrāsyaḥ krūralocanaḥ|| ugro vikaṭadaṃṣṭraśca vakrāsyo vakranāsikaḥ || 97 || jaṃbhako jṛṃbhaṇamukho jvālānetro vṛkodaraḥ || gartanetro mahānetrastucchanetroṃ'tramaṇḍanaḥ || 98 || jvalatkeśaḥ kaṃbuśirāḥ kharvagrīvo mahāhanuḥ || mahānāso laṃbakarṇaḥ karṇaprāvaraṇonasaḥ ||99|| ityādayo mune kṣetraṃ durvṛttarudhirapriyāḥ || trāsayaṃto durācārānrakṣaṃti paritaḥ sadā ||4.2.72.100|| trailokyavijayādyāśca jvālāmukhyaṃtagāśca yāḥ || śaktayo'tra mayā khyātā mune kalaśasaṃbhava || 101 || tāḥ kāśīṃ parirakṣaṃti caturdikṣūdyatāyudhāḥ || tāḥ samarcyāḥ prayatnena mahāvighna praśāṃtaye ||102|| bhairavā rurumukhyāśca mahābhayanivārakāḥ || saṃpūjyāḥ sarvadā kāśyāṃ sarvasaṃpattihetavaḥ ||103|| vidyujjihvaprabhṛtayo vetālā ugrarūpiṇaḥ || atyugrānapi vighnaughānhariṣyaṃtyarcitā iha || 104 || tathā bhūtāvalī cātra nānābhīṣaṇarūpiṇī || udāyudhā'vati purīṃ śatakoṭimitā mune || 105 || nirvāṇalakṣmīkṣetrasya pālayitrī padepade || etā vai devatāḥ pūjyāḥ kāśyāṃ nirvāṇakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 106 || śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ naro durgajayābhidham || nānāśaktisamāyuktaṃ durgamāśu tariṣyati || 107 || ya ete bhairavāḥ proktā ye vetālā udāhṛtāḥ || teṣāṃ nāmāni cākarṇya naro viprairna dūyate || 108 || adṛṣṭā api te bhūtā etadākhyānapāṭhakam || rakṣiṣyaṃti prayatnena saha śrotṛjanena ca || 109 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāśībhaktiparairnaraiḥ || śrotavyamidamākhyānaṃ mahāvighnanivāraṇam || || 4.2.72.110 || gṛhepi yasya likhitametatsthāsyati pūjitam | tasyāpadāṃ sahasrāṇi nāśayiṣyaṃti devatāḥ || 111 || kāśyāṃ yasyāsti vai prema tena kṛtvā''daraṃ gurum || śrotavyamidamākhyānaṃ vajrapaṃjarasannibham ||112 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe durgāvijayo nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 72 ||
<4.2.73>
agastya uvāca || trilocanaṃ samāsādya devadevaḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ || jagadaṃbikayāyuktaḥ kiṃ cakārāśu tadvada || 1 || || skanda uvāca || || mune kalaśajākhyāmi yatpṛṣṭaṃ tanniśāmaya || virajaḥsaṃjñakaṃ pīṭhaṃ yatproktaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 2 || tatpīṭhadarśanādeva virajā jāyate naraḥ || yatrāsti tanmahāliṃgaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ trilocanam || 3 || tīrthaṃ pilipilākhyaṃ taddyunadyaṃbhasi viśrutam || sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ tatkāśyāṃ parigīyate || 4 || viṣṭapatritayāṃtarye devarṣimanujoragāḥ || sasaritparvatāraṇyāḥ saṃti te tatra yanmune || 5 || tadārabhya ca tattīrthaṃ tacca liṃgaṃ trilocanam || triviṣṭapamiti khyātamatohetormahattaram || 6 || triviṣṭapasya liṃgasya mahimoktāḥ pinākinā || jagajjananyāḥ purato yathā vacmi tathā mune ||7|| || devyuvāca || || devadeva jagannātha śarva sarvada sarvaga || sarvadṛksarvajanaka kiṃcitpṛcchāmi tadvada || ||8|| idaṃ tava priyaṃ kṣetraṃ karmabījamahauṣadham || naiḥśreyasyāḥ śriyo gehaṃ mamāpi prītidaṃ mahat ||9|| yatkṣetrarajasopyagre trilokyapi tṛṇāyate || tasyākhilasya mahimā viṣvakkenāvagamyate || 4.2.73.10 || yānīha saṃti liṃgāni tāni sarvāṇyasaṃśayam || nirvāṇakāraṇānyeva svayaṃbhūnyapi tānyapi || 11 || yadyapyevaṃ tathāpīśa viśeṣaṃ vaktumarhasi || kāśyāmanādisiddhāni kāni liṃgāni śaṃkara ||12|| yatra devaḥ sadā tiṣṭhetsaṃvarte'pi sa vallabhaḥ || yairiyaṃ prathitiṃ prāptā kāśī muktipurīti ca|| || 13 || yeṣāṃ smaraṇatopyatra bhavetpāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ|| darśanasparśanābhyāṃ ca syātāṃ svargāpavargakau || 14 || yeṣāṃ samarcanādeva madhye janma sakṛdvibho || liṃgāni pūjitāni syuḥ kāśyāṃ sarvāṇi niścitam ||15|| vidhāya mayyanukrośaṃ kāruṇyāmṛtasāgara || etadācakṣva me śaṃbho pādayoḥ praṇatāsmyaham ||16|| ityākarṇya maheśānastasyā devyāḥ subhāṣitam|| kathayāmāsa rvidhyāre mahāliṃgāni sattama ||17|| yannāmākarṇanādeva kṣīyaṃte pāparāśayaḥ || prāpyate puṇyasaṃbhāraḥ kāśyāṃ nivārṇakāraṇam || 18 || || devadeva uvāca || || śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ kṣetre'sminmuktikāraṇam || idaṃ vidaṃti naivāpi brahmanārāyaṇādayaḥ || 19 || asaṃkhyātāni liṃgāni pārvatyānaṃdakānane || sthūlānyapi ca sūkṣmāṇi nānāratnamayāni ca || 4.2.73.20 || nānādhātumayānīśe dārṣadānyapyanekaśaḥ || svayaṃbhūnyapyanekāni devarṣisthāpitānyaho ||21|| siddhacāraṇagaṃdharva yakṣarakṣorcitānyapi || asuroragamartyaiśca dānavairapsarogaṇaiḥ ||22|| diggajergiribhistīrtherṛkṣa vānara kinnaraiḥ || patatripramukhairdevi svasvanāmāṃkitāni vai ||23|| pratiṣṭhitāni yānīha muktihetūni tānyapi || adṛśyānyapi dṛśyāni duravasthānyapi priye ||24|| bhagnānyapi ca kālena tāni pūjyāni suṃdari|| parārdhaśatasaṃkhyāni gaṇitānyekadā mayā|| 25|| gaṃgābhasyapi tiṣṭhaṃti ṣaṣṭikoṭimitānihi|| siddhaliṃgāni tānīśe tiṣye'dṛśyatvamāyayuḥ || 26 || gaṇanādivasādavārṅmamabhaktajanaiḥpriye || pratiṣṭhitāni yānīha teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate ||27|| tvayā tu yāni pṛṣṭāni yairidaṃ kṣetramuttamam || tāni liṃgāni vakṣyāmi muktihetūni suṃdari || 28 || kalāvatīva gopyāni bhaviṣyaṃti girīṃdraje || paraṃ teṣāṃ prabhāvo yaḥ svasvasthānaṃ na hāsyati || 29 || kalikalmaṣapuṣṭā ye ye duṣṭā nāstikāḥ śaṭhāḥ || eteṣāṃ siddhaliṃgānāṃ jñāsyaṃtyākhyāmapīha na || 4.2.73.30 || nāmaśravaṇatopīha yalliṃgānāṃ śubhānane || vṛjināni kṣayaṃ yāṃti vardhaṃte puṇyarāśayaḥ || 31 || oṃkāraḥ prathamaṃ liṃgaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca trilocanam || tṛtīyaśca mahādevaḥ kṛttivāsāścaturthakam || || 32 || ratneśaḥ paṃcamaṃ liṃgaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ caṃdreśvarābhidham || kedāraḥ saptamaṃ liṃgaṃ dharmeśaścāṣṭamaṃ priye || 33 || vīreśvaraṃ ca navamaṃ kāmeśaṃ daśamaṃ viduḥ || viśvakarmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ śubhamekādaśaṃ param || 34 || dvādaśaṃ maṇikarṇīśamavimuktaṃ trayodaśam || caturdaśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ mama viśveśvarābhidham || 35 || priye caturdaśaitāni śriyohetūni suṃdari || eteṣāṃ samavāyoyaṃ muktikṣetramiheritam || 36 || devatāḥ samadhiṣṭhātryaḥ kṣetrasyāsya parā imāḥ || ārādhitāḥ prayacchaṃti nṛbhyo naiḥśreyasīṃ śriyam ||37 || ānaṃdakānane muktyai proktānyetāni suṃdari || priye caturdaśejyāni mahāliṃgāni dehinām || 38 || pratimāsaṃ samārabhya tithiṃ pratipadaṃ śubhām || eteṣāṃ liṃgamukhyānāṃ kāryā yātrā prayatnataḥ ||39|| anārādhya mahādevameṣu liṃgeṣu kuṃbhaja || kaḥ kāśyāṃ mokṣamāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ||4.2.73.40|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāśīphalamabhīpsubhiḥ || pūjyānyetāni liṃgāni bhaktyā paramayā mune ||41|| || agastya uvāca || || etānyeva kimanyāni mahāliṃgāni ṣaṇmukha || nirvāṇakāraṇānīha yadi saṃti tadā vada || 42 || || skaṃda uvāca || || anyānyapi ca saṃtīha mahāliṃgāni suvrata || kaliprabhāvādguptāni bhaviṣyaṃtyeva tāni vai || || 43 || yasyeśvare sadābhaktiryaḥ kāśītattvavittamaḥ || sa evaitāni liṃgāni vetsyatyanyo na kaścana || 44 || yeṣāṃ nāmagraheṇāpi kalikalmaṣa saṃkṣayaḥ || amṛteśastārakeśo jñāneśaḥ karuṇeśvaraḥ || 45 || mokṣadvāreśvaraścaiva svargadvāreśvarastathā || brahmeśo lāṃgalaścaiva vṛddhakāleśvarastathā || 46 || vṛṣeśaścaiva caṃḍīśo naṃdikeśo maheśvaraḥ || jyotīrūpeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ khyātamatra caturdaśam || 47 || kāśyāṃ caturdaśaitāni mahāliṃgāni suṃdari || imāni muktihetūni liṃgānyānaṃdakānane || 48 || kalikalmaṣabuddhīnāṃ nākhyeyāni kadācana || etānyārādhayedyastu liṃgānīha caturdaśa || 49 || na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ saṃsārādhvani karhicit || kāśīkośoyamatulo na prakāśyo yatastataḥ || || 4.2.73.50 || etalliṃgābhidhā devi mahāpadyapi duḥkhahṛt || rahasyaṃ paramaṃ caitatkṣetrasyāsya varānane || 51 || caturdaśāpi liṃgāni matsānnidhyakarāṇi hi || avimuktasya hṛdayametadeva girīṃdraje || 52 || imāni yāni liṃgāni sarveṣāṃ muktidāni hi || ekaikabhuvanasyeha sāramādāya sarvataḥ || mayaitāni kṛtānyeva mahābhaktikṛpāvaśāt || 53 || asminkṣetre dhruvaṃ muktiriti yā prathiti priye || kāraṇaṃ tatra liṃgāni mamaitāni caturdaśa ||54|| ta eva vratinaḥ kāṃte ta eva ca tapasvinaḥ|| dhyātānyetāni yairbhaktairliṃgānyānaṃdakānane ||55|| ta evābhyastasadyogā dattadānāsta eva hi || kāśyāmimāni liṃgāni yairdṛṣṭānyapi dūrataḥ || 56|| iṣṭāpūrtāśca ye dharmāḥ praṇītā munisattamaiḥ || te sarve tena vihitā yāvajjīvaṃ nirenasā || 57 || yenāvimuktamāsādya mahāliṃgāni pārvati || sakṛdabhyarcitānīha sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ || 58 || || skaṃda uvāca || || anyānyapi ca viṃdhyāre devyai proktāni śaṃbhunā || svabhaktānāṃ hitāthārya tānyathākarṇayāgraja || 59 || śaileśaḥ saṃgameśaśca svarlīno madhyameśvaraḥ || hiraṇyagarbha īśāno goprekṣo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 4.2.73.60 || upaśāṃta śivo jyeṣṭho nivāseśvara eva ca || śukreśo vyāghraliṃgaṃ ca jaṃbukeśaṃ caturdaśam || 61 || mune caturdaśaitāni mahāṃtyāyatanāni vai || eteṣāmapi sevāto naro mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 62 || caitrakṛṣṇapratipadaṃ samārabhya prayatnataḥ || ā caturdaśipūjyāni liṃgānyetāni sattamaiḥ || 63 || eteṣāṃ vārṣikī yātrā sumahotsavapūrvakam || kāryā mumukṣubhiḥ samyakkṣetrasaṃsiddhidāyinī || || 64 || mune caturdaśaitāni mahāliṃgāni yatnataḥ || dṛṣṭvā na jāyate jaṃtuḥ saṃsāre duḥkhasāgare ||65|| kṣetrasya paramaṃ tattvametadeva priye dhruvam || saṃsārarogagrastānāmidameva mahauṣadham || 66 || kṣetrasyopaniṣaccaiṣā muktibījamidaṃ param || karmakānanadāvāgnireṣā liṃgāvaliḥ priye || 67 || ekaikasyāsya liṃgasya mahimādyaṃta varjitaḥ || mayaiva jñāyate devi samyaṅnānyena kenacit ||68|| iti śrutvā mune prāha devī hṛṣṭatanūruhā || praṇamya devamīśānaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvadaṃ śivam || 69 || || devyuvāca || || rahasyaṃ paramaṃ kāśyāṃ yadetatsamudīritam || tacchrutvotsukatāṃ prāptaṃ mano metīva vallabha || 4.2.73.70 || yaduktaṃ ligamekaikaṃ mahāsārataraṃ param || kāśyāṃ paramanirvāṇakāraṇaṃ kāraṇeśvara || 71 || pratyekaṃ mahimānaṃ me brūhyeṣāṃ bhuvaneśvara || caturdaśānāṃ liṃgānāṃ śravaṇādaghahāriṇām || || 72 || oṃkāreśasya liṃgasya kathamatra samāgamaḥ || atipuṇyatamāttasmātkṣetrādamarakaṃṭakāt || 73 || kimātmako'yamoṃkāro mahimāsya ca ko hara || kenārādhi purā caiṣa dadāvārādhitaśca kim || 74 || mṛḍānīvāksudhāmetāṃ vidhāya śrutigocarām || kathāmakathayaddeva oṃkārasyamahādbhutām || 75 || || devadeva uvāca || || kathāmākarṇayāparṇe varṇayāmi tavāgrataḥ || yathoṃkārasya liṃgasya prādurbhāva ihābhavat ||76|| purānaṃdavane cātra brahmaṇā viśvayoninā || tapastaptaṃ mahādevi samādhiṃ dadhatāparam || 77 || pūrṇe yugasahasre'tha bhittvā pātālasaptakam|| udatiṣṭhatpurojyotirvidyotita harinmukham || 78 || yadaṃtarāvirabhavannirvyājena samādhinā|| tadeva paramaṃ dhāma bahirāvirabhūdvidheḥ ||79|| yobhūccaṭacaṭāśabdaḥ sphuṭato bhūmibhāgataḥ|| tacchabdādvyasṛjadvedhāḥ samādhiṃ kramato vaśī || || 4.2.73.80 || sraṣṭāvisṛṣṭa taddhyāno yāvadunmīlyalocane || puraḥ paśyeddadarśāgre tāvadakṣaramādimam || 81 || akāraṃ sattvasaṃpannamṛkkṣetraṃ sṛṣṭipālakam || nārāyaṇātmakaṃ sākṣāttamaḥ pāre pratiṣṭhitam || 82 || ukāramatha tasyāgre rajorūpaṃ yajurjanim || vidhātāraṃ samastasya svākāramiva biṃbitam || 83 || nīravadhvāṃtasaṃketa sadanābhaṃ tadagrataḥ || makāraṃ sa dadarśātha tamorūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 84 || sāmno yoniṃ laye hetuṃ sākṣādrudrasvarūpiṇam || atha tatpurato dhyātā vyadhātsvanayanātithim || 85 || viśvarūpamayākāraṃ saguṇaṃ vāpi nirguṇam|| anākhyanādasadanaṃ paramānaṃdavigraham ||86|| śavdabrahmeti yatkhyātaṃ sarvavāṅmayakāraṇam || athopariṣṭānnādasya biṃdurūpaṃ parātparam || 87 || kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca jagadyoniṃ ca taṃ param || vidhirvilokayāṃcakre tapasāgocarīkṛtam || 88 || avanādomiti khyātaṃ sarvasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || bhaktamunnayate yasmāttadomiti ya īritaḥ || 89 || arūpopi sarūpāḍhyaḥ sa dhātrā netragīkṛtaḥ || tārayedyadbhavāṃbhodheḥ svajapāsaktamānasam || tatastāra iti khyāto yastaṃ brahmā vyalokayat || 4.2.73.90 || praṇūyate yataḥ sarvaiḥ paranirvāṇakāmukaiḥ || sarvebhyobhyadhikastasmātpraṇavo yaiḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 91 || svasevitāraṃ puruṣaṃ praṇayedyaḥ paraṃpadam || atastapraṇavaṃ śāṃtaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtavānvidhiḥ || 92 || trayīmayasturīyoyasturyātītokhilātmakaḥ || nādabiṃdusvarūpo yaḥ sa praikṣi dvijagāminā || 93 || prāvartaṃta yato vedāḥ sāṃgāḥ sarvasya yonayaḥ || savedādiḥ padmabhuvā purastādavalokitaḥ || 94 || vṛṣabho yastridhābaddho roravīti mahomayaḥ || sanetraviṣayī cakre paramaḥ parameṣṭhinā || 95 || śṛṃgaścatvāri yasyāsanhastāsaḥ sapta eva ca || dve śīrṣe ca trayaḥ pādāḥ sa devo vidhinaikṣata || 96 || yadaṃtarlīnamakhilaṃ bhūtaṃ bhāvi bhavatpunaḥ || tadbījaṃ bījarahitaṃ druhiṇena vilokitam || 97 || līnaṃ mṛgyeta yatraitadābrahmastaṃbabhājanam|| ataḥ sa bhājyate sadbhiryalliṃgaṃ tadvilokitam ||98|| paṃcārthā yatra bhāsaṃte paṃcabrahmamayaṃ hi yat || ādipaṃcasvarūpaṃyanniraikṣi brahmaṇā hi tat || 99 || tamālokya tato vedhā liṃgarūpiṇamīśvaram || paṃcākṣaraṃ prapaṃcācca bhinnaṃ tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram || 4.2.73.100 || brahmovāca || | nama oṃkārarūpāya namo'kṣaravapurdhṛte || namo'kārādivarṇānāṃ prabhavāya sadāśiva || 101 || akārastvamukārastvaṃ makārastvamanākṛte || ṛgyajuḥ sāmarūpāya rūpātītāya te namaḥ || 102 || namo nādātmane tubhyaṃ namo biṃdukalātmane || aliṃgaliṃgarūpāya sarvarūpasvarūpiṇe || 103 || namaste dhāma nidhaye nidhanādivivarjita || namo bhavāya rudrāya śarvāya ca namostute || 104 || nama ugrāya bhīmāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ || namastārasvarūpāya saṃbhavāya namostu te || 105 || amāyāya namastubhyaṃ namaḥ śivatarāya te || kapardine namastubhyaṃ śitikaṃṭha namostu te || 106 || mīḍhuṣṭamāya giriśa śipiviṣṭāya te namaḥ || namo'hrasvāya kharvāya bṛhate vṛddharūpiṇe || 107 || kumāragurave tubhyaṃ kumāravapuṣe namaḥ || namaḥ śvetāya kṛṣṇāya pītāyāruṇamūrtaye || 108 || dhūmravarṇāya piṃgāya namaḥ kirmīravarcase || namaḥ pāṭalavarṇāya namo haritatejase || 109 || nānāvarṇasvarūpāya varṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ || namaste svararūpāya namo vyaṃjanarūpiṇe || 4.2.73.110 || udāttāyānudāttāya svaritāya namo namaḥ || hrasvadīrghapluteśāya savisargāya te namaḥ || || 111 || anusvārasvarūpāya namaste sānunāsika || namo niranunāsāya daṃtyatālavyarūpiṇe || 112 || oṣṭhyorasyasvarūpāya nama ūṣmasvarūpiṇe || aṃtasthāya namastubhyaṃ paṃcamāya pinākine || 113 || niṣādāya namastubhyaṃ niṣādapataye namaḥ || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgādi vādyarūpāya te namaḥ || 114 || namastārāya maṃdrāya ghorāyāghoramūrtaye || namastānasvarūpāya mūrcchanāṃ pataye namaḥ || 115 || sthāyisaṃcāribhedena namo bhāvasvarūpiṇe || tālapriyāya tālāya lāsyatāṃḍavajanmane || 116 || tauryatrikasvarūpāya tauryatrikamahāpriya || tauryatrikakṛtāṃbhaktyā nirvāṇaśrīpradāyaka ||117|| sthūlasūkṣmasvarūpāya dṛśyādṛśya svarūpiṇe || arvācīnāya ca namaḥ parācīnāya te namaḥ || 118 || vākprapaṃca svarūpāya vākprapaṃca parāya ca || ekāyānekabhedāya sadasatpataye namaḥ ||119|| śabdabrahma namastubhyaṃ parabrahma namostute || namo vedāṃtavedyāya vedānāṃ pataye namaḥ || 4.2.73.120 || namo vedasvarūpāya vedagocaramūrtaye || pārvatīśa namastubhyaṃ jagadīśa namostu te || 121 || namaste devadeveśa deva divyapadaprada || śaṃkarāya namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ maheśvara || 122 || namaste jagadānaṃda namaste śaśiśekhara || mṛtyuṃjaya namastubhyaṃ namaste tryaṃbakāya ca || 123 || namaḥ pinākahastāya triśūlāyudhadhāriṇe || namastripurahaṃtre ca namoṃdhaka niṣūdana || 124 || kaṃdarpadarpadalana namojālaṃdharāraye || kālāya kālakālāya kālakūṭaviṣādine || 125 || viṣādahaṃtre bhaktānāmabhaktaika viṣādada || jñānāya jñānarūpāya sarvajñāya namo'stute || || 126 || yogasiddhipradosi tvaṃ yogināṃ yogasattama || tapasāṃ phaladosi tvaṃ tapasvibhyastapodhana || 127 || tvameva maṃtrarūposi maṃtrāṇāṃ phalado bhavān || mahādānaphalaṃ tvaṃ vai mahādānaprado bhavān || 126 || mahāyajñastvameveśa mahāyajña phalaprada || tvaṃ sarvaḥ sarvagastvaṃ vai sarvadaḥ sarvadṛgbhavān ||129|| sarvabhuksarvakartā tvaṃ sarvasaṃhārakāraka || yogināṃ hṛdayākāśa kṛtālaya namostu te || 4.2.73.130 || tvameva viṣṇurūpeṇa śaṃkhacakragadādhara || trilokīṃ trāyase trātaḥ sattvamūrte namostu te || 131|| tvameva vidadhāsye tadvidhirbhūtvā vidhānavit || rajorūpaṃ samālaṃbya nīrajaskapadaprada || 132 || tvameva hi mahārudrastvaṃ mahogro bhujaṃgabhṛt || tvameva hi mahābhīmo mahāpitṛvanecara || 133 || tāmasīṃ tanumāśritya tvaṃ kṛtāṃta kṛtāṃtaka || kālāgnirudro bhū'tvāṃte tvaṃ saṃvarta pravartakaḥ || 134 || tvaṃ puṃprakṛtirūpābhyāṃ mahadādyakhilaṃ jagat || akṣipakṣmasamutkṣepātpunarāviḥ karopyaja ||135|| unmeṣavinimeṣau te sargāsargaikakāraṇam || kapālamālākheloyaṃ bhavataḥ svairacāriṇaḥ || 136 || tvatkaṃṭhe nṛkaroṭīyaṃ dhūrjaṭe yā vibhāsate || sarveṣāmaṃtadagdhānāṃ sāsphuṭaṃ bījamālikā || 137 || tvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ śaṃbho tvayi sarvaṃ carācaram || kastvāṃ stotuṃ vijānāti purāṃ vācāmagocaram || 138 || stotā tvaṃ hi stutistvaṃ hi nityaṃ stutyastvameva ca || vedmyoṃ namaḥ śivāyeti nānyadve'dmyeva kiṃcana || 139 || tvameva hi śaraṇyaṃ me tvameva hi gatiḥ parā || tvāmeva praṇamāmīśa namastubhyaṃ namo namaḥ || 4.2.73.140 || ityudīryāsakṛdvedhāḥ praṇanāma maheśvaram || praṇavākhyaṃ mahāliṃgarūpiṇaṃ daṃḍavatkṣitau || 141 || || īśvara uvāca || || tato girīṃdratanaye śrutvā brahmastutiṃ parām || paramaiśvaryasaṃpatti hetuṃ tuṣṭohamadbhutam || 142 || amūrto'haṃ tato liṃgānmūrtimāsthāya śāṃkarīm || prasannosmi varaṃ brūhītyuvāca caturānanam || 143 || caturvaktraḥ samutthāya pratyakṣaṃ vīkṣya māmatha || punarjayajayetyuktvā praṇanāma kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 144 || ānaṃdabāṣpasalilanetro hṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || gadgadena svareṇātha provāca jalajāsanaḥ || 145 || brahmovāca || || yadi prasanno deveśa yadi deyo varo mama || tadetasminmahāliṃge sānnidhyaṃ te'stu śaṃkara || 146 || ayameva varo deyo nānyaṃ varamahaṃ vṛṇe || oṃkāreśvaranāmaitadastu bhaktaikamuktidam || 147 || || skaṃda uvāca || || vidhyuktamiti viprarṣe samākarṇya tadeśitā || uvāca vacanaṃ caitattathāstu caturānanam ||148|| varānanyānapi vibhuḥ prasannastatkṣaṇāddadau|| vidhaye dīrghatapase tayā stutyātitoṣitaḥ ||149|| || īśvara uvāca || suraśreṣṭha tapaḥśreṣṭha sarvāmnāya nidhirbhava || sṛṣṭeḥkaraṇasāmarthyaṃ tavāstu madanugrahāt ||4.2.73.150|| pitāmahastvaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ mānyabhūrbhavān || tvattapaḥphaladānārthaṃ yadetalliṃgamutthitam || 151 || paramoṃkārarūpaṃ ca śabdabrahmamayaṃ vidhe || asyārādhanataḥ puṃsāṃ na dūraṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam ||152|| akārākhyamidaṃ liṃgamukārākhyamidaṃ param || makārāhvayametacca nādākhyaṃ biṃdusaṃjñakam || 153 || paṃcāyatanamīśānamitthametadudīritam || mokṣāya sarvajaṃtūnāmasminnānaṃdakānane || 154 || snātvā matsyodarī tīrthe vilokyoṃkāramīśvaram || na jātu jāyate jaṃturjananī jaṭhare kvacit || 155 || etannādeśvaraṃ liṃgametalliṃgaṃ sudurlabham || ramye matsyodarī tīre dṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ vimuktidam || 156 || yadetatkāpilaṃ jyotiretalliṃge vilokyate || atastu kapileśākhyametalliṃgaṃ sudurlabham ||157|| matsyodarī yadā gaṃgā kapileśvara sannidhau || tadā tatra naraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 158 || varaṇotsiktapānīye dyunadītoyamiśrite || snātvā nādeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā naraḥ kimanuśocati || 159 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tīrthāni saha sāgaraiḥ || ṣaṣṭi koṭi sahasrāṇi matsyodaryāṃ viśaṃti hi ||4.2.73.160|| praṇaveśa samīpe tu yadā gaṃgā sameṣyati || tadā puṇyatamaḥ kālo devarṣi pitṛvallabhaḥ || 161 || tatra snānaṃ japodānaṃ havanaṃ devatārcanam || matsyodaryāmakṣayaṃ syādoṃkāreśvarasannidhau || 162 || oṃkāradarśanādeva vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet || tasmātkāśyāṃ prayatnena dṛśya oṃkāra īśvaraḥ || 163 || durlabhaṃ mānavaṃ janma caturvargaikasādhanam || jalabudbudavattatsyānnādeśo yena nekṣitaḥ || 164 || nirīkṣya kapileśānaṃ snātvā matsyodarījale || kṛtvā piṃḍapradānāni pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet || 165 || kṛtvāpi mohātpāpāni bhūrīṇyeva mahāṃtyapi || kāśyāmoṃkāramālokya kutastrasyati vai yamāt || 166 || oṃkārayātrābhimukhaṃ naraṃ vīkṣya pitāmahāḥ || parinṛtyaṃti muditāḥ svasaṃtānasamudbhavam || 167 || yasya yasya ca vai nāma smṛtvā smṛtvā namasyati || taṃ tamunnayate prājñaḥ pitaraṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam || 168 || rudrāṇāṃ niyutaṃ japtvā yatphalaṃ samyagāpyate || tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ bhaktyoṃkāra vilokanāt || 169 || kevalaṃ bhūmibhārāya janmino janma tasya vai || yenānaṃdavane dṛṣṭo noṃkāraḥ sarvakāmadaḥ || 4.2.73.170 || ekamoṃkāramālokya samaste kṣoṇimaṃḍale || liṃ gajātāni sarvāṇi dṛṣṭāni syurna saṃśayaḥ || 171 || praṇaveśaṃ praṇamyātha yadyanyatra vipadyate || svargalokamavāpyātha kāśyāṃ muktimavāpnuyāt || 172 || asmim̐lliṃge sadā brahmansthāsyāmīti viniścitam || dāsyāmi ca sadā mokṣametalliṃgārcakāya vai || 173 || oṃkāraṃ sakṛdapyatra naro natvā prayatnataḥ || kṛtakṛtyo bhavennūnaṃ paramānmadanugrahāta || 174 || oṃkārapaścime bhāge tāratīrthamanuttamam || kṛtodakakriyastatra narastarati durgatim || 175 || oṃkāreśasya ye bhaktā jñeyāste naiva mānavāḥ || manuṣyacarmaṇā naddhāste rudrā mokṣagāminaḥ || 176 || asya liṃgasya mahimā nānyairatrāvagamyate || tvatpuṇyodayato yasmādvidhetrāvirabhūdidam || 177 || etalliṃgaprabhāvācca sarvaṃ jñāsyasi tattvataḥ || vidhe vidhehi tasmāttvaṃ sarvametaccarācaram ||178|| iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai brahmaṇe padmasaṃbhave| tasminneva mahāliṃge śaṃbhurlīno babhūva ha ||179|| || skaṃda uvāca || || brahmāpi bhajatedyāpi talliṃgaṃ kalaśodbhava || stuvanbrahma stavenaiva svātmanā vihitena hi ||4.2.73.180|| brahmastavaṃ japanmartyaḥ sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || pūryate ca mahāpuṇyairjñānaṃ prāpnoti sattamam || 181 || brahmastavamimaṃ japtvā trikālaṃ parivatsaram || aṃtakāle bhavejjñānaṃ yena baṃdhātpramucyate || || 182 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhtiāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdha oṃkāramahimavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 73 ||
<4.2.74>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇu vātāpi saṃhartaḥ kāśyāṃ pātakataṃkinī || padmakalpe tu yā vṛttā damanasya dvijanmanaḥ ||1|| bhāradvājasya tanayo damano nāma nāmataḥ || kṛtamauṃjīvidhiḥ sotha vidyājātaṃ pragṛhya ca || 2 || saṃsāraduḥkhabahulaṃ jīvitaṃ cāpi caṃcalam || vijñāya damano vidvānnirjagāma gṛhānnijāt || 3 || kāṃciddiśaṃ samālaṃbya nirvedaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || pratyāśramaṃ pratinagaṃ pratyabdhi pratikānanam || 4 || pratitīrthaṃ pratinadi sa babhrāma tapoyutaḥ || yāvaṃtyāyatanānīha tiṣṭhaṃti parito bhuvam ||5|| adhyuvāsa sa tāvaṃti saṃyateṃdriyamānasaḥ || paraṃ na manasaḥ sthairyaṃ kvāpi prāpi ca tena vai || 6 || manorathopadeṣṭā ca kutracitkvāpi nekṣitaḥ || kadāciddaivayogātsa damano nāma tāpasaḥ ||7|| revātaṭe niraikṣiṣṭa tīrthaṃ cāmarakaṃṭakam || mahadāyatanaṃ puṇyamoṃkārasyāpi tatra vai ||8|| dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanā āsīccetaḥ sthairyamavāpa ha || atha pāśupatāṃstatra sa nirīkṣya tapodhanān || 9 || vibhūtibhūṣitatanūnkṛtaliṃgasamarcanān || vihitaprāṇayātrāṃśca kṛtāgamavicāraṇān || 4.2.74.10 || svasthopaviṣṭānsvapuroragrato'calamānasān || praṇamyopāviśattatra tadācāryasya sannidhau || 11 || prabaddhahastayugalaḥ praṇamatarakaṃdharaḥ || atha pāśupatācāryo gargo nāma mahāmuniḥ || 12 || vārdhakena samākrāṃtastapasā kṛśavigrahaḥ || śaṃbhorārādhaneniṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvatapasviṣu ||13|| papraccha damanaṃ ceti kastvaṃ kasmādihāgataḥ || taruṇopi viraktosi kutastadvada sattama |||14||| iti praṇayapūrvaṃ sa niśamya damano'bravīt || bhagoḥ pāśupatācārya sarvajñārādhanapriya || 15 || kathayāmi yathārthaṃ te nijacetoviceṣṭitam || ahaṃ brāhmaṇadāyādo vedaśāstrakṛtaśramaḥ || 16 || saṃsārāsāratāṃ jñātvā vānaprasthamaśiśriyam || anenaiva śarīreṇa mahāsiddhimabhīpsatā ||17|| snātaṃ bahuṣu tīrtheṣu maṃtrā japtāstu koṭiśaḥ || devatāḥ sevitā bahvyo havanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ bahu || 18 || śuśrūṣitāśca guravo bahavo bahvanehasam || mahāśmaśāneṣu niśā bhūyasyopyativāhitāḥ || 19 || śikharāṇi girīṃdrāṇāṃ mayā cādhyuṣitānyaho || divyauṣadhi sahasrāṇi mayā saṃsādhitānyapi ||4.2.74.20|| rasāyanāni bahuśaḥ sevitāni mayā punaḥ || mahāsāhasamālaṃbya siddhādhyuṣitakaṃdarāḥ || 21 || mayā praviṣṭā bahuśaḥ kṛtāṃtavadanopamāḥ || tapaścāpi mahattaptaṃ bahubhirniyamairyamaiḥ || 22 || paraṃ kiṃcitkvacinnaikṣi siddhyaṃkuramapi prabho || idānīṃ tvāmanuprāpya mahīṃ paryaṭatā mayā || 23 || manasaḥ sthairyamāpannamiva saṃprāptasiddhinā || avaśyaṃ tvanmukhāṃbhojādyadvaco niḥsariṣyati || || 24 || tenaiva mahatī siddhirbhavitrī mama nānyathā || tadbrūhi sūpadeśaṃ ca kathaṃ siddhirbhavenmama || 25 || anenaiva śarīreṇa pārthivena prathīyasī || damanasya niśamyeti gargācāryo vacastadā || 26 || pratyakṣadṛṣṭaṃ provāca mahadāścaryamuttamam || sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tatra śiṣyāṇāṃ sthiracetasām || mumukṣūṇāṃ dhṛtavatāṃ mahāpāśupataṃ vratam ||27|| || garga uvāca || || anenaiveha dehena yadi tvaṃ siddhikāmukaḥ || śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā tadā te kathayāmyaham ||28|| avimukte mahākṣetre sarvasiddhiprade satām || dharmārthakāmamokṣākhya ratnānāṃ paramākare || 29 || samāśritānāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvakarmaṇām || śalabhānāṃ pradīpābhe tamaḥstoma mahādvipi || 4.2.74.30 || karmabhūruha dāvāgnau saṃsārābdhyaurvaśocipi || nirvāṇalakṣmī kṣīrābdhau sukhasaṃketasadmani || 31 || dīrghanidrā prasuptānāṃ paramodbodhadāyini || yātāyātaśramāpannaprāṇimārgamahīruhi || 32 || anekajanmajanita mahāpāpādrivajriṇi || nāmoccārakṛtāṃ puṃsāṃ mahāśreyo vidhāyini || 33 || viśveśituḥ paredhāmni sīmni svargāpavargayoḥ || svardhunī lolakallolā nityakṣālita bhūtale || 34 || evaṃvidhe mahākṣetre sarvaduḥkhaughahāriṇi || pratyakṣaṃ mama yadvṛttaṃ tadbravīmi mahāmate || 35 || yatra kālabhayaṃ nāsti yatra nāstyenaso bhayam || tatkṣetramahimānaṃ kaḥ samyagvarṇayituṃ kṣamaḥ || 36 || tīrthāni yāni lokesmiñjaṃtūnāmaghahānyaho || tāni sarvāṇi śuddhyarthaṃ kāśīmāyāṃti nityaśaḥ || 37 || api kāśyāṃ vasedyastu sarvāśī sarvavikrayī || sa yāṃ gatiṃ labhenmartyo yajñairdānairna sānyataḥ || 38 || rāgabījasamudbhūtaḥ saṃsāraviṭapo mahān || dīrghasvāpa kuṭhāreṇa cchinnaḥ kāśyāṃ na vardhate || 39 || sarveṣāmūṣarāṇāṃ tu kāśī parama ūṣaraḥ || vapturbījamidaṃ tasminnuptaṃ naiva prarohati || 4.2.74.40 || smariṣyaṃtīha ye kāśīmavaśyaṃ tepi sādhavaḥ || tepyaghaugha vinirmuktā yāsyaṃti gatimuttamām || 41 || vibhūtiḥ sarvalokānāṃ satyādīnāṃ subhaṃgurā || abhaṃgurā vimuktasya sā tu labhyā śivājñayā || 42 || kṛmikīṭapataṃgānāmavimukte tanutyajām || vibhūtirdṛśyate yā sā kvāsti brahmāṃḍamaṃḍale || 43 || vārāṇasī yadā prāptā kadācitkālaparyayāt || sa upāyo vidhātavyo yena no niṣkramo bahiḥ || 44 || pūrvato maṇikarṇīśo brahmeśo dakṣiṇe sthitaḥ || paścime caiva gokarṇo bhārabhūtastathottare ||45|| ityetaduttamaṃ kṣetramavimukte mahāphalam || maṇikarṇī hrade snātvā dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃvibhum ||46|| kṣetraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || tatra śrāddhapradātuśca mucyaṃte prapitāmahāḥ || 47 || avimukta samaṃ kṣetramapi brahmāṃḍagolake || na vidyate kvacitsatyaṃ satyaṃ sādhakasiddhidam ||48|| rakṣaṃti satataṃ kṣetraṃ yatra pāśāsipāṇayaḥ || mahāpāriṣadā ugrāḥ krūrebhyo'krūrabuddhayaḥ || 49 || prāgdvāramaṭṭahāsaśca gaṇakoṭiparīvṛtaḥ || rakṣedaharniśaṃ kṣetraṃ durvṛttebhyo vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 4.2.74.50 || tathaiva bhūtadhātrīśaḥ kṣetradakṣiṇarakṣakaḥ || gokarṇaḥ paścimadvāraṃ pāti koṭigaṇāvṛtaḥ || 51 || udagdvāraṃ tathā rakṣedghaṃṭākarṇo mahāgaṇaḥ || aiśaṃkoṇaṃ chāgavaktro bhīṣaṇo vahnidigdalam ||52 || rakṣaḥ kāṣṭhāṃ śaṃkukarṇo dṛmicaṃḍo maruddiśam || itthaṃ kṣetraṃ sadā pāṃti gaṇā ete'ti bhāsvarāḥ ||853|| kālākṣoraṇa bhadrastu kauleyaḥ kālakaṃpanaḥ || ete pūrveṇa rakṣaṃti gaṃgāpāre sthitā gaṇāḥ || 54 || vīrabhadro nabhaścaiva kardamāliptavigrahaḥ || sthūlakarṇo mahābāhurasipāre vyavasthitāḥ || 55 || viśālākṣo mahābhīmaḥ kuṃḍodaramahodarau || rakṣaṃti paścimadvāraṃ dehalīdeśasaṃsthitāḥ ||56|| naṃdisenaśca paṃcālaḥ kharapādakaraṃṭakaḥ || ānaṃdogopako babhrū rakṣaṃti varaṇātaṭe |||| 57 || tasminkṣetre mahāpuṇye liṃgamoṃkārasaṃjñakam|| tatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā dehenānena sādhakāḥ || 58 || kapilaścaiva sāvarṇiḥ śrīkaṃṭhaḥ pigaloṃśumān || ete pāśupatāḥ siddhāstalliṃgārādhanena hi || 59 || ekadā tasya liṃgasya kṛtvā paṃcāpipūjanam || nṛtyataḥ sahuḍutkāraṃ tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yayuḥ || 4.2.74.60 || anyacca te pravakṣyāmi tatra yadvṛttamadbhutam || niśāmaya mahābuddhe damana dvijasattama || 61 || ekā bhekī mune tatra caraṃtī liṃga sannidhau || pradakṣiṇaṃ sadā kuryānnirmālyākṣatabhakṣiṇī || 62 || sā tatra mṛtyuṃ na prāpa śivanirmālyabhakṣaṇāt || kṣetrādanyatra maraṇaṃ jātaṃ tasyāstadenasaḥ || 63 || varaṃ viṣamapiprāśyaṃ śivasvaṃ naiva bhakṣayet || viṣamekākinaṃ haṃti thivasvaṃ putrapauvakam || 64|| śivasya paripuṣṭāṃgāḥ sparśanīyā na sādhubhiḥ || tena karmavipākena tataste rauravaukasaḥ ||65|| kaścitkākaḥ samālokya maṃḍūkīṃ tāmitastataḥ || poplūyamānāmādāya caṃcvā kṣetrādbahirgataḥ ||66 || varṣābhvī tena sā kṣiptā kākena kṣetrabāhyataḥ || atha sā kālato bhekī tatraiva kṣetrasattame || 67 || pradakṣiṇīkaraṇato liṃgasyasparśanādapi|| puṇyāpuṇyavatījātā kanyāpuṣpabaṭorgṛhe || 68 || śubhāvayavasaṃsthānā śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitā || paraṃ gṛdhramukhī jātā nirmālyākṣatabhakṣaṇāt || 69 || samyaggītarahasyajñā nitarāṃ madhurasvarā || saptasvarāstrayo grāmā mūrcchanāstvaikaviṃśatiḥ ||4.2.74.70 || tānā ekonapaṃcāśa tālā ekottaraṃśatam || rāgāḥ ṣaḍeva teṣāṃ tu paṃcapaṃcāpi cāṃganāḥ||71 || ṣaḍviṃśadrāgarāgiṇya iti rāgi mudāvahāḥ || deśakāla vibhedena paṃcaṣaṣṭistathā parāḥ || 72 || yāvaṃta eva tālāḥ syu rāgāstāvaṃta eva hi || iti gītopaniṣadā pratyahaṃ sā śubhavratā || 73 || mādhavī madhurālāpā sadoṃkāraṃ samarcayet || prāpyāpyanarghyatāruṇyaṃ sā tu puṣpabaṭoḥ sutā || 74 || prāgjanmavāsanāyogādoṃkāraṃ bahvamaṃsta vai || svabhāva caṃcalaṃ cetastasyāstalliṃga sevanāt || 75 || damanasthairyamagamadyogeneva mahātmanaḥ || na divā bādhayāṃcakre kṣuttṛṇnidrā kṣapā sutām || 76 || ataṃdritamanā āsītsā talliṃga nirīkṣaṇe || akṣṇornimeṣā yāvaṃtastasyā āsandivāniśam || 77 || tāvatkālastayā sādhvyā mahānvighno'numīyate || nimeṣāṃtaritaḥ kālo yo yo vyathoṃgato mama || liṃgānavekṣaṇāttatra prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhaveta || 78 || iti saṃcitayaṃtyeva sevāṃ tatyāja noṃkṛteḥ || jalābhilāṣiṇī sā tu liṃganāmāmṛtaṃ pibet || 79 || nānya ddidṛkṣiṇī tasyā akṣiṇī śrutige api || vihāya liṃgamoṃkāraṃ hṛdvihāyaḥ sthitaṃ satām || 4.2.74.80 || tasyāḥ śabdagrahau nānya śabdagrahaṇatatparau || atīva nipuṇau jātau tatsanmālyakaraukarau || 81 || nānyatra caraṇau tasyāścarataḥ sukhavāṃchayā || tyaktvoṃkārājirakṣoṇīṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ nirvāṇapadmayā || 82 || oṃkāraṃ praṇavaṃ sāraṃ parabrahmaprakāśakam || śabdabrahmatrayīrūpaṃ nādabiṃdukalālayam || 83 || sadakṣaraṃ cādirūpaṃ viśvarūpaṃ parāvaram || varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ śāśvataṃ śāṃtamīśvaram || 84 || sarvalokaikajanakaṃ sarvalokaikarakṣakam || sarvalokaikasaṃhartṛ sarvalokaikavaṃditam || 85 || ādyaṃtarahitaṃ nityaṃ rśivaṃ śaṃkaramavyayam || ekaguṇatrayātītaṃ bhaktasvāṃtakṛtāspadam || 86 || nirupādhiṃ nirākāraṃ nirvikāraṃ niraṃjanam || nirmalaṃ nirahaṃkāraṃ niṣprapaṃcaṃ nijodayam || 87 || svātmārāmamanaṃtaṃ ca sarvagaṃ sarvadarśinam || sarvadaṃ sarvabhoktāraṃ sarvaṃ sarvasukhāspadam ||88|| vāgiṃdriyaṃ tadīyaṃ ca proccarattadaharniśam || nāmāṃtaraṃ na gṛhṇāti kvacidanyasyakasyacit||89|| etannāmākṣararasaṃ rasayaṃtī divāniśam || rasanā naiva jānāti tasyā anyadrasāṃtaram || 4.2.74.90 || saṃmārjanaṃ raṃgamālāḥ prāsādaṃ paritaḥ sadā || vidadhyānmādhavī tatra tathārcā pātraśodhanam || 91 || tatra pāśupatā ye vai praṇaveśārcane ratāḥ || tāṃśca śuśrūṣayennityaṃ pitṛbuddhyāti bhaktitaḥ || 92 || vaiśākhasya caturdaśyāmekadā sā tu mādhavī || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā divopavasānvitā || 93 || yātrāmilitabhakteṣu prātaryāteṣu sarvataḥ || saṃmārjanādikaṃ kṛtvā liṃgamabhyarcya harṣataḥ || 94 || gāyaṃtī madhuraṃ gītaṃ nṛtyaṃtī nijalīlayā|| dhyāyaṃtī liṃgamoṃkāraṃ tatra liṃge layaṃ yayau || 95 || anenaiva śarīreṇa pārthivena mahāmatiḥ || asmadācāryamukhyānāṃ paśyatāṃ ca tapasvinām || 96 || prādurbabhūva yalliṃgājjyotirjaṭilitāṃbaram || tatra jyotiṣi sā bālā jyotirmayyapi sāpyabhūt || 97 || rādhaśuklacaturdaśyāmadyāpi kṣetravāsinaḥ || tatra yātrāṃ prakurvaṃti mahotsavapuraḥsarāḥ || 98 || tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā caturdaśyāmupoṣitāḥ || prāpnuvaṃti paraṃ jñānaṃ yatrakutrāpi vai mṛtāḥ || 99 || brahmāṃḍodara madhye tu yāni tīrthāni sarvataḥ || tāni vaiśākhabhūtāyāmāyāṃtyoṃkṛti darśane ||4.2.74.100|| liṃgāgre śrīmukhī nāmnī guhāsti paramottamā || pātālasya ca taddvāraṃ tatra siddhā vasaṃti hi || 101 || tiṣṭheyuḥ paṃcarātraṃ ye guhāyāṃ tatra suvratāḥ || te nāgakanyāḥ paśyaṃti brūyustāśca śubhāśubham || 102 || kaṃdarottaradigbhāge tatra kūpo rasodakaḥ || āṣaṇmāsaṃ ca tatpītvā pibedbrahmarasāyanam || 103 || tatra nādeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā nādanidānabhūḥ || sarvanādātmakaṃ viśvaṃ tacchravo gocarī bhavet || 104 || tatra matsyodarīṃ snātvā svardhunīṃ varuṇāplutām || kṛtakṛtyo bhavejjaṃturnaiva śocati kutracit || 105 || asaṃkhyātā gatāḥ siddhimoṃkāreśvarasevakāḥ || pārthivenaiva dehena divyabhūtena tatkṣaṇāt || 106 || avimuktaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ brahmāṃḍādapi sarvataḥ || tatopi para oṃkāra ukto matsyodarī taṭe || 107 || praṇaveśoṃ'ga yaiḥ kāśyāṃ na nato nāpi cārcitaḥ || kimarthaṃ te samutpannā mātṛtāruṇyahāriṇaḥ || 108 || yadā prabhṛti viśveśo maṃdarādāgato'bhavat || tasminnānaṃda gahane tadāprabhṛti sattama || 109 || sarvāṇyāyatanānyāśu sābdhīni sa girīṇyapi || sa nadīni sa tīrthāni sa dvīpāni yayustataḥ || || 4.2.74.110 || idānīṃ mama bhāgyena smāritohaṃ tvayā mune || ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi yāmaḥ kāśīṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 111 || etepi mama śiṣyā ye mahāpāśupatavratāḥ || kāśīṃ yiyāsavastepi yataḥ sarve mumukṣavaḥ || 112 || api vārdhakamāsādya yaiḥ kāśī naiva śīlitā || mānuṣe durlabhe naṣṭe kutasteṣāṃ mahāsukham || 113 || yāvanneṃdriya vaikalyaṃ yāvannaivāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ || tāvatsevyaṃ prayatnena śaṃbhorānaṃdakānanam|| 114 || ya ānaṃdavanaṃ śaṃbhoḥ śiśriyuḥ śrīniketanam || acalāśrīrna muṃcettānmahāsaukhyaikaśevadhīn || 115 || ityākhyāya kathāṃ ramyāṃ gargaḥ pāśupatottamaḥ || bhāradvājena sahitaḥ prāpa vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 116 || damanopi hi dharmātmā gargācāryeṇa saṃyutaḥ || ārādhya śrīmadoṃkāraṃ tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gataḥ || 117 || || skaṃda uvāca || || ilvalāre paraṃ sthānamoṃkāramavimuktake || tatra siddhiparāṃ jagmuḥ sādhakā bahuśo mune || 118 || kalau kaluṣacittānāṃ puro nākhyeyameva hi || praṇaveśvaramāhātmyaṃ nāstikānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 119 || ye niṃdaṃti mahādevaṃ kṣetraṃ niṃdaṃti ye'dhiyaḥ || purāṇaṃ ye ca niṃdaṃti te saṃbhāṣyā na kutracit || 4.2.74.120 || oṃkārasadṛśaṃ liṃgaṃ na kvacijjagatītale || iti gauryai samākhyātaṃ devadevena niścitam || 121 || imamadhyāyamākarṇya narastadgatamānasaḥ || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivalokamavāpnuyāt || 122 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthekāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdha oṃkāramāhātmyaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 74 || || cha ||
<4.2.75>
|| agastya uvāca || || śrutvoṃkārakathāmetāṃ mahāpātakanāśinīm || na tṛptosmi viśākhātha brūhi traiviṣṭapīṃ kathām || 1 || kathaṃ ca kathitā devyai devadevena ṣaṇmukha || āvirbhūtirmahābuddhe puṇyā trailocanī parā || 2 || skaṃda uvāca || || ākarṇaya mune vacmi kathāṃ śramanivāriṇīm || yathā devena kathitāṃ triviṣṭapasamudbhavām || 3 || virajākhyaṃ hi tatpīṭhaṃ tatra liṃgaṃ triviṣṭapam || tatpīṭhadarśanādeva virajā jāyate naraḥ || 4 || tisrastu saṃgatāstatra srotasvinyo ghaṭodbhava || tisraḥ kalmaṣahāriṇyo dakṣiṇe hi trilocanāt || 5 || srotomūrtidharāḥ sākṣālliṃgasnapanahetave || sarasvatyatha kāliṃdī narmadā cātiśarmadā || 6 || tisropi hi trisaṃdhyaṃ tāḥ saritaḥ kuṃbhapāṇayaḥ || snapayaṃti mahādhāma liṃgaṃ traiviṣṭapaṃ mahat || 7 || liṃgāni paritastābhiḥ svanāmnāsthāpi tānyapi || teṣāṃ saṃdarśanātpuṃsāṃ tāsāṃ snānaphalaṃ bhavet || 8 || sarasvatīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dakṣiṇena triviṣṭapāt || sārasvataṃ padaṃ dadyāddṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ ca jāḍyahṛt || 9 || yamuneśaṃ pratīcyāṃ ca narairbhaktyā samarcitam || api kilbiṣavadbhiśca yamalokanivāraṇam || 4.2.75.10||| dṛṣṭaṃ trilocanātprācyāṃ narmadeśaṃ suśarmadam || talliṃgārcanato nṛṇāṃ garbhavāso niṣidhyate || 11 || snātvā pilipilā tīrthe triviṣṭapasamīpataḥ || dṛṣṭvā trilocanaṃ liṃgaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ pariśocati || 12 || triviṣṭapasya liṃgasya smaraṇādapi mānavaḥ || triviṣṭapa patirbhūyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 13 || triviṣṭapasya draṣṭāraḥ sraṣṭāraḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ || kṛtakṛtyāsta evātra ta evātra mahādhiyaḥ || 14 || ānaṃdakānane liṃgaṃ praṇataṃ yaistriviṣṭapam || trilocanasya nāmāpi yaiḥ śrutaṃ śuddhabuddhibhiḥ || 15 || saptajanmārjitātpāpātte pūtā nātra saṃśayaḥ || pṛthivyāṃ yāni liṃgāni teṣu dṛṣṭeṣu yatphalam || 16 || tatsyātriviṣṭape dṛṣṭe kāśyāṃ manye tatodhikam || kāśyāṃ triviṣṭape dṛṣṭe dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ triviṣṭapam || 17 || kṣaṇānnirdhūta pāposau na punargarbhabhāgbhaveta || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvāvabhṛthavānsa ca || 18 || yo vai pilipilā tīrthe snātvottaravahāṃbhasi || sarittrayaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yatra sākṣādvasetsadā || 19 || tatra śrāddhādikaṃ kṛtvā gayāyāṃ kiṃ kariṣyati || snātvā pilipilā tīrthe kṛtvā vai piṃḍapātanam || 4.2.75.20 || dṛṣṭvā triviṣṭapaṃ liṃgaṃ koṭitīrthaphalaṃ labhet || yadanyatrārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkāśī darśanādvrajet || 21 || kāśyāṃ tu yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatpaiśācapadapradam || pramādātpātakaṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhorānaṃdakānane || 22|| dṛṣṭvā triviṣṭapaṃ liṃgaṃ tatpāpamapi hāsyati || sarvasminnapi bhūpṛṣṭhe śreṣṭhamānaṃdakānanam || 23 || tatrāpi sarvatīrthāni tatopyoṃkārabhūmikā || oṃkārādapi salliṃgānmokṣavartma prakāśakāt || 24 || atiśreṣṭhataraṃ liṃgaṃ śreyorūpaṃ trilocanam || 25 || tejasviṣu yathā bhānurdṛśyeṣu ca yathā śaśī || tathā liṃgeṣu sarveṣu paraṃ liṃgaṃ trilocanam || 26 || trilocanārcakānāṃ sā padavī na davīyasī || paraṃ nirvāṇapadmāyā mahāsaukhyaikaśevadheḥ ||27|| sakṛttrilocanārcāto yacchreyaḥ samupārjyate || na tadā janmasaṃpūṃjya liṃgānyanyāni labhyate ||28|| kāśyāṃ trilocanaṃ liṃgaṃ yercayaṃti mahādhiyaḥ || tercyāstribhuvanaukobhirmamaprītimabhīpsubhiḥ || 29 || kṛtvāpi sarvasaṃnyāsaṃ kṛtvā pāśupatavratam || niyamebhyaḥ skhalitvāpi kuto bibhyati mānavāḥ || 4.2.75.30 || vidyamāne mahāliṃge mahāpāpaughahāriṇi|| triviṣṭape puṇyarāśau mokṣanikṣepasadmani ||31|| samabhyarcya mahāliṃgaṃ sakṛdeva trilocanam ||' mucyate kaluṣaiḥ sarvairapijanmaśatārjitaiḥ||| 32 || brahmahāpi surāpo vā steyī vā gurutalpagaḥ || tatsaṃyogyapi vā varṣaṃ mahāpāpī prakīrtitaḥ || 33 || paradārarataścāpi parahiṃsā ratopi vā || parāpavādaśīlopi tathā visraṃbhaghātakaḥ || 34 | kṛtaghnopi bhrūṇahāpi vṛṣalīpatireva vā || mātāpitṛgurutyāgī vahnido garadopi vā || 35 || goghnaḥ strīghnopi śūdraghnaḥ kanyādūṣayitāpi ca || krūro vā piśuno vāpi nijadharmaparāṅmukhaḥ || 36|| niṃdako nāstiko vāpi kūṭasākṣyapravādakaḥ|| abhakṣyabhakṣako vāpi tathā'vikreya vikrayī || 37 || ityādi pāpaśīlopi muktvaikaṃ śivaniṃdakama || pāpānniṣkṛtimāpnoti natvā liṃgaṃ trilocanam || 38 || śivaniṃdārato mūḍhaḥ śivaśāstraviniṃdakaḥ || tasya no niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā kvāpi śāstrepi kenacit || 39 || ātmaghātī sa vijñeyaḥ sadā trailokyaghātakaḥ || śivaniṃdāṃ vidhatte yaḥ sa nābhāṣyo'dhamādhamaḥ|| 4.2.75.40|| śivaniṃdāratā ye ca śivabhaktajaneṣvapi|| te yāṃti narake ghore yāvaccaṃdradivākarau||41|| śaivāḥ pūjyāḥ prayatnena kāśyā mokṣamabhīpsubhiḥ|| teṣvarciteṣvapi śivaḥ prīto bhavatyasaṃśayaḥ || 42 || sarveṣāmiha pāpānāṃ prāyaścittacikīrṣayā || niḥśaṃkaireva vaktavyaṃ pramāṇajñairidaṃ vacaḥ || 43 || puraścaraṇakāmaścedbhītosi yadi pāpataḥ || manyase yadi naḥ satyaṃ vākyaśāstrapramāṇataḥ || 44 || tataḥ sarvaṃ parityajya kṛtvā manasi niścayam || ānaṃdakānanaṃ yāhi yatra viśveśvaraḥ svayam || 45 || yatra kṣetrapraviṣṭānāṃ narāṇāṃ niścitātmanām || na bādhate'ghanicayaḥ prāpyeta ca parovṛṣaḥ || 46 || tatrādyāpi mahātīrthaṃ trisrotasyatinirmale || puṇye pilipilānāmni trisaritparisevite || 47 || trilocanākṣivikṣepa parikṣipta mahainasi || snātvā gṛhyoktavidhinā tarpaṇīyānpratarpya ca || 48 || dattvā deyaṃ yathāśakti vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || dṛṣṭvā triviṣṭapaṃ liṃgaṃ samabhyarcyātibhaktitaḥ || 49 || gaṃdhādyairvividhairmālyaiḥ paṃcāmṛtapuraḥsaraiḥ || dhūpairdīpaiḥ sanaivedyairvāsobhirbahubhūṣaṇaiḥ || 4.2.75.50 || pūjopakaraṇairdravyairghaṃṭādarpaṇacāmaraiḥ || citradhvajapatākābhirnṛtyavādyasugāyanaiḥ || 51 || japaiḥ pradakṣiṇābhiśca namaskārairmudāyutaiḥ || paricārakasaṃtoṣaiḥ kṛtveti paripūjanam || 52 || brāhmaṇānvācayetpaścānniṣpāpohamiti bruvan || evaṃ kurvannaraḥ prājño nirenā jāyate kṣaṇāt || 53 || tataḥ paṃcanade snātvā maṇikarṇī hrade tataḥ || tato viśveśamabhyarcya prāpnoti sukṛtaṃ mahat ||54 || prāyaścittamidaṃ proktaṃ mahāpāpaviśodhanam || nāstike na pravaktavyaṃ kāśīmāhātmya niṃdake || 55 || dadacca dravyalobhena prāyaścittamidaṃ śubham|| dātā narakamāpnoti satyaṃsatyaṃ ghaṭodbhava || 55 || kṣamāṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛnya yatphalaṃ samyagāpyate || pradoṣe tatphalaṃ kāśyāṃ saptakṛtvastrilocane || 57 || bhujaṃgamekhalaṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā triviṣṭapam || janmāṃtarepi muktaḥ syādanyatra maraṇe sati || 58 || anyatra sarvaliṃgeṣu puṇyakālo viśiṣyate || triviṣṭape puṇyakālaḥ sadā rātridivaṃ nṛṇām || 59 || liṃgānyoṃkāramukhyāni sarvapāpaprakṛṃtyalam || paraṃ trailocanī śaktiḥ kācidanyaiva pārvati || 4.2.75.60 || yataḥ sarveṣu liṃgeṣu liṃgametadanuttamam || tatkāraṇaṃ śṛṇva parṇe karṇe kuru vadāmyaham || 61 || purā me yogayuktasya liṃgametadbhuvastalāt || udbhidya saptapātālaṃ niragātpurato mahat || 62 || asmim̐llige purā gauri suguptaṃ tiṣṭhatā mayā || tubhyaṃ netratrayaṃ dattaṃ niraikṣiṣṭhāstathottamam || 63 || tadā prabhṛti deveśi liṃgametattrilocanama || viṣṭapatritayāṃtasthairgīyate jñānadṛṣṭidam || 54 || trilocanasya ye bhaktāstepi sarve trilocanāḥ || mama pāriṣadāste tu jīvanmuktā'sta eva hi || 65 || trilocanasya liṃgasya mahimānaṃ na kaścana || samyagvetti maheśāni mayaiva parigopitam ||66|| śuklarādhatṛtīyāyāṃ snātvā pailipile hrade || upoṣaṇaparā bhaktyā rātrau jāgaraṇānvitāḥ ||67|| trilocanaṃ pūjayitvā prātaḥ snātvāpi tatra vai || punarliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya dattvā dharmaghaṭānapi || 68 || sānnānsadakṣiṇāndevi pitṝnuddiśya harṣitāḥ || vidhāya pāraṇaṃ paścācchivabhaktajanaiḥ saha || 69 || visṛjya pārthivaṃ dehaṃ tena puṇyena noditāḥ || bhavaṃti devi niyataṃ gaṇā mama purogamāḥ || 4.2.75.70 || tāvaddhamaṃti saṃsāre devā martyā mahoragāḥ || gauri yāvanna paśyaṃti kāśyāṃ liṃgaṃ trilocanam ||71|| sakṛttriviṣṭapaṃ dṛṣṭvā snātvā pailipile hrade || na jātuḥ mātustanapo jāyate jaṃturatra hi ||72|| pratimāsaṃ sadāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca bhāmini || āyāṃti sarvatīrthāni draṣṭuṃ devaṃ triviṣṭapam ||73|| triviṣṭapāddakṣiṇataḥ snātaḥ pailipileṃ'bhasi || tatra saṃdhyāmupāsyaikāṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || 74 || pādodakākhyastatraiva kūpaḥ pāpavināśakaḥ || prāśya tasyodakaṃ martyo na martyo jāyate punaḥ ||75 || tasya liṃgasya pārśve tu saṃti liṃgānyanekaśaḥ || kaivalyadāni tānyatra darśanātsparśanādapi||76|| tatra śāṃtanavaṃ liṃgaṃ gaṃgātīre pratiṣṭhitam || taddṛṣṭvā śāṃtimāpnoti naraḥ saṃsāratāpitaḥ ||77|| taddakṣiṇe mahāliṃgaṃ mune bhīṣmeśa saṃjñitam || kaliḥ kālaśca kāmaśca bādhaṃte na tadīkṣaṇāt || 78 || tatpratīcyāṃ mahāliṃgaṃ droṇeśa iti kīrtitam || yalliṃgapūjanāddroṇo jyotīrūpaṃ punardadhau || 79 || aśvatthāmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tadagre cātipuṇyadam || yadarcanavaśāddrauṇirna bibhetyapi kālataḥ || 4.2.75.80 || droṇeśādvāyu digbhāge vālakhilyeśvaraṃ param || talliṃgaṃ śraddhayā dṛṣṭvā sarvakratuphalaṃ labhet || 81 || tadvāme liṃgamālokya vālmīkeśvarasaṃjñitam || tasya saṃdarśanādeva viśoko jāyate naraḥ || 82 || anyaccātraiva yadvṛttaṃ tadbravīmi ghaṭodbhava || triviṣṭapasya māhātmyaṃ devyai devena bhāṣitam || 83 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe paṃcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||
<4.2.76>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇuṣva maitrāvaruṇe purākalpe rathaṃtare || itihāsa ihāsīdyaḥ pīṭhe virajasaṃjñite || 1 || trilocanasya prāsāde maṇimāṇikyanirmite || nānābhaṃgi gavākṣāḍhye ratnasānāvivāyate || 2 || kadācidapi kalpāṃte dyo loke bhraṃśati kṣaye || prottaṃbhanaṃ staṃbha iva datto viśvakṛtā svayam || 3 || maruttaraṃgitāgrābhiḥ patākābhiritastataḥ || sannivārayatīvetthamaghaughānviśato mune || 4 || dedīpyamāna sauvarṇa kalaśena virājite || pārvaṇena śaśāṃkena khedādiva samāśrite || 5 || tatra pārāvatadvaṃdvaṃ vasetsvairaṃ kṛtālayam || prātaḥsāyaṃ ca madhyāhne kurvannityaṃ pradakṣiṇam || 6 || uḍḍīyamānaṃ paritaḥ pakṣavāteritastataḥ || rajaḥprāsādasaṃlagnaṃ dūrīkurvaddinedine || 7 || trilocaneti satataṃ nāma bhaktairudāhṛtam || triviṣṭapeti ca tathā tayoḥ karṇātithī bhavet || 8 || caturvidhāni vādyāni śaṃbhuprītikarāṇyalam || tayoḥ karṇaguhāṃ prāpya pratiśabdaṃ pratanvate || 9 || maṃgalārārtikajyotistrisaṃdhyaṃ pakṣiṇostayoḥ || netrāṃta nirviśannityaṃ bhaktaceṣṭāṃ pradarśayet ||4.2.76.10|| prāṇayātrāṃ vihāyāpi kadācitsthiramānasau || noḍḍīyavāṃchitaṃ yātaḥ paśyaṃtau kautukaṃ khagau || 11 || tatra bhaktajanākīrṇaṃ prāsādaṃ parito mune || taṃḍulādi caraṃtau tau kurvāte ca pradakṣiṇam || 12 || devadakṣiṇadigbhāge catuḥsrotasvinī jalam || tṛṣārtau dhayato vipra snātau jātu cidaṃḍajau || 13 || tayoritthaṃ vicaratostrilocanasamīpataḥ || agādbahutithaḥ kālo dvijayoḥ sādhuceṣṭayoḥ || 14 || atha devālayaskaṃdhe gavākṣāṃtargatau ca tau || śyenena kenaciddṛṣṭau krūradṛṣṭyā sukhasthitau || 15 || tacca pārāvatadvaṃdvaṃ śyenaḥ parijighṛkṣukaḥ || avatīryāṃbarādāśu praviṣṭonyaśivālaye || 16 || tato vilokayāmāsa tadāgamavinirgamau || kena mārgeṇa viśato durgametau patattriṇau || 17 || kenādhvanā ca niryātaḥ kva kāle kurutaśca kim || kathaṃ yugapade tau me grāhyau svairaṃ bhaviṣyataḥ || 18 || madhye durgapraviṣṭau ca mamavaśyāvimau na yat || ekadṛṣṭiḥ kṣaṇaṃ tasthau śyena itthaṃ viciṃtayan || 19 || aho durgabalaṃ prājñāḥ śaṃsaṃtyeveti hetutaḥ || durbalopyākalayituṃ sahasārirna śakyate ||4.2.76.20 || kariṇāṃ tu sahasreṇa varāśvānāṃ na lakṣataḥ || tatkarmasiddhirnṛpaterdurgeṇaikena yadbhavet || 21 || durgastho nābhibhūyeta vipakṣaḥ kenacitkvacit || svataṃtraṃ yadi durgaṃ syādamarmajñaprakāśitam || 22 || iti durgabalaṃ śaṃsañśyeno roṣāruṇekṣaṇaḥ || asādhvasau kalaravau vīkṣya yāto nabhoṃgaṇam || 23 || atha pārāvatīdakṣā vipakṣaṃ prekṣya pakṣiṇam || mahābalaṃ durgabalā prāha pārāvataṃ patim || 24 || || kalaravyuvāca || || priya pārāvata prājña sarvakāmi sukhārava || tava dṛgviṣayaṃ prāptaḥ śyenoya prabalo ripuḥ || 25 || sāvajñaṃ vākyamākarṇya pārāvatyāḥ sa tatpatiḥ || pārāvatīmuvācedaṃ kā ciṃteti tava priye || 26 || || pārāvata uvāca || || kati nāma na saṃtīha subhage vyomacāriṇaḥ || kati devālayeṣveṣu khagā nopaviśaṃti hi || 27 || kati caiva na paśyaṃti nau sukhasthāviha priye || tebhyo yadīha bhetavyaṃ kuto nau tatsukhaṃ priye || 28 || ramasva tvaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ tyaja ciṃtāmimāṃ śubhe || asya śyenavarākasya gaṇanāpi na me hṛdi || 29 || itthaṃ pārāvatavacaḥ śrutvā pārāvatī tataḥ || maunamālaṃbya saṃtasthe patyuḥ pādārpitekṣaṇā || 4.2.76.30 || hitavartmopadiśyāpi priya priyacikīrṣayā || sādhvyā joṣaṃ samāstheyaṃ kāryaṃ patyurvacaḥ sadā || 31 || anyedyurapyathāyātaḥ śyeno paśyatsa daṃpatī || aparicchinnayā dṛṣṭyā yathā mṛtyurgatāyuṣam || 32 || atha maṃḍalagatyā sa prāsādaṃ parito bhraman || nirīkṣya tadgatāyātau yāto gaganamārgataḥ || 33 || gate'tha nabhasi śyene punaḥ pārāvatāṃganā || provāca preyasī nātha dṛṣṭo duṣṭastvayā'hitaḥ || 34 || tasyā vākyaṃ samākarṇya punaḥ kalaravobravīt || kiṃ kariṣyatyasau mugdhe mama vyomavihāriṇaḥ || 35 || durgaṃ ca svargatulyaṃ me yatra nāstyarito bhayam || ayaṃ na tā gatīrvetti yā vedāhaṃ nabhoṃgaṇe || 36 || praḍīnoḍḍīna saṃḍīna kāṃḍavyāḍakapāṭikāḥ ||| sraṃsanī maṃḍalavatī gatayoṣṭāvudāhṛtāḥ || 37 || yathaitāsviha kauśalyaṃ mayi pārāvati priye || gatiṣu kvāpi kasyāpi pakṣiṇo na tathāṃbare || 38 || sukhena tiṣṭha kā ciṃtā mayi jīvati te priye || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sāsthitā mūkavatsatī || 39 || aparedyurapi śyenastatra bhāraśilātale || kiyadaṃtaramāsādyopaviṣṭo'tiprahṛṣṭavat ||4.2.76.40|| āyāmaṃ tatra saṃsthitvā tatkulāyaṃ vilokya ca || punarvinirgataḥ śyenaḥ sāpi bhītābravītpunaḥ ||41|| priyasthānamidaṃ tyājyaṃ duṣṭadṛṣṭividūṣitam || asau krūroti nikaṭamupaviṣṭo'tihṛṣṭavat || 42 || sāvajñaṃ sa punaḥ prāha kiṃ kariṣyatyasau priye || mṛgākṣīṇāṃ svabhāvoyaṃ prāyaśo bhīruvṛttayaḥ || 43 || itaredyurapi prāptaḥ sa ca śyeno mahābalaḥ || tayorabhimukhaṃ tatra sthito yāma dvayāvadhi ||44|| punarvilokya tadvartma śīghraṃ yāto yathāgatam|| gatetha śakunau tasminsā babhāṣe vihaṃgamī|| ||45|| nātha sthānāṃtaraṃ yāvo mṛtyurnau nikaṭotra yat || punarduṣṭe praṇaṣṭesminnāvāṃ syāvaḥ sukhaṃ priya ||46|| priya yasya sapakṣasya gatiḥ sarvatra siddhidā || sa kiṃ svadeśarāgeṇa nāśaṃ prāpnoti buddhimān|| 47 || sopasargaṃ nijaṃ deśaṃ tyaktvā yonyatra na vrajet || sa paṃgurnāśamāpnoti kūlasthita iva drumaḥ || 48
