|| priyoditaṃ niśamyeti sa bhavitrī daśārditaḥ || sarīḍhaṃ punarapyāha priye mā bhaiḥ khagāttataḥ || 49 || athāparasminnahani sa śyenaḥ prātareva hi || taddvāradeśamāsādya sāyaṃ yāvatsthito balaḥ || 4.2.76.50 || astācalasya śikharaṃ yāte bhānau gate khage || kulāyādbāhyamāgatyovāca pārāvatī patim || 51 || nātha nirgamanasyāyaṃ kālaḥ kālo'tidūrataḥ || yāvattāvadviniryāhi tyaktvā māmapi sanmate || 52 || tvayi jīvati duṣprāpyaṃ na kiṃcijjagatītale || punardārāḥ punarmitraṃ punarvasu punargṛham || || 53 || yadyātmā rakṣitaḥ puṃsā dārairapi dhanairapi || tadā sarvaṃ hariścaṃdrabhūpeneveha labhyate || 54 || ayamātmā priyo baṃdhurayamātmā mahaddhanam || dhamārthakāmamokṣāṇāmayamātmārjakaḥ paraḥ || 55 || yāvadātmani vai kṣemaṃ tāvatkṣemaṃ jagattraye || sopi kṣemaḥ sumatinā yaśasā saha vāṃchyate || 96 || yaśohīnaṃ tu yatkṣemaṃ tatkṣemānnidhanaṃ varam || tadyaśaḥ prāpyate puṃbhirnītimārgapravartane || 57 || ato nītipathaṃ śrutvā nātha sthānādito vraja || na gamiṣyasi cetprātastato me saṃsmariṣyasi || 58 || ityuktopi sa vai patnyā pārāvatyā sumedhayā || na niryayau pratisthānādbhavitryā prativāritaḥ || 59 || athoṣasi samāgatya śyenena balinā tadā || tannirgamādhvā saṃruddhaḥ kiṃcidbhakṣyavatā mune || 4.2.76.60 || dināni katicittatra sthitvā śyeno mahāmatiḥ || pārāvatamuvācedaṃ dhiktvāṃ pauruṣavarjitam || 61 || kiṃvā yudhyasva durbuddhe kiṃvā niryāhi me girā || kṣudhākṣīṇo mṛtaḥ paścānnirayaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam|| 62 || dvau bhavaṃtāvahaṃ caikaścalau jayaparājayau || sthānārthaṃ yudhyataḥ sattvātsvargo vā durgameva vā || 63 || purupārthaṃ samālaṃbya ye yataṃte mahādhiyaḥ || vidhireva hi sāhāyyaṃ kuryāttatsattvacoditaḥ || 64 || itthaṃ sa śyenasaṃproktaḥ patnyāpyutsāhitaḥ khagaḥ || ayudhyattena śyenena svadurgadvāramāśritaḥ || 65 || kṣudhitastṛṣitaḥ sotha śyenena balinā dhṛtaḥ || caraṇena dṛḍhenāśu caṃcvā sāpi dhṛtā khagī|| 66 || tāvādāyoḍḍayāṃcakre śyeno vyomani satvaram || ciṃtayadbhakṣaṇasthānamanyapakṣivivarjitam || 67 || atha patnyā kalaravaḥ proktastatra sumedhayā || vacovamānitaṃ nātha tvayā me strīti buddhitaḥ || 68 || ato'vasthāmimāṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ kuryāmabalāyataḥ || adhunāpi vacaścaikaṃ karoṣi yadi me priya || 65 || tadā hitaṃ te vakṣyāmi kuru caivāvicāritam || mamaikavākyakaraṇātstrījito na bhavipyasi || 4.2.76.70 || yāvadāsyagatāsmyasya yāvatkhastho na bhūmigaḥ || tāvadātmavimuktyaivamareḥ pādaṃ dṛḍhaṃ daśa |||71||| iti patnīvacaḥ śrutvā tathā sa kṛtavānkhagaḥ || sapīḍito dṛḍhaṃ pāde śyenaścītkṛtavānbahu || 72 || tena cītkaraṇenātha muktā sā mukhasaṃpuṭāt|| pādāṃguli ślathatvena sopi pārāvato'patat|| 73 || vipadyapi ca na prājñaiḥ saṃtyā jyaḥ kvacidudyamaḥ || kva caṃcupuṭastasya kva ca tatpādapīḍanam ||74|| kva ca dvayostathābhūtā darermokṣaṇamadbhutam || durbalepyudyamavati phalaṃ bhāgyaṃ yato'rpayet || || 75 || tasmādbhāgyānusāreṇa phalatyeva sadodyamaḥ || praśaṃsaṃtyudyamaṃ cāto vipadyapi manīṣiṇaḥ || 76 || atha tau kālayogena vipannau sarayūtaṭe || muktipuryāmayodhyāyāmeko vidyādharo'bhavat || 77 || mṛtānāṃ yatra jaṃtūnāṃ kāśīprāptirbhaveddhruvam || maṃdāradāmatanayo nāmnā parimalālayaḥ || 78 || anekavidyānilayaḥ kalākauśalabhājanam|| kaumāraṃ vaya āsādya śivabhaktiparobhavat || 79 || niyamaṃ cātijagrāha vijiteṃdriyamānasaḥ || ekapatnīvrataṃ nityaṃ cariṣyāmīti niścitam|| 4.2.76.80 || parayoṣitsamāsaktirāyuḥ kīrti balaṃ sukham || haretsvarga gatiṃ cāpi tasmāttāṃ varjayetsudhīḥ || 81 || aparaṃ cāpi niyamaṃ sa śuciṣmānsamādade || gatajanmāṃtarābhyāsāttrilocanasamāśrayāt || 82 || samastapuṇyanilayaṃ samastārthaprakāśakam || samastakāmajanakaṃ parānaṃdaikakāraṇam || || 83 || yāvaccharīramarujaṃ yāvanneṃdriyaviplavaḥ || tāvattrilocanaṃ kāśyāmanarcyāśnāmi nāṇvapi ||84|| itthaṃ māṃdāradāmiḥ sa nityaṃ parimalālayaḥ || kāśyāṃ triviṣṭapaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgacchetprayatnavān || 85 || pārāvatyapi sā jātā ratnadīpasya maṃdire || nāgarājasya pātāle nāmnā ratnāvalīti ca || 86 || samastanāgakanyānāṃ rūpaśīlakalāguṇaiḥ || ekaiva ratnabhūtāsīdratnadīporagātmajā || 87 || tasyā sakhīdvayaṃ cāsīdekā nāmnā prabhāvatī || kalāvatī tathānyā ca nityaṃ tadanuge ubhe || 88|| svadehādanapāyinyau chāyākāṃtī yathā tayā || te dve sakhyāvabhūtāṃhi ratnāvalyā ghaṭodbhava || 89 || sā tu bālye vyatikrāṃte kiṃcidudrinnayauvanā || śivabhaktaṃ svapitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā niyamamagrahīt || 4.2.76.90 || pitastrilocanaṃ kāśyāmarcayitvā dinedine || ābhyāṃ sakhībhyāṃ sahitā maunaṃ tyakṣyāmi nānyathā || || 91 || evaṃ nāgakumārī sā sakhīdvayasamanvitā || trilocanaṃ samabhyarcya gṛhānaharahovrajet || 92 || dinedine sā pratyagraiḥ kusumairiṣṭagaṃdhibhiḥ || suvicitrāṇi mālyāni pariguṃphyārcayedvibhum || 93 || tisropi gītaṃ gāyaṃti lasadgāṃdhārasuṃdaram || rāsamaṃḍalabhedena lāsyaṃ tisropi kurvate || 94 || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgāṃśca layatālavicakṣaṇāḥ || vādayaṃti mudā yuktāstisropīśvarasannidhau ||95|| itthamārādhayaṃtīśaṃ tisro nāgakumārikāḥ || vicitragaṃdhamālābhiḥ saṃmārjanavilepanaiḥ || 96 || ekadā mādhave māsi tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitāḥ || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nṛtyagītakathādibhiḥ || 97 || prātaścaturthīṃ snātvātha tīrthaṃ pailipile śubhe || trilocanaṃ samarcyātha prasuptā raṃgamaṃḍape || 98 || suptāsu tāsu bālāsu trinetraḥ śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ || śuddhakarpūragaurāṃgo jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍalaḥ || 99 || tamālanīlasugrīvaḥ sphuratphaṇivibhūṣaṇaḥ || vāmārdhavilasacchaktirnāgayajñopavītavān |||4.2.76.100|| tasmādeva viniṣkramya liṃgātpannagamekhalāt || uvāca ca tato bālā vibhuruttiṣṭhateti saḥ || 101 || utthāya tā vinirmārjya locane śrutisaṃgate || aṃgamoṭanavatyaśca jṛṃbhābhiḥ kvaṇitānanāḥ || 102 || yāvatpaśyaṃti purataḥ saṃbhramāpannamānasāḥ || atarkitāgamastāvattābhirdṛṣṭastrilocanaḥ ||103|| vavaṃduratha tā bālā jñātvā lakṣmabhirīśvaram || tuṣṭvuśca prahṛṣṭāsyāḥ sannakaṃṭhyotigadgadam|| || 104 || jayaśaṃbho jayeśāna jaya sarvaga sarvada || jaya tripurasaṃhartarjayāṃdhakaniṣūdana || 105 || jaya jālaṃdharahara jaya kaṃdarpadarpahṛt || jaya trailokyajanaka jaya trailokyavardhana || 106 || jaya trailokyanilaya jaya trailokyavaṃdita || jaya bhaktajanādhīna jaya pramathanāyaka || 107 || jaya tripathagāpāthaḥ prakṣālitajaṭātaṭa || jaya caṃdrakalājyotirvidyotitajagattraya || 108 || jaya sarpaphaṇāratna prabhābhāsitavigraha || jayādrirājatanayā tapaḥkrītārdhadehaka || 109 || jaya śmaśānanilaya jaya vārāṇasīpriya || jayānaṃdavanādhyāsi prāṇinirvāṇadāyaka || 4.2.76.110 || jaya viśvapate śarva śarvarīparivarjita || jaya nṛtyapriyeśogra jaya gītaviśārada || 111 || jaya praṇavasadvāsa jaya dhāma mahānidhe || jaya śūlinvirūpākṣa jaya praṇatasarvada || 112 || vidhiḥ sarvavidhijñopi na tvāṃ stotuṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || vāco vācaspaternātha tvatstutau parikuṃṭhitāḥ || 113 || vidaṃti vedāḥ sarvajña na tvāṃ nātha yathārthataḥ || manatīha mano na tvāmanaṃtaṃ cādivarjitam || 114 || namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namonamaḥ || trilocana namastubhyaṃ triviṣṭapa namostu te || 115 || ityuktvā daṃḍavadbhūmau praṇipetuḥ kumārikāḥ || athotthāpya kumārīstāḥ provāca śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ || 116|| suto maṃdāradāmnaśca nāmnā parimalālayaḥ || patirvidyādharavaro bhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati || 117 || ciraṃ vidyādhare loke bhogānbhuktvā samaṃtataḥ || tato nirvedamāpannāḥ kāśīsiddhimavāpsyatha || || 118 || yūyaṃ tisropi me bhaktāḥ sa ca vidyādharo yuvā || catvāropyeta evātra pratimokṣamavāpsyatha || 119 || janmāṃtarepi me sevā bhavatībhiśca tena ca || vihitā tena vo janma nirmalaṃ bhaktibhāvitam || 4.2.76.120 || etacca bhavatī stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhiṣyati me puraḥ || tasya kāmaṃ pradāsyāmi bhavatīnāmiva sphuṭam || 121 || tyajetkṣapākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śuciḥ prātaḥ paṭhannaraḥ || divākṛtamalaṃ haṃti sāyaṃ paṭhanataḥ sphuṭam ||122|| ityuktavati deveśe tāḥ kanyā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || praṇamya procurīśānaṃ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭāḥ || || 123 || nāgakanyā ūcuḥ || || pṛcchāmo brūhi no nātha karuṇākara śaṃkara || janmāṃtare kathaṃ sevā caturbhirbhavataḥ kṛtā || 124 || bhavaprāgbhava vṛttāṃtaṃ tasyāpi sukṛtātmanaḥ || asmākamapi cākhyāhi kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe ||125|| iti śrutvā praṇayato bālodīritamīśitā || provāca tāsāṃ tasyāpi bhavāṃtaraviceṣṭitam || || 126 || || īśvara uvāva || || śṛṇudhvaṃ nāgatanayāstisropi hi samāhitāḥ || prāgbhave bhavatīnāṃ ca tasyāpi kathayāmyaham || 127 || eṣā ratnāvalī pūrvamāsītpārāvatī khagī || sa ca vidyādharavaraḥ patirasyāḥ khagobhavat || 128 || prāsādetra mamaitābhyāmuṣitaṃ suciraṃ sukham|| rajaḥprāsādasaṃlagnaṃ nunnaṃ pakṣānilaiḥ punaḥ || 129 || upariṣṭādadhastācca kṛtā bahvyaḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ || vyomnā saṃcaramāṇābhyāṃ saṃcaradbhyāṃ mamājire || 4.2.76.130 || snātaṃ caturnade tīrthe pītaṃ tatrāṃbu cāsakṛt || ābhyāṃ kalaravābhyāṃ ca kṛtaḥ kalaravo mude || 131 || etābhyāṃ sthiracetobhyāṃ muditābhyāmatīva hi || dṛṣṭāni kautukānyatra mama bhaktaiḥ kṛtāni vai ||132|| amūbhyāṃ bahuśo dṛṣṭā mama maṃgaladīpikāḥ || pītaṃ śrutipuṭābhyāṃ ca mama nāmākṣarāmṛtam || 133 || tiryagyoniprabhāvena na mṛtau mama sannidhau || mṛtaṃ puryāmayodhyāyāṃ kāśīprāptikṛti dhruvam || 134 || ayodhyānidhanādeṣā ratnadīpasutābhavat || patiḥ pārāvato'syāḥ sa jāto vidyādharāṃgajaḥ ||135|| eṣā prabhāvatī nāgī nāgarājasya padminaḥ || iha janmani kanyāsītpūrvaṃ janma bravīmi vaḥ ||136|| triśikhasyorageṃdrasya sutā ceyaṃ kalāvatī || etasyā api vṛttāṃtaṃ niśāmayata vacmyaham|| 137 || bhavāṃtare tṛtīye'taḥ kanye cārāyaṇasya ha || āstāṃ maharṣeḥ śīlāḍhye premavatyau parasparam ||138|| pitrā cārāyaṇenāpi tābhyāṃ saṃpreritena te || āmuṣyāyaṇa putrāya datte nārāyaṇāya hi ||39|| aprāptayauvanaḥ sotha samidāharaṇāya vai || gato vidhivaśāddaṣṭo daṃdaśūkena kānane ||4.2.76.140|| bhavānīgautamī nāmnyo te tu cārāyaṇāṃgaje || vaidhavya duḥkhamāpanne dainyagraste babhūvatuḥ || 141 || ataeva prayatnena pariṇetā vivarjayet || devatāsaridāhvānāṃ kanyā pāṇigrahe sudhīḥ || 142 || atharṣeḥ kasyaciddaivādāśrame paramādbhute || raṃbhāphalānyadattāni mohājjagṛhatustadā ||143|| kṛtvā māsopavāsādi vratāni brāhmaṇāṃgaje || avāpya nidhanaṃ kālācchākhāmṛgyau babhūvatuḥ || 144 || phalacauryavipākena vānarītvaṃ tayorabhūt || śīlarakṣaṇadharmeṇa kāśyāṃ janimavāpatuḥ ||145|| sa ca nārāyaṇo vipraḥ pitṛśuśrūṣaṇavrataḥ|| daṣṭopi daṃdaśūkena kāśyāṃ pārāvatobhavat || 146 || evaṃ bhavāṃtarecāsīdetayoḥ patireṣa kaḥ || tisṛṇāṃ bhavatīnāṃ ca bhāvī bhartādhunāpi hi || 147 || prāsādasyāsya pārśve tu nyagrodhastu mahānabhūt || tasmiñśākhini śākhāḍhye śākhāmṛgyau babhūvatuḥ || 148 || catuḥsrotasvinī tīrthe krīḍayā ca mamajjatuḥ || papatuścāpi pānīyaṃ tasmiṃstīrthaṃ tṛṣāture || 149 || jātisvabhāvacāpalyātkrīḍaṃtyau ca pradakṣiṇam || cakraturbahukṛtvaśca liṃgaṃ dadṛśaturbahu || 4.2.76.150 || vicaraṃtyāviti svairaṃ tatra nyagrodha sannidhau || kenacidyogiveṣeṇa pāśena ca niyaṃtrite || 151 || bhikṣārthaṃ śikṣite tena tadutplutyādi nartanam|| atha te kvāpi markaṭyau kāladharmavaśaṃgate|| || 152 || kāśīvāsaja puṇyena trailocanyānusevayā || prādakṣiṇyādirūpiṇyā jāte nāgasute iti ||153|| adhunā taṃ patiṃ prāpya vidyādharakumārakam || nirviśya svargabhogāṃśca kāśyāṃ nirvṛtimeṣyatha || 154 || yadalpamapi vai kāśyāṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāvaham || tasya mokṣaḥ parīpāko niścitaṃ madanugrahāt ||155|| trilokyā api sarvasyāḥ śreṣṭhā vārāṇasī purī || tatopi liṃgamoṃkāraṃ tatopyatra trilocanam ||156|| tiṣṭhamānotra liṃgehaṃ bhaktamuktiṃ diśāmyaham || tataḥ sarvaprayatnena kāśyāṃ pūjyastrilocanaḥ || 157 || ityuktvā devadeveśastatprāsādāṃtaraṃ viśat || avācyarūpamāsādya sthūlaṃ tribhuvanādapi || 158 || tāśca svaṃ svaṃ padaṃ prāpya tadvṛttāṃtamaśeṣataḥ || svamātṛpurataścoktvā kṛtakṛtyā ivābhavan||159|| ekadā mādhave māsi mahāyātrā samāgatā || vidyādharāstathā nāgā militāḥ saparicchadāḥ ||4.2.76.160|| virajaske mahākṣetre trilocanasamīpataḥ || devasya varadānācca pṛṣṭvānyonyaṃ kulāvalīm ||161|| vidyādharāya tā nāgaiḥ kanyāstisropi kalpitāḥ || maṃdāradāmā saṃtuṣṭaḥ prāpya tacca snuṣātrayam|| 162 || ratnadīpaśca nāgeṃdraḥ padmī ca bhujageśvaraḥ || triśikhopi phaṇīṃdraśca hṛṣṭā ete trayopi ca || 163 || jāmātaraṃ samāsādya śubhaṃ parimalālayam || anyonyaṃ svajanāste tu mudā vikasitekṣaṇāḥ || 164 || vivāhotsava mākalpya svaṃ svaṃ bhuvanamāviśan || trilocanasya liṃgasya varṇayaṃtotigauravam || 165 || sa ca vidyādharaḥ śrīmānnāgībhirvipulaṃ sukham || bhuktvā vārāṇasīṃ prāpya saṃsevyātha trilocanam || 166 || gāyangītaṃ sumadhuraṃ nāgībhiḥ sahitaḥ kṛtī || ātmānaṃ cātisaṃsmṛtya madhye liṃgaṃ layaṃ gataḥ || 167 || || skaṃda uvāca || || trilocanasya mahimā kalau devena gopitaḥ || atolpasattvā manujā na talliṃgamupāsate || 168 || trilocanakathāmetāṃ śrutvā pāpānvitopyaho || vipāpmā jāyate martyo labhate ca parāṃ gatim || 169 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe trilocanaprabhāvonāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 ||
<4.2.77>
|| pārvatyuvāca || || namaste devadeveśa praṇamatkaruṇānidhe || vada kedāramāhātmyaṃ bhaktānāmanukaṃpayā ||1|| tasmim̐lliṃge mahāprītistava kāśyāmanuttamā || tadbhaktāśca janā nityaṃ devadevamahādhiyaḥ || 2 || || devadeva uvāca || || śṛṇvaparṇebhidhāsyāmi kedāreśvara saṃkathām || samākarṇyāpi yāṃ pāpopyapāpo jāyate kṣaṇāt || 3 || kedāraṃ yātukāmasya puṃso niścitacetasaḥ || ājanmasaṃcitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 4 || gṛhādvinirgate puṃsi kedāramabhiniścitam || janmadvayārjitaṃ pāpaṃ śarīrādapi nirvrajet || 5 || madhye mārgaṃ prapannasya trijanmajanitaṃ tvagham || dehagehādviniḥsṛtya nirāśaṃ yāti niḥśvasat || 6 || sāyaṃkedārakedārakedāreti triruccaran|| gṛhepi nivasannūnaṃ yātrāphalamavāpnuyāt || 7 || dṛṣṭvā kedāraśikharaṃ pītvā tatratyamaṃbu ca || saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||8|| harapāpahrade snātvā kedāreśaṃ prapūjya ca || koṭijanmārjitainobhirmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||9|| sakṛtpraṇamya kedāraṃ harapāpakṛtodakaḥ || sthāpya liṃgaṃ hṛdaṃbhoje prāṃte mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati||4.2.77.10|| harapāpahrade śrāddhaṃ śraddhayā yaḥ kariṣyati || uddhṛtya saptapuruṣānsa me lokaṃ gamiṣyati || 11 || ṣurā rāthaṃtare kalpe yadabhūdatra tacchṛṇu || aparṇe dattakarṇā tvaṃ varṇayāmi tavāgrataḥ ||12|| eko brāhmaṇadāyāda ujjayinyā ihāgataḥ || kṛtopanayanaḥ pitrā brahmacaryavratesthitaḥ ||13|| sthalīṃ pāśupatīṃ kāśīṃ sa vilokya samaṃtataḥ|| dvijaiḥ pāśupataiḥ kīrṇāṃ jaṭāmukuṭabhūṣitaiḥ || 14 || kṛtaliṃgasamarcaiśca bhūtibhūṣitavarṣmabhiḥ || bhikṣāhṛtānnasaṃtuṣṭaiḥ puṣṭairgaṃgāmṛtodakaiḥ || 15 || babhūvānaṃditamanā vrataṃ jagrāha cottamam|| hiraṇyagarbhādācāryānmahatpāśupatābhidham || 16 || sa ca śiṣyo vaśiṣṭhobhūtsarvapāśupatottamaḥ || snātvā hrade harapāpe nityaprātaḥ samutthitaḥ ||17|| vibhūtyāharahaḥ snāti trikālaṃ liṃgamarcayan || nāṃtaraṃ sa vijānāti śivaliṃge gurau tathā ||18|| sa dvādaśābdadeśīyo vaśiṣṭho guruṇā saha || yayau kedārayātrārthaṃ giriṃ gaurīgurorgurum ||19|| yatra gatvā na śocaṃti kiṃcitsaṃsāriṇaḥ kvacita || prāśyodakaṃ liṃgarūpaṃ liṃgarūpatvamāgatāḥ ||4.2.77.20|| asidhāraṃ giriṃ prāpya vaśiṣṭhasya tapasvinaḥ || gururhiraṇyagarbhākhyaḥ paṃcatvamagamattadā || 21 || paśyatāṃ tāpasānāṃ ca vimāne sārvakāmike || āropya taṃ pāriṣadāḥ kailāsamanayanmudā || 22 || yastu kedāramuddiśya gehādardhapathepyaho || akātarastyajetprāṇānkailāse sa ciraṃ vaset || 23 || tadāścaryaṃ samālokya sa vaśiṣṭhastapodhanaḥ || kedārameva liṃgeṣu bahvamaṃsta suniścitam || 24|| atha kṛtvā sa kaidārīṃ yātrāṃ vārāṇasīmagāt || agrahīnniyamaṃ cāpi yathārthaṃ cākarotpunaḥ || || 25 || prati caitraṃ sadā caitryāṃ yāvajjīvamahaṃ dhruvam || vilokayiṣye kedāraṃ vasanvārāṇasīṃ purīm || 26 || tena yātrāḥ kṛtāḥ samyak ṣaṣṭirekādhikā mudā || ānaṃdakānane nityaṃ vasatā brahmacāriṇā || 27 || punaryātrāṃ sa vai cakre madhau nikaṭavartini || paramotsāhasaṃtuṣṭaḥ palitā kalitopyalam|| 28 || tapodhanaistannidhanaṃ śaṃkamānairnivāritaḥ || kāruṇyapūrṇahṛdayairanyairapi ca saṃgibhiḥ || 29 || tatopi na tadutsāhabhaṃgobhūddṛḍhacetasaḥ || madhye mārgaṃ mṛtasyāpi guroriva gatirmama || 4.2.77.30 || iti niścitacetaske vaśiṣṭhe tāpase śucau || aśūdrānna parīpuṣṭe tuṣṭohaṃ caṃḍike'bhavam || 31 || svapremayā sa saṃprokto vaśiṣṭhastāpasottamaḥ || dṛḍhavrata prasannosmi kedāraṃ viddhi māmiha || 32 || abhīṣṭaṃ ca varaṃ mattaḥ prārthayasvāvicāritam || ityuktavatyapi mayi svapno mithyeti sobravīt|| 33 || tatopi sa mayā proktaḥ svapno mithyā'śuciṣmatām || bhavādṛśāmamithyaiva svākhyā sadṛśavartinām || 34 || varaṃ brūhi prasannosmi svapnaśaṃkāṃ tyaja dvija || tava sattvavataḥ kiṃcinmayādeyaṃ na kiṃcana || 35 || ityuktaṃ me samākarṇya varayāmāsa māmiti || śiṣyo hiraṇyagarbhasya tapasvijanasattamaḥ || 36 || yadi prasanno deveśa tadā me sānugā ime || sarve śūlinnugrāhyā eṣa eva varo mama || 37 || devi tasyedamākarṇya paropakṛtiśālinaḥ || vacanaṃ nitarāṃ prītastatheti tamuvāca ha || 38 || punaḥ paropakaraṇāttattapo dviguṇīkṛtam || tena puṇyena sa mayā punaḥ prokto varaṃ vṛṇu || 39 || sa vaśiṣṭho mahāprājño dṛḍha pāśupatavrataḥ || devi me prārthayāmāsa himaśailādiha sthitim || 4.2.77.40 || tatastattapasākṛṣṭaḥ kalāmātreṇa tatra hi || himaśaile tataścātra sarvabhāvena saṃsthitaḥ || 41 || tataḥ prabhāte saṃjāte sarveṣāṃ paśyatāmaham || himādre prasthitaḥ prāptastūyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ ||42|| vaśiṣṭhaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā sarvasārthasamāyutam || harapāpahrade tīrthe sthitohaṃ tadnugrahāt || 43 || matparigrahataḥ sarve harapāpe kṛtodakāḥ || ārādhya māmanenaiva vapuṣā siddhimāgatāḥ || 44 || tadā prabhṛti liṃgesminsthitaḥ sādhakasiddhaye || avimukte pare kṣetre kalikāle viśeṣataḥ || 45|| tuṣārādriṃ samāruhya kedāraṃ vīkṣya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ saptaguṇitaṃ kāśyāṃ kedāradarśane || 46 || gaurīkuṃḍaṃ yathā tatra haṃsatīrthaṃ ca nirmalam || yathā madhusravā gaṃgā kāśyāṃ tadakhilaṃ tathā || 47 || idaṃ tīrthaṃ harapāpaṃ saptajanmāghanāśanam || gaṃgāyāṃ militaṃ paścājjanmakoṭikṛtāghaham || 48 || atra pūrvaṃ tu kākolau yudhyatau khānnipetatuḥ || paśyatāṃ tatra saṃsthānāṃ haṃsau bhūtvā vinirgatau ||49|| gauri tvayā kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ snānamatra mahāhrade || gaurītīrthaṃ tataḥ khyātaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam || 4.2.77.50 || atrāmṛtasravā gaṃgā mahāmohāṃdhakārahṛt || anekajanmajanita jāḍyadhvaṃsavidhāyinī || 51 || sarasā mānasenātra pūrvaṃ taptaṃ mahātapaḥ || atastu mānasaṃ tīrthaṃ jane khyātimidaṃ gatam ||52|| atra pūrvaṃ janaḥ snānamātreṇaiva pramucyate || paścātprasāditaścāhaṃ tridaśairmuktidurdṛśaiḥ || 53 || sarve muktiṃ gamiṣyaṃti yadi deveha mānavāḥ || kedārakuṃḍe susnātāstadocchittirbhaviṣyati || 54 || sarveṣāmeva varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca dharmiṇām|| tasmāttanuvisargetra mokṣaṃ dāsyati nānyathā || 55 || tatastaduparodhena tatheti ca mayoditam || tadārabhya mahādevi snānātkedārakuṃḍataḥ|||| 56 || samarcanācca bhaktyā vai mama nāma japādapi || naiḥśreyasīṃ śriyaṃ dadyāmanyatrāpi tanutyajāma || 57 || kedāratīrthe yaḥ snātvā piṃḍāndāsyati cātvaraḥ || ekottaraśataṃ vaṃśyāstasya tīrṇā bhavāṃbudhim|| 58 || bhaumavāre yadā darśastadā yaḥ śrāddhado naraḥ || kedārakuṃḍamāsādya gayāśrāddhena kiṃ tataḥ || 59 || kedāraṃ gaṃtukāmasya buddhirdeyā narairiyam || kāśyāṃ spṛśaṃstvaṃ kedāraṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi || 4.2.77.60 || caitrakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmupavāsaṃ vidhāya ca || trigaṃḍūṣānpibanprātarhṛlliṃgamadhitiṣṭhati || 61 || kedārodakapānena yathā tatra phalaṃ bhavet || tathātra jāyate puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ cāpi na saṃśayaḥ || 62 || kedārabhaktaṃ saṃpūjya vāsonnadraviṇādibhiḥ || ājanmajanitaṃ pāpaṃ tyaktvā yāti mamālayam || || 63 || āṣaṇmāsaṃ trikālaṃ yaḥ kedāreśaṃ namasyati || taṃ namasyaṃti satataṃ lokapālā yamādayaḥ || 64 || kalau kedāramāhātmyaṃ yopi kopi na vetsyati || yo vetsyati supuṇyātmā sarvaṃ vetsyati sa dhruvam || 65 || kedāreśaṃ sakṛddṛṣṭvā devi me'nucaro bhavet || tasmātkāśyāṃ prayatnena kedāreśaṃ vilokayet ||66|| citrāṃgadeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kedārāduttare śubham || tasyārcanānnaro nityaṃ svargabhogānupāśnute || 67 || kedārāddakṣiṇe bhāge nīlakaṃṭha vilokanāt || saṃsāroragadaṣṭasya tasya nāsti viṣādbhayam || 68 || tadvāyavyaṃbarīṣeśo narastadavalokanāt || garbhavāsaṃ na cāpnoti saṃsāre duḥkhasaṃkule ||69|| iṃdradyumneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatsamīpe samarcya ca || tejomayena yānena sa svarga bhuvi modate || 4.2.77.70 || taddakṣiṇe naro dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ kālaṃjareśvaram || jarāṃ kālaṃ vinirjitya mama loke vasecciram ||71|| dṛṣṭvā kṣemeśvaraṃ liṃgamudkcitrāṃgadeśvarāt || sarvatra kṣemamāpnoti loke'tra ca paratra ca ||72|| || skaṃda uvāca || || devadevena viṃdhyāre kedāra mahimā mahān || ityākhyāyi purāṃbāyai mayā tepi nirūpitaḥ || 73 || kedāreśvaraliṃgasya śrutvotpattiṃ kṛtī naraḥ || śivalokamavāpnoti niṣpāpo jāyate kṣaṇāt || 74 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe kedāramahimākhyānaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||77||
<4.2.78>
|| pārvatyuvāca || ānaṃdakānane śaṃbho yalliṃgaṃ puṇyavardhanam || yannāmasmaraṇādeva mahāpātakasaṃkṣayaḥ || 1 || yatsevyaṃ sādhakairnityaṃ yatra prītiranuttamā || yatra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ dhyātaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 2 || yasya saṃsmaraṇādeva yalliṃgasya vilokanāt || yalliṃgapraṇateścāpi yasya saṃsparśanādapi || 3 || paṃcāmṛtādi snapanapūrvādyasyārcanādapi || talliṃgaṃ kathayeśāna bhavecchreyaḥ paraṃparā ||4|| || skaṃda uvāca || || iti devīsamuditaṃ samākarṇya vaṭodbhava || sarvajñena yadākhyātaṃ tadākhyāsyāmi te śṛṇu || 9 || devadeva uvāca || || ume bhavatyā yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavabaṃdhavimokṣakṛt || tato'haṃ kathayiṣyāmi liṃgaṃ sthiramanā bhava || 6 || ānaṃdakānane cātra rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mama || na mayā kasyacitkhyātaṃ na praṣṭuṃ vetti kaścana ||7|| saṃti liṃgānyanekāni mamānaṃdavane priye|| paraṃ tvayā yathā pṛṣṭaṃ yathāvattadbravīmi te || 8 || yatra muktisvarūpā tvaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhasi viśvage || yatra te naṃdanaścāsti kṣetraṃ vighnavighātakṛt || 9 || mamāpi yena tripuraṃ samare jayakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || jayāśā pūritā stutyā bahumodakadānataḥ || 4.2.78.10 || yatrāsti tīrthamaghahṛtpitṛprītivivardhanam || yatsnānādvṛtrahā vṛtravadhapāpādvimuktavān || 11 || dharmādhikaraṇaṃ yatra dharmarājopyavāptavān || suduṣkaraṃ tapastaptvā parameṇa samādhinā || 12 || pakṣiṇopi hi yatrāpurjñānaṃ saṃsāramocanam || ramyo hiraṇmayo yatra babhūva bahupāddrumaḥ || || 13 || yalliṃgadarśanādeva durdamo nāma pārthivaḥ || udvejakopi lokānāṃ kṣaṇāddharmamatistvabhūt || 14 || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyamāvirbhāvaṃ ca suṃdari || niśāmayābhidhāsyāmi mahāpātaka nāśanam || 15 || dharmapīṭhaṃ taduddiṣṭamatrānaṃdavane mama || tatpīṭhadarśanādeva naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 16 || purā vivasvataḥ putro yamaḥ paramasaṃyamī || tapastatāpa vipulaṃ viśālākṣi tavāgrataḥ || 17 || śiśire jalamadhyastho varṣāsvabhrāvakāśakaḥ || tapartau paṃcavahnisthaḥ kadāciditi taptavān || 18 || pādāgrāṃguṣṭhabhūsparśī bahukālaṃ sa tasthivān || ekapādasthitaḥ sopi kadācidbahvanehasam || 19 || samīrābhyavahartāsīdbahudiṣṭaṃ sadiṣṭavān || papau sa tu pipāsuḥ sankuśāgrajalavipruṣaḥ || 4.2.78.20 || divyāṃ caturyugīmitthaṃ sa nināya tapaścaran || caturguṇaṃ didṛkṣurmāṃ parameṇa samādhinā || 21 || tatohaṃ tasya tapasā saṃtuṣṭaḥ sthiracetasaḥ || yayau tasmai varāndātuṃ śamanāya mahātmane ||22|| vaṭaḥ kāṃcanaśākhākhyo yastapastāpasaṃtatim || dūrīcakāra succhāyo bahudvijasamāśrayaḥ || 23 || maṃdamada marullola pallavaiḥ karapallavaiḥ || yodhvagānadhvasaṃtaptānāhvaye divatāpahṛt || 24 || svānurāgaiḥ surabhibhiḥ svādubhiśca pacelimaiḥ || prīṇayedarthisārthaṃ yo vṛttairnijaphalairalam ||25|| tadadhastātparaṃ vīkṣya tamahaṃ tapanāṃgajam || sthāṇuniścala varṣmāṇaṃ nāsāgranyastalocanam || 26 || tapastejobhirudyadbhiḥ paritaḥ paridhīkṛtam || bhānumaṃtamivākāśe sunīle svena tejasā || 27 || svākhyāṃkitaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyātibhaktitaḥ || svaccha sūryopalamayatejaḥ puṃjairivārcitam || 28 || sākṣīkṛtyeva talliṃgaṃ tapyamānaṃ mahattapaḥ || pratyavocaṃ dharmarājaṃ varaṃ brūhīti bhāskare || 29 || alaṃ taptvā mahābhāga prasannosmi śubhavrata || niśamya śamanaśceti dṛṣṭvā māṃ praṇanāma ha || 4.2.78.30 || cakāra stavanaṃ cāpi parihṛṣṭeṃdriyeśvaraḥ || nirvyājaṃ sa samādhiṃ ca visṛjya bradhnanaṃdanaḥ || 31 || dharma uvāca || || namonamaḥ kāraṇakāraṇānāṃ namonamaḥ kāraṇavarjitāya || namonamaḥ kāryamayāya tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ kāryavibhinnarūpa || 32 || arūparūpāya samastarūpiṇe parāṇurūpāya parāparāya || apārapārāya parābdhipāra pradāya tubhyaṃ śaśimaulaye namaḥ|| || 33 || anīśvarastvaṃ jagadīśvarastvaṃ guṇātmakastvaṃ guṇavarjitastvam || kālātparastvaṃ prakṛteḥ parastvaṃ kālāya kālātprakṛte namaste ||34 || tvameva nirvāṇapada pradosi tvameva nirvāṇamanaṃtaśakte || tvamātmarūpaḥ paramātmarūpastvamaṃtarātmāsi carācarasya || 35 || tvatto jagattvaṃ jagadevasākṣājjagattvadīyaṃ jagadekabaṃdho || hartāvitā tvaṃ prathamo vidhātā vidhātṛviṣṇvīśa namo namaste || 36 || mṛḍastvameva śrutivartmageṣu tvameva bhīmo'śrutivartmageṣu || tvaṃ śaṃkaraḥ somasubhaktibhājāmugrosi rudra tvamabhaktibhājām || 37 || tvameva śūlī dviṣatāṃ tvameva vinamraceto vacasāṃ śivosi || śrīkaṃṭha ekaḥ svapadaśritānāṃ durātmanāṃ hālahalograkaṃṭhaḥ || 38 || namostu te śaṃkara śāṃtaśaṃbho namostu te caṃdrakalāvataṃsa || namostu tubhyaṃ phaṇibhūṣaṇāya pinākapāṇeṃ'dhakavairiṇe namaḥ || 39 || sa eva dhanyastava bhaktibhāgyastavārcako yaḥ sukṛtī sa eva || tavastutiṃ yaḥ kurute sadaiva sa stūyate duścyavanādi devaiḥ || 4.2.78.40 || kastvāmiha stotumanaṃtaśakte śaknoti mādṛglaghubuddhivaibhavaḥ || prācāṃ na vācāmihagocaro yaḥ stutistvayīyaṃ natireva yāvat || 41 || skaṃda uvāca|| || udīrya sūryasya sutotibhaktyā namaḥ śivāyeti samuccaransaḥ || ilāmilanmauliratīva hṛṣṭaḥ sahasrakṛtvaḥ praṇanāma śaṃbhum ||42|| tataḥ śivastaṃ tapasātikhinnaṃ nivārya tābhyaḥ praṇatibhya īśvaraḥ || varāndadau saptaturaṃgasūnave tvaṃ dharmarājo bhava nāmatopi || 43 || tvameva dharmādhikṛtau samasta śarīriṇāṃ sthāvarajaṃgamānām || mayā niyuktodya dinādikṛtyaḥ praśādhi sarvānmama śāsanena ||44|| tvaṃ dakṣiṇāyāśca diśodhināthastvaṃ karmasākṣī bhava sarvajaṃtoḥ || tvaddarśitādhvāna ito vrajaṃtu svakarmayogyāṃ gatimuttamādhamāḥ || 45 || tvayā yadetanmamabhaktibhājā liṃgaṃ samārādhitamatra dharma || taddarśanātsparśanato'rcanācca siddhirbhaviṣyatyacireṇa puṃsām|| 46 || dharmeśvaraṃ yaḥ sakṛdeva martyo vilokayiṣyatyavadātabuddhiḥ || snātvā puraste'tra ca dharmatīrthe na tasya dūre puruṣārthasiddhiḥ || 47 || kṛtvāpyaghānāmiha yaḥ sahasraṃ dharmeśvaraṃ paśyati daivayogāt|| sahetano jātu sa nārakīṃ vyathāṃ kathāṃ tadīyāṃ divikurvatemarāḥ || 48 || yo dharmapīṭhaṃ pratilabhya kāśyāṃ svaśreyase no yatate'tra martyaḥ || kathaṃ sa dharmatvamivātitejāḥ kariṣyati svaṃ kṛtakṛtyameva || tvayā yathāptā iha dharmarāja manorathāste gurubhistapobhiḥ || tathaiva dharmeśvarabhaktibhājāṃ kāmāḥ phaliṣyaṃti na saṃśayotra || 4.2.78.50 || kṛtvāpyaghānyeva mahāṃtyapīha dharmeśvarārcāṃ sakṛdeva kurvan || kuto bibheti priyabaṃdhureva tava tvadīyārcita liṃgabhaktaḥ || 51 || patreṇa puṣpeṇa jalena dūrvayā yo dharmadharmeśvaramarcayiṣyati || samarcayiṣyaṃtyamṛtāṃdhasastaṃ maṃdāramālābhiratiprahṛṣṭāḥ || 52 || tvatto vibheṣyaṃti kṛtainaso ye bhayaṃ na teṣāṃ bhavitā kadācit || dharmeśvarārcā racanāṃ kariṣyatāṃ hariṣyatāṃ baṃdhutayāmanaste || 53 || yadatra dāsyaṃti hi dharmapīṭhe narā dyunadyāṃ kṛtamajjanāśca || tadakṣayaṃ bhāvi yugāṃtarepi kṛtapraṇāmāstava dharmaliṃge || 54 || ye kārtike māsi sitāṣṭamī tithau yātrāṃ kariṣyaṃti narā upoṣitāḥ || rātrau ca vai jāgaraṇaṃ mahotsavairdharmeśvare tena punarbhavā bhuvi || 55 || stutiṃ ca ye vai tvadudīritāmimāṃ narāḥ paṭhiṣyaṃti tavāgrataḥ kvacit || nirenasaste mama lokagāminaḥ prāpsyaṃti te vaibhavataḥ sakhitvam || 56 || punarvaraṃ brūhi yathepsitaṃ dade tejonidhernaṃdana dharmarāja || adeyamatrāsti na kiṃcideva te vidhehi vāgudyamamātrameva || 57 || prasannamūrtiṃ sa vilokya śaṃkaraṃ kāruṇyapūrṇaṃ svamanorathābhidam || ānaṃdasaṃdohasaronimagno vaktuṃ kṣaṇaṃ naiva śaśāka kiṃcit || 58 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe dharmeśamahimākhyānaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 78 ||
<4.2.79>
|| skaṃda uvāca || ānaṃdabāṣpasalilaruddhakaṃṭhaṃ vilokya tam|| mṛḍaḥ pasparśa pāṇibhyāṃ saudhābhyāṃ tu sudhāṃbudhiḥ || 1 || atha tatsparśasaukhyena dharmarājo mahātapāḥ || punaraṃkurayāmāsa tapogni jvalitāṃ tanum || 2 || tataḥ provāca sa brādhnirdeva devamumāpatim || prasannavadanaṃ śāṃtaṃ śāṃtapāriṣadāvṛtam || 3 || prasannosi yadīśāna sarvajña karuṇānidhe || kimanyena vareṇātra yattvaṃ sākṣātkṛto mayā || 4 || yaṃ na vedā viduḥ samyaṅna ca tau vedapūruṣau || tatopi varayogyosmi tannātha prārthayāmyaham || 5 || śrīkaṃṭhāṃḍaja ḍiṃbhānāmamīṣāṃ madhurabruvām || mattapaścirasākṣīṇāṃ matpuraḥ prāptajanmanām || 6 || pitṛbhyāṃ parihīnānāmitihāsa kathāvidām || tyaktāhāravihārāṇāṃ kīrāṇāṃ varado bhava ||7|| etatprasūtisamaye āmayena prapīḍitā || śukī paṃcatvamāpannā śukaḥ śyenena bhakṣitaḥ || 8 || rakṣitānāmanāthānāṃ sadā manmukhadarśinām || anāthanātha bhavatā hyāyuḥśeṣasvarūpiṇā || 9 || iti dharmavacaḥ śrutvā paropakṛtinirmalam || tānāhūya mune śaṃbhurvinayāvanatānanān ||4.2.79.1 0|| uvāca dharmeti prītaḥ śukaśāvānidaṃ vacaḥ || ayi pattrarathā brūta sādhavo dharmasaṃgatāḥ || 11 || ko varo bhavatā deyo dharmeśa paricāriṇām || sādhusaṃsargasaṃkṣīṇa janmāṃtaramahainasām || 12 || iti śrutvā maheśasya vacanaṃ te patattriṇaḥ || procuḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ namaste bhavanāśana || 13 || || pakṣiṇa ūcuḥ || || anāthanātha sarvajña ko varo naḥ samīhitaḥ || itopi tryakṣa yatsākṣāttiryaktvepi samīkṣitāḥ || 14 || lābhāḥ saṃtūdyamavatāṃ girīśeha paraḥ śatāḥ || paraṃ paroyaṃ lābhotra yattvaṃ dṛggocarī bhaveḥ || 15 || yadetaddṛśyate nātha tatsarvaṃ kṣaṇabhaṃguram || abhaṃguro bhavānekastvatsaparyāpyabhaṃgurā || 16 || vicitrajanmakoṭīnāṃ smṛtirnotra parisphuret || etattapasviracitaliṃgapūjā vilokanāt || 17 || devayonirapi prāptā ciramasmābhirīśitaḥ || divyāṃganā sahasrāṇi tatra bhuktvā svalīlayā|| 18 || āsurī dānavī nāgī nairṛtī cāpi kainnarī || vidyādharī ca gāṃdharvī yonirasmābhirarjitā || || 19 || naratve bhūpatitvaṃ ca pariprāptamanekaśaḥ || jale jalacaratvaṃ ca sthale ca sthalacāritā || 4.2.79.20 || vane vanaukaso jātā grāmeṣu grāmavāsinaḥ || dātāro yācitāraśca rakṣitāraśca ghātukāḥ || 21 || sukhinopi vayaṃ jātā duḥkhino vayamāsma ca || jetāraśca vayaṃ jātāḥ parājetāra eva ca || 22 || adhītinopi mūrkhāśca svāminaḥ sevakā api || caturṣu bhūtagrāmeṣu uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ || 23 || abhūma bhūriśaḥ śaṃbho na kvāpi sthairyamāgatāḥ || itoyonestato yonau tato yonestatonyataḥ || 24 || pinākinkvāpi na prāpi sukhaleśo manāgapi || idānīṃ puṇyasaṃbhārairdharmeśvaravilokanāt ||25|| tāpaneḥsutapo vahnijvālāprajvalitainasaḥ || saṃvīkṣya tryakṣa sākṣāttvāṃ kṛtakṛtyā babhūvima || 26 || tathāpi cedvaro deyastiryakṣvasmāsu dhūrjaṭe || kṛpaṇeṣvapi śocyeṣu jñānaṃ sarvajña dehi tat || 27 || yena jñānena muktāḥ smo'muṣmātsaṃsārabaṃdhanāt || yaṃtritāḥ prākṛtaiḥ pāśairadurbhedyaiśca mādṛśaiḥ || 28 || aiṃdraṃ padaṃ na vāṃchāmo na cāṃdraṃ nānyadeva hi || vāñchāmaḥ kevalaṃ mṛtyuṃ kāśyāṃ śaṃbho'punarbhavam || 29 || tvatsānnidhyādvijānīmaḥ sarvajña sakalaṃ vayam || yathā caṃdanasaṃsargātsarve surabhayo drumāḥ || 4.2.79.30 || etadeva paraṃ jñānaṃ saṃsārocchittikāraṇam || vapurvisarjanaṃ kāle yattavānaṃdakānane || 31 || nirmathya viṣvagvāgjālaṃ sārabhūtamidaṃ param || brahmaṇodīritaṃ pūrvaṃ kāśyāṃ muktistanutyajām ||32|| yadvācyaṃ bahubhirgraṃthaistadaṣṭābhirihākṣaraiḥ || hariṇoktaṃ ravipuraḥ kaivalyaṃ kāśisaṃsthitau || 33 || yājñavalkyo munivaraḥ proktavānmunisaṃsadi || raveradhītya nigamānkāśyāmaṃte paraṃ padam || 34 || svāmināpi jagaddhātrī purato maṃdarācale || idameva purā proktaṃ kāśīnirvāṇajanmabhūḥ || 35 || kṛṣṇadvaipāyanopyevaṃ śaṃbho vakṣyati nānyathā|| yatraviśveśvaraḥ sākṣānmuktistatra padepade ||36|| vadaṃtyanyepi munayastīrthasaṃnyāsakāriṇaḥ|| ciraṃtanā lomaśādyāḥ kāśikā muktikāśikā || 37 || vayamapyevaṃ jānīmo yatra svargataraṃgiṇī|| ānaṃdakānane śaṃrbhomokṣastatraiva niścitam || 38 || bhūtaṃ bhāvi bhaviṣyaṃ yatsvarge martye rasātale || tatsarvameva jānīmo dharmeśānugrahātparāt ||39|| ato hiraṇyagarbhoktaṃ hariproktaṃ munīritam || bhavatoktaṃ ca nikhilaṃ śaṃbho jānīmahe vayam||4.2.79.40|| karāmalakavatsarvametadbrahmāṃḍagolakam || asmadvāggocare'styeva dharmapīṭhaniṣevaṇāt || 41 || dharmarājasya tapasā tiryañcopi vayaṃ vibho || jātāḥ sma nirvikalpaṃ hi sarvajñānasya bhājanam || 42 || madhuraṃ mṛdulaṃ satyaṃ svapramāṇaṃ susaṃskṛtam || hitaṃ mitaṃ sadṛṣṭāṃtaṃ śrutvā pakṣisubhāṣitam || 43 || devotivismayāpanno 'varṇayatpīṭhagauravam || trailokyanagare cātra kāśīrājagṛhaṃ mama || 44 || tatrāpi bhogabhavanamanarghyamaṇinirmitam || mokṣalakṣmīvilāsākhyaḥ prāsādo meti śarmabhūḥ || 45 || patattriṇo pimucyaṃte yaṃ kurvāṇāḥ pradakṣiṇam || svecchayā vicaraṃtaḥ khe khecarā api devatāḥ ||46|| mokṣalakṣmīvilāsākhya prāsādasya vilokanāt || śarīrāddūrato yāti brahmahatyāpi nānyathā || 47 || mokṣalakṣmīvilāsasya kalaśo yairnirīkṣataḥ || nidhānakalaśāstāṃstu na muṃcaṃti padepade || 48 || dūratopi patākāpi mama prāsādamūrdhagā || netrātithī kṛtā yaistu nityaṃ te'tithayo mama || 49 || bhūmiṃ bhittvā svayaṃ jātastatprāsādamiṣeṇa hi || ānaṃdākhyasya kaṃdasya kopyeṣa paramoṃkuraḥ ||4.2.79.50|| brahmādisthāvarāṃtāni yatra rūpaṇyanekaśaḥ || māmevopāsate nityaṃ citraṃ citragatānyapi ||51|| sasaudho mekhile loke sthānaṃ paramanirvṛteḥ || ratiśālā sa me ramyā sa me viśvāsabhūmikā ||52|| mama sarvagatasyāpi prāsādoyaṃ parāspadam || paraṃ brahma yadāmnātaṃ paramopaniṣadgirā || amūrtaṃ tadahaṃ mūrto bhūyāṃ bhaktakṛpāvaśāt || 53 || naiḥśreyasyāḥ śriyo dhāma tadyāmyāṃ maṃḍaposti me || tatrāhaṃ satataṃ tiṣṭhe tatsadomaṃḍapaṃ mama || 54 || nimeṣārdhapramāṇaṃ ca kālaṃ tiṣṭhati niścalaḥ || tatra yastena vai yogaḥ samabhyastaḥ samāḥ śatam || 55 || nirvāṇamaṃḍapaṃ nāma tatsthānaṃ jagatītale || tatrarcaṃ saṃjapannekāṃ labhetsarvaśruteḥ phalam || || 56 || prāṇāyāmaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādapyekaṃ muktimaṃḍape || tenāṣṭāṃgaḥ samabhyasto yogo'nyatrāyutaṃ samāḥ || 57 || nirvāṇamaṃḍape yastu japedekaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || koṭirudreṇa japtena yatphalaṃ tasya tadbhavet ||58|| śucirgaṃgāṃbhasi snāto yo japecchatarudriyam || nirvāṇamaṃḍape jñeyaḥ sa rudro dvijaveṣabhṛt || 59 || brahmayajñasakṛtkṛtvā mama dakṣiṇamaṃḍape || brahmalokamavāpyātha paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 4.2.79.60 || dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇāni setihāsāni tatra yaḥ || paṭhennirabhilāṣuḥ sansa vasenmama veśmani || 61 || tiṣṭhediṃdriyacāpalyaṃ yo nivārya kṣaṇaṃ kṛtī || nirvāṇamaṃḍapenyatra tena taptaṃ mahattapaḥ || 62 || vāyubhakṣaṇatonyatra yatpuṇyaṃ śaradāṃ śatam || tatpuṇyaṃ ghaṭikārdhena maunaṃ dakṣiṇamaṃḍape || 63 || mitaṃ kṛṣṇalakenāpi yodadyānmuktimaṃḍape || svarṇaṃ sauvarṇayānena sa tu saṃcarate divi || 64 || tatraikaṃ jāgaraṃ kuryādyasminkasmindinepi yaḥ || upoṣitorcayelliṃgaṃ sa sarvavratapuṇyabhāk || 65 || tatra dattvā mahādānaṃ tatra kṛtvā mahāvratam || tatrādhītyākhilaṃ vedaṃ cyavate na naro divaḥ || 66 || prayāṇaṃ kurvate yasya prāṇā me muktimaṃḍape || samāmanupraviṣṭotra tiṣṭhedyāvadahaṃ khalu || 67 || jalakrīḍāṃ sadā kuryāṃ jñānavāpyāṃ sahomayā || yadaṃbupānamātreṇa jñānaṃ jāyeta nimarlam || 68 || tajjalakrīḍanasthānaṃ mama prītikaraṃ mahat || amuṣminrājasadane jāḍyahṛjjalapūritam || 69 || tatprāsādapurobhāge mama śṛṃgāramaṃḍapaḥ || śrī pīṭhaṃ taddhi vijñeyaṃ niḥśrīkaśrīsamarpaṇam ||4.2.79.70|| madarthaṃ tatra yo dadyāddukūlāni śucīnyaho || mālyāni suvicitrāṇi yakṣakardamavaṃti ca || 71 || nānā nepathyavastūni pūjopakaraṇā'nyapi || sa śriyālaṃkṛtastiṣṭhedyatra kutrāpi sattamaḥ ||72|| nirvāṇalakṣmīrvṛṇute taṃ nirvāṇapadāptaye || yatra kutrāpi nidhanaṃ prāpnuyādapi sa dhruvam || 73 || mokṣalakṣmīvilāsākhya prāsādasyottare mama || aiśvaryamaḍapaṃ ramyaṃ tatraiśvaryaṃ dadāmyaham || 74 || matprāsādaiṃdradigbhāge jñānamaṃḍapamasti yat || jñānaṃ diśāmi satataṃ tatra māṃ dhyāyatāṃ satām || 75 || bhavāni rājasadane mamāsti hi mahānasam || yattatropahṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ nirviśāmi mudaiva tat || 76 || viśālākṣyā mahāsaudhe mama viśrāmabhūmikā || tatra saṃsṛtikhinnānāṃ viśrāmaṃ śrāṇayāmyaham || || 77 || niyamasnānatīrthaṃ ca cakrapuṣkariṇī mama || tatra snānavatāṃ puṃsāṃ tannairmalyaṃ diśāmyaham || 78 || yadāhuḥ paramaṃ tattvaṃ yadāhurbrahmasattamam || svasaṃvedyaṃ yadāhuśca tattatrāṃte diśāmyaham ||79|| yadāhustārakaṃ jñānaṃ yadāhuratinirmalam || svātmārāmaṃ yadāhuśca tattatrāṃte diśāmyaham || 4.2.79.80 || jaganmaṃgalabhūryātra paramā maṇikarṇikā || vipāśayāmi tatrāhaṃ karmabhiḥ pāśitānpaśūn || 81 || nirvāṇaśrāṇane yatra pātrāpātraṃ na ciṃtaye || ānaṃdakānane tanme dānasthānaṃ divāniśam || 82 || bhavāṃbudhau mahāgādhe prāṇinaḥ parimajjataḥ || bhūtvaiva karṇadhāroṃte yatra saṃtārayāmyaham || 83 || saubhāgyabhāgyabhūryā vai vikhyātā maṇikarṇikā || dadāmi tasyāṃ sarvasvamagrajāyāṃtyajāya vā ||84|| mahāsamādhisaṃpannairvedāṃtārtha niṣevibhiḥ || duṣprāponyatra yo mokṣaḥ śocyairapi sa labhyate || 85 || dīkṣito vā divākīrtiḥ paṃḍito vāpyapaṃḍitaḥ || tulyo me mokṣadīkṣāyāṃ saṃprāpya maṇikarṇikām || 86 || yattyāgenyatra kṛpaṇastatprāpya maṇikarṇikām || dadāmi jaṃtumātrāya sarvasvaṃ cirasaṃcitam || 87 || yadi daivādiha prāptastrisaṃyogo'tidurghaṭaḥ || avicāraṃ tadā deyaṃ sarvasvaṃ cirasaṃcitam || 88 || śarīramatha saṃpattiratha sā maṇikarṇikā || trisaṃyogoyamaprāpyo devairiṃdrādikairapi || 89 || punaḥ punarvicāryeti jaṃtumātrebhya eva ca || nirvāṇalakṣmīṃ yacchāmi sadopamaṇikarṇikam || 4.2.79.90 || muktidā na mahī sā me vārāṇasyāṃ mahīyasī || tanmahī rajasā sāmyaṃ trilokyapi na codvahet || 91 || paraṃ liṃgārcanasthānamavimukteśvareśvaram || tatra pūjāṃ sakṛtkṛtvā kṛtakṛtyo naro bhavet || 92 || sāyaṃ pāśupatīṃ saṃdhyāṃ kuryāṃ paśupatīśvare || vibhūtidhāraṇāttatra paśupāśairna badhyate || 93 || prātaḥsadhyākaromyeva sadoṃkāraniketane || tatraikāpi kṛtā saṃdhyā sarvapātakakṛṃtanī || 94 || vasāmi kṛttivāsehaṃ sadā prati caturdaśi || atra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā caturdaśyāṃ na garbhabhāk || 99 || ratneśvarorcito dadyānmahāratnāni bhaktitaḥ || ratnaiḥ samarcya talliṃgaṃ strīratnādi labhennaraḥ || 96 || viṣṭapatritayāṃtaḥsthopyahaṃ liṃge triviṣṭape || tiṣṭhāmi satataṃ bhaktamanorathasamṛddhaye || 97 || virajaskaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ tatra saṃsevya mānavaḥ || virajā jāyate nūnaṃ caturnada kṛtodakaḥ || 98 || mahādeve mahāpīṭhaṃ mama sādhakasiddhidam || tatpīṭhadarśanādeva mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate || 99 || pitṛprītipradaṃ pīṭhaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajasaṃjñakam || pitṛtarpaṇakṛttatra pitṝṃstārayati kṣaṇāt || 4.2.79.100 || ādikeśavapīṭhehamādikeśavarūpadhṛk || śvetadvīpaṃ naye bhaktānvaiṣṇavānativallabhān || 101 || tatraiva maṃgalāpīṭhe sarvamaṃgaladāyini || upa paṃcanade tīrthe bhaktānsaṃtārayāmyaham || 102 || biṃdumādhavarūpeṇa yatrāhaṃ vaiṣṇavāñjanān || naye paṃcanadasnātāṃstadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 103 || paṃcamudre mahāpīṭhe ye vīreśvarasevakāḥ || teṣāṃ paramanirvāṇaṃ kālenālpena jāyate |||| 104 || tatra siddheśvarīpīṭhe caṃdreśvara samīpataḥ || tatra saṃnidhikartṝṇāṃ siddhiḥ ṣaṇmāsato bhavet || 105 || kāśyāṃ ca yoginīpīṭhe yogasiddhividhāyini || siddhīruccāṭanādyāśca kairna labdhāḥ susādhakaiḥ || 106 || anekānīha pīṭhāni saṃti kāśyāṃ padepade || paraṃ dharmeśapīṭhasya kācicchaktiranuttamā || 107 || yatrāmī bālakīrāśca nirmalajñānabhājanam || āsuḥ sadupadeśānme trātatrāteti bhāṣiṇaḥ || 108 || etaddharmeśvaraṃ pīṭhaṃ tyajāmyadyadināvadhi || na kadācittaraṇijatvattapovanamuttamam || 109 || mamānugrahataḥ kīrānetānpaśya raveḥ suta || divyavimānamāruhya gaṃtāro matpuraṃ mahat || 4.2.79.110 || tatra bhuktvā ciraṃ bhogāñjñānaṃ prāpya mayeritam || iha muktimavāpsyaṃti tvatsaṃsargātinirmalāḥ || 111 || ityuktavati deveśe kailāsaśikharopamam || divyaṃ vimānamāpannaṃ rudrakanyāpariṣkṛtam || 112 || āruhyate na yānena divyarūpavarāḥ khagāḥ || kailāsamabhisaṃjagmurdharmamāpṛcchyate'malāḥ ||113|| || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe dharmeśākhyānanāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||
<4.2.80>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || kuṃbhodbhūta tadāścaryaṃ vilokya jagadaṃbikā || uvāca śaṃbhuṃ praṇatā praṇatārtiharaṃ param ||1|| || aṃbikovāca|| || asya pīṭhasya māhātmyaṃ mahādeva maheśvara || tiraścāmapi yajjātaṃ jñānaṃ saṃsāramocanam || 2 || ataḥ prabhāvaṃ vijñāya dharmapīṭhasya dhūrjaṭe || dharmeśvarasamīpehaṃ sthāsyāmyadya dināvadhi || 3 || atra liṃge tu ye bhaktāḥ striyo vā puruṣāstu vā || teṣāmabhīṣṭāṃ saṃsiddhiṃ sādhayiṣyāmyahaṃ sadā || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || sādhukṛtaṃ tvayā devi kṛtavatyā parigraham || asyeha dharmapīṭhasya manorathakṛtaḥ satām || 5 || ta eva viśvabhoktāro viśvamānyāsta eva hi || ye tvāṃ viśvabhujāmatra pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || 6 || viśve viśvabhuje viśvasthityutpattilayaprade || narāstvadarcakāścātra bhaviṣyaṃtyamalātmakāḥ ||7|| manorathatṛtīyāyāṃ yaste bhaktiṃ vidhāsyati || tanmanorathasaṃsiddhirbhavitrī madanugrahāt || 8 || nārī vā puruṣo vātha tvadvratācaraṇātpriye || manorathāniha prāpya jñānamaṃte ca lapsyate || 9 || || devyuvāca || || manorathatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ kīdṛkkathā katham || kiṃ phalaṃ kaiḥ kṛtaṃ nātha kathayaitatkṛpāṃ kuru || 4.2.80.10 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi yathā pṛṣṭaṃ bhavatyā bhavatāriṇi || manorathavrataṃ caitadguhyādguhyataraṃ param || 11 || pulomatanayā pūrvaṃ tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ || kiṃcinmanorathaṃ prāptuṃ na cāpa tapasaḥ phalam || 12 || apūpujattato māṃ sā bhaktyā paramayā mudā || gītena sarahasyena kalakaṃṭhīkalena hi || 13 || tadgānenātisaṃtuṣṭo mṛdunā madhureṇa ca || sutālena suraṃgeṇa dhātumātrākalāvatā || 14 || provāca tāṃ varaṃ brūhi prasannosmi pulomaje || anena ca sugītena tvanayā liṃgapūjayā || 15 || ||pulomajovāca || || yadi prasanno deveśa tadā yo me manorathaḥ || taṃ pūraya mahādeva mahādevī mahāpriya || 16 || sarvadeveṣu yo mānyaḥ sarvadeveṣu suṃdaraḥ || yāyajūkeṣu sarveṣu yaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sostu me patiḥ || 17 || yathābhilaṣitaṃ rūpaṃ yathābhilaṣitaṃ sukham || yathābhilaṣitaṃ cāyuḥ prasanno dehi me bhava || 18 || yadāyadā ca patyā me saṃgaḥ syāddhṛtsukhecchayā || tadātadā ca taṃ dehaṃ tyaktvānyaṃ dehamāpnuyām|| || 19 || sadā ca liṃgapūjāyāṃ mama bhaktiranuttamā || bhava bhūyādbhavahara jarāmaraṇahāriṇī || 4.2.80.20 || bharturvyayepi vaidhavyaṃ kṣaṇamātramapīha na || mama bhāvi mahādeva pātivratyaṃ ca yātu mā || 21 || || skaṃda uvāca || || imaṃ manorathaṃ tasyāḥ paulomyāḥ purasūdanaḥ || samākarṇya kṣaṇaṃ smitvā prāheśo vismayānvitaḥ || 26 || īśvara uvāca || || pulomakanye yaścaiṣa tvayākāri manorathaḥ || lapsyase vratacaryātastatkuruṣva jiteṃdriye || 23 || manorathatṛtīyāyāścaraṇena bhaviṣyati || tatprāptaye vrataṃ vakṣye tadvidhehi yathoditam|| 24 || tena vratena cīrṇena mahāsaubhāgyadena tu || avaśyaṃ bhavitā bāle tava caivaṃ manorathaḥ || 25 || || pulomakanyāvoca || || kāruṇyavāridhe śaṃbho praṇataprāṇi sarvada || kimātmikātha kā śaktiḥ kā pūjyā tatra devatā || 26 || kadā ca tadvidhātavyamiti kartavyatā ca kā || ityākarṇya śivo vākyaṃ tāṃ tu praṇijagāda ha || 27|| || īśvara uvāca || || manorathatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ paulomi tacchubham|| pūjyā viśvabhujā gaurī bhujaviṃśatiśālinī || 28 || varado'bhayahastaśca sākṣasūtraḥ samodakaḥ || devyāḥ purastādvratinā pūjya āśāvināyakaḥ||29|| caitraśukla tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛtvā vai daṃtadhāvanam || sāyaṃtanīṃ ca nirvartya nātitṛptyā bhujikriyām ||4.2.80.30|| niyamaṃ ceti gṛhṇīyājjitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || saṃtyaktāspṛśya saṃsparśaḥ śucistadgatamānasaḥ || 31 || prātarvrataṃ cariṣyāmi mātarviśvabhujenaghe || vidhehi tatra sāṃnidhyaṃ manmanorathasiddhaye || 32 || niyamaṃ ceti saṃgṛhya svapedrātrau śubhaṃ smaran|| prātarutthāya medhāvī vidhāyāvaśyakaṃ vidhim || 33 || śaucamācamanaṃ kṛtvā daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ samādadet || aśokavṛkṣasya śubhaṃ sarvaśokaniśātanam ||34|| nityaṃtanaṃ ca niṣpādya vidhiṃ vidhividāṃvaraḥ || snātvā śuddhāṃbaraḥ sāyaṃ gaurīpūjāṃ samācaret || 35 || ādau vināyakaṃ pūjya ghṛtapūrānnivedya ca || tatorcayedviśvabhujāmaśokakusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 36 || aśokavartinaivedyairdhūpaiścāgurusaṃbhavaiḥ || kuṃkumenānulipyādāvekabhaktaṃ tataścaret || 37 || aśokavartisahitairghṛtapūrairmanoharaiḥ || evaṃ caitratṛtīyāyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ pulomaje ||38|| rādhādiphālgunāṃtāsu tṛtīyāsu vrataṃ caret || krameṇa daṃtakāṣṭhāni kathayāmi tavānaghe ||39|| anulepanavastūni kusumāni tathaiva ca || naivedyāni gajāsyasya devyāścāpi śubhavrate || 4.2.80.40 || annāni caikabhaktasya śṛṇutāni phalāptaye || jaṃbvapāmārga khadira jātī cūtakadaṃbakam||41|| plakṣoduṃbarakharjūrī bījapūrī sadāḍimī || daṃtakāṣṭha drumā ete vratinaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ ||42|| siṃdūrāguru kastūrī caṃdanaṃ raktacaṃdanam || gorocanā devadāru padmākṣaṃ ca niśādvayam ||43|| prītyānulepanaṃ bāle yakṣakardamasaṃbhavam || sarveṣāmapyalābhe ca praśasto yakṣakardamaḥ ||44|| kastūrikāyā dvau bhāgau dvau bhāgau kuṃkumasya ca || caṃdanasya trayo bhāgāḥ śaśinastveka eva hi || 45 || yakṣakardama ityeṣa samastasuravallabhaḥ || anulipyātha kusumairarcayedvacmi tānyapi || 46 || pāṭalā mallikā padma ketakī karavīrakaḥ || utpalai rājacaṃpaiśca naṃdyāvartaiśca jātibhiḥ || 47 || kumārībhiḥ karṇikārairalābhetacchadaiḥ saha || sugaṃdhibhiḥ prasūnoghaiḥ sarvālābhepi pūjayet || 48 || karaṃbho dadhibhaktaṃ ca sacūtarasamaṃḍakāḥ || pheṇikā vaṭakāścaiva pāyasaṃ ca saśarkaram || 49 || samudgaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhaktaṃ kārttike vinivedayet || iṃḍerikāśca laḍḍūkā māghe laṃpasikā śubhā || 4.2.80.50 || muṣṭikāḥ śarkarāgarbhāḥ sarpiṣā parisādhitāḥ || nivedyāḥ phālgune devyai sārdhaṃ vighnajitā mudā || 51 || nivedayedyadannaṃ hi ekabhaktapi tatsmṛtam || anyannivedya saṃmūḍho bhuṃjāno'nyatpatedadhaḥ || 52 || pratimāsaṃ tṛtīyāyāmevamārādhya vatsaram || vratasaṃpūrtaye kuryātsthaṃḍile'gnisamarcanam || 53 || jātavedasamaṃtreṇa tilājyadraviṇena ca || śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ homaṃ kārayedvidhinā vratī ||54|| sadaiva nakte pūjoktā sadā nakte tu bhojanam || nakta eva hi homo'yaṃ nakta eva kṣamāpanam || 55 || gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ me bhaktyā mātarvighnajitā saha || namostu te viśvabhuje pūrayāśu manoratham || 56 || namo vighnakṛte tubhyaṃ nama āśāvināyaka || tvaṃ viśvabhujayā sārdhaṃ mama dehi manoratham ||57|| etau maṃtrau samuccārya pūjyā gaurīvināyakau || vratakṣamāpane deyaḥ paryaṃkastūlikānvitaḥ || 58 || upadhānyā samāyukto dīpīdaparṇasaṃyutaḥ || ācāryaṃ ca sapatnīkaṃ paryaṃka upaveśya ca || 59 || vratī samarcayedvastraiḥ karakarṇavibhūṣaṇaiḥ || sugaṃdhacaṃdanairmālyairdakṣiṇābhirmudānvitaḥ || 4.2.80.60 || dadyātpayasvinīṃ gāṃ ca vratasyaparipūrtaye || tathopabhogavastūnicchatropānatkamaṃḍalum || 61 || manorathatṛtīyāyā vratametanmayā kṛtam || nyūnātiriktaṃ saṃpūrṇametadastu bhavadgirā ||62|| ityācāryaṃ samāpṛcchya tathetyuktaśca tena vai || āsīmāṃtamanuvrajya dattvānyebhyopi śaktitaḥ || 63 || naktaṃ samācaretpoṣyaiḥ sārdhaṃ suprītamānasaḥ || prātaścaturthyāṃ saṃbhojya caturaśca kumārakān || 64 || abhyarcya gaṃdhamālyādyairdvādaśāpi kumārikāḥ || evaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti vratametatsunirmalam ||65|| kāryaṃ manorathāvāptyai sarvairetadvrataṃ śubham || patnīṃ manoramāṃ kulyāṃ manovṛttyanusāriṇīm ||66|| tāriṇīṃ duḥkhasaṃsārasāgarasya pativratām || kurvannetadvrataṃ varṣaṃ kumāraḥ prāpnuyātsphuṭam || 67 || kumārī patimāpnoti svāḍhyaṃ sarvaguṇādhikam || suvāsinī labhetputrānpatyuḥ saukhyamakhaṃḍitam || 68 || durbhagā subhagāsyācca dhanāḍhyā syāddaridriṇī || vidhavāpi na vaidhavyaṃ punarāpnoti kutracit || 69 || gurviṇī ca śubhaṃ putraṃ labhate sucirāyuṣam || brāhmaṇo labhate vidyāṃ sarvasaubhāgyadāyinīm || 4.2.80.70 || rājyabhraṣṭo labhedrājyaṃ vaiśyo lābhaṃ ca viṃdati || ciṃtitaṃ labhate śūdro vratasyāsya niṣevaṇāt || 7 ||| dharmārthī dharmamāpnoti dhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt || kāmī kāmānavāpnoti mokṣārthī mokṣamāpnuyāt || 72 || yo yo manoratho yasya sa taṃ taṃ viṃdate dhruvam || manorathatṛtīyāyā vratasya caraṇādvratī || 73 || || skaṃda uvāca || || itthaṃ niśamya śivataḥ śivā saṃtuṣṭamānasā || punaḥ papraccha viśveśaṃ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭā || 74 || anyatra ye vrataṃ caitatkariṣyaṃti sadāśiva || te kathaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti māṃ ca āśāvināyakam || 75 || || śiva uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi sarvasaṃdehabhedini || vārāṇasyāṃ samarcyā tvaṃ viśve pratyakṣarūpiṇī ||76|| āśā vighnajitā sārdhaṃ sarvāśāpūrtikāriṇā || hāriṇānaṃtavighnānāṃ mama kṣetra śubhārthinā || 77 || kṣipramāgamayitvā ca natvā dūraṃgatānapi || kṛtakṛtyānvidhāyātha ciṃtitaiḥ samanorathaiḥ || 78 || anyatra vratibhirviśve kāṃcanīpratimā tava || paṃcakṛṣṇalakādūrdhvaṃ kāryā vighnahṛtopi ca || 79 || ācāryāya vratī dadyād vratāṃte pratimā dvayam || sakṛtkṛte vratī cāsminkṛtakṛtyo vratī bhavet || 4.2.80.80 || tataḥ pulomajā devi śrutvaitadvratamuttamam || kṛtvā manorathaṃ prāpa yathābhivāṃchitaṃ hṛdi ||81|| aruṃdhatyā vasiṣṭhopi labdho'tri'nasūyayā || sunītyottānapādācca dhruvaḥ prāptoṃ'gajottamaḥ || 82 || sunītedurbhargatvaṃ ca punarasmādvratādgatam || caturbhujaḥ patiḥ prāptaḥ kṣīranīradhijanmanā || 83 || kiṃ bahūktena suśroṇi kṛtaṃyena vrataṃ tvidam || vratāni tena sarvāṇi kṛtāni vratinā dhruvam || 84 || śrutvā dhīmānkathāṃ puṇyāṃ punastadgatamānasaḥ || śubhabuddhimavāpnoti pāpairapi vimucyate || 85 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe uttarārdhe dharmeśvarākhyāne viśvabhujāśāvināyakapraśaṃsane manorathatṛtīyāvratākhyānaṃ nāmāśītitamodhyāyaḥ || 80 ||
<4.2.81>
|| agastya uvāca || || dharmatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ kīdṛgdevena śaṃbhunā || skaṃda devyai samākhyātaṃ tadākhyāhi kṛpāṃ kuru || 1 || || skaṃda uvāca || || viṃdhyonnatihṛdākhyāmi dharmatīrthasamudbhavam || ākarṇaya mahāprājña yathā devena bhāṣitam || 2 || vṛtraṃ nihatya vṛtrārirbrahmahatyāmavāptavān || anutaptotha papraccha prāyaścittaṃ purohitam || 3 || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || yadi tvaṃ devarājemāṃ brahmahatyāṃ sudustyajām || apānunutsustadyāhi kāśīṃ viśveśapālitām || 4 || nānyatkiṃcitkvaciddṛṣṭaṃ brahmahatyāmahauṣadham || rājadhānīṃ parityajya śakra viśveśituḥ parām || 5 || bhairavasyāpihastāgrādapatadvaidhasaṃ śiraḥ || yatrānaṃdavane tatra vṛtraśatro vraja drutam ||6|| sīmānamapi saṃprāpya śakrānaṃdavanasya hi || brahmahatyā palāyeta vepamānā nirāśrayā || 7 || anyeṣāmapi pāpānāṃ mahāpāpajuṣāmapi || nāśayitrī parā kāśī viśveśa samadhiṣṭhitā || 8 || mahāpātakato muktiḥ kāśyāme va śatakrato || mahāsaṃsārato muktiḥ kāśyāmeva na cānyataḥ ||9|| nirvāṇanagarī kāśī kāśī sarvāghasaṃghahṛt || viśveśituḥ priyā kāśī dyauḥ kāśī sadṛśī nahi || || 4.2.81.10 || brahmahatyābhayaṃ yasya yasya saṃsārato bhayam|| jātucittena na tyājyā kāśikā muktikāśikā ||11|| jaṃtūnāṃ karmabījānāṃ yatra dehavisarjane || na jātucitprarohosti haradṛṣṭyāptaśuṣmaṇām || 12 || tāṃ kāśīṃ prāpya vṛtrāre vṛtrahatyāpanuttaye || samārādhaya viśveśaṃ viśvamuktipradāyakam || 13 || bṛhaspateriti vaco niśamya sa sahasradṛk || āyāddrutataraṃ kāśīṃ mahāpātakaghātukām || 14 || snātvottaravahāyāṃ ca dharmeśaṃ paritaḥ sthitaḥ || ārādhayanmahādevaṃ brahmadvatyāpa nuttaye || 15 || mahārudrajapāsaktaḥ sutrāmātha trilocanam || dadarśa liṃgamadhyasthaṃ svabhāsā dīpitāṃbaram || 16 || punastuṣṭāva vedoktai rudrasūktairanekadhā || viniṣkramya tato liṃgādāvirbhūya bhavovadat || 17 || śacīpate prasannosmi varaṃ varaya suvrata || kiṃ deyaṃ drutamākhyāhi dharmapīṭhakṛtāspada || 18 || śrutveti devadevasya sa premavacanaṃ hariḥ || sarvajña kiṃte'viditaṃ tamuvāceti vṛtrahā || 19 || tatastatkṛpayānunno dharmapīṭhaniṣevaṇāt || niṣpādya tīrthaṃ tatreśo'tra snāhīṃdreti cābravīt ||4.2.81.20|| tatreṃdraḥ snānamātreṇa divyagaṃdho'bhavatkṣaṇāt || avāpa ca ruciṃ cāruṃ prāktanīṃ śātayājñikīm ||21|| tadāścaryamatho dṛṣṭvā munayo nāradādayaḥ || parisasnurmudāyuktā dharmatīrthe'ghahāriṇi || 22 || atarpayanpitṝndivyānvyadhuḥ śrāddhāni śraddhayā || dharmeśaṃ snāpayāmāsustattīrthāmbubhṛtairghaṭaiḥ || 23 || tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ dharmāṃdhuriti viśrutam || brahmahatyādi pāpānāmakleśaṃ kṣālanaṃ param || 24 || yatphalaṃ tīrtharājasya snānena parikīrtyate || sahasraguṇitaṃ tatsyāddharmāṃdhu snānamātrataḥ || 25 || gaṃgādvāre kurukṣetre gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || yatphalaṃ labhate martyo dharmatīrthe tadāpnuyāt || 26 || narmadāyāṃ sarasvatyāṃ gautamyāṃ siṃhage gurau || snātvā yatphalamāpyeta dharmakūpe tadāpnuyāt|| 27 || mānase puṣkare caiva dvārike sāgare tathā || tīrthe snātvā phalaṃ yatsyāttatsyāddharmajalāśaye ||28|| kārtikyāṃ sūkarakṣetre caitryāṃ gaurīmahāhrade || śaṃkhoddhāre haridine yatphalaṃ tatphalaṃ tviha ||29|| tīrthadvayaṃ pratīkṣaṃte sisnāsūnpitaro narān || gaṃgāyāṃ dharmakūpe ca piṃḍanirvapaṇāśayā ||4.2.81.30|| pitāmahasamīpe vā dharmeśasyāgratotha vā || phalgau ca dharmakūpe ca mādyaṃti prapitāmahāḥ || 31 || dharmakūpe naraḥ snātvā paritarpya pitāmahān || gayāṃ gatvā kimadhikaṃ kartā pitṛmudāvaham || 32 || yathā gayāyāṃ tṛptāḥ syuḥ piṃḍadāne pitāmahāḥ || dharmatīrthe tathaiva syurna nyūnaṃ naiva cādhikam || 33 | te dhanyāḥ pitṛbhaktāste prīṇitāstaiḥ pitāmahāḥ|| paitrādṛṇāddharmatīrthe niṣkṛtiryaiḥ kṛtā sutaiḥ || || 34 || tattīrthasya prabhāveṇa niṣpāpobhūtkṣaṇena ca || praṇamya devadeveśamiṃdro'gādamarāvatīm ||35|| apāro mahimā tasya dharmatīrthasya kuṃbhaja || tatkūpe svaṃ nirīkṣyāpi śrāddhadānaphalaṃ labhet || 36 || tatrāpi kākiṇī mātraṃ yacchetpitṛmude naraḥ || akṣayaṃ phalamāpnoti dharmapīṭhaprabhāvataḥ || 37 || tatra yo bhojayedviprānyatinotha tapasvinaḥ || sikthe sikthe labhetsotha vājapeyaphalaṃ sphuṭam || 38 || prāpyāmarāvatīṃ śakrastato diviṣadāṃ puraḥ || dharmapīṭhasya māhātmyaṃ mahatkāśyāmavarṇayat || 39 || āgatya punarapyatra śaṃbhorānaṃdakānane || munivṛṃdārakaiḥ sārdhaṃ liṃgamasthāpayaddhariḥ ||4.2.81.40|| tārakeśātpaścimata iṃdreśvaramitīritam || tasya saṃdarśanātpuṃsāmaiṃdraloko na dūrataḥ ||41|| taddakṣiṇe śacīśaśca svayaṃ śacyā pratiṣṭhitaḥ || śacīśārcanataḥ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavet || 42 || tatsamīpesti raṃbheśo bahusaukhyasamṛddhidaḥ || iṃdreśvarasya parito lokapāleśvaro paraḥ || 43 || tadarcanātprasīdaṃti lokapālāḥ samṛddhidāḥ || dharmeśātpaścimāśāyāṃ dharaṇīśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || taddarśanena dhairyaṃ syādrājye rājakulādiṣu || 44 || dharmeśāddakṣiṇe pūjyaṃ tattveśākhyaṃ paraṃ naraiḥ || tattvajñānaṃ pravarteta talliṃgasya samarcanāt || 45 || dharmeśātpūrvadigbhāge vairāgyeśaṃ samarcayet || nivṛttiścetasastasya liṃgasya sparśanādapi || 46 || jñāneśvaraṃ tathaiśānyāṃ jñānadaṃ sarvadehinām || aiśvaryeśamudīcyāṃ ca liṃgāddharmeśvarācchubhāt || 47 || taddarśanādbhavennṛṇāmaiśvaryaṃ manasepsitam || paṃcavaktrasya rūpāṇi liṃgānyetāni kuṃbhaja ||48|| etānyavaśyaṃ saṃsevya naraḥ prāpnoti śāśvatam || anyattatraiva yadvṛttaṃ tadākhyāmi mune śṛṇu ||49|| yacchrutvāpi naro ghore saṃsārābdhau na majjati || kadaṃbaśikharo nāma viṃdhyapādo mahāniha || 4.2.81.50 || damasya putrastatrāsīddurdamo nāma pārthivaḥ || pitaryuparate rājyaṃ saṃprāpyāvijiteṃdriyaḥ || 51 || haretpuraṃdhrīḥ prasabhaṃ paurāṇāṃ kāmamohitaḥ || asādhavaḥ priyāstasya sādhavo'priyatāṃ yayuḥ || 52 || adaṃḍyāndaṃḍayāṃcakre daṃḍyeṣvāsītparāṅamukhaḥ || sadaiva mṛgayāśīlaḥ so'bhūnmṛgayu saṃgataḥ || || 53 || vivāsitāḥ svaviṣayāttena sanmatidāyinaḥ || dharmādhikāriṇaḥ śūdrā brāhmaṇāḥ karadīkṛtāḥ ||54|| paradāreṣusaṃtuṣṭaḥ svadāreṣu parāṅmukhaḥ || ānarca jātucinnaiva devau duḥkhāṃtakāriṇau || 55 || hāriṇau sarvapāpānāṃ sarvavāṃchitadāyinau || sarveṣāṃ jagatīsārau śrīkaṃṭhaśrīpatīpatī || 56 || svaprajāsveka udito dhūmaketurivāparaḥ || durdamo nāma bhūpālaḥ kṣayāyā kāṃḍa eva hi ||57|| sa kadācinmṛgayubhiḥ pāpardhi vyasanāturaḥ || sārdhaṃ viveśāraṇyāni gṛṣṭipṛṣṭhānugo hayī || || 58 || ekākī daivayogena durdamaḥ so'vanīpatiḥ | dhanvī turaṃgamāruḍho'viśadānaṃdakānanam || 59 || sa vilokyātha sarvatra pādapā navakeśinaḥ || succhāyāṃśca suvistārāngataśrama ivābhavat || 4.2.81.60 || sugaṃdhena suśītena sumadena suvāyunā || kṣaṇaṃ saṃvījito rājā pallavavyajanaiḥ kujaiḥ || 63 || kevalaṃ mṛgayā jātastatkhedo na vyapāvrajat || ājanmajanitaḥ khedo niragāttadvanekṣaṇāt || 62 || madhye vanaṃ sa cāpaśyatprāsādaṃ cuṃbitāṃbaram || mahāratnaśalākānāṃ ramyamekamivākaram ||63|| athāvaruhya turagātsa bhūpālotivismitaḥ || dharmeśamaṃḍapaṃ prāpya svātmānaṃ praśaśaṃsa ha ||64|| dhanyosmyahaṃ prasannosmi dhanye medya vilocane || dhanyamadyatanaṃ cāharyadapaśyamimāṃ bhuvam || 65 || punarniniṃda cātmānaṃ dharmapīṭha prabhāvataḥ || dhiṅmāṃ durjanasaṃsargaṃ tyaktasajjanasaṃgamam || 66 || jaṃtūdvegakaraṃ mūḍhaṃ prajāpīḍanapaṃḍitam || paradāraparadravyāpahṛtyāsukhamāninam ||67|| adyayāvanmama gataṃ vṛthājanmālpamedhasa || dharmasthānānīdṛśāni yaddṛṣṭāni na kutracit || 68 || evaṃ bahu viniṃdya svaṃ natvā dharmeśvaraṃ vibhum || āruhyāśvaṃ yayau rājā durdamo viṣayaṃ svakam || 69 || tatomātyānsamāhūya kramāyātāṃściraṃtanān || navīnānparinirvāsya paurāṃścāpi samāhvayat || 4.2.81.70 || brāhmaṇāṃścanamaskṛtya tebhyo vṛttīḥ pradāya ca || putre rājyaṃ samāropya prajādharme niveśya ca || 71 || paridaṃḍya ca daṃḍārhānsādhūṃśca paritoṣya ca || dārānapi parityajya viṣayeṣu parāṅmukhaḥ || 72 || samāgacchadathaikākī kāśīṃ śreyovikāsinīm || dharmeśvaraṃ samārādhya kālānnirvāṇamāptavān || 73 || dharmeśadarśanānnityaṃ tathābhūtaḥ sa durdamaḥ || babhūva damināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ prāṃte mokṣaṃ ca labdhavān || 74 || itthaṃ dharmeśa māhātmyaṃ mayā svalpaṃ nirūpitam || dharmapīṭhasya māhātmyaṃ samyakko veda kuṃbhaja || 79 || idaṃ dharmeśvarākhyānaṃ yaḥ śroṣyati narottamaḥ || ājanmasaṃcitātpāpātsa mukto bhavati kṣaṇāt ||76|| śrāddhakāle viśeṣeṇa dharmeśākhyānamuttamam|| śrāvayedbrāhmaṇāndhīmānpitṝṇāṃ tṛptikāraṇam || 77 || dharmākhyānamidaṃ śṛṇvannapi dūrasthitaḥ sudhīḥ || sarvapāparvinirmukto gaṃtāṃte śivamaṃdiram || 78 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe uttarārdhe dharmeśvarākhyānanāmaikāśītitamodhyāyaḥ || 81 ||
<4.2.82>
|| pārvatyuvāca || || vīreśasya maheśāna śrūyate mahimā mahān || parāṃ siddhiṃ paropatustatra siddhāḥ paraḥ śatāḥ ||1|| kathamāvirbhavastasya kāśyāṃ liṃgavarasya tu || āśusiddhipradasyeha tanme brūhi jagatpate || || 2 || || maheśvara uvāca || || niśāmaya mahādevi vīreśāvirbhavaṃ param || yaṃ śrutvāpi naraḥ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti vipulaṃ śive ||3|| āsīdamitrajinnāma rājā parapuraṃjayaḥ || dhārmikaḥ sattvasaṃpannaḥ prajāraṃjanatatparaḥ || 4 || yaśodhano vadānyaśca sudhīrbrāhmaṇadaivataḥ || sadaivāvabhṛthasnānapariklinna śiroruhaḥ || 5 || vinīto nītisaṃpannaḥ kuśalaḥ sarvakarmasu || vidyābdhipāradṛśvā ca guṇavānguṇivatsalaḥ || 6 || kṛtajño madhurālāpaḥ pāpakarmaparāṅmukhaḥ || satyavākchaucanilayaḥ svalpavāgvijiteṃdriyaḥ || 7 || raṇāṃgaṇe kṛtāṃtābhaḥ saṃkhyāvāṃśca sadojire || kāminīkāmakelijño yuvāpi sthavirapriyaḥ || 8 || dharmārthaidhitakośaśca samṛddhabalavāhanaḥ || subhagaśca surūpaśca sumedhāḥ suprajāśrayaḥ ||9|| sthairya dhairya samāpanno deśakālavicakṣaṇaḥ || manyamānaprado nityaṃ sarvadūṣaṇavarjitaḥ || 4.2.82.10 || vāsudevāṃghriyugale cetovṛttiṃ nidhāya saḥ || cakāra rājyaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ viṣvagīti vivarjitam || 11 || alaṃghyaśāsanaḥ śrīmānviṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || abhunakpracurānbhogānsamaṃtādviṣṇusātkṛtān || 12 || harerāyatanānyuccaiḥ pratisaudhaṃ padepade || tasya rājye samabhavanmahābhāgyanidheḥ śive ||13|| goviṃdagopagopāla gopījanamanohara || gadāpāṇe guṇātīta guṇāḍhya garuḍadhvaja || 14 || keśihṛtkaiṭabhārāte kaṃsāre kamalāpate || kṛṣṇakeśava kaṃjākṣa kīnāśa bhayanāśana || 15 || puruṣottama pāpāre puṃḍarīkavilocana || pītakauśeyavasana padmanābha parātpara || 16 || janārdana jagannātha jāhnavījalajanmabhūḥ || janmināṃ janmaharaṇa jaṃjapūkāghanāśana || 17 || śrīvatsavakṣaḥ śrīkāṃta śrīkara śreyasāṃ nidhe || śrīraṃgaśārṅgakodaṃḍa śaure śītāṃśulocana || 18 || daityāre dānavārāte dāmodara duraṃtaka || devakīhṛdayānaṃda daṃdaśūkeśvareśaya || 19|| viṣṇo vaikuṃṭhanilaya bāṇāre viṣṭaraśravaḥ || viṣvaksena virādhāre vanamālinvanapriya || 4.2.82.20 || trivikramatrilokīśa cakrapāṇe caturbhuja || ityādīni pavitrāṇi nāmāni pratimaṃdiram || 21 || strīvṛddhabālagopāla vadanodīritāni tu || śrūyate yatrakutrāpi ramyāṇi madhuvidviṣaḥ || 22 || surasākānanānyeva vilokyaṃte gṛhegṛhe|| caritrāṇi vicitrāṇi pavitrāṇyabdhijāpateḥ || 23 || saudhabhittiṣu dṛśyaṃte citrakṛnnirmitāni tu || ṛte harikathāyāstu nānyā vārtā niśamyate || || 24 || hariṇā naiva vidhyaṃte harināmāṃśadhāriṇaḥ || tasya rājño bhayādvyādhairaraṇyasukhacāriṇaḥ || 25 || na matsyā naiva kamaṭhā na varāhāśca kenacit || hanyaṃte kvāpi tadbhītyā matsyamāṃsāśināpi vai || 26 || apyuttānaśayāstasya rāṣṭre mitrajitaḥ kvacit || stanapānaṃ na kurvaṃti saṃprāpya harivāsaram || 27 || paśavopi tṛṇāhāraṃ parityajya harerdine || upoṣaṇaparā jātā anyeṣāṃ kā kathā nṛṇām || 28 || mahāmahotsavaḥ sarvaiḥ puraukobhirvitanyate || tasminpraśāsati bhuvaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare || 29 || sa eva daṃḍyo'bhūttasya rājño mitrajitaḥ kṣitau || yo viṣṇubhaktirahitaḥ prāṇairapi dhanairapi || 4.2.82.30 || aṃtyajā api tadrāṣṭre śaṃkhacakrāṃkadhāriṇaḥ || saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ dīkṣitā iva saṃbabhuḥ || 31 || śubhāni yāni karmāṇi kriyaṃte'nudinaṃ janaiḥ || vāsudeve samarpyaṃte tāni tairaphalepsubhiḥ || 32 || vinā mukuṃdaṃ govidaṃ paramānaṃdamacyutam || nānyo japyetamanyeta na bhajyeta janaiḥ kvacit || 33 || kṛṣṇa eva paro deva kṛṣṇaeva parāgatiḥ || kṛṣṇa eva paro baṃdhustasyāsīdavanīpateḥ ||34|| evaṃ tasminmahīpāle rājyaṃ samyakpraśāsati || ekadā nāradaḥ śrīmāṃstaṃ didṛkṣuḥ samāyayau ||35|| rājñā samarcitaḥ sotha madhuparka vidhānataḥ || nārado varṇayāmāsa tamamitrajitaṃ nṛpam || 36 || || nārada uvāca || || dhanyosi kṛtakṛtyosi mānyopyasi divaukasām || sarvabhūteṣu goviṃdaṃ paripaśyanviśāṃpate || 37 || yo veda puruṣo viṣṇuryo yajñapuruṣo hariḥ || yoṃtarātmāsya jagataḥ kartā hartāvitā vibhuḥ || 38 || tanmayaṃ paśyato viśvaṃ tava bhūpālasattama || darśanaṃ prāpya śubhadaṃ śucitvamagamaṃ param || 39 || eka eva hi sārotra saṃsāre kṣaṇabhaṃgure || kamalākāṃta pādābja bhaktibhāvo'khilapradaḥ || 4.2.82.40 || parityajya hi yaḥ sarvaṃ vipṇumekaṃ sadā bhajet || sumedhasaṃ bhajaṃte taṃ padārthāḥ sarva eva hi || 41 || hṛpīkeśe hṛṣīkāṇi yasya sthairyaṃ gatānyaho || sa eva sthairyamāpnoti brahmāṃḍe'tīva caṃcale || 42 || yauvanaṃ dhanamāyuṣyaṃ padminījalabiṃduvat || atīva capalaṃ jñātvā'cyutamekaṃ samāśrayet || 43 || vāci cetasi sarvatra yasya devo janārdanaḥ || sa eva sarvadā vaṃdyo nararūpī janārdanaḥ || 44 || nirvyāja praṇidhānena śīlayitvā śriyaḥpatim || puruṣottamatāṃ ko na prāptavāniha bhūtale || 45 || anayā viṣṇubhaktyā te saṃtuṣṭeṃdriyamānasaḥ || upakartumanā brūyāṃ tanniśāmaya bhūpate || 46 || bālā vidyādharasutā nāmnā malayagaṃdhinī || krīḍaṃtī piturākroḍe hṛtā kaṃkālaketunā || 47 || kapālaketuputreṇa dānavena balīyasā || āgāminyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tasyāḥ pāṇigrahṛṃ kila || 48 || pātāle caṃpakāvatyāṃ nagaryāṃ sāsti sāṃpratam || hāṭakeśātsamāgacchaṃstayā haṃsāśrunetrayā || 49 || dṛṣṭaḥ praṇamya vijñapto yathā tacca nithāmaya || brahmacārinmuniśreṣṭha gaṃdhamādanaśailataḥ || 4.2.82.50 || bālakrīḍanakāsaktāṃ mohayitvā nināya saḥ || kaṃkālaketurdurvṛtto durjayonyāstraghātataḥ || 51 || svasya triśūlaghātena mriyate nānyathā raṇe || jagatparyākulīkṛtya nidrātyatravinirbhayaḥ || 52 || yadi kopi kṛtajño māṃ hatvemaṃ duṣṭadānavam || maddattena triśūlena nayedbhadraṃ bhavennaraḥ || 53 || yadatropacikīrṣustvaṃ rakṣa māṃ duṣṭadānavāt || mamāpi hi varo datto bhagavatyā mahāmune || 54 || viṣṇubhakto yuvā dhīmānputri tvāṃ pariṇeṣyati || ā tṛtīyā tithi yathā tadvākyaṃ tathyatāṃ vrajet || 55 || tathā nimittamātraṃ tvaṃ bhava yatnaṃ samācara || iti tadvacanādrājanviṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇam || yuvānaṃ cāpi dhīmaṃtaṃ tvāmanu prāptavānaham ||56|| tadgaccha kāryasiddhyai tvaṃ hatvā taṃ duṣṭadānavam || ānayāśu mahābāho śubhāṃ malayagaṃdhinīm || 57 || sā tu vidyādharī jīvedvilokya tvāṃ nareśvara || pārvatīvacanādduṣṭaṃ ghātayiṣyatyayatnataḥ || 58 || iti nāradavākyaṃ sa niśamyāmitrajinnṛpaḥ || analpotkaliko jāto vidyādharasutāṃ prati || 59 || upāyaṃ cāpi papraccha gaṃtuṃ tāṃ caṃpakāvatīm || nāradena punaḥ proktaḥ sa rājā girirājaje || 4.2.82.60 || tūrṇamarṇavamāsādya pūrṇimādivase nṛpa || bhavāndrakṣyati potasthaḥ kalpavṛṃdārathasthitam ||61|| tatra divyāṃganā kāciddivyaparyaṃka saṃsthitā || vīṇāmādāya gāyaṃtī gāthāṃ gāsyati susvaram || 62 || yatkarmavihitaṃ yena śubhaṃ vātha śubhetaram || sa eva bhuṃkte tattathyaṃ vidhisūtraniyaṃtritaḥ || 63 || gāthāmimāṃ sā saṃgīya sarathā sa mahīruhā || saparyaṃkā kṣaṇādeva madhye siṃdhuṃ pravekṣyati ||64|| bhavānapyaviśaṃkaṃ ca tataḥ potānmahārṇave || tāmanu vrajatu kṣipraṃ yajñavārāhamāstuvan ||65|| tato drakṣyasi pātāle nagarīṃ caṃpakāvatīm || mahāmanoharā rājansahitāṃ bālayānayā ||66|| ityuktvāṃtarhito devi sa caturmukhanaṃdanaḥ || rājāpyarṇavamāsādya yathoktaṃ parilakṣya ca || 67 || viveśāṃtaḥsamudraṃ ca nagarīmāsasāda tām || sātha vidyādharī bālā netraprāghuṇakī kṛtā || 68 || tena rājñā trijagatī sauṃdaryaśrīrivaikikā || pātāladevateyaṃ vā mamanetrotsavāya kim ||69|| niraṇāyi madhudveṣṭrā sraṣṭuḥ sṛṣṭivilakṣaṇā || kuhūrāhubhayādeṣā kāṃtiścāṃdramasī kimu ||4.2.82.70|| yoṣidrūpaṃ samāśritya tiṣṭhate'trākuto'bhayā || itthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tāṃ nirvarṇya sa rājāgāttadaṃtikam || 71 || sā vilokyātha taṃ bālā nitarāṃ madhurākṛtim || viśālorasthalatalaṃ pralaṃbatulasīsrajam || 72 || śaṃkhacakrāṃkasubhaga bhujadvayavirājitam || harināmākṣarasudhā sudhauta radanāvalim || 73 || bhavānībhaktibījotthaṃ bhūruhaṃ puruṣākṛtim || manorathaphalaiḥ pūrṇamāsīddhṛṣṭatanūruhā ||74|| dolāparyaṃkamutsṛjya hrībharā namrakaṃdharā || vepathuṃ ca pariṣṭabhya bālā provāca bhūpatim ||75 || kastvamatra kṛtāṃtasya bhavanaṃ madhurākṛte || prāpto me maṃdabhāgyāyāścetovṛttiṃ niruṃdhayan || 76 || yāvannāyāti subhaga sa kaṭhoratarākṛtiḥ || atiparyākulīkṛtya trilokīṃ dānavo muhuḥ ||77|| kaṃkālaketurdurvṛttastvavadhyaḥ parahetibhiḥ || tāvadguptaṃ samātiṣṭha śastrāgāreti gahvare ||78|| na me kanyāvrataṃ bhaṃktuṃ sa samartha umā varāt|| āgāminyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ paraśvaḥ pāṇipīḍanam || 79 || saṃcikīrṣati duṣṭātmā gatāyurmama śāpataḥ || mā tadbhītiṃ kuru yuvaṃstatkāryaṃ bhavitāciram || 4.2.82.80 || vidyādharyeti coktaḥ sa śastrāgāre nigūḍhavat || sthito vīro mahābāhurdānavāgamane kṣaṇaḥ ||81|| atha sāyaṃ samāyāto dānavo bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ|| triśūlaṃ kalayanpāṇau mṛtyorapi bhayāvaham || 82 || āgatya dānavo raudraḥ pralayāṃbudanisvanaḥ || vidyādharīṃ jagādeti madāghūrṇitalocanaḥ ||83|| gṛhāṇemāni ratnāni divyāni varavarṇini || kanyātvaṃ ca paraśvaste pāṇigrāhādapaiṣyati || 84 || dāsīnāmayutaṃ prātardāsyāmi tava suṃdari || āsurīṇāṃ surīṇāṃ ca dānavīnāṃ manoharam || 85 || gaṃdharvīṇāṃ narīṇāṃ ca kinnarīṇāṃ śataṃśatam || vidyādharīṇāṃ nāgīnāṃ yakṣiṇīnāṃ śatāni ṣaṭ || 86 || rākṣasīnāṃ śatānyaṣṭau śatamapsarasāṃ varam || etāste paricāriṇyo bhaviṣyaṃtyamalāśaye || 87 || yāvatsaṃpattisaṃbhāro dikpālānāṃ gṛheṣu vai || matparigrahatāṃ prāpya tāvatastvamiheśvarī || 88 || divyānbhogānmayā sārdhaṃ bhokṣyase matparigrahāt || kadā paraśvo bhavitā yasminvaivāhiko vidhiḥ || 89 || tvadaṃgasaṃgasaṃsparśa sukhasaṃdoha meduraḥ || parāṃ nirvṛtimāpsyāmi paraśvo nikaṭaṃ yadi || 4.2.82.90 || manorathāściraṃ yāvadyaṃ me hṛdi samedhitāḥ || tānkṛtārthī kariṣyāmi paraśvastava saṃgamāt || 91 || jitvā devānraṇe sarvāniṃdrādīnmṛgalocane || trailokyaiśvaryasaṃpattestvāṃ kariṣyāmi ceśvarīm || 92 || ādhāyāṃke triśūlaṃ sve suṣvāpeti pralapya saḥ || naramāṃsavasāsvāda pramatto vītasādhvasaḥ || ||93|| varaṃ smaraṃtī sā gauryā vidyādharakumārikā || vijñāya taṃ pramattaṃ ca susuptaṃ cātinirbhayam || 94 || āhūya taṃ naravaraṃ varaṃ sarvāṃgasuṃdaram ||| viṣṇubhaktikṛtatrāṇaṃ prāṇanātheti jalpya ca || 95 || śūlaṃ tadaṃkādādāya gṛhāṇemaṃ jahi drutam || iti triśūlaṃ bālāto bālārkasadṛśadyuti || 96 || samādāya mahābāhuḥ sa tadā mitrajinnṛpaḥ || jaharṣa ca jagādoccairbālāyāścābhayaṃ diśan || 97 || vāmapādaprahāreṇa tamātāḍya sa nirbhayaḥ || saṃsmaraṃścakriṇaṃ citte jagadrakṣāmaṇiṃ harim || 98 || jargāda tiṣṭha re duṣṭa kanyādharṣaṇalālasa || yudhyasvātra mayā sārdhaṃ na suptaṃ hanmyahaṃ ripum ||99|| iti saṃśrutya saṃbhrāṃta utthāya sa danoḥ sutaḥ || triśūlaṃ dehi me kāṃte provāceti muhurmuhuḥ || 4.2.82.100 || koyaṃ mṛtyugṛhaṃ prāptaḥ kasya ruṣṭo'dya cāṃtakaḥ || ka āyuṣādya saṃtyakto yaḥ prāpto mama gocaram ||101 || mama pracaṃḍa dordaṃḍa kaṃḍū kaṃḍūyana kṣamaḥ || nālpo naroyaṃ bhavitā kiṃ triśūlena suṃdari ||102|| mābhairme kautukaṃ paśya bhakṣyo'yaṃ mama sāṃpratam || kālena matto bhītena svayamevopaḍhaukitaḥ || 103 || ityuktvā muṣṭighātena tenoccairdanusūnunā || hṛdaye nihato rājā śilātikaṭhine drutam || 104 || sa cakriṇā kṛtatrāṇaḥ pīḍāmalpīyasīmapi || no veda kaṭhinoraskastatkaraṃ pratyutānudat || 105 || atha kopavatā rājñā hato vaktre capeṭayā || āghūrṇitaśirā bhūmau patitvā punarutthitaḥ || 106 || uvāca ca vaco dhairyamavaṣṭabhya mahābalī || 107 || || dānava uvāca || || jñātaṃ na tvaṃ manuṣyosi nṛrūpeṇa caturbhujaḥ || āyātaśchidramāsādya haṃtuṃ māṃ dānavāṃtakaḥ || 108 || ekaṃ vidhehi madhubhidyadi tvaṃ balavānasi || vihāyaitanmahacchūlaṃ yudhyasva svāyudhairmayā ||109|| tvayā kapaṭarūpeṇa balinaḥ kaiṭabhādayaḥ || na balena hatāḥ saṃkhye hatā evacchalena hi || 4.2.82.110 | baliṃ pātālamanayastvaṃ nṛvāmanatāṃ dadhat || nṛmṛgatvena bhavatā hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || 111 || tvayā jaṭilarūpeṇa laṃkeśo vinipātitaḥ || gopālaveṣamāsādya kaṃsādyā ghātitāstvayā || 112 || strīrūpeṇāharastvaṃ tu vipralāpyā surānsudhām || yādo rūpeṇa bhavatā śaṃkhādyāni hatā bahu ||113|| māyāvināmagragaṇya sarvamarmajñasādhaka || na tvattohaṃ bibhemyadya yadi śūlaṃ vihāsyasi || 114 || athavā dainyavacanaḥ kimebhiḥ kātarocitaiḥ || na tyakṣyasi triśūlaṃ tvaṃ na tvāṃ jeṣyāmyahaṃ raṇe || 115 || avaśyameva martavyamadya prātaḥ śarīriṇā || tvatkareṇa varaṃ mṛtyurbalenāpicchalena vā || 116 || iyaṃ vidyādharī kanyā na mayā dūṣitā satī || sākṣācchrīreva maṃtavyā tavārthaṃ rakṣitā mayā || 117 || ityuktvā vāmadordaṃḍaprahāreṇātiniṣṭhuram || nijaghāna danoḥ sūnustaṃ śiloccayakaṃpinā || 118 || nṛpo vakṣaḥ prahāraṃ taṃ viṣahya raṇa mūrddhani || lakṣīcakāra tadvakṣastriśūlaṃ tolayankare || 119 || nijaghāna mahābāhuḥ sa ca prāṇāñjahau kṣaṇāt || itthaṃ kaṃkālaketuṃ sa nihatya surakaṃpanam || 4.2.82.120 || vidyādharīṃ prapaśyaṃtīṃ prāha hṛṣṭatanūruhām || nāradasya munervākyāttava suśroṇi vāṃchitam || 121 || kṛtaṃ mayā kṛtajñe kiṃ karavāṇyadhunā vada || śrutveti tasya sā vākyaṃ prāha gaṃbhīracetasaḥ || 122 || malayagaṃdhinyuvāca || || athodāramate vīra nija prāṇaiḥ paṇīkṛtām || kiṃ māṃ pṛcchasi jīvāto kulakanyā pradūṣitām || 123 || iti bruvatyāṃ kanyāyāṃ punaḥ svairacaro muniḥ || atarkitāgamaḥ prāpto nārado devalokataḥ ||124|| tatastutuṣatustau tu dṛṣṭvā taṃ munisattamam || kṛtapraṇāmau muninā pariviśrāṇitāśiṣau ||125|| pāṇigraheṇa vidhinā'bhiṣiktau nāradena tu || jagmaturnāradādiṣṭa vartmanā kṛtamaṃgalau || 126 || tayā malayagaṃdhinyā yutaḥ so'mitrajinnṛpaḥ || purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ prāpya paurairvihitamaṃgalām || 127 || yadvīkṣaṇādapi naro nārakī naiva jātucit || gatimāpnoti medhāvī tāṃ purīmaviśannṛpaḥ || 128 || yasyāṃ puryāṃ praveśaṃ na labhaṃte vāsavādayaḥ || kaivalyajanayitryāṃ hi tāṃ purīmaviśannṛpaḥ ||129|| api smṛtvā purīṃ yāṃ vai kāśīṃ trailokyakāṃkṣitām || na naro lipyate pāpaistāṃ viveśa sa bhūpatiḥ |||| 4.2.82.130 || yasyāṃ puryāṃ praviṣṭo nā mahadbhirapi pātakaiḥ || nābhibhūyeta tāṃ kāśīṃ prāviśatsa viśāṃpatiḥ || 131 || sāpi vidyādharī kāśī samṛddhiṃ vīkṣya dūrataḥ || niniṃda svargalokaṃ ca pātālanagarīmapi || 132 || prāpyā mitrajitaṃ kāṃtaṃ tathā hṛṣṭā na sā vadhūḥ || yathā dṛṣṭvāpyaho kāśīṃ paramānaṃdaketanam || 133 || sā kṛtārthamivātmānaṃ manyamānā manasvinī || tena patyā ca kāśyā ca parāṃ nirvṛtimāyayau || 134 || sopyamitrajidāsādya patnīṃ malayagaṃdhinīm || dharmapradhānaṃ saṃsevya kāmaṃ prāptottamaṃ sukham || 135 || saikadā taṃ patiṃ rājñī viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇam || raho vijñāpayāṃcakre patibhaktā sutārthinī || 136 || || rājñyuvāca || || bhūpābhīṣṭatṛtīyāyāścariṣyāmi mahāvratam || yadyanujñā bhavedbhartuḥ putrakāmārthitapradam || 137 || || rājovāca || || devyabhīṣṭatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ kīdṛgbhavedvada || kā devatā tatra pūjyā vidhānaṃ cāpi kiṃ phalam || 138 || nārī patyananujñātā yā vratādi samācaret || jīvaṃtī duḥkhinī sā syānmṛtā nirayamṛcchati || 139 || iti rājñoditā rājñī pravaktumupacakrame || iti kartavyatāṃ tasya vratasya sarahasyakām||4.2.82.140|| || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṇḍe uttarārdha vīreśvarāvirbhāve'mitrajitparākramo nāma dvyaśītitamodhyāyaḥ || 82 ||
<4.2.83>
rājñyuvāca || || avadhehi dharānātha kathayāmi yathātatham || vratasyāsya vidhānaṃ ca phalaṃ cābhīṣṭadevatām || 1 || purā puraḥ śrīdapatnyāḥ śrīmukhyā brahmasūnunā || nāradena sutārthinyā vratametadudīritam || 2 || cīrṇaṃ cātha tayā devyā putrobhūnnalakūbaraḥ || anyābhirapi bahvībhiḥ putrāḥ prāptā vratāditaḥ || 3 || vidhināpyatra saṃpūjyā gaurī sarvavidhānavit || stanaṃdhayena sahitā dhayatā stanamunmukham || 4 || mārgaśīrṣa tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ kalaśopari || tāmrapātraṃ nidhāyaikaṃ taṃḍulaiḥ paripūritam || 5 || avicchinnaṃ navīnaṃ ca rajanīrāgaraṃjitam || vāsaḥ pātropari nyasya sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ param ||6|| tasyopari śubhaṃ padmaṃ raviraśmivikāsitam || tatkarṇikāyā upari catuḥsvarṇavinirmitam || 7 || vidhiṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā ratnapaṭṭābaṃrādibhiḥ || puṣpairnānāvidhai ramyaiḥ phalairnāraṃgamukhyakaiḥ || 8 || sugaṃdhaiścaṃdanādyaiśca karpūra mṛganābhibhiḥ || paramānnādi naivedyaiḥ pakvānnairbahubhaṃgibhiḥ ||9|| dhūpairagurumukhyaiśca ramye kusumamaṃḍape || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ viniṃdraiḥ paramotsavaiḥ || 4.2.83.10 || hastamātramite kuṃḍe jātavedasa ityṛcā || ghṛtena madhunāplutya juhuyānmaṃtraviddvijaḥ || 11 || sahasrakamalānāṃ ca smerāṇāṃ svayameva hi || navaprasūtāṃ kapilāṃ suśīlāṃ ca payasvinīm || 12 || dadyādācāryavaryāya sālaṃkārāṃ salakṣaṇām || upoṣya daṃpatī bhaktyā navāṃbaravibhūṣitau || 13 || prātaḥsnātvā caturthyāṃ ca saṃpūjyācāryamādṛtaḥ || vastrairābharaṇairmālyairdakṣiṇābhirmudānvitau || 14 || sopaskarāṃ ca tāṃ mṛrtimācāryāya nivedayet || samuccarannimaṃ maṃtraṃ vratakṛnmithunaṃ mudā || 15 || namo viśvavidhānajñe vidhe vividhakāriṇi || sutaṃ vaṃśakaraṃ dehi tuṣṭāmuṣmādvratācchubhāt || 16 || sahasaṃ bhojayitvātha dvijānāṃ bhaktipūrvakam || bhuktaśeṣeṇa cānnena kuryādvai pāraṇaṃ tataḥ || 17 || itthametadvrataṃ rājaṃścikīrṣāmi tvayā saha || kuru caitatpriyaṃ mahyamabhīṣṭaphalalabdhaye || 18 || iti bhūpālavaryeṇa śrutvā saṃhṛṣṭacetasā || muneva taṃ samācīrṇaṃ sāṃtarvatnī babhūva ha || 19 || tayātha prārthitā gaurī garbhiṇyā bhaktitoṣitā || putraṃ dehi mahāmāye sākṣādviṣṇvaṃśasaṃbhavam || 4.2.83.20 || jātamātro vrajetsvargaṃ punagayāti cātra vai || bhaktaḥ sadāśive'tyarthaṃ prasiddhaḥ sarvabhūtale ||21|| vinaiva stanyapānena ṣoḍaśābdākṛtiḥ kṣaṇāt || evaṃbhūtaḥ suto gauri yathā me syāttathākuru ||22|| mṛḍānyāpi tathetyuktā rājñī bhaktyātituṣṭayā || atha kālena tanayaṃ mūlarkṣe sāpyajījanat || 23 || hitairamātyairatha sā vijñaptāriṣṭasaṃsthitā || devi rājārthinī cettvaṃ tyaja duṣṭarkṣajaṃ sutam || || 24 || sā maṃtrivākyamākarṇya kevalaṃ patidevatā || atyākṣīttaṃ tathā prāptaṃ tanayaṃ nayakovidā || 25 || dhātreyikāṃ samākārya prāhedaṃ sā nṛpāṃganā || paṃcamudre mahāpīṭhe vikaṭā nāma mātṛkā || 26 || tadagre sthāpayitvāmuṃ bālaṃ dhātreyike vada || gauryādattaḥ śiśurasau tavāgre viniveditaḥ || 27 || rājñyā patyuḥ priyeṣiṇyā maṃtrivijñaptinunnayā || sāpi rājñyuditaṃ śrutvā śiśuṃ lāsya śaśiprabham || 28 || vikaṭāyāḥ puraḥ sthāpya gṛhaṃ dhātreyikā gatā || atha sā vikaṭā devī samāhūya ca yoginīḥ || 29 || uvāca nayata kṣipraṃ śiśuṃ mātṛgaṇāgrataḥ || tāsāmājñāṃ ca kuruta rakṣatāmuṃ prayatnataḥ || 4.2.83.30 || yoginyo vikaṭāvākyātkhecaryastāḥ kṣaṇena tam || ninyurgaganamārgeṇa brāhmyādyā yatra mātaraḥ || 31 || praṇamya yoginīvṛṃdaṃ taṃ śiśuṃ sūryavarcasam || puro nidhāya mātṝṇāṃ provāca vikaṭoditam || 32 || brahmāṇī vaiṣṇavī raudrī vārāhī nārasiṃhikā || kaumārī cāpi māheṃdrī cāmuṃḍā caiva caṃḍikā | 33 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ bālakaṃ ramyaṃ vikaṭāpreṣitaṃ tataḥ || papracchuryugapaḍḍiṃbhaṃ kaste tātaḥ prasūśca kaḥ|| 34 || mātṛbhiśceti puṣṭaḥ sa yadā kiṃcinna vakti ca || tadā tadyoginīcakraṃ prāha mātṛgaṇastviti || 35 || rājyayogyo bhavatyeṣa mahālakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ || punastatraiva netavyo yoginyastvavilaṃbitam || 36 || paṃcamudrā mahādevī tiṣṭhate yatra kāmyadā | yasyāḥ saṃsevanānnṛṇāṃ nirvāṇaśrīradūrataḥ || 37 || sarvatraśubhajanminyāṃ kāśyāṃ muktiḥ padepade || tathāpi saviśeṣaṃ hi tatpīṭhaṃ sarvasiddhikṛt || 38 || tatpīṭhasevanādasya ṣoḍaśābdākṛteḥ śiśoḥ || siddhirbhavitrī paramā viśveśānugrahātparāt || || 39 || evaṃ mātṛgaṇāśīrbhiryoginībhiḥ kṣaṇena hi || prāpito mātṛvākyena paṃcamudrāṃkitaṃ punaḥ || 4.2.83.40 || saṃprāpya tanmahāpīṭhaṃ svargalokādihāgataḥ || ānaṃdakānane divyaṃ tatāpa vipulaṃ tapaḥ || 41 || tapasātīva tīvreṇa niścaleṃdriyacetasaḥ || tasya rājakumārasya prasannobhūdumādhavaḥ| ||42|| āvirbabhūva purato liṃgarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ || provāca ca prasannosmi varaṃ brūhi nṛpāṃgaja ||43|| || skaṃda uvāca || || sarvajyotirmayaṃ liṃgaṃ purato vīkṣya vāṅmayam || saptapātālamudbhidya sthitaṃ bṛhadanugrahāta || 44 || praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau parituṣṭāva dhūrjaṭim || sūktairjanmāṃtarābhyastaiḥ suhṛṣṭo rudradevataiḥ || 45 || tataḥ prasanno bhagavāndevadevo maheśvaraḥ || saṃtuṣṭastapasā tasya provāca vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ|| 46 || || devadeva uvāca || || varaṃ varaya saṃtapta tapasā kleśitaṃ vapuḥ || tvayedaṃ bālavapuṣā vaśīkṛtaṃ mano mama || 47 || śivoktaṃ ca samākarṇya varadānaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || varaṃ ca prārthayāṃcakre parihṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || 48 || || kumāra uvāca || || devadevamahādeva yadi deyo varo mama || tadatra bhavatā stheyaṃ bhavatāpahṛtā sadā || 49 || asmim̐lliṃge sthitaḥ śaṃbho kuru bhaktasamīhitam || vinā mudrādikaraṇaṃ maṃtreṇāpi vinā vibho || 4.2.83.50 || diśa siddhiṃ parāmatra darśanātsparśanānnateḥ || asya liṃgasya ye bhaktā manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ ||51 || sadaivānugrahasteṣu kartavyo vara eṣa me || iti tadvratamākarṇya liṃgarūpovadatprabhuḥ ||52|| evamastu yaduktaṃ te vīravaiṣṇava sūnunā || janeturviṣṇubhaktācca rājño'mitrajjito bhavān || 53 || viṣṇvaṃśa evamutpanno mama bhaktiparāṃgaja || vīravīreśvaraṃ nāma liṃgametattvadākhyayā || 54 || kāśyāṃ dāsyatyabhīṣṭāni bhaktānāṃ ciṃtitānyaho || asmim̐lliṃge sadā vīra sthāsyāmyadyadināvadhi || 55 || dāsyāmi ca parāṃ siddhimāśritebhyo na saṃśayaḥ || paraṃ na mahimānaṃ me kalau kaścicca vetsyati || 56 || yastu vetsyati bhāgyena sa parāṃ siddhimāpsyati || atra japtaṃ hutaṃ dattaṃ stutamarcitameva vā || 57 || jīrṇoddhārādikaraṇamakṣayyaphalahetukam || tvaṃ tu rājyaṃ paraṃ prāpya sarvabhūpāladurlabham|| 58 || bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulānaṃte siddhimavāpsyasi || purī vārāṇasī ramyā sarvasmiñjagatītale ||59|| puṇyastatrāpi saṃbhedaḥ saritorasi gaṃgayoḥ || tato'pi ca hayagrīvaṃ tīrthaṃ caivāti puṇyadam || 4.2.83.60 || yatra viṣṇurhayagrīvo bhaktaciṃtitamarpayet || hayagrīvācca vai tīrthādgajatīrthaṃ viśiṣyate || 61 || yatra vai snānamātreṇa gajadānaphalaṃ labhet || kokāvarāhatīrthaṃ ca puṇyadaṃ gajatīrthataḥ || 62 || kokāvarāhamabhyarcya tatra no janmabhāgjanaḥ || api kokāvarāhācca dilīpeśvarasannidhau || 63 || dilīpatīrthaṃ suśreṣṭhaṃ sadyaḥ pāpaharaṃ param || tataḥ sagaratīrthaṃ ca sagareśa samīpataḥ || 64 || yatra majjannaro majjenna bhūyo duḥkhasāgare || saptasāgaratīrthaṃ ca śubhaṃ sagaratīrthataḥ || 65 || saptābdhisnānajaṃ puṇyaṃ yatra snātvā naro labhet || mahodadhīti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ saptābdhitīrthataḥ || 66 || sakṛdyatrāpluto dhīmāndahedaghamahodadhim || cauratīrthaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ kapileśvara sannidhau || 67 || pāpaṃ suvarṇacauryādi yatra snātvā kṣayaṃ vrajet || haṃsatīrtha tatopīḍyaṃ kedāreśvara sannidhau || 68 || haṃsa svarūpī yatrāhaṃ nayāmi brahmadehinaḥ || 69 || tatastribhuvanākhyasya keśavasyāti puṇyadam || tīrthaṃ yatrāplutā martyā martyalokaṃ viśaṃti na || 4.2.83.70 || govyāghre śvara tīrthaṃ ca tatopyadhikameva hi || svabhāvavairamutsṛjya yatrobhau siddhimāpatuḥ || 71 || tatopi hi varaṃ vīra tīrthaṃ māṃdhātusaṃjñitam || cakravartipadaṃ yatra prāptaṃ tena mahībhujā || 72 || tatopi mucukuṃdākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ cātīva puṇyadam || yatra snāto naro jātu ripubhirnābhibhūyate ||73|| pṛthu tīrthaṃ tatopyuccaiḥ śreyasāṃ sādhanaṃ param || pṛthvīśvaraṃ yatra dṛṣṭvā naraḥ pṛthvīpatirbhavet || 74 || tataḥ paraśurāmasya tīrthaṃ cātīva siddhidam || yatra kṣatravadhātpāpājjāmadagnyo vimuktavān | |75| adyāpi kṣatravadhajaṃ pāpaṃ tatra praṇaśyati || ekena snānamātreṇa jñānājñānakṛtena ca || 76 || tatopi śreyasāṃ kartṛ tīrthaṃ kṛṣṇāgrajasya hi || yatra sūtavadhātpāpādbaladevo vimuktavān || 77 || divodāsasya vai tīrthaṃ tatra rājño'timedhasaḥ || tatra snāto naro jātu na jñānāccyavateṃ'tataḥ || 78 || tatopi hi mahātīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || yatra bhāgīrathī sākṣānmūrtirūpeṇa tiṣṭhati || 79 || snātvā bhāgīrathī tīrthe kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ vidhānavit || dattvā dānaṃ ca pātrebhyo na bhūyo garbhabhāgbhavet || 4.2.83.80 || harapāpaṃ ca bho vīra tīrthaṃ bhāgīrathītaṭe || tatra snātvā kṣayaṃ yāṃti mahāpāpakulānyapi ||81|| yo niṣpāpeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatra paśyati mānavaḥ || niṣpāpo jāyate vīra sa talliṃgekṣaṇātkṣaṇāt ||82|| daśāśvamedhatīrthaṃ ca tatopi pravaraṃ matam || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ yatra snātvā phalaṃ labhet |83|| tatopi śubhadaṃ vīra baṃdītīrthaṃ pracakṣate || yatra snāto naro mucyedapi saṃsārabaṃdhanāt || 84 || hiraṇyākṣeṇa daityena bahuśo devatāḥ purā || baṃdīkṛtā nigaḍitā stuṣṭuvurjagadaṃbikām || 85 || tato viśṛṃkhalībhūtairvaṃditā yajjagajjaniḥ || tadā prabhṛti baṃdīti gīyatedyāpi mānavaiḥ || 86 || baṃdītīrthastu tatraiva mahānigaḍakhaṃḍanam || tatra snāto vimucyeta sarvasmātkarmapāśataḥ || 87 || baṃdītīrthaṃ mahāśreṣṭhaṃ kāśipuryāṃ viśāṃpate || tatra snāto naro yāyādvimuktiṃ devyanugrahāt || 88 || tatopi hi śreṣṭhataraṃ prayāgamiti viśrutam || prayāgamādhavo yatra sarvayāgaphalapradaḥ || 89 || kṣoṇīvarāhatīrthaṃ ca tatopi śubhadaṃ param || tatra snāto naro jātu tiryagyoniṃ na gacchati || 4.2.83.90 || tataḥ kāleśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ vīraśreṣṭhataraṃ param || kalikālau na bādhete yatra snātaṃ narottamam ||91 || aśokatīrthaṃ tatraiva tatopyatitarāṃ śubham || yatra snāto naro jātu nāpatecchokasāgare || 92 || tatoti nirmalataraṃ śakratīrthaṃ nṛpāṃgaja || śukradvārā na jāyeta yatra snāto narottamaḥ ||93|| tato'pi puṇyadaṃ rājanbhavānītīrthamuttamam || yatra snātvā bhavānīśau dṛṣṭvā naiva punarbhavet || 94 || prabhāsatīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ tatopi śubhadaṃ nṛṇām || someśvarasya puratastatra snāto na garbhabhāk || 95 || tato garuḍatīrthaṃ ca saṃsāraviṣanāśanam || garuḍeśaṃ samabhyarcya tatra snātvā na śocati || 96 || brahmatīrthaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ vīrabrahmeśvarātpuraḥ || brahmavidyāmavāpnoti tatra snānena mānavaḥ || 97 || tato vṛddhārkatīrthaṃ ca vidhitīrthaṃ tataḥ param || tatrāpluto naro yāti ravilokaṃ sunirmalam || 98 || tato nṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ
