ca mahābhayanivāraṇam || kālādapi kutastatra snātvā paribibheti ca || 99 || tatopi puṇyadaṃ nṛṇāṃ tīrthaṃ citraratheśvaram || yatra snātvā ca dattvā ca citraguptaṃ na paśyati ||4.2.83.100|| dharmatīrthaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ dharmeśa purataḥ sthitam || tatra śrāddhadikaṃ kṛtvā pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet ||101|| viśālatīrthaṃ vimalaṃ viśālaphaladaṃ tataḥ || tatra snātvā viśālākṣī dṛṣṭvā garbhena jāyate || 102 || jarāsaṃdheśa tīrthaṃ ca jarāsaṃdheśasannidhau || saṃsārajvarapīḍābhistatra snāto na muhyati || 103 || tato'pi lalitātīrthaṃ mahāsaubhāgyavardhanam || snātvārcayitvā lalitāṃ na daridro na duḥkhabhāk || 104 || tato gautamatīrthaṃ ca sarvapāpaviśodhanam || snātvā piṃḍānvinirvāpya yatra śocati na kvacit || 105 || gaṃgākeśavatīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ cāgastya saṃjñakam || tatastu yoginītīrthaṃ trisaṃdhyākhyaṃ tataḥ param || 106 || tatastu nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ tata āruṃdhateyakam || vāsiṣṭhaṃ ca tatastīrthaṃ mārkaṃṇḍeyamanuttamam || 107 || jñeyānyetāni tīrthāni puṇyadānyuttarottarama || khurakartari saṃjñaṃ ca tatastīrthamanuttamam || 108 || tatra śrāddhādikaraṇānnaromucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ || tato bhagīrathaṃ tīrthaṃ rājarṣeratipuṇyadam|| 109 || tatrālpamapi yacchedyatkalpāṃtepyakṣayaṃ hi tat || etebhyopi hi tīrthebhyo liṃgakoṭitrayādapi ||4.2.83.110 || vīravīreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mahāśreṣṭhaṃ bhaviṣyati || vīratīrthe naraḥ snātvā vīreśaṃ paripūjya ca || 111 || tīrtheṣveteṣu sarveṣu snāto bhavati nānyathā || yastu vīreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ naktamabhyarcayipyati || tena trikoṭisaṃkhyāni liṃgānīhārcitāni vai || 112 || yastu kāmayate lakṣmīṃ muktidāṃ bhuktidāmapi || tena vīreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsevyamatiyatnataḥ || 113 || vidhāyaikaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ naro vīreśamarcayan || bhūtāyāṃ naiva gṛhṇāti śarīraṃ pāṃcabhautikam || 114 || idaṃ liṃgaṃ sadābhyarcyaṃ siddhaiḥ saṃsiddhikāmukaiḥ || aihikāmuṣmikānyasmātsarvānkāmānsamarthayet || 115 || paṃcāmṛtena snapanaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ || palepale phalaṃ tasya vīreśe ghaṭakoṭijam || 116 || yadanyatra phalaṃ liṃge koṭipuṣpa pradānataḥ || tadekenaiva puṣpeṇa vīreśe nātra saṃśayaḥ || 117 || ekāmapyāhutiṃ dattvā vīreśvarasamīpataḥ || koṭihomaphalaṃ samyaṅnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 118 || sikthesikthe ca naivaidyai koṭisikthaphalaṃ bhavet || atyalpamapi vīreśe kṛtamakṣayatāṃ vrajet || 119 || apyekaṃ yo mahārudraṃ japedvīreśa sannidhau || jāpayedvā bhavettasya koṭirudraphalaṃ dhruvam || 4.2.83.120 || vratotsargādi vīreśe yatkṛtaṃ vratibhirnṛbhiḥ || tatkoṭiguṇasaṃkhyākaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 121 || kṛtā aṣṭau namaskārā yena vīreśvarāgrataḥ || aṣṭakoṭi namaskāraphalaṃ tasya na saṃśayaḥ || 122 || sarvāsāṃ saṃpadāṃ sthānamidaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaviṣyati || vīraśveraṃ na saṃdeho vīra me varadānataḥ || 123 || jñānamutpatsyate puṃsāṃ tārakākhyaṃ mamājñayā || jīvatāmeva tatsevyametalliṃgaṃ śubhārthibhiḥ || 124 || etacchrutvā punaḥ prāha vīro mitrajitaḥ sutaḥ || praṇamya devadeveśaṃ paripūrṇamanorathaḥ || 125 || tīrthānyetāni deveśa yānyuktāni mamāgrataḥ || kṛpayā punarapyeva tadanyāni vada prabho || 126 || ādikeśavamārabhya tattīrthācca bhagīrathāt || yeṣāṃ śravaṇamātreṇa niṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ || 127 || iti śrutvā maheśāno mahīpa tanayoditam || punastīrthāni gaṃgāyāṃ vaktuṃ samupacakrame || 128 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍe uttarārdhe vīreśvarāvirbhāvonāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 ||
<4.2.84>
|| skaṃda uvāca || ākarṇaya kṣoṇisura yathā sthāṇuracīkarat || gaṃgāvaraṇayoḥ puṇyātsaṃbhedāttīrthabhūmikām|| 1 || saṃgame tatra niṣṇātaḥ saṃgameśaṃ samarcya ca || naro na jātu jananī garbhasaṃgamavāpnuyāt || 2 || tatra pādodakaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra devena śārṅgiṇā || ādau pādau kṣalitau tu maṃdarāccāgatena yat || 3 || vipṇupādodake tīrthe vārikāryaṃ karoti yaḥ || vyatīpātena niyataṃ bhūyaḥ sāṃsārikī gatiḥ ||4|| kṛtapādodaka snānaḥ kṛtakeśavapūjanaḥ || vītasaṃsāravasatiḥ kāśyāmāsīnnarottamaḥ || 5 || kāśyāṃ sā bhūmiruddiṣṭā śvetadvīpa iti dvijaiḥ || tatra puṇyārjanaṃ kṛtvā śvetadvīpādhipo bhavet || 6 || tataḥ pādodakāttīrthāttīrthaṃ kṣīrābdhisaṃjñakam || tatrārjita mahāpuṇyo vasetkṣīrābdhirodhasi || 7 || kṣīrodāddakṣiṇebhāge tīrthaṃ śaṃkhākhyanuttamam || tatra snāto bhavennūnaṃ nāśaṃkhādinidheḥ patiḥ || 8 || arvākca śaṃkhatīrthādvai cakratīrthamanuttamam || saṃsāracakre na patettattīrthajalamajjanāt || 9|| gadātīrthaṃ tadagre tu saṃsāragadanāśanam || tatra śrāddhādikaraṇātpaśyeddevaṃ gadādharam || 4.2.84.10 || padmākṛtpadmatīrthaṃ ca tadagre pitṛtṛptikṛt || tatra snānādikaraṇātprāpnuyādaghasaṃkṣayam || 11 || tatastīrthaṃ mahālakṣmyā mahāpuṇyaphalapradam || tatrābhyarcya mahālakṣmīṃ nirvāṇakamalāṃ labhet || 12 || tato gārutmataṃ tīrthaṃ saṃsāragaranāśanam || kṛtodakakriyastatra vaikuṃṭhe vasatiṃ labhet || 13 || tato nāradatīrthaṃ ca brahmavidyaikakāraṇam || tatra snānena muktaḥ syāddṛṣṭvā nāradakeśavam || 19| || prahlādatīrthaṃ tadyāmye mahābhaktiphalapradam || tatra vai snānamātreṇa viṣṇoḥ priyataro bhavet || 15 || aṃbarīṣaṃ tatastīrthaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || tatra vai śubhakarmāṇo janā no garbhabhājanam || || 16 || ādityakeśavaṃ nāma tadagre tīrthamuttamam || kṛtābhiṣekastatrāpi labhetsvargābhiṣecanam || 17 || dattātreyasya tatrāsti tīrthaṃ trailokyapāvanam || yogasiddhiṃ labhe tatra snānamātreṇa bhāvataḥ || 18 || tadagre bhārgavaṃ tīrthaṃ mahājñānasamarpakam || tatra snānavidhānena bhavedbhārgava lokabhāk || 19 || tato vāmanatīrthaṃ ca viṣṇusānnidhyahetukam || tatra śrāddhavidhānena mucyate pitṛjādṛṇāt || 4.2.84.20 || naranārāyaṇākhyaṃ hi tatastīrthaṃ śubhapradam || tattīrthamajjanātpuṃsāṃ garbhavāsaḥ sudurlabhaḥ || 21 || yajñavārāhatīrthaṃ ca tato dakṣiṇataḥ śubham || yatra snātasya vai puṃsāṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ dhruvam|| 22 || vidāranārasiṃhākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ tatrāsti pāvanam || yatraikasnānato naśyedagha janmaśatārjitam || 23 || gopīgoviṃdatīrthaṃ ca tato vaiṣṇavalokadam || yasminsnāto naro vidvānna viṃdyādgarbhavedanam || 24 || lakṣmīnṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ ca gopīgoviṃda dakṣiṇe || nirvāṇalakṣmyā yatratyo vriyate tu narottamaḥ || 25 || taddakṣiṇāyāṃ kāṣṭhāyāṃ śeṣatīrthamanuttamam|| mahāpāpaugha śeṣopi na tiṣṭhedyannimajjanāt || || 26 || śaṃkhamādhavatīrthaṃ ca tadyāmyāṃ diśi cottamam || tattīrthasevanānnṛṇāṃ kutaḥ pāpabhayaṃ mahat || 27 || tatopi pāvanataraṃ tīrthaṃ tatkṣaṇasiddhidam || nīlagrīvākhyamatulaṃ tatsnāyī sarvadā śuciḥ || 28 || tatroddālakatīrthaṃ ca sarvāghaugha vināśanam || dadāti mahatīmṛddhiṃ snānamātreṇa tannṛṇām || 29 || tataḥ sāṃkhyākhya tīrthaṃ ca sāṃkhyeśvara samīpataḥ || tattīrthasevanātpuṃsāṃ sāṃkhyayogaḥ prasīdati || 4.2.84.30 || svarlokādyatra saṃlīnaḥ svayaṃ deva umāpatiḥ || ataḥ svarlīnatīrthaṃ ca svarlīneśvara sannidhau || 31 || tatra snānena dānena śraddhayā dvijabhojanaiḥ || japahomārcanaiḥ puṃsāmakṣayaṃ sarvameva hi || 32 || mahiṣāsuratīrthaṃ ca tatsamīpeti pāvanam || yatra taptvā sa daityeṃdro vijigye sakalānsurān || 33 || tattīrthasevakodyāpi nāribhiḥ paribhūyate || na pātakairmahadbhiśca prārthitaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet || 34 || bāṇatīrthaṃ ca tasyārāttatsahasrabhujapradam || tatra snāto naro bhaktiṃ prāpnuyācchāṃbhavīṃ sthirām || 35 || gopratāreśvaraṃ nāma tadagre tīrthamuttamam || aputropi taredyatra snāto vaitaraṇīṃ sukham || 36 || tīrthaṃ hiraṇyagarbhākhyaṃ tadyāmye sarvapāpahṛt|| tatra snāto hiraṇyena mucyate na kadācana ||37|| tataḥ praṇavatīrthaṃ ca sarvatīrthottamottamam || jīvanmukto bhavettatra snānamātreṇa mānavaḥ || 38 || tataḥ piśaṃgilā tīrthaṃ darśanādapi pāpahṛt || mune mamādhiṣṭhānaṃ vai tadagaste'ti siddhidam || 39 || snātvā piśaṃgilā tīrthe dattvā dānaṃ ca kiṃcana || kiṃ śocati kṛtātpāpādanyatrāpi mṛto yadi || 4.2.84.40 || yo vai piśaṃgilā tīrthe snātvā māmarcayiṣyati || bhaviṣyati sa me mittraṃ mitratejaḥ samaprabham || 41 || tatastraiviṣṭapīdṛṣṭi nirmalīkṛta puṣkalam|| tīrthaṃ pilipilākhyaṃ vai manomalavināśanam || 42 || || tatra śrāddhādikaraṇāddīnānātha pratarpaṇāt || mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti mānavotīva niścalām || 43 || tato nāgeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ mahāghapariśodhanam || tattīrthamajjanādeva bhavetsarvāghasaṃkṣayaḥ || 44 || taddakṣiṇe mahāpuṇyaṃ karṇādityākhyamuttamam || tīrthaṃ yatrāpluto martyo bhāskarīṃ śriyamāvahet || 45 || tato bhairavatīrthaṃ ca mahāghaughakṣayapradam || caturarthodayakaraṃ sarvavighnanivāraṇam || 46 || bhaumāṣṭamyāṃ tatra naraḥ snātvā saṃtarpayetpitṝn || dṛṣṭvā ca bhairavaṃ kālaṃ kaliṃ kālaṃ ca saṃjayet || 47 || tīrthaṃ kharvanṛsiṃhākhyaṃ tīrthādbharavataḥ puraḥ || tatra snātasya vai puṃsaḥ kutoghajanitaṃ bhayam || 48 || mṛkaṃḍasya munestīrthaṃ tadyāmyāmatinirmalama || tatra snānena martyānāṃ nāpāyamaraṇaṃ kvacit || 49 || tataḥ paṃcanadākhyaṃ vai sarvatīrthaniṣevitam || tīrthaṃ yatra naraḥ snātvā na saṃsārī punarbhavet || 4.2.84.50 || brahmāṃḍodaravartīni yāni tīrthāni sarvataḥ || ūrje yatra samāyāṃti svāghaugha parinuttaye || 51 || sarvadā yatra sarvāṇi daśamyādidinatrayam || tiṣṭhaṃti tīrthavaryāṇi nijanairmalyahetave || || 52 || bhūriśaḥ sarvatīrthāni madhya kāśi padepade || paraṃ pāṃcanadaḥ kaiścinmahimānāpi kutracit || 53 || apyekaṃ kārtikasyāhastatra vai saphalīkṛtam || japahomārcanādānaiḥ kṛtakṛtyāsta eva hi || 54 || sarvāṇyapi ca tīrthāni yugapattulitānyapi || nādhijanmuḥ paṃcanadyāḥ kalāyā api tulyatām || 55 || snātvā pāṃcanade tīrthe dṛṣṭvā vai biṃdumādhavam || na jātu jāyate dhīmāñjananī jaṭharājire || 56 || tato jñānahadaṃ tīrthaṃ jaḍānāmapi jāḍyahṛt || tatra snāto naro jātu jñānabhraṃśaṃ na cāpnuyāt || 57 || tatra jñānahrade snātvā dṛṣṭvā jñāneśvaraṃ naraḥ || jñānaṃ tadadhigacchedvai yena no bādhyate punaḥ || 58 || tatosti maṃgalaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvāmaṃgalanāśanam || tatrāvagāhanaṃ kṛtvā bhavenmaṃgalabhājanam || 59 || amaṃgalāni naśyeyurbhaveyurmaṃgalāni ca || snāturvai maṃgale tīrthe namaskartuśca maṃgalam || || 4.2.84.60 || mayūkhamālinastīrthaṃ tadagre malanāśanam || tatrāpluto gabhastīśaṃ vilokya vimalo bhavet || 61 || makhatīrthaṃ tu tatraiva makhaiśvara samīpataḥ || makhajaṃ puṇyamāpnoti tatra snāto narottamaḥ || 62 || tatpārśve biṃdutīrthaṃ ca paramajñānakāraṇam || tatra śrāddhādikaṃ kṛtvā labhetsukṛtamuttamam || 63 || pippalādasya ca munestīrthaṃ tadyāmyadiksthitam || snātvā śanerdine tatra dṛṣṭvāvai pippaleśvaram || 64 || pippalaṃ tatra sevitvā aśvattha iti maṃtrataḥ || śanipīḍāṃ na labhate duḥsvapnaṃ cāpi nāśayet || 65 || tatastāmravarāhākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ caivātipāvanam || yatra snānena dānena na majjedaghasāgare || 66 || tadagre kālagaṃgā ca kalikalmaṣanāśinī || tasyāṃ snātvā naro dhīmāṃstatkṣaṇānniragho bhavet ||67|| iṃdradyumnaṃ mahātīrthamiṃdradyumneśvarāgrataḥ || toyakṛtyaṃ tatra kṛtvā lokamaiṃdramavāpnuyāta|| 68|| tatastu rāmatīrthaṃ ca vīrarāmeśvarāgrataḥ|| tattīrthasnānamātreṇa vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 69 || tata aikṣvākavaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvāghaughavināśanam || tatra snānena pūtātmā jāyate manujottamaḥ || 4.2.84.70 || maruttatīrthaṃ tatprāṃte marutteśvarasannidho || tatra snātvā tamarcyeśaṃ mahadaiśvaryamāpnuyāt || 71 || maitrāvaruṇatīrthaṃ ca tataḥ pātakanāśanam || tatra piṃḍapradānena pitṝṇāṃ bhavati priyaḥ || 72 || tatognitīrthavimalamagnīśa purato mahat || agnilokamavāpnoti tattīrthaparimajjanāt || 73 || aṃgāratīrthaṃ tatraiva aṃgāreśvarasannidhau || tatrāṃgāra caturthyāṃ nu snātvā niṣpāpatāmiyāt || 74 || tato vai kalitīrthaṃ ca kalaśeśvarasannidhau || snātvā talliṃgamabhyarcya kalikālānna bibhyati ||75|| caṃdratīrthaṃ ca tatraiva caṃdreśvarasamīpataḥ || tatra snātvārcya caṃdreśaṃ caṃdralokamavāpnuyāt || 76 || tadagre vīratīrthaṃ ca vīreśvara samīpataḥ || yaduktaṃ prāktavapurastīrthānāmuttamaṃ param || 77 || vighneśatīrthaṃ ca tataḥ sarvavighnavighātakṛt || jātucittatra saṃsnāto na vighnairabhibhūyate || 78 || hariścaṃdrasya rājarṣastatastīrthamanuttamam || yatra snāto naro jātu na satyāccayavate kacit || 79 || hariścaṃdrasya tīrthe tu yacchreyaḥ samupārjitam || tadakṣayaphalaṃ vīra iha loke paratra ca || 4.2.84.80 || tataḥ parvatatīrthaṃ ca parvateśa samīpataḥ || sarvaparvaphalaṃ tasya snātvā parvaṇyaparvaṇi ||81|| kaṃbalāśvataraṃ tīrthaṃ tatra sarvaviṣāpaham || tatra snāto bhavenmartyo gītavidyāviśāradaḥ || 82 || tataḥ sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ sarvavidyopapādakam || tiṣṭheyuḥ pitarastatra saha devarṣimānavaiḥ || 83 || umātīrthaṃ tu tatraiva sarvaśaktisamanvitam || aumeyalokaprāptyai syātsnānamātreṇa niścitam || 84 || tatastrilokī vikhyātaṃ trilokyuddharaṇakṣamam || tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhataraṃ vīra yadākhyā maṇikarṇikā || 85 || cakrapuṣkariṇītīrthaṃ tadādau viṣṇunā kṛtam || tadākhyā karṇanādeva sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 86 || svargaukasastrisaṃdhyaṃ vai japaṃti maṇikarṇikām || yannāmagrahaṇaṃ puṃsāṃ śreyasaṃ paramāya hi || 87 || yaiḥ śrutā yaiḥ smṛtā vīra yairdṛṣṭā maṇikarṇikā || ta eva kṛtino loke kṛtakṛtyāsta eva hi || 88 || triloke ye japaṃtīha mānavā maṇikarṇikām || japāmi tānahaṃ vīra trikālaṃ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ || 89 || iṣṭaṃ tena mahāyajñaiḥ sahasraśatadakṣiṇaiḥ || paṃcākṣarī mahāvidyā yenoktā maṇikarṇikā || 4.2.84.90 || mahādānāni dattāni tena vai puṇyakarmaṇā || yenāhamarcito vīra saṃprāpya maṇikarṇikām || 91 || maṇikarṇyaṃbubhiryena tarpitāḥ prapitāmahāḥ || tena śrāddhāni dattāni gayāyāṃ madhupāyasaiḥ || 92 || maṇikarṇījalaṃ yena saṃpītaṃ śuddhabuddhinā || kiṃ tasya somapānaistaiḥ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇaiḥ || 93 || te snātāḥ sarvatīrtheṣu mahāparvasubhūriśaḥ || tathā ca sarvāvabhṛthairyaiḥ snātā maṇikarṇikā || || 94 || taiḥ surāḥ pūjitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇumukhā makhaiḥ || yaiḥ svarṇakusumairatnairarcitā maṇikarṇikā ||95|| ahaṃ tenomayā sārdhaṃ dīkṣāṃ saṃprāpya śāṃbhavīm || arcitaḥ pratyahaṃ yena pūjitā ṇikarṇikā || 96 || tapāṃsi tena taptāni śīrṇaparṇādinā ciram || sevitā śraddhayā yena śrīmatī maṇikarṇikā || 97 || dattvā dānāni bhūrīṇi makhāniṣṭvā tu bhūriśaḥ || ciraṃ taptvāpyaraṇyeṣu svargaiśvaryānmahīṃ punaḥ || 98 || vipuletra mahīpṛṣṭhe paṃcakrośyāṃ manoharā || saṃśritā maṇikarṇīyaiste yātāścānivartakāḥ || 99 || dānānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca kratūnāṃ tapasāmapi || idameva phalaṃ manye yadāpyā maṇikarṇikā || 4.2.84.100 || mokṣalakṣmīriyaṃ sākṣācchrīmatī maṇikarṇikā || prāyosyā mahimānaṃ vai navedmyahamapi sphuṭam || 101 || avācyāṃ maṇikarṇyāśca tīrthaṃ pāśupataṃ param || tīrthaṃ tu rudravāsākhyaṃ viśvatīrthamataḥ param || 102 || muktitīrthaṃ tato ramyamavimuktamathottamam || tīrthaṃ ca tārakaṃ skāṃdaṃ ḍhuṃḍhestīrthaṃ tatopi ca || 103 || bhavāneyamathaiśānaṃ jñānatīrthamathottamam || naṃditīrthaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ tataḥ || 104 || nābhitīrthamidaṃ caiva brahmanālamataḥ param || tato bhāgīrathaṃ tīrthaṃ yattavāgre purākathi ||105|| tīrthātyuttaravāhinyāṃ svardhunyāṃ kāśisannidhau || saṃtyanekāni puṇyāni mayoktānyalpaśaḥ punaḥ || 106 || tatrāpi nitarāṃ śreṣṭhā paṃcatīrthī(?) nṛpāṃgaja || yasyāṃ stātvā naro bhūyo garbhavāsaṃ na saṃsmaret || 107 || prathamaṃ cāsisaṃbhedaṃ tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ param|| tato daśāśvamedhākhyaṃ sarvatīrthaniṣevitam || 108 || tataḥ pādodakaṃ tīrthamādikeśavasannidhau || tataḥ paṃcanadaṃ puṇyaṃ snānamātrādaghaughahṛt || 109 || eteṣāmapi tīrthānāṃ caturṇāmapi sattama || paṃcamaṃ maṇikarṇyākhyaṃ manāveyavaśuddhidam ||4.2.84.110|| ahaṃ snāmyatra satatamumayā saha parvasu || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ saheṃdrādisurarṣibhiḥ || 111 || ata evātra gīyeta gātheyaṃ śrutisaṃmatā|| nāgalokakṛtāvāsaiḥ svargaukobhiśca saṃtatam || 112 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || maṇikarṇī samaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti brahmāṃḍagolake || 113 || paṃcatīrthyāṃ naraḥ snātvā na dehaṃ pāṃcabhautikam || gṛhṇāti jātucitkāśyāṃ paṃcāsyovātha jāyate || 114 || iti dattvā varāndevo vīrasyāṃtardadhe haraḥ || sa ca vīropi vīreśaṃ prārcya prāptaḥ samīhitam || 115 || || skaṃda uvāca|| || tīrthādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyamagaste yo niśāmayet || tasyāghasaṃkṣayaṃ yāyādapi janmaśatārjitam || 116 || iti vīreśvarākhyānaṃ tīrthākhyānaprasaṃgataḥ || kathitaṃ te purāgaste kāmeśaṃ kathayāmyataḥ ||117|| || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe vīreśvarākhyānaṃ nāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 84 || |||||
<4.2.85>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || jagajjananyāḥ pārvatyāḥ purogaste purāriṇā || yathākhyāyi kathā puṇyā tathā te kathayāmyaham || 1 || purā mahīmimāṃ sarvāṃ sasamudrādrikānanām || sasaritkāṃ sārṇavāṃ ca sagrāmapurapattanām || 2 || paribhramya mahātejā mahāmarṣo mahātapāḥ || durvāsāḥ saṃpariprāptaḥ śaṃbhorānaṃdakānanam || 3 || vilokyākrīḍamakhilaṃ bahuprāsādamaṃḍitam|| bahukuṃḍataḍāgaṃ ca śaṃbhostoṣamupāgamat||| padepade munīnāṃ ca jitakāla mahābhiyām || dṛṣṭoṭajāni ramyāṇi durvāsā vismitobhavat|| || 5 || sarvartukusumānvṛkṣānsucchāyasnigdhapallavān || saphalānsulatāśliṣṭāndṛṣṭvā prītimagānmuniḥ || 6 || durvāsāścātihṛṣṭobhūddṛṣṭvā pāśupatottamān || bhūtibhūṣitasarvāṃgāñjaṭājaṭitamaulikān || 7 || kaupīnamātra vasanānsmarāri dhyāna tatparān || kakṣīkṛtamahālābūnhuḍutkārajitāṃbudān || 8 || karaṃḍadaṃḍapānīya pātramātraparigrahān || kvacittridaṃḍino dṛṣṭvā niḥsaṃgā niṣparigrahān || 9 || kālādapi nirātaṃkānviśveśaśaraṇaṃ gatān || kvacidvedarahasyajñānābālyabrahmacāriṇaḥ || 4.2.85.10 || nityaṃ bhāgīrathīsnānaparipiṃgalamūrdhajān || 5|| vilokya kāśyāṃ durvāsā brāhmaṇānmumudetarām || 11 || paśuṣvapi ca yā tuṣṭirmṛgeṣvapi ca yā dyutiḥ || tiryakṣvapi ca yā hṛṣṭiḥ kāśyāṃ nānyatra sā sphuṭam || 12 || idaṃ suśreyaso vyuṣṭiḥ kvāmareṣu triviṣṭape || yatratyeṣvapi tiryakṣu paramānaṃdavardhinī|| 13 || varametepi paśava ānaṃdavanacāriṇaḥ || sadānaṃdāḥ punardevānanaṃdanavanāśritāḥ || 14 || varaṃ kāśīpurīvāsī mlecchopi hi śubhāyatiḥ || nānyatratyo dīkṣitopi sa hi mukterabhājanam|| 15 || vaiśveśvarī purī caiṣā yathā me cittahāriṇī || sarvāpi na tathā kṣoṇī na svargo naiva nāgabhūḥ||16|| sthairyaṃ babaṃdha na kvāpi bhramato me manogatiḥ || sarvasminnapi bhūbhāge yathā sthairyamagādiha || 17 || ramyā purī bhavedeṣā brahmāṃḍādakhilādapi || pariṣṭutyeti durvāsāścetovṛttimavāpa ha || 18 || tapyamānopi hi tapaḥ suciraṃ sa mahātapāḥ|| yadā nāpa phalaṃ kiṃciccukopa ca tadā bhṛśam || 19 || dhikca māṃ tāpasaṃ duṣṭaṃ dhikca me duścaraṃ tapaḥ || dhikca kṣetramidaṃ śaṃbhoḥ sarveṣāṃ ca pratārakam || 4.2.85.20 || yathā na muktiratra syātkasyāpi karavai tathā || iti śaptuṃ yadodyuktaḥ saṃjahāsa tadā śivaḥ ||21|| tatra liṃgamabhūdekaṃ khyātaṃ prahasiteśvaram || talliṃgadarśanātpuṃsāmānaṃdaḥ syātpadepade || 22 || uvāca vismayāviṣṭo manasyeva maheśitā || īdṛśebhyastapasvibhyo namostviti punaḥpunaḥ ||23|| yatraiva hi tapasyaṃti yatraiva vihitāśramāḥ || labdhapratiṣṭhā yatraiva tatraivāmarṣiṇo dvijāḥ||24|| manākciṃtitamātraṃ tu cellabhaṃte na tāpasāḥ || krudhā tadaiva jīyaṃte hāriṇyā tapasāṃ śriyaḥ || 25 || tathāpi tāpasā mānyāḥ svaśreyovṛddhikāṃkṣibhiḥ || akrodhanāḥ krodhanā vā kā ciṃtā hi tapasvinām || 26 || iti yāvanmaheśāno manasyeva viciṃtayet || tāvattatkrodhajo vahnirvyānaśe vyomamaṃḍalam || 27 || tatkodhānaladhūmoghairvyāpitaṃ yannabhoṃgaṇam || taddadhāti nabhodyāpi nīlimānaṃ mahattaram || 28 || tato gaṇāḥ parikṣubdhāḥ pralayārṇava nīravat || āḥ kimetatkimetadvai bhāṣamāṇāḥ parasparam || 29 || garjaṃtastarjayaṃtaśca prodyatā yudhapāṇayaḥ || pramathāḥ paritasthuste parito dhāma śāṃbhavam ||4.2.85.30|| ko yamaḥ kothavā kālaḥ ko mṛtyuḥ kastathāṃtakaḥ|| ko vā vidhātā ke lekhāḥ kuddheṣvasmāsu kaḥ paraḥ || 31 || agniṃ pibāmo jalavaccūrṇīkurmokhilāngirīn || saptāpi cārṇavāṃstūrṇaṃ karavāma marusthalīm || 32 || pātālaṃ cānayāmordhvamadho dadhmothavā divam || ekameva hi vā grāsaṃ gaganaṃ karavāmahe || 33 || brahmāṃḍabhāṃḍamathavā sphoṭayāmaḥ kṣaṇena hi || āsphālayāmo vānyonyaṃ kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ ca tālavat|| 34 || grasāmo vātha bhuvanaṃ muktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || yatra muktā bhavaṃtyeva mṛtamātreṇa jaṃtavaḥ || 35 || kuto'yaṃ dhūmasaṃbhāro jvālāvalyaḥ kutastvamūḥ || ko vā mṛtyuṃjayaṃ rudraṃ no vidyānmadamohitaḥ || 36 || iti pāriṣadāḥ śaṃbhormahābhaya bhayapradāḥ || jalpaṃtaḥ kalpayāmāsuḥ prākāraṃ gaganaspṛśam||37|| śakalīkṛtya bahuśaḥ śilāvatpralayānalam || naṃdī ca naṃdiṣeṇaśca somanaṃdī mahodaraḥ || || 38 || mahāhanurmahāgrīvo mahākālo jitāṃtakaḥ || mṛtyuprakaṃpano bhīmo ghaṃṭākarṇo mahābalaḥ ||39|| kṣobhaṇo drāvaṇo jṛṃbhī pacāsyaḥ paṃcalocanaḥ || dviśirāstriśirāḥ somaḥ paṃcahasto daśānanaḥ || 4.2.85.40 || caṃḍo bhṛṃgiriṭistuṃḍī pracaṃḍastāṃḍavapriyaḥ || piciṃḍilaḥ sthūlaśirāḥ sthūlakeśo gabhastimān || 41 || kṣemakaḥ kṣemadhanvā ca vīrabhadro raṇapriyaḥ || caṃḍapāṇiḥ śūlapāṇiḥ pāśapāṇiḥ karodaraḥ || 42 || dīrghagrīvotha piṃgākṣaḥ piṃgalaḥ piṃgamūrdhajaḥ || bahunetro laṃbakarṇaḥ kharvaḥ parvatavigrahaḥ ||43|| gokarṇo gajakarṇaśca kokilākhyo gajānanaḥ || ahaṃ vai naigameyaśca vikaṭāsyoṭṭahāsakaḥ ||44|| sīrapāṇiḥ śivārāvo vaiṇiko veṇuvādanaḥ || durādharṣo duḥsahaśca garjano riputarjanaḥ || 45 || ityādayo gaṇeśānāḥ śatakoṭi durāsadāḥ || kāśyāṃ nivārayāmāsurapi prābhaṃjanīṃ gatim || 46 || kṣubdheṣu teṣu vīreṣu cakaṃpe bhuvanatrayam || durvāsasaśca kopāgni jvālābhirvyākulīkṛtam || 47 || tadā viviśatuḥ kāśyāṃ sūryācaṃdramasāvapi || na gaṇairakṛtānujñau tattejaḥ śamitaprabhau || 48 || nivārya pramathānīkamatikṣubdhamumādhavaḥ || madaṃśa eva hi munīrānasūye ya eṣa vai || 49 || atho durvāsase liṃgādāvirāsītkṛpānidhiḥ || mahātejomayaḥ śaṃbhurmuniśāpātpurīmavan ||4.2.85.50|| mābhūcchāpo muneḥ kāśyāṃ nirvāṇapratibaṃdhakaḥ || ityanukrośato devastasya pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ|| 51 || uvāca ca prasannosmi mahākrodhana tāpasa || varayasva varaḥ kaste mayā deyo viśaṃkitaḥ || 52|| tato vilajjitogastya śāpodyatakaro muniḥ || aparāddhaṃ bahu mayā krodhāṃdheneti durdhiyā || 53 || uvāca ceti bahuśo dhiṅmāṃ krodhavaśaṃgatam || trailokyābhayadāṃ kāśīṃ śaptumudyatacetasam || 54 || duḥkhārṇava nimagnānāṃ yātāyāteti khedinām || karmapāśitakaṃṭhānāṃ kāśyekā muktisādhanam|| 55|| sarveṣāṃ jaṃtujātānāṃ jananyekaikkāśikā| mahāmṛtastanyadātrī netrī ca paramaṃ padam || 56 || jananyā saha no kāśī labhedupamitiṃ kvacit|| dhārayejjananī garbhe kāśī garbhādvimocayet ||57 || evaṃbhūtāṃ tu yaḥ kāśīmanyopi hi śapiṣyati || tasyaiva śāpo bhavitā na tu kāśyāḥ kathaṃcana || 58 || iti durvāsaso vākyaṃ śrutvā devastrilocanaḥ || atīva tuṣito jātaḥ kāśīstavana labdhamut ||59|| yaḥ kāśīṃ stauti medhāvī yaḥ kāśīṃ hṛdi dhārayet || tena taptaṃ tapastīvraṃ teneṣṭaṃ kratukoṭibhiḥ ||4.2.85.60|| jihvāgre vartate yasya kāśītyakṣarayugmakam || na tasya garbhavāsaḥ syātkvacideva sumedhasaḥ || 61 || yo maṃtraṃ japati prātaḥ kāśī varṇadvayātmakam|| sa tu lokadvayaṃ jitvā lokātītaṃ vrajetpadam ||62|| ānusūyeya te jñānaṃ kāśīstavana puṇyataḥ || yathedānīṃ samutpannaṃ tathā na tapasaḥ purā || 63 || mune na me priyastadvaddīkṣito mama pūjakaḥ || yādṛkpriyataraḥ satyaṃ kāśīstavana lālasaḥ ||64|| tādṛktuṣṭirna me dānaistādṛktuṣṭirna me makhaiḥ || na tuṣṭistapasā tādṛgyādṛśī kāśisaṃstavaiḥ || 65 || ānaṃdakānanaṃ yena stutametatsucetasā || tenāhaṃ saṃstutaḥ samyaksarvaiḥ sūktaiḥ śrutīritaiḥ || 66 || tava kāmāḥ samṛddhāḥ syurānusūyeya tāpasa || jñānaṃ te paramaṃ bhāvi mahāmohavināśanam || 67 || aparaṃ ca varaṃ brūhi kiṃ dātavyaṃ tavānagha || tvādṛśā eva munayaḥ ślāghanīyā yataḥ satām|| 68 || yasyāstveva hi sāmarthyaṃ tapasaḥ kruddhyatīhasaḥ || kupitopyasamarthastu kiṃ kartā kṣīṇavṛttivat||69|| iti śrutvā pariṣṭutya durvāsāḥ kṛttivāsasam || varaṃ ca prārthayāmāsa parihṛṣṭa tanūruhaḥ || 4.2.85.70 || ||durvāsā uvāca || || devadeva jagannātha karuṇākara śaṃkara || mahāparādhavidhvaṃsinnaṃdhakāre smarāṃtaka || 71 || mṛtyuṃjayograbhūteśa mṛḍānīśa trilocana || yadi prasanno me nātha yadi deyo varo mama || 72 || tadidaṃ kāmadaṃ nāma ligamastviha dhūrjaṭe || idaṃ ca palvalaṃ metra kāmakuṃḍākhyamastu vai || 73 || || devadeva uvāca || || evamastu mahātejo mune paramakopana || yattvayā sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ durvāseśvarasaṃjñitam|| 74 || tadeva kāmakṛnnṛṇāṃ kāmeśvaramihāstviti || yaḥ pradoṣe trayodaśyāṃ śanivāsarasaṃyuji || 75 || saṃsnāsyati naro dhīmānkāmakuṃḍe tvadāspade || tvatsthāpitaṃ ca kāmeśaṃ liṃgaṃ drakṣyati mānavaḥ || 76 || sa vai kāmakṛtāddoṣādyāmīṃ nāpsyati yātanām || bahavopi hi pāpmāno bahubhirjanmabhiḥ kṛtāḥ || 77 || kāmatīrthāṃbu saṃsnānādyāsyaṃti vilayaṃ kṣaṇāt || kāmāḥ samṛddhimāpsyaṃti kāmeśvara niṣevaṇāt || 78 || iti dattvā varāñśaṃbhustalliṃge layamāyayau|| || skaṃda uvāca || talliṃgārādhanātkāmāḥ prāptā durvāsasā bhṛśam || 79 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāśyāṃ kāmeśvaraḥ sadā || pūjanīyaḥ prayatnena mahākāmābhilāṣukaiḥ ||4.2.85.80 || kāmakuṃḍakṛtasnānairmahāpātakaśāṃtaye || idaṃ kāmeśvarākhyānaṃ yaḥ paṭhiṣyati puṇyavān || yaḥ śroṣyati ca medhāvī tau niṣpāpau bhaviṣyataḥ || 81 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe durvāsaso varapradānaṃ nāma paṃcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 85 ||
<4.2.86>
|| pārvatyuvāca || || viśvakarmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ yatkāśyāṃ prathitaṃ param || tasya liṃgasya kathaya devadeva samudbhavam || 1 || || devadeva uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm || viśvakarmeśa liṃgasya prādurbhāvaṃ manoharam||2|| viśvakarmābhavatpūrvaṃ brahmaṇastvaparā tanuḥ || tvaṣṭuḥ prajāpateḥ putro nipuṇaḥ sarvakarmasu ||3|| kṛtopanayanaḥ sotha bālo gurukule vasan || cakāra guruśuśrūṣāṃ bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ||4 || ekadā tadguruḥ prāha prāvṛṭkāle samāgate || kurūṭajaṃ madarthaṃ tvaṃ yathā prāvṛṇna bādhate || 5 || yatkadācinna bhajyeta na purātanatāṃ vrajet|| gurupatnyātvabhihito re tvāṣṭra kuru kaṃcukam ||6|| mamāṃgayogyaṃ no gāḍhaṃ na ślathaṃ ca prayatnataḥ || vinaiva vāsasā cāru vālkalaṃ ca sadojjvalam ||7|| guruputreṇa cājñapto mamārthaṃ pāduke kuru || yadārūḍhasya me pādau na paṃkaḥ saṃspṛśetkvacit || 8 || carmādibaṃdhanirmukte dhāvato me sukhaprade || yābhyāṃ ca saṃcare vāri sthala bhūmāviva drutam|| || 9 || gurukanyāpi taṃ prāha tvāṣṭra me śravaṇocite || bhūṣaṇe svena hastena kuru kāṃcananirmite ||4.2.86.10|| kumārī krīḍanīyāni kautukāni ca dehi me || daṃtidaṃtamayānyeva svahastaracitāni ca || 11 || gṛhopakaraṇaṃ dravyaṃ musalolūkhalādikam || tathā ghaṭaya medhāvinyathā truṭyati na kvacit || 12 || akṣālitānyapi yathā nityaṃ pīṭhāni sattama || ujjvalāni bhavaṃtyeva sthālikāśca tathā kuru || 13 || sūpakarmaṇyapi ca māṃ praśādhi tvaṣṭranaṃdana || yathāṃgulyo na dahyaṃte pākaḥ syācca yathā śubhaḥ || || 14 || ekastaṃbhamayaṃ gehamekadāruvinirmitam || tathā kuru varaṃ tvāṣṭra yatrecchā tatra dhāraye || 15 || ye sahādhyāyinopyasya vayojyeṣṭhāśca tepi hi || sarvesarve samīhaṃte karma tatkṛtameva hi||16|| tatheti sa pratijñāya sarveṣāṃ puratodrije || madhye vanaṃ prāviśacca mahāciṃtābhayārditaḥ ||17|| kiṃcitkartuṃ na jānāti pratijñātaṃ ca tena vai|| sarveṣāṃ purataḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmīti niścitam|| 18|| kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi ko me sāhāyyamarpayet || buddherapi vanasthasya śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajāmi ca || 19 || aṃgīkṛtya gurorvākyaṃ gurupatnyā guroḥ śiśoḥ || yo na niṣpādayenmūḍhaḥ sa bhavennirayī naraḥ || 4.2.86.20 || guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ dharma eko hi brahmacāriṇām || aniṣpādya tu tadvākyaṃ kathaṃ me niṣkṛtirbhavet || 21 || gurūṇāṃ vākyakaraṇātsarva eva manorathāḥ || siddhyaṃtītarathā naiva tasmātkāryaṃ hi tadvacaḥ ||22|| kathaṃ tadvacasaḥ siddhiṃ prāpsyāmyatra vane sthitaḥ || kaśca metra sahāyī syāddhiṣaṇādurbalasya vai || 23 || āstāṃ gurukathā dūraṃ yo'nyasyāpi laghorapi || omityuktvā na kurute kāryaṃ sotha vrajatyadhaḥ || 24 || kathametāni karmāṇi kariṣye'jño'sahāyavān || aṃgīkṛtāni tadbhītyā namaste bhavitavyate || 25 || yāvaditthaṃ ciṃtayati sa tvāṣṭro vanamadhyagaḥ || tāvattadeva saṃprāptastenaiko'darśi tāpasaḥ || 26 || atha natvā sa taṃ prāha vane dṛṣṭaṃ tapasvinam || ko bhavānmānasaṃ me yo nitarāṃ sukhayatyaho ||27|| tvaddarśanena me gātraṃ ciṃtāsaṃtāpatāpitam || himānī gāhaneneva śītalaṃ bhavati kṣaṇam || 28 || kiṃ tvaṃ me prāktanaṃ karma prāptaṃ tāpasarūpadhṛk || athavā karuṇāvārdhirāvirbhūtaḥ śivo bhavān || 29 || yosi sosi namastubhyamupadeśena yuṃkṣva mām || gurūktaṃ gurupatnyuktaṃ gurvapatyoktameva ca || 4.2.86.30 || kathaṃ kartumahaṃ śaktaḥ karma tatra diśādbhutam || kuru me buddhisāhāyyaṃ nirjane baṃdhutāṃ gataḥ || || 31 || ityuktastena sa vane tāpaso brahmacāriṇā || kāruṇyapūrṇahṛdayo yathoktamupadiṣṭavān || 32 || ya āptatvena saṃpṛṣṭo durbuddhiṃ saṃprayacchati || sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 33 || tāpasa uvāca || || brahmacāriñśṛṇu brūyāṃ kimadbhutataraṃ tvidam|| viśveśānugrahādbrahmāpyabhavatsṛṣṭikovidaḥ || 34 || yadi tvaṃ tvāṣṭra sarvajñaṃ kāśyāmārādhayiṣyasi || tataste viśvakarmeti nāma satyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 35 || viśveśānugrahātkāśyāmabhilāṣā na durlabhāḥ || sulabho durlabho vai yadyatra mokṣastanutyajām || 36 || sṛṣṭeḥkaraṇa sāmarthyaṃ sṛṣṭirakṣāpravīṇatā || vidhinā viṣṇunā prāpi viśveśānugrahātparāt || 37 || yāhi vaiśveśvaraṃ sadma padmayā samadhiṣṭhitam || nirvāṇasaṃjñayā bālā yadīccheḥ svānmanorathān || 38 || sa hi sarvapradaḥ śaṃbhuryācitaścopamanyunā || payomātraṃ dadau tasmai sarvaṃ kṣīrābdhimeva ca || 39 || ānaṃdakānane śaṃbhoḥ kiṃ kiṃ kena na labhyate || yatra vāsakṛtāṃ puṃsāṃ dharmarāśiḥ padepade || 4.2.86.40 || svardhunī sparśamātreṇa mahāpātakasaṃtatiḥ || yatra saṃkṣayati kṣipraṃ tāṃ kāśīṃ ko na saṃśrayet || 41 || na tādṛgdharmasaṃbhāro labhyate kratukoṭibhiḥ || yādṛgvārāṇasī vīthī saṃcāreṇa padepade || 42 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yadyatrāsti manorathaḥ || tadā vārāṇasīṃ yāhi yāhi trailokyapāvanīm || 43 || sarvakāmaphalaprāptistadaiva syāddhruvaṃ nṛṇām || yadaiva sarvadaḥ sarvaḥ kāśyāṃ viśveśvaraḥ śritaḥ || 44 || sa tāpasoktamākarṇya tvāṣṭra itthaṃ suhṛṣṭavān || kāśīsaṃprātyupāyaṃ ca tameva samapṛcchata ||45|| || tvāṣṭra uvāca || || tadānaṃdavanaṃ śaṃbhoḥ kvāsti tāpasasattama || yatra no durlabhaṃ kiṃcitsādhakānāṃ trayīsthitam || 46 || svarge vā martyaloke vā balisadmani vā mune || kva tadānaṃdagahanaṃ yatrānaṃdapayobdhijā || 47 || yatra viśveśvaro devo viśveṣāṃ karṇadhārakaḥ || vyācaṣṭe tārakaṃ jñānaṃ yena tanmayatāṃ yayuḥ || 48 || sulabhā yatra niyatamānaṃdavanacāriṇaḥ || api naiḥśreyasī lakṣmīḥ kimanyelpa manorathāḥ||49|| kastāṃ māṃ prāpayecchaṃbhoḥ kathaṃ yāmi tathā vada || sa tapasvīti tadvākyamākarṇya śraddhayānvitam ||4.2.86.50|| prāhāgaccha nayāmi tvāṃ yiyāsurahamapyaho|| durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ yadi kāśī na sevitā || 51 || punaḥkva nṛtvaṃ śreyobhūḥ kva kāśīkarmabaṃdhahṛt || vṛthāgate hi mānuṣye kāśīprāptivivarjanāt || 52 || āyuṣyaṃ ca bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarvameva vṛthāgatam|| atohaṃ saphalīkartuṃ mānuṣyaṃ cāticaṃcalam || 53 || yāsyāmi kāśīmāyāhi māyāṃ hitvā tvamapyaho || iti tena saha tvāṣṭro muninātikṛpālunā || 54 || purīṃ vaiśveśvarīṃ prāpto manaḥsvāsthyamavāpa ca || tataḥ prāpayya tāṃ kāśīṃ tāpasaḥ kvāpyatarkitam || 55 || jagāma kuṃbhasaṃbhūta sa tvāṣṭropītyamanyata || avaśyaṃ sa hi viśveśaḥ sarveṣāṃ ciṃtitapradaḥ|| 56|| satpathasthiravṛtīnāṃ dūrasthopi samīpagaḥ || yasminprasannadṛktryakṣastaṃ daviṣṭhamapi dhruvam ||57||| sunediṣṭhaṃ karotyeva svayaṃvartmopadeśayan || kvāhaṃ tatra vane bālaściṃtākulitamānasaḥ || kva tāpasaḥ sa yo māṃ vai sūdiśyeha cānayat || 58 || kheloyamasya tryakṣasya yasya bhaktasya kutracit || na durlabhataraṃ kiṃcidaho kvāhaṃ kva kāśikā || 59 || nārādhito mayā śaṃbhuḥ prāktane janmani kvacit || śarīritvānumānena jñātametadasaṃśayam|| 4.2.86.60 || asmiñjanmani bālatvānna caivārādhitaḥ sphuṭam || pratyakṣameva me vaitatkutonugrahadhīrmayi || 61 || ājñātaṃ gurubhaktirme hetuḥ śaṃbhuprasādane || yayehānugṛhītosmi viśveśena kṛpālunā || 62 || athavā kāraṇāpekṣastryakṣastvitaradevavat || raṃkamapyanugṛhṇāti kevalaṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛpā|| 63 || yadi no mayyanukrośaḥ kathaṃ tāpasasaṃgatiḥ || tadrūpeṇa svayaṃ śaṃbhurānināyeha māṃ dhruvam ||64|| na dānāni na vai yajñā na tapāṃsi vratāni ca ||| śaṃbhoḥ prasādahetūni kāraṇaṃ tatkṛpaiva hi || || 65 || dayāmapi tadā kuryādasau viśveśvaraḥ parām || yadāśrutyuktamadhvānaṃ sadbhiḥ kṣuṇṇaṃ na saṃtyajet || 66 || anukrośaṃ samarthyeti sa tvāṣṭraḥ rśābhavaṃ śuciḥ|| saṃsthāpya liṃgamīśasyārādhayatsvasthamānasaḥ || 67 || ānīya puṣpasaṃbhāramārtavaṃ kānanādbahu || snātvābhyarcayatīśānaṃ kaṃdamūlaphalāśanaḥ || 68 || itthaṃ tvaṣṭṛtanūjasya liṃgārādhanacetasaḥ || trihāyanātprasannobhūttasyeśaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ || 69 || tasmādeva hi liṃgācca prādurbhūya bhavo'bravīt || varaṃ varaya re tvāṣṭra dṛḍhabhaktyānayā tava || || 4.2.86.70 || prasannosmi bhṛśaṃ bāla gurvarthakṛtacetasaḥ || guruṇā gurupatnyā ca gurvapatyadvayena ca || 71 || yathārthitaṃ tathā kartuṃ te sāmarthyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 72 || anyānvarāṃśca te dadyāṃ tvāṣṭra tuṣṭastvadarcayā || tāñśṛṇuṣva mahābhāga liṃgasyāsyādbhutaśriyaḥ || 73 || tvaṃ suvarṇādidhātūnāṃ dārūṇāṃ dṛṣadāmapi || maṇīnāmapiratnānāṃ puṣpāṇāmapi vāsasām || 74 || karpūrādisugaṃdhīnāṃ dravyāṇāmapyapāmapi || kaṃdamūlaphalānāṃ ca dravyāṇāmapi ca tvacām|| || 75 || sarveṣāṃ vastujātānāṃ kartuṃ karma pravetsyasi || yasya yasya ruciryatra sadma devālayādiṣu || 76 || tasya tasyeha tuṣṭyai tvaṃ tathā kartuṃ pravetsyasi || sarvanepathyaracanāḥ sarvāḥ sūpasya saṃskṛtīḥ ||77|| sarvāṇi śilpakāryāṇi tauryatrikamathāpi ca || sarvaṃ jñāsyasi kartuṃ tvaṃ dvitīya iva padmabhūḥ ||78|| nānāvidhāni yaṃtrāṇi nānāyudhavidhānakam || jalāśayānāṃ racanāḥ sudurgaracanāstathā || 79 || tādṛkkartuṃ purā vetsi yādṛṅnānyo'dhiyāsyati || kalājātaṃ hi sarvaṃ tvamavayāsyasi me varāt || 4.2.86.80 || sarveṃdrajālikī vidyā tvadadhīnā bhaviṣyati || sarvakarmasu kauśalyaṃ sarvabuddhivariṣṭhatām ||81 || sarveṣāṃ ca manovṛttiṃ tvaṃ jñāsyasi varānmama || kiṃ bahūktena yatsvarge yatpātāle yadatra ca|| 82|| atilokottaraṃ karma tatsarvaṃ vetsyasi svayam || 83 || viśveṣāṃ viśvakarmāṇi viśveṣu bhuvaneṣu ca || yato jñāsyasi tannāma viśvakarmeti te'nagha || 84 || aparaḥ ko varo deyastava taṃ prārthayāśvaho || tavādeyaṃ na me kiṃcilliṃgārcanaratasya hi || 85 || anyatrāpi hi yo liṃgaṃ samarcayati sanmatiḥ || tasyāpi vāṃchitaṃ deyaṃ kiṃpunaryovikāśikam || 86 || yena kāśyāṃ samabhyarci yena kāśyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam || yena kāśyāṃ stutaṃ liṃgaṃ sa me rūpāya darpaṇaḥ|| 87 || tattvaṃ svacchosi mukuro mama netratrayasya hi || kāśyāṃ liṃgārcanāttvāṣṭra varaṃ varaya suvrata || 88 || kāśyāṃ yo rājadhānyāṃ me hitvā māmanyamarcayet || sa varākolpadhīrmuṣṭo'lpatuṣṭirmuktivarjitaḥ || 89 || tadānaṃdavanehyatra samarcyohaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || druhiṇopeṃdracaṃdreṃdrairihānyo na samarcyate || 4.2.86.90 || yathānaṃdavanaṃ prāpya tvaṃ māmarcitavānasi || tathānye puṇyakarmāṇo māmabhyarcyaiva māmitāḥ || 91 || anugrāhyo'si nitarāṃ tato varaya durlabham || śrāṇitaṃ tadavaihi tvaṃ vada mā cirayasva bhoḥ || 92 || || viśvakarmovāca || || idaṃ yatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ mayājñenāpi śaṃkara || talliṃgamanyepyārādhya saṃtu samṛddhibhājanam || 93 || anyacca nātha prārthyosi tacca viśrāṇayiṣyasi || mayā vinirmāpayitā svaṃ prāsādaṃ kadā bhavān || 94 || devadeva uvāca || || evamastu yaduktaṃ te tava liṃgasamarcakāḥ || samṛddhibhājanaṃ vai syuḥ syuśca nirvāṇadīkṣitāḥ || 95 || yadā ca rājā bhavitā divodāso vidhervarāt|| tadā me vacanāttāta prāsādaṃ me vidhāsyati || 96 || navīkṛtya punaḥ kāśī nirviṣṭā tena bhūbhujā || gaṇeśamāyayā rājyātparinirviṇṇacetasā || 97 || viṣṇoḥ sadupadeśācca māmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || nirvāṇalakṣmīḥ prāpteha hitvā rājyaśriyaṃ calām|| 98 || viśvakarmanvraja guroḥ śāsanāya yatasva ca || gurubhaktikṛto yasmānmadbhaktā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 99 || ye guruṃ cāvamanyaṃte tevamānyā mayāpyaho || tasmādgurūpadiṣṭaṃ hi kuru śiṣyasamīhitam || 4.2.86.100 || tata āgatya me pārśvaṃ yāvannirvāṇameṣyasi || tāvatsthāsyasi śuddhātmā devānāṃ hitamācaran || 101 || tavātra liṃge satataṃ sthāsyāmyahamabhīṣṭadaḥ || asya liṃgasya bhaktānāṃ nirvāṇaśrīradūrataḥ ||102 || aṃgāreśādudīcyāṃ ye tvalliṃgasyasamarcakāḥ || teṣāṃ manorathāvāptirbhaviṣyati padepade || 103 || ityuktvāṃtardadhe devastvāṣṭropi gurumāptavān || guroḥ samīhitaṃ bhūri vidhāya sa gṛhānyayau ||104|| gṛhepi mātāpitarau saṃtoṣya nijakarmaṇā || taduktājñāṃ samādhāya punaḥ kāśīṃ samāyayau || 105 || svaliṃgārādhanāsakto nādyāpi tvaṣṭṛnaṃdanaḥ || kāśīṃ tyajati medhāvī sarvadeva priyaṃ caran || 106 || || īśvara uvāca || || pṛṣṭāni yāni rligāni tvayā devi girīṃdraje || kāśī muktau samarthāni tānyuktāni mayā tava|| 107 || liṃgamoṃkārasaṃjñaṃ ca tathā devaṃ triviṣṭapam || mahādevaḥ kṛttivāsā ratneśaścaṃdrasaṃjñakaḥ || 108 || kedāraścāpi dharmeśastathā vīreśvarābhidhaḥ || kāmeśaviśvakarmeśau maṇikarṇīśvarastathā || 109 || mamārcyamavimuktākhyaṃ tato devi mamā khyakam || viśvanātheti viśvasminprathitaṃ viśvasaukhyadam|| 4.2.86.110 || avimuktaṃ samāsādya yena viśveśvarorcitaḥ || na tasyāsti punarjanma kalpakoṭiśateṣvapi || 111 || aṣṭau māsānvihāraḥ syādyatīnāṃ saṃyatātmanām || ekatra caturomāsānabdaṃ nāvāsa iṣyate || 112 || avimukte praviṣṭānāṃ vihāro naiva yujyate || mokṣopyasaṃśayaścātra tasmāttyājyā na kāśikā || 113 || ānaṃdakānanaṃ hitvā nānyadgacchettapovanam || tapoyogaśca mokṣaśca yatotraiva madāśrayāt || 114 || kṛpayā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ kṣetrametanmayā kṛtam || avaśyameva siddhyaṃti kṣetresminsiddhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 125 || atītaṃ vartamānaṃ ca jānato'jñānataḥ kṛtam || yadenastallayaṃ yāyādānaṃdavanavīkṣaṇāt || 116 || atyugraiśca tapobhiryanmahādānairmahāvrataiḥ || niyamaiśca yamaiḥ samyaktvayogena mahāmakhaiḥ || 117 || vedāṃtaśāstrābhyasanaiḥ sarvopaniṣadāśrayāt || ebhirvai yadavāpyeta tatkāśyāṃ helayāpyate ||118|| karmasūtreṇa baddhā vai bhrāmyaṃte tāvadeva hi || yāvadvaiśveśvare dhāmni mama naiva tanutyajaḥ ||119|| kāśyāṃ svalīlayā devi tiryagyonijuṣāmapi|| dadāmi cāṃte tatsthānaṃ yatra yāṃti na yājñikāḥ || 4.2.86.120 || bhūtagrāmo'khilopyatra muktikṣetre kṛtālayaḥ || kālena nidhanaṃ yāto yātyeva paramāṃ gatim || 121 || viṣayāsaktacittopi tyaktadharmaratistvapi || kālenojjhitadeho'tra na saṃsāraṃ punarviśet || 122 || prayāge yatphalaṃ devi māghe copanimajjanāt || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ kṣaṇekṣaṇe || 123 || asya kṣetrasya mahimā kopi vācāmagocaraḥ || uddeśamātramākhyāyi mayā te prītikāmyayā || 124 || caturdaśānāṃ liṃgānāṃ śrutvākhyānāni sattamaḥ || caturdaśa sulokeṣu pūjāṃ prāpsyatyanuttamām || 125|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe viśvakarmeśa prādurbhāvo nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 86 ||
<4.2.87>
|| agastya uvāca || || sarvajñasūno ṣaḍvaktra sarvārthakuśala prabho || prādurbhāvaṃ niśamyaiṣāṃ liṃgānāṃ muktidāyinām || 1 || nitarāṃ paritṛptosmi sudhāṃ pītveva nirjaraḥ || oṃkārapramukhairliṃgairidamānaṃdakānanam||2|| ānaṃdamevajanayedapi pāpajuṣāmiha || parānaṃdamahaṃ prāptaḥ śrutvaitalliṃgakīrtanam ||3|| jīvanmuktaivāsaṃ hi kṣetratattvaśruteraham || skaṃdadakṣeśvarādīni liṃgānīha caturdaśa || yānyuktāni samācakṣva tatprabhāvamaśeṣataḥ || 4 || yo dakṣo garhayāmāsa madhye devasabhaṃ vibhum || sa kathaṃ liṃgamīśasya pratyasthāpayadadbhutam ||5|| iti śrutvā śikhirathaḥ kuṃbhayonerudīritam || sūta saṃkathayāmāsa dakṣeśvara samudbhavam ||6|| || skaṃda uvāca || ākarṇaya mune vacmi kathāṃ kalmaṣahāriṇīm || puraścaraṇakāmosau dakṣaḥ kāśīṃ samāyayau || 7 || chāgavaktro virūpāsyo dadhīci paridhikkṛtaḥ || prāyaścittavidhānārthaṃ sūpadiṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā || 8 || ekadā devadevasya sevārthaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ || kailāsamagamadviṣṇuḥ padmayonipuraskṛtaḥ || 9 || iṃdrādayo lokapālā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ || ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā vidyādharoragāḥ || 4.2.87.10 || ṛṣayo'psarasoyakṣā gaṃdharvāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ || tairnato devadeveśaḥ parihṛṣṭatanūruhaiḥ ||11|| stutaśca nānā stutibhiḥ śaṃbhunāpi kṛtādarāḥ || viviśuścāsanaśreṇyāṃ tanmukhāsaktadṛṣṭayaḥ || 12 || atha teṣūpaviṣṭeṣu śaṃbhunā viṣṭaraśravāḥ || kṛtahastaparisparśamānaḥ pṛṣṭo mahādaram || 13 || śrīvatsalāṃchana hare daityavaṃśadavānala || kaccitpālayituṃ śaktistrilokīmastyakuṃṭhitā|| 14 || ditijāndanujānduṣṭānkaccicchāsi raṇāṃgaṇe || api kuddhānmahīdevānmāmiva pratimanyase || 15 || bādhayā rahitā gāvaḥ kaccitsaṃti mahītale || striyaḥ saṃti hi suśrīkāḥ pativrataparāyaṇāḥ || 16 || vidhiyajñāḥ pravartaṃte pṛthivyāṃ bahudakṣiṇāḥ || nirābādhaṃ tapaḥ kaccidasti śaśvattapasvinām || 17 || niṣpratyūhaṃ paṭhaṃtyeva sāṃgānvedāndvijottamāḥ || mahīpālāḥ prajāḥ kaccitpāṃti tvamivakeśava || 18|| sveṣu sveṣu ca dharmeṣu kaccidvarṇāśramāstathā || niṣṭhāvaṃto hi tiṣṭhaṃti prahṛṣṭeṃdriyamānasāḥ || 19 || dhūrjaṭiḥ paripṛchyeti hṛṣṭaṃ vaikuṃṭhanāyakam| brahmāṇaṃ cāpi papraccha brāhmaṃ tejaḥ samedhate || 4.2.87.20 || satyamaskhalitaṃ kaccidasti trailokyamaṃḍape || tīrthāvarodho na kvāpi kenacitkriyate vidhe || 21 || iṃdrādayaḥ surāḥ kaccitsveṣu sveṣu pureṣvaho || rājyaṃ praśāsati svasthāḥ kṛṣṇadordaṃḍapālitāḥ || 22 || pratyekaṃ paripṛcchayeśaḥ sarvānitthaṃ kṛtādarān || pṛṣṭvā gamanakāryaṃ ca teṣāṃ kṛtvā manorathān || 23 || visasarjātha tānsarvāndevaḥ saudhaṃ samāviśat || gateṣvatha ca deveṣu svasva dhiṣṇyeṣu hṛṣṭavat || 24 || madhye mārgaṃ sa ciṃtobhūddakṣaḥ satyāḥ pitā tadā || anyadevasamānaṃ sa mānaṃ prāpa na cādhikam || 25 || atīva kṣubdhacittobhūnmaṃdarāghātato'bdhivat || uvāca ca manasyetanmahākrodharayāṃdhadṛk|| 26 || atīvagarvito jātaḥ satī me prāpya kanyakām || kasyacinnāpyasau prāyo na kosyāpi kvacitpunaḥ || 27 || kiṃ vaṃśyastveṣa kiṃ gotraḥ kiṃ deśīyaḥ kimātmakaḥ || kiṃ vṛttiḥ kiṃ samācāro vipā(ṣā?)dī vṛṣavāhanaḥ || 28 || na prāyaśastapasvyeṣa kva tapaḥ kvāstradhāraṇam || na gṛhastheṣu gaṇyosau śmaśānanilayo yataḥ || 29 || asau na brahmacārī syātkṛtapāṇigraha sthitiḥ|| vānaprasthyaṃ kutaścāsminnaiśvaryamadamohite ||4.2.87.30|| na brāhmaṇobhavatyeṣa yato vedo na vettyamum || śastrāstradhāraṇātprāyaḥ kṣatriyaḥ syānna sopyayam|| 31 || kṣatātsaṃtrāṇanātkṣatraṃ tatkvāsminpralayapriye || vaiśyopi na bhavedeṣa sadā nirdhanaceṣṭanaḥ || 32 || śūdropi na bhavetprāyo nāgayajñopavītavān || evaṃ varṇāśramātītaḥ kosau samyaṅnakīrtyate || 33 || sarvaḥ prakṛtyā jñāyeta sthāṇuḥ prakṛtivarjitaḥ || prāyaśaḥ puruṣonāsāvardhanārīvapuryataḥ || 34 || yoṣāpi na bhavedeṣa yatosau śmaśrulānanaḥ || napuṃsakopi na bhavelliṃgamasyayatorcyate || 35 || bālopi na bhavatyeṣa yato'yaṃ bahuvārṣikaḥ|| anādivṛddho lokeṣu gīyate cogra eṣa yat || 36 || ato yuvatvaṃ saṃbhāvyaṃ nātra nūnaṃ ciraṃtane || vṛddho'pi na bhavatyeṣa jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ || 37 || brahmādīnsaṃharetprāṃte tathāpi ca na pātakī || puṇyaleśopi nāstyasminbrahmamaulicchidikrudhā|| 38 || asthinepathyavati ca kva śucitvaṃ vivāsasi || kiṃ bahūktena no kiṃcijjñāyate'sya viceṣṭitam || 29 || aho dhārṣṭyaṃ mahaddṛṣṭaṃ jaṭilasyādya cādbhutam || yadāsanānnotthitosau dṛṣṭvā māṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum || 4.2.87.40 || evaṃbhūtā bhavaṃtyeva mātāpitṛvivarjitāḥ || nirguṇā akulīnāśca karmabhraṣṭā niraṃkuśāḥ || 41 || svacchaṃdacāriṇo'nāthāḥ sarvatra svābhimāninaḥ || akiṃcanā apiprāyastathāpīśvaramāninaḥ || 42 || jāmātṝṇāṃ svabhāvoyaṃ prāyaśo garvabhājanam || kiṃcidaiśvayarmāsādya bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 43 || dvijarājaḥ sa garviṣṭho rohiṇīpremanirbharaḥ || kṛttikādiṣu cāsnehī mayā śaptaḥ kṣayīkṛtaḥ || 44 || asyāhaṃ garvasarvasvaṃ hariṣyāmyeva śūlinaḥ || yathāvamānitaścāhamanenāsya gṛhaṃ gataḥ || 45 || tathāsyāhaṃ kariṣyāmi mānahāniṃ ca sarvataḥ || saṃpradhāryeti bahuśaḥ sa tu dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 46 || prāpya svabhavanaṃ devānājuhāva savāsavān || ahaṃ yiyakṣuryūyaṃ me yajñasāhāyyakāriṇaḥ || 47 || bhavaṃtu yajñasaṃbhārānānayaṃtu tvarānvitāḥ || śvetadvīpamatho gatvā cakre cakriṇamacyutam || 48 || mahākratūpadraṣṭāraṃ yajñapūruṣameva ca || tasyartvijobhavansarva ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ || 49 || prāvartata tatastasya dakṣasya ca mahādhvaraḥ || dṛṣṭvā devanikāyāṃśca tasmindakṣa mahādhvare || 4.2.87.50 || anīśvarāṃstato vedhā vyājaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ yayau || dadhīciratha saṃvīkṣya sarvāṃstrailokyavāsinaḥ || 51 || dakṣayajñe samāyātānsatīśvaravivarjitān || prāptasaṃmānasaṃbhārānvāsolaṃkṛtipūrvakam ||52 || dakṣasya hi śubhodarkamicchanprovāca ceti vai || || dadhīciruvāca || dakṣaprajāpate dakṣa sākṣāddhātṛsvarūpadhṛk || 53 || na cāsti tava sāmarthyaṃ kvāpi kasyāpi niścitam || yādṛśaḥ kratusaṃbhārastava ceha samīkṣyate || 54 || na tādṛṅnedasi prāyaḥ kvāpi jñāto mahāmate || kratustu naiva kartavyo nāsti kratusamo ripuḥ || 55 || kartavyaścettadākāryaḥ syāccetsaṃpatti rīdṛśī || sākṣādagniḥ svayaṃ kuṃḍe sākṣādiṃdrādidevatāḥ ||56|| sākṣācca sarve maṃtrā vai sākṣādyajñapumānasau || ācāryapadavīmeṣa devācāryaḥ svayaṃ caret || sākṣādbrahmā svayaṃ caiṣa bhṛgurvai karmakāṃḍavit || 57 || ayaṃ pūṣā bhagastveṣa iyaṃ devī sarasvatī || ete ca sarvadikpālā yajñarakṣākṛtaḥ svayam || 58|| tvaṃ ca dīkṣāṃ śubhāṃ prāpto devyā ca śatarūpayā || jāmātā tveṣa te dharmaḥ patnībhirdaśabhiḥ saha || 59 || svayameva hi kurvīta dharmakāryaṃ prayatnataḥ || oṣadhīnāmayaṃ nāthastava jāmātṛṣūttamaḥ || 4.2.87.60 || saptaviṃśatibhiḥ sārdhaṃ patnībhistava kāryakṛt || oṣadhīḥ pūrayetsarvā dvijarājo mahāsudhīḥ ||61|| dīkṣito rājasūyasya dattatrailokyadakṣiṇaḥ || mārīcaḥ kaśyapaścāsau prajāpatiṣu sattamaḥ || trayodaśamitābhiśca bhāryābhistava kāryakṛt || 62 || haviḥ kāmadughā sūte kalpavṛkṣaḥ samitkuśān || dārupātrāṇi sarvāṇi śakaṭaṃ maṃḍapādikam || 63 || viśvakarmāpyalaṃkārānkurutebhyāgatartvijām || vasūni cā'pi vāsāṃsi vasavoṣṭau dadatyapi || 64 || svayaṃlakṣmīralaṃkuryādyāvai cātra suvāsinīḥ || 65 || sarve sukhāya me dakṣa vīkṣamāṇasya sarvataḥ || ekaṃ duḥkhākarotyeva yattvaṃ vismṛtavānasi || 66 || jīvahīno yathā deho bhūṣitopi na śobhate || tatheśvaraṃ vinā yajñaḥ śmaśānamiva lakṣyate || 67 || itthaṃ dadhīcivacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || bhṛśaṃ jajvāla kopena haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmavat || 68 || pūrvastutyāti saṃhṛṣṭo dṛṣṭo yosau dadhīcinā || sa eva cāpi kopāgnimudvamanvīkṣito mukhāt || 69 || pratyuvācātha taṃ vipraṃ vepamānāṃgayaṣṭikaḥ || dakṣaḥ prajāpatī roṣājjighāṃsuriva taṃ dvijam || 4.2.87.70 || || dakṣa uvāca || || brāhmaṇosi dadhīce tvaṃ kiṃ karomi tavātra vai || dīkṣāmahamaho prāptaḥ kartuṃ nāyāti kiṃcana || 71 || bhavānkena samāhūto yadatrāgānmahājaḍaḥ || āgatopi hi kena tvaṃ pṛṣṭa itthaṃ prabravīṣi yat || 72 || sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyo yatra śrīmānayaṃ hariḥ || svayaṃ vai yajñapuruṣaḥ sa makhaḥ kiṃ śmaśānavat || 73 || yatra vajradharaḥ śakraḥ śatayajñaikadīkṣitaḥ || trayastriṃśatikoṭīnāmamarāṇāṃ patiḥ svayam || 74 || taṃ tvaṃcopamimīṣemuṃ śmaśānena mahāmakham || dharmarāṭca svayaṃ yatra dharmādharmaikakovidaḥ || 75 || śrīdosti yatra śrīdātā sākṣādyatrāśuśukṣaṇiḥ || taṃ yajñamupamāsi tvamamaṃgalabhuvātayā || 76 || devācāryaḥ svayaṃ yatra kratorācāryatāgataḥ || abhimānavaśāttaṃ tvamākhyāsi pitṛkānanam || 77 || yatrārtvijyaṃ bhajaṃte'mī vasiṣṭhapramukharṣayaḥ || tamadhvaraṃ samācakṣe maṃgaletarabhūmivat || 78 || niśamyeti muniḥ prāha dadhīcirjñānināṃ varaḥ || sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyo bhavedyajñapumānhariḥ || 79 || tathāpi śāṃbhavī śaktirvede viṣṇuḥ prapaṭhyate || vāmāṃgaṃ sraṣṭurādyasya haristaditaradvidhiḥ || 4.2.87.80 || dīkṣito yośvamedhānāṃ śatasya kuliśāyudhaḥ || durvāsasā kṣaṇenāpi nīto niḥśrīkatāṃ hi saḥ || 81 || punarārādhya bhūteśaṃ prāpaikāmamarāvatīm || yastvayā dharmarājotra kathitaḥ kraturakṣakaḥ || 82 || balaṃ tasyākhilairjñātaṃ śvetaṃ pāśayataḥ purā || dhanadastryaṃbakasakhastaccakṣuścāśuśukṣaṇiḥ || 83 || pārṣṇigrāhyabhavadrudro devācāryasya vai tadā || yadā tārāmadhārṣītsa dvijarājo'tisuṃdarīm || 84 || taṃ vidaṃti vasiṣṭhādyāstavārtvijyaṃ bhajaṃti ye || eko rudro na dvitīyaḥ saṃvidānā apīti hi || 85|| prāvartaṃtarṣayonyepi gauravāttava te kratau || yadi me brāhmaṇasyaikaṃ śṛṇoṣi vacanaṃ hitam || 86 || tadā kratuphalādhīśaṃ viśveśaṃ tvaṃ samāhvaya || vinā tena kraturasau kṛtopyakṛta eva hi || 87 || sati tasmnimahādeve viśvakarmaikasākṣiṇi || tavāpi caiṣā sarveṣāṃ phaliṣyaṃti manorathāḥ || 88 || yathā jaḍāni bījāni na phalaṃti svayaṃ tathā || jaḍāni sarvakarmāṇi na phalaṃtīśvaraṃ vinā || 89 || arthahīnā yathā vāṇī dharmahīnā yathā tanuḥ || patihīnā yathā nārī śivahīnā tathā kriyā || || 4.2.87.90 || gaṃgāhīnā yathā deśāḥ putrahīnā yathā gṛhāḥ || dānahīnā yathā saṃpacchivahīnā tathā kriyā || 91 || maṃtrihīnaṃ yathā rājyaṃ śrutihīnā yathā dvijāḥ || yoṣā hīnaṃ yathā saukhyaṃ śivahīnā tathā kriyā || 92 || darbhahīnā yathā saṃdhyā tilahīnaṃ ca tarpaṇam || havirhīno yathā homaḥ śivahīnā tathā kriyā || 93 || itthaṃ dadhīcinākhyātaṃ jagrāha vacanaṃ na tat || dakṣo dakṣopi tatraiva śaṃbhormāyā vimohitaḥ|| 94 || provāca ca bhṛśaṃ kruddhaḥ kā ciṃtā tava me kratoḥ || kratumukhyāni sarvāṇi yāni karmāṇi sarvataḥ || 95 || tāni siddhyaṃti niyataṃ yathārthakaraṇādiha || ayathārthavidhānena siddhyetkarmāpi neśituḥ || 96 || svakarmasiddhaye cātha sarva eva hi ceśvaraḥ || īśvaraḥ karmaṇāṃ sākṣī yattvayāpīti bhāṣitam || 97 || tattathāstu paraṃ sākṣī nārthaṃ dadyācca kutracit || 98 || jaḍāni sarvakarmāṇi na phalaṃtīśvaraṃ vinā || yaduktaṃ bhavatā tatrāpyaho dṛṣṭāṃtayāmyaham || 99 || jaḍānyapi ca bījāni kālaṃ saṃprāpyavātmanaḥ || aṃkūrayaṃti kālācca puṣpyaṃti ca phalaṃti ca || 4.2.87.100 || vināpīśaṃ tathā karma svayaṃ kālātphalatyaho || kimīśvareṇa tenātra mahāmaṃgalamūrtinā || 101 || || dadhīciruvāca || || yathārthakaraṇātsiddhamapi kāryaṃ kadācana || īśvaraprātikūlyācca siddhamevāśu naśyati || 102 || īśvarecchā balātkarma kṛtamapyavidhānataḥ || saṃsiddhyettadadhīnāśca kathaṃ sarva iheśvarāḥ || 103 || sāmānyasākṣivanneśaḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvakarmaṇām || sākṣībhavedasaṃdigdhaḥ phalasya pratibhūrapi || 104 || bhūjalādisvarūpeṇa bījamāviśyasarvakṛt || svayaṃ kālasvarūpeṇa vidadhyādaṃkurodayam || 105 || yattvayoktaṃ vināpīśaṃ kāle karmaphaletsvayam || sa eva kālo bhagavānsarvakartā maheśitā || 106 || anyacca bhavatā proktaṃ tadekaṃ tathyameva tat || kimīśvareṇa tenātra mahāmaṃgalamūrtinā || 107 || ye mahāṃto bhavaṃtyeva ye ca maṃgalamūrtayaḥ || īśvarākhyā ca yeṣvasti kiṃ tairatra tavāṃtike || 108 || uttarāduttaraṃ ceti pratyuttarayati dvije || dadhīcau cukrudhe'tyaṃtaṃ dakṣogarvātisuśriyā || 109 || ādideśa samīpasthānālokya paritastviti || brāhmaṇāpasadaṃ cāmuṃ paridūrayatāśu vai || 4.2.87.110 || amuṣmādadhvaraśreṣṭhādavariṣṭhamanogatam || itthaṃ dadhīcirākarṇya provāca prahasanniva || 111 || kiṃ māṃ dūrayase mūḍha dūrībhūto bhavānapi || sarvebhyo maṃgalebhyaśca sarvairebhiḥ samaṃ dhruvam || 112 || akāṃḍe krodhajo daṃḍastava mūrdhni patiṣyati || maheśitustrijagatī pariśāstuḥ prajāpate || 113 || ityuktvā nirjagāmāśu yajñavāṭāttato dvijaḥ || tasminniryāti niryāto durvāsāścyavano bhavān || 114 || uttaṃka upamanyuśca ṛcīkoddālakāvapi || māṃḍavyo vāmadevaśca gālavo gargagautamau ||115|| śivatattvavidonyepi dakṣayajñādviniryayuḥ || gate dadhīcau sānaṃdaṃ prāvartata mahāmakhaḥ ||116|| ye sthitā brāhmaṇāstatra tebhyo dviguṇa dakṣiṇām || prādātprajāpatirdakṣastvanyebhyopyadhikaṃ vasu || || 117 || sarve jāmātarastena toṣitā bhūriśodhanaiḥ || kanyāścālaṃkṛtāḥ sarvā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ ||118|| ṛṣipatnyopi bahuśo devapatnyopyanekaśaḥ || tathā purāṃganāḥ sarvāstena mānabhuvaḥ kṛtāḥ || 119 || brahmaghoṣeṇa tāreṇa vyomaśabdaguṇaṃ sphuṭam || kāritaṃ tena dakṣeṇa viprāṇāṃ hṛṣṭacetasām || 4.2.87.120 || agnirmaṃdāgnirabhavattasmiñjuhvati dīkṣite || haviḥ parimalenaiva paritṛptā digaṃganāḥ || 121 || svāhākārairvaṣaṭkāraiḥ surā jātāḥ picaṃḍilāḥ || racitā girayastena sadannānāṃ padepade ||122|| ghṛtakulyāḥ kṛtāstena madhukulyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || mahāsarāṃsi payasāṃ drapsasyāpi mahāhradāḥ || 123 || rāśayaśca dukūlānāṃ ratnānāṃ śikharāṇi ca || yajñavāṭasya vasudhā svarṇarūpyamayīkṛtā || 124 || na labhyaṃte kratau tasya mārgitā api mārgaṇāḥ || hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭāḥ samabhavannapi tatparicārakāḥ || 125 || dhvanirmaṃgalagītānāṃ vyānaśe gaganāṃgaṇam || jahṛṣe cāpsarovṛṃdairgaṃdharvairmumudetarām || 126 || vidyādharairnanaṃde ca vasudhā vavṛdhe bhṛśam || mahāvibhavasaṃbhāre tasmindākṣe mahākratau || itthaṃ pravṛtte'tha muniḥ kailāsaṃ nārado yayau ||127|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe dakṣayajñaprādurbhāvonāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 87|| || cha || ||
<4.2.88>
agastya uvāca || || śivalokaṃ samāsādya muninā brahmasūnunā || kiṃ cakre brūhi ṣaḍvaktra kathāṃ kautukaśālinīm || 1 || skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇu kuṃbhaja vakṣyāmi nāradena mahātmanā || yatkṛtaṃ tatra gatvāśu kailāsaṃ śaṃkarālayam || 2 || munirgaganamārgeṇa prāpya taddhāma śāṃbhavam|| dṛṣṭvā śivau praṇamyātha śivena vihitādaraḥ || 3 || taduddiṣṭāsanaṃ bheje paśyaṃstatkrīḍanaṃ param|| krīḍaṃtau tau tu cākṣābhyāṃ yadā na ca virametuḥ || 4 || tadautsukyena sa muniḥ preryamāṇa uvāca ha || || nārada uvāca || || devadeva tava krīḍākhilaṃ brahmāṃḍagolakam || māsā dvādaśa ye nātha te sāriphalake gṛhāḥ || 5 || kṛṣṇāḥ kṛṣṇetarā yā vai tithayastāśca sārikāḥ || dvipaṃcadaśamāse yāstvakṣayugmaṃ tathāyane || 6 || sṛṣṭipralaya saṃjñau dvau glahau jayaparājayau || devījaye bhavetsṛṣṭirasṛṣṭirdhūrjaṭerjaye || 7 || bhavatoḥ khelasamayo yaḥ sā sthitirudāhṛtā|| itthaṃ krīḍaiva sakalametadbrahmāṃḍamīśayoḥ || 8 || na devī jeṣyati patiṃ neśaḥ śaktiṃ vijeṣyati || kiṃcidvijñaptukāmosmi tanmātaravadhāryatām || 9 || devaḥ sarvajñanāthopi na kiṃcidavabudhyati || mānāpamānayoryasmādasau dūre vyavasthitaḥ || 4.2.88.10 || līlātmā guṇavāneṣa vicārādatinirguṇaḥ || kurvannapi hi karmāṇi bādhyate naiva karmabhiḥ || 11 || madhyasthopi hi sarvasya mādhyasthyamavalaṃbatai || sarvatrāyaṃ maheśāno mitrā'mitrasamānadṛk || 12 || tvaṃ śaktirasya devasya sarveṣāṃ mānyabhūḥ parā || dakṣasyāpi tvayā māno datto patyanimittakaḥ || 13 || paraṃ tvaṃ sarvajagatāṃ janayitryekikā dhruvam || tvatta āvirbhavaṃtyeva dhātṛkeśavavāsavāḥ|| || 14 || tvamātmānaṃ na jānāsi tryakṣamāyāvimohitā || ataeva hi me cittaṃ dunotyatitarāṃ sati || 15 || anyā api hi yāḥ satyaḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ || tā bhartṛcaraṇau hitvā kiṃcidanyanna manvate || 16 || athavāstāmiyaṃ vārtā prastutaṃ prabravīmyaham || adya nīlagirestasmāddharidvārasamīpataḥ || 17 || apūrvamiva saṃvīkṣya pariprāptastavāṃtikam || atyāścaryaviṣādābhyāṃ kicidvaktumihotsukaḥ || 18 || āścaryaheturevāyaṃ yatpuṃjātaṃ trayītale || taddṛṣṭaṃ sakalatraṃ ca dakṣasyādhvaramaṃḍape || 19 || sālaṃkāraṃ samānaṃ ca sānaṃdamukhapaṃkajam || vismṛtākhilakāryaṃ ca dakṣayajñapravartakam || 4.2.88.20 || viṣāde kāraṇaṃ caitadyato jātamidaṃ jagat || yasminpravartate yatra layameṣyati ca dhruvam || 21 || tadeva tatra no dṛṣṭaṃ bhavadvaṃdvaṃ bhavāpaham || prāyo viṣādajanakaṃ bhavatoryadadarśanam || 22 || tadeva nābhavattatra samabhūdanyadeva hi || tacca vaktuṃ na śakyeta tadvaktā dakṣa eva saḥ || 23 || tāni vākyāni cākarṇya druhiṇena yayetataḥ || maharṣiṇā dadhīcena dhikkṛto nitarāṃ hi saḥ ||24 || śaptaśca vīkṣamāṇānāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ prajāpatiḥ || mayā ca karṇau pihitau śrutvā tadgarhaṇā giraḥ || 25 || dadhīcinā samaṃ keciddurvāsaḥ pramukhā dvijāḥ || bhavaniṃdāṃ samākarṇya kiyatopi viniryayuḥ ||26|| prāvartata mahāyāgo hṛṣṭapuṣṭamahājanaḥ || tathā draṣṭuṃ na śaknomi tata āgatavāniha ||27 || bhaginyopi ca yā devi tava tatra sabhartṛkāḥ || tāsāṃ gauravamālokya na kiṃcidvaktumutsahe || 28 || iti devī samākarṇya satī dakṣakumārikā || karādakṣau samutsṛjya dadhyau kiṃcitkṣaṇaṃ hṛdi || 29 || uvāca ca bhavatvevaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava eva me || saṃpradhāryeti manasi satī dākṣāyaṇī tataḥ ||4.2.88.30|| drutameva samuttasthau praṇanāma ca śaṃkaram || maulāvaṃjalimādhāya devī devaṃ vyajijñapat ||31|| || devyuvāca || || vijayasvāṃdhakadhvaṃsiṃ tryaṃbaka tripurāṃtaka || caraṇau śaraṇaṃ te me dehyanujñā sadāśiva ||32|| mā niṣedhīḥ prārthayāmi yāsyami pituraṃtikam || uktveti maulimadadhādaṃdhakāri padāṃbuje || 33 || athoktā śaṃbhunā devī mṛḍānyuttiṣṭha bhāmini || kimapūrṇaṃ tavāstyatra vadasau bhāgyasuṃdari || 34 || lakṣmyā api ca saubhāgyaṃ brahmāṇyai kāṃtiruttamā || śacyai nityanavīnatvaṃ bhavatyā dattamīśvari || 35 || tvayā ca śaktimānasmi mahadaiśvaryarakṣaṇe || tvāṃ ca śaktiṃ samāsādya svalīlārūpadhāriṇīm || 36 || etatsṛjāmi pāmyadmi tvallīlāpreritoṃgane || kuto māṃ hātumicchestvaṃ mama vāmārdhadhāriṇi || 37 || śivā śivoditaṃ ceti śrutvāpyāha maheśvaram || jīviteśa vihāya tvāṃ na kvāpi pariyāmyaham ||38|| mano me caraṇadvaṃdve tava sthāsyati niścalam || kratuṃ draṣṭuṃ pituryāmi naikṣi yajño mayā kvacit ||39|| śaṃbhuḥ kātyāyanīvākyāmiti śrutvā tadābravīt || kratustvayā nekṣitaścedāharāmi tataḥ kratum || 4.2.88.40 || macchakti dhāriṇī tvaṃ vā sṛjaivānyāṃ kratukriyām || anyo yajñapumānastu saṃtvanye lokapālakāḥ || 41 || anyānāśu vidhehi tvamṛṣīnārtvijyakarmaṇi || punarjagāda devīti śrutvā śaṃbhorudīritam || 42 || pituryajñotsavo nātha draṣṭavyo'tra mayā dhruvam || dehyanujñāṃ gamiṣyāmi mā me kārṣīrvaconyathā || 43 || kaḥ pratīpayituṃ śaktaśceto vā jalameva vā || nimnāyābhyudyataṃ nātha mādya māṃ pratiṣedhaya || 44 || niśamyeti punaḥ prāha sarvajño bhūtanāyakaḥ || mā yāhi devi māṃ hitvā gatā ca na miliṣyasi || 45 || adya prācīṃ yiyāsuṃ tvāṃ vārayetpaṃguvāsaraḥ || nakṣatraṃ ca tathā jyeṣṭhā tithiśca navamī priye || 46 || adya saptadaśo yogo viyogodya tano'śubhaḥ || dhaniṣṭhārdha samutpanne tava tārādya paṃcamī || || 47 || mā gā devi gatādya tvaṃ nahi drakṣyasi māṃ punaḥ || punardevī babhāṣe sā yadi nāmnāpyahaṃ satī || 48 || tadā tanvaṃtareṇāpi kariṣye tava dāsatām || tato bhavaḥ punaḥ prāha ko vā vārayituṃ prabhuḥ || 49 || parikṣubdhamanovṛttiṃ striyaṃ vā puruṣaṃ tu vā || punarna darśanaṃ devi mayā satyaṃ bravīmyaham ||4.2.88.50|| paraṃ na devi gaṃtavyaṃ mahāmānadhanecchubhiḥ || anāhūta tayā kāṃte mātāpitṛgṛhānapi || 51 || yathā siṃdhugatā siṃdhurna punaḥ parivartate || tathādya gaṃtryā no jātu tavāgamanamiṣyate || 52 || || devyuvāca || || avaśyaṃ yadyahaṃ raktā tava pādābuṃjadvaye || tathā tvameva me nātho bhaviṣyasi bhavāṃtare || 53 || ityuktvā niryayau devī kopāṃdhīkṛtalocanā || yiyāsubhiśca kāryārthaṃ yatkartavyaṃ na tatkṛtam || 54 || na nanāma mahādevaṃ na ca cakre pradakṣiṇam || ataeva hi sā devī na gatā punarāgatā || 55 || apraṇamya maheśānamakṛtvāpi pradakṣiṇam || adyāpi na nivartaṃte gatāḥ prāgvāsarā iva || 56 || tayā caraṇacāriṇyā rājñyā tribhuvaneśituḥ || api tatpāvanaṃ vartma meneti kaṭhinaṃ bahu || 57 || devopi tāṃ satīṃ yāṃtīṃ dṛṣṭvā caraṇacāriṇīm || atīva vivyathe citte gaṇāṃścātha samāhvayat || 58 || gaṇā vimānaṃ nayata manaḥpavanacakriṇam || paṃcāsyāyutasaṃyuktaṃ ratnasānudhvajocchritam || 59 || mahāvātapatākaṃ ca mahābuddhyakṣalakṣitam || narmadālakanaṃdā ca yatreṣādaṃḍatāṃgate || 4.2.88.60 || chatrībhūtau ca yatrastaḥ sūryācaṃdramasāvapi || yasminmakaratuṃḍaṃ ca vārāhīśaktiruttamā || 61 || dhūḥ svayaṃ cāpi gāyatrī rajjavastakṣakādayaḥ || sārathiḥ praṇavo yatra kreṃkāraḥ praṇavadhvaniḥ || 62 || aṃgāni rakṣakā yatra varūthaśchaṃdasāṃ gaṇaḥ || ityājñaptā gaṇāstūrṇaṃ rathaṃ ninyurharājñayā || 63 || devyā sanāthaṃ taṃ kṛtvā vimānaṃ pārṣadā divi || anujagmurmahādevīṃ divyāṃ tejovijṛṃbhiṇīm|| 64 || sā kṣaṇaṃ tryakṣaramaṇī vīkṣya dakṣasabhāṃgaṇam|| nabhoṃ'gaṇādvimānasthānato vegādavātarat || 65 || aviśad yajñavāṭaṃ ca cakitaṃrakṣi vīkṣitā || kṛtamaṃgalanepathyāṃ prasūṃ dṛṣṭvā kirīṭinīm|| 66 || sabhartṛkāśca bhaginīrnavālaṃkṛtiśālinīḥ || sāścaryāśca sagarvāśca sānaṃdāśca sasādhvasāḥ || 67|| aciṃtitā tvanāhūtā vimānāddharavallabhā || kathameṣā pariprāptā kṣaṇamitthaṃ prapaśyatīḥ|| || 68 || asaṃbhāṣyā pitāḥ sarvā gatā dakṣāṃtikaṃ satī || pitrā pṛṣṭā tu mātrāpi bhadraṃ jātaṃ tvadāgame || 69 || || satyuvāca || || yadi bhadraṃ janetarme samāgamanato bhavet || kathaṃ nāhaṃ samāhūtā yathaitā me sahodarāḥ || 4.2.88.70 || || dakṣa uvāca || || ayi kanye mahādhanye hyananye sarvamaṃgale || ayaṃ te na manāgdoṣo doṣa eṣa mamaiva hi || 71 || tādṛgvidhāya yatpatye mayā dattājñabuddhinā || yadahaṃ taṃ samājñāsyamīśvarosau nirīśvaraḥ || 72 || tadā kathamadāsyaṃ tvāṃ tasmai māyāsvarūpiṇaṃ || ahaṃ śivākhyayā tuṣṭo na jāne śivarūpiṇam|| 73 || pitāmahena bahudhā varṇitosau mamāgrataḥ || śaṃkaroyamayaṃ śabhurasau paśupatiḥ śivaḥ || 74 || śrīkaṃṭhosau maheśo'sau sarvajñosau vṛṣadhvajaḥ || asmai kanyāṃ prayaccha tvaṃ mahādevāya dhanvine || 75 || vākyācchatadhṛtestasmāttasmai dattā mayānaghe || na jāne taṃ virūpākṣamukṣagaṃ viṣabhakṣiṇam || 76 || pitṛkānanasaṃvāsaṃ śūlinaṃ ca kapālinam || dvijihvasaṃgasubhagaṃ jalādhāraṃ kapardinam|| 77 || kalaṃkikṛtamauliṃ ca dhūlidhūsaracarcitam || kvacitkaupīnavasanaṃ nagnaṃ vātūlavatkvacit || 78 || kvacicca carmavasanaṃ kvacidbhikṣāṭanapriyam || viṭaṃkabhūtānucaraṃ sthāṇumugraṃ tamoguṇam|| || 79 || rudraṃ raudraparīvāraṃ mahākālavapurdharam || nṛkaroṭīparikaraṃ jātigotravivarjitam || 4.2.88.80 || na samyagvetti taṃ kaścijjānānopi pratāritaḥ || kiṃ bahūktena tanaye samasta nayaśālini || 81 || kva pāṃsulapaṭacchanno mahāśaṃkhavibhūṣaṇaḥ || prabaddhasarpakeyūraḥ pralaṃbita jaṭāsaṭaḥ || 82 || ḍamaḍḍamarukavyagra hastāgraḥ khaṃḍacaṃdrabhṛt || tāṃḍavāḍaṃbararuciḥ sarvāmaṃgala ceṣṭitaḥ ||83|| mṛḍāni saharaḥ kvā'yamadhvaro maṃgalālayaḥ || ataeva samāhūtā neha tvaṃ sarvamaṃgale || 84 || dukūlānyanukūlāni ratnālaṃkṛtayaḥ śubhāḥ || prāgeva dhāritāstetra paśyāgatya gṛhāṇa ca || 85 || iha maṃgalaveśeṣu deveṃdreṣu sa śūladhṛk || kathamarho bhavecceti maṃgale viṣamekṣaṇaḥ || 86 || ityākarṇya satī sādhvī janeturuditaṃ tadā || atyaṃtadūnahṛdayā vaktuṃ samupacakrame ||87|| satyuvāca || || nākarṇitaṃ mayā kiṃcittvayi prabruvati prabho || padadvayīṃ samākarṇya tāṃ ca te kathayāmyaham ||88|| na samyagvetti taṃ kaścijjānānopi pratāritaḥ || etatsamyaktvayākhyāyi kastaṃ vetti sadāśivam|| 89 || tvaṃ tu pratāritaḥ pūrvamadhunāpi pratāritaḥ || kṛtvā tena ca saṃbaṃdhamasaṃbaddhapralāpabhāk || 4.2.88.90 || yādṛśaṃ vakṣitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ tādṛśaṃ yadyamanyathāḥ || kuto māmadadāstasmai yaṃ ca kaśca na veda na || 91 || athavā tena saṃbaṃdhe na heturbhavato matiḥ || tatra heturabhūttāta mama puṇyaikagauravam|| || 92 || athoktvaivaṃ bahutaraṃ tvaṃ janetāsya varṣmaṇaḥ || śrutānena ca dehena patyuḥ parivigarhaṇā || 93 || puraścaraṇamevaitadyadasyaiva visarjanam || suślāghyajanmayā tāvatprāṇitavyaṃ suyoṣitā || yāvajjīvitanāthasyāśravaṇīyā vigarhaṇā || 94 || ityuktvā krodhadīptāgnau mahādevasvarūpiṇi || juhāva dehasamidhaṃ prāṇarodhavidhānataḥ || 95 || tato vivarṇatāṃ prāptāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || nāgnirjajvāla ca tathā yathājyāhutibhiḥ purā || 96 || maṃtrāḥ kuṃṭhitasāmarthyāstatkṣaṇādeva cābhavan || aho mahāniṣṭataraṃ kimetatsamupasthitam ||97|| kecidūcurdvijavarā mithaḥ pariyiyāsavaḥ || mahājhaṃjhānilaḥ prāptaḥ parvatāṃdolanakṣamaḥ || 98|| makhamaṃḍapa bhūstena kṣaṇataḥ sthapuṭīkṛtā || akāṃḍaṃ taḍidāpāto jātobhūdbhūprakapanaḥ ||99|| divaścolkāḥ prapatitāḥ piśācā nṛtyamādadhuḥ || ātāpigṛdhrairupari gagane maṃḍalāyitam || 4.2.88.100 || raveradhastādaśivaṃ śivāstatrāpyarāriṣuḥ || meghārudhiravipuḍbhistatra vṛṣṭiṃ vyadhuḥ parām || 101 || nirghātaniḥsvano bhūmerutthito hṛtprakaṃpanaḥ || divyāyudhāni ca mitho yudhyaṃti smātibhīṣaṇam || 102 || havanīyaṃ mahadravyaṃ dūṣitaṃ kroṣṭubhiḥ śvabhiḥ || cakorāḥ karaṭāstatra viceruryajñamaṃḍape || 103 || śmaśānavāṭavajjāto yajñavāṭaḥ sa vai kṣaṇāta|| yadyatrāvasthitaṃ sarvaṃ tattatraiva pariṣṭhitam || 104 || citranyastamivāsīcca vastujātamaśobhi ca || sthagitā iva saṃvṛttāstatra cakradharādayaḥ || 105 || dakṣopi vadanaglānimavāpya saparicchadaḥ || punaryathākathaṃcicca yajñaṃ prāvartayandvijāḥ ||106|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe satīdehavisarjanaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 88 ||
<4.2.89>
|| skaṃda uvāca || punaḥ sa nārado'gastya devyāḥ prāksamupāgataḥ || tadvṛttāṃtamaśeṣaṃ ca harāyāvedituṃ yayau || 1 || dṛṣṭvā sa nāradaḥ śaṃbhuṃ naṃdinā saha saṃkathām || kāṃcittarjanivinyāsa pūrvaṃ kurvaṃtamānamat || 2 || upāviśacca śailādi visṛṣṭāsanamuttamam || vailakṣyaṃ nāṭayankiṃcitkṣaṇaṃ joṣaṃ samāsthitaḥ ||3|| ākāreṇaiva sarvajñastadvṛttāṃtaṃ viveda ha|| avādīcca muniṃ śaṃbhuḥ kuto maunāvalaṃbanam || 4 || śarāriṇāṃ sthitiriyamutpattipralayātmikā || divyānyapi śarīrāṇi kālādyāṃtyevameva hi || 5 || dṛśyaṃ vinaśvaraṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣādyadanīśvaram || tato'tra citraṃ kiṃ brahmankaṃkālaḥ kālayenna vai ||6|| abhāvino hi bhāvasya bhāvaḥ kvāpi na saṃbhavet || bhāvinopi hi nābhāvastato muhyaṃti no budhāḥ || 7 || śaṃbhūdīritamākarṇya sa itthaṃ munipuṃgavaḥ || proktavānsatyamevaitadyaddevena prabhāṣitam || 8 || avaśyameva yadbhāvyaṃ tadbhūtaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || paraṃ māṃ bādhatetyaṃtaṃ ciṃtaikā cittamāthinī || 9 || nāpacīyeta te kiṃcinnopacīyeta tattvataḥ || avyayatvācca pūrṇatvāddhānivṛddhī kṛtastvayi || 4.2.89.10 || aho varākaḥ saṃsāraḥ kva bhaviṣyatyanīśvaraḥ || ārabhyādyadinaṃ na tvāmarcayiṣyaṃti kepi yat || 11 || yataḥ prajāpatirdakṣo na tvāmāhūtavānkratau || tenādyarīḍhi taṃ dṛṣṭvā devarṣimanujā api|| 12 || tava rīḍhāṃ kariṣyaṃti kimaiśvaryeṇa rīḍhinām || prāptāvaheḍanā loke jitakālabhayā api || athaiśvaryeṇa saṃpannāḥ pratiṣṭhābhājanaṃ kimu || 13 || mahīyasāyuṣā teṣāṃ vasubhirbhūribhiśca kim || ye'bhimānadhanāneha labdharīḍhāḥ padepade || 14 || acetanāśca sāvajñā jīvaṃtopi na kīrtaye || abhimānadhanā dhanyā varaṃ yoṣitsusāsatī || 15 || yā tvadviniṃdāśravaṇāttṛṇīcakre svajīvitam|| ityākarṇya mahākālaḥ samyagjñātvā satīvyayam || 16 || satyaṃ mune satī devī tṛṇīcakre svajīvitam || joṣaṃ sthite munau tatra tanmahākālasādhvasāt ||17|| rudraścātīvarudrobhūdbahukopāgnidīpitaḥ || tatastatkopajādvahnirāvirāsīnmahādyutiḥ ||18|| pratyakṣaḥ pratimākāraḥ kālamṛtyuprakaṃpanaḥ || uvāca ca praṇamyeśaṃ bhuśuṃḍīṃ mahatīṃ dadhat ||19|| ājñāṃ dehi pitaḥ kiṃ te karavai dāsyamuttamam|| brahmāṃḍamekakavalaṃ karavāṇi tvadājñayā || 4.2.89.20 || pibāmi cārṇavānsaptāpyekena culukena vai || rasātalaṃ vā pātālaṃ pātālaṃ vā rasātalam || 21 || tvadājñayā nayāmīśa vinimayya svahelayā || salokapālamiṃdraṃ vā dhṛtvā keśairihānaye || 22 || api vaikuṃṭhanāthaścettatsāhāyyaṃ kariṣyati || tadā taṃ kuṃṭhitāstraṃ ca kariṣyāmi tvadājñayā || 23 || danujā ditijāḥ ke vai varā kāraṇadurbalāḥ || teṣu cotkaṭatāṃ kopi dhatte taṃ praṇihanmyaham || 24 || kālaṃ badhnāmi vā saṃkhye mṛtyorvā mṛtyumarthaye || sthāvareṣu careṣvatra mayi kuddhe raṇāṃgaṇe || 25 || tvadbalena maheśāna na kopi sthairyameṣyati || mamapādatalāghātādetadvai kṣoṇimaṃḍalam || 26 || kadalīdalavadvātādvepate sarasātalam || cūrṇīkaromi dordaṃḍaghātāccaitānkulācalān || 27 || kiṃ bahūktena dehyājñāṃ mamāsādhyaṃ na kiṃcana || tvatpādabalamāsādya kṛtaṃ viddhyadyaciṃtitam || 28 || iti pratijñāṃ tasyeśaḥ śrutvā kṛtamamanyata || kṛtakṛtyamivātyaṃtaṃ taṃ mudā pratyuvāca ca || 29 || mahāvīrosi re bhadra mama sarvagaṇeṣviha || vīrabhadrākhyayā tvaṃ hi prathitiṃ paramāṃ vraja || 4.2.89.30 || kuru me satvaraṃ kāryaṃ dakṣayajñaṃ kṣayaṃ naya || ye tvāṃ tatrāvamanyaṃte tatsāhāyyavidhāyinaḥ || 31 || te tvayāpyavamaṃtavyā vraja putra śubhodaya || ityājñāṃ mūrdhni cādhāya sa tataḥ pārameśvarīm || 32 || haraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya jagmivānatiraṃhasā || tatastadanugāñśaṃbhuḥ svaniḥśvāsasamudgatān || 33 || śatakoṭimitānugrāngaṇānannyānavāsṛjat || te gaṇā vīrabhadraṃ taṃ yāṃtaṃ kecitpurogatāḥ || 34 || kecittadanugā jātāḥ kecittatpārśvagā yayuḥ|| aṃbaraṃ taiḥ samākrāṃtaṃ tejovījita bhāskaraiḥ || 35 || śṛṃgāgrāṇi girīṇāṃ ca kaiścidutpāṭitāni vai || ācūḍamūlāḥ kaiścicca vidhatā vai śiloccayāḥ ||36|| utpāṭya mahato vṛkṣānkecitprāptā makhāṃgaṇam || kaiścidutpāṭitā yūpāḥ kecitkuṃḍānyapūpuran || 37 || maṃḍapaṃ dhvaṃsayāmāsuḥ kecitkrodhoddhurāgaṇāḥ || acīkhananvai vedīśca kecidvai śūlapāṇayaḥ || abhakṣayanhavīṃṣyanye pṛṣadājyaṃ papuḥ pare || 38 || dadhvaṃsurannarāśīṃśca kecitparvatasannibhān || kecidvai pāyasāhārāḥ kecidvai kṣīrapāyinaḥ || || 39 || kecitpakvānnapuṣṭāṃgā yajñapātrāṇyacūrṇayan || amoṭayansrucādaṃḍānkeciddordaṃḍaśālinaḥ || 4.2.89.40 || vyabhajañchakaṭānkecitpaśūnkecidajīgilan || agniṃ nirvāpayāmāsuḥ kecidatyagnitejasaḥ || 41 || svayaṃ paridadhuścānye dukūlāni mudā yutāḥ || jagṛhuḥ kecana purā ratnānāṃ parvataṃ kṛtam || 42 || ekena ca bhago devaḥ paśyaṃścakre vilocanaḥ || pūṣṇo daṃtāvalīmanyaḥ pātayāmāsa kopitaḥ || 43 || yajñaḥ palāyito dṛṣṭaḥ kenacinmṛgarūpadhṛk || śirovirahitaścakre tena cakreṇa dūrataḥ || 44 || ekaḥ sarasvatīṃ yāṃtīṃ dṛṣṭvā nirnāsikāṃ vyadhāt || aditeroṣṭhapuṭakau chinnāvanyena kopinā || 45 || aryamṇo bāhuyugalaṃ tathotpāṭitavānparaḥ|| agnerutpāṭayāmāsa kaścijjihvāṃ prasahya ca ||46|| ciccheda vāyorvṛṣaṇaṃ pārṣadonyaḥ pratāpavān || pāśayitvā yamaṃ kaścitko dharma iti pṛṣṭavān ||47|| yatra dharme maheśo na prathamaṃ paripūjyate || nairṛtaṃ saṃgṛhītvānyaḥ keśeṣvātolyacāsakṛt ||48|| anīśvaraṃ havirbhuktaṃ tvayetyā tāḍayatpadā || kuberamaparo dhṛtvā pādayoradhunodbalāt || 49 || vāmayāmāsa bahuśo bhakṣitā hyadhvarāhutīḥ || ekādaśā'pi ye rudrā lokapālaikapaṃktayaḥ || 4.2.89.50 || rudrākhyā dhāraṇavaśātpramathaiste'vahelitāḥ || varuṇodaramāpīḍya pramathonyo balenahi || 51 || bahirudgirayāmāsa yaddattaṃ ceśavarjjitam || māyūrīṃ tanumāsādya sahasrākṣo mahāmatiḥ || 52 || uḍḍīya girimāśrityacchannaḥ kautukamaikṣata || brāhmaṇānpramathā natvā yātayāteticābruvan || 53 || pramathāḥ kālayāmāsuranyānapi ca yācakān || itthaṃ pramathite yāge pramathaiḥ prathamāgataiḥ || vīrabhadraḥ svataḥ prāptaḥ pramathānīkinī vṛtaḥ ||54|| yajñavāṭaṃ śmaśānābhaṃ dṛṣṭvā taiḥ pramathaiḥ purā || atiśocyāṃ daśāṃ nītaṃ vīrabhadrastato jagau || || 55 || gaṇāḥ paśyata durvṛttaiḥ prārabdhānāṃ ca karmaṇām || anīśvarairavastheyaṃ kuto dveṣo maheśvare || 56 || ye dviṣaṃti mahādevaṃ sarvakarmaikasākṣiṇam || dharmakārye pravṛttāstu te prāpsyaṃtīdṛśaṃ daśām || 57 || kva sa dakṣo durācāraḥ kva ca yajñabhujaḥ surāḥ || dhṛtvā sarvānānayata yāta drutataraṃ gaṇāḥ ||58|| ityājñā vīrabhadrasya prāpya te pramathā drutam|| yāvadyāṃtyagratastāvadṛṣṭaḥ kuddho gadādharaḥ || 59 || tena te pramathāḥ sarve mahābalaparākramāḥ || śuṣkaparṇatṛṇāvasthāṃ prāpitā vātyayeva hi ||4.2.89.60|| atha naṣṭeṣu sarveṣu pramatheṣu harerbhayāt || cukopa vīrabhadraḥ sa pralayānalasaṃnibhaḥ || 61 || dadarśa śārṅgiṇaṃ cāgre svagaṇaiśca pariṣṭutam || caturbhujairasaṃkhyātairjitadaityamahābalaiḥ ||62|| cakribhirgadibhirjuṣṭaṃ khaḍgibhiścāpi śārṅgibhiḥ || vīrabhadrastataḥ prāha dṛṣṭvā taṃ daityasūdanam || 63 || tvaṃ tu yajñapumānatra mahāyajñapravartakaḥ || rakṣitā nijavīryeṇa dakṣasya tryakṣavairiṇaḥ || 64 || kiṃ vā dakṣaṃ samānīya dehi yudhyasva vā mayā || na dāsyasi ca ceddakṣaṃ tatastaṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ || 65 || prāyaśaḥ śaṃbhubhakteṣu yatastvaṃ procyase'graṇīḥ || ekone'bjasahasreprāgdadau netrāṃbujaṃ bhavān || 66 || tuṣṭena śaṃbhunā dattaṃ tubhyaṃ cakraṃ sudarśanam || yatsāhāyyamavāpyājau tvaṃ jayerdanujādhipān || 67 || ityākarṇya vacastasya vīrabhadrasya corjitam|| jijñāsustadbalaṃ viṣṇurvīrabhadramuvāca ha || 68 || tvaṃ śaṃbhoḥ suta deśīyo gaṇānāṃ pravarosyaho || rājādeśamanuprāpya tatopyatibalo mahān || 69 || yosi sosyahamapyatra dakṣarakṣaṇadakṣadhīḥ || paśyāmi tava sāmarthyaṃ kathaṃ dakṣaṃ hariṣyasi || 4.2.89.70 || ityukto vīrabhadraḥ sa tena vai śārṅgadhanvanā || pramathāndṛṣṭibhaṃgyaiva prerayāmāsa saṃgare || 71 || atha taiḥ pramathairviṣṇoranugā gaditā raṇe || ādadānāstṛṇaṃ vaktre ṇāpitāḥ pāśavīṃ daśām || 72 || tatastārkṣyarathaḥ kruddhastvekaikaṃ raṇamūrdhani || sahasreṇasahasreṇa bāṇānāṃ hṛdyatāḍayat || 73 || te bhinnavakṣasaḥ sarve gaṇā rudhiravarṣiṇaḥ || vāsaṃtīṃ kaiṃśukīṃ śobhāṃ pariprāpūraṇājire || 74 || kṣaraṃta iva mātaṃgāḥ sravaṃta iva parvatāḥ || madena dhāturāgeṇa miśraiḥ śuśubhire gaṇāḥ || 75 || tataḥ prahasya gaṇapo'bravīdvai kuṃṭhanāyakam || he śārṅgadhanvañjāne tvāṃ tvaṃ raṇāṃgaṇa paṃḍitaḥ || 76 || paraṃ yudhyasi daityeṃdrairdānaveṃdrairna pārṣadaiḥ || ityuktā vīrabhadreṇa bhuśuṃḍīkalitākare ||77|| gadinā'tha gadā tūrṇaṃ daityeṃdragirireṇukṛt || tataḥ prahatavānvīro bhuśuṃḍyā taṃ gadādharam || 78 || tadaṃgasaṃgamāsādya vidadre śatadhā tayā || kaumodakī prahāreṇa vīrabhadraṃ pratāpinam || 79 || jaghāna vāsudevopi tarasā'jñātavedanam || tataḥ khaṭvāṃgamādāya gadāhastaṃ gadādharam ||4.2.89.80|| ātāḍya savyadordaṃḍe gadāṃ bhūmāvapātayat || kupitoyaṃ madhudveṣī cakreṇātāḍayacca tam || 81 || sa ca cakraṃ samāgacchaddṛṣṭvā sasmāra śaṃkaram || śaṃkarasmaraṇāccakraṃ manāgvakratvamāpya ca || kaṃṭhamāsādyavīrasya samyagjātaṃ sudarśanam ||82|| tena cakreṇa śuśubhe nitarāṃ sa gaṇeśvaraḥ || vīralakṣmyāvṛta iva samare vijayasrajā || 83 || tataḥ sudarśanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatkaṃṭhābharaṇaṃ hariḥ || manāksa cakitaṃ smitvā tato jagrāha naṃdakam || 84 || sanaṃdakaṃ karaṃ tasya prodyataṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ || paśyatāṃ divisiddhānāṃ staṃbhayāmāsa huṃkṛtā || 85 || abhyadhāvacca vegena gṛhītvā śūlamujjvalam || yāvajjighāṃsati hariṃ tāvadākāśavācayā || 86 || vārito gaṇarājaḥ sa mā kārṣīḥ sāhasaṃ tviti || tatastamapahāyāśu vīrabhadro gaṇottamaḥ || 87 || prāpya dakṣaṃ vinadyoccairdhiktvāmīśvaraniṃdakam || yasyedṛgasti saṃpattiryatradevāḥ sahāyinaḥ || sa kathaṃ seśvaraṃ karma na kuryāddakṣatāṃdadhat || 88 || yenāsyena pavitreṇa bhavatā niṃditaḥ śivaḥ || cūrṇayāmi tadāsyaṃ te capeṭābhiḥ samaṃtataḥ ||89|| ityuktvā tasya dakṣasya harapāruṣyabhāṣiṇaḥ || ciccheda vadanaṃ vīraścapeṭaśataghātanaiḥ || || 4.2.89.90 || tatastvaditimukhyānāṃ militānāṃ mahotsave || troṭayāmāsa karṇādīnyaṃgapratyaṃgakāni ca || 91 || veṇīdaṃḍāśca kāsāṃcittenacchinnā mahāruṣā || kāsāṃcicca karāśchinnā kāsāṃcitkartitāstanāḥ || 92 || nāsāpuṭāṃstathānyāsāṃ pāṭayāmāsa pārṣadaḥ || ciccheda cāṃgulīścāpi tathānyāsāṃ śivapriyaḥ|| || 93 || ye ye niniṃdurdeveśaṃ ye ye ca śuśruvustadā || teṣāṃ jihvāśrutīḥ kopādacchinaccākaroddvidhā || 94 || kecidullaṃbitā yūpe pāśayitvā dṛḍhaṃ gale || adhomukhāyai deveśaṃ vihāyāttaṃ mahāhaviḥ || 95 || dvijarājaśca dharmaśca bhṛgumārīcimukhyakāḥ || atyaṃtamapamānasya bhājanaṃ tena kāritāḥ || 96 || ete jāmātarastasya yato dakṣasya durdhiyaḥ || hitvā maheśvaramamūnsopaśyadadhikāñśivāt || 97 || tāni kuṃḍāni te yūpāste staṃbhāḥ sa ca maṃḍapaḥ || tāvedyastāni pātrāṇi tāni havyānyanekadhā || 98 || te ca vai yajñasaṃbhārāste te yajñapravartakāḥ || te rakṣapālāstemaṃtrā vineśurhelayā'khilāḥ || 99 || stokenaiva hi kālena yathardhiḥ paravaṃcanāt || arjitā naśyati kṣipraṃ dakṣasaṃpadgatā'śivā ||4.2.89.100|| nīte mahākratau tena sagaṇenedṛśīṃ daśām || vidhirvidhi vilopācca haraṃ vijñāpya cānayat ||101 || tatra yatra makhaḥ sobhūdīdṛkṣaḥ śivavarjitaḥ || āyātetha mahādeve vīrabhadrotilajjitaḥ || 102 || natvā na kiṃcidavadaddevaḥ sarvamavaitsvayam || prasādya devadeveśaṃ surajyeṣṭho'bravītpunaḥ || 103 || aparādhyapyayaṃ dakṣaḥ saṃprasādyaḥ kṛṣānidhe || yathāpūrvaṃ punaramūnsarvānkāraya śaṃkara || 104 || yathāvidhiḥ pravarteta vaidikaḥ punareva hi || tathājñā dīyatāṃ śaṃbho karmasiddhyati seśvaram||105 || anīśvarāsu sarvāsu kriyāsu parameśvara || evameva bhavatyeva vighrajātāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 106 || vicārato varākoyama dakṣo bhaktatarastava || kurvanyo'nīśvaraṃ karma paradṛṣṭāṃtatāṃ gataḥ || 107 || anyopi yo maheśānaṃ hitvā karma kariṣyati || tasya tatkarmasaṃsiddhirdakṣasyeva bhaviṣyati ||108|| ato na kaścitkiṃcicca kvacitkarma vinā śivam || vidhāsyati niśamyāsya dakṣatyedṛkṣa ceṣṭitam ||109|| vidhīritamiti śrutvā smitvā devo maheśvaraḥ || vīramājñāpayāmāsa yathāpūrvaṃ prakalpaya || 4.2.89.110 || vīrabhadropi tatsarvaṃ śarvājñāṃ pratipadya ca || vinā dakṣasya vadanaṃ yathāpūrvamakalpapayat || 111 || īśvaraṃ ye viniṃdaṃti te mūkāḥ paśavo dhruvam || tato meṣamukhaṃ dakṣaṃ vīrabhadro gaṇo vyadhāt || 112 || devo brahmāṇamāpṛcchaya dharmādgārhasthyataścyutaḥ || sapāpaṃ dohimaprasthaṃ jagāma tapase tataḥ || 113 || anāśramavatā puṃsā yataḥ kālo manāgapi || mudhā kalayitavyo na tasmācchreyaḥ sadā śrama || 114 || ataḥ sa sarvaṃ tapasāṃ phaladātā maheśvaraḥ || tapaścacāra sagaṇo brahmā dakṣaṃ tvaśikṣayat || 115 || haraniṃdā samudbhūta pāpapaṃkaṃ sudustyajam || yadi kṣālayituṃ kāṃkṣā tadā vārāṇasīṃ vraja || 116 || prāpya vārāṇasīṃ puṇyāṃ mahāpāpaughahāriṇīm || kuru liṃgapratiṣṭhāṃ tvaṃ tena śaṃbhuḥ sa tuṣyati || 117 || tuṣṭe maheśvare tuṣṭaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || nānyatra pāpaṃ te gaṃtṛ vinā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 118 || brahmahatyādi pāpānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || proktaṃ na haraniṃdāyāstatra kāśyeva kevalama ||119|| kāśyāṃ liṃgapratiṣṭhāyaiḥ kṛtā'tra sukṛtātmabhiḥ || sarve dharmāḥ kṛtāstaistu ta eva puruṣārthinaḥ || 4.2.89.120 || ityākarṇya vidhervākyaṃ dakṣaḥ prāpyātha satvaram || avimuktaṃ mahākṣetraṃ tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ ||121|| saṃsthāpya liṃgaṃ vidhivalliṃgārādhanatatparaḥ || na vetti liṃgādaparaṃ sa kiṃcijjagatītale || 122 || divāniśaṃ maheśānaṃ pariṣṭauti samarcati || namati dhyāyatīkṣeta dakṣo dakṣaprajāpatiḥ ||123|| ekacittasya dakṣasya dhyāyato liṃgamaiśvaram || samāḥ sahasramagamanmitaṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyayā |||24||| menāṃ yāvatsatī prāpya himācalapativratām || umārūpāti tapasā patiṃ prāpa pinākinam ||125|| tāvatsa dakṣastapasi niścalo liṃgamārcayat || tataḥ kāśīṃ samāsādya saha bhartrā girīṃdrajā ||126|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ niścalahṛdaṃ śivaliṃgārcane ratam || haraṃ vyajijñapaddevī kṣīṇoyaṃ tapasā vibho || 127 || prasādaya kṛpāsiṃdho varaṇainaṃ prajāpatim || ityukto'parṇayā śaṃbhuḥ prāha taṃ dakṣamīśitā || 128 || varaṃ brūhi mahābhāga dāsyāmi manasepsitam || itīśoditamākarṇya praṇamya bahuśo haram ||129|| stutvā nānāvidhaiḥ stotraiḥ prasannaṃ vīkṣya śaṃkaram || provāca devadeveśaṃ yadi deyo varo mama || 4.2.89.130 || tattvadīya padadvaṃdve nirdvaṃdvā bhaktirastu me || idaṃ ca te mahāliṃgaṃ yanmayā'tra pratiṣṭhitam || asmim̐lliṃge tvayā nātha sthātavyaṃ sarvadaiva hi || 131 || | mayāparāddhaṃ yaddeva tatkṣaṃtavyaṃ kṛpānidhe || eta eva varāḥ saṃtu krimanyairuttamairvaraiḥ ||132|| iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ prasannotitarāṃ bhavaḥ || provāca ca yaduktaṃ te tattathāstu na cānyathā || 133|| anyacca te varaṃ dadyāṃ tacchṛṇuṣva prajāpate || yattvayā sthāpitaṃ liṃgametaddakṣeśvarābhidham || 134 || asya saṃsevanātpuṃsāmaparādhasahasrakam|| kṣamiṣyehaṃ na saṃdehastasmātpūjyamidaṃ janaiḥ || 135 || tvaṃ tu liṃgārcanādasmātsarvamānyo bhaviṣyasi || parārdhadvitayaprāṃte tato mokṣamavāpsyasi || 136 || ityuktvā devadeveśastasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yayau || dakṣopi gatavāngehaṃ pariprāptamanorathaḥ || 137|| || skaṃda uvāca || || ityagastya samākhyāto dakṣeśvarasamudbhavaḥ || yaṃ śrutvā mucyate jaṃturaparādha śatairapi |||138|| śrutvākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ dakṣeśvarasamudbhavam || naro na lipyate pāpairaparādhālayopi hi || 139 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe dakṣeśvaraprādurbhāvonāma navāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 89 || ||
<4.2.90>
agastya uvāca || || pārvatīhṛdayānaṃda pārvatīśa samudbhavam || kathayeha yaduddiṣṭaṃ bhavatā prāgaghāpaham || 1 || || skaṃda uvāca || śṛṇvagaste yadā menā himācalapativratā || girīṃdrajāṃ sutāmāha putri tesya maheśituḥ || 2 || kiṃ sthānaṃ vasatirvā kā ko baṃdhurvetsi kiṃcana || prāyo gṛhaṃ na jāmāturasya kopi ca kutracit || 3 || niśamyeti vaco māturatihrīṇā girīṃdrajā || āsādyāvasaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ natvā gaurī vyajijñapat || 4 || mayā śvaśrūgṛhaṃ kāṃta gamyamadya viniścitam || nāthātra naiva vastavyaṃ naya māṃ svaṃ niketanam || 5 || girīṃdrajāgiraṃ śrutvā girīśa iti tattvavit || hitvā himagiriṃ prāpto nijamānaṃdakānanam || 6|| prāpyānaṃdavanaṃ devī paramānaṃdakāraṇam|| vismṛtya pitṛsaṃvāsaṃ jātā cānaṃdarūpiṇī || 7 || atha vijñāpayāṃcakre gaurī giriśamekadā || acchinnānaṃdasaṃdohaḥ kutaḥ kṣetre'tra tadvada || 8 || iti gaurīritaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca pinākadhṛk || paṃcakrośaparīmāṇe kṣetresminmuktisadmani || 9 || tilāṃtaraṃ na devyasti vinā liṃgaṃ hi kutracit || ekaikaṃ parito liṃgaṃ krośaṃ krośaṃ ca yāvaniḥ || 4.2.90.10 || anyatrāpi hi sā devi bhavedānaṃdakāraṇam || atrānaṃdavane devi paramānaṃdajanmani || 11 || paramānaṃdarūpāṇi saṃti liṃgānyanekaśaḥ || caturdaśasu lokeṣu kṛtino ye vasaṃti hi || 12 || taiḥ svanāmneha liṃgāni kṛtvā''pi kṛtakṛtyatā || atra yena mahādevi liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ mama || 13 || vetti tacchreyasaḥ saṃkhyāṃ śeṣopi na viśeṣavit || 14 || paricchedavyatītasyānaṃdasya parakāraṇam || atastvidaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ lirgairbhūyobhiradrije || 15 || niśamyeti mahādevī punaḥ pādau praṇamya ca || dehyanujñāṃ mahādeva liṃgasaṃsthāpanāya me||16|| patyurājñāṃ samāsādya yacchecchreyaḥ pativratā || na tasyāḥ śreyaso hāniḥ saṃvartepi kadācana || 17 || iti prasādya deveśamājñāṃ prāpya maheśituḥ || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ gauryā mahādeva samīpataḥ || 18 || talliṃgadarśanātpuṃsāṃ brahmahatyādipātakam || vilīyeta na saṃdeho dehabaṃdhopi no punaḥ || 19 || tatra liṃge varo datto devadevena yaḥ punaḥ || niśāmaya mune taṃ tu bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 4.2.90.20 || liṃgaṃ yaḥ pārvatīśākhyaṃ kāśyāṃ saṃpūjayiṣyati || taddehāvasitiṃ prāpya kāśīliṃgaṃ bhaviṣyati || 21 || kāśīliṃgatvamāsādya māmevānupravekṣyati || caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ pārvatīśasamarcanāt || 22 || iha saubhāgyamāpnoti paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim || pārvatīśvaramārādhya yoṣidvā puruṣopi vā || 23 || na garbhamāviśedbhūyo bhavetsaubhāgyabhājanam || pārvatīśasya liṃgasya nāmāpi parigṛhṇataḥ ||24|| api janmasahasrasya pāpaṃ kṣayati tatkṣaṇāt || pārvatīśasya māhātmyaṃ yaḥ śroṣyati narottamaḥ || aihikāmuṣmikānkāmānsa prāpsyati mahāmatiḥ || 25 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe pārvatīśavarṇanaṃ nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 90 ||
<4.2.91>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || pārvatīśasya mahimā kathitaste mayānagha || mune niśāmayedānīṃ gaṃgeśvarasamudbhavam || 1 || yaṃ śrutvā yatrakutrāpi gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet || cakrapuṣkariṇītīrthaṃ yadā gaṃgā samāgatā || || 2 || tena dailīpinā sārdhamasminnānaṃdakānane || kṣetraprabhāvamatulaṃ jñātvā śaṃbhuparigrahāt || 3 || smṛtvā liṃgapratiṣṭhāyāḥ kāśyāṃ lokottaraṃ phalam || gaṃgayā sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ viśveśātpūrvataḥ śubham|| 4|| gaṃgeśvarasya liṃgasya kāśyāṃ dṛṣṭiḥ sudurlabhā || tithau daśaharāyāṃ ca yo gaṃgeśaṃ samarcayet || 5 || tasya janmasahasrasya pāpaṃ saṃkṣīyate kṣaṇāt || kalau gaṃgeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ guptaprāyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 6 || tasya saṃdarśanaṃ puṃsāṃ jāyate puṇyahetave || dṛṣṭaṃ gaṃgeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ yena kāśyāṃ sudurlabham || 7|| pratyakṣarūpiṇī gaṃgā tena dṛṣṭā na saṃśayaḥ || kalau sudurlabhā gaṃgā sarvakalmaṣahāriṇī || 8 || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho mitrāvaruṇanaṃdana|| tatopi tiṣye saṃprāpte kāśyatyaṃtaṃ sudurlabhā || 9 || tatopi durlabhaṃ kāśyāṃ liṃgaṃ gaṃgeśvarābhidham || yasya saṃdarśanaṃ puṃsāṃ bhavetpāpakṣayāya vai || 4.2.91.10 || śrutvā gaṃgeśa māhātmyaṃ na naro nirayī bhavet || labhecca puṇyasaṃbhāraṃ ciṃtitaṃ cādhigacchati || 11 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ catutheṃ kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe gaṃgeśvaramahimākhyānaṃ nāmaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||
<4.2.92>
|| skaṃda uvāca || || narmadeśasya māhātmyaṃ kathayāmi mune tava || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa mahāpātakasaṃkṣayaḥ || 1 || asya vārāhakalpasya praveśe munipuṃgavaiḥ || āpṛcchi kā saricchreṣṭhā vada tāṃ tvaṃ mṛkaṃḍaja ||2|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve saṃti nadyaḥ paraḥśatam || sarvā apyaghahāriṇyaḥ sarvā api vṛṣapradāḥ ||3|| sarvābhyopi nadībhyaśca śreṣṭhāḥ sarvāḥ samudragāḥ|| tatopi
