hi mahāśreṣṭhāḥ saritsu sariduttamāḥ || 4 || gaṃgā ca yamunācātha narmadā ca sarasvatī || catuṣṭayamidaṃ puṇyaṃ dhunīṣu munipuṃgavāḥ || 5 || ṛgvedamūrtirgaṃgā syādyamunā ca yajurdhruvam || narmadā sāmamūrtistu syādatharvā sarasvatī || 6 || gaṃgā sarvasaridyoniḥ samudrasyāpi pūraṇī || gaṃgāyā na labhetsāmyaṃ kācidatra saridvarā || || 7 || kiṃtu pūrvaṃ tapastaptvā revayā bahvanehasam || varadānonmukho dhātā prārthitaśceti sattama || 8 || gaṃgā sāmyaṃ vidhe dehi prasannosi yadi prabho || brahmaṇātha tataḥ proktā narmadā smitapūrvakam ||9|| yadi tryakṣasamatvaṃ tu labhyate'nyena kenacit || tadā gaṃgāsamatvaṃ ca labhyate saritānyayā ||4.2.92.10|| puruṣottama tulyaḥ syātpuruṣonyo yadi kvacita || srotasvinī tadā sāmyaṃ labhate gaṃgayā parā || 11 || yadi gaurī samā nārī kvacidanyā bhavediha || anyā dhunīha svardhunyāstadā sāmyamupaiṣyati || 12 || yadi kāśīpurī tulyā bhavedasyā kvacitpurī || tadā svargataraṃgiṇyāḥ sāmyamanyā nadī labhet || 13 || niśamyeti vidhervākyaṃ narmadā sariduttamā || dhāturvaraṃ parityajya prāptā vārāṇasīṃ purīm || 14 || sarvebhyopi hi puṇyebhyaḥ kāśyāṃ liṃgapratiṣṭhiteḥ || aparā na samuddiṣṭā kaiścicchreyaskarī kriyā || 15 || atha sā narmadā puṇyā vidhipūrvāṃ pratiṣṭhitim || vyadhātpilipilātīrthe triviṣiṣṭapasamīpataḥ || 16 || tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ prasannobhū'ttasyai nadyai śubhātmane || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva subhage yattubhyaṃ rocate'naghe || 17 || saridvarā niśamyeti revā prāha maheśvaram || kiṃ vareṇeha deveśa bhṛśaṃ tucchena dhūrjaṭe || || 18 || nirdvaṃdvā tvatpadadvaṃdve bhaktirastu maheśvara || śrutveti nitarāṃ tuṣṭo revāgiramanuttamām || 19 || provāca ca sariccheṣṭhe tvayoktaṃ yattathāstu tat || gṛhāṇa puṇyanilaye vitarāmi varāṃtaram || 4.2.92.20 || yāvaṃtyo dṛṣadaḥ saṃti tava rodhasi narmade || tāvaṃtyo liṃgarūpiṇyo bhaviṣyaṃti varānmama || 21 || anyaṃ ca te varaṃ dadyā tamapyākarṇayottamam || duṣprāpaṃ yajñatapasāṃ rāśibhiḥ paramārthataḥ || 22 || sadyaḥ pāpaharā gaṃgā saptāhena kaliṃdajā || tryahātsarasvatī reve tvaṃ tu darśanamātrataḥ || || 23 || aparaṃ ca varaṃ dadyāṃ narmade darśanāghahe || bhavatyā sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ narmadeśvarasaṃjakam || 24 || yattalliṃgaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ muktiṃ dāsyati śāśvatīma || asya liṃgasya ye bhaktāstāndṛṣṭvā sūryanaṃdanaḥ || 25 || praṇamiṣyaṃti yatnena mahāśreyobhivṛddhaye || saṃti liṃgānyanekāni kāśyāṃ devi padepade || 26 || paraṃ hi narmadeśasya mahimā kopi cādbhutaḥ || ityuktvā devadeveśastasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yayau || 27 || narmadāpi prahṛṣṭāsītpāvitryaṃ prāpya cādbhutam || svadeśaṃ ca pariprāptā dṛṣṭamātrāghahāriṇī || 28 || vākyaṃ mṛkaṃḍajamunestepi śrutvā munīśvarāḥ || prahṛṣṭacetaso jātāścakruḥ svaṃ svaṃ tato hitam || 29 || || skaṃda uvāca || || narmadeśasya māhātmyaṃ śrutvā bhaktiyuto naraḥ || pāpakaṃcukamutsṛjya prāpsyati jñānamuttamam || 4.2.92.30 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe narmadeśvarākhyānaṃ nāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 92 ||
<4.2.93>
|| agastya uvāca || || narmadeśasya māhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam || idānīṃ kathaya skaṃda satīśvara samudbhavam || 1 || skaṃda uvāca || || mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhūta kathayāmi kathāṃ śṛṇu || yathā satīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāmāvirbabhūva ha || 2 || purā tatāpa sumahattapaḥ śatadhṛtirmune || tapasā tena deveśaḥ saṃtuṣṭo varado'bhavat || 3 || uvāca cāpi brahmāṇaṃ nitarāṃ brāhmaṇapriyaḥ || sarvajñanātho lokātmā varaṃ varaya lokakṛt || 4 || || brahmovāca || || yadi prasanno deveśa varaṃ dāsyasi vāṃchitam || tadā tvaṃ me bhava suto devī dakṣasutā'stu ca || 5 || iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ sarvado brahmaṇo varam || smitvā devīmukhaṃ vīkṣya provāca caturānanam || 6 || brahmaṃstvadvāṃchitaṃ bhūyātkimadeyaṃ pitāmaha || ityuktvā brahmaṇo bhālādāvirāsīcchaśāṃkabhṛt || 7 || rudansa uttānaśayo brahmaṇo mukhamaikṣata || tato brahmāpi taṃ bālaṃ rudaṃtaṃ pravilokya ca || 8 || kiṃ māṃ janakamāpyāpi tvaṃ rodiṣi muhurmuhuḥ || śrutveti pṛthukaḥ prāha yathoktaṃ parameṣṭhinā || 9 || nāmne rodimi me sraṣṭurnāma dehi pitāmaha || rodanādrudra ityākhyāṃ samāyā ḍiṃbhako labhat ||4.2.93.10|| || agastya uvāca || || arbhakatvaṃ gatopīśaḥ kiṃ ruroda ṣaḍānana || yadi vetsi tadācakṣva mahatkautūhalaṃ hi me || 11 || || skaṃda uvāca || || sarvajñasya kumāratvātkiṃcitkiṃcidavaimyaham || rodane kāraṇaṃ vacmi śṛṇu kuṃbhasamudbhava || 12 || manasīti vicārobhūddevasya paramātmanaḥ || buddhivaibhavamasyāho vīkṣituṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||13|| satyalokādhināthasya caturāsyasya vedhasaḥ || ityānaṃdātsamudbhūto vāṣpapūro maheśituḥ ||14|| || agastya uvāca || || kiṃ buddhivaibhavaṃ dhātuḥ śaṃbhunā manasīkṣitam | yenānaṃdāśru saṃbhāro bālyepyabhavadīśituḥ ||15|| etatkathaya me prājña sarvajñānaṃdavardhana || śrutvāgastyuditaṃ vākyaṃ tārakāriruvāca ha ||16|| deve na manasi dhyātamiti kuṃbhajane mune || vināpatyaṃ janetāraṃ ka uddhartumiha prabhuḥ || 17 || eko manorathaścāyaṃ dvitīyoyaṃ suniścitam || apatyatvaṃ gate cāsminsmarturutpattihāriṇi || 18 || kṣaṇaṃkṣaṇaṃ samālokyamaṃgasparśe kṣaṇaṃkṣaṇam || ekaśayyāsanāhāraṃ lapsyate'nena kṣaṇekṣaṇe || 19 || yoyaṃ na gocaraḥ kvāpi vāṇīmanasayorapi || sa me'patyatvamāsādya kiṃ na dāsyati ciṃtitam || 4.2.93.20 || yo'muṃ sakṛtspṛśejjaṃturyomuṃ paśyetsakṛnmudā | na sa bhūyobhijāyeta bhaveccānaṃdameduraḥ || 21 || gṛhakrīḍanakaṃ me sau yadi bhūyātkathaṃcana || tadāparasya saukhyasya nidhānaṃ syāmasaṃśayam || 22 || vidheḥ samīhitaṃ ceti nūnaṃ jñātvā sa sarvavit || ānaṃdavāṣpakalitaṃ cakṣustrayamadīdharat || 23 || śrutvaityagastiḥ skaṃdasya bhāṣitaṃ paryamūmudat || nanāma cāṃghrī provāca jayasarvajñanaṃdana || 24 || vidherapi manojñātaṃ śaṃbhorapi manogatam | | samyakcittaṃ tvayā jñātaṃ namastubhyaṃ cidātmane || 25 || skaṃdopi nitarāṃ tuṣṭaḥśroturānaṃdadarśanāt || dhanyosyagastya dhanyosi śrotuṃ jānāsi tattvataḥ || 26 || na me śramo vṛthā jāto bruvataste puraḥ kathām || ityagastiṃ samābhāṣya punaḥ prāha ṣaḍānanaḥ || 27 | | deve rudratvamāpanne devī dakṣasutābhavat || sāpi taptvā tapastīvraṃ satī kāśyāṃ varārthinī || 28 || dadarśa liṃgarūpeṇa prādurbhūtaṃ haraṃ puraḥ || alaṃ taptvā mahādevi proktavaṃtamiti sphuṭam || 21 || idaṃ satīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati .|| yathā manorathaste'tra phalito dakṣakanyake || 4.2.93.30 || tathaitalliṃgamārādhyānyasyāpi hi phaliṣyati || kumārī prāpsyati patiṃ manasopi samucchritam || 31 || etalliṃgaṃ samārādhya kumāropi varāṃganām || yasya yasya hi yaḥ kāmastasya tasya hi sa dhruvam || 32 || bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ satīśvarasamarcagāt || satīśvaraṃ samabhyarcya yo yo yaṃ yaṃ samīhate || 33 || tasya tasya sa sa kṣipraṃ bhaviṣyati manorathaḥ || 34 || itoṣṭame ca divase tvajjanetā prajāpatiḥ || mahyaṃ dāsyati kanyāṃ tvāṃ saphalaste manorathaḥ || ityuktvā devadeveśastatraivāṃtarhitobhavat || 35 | | sāpi svabhavanaṃ yātā satī dākṣāyaṇī mudā | | pitāpi tasmai prādāttāṃ rudrāya divaseṣṭame || 36 || || skaṃda uvāva || || itthaṃ satīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāṃ prādurabhūnmune || smaraṇādapi liṃgaṃ ca dadyātsattvaguṇaṃ param || 37 || ratneśātpūrvato bhāge dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ satīśvaram | | mucyate pātakaiḥ sadyaḥ kramājjñānaṃ ca viṃdati || 38 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe satīśvaraprādurbhāvo nāma trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 93 || || cha ||
<4.2.94>
|| skaṃda uvāca | | || anyānyapi ca liṃgāni kathayāmi mahāmune || amṛteśamukhādīni yannāmāpyamṛtapradam || 1 || purā sanāru nāmāsīnmuniratra gṛhāśramī || brahmayajñarato nityaṃ nityaṃ cātithidaivataḥ || 2 || liṃgapūjārato nityaṃ nityaṃ tīrthāpratigrahī || tasyarṣerabhavatputraḥ sanārorupajaṃghaniḥ ||3|| sa kadācidgatoraṇyaṃ tatra daṣṭaḥ pṛdākunā || atha tatsa vayobhiśca sa ānītaḥ svamāśramam || 4 || sanāruṇā samucchvasya nītaḥ sa upajaṃghaniḥ || mahāśmaśānabhūbhāgaṃ svargadvārasamīpataḥ || 5 || tatrāsīcchrīphalākāraṃ liṃgamekaṃ suguptavat || nidhāya tatra taṃ yāvacchavaṃ saṃciṃtayetsudhīḥ || 6 || sarpadaṣṭasya saṃskāraḥ kathaṃ bhavati ceti vai || tāvatsa jīvannuttasthau suptavaccaupajaṃghaniḥ || 7 || atha taṃ vīkṣya sa muniḥ sanārurupajaṃghanim || punaḥ prāṇitasaṃpannaṃ vismayaṃ prāptavānparam || 8 || prāṇitavye'tra ko heturmacchiśorupajaṃghaneḥ || kṣetrādbahirahiryaṃ hi daṣṭā naiṣītparāsu tām || 9 || iti yāvatsa saṃdhatte dhiyaṃ tajjīvitaikikām|| tāvatpipīlikā tvekā mṛtaṃ kvāpi pipīlikam || 4.2.94.10 || ānināya ca tatraiva sopya nannirgatastataḥ || atha vijñāya sa munistattvaṃ jīvitasūcitam|| 11 || mṛdu hastatalenaiva yāvatkhanati vai muniḥ || tāvacchrīphalamātraṃ hi liṃgaṃ tena samīkṣitam || 12 || sanāruṇātha talliṃgaṃ tena tatra samarcitam || cirakālīna liṃgasya kṛtaṃ nāmāpi sānvayam || 13 || amṛteśvaranāmedaṃ liṃgamānaṃdakānane || etalliṃgasya saṃsparśādamṛtatvaṃ labheddhruvam || 14 || amṛteśaṃ samabhyarcya jīvatputraḥ sa vai muniḥ|| svāspadaṃ samanuprāpto dṛṣṭaāścaryavajjanaiḥ || 15 || tadāprabhṛti talliṃgamamṛteśaṃ munīśvara || kāśyāṃ siddhipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ kalau guptaṃ bhavetpunaḥ || 16 || amṛteśvara saṃsparśānmṛtā jīvaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || amṛtatvaṃ bhajaṃte'tra jīvaṃtaḥ sparśamātrataḥ || 37 || amṛteśa samaṃ liṃgaṃ nāsti kvāpi mahītale|| talliṃgaṃ śaṃbhunā tiṣye kṛtaṃ guptaṃ prayatnataḥ || 18 || amṛteśvara nāmāpi ye kāśyāṃ parigṛhṇate || na teṣāmupasargotthaṃ bhayaṃ kvāpi bhaviṣyati||19|| mune'nyacca mahāliṃgaṃ karuṇeśvarasaṃjñitam|| mokṣadvāra samīpe tu mokṣadvāreśvarāgrataḥ ||4.2.94.20|| darśanāttasya liṃgasya mahākāruṇikasya vai || na kṣetrānnirgamo jātu bahirbhavati kasyacit || 21 || snātavyaṃ maṇikarṇyāṃ ca draṣṭavyaḥ karuṇeśvaraḥ || kṣetropasargajā bhītirhātavyā parayā mudā || 22 || somavāsaramāsādya ekabhaktavrataṃ caret || yaṣṭavyaḥ karuṇāpuṣpairvratinā karuṇeśvaraḥ || 23 || tena vratena saṃtuṣṭaḥ karuṇeśaḥ kadācana || na taṃ kṣetrādbahiḥ kuryāttasmātkāryaṃ vrataṃ tvidam || 24 || tatpatraistatphalairvāpi saṃpūjyaḥ karuṇeśvaraḥ || yo na jānāti talliṃgaṃ samyagjñānavivarjitaḥ || 25 || tenārcyaḥ karuṇāvṛkṣo deveśaḥ prīyatāmiti || yo varṣaṃ somavārasya vrataṃ kuryāditi dvijaḥ || 26 || prasannaḥ karuṇeśotra tasya dāsyati vāṃchitam || draṣṭavyaḥ karuṇeśotra kāśyāṃ yatnena mānavaiḥ || 27 || iti te karuṇeśasya mahimokto mahattaraḥ || yaṃ śrutvā nopasargotthaṃ bhayaṃ kāśyāṃ bhaviṣyati || 28 || mokṣadvāreśvaraṃ caiva svargadvoreśvaraṃ tathā || ubhau kāśyāṃ naro dṛṣṭvā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca viṃdati || 29 || jyotīrūpeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kāśyāmanyatprakāśate || tasya saṃpūjanādbhaktā jyotīrūpā bhavaṃti hi || 4.2.94.30 || cakrapuṣkariṇī tīre jyotīrūpeśvaraṃ param || samabhyarcyāpnuyānmartyo jyotīrūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 31 || yadā bhāgīrathī gaṃgā tatra prāptā saridvarā || tadārabhyārcayennityaṃ talliṃgaṃ svardhunī mudā || 32 || purā viṣṇau tapatyatra talliṃgaṃ svayameva hi || tatrāvirāsīttejasvi tena kṣetramidaṃ śubham || 33 || cakrapuṣkariṇī tīre jyotīrūpeśvaraṃ tadā || dūrasthopīha yo dhyāyettasya siddhiradūrataḥ||34|| eteṣvapi ca liṃgeṣu caturdaśasu sattama|| liṃgāṣṭakaṃ mahāvīryaṃ karmabījadavānalam || 35 || oṃkārādīni liṃgāni yānyuktāni caturdaśa || tathā dakṣeśvarādīni liṃgānyaṣṭau mahāṃti ca ||36|| śailaiśādīni liṃgāni tathā yāni caturdaśa || punaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadetāni kṣetrasaṃsiddhi hetave || 37 || ṣadatriṃśattattvarūposau ligeṣveṣu sadāśivaḥ || asminkṣetre vasannityaṃ tārakaṃ jñānamādiśet || 38 || kṣetrasya tattvametaddhi ṣaṭtriṃśalliṃgarūpyaho || eteṣāṃ bhajanātpuṃsāṃ na bhaveddurgatiḥ kvacit ||39|| mune rahasyabhūtāni rligānyetāni niścitam|| etalliṃgaprabhāvācca muktiratra suniścitā || 4.2.94.40 || mokṣakṣetramiṃdaṃ kāśī liṃgairetairmehāmate || etānyanyāni siddhāni saṃbhavaṃti yugeyuge || 41 || ānaṃdakānanaṃ śaṃbhoḥ kṣetrametadanādimat|| atra saṃsthitimāpannā muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ || 42 || yogasiddhirihāstyeva tapaḥsiddhirihaiva hi || vratasiddhirmaṃtrasiddhistīrthasiddhiḥ suniścitam || 43 || siddhyaṣṭakaṃ tu yatproktamaṇimādi mahattaram || tajjanmabhūmireṣaiva śaṃbhorānaṃdavāṭikā ||44|| nirvāṇalakṣmyāḥ sadanametadānaṃdakānanam || etatprāpya na moktavyaṃ puṇyaiḥ saṃsārabhīruṇā || 45 || ayameva mahālābha idameva paraṃ tapaḥ || etadeva mahatpuṇyaṃ labdhā vārāṇasīha yat || || 46 || avaśyaṃ janmino mṛtyuryatra kutra bhaviṣyati || karmānusāriṇī labhyā gatiḥ paścācchubhāśubhā || 47 || mṛtyuṃ vijñāya niyataṃ gatikarmānusāriṇīm || avaśyaṃ kāśikā sevyā sarvakarmanivāriṇī || 48 || mānuṣyaṃ prāpya yaṃ mūḍhā nimeṣamitajīvitam || na sevaṃte purīṃ kāśīṃ te muṣṭā maṃdabuddhayaḥ || 49 || durlabhaṃ janma mānuṣyaṃ durlabhā kāśikāpurī || ubhayoḥ saṃgamāsādya muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ || 4.2.94.50 || kva ca tādṛktapāṃsīha kva tādṛgyoga uttamaḥ || yādṛgbhiḥ prāpyate muktiḥ kāśyāṃ mokṣottamottamaḥ || 51 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyapūrvaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || na kāśī sadṛśī muktyai bhūmiranyā mahītale|| 52 || viśveśo muktido nityaṃ muktyai cottaravāhinī || ānaṃdakānane muktirmuktirnānyatra kutracit || 53 || eka eva hi viśveśo muktido nānya eva hi || sa eva kāśīṃ prāpayya muktiṃ yacchati nānyataḥ || 54 || sāyujyamuktiratraiva sānnidhyādirathānyataḥ || sulabhā sāpi no nūnaṃ kāśyāṃ mokṣosti helayā ||55|| || skaṃda uvāca || || śṛṇvagastya mahābhāga bhaviṣyaṃ kathayāmyaham || kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāso'kathayadyanmahadvacaḥ || niściketumanāḥ paścādyatkariṣyati tacchṛṇu ||56|| || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe'mṛteśādiliṃgaprādurbhāvonāma caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 94 ||
<4.2.95>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu sūta mahābuddhe yathā skaṃdena bhāṣitam || bhaviṣyaṃ mama tasyāgre kuṃbhayone mahāmate || 1 || || skaṃda uvāca || || niśāmaya mahābhāga tvaṃ maitrāvaruṇe mune || pārāśaryo munivaro yathā mohamupaiṣyati || 2 || vyasya vedānmahābuddhirnānā śākhā prabhedataḥ || aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni sūtādīnparipāṭhya ca || 3 || śrutismṛtipurāṇānāṃ rahasyaṃ yastvacīkarat || mahābhāratasaṃjñaṃ ca sarvalokamanoharam ||4|| sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvaśāṃtikaraṃ param || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa brahmahatyā vinaśyati ||5|| ekadā sa muniḥ śrīmānparyaṭanpṛthivītale || saṃprāpto naimiṣāraṇyaṃ yatra saṃti munīśvarāḥ || 6 || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi śaunakādyāstapodhanāḥ ||. tripuṃḍritamahābhālā lasadrudrākṣamālinaḥ || 7 || vibhūtidhāriṇo bhaktyā rudrasūktajapapriyān || liṃgārādhanasaṃsaktāñchivanāmakṛtādarān || 8 || eka eva hi viśveśo muktido nānya eva hi || iti bruvāṇānsatataṃ pariniścitamānasān || 9 || vilokya sa munirvyāsastāsarvāngiriśātmanaḥ || utkṣipya tarjanīmuccaiḥ provācedaṃ vacaḥ punaḥ || 4.2.95.10 || parinirmathya vāgjālaṃ suniścityāsakṛdbahu || idamekaṃ parijñātaṃ sevyaḥ sarveśvaro hariḥ || 11 || vede rāmāyaṇe caiva purāṇeṣu ca bhārate || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu harireko'tra nāparaḥ || 12 || satyaṃ satyaṃ trisatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ na mṛṣā punaḥ || na vedādaparaṃ śāstraṃ na devocyutataḥ paraḥ || 13 || lakṣmīśaḥ sarvado nānyo lakṣmīśopyapavargadaḥ || eka eva hi lakṣmīśastato dhyeyo na cāparaḥ || 14 || bhuktermukterihānyatra nānyo dātā janārdanāt|| tasmāccaturbhujo nityaṃ sevanīyaḥ sukhepsubhiḥ || 15 || vihāya keśavādanyaṃ ye sevaṃtelpamedhasaḥ || saṃsāracakre gahane te viśaṃti punaḥpunaḥ || 16 || eka eva hi sarveśo hṛṣīkeśaḥ parātparaḥ || taṃ sevamānaḥ satataṃ sevyastrijagatāṃ bhavet||17|| eko dharmaprado viṣṇustveko bahvarthado hariḥ || ekaḥ kāmapradaścakrī tveko mokṣapradocyutaḥ || 18 || śārṅgiṇaṃ ye parityajya devamanyamupāsate || te sadbhiśca bahiṣkāryā vedahīnā yathā dvijāḥ || 19 || śrutveti vākyaṃ vyāsasya naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ|| pravepamānahṛdayāḥ pariprocuridaṃ vacaḥ || 4.2.95.20 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || pārāśarya mune mānyastvamasmākaṃ mahāmate || yato vedāstvayā vyastāḥ purāṇānyapi vetti yat || 21 || yataśca kartā tvamasi mahato bhāratasya vai || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ viniścayakṛto dhruvam || 22 || tattvajñaḥ koparaścātra tvattaḥ satyavatīsuta|| bhavatā yatpratijñātaṃ niścityokṣipyatarjanīm || 23 || asminmāṇavakāstatra pariśraddadhate nahi || pratijñā tasya vacasastava śraddhā bhavettadā ||24|| yadā''naṃdavane śaṃbhoḥ pratijānāsi vai vacaḥ ||25|| gaccha vārāṇasīṃ vyāsa yatra viśveśvaraḥ svayam || na tatra yugadharmosti na ca lagnā vasuṃdharā ||26|| iti śrutvā munirvyāsaḥ kiṃcitkupitavaddhṛdi || jagāma tūrṇaṃ sahitaḥ svaśiṣyairayutonmitaiḥ || 27 || prāpya vārāṇasīṃ vyāsaḥ snātvā paṃcanade hrade || śrīmanmādhavamabhyarcya yayau pādodakaṃ tataḥ || 28 || tatra snānādikaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā caivādikeśavam || paṃcarātraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vaiṣṇavairabhinaṃditaḥ || 29 || agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ śaṃkhairvādyamānaiḥ pramoditaḥ || jayaviṣṇo hṛṣīkeśa goviṃda madhusūdana || 4.2.95.30 || acyutānaṃtavaikuṃṭha mādhavopeṃdrakeśava || trivikrama gadāpāṇe śārṅgapāṇe janārdana || 31 || śrīvatsavakṣaḥ śrīkāṃta pītāṃbara murāṃtaka || kaiṭabhāre balidhvaṃsinkaṃsāre keśisūdana || || 32 || nārāyaṇāsuraripo kṛṣṇa śaure caturbhuja || devakīhṛdayānaṃda yaśodānaṃdavardhana || 33 || puṃḍarīkākṣa daityāre dāmodara balapriya || balārātistuta hare vāsudeva vasuprada || 34 || viṣvakcamūstārkṣya rathavanamālinnarottama || adhokṣaja kṣamādhāra padmanābha jaleśaya ||35|| nṛsiṃha yajñavārāha gopagopālavallabha || gopīpate guṇātīta garuḍadhvaja gotrabhṛt || 36 || jaya cāṇūramathana jaya trailokyarakṣaṇa || jayānādya jayānaṃda jaya nīlotpaladyute || 37 || kaustubhodbhūṣitoraska pūtanādhātuśoṣaṇa || rakṣarakṣa jagadrakṣāmaṇe narakahāraka || 38 || sahasraśīrṣapuruṣa puruhūta sukhaprada || yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyaṃ vai tatraikaḥ puruṣo bhavān || 39 || ityādi nāmamālābhiḥ saṃstuvanvanamālinam || svacchaṃdalīlayā gāyannṛtyaṃśca parayā mudā || 4.2.95.40 || vyāso viśveśabhavanaṃ samāyātaḥ suhṛṣṭavat || jñānavāpī purobhāge mahābhāgavataiḥ saha || 41 || virājamānasatkaṃṭhastulasīvaradāmabhiḥ || svayaṃ tāladharo jātaḥ svayaṃ jātaḥ sunartakaḥ ||42|| veṇuvādanatattvajñaḥ svayaṃ śrutidharobhavat || nṛtyaṃ parisamāpyetthaṃ vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ || 43 || punarūrdhvabhujaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ śiṣyamadhyagaḥ || punaḥ papāṭha tāneva ślokāngāyannivoccakaiḥ || 44 || parinirmathya vāgjālaṃ suniścityāsakṛdbahu || idamekaṃ parijñātaṃ sevyaḥ sarveśvaro hariḥ || 45 || ityādi ślokasaṃghātaṃ svapratijñā prabodhakam|| yāvatpaṭhati sa vyāsaḥ savyamutkṣipya vai bhujam || 46 || tastaṃbha tāvattadbāhuṃ sa śailādiḥ svalīlayā || vākstaṃbhaścāpi tasyāsīnmunervyāsasya sanmuneḥ || 47 || tato guptaṃ samāgamya viṣṇurvyāsamabhāṣata || aparāddhaṃ mahaccātra bhavatā vyāsa niścitam || 48 || tavaitadaparādhena bhītirmepi mahattarā || eka eva hi viśveśo dvitīyo nāsti kaścana || 49 || tatprasādādahaṃ cakrī lakṣmīśastatprabhāvataḥ || trailokyarakṣāsāmarthyaṃ dattaṃ tenaiva śaṃbhunā ||4.2.95.50|| tadbhaktyā paramaiśvaryaṃ mayā labdhaṃ varāttataḥ || idānīṃ stuhi taṃ śaṃbhuṃ yadi me śubhamicchasi ||51|| anyadāpi na vai kāryā bhavatā śemuṣīdṛśī || pārāśarya iti śrutvā saṃjñayā vyājahāra ha ||52|| bhujastaṃbhaḥ kṛtastena naṃdinā dṛṣṭimātrataḥ || vākstaṃbhastadbhayājjātaḥ spṛśa me kaṃṭhakaṃdalīm|| 53 || yathā stotuṃ bhavānīśa prabhavābhi bhavāṃtakama || saṃspṛśya viṣṇustatkaṃṭhaṃ guptameva jagāma ha ||54|| tataḥ satyavatīsūnustathā staṃbhitadorlataḥ|| prārabdhavānmaheśānaṃ parituṣṭotumudāradhīḥ || || 55 || || vyāsa uvāca || || eko rudro na dvitīyo yatastadbrahmaivaikaṃ neha nānāsti kiṃcit || yadyapyanyaḥ kopi vā kutracidvā vyācaṣṭāṃ tadyasya śaktirmadagre || 26 || yaḥ kṣīrābdhermaṃdarāghātajāto jvālāmālī kālakūṭoti bhīmaḥ || taṃ soḍhuṃ vā ko paro'bhūnmaheśādyatkīlābhiḥ kṛṣṇatāmāpa viṣṇuḥ || 57 || yadvāṇobhūcchrīpatiryasya yaṃtā lokeśo yatsyaṃdanaṃ bhūḥ samastā || vāhā vedā yasya yeneṣupātāddagdhā grāmāstraipurāstatsamaḥ kaḥ || 58 || yaṃ kadarpo vīkṣamāṇaḥ samānaṃ devairanyairbhasmajātaḥ svayaṃ hi || pauṣpairbāṇaiḥ sarvaviśvaikajetā ko vā stutyaḥ kāmajetustatonyaḥ || 59 || yaṃ vai vedo veda no naiva viṣṇurnovā vedhā no mano naiva vāṇī || taṃ deveśaṃ mādṛśaḥ kolpamedhā yāthātmyādvai vettyaho viśvanātham || 4.2.95.60 || yasminsarvaṃ yastu sarvatra sarvo yo vai kartā yo'vitā yo'pahartā || no yasyādiryaḥ samastādireko no yasyāṃto yoṃtakṛttaṃ natosmi || 61 || yasyaikākhyā vājimedhena tulyā yasyā na tyā caikayālpeṃdralakṣmīḥ || yasya stutyā labhyate satyaloko yasyārcāto mokṣalakṣmīradūrā ||62|| nānyaṃ devaṃ vedmyahaṃ śrīmaheśānnānyaṃ devaṃ staumi śaṃbhorṛte'ham || nānyaṃ devaṃ vā namāmi trinetrātsatyaṃ satyaṃ satyametanmṛṣā na || 63 || itthaṃ yāvatstauti śaṃbhuṃ maharṣistāvannaṃdī śāṃbhavāddṛkprasādāt || taddoḥ staṃbhaṃ tyaktavāṃścābabhāṣe smāyaṃsmāyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo namo vaḥ || 64 || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || idaṃ stavaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ vyāsa te parikīrtitam || yaḥ paṭhiṣyati medhāvī tasya tuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ ||65|| vyāsāṣṭakamidaṃ prātaḥ paṭhitavyaṃ prayatnataḥ || duḥsvapnapāpaśamanaṃ śivasānnidhyakārakam || 66 || mātṛhā pitṛhā vāpi goghno bālaghra eva vā || surāpī svarṇahṛdvāpi niṣpāpo syāḥ stuterjapāt || 67 || skaṃda uvāca || || pārāśaryastadārabhya śaṃbhubhaktiparobhavat || liṃgaṃ vyāseśvaraṃ sthāpya ghaṃṭākarṇa hradāgrataḥ ||68|| vibhūtibhūṣaṇo nityaṃ nityarudrākṣabhūṣaṇaḥ || rudrasūktaparo nityaṃ nityaṃ liṃgārcakobhavat || 69 || sa kṛtvā kṣetrasaṃnyāsaṃ tyajennādyāpi kāśikām || tattvaṃ kṣetrasya vijñāya nirvāṇapadadāyinaḥ || 4.2.95.70 || ghaṃṭākarṇahrade snātvā dṛṣṭvā vyāseśvaraṃ naraḥ || yatrakutra mṛto vāpi vārāṇasyāṃ mṛto bhavet || 71 || kāśyāṃ vyāseśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayitvā narottamaḥ || na jñānādbhraśyate kvāpi pātakairnābhibhūyate || 72 || vyāseśvarasya ye bhaktā na teṣāṃ kalikālataḥ || na pāpato bhayaṃ kvāpi na ca kṣetropasargataḥ || 73 || vyāseśvaraḥ prayatnena draṣṭavyaḥ kāśivāsibhiḥ || ghaṃṭākarṇakṛtasnānaiḥ kṣetrapātakabhīrubhiḥ || 74 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe vyāsabhujastaṃbhonāma paṃcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 95 ||
<4.2.96>
|| agastya uvāca || || kṛpṇadvaipāyanaḥ skaṃda śaṃbhubhaktiparo yadi || yadi kṣetrarahasyajñaḥ kṣetrasaṃnyāsakṛdyadi || 1 || tathā dṛṣṭaprabhāvaścettathā cejjñānināṃ varaḥ || purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kathaṃ kila śapiṣyati || 2 || || skaṃda uvāca || || satyametattvayā pṛcchi kathayāmi mune śṛṇu || tasya vyāsasya caritaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ tvayi pṛcchati || 3 || yadārabhya munestasya naṃdī staṃbhitavānbhujam || tadārabhya maheśānaṃ saṃstauti paramādṛtaḥ || 4 || kāśyāṃ tīrthānyanekāni kāśyāṃ ligānyanekaśaḥ || tathāpi sevyo viśveśaḥ snātavyā maṇikarṇikā ||5 || liṃgeṣveko hi viśveśastīrtheṣu maṇikarṇikā || iti saṃvyāharanvyāsastaddvayaṃ bahu manyate || 6 || tyaktvā sa bahu vāgjālaṃ prātaḥ snātvā dinedine || nirvāṇamaṃḍape vakti mahimānaṃ maheśituḥ || 7 || śiṣyāṇāṃ purato nityaṃ kṣetrasya mahimā mahān || vyākhyāyate mudā tena vyāsena paramarṣiṇā || 8 || atra yatkriyate kṣetre śubhaṃ vā'śubhameva vā || saṃvartepi na tasyāṃtastasmācchreyaḥ samācaret || 9 || kṣetrasiddhiṃ samīhaṃte ye cātra kṛtino janāḥ || yāvajjīvaṃ na taistyājyā sudhībhirmaṇikarṇikā || 4.2.96.10 || cakrapuṣkariṇī tīrthe snātavyaṃ prativāsaram || puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalaistoyairarcyo viśveśvaraḥ sadā || 11 || svavarṇāśramadharmaśca tyaktavyo na manāgapi || pratyahaṃ kṣetramahimā śrotavyaḥ śraddhayā sakṛt ||12|| yathāśakti ca deyāni dānānyatra suguptavat || annānyapi ca deyāni vighnānparijihīrṣuṇā || 13 || paropakaraṇaṃ cātra kartavyaṃ sudhiyā sadā || parvasvapi viśeṣeṇa snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||14|| viśeṣapūjā kartavyā sumahotsavapūrvakama || kāryāstathādhikā yātrāḥ samarcyāḥ kṣetradevatāḥ|||35|| atra marma na vaktavyaṃ sudhiyāṃ kasyacitkvacit || paradāra paradravya parāpakaraṇaṃ tyajet || 16 || parāpavādo no vācyaḥ parerṣyāṃ na ca kārayet || asatyaṃ naiva vaktavyaṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhagatairapi || 17 || atratya jaṃturakṣārthamasatyamapi bhāṣayet || yenakenaprakāreṇa śubhenāpyaśubhena vā||18|| atratyaḥ prāṇimātropi rakṣaṇīyaḥ prayatnataḥ || ekasminrakṣite jaṃtāvatra kāśyāṃ prayatnataḥ || trailokyarakṣaṇātpuṇyaṃ yatsyāttatsyānna saṃśayaḥ || 19 || ye vasaṃti sadā kāśyāṃ kṣetrasaṃnyāsakāriṇaḥ || ta eva rudrā maṃtavyā jīvanmuktā na saṃśayaḥ || 4.2.96.20 || te pūjyāste namaskāryāste saṃtoṣyāḥ prayatnataḥ || teṣu vai parituṣṭeṣu tuṣyedviśveśvaraḥ svayam || 21 || kāśyāṃ vasaṃti ye martyā dūrasthairapi sannaraiḥ || yogakṣemo vidhātavyasteṣāṃ viśveśiturmude || 22 || prasarastviṃdriyāṇāṃ ca nivāryotra nivāsibhiḥ || manasopi hi cāṃcalyamiha vāryaṃ prayatnataḥ || 23 || maraṇaṃ nābhikāṃkṣeddhi kāṃkṣyo mokṣo'pino punaḥ || śarīraśoṣaṇopāyaḥ kartavyaḥ sudhiyā nahi || 24 || śarīrasauṣṭhavaṃ kāṃkṣyaṃ vratasnānādisiddhaye || āyurbahvatra vai ciṃtyaṃ mahāphalasamṛddhaye || 25 || ātmarakṣātra kartavyā mahāśreyobhivṛddhaye || atrātma tyajanopāyaṃ manasāpi na ciṃtayet || 25 || ekasminnapi yaccāhni kāśyāṃ śreyobhilabhyate || na tu varṣaśatenāpi tadanyatrāpyate kvacit || 27 || anyatra yogābhyasanādyāvajjanma yadarjyate || vārāṇasyāṃ tadekena prāṇāyāmena labhyate ||28|| sarvatīrthāvagāhācca yāvajjanma yadarjyate || tadānaṃdavane prāpyaṃ maṇikarṇyekamajjanāt || || 29 || sarvaliṃgārcanātpuṇyaṃ yāvajjanma yadarjyate || sakṛdviśveśamabhyarcya śraddhayā tadavāpyate ||4.2.96.30 || yajjanmanāṃ sahasreṇa nirmalaṃ puṇyamarjitam || tatpuṇyaparivartena bhavedviśveśadarśanam || 3| || gavāṃ koṭi pradānena samyagdattena yatphalama || tatphalaṃ samyagāpyeta viśveśvara vilokanāt || 32 || yatṣoḍaśamahādānaiḥ puṇyaṃ proktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ || tatpuṇyaṃ jāyate puṃsāṃ viśveśe puṣpadānataḥ ||33|| aśvamedhādibhiryajñairyatphalaṃ prāpyatekhilaiḥ || paṃcāmṛtānāṃ snapanādviśveśe tadavāpyate ||34|| vājapeyasahasreṇa samyagiṣṭena yatphalam || sakṛnmahārhairnaivedyairviśveśe tacchatādhikam ||32|| dhvajātapatraṃ camaraṃ viśveśe yaḥ samarpayet || ekacchatraṃ sa vai rājyaṃ prāpnuyādvasudhātale || 35 || mahāpūjopakaraṇaṃ yorpayedviśvabhartari || na taṃ saṃpattisaṃbhārā vimuṃcaṃtīha kutracit || 37 || sarvartukusumāḍhyāṃ ca yaḥ kuryātpuṣpavāṭikām || tadaṃgaṇe kalpavṛkṣāśchāyāṃ kurvaṃti śītalām ||38|| yaḥ kṣīrasnapanārthaṃ vai viśveśe dhenumarpayet || kṣīrārṇavataṭe tasya nivaseyuḥ pitāmahāḥ || || 39 || viśveśarājasadane yaḥ sudhāṃ citrameva vā || kārayettasya bhavanaṃ kailāsacitritaṃ bhavet || 4.2.96.40 || brāhmaṇānyatino vāpi tathaiva śivayoginaḥ || bhojayedyotra vai kāśyāmekaika gaṇanā kramāt || 41 || koṭibhojyaphalaṃ tasya śraddhayā nātra saṃśayaḥ || tapastvatra prakartavyaṃ dānamatra pradāpayet || 42 || viśveśastoṣaṇīyotra snānahomajapādibhiḥ || anyatra koṭijapyena yatphalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ || aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tadatra samavāpyate || 43 || koṭihomena yatproktaṃ phalamanyatra sūribhiḥ || aṣṭottarāhutiśatāttadatrānaṃdakānane || 44 || yo japedrudrasūktāni kāśyāṃ viśveśasannidhau || pārāyaṇena vedānāṃ sarveṣāṃ phalamāpyate || 45 || tasya puṇyaṃ na jānāmi ciṃtite cākṣare pare || kāśyāṃ nityaṃ pravastavyaṃ sevyottaravahā sadā || 46 || āpadyapi hi ghorāyāṃ kāśī tyājyā na kutracit || yataḥ sarvāpadāṃhartā trātā viśvapatiḥ prabhuḥ || 47 || avaṃdhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryātsnānadānajapādibhiḥ || yataḥ kāśyāṃ kṛtaṃ karma mahattvāya prakalpate || 48 || kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇādīni kartavyāni prayatnataḥ || tatheṃdriyavikārāśca na bādhaṃtetra karhicit || 49 || yadīṃdriyāṇi kurvaṃti vikriyāmiha dehinām || tadātravāsasaṃ siddhirvighnebhyo naiva labhyate || 4.2.96.50 || || agastya uvāca || || kṛcchra cāṃdrāyaṇādīni vyāso vakṣyati yāni vai|| teṣāṃ svarūpamākhyāhi skaṃdeṃdriya viśuddhaye || 51 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kathayāmi mahābuddhe kṛcchrādīni tavāgrataḥ || yāni kṛtvātra manujo dehaśuddhiṃ labhetparām || 52 || ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca || upavāsena caikena pādakṛcchraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||53 || vaṭoduṃbararājīva bilvapatrakuśodakam || pratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ pītaṃ parṇakṛcchraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||54|| piṇyākaghṛtatakrāṃbu saktūnāṃ prativāsaram || ekaikamupavāsaśca kṛcchraḥ saumyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 55 || haviṣā prātaraśnīta haviṣā sāyameva ca || haviṣā yācitaṃ trīṃstu sopavāsastrayahaṃ vaset || 56 || ekaikagrāsamaśnīyādahāni trīṇi pūrvavat || tryahaṃ copavasedaṃtyamatikṛcchraṃ carandvijaḥ || 57 || kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ payasā divasānekaviṃśatiḥ || dvādaśāhopavāsena parākaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 58 || tryahaṃ prātastrayahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitam|| tryahaṃ copavasedaṃtyaṃ prājāpatyaṃ carandvijaḥ || 59 || gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpiḥ kuśodakam|| ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchraḥ sāṃtapanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4.2.96.60 || pṛthaksāṃtapanadravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsakaḥ || saptāhena tu kṛcchroyaṃ mahāsāṃtapanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 61 || taptakṛcchraṃ caranvipro jalakṣīraghṛtānilān || etāṃstryahaṃ pibeduṣṇānsakṛtsnāyī samāhitaḥ || 62 || tryahamuṣṇāḥ pibedāpastryahamuṣṇaṃ payaḥ pibet || tryahamuṣṇaghṛtaṃ prāśya vāyubhakṣo dinatrayam || 63 || palamekaṃ payaḥ pītvā sarpiṣaśca paladvayam || palamekaṃ tu toyasya taptakṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ || 64 || gomūtreṇa samāyuktaṃ yāvakaṃ yaḥ prayojayet || kṛcchramekāhnkiṃ proktaṃ śarīrasya viśodhanam || 65 || hastāvuttānataḥ kṛtvā divasaṃ mārutāśanaḥ || rātrau jale sthito vyuṣṭaḥ prājāpatyena tatsamam|| 66|| ekaikaṃ hrāsayedgrāsaṃ kṛṣṇe śukle ca vardhayet|| upaspṛśaṃ striṣavaṇametaccāṃdrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || 67 || ekaikaṃ vardhayedgrāsaṃ śukle kṛṣṇe ca hrāsayet || bhuṃjīta darśe no kiṃcideṣa cāṃdrāyaṇo vidhiḥ ||68|| caturaḥ prātaraśnīyātpiṃḍānvipraḥ samāhitaḥ || caturostamite sūrye śiśucāṃdrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || 69 || aṣṭāvaṣṭau samaśnīyātpiṃḍānmadhyaṃdine sthite || niyatātmā haviṣyasya yaticāṃdrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || 4.2.96.70 || yathākathaṃcitpiṃḍānāṃ tisrośītīḥ samāhitaḥ || māsenāśnanhaviṣyasya caṃdrasyaiti salokatām || 71 || adbhirgātrāṇi śudhyaṃti manaḥ satyena śuddhyati || vidyā tapobhyāṃ bhūtātmā buddhirjñānena śuddhyati ||72|| tacca jñānaṃ bhavetpuṃsāṃ samyakkāśīniṣevaṇāt || kāśīniṣevaṇena syādviśveśakaruṇodayaḥ|| || 73 || tato mahodayāvāptiḥ karmanirmūlanakṣamā|| ataḥ kāśyāṃ prayatnena snāna dāna tapo japaḥ ||74|| vrataṃ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ smṛtyuktādhva niṣevaṇam || pratikṣaṇe pratidinaṃ viśveśa padaciṃtanam || 75 || liṃgārcanaṃ trikālaṃ ca liṃgasyāpi pratiṣṭhitiḥ || sādhubhiḥ saha saṃlāpo jalpaḥ śivaśiveti ca ||76|| atitheścāpi satkāro maitrītīrthanivāsibhiḥ || āstikyabuddhirvinayo mānāmāna samānadhīḥ || 77 || akāmitā tvanauddhatyamarāgitvamahiṃsanam || apratigrahavṛttiśca matiścānugrahātmikā || 78 || adaṃbhitātvamātsaryamaprārthitadhanāgamaḥ || alobhitvamanālasyamapāruṣyamadīnatā || 79 || ityādi satpravṛttiśca kartavyā kṣetravāsinā || pratyahaṃ ceti śiṣyebhyaḥ sadharmamupadekṣyati || 4.2.96.80 || nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī nityaṃ bhikṣākṛtāśanaḥ || liṃgapūjārcako nityamitthaṃ vyāso vasetpurā || || 81 || ekadā tasya jijñāsāṃ kartuṃ devīṃ harovadat || adya bhikṣāṭanaṃ prāpte vyāse paramadhārmike || 82 || api sarvagate kvāpi bhikṣāṃ mā yaccha suṃdari || tathetyuktā bhavānī sā bhavaṃ bhavanivāraṇam|| 83 || namaskṛtya pratigṛhaṃ tasya bhikṣāṃ nyaṣedhayat || sa muniḥ sahitaḥ śiṣyairbhikṣāmaprāpya dūnavat || 84 || velātikramamālokya punarbabhrāma tāṃ purīm|| gṛhegṛhe pariprāptā bhikṣānyaiḥ sarvabhikṣukaiḥ ||85|| tadahninālabhadbhikṣāṃ saśiṣyaḥ sa muniḥ kvacit || atha sāyaṃtanaṃ karma kṛtvā chātraiḥ samanvitaḥ || 86 || upoṣaṇaparo bhūtvā tathaivāsīdaharniśam|| athānyedyurmunirvyāsaḥ kṛtvā mādhyāhnikaṃ vidhim|| 87 || yayau bhikṣāṭanaṃ kartuṃ saśiṣyaḥ paritaḥ purīm || sarvatra sa paribhrāṃtaḥ pratisaudhaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 88 || na kvāpi labdhavānbhikṣāṃ bhāgyahīno dhanaṃ yathā || atha ciṃtitavānvyāsaḥ pariśrāṃtaḥ paribhraman || 89 || ko heturyanna labhyeta bhikṣā yatnena rakṣitā || aṃtevāsina āhūya vyāsaḥ papraccha cākhilān || 4.2.96.90 || bhavadbhirapi no bhikṣā pariprāpteti gamyate || kimatra puri saṃvṛttaṃ dvitrā yāta mamājñayā || 91 || dvitīyehnyapi yadbhikṣā na labhyetātiyatnataḥ || aniṣṭaṃ kiṃcidatrāsīnmahāgurunipātajam || 92 || annakṣayo vā sarvasyāṃ nagaryāmabhavatkṣaṇāt || rājadaṃḍotha yugapajjātaḥ sarvapuraukasām || 93 || athavā vāritā bhikṣā kenāpyasmāsu cerṣyayā || puraukasobhavandusthāstūpasargeṇa kenacit || 94 || kimetadakhilamajñātvā samāgacchata satvaram || dvitrāḥ pavitracaraṇātprāpyānujñāṃ guroratha || samācakhyuḥ samāgamya dṛṣṭvarddhi tatpuraukasām || 95 || || śiṣyā ūcuḥ || || śṛṇvaṃtvārādhyacaraṇā nopasargotra kaścana || nānnakṣayo vā sarvasyāṃ nagaryāmiha kutracit || || 96 || yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣādyatrā'maradhunī svayam || tvādṛśā yatra munayaḥ kva bhīstatropasargajā || 97 || samṛddhiryā gṛhasthānāmiha viśveśituḥ puri || na sarddhirasti vaikuṃṭhe svalpāstā alakādayaḥ || 98 || ratnākareṣu ratnāni na tāvaṃti mahāmune|| yāvaṃti saṃti viśveśanirmālyopabhujāṃ gṛhe || 99 || gṛhegṛhetra dhānyānāṃ rāśayo yādṛśaḥ punaḥ || na tādṛśaḥ kalpavṛkṣadattā aiṃdre pure kvacit || 4.2.96.100 || yatra sākṣādviśālākṣī suvistāraphalapradā || na tatra puri sarvasyāṃ naro vai nirdhanaḥ kvacit || 101 || nirvāṇalakṣmyāḥ sadane tvasminnānaṃdakānane || mokṣopi yatra sulabhaḥ kimanyattatra durlabham || 102 || sīmaṃtinyaḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ pativrataparāyaṇāḥ || sarvā bhavānī rūpiṇyo viśveśārpitasatkriyāḥ ||103|| yāvaṃtaḥ puruṣāḥ kāśyāṃ sarva eva gaṇādhipāḥ || sarva eva kumārā vai sarve tārakadṛṣṭayaḥ ||104|| tripuṃḍrāṃkitabhālā ye te sarve caṃdramaulayaḥ || upasargasahasraiśca pīḍyamānā apīha ye || 105 || na tyajaṃti sadā kāśīṃ sarvajñā eva tekhilāḥ || gṛhegṛhepi vaṭavo brahmavādavivādinaḥ || 106 || svardhunī dhūtakaluṣāḥ saṃtīha caturānanāḥ || nirvāṇalakṣmīpatayaḥ kṣetrasaṃnyāsakāriṇaḥ||107|| sarva eva hṛṣīkeśāḥ sarve vai puruṣottamāḥ || acyutā eva vijñeyā etatkṣetraparigrahāḥ || 108 || striyo vā puruṣā vāpi sarva eva na saṃśayaḥ || sarva eva trinayanāḥ sarva eva caturbhujāḥ || 109 || śrīkaṃṭhāḥ sarva evātra sarve mṛtyuṃjayā dhruvam || mokṣaśrī śritavarṣmāṇastvardhanārīśvarāyataḥ || 4.2.96.110 || dharmarāśiḥ paraścātra mahāṃto'trārtharāśayaḥ || sarve kāmāḥ phalaṃtyatra kaivalyaṃ cātra nirmalam || 111 || na garbhavāsasaṃsargaḥ kāśīsaṃsthitikāriṇām || na kaliścātra bādheta kālo naiva prabādhate || 112 || enāṃsi nātra bādhaṃte viśveśaśaraṇārthinaḥ || yatra viśveśvaraḥ sākṣānnādabiṃdukalātmakaḥ || 113 || dhvanirūpī hi tatrāsti praṇavo maṃtravigrahaḥ || ato vigrahavaṃtotra saṃti vedā viniścitam || 114 || sarasvatī saridrūpā hyataḥ śāstraniketanam || ānaṃdakānanaṃ sarvaṃ dharmaśāstrakṛtālayam|| 115 || yāvaṃto divi vai devāstāvaṃtotra mṛṣā na hi || nīrājayaṃti viśveśaṃ rātrau rātrau sadā'hayaḥ || || 116 || svaphaṇāmaṇidīpaiśca prāpya kāśīṃ rasātalāt || samudrāḥ sarva evātra kāmadhenuvrajānvitāḥ ||117|| paṃcapīyūṣadhārābhirviśveśaṃ snapayaṃti hi || maṃdāraḥ pārijātaśca saṃtāno haricaṃdanaḥ || 118 || kalpadrumaśca paṃcaite tarubhiḥ saha sarvadā || 119 || sarve suranikāyāśca sarva eva maharṣayaḥ || yoginaḥ sarva evātra kāśīnāthamupāsate ||4.2.96.120|| vidyānāṃ sadanaṃ kāśī kāśī lakṣmyāḥ parālayaḥ || muktikṣetramidaṃ kāśī kāśī sarvā trayīmayī||121|| iti śrutvā munivaraḥ pārāśaryo mahātapāḥ || evaṃ babhāṣe tāñśiṣyānpunaḥślokaṃ paṭhaṃtvamum || 122 || || śiṣyā ūcuḥ || || vidyānāṃ cāśrayaḥ kāśī kāśī lakṣmyāḥ parālayaḥ || muktikṣetramidaṃ kāśī kāśī sarvā trayīmayī || 123 || || skaṃda uvāca || || niśamyeti tadā vyāsaḥ krodhāṃdhīkṛtalocanaḥ || kṣutkṛśānujvalanmūrtiḥ kāśīṃ śapsyati kuṃbhaja || || 124 || || vyāsa uvāca || || mā bhūttraipūruṣīvidyā mā bhūttraipūruṣaṃ dhanam || mā bhūttraipṛruṣī muktiḥ kāśīṃ vyāsaḥ śapanniti ||125|| garvaḥ parotra vidyānāṃ dhanagarvotra vai mahān || muktigarveṇa no bhikṣāṃ prayacchaṃtyatra vāsinaḥ || 126 || iti kṛtvā matiṃ vyāsaḥ kāśyāṃ śāpamadāttadā || dattvāpi śāpaṃ sa munirbhikṣituṃ krodhavānyayau|| || 127 || pratigehaṃ tvarāyuktaḥ praviśanvyomadattadṛk || babhrāma nagarīṃ sarvāṃ kvāpi bhaikṣaṃ na labdhavān ||128|| aṃśumālinamāvīkṣya manāglohitamaṃḍalam || bhikṣāpātraṃ parikṣipya niryayāvāśramaṃ prati ||129 || atha gacchanmahādevyā gṛhadvāri niṣaṇṇayā || prākṛtastrīsvarūpiṇyā bhikṣāyai prārthitotithiḥ || 4.2.96.130 || || gṛhiṇyuvāca || || bhagavanbhikṣukāstāvadadya dṛṣṭā na kutracit || asatkṛtyātithiṃ nātho na me bhokṣyati karhicit || 131 || vaiśvadevādikaṃ karma kṛtvā gṛhapatirmama || pratīkṣetātithipathaṃ tasmāttvamatithirbhava || 132 || vinātithi gṛhasthoyastvannameko niṣevate || niṣevate'ghaṃ sa paraṃ sahitaḥ svapitāmahaiḥ || 133 || tasmāttvaritamāyāhi kuru me patyurīhitam || gārhasthyaṃ saphalaṃ kartumicchato'tithipūjanāt || 134 || iti śrutvā gatāmarṣo vyāsastāmāha vismitaḥ || || vyāsa uvāca || || bhadre kā tvaṃ kutaḥ prāptā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā na kutracit || 135 || manye dharmamayī mūrtiḥ kāpi tvaṃ śucimānasā || tvaddarśanātparāṃ prītiṃ saṃprāptānīṃdriyāṇi me || 136 || tvaṃ sudhaiva bhaveḥ prāyaḥ sarvāvayavasuṃdari || maṃdarāghātasaṃtrāsātyaktakṣīrārṇavasthitiḥ || 137 || kalāsudhākarasyātha kuhū rāhubhayārditā || sīmaṃtinī svarūpeṇa tiṣṭheḥ kāśyāmanirbhayā || 138 || athavā kamalāsi tvaṃ vihāya kamalālayam || niśi saṃkocinaṃ kāśyāṃ vikāśinyāṃ vaseḥ sadā || 139 || kiṃvā nu karuṇāmūrtiriha kāśinivāsinām || sarvaduḥkhaughahariṇī parānaṃdapradāyinī || 4.2.96.140 || vārāṇasyāḥ kimathavā'dhiṣṭhātrī devatā tvamu|| kiṃ vā nirvāṇalakṣmīstvaṃ yā kāśyāṃ parigīyate || 141 || śvapākaṃ yāyajūkaṃ vā prāṃte'laṃkurvatī samam|| madbhāgyaṃ vā pariṇatametadyoṣitsvarūpataḥ || 142 || athavā sā bhavennūnaṃ yā kṣetre parigīyate || bhaktapotapradā bhaktyā bhavānī bhavanāśinī || 143 || sarvathaiva na nārī tvaṃ nāsurī naiva kinnarī|| vidyādharā na no nāgī no gaṃdharvī na yakṣiṇī || 144 || tvamiṣṭadevataivāsi kācinme mohahāriṇī || keyaṃ ciṃtāthavāmetra kācittvaṃ bhava suṃdari ||145|| paravānasmyahaṃ jātastavadarśanato'dhunā || avaśyamevakartāsmi tavādeśyaṃ tadādiśa || 146 || ekaṃ tapovyayaṃ hitvā kārayiṣyasi yatpunaḥ || tadevāhaṃ kariṣyāmi vidheyaḥ śubhalocane || 147 || na vacastvādṛśīnāṃhi mahattvaṃ hāpayetsatām || paraṃ tvaṃ kāsi subhage satyaṃ brūhi mamāgrataḥ || 148 || athavā tava dehesminkvā satyaṃ nirmalekṣaṇe || iti pṛṣṭāha muninā sā viśvāyurghaṭodbhava || 149 || atratyasyaiva hi mune gṛhiṇī gṛhamedhinaḥ || nityaṃ vīkṣe caraṃtaṃ tvāṃ bhikṣāṃ śiṣyagaṇairvṛtam || 4.2.96.150 || tvameva māṃ no jānīṣe jāne tvāmahameva hi || tapasvinkiṃ bahūktena yāvannāstaṃ vrajedraviḥ || 151 || prāṇanāthasya me tāvadātithyaṃ saphalīkuru || tacchutvā sa muniḥ prāha vinayānatakaṃdharaḥ || 152 || || vyāsa uvāca || || asti me niyamaḥ kaścitsa siddhiṃ cedvrajecchubhe || ekabhikṣāṃ tadāhaṃ tu kariṣye nānyathā punaḥ || 153 || tapasvyudīritaṃ śrutvā sā provāca vacastataḥ || aviśaṃka vada mune kastesti niyamaḥ sudhīḥ || 154 || mama bhartuḥ prasādena kiṃcinnyūnaṃ yato'tra na || iti śrutvā prahṛṣṭātmā sa tāmāha tapodhanaḥ || 155 || ayutaṃ mama śiṣyā ye taiḥ sapaktimahaṃ vṛṇe || astaṃ yāvanna yātyarkastāvadbhokṣyenyathā nahi || 156 || niśamyeti prahṛṣṭāsyā sā provāca muniṃtataḥ || kiṃ vilaṃbena tadyāhi sarvāñśiṣyānsamāhvaya || 157 || punaḥ prāha sa tāṃ sādhvi tvetāvatsiddhirasti te || yena tṛptiṃ gamiṣyaṃti macchiṣyāḥ sarva eva te||158|| smitvātha sābravīttaṃ tu mune bharturanugrahāt || siddhameva sadaivāste sarvaṃ tāvanmamālaye |||| 159 || yāvatārthijanastṛptimeti sarvopi sarvaśaḥ || vayaṃ na tādṛṅmahilā bhartṛsaṃdehakārikāḥ || 4.2.96.160 || āyātorthī yadā gehe siddhaṃ kāryaṃ tadaiva hi || paripūrṇā diśaḥ sarvāḥ paripūrṇāmanorathāḥ || 161 || paripūrṇagṛhaṃ sarvaṃ patyuḥpāda prasādataḥ || yāhi tūrṇaṃ samāyāhi yāvadannārthibhiḥ saha || 162 || patirme bahukālīnaḥ kālaṃ na sahate ciram || priyātithiḥ priyatamastadātithyasamṛddhaye ||163|| āśu gatvā samāgaccha yāvannāstamito raviḥ || iti prahṛṣṭastvaritaḥ śiṣyānāhūya sarvataḥ || || 164 || āgatyatāṃ punaḥ prāha dṛṣṭvā tanmārgalocanām || mātaḥ sarve samāyātāstvaritaṃ dehi bhojanam || 165 || astācalaṃ hi samayā samiyādeṣa bhāskaraḥ || ityuktvā maṃdirasyāṃtarviviśuste tapodhanāḥ || 166 || tanmaṃḍapamaṇijyotistatyāhitadinaśriyaḥ || yāvadgacchatitatsaudhamadhyamāśu tapasvinaḥ || 167 || pādauprakṣālya tāvatte kaiścitkaiścitsamarcya ca || katicitpariviṣṭānnā bhoktumevopaveśitāḥ || 168 || taddivyapākasaṃbhārāndṛṣṭavā taddṛṣṭayaḥ kṣaṇāt || parātṛptimupāgacchanghrāṇanyāmodarājibhiḥ || 169 || atitṛptiṃ samāpannāste tadannaniṣevaṇāt || ācāṃtāścaṃdanaiḥ sragbhiraṃbaraiḥ paribhūṣitāḥ || 4.2.96.170 || atha sāṃdhyaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā propaviśya tadagrataḥ || abhinaṃdya mahāśīrbhiryāvadgaṃtuṃ pracakramuḥ || 171 || tāvadvṛddhagṛhasthena gṛhiṇī sā kaṭākṣitā || papraccha tīrthe vasatāṃ ko dharmo mukhya eva hi || 172 || tathā tadanusāreṇa tīrthe vartāmahe vayam || sarvadharmavidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śrutvā tadgṛhiṇī vacaḥ ||173|| tadādarasudhāklinna mahānnasvādatarpitaḥ || pratyuvāca munirvyāsaḥ smitvā tāṃ sarvavittamām ||174|| || vyāsa uvāca || || svacchāṃtaḥkaraṇemātarmahāmiṣṭānnamānade || sa eṣa dharmo nānyosti yattvayā paricaryate ||175|| tvameva dharmaṃ jānāsi patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratā || yadi pṛcchasi māṃ satyaṃ tadā kiṃcana vacmi te || 176 || vaktavyameva pṛṣṭena manāgapi vijānatā || sa eva dharmaḥ subhage nānyo dharmosti kaścana || 177 || yenaiṣa toṣamāyāti tava bhartā ciraṃtanaḥ || || gṛhiṇyuvāca || || ayaṃ dharmo bhavennūnaṃ kriyate ca svaśaktitaḥ || 178 || sādhāraṇāni dharmāṇi saṃpṛcche tāni me vada || || vyāsa uvāca || || anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ parotkarṣasahiṣṇutā ||179|| vicārya kāritā nityaṃ svadhiṣṇyodaya ciṃtanam || gṛhastha uvāca || || eṣu dharmeṣu bho vidvaṃstvayi kostīha tadvada || 4.2.96.180 || tataḥ sthagitavadvyāsastasthau kiṃcinna coktavān || tataḥ punargṛhasthena sa hi proktastapodhanaḥ || 181 || yadyeta eva vai dharmāstvayā ye pratipāditāḥ || taddāṃtatā tavaivaikṣi dānaṃ śāpasya cottamam || 182 || tvayyeva hi dayā samyagdhairyaṃ tvayyeva cottamam || tvayi saṃbhāvanāstyeva kāmakrodhavinigrahe || 183 || tvameva samyagjānīṣe vaktuṃ codvegavarjitam || tvayyeva samyagdṛśyeta parotkarṣa sahiṣṇutā || 184 || vicārya kāritāyāśca tvameva nilayomahān || svasyadhiṣṇyasya ca bhavāṃściṃtayedudayaṃ dhruvam || 85 || mamaikaṃ brūhi bho vidvañchāpaṃ dadyācca yaḥ krudhā || alabhansvārthasaṃsiddhimabhāgyāttasya kasya saḥ || 186 || || vyāsa uvāca || || yaḥ svārthasiddhimalabhannabhāgyācchapati krudhā || sa śāpaḥ pratyuta bhavecchapturevāvivekinaḥ || 187 || || gṛhastha uvāca || || bhavatā bhramatā vipra nāptābhikṣā yadāpyaho || tadāparāddhaṃ kimiha varākaiḥ kṣetravāsibhiḥ || 188 || tapasviñśṛṇu me vākyaṃ rājadhānyāṃ mameha yaḥ || ṛddhiṃ draṣṭuṃ na śaknoti pariśaptaḥ sa eva hi || 189 || adya prabhṛti na kṣetre madīye śāpavarjite || āvasa krodhana mune na vāse yogyatātra te || || 4.2.96.190 || idānīmeva nirgaccha bahiḥ kṣetrādito bhava || tvadvidhānāṃ na yogyaṃ me kṣetraṃ mokṣaikasādhanam || 191 || atrālpamapi yaddauṣṭyaṃ kṛtaṃ matkṣetravāsinām || taddauṣṭyasya parīpāko rudrapaiśācyameva hi || 192 || tacchrutvā vepamānaḥ sa pariśuṣkauṣṭhatālukaḥ || jagāma śaraṇaṃ gaurīṃ luṭhaṃstaccaraṇāgrataḥ || 193 || uvāca ca vaco mātastrāhi trāhi bhṛśaṃ rudan || anāthastvatsanāthohaṃ bāliśastava bālakaḥ || 194 || śaraṇāgataṃ ca saṃtrāhi rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam || bahūnāmāgasāṃ gehamasmākaṃ duṣṭamānasam|| 195 || śaṃbhuśāpo'nyathākartuṃ bhavatyāpi na śakyate || ahaṃ ca śaraṇāyātastadekaṃ kriyatāṃ śive || 196 || pratyaṣṭami sadā kṣetre pratibhūtaṃ ca pārvati || diśa praveśanādeśaṃ neśastvadvākyalaṃghakaḥ || 197 || ityuktā tena muninā bhavānī karuṇājaniḥ || mukhaṃ maheśiturvīkṣya tathetyāha tadājñayā || 198 || athāṃtarhitavaṃtau tau śivau kṣetraśivaṃkarau || vyāsopi niryayau kṣetrātsvāparādhavaśaṃ vadan|| 199 || ahorātraṃ sa paśyanvai kṣetraṃ dṛṣṭeradūragam || prāpyāṣṭamīṃ ca bhūtāṃ ca madhye kṣetraṃ sadā viśet || 4.2.96.200 || lolārkādagnidigbhāge svardhunīṃ pūrvarodhasi || sthito hyadyāpi paśyetsa kāśīprāsādarājikām || 201 || || skaṃda uvāca || || itthaṃ kuṃbhaja sa vyāsaḥ kṣetre śāpaṃ pradāsyati || kṣetraśāpapradānācca bahiryāsyati tatkṣaṇāt || || 202 || ataevāvimuktasya kṣetrasya śubhaśaṃsinaḥ || bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ nityamanyathā tvanyathaiva hi || 203 || śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ vyāsaśāpa vimokṣaṇam || mahādurgopasargebhyo bhayaṃ tasya na kutracit || 204 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe vyāsaśāpavimokṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 96 || || cha ||
<4.2.97>
|| agastya uvāca || || etadbhaviṣyaṃ śrutvāhaṃ vyāsasya śivanaṃdana || āścaryabhājanaṃ jātastīrthāni kathayādhunā || 1 || ānaṃdakānane yāni yatra saṃti ṣaḍānana || tāni liṃgasvarūpāṇi samācakṣva mamāgrataḥ || 2 || || skaṃda uvāca || || ayameva hi vai praśno devyai devena bhostadā || yādṛśaḥ kathito vacmi tādṛśaṃ śṛṇu kuṃbhaja || 3 || || devyuvāca || || yāni yāni hi tīrthāni yatrayatra maheśvara || tāni tānīha me kāśyāṃ tatratatra vada prabho || 4 || || devadeva uvāca || || śṛṇu devi viśālākṣi tīrthaṃ liṃgamudāhṛtam || jalāśayepi tīrthākhyā jātā mūrti parigrahāt || || 5 || mūrtayo brahmaviṣṇvarkaśivavighneśvarādikāḥ || liṃgaṃ śaivamiti khyātaṃ yatraitattīrthameva tat ||6|| vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevaḥ prathamaṃ tīrthamucyate || taduttare mahākūpaḥ sārasvatapadapradaḥ || 7 || kṣetrapūrvottarebhāge taddṛṣṭaṃ paśupāśahṛt || tatpaścādvigrahavatī pūjyā vārāṇasī naraiḥ || 8 || sā pūjitā prayatnena sukhavastipradā sadā || mahādevasya pūrveṇa goprekṣaṃ liṃgamuttamam || 9 || taddarśanādbhavetsamyaggodānajanitaṃ phalam || golokātpreṣitā gāvaḥ pūrvaṃ yacchaṃbhunā svayam || 4.2.97.10 || vārāṇasīṃ samāyātā goprekṣaṃ tattataḥ snṛtam || goprekṣāddakṣiṇebhāge dadhīcīśvarasaṃjñitam ||1 1|| taddarśanādbhavetpuṃsāṃ phalaṃ yajñasamudbhavam || atrīśvaraṃ tu tatprācyāṃ madhukaiṭabhapūjitam || 12 || liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayatnena vaiṣṇavaṃ padamṛcchati || goprekṣātpūrvadigbhāge liṃgaṃ vai vijvaraṃ smṛtam ||13|| tasya saṃpūjanānmartyo vijvaro jāyate kṣaṇāt || prācyāṃ vedeśvarastasya caturvedaphalapradaḥ || 14 || vedeśvarādudīcyāṃ tu kṣetrajñaścādikeśavaḥ || dṛṣṭaṃ tribhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ tasya saṃdarśanāddhruvam || 15 || saṃgameśvaramālokya tatprācyāma jāyatenaghaḥ || caturmukhena vidhinā tatpūrveṇa caturmukham || 16 || prayāgasaṃjñakama liṃgamarcitama brahmalokadam || tatra śāṃtikarī gaurī pūjitā śāṃtikṛdbhavet || 17 || varaṇāyāstaṭe pūrve pūjyaṃ kuṃtīśvaraṃ nṛbhiḥ || tatpūjanātprajāyaṃte putrā nijakulojjvalāḥ || 18|| kuṃtīśvarāduttaratastīrthaṃ vai kāpilo hradaḥ || tatra vai snānamātreṇa vṛṣabhadhvajapūjanāt || 19 | rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ tvavikalaṃ bhavet || roravādiṣu ye kecitpitaraḥ koṭisaṃmitāḥ ||4.2.97.20|| tatra śrāddhe kṛte putraiḥ pitṛlokaṃ prayāṃti te || ānusūyeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ goprekṣāduttare mune|| 21 || taddarśanādbhavetstrīṇāṃ pātivratya phalaṃ sphuṭam || talliṃgapūrvadigbhāge pūjyaḥ siddhivināyakaḥ ||22|| yāṃ siddhiṃ yaḥ samīheta sa tāmāpnoti tannateḥ || hiraṇyakaśiporliṃgaṃ gaṇeśātpaścime tataḥ ||23|| hiraṇyakūpastatrāsti hiraṇyāśvasamṛddhikṛt || 24 || muṃḍāsureśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatpratīcyāṃ ca siddhidam|| abhīṣṭadaṃ tu nairṛtyāṃ goprekṣādvṛṣabheśvaram || 25 || mune skaṃdeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mahādevasya paścime || talliṃgapūjanānnṛṇāṃ bhavenmama salokatā || 26 || tatpārśvato hi śākheśo viśākheśaśca tatra vai || naigameyeśvarastatra yenye naṃdyādayo gaṇāḥ || 27 || teṣāmapi hi liṃgāni tatra saṃti sahasraśaḥ || taddarśanādbhavetpuṃsāṃ tattadgaṇasalokatā || 28|| naṃdīśvarātpratīcyāṃ ca śilādeśaḥ kudhīharaḥ || mahābalapradastatra hiraṇyākṣeśvaraḥ śubhaḥ || 29 || taddakṣiṇeṭṭahāsākhyaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvasukhapradam || prasannavadaneśākhyaṃ liṃgaṃ tasyottare śubham ||4.2.97.30 || prasannavadanastiṣṭhedbhaktastaddarśanācchubhāt || taduttare prasannodaṃ kuṃḍaṃ nairmalyadaṃ nṛṇām || 31 || pratīcyāmaṭṭahāsasya mitrāvaruṇanāmanī || liṃge tallokade pūjye mahāpātakahāriṇī || 32 || nairṛtyāṃ cāṭṭahāsasya vṛddhavāsiṣṭhasaṃjñakam || liṃgaṃ tatpūjanātpuṃsāṃ jñānamutpadyate mahat || 33 || vasiṣṭheśa samīpasthaḥ kṛṣṇeśo viṣṇulokadaḥ || tadyāmyāṃ yājñavalkyeśo brahmatejovivadharnaḥ || 34 || prahlādeśvaramabhyarcya tatpaścādbhaktivardhanam || svayaṃlīnaḥ śivo yatra bhaktānugrahakāmyayā || 35 || ataḥ svalīnaṃ tatpūrve liṃgaṃ pūjyaṃ prayatnataḥ || sadaiva jñānaniṣṭhānāṃ paramānaṃdamicchatām || yā gatirvihitā teṣāṃ svalīne sā tanutyajām || 36 || vairocaneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ svalīnātpurataḥ sthitam|| taduttare balīśaṃ ca mahābalavivardhanam || 37 || tatraiva liṃgaṃ bāṇeśaṃ pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam || caṃdreśvarasya pūrveṇa liṃgaṃ vidyeśvarābhidham || 38 || sarvāvidyāḥ prasannāḥ syustasya liṃgasya sevanāt || taddakṣiṇe tu vīreśo mahāsiddhi vidhāyakaḥ ||39|| tatraiva vikaṭā devī sarvaduḥkhaughamocanī || paṃcamudraṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ tajjñeyaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 4.2.97.40 || tatra japtā mahāmaṃtrāḥ kṣipraṃ sidhyaṃti nānyathā || tatpīṭhe vāyukoṇe tu saṃpūjyaḥ sagareśvaraḥ ||41 || tadarcanādaśvamedhaphalaṃ tvavikalaṃ bhavet || tadīśāne ca vālīśastiryagyoni nivārakaḥ || 42 || mahāpāpaughavidhvaṃsī sugrīveśastaduttare || hanūmadīśvarastatra brahmacaryaphalapradaḥ || 43 || mahābuddhipradastatra pūjyo jāṃbavatīśvaraḥ || āśvine yeśvarau pūjyau gaṃgāyāḥ paścime taṭe || 44 || taduttare bhadrahrado gavāṃ kṣīreṇa pūritaḥ || kapilānāṃ sahasreṇa samyagdattane yatphalam || 45 || tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ snāto bhadrahrade dhruvam || pūrvābhādrapadā yuktā paurṇamāsī yadā bhavet || 46 || tadā puṇyatamaḥ kālo vājimedhaphalapradaḥ || hrada paścima tīre tu bhadreśvara vilokanāt || 47 || golokaṃ prāpnuyāttasmātpuṇyānnaivātra saṃśayaḥ || bhadreśvarādyātudhānyāmupaśāṃta śivo mune || 48 || tasya liṃgasya saṃsparśātparā śāṃtiṃ samṛcchati || upaśāṃta śivaṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā janmaśatārjitam ||49|| tyajedaśreyaso rāśiṃ śreyorāśiṃ ca viṃdati || taduttare ca cakreśo yonicakra nivārakaḥ || 4.2.97.50 || taduttare cakrahrado mahāpuṇyavivardhanaḥ || snātvā cakrahrade martyaścakreśaṃ paripūjya ca || 51 || śivalokamavāpnoti bhāvitenāṃtarātmanā || tannairṛte ca śūleśo draṣṭavyaśca prayatnataḥ || 52 || śūlaṃ tatra purā nyastaṃ snānārthaṃ varavarṇini || hradastatra samutpannaḥ śūleśasyāgrato mahān || 53 || snānaṃ kṛtvā hrade tatra dṛṣṭvā śūleśvaraṃ vibhum || rudralokaṃ narā yāṃti tyaktvā saṃsāragahvaram ||54|| tatpūrvato nāradena tapastaptaṃ mahattaram|| liṃgaṃ ca sthāpitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kuṃḍaṃ cāpi śubhaṃ kṛtam || 55 || tatra kuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā vai nāradeśvaram || saṃsārābdhimahāghoraṃ saṃtarennātra saṃjayaḥ || 56 || nāradeśvara pūrveṇa dṛṣṭvā'vabhrātakeśvaram || nirmalāṃ gatimāpnoti pāpaughaṃ ca vimuṃcati || 57 || tadagre tāmrakuṃḍaṃ ca tatra snāto na garbhabhāk || vighnahartā gaṇādhyakṣastadvāyavye suvighnahṛt || 58 || tatra vighnaharaṃ kuṃḍaṃ tatra snāto na vighnabhāk || anārakeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tadudagdiśi cottamam || 59 || kuṃḍaṃ cānārakākhyaṃ vai tatra snāto na nārakī || varaṇāyāstaṭe ramye varaṇeśastaduttare || 4.2.97.60 || tatra pāśupataḥ siddhastvakṣapādo mahāmune || anenaiva śarīreṇa śāśvatīṃ siddhimāgataḥ || 61 || tatpaścime ca śaileśaḥ paranirvāṇakāmadaḥ || koṭīśvaraṃ tu tadyāmyāṃ liṃgaṃ śāśvatasiddhidam || 62 || koṭitīrthe hrade snātvā koṭīśaṃ paripūjya ca || gavāṃ koṭipradānasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 63 || mahāśmaśānastaṃbhosti koṭīśādvahnidiksthitaḥ || tasminstaṃbhe mahārudrastiṣṭhate comayā saha || 64 || taṃ staṃbhaṃ samalaṃkṛtya narastatpadamāpnuyāt || tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramaṃ kapāleśa samīpataḥ ||65|| kapālamocanaṃ nāma tatra snāto'śvamedhabhāk || ṛṇamocanatīrthaṃ tu tadudagdiśi śobhanam || 66 || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā mukto bhavati carṇataḥ || tatraivāṃgārakaṃ tīrthaṃ kuṃḍaṃ cāṃgāranirmalam || 67 || snātvāṃgāraka tīrthe tu bhavedbhūyo na garbhabhāk || aṃgāravārayuktāyāṃ caturthyāṃ snāti yo naraḥ || vyādhibhirnābhi bhūyeta na ca duḥkhī kadācana || 68 || viśvakarmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ jñānadaṃ ca taduttare || mahāmuṃḍeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tasya dakṣiṇataḥ śubham|| 69 || kūpaḥ śubhoda nāmāpi snātavyaṃ tatra niścitam || tatra muṃḍamayī mālā mayā kṣiptātiśobhanā || 4.2.97.70 || mahāmuṃḍā tato devī samutpannāghahāriṇī || khaṭvāṃgaṃ ca dhṛtaṃ tatra khaṭvāṃgeśastatobhavat || 71 || niṣpāpo jāyate martyaḥ khaṭvāṃgeśa vilokanāt || bhuvaneśastato yāmyāṃ kuṃḍaṃ ca bhuvaneśvaram || 72 || tatra kuṃḍe naraḥ snāto bhuvane śobhavennaraḥ || tadyāmyāṃ vimaleśaśca kuṃḍaṃ ca vimalodakam || 73 || tatra snātvā vilokyeśaṃ vimalo jāyate naraḥ || tatra pāśupataḥ siddhastryaṃbako nāma nāmataḥ || 74 || anenaiva śarīreṇa rudralokamavāptavān || bhṛgorāyatanaṃ tasya paścime'tīva puṇyadam || 72 || vidhipūrvaṃ tadabhyarcya prāpnuyācchivamaṃdiram || śubheśvaraśca tadyāmyāṃ mahāśubhaphalapradaḥ || 76 || tatra siddhaḥ pāśupataḥ kapilarṣirmahātapāḥ || tatrāsti hi guhā ramyā kapileśvara saṃnidhau || 77 || tāṃ guhāṃ praviśedyo vai na sa garbhe viśetkvacit || tatra yajñodakūposti vājimedhaphalapradaḥ || 78 || oṃkāra eṣa evāsāvādivarṇamayātmakaḥ || matsyodaryuttare kūle nādeśastvahameva ca || 79 || nādeśaḥ paramaṃ brahma nādeśaḥ paramā gatiḥ || nādeśaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ duḥkhasaṃsāramocanam || 4.2.97.80 || kadācittasya devasya darśane yāti jāhnavī || matsyodarī sā kathitā snānaṃ puṇyairavāpyate || 81 || matsyodarī yadā gaṃgā paścime kapileśvaram || samāyāti mahādevi tadā yogaḥ sudurlabhaḥ || 82 || uddālakeśvaraṃ liṃgamudīcyāṃ kapileśvarāt || taddarśanena saṃsiddhiḥ parā sarvairavāpyate || 83 || taduttare bāṣkulīśaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam || bāṣkulīśāddakṣiṇato liṃgaṃ vai kaustubheśvaram || 84 || tasyārcanena ratnaughairna viyujyeta karhicit || śaṃkukarṇeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kaustubheśvaradakṣiṇe || || 85 || saṃsevya paramaṃ jñānaṃ labhedadyāpi sādhakaḥ || aghoreśo guhādvāri kūpastasyottare śubhaḥ || 86 || aghoroda iti khyāto vājimedhaphalapradaḥ || gargeśo damaneśaśca tatra liṃgadvayaṃ śubham || 87 || anenaiveha dehena yatra tau siddhimāpatuḥ || talliṃgayoḥ samarcātaḥ siddhirbhavati vāṃchitā || 88 || taddakṣiṇe mahākuṃḍaṃ rudrāvāsa iti smṛtam || tatra rudreśamabhyarcya koṭirudraphalaṃ labhet || 89 || caturdaśī yadāparṇe rudranakṣatra saṃyutā || tadā puṇyatamaḥ kālastasminkuṃḍe mahāphalaḥ || 4.2.97.90 || rudrakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā rudreśvaraṃ vibhum || yatratatra mṛto vāpi rudralokamavāpnuyāt || 91 || rudrasya nairṛte bhāge liṃgaṃ tatra mahālayam || tadagre pitṛkūposti pitṝṇāmālayaḥ paraḥ ||92|| tatra śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā piṃḍānkūpe parikṣipet || ekaviṃśakulopetaḥ śrāddhakṛdrudralokabhāk || 93 || tatra vaitaraṇī nāma dīrghikā paścimānanā || tasyāṃ snāto naro devi narakaṃ naiva gacchati || 94 || bṛhaspatīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ rudrakuṃḍācca paścime || gurupuṣyasamāyoge dṛṣṭvā divyāṃ labhedgiram || 95 || rudrāvāsāddakṣiṇataḥ kāmeśaṃ liṃgamuttamam || taddakṣiṇe mahākuṃḍaṃ snānācciṃtita kāmadam || 96 || caitraśukla trayodaśyāṃ tatra yātrā ca kāmadā || nalakūbara liṃgaṃ ca prācyāṃ kāmeśvarācchubham ||97|| tadagre pāvanaḥ kūpo dhanadhānya samṛddhidaḥ || nalakūbarapūrveṇa sūryācaṃdramaseśvarau || 96 || ajñānadhvāṃtapaṭalīṃ haratastau samarcitau || taddakṣiṇedhvakeśaśca dṛṣṭo mohavināśanaḥ || ||99|| tatra siddhīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mahāsiddhisamarpakam || tatraiva maṃḍaleśaśca maṃḍaleśapadapradaḥ || 4.2.97.100 || kāmakuṃḍasya pūrveṇa cyavaneśaḥ samṛddhidaḥ || tatraiva sanakeśaśca rājasūyaphalapradaḥ || 101 || sanatkumāra liṃgaṃ ca tatpaścādyogasiddhikṛt || taduttare sanaṃdeśo mahājñāna samarthakaḥ ||102|| tadyāmyāmāhutīśaśca dṛṣṭo homaphalapradaḥ || tadyāmyāṃ puṇyajanakaṃ liṃgaṃ paṃcaśikheśvaram || 103 || mārkaṃḍeya hradastasya paścime puṇyavardhanaḥ || tasminhrade naraḥ snātvā kiṃ bhūyaḥ pariśocati || 104|| tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca bhavedakṣaya puṇyadam || taduttare ca kuṃḍeśaḥ sarvasiddhairnamaskṛtaḥ ||105|| dīkṣāṃ pāśupatīṃ labdhvā dvādaśābdena yatphalam || tatphalaṃ labhate vipra martyaḥ kuṃḍeśa darśanāt || || 106 || mārkaṃḍeya hradātpūrvaṃ śāṃḍilyeśaḥ supuṇyadaḥ || tatpaścime ca caṃḍeśaścaṃḍāṃśu grahaṇāghahṛt || 107 || dakṣiṇe ca kapāleśātkuṃḍaṃ śrīkaṃṭhasaṃjñitam || tatra kuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā dātā syācchrīprabhāvataḥ || 108 || mahālakṣmīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tasya kuṃḍasya sannidhau || mahālakṣmīṃ samabhyarcya snātastatkuṃḍavāriṣu ||109|| cāmarāsaktahastābhirdivyastrībhiśca vījyate || yadā matsyodarīṃ yāṃti svargalokāddivaukasaḥ || tadā tenaiva mārgeṇa yāṃti strībhirvṛtāḥ sukham ||4.2.97.110|| svargadvāramataḥ khyātaṃ tatsthānaṃ munisattama || tatkuṃḍa dakṣiṇebhāge liṃgaṃ brahmapadapradam || 111 || gāyatrīśvara sāvitrīśvarau pūjyau prayatnataḥ || matsyodaryāstaṭe ramye liṃgaṃ satyavatīśvaram ||112|| tayoḥ pūrveṇa saṃpūjya tapaḥśrī parivardhanam || ugreśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ lakṣmīśātpūrvadiksthitam ||113|| jātismaro bhavenmartyastalliṃgasya samarcanāt || taddakṣiṇe cograkuṃḍaṃ snānātkanakhalādhikam || 114 || karavīreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃtasya kuṃḍaṃsya paścime || tasya darśanataḥ puṃsāṃ jāyate rogasaṃkṣayaḥ || 115 || tadvāvye marīcīśaṃ kuṃḍaṃ cāghaughanāśanam || tatpaścācceṃdrakuṃḍaṃ liṃgaṃ ceṃdreśvaraṃ mune || 116 || iṃdreśāddakṣiṇebhāge śubhā karkoṭavāpikā || tatra vāpījale snātvā dṛṣṭvā karkoṭakeśvaram || || 117 || nāgānāmādhipatyaṃ tu jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || tatpaścāddṛmicaṃḍeśo brahmahatyāharo haraḥ || 118|| taddakṣiṇe mahākuṃḍaṃ rudralokaphalapradam || tatpaścime mahāliṃgamagnīśa iti viśrutam || 119 || āgneyaṃ nāma kuṃḍaṃ ca tatpūrvegnisalokadam || āgneyeśvarataḥ prācyāṃ kuṃḍaṃ taddakṣiṇe śubham|| 4.2.97.120 || tatra kuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā svarge vasati pūrvajaiḥ || tatprācyāṃ bālacaṃdreśaścaṃdralokagatipradaḥ || 121 || parito bālacaṃdreśaṃ gaṇaliṃgānyanekaśaḥ || vilokya tāni liṃgāni gāṇapatyaṃ padaṃ labhet ||122 || bālacaṃdra samīpe tu kūpaḥ pitṛgaṇapriyaḥ || tatra śrāddhapradaḥ snātvā pitṝnsaptā'tra tārayet || 123 || tadaṃdhoḥ pūrvato liṃgaṃ puṇyaṃ viśveśvarāhvayam|| viśveśvarasya pūrveṇa vṛddhakāleśvaro haraḥ || 124 || kālodo nāma kūposti tadagre sarvarogahṛt || yaistu tatrodakaṃ pītaṃ strībhiḥ puṃbhiḥ svakarmabhiḥ || 125 || na teṣāṃ parivartotra kalpakoṭiśatairapi || tatpītvā janmabaṃdhotthādbhayānmucyeta mānavaḥ || 126 || tatra kūpe tu yaddattaṃ dānaṃ śivaratātmanām || saṃvartepi na tasyāsti nāśaḥ kalaśasaṃbhava ||127|| khaṃḍasphuṭitasaṃskāraṃ tatra kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || te rudralokamāsādya modaṃte sukhinaḥ sadā || 128 || kāleśāddakṣiṇe bhāge mṛtyvīśastvapamṛtyuhṛt || liṃgaṃ dakṣeśvarāhvaṃ ca tataḥ kūpādudagdiśi || 29 || aparādhasahasraṃ tu naśyettasya samarcanāt || 4.2.97.130 || mahākāleśa liṃgaṃ ca dakṣeśātpūrvato mahat || mahākuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā mahākālaṃ tu yorcayet ||131|| arcitaṃ tena vai tatra jagadetaccarācaram || aṃtakeśvaramālokya tadyāmyāṃ nāṃtakasya bhīḥ || 132 || hastipāleśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tasya dakṣiṇato mune|| tasya pūjanato yāti puṇyaṃ vai hastidānajam || 133 || tatrairāvatakuṃḍaṃ ca liṃgamairāvateśvaram || talliṃgamarcayanmartyo dhanadhānyasamṛddhibhāk || 134 || taddakṣiṇe śreyase ca liṃgaṃ syānmālatīśvaram || hastīśvarāduttare tu jayaṃteśo jayapradaḥ || 135 || baṃdīśvaro mahākāla kuṃḍāduttarataḥ śubhaḥ || baṃdikuṃḍaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ mahāghahṛt|| 136|| tatra snānena dānena śrāddhenākṣayamaśnute || dhanvaṃtarīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kuṃḍaṃ tannāma caiva hi || 137 || tasya liṃgasya nāmānyatkuṃḍanāmānyadeva hi || tuṃgeśvaraṃ liṃga nāma kuṃḍaṃ vaidyeśvarābhidham || 138 || sudhāmayyo mahauṣadhyaḥ kṣiptāstatra mahādhiyaḥ || tatkuṃḍasnānatastasmāttalliṃga parivīkṣaṇāt || naśyaṃti vyādhayaḥ sarve saha pāpaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ || 139 || taduttare halīśeśaḥ sarvavyādhinipūdanaḥ || śiveśvaraḥ śivakarastuṃganāmnaśca dakṣiṇe || 4.2.97.140 || jamadagnīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ śiveśāddakṣiṇe śubham || tatpaścime bhairaveśaḥ kūpastasyottare śubhaḥ ||141 || tadudasparśamātreṇa sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet || tatkūpapaścime bhāge sukeśo yogasiddhidaḥ || 142 || tannairṛtyāṃ ca vyāseśaḥ kūpaśca vimalodakaḥ || vyāsakūpe naraḥ snātvā tarpayitvā surānpitṝn || 143 || akṣayaṃ labhate lokaṃ yatrakutrābhikāṃkṣitam || vyāsatīrthātpaścimato ghaṃṭākarṇo hrado mahān || 144 || ghaṃṭākarṇahrade snātvā vyāsaṃśa paridarśanāt || yatratatra mṛto vāpi vārāṇasyāṃ mṛto bhavet || 145 || ghaṃṭākarṇa samīpe tu paṃcacūḍāpsaraḥ saraḥ || paṃcacūḍājale snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tamīśvaram || 146|| svargalokaṃ naro yāti paṃcacūḍāpriyo bhavet || gaurīkūpastatovācyāṃ sarvajāḍyavināśanaḥ || 147 || paṃcacūḍottare bhāge tīrthaṃ cāśokasaṃjñitam|| maṃdākinī mahātīrthaṃ tadudīcyāṃ mahāghahṛt || 148 || svargalokepi sā puṇyā kiṃ punarmānave mune || taduttare madhyameśo madhye kṣetraṃ svapityaho ||149|| tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā'śokāṣṭamyāṃ madhau naraḥ || na jātu śokaṃ labhate sadānaṃdamayo bhavet||4.2.97.150|| muktikṣetrapramāṇaṃ ca krośaṃ krośaṃ ca sarvataḥ|| ārabhya liṃgādasmācca puṇyadānmadhyameśvarāt ||151|| etadeva sadā prāhuḥ sarve vai prapitāmahāḥ || kaścidasmatkule jāto maṃdākinyā jalāplutaḥ ||152|| bhojayetprayato viprānyatīnpāśupatānapi || madākinyāṃ naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā vai madhyameśvaram || 153 || ekaviṃśatkulopeto rudraloke vasecciram || madhyameśādavācyāṃ ca viśvedeveśvaraḥ śubhaḥ ||154|| tadarcanādarcitāḥ syurviśvedevāstrayodaśa || tatpūrve vīrabhadreśo mahāvīrapadapradaḥ ||155|| bhadradā bhadrkālī ca tasya dakṣiṇataḥ śubhā || bhadrākāla hrado nāma tatrātīva śubhapradaḥ ||156|| āpastaṃbeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatprācyāṃ jñānadaṃ param || taduttare puṇyakūpastatpaścācchaunako hradaḥ || 157 || hradapaścimato liṃgaṃ śaunakeśaṃ sudhīpradam || hrade tatra naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā vai śaunakeśvaram || 158 || jñānaṃ tatsaṃlabheddivyaṃ yena mṛtyuṃ taratyasau || taddakṣiṇe jaṃbukeśastiryagyoni nivārakaḥ ||159|| taduttare mataṃgeśo gānavidyāprabodhakaḥ || mataṃgeśasya vāyavye nānāliṃgāni sarvataḥ ||4.2.97.160|| munibhiḥ sthāpitānīha sarvasiddhipradāni ca || brahmarāteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mataṃgeśācca dakṣiṇe ||161|| talliṃgadarśanādāyurnāṃtarācchidyate kvacit || tatrājyapeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ pitṛliṃgānyanekaśaḥ || talliṃgasevayā sarve tuṣyaṃti prapitāmahāḥ || 162 || taddakṣiṇe siddhakūpaḥ siddhāḥ saṃti sahasraśaḥ|| vāyurūpāstu ye siddhā ye siddhā bhānuraśmigāḥ || 163 || taiḥ sthāpitaṃ tu yalliṃgaṃ tatsiddheśvaramīritam || tasya saṃdarśanādeva sarvāḥ syuḥ siddhayo'malāḥ || 164 || tatpaścime siddhavāpī pītā snātā ca siddhidā || prācyāṃ ca siddhakūpādvai liṃgaṃ vyāghreśvarābhidham || 165 || talliṃgadarśanānnṛṇāṃ na bhayaṃ vyāghracorajam || jyeṣṭheśvaraṃ ca tadyāmyāṃ jyeṣṭhasthāneti siddhidam ||166|| taddakṣiṇe mudāṃ dhāma liṃgaṃ prahasiteśvaram || taduttare nivāseśa kāśīvāsaphalapradaḥ || 167 || catuḥsamudrakūposti tatrābdhisnāna puṇyadaḥ || jyeṣṭhā devī tu tatrāsti natā jyeṣṭhapadapradā || 168 || avācyāṃ vyāghraliṃgācca liṃgaṃ caṃḍīśvarābhidham || taduttare daṃḍakhātaṃ saraḥ pitṛmudāvaham || 169 || grahaṇānaṃtare snānaṃ daṃḍakhāteti puṇyadam || jaigīṣavya guhā tatra tatra liṃgaṃ tadāhvayam||4.2.97.170|| trirātropoṣitastatra jñānaṃ labhyeta nirmalam || mahāpuṇyapradaṃ liṃgaṃ tatpaścāddevaleśvaram || 171 || śatakālastatsamīpe śataṃ kālānumāpatiḥ || talliṃgāvirbhave kāśyāṃ kālayāmāsa kuṃbhaja || 172 || talliṃgadaśarnādāyuḥ śatavarṣāṇyakhaṃḍitam || śātātapeśastadyāmyāṃ mahājapaphalapradaḥ || 173 || tatpaścime hetukeśo hetubhūto mahāphale || taddakṣiṇekṣapādeśo mahājñānaprarvatakaḥ || 174 || tadagre ca kaṇādeśastatra puṇyodakaḥ prahiḥ || snātvā kāṇādakūpe yaḥ kaṇādeśaṃ samarcayet || 175|| na dhanena na dhānyena tyajyate sa kadācana || tasya dakṣiṇato dṛśyo bhūtīśo bhūtikṛtsatām ||176|| tatpaścime'ghasaṃhartṛ āṣāḍhīśvara saṃjñitam || durvāseśaśca tatpūrve sarvakāmasamṛddhikṛt ||177 || tadyāmyāṃ bhārabhūteśaḥ pāpabhārāpahārakaḥ || vyāseśvarasya pūrveṇa dvau śaṃkhalikhiteśvarau || tau dṛśyau yatnataḥ kāśyāṃ mahājñāna pravartakau || 178|| yatsamāpyāpyate puṇyaṃ niṣṭhā pāśupatavratam || tadāpyatetra viśveśa sakṛdīkṣaṇataḥ kṣaṇāt ||179|| tadīśānevadhūteśo yogajñānapravartakaḥ || tīrthaṃ caivāvadhūteśaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśakṛt ||4.2.97.180|| avadhūteśvarātpūrve liṃgaṃ paśupatīśvaram || talliṃgasevayā puṃsāṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam ||181|| taddakṣiṇe gobhileśo mahābhilaṣitapradaḥ| jīmūtavāhaneśaśca tatpaścālliṃgamuttamam || 182 || vidyādharapadaprāptistalliṃgaparisevanāt|| mayūkhārkaḥ paṃcanade gabhastīśaśca tatra vai || 183 || dadhikalpahrado nāma tadudīcyāṃ mahāprahiḥ || durlabhaṃ tatprahisnānaṃ durlabhaṃ ca tadīkṣaṇam || 184 || gabhastīśottare bhāge dadhikalpeśvaro haraḥ || narastamāśu saṃvīkṣya kalpaṃ tryakṣapure vaset || 185 || gabhastīśāddakṣiṇe tu maṃgalāṃ maṃgalālayām || uddiśya maṃgalāṃ gaurīṃ bhojayeddvijadaṃpatī || 186 || alaṃkṛtya yathāśakti tatpuṇyāṃto na karhicit || kṣitipradakṣiṇaphalā maṃgalaikā pradakṣiṇā || 187 || vadanaprekṣaṇādevī mukhaprekṣeśvarottare || maṃgalāyāḥ samīpe tu sarvasiddhikarī śivā || 188 || liṃge tvaṣṭrīśavṛtteśau mukhaprekṣottare śubhe || sahemabhūmidānasya phalaṃ darśanatastayoḥ ||189|| taduttare carcikāyā devyāḥ saṃdarśanaṃ śubham || revateśvara liṃgaṃ ca carcikāgreṇa śāṃtikṛt || 4.2.97.190 || mahāśubhāyatasyāgre liṃgaṃ paṃcanadeśvaram || maṃgalodo mahākūpo maṃgalā paścime śubhaḥ || 191 || upamanyormahāliṃgaṃ maṃgalā paścime śubham || vyāghrapādeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatpaścādvyāghrabhītihṛt || 192 || nairṛtyāṃ ca gabhastīśācchaśāṃkeśoghasaṃghahṛt || tatpaścime caitrarathaṃ liṃgaṃ divyagatipradam || 193 || revateśātpaścimato jaiminīśo mahāghahṛt || tatra liṃgānyanekāni ṛṣīṇāmṛṣisattama || 194 || jaiminīśācca vāyavye liṃgaṃ vai rāvaṇeśvaram || na taddaśarnataḥ puṃsāṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahābhayam || 195 || taddakṣiṇe varāheśo māṃḍavyeśastato yame || taddakṣiṇe pracaṃḍeśo yogeśo dakṣiṇe tataḥ || 196 || taddakṣiṇe ca dhāteśaḥ someśaśca tadagrataḥ || tannairṛtyāṃ kanakeśo mahākanakadaḥ satām || 197 || taduttare pāṃḍavānāṃ paṃcaliṃgāni sanmude || saṃvarteśastadagre ca śveteśastasya paścime || 198 || tatpaścātkalaśeśaśca liṃgaṃ kālābhayapradam || kālena pāśite śvete mune kuṃbhātsamutthitam ||199|| citragupteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tadudīcyāmaghāpaham || citragupteśvarātpaścādyo dṛḍheśo mahāphalaḥ || 4.2.97.200 || kalaśeśādavācyāṃ ca graheśo liṃgamuttamam || grahabādhāṃ śamayati talliṃga parilokanam || 201 || citragupteśvarātpaścādyadṛccheśo mahāphalaḥ || utathyavāmadeveśaṃ liṃgaṃ yāmyāṃ graheśvarāt ||202|| kaṃbalāśvatareśau ca tasya dakṣiṇataḥ śubhe || tatraiva nirmalaṃ liṃgaṃ nalakūbarapūjitam || 203 || tadyāmyāṃ maṇikarṇīśaṃ tadudakpaliteśvaram || jarāharaṃ ca tatraiva tatpaścātpāpanāśanam ||204|| tatpaścime nirjareśastannairṛtyāṃ pitāmahaḥ || pitāmahasrotikā ca tatra śrāddhaṃ mahāphalam ||205|| tadyāmyāṃ varuṇeśaśca bāṇeśastasya dakṣiṇe| pitāmahasrotikāyāṃ kūśmāṃḍeśastu siddhikṛt || 206 || tatpūrvato rākṣaseśo gaṃgeśastasya dakṣiṇe || taduttare nimnageśāḥ saṃti liṃgānyanekaśaḥ || 207 || vaivasvateśvarastatra yamalokanivārakaḥ || tatpaścādaditīśaśca cakreśastasya cāgrataḥ || 208 || tadagre kālakeśākhyo dṛṣṭapratyayakṛtparaḥ || chāyā saṃdṛśyate tatra niṣpāpastadavekṣaṇāt || 209 || tadagre tārakeśaśca tadagre svarṇabhāradaḥ|| taduttare marutteśaḥ śakreśaśca tadagrataḥ || 4.2.97.210 || taddakṣiṇe ca raṃbheśastatraiva ca śaśīśvaraḥ || taduttare lokapeśāstatra liṃgānyanekaśaḥ || 211 || nāgagaṃdharvayakṣāṇāṃ kinnarāpsarasāmapi || devarṣigaṇavṛdānāṃ nānāsiddhikarāṇyapi || 212 || śakreśāddakṣiṇe bhāge phālguneśo mahāghahṛt || mahāpāśupateśaśca tadyāmyāṃ śubhakṛtparaḥ || 213 || tatpaścime samudreśa īśāneśastaduttare|| tatpūrve lāṃgalīśaśca sarvasiddhisamarpakaḥ || 214 || rāgadveṣavinirmuktāḥ siddhiṃ yāṃti ca pūjakāḥ || teṣāṃ mokṣo mayā khyāto na tu te devi mānavāḥ || 215 || madhupiṃgaśvetaketū lāṃgalīśe tapasvinau || anenaiva śarīreṇa jagmatuḥ siddhimuttamām || 216 || tatraiva nakulīśaśca kapileśaśca tatra vai|| rahasyaṃ paramaṃ cobhau mama vrata niṣeviṇau|| 217 || tatsannidhau prītikeśastatra prītirmama priye || tatropavāsādekasmātphalamabdaśatādhikam || 218 || ekaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prītikeśa upoṣitaḥ || gaṇatvapadavī tasya niścitā mama parvaṇi || 219 || devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge tatra vāpī śubhodakā || tadaṃbuprāśanaṃ nṛṇāmapunarbhavahetave || 4.2.97.220 || tajjalātpaścime bhāge daṃḍapāṇiḥ sadāvati || tatprācyavācyuttarasyāṃ tāraḥ kālaḥ śilādajaḥ||221|| liṃgatrayaṃ hṛdabjeyacchraddhayāpī tamarpayet || yaistatra tajjalaṃ pītaṃ kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ ||222|| avimuktasamīpecyoṃ mokṣeśo mokṣabuddhidaḥ || karuṇeśo dayādhāma tadudīcyāṃ samarcayet ||223|| svarṇākṣeśastu tatprācyāṃ jñānadastasya cottare || saubhāgyagaurī saṃpūjyā bahusaubhāgyasaṃpade ||224|| viśveśāddakṣiṇebhāge nikuṃbheśaḥ prayatnataḥ || kṣetrakṣemakaraḥ pūjyastatpaścādvighnanāyakaḥ || 225 || sarvavighnacchidabhyarcyaścaturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ || virūpākṣo nikuṃbheśādvahnau pūjyaḥ susiddhidaḥ || 226 || taddakṣiṇe ca śukreśaḥ putrapautrapravardhanaḥ || tadudīcyāṃ mahāliṃgaṃ devayānīśvarābhidham|| 227 || śukreśādagrataḥ pūjyaḥ kaceśa iti saṃjñitaḥ || śukrakūpamupaspṛśya hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 228 || bhavānīśau namasyau ca śukreśātpaścime śubhau || bhaktapotapradau tau tu nijabhaktasya sarvadā || 229 || alarkeśaḥ samabhyarcyaḥ śukreśātpūrvadiksthitaḥ || madālaseśvarastatra tatpūrve sarvavighnahṛt || 4.2.97.230 || gaṇeśvareśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ param || hatvā laṃkeśvaraṃ vipra raghuṇātha pratiṣṭhitam ||231|| talliṃgasparśanādāśu brahmahāpi viśudhyati || mahāpuṇyapradaṃ cānyattatrārcyaṃ tripurāṃtakam || 232 || dattātreyeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tasya paścimataḥ śubham || tadyāmyāṃ harikeśeśo gokarṇeśastataḥ param || 233 || sarastadagre pāpaghnaṃ tatpaścācca dhruveśvaraḥ || tadagre dhuvakuṃḍaṃ ca pitṛprītikaraṃ param || 234 || taduttarapiśāceśaḥ paiśācya padahārakaḥ || pitrīśastadyamadiśi pitṛkuṃḍaṃ tadagrataḥ || 235 || tatra śrāddhakṛtāṃ puṃsāṃ tuṣyeyuḥ prapitāmahāḥ|| agre dhruveśāttāreśo vaidyanāthaḥ sa eva hi || 236 || tannairṛtyāṃ manoliṃgaṃ vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ param || priyavrateśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ vaidyanāthapurogatam|| 237 || tadyāmyāṃ mucukuṃdeśastatpārśve gautameśvaraḥ || tatpaścimena bhadreśtadyāmyāmṛṣyaśṛṃgiṇaḥ || 238 || brahmeśastatpurastācca parjanyeśastadīśagaḥ || tatprācyāṃ nahuṣeśaśca viśālākṣī ca tatpuraḥ || 239 || viśālākṣīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatraiva kṣetravastidam || jarāsaṃdheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tadyāmyāṃ jvaranāśanam || 4.2.97.240 || tatpurastāddhiraṇyākṣaliṃgaṃ pūjyaṃ hiraṇyadam || tatpaścime gayādhīśastatpratīcyāṃ bhagīrathaḥ || 241 || tadagre ca dilīpeśo brahmeśātpaścime mune || tatra liṃgaṃ sakuṃḍaṃ ca snāturiṣṭaphalapradam || 242 || tatra viśvāvasorliṃgaṃ muṃḍeśastatra pūrvataḥ || taddakṣiṇe vidhīśaśca tadyāmyāṃ vājimedhakaḥ ||243 || daśāśvamedhike snātvā dṛṣṭvā talliṃgamuttamam || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 244 || taduttare mātṛtīrthaṃ snāturjanmabhayāpahṛt || tatra snānaṃ tu yakuryānnārī vā puruṣopi vā || 245 || īpsitaṃ phalamāpnoti mātṛṇāṃ ca prasādataḥ || dakṣiṇe tava kuṃḍācca puṣpadaṃteśvaraḥ paraḥ || 246 || tadagnidiśi devarṣi gaṇa liṃgānyanekaśaḥ || puṣpadaṃtāddakṣiṇataḥ siddhīśaḥ parasiddhidaḥ || 247 || paṃcopacārapūjātaḥ svapne siddhiṃ parāṃ diśet || rājyaprāptirbhavetpuṃsāṃ hariścaṃdreśasevayā || 248 || tatpaścime nairṛteśoṃgiraseśastato yame || taddakṣiṇe ca kṣemeśaścitrāṃgeśastato yame || 249 || taddakṣiṇe ca kedāro rudrānucaratāpradaḥ || caṃdrasūryānvayairbhūpaiḥ kedārāddakṣiṇāpathe || 4.2.97.250 || pratiṣṭhitāni liṃgāni śataśotha sahasraśaḥ || lolārkāddakṣiṇāśāyāṃ sarvāśāpūrakorcitaḥ || 251 || karaṃdhameśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatpratīcyāṃ mahāphalam || tatpaścime mahādurgā mahādurgaprabhaṃjanī || 252 || śuṣkeśvaraṃ ca tadyāmyāṃ śuṣkayā saritārcitam || janakeśastatpratīcyāṃ śaṃkukarṇastaduttare || 253 || mahāsiddhīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tatprācyāṃ sarvasiddhidam || siddhakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā siddheśvaraṃ mahat || 254 || sarvāsāmeva siddhīnāṃ pāraṃ gacchati mānavaḥ || śaṃkukarṇeśa vāyavye liṃgaṃ vāḍavyasaṃjñitam || 255 || tadagre ca vibhāṃḍeśaḥ kaholeśastaduttare || tatra dvāreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ devī dvāreśvarī śubhā || 256 || tatpūjanādbhavetsiddhirānaṃdāraṇya vastidā || rakṣakāśca gaṇāstatra nānārūpāyudhā mune || 257 || tatraiva haridīśaṃ ca liṃgaṃ kātyāyanaṃ tataḥ || tatpārśve jāṃgaleśaśca tatpaścānmukuṭeśvaraḥ || 258 || tatraiva kuṃḍaṃ vimalaṃ sarvayātrāphalapradam || snātvā mukuṭakuṃḍe ca dṛṣṭvā vai mukuṭeśvaram || 259 || yātrayā sarva liṃgānāṃ yatphalaṃ tadavāpyate || tapasaścāpi yogasya siddhidā sā'vanīparā ||4.2.97.260|| mune śataṃ sahasrāṇi tatra liṃgāni siddhaye || ekā diguttarā devi vārāṇasyāṃ priyā mama || 261 || tatrāpi paṃcāyatane ratirme nitarāṃ priye || utpattisthiti kālepi tatrāhaṃ sarvadā sthitaḥ || 262 || evaṃ yastu vijānāti na sa pāpaiḥ pralipyate || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ trisatyaṃ nānyataḥ priye || 263 || śīghraṃ tatraiva gaṃtavyaṃ yadīcchenmāmakaṃ padam || uddeśamātraṃ ligāni kathitāni mayā mune || 264 || dvistriḥ kṛtvaḥ sthāpitāni bhaktyā liṃgāni kānicit || na tāni punaruktāni śraddhayārcyāni sarvataḥ || 265 || etāni yāni liṃgāni yāni kuṃḍāni yeṃ'dhavaḥ || yā vāpyastāni sarvāṇi śraddheyāni manīṣibhiḥ ||266|| eteṣāṃ darśanātsnānātphalamatrottarottaram|| atratyānāṃ ca liṃgānāṃ kūpānāṃ sarasāmapi ||267|| vāpīnāṃ cāpi mūrtīnāṃ kaḥ saṃkhyātuṃ prabhurbhavet || ānaṃdakānanasthāni tṛṇānyapi paraṃ varam ||268|| divaukasopi nānyatra yatpunarjanmabhājanam|| sarvaliṃgamayī kāśī sarvatīrthekajanmabhūḥ ||269|| svargāpavargayordātrī dṛṣṭā dehāṃtasevitā || mama priyatamā devi tvameva tapaso balāt || 4.2.97.270 || svabhāvatastviyaṃ kāśī sukhaviśrāmabhūrmama || ye kāśyānāma gṛhṇaṃti yenumodaṃta eva hi || 271 || te me śākhaviśākhābhāḥ skaṃdanaṃdigajāsyavat || ta eva bhaktā me devi ta eva mama sevakāḥ ||272|| mumukṣavasta evātra yecānaṃdavanaukasaḥ || tapastaptaṃ mahattaistu kṛtaṃ taistu mahāvratam|| 273 || taiśca dattaṃ mahādānaṃ ye cānaṃdavanaukasaḥ || te snātasarvatīrthā vai tekhilādhvaradīkṣitāḥ || 274 || te cīrṇasarvadharmāhi ye cānaṃdavanaukasaḥ || surāsuroraganarā bhūmibhārāyate'khilāḥ || vayasyapīha carame yenānaṃdavanaukasaḥ || 275 || aṃtyajopi varaḥ kāśyāṃ nānyatra śrutipāragaḥ || saṃsārapāragaḥ pūrvastvaṃtyaścāṃtyajatopyadhaḥ || 276 || sa eva nūnaṃ sarvajñaḥ sa eva hyadhikekṣaṇaḥ || yaḥ pārthivīṃ tanuṃ hitvā kāśyāṃ dhatte sudhāmayīm ||277|| śrutvādhyāyamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtharahasyavat || kāśīdarśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti niyataṃ naraḥ||278|| yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ prātaḥ prātardinedine || dṛṣṭāni tena sarvāṇi tīrthānyetāni nānyathā || 279 || sarvaliṃgamayādhyāyaṃ yo'muṃ nityaṃ japetsudhīḥ || na taṃ yamo na taṃ dūtā nainamaṃhopi bādhate || 4.2.97.280 || brahmayajñaphalaṃ tasya jāyate sukṛtātmanaḥ || yo japedamumadhyāyaṃ śucistadgatamānasaḥ || 281 || sa snātaḥ sarvakuṃḍeṣu sarvavāpyaṃbupaḥ sa ca || sarvaliṃgārcakaḥ sotra yo'mumadhyāyamājapet||282|| kimanyairbahubhiḥ stotrairatistokaphalapradaiḥ || matpremavadbhiradhyāyo japtavyoyaṃ mahāphala||283|| mahādāneṣu datteṣu yatphalaṃ prāpyate'tra vai || sakṛjjapānmahādhyāyādamuṣmāttatsamāpyate || 284 || snātvā sarvāṇi tīrthāni dṛṣṭvā liṃgānyanekaśaḥ || yatphalaṃ labhyate martyaistadetajjapanāddhruvam || 285 || idameva tapotyugramayameva japo mahān || kāśīliṃgāvalī nāmādhyāyo japyeta yanmune || 286 || mama druhe nāstikāya vedaniṃdāratāya ca|| na dātavyo na dātavyo na dātavyo japastvayam || 287 || adhyāyasyāsya japanātpāpaṃ brahmavadhodbhavam || agamyāgamanaṃ cāpi tathābhakṣasyabhakṣaṇam || 288 || gurudārābhicārotthaṃ hemasteyasamudbhavam || mātāpitṛvadhājjātaṃ gobhrūṇahananodbhavam || 289 || mahāpāpāni pāpāni jñātājñātāni bhūriśaḥ || upapāpāni pāpāni manovākkāyajānyapi || 4.2.97.290 || vilayaṃ yāṃtyaśeṣāṇi niḥsaṃdehaṃ mamājñayā || putrānpautrāndhanaṃ dhānyaṃ kalatraṃ kṣetrameva ca||291|| manaḥsamīhitaṃ sarvaṃ svargaṃ mokṣasukhānyapi || japtvādhyāyamimaṃ vidvānprāpsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ||292|| iti yāvatsamākhyāti devo devīpuraḥ kathām || tāvannaṃdīsamāgatya praṇamyeti vyajijñapat|| 293 || jātā parisamāptiśca mahāprāsādanirmiteḥ || sajjīkṛto rathaścāyaṃ brahmādyā militāḥ surāḥ || 294 || tārkṣyagaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣo dvāri tiṣṭhati sānugaḥ || pratīkṣamāṇo'vasaraṃ puraskṛtya munīśvarān|| 295 || caturdaśasu lokeṣu ye ye tiṣṭhaṃti suvratāḥ || te niśamyādyamilitāḥ prāveśika mahotsavam || 296 || || skaṃda uvāca || || iti naṃdivacaḥ śrutvā devo devī samāyutaḥ || divyaṃ rathaṃ samāruhya nirjagāma triviṣṭapāt || 297 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe kṣetratīrthavarṇanaṃ nāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 97||
<4.2.98>
|| vyāsa uvāca|| || śṛṇu sūta mahābhāga yathā skaṃdena bhāṣitaḥ|| mahāmahotsavaḥ śaṃbhoḥ pṛcchate kuṃbhasaṃbhave || 1 || || skaṃda uvāca || || niśāmaya mahāprājña śaṃbhu prāveśikīṃ kathām || trailokyānaṃdajananīṃ mahāpātakataṃkinīm || 2 || maṃdarādāgataḥ śaṃbhuścaitre damanaparvaṇi || prāpyāpyānaṃdagahanamitaścetaścacāra ha || 3 || mokṣalakṣmīvilāsetha prāsāde siddhimāgate || devo virajasaḥ pīṭhādaṃtargehaṃ viveśa ha || 4 || ūrjaśuklapratipadi budharādhāsamāyuji || caṃdre saptamarāśisthe śeṣeṣūccagraheṣu ca || 5 || vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu prasannāsu haritsu ca || brāhmaṇānāṃ śrutirava nyakkṛtānyaravāṃtare || 6 || pratiśabdita bhūrloka bhuvarlokāṃtarādhvani || sarvaṃ pramuditaṃ cāsīcchaṃbhoḥ prāveśikotsave || 7 || jagurgaṃdharvanikarā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || 28 || cāraṇāstu stutiṃ kuryurjarhṛṣurdevatāgaṇāḥ ||8|| vavurgaṃdhavahā vātā vavṛṣuḥ kusumairghanāḥ || sarve maṃgalanepathyāḥ sarve maṃgalabhāṣiṇaḥ ||9|| sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ sarve jātā ānaṃdamedurāḥ|| surāsureṣu sarveṣu gaṃdharveṣūrageṣu ca || 4.2.98.10 || vidyādhareṣu sādhyeṣu kinnareṣu nareṣu ca || strīpuṃjāteṣu sarveṣu rejuścatvāra eva ca || 11 || niṣpratyūhaṃ ca nitarāṃ puruṣārthāḥ padepade || dhūpadhūmabharairvyoma yadraktaṃ tu tadā mune || 12 || nādyāpi nīlimānaṃtaṃ parityajati karhicit || nīrājanāya ye dīpāstadā sarve prabodhitāḥ || 13 || teṣāṃ jyotīṃṣi khedyāpi rājaṃte tārakācchalāt || pratisaudhaṃ patākāśca nānākārā vicitritāḥ || 14 || ramyadhvajaprabhādhautā rejuḥ prati śivālayam || kvacidgāyaṃti gītajñāḥ kvacinnṛtyaṃti nartakāḥ || 15 || caturvidhāni vādyāni vādyaṃte ca kvacitkvacit || pratyadhvaṃ caṃdanarasacchaṭā picchilabhūmayaḥ || 16 || harita śveta māṃjiṣṭha nīla pīta bahuprabhāḥ || pratyaṃgaṇaṃ śubhākārā raṃgamālāścakāśire || 17 || ratnakuṭṭimabhūbhāgā gopurāgreṣu rejire || sudhojjvalā harmyamālāḥ saudhanāmaprapedire ||18|| acetanānyapi tadā cetanānīva saṃbabhuḥ || yāni kānīha kīrtyaṃte maṃgalāni ghaṭodbhava || 19|| teṣāmeva hi sarveṣāṃ tattu janmadivābhavat || āgatya devadevotha muktimaṃḍapamāviśat || 4.2.98.20 || athābhiṣiktaścaturānanena maharṣivṛṃdaiḥ saha devadevaḥ || śubhāsanasthaḥ sahito bhavānyā kumāravṛṃdaiḥ parito vṛtaśca|| || 21 || ratnairasaṃkhyairbahubhirdukūlairmālyairvicitrairlasadiṣṭagaṃdhaiḥ || apūpujandevagaṇā maheśaṃ tadā mudāte ca mahoragreṃdrāḥ || 22 || ratnākaraiścāpi girīṃdravyairyathā svamanyairapi puṇyadhībhiḥ || saṃpūjitaḥ kuṃbhaja tatra śaṃbhurnīrājito mātṛgaṇairatheśaḥ ||23|| saṃtoṣya sarvānprathamaṃ munīṃdrānsvaisvairhṛdisthaiśca cirābhilāṣaiḥ || brahmāṇamābhāṣya śivotha viṣṇuṃ jagāda sarvāmaravṛṃdavaṃdyaḥ || 24 || ito niṣīdeti samānapūrvaṃ tvaṃ me samastaprabhutaikahetuḥ || dūrepi tiṣṭhannikaṭastvameva tvatto na kaścinmama kāryakartā || 25 || tvayā divodāsa nareṃdravaryaḥ sadūpadeśaiśca tathopadiṣṭaḥ || yathā sa siddhiṃ paramāmavāpa samīhitaṃ me nikhilaṃ ca siddham || 26 || viṣṇo varaṃ brūhi ya īpsitaste nādeyamatrāsti kimapyaho te|| idaṃ mayā''naṃdavanaṃ yadāptaṃ hetustu tatratvamasau gaṇeśaḥ || 27 || na me priyaṃ kiṃcana viṣṭapatraye tathā yatheyaṃ parasaukhyabhūmiḥ || vārāṇasī brahmarasāyanasya khanirjaniryatra na dīrghaśāyinām || 28 || śrutveti vākyaṃ jagadīśituśca provāca viṣṇurvaradaṃ maheśam || yadi prasannosi pinākapāṇe tadā padāddūramahaṃ na te syām || 29 || śrutveti vākyaṃ madhusūdanasya jagāda tuṣṭo nitarāṃ purāriḥ || sadā murāre mama sannidhau tvaṃ tiṣṭhasva nirvāṇaramāśrayetra || 4.2.98.30 || ādāvanārādhya bhavaṃtamatra yo māṃ bhajiṣyatyapi bhaktiyuktaḥ || samīhitaṃ tasya na setsyati dhruvaṃ parātparānmeṃbuja cakrapāṇe ||31 || sarvatra saukhyaṃ mama muktimaṃḍape saṃtiṣṭhamānasya bhavedihācyuta || na tattu kailāsagirau sunirmale na bhaktacetasyapi niścalaśriyi || 32 || nimeṣamātraṃ sthiracittavṛttayastiṣṭhaṃti ye dakṣiṇamaṃḍapetra me || ananyabhāvā api gāḍhamānasā na te punargarbhadaśāmupāsate || 33 || saṃsnāya ye cakrasarasyagādhe samastatīrthaika śirovibhūṣaṇe || kṣaṇaṃ viśaṃtīha nirīhamānasā nirenasaste mama pārṣadā hi || 34 || smaraṃti ye māmapavargamaṃḍape kiṃcidyathāśakti dadatyapi svam || śṛṇvaṃti puṇyāśca kathāḥ kṣaṇaṃ sthirāste koṭigodānaphalaṃ bhajaṃti || 35 || upeṃdrataptāni tapāṃsi taiściraṃ snātā hi te cākhilatīrthasārthakaiḥ || snātveha ye vai maṇikarṇikā hrade samāsate muktijanāśrayekṣaṇam || 36 || tīrthāni saṃtīha padepade hare tulā kva teṣāṃ maṇikarṇikāyāḥ || katīhano saṃti śubhāśca maṃḍapāḥ paraṃparomuktiramāśrayoyam || 37 || kaivalyamaṃḍapasyāsya bhaviṣye dvāpare hare || loke khyātirbhavitrīyameṣa kukkuṭamaṃḍapaḥ || 38 || || hariruvāca || || bhālanetrasamākhyāhi kathaṃ nirvāṇamaṃḍapaḥ || tathā khyātimasau gaṃtā yathā devena bhāṣitam || 39 || || devadeva uvāca || || mahānaṃdo dvijo nāma bhaviṣyotra caturbhuja || agravedīsamācārastyaktatīrthapratigrahaḥ || 4.2.98.40 || adāṃbhiko'krūramanāḥ sadaivātithivallabhaḥ || atha yauvanamāsādya pitaryuparate sa hi || 41 || viṣameṣu śaraistīvraiḥ kāritastvapade padam || jahāra kasyacidbhāryā maitrīṃ kṛtvā tu tena vai || 42 || tayā ca prerito'peyaṃ papau cāpi vimohitaḥ || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇarucirabhūnmadanamohitaḥ ||43|| vaiṣṇavāndhanino dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaveṣabhṛt || śaivānniṃdati mūḍhātmā narakatrāṇakāraṇam ||44|| śivabhaktānsamālokya kiṃcicca pariditsukān || garhayedvaiṣṇavānsarvāñśaivaliṃgopajīvakaḥ || 45 || iti pākhaṃḍadharmajñaḥ saṃdhyāsnānaparāṅmukhaḥ || viśālatilakaḥ sragvī śuddhadhautāṃbarojvalaḥ || 46. || 27 || śikhī copagrahakaraḥ sarvebhyo'satpratigrahī|| tasyāpatyadvayaṃ jātamunmattapathavartinaḥ || 47 || evaṃ tasya pravṛttasya kaścitparvatadeśataḥ || samāgamiṣyati dhanī tīrthayātrārthasiddhaye || 48 || snātvā sa cakrasarasi kathayiṣyati ceti vai || ahamasti dhanoditsurjātyā cāṃḍālasattamaḥ ||49|| asti kaścitpratigrāhī yasmai dadyāmahaṃ dhanam || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kaiściccāṃgulisaṃjñayā ||4.2.98.50|| uddiṣṭa upaviṣṭosau yo japeddhyānamudrayā || eṣa pratigrahaṃ tvatto grahīṣyati na cetaraḥ ||51|| iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā sa gatvā tatsamīpataḥ || daṃḍavatpraṇipatyātha taṃ babhāṣe tadāṃtyajaḥ ||52|| māmuddhara mahāvipra tīrthaṃ me saphalīkuru || kiṃcidvastvasti me tattvaṃ gṛhāṇānugrahaṃ kuru || 53 || athākṣamālikāṃ karṇe kṛtvā dhyānaṃ visṛjya ca || kiyaddhanaṃ tavāstīha papraccha karasaṃjñayā || 54 || tasya saṃjñāṃ sa vai buddhvā provācāti prahṛṣṭavat || saṃtṛptiryāvatā te syāttāvaddāsyāmi nānyathā || 55 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tyaktvā maunamuvāca ha || sānaṃdaḥ sa mahānaṃdo niḥspṛhosmi pratigrahe || 56 || paraṃ te'nugrahārthaṃ tu kariṣyāmi pratigraham || kiṃca me vacanaṃ tvaṃ cetkariṣyasyuttamottama ||57|| yāvadastyakhilaṃ vittaṃ tanmadhye nyasya kasyacit || na stokamapi dātavyaṃ tadā''dāsyāmi nānyathā ||58|| || cāṃḍāla uvāca || || yāvadasti mayānītaṃ viśveśaprītaye vasu|| tāvattubhyaṃ pradāsyāmi viśveśastvaṃ yato mama||59|| ye vasaṃtīha viśveśa rājadhānyāṃ
