dvijottama || kṣudrākṣudrā jaṃtumātrā viśveśāṃ śāsta eva hi||4.2.98.60|| paroddharaṇaśīlā ye ye parecchāprapūrakāḥ || paropakṛtiśīlā ye viśveśāṃ śāsta eva hi || 61 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahṛṣṭeṃdriyamānasaḥ || uvāca pārvatīyaṃ taṃ so'grajanmāṃtyajaṃ tadā || 62 || āyāhi darbhānādehi kurūtsargaṃ tvarānvitaḥ || tatheti sa cakārāśu pārvatīyo mahāmanāḥ || 33 || viśveśaḥ prīyatāṃ ceti procya yāto yathāgataḥ || sa ca dvijo dvijairanyairdhikkṛtopi vasanniha || 64 || bahirnirgatamātrastu bahubhiḥ paribhūyate || cāṃḍālabrāhmaṇaścaiṣa cāṃḍālātta dhanastvasau || 65 || asāveva hi cāṃḍālaḥ sarvalokabahiṣkṛtaḥ || itthaṃ tamanudhāvaṃti thūtkurvaṃtaḥ parito hare || 66 || sa ca tadbhayato gehātkākabhītadivāṃdhavat || na niḥsaretkvacidapi lajjākṛti natāsyakaḥ||67|| sa ekadā saṃpradhārya gṛhiṇyā lokadūṣitaḥ || jagāma kīkaṭāndeśāṃstyaktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm ||68|| madhye mārgaṃ sa gacchanvai lakṣitastu sakāṃcanaḥ || api kārpaṭikāṃtasthaḥ sa ruddho mārgarodhibhiḥ||69|| nītvā te tamaraṇyānīṃ taskarāḥ saparicchadam|| ulluṃṭhya dhanamādāya samālocya parasparam||4.2.98.70|| procurbhūridhanaṃ caitajjīryatyasminna jīvati || asau dhanī prayatnena vadhyaḥ saparicārakaḥ || 71 || saṃpradhāryeti teprāhuḥ smartavyaṃ smara pāṃthika || tvāṃ vayaṃ ghātayiṣyāmo niścitaṃ saparicchadam || 72 || niśamyeti manasyeva kathayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ || aho pratigṛhītaṃ me yadarthaṃ vasu bhūriśaḥ || 73 || kuṭuṃbamapi tannaṣṭaṃ naṣṭaścāpi pratigrahaḥ || jīvitaṃ cāpi me naṣṭaṃ naṣṭā kāśīpurīsthitiḥ || 74 || yugapatsarvamevāśu naṣṭaṃ durbuddhiceṣṭayā || na kāśyāṃ maraṇaṃ prāptaṃ tasmādduṣṭapratigrahāt || 75 || prāṃte kuṭuṃbasmaraṇāttathākāśīsmṛterapi || corairhatopi sa tadā kīkaṭe kukkuṭo'bhavat ||76|| sā kukkuṭī sutau tau tu tāmracūḍatvamāpatuḥ || prāṃte kāśīsmaraṇato jātā jātismṛtiḥ parā || 77 || itthaṃ bahutithekāle gate kārpaṭikottamāḥ || tasminnevādhvani prāptāścatvāro yatra kukkuṭāḥ ||78|| vārāṇasyāḥ kathāṃ proccaiḥ kurvaṃto'nyonyameva hi || kāśīkathāṃ samākarṇya tadā te caraṇāyudhāḥ || 79 || jātismṛtiprabhāveṇa tatsaṃgena tu nirgatāḥ || taiśca kārpaṭikaśreṣṭheḥ pathi dṛṣṭvā kṛpālubhiḥ || 4.2.98.80 || taṃdulādiparikṣepaiḥ prāpitāḥ kṣetramuttamam || te tu kṣetraṃ samāsādya catvāraścaraṇāyudhāḥ || 81 || cariṣyaṃto'tra parito muktimaṃḍapamuttamam || jitāhārānsaniyamānkāmakrodhaparāṅmukhān || 82 || prahāsānmatkathālāpām̐llābhamohavivarjitān || svardhunīsnānasaṃklinna sunirmalaśiroruhān || 93 || mannāmoccāraṇaparānmatkathārpitasuśrutīn || maddattacittasadvṛttīndṛṣṭvā kṣetranivāsinaḥ ||84 || mānayāmāsuratha tānkukkuṭānsādhuvartmanaḥ || prāktanāṃ vāsanāyogātsaṃpradhārya parasparam || krameṇāhāramākuṃcya prāṇāṃstyakṣyaṃti cātra vai || 85 || paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ viṣṇo te madanugrahāt || vimānamadhiruhyāśu kailāsaṃ prāpya matpadam ||86|| nirviśya suciraṃ kālaṃ divyānbhogānanuttamān || tato'tra jñānino bhūtvā muktiṃ prāpsyaṃti śāśvatīm || 87 || tato lokāstadadārabhya kathayiṣyaṃti sarvataḥ || muktimaṃḍapanāmaitadeṣa kukkuṭamaṃḍapaḥ || 88 || caritramapi vai teṣāṃ ye smariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || muktimaṃḍapamāsādya śreyaḥ prāpsyaṃti tepi hi || 89 || iti yāvatkathāṃ śaṃbhurbhaviṣyāmagrato hareḥ || akarottumulo nādo ghaṃṭānāṃ tāvadudgataḥ || 4.2.98.90 || athanaṃdinamāhūya devadeva umādhavaḥ || provāca naṃdinvijñāyāgatya brūhi kuto ravaḥ ||91|| atha naṃdī samāgatya provāca vṛṣabhadhvajam|| namaskṛtya prahṛṣṭāsyaḥ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ || 92 || || naṃdyuvāca || || devadeva trinayana kimapūrvaṃ bravīmi te || mokṣalakṣmīvilāso'tra kaiścitkaiścitsamarcyate||93|| atha smitvābravīcchaṃbhuḥ siddhaṃ nastu samīhitam || utthāya devadeveśaḥ saha devyā sumaṃgalaḥ||94|| brahmaṇā hariṇā sārdhaṃ tato'gādraṃgamaṃḍapam || || skaṃda uvāca || || śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ paramānaṃdakāraṇam || naraḥ parāṃ mudaṃ prāpya kailāsaṃ prāpsyati dhruvam || 95 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe muktimaṃḍapagamanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 98 ||
<4.2.99>
|| vyāsa uvāca || śṛṇu sūta yathā proktaṃ kuṃbhaje śarajanmanā || devadevasya caritaṃ viśveśasya parātmanaḥ || 1 || agastya uvāca || senānīḥ kathaya tvaṃ me tato nirvāṇamaṃḍapāt || nirgatya devo deveṃdraiḥ sahitaḥ kiṃ cakāra ha|| 2 || skaṃda uvāca || muktimaṃḍapataḥ śaṃbhurbrahmaviṣṇupurogamaḥ || śṛṃgāramaṃḍapaṃ prāpya yaccakāra vadāmi tat || 3 || prāṅmukhastūpaviśyeśaḥ sahāsmābhiḥ saheśayā || brahmaṇādhiṣṭhitaḥ savye vāmapārśvetha śārṅgiṇā || 4 || vījyamāno maheṃdreṇa ṛṣibhiḥ parito vṛtaḥ || gaṇaiḥ pṛṣṭhapradeśasthairjoṣaṃ tiṣṭhadbhirādarāt || 5|| udāyudhaiḥ sevyamānaścāvasanmānabhūribhiḥ || brahmaṇe viṣṇave śaṃbhuḥ pāṇimutkṣipya dakṣiṇam || 6 || darśayāmāsa deveśo liṃgaṃ paśyata paśyata || idameva paraṃ jyotiridameva parātparam || || 7 || idameva hi me rūpaṃ sthāvaraṃ cāti siddhidam || ete pāśupatā siddhā ābāla brahmacāriṇaḥ || 8 || jiteṃdriyāstaponiṣṭhāḥ paṃcārthajñānanirmalāḥ || bhasmakūṭaśayā dātāḥ suśīlā ūrdhvaretasaḥ ||9 || liṃgārcanaratā nityamananyeṃdriyamānasāḥ || sadaiva vāruṇāgneya snānadvaya sunirmalāḥ || 4.2.99.10 || kaṃdamūlaphalāhārāḥ paratattvārpitekṣaṇāḥ || satyavaṃto jitakrodhā nirmohā niṣparigrahāḥ || 11 || nirīhā niṣprapaṃcāśca nirātaṃkā nirāmayāḥ || nirbhagā nirupāyāśca niḥsaṃgā nirmalāśayāḥ || 12 || nistīrṇodagrasaṃsārā nirvikalpā nirenasaḥ || nirdvaṃdvā niścitārthāśca nirahaṃkāravṛttayaḥ || 13 || sadaiva me mahāprītā matputrā matsvarūpiṇaḥ || ete pūjyā namasyāśca madbuddhyāmatparāyaṇaiḥ || 14 || arciteṣveṣvahaṃ prīto bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || asminvaiśveśvare kṣetre saṃbhojyāḥ śivayoginaḥ || 15 || koṭibhojyaphalaṃ samyagekaika parisaṃkhyayā || ayaṃ viśveśvaraḥ sākṣātsthāvarātmā jagatprabhuḥ || 16 || sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ kartā bhaktijuṣāmiha || ahaṃ kadāciddṛśyaḥ syāmadṛśyaḥ syāṃ kadācana || 17 || ānaṃdakānane cātra svairaṃ tiṣṭhāmi devatāḥ || anugrahāya sarveṣāṃ bhaktānāmiha sarvadā || 18 || sthāsyāmi liṃgarūpeṇa ciṃtitārthaphalapradaḥ || svayaṃbhūnyasvayaṃbhūni yāni liṃgāni sarvataḥ || tāni sarvāṇi cāyāṃti draṣṭuṃ liṃgamidaṃ sadā || 19 || ahaṃ sarveṣu liṃgeṣu tiṣṭhāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ || paraṃ tviyaṃ parāmūrtirmama liṃgasvarūpiṇī || 4.2.99.20 || yena liṃgamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śraddhayā śuddhacakṣuṣā || sākṣātkāreṇa tenāhaṃ dṛṣṭa eva divaukasaḥ || 21 || śravaṇādasya liṃgasya pātakaṃ janmasaṃcitam || kṣaṇātkṣayati śṛṇvaṃtu devā ṛṣigaṇaiḥ saha || 22 || smaraṇādasya liṃgasya pāpaṃ janmadvayārjitam || avaśyaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ mama vākyānna saṃśayaḥ ||23 || etalliṃgaṃ samuddiśya gṛhānniṣkramaṇakṣaṇāt || vilīyate mahāpāpamapi janmatrayārjitam ||24|| darśanādasya liṃgasya hayamedhaśatodbhavam || puṇyaṃ labheta niyataṃ mamānugrahatomarāḥ ||25|| svayaṃbhuvosya liṃgasya mama viśveśituḥ surāḥ || rājasūyasahasrasya phalaṃ syātsparśamātrataḥ||26|| puṣpamātra pradānācca culukodakapūvarkam || śatasauvarṇikaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate bhaktiyogataḥ ||27|| pūjāmātraṃ vidhāyāsya liṃgarājasya bhaktitaḥ || sahasrahemakamalapūjāphalamavāpyate || 28 || vidhāya mahatī pūjāṃ paṃcāmṛtapuraḥsarām || asya liṃgasya labhate puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam || 29 || vastrapūtajalairliṃgaṃ snāpayitvā mamāmarāḥ || lakṣāśvamedhajanitaṃ puṇyamāpnoti sattamaḥ || 4.2.99.30 || sugaṃdhacaṃdanarasairliṃgamālipya bhaktitaḥ || ālipyate surastrībhiḥ sugaṃdhairyakṣakardamaiḥ || 31 || sāmoda dhūpadānaiśca divyagaṃdhāśrayo bhavet || ghṛtadīpaprabodhaiśca jyotīrūpa vimānagaḥ || 32 || karpūravartidīpena sakṛddattena bhaktitaḥ|| karpūradehagauraśrīrbhavedbhālavilocanaḥ || 33 || dattvā naivedyamātraṃ tu sikthesikthe yugaṃyugam || kailāsādrau vaseddhīmānmahābhogasamanvitaḥ || 34 || viśveśe paramānnaṃ yo dadyātsājya saśarkaram || trailokyaṃ tarpitaṃ tena sadevapitṛmānavam|| 35 || mukhavāsaṃ tu yo dadyāddarpaṇaṃ cārucāmaram || ullocaṃ sukhaparyaṃkaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat || 36 || saṃkhyā sāgararatnānāṃ kathaṃcitkartumiṣyate || mukhavāsādidānasya kaḥ saṃkhyāmatra kārayet || 37 || pūjopakaraṇadravyaṃ yo ghaṃṭā gaḍukādikam || bhaktyā me bhavane dadyātsa vasedatra meṃtike || 38 || yo gītavādyanṛtyānāmekaṃ matprītaye vyadhāt || tasyāgrato divārātraṃ bhavettauryatrikaṃ mahat || 39 || citralekhanakarmādi prāsāde me'tra kārayet || yaḥ sacitrānmahābhogānbhuṃkte matpurataḥ sthitaḥ ||4.2.99.40|| sakṛdviśveśvaraṃ natvā madhye janmasudhīrnaraḥ || trailokyavaṃditapado jāyate vasudhāpatiḥ|| || 41 || yastu viśvevaraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyanyatrāpi vipadyate || tasya janmāṃtare mokṣo bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 42 || viśveśākhyā tu jihvāgre viśvanāthakathāśrutau || viśveśaśīlanaṃ citte yasya tasya janiḥ kutaḥ || 43 || liṃgaṃ me viśvanāthasya dṛṣṭvā yaścānumodate || sa me gaṇeṣu gaṇyeta mahāpuṇyabalāśritaḥ || 44 || nityaṃ viśveśa viśveśa viśvanātheti yo japet || trisaṃdhyaṃ taṃ sukṛtinaṃ japāmyahamapi dhruvam || 15 || mamāpīdaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sadā pūjyatamaṃ surāḥ .|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjyaṃ devarṣi mānavaiḥ || 46 || yairna viśveśvaro dṛṣṭo yairna viśveśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || kṛtāṃtadūtaiste dṛṣṭāstaiḥ smṛtā garbhavedanā || 47 || yairidaṃ praṇataṃ liṃgaṃ praṇatāste surāsuraiḥ || yasyai kena praṇāmena dikpālapadamalpakam || dikpālapadataḥ pātaḥ pātaḥ śivanaternahi || 48 || śṛṇvaṃtu devarṣigaṇāḥ samastāstathyaṃ bruve tacca paropakṛtyai || na bhūrbhuvaḥ svargamaharjanāṃtarviśveśatulyaṃ kvacidasti liṃgam || 49 || na satyaloke na tapasyaho surā vaikuṃṭhakailāsarasātaleṣu || tīrthaṃ kvacidvai maṇikarṇikāsamaṃ liṃgaṃ ca viśveśvaratulyamanyataḥ || 4.2.99.50 || na viśvanāthasya samaṃ hi liṃgaṃ na tīrthamanyanmaṇikarṇikātaḥ || tapovanaṃ kutracidasti nānyacchubhaṃ mamānaṃdavanena tulyam || 51 || vārāṇasī tīrthamayī samastā yasyāstunāmāpi hi tīrthatīrtham || tatrāpi kācinmama saukhyabhūmirmahāpavitrā maṇikarṇikāsau || 52 || sthānādamuṣmānmamarājasaudhātprācyāṃ manāgīśasamāśritāyām || savyepasavye ca karāḥ krameṇa śatatrayī yāpi śatadvayī ca || 53 || hastāḥ śataṃ paṃca surāpagāyāmudīcyavācyormaṇikarṇikeyam || sārastrilokyāḥ parakośabhūmiryaiḥ sevitā te mama hṛcchayā hi || 54 || asminmamānaṃdavane yadetalliṃgaṃ sudhādhāma sudhāmadhāma || āsapta pātālatalātsvayaṃbhu samutthitaṃ bhaktakṛpāvaśena ||55|| yesmiñjanāḥ kṛtrimabhāvabuddhyā liṃgaṃ bhajiṣyaṃti ca hetuvādaiḥ || teṣāṃ hi daṃḍaḥ para eṣa eva nagarbhavāsādviramaṃti te dhruvam || 56 || yadyaddhitaṃ svasya sadaiva tattalliṃgetra deyaṃ mama bhaktimadbhiḥ || ihāpyamutrāpi na tasya saṃkṣayo yatheha pāpasya kṛtasya pāpibhiḥ || 57 || dūrasthitairapyadhibuddhibhiryairliṃgaṃ samārādhi mamedamatra || mayaiva dattaiḥ śubhavastujātairniḥśreyasaḥ śrīrvasaṃ(?)yetsatastān || 58 || śṛṇuṣva viṣṇo śṛṇu sṛṣṭikartaḥ śṛṇvaṃtu devarṣigaṇāḥ samastāḥ || idaṃ hi liṃgaṃ parasiddhidaṃ satāṃ bhedo manāgatra na matsakāśataḥ || 59 || asminhi liṃge'khilasiddhisādhane samarpitaṃ yaiḥ sukṛtārjitaṃ vasu || tebhyotimātrākhilasaukhyasādhanaṃ dadāmi nirvāṇapadaṃ sunirbhayam || 4.2.99.60 || utkṣipya bāhuṃ tvasakṛdbravīmi trayīmaye'smiṃstrayameva sāram || viśveśa liṃgaṃ maṇikarṇikāṃbu kāśīpurī satyamidaṃ trisatyam || 61 || utthāya devotha sa śaktirīśastasminhi liṃge kṛtacārupūjaḥ || yayau layaṃ te ca surā jayeti jayeti coktvā nunuvustamīśam || 62 || skaṃda uvāca || || kṣetrasya maitrāvaruṇe vimuktasya mahāmate || prabhāvasyaikadeśoyaṃ kathitaḥ kalmaṣāpahaḥ || 63 || tavāgre tu yathābuddhi kāśīviśleṣatāpi naḥ || acireṇaiva kālena kāśīṃ prāpsyasyanuttamām || 64 || astācalasya śikharaṃ prāptavāneṣa bhānumān || tavāpi hi mamāpyeṣa maunasya samayo'bhavat || 65 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śrutveti sa muniḥ sūta saṃdhyopāstyai vinirgataḥ|| praṇamyau meyamasakṛllopāmudrā samanvitaḥ || 66 || rahasyaṃ parivijñāya kṣetrasya śaśimaulinaḥ || agastyo niścitamanāḥ śivadhyānaparobhavat || 67 || ānaṃdakānanasyeha mahimānaṃ mahattaram || kotra varṇayituṃ śaktaḥ sūta varṣaśatairapi || 68 || yathā devyai samākhyāyi śivena paramātmanā || tathā skaṃdena kathitaṃ māhātmyaṃ kuṃbhasaṃbhave || 69|| tavāgre ca samākhyātaṃ śukādīnāṃ ca sattama || idānīṃ praṣṭukāmosi kiṃ tatpṛccha vadāmi te||4.2.99.70|| śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || samastaciṃtitaphalapradaṃ martyo bhavetkṛtī ||71|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe viśveśvaraliṃgamahimākhyo nāma navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 99 ||
<4.2.100>
|| sūta uvāca || || idaṃ skāṃdamahaṃ śrutvā kāśīkhaṃḍamanuttamam || nitarāṃ paritṛptosmi hṛdi cāpi vidhāritam || 1 || anukramaṇikādhyāyaṃ tathā māhātmyamuttamam || pārāśarya samācakṣva yathāpūrvamidaṃ bhavet|| 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || sūtāvadhehi dharmātmañjātūkarṇya niśāmaya || śukavaiśaṃpāyanādyāḥ śṛṇvaṃtvapi ca bālakāḥ || 3 || anukramaṇikādhyāyaṃ māhātmyaṃ cāpi khaṃḍajam || pravakṣyāmyaghanāśāya mahāpuṇyapravardhanam || 4 || viṃdhyanāradasaṃvādaḥ prathame parikīrtitaḥ || satyalokaprabhāvaśca dvitīyaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || 5 || agasterāśramapade devānāmāgamastataḥ || pativratā caritraṃ ca prasthānaṃ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ || 6 || tīrthapraśaṃsā ca tataḥ saptapuryastataḥ smṛtāḥ || saṃyaminyāḥ svarūpaṃ ca bradhnalokastataḥ param || 7 || iṃdrāgnyorlokasaṃprāptistataśca śivaśarmaṇaḥ || agneḥ samudbhavastasmāt kravyādvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ ||8 || gaṃdhavatyalakāpuryorīśayostu samudbhavaḥ || caṃdralokapariprāptiḥ śivaśarmadvijanmanaḥ || 9 || uḍuloka kathā tasmāttataḥ śukrasamudbhavaḥ || māheya gurusaurīṇāṃ lokānāṃ varṇanaṃ tataḥ || 4.2.100.10 || saptarṣīṇāṃ tato lokā dhruvasya ca tapastataḥ || tato dhruvapadaprāptirdhruvaloka sthitistataḥ. || 11 || darśanaṃ satyalokasya tasya vai śivaśarmaṇaḥ || caturbhujābhiṣekaśca nirvāṇaṃ śivaśarmaṇaḥ || 12|| skaṃdāgastyośca saṃvādo maṇikarṇyāḥ samudbhavaḥ || tatastu gaṃgāmāhātmyaṃ tato daśaharāstavaḥ ||13 || prabhāvaścāpi gaṃgāyā gaṃgānāmasahasrakam || vārāṇasyāḥ praśaṃsātha bhairavāvirbhavastataḥ || 14 || daṃḍapāṇeḥ samudbhūtirjñānavāpyudbhavastataḥ || ākhyānaṃ ca kalāvatyāḥ sadācārastataḥ param || 15 || brahmacāri prakaraṇaṃ tataḥ strīlakṣaṇāni ca || kṛtyākṛtyaprakaraṇamavimukteśavarṇanam || 16 || tato gṛhasthadharmāśca tato yoganirūpaṇam || kālajñānaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ divodāsasya varṇanam || 17 || kāśyāśca varṇanaṃ tasmādyoginīvarṇanaṃ tataḥ || lolārkasya samākhyānamuttarārkakathā tataḥ|| || 18|| sāṃbādityasya mahimā drupadāditya śaṃsanam || tatastu garuḍākhyānamaruṇārkādayastataḥ || 19 || daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ maṃdarācca gaṇāgamaḥ || piśācamocanākhyānaṃ gaṇeśapreṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 4.2.100.20 || māyāgaṇapateścātha ḍhuṃḍhiprādurbhavastataḥ || viṣṇumāyāprapaṃcotha divodāsavisarjanam || 21 || tataḥ paṃcanadotpattirbiṃdumādhavasaṃbhavaḥ || tato vaiṣṇavatīrthānāṃ māhātmyaparivarṇanam || 22 || prayāṇaṃ maṃdarātkāśīṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaśūlinaḥ || jaigīṣavyena saṃvādo jyeṣṭhasthāne maheśituḥ ||23 || tataḥ kṣetrarahasyasya kathanaṃ pāpanāśanam || athātaḥ kaṃdukeśasya vyāghreśasya samudbhavaḥ ||24|| tataḥ śaileśvarakathā ratneśasya ca darśanam || kṛttivāsaḥ samutpattistataścāyatanāgamaḥ ||25|| devatānāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ durgāsuraparākramaḥ || durgāyā vijayaścātha tata oṃkāravarṇanam || 26 || punaroṃkāramāhātmyaṃ trilocanasamudbhavaḥ || trilocanaprabhāvotha kedārākhyānameva ca || 27 || tato dharmeśamahimā tataḥ pakṣikathā śubhā || tato viśvabhujākhyānaṃ durdamasya kathā tataḥ || 28 || tato vīreśvarākhyānaṃ vīreśa mahimā punaḥ || gaṃgātīrthaiśca saṃyuktā kāmeśa mahimā tataḥ || 29 || viśvakarmeśa mahimā dakṣayajñasamudbhavaḥ || satyā dehavisargaśca tato dakṣeśvarodbhavaḥ || 4.2.100.30 || tato vai pārvatīśasya mahimnaḥ parikīrtanam || gaṃgeśasyātha mahimā narmadeśasamudbhavaḥ || 31 || satīśvarasamutpattiramṛteśādi vaṇarnam || vyāsasya hi bhujastaṃbho vyāsaśāpavimokṣaṇam || 32 || kṣetratīrthakadaṃbaṃ ca muktimaṃḍapa saṃkathā || viśveśāvirbhavaścātha tato yātrāparikramaḥ || 33 || etadākhyānaśatakaṃ krameṇa parikīrtitam || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvakhaṃḍa śruteḥ phalam || anukramaṇikādhyāyepyasti yātrāparikramaḥ ||34|| || sūta uvāca || yātrā parikramaṃ brūhi janānāṃ hitakāmyayā || yathāvatsiddhikāmānāṃ satyavatyāḥ sutottama || 35 || || vyāsa uvāca|| || niśāmaya mahāprājña lomaharṣaṇa vacmi te || yathā prathamato yātrā kartavyā yātrikairmudā || 36 || sacailamādau saṃsnāya cakrapuṣkariṇījale || saṃtarpyadevāsapitṝnbrāhmaṇāṃśca tathārthinaḥ || 37 || ādityaṃ draupadīṃ viṣṇuṃ daṃḍapāṇiṃ maheśvaram || namaskṛtya tato gaccheddraṣṭuṃ ḍhuṃḍhivināyakam ||38|| jñānavāpīmupaspṛśya naṃdikeśaṃ tatorcayet || tārakeśaṃ tatobhyarcya mahākāleśvaraṃ tataḥ || 39 || tataḥ punardaṃḍapāṇimityeṣā paṃcatīrthikā || 4.2.100.40 || dainaṃdinī vidhātavyā mahāphalamabhīpsubhiḥ || tato vaiśveśvarī yātrā kāryā sarvārtha siddhidā||41 || dvisaptāyatanānāṃ ca kāryā yātrā prayatnataḥ || kṛṣṇāṃ pratipadaṃ prāpya bhūtāvadhi yathāvidhi || 42 || athavā pratibhūtaṃ ca kṣetrasiddhimabhīpsubhiḥ || tattattīrthakṛtasnānastattalliṃgakṛtārcanaḥ ||43|| maunena yātrāṃ kurvāṇaḥ phalaṃ prāpnoti yātrikaḥ|| oṃkāraṃ prathamaṃ paśyenmatsyodaryāṃ kṛtodakaḥ || 44 || triviṣṭapaṃ mahādevaṃ tato vai kṛttivāsasam || ratneśaṃ cātha caṃdreśaṃ kedāraṃ ca tato vrajet ||45|| dharmeśvaraṃ ca vīreśaṃ gacchetkāmeśvaraṃ tataḥ || viśvakarmeśvaraṃ cātha maṇikarṇīśvaraṃ tataḥ || 46 || avimukteśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tato viśveśamarcayet || eṣā yātrā prayatnena kartavyā kṣetravāsinā || 47 || yastu kṣetramuṣitvā tu naitāṃ yātrāṃ samācaret || vighnāstasyopatiṣṭhaṃte kṣetroccāṭanasūcakāḥ || 48 || aṣṭāyatana yātrānyā kartavyā vighraśāṃtaye || dakṣeśaḥ pārvatīśaśca tathā paśupatīśvaraḥ ||49|| gaṃgeśo narmadeśaśca gabhastīśaḥ satīśvaraḥ || aṣṭamastārakeśaśca pratyaṣṭami viśeṣataḥ || 4.2.100.50 || dṛśyānyetāni liṃgāni mahāpāpopaśāṃtaye || aparāpi śubhā yātrā yogakṣemakarī sadā || 51 || sarvavighropahaṃtrī ca kartavyā kṣetravāsibhiḥ || śaileśaṃ prathamaṃ vīkṣya varaṇāsnānapūrvakam || 52 || snānaṃ tu saṃgame kṛtvā draṣṭavyaḥ saṃgameśvaraḥ || svalīna tīrthe susnātaḥ paśyetsvalīnamīśvaram || 53 || snātvā maṃdākinī tīrthe draṣṭavyo madhyameśvaraḥ || paśyeddhiraṇyagarbheśaṃ tatra tīrthe kṛtodakaḥ || 54 || maṇikarṇyāṃ tataḥ snātvā paśyedīśānamīśvaram|| tataḥ kūpamupaspṛśya goprekṣamavalokayet || 55 || kāpileya hrade snātvā vīkṣeta vṛṣabhadhvajam || upaśāṃtaśivaṃ paśyettatkūpavihitodakaḥ || 56 || paṃcacūḍāhrade snātvā jyeṣṭhasthānaṃ tatorcayet || catuḥsamudrakūpe tu snātvā devaṃ samarcayet || 57 || devasyāgre tu yā vāpī tatropasparśane kṛte || śukreśvaraṃ tataḥ paśyettatkūpavihitodakaḥ ||58|| daṃḍakhāte tataḥ snātvā vyāghreśaṃ pūjayettataḥ || śaunakeśvarakuṃḍe tu snānaṃ kṛtvā tatorcayet ||59|| jaṃbukeśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ kṛtvā yātrāmimāṃ naraḥ|| kvacinna jāyate bhūyaḥ saṃsāre duḥkhasāgare ||4.2.100.60|| samārabhya pratipadaṃ yāvatkṛṣṇā caturdaśī || etatkrameṇa kartavyānye tadāyatanāni vai ||61|| imāṃ yātrāṃ naraḥ kṛtvā na bhūyopyabhijāyate || anyā yātrā prakartavyaikā daśāyatanodbhavā ||62 || āgnīdhra kuṃḍe susnātaḥ paśyedāgnīdhramīśvaram || urvaśīśaṃ tato gacchettatastu nakulīśvaram ||63|| āṣāḍhīśaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā bhārabhūteśvaraṃ tataḥ || lāṃgalīśamathālokya tatastu tripurāṃtakam || 64 || tato manaḥprakāmeśaṃ prītikeśamatho vrajet || madālaseśvaraṃ tasmāttilaparṇeśvaraṃ tataḥ || 65 || yātraikādaśaliṃgānāmeṣā kāryā prayatnataḥ|| imāṃ yātrāṃ prakurvāṇo rudratvaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 66|| ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi gārī yātrāmanuttamām|| śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ yā yātrā viṣvagṛddhidā || 67 || goprekṣatīrthe susnāya mukhanirmālikāṃ vrajet || jyeṣṭhāvāpyāṃ naraḥ snātvā jyeṣṭhāgaurīṃ samarcayet ||68|| saubhāgyagaurī saṃpūjyā jñānavāpyāṃ kṛtodakaiḥ|| tataḥ śṛṃgāragaurīṃ ca tatraiva ca kṛtodakaḥ || 69 || snātvā viśālagaṃgāyāṃ viśālākṣīṃ tato vrajet || susnāto lalitātīrthe lalitāmarcayettataḥ ||4.2.100.70|| snātvā bhavānītīrthetha bhavānīṃ paripūjayet || maṃgalā ca tatobhyarcyā biṃdutīrthakṛtodakaiḥ || 71 || tato gacchenmahālakṣmīṃ sthiralakṣmīsamṛddhaye || imāṃ yātrāṃ naraḥ kṛtvā kṣetresminmuktijanmani || 72 || na duḥkhairabhibhūyeta ihāmutrāpi kutracit || kuryātpraticaturthīha yātrāṃ vighneśituḥ sadā || 73 || brāhmaṇebhyastaduddeśāddeyā vai modakā mude || bhaume bhairavayātrā ca kāryā pātakahāriṇī || 74 || ravivāre raveryātrā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāravisaṃyuji || tathaiva ravisaptamyāṃ sarvavighnopaśāṃtaye || 75 || navamyāmathavāṣṭamyāṃ caṃḍīyātrā śubhā matā || aṃtargṛhasya vai yātrā kartavyā prativāsaram || 76 || prātaḥsnānaṃ vidhāyādau natvā paṃcavināyakān || namaskṛtvātha viśveśaṃ sthitvā nirvāṇamaṃḍape || 77 || aṃtargṛhasya yātrā vai kariṣye ghaughaśāṃtaye || gṛhītvā niyamaṃ ceti gatvātha maṇikarṇikām || 78 || snātvā maunena cāgatya maṇikarṇīśamarcayet || kaṃbalāśvatarau natvā vāsukīśaṃ praṇamya ca ||79|| parvateśaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā gaṃgākeśavamapyatha || tatastu lalitāṃ dṛṣṭvā jarāsaṃdheśvaraṃ tataḥ ||4.2.100.80|| tato vai somanāthaṃ ca vārāhaṃ ca tato vrajet || brahmeśvaraṃ tato natvā natvāgastīśvaraṃ tataḥ || 81 || kaśyapeśaṃ namaskṛtya harikeśavanaṃ tataḥ || vaidyanāthaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā dhruveśamatha vīkṣya ca || 82 || gokarṇeśvaramabhyarcya hāṭakeśamatho vrajet || asthikṣepa taḍāge ca dṛṣṭvā vai kīkaseśvaram || 83 || bhārabhūtaṃ tato natvā citregupteśvaraṃ tataḥ || citraghaṃṭāṃ praṇamyātha tataḥ paśupatīśvaram || 84 || pitāmaheśvaraṃ gatvā tatastu kalaśeśvaram || caṃdreśastvatha vīreśo vidyeśognīśa eva ca ||85|| nāgeśvaro hariścaṃdraściṃtāmaṇivināyakaḥ || senāvināyakaścātha draṣṭavyaḥ sarvavighnahṛt || 86 || vasiṣṭhavāmadevau ca mūrtirūpadharāvubhau || draṣṭavyau yatnataḥ kāśyāṃ mahāvighnavināśinau || 87 || sīmāvināyakaṃ cātha karuṇeśaṃ tato vrajet || trisaṃdhyeśo viśālākṣī dharmeśo viśvabāhukā || āśāvināyakaścātha vṛddhādityastataḥ punaḥ || 88 || caturvaktreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ brāhmīśastu tataḥ paraḥ || tato manaḥprakāmeśa īśāneśastataḥ param || 89 || caṃḍīcaṃḍīśvarau dṛśyau bhavānīśaṃkarau tataḥ || ḍhuṃḍhiṃ praṇamya ca tato rājarājeśamarcayet || 4.2.100.90 || lāṃgalīśastatobhyarcyastatastu nakulīśvaraḥ || parānneśamatho natvā paradravyeśvaraṃ tataḥ || 91 || pratigraheśvaraṃ vāpi niṣkalaṃkeśameva ca || mārkaṃḍeyeśamabhyarcya tataścāpsaraseśvaram || 92 || gaṃgeśorcyastato jñānavāpyāṃ snānaṃ samācaret || naṃdikeśaṃ tārakeśaṃ mahākāleśvaraṃ tataḥ || 93 || daṃḍapāṇiṃ maheśaṃ ca mokṣeśaṃ praṇamettataḥ || vīrabhadreśvaraṃ natvā avimukteśvaraṃ tataḥ ||94|| vināyakāṃstataḥ paṃca viśvanāthaṃ tato vrajet ||. tato maunaṃ visṛjyātha maṃtrametamudīrayet || 95 || aṃtargṛhasya yātreyaṃ yathāvadyā mayā kṛtā || nyūnātiriktayā śaṃbhuḥ prīyatāmanayā vibhuḥ ||96|| iti maṃtraṃ samuccārya kṣaṇaṃ vai muktimaṃḍape || viśramya yāyādbhavanaṃ niṣpāpaḥ puṇyavānnaraḥ ||97|| saṃprāpya vāsaraṃ viṣṇorviṣṇutīrtheṣu sarvataḥ || kāryā yātrā prayatnena mahāpuṇya samṛddhaye || 98 || nabhasya paṃcadaśyāṃ ca kulastaṃbhaṃ samarcayet || duḥkhaṃ rudrapiśācatvaṃ na bhavedyasya pūjanāt || 99 || śraddhāpūrvamimā yātrā kartavyāḥ kṣetravāsibhiḥ || parvasvapi viśeṣeṇa kāryā yātrāśca sarvataḥ || 4.2.100.100 || na vaṃdhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryādvināyātrāṃ kvacitkṛtī || yātrādvayaṃ prayatnena kartavyaṃ prativāsaram || 101 || ādau svargataraṃgiṇyāstato viśveśiturdhruvam || yasya vaṃdhyaṃ dinaṃ yātaṃ kāśyāṃ nivasataḥ sataḥ || 102|| nirāśāḥ pitarastasya tasminneva dine'bhavan || sa daṣṭaḥ kālasarpeṇa sa dṛṣṭo mṛtyunā sphuṭam || 103 || sa muṣṭastatra divase viśveśo yatra nekṣitaḥ || sarvatīrtheṣu sasnau sa sarvayātrāṃ vyadhātsa ca || maṇikarṇyāṃ tu yaḥ snāto yo viśveśaṃ niraikṣata ||104|| satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || dṛśyo viśveśvaro nityaṃ snātavyā maṇikarṇikā||105|| || vyāsa uvāca || || sūta skāṃdamidaṃ śrutvā kāśīmāhātmyamuttamam || naro na nirayaṃ yāti kṛtvāpyaghasahasrakam || 106 || snātvā sarvāṇi tīrthāni yacchreyaḥ samupārjyate || kāśīkhaṃḍasya śravaṇāttatsyātsūta na saṃśayaḥ ||107|| dattvā dānāni sarvāṇi kṛtvā yajñānanekaśaḥ || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyastadā tacchravaṇāddhruvam ||108 || taptvā tapāṃsi cogrāṇi prāpyate yanmahatphalam || śravaṇādasya khaṃḍasya labhate tanna saṃśayaḥ || 109 || adhītya caturo vedānsāṃgānyatphalamāpyate || kāśīkhaṃḍaṃ samākarṇya tatphalaṃ labhyate naraiḥ || 4.2.100.110 || gayayāṃ śrāddhadānācca yathā tṛpyaṃti pūrvajāḥ || tathaitacchravaṇānnṛṇāṃ tṛpnuvaṃti pitāmahāḥ || 111 || taiśca sarvapurāṇāni śrutāni sthirabuddhibhiḥ || kāśīkhaṃḍaṃ śrutaṃ yaiśca sarveṣāṃ śreyasāṃ padam || 112 || śrutāśca sarvadharmāstairmahāpuṇyekarāśibhiḥ || śrutaṃ yaiḥ sthiracetobhiḥ kāśīmāhātmyamuttamam||113 || idameva hi devejyā paramā parikīrtitā || japettatkhaṃḍamakhilaṃ śrotavyaṃ śraddhayā dvijāḥ || 114 || śṛṇuyādekamapi ya ākhyānaṃ kāśikhaṃḍajam || śrutāni tena sarvāṇi dharmaśāstrāṇyasaṃśayam || 115 || mahādharmaikajananaṃ mahārthapratipādakam || kāraṇaṃ sarvakāmāpteḥ kāśīkhaṃḍamidaṃ smṛtam || 116 || etacchravaṇataḥ puṃsāṃ kaivalyaṃ naiva dūrataḥ || tuṣyaṃti sarve pitaraḥ śrutvaitatkhaṃḍamuttamam || 117|| prīṇaṃtyamartyāḥ sarvepi brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || munayaḥ parimodaṃte mādyaṃti sanakādayaḥ || 118 || hṛṣṭaḥ sarvo bhavedeva bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ || mahimaśravaṇādasmādvārāṇasyā na saṃśayaḥ || 119 || ya idaṃ śrāvayedvidvānsamastaṃ tvardhameva vā || pādamātraṃ tadardhaṃ vā tvekaṃ vyākhyānamuttamam || 4.2.100.120 || sa namasyaḥ prayatnena saṃpūjyastviṣṭadevavat || tasmai deyaṃ prayatnena viśveśa prītaye sadā || 121 || tasmiṃstuṣṭe hi saṃtuṣṭo viśveśo nātra saṃśayaḥ|| yatraitatpaṭhyate khaṃḍaṃ parānaṃdasamāśrayam || 122 || na tatra prabhavetkaścidamaṃgalasamudbhavaḥ || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādvidvānyaścedaṃ śrāvayetsudhīḥ || 123 || yaḥ paṭhedapi puṇyātmā te sarve rudramūrtayaḥ || ya etatpustakaṃ ramyaṃ lekhayitvā samarpayet || 124 || akhilāni purāṇāni tena dattāni nānyathā || atrākhyānāni yāvaṃti ślokā yāvaṃta eva hi || 125 || tathā padāni yāvaṃti varṇā yāvaṃta eva hi || yāvaṃtyapi ca mātrāṇi yāvaṃtyaḥ padapaṃktayaḥ || 126 || guṇe sūtrāṇi yāvaṃti yāvaṃtaḥ paṭataṃtavaḥ || citrarūpāṇi yāvaṃti ramyapustakasaṃcake || 127 || tāvadyugasahasrāṇi dātā svarge mahīyate || etaddvādaśakṛtvo yaḥ śṛṇuyātkhaṃḍamuttamam || 128 || brahmahatyāpi tasyāśu naśyecchaṃbhoranugrahāt || aputraḥ śṛṇuyādyastu susnātaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ || 129 || tasya putro bhavatyeva śaṃbhorājñā prabhāvataḥ || kiṃ bahūktena sūteha yasya yasya manorathaḥ || 4.2.100.130 || yo yastaṃ taṃ sa sasadā śrutvaitatprāpnuyātkṛtī || śṛṇuyāddūradeśepi yaḥ kāśīkhaṃḍamuttamam || 131 || sa kāśīvāsapuṇyasya bhājanaṃ syācchivājñayā || etacchravaṇataḥ puṃsāṃ sarvatra vijayo bhavet || saubhāgyaṃ cāpi sarvatra prāpnuyānnirmalāśayaḥ || 132 || yasya viśveśvarastuṣṭastasyaitacchravaṇe matiḥ || jāyate puṇyayuktasya mahānirmalacetasaḥ || 133 || sarveṣāṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca mahāmaṃgalamuttamam || gṛhepi likhitaṃ pūjyaṃ sarvamaṃgalasiddhaye ||134|| || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ caturthe kāśīkhaṃḍa uttarārdhe'nukramaṇikānāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 100 || ||7|| || śrīkāśīkhaṇḍottarārdhaṃ sampūrṇam || || samāptaṃ cedaṃ caturthaṃ kāśīkhaṃḍam ||4||
